papers.title: ParVL: Parallel Scaling and Expandable Compute Allocation for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Existing scaling strategies for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically expand either model parameters or sequential inference computation, incurring substantial memory or latency overhead. More importantly, most existing methods fail to alter the rigid, fixed computation allocation between the Vision Transformer and the Large Language Model components, limiting task-specific optimization. To address this, we introduce the Parallel Vision-Language (ParVL) scaling framework for MLLMs, which scales parallel computation by reusing the existing ViT and LLM backbone parameters across multiple vision and language branches. This framework raises a central question: given a fixed backbone parameter budget, how should additional shared-backbone computation be allocated between the vision and language modalities? We instantiate each parallel computational stream with branch-specific prefix parameters over a shared backbone, and train the entire model end-to-end via full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on roughly 13B tokens. We systematically study the computation-allocation trade-off between the ViT encoder and LLM decoder. ParVL improves overall multimodal performance over same-recipe single-branch baselines, and the best evaluated vision--language allocation varies across tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/YangYangGirl/ParVL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 Parallel Vision-Language (ParVL) 缩放框架，通过复用现有 ViT 和 LLM 骨干参数，在多个视觉与语言分支上扩展并行计算，并研究视觉与语言模态间的计算分配权衡。作者用分支特定的 prefix 参数实例化并行计算流，在约 13B token 上进行全参数监督微调，报告称 ParVL 相较同配方单分支基线提升了整体多模态性能，且最优的视觉-语言分配因任务而异。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 缩放策略通常扩展模型参数或顺序推理计算，带来较大内存或延迟开销，且多数方法无法改变 ViT 与 LLM 组件之间固定的计算分配，限制任务特定优化。
Method: 提出 ParVL 框架，在固定骨干参数预算下通过多个共享骨干的视觉/语言分支扩展并行计算；每个并行计算流用分支特定的 prefix 参数实例化，并采用全参数监督微调（约 13B tokens）端到端训练，系统研究 ViT 编码器与 LLM 解码器之间的计算分配权衡。
Result: ParVL 在整体多模态性能上优于同配方单分支基线，且最佳视觉-语言计算分配因任务不同而变化；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调在固定骨干参数预算下，将额外计算在视觉与语言模态间灵活分配是可行的缩放方向，且最优分配具有任务依赖性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, limiting fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon TIR scenarios. On-policy self-distillation offers denser signals through teacher branches with privileged context, but existing approaches typically derive such context from ground-truth answers or retrieved skills, which may not reflect the states actually visited by the agent. Moreover, token-level supervision fails to capture the turn-level structure of tool interactions. To address this, we propose TurnSight, a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework that derives supervision directly from execution-conditioned hindsight. It then constructs multiple hindsight views with different lookahead horizons and selects reliable supervision through cross-horizon directional agreement. Finally, the selected hindsight signal is normalized across sibling rollouts and used to adaptively modulate RL advantages while preserving their original optimization direction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of TurnSight. Our codes are available at https://github.com/quchangle1/TurnSight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TurnSight，一种面向工具集成推理 (Tool-Integrated Reasoning, TIR) 的 turn 级事后自蒸馏框架，用于改进长程工具交互中的细粒度信用分配。该方法从执行条件事后 (execution-conditioned hindsight) 直接构造监督信号，构建不同前瞻视野的多视角并在跨视野方向一致性下筛选可靠监督，再对兄弟 rollouts 归一化后自适应调制 RL 优势。摘要报告在三个基准上的实验验证了有效性，并公开代码。
Motivation: 现有 TIR 的强化学习方法常依赖轨迹级监督，在长程工具交互中难以进行细粒度信用分配；已有的在线自蒸馏方法从真实答案或检索技能中获取特权上下文，未必反映智能体实际访问的状态，且 token 级监督无法捕捉工具交互的 turn 级结构。
Method: 提出 TurnSight：先从执行条件事后推导监督信号，构造多个不同 lookahead 视野的事后视图，通过跨视野方向一致性选择可靠监督；随后将选中的信号在兄弟 rollouts 间归一化，用于自适应地调节 RL advantage，同时保留原始优化方向。
Result: 摘要称在三个基准上的大量实验验证了 TurnSight 的有效性，但未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为 turn 级事后自蒸馏能提供比轨迹级监督更稠密、更贴合智能体实际状态的信号，从而改善 TIR 中的信用分配；局限性与更细分析未在摘要中说明。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems with more inference-time compute. The term "test-time scaling," however, now covers diverse inference algorithms that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, or search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable under a single scalar "budget," or reporting accuracy without the inference protocol that produced it, makes results difficult to compare across studies. We develop a systematic account of test-time scaling along three axes. First, we formalize test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling with terminal reduction, and prefix-level scaling. Second, we treat the evaluated object as the entire inference system and develop evaluation principles that separate end-to-end system performance from candidate-bank diagnostics. We introduce an evaluation profile whose coordinates and simple functionals recover or bound common repeated-sampling metrics, and prescribe protocol-matched reporting of compute and uncertainty. Third, we specify reproducibility requirements for inference protocols, distinguishing exact replay from distributional reproducibility and identifying the artifacts needed to support each. We also organize the open-weight reasoning ecosystem by model-side and interface mechanisms, apply these principles to broad-knowledge, symbolic-reasoning, and competition-mathematics benchmarks, and assemble over 2 billion full reasoning traces for release with progressively richer verifier and token-level signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推理大语言模型（reasoning LLMs）中测试时扩展（test-time scaling）这一概念被泛化使用的问题，提出系统性的分析框架：把测试时扩展形式化为自回归模型隐式前缀树上的预算推理（budgeted inference），区分单轨迹顺序扩展、叶级扩展和前缀级扩展三种结构模态，并给出评估原则与可复现性要求。作者还按模型侧与接口机制梳理了开放权重推理生态，在知识、符号推理和竞赛数学基准上应用这些原则，并组装了超过 20 亿条完整推理轨迹供发布。
Motivation: 现有研究把多样化的推理算法（单轨迹延展、采样后投票/验证、对未完成部分状态搜索）混在同一标量预算下，或只报告准确率而不说明推理协议，导致跨研究结果难以比较。
Method: 从三个轴展开：一是把测试时扩展形式化为前缀树上的预算推理并区分三种结构模态；二是把被评估对象视为整个推理系统，提出将端到端系统性能与候选库诊断分离的评估原则，并引入坐标与简单泛函可恢复或界定常用重复采样指标的评估画像，要求协议匹配的计算量与不确定性报告；三是区分精确重放与分布可复现性，明确各自所需的工件。
Result: 摘要报告将上述原则应用于广博知识、符号推理和竞赛数学等基准，并组装超过 20 亿条完整推理轨迹，伴随逐步丰富的验证器与 token 级信号供发布。
Conclusion: 作者强调应将不同推理算法按结构统计特性区分对待，并以协议匹配方式报告计算量与不确定性，否则测试时扩展的结果难以跨研究复现和比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Perceptual Anchoring: Prototype-Guided Text Calibration for Training-free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) partitions an image into semantically distinct regions based on arbitrary text descriptions, without learning any additional parameters. However, existing methods typically focus on improving visual representations while treating text embeddings that encode only generic category concepts as fixed classification references. The resulting semantic gap between these generic concepts and the visual representations that capture the specific appearances of target instances often causes incomplete masks and erroneous predictions in non-target regions. Inspired by the symbol-percept correspondence underlying perceptual anchoring, we propose Prototype-Guided Text Calibration (PTC) for training-free OVSS. In the Perceiving stage, PTC selects reliable visual evidence based on initial matching scores to construct category-specific visual prototypes. In the Anchoring stage, PTC uses these prototypes to calibrate their corresponding text embeddings, with the calibration strength adaptively adjusted based on the amount of visual evidence. Consequently, the calibrated text embeddings align more accurately with instance-specific visual representations while preserving generic category semantics and open-vocabulary generalization. Moreover, PTC requires neither additional training nor external models and can serve as a plug-and-play module for existing methods. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks show that PTC significantly enhances the performance of six representative methods and yields more complete and accurate segmentation results. These results validate PTC as a simple and effective approach to improving visual-text alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对训练自由开放词汇语义分割 (training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation) 中文本嵌入仅编码通用类别概念、难以对齐实例级视觉表示的问题，提出原型引导文本校准 (Prototype-Guided Text Calibration, PTC)。PTC 先基于初始匹配分数挑选可靠视觉证据构造类别原型，再用原型校准文本嵌入，并按视觉证据量自适应调节校准强度。该方法无需训练或外部模型，可作为即插即用模块；在八个基准上的实验表明它能显著提升六种现有方法，得到更完整准确的分割结果。
Motivation: 现有训练自由 OVSS 方法通常只改进视觉表示，而把编码通用类别概念的文本嵌入视为固定的分类参考，导致通用概念与目标实例具体外观之间存在语义差距，产生不完整掩码和非目标区域的错误预测。
Method: 提出 PTC，包含 Perceiving 和 Anchoring 两个阶段：前者根据初始匹配分数选择可靠视觉证据以构造类别特定原型，后者利用这些原型校准对应文本嵌入，校准强度根据视觉证据量自适应调整，从而在保留通用类别语义与开放词汇泛化能力的同时更准确地对齐实例特定视觉表示。
Result: 摘要报告在八个基准上的大量实验表明，PTC 能显著提升六种代表性方法的性能，并产生更完整、更准确的分割结果；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PTC 是一种简单有效的视觉-文本对齐改进手段，无需额外训练或外部模型，可作为即插即用模块集成到现有方法中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Assessment of Conditional Diffusion Model for Synthetic Histopathology Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic histopathology image generation has emerged as an approach that may address data scarcity in computational pathology, yet current evaluation methodologies may not fully assess synthetic data quality for medical applications. This work investigates and addresses limitations in existing evaluation metrics, investigating an approach for assessing synthetic histopathology image quality through domain-specific metrics and downstream task validation. We show that conventional synthetic data evaluation metrics such as Frechet Inception Distance (FID) and Inception Score (IS) may have limitations when applied to histopathology images due to their reliance on ImageNet-pretrained feature extractors. To address these limitations, we propose for consideration modified FID and IS approaches utilizing foundation models pretrained on digital pathology datasets, supplemented by precision-recall based metrics as part of an additional quality assessment. Using conditional denoising diffusion models trained on four benchmark datasets, with a two-step training approach, we generated synthetic datasets with systematically varied quality characteristics. We also measured the correlation between the synthetic data quality metrics with downstream nuclei segmentation performance using common metrics including the aggregated Jaccard index (AJI+) and the Dice coefficient. The study results suggest that pathology-specific metrics may provide improved discriminative power. Specifically, the modified Inception Score indicates higher correlation with downstream task performance (r=0.6096 with AJI+, p=0.0122), compared to the original IS (r=0.0708, p=0.7944). Our observations indicate that increasing the variety of generated training data has a higher positive correlation with segmentation model performance than improving the visual fidelity of individual generated images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成组织病理学图像的质量评估方法，指出现有指标在病理图像上的局限，并提出使用基于数字病理数据预训练的基础模型修改 FID 与 IS，辅以 precision-recall 类指标。作者用条件去噪扩散模型在四个基准数据集上以两阶段训练生成质量特性系统变化的合成数据，并与下游细胞核分割性能（AJI+、Dice）做相关性分析。结果表明病理专属指标区分度更高，且增加生成数据多样性比提升单张图像的视觉保真度更能提升分割模型性能。
Motivation: 合成组织病理学图像有望缓解计算病理学中的数据稀缺，但现有评估方法可能无法充分衡量合成数据在医学应用中的质量；常规指标如 FID 和 IS 依赖 ImageNet 预训练特征提取器，可能与病理图像域不匹配。
Method: 提出将 FID 和 IS 改为基于数字病理数据集预训练的基础模型特征来计算，并引入 precision-recall 类指标作为补充质量评估；使用条件去噪扩散模型（conditional denoising diffusion models）在四个基准数据集上采用两阶段训练方式，生成具有系统性质量差异的合成数据集。
Result: 病理专属指标表现出更好的判别力：改进后的 Inception Score 与下游 AJI+ 的相关性为 r=0.6096（p=0.0122），而原始 IS 仅 r=0.0708（p=0.7944）；此外，增加生成训练数据多样性比提升单张图像视觉质量与分割模型性能有更强的正相关。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Recover Semantic Optimization Opportunities That Compilers Miss?
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing compilers miss profitable transformations when their enabling semantics are absent from the analyzed program representation. We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can recover such semantics from heterogeneous C/C++ context and realize them as validated, contract-preserving artifacts. We introduce SeGaBench, an executable benchmark containing 100 synthetic and 20 source-backed cases spanning low-level assumptions, data-structure invariants, and high-level semantic lifting. Each case includes hidden enabling semantics, an oracle artifact, correctness and semantic validators, and a reproducible performance protocol. We evaluate five LLMs using five independent responses per case. The strongest model produces correct artifacts in 94.8% of responses, achieves at least 1.05x speedup in 83.3%, and obtains a performance success on 93.3% of cases. Nevertheless, correct artifacts often close only part of the oracle gap. These results show that LLMs can complement compiler analysis as speculative semantic proposers, provided that their artifacts are validated and evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究编译器因程序表示中缺少使能语义而错过的优化机会，能否由大语言模型 (LLM) 从 C/C++ 异构上下文中恢复。作者提出可执行基准 SeGaBench，包含 100 个合成例与 20 个源码来源例，覆盖底层假设、数据结构不变量和高级语义提升。评估五个 LLM 后，最强模型在 94.8% 的响应中产出正确工件，83.3% 响应达到至少 1.05x 加速，并在 93.3% 用例上取得性能成功。
Motivation: 优化编译器在使能语义未出现在被分析的程序表示中时会漏掉有利可图的变换；本文探讨 LLM 能否利用程序之外的上下文恢复这些语义并生成经过验证的、保持契约的优化工件。
Method: 构建 SeGaBench 基准，每个用例包含隐藏的使能语义、oracle 工件、正确性与语义验证器以及可复现的性能协议；对五个 LLM 各进行五次独立响应评估。
Result: 最强模型在响应层面有 94.8% 生成正确工件，83.3% 的响应实现至少 1.05x 加速，93.3% 的用例获得性能成功；但正确工件通常只填补 oracle 差距的一部分。
Conclusion: 结果表明 LLM 可以作为推测性语义提议者 (speculative semantic proposers) 补充编译器分析，前提是工件经过验证和评估；同时强调正确工件与 oracle 之间仍存在性能差距。

papers.title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. To address these challenges, we propose Video-DR, featuring a decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking that compels exhaustive cross-frame visual grounding prior to web retrieval. Our framework adopts a two-stage training recipe: supervised fine-tuning followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), enabling autonomous exploration that breaks the imitation-learning ceiling. Furthermore, we curate Video-DR-Bench, a human-AI collaborative benchmark comprising 200 complex, multi-hop VQA instances. Empirical results demonstrate that our Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B establishes a new state-of-the-art of 64.0% average accuracy, surpassing proprietary Claude-4.5-Sonnet (59.0%) by 5.0 points and significantly outperforming GPT-5 (52.5%) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (57.5%). The 30B-A3B variant achieves 59.3%, competitive with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and demonstrating the effectiveness of our training paradigm even at compact scale. Code: https://github.com/Osilly/Vision-DeepResearch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR)，将多模态深度研究智能体从静态图像扩展到连续视频流，该设定要求密集时空定位与开放网络探索相结合。初步评估发现现有模型存在模态偏差和参数知识泄漏两个瓶颈，作者提出解耦的感知-探索流水线与阶段式工具解锁，并采用 SFT 加 GRPO 的两阶段训练。作者还构建了包含 200 个复杂多跳 VQA 实例的 Video-DR-Bench 基准，Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B 达到 64.0% 平均准确率，超过 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 5.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有深度研究智能体主要面向静态图像或文本，难以应对连续视频流所需的密集时空定位与开放网络搜索；初步评估揭示两个关键瓶颈：模态偏差（智能体绕过视觉工具转而进行文本搜索）和参数知识泄漏（模型依赖内部记忆而非真实的工具增强执行）。
Method: 提出解耦的感知-探索流水线，通过阶段式工具解锁强制在网页检索前完成跨帧视觉定位。训练采用两阶段方案：先监督微调 (SFT)，再用群组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 实现自主探索，以突破模仿学习的上限。同时构建 Video-DR-Bench，包含 200 个复杂多跳 VQA 实例。
Result: Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B 达到 64.0% 平均准确率，超过专有模型 Claude-4.5-Sonnet（59.0%）5.0 个百分点，并显著优于 GPT-5（52.5%）和 Gemini 2.5 Pro（57.5%）；30B-A3B 变体取得 59.3%，与 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为解耦感知-探索、阶段式工具解锁以及 SFT+GRPO 的训练范式有效，且即使在紧凑规模下也能取得有竞争力的结果，并已开源代码。摘要未专门讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video editing requires low-latency causal generation with bounded computational resources while preserving source fidelity and long-term temporal consistency. We present JoyAI-Video-Edit, a 16B-parameter autoregressive diffusion framework for real-time, open-ended video editing without access to future frames or a predefined video duration. Our method combines chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation, Source-Anchored Distribution Matching Distillation (SA-DMD), and Long-Horizon Autoregressive Distillation to reduce train--inference mismatch, preserve source fidelity during two-step generation, and mitigate accumulated temporal drift. Extensive automatic and human evaluations show that JoyAI-Video-Edit substantially outperforms existing streaming editors and remains competitive with strong offline systems on both short and long videos. The complete system achieves end-to-end 720p video editing at approximately 30 FPS on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Code is available at https://github.com/jd-opensource/JoyAI-Video-Edit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JoyAI-Video-Edit，一个 16B 参数的自回归扩散框架，用于在无未来帧、无预设时长条件下的实时开放式视频编辑。方法结合分块自回归自适应、源锚定分布匹配蒸馏（SA-DMD）和长程自回归蒸馏，分别缓解训练-推理不一致、两步生成中的源保真度下降以及时序漂移累积。自动与人工评估显示其显著优于现有流式编辑系统，并可与强离线系统竞争；系统在单张 Nvidia B200 GPU 上实现约 30 FPS 的 720p 端到端视频编辑。代码已开源。
Motivation: 实时视频编辑需要低延迟的因果生成，同时受限于计算资源，并且要保持源视频保真度和长期时序一致性；现有流式编辑方法在这些约束下难以兼顾质量与时效。
Method: 采用自回归扩散（autoregressive diffusion）框架，按块（chunk-wise）进行自回归自适应，并引入源锚定分布匹配蒸馏（SA-DMD）以在两步生成中保持源保真度，以及长程自回归蒸馏（Long-Horizon Autoregressive Distillation）来抑制长时间的时序漂移累积。
Result: 大量自动和人工评估显示，该方法显著优于现有流式编辑器，并且在短视频和长视频上均能与强离线编辑系统抗衡；完整系统在单块 Nvidia B200 GPU 上实现约 30 FPS 的 720p 端到端视频编辑。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，所提出的自回归扩散框架结合针对性的蒸馏策略，能够在无需未来帧和预设时长的开放设定下实现接近实时且质量与离线系统相当的视频编辑，代码已开源供复现。

papers.title: ReflectRL: Learning from Golden Negative Trajectories via Reflective-to-Direct Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy training has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, and is often enhanced by golden trajectories from stronger expert models. However, when the expert fails on harder problems, existing trajectory-guided methods lose their main source of supervision, and these failed trajectories are typically discarded as negative samples. We argue that such failures, which we call Golden Negative Trajectories, can still provide valuable reasoning signals when treated not as demonstrations to imitate, but as flawed trajectories to reflect upon. We identify a Reflection Advantage: for hard problems, reflecting on a flawed trajectory can be easier and more effective than solving the problem directly from scratch. Motivated by this, we propose ReflectRL, a lightweight plug-and-play framework that learns from Golden Negative Trajectories during on-policy training. ReflectRL first uses these trajectories to elicit Reflective Reasoning, then applies Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition to transfer the acquired reasoning behavior back to Direct Reasoning. Experiments across 9 benchmarks, 4 LLM backbones, and 4 on-policy training methods show that ReflectRL consistently improves reasoning performance with minimal overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReflectRL，一个轻量级即插即用的训练框架，在 on-policy 训练中利用专家模型失败轨迹（称为 Golden Negative Trajectories）而非丢弃它们。该方法先让模型对这些有缺陷的轨迹进行反思推理（Reflective Reasoning），再通过 Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition 将反思行为迁移回直接推理（Direct Reasoning）。在 9 个基准、4 个 LLM 主干和 4 种 on-policy 训练方法上的实验显示，该框架能以极小的额外开销持续提升推理性能。
Motivation: 现有基于轨迹指导的后训练方法依赖强专家模型成功生成的 golden trajectories，但当专家在难题上失败时，这一主要监督来源就失效，失败轨迹通常被当作负样本丢弃。作者认为这些失败轨迹如果被当作需要反思的缺陷样例而非模仿示范，仍能提供有价值的推理信号，并指出 Reflection Advantage：对难题而言，反思一条有缺陷的轨迹比从零直接求解更容易、更有效。
Method: ReflectRL 首先利用 Golden Negative Trajectories 诱导模型产生反思式推理，然后应用 Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition，把从反思中获得的推理行为迁移回直接推理模式，从而在 on-policy 训练中复用原本被废弃的失败轨迹。
Result: 在 9 个推理基准、4 种 LLM 主干和 4 种 on-policy 训练方法上的实验表明，ReflectRL 能够一致地提高推理性能，且额外开销很小。
Conclusion: 作者主张不应把专家失败轨迹当作无监督价值的负样本丢弃，而应将其作为反思对象来增强推理训练；ReflectRL 以即插即用方式落地这一思想，适用于多种 LLM 与训练方法。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张不应把专家失败轨迹当作无监督价值的负样本丢弃，而应将其作为反思对象来增强推理训练；ReflectRL 以即插即用方式落地这一思想，适用于多种 LLM 与训练方法。

papers.title: UniWorld-Design: From Pixel Generation to Layer-Native Design
papers.abstract_en: We introduce UniWorld-Design, a framework that redefines image generation from flat pixel synthesis to structured visual composition, with semantic RGBA layers as the atomic units of generation, understanding, and editing. Our key insight is that pixels define how an image is rendered, whereas layers define how an image is created, understood, and edited. Just as human designers create and manipulate visual content through layers rather than raw pixels, UniWorld-Design equips multimodal generative models with a layer-native design space. UniWorld-Design comprises two models. The Text-to-RGBA (T2RGBA) model generates standalone RGBA assets directly from text. The Image-to-Layer (I2L) model conditions on a finished image, a global instruction and per-layer prompts, and jointly produces ordered, complete semantic RGBA layers. Its instruction interface supports top-level decomposition, recursive decomposition and targeted extraction, making layering an instruction-addressable operation for agentic editing. Because I2L learns complete semantic objects rather than visible-pixel partitions, its layers stay usable when moved or removed. On the Crello benchmark, I2L reduces per-layer RGB L1 error by 37% and achieves a 34% relative improvement in Alpha Soft IoU over Qwen-Image-Layered. Separately, T2RGBA achieves the highest CLIP Score, outperforming LayerDiffuse and OmniAlpha.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniWorld-Design 框架，将图像生成从平面像素合成重构为结构化视觉组合，以语义 RGBA 层作为生成、理解与编辑的原子单元。框架包含两个模型：Text-to-RGBA (T2RGBA) 直接从文本生成独立 RGBA 素材，Image-to-Layer (I2L) 在给定成品图、全局指令和逐层提示的条件下，联合生成有序且完整的语义 RGBA 层。在 Crello 基准上，I2L 将逐层 RGB L1 误差降低 37%，Alpha Soft IoU 相对 Qwen-Image-Layered 提升 34%；T2RGBA 取得最高 CLIP Score，优于 LayerDiffuse 和 OmniAlpha。
Motivation: 现有图像生成停留在平面像素合成，但像素只决定图像如何渲染，层才决定图像如何被创建、理解和编辑；人类设计师正是通过层而不是原始像素来操作视觉内容，因此需要为多模态生成模型引入层原生的设计空间。
Method: 提出两个模型组成的框架：T2RGBA 从文本直接生成独立 RGBA 素材；I2L 以成品图像、全局指令和逐层提示为条件，联合输出有序的完整语义 RGBA 层，其指令接口支持顶层分解、递归分解和定向提取，使分层成为可寻址的智能体编辑操作。I2L 学习完整语义对象而非可见像素分区，因此层在被移动或移除后仍然可用。
Result: 在 Crello 基准上，I2L 相比 Qwen-Image-Layered 将逐层 RGB L1 误差降低 37%，Alpha Soft IoU 获得 34% 的相对提升；T2RGBA 取得最高 CLIP Score，超过 LayerDiffuse 和 OmniAlpha。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以语义层为原子单元可以重新定义图像生成与编辑，使分层成为指令可寻址的操作，并在层分解质量和文本生成素材质量上取得可量化的改进。

papers.title: Should We Type or Talk to LLM Agents? A Comprehensive Study of Voice and Keyboard Input Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Human input reaches language models by typing or speaking, and each channel leaves a distinct signature: orthographic noise for keyboards; for voice, disfluency from conventional transcription and restructuring from AI-backed dictation tools. How do they impact an LLM's performance? In this paper we present HIVE (Human Input-Variation Engine), a suite of voice transcription perturbations and QWERTY keyboard perturbations. We use HIVE to evaluate how robust models are to these perturbations. We present seven findings. (i) Voice transcription perturbations lower accuracy across every instruction-tuned model we test, and it is the structure of the transcription rather than its fillers that carries the cost. (ii) QWERTY keyboard perturbations cost less, and a model absorbs a lot of them before accuracy falls away. (iii) Both trace back to one cause, how many of the question's tokens survive the perturbation: destroying a token is what hurts, while adding new ones alongside it costs little. (iv) The gap between the two channels appears only where the answer must be constructed or deduced; on multiple choice there is none. (v) The harm does not solely come from test-set contamination. (vi) It cannot be trained away with lightweight adaptation. (vii) A thinking budget recovers the keyboard channel almost entirely but leaves the spoken registers untouched, and compressed speech is worse with it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人类通过语音或键盘输入到达 LLM 时，不同输入通道留下的扰动对模型性能的影响，并提出 HIVE（Human Input-Variation Engine）来系统评估语音转录扰动与 QWERTY 键盘扰动。作者给出七项发现：语音转录扰动普遍降低指令微调模型准确率，且代价来自转录结构而非填充词；键盘扰动代价较小；两种扰动的共同根源是被破坏的问题 token 数量；通道差异只出现在需要构造或推断答案的任务上；危害并非仅来自测试集污染；轻量适配无法消除；思考预算几乎完全恢复键盘通道但无法恢复语音通道，且压缩语音配合思考预算反而更差。
Motivation: 人类的输入到达语言模型有打字和说话两种通道，每种通道留下不同的扰动特征（键盘对应正字法噪声，语音对应常规转录的流利度问题以及 AI 转写工具带来的重构），但现有研究缺乏对这些输入扰动如何影响 LLM 性能的系统理解。
Method: 提出 HIVE（Human Input-Variation Engine），包含一套语音转录扰动和 QWERTY 键盘扰动，用于评估模型对这些扰动的鲁棒性，并分析扰动与性能损失之间的归因关系。
Result: 摘要报告语音转录扰动在测试的所有指令微调模型上都会降低准确率，代价主要来自转录结构而非填充词；键盘扰动代价更小，模型能吸收大量键盘扰动；两类扰动均可归结为问题中存活 token 的数量，破坏 token 造成伤害，而额外新增 token 代价很小；通道差异只出现在答案需要构造或推断的任务上，多项选择题无差异；危害不完全来自测试集污染；轻量适配无法训练消除；思考预算能几乎完全恢复键盘通道但无法恢复语音通道，且压缩语音配合思考预算时性能更差。
Conclusion: 作者强调语音与键盘输入扰动对 LLM 的影响机制不同，且轻量适配与思考预算都不能统一修复，说明需要针对输入通道本身的鲁棒性研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Information-Geometric Forward Policy Training in GFlowNets
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have emerged as a flexible framework for amortised inference over discrete and mixed discrete-continuous objects, requiring only an unnormalised target density specified through a reward. In this work, we formulate forward-policy training in GFlowNets through the information geometry of the induced trajectory sampler. Treating the forward policy as an induced trajectory sampler, we show that its intrinsic first-order geometry is given by the Fisher-Rao metric of the trajectory family, and that the associated natural gradient provides the canonical local update whenever the corresponding Fisher information is computable or accurately approximable. We derive an exact decomposition of the trajectory Fisher into per-step conditional second moments, which clarifies when temporal score interactions vanish and when dense couplings remain under shared parameterisation. This leads to three computational regimes: settings with tractable exact Fisher information, settings where Monte Carlo estimators of the expected Fisher are sufficient, and structure-exploitable settings in which target locality or factorisation yields accurate approximations of the Fisher expectation. In the latter case, graphical-model tools such as exact marginalisation, separator methods, and belief propagation provide principled surrogates for natural-gradient updates. The resulting framework turns target structure into optimisation geometry and yields a tractable route to structure-aware forward-policy training in GFlowNets. We illustrate the framework empirically through examples comparing convergence and exploration behaviour under Riemannian and Euclidean optimisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将 GFlowNets 的前向策略训练置于轨迹采样器的信息几何框架中，指出其内在一阶几何由轨迹族的 Fisher-Rao 度量给出，相应的自然梯度在 Fisher 信息可计算或可近似时构成局部更新。作者推导了轨迹 Fisher 信息关于每步条件二阶矩的精确分解，并据此划分出三种计算场景。经验示例对比了 Riemannian 与 Euclidean 优化下的收敛与探索行为。
Motivation: GFlowNets 的前向策略训练通常依赖普通梯度更新，未利用轨迹分布的内在几何以及奖励/目标结构。论文试图用信息几何为前向策略提供规范且结构感知的更新方式。
Method: 将前向策略视为诱导轨迹采样器，证明其内在一阶几何为轨迹族的 Fisher-Rao 度量；推导轨迹 Fisher 信息分解为每步条件二阶矩的精确形式，以厘清时间分数交互何时消失、何时在共享参数化下保持稠密耦合。据此提出三种计算体制：可精确求 Fisher 信息、可用 Monte Carlo 估计期望 Fisher、以及可利用目标局部性或因子化结构以图模型工具（精确边缘化、separator 方法、belief propagation）近似 Fisher 期望，从而构造自然梯度更新。
Result: 摘要仅报告了通过示例对 Riemannian 与 Euclidean 优化的收敛和探索行为进行的经验比较，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该框架将目标结构转化为优化几何，为 GFlowNets 中结构感知的前向策略训练提供了可行路径；其适用性取决于对应 Fisher 信息是否可计算或可准确近似。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Separating quantum circuits from classical LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models - transformers and diffusion language models - are built around two canonical algorithmic tasks: prediction and generation. We prove unconditional separations between low-depth quantum computation and the corresponding bounded-resource classical language-model architectures in both regimes. Concretely, we exhibit the following: 1. Distributional separation. We give a distribution that is sampleable by $\textsf{QNC}^0$ circuits (i.e., a family of constant-depth quantum circuits consisting of bounded fan-in gates) that no constant-round diffusion language model ($\textsf{DLM}$) with shallow scheduling and denoising can sample within constant distance, even when allowed sublinear chain-of-thought and output-token revision/remasking events, the very features modern $\textsf{DLM}$s rely on. 2. Functional separation. We exhibit a function computable in $\land \circ \textsf{QNC}^0[\log\log n]$ (i.e., a family of O$(\log\log n)$-depth $\textsf{QNC}^0$ circuits, where $n$ is the input length, followed by a single classical $\mathsf{AND}$ gate) such that any constant-depth decoder-only transformer computing the function must be large: it would have to have width $n^{Ω(1)}$. Together, our work initiates the study of quantum advantage in the era of large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在理论上证明低深度量子计算与有界资源的经典语言模型架构（Transformer 和扩散语言模型）之间存在无条件分离。作者给出两类结果：一是存在可由 QNC^0 电路采样的分布，任何常数轮扩散语言模型 (DLM) 即使允许亚线性 chain-of-thought 和输出 token 修订/重掩码事件，也无法在常数距离内采样该分布；二是存在可由 AND∘QNC^0[log log n] 计算的函数，任何常数深度 decoder-only Transformer 计算该函数都需要宽度 n^Ω(1)。作者称该工作开启了 LLM 时代量子优势的研究。
Motivation: 现代大语言模型（Transformer 和扩散语言模型）围绕预测与生成两个核心任务构建，而关于低深度量子计算能否在这些任务上超越有界资源的经典语言模型架构，此前缺乏系统性研究。
Method: 通过复杂度理论构造无条件分离：分别给出 QNC^0 电路可采样的分布和 AND∘QNC^0[log log n] 可计算的函数，并证明常数轮扩散语言模型与常数深度 decoder-only Transformer 在给定资源限制下无法实现对应的采样或计算。
Result: 摘要报告两个分离结果：分布层面，常数轮 DLM 即使允许亚线性 chain-of-thought 与 token 修订/重掩码，也无法在常数距离内采样 QNC^0 可采样的分布；函数层面，常数深度 decoder-only Transformer 计算该函数需要宽度 n^Ω(1)。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些无条件分离表明低深度量子电路相对经典语言模型架构存在能力优势，并借此发起对 LLM 时代量子优势的系统研究；摘要未讨论该结论对实际语言模型任务的直接应用影响。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些无条件分离表明低深度量子电路相对经典语言模型架构存在能力优势，并借此发起对 LLM 时代量子优势的系统研究；摘要未讨论该结论对实际语言模型任务的直接应用影响。

papers.title: Interpretable Adaptive Sampling for LLM Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by generating and aggregating multiple candidate answers, yet many pipelines use fixed per-query budgets that spend the same compute on easy and difficult prompts. These fixed budgets are also difficult to inspect because they do not explain why a given prompt receives a particular number of samples. We propose adaptive} test-time scaling with a lightweight fuzzy controller that maps interpretable signals, including estimated prompt complexity and model confidence, to a per-query sampling budget. The controller assigns fewer samples to easier or more confident prompts and more samples to harder or less certain prompts, making inference-time compute inspectable rather than fixed or opaque. We evaluate under a fair-alignment protocol with matched decoding settings and controlled answer selection, and compare against best-of-$N$, compute-aware scaling, and self-certainty-based baselines on question-answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across models and datasets, adaptive fuzzy control improves over several standard baselines and remains close to a selector-matched full-budget control while reducing the average number of samples. These findings suggest that interpretable adaptive sampling is a practical direction for more efficient test-time reasoning in large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型测试时计算扩展（test-time scaling）中固定每查询采样预算的问题，提出一种轻量级模糊控制器，将可解释信号（估计的提示复杂度与模型置信度）映射到每查询采样数量。在问答与数学推理任务上，该方法在匹配解码设置与受控答案选择的公平对齐协议下，与 best-of-N、compute-aware scaling 和基于自置信度的基线比较，报告能够减少平均采样数并接近全预算对照的性能。
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展流水线常对每个查询使用固定预算，在简单与困难提示上花费相同计算量，且难以检查为何某个提示获得特定数量的样本。
Method: 提出自适应测试时扩展：一个轻量级模糊控制器根据估计的提示复杂度和模型置信度分配每查询采样预算，简单或高置信度提示分配较少样本，困难或低置信度提示分配较多样本。
Result: 在问答和数学推理任务上，跨多个模型与数据集，自适应模糊控制优于若干标准基线，并接近选择器匹配的全预算对照，同时降低平均采样数量。
Conclusion: 作者认为可解释的自适应采样是大语言模型中更高效测试时推理的一个实用方向。

papers.title: Prithvi-Precip: Integrating Satellite Observations into an Atmospheric AI Foundation Model for Precipitation Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate precipitation forecasting remains one of the most challenging problems in weather prediction. While recent AI weather prediction (AIWP) systems have achieved substantial improvements in medium-range forecasting skill, precipitation often remains a secondary target and is commonly learned from reanalysis datasets that contain considerable uncertainty. In this work, we investigate two complementary strategies for improving AI-based precipitation forecasts. Building on the Prithvi-WxC foundation model, we develop Prithvi-Precip, a global precipitation forecasting system, and examine (1) the impact of training targets derived from satellite-based precipitation estimates rather than reanalysis fields and (2) the direct assimilation of satellite observations into the forecasting model. We systematically evaluate key design choices for finetuning the Prithvi-WxC AI foundation model for precipitation forecasting. We find that autoregressive rollout training produces substantially more accurate forecasts than direct conditioning on forecast lead time. Using independent radar-based precipitation estimates for evaluation, we show that training on satellite-derived precipitation targets yields improved forecast accuracy relative to training on MERRA-2 precipitation fields. Furthermore, direct ingestion of satellite observations provides additional improvements at short lead times, with the largest gains occurring in tropical and subtropical regions. Together, these advances enable Prithvi-Precip to substantially improve upon directly comparable precipitation forecasts from the Goddard Earth Observing System. Our results highlight the potential of improved precipitation targets and the direct integration of satellite observations as promising pathways for advancing medium-range AI precipitation forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Prithvi-WxC 大气 AI 基础模型之上构建全球降水预报系统 Prithvi-Precip，围绕两条互补路线展开：用卫星降水估计替代再分析场作为训练目标，以及把卫星观测直接纳入预报模型。作者系统对比了微调设计选择，发现自回归 rollout 训练显著优于按预报时效直接条件化；基于卫星降水目标训练优于基于 MERRA-2 降水场，且短时效直接摄入卫星观测带来额外提升，尤其体现在热带与副热带。在独立雷达降水估计评估下，Prithvi-Precip 明显优于 Goddard Earth Observing System（GEOS）直接可比的降水预报。
Motivation: 降水预报是天气预报中最具挑战性的问题之一，但现有 AI 天气预报（AIWP）系统常将降水作为次要目标，并且通常从含有较大不确定性的再分析数据学习降水，缺乏对更优训练目标和观测同化路径的系统研究。
Method: 作者基于 Prithvi-WxC 基础模型微调得到全球降水预报系统 Prithvi-Precip，检验两类策略：一是训练目标改用卫星降水估计而非再分析场，二是将卫星观测直接同化进预报模型；同时系统评估自回归 rollout 训练与直接条件化于预报时效等微调设计选择。
Result: 摘要报告自回归 rollout 训练比直接条件化于预报时效产生更准确的预报；以独立雷达降水估计评估，用卫星降水目标训练优于用 MERRA-2 降水场训练；直接摄入卫星观测在短预报时效带来额外改进，最大增益出现在热带和副热带地区，整体性能显著优于 GEOS 的直接可比降水预报。
Conclusion: 作者总结指出，改进降水训练目标和直接集成卫星观测是推进中期（medium-range）AI 降水预报的有前景途径，并强调这些进展共同支撑了 Prithvi-Precip 相对现有系统的提升。

papers.title: A game theory for foundation models shows new paths to rational cooperation through similarity inference
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous agents powered by foundation models are increasingly integrated into social and economic systems, understanding the principles governing their collective behavior is essential for ensuring safety and cooperation. Classical game theory, the dominant framework for modeling rational interaction, is built upon the assumption of `decoupled agency,' where agents treat their own decision-making as independent of the environment and other actors. Modern AI agents, however, jointly predict their own future actions alongside external observations. Here, we report a striking finding: when interacting in stylized social dilemmas, foundation model agents engaging in optimal planning consistently converge to stable cooperation, directly contradicting classical game-theoretic predictions of mutual defection. To understand this phenomenon, we introduce the `embedded Bayesian agent,' a theoretical model for foundation model agents. By shifting from decoupled to embedded agency, these agents model themselves as part of the universe they inhabit, maintaining epistemic uncertainty about their own decision-making algorithms. We show that by inferring whether others are behaviorally similar, an embedded agent treats its own deliberation during planning as evidence: a decision to cooperate predicts a similar decision by a similar partner. We formalize this mechanism of similarity inference through the `embedded equilibrium,' a novel solution concept replacing the Nash equilibrium to provide a foundational game theory for the social behavior of modern AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告基础模型智能体在风格化社会困境中通过最优规划一致收敛到稳定合作，直接违背经典博弈论对相互背叛的预测。作者提出嵌入式贝叶斯智能体 (embedded Bayesian agent) 理论模型，将智能体视为对自身决策算法保持认知不确定性的嵌入式主体，并引入嵌入式均衡 (embedded equilibrium) 取代纳什均衡来形式化相似性推断机制。
Motivation: 基础模型驱动的自主智能体日益融入社会与经济系统，需要理解其集体行为以确保安全与合作。经典博弈论基于解耦能动性 (decoupled agency) 假设，而现代 AI 智能体是联合预测自身未来行动与外部观察的，原有框架不再适用。
Method: 提出嵌入式贝叶斯智能体模型：从解耦能动性转向嵌入式能动性，智能体把自己建模为所居宇宙的一部分，并对其自身决策算法保持认知不确定性。通过推断他人是否行为相似，智能体将自身规划时的思考作为证据——合作决定预测相似伙伴也会合作；该机制以嵌入式均衡这一新解概念形式化。
Result: 摘要报告在风格化社会困境 (stylized social dilemmas) 中，基础模型智能体进行最优规划时一致收敛到稳定合作，直接违背经典博弈论预测的相互背叛。
Conclusion: 作者认为从解耦能动性转向嵌入式能动性可以为现代 AI 智能体的社会行为提供基础博弈论框架。摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TACT: Taxonomy-Aligned Post-Training for Pedagogically Adaptive English Tutoring
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide conversational practice for English-as-a-second-language (ESL) learners. Effective ESL tutoring, however, requires more than fluent response generation: a tutor must select an appropriate pedagogical action based on learner behavior and dialogue context. Human-tutoring research offers principles for adaptive support, but they are often task-specific and remain insufficiently integrated into LLM-based ESL tutor training and evaluation. We present TACT (Taxonomy-Aligned Conversational Tutor), a human-grounded framework for post-training and evaluating pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors. Drawing on established literature, we develop two complementary taxonomies: the Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy with 13 tutor response strategies and the Student-Move Taxonomy characterizing learner behavior by move type and status. Using these taxonomies, we construct TACTCorpus, which enriches 260 authentic teacher-student conversations with 32,379 annotations and quality-controlled augmented training data. We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through supervised fine-tuning followed by taxonomy-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization, producing TACTutor and optimizing it for scaffolding quality rather than reference imitation alone. On TACTBench, a strategy-balanced diagnostic benchmark comprising 78 authentic tutoring contexts, TACTutor improves over its backbone by 20.30% and outperforms all evaluated proprietary baselines under the same protocol, while maintaining backbone performance on established external educational benchmarks; in a blinded study with 50 learners, it also receives the highest overall mean rating among the evaluated tutors. We release the data, benchmark, and model weights, providing an open foundation for developing pedagogically adaptive ESL tutors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TACT (Taxonomy-Aligned Conversational Tutor)，一个面向 ESL 英语教学的对话式辅导系统后训练与评估框架。作者基于人类辅导研究建立 Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy（13 种辅导策略）与 Student-Move Taxonomy（学生行为按动作类型与状态分类），构建 TACTCorpus（260 段真实师生对话、32,379 条标注），并对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行监督微调与 taxonomy 对齐的 Group Relative Policy Optimization 训练，得到 TACTutor。在 TACTBench 上 TACTutor 相对其基座模型提升 20.30%，在相同评测协议下超过所有专有基线，并在 50 名学习者的盲评中获得最高总体平均分。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地用于 ESL 学习者的对话练习，但有效的辅导不仅需要流利生成回复，还需要根据学习者行为与对话上下文选择恰当的教学动作。人类辅导研究提供了自适应支持的原则，但这些原则往往针对特定任务，尚未充分整合进基于 LLM 的 ESL 辅导训练与评测中。
Method: 构建两套互补的分类体系：Tutor-Strategy Taxonomy 涵盖 13 种教师回复策略，Student-Move Taxonomy 描述学生行为类型与状态；基于它们构造 TACTCorpus，包含 260 段真实师生对话的 32,379 条标注及质量控制的增强训练数据；随后对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行监督微调，再用 taxonomy 对齐的 Group Relative Policy Optimization 优化，得到 TACTutor，目标是优化脚手架质量（scaffolding quality）而非单纯模仿参考回复。
Result: 在包含 78 个真实辅导场景的策略平衡诊断基准 TACTBench 上，TACTutor 相比其基座模型提升 20.30%，并在相同评测协议下优于所有被评估的专有基线；同时在既有外部教育基准上保持基座性能。50 名学习者的盲评研究中，TACTutor 获得所有被评估辅导系统中最高的总体平均评分。
Conclusion: 作者强调以分类学对齐的强化学习来优化教学脚手架质量，并公开了数据、基准与模型权重，为可教学自适应的 ESL 辅导系统提供开放基础。

papers.title: Muon Meets Mamba: Spectral Optimization for State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Muon is a recent optimizer that orthogonalizes the update to each weight matrix with a Newton-Schulz iteration, which performs steepest descent under the spectral norm. Almost all the evidence for it comes from Transformer models, and its behavior on state-space models is largely unreported. We compare Muon with AdamW on Mamba-2 130M under a controlled protocol that varies only which weight groups are trained with Muon. The benefit is localized. Muon on the output projection alone beats Muon on the input projection or on both. The advantage is mainly one of token efficiency. It holds on two corpora and two token budgets, and persists when training continues well past the compute-optimal point. Conditioning does not explain the gain. Muon lowers the condition number of whichever projection it trains, but the better-conditioned input projection is not the one that helps.

Motivation: Muon 优化器通过 Newton-Schulz 迭代对每个权重矩阵的更新做正交化，即在谱范数下执行最陡下降，但此前证据几乎全部来自 Transformer 模型，其在状态空间模型上的行为缺乏报道。
Method: 在 Mamba-2 130M 上采用受控实验协议，固定其余训练设置，仅改变哪些权重组（输入投影、输出投影或两者）使用 Muon 训练，并与 AdamW 对照。
Result: Muon 仅作用于输出投影时优于作用于输入投影或两者同时使用；优势主要是 token 效率，在两个语料和两个 token 预算下成立，且持续训练到远超计算最优点时依然存在。Muon 降低所训练投影的条件数，但条件数并不能解释性能增益。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 Muon 在状态空间模型上的收益是局部化的，且优势不能用条件数解释，提示其作用机制需要进一步研究。

papers.title: Progressive Learning of a Diffusion-based Inpainting Model for Separating Overlapped Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: Overlapped friction ridge patterns are a recurring problem in latent fingerprints recovered from crime scenes and in live-scan scenarios where residual fingerprints on the sensor may corrupt subsequent acquisitions. Existing approaches for separating overlapped fingerprints either rely on rule-based orientation field completion that requires strong domain knowledge or train end-to-end deep neural networks that do not account for domain-specific considerations. This work introduces a diffusion-based pipeline for separating component fingerprints from an image containing overlapping friction ridge patterns. We formulate the separation problem as an inpainting task and progressively learn a diffusion model for this task in multiple stages. Starting from a pre-trained Stable Diffusion model, we progressively incorporate a fingerprint prior, add the ability to complete partial fingerprints, and finally propose \textbf{overlap-aware inpainting} that reconstructs each component print using a diffusion inpainting model based on multi-channel conditioning. Experiments on two public datasets demonstrate that component fingerprints reconstructed using the proposed diffusion-based inpainting method can match with their mated counterparts with very high probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的叠印指纹分离方法，将分离问题建模为修复 (inpainting) 任务，并从预训练 Stable Diffusion 出发分阶段渐进学习。流程逐步引入指纹先验、部分指纹补全能力，最终提出基于多通道条件的 overlap-aware inpainting 来重建每个分量指纹。在两个公共数据集上的实验表明，重建的分量指纹能以很高概率与其配对指纹匹配。
Motivation: 重叠摩擦脊线模式在犯罪现场潜在指纹和活体扫描残留指纹中反复出现，影响后续采集与匹配。现有分离方法要么依赖需要强领域知识的基于规则的取向场补全，要么使用未考虑领域特定问题的端到端深度网络。
Method: 将重叠指纹分离表述为图像修复任务，采用多阶段渐进式训练扩散模型：从预训练 Stable Diffusion 初始化，逐步加入指纹先验，增加对部分指纹的补全能力，最后提出基于多通道条件信息的 overlap-aware inpainting 分别重建各分量指纹。
Result: 在两个公共数据集上的实验显示，利用所提扩散修复方法重建的分量指纹与其配对的原始指纹匹配概率很高。
Conclusion: 作者认为渐进式地融入指纹先验并采用多通道条件扩散修复，是应对潜在指纹与活体扫描场景中重叠指纹分离的有效途径；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Logic Before Language: Pre-pretraining on Formal Derivations Fosters Skill Acquisition and Compressibility
papers.abstract_en: Pre-pretraining language models (LMs) on symbolic data can accelerate and improve natural language acquisition. However, existing pre-pretraining tasks, such as Dyck and procedural algorithms, rely on narrow primitives that fail to capture the expressive capacity of natural language. Moreover, prior studies remain restricted to relatively small token budgets, offering limited insight into skill emergence and representational dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose logic pre-pretraining (Logic-PPT) as a principled initialization strategy, leveraging formal derivations to impart richer structural and linguistic biases. Formal derivations require abstract mechanisms that are central to natural language, simultaneously binding variables, connecting quantifiers and relational dependencies, and composing predicate-argument structures over long contexts. Scaling our evaluation to a 100B-token regime, logic pre-pretraining substantially accelerates skill acquisition in LMs, achieving 80\% accuracy on linguistic tasks with 36B fewer tokens than standard initialization, and outperforming alternative pre-pretraining baselines. Mechanistically, formal derivations induce persistent structural reorganization, distinctively characterized by a lower-rank, spectrally concentrated representation space. Crucially, we show that this internal geometry enables improved model compressibility via pruning, matching the dense baseline performance even at $\approx$33\% sparsity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出逻辑预训练（Logic-PPT），通过在形式推导（formal derivations）这类符号数据上进行预预训练，为语言模型注入更丰富的结构与语言先验。在100B token训练规模下，逻辑预训练显著加速技能习得，用比标准初始化少36B token即达到80%的语言任务准确率，并优于其他预预训练基线。机制层面，形式推导诱发持久的结构重组，得到低秩、谱集中的表示空间，使模型在约33%稀疏度下剪枝仍能匹配密集基线性能。
Motivation: 现有预预训练任务（如Dyck语言和程序算法）依赖狭窄原语，难以覆盖自然语言的表达能力；同时先前研究局限于较小的token预算，限制了对技能涌现与表示动态的观察。
Method: 提出逻辑预训练（Logic-PPT）作为初始化策略，利用形式推导来传递同时绑定变量、连接量词与关系依赖、在长上下文中组合谓词-参数结构等抽象机制，从而赋予模型更丰富的结构偏差。
Result: 在100B token规模下，逻辑预训练比标准初始化少用36B token即可在语言任务上达到80%准确率，且优于其他预预训练基线；该过程诱发的低秩、谱集中表示空间还使模型在约33%稀疏度下通过剪枝匹配密集基线性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明形式推导预训练能够引发动机内部持久的结构重组，且这种内部几何特性支持更好的模型可压缩性（剪枝）。该研究聚焦语言模型预训练与表征机制，与给定气象类关键词无直接关联。

papers.title: Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences usually relies on a sparse terminal reward evaluated on the final generated samples, presenting a severe temporal credit-assignment challenge across the multi-step denoising process. We propose Latent Reward Registers, a mechanism that estimates terminal preference directly from intermediate noisy latents by prepending learnable, position-free register tokens to the input sequence of a frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This independent readout mechanism extracts latent reward evidence without altering the generator's hidden states or velocity field. The resulting dense, differentiable reward signal throughout the full denoising process facilitates two alignment strategies. For training, Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) distills reward-guided updates along on-policy trajectories, bypassing the computationally expensive rollouts of standard policy gradients. For inference, Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS) steers trajectories via magnitude-matched reward gradients without parameter updates. Empirically, at high noise levels (u = 0.8), the registers reach the highest pairwise accuracy among the evaluated latent reward models. Furthermore, RG-OPD outperforms online reinforcement learning baselines while reducing GPU hours by up to 33x, and RGS establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods, strictly enhancing both alignment and perceptual metrics. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/Guanys-dar/latent-reward-register
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Reward Registers，通过在冻结的 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 输入序列中前置可学习的、与位置无关的 register token，直接从中间含噪隐变量估计终端偏好奖励，从而在扩散模型的多步去噪过程中提供稠密、可微的奖励信号。作者由此发展出两种对齐策略：训练侧的 Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) 和推理侧的 Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS)。实验表明该方法在高噪声水平下奖励预测准确率最高，且 RG-OPD 以更少的 GPU 小时超越在线强化学习基线，RGS 在无训练方法中达到新的最优。
Motivation: 扩散模型与人类偏好对齐通常依赖最终生成样本上的稀疏终端奖励，这导致多步去噪过程中存在严重的时间信用分配 (temporal credit assignment) 问题。
Method: Latent Reward Registers 在冻结的 DiT 输入序列中前置可学习、位置无关的 register token，从中间含噪隐变量直接读出奖励证据，不改变生成器的隐状态或速度场；基于该稠密奖励，训练策略 RG-OPD 在在线策略轨迹上蒸馏奖励引导更新，推理策略 RGS 使用幅度匹配的奖励梯度引导采样而无需参数更新。
Result: 在高噪声水平 (u=0.8) 下，registers 在已评估的潜在奖励模型中达到最高成对准确率；RG-OPD 在超越在线强化学习基线的同时将 GPU 小时数降低最多 33 倍；RGS 在无训练方法中达到新的最优，同时提升对齐指标与感知质量指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于冻结 DiT 的独立奖励读出机制可以提供稠密可微的奖励信号，并同时支撑训练期与推理期两种高效对齐策略；代码和权重已公开。

papers.title: Robust Low-Tubal-Rank Tensor Completion under Cross-Concentrated Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Tensor cross-concentrated sampling (t-CCS) bridges entrywise sampling and t-CUR slice-wise sampling by observing entries only within selected horizontal and lateral slices. Existing t-CCS completion methods, however, assume that the observations are free of gross corruption. In this work, we study robust recovery of a third-order low-tubal-rank tensor from partial t-CCS observations contaminated by sparse, arbitrarily large outliers. We propose Robust Iterative t-CUR (R-ItCUR), a tensor-native algorithm that partitions the sampled tensor cross into two exterior blocks and an intersection block, applies adaptive blockwise Welsch correction for outlier suppression, and updates the low-rank component through projected blockwise gradient descent. By operating directly on the sampled cross, R-ItCUR avoids reconstructing the full tensor throughout the iterations, resulting in substantial memory and computational savings. Experiments on synthetic tensors, cardiac MRI data, and three-dimensional seismic data demonstrate accurate recovery and strong robustness to sparse gross corruptions. The results further highlight the importance of explicitly exploiting the cross-concentrated sampling structure in robust tensor completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在交叉集中采样 (t-CCS) 下，从含有稀疏、任意大异常值的部分观测中恢复三阶低管秩 (low-tubal-rank) 张量。作者提出 Robust Iterative t-CUR (R-ItCUR)，直接在采样的张量交叉块上做自适应分块 Welsch 校正和投影分块梯度下降，避免在迭代中重建完整张量。合成张量、心脏 MRI 与三维地震数据实验表明该方法恢复准确且对稀疏粗大异常值鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有 t-CCS 张量补全方法假设观测无粗大损坏，但实际采样数据常含稀疏的任意大异常值；同时迭代中重建完整张量会带来过高的内存和计算开销。
Method: 将采样的张量交叉分为两个外部块和一个相交块，对三个块分别做自适应 Welsch 校正以抑制异常值，并通过投影分块梯度下降更新低秩分量；整个过程只操作采样交叉，不重建完整张量。
Result: 在合成张量、心脏 MRI 数据和三维地震数据上的实验证明该方法能精确恢复低管秩张量，并对稀疏粗大损坏表现出强鲁棒性；结果还强调显式利用交叉集中采样结构对鲁棒补全的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式利用 t-CCS 采样结构以及张量原生 (tensor-native) 的分块校正与更新策略是鲁棒补全的关键，且带来了可观的存储和计算节省。

summary_sections.result: 在合成张量、心脏 MRI 数据和三维地震数据上的实验证明该方法能精确恢复低管秩张量，并对稀疏粗大损坏表现出强鲁棒性；结果还强调显式利用交叉集中采样结构对鲁棒补全的重要性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调显式利用 t-CCS 采样结构以及张量原生 (tensor-native) 的分块校正与更新策略是鲁棒补全的关键，且带来了可观的存储和计算节省。

papers.title: A Physics-Flavored Transformer Network for Parametrizing Contraction Dynamics of Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues
papers.abstract_en: Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues (ESMs) have become a key structure for biomedical disease modeling and pharmacological screening, yet their functional characterization often relies on simplistic metrics like peak force, discarding critical kinetic information. This is partially due to the high level of mathematical complexity which mechanistic models introduce to capture these dynamics. Hence, exactly the complexity prevents scalable application and widespread adaptation in the field. Here we present a Physics-Flavored Neural Network (PFNN) that automates the kinetic phenotyping of ESMs. Our architecture integrates a stretched-exponential physical model into a CNN-Transformer, enabling the extraction of physically meaningful parameters directly from force-time profiles. To address the scarcity of labeled biological data, we employ a hybrid training paradigm: the model develops a "physical intuition" on synthetic data before undergoing unsupervised self-alignment on unlabeled real-world measurements. Our results demonstrate that this physics-flavored approach achieves high-fidelity parameterization across diverse contractile phenotypes and cell lines, including Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy models. Our scalable, self-improving pipeline bridges the gap between idealized biophysics and noisy \emph{in vitro} data, providing a robust tool for high-throughput biophysical research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理风味神经网络 (PFNN)，将 stretched-exponential 物理模型嵌入 CNN-Transformer 架构，直接从力-时间曲线中提取工程化骨骼肌组织 (ESM) 的动力学参数。采用先在合成数据上训练、再在无标签真实测量数据上进行无监督自对齐的混合训练范式，实现在多种收缩表型和细胞系（包括 Duchenne 肌营养不良模型）上的高保真参数化。
Motivation: ESM 的功能表征常依赖峰值力等简化指标，丢弃关键动力学信息；而机制模型因数学复杂难以规模化应用，因此需要一种自动化、可扩展的动力学表型分析方法。
Method: 提出 PFNN，将 stretched-exponential 物理模型集成进 CNN-Transformer，直接从力-时间曲线提取物理有意义的参数。训练采用混合范式：先在合成数据上建立物理直觉，再在无标签真实数据上进行无监督自对齐。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种收缩表型和细胞系（包括 Duchenne 肌营养不良模型）上实现高保真参数化，表明物理风味方法能有效应对多样化动力学的参数提取。
Conclusion: 该可扩展、自改进的流程弥合了理想生物物理与含噪声体外数据之间的差距，为高通量生物物理研究提供稳健工具。

papers.title: PRISM: Powerful Time Series to Image (TS2I) Representations for Multivariate Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) underpins applications in predictive maintenance, finance, and cloud computing, however performance remains sensitive to representation choices, especially in multivariate settings. While transforming time series into images has shown success in forecasting and classification, it remains unclear how multivariate, high-dimensional series should be mapped to multi-channel images and whether vision backbones can match time-domain baselines in TSAD. We introduce PRISM, a plug-and-play meta-workflow enabling systematic construction and evaluation of image-based representations for multivariate TSAD. Our evaluation spanning over 7,000 experiments shows that well-designed PRISM configurations are competitive with 24 time-domain baselines, achieving the best VUS-PR on 10 of 14 datasets, with an average improvement of 41% over the best competing method on those datasets. Further, we identify channelization - how the channel dimension of multi-channel images is constructed - as a critical and previously understudied design dimension, and introduce MSM, a novel statistics-based scheme achieving 11-27% gains over PCA-based alternatives. Finally, ImageNet-pretrained encoders transfer effectively to TSAD, with frozen encoders retaining 92% of fine-tuned performance while training 1.8 times faster. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Smendowski/PRISM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM，一个即插即用的元工作流 (meta-workflow)，用于系统地构建和评估面向多元时间序列异常检测 (multivariate TSAD) 的图像表示。作者在超过 7,000 个实验中将 PRISM 配置与 24 个时域基线对比，在 14 个数据集中的 10 个上取得最佳 VUS-PR，并在这些数据集上平均比最优竞争方法提升 41%。研究还识别出通道化 (channelization) 这一被忽视的设计维度，并提出基于统计的 MSM 方案；此外，ImageNet 预训练编码器可有效迁移到 TSAD。
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测 (TSAD) 对表示选择敏感，尤其在多元场景下表现不稳定。将时间序列转为图像在预测和分类任务上已展现潜力，但多元高维序列应如何映射为多通道图像、以及视觉骨干网络能否匹敌时域基线，此前尚不清楚。
Method: 引入 PRISM 元工作流，以即插即用方式系统构造和评估多元 TSAD 的图像化表示。重点研究通道化 (channelization) 这一多通道图像通道维度的构造方式，并提出新的基于统计学的 MSM 方案，替代 PCA 类通道构造方法。
Result: 在超过 7,000 个实验中，精心设计的 PRISM 配置在 14 个数据集中的 10 个上达到最佳 VUS-PR，平均比最优竞争方法提升 41%；MSM 方案相比 PCA 类方案获得 11-27% 的提升；冻结的 ImageNet 预训练编码器可保留微调性能的 92%，训练速度快 1.8 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为，经过良好设计的图像化表示能够使视觉模型与 24 个时域基线竞争，其中通道化是关键的此前未充分研究的设计维度；预训练视觉编码器为 TSAD 提供高效迁移方案。代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GeoMAR: Unleashing Geometrically Aligned Features for Masked Autoregressive Blind Face Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Codebook-based blind face restoration (BFR) often suffers from ambiguous conditioning features and a fragile prediction mechanism under severe degradation. To address these challenges, we propose GeoMAR, a framework designed to unleash geometrically aligned features with masked autoregressive (MAR) refinement for robust face restoration. For feature conditioning, we introduce a dual-input extraction pipeline to extract component-based geometric descriptions with explicit, spatially faithful anchors. These textual priors are integrated with low-quality (LQ) features via an Aligned Geometric Priors Injector, which employs a KV-Q exchange strategy to generate geometrically aligned features. For prediction mechanism, we reformulate the one-step mapping into a multi-step MAR process. This coarse-to-fine generation progressively refines complex facial regions based on increasingly reliable context. Experiments on one synthetic and three real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GeoMAR achieves highly competitive perceptual quality and coherent visual structures compared with existing methods. The code is available at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/GeoMAR.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoMAR，一个基于码本 (codebook) 的盲人脸恢复 (blind face restoration, BFR) 框架，针对严重退化下条件特征模糊和预测机制脆弱的问题。方法通过双输入提取管道获得组件级几何描述，并用对齐几何先验注入器 (Aligned Geometric Priors Injector) 结合低质量特征，同时将一步映射改为多步掩码自回归 (masked autoregressive, MAR) 粗到细生成。实验在一个合成和三个真实世界基准上表明其感知质量和结构连贯性具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有基于码本的盲人脸恢复在严重退化下常受限于模糊的条件特征和脆弱的单步预测机制，导致恢复结果不稳定、结构不自然。
Method: 提出双输入提取管道提取带有显式空间锚点的组件级几何描述，作为文本先验与低质量特征结合；使用 KV-Q 交换策略的对齐几何先验注入器生成几何对齐特征；并将一步映射重构为多步 MAR 粗到细生成过程，逐步基于更可靠的上下文细化复杂面部区域。
Result: 在一个合成和三个真实世界基准上，GeoMAR 相比现有方法取得具有竞争力的感知质量和连贯的视觉结构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调借助几何对齐特征与掩码自回归逐步细化，可以有效改善严重退化下的盲人脸恢复鲁棒性，并公开代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Transformer Revolution, Part 1: Dynamic Processing through Output- Weight Interconnections
papers.abstract_en: This paper offers a new interpretation of the Transformer during inference. Against the "stochastic parrot" view that large language models merely reproduce statistical regularities learned in training, we argue that Transformers construct and apply prompt-dependent transformations whose parameters are generated during inference. We call this form of computation SIDPP: Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing. The Transformer is interpreted as a system that transforms concepts by means of concepts. Token vectors are the concepts to be transformed; parameterized transformations defined by matrices and vectors are the transforming concepts. These may be static, when fixed through training, or dynamic, when generated from the input sequence. Mechanically, they correspond to groups of simple neural networks. The Transformer's architectural novelty lies in output-weight interconnections, through which the outputs of some networks determine the weights of others, alongside ordinary output-input interconnections. By means of these interconnections, the system constructs transformations from the prompt and uses them to modify token representations. The contribution of dynamic processing grows with prompt length and may equal or exceed that of static processing, a phenomenon we call strong prompt sensitivity. This account bears on interpretability, predictability, control, and the design of smaller, more sustainable systems. Finally, since the human neural system possesses the mechanisms required to implement SIDPP, we argue that a form of SIDPP may, in principle, be neurally realized in the cerebral cortex. We therefore conjecture that human language processing may itself be a form of SIDPP produced by a functional architecture relevantly similar to that of the Transformer.
papers.comment: v1: 7 Sections, References, Appendix, Tables (2 tables), Figures Part A (6 figures), Figures Part B (42 figures), Figures Part C (5 figures)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对 Transformer 推理过程的一种新解释，反对将大语言模型视为仅复现训练统计规律的“随机鹦鹉”（stochastic parrot）观点，主张 Transformer 在推理时会构建并应用由提示词生成的参数化变换，作者称之为 SIDPP（Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing）。该框架把 token 向量视为被变换的概念、参数化变换视为进行变换的概念，并强调架构新意在于输出-权重互连（output-weight interconnections）。摘要的核心理论主张是动态处理的贡献随提示长度增长并可能达到或超过静态处理，作者称之为强提示敏感性（strong prompt sensitivity）。
Motivation: 针对大语言模型被贬为“随机鹦鹉”、认为其只是复现训练数据统计规律的观点，作者希望从推理时的动态处理机制出发给出新的解释框架。该框架的目的在于服务于可解释性、可预测性、可控性以及设计更小、更可持续的系统。
Method: 提出 SIDPP 解释框架：token 向量是被变换的概念，由矩阵和向量定义的参数化变换是变换概念，变换可静态（训练固定）或动态（由输入序列生成），机制上对应一组简单神经网络。关键在于输出-权重互连，即部分网络的输出决定另一部分网络的权重，与普通输出-输入互连并列，系统据此从提示词构造变换并修改 token 表示。
Result: 摘要给出的核心结论是理论性的：动态处理的贡献随提示长度增长，可能等于或超过静态处理，即“强提示敏感性”。摘要未报告具体数值实验；论文本身包含 2 个表格及 42 幅左右的图（分三部分），但具体结果未在摘要中量化。
Conclusion: 作者认为该解释有助于可解释性、可预测性、可控性以及更小可持续系统的设计；并猜测人脑皮层具备实现 SIDPP 的机制，进而推测人类语言处理本身可能是一种与 Transformer 功能架构相关的 SIDPP 形式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Equivariant Music Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Humans recognize a musical passage even when it is shifted in time or transposed in pitch, indicating a notion of equivariance in the representation space. Our analysis, however, shows that standard music transformers map such time-shifted or pitch-transposed inputs onto uncorrelated representations: these models become progressively less equivariant as they scale in size or train longer. This suggests that in standard music transformers, additional model capacity is allocated to memorizing absolute patterns rather than capturing shared musical structures. In this paper, we propose the Equivariant Music Transformer (EMT), which enforces equivariance through self-distillation by jointly optimizing a next-token-prediction and an auxiliary equivariance regularization loss. We find that the additional equivariance loss acts as a beneficial regularizer, simultaneously improving next-token prediction and producing equivariant latent representations. Through both objective and subjective evaluations, EMT demonstrates superior equivariance and generative capability compared to data augmentation, feature engineering, and state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. More broadly, our findings reveal that standard language modeling methods alone do not capture music's translational symmetries, and dedicated inductive biases are required to produce better music representations. The code, weights and demos are available online.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析发现标准音乐Transformer对时间平移或音高转置的输入会映射到不相关的表示，且模型规模越大、训练时间越长，等变性反而越差。作者提出Equivariant Music Transformer (EMT)，通过自蒸馏联合优化下一token预测与辅助等变正则化损失，在客观和主观评估中均优于数据增强、特征工程和SOTA基线。
Motivation: 人类能识别经过时间平移或音高转置的音乐片段，说明表示空间应具备等变性；但标准音乐Transformer缺乏该性质，且越大的模型或越长时间的训练会把更多容量用于记忆绝对模式而非共享音乐结构。
Method: 提出EMT，通过自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 强制等变性，具体是联合优化next-token-prediction损失与辅助的等变正则化 (equivariance regularization) 损失。
Result: 额外的等变损失作为有益正则化，同时改善下一token预测并产生等变的潜在表示；在客观与主观评估中，EMT的等变性和生成能力均优于数据增强、特征工程及SOTA基线。
Conclusion: 标准语言建模方法本身不足以捕捉音乐的平移对称性，需要专门的归纳偏置才能生成更好的音乐表示；代码、权重和演示已在线公开。

papers.title: Low-Dimensional High-Leverage Subspace Optimization: Beyond Full-Parameter Coupled Training for Neural Network Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization suffers severe accuracy degradation on compact networks, rooted in the dominant full-parameter coupled training paradigm that ignores parameter subspace heterogeneity. Their limited feature redundancy leaves little room to absorb quantization errors. Conventional pipelines adopt monolithic optimization: PTQ reconstructs fixed pretrained models without improving inherent quantization friendliness; QAT updates all parameters jointly, suffering from gradient coupling between backbone weights and calibration parameters. In this paper, we identify normalization affine parameters as a low-dimensional high-leverage subspace dominating quantization robustness, and propose Normalization Affine Preconditioning (NAP) for targeted subspace optimization. For PTQ, NAP freezes backbone weights and fine-tunes only affine parameters under the target fake-quantization graph on full-precision models, proactively boosting quantization friendliness before downstream reconstruction. For QAT, we introduce an alternating QAT-NAP schema that decouples feature learning and numerical calibration, breaking the performance ceiling of saturated joint training. Theoretical analysis confirms BN affine parameters fully cancel the channel-wise affine component of quantization distortion, while nonlinear rounding and clipping residuals form the irreducible error boundary; distillation-guided NAP acts as directional flatness optimization, projecting teacher-student logit mismatch onto the restricted subspace. Experiments on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 show NAP recovers severely collapsed low-bit quantization, consistently boosts reconstruction-based PTQ, and outperforms saturated full-parameter QAT with negligible tuning cost. This work reveals the principle of targeted low-dimensional subspace optimization, offering a new perspective beyond full-parameter coupled training for efficient deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低比特量化在紧凑网络上精度严重下降的问题，指出传统全参数耦合训练忽视参数子空间异质性，并提出 Normalization Affine Preconditioning (NAP) 进行定向子空间优化。作者识别归一化仿射参数为低维高杠杆子空间，在 PTQ 中冻结主干并仅微调仿射参数，在 QAT 中采用交替的 QAT-NAP 模式以解耦特征学习与数值校准。理论分析表明 BN 仿射参数可完全抵消量化失真的逐通道仿射分量，实验在 ImageNet 和 CIFAR-100 上显示 NAP 能恢复严重崩溃的低比特量化并超越饱和的全参数 QAT。
Motivation: 低比特量化在紧凑网络上的性能退化源于传统全参数耦合训练范式忽视参数子空间异质性，而紧凑网络有限的特征冗余难以吸收量化误差；现有 PTQ 只做后重建而不提升量化友好性，QAT 联合更新所有参数则受主干权重与校准参数之间的梯度耦合限制。
Method: 提出 Normalization Affine Preconditioning (NAP)：对 PTQ，冻结主干权重、在目标伪量化图下仅微调仿射参数以主动提升量化友好性；对 QAT，引入交替 QAT-NAP 训练范式解耦特征学习与数值校准；理论部分分析 BN 仿射参数对量化失真的抵消机制，并将蒸馏引导的 NAP 解释为限制子空间内的方向性平坦性优化。
Result: ImageNet 和 CIFAR-100 实验表明，NAP 能恢复严重崩溃的低比特量化、一致提升基于重建的 PTQ，并以可忽略的调参成本超过饱和的全参数 QAT。
Conclusion: 本文论证了在紧凑网络上，针对低维高杠杆子空间（即归一化仿射参数）的定向优化可以替代全参数耦合训练，为高效深度学习的量化提供新视角。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When and Where to Look: Adaptive Visual Evidence Scheduling for Efficient Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Efficient long-video understanding requires vision--language models (VLMs) to reason over a small number of frames selected as sparse visual evidence. Existing relevance-based methods rely on static one-shot selection with fixed frame budgets and candidate pools, while agent-based schedulers achieve adaptivity through costly multi-round reasoning and interactive search. We propose EcoFrame, a training-free framework for low-overhead query-adaptive visual evidence scheduling. EcoFrame leverages the VLM's inference feedback to determine when to increase the frame budget and where to search for additional candidate evidence. Specifically, entropy-gated budget scheduling uses output uncertainty to stop early when the current evidence is sufficient or progressively expand the frame budget otherwise. Meanwhile, attention-guided candidate proposal converts frame-level attention into a temporal prior, enabling dense local search in informative regions while preserving global coverage when attention is diffuse. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate that EcoFrame achieves a better accuracy--efficiency trade-off across multiple VLM backbones. On Qwen2.5-VL, EcoFrame achieves an average accuracy of 64.4, surpassing BOLT at 63.5, while providing a $1.85\times$ speedup over AKS and BOLT. Compared with the agent-based A.I.R., EcoFrame maintains comparable accuracy with up to a $13.5\times$ inference speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/EcoFrame.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EcoFrame，一个无需训练的查询自适应视觉证据调度框架，用于高效长视频理解。EcoFrame 利用 VLM 的推理反馈，通过熵门控预算调度决定何时增加帧预算或提前停止，并通过注意力引导的候选提议在信息密集区域进行局部搜索。在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 MLVU 上的实验表明，它在多个 VLM 主干上取得更好的精度-效率权衡，例如在 Qwen2.5-VL 上平均准确率 64.4，超过 BOLT 的 63.5，同时相对 AKS 和 BOLT 获得 1.85 倍加速，相对基于智能体的 A.I.R. 获得最高 13.5 倍推理加速。
Motivation: 现有基于相关性的长视频理解方法依赖固定帧预算和候选池的静态一次性选择，而基于智能体的调度器通过昂贵的多轮推理实现自适应。需要一种低开销、查询自适应的视觉证据调度方案。
Method: EcoFrame 采用两方面的机制：熵门控预算调度根据输出不确定性决定是否提前停止或逐步扩大帧预算；注意力引导的候选提议将帧级注意力转化为时间先验，在信息丰富区域进行密集局部搜索，并在注意力分散时保持全局覆盖。整体框架无需训练，直接利用 VLM 的推理反馈。
Result: 在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 MLVU 上，EcoFrame 在多个 VLM 主干上取得更好的准确率-效率权衡。在 Qwen2.5-VL 上平均准确率 64.4，优于 BOLT 的 63.5；相对 AKS 和 BOLT 提供 1.85 倍加速，相对基于智能体的 A.I.R. 在保持相近准确率的同时提供最高 13.5 倍推理加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EcoFrame 作为无需训练的调度框架，能够以低开销实现查询自适应的视觉证据选择，在长视频理解中显著改善精度与效率的权衡，尤其相比基于智能体的方法大幅降低推理代价。

papers.title: Implementing Causal Perception: Competing SCMs and Situated Fairness
papers.abstract_en: Causal perception occurs when agents with competing Structural Causal Models (SCMs) of the same system infer different probability distributions, including the hypothetical distributions implied by each agent's SCM under the same set of interventions. It shapes how agents reason about the system and how they perceive its fairness. Causal perception is a promising probabilistic framework, but it has remained purely theoretical. This work provides the first implementation of the causal perception framework of Álvarez and Ruggieri (2025). We operationalize structural (agents disagree on the causal graph) and parametrical (agents agree on the causal graph but disagree on its weights) causal perception. We design algorithms for computing interventional and counterfactual distributions and propose suitable distance measures to quantify the disagreement. Using the German Credit dataset, we illustrate how causal perception affects accuracy and fairness in a multi-expert decision setting. We show that the perception verdict is sensitive to the choice of distance metric and threshold. We also show that causal perception changes fairness assessments and threshold-based decisions. Bias proves situated with respect to the agent's SCM, demonstrating that competing worldviews in fairness problems cannot be ignored.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次实现 Álvarez 和 Ruggieri（2025）提出的因果感知（causal perception）框架，将结构型与参数型因果感知操作化，并设计算法计算干预分布与反事实分布，用距离度量量化不同智能体（agent）之间的分歧。作者在 German Credit 数据集上的多专家决策场景中展示，因果感知会改变公平性评估和基于阈值的决策，且感知判定对距离度量和阈值的选择敏感。
Motivation: 因果感知虽然为竞争性结构因果模型（SCMs）下的公平性推理提供了有前景的概率框架，但此前一直停留在纯理论层面，缺少具体实现和实证检验。
Method: 将因果感知操作化为结构型（智能体对因果图有分歧）与参数型（智能体共享因果图但权重不同）两类，设计计算干预分布和反事实分布的算法，并提出合适的距离度量来量化分歧。
Result: 在 German Credit 数据集上，因果感知影响多专家决策场景中的准确率与公平性；感知判定对距离度量和阈值敏感，且因果感知会改变公平性评估与基于阈值的决策。
Conclusion: 偏差（bias）相对于智能体的 SCM 是情境化的，说明公平性问题中竞争性世界观不能被忽略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trajectory inference via Acceleration Matching
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory inference is a fundamental problem in many scientific domains: given a collection of unpaired snapshots of observations at discrete time points, the goal is to generate smooth trajectories that best resemble and interpolate the data. Existing algorithms exhibit computational challenges: they either rely on preprocessing subroutines to enforce smoothness or on simulation-based training objectives, both of which can be expensive. In order to overcome these limitations, we propose a new algorithm called Acceleration Matching (\texttt{AM}). Our approach consists of lifting the original interpolation problem to phase space and then regressing onto an explicit conditional acceleration field that induces random, smooth trajectories that agree with the prescribed marginals. Importantly, our resulting training algorithm only requires positional data, avoids trajectory simulation during training, and is devoid of expensive preprocessing. We provide ample numerical evidence suggesting that \texttt{AM} is competitive with or superior to existing algorithms on several benchmark problems from the existing literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出加速度匹配（Acceleration Matching, AM）算法，用于轨迹推断（trajectory inference）：给定离散时间点上未配对的观测快照，生成与数据匹配的光滑轨迹。方法将插值问题提升到相空间（phase space），回归一个显式的条件加速度场，从而诱导随机、光滑且满足给定边际分布的轨迹。训练只需位置数据，避免训练中的轨迹模拟和昂贵的预处理。数值实验表明 AM 在多个基准问题上与现有算法竞争力相当或更优。
Motivation: 现有轨迹推断算法要么依赖预处理子程序来强制光滑性，要么使用基于模拟的训练目标，两者都可能计算昂贵。该工作旨在消除这些额外开销，使训练更高效。
Method: 将原始插值问题提升到相空间，回归到显式的条件加速度场（conditional acceleration field），该场诱导随机、光滑且与指定边际分布一致的轨迹。训练算法仅需位置数据，不需要在训练过程中模拟轨迹，也不需要昂贵预处理。
Result: 摘要报告数值证据表明 AM 在文献中的多个基准问题上与现有算法竞争力相当或更优；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该算法避免了轨迹模拟和预处理，仅依赖位置数据即可训练，并在多个基准上表现有竞争力。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight matrix into two sparse factors whose shared intermediate coordinates serve as individually addressable circuit units. Without training a separate replacement network, this parametric representation supports the same scoring, selection, and ablation circuit extraction workflow used for methods that learn sparse features. Across single-matrix replacements, SWD matches the held-out fidelity achieved by Transcoder and other strong baselines while using less than 1% of the data that those baselines use to train their replacements. For matched replacement fidelity, SWD reaches the same circuit sufficiency and necessity targets with fewer active read/write edges and selected units across tasks on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3.5-27B. We further show that SWD remains effective for full-model replacement of all attention and MLP weight matrices after fine-tuning the nonzero factor values. Finally, SWD also features a zero-data variant, allowing broader use of mechanistic interpretability analysis (e.g., per-step analysis).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD)，将预训练线性层的权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子，其共享中间坐标作为可单独寻址的电路单元，无需训练替代网络即可进行评分、选择和消融的电路提取流程。摘要报告 SWD 在单矩阵替换中达到与 Transcoder 等基线相当的保持保真度，但仅使用不到 1% 的训练数据，并在 GPT-2、Qwen2.5、Qwen3.5-27B 上以更少的活跃读写边和选定单元达到相同的电路充分性与必要性目标；此外还支持全模型替换和零数据变体。
Motivation: 密集预训练 Transformer 并不自然暴露可用于电路提取的可解释单元。现有方法通过学习辅助稀疏表示或训练稀疏模型来获得这类单元，既带来大量额外计算，也可能在分析与原始预训练模型之间引入保真度差距。
Method: SWD 将每个权重矩阵重参数化为两个稀疏因子的乘积，中间共享坐标充当可寻址电路单元；不训练替代网络，直接复用基于稀疏特征方法的评分、选择和消融工作流。论文还提出对非零因子微调以实现全模型替换，以及一个零数据变体。
Result: 在单矩阵替换中，SWD 达到与 Transcoder 等强基线相当的保持保真度，而训练数据不到后者的 1%；在匹配的替换保真度下，SWD 用更少的活跃读/写边和选定单元达到相同的电路充分性与必要性目标。全模型替换和零数据变体也被报道有效。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 SWD 通过稀疏权重分解实现高效电路提取，大幅降低对替代模型训练数据的需求，并支持零数据机制可解释性分析（如逐步骤分析）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamDAM: Presence-Aware Memory for Real-Time Streaming Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Quality-tier video object segmentation (VOS) trackers such as DAM4SAM top accuracy leaderboards, but they are measured offline, one frame at a time with no clock. Under an honest streaming protocol at 30 frames per second, where a frame that misses its budget is served the last mask already computed, the winner collapses: the rich memory that makes it accurate is too slow to keep up, and what it emits is blind to whether the object is even present. We trace both failures to one place, the tracker's memory pipeline, and rebuild it for streaming. \method{} makes the memory machinery itself run at frame rate through in-model optimization rather than a bolted-on fallback, and governs it with a single learned presence signal that decides what enters memory, how far back the tracker reads, when to withhold output, and when to re-detect. A mechanism analysis shows why a fixed policy cannot win: the control that helps when an object truly disappears is the one that hurts when it is merely hard to see, so the choice must be made per frame. Across four benchmarks and five modern baselines, \method{} is the strongest streaming tracker, recovers nearly all of the offline model's accuracy under the clock, and on the hardest content exceeds the offline model it is built from.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamDAM，一种面向实时流式视频目标分割 (streaming video object segmentation) 的显存机制，核心思路是用单一学习到的存在性信号 (presence signal) 统一控制记忆写入、回溯读取范围、输出抑制与重检测。摘要称该方法通过模型内优化让记忆机制本身达到帧率运行，并在四个基准和五个现代基线上成为最强的流式跟踪器，同时几乎恢复离线模型的精度。
Motivation: 高质量的 VOS 跟踪器（如 DAM4SAM）在离线逐帧评测中精度领先，但在 30fps 的诚实流式协议下会崩溃：丰富记忆的计算速度跟不上，且其输出对目标是否仍然存在不敏感；作者将这两个失败均追溯到跟踪器的记忆流水线。
Method: 重建记忆流水线，通过模型内优化 (in-model optimization) 而非外挂回退机制，使记忆机制本身达到帧率运行；并用一个学习的 presence signal 决定哪些内容进入记忆、跟踪器回溯多远、何时抑制输出以及何时重新检测。
Result: 在四个基准和五个现代基线上，StreamDAM 是最强的流式跟踪器，能在时钟约束下恢复离线模型几乎全部的精度，并在最难的内容上超过其构建所基于的离线模型。
Conclusion: 固定策略无法同时应对目标真正消失与仅难以看清两种情况，因为对前者有效的控制在后者反而有害，因此必须逐帧做出决策；摘要强调逐帧存在性控制是流式 VOS 的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniEvo-RS: Omni-Prompt Unified Remote Sensing Segmentation with Representative Exemplar-Driven Prototype Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-driven vision-language models (VLMs) hold immense promise for accelerating dense remote sensing (RS) annotation, but static models suffer from severe performance degradation when deployed on novel scenes, unseen categories, or visually confusing backgrounds. Moreover, existing unified paradigms primarily rely on intra-image specific prompts, lacking flexible task routing to adapt to multi-intent operational workflows. In practical batch mapping, annotators typically refine a small set of representative samples before processing large datasets. Motivated by this practice, we propose UniEvo-RS, an omni-prompt unified RS segmentation framework equipped with representative exemplar-driven prototype evolution. First, we construct a multi-instruction prompt dataset that unifies text-driven and visual-driven prompts within a single architecture, establishing a dynamic task-routing mechanism for highly diverse RS annotation scenarios. Second, we introduce a representative feedback-driven, training-free prototype evolution mechanism. By contrasting manual annotations with initial predictions on exemplars, UniEvo-RS distills prediction errors into positive and negative prototypes. These prototypes enhance LLM query recall and suppress spatial background noise under a fixed-budget clustering memory. Extensive experiments show that UniEvo-RS unifies diverse prompting tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance across most settings. Crucially, with minimal interaction on a few exemplars, it enables training-free, progressive accuracy enhancement on unseen categories during batch annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniEvo-RS，一个面向遥感影像的统一提示分割框架（omni-prompt unified RS segmentation），将文本驱动与视觉驱动提示统一到单一架构中，并引入基于代表性示例反馈的原型演化机制（prototype evolution）。该方法在多种提示任务上取得最优性能，并能在少量人工标注示例的交互下，以无需训练的方式逐步提升对未见过类别的分割精度。
Motivation: 现有的提示驱动视觉语言模型在遥感场景中面对新场景、未见类别或视觉混淆背景时性能退化严重，且统一分割范式主要依赖图像内特定提示，缺乏适应多意图工作流的灵活任务路由。作者从实际批量制图中标注者先精修少量代表性样本再处理大数据的做法出发，希望让模型也利用这种少量交互反馈。
Method: 构建一个多指令提示数据集，将文本驱动和视觉驱动提示统一在同一架构内，并建立动态任务路由机制；同时提出无需训练、基于代表性反馈的原型演化机制，通过对比人工标注与初始预测，将预测误差提炼为正负原型，并在固定预算聚类记忆下增强 LLM 查询召回、抑制空间背景噪声。
Result: 实验表明 UniEvo-RS 能统一多种提示任务，在大多数设置下达到当前最优性能；在仅对少量示例进行最小交互的情况下，能够在批量标注过程中以无需训练的方式逐步提升对未见过类别的精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调，代表性示例驱动的原型演化可以低成本地利用少量人工标注反馈，逐步提升遥感分割模型在批量标注中的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0
