papers.title: Socially Grounded Agentic AI: Coordinating Plural Perspectives through Social Theory
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse social contexts, alignment can no longer be framed as the optimization of a single, unified set of values. Instead, systems must be able to recognize, represent, and respond to multiple legitimate perspectives. This has led to growing interest in pluralistic alignment, which seeks to move beyond one-size-fits-all models of appropriate behaviour. However, current approaches often lack a clear account of how values are socially organized, contested, and coordinated in practice. In this paper, we argue that social theory provides essential conceptual and design resources for addressing these challenges. Drawing on established traditions in sociology, we show how perspectives can be understood as structured by roles, shaped through interaction, and distributed across fields of power and expertise. We translate these insights into concrete implications for AI system design, including role-based representations, structured coordination among perspectives, and context-sensitive evaluation. For agentic systems, this requires aligning not only final outputs, but also the role activations, deliberative traces, aggregation rules, and feedback loops through which those outputs are produced. Our contribution is to reposition pluralistic alignment as a problem of socially grounded coordination rather than output diversification. We outline a design space for systems that engage multiple perspectives in structured and accountable ways, and we identify directions for future work to implement and empirically evaluate these approaches in real-world settings.
papers.comment: Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为AI对齐不应被理解为对单一统一价值集的优化，而需在多样化社会情境中识别、表征并回应多种合法观点。作者借鉴社会学理论，将观点理解为由角色结构化、通过互动形成并分布在权力与专业知识领域中的产物，并把多元化对齐重新定位为社会性协调问题，而非简单的输出多样化。论文面向智能体系统提出包括基于角色的表征、结构化协调机制和情境敏感评估在内的设计方向，但未提供实验验证。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法通常假设存在一套统一的价值标准，难以适应多样化的社会部署场景；多元化对齐虽已受到关注，但缺乏对价值观如何在社会中被组织、争论和协调的清晰理论说明。
Method: 引入社会学传统作为概念与设计资源，提出将观点视为由角色、互动和权力分布所塑造的结构，并把该视角转化为AI系统设计含义，强调智能体对齐应覆盖角色激活、审议轨迹、聚合规则和反馈回路等产出过程。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果或定量指标，主要贡献是概念性的：把多元化对齐重新定义为基于社会理论的协调问题，并勾勒出结构化和可问责地协调多视角系统的设计空间。
Conclusion: 论文主张以社会性的协调框架替代输出多样性范式，并指出未来需要在真实世界环境中实现和实证评估这些方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Efficiency Becomes Fragility: Exploiting Dynamic Routing Vulnerabilities in Adaptive UAV Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Resource constraints on UAV platforms have driven a paradigm shift in aerial tracking, from pursuing performance toward balancing accuracy with efficiency. Adaptive Transformer Trackers, which leverage an input-dependent dynamic routing architecture, have emerged as a representative solution to this challenge. However, we reveal that behind this computation-on-demand flexibility hides a critical structural flaw: the Lipschitz singularity of computational path decisions, which has an unbounded local Lipschitz constant at discrete layer-skipping decision boundaries. This mathematical discontinuity renders adaptive tracking networks inherently unstable: tiny input perturbations can be amplified at the gating modules, causing dramatic changes in the inference topology. We formally characterize this singularity in the context of adaptive tracking architectures and, for the first time, identify it as a directly exploitable new attack surface. This insight reveals a previously overlooked and highly vulnerable topological path space attack surface. Based on this, we propose the Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) framework. API generates imperceptible perturbations to precisely manipulate the gating decisions, forcing the inference onto altered computational paths. The severe inconsistency between the original and the inverted paths dismantles the representation capability of the model. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art adaptive trackers demonstrate that API achieves superior perturbation stealthiness, more effective attack, and faster inference speeds. This work opens a new dimension for the security analysis of dynamic tracking networks and provides a theoretical warning for constructing robust adaptive tracking architectures in the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对UAV平台上自适应Transformer跟踪器的动态路由架构，揭示其计算路径决策存在Lipschitz奇异性：在离散的层跳过决策边界处局部Lipschitz常数无界，导致微小输入扰动可被门控模块放大并显著改变推理拓扑。作者首次将此数学不连续性识别为可直接利用的攻击面，并提出对抗路径反转（Adversarial Path-Inversion, API）框架，通过不可感知扰动操纵门控决策、迫使推理进入改变后的计算路径，破坏模型表示能力。在多个最先进自适应跟踪器上的实验表明API具有更好的扰动隐蔽性、更强的攻击效果和更快的推理速度。
Motivation: UAV平台资源受限使得跟踪器从追求精度转向平衡精度与效率，自适应Transformer跟踪器为此采用输入依赖的动态路由，但其门控决策的数学不连续性构成被忽视的结构性缺陷，形成新的安全攻击面。
Method: 形式化刻画自适应跟踪架构中计算路径决策的Lipschitz奇异性，提出API框架：生成不可感知扰动以精确操纵门控决策，使推理被迫进入改变后的计算路径，利用原始路径与反转路径间的严重不一致来破坏网络表示能力。
Result: 在多个最先进的adaptive trackers上，API相比现有方法取得了更优的扰动隐蔽性、更强的攻击有效性以及更快的推理速度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该工作为动态跟踪网络的安全分析开辟新维度，并对未来构建鲁棒自适应跟踪架构提出理论警示；其安全分析针对动态跟踪网络，未涉及其他应用领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NCGR: Noise-Conditional Gated Rectification for Camera Extrinsic Perturbations in BEV 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based bird's-eye-view (BEV) 3D detection typically assumes accurate and fixed camera extrinsics. In detectors using spatial cross-attention (SCA), extrinsic perturbations displace the image-plane projections of BEV reference points, causing queries to sample features from incorrect regions and degrading detection performance. To address this failure mode, Noise-Conditional Gated Rectification (NCGR) is proposed to compensate for projection errors without explicitly estimating a full six-degree-of-freedom extrinsic correction. For each query-camera pair, a 2D rectification offset is predicted and modulated by a camera-level gate to rectify the base projection before native deformable sampling. During training, the perturbation-derived quantities used to construct the condition and gate are gradually replaced through scheduled interpolation by counterparts generated from an auxiliary scalar predicted from camera features. This transition enables blind inference without perturbation metadata. During training, a weight-shared clean-teacher/perturbed-student pair is used, and the rectification module is supervised by a BEV-consistency objective between the two branches. NCGR is evaluated on nuScenes with simulated dynamic and static extrinsic perturbations. In a five-camera dynamic stress test, NCGR achieves 39.69% NDS, compared with 28.00% for BEVFormer and 33.23% for CAPE. Under clean extrinsics, NCGR maintains performance comparable to that of BEVFormer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于相机的鸟瞰图 (BEV) 3D 检测中相机外参扰动导致的性能退化问题，提出噪声条件门控修正 (NCGR)。NCGR 不显式估计完整的六自由度外参修正，而是为每个 query-camera 对预测一个 2D 修正偏移，并由相机级门控调制后再进行可变形采样。训练时通过计划插值将扰动派生量逐步替换为由相机特征预测的辅助标量，从而支持无扰动元数据的盲推理，并用权重共享的干净教师/扰动学生分支和 BEV 一致性目标监督修正模块。
Motivation: 基于空间交叉注意力 (SCA) 的 BEV 检测器通常假设外参准确且固定；外参扰动会使 BEV 参考点在图像平面的投影发生偏移，导致 query 从错误区域采样特征，检测性能下降。
Method: 提出 NCGR：为每个 query-camera 对预测 2D 修正偏移，叠加到基础投影上，并用相机级门控调节该修正；训练阶段通过计划插值，把用于构造条件和门控的扰动派生量逐渐替换为由相机特征预测的辅助标量，使推理阶段无需扰动元数据；同时使用权重共享的干净教师/扰动学生分支，以 BEV 一致性目标监督修正模块。
Result: 在 nuScenes 的模拟动态和静态外参扰动评估中，五相机动态压力测试下 NCGR 达到 39.69% NDS，而 BEVFormer 为 28.00%、CAPE 为 33.23%；在清洁外参下，NCGR 性能与 BEVFormer 相当。
Conclusion: NCGR 能补偿投影误差而无需完整外参修正，并在推理时无需扰动信息即可工作；其有效性在 nuScenes 的模拟扰动场景中得到验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Production deployments often swap between different-sized models in a family for cost-quality cascading, mid-conversation switching, and routing, and each swap forces the receiver to repay the prefill from scratch. We propose cross-model KV cache transfer, where the receiver reuses the source's KV cache, skipping prefill. We find that cross-model KV has substantial linear structure across matched-KV pairs, where source and target share KV head count and per-head dimension. On Qwen3 14B->32B, one source layer explains 56% of variance in the target's keys and 32% in values, rising to 79% and 65% with multiple source layers. Building on this, we design a closed-form ridge mapper that operates per head and proceeds in three steps. First, for each target layer we select the top-k most predictive source layers and concatenate their KV as input. Second, we strip RoPE from the keys before mapping, so the fit is position-free and reusable across context lengths. Third, we fit ridge regression on a small calibration set of 500 FineWeb-Edu sequences of 1,024 tokens each. Surprisingly, across six pairs in three families, this linear mapper retains 73-98% of the receiver's standalone-prefill accuracy on four pairs, while two degrade sharply. A nonlinear MLP recovers up to +37 pp HellaSwag retention on the failures. The mapper runs 2.7-25x faster than re-prefill and remains stable across multi-turn handoff, making cross-model KV cache transfer practical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨模型 KV 缓存迁移 (cross-model KV cache transfer)，让同一模型家族中不同尺寸模型在切换时复用源模型的 KV 缓存、跳过重新 prefill。作者发现匹配的 KV 对之间存在显著线性结构，并据此设计了一个封闭式岭回归映射器 (closed-form ridge mapper)，按 head 进行、先选择最可预测的源层、映射前去掉 RoPE 使拟合与位置无关。在六个模型对上，线性映射器在四个对上保留了接收模型独立 prefill 精度的 73-98%，两个对则显著退化；非线性 MLP 可恢复最多 +37 pp 的 HellaSwag 保留率，且映射比重新 prefill 快 2.7-25 倍。
Motivation: 生产部署常因成本-质量级联、对话中切换和路由而在这类模型家族的不同尺寸模型之间切换，每次切换都迫使接收模型从头支付 prefill 计算开销。
Method: 提出跨模型 KV 缓存迁移：先按层选取 top-k 个最具预测性的源层并拼接其 KV 作为输入；在映射前去除 keys 的 RoPE，使拟合与位置无关并可跨上下文长度复用；然后用 500 条 1,024-token 的 FineWeb-Edu 序列作为校准集，为每个 head 拟合岭回归；对线性映射失败的情况进一步使用非线性 MLP 恢复精度。
Result: 在 Qwen3 14B->32B 上，单个源层可解释目标 keys 的 56% 方差和 values 的 32% 方差，使用多个源层时提升到 79% 和 65%。跨三个家族共六对模型，四个对保留了接收模型独立 prefill 精度的 73-98%，两个对显著退化；MLP 在失败情况下可恢复最多 +37 pp 的 HellaSwag 保留率；映射器运行速度比重新 prefill 快 2.7-25 倍，并在多轮切换中保持稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要认为跨模型 KV 缓存迁移在实践上是可行的，线性映射器是高效且稳定的核心方案；但部分模型对会出现精度大幅下降，需要非线性 MLP 等补救手段，说明该方法对某些模型对仍有局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Intertemporal Preference Steering in Qwen3 via Contrastive Activation Addition
papers.abstract_en: We study linear representations of temporal horizon in the large language model Qwen3-32B and use them to change the model's time-related preferences, recommendations, and capabilities. We train contrastive linear probes on teacher-forced temporal-choice answers to find a short-term versus long-term direction in the model's residual stream, and evaluate contrastive activation-addition steering on a held-out binary temporal-choice task, an out-of-distribution monetary intertemporal-choice task, and a TravelPlanner capability benchmark. The central result is that temporal-horizon directions can be identified with simple contrastive linear probes and then used for steering to induce large, bidirectional preference changes. On an out-of-distribution monetary choice task that varies reward size and delay, steering strongly shifts the model's indifference threshold between smaller-sooner and larger-later rewards in both directions. We further show improvements on a planning-related capability metric under moderate temporal steering. These results suggest that model intertemporal preferences are measurable and steerable, which is relevant for AI systems that give advice involving delayed costs and benefits, and for safety questions about long-horizon planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Qwen3-32B 上研究时间视野 (temporal horizon) 的线性表示，并通过对比激活加法 (contrastive activation addition) 定向改变模型的跨期偏好、推荐与规划相关能力。核心结论是，用简单的对比线性探针即可识别短期与长期方向，且该方向可用于双向、大幅度的偏好操控；在分布外的货币跨期选择任务中，干预明显移动了更小更早奖励与更大更晚奖励之间的无差异阈值。
Motivation: LLM 在涉及延迟成本与收益的建议中可能表现出可测且可干预的跨期偏好，但这类时间相关偏好是否可表示、可操控尚不清楚，且对长视野规划的安全问题有直接影响。
Method: 在教师强迫 (teacher-forced) 的时间选择答案上训练对比线性探针，在残差流 (residual stream) 中定位短期与长期方向；随后用对比激活加法对该方向进行双向 steering，并在留出二选一时间任务、分布外货币跨期选择任务和 TravelPlanner 基准上评估。
Result: 时间视野方向可被简单对比线性探针识别，steering 能在两个方向大幅改变偏好；在改变奖励大小和延迟的分布外货币选择任务中，模型的无差异阈值被显著双向移动；中等强度的 temporal steering 还提升了规划相关能力指标。
Conclusion: 摘要认为模型的内在跨期偏好是可测量、可操控的，这对提供延迟成本收益建议的 AI 系统以及长视野规划的安全问题具有意义。

papers.title: CARE-X: Towards Clinically Useful Radiology VLMs with Auxiliary Supervision, Reward-Aligned Learning, and Tool-Augmented Measurement
papers.abstract_en: A clinically useful chest X-ray system must go beyond fluent report generation: it should classify findings with tunable decision thresholds, localize them spatially, and derive the anatomical measurements upon which many diagnoses depend. Today's Vision-Language Models (VLMs) treat these as separate problems, if they address them at all, leaving a gap between what radiologists need and what generative models provide. We introduce CARE-X, a chest X-ray VLM that narrows this gap by unifying auxiliary discriminative supervision with reward-aligned generation. CARE-X augments its generative backbone with focal-loss classification and composite-loss grounding heads, co-trained alongside the language-modeling objective. This auxiliary supervision produces discriminative diagnostic predictions with tunable decision thresholds and precise spatial localization while also improving report quality, providing evidence that structured prediction and generation reinforce one another. Building on this foundation, Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization (DAPO) leverages task-specific reward signals for report generation, visual question answering (VQA), and spatial grounding, directly optimizing the clinical quality metrics that matter in practice. The result is state-of-the-art performance on the majority of metrics across four report-generation benchmarks, 94.0% VQA accuracy on ReXVQA (+6.0 pp over the next-best baseline), and generative spatial decoding that reaches near parity with dedicated detection heads. Separately, to address measurement-dependent diagnoses, we couple Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct with native tool-calling capabilities for invoking deterministic measurement tools, while retaining full visual access to the image. This hybrid inference yields +43.6 pp average F1 over perception-only baselines across five measurement-dependent conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARE-X，一个面向胸部 X 光片的视觉-语言模型 (VLM)，将辅助判别监督与奖励对齐生成统一起来。模型在生成骨干上联合训练 focal-loss 分类头和 composite-loss 定位头，并使用 Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization (DAPO) 优化报告生成、VQA 和空间定位的临床质量指标。摘要报告在四个报告生成基准的多数指标上达到 SOTA，ReXVQA 准确率 94.0%，且工具增强推理在测量依赖任务上大幅超越仅感知基线。
Motivation: 当前生成式 VLM 很少同时处理可调阈值的发现分类、空间定位和解剖测量，而这些是放射科医生实际工作流所需，导致生成模型与临床需求之间存在明显差距。
Method: CARE-X 在生成骨干上增加 focal-loss 分类头和 composite-loss grounding 头，与语言建模目标联合训练；随后用 DAPO 对报告生成、VQA 和空间 grounding 进行奖励对齐。针对测量类诊断，将 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 与原生工具调用能力耦合，调用确定性测量工具同时保留对图像的完整视觉访问。
Result: 摘要报告 CARE-X 在四个报告生成基准的多数指标上达到 SOTA，ReXVQA VQA 准确率 94.0%（较次优基线 +6.0 个百分点），生成式空间解码接近专用检测头的表现；混合工具推理在五个测量依赖条件上较仅感知基线平均 F1 提升 +43.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化预测与生成可以相互增强，辅助监督和奖励对齐能够同时提升判别与生成性能，而工具增强推理对测量依赖的诊断条件有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Confidence Horizons
papers.abstract_en: Anytime-valid inference enables analysts to continuously monitor their data and stop experiments early. However, the majority of these methods incur a certain conservativeness by remaining valid on infinite time horizons. In practice, a bound on the horizon may be imposed due to budgetary, practical, or ethical constraints. In this paper, we ask the question: "Is it possible to obtain sharper large-sample anytime-valid inference by forgoing validity beyond some finite time horizon?". We provide a positive answer to this question by proposing a family of statistical objects that we call "confidence horizons". These objects can be viewed as large-sample confidence sequences on bounded time horizons, or alternatively as group sequential repeated confidence intervals with a maximal number of interim peeking times. We make explicit connections to the group sequential boundaries of Pocock [1977], O'Brien--Fleming [1979], and Wang--Tsiatis [1987]. We derive closed-form distribution functions of certain statistics which can be used to calculate the asymptotic quantiles of confidence horizons exactly, sidestepping the repeated integration typically employed in group sequential methods. We illustrate the use of confidence horizons for treatment effect estimation in sequentially randomized experiments under adaptive Neyman allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类称为"置信视界"（confidence horizons）的统计对象，用于在有限时间视界上获得更锐利的大样本任意时点有效推断（anytime-valid inference）。其思想是通过放弃有限视界之外的保证来降低保守性，可视为有界时间视界上的大样本置信序列，也可视为具有最大期中窥视次数的组序贯重复置信区间。摘要还建立了与 Pocock、O'Brien--Fleming 和 Wang--Tsiatis 组序贯边界的明确联系。
Motivation: 多数任意时点有效推断方法通过在无限时间视界上保持有效性而引入一定保守性，但在实际中预算、实践或伦理约束往往规定了视界上界。作者追问：若放弃有限时界之外的保证，能否获得更锐利的大样本任意时点有效推断？
Method: 提出一族称为"置信视界"（confidence horizons）的对象，可看作有界时间视界上的大样本置信序列，或带最大期中窥视次数的组序贯重复置信区间；并推导某些统计量的闭式分布函数，从而精确计算其渐近分位数，避免了组序贯方法中常用的重复积分。
Result: 摘要给出肯定回答：通过放弃超过有限时间视界的有效性可获得更锐利的大样本任意时点有效推断；并展示了该方法在自适应 Neyman 分配下的序贯随机实验中用于处理效应估计。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作建立了与经典组序贯边界的显式联系，并提供计算渐近分位数的闭式结果，使得有限视界下的任意时点有效推断更易使用。摘要未报告具体数值结果或数据集实验。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a large language model on new data degrades what it previously learned. We present Omega-S, a drop-in penalty computed from the weight matrix alone: it needs no previous-task data, no Fisher matrix and no stored copy of the old weights. It is three lines in an existing training loop and adds under 4% to the cost of a step. Retention. On Llama-3-8B with LoRA, fine-tuned from code to prose and measured by HumanEval over ten seeds, Omega-S retains more of the original capability than no regularisation on 9 of 10 seeds (0.173 -> 0.238 absolute pass@1; sign test one-sided p=0.011, Wilcoxon p=0.006), as a retention ratio, 62.9% -> 84.1%. It also beats tuned weight decay on 10 of 10 seeds (p=0.002) and tuned EWC on 8 of 10 (p=0.014), every arm re-measured in the same session. Mechanism, measured rather than asserted. Omega-S is topological by construction, its objective built from Tr(A^3), but we measured which of its four factors actually moves and three do not: their elasticity with respect to the weights is at or below 1e-4, against 9e-3 for the degree-variance term. As implemented, the composite reduces to a penalty on the variance of node degrees, which means row magnitude in square modules and directional alignment in non-square ones. We report this because a method whose name promises one thing and whose gradient does another should say so. We also enumerate the open design choices, including a contrast-preserving construction that does what it was designed to do and makes retention worse on all ten seeds. Repeating an identical configuration, same seed and same hardware, gives a standard deviation of 0.104 in retention ratio. We have not found this quantified for low-rank fine-tuning of language models, and it bounds every seed-paired comparison in this literature, ours included. Code, per-seed results and the full record of negative results are available.
papers.comment: 15 pages of main text plus appendices; 12 tables. Code, per-seed data and all negative results at https://github.com/BiomeMakers/OmegaS-LLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Omega-S，一种仅由权重矩阵计算的正则惩罚项，用于缓解 LLM 微调时对已有能力的遗忘；它不需要旧任务数据、Fisher 矩阵或旧权重副本，只需在训练循环中加三行代码，且每步开销增加不到 4%。在 Llama-3-8B 上使用 LoRA 从代码微调到散文，并以 HumanEval 在十个种子上测量，Omega-S 在 9/10 种子上比无正则保留更多原始能力（pass@1 从 0.173 提升到 0.238，保留率从 62.9% 提高到 84.1%）。作者还测量了机制：虽然目标是基于 Tr(A^3) 的拓扑构造，但实际只有节点度方差项在起作用，其余三个因子的弹性不超过 1e-4。
Motivation: 针对大语言模型在新数据上微调会遗忘先前所学的问题，需要一个不需要旧任务数据、不需要 Fisher 矩阵、也不需要存储旧权重的轻量正则化方法来保持原有能力。
Method: Omega-S 是一个即插即用的惩罚项，只从权重矩阵计算，形式上基于 Tr(A^3)，实现上实际退化为对节点度方差的惩罚，对应方阵模块的行幅值和非方阵模块的方向对齐；作者同时列举了未决的设计选择，包括一种保持对比度的构造。
Result: 在 Llama-3-8B + LoRA 的代码到散文微调实验中，Omega-S 在 10 个种子中的 9 个上优于无正则（保留率 62.9% -> 84.1%；符号检验单侧 p=0.011，Wilcoxon p=0.006），在 10/10 个种子上优于调参后的 weight decay（p=0.002），在 8/10 个种子上优于调参后的 EWC（p=0.014）。机制测量显示四个因子中只有度方差项实际生效（弹性 9e-3，其余 <=1e-4）；相同配置重复实验的保留率标准差为 0.104。
Conclusion: 作者强调应如实报告方法的实际梯度行为：Omega-S 名义上是拓扑构造，实际起作用的是对节点度方差的惩罚；并指出对比保持构造会使所有十个种子的保留率变差，且重复实验的标准差限制了此类种子配对比较的结论强度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MuRA: Multi-Rank Adaptation for Efficient and Effective Test-Time Vision-Language Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities but suffer significant performance degradation under distribution shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) via Low-Rank Adaptation offers a parameter-efficient solution, we identify a fundamental bottleneck in current methods: the reliance on static rank configurations. Because visual inputs inherently possess varying information densities, a fixed rank forces an inevitable optimization compromise, leading to underfitting on complex scenes and overfitting on simple ones. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-Rank Adaptation (MuRA), a novel framework that dynamically selects and fuses adaptation modules of varying capacities based on token-level visual complexity. MuRA synergizes Multi-Rank Orthogonal Decomposition to provide a superior, knowledge-preserving initialization, and Unified Component Fusion with Continuous Router Updating to sustainably learn semantic-to-rank mappings. Furthermore, we provide rigorous theoretical justifications mathematically proving the necessity and gradient stability of this adaptive mechanism. Crucially, MuRA's dynamic design uniquely thrives at the deepest visual layer, capitalizing on the shortest gradient backpropagation path. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MuRA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across extensive domain generalization and cross-dataset benchmarks while significantly reducing both computational and memory overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuRA（Multi-Rank Adaptation），用于视觉-语言模型在测试时自适应（test-time adaptation）以缓解分布偏移下的性能下降。MuRA 根据 token 级视觉复杂度动态选择和融合不同容量的适配模块，并联合多秩正交分解与统一组件融合。摘要称该方法在域泛化和跨数据集基准上取得最先进准确率，同时显著降低计算与内存开销。
Motivation: 现有基于低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation）的测试时自适应依赖静态秩配置，而视觉输入的信息密度是变化的，固定秩迫使优化在复杂场景欠拟合与简单场景过拟合之间折中。
Method: 提出 MuRA 框架：通过 token 级视觉复杂度动态选择并融合不同容量的适配模块；用多秩正交分解提供保留知识的初始化；用统一组件融合与连续路由器更新学习语义到秩的映射；并从理论上证明该自适应机制的必要性与梯度稳定性。
Result: 摘要报告在域泛化与跨数据集基准上取得 state-of-the-art 准确率，同时显著降低计算和内存开销；动态设计在最深视觉层表现最佳，得益于最短的反向传播路径。
Conclusion: 作者强调动态选择和融合多容量适配模块可以克服静态秩的优化折中，并证明该方法在视觉-语言模型测试时泛化上的效率与效果优势；摘要未涉及天气或降水相关任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BanglaWild: An In-the-Wild Bengali Scene Text Recognition Benchmark for OCR and Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In-the-wild Bengali scene text recognition is largely unmeasured: existing resources target handwritten documents or constrained sign-board parsing, report only aggregate edit-distance metrics, and evaluate either conventional OCR or VLMs, never both on the same in-the-wild data. To address this gap, we introduce BANGLAWILD, a benchmark of 2,535 Bengali scene text images, each paired with a verbatim gold transcription, two categorical axes, four diagnostic attributes, and an orthographically standard form where the in-image text deviates from canonical spelling. We evaluate fifteen VLMs and three conventional OCR systems under three prompting strategies, fine-tune 6 open-source models with LoRA, and complement edit-distance metrics with an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our results reveal a persistent gap in which larger models within the same family do not outperform smaller ones. Our fifteen-class error taxonomy shows that visual mis-recognition accounts for ~60% of errors in the strongest systems, while conjunct-related errors contribute under 2%, challenging a long-standing assumption in Bengali OCR research; the same visual dominant profile also holds across architectures, including the one conventional baseline that reads Bengali reliably. Prompt language mainly affects cross-script drift and LoRA reduces catastrophic failures in weak models without lifting the ceiling on already competent ones. Code and data will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BANGLAWILD，一个包含 2,535 张孟加拉语场景文本图像的在野 (in-the-wild) 基准，每张图像配有逐字真值转录、两个分类轴、四个诊断属性以及拼写规范形式。作者评估了十五个 VLM 和三个传统 OCR 系统在三种提示策略下的表现，并用 LoRA 微调了六个开源模型，同时用 LLM-as-a-Judge 补充编辑距离指标。结果发现同一模型家族中较大模型并不优于较小模型，十五类错误分类显示视觉误识别约占最强系统错误的 60%，而辅音连字相关错误不足 2%，挑战了孟加拉语 OCR 研究中的一个长期假设。
Motivation: 在野孟加拉语场景文本识别缺乏系统性评测：现有资源主要针对手写文档或受限的招牌解析，只报告聚合编辑距离指标，且要么评测传统 OCR 要么评测 VLM，从未在同一在野数据上同时评测两者。
Method: 构建 BANGLAWILD 基准数据集，包含 2,535 张图像及多维度标注；对十五个 VLM 和三个传统 OCR 系统采用三种提示策略进行评估，对六个开源模型进行 LoRA 微调，并设计十五类错误分类法进行分析。
Result: 摘要报告同一模型家族内较大模型并未超越较小模型；视觉误识别占最强系统错误的约 60%，辅音连字相关错误占比不足 2%；提示语言主要影响跨文种漂移 (cross-script drift)，LoRA 能减少弱模型的灾难性失败但不会提升已强模型的天花板。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有基准和方法忽视了在野场景文本的视觉主导错误，并计划公开代码和数据；该工作主要面向孟加拉语 OCR 与 VLM 评估，而非天气或降水领域。

papers.title: MultiGlobeQA: A Multilingual and Globally Diverse Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial reasoning, i.e., computing distances, containment, and other spatial relations over real-world entities, is central to navigation and logistics, yet large language models (LLMs) struggle with the required geometric and topological computation despite storing considerable geographic knowledge. Existing benchmarks localize these failures only partially: they are synthetic or smallscale, largely monolingual, and offer limited control over geographic coverage. We introduce MultiGlobeQA, a multilingual benchmark of 46,060 question-answer pairs spanning 14 spatial-function families and 15 answer formats, with execution-based ground truth over three knowledge graphs. It covers 201 countries and territories via income- and density-stratified sampling, with parallel questions in English and 16 additional high- and low-resource languages. Across parametric, reasoning, and agentic settings, LLMs collapse on tasks requiring grid indexing and shape computation, while topological relations and directions fare best. Retrieval and tool use yield considerable gains, yet performance plateaus below two thirds even when gold facts are supplied, indicating that computation, not access to knowledge, is the bottleneck. Models also underperform on low-income regions, a gap that gold facts widen rather than close.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiGlobeQA，一个多语言、全球覆盖的地理空间推理基准，包含 46,060 个问答对，覆盖 14 类空间函数和 15 种答案格式，基于三个知识图谱执行真值。基准覆盖 201 个国家和地区，并按收入和人口密度分层采样，提供英语及 16 种高低资源语言的平行问题。评测发现 LLM 在网格索引和形状计算任务上表现崩溃，拓扑关系和方向最好；即使提供黄金事实，性能也低于三分之二，表明计算而非知识获取是瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有地理空间推理基准多是合成或小规模、基本单语，且对地理覆盖控制有限，无法充分定位 LLM 在地理空间推理上的失败模式。
Method: 构建多语言、全球多样化的基准 MultiGlobeQA，通过收入和密度分层采样覆盖 201 个国家与地区，在三个知识图谱上以执行方式生成真值，并评估参数化、推理和智能体（agentic）三种设置。
Result: LLM 在网格索引和形状计算任务上表现差，拓扑关系和方向最好；检索与工具使用带来可观提升，但即使提供黄金事实性能仍低于三分之二；模型在低收入地区表现更差，且该差距在提供黄金事实时反而扩大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调地理空间推理的瓶颈在于计算而非知识获取，并指出低收入地区覆盖不足与真值提供反而加剧的公平性差距。

papers.title: Operationally Feasible Synthetic Power-Grid Scenarios via Learning the AC-Operable Joint Distribution
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic power-grid scenarios are essential for planning, resilience assessment, contingency analysis, and data-driven power-system applications. Recent synthetic grid generation methods have improved structural realism and operational feasibility by incorporating engineering knowledge through post-generation validation, optimization, or physics-aware generation. However, generated scenarios may still exhibit low AC feasibility and robustness, limiting their practical value for downstream power-system studies. This paper proposes a feasibility-aware distribution-learning framework that learns the AC-operable joint distribution of network topology, branch electrical parameters, and time-varying load profiles. Instead of enforcing feasibility after generation, the proposed framework incorporates AC power-flow convergence and operational constraints into hierarchical diffusion-based distribution learning. This enables the generator itself to produce operationally feasible grid scenarios through efficient diffusion sampling. The hierarchical architecture decomposes the high-dimensional generation task into three engineering-motivated stages: topology and bus-attribute generation, branch-parameter generation conditioned on the generated structure, and load-profile generation conditioned on both network structure and electrical characteristics. Experiments on benchmark systems demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves operational feasibility and contingency robustness while maintaining strong statistical fidelity and eliminating optimization-based post-processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可行性感知的分布学习框架，用于合成电网场景生成。该框架将交流潮流收敛与运行约束纳入基于扩散的分层生成过程，直接学习网络拓扑、支路电气参数与时变负荷分布的 AC 可运行联合分布，从而在采样阶段即产出运营可行场景。实验表明该方法显著提升运营可行性与事故鲁棒性，同时保持统计保真度，并省去基于优化的后处理步骤。
Motivation: 现有合成电网生成方法通过生成后校验、优化或物理感知生成来提升结构真实性与运营可行性，但生成的场景仍可能出现较低的交流可行性和鲁棒性，限制其在下游电力系统研究中的实用价值。
Method: 提出可行性感知的分层扩散生成框架：将高维生成任务分解为拓扑与节点属性生成、条件于结构的支路参数生成、以及条件于结构与电气特性的负荷曲线生成三个阶段，并把电力系统交流潮流收敛及运行约束嵌入扩散式分布学习，使生成器自身具备可运行性。
Result: 在基准系统上的实验表明，该方法在不依赖优化后处理的情况下，显著改善场景的运营可行性与事故鲁棒性，同时保持较强的统计保真度。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过在生成阶段而非生成后强制可行性，可以用高效的扩散采样直接产生运营可行的合成电网场景；摘要未报告具体数值或与特定基线的量化对比。

papers.title: Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online without access to ground-truth supervision. SAFT leverages intrinsic structural priors to regularize the VLM's latent space via LoRA adapters. We rigorously evaluate SAFT across a spectrum of base model capabilities to demonstrate its versatility. Our results show that SAFT consistently denoises the reward landscape, yielding faster policy convergence and substantially improved alignment (EPIC distance) relative to the underlying base model, suggesting that failures can often be attributed to structural brittleness rather than semantic misunderstanding. By replacing extensive human preference annotation with structural inductive biases inherent to the task, SAFT offers a scalable path for stabilizing text-conditioned RL and underscores the broader value of incorporating task structure as a general inductive bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构感知微调 (Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning, SAFT)，一种无需真值监督的自监督方法，用于在线精化视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为奖励模型时产生的噪声奖励信号。SAFT 通过 LoRA 适配器利用任务内在的结构先验约束 VLM 的隐空间，并在不同能力的基础模型上评估。结果表明 SAFT 能持续降低奖励景观中的噪声，加速策略收敛，并相对基础模型显著提升对齐度 (EPIC distance)。
Motivation: RL 中手工设计奖励函数仍是主要瓶颈，用大模型 VLM 作为奖励模型可绕过手工工程，但这些基于文本-观测相似度的奖励往往噪声大、不可靠，直接部署受限。
Method: 提出 SAFT，一种自监督在线精化方法：在无真值监督的情况下，利用任务内在的结构先验通过 LoRA 适配器对 VLM 的隐空间进行正则化，从而降低奖励信号的噪声。
Result: 在多种基础模型能力上评估，SAFT 一致地使奖励景观去噪，带来更快的策略收敛，并相对底层基础模型显著提升对齐度 (EPIC distance)；作者认为失败常可归因于结构脆弱性而非语义误解。
Conclusion: SAFT 用任务结构归纳偏置替代大规模人类偏好标注，为稳定文本条件 RL 提供可扩展路径，并强调将任务结构作为通用归纳偏置的价值。

papers.title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
papers.abstract_en: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five representative domains, each containing 100 interconnected subtasks ordered by increasing difficulty and opportunities for cross-task skill reuse. Our experiments show that sequential execution generally improves performance, but the gains vary substantially across models and domains. Moreover, in-context learning performs comparably to explicit skill maintenance on average, suggesting that much of the improvement arises from adaptation to prior context and feedback rather than reusable skill abstraction alone. Explicit skills nevertheless provide selective benefits for tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. We further find that less capable models tend to accumulate larger, more fragmented collections of task-specific skills. These findings show that current in-context skill evolution mechanisms can support continual adaptation, but still struggle to consistently consolidate experience into robust and transferable skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ContinualSkillBench，一个用于评测大语言模型智能体在上下文内持续技能学习 (in-context continual skill learning) 的动态框架，覆盖五个代表性领域，每个领域包含 100 个按难度递增且存在跨任务技能复用机会的相互关联子任务。实验表明顺序执行总体上能提升性能，但提升幅度在模型和领域间差异明显；上下文内学习与显式技能维护的平均表现相当，说明大部分收益来自对先前上下文和反馈的适应，而非可复用的技能抽象。作者还发现能力较弱的模型倾向于积累更大且更碎片化的任务特定技能集合。
Motivation: 现代智能体框架通过外部技能库 (skill library) 帮助大语言模型解决复杂任务，但系统能否有效演化技能、以及这些技能是否真正提升任务求解能力仍不清楚，缺少针对性的评测手段。
Method: 引入 ContinualSkillBench 动态评测框架，设计五个领域各含 100 个相互关联、按难度递增排列的子任务，以考察跨任务技能复用与持续学习；比较顺序执行、上下文内学习与显式技能维护等机制。
Result: 顺序执行通常改善性能但收益因模型和领域而异；上下文内学习在平均表现上与显式技能维护相当，显式技能仅在对可复用流程或精确输出有要求的任务上提供选择性优势；能力较弱的模型会积累更大且更碎片化的任务特定技能集合。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前上下文内技能演化机制能够支持持续适应，但仍难以稳定地将经验整合为稳健且可迁移的技能；这为后续智能体技能维护与迁移研究指出了局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 顺序执行通常改善性能但收益因模型和领域而异；上下文内学习在平均表现上与显式技能维护相当，显式技能仅在对可复用流程或精确输出有要求的任务上提供选择性优势；能力较弱的模型会积累更大且更碎片化的任务特定技能集合。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为当前上下文内技能演化机制能够支持持续适应，但仍难以稳定地将经验整合为稳健且可迁移的技能；这为后续智能体技能维护与迁移研究指出了局限。

papers.title: GENESIS: Towards Explainable Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal Discovery (CD) from observational data faces two fundamental challenges. First, purely statistical methods often lack the power to resolve structural ambiguities in low-sample regimes. Second, although LLM-assisted hybrid approaches improve structure recovery through semantic reasoning, the influence of that reasoning on individual edge decisions remains largely opaque. Consequently, existing hybrid methods fail to satisfy a fundamental requirement: explaining why a particular edge is included or excluded in the learned directed acyclic graph (DAG). This is critical in real-world applications, where no ground-truth DAG exists and every structural decision must be independently justified. We formalize this requirement as decision traceability, requiring every inferred edge to be supported by auditable statistical evidence, Markov Blanket consistency, or explicit domain reasoning. We propose GENESIS, an explainable hybrid CD framework that decomposes graph construction into interpretable decision points. GENESIS first identifies and scores three-node structural motifs, including chains, forks, and colliders, to establish transparent structural priors, then progressively refines the graph by integrating these priors with observational evidence, invoking domain knowledge only when statistical evidence is insufficient. By design, every edge decision is resolved through an auditable source of evidence. Experiments show that GENESIS achieves 100% decision traceability across all settings, establishing explainability as a first-class objective in causal discovery. Despite this additional requirement, GENESIS consistently outperforms purely statistical CD methods on the majority of benchmark datasets across all sample regimes in terms of Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art LLM-assisted approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 GENESIS，一个可解释的混合因果发现 (causal discovery) 框架，将图构建分解为可解释的决策点：先识别并给三类三节点结构基元（链、叉、对撞）打分以建立透明的结构先验，再逐步结合观测证据细化图，并仅在统计证据不足时调用领域知识。摘要报告 GENESIS 在所有设置下达到 100% 的决策可追溯性，并在多数基准数据集上以结构汉明距离 (SHD) 优于纯统计方法，性能与最先进的 LLM 辅助方法相当。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 辅助混合因果发现方法虽能通过语义推理改善结构恢复，但单个边被纳入或排除的推理过程不透明；在无 ground-truth DAG 的真实应用中，每个结构决策都必须能独立论证。作者将该要求形式化为决策可追溯性，即每条推断边需由可审计的统计证据、马尔可夫毯 (Markov Blanket) 一致性或显式领域推理支持。
Method: GENESIS 将图构建分解为可解释决策点：先识别和打分三节点结构基元（链、叉、对撞）以获得透明的结构先验，然后逐步将这些先验与观测证据整合来细化图，统计证据不足时才引入领域知识；每个边决策都通过可审计的证据来源解决。
Result: 实验表明 GENESIS 在所有设置下都实现 100% 的决策可追溯性；尽管附加了这一要求，它在大多数基准数据集上、所有样本规模下，其结构汉明距离 (SHD) 都优于纯统计因果发现方法，并与最先进的 LLM 辅助方法性能相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可以将可解释性作为因果发现的一等目标来对待，同时仍保持有竞争力的结构恢复性能；该框架面向不存在 ground-truth DAG、需要逐边论证的真实应用场景。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: ADMITBench: A Safety-Governed Reference Framework for Evaluating the Admissibility of Industrial LLM Advisories
papers.abstract_en: This white paper presents ADMITBench, a reference framework for evaluating industrial LLM advisories at the level of the proposed action. The framework implements a versioned, safety-governed evaluation contract that checks whether a recommendation is supported by the available evidence, permitted under the stated authority and procedure, and acceptable under the plant-specific consequence checks encoded in the selected evaluation profile. In this report, \emph{safety-governed} means that eligibility is determined through explicit, non-compensatory checks derived from a versioned plant profile; it does not mean that the evaluator, model, or plant has been safety-certified. Release 0.1.0 is a public reference implementation for technical and research evaluation, not an authorisation for physical execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份白皮书，提出 ADMITBench，一个用于在“拟议行动”层面评估工业 LLM 建议 (advisory) 的参考框架。框架实现了一个带版本管理的、由安全治理约束的评估契约，检查建议是否被可用证据支持、是否在所声明的权限和流程下被允许、以及是否通过所选评估配置中的工厂特定后果检查。文中明确说明这里的 safety-governed 指通过显式、非补偿性检查决定资格，不代表评估器、模型或工厂已获得安全认证；0.1.0 版是面向技术与研究评估的公开参考实现，而非物理执行的授权。
Motivation: 工业场景中 LLM 生成的操作建议需要在执行层面被系统性地评估，而现有做法缺少一个显式、可版本化、带安全约束的评估契约来判定建议的可接受性。
Method: 提出 ADMITBench 框架，实现一个版本化、安全治理的评估契约 (evaluation contract)，对每条建议依次执行证据支持检查、权限与流程检查，以及由所选评估配置 (evaluation profile) 编码的工厂特定后果检查，并用显式、非补偿性 (non-compensatory) 检查决定资格。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数值；本报告发布的是公开参考实现 Release 0.1.0，用于技术和研究评估。
Conclusion: 作者强调 safety-governed 的含义仅限于通过显式非补偿性检查判定资格，而非任何形式的安全认证；该框架及其发布版本不构成对物理执行的授权。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CPrefix: A Combinatorial Tensor Framework for Structured Discrete Color Mappings
papers.abstract_en: Discrete multi-channel mappings are typically represented through sampled values, providing accurate evaluations but limited insight into their underlying structure. We introduce CPrefix, a combinatorial observable representation for discrete mappings, realized within a unified tensor framework that enables representation, reconstruction, and structural analysis. The framework is based on a counting tensor induced by multinomial counting observables. Its support forms a discrete Pascal simplex, not as a constraint on the observable space, but as a latent combinatorial representation from which mappings are reconstructed. This formulation separates the combinatorial organization of a mapping from its measured values, exposing the observable structure underlying the mapping. The framework is validated on ICC display and printer profiles through latent reconstruction and perceptual gamut transport. Accurate reconstruction demonstrates that color mappings admit faithful observable representations, while reconstruction residuals provide insight into the compatibility of the underlying mapping with the proposed representation. Although demonstrated on color transformations, the framework is independent of the physical interpretation of the observables, making it applicable to structured multi-channel mappings arising from color imaging, spectral measurements and other discrete systems.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE ICIP 2026 Workshop on Computational Color Imaging (CCIW 2026). Withdrawn from the proceedings because the author was unable to attend the conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CPrefix，一种面向离散多通道映射的组合可观测量表示，统一在张量框架中实现表示、重建与结构分析。该框架基于由多项式计数可观测量 (multinomial counting observables) 诱导的计数张量，其支撑形成离散 Pascal simplex，作为潜在组合表示而非对可观测空间的约束，从而将映射的组合组织与其测量值分离。作者在 ICC 显示器和打印机特性文件上通过潜在重建和感知色域传输进行验证，表明颜色映射具有忠实的可观测表示。该框架不依赖观测量的物理意义，可推广到颜色成像、光谱测量等结构化多通道离散系统。
Motivation: 离散多通道映射通常以采样值表示，虽能提供准确评估，但对底层结构理解有限；需要一种能够揭示映射内在结构的表示方法。
Method: 提出基于计数张量的统一张量框架，利用多元多项式计数可观测量构造表示，将映射的组合组织与测量值分离，并以离散 Pascal simplex 作为潜在组合表示来重建映射。
Result: 在 ICC 显示器与打印机配置文件上的潜在重建实现了准确重构，表明颜色映射存在忠实的可观测表示；重建残差可用于分析底层映射与所提表示的兼容性。
Conclusion: 尽管以颜色变换作为示例，该框架独立于观测量的物理解释，适用于颜色成像、光谱测量及其他离散系统产生的结构化多通道映射。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CRS-Triage: Confidence- and Reliability-Aware Selective Triage under Incomplete Clinical Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Emergency triage requires reliable decisions within a short time period. However, the available electronic health record (EHR) data, including structured data and clinical text, are often incomplete, unreliable, and inconsistent. This makes machine learning (ML)-based triage prediction more challenging, as existing ML models typically rely on complete and reliable EHR data to accurately predict patients' acuity levels. To address this, we propose confidence- and reliability-aware selective triage (CRS-Triage) to predict patients' acuity levels with a confidence score. By comparing the confidence score with a predefined threshold, CRS-Triage can selectively determine whether the model should make the decision or defer the case. Specifically, CRS-Triage separately evaluates the reliability of structured data and clinical text and then jointly considers the consistency between the two modalities to estimate the confidence of each prediction. Moreover, to reduce the risk of missing high-acuity patients, namely under-triage, CRS-Triage prefers to assign patients slightly higher acuity levels, namely over-triage, by penalizing under-triage errors. Experiments on the MIMIC-IV-ED dataset show that CRS-Triage achieves strong predictive performance. It also provides a better risk-coverage trade-off and remains reliable when the available EHR data are incomplete, degraded, or inconsistent across modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRS-Triage，一种针对不完整临床证据的置信度与可靠性感知的选择性分诊（selective triage）方法。它分别评估结构化数据和临床文本的可靠性，并结合跨模态一致性估计每个预测的置信度，通过阈值决定模型直接决策还是延后（defer）。在 MIMIC-IV-ED 数据集上的实验表明该方法性能较强，在 EHR 数据不完整、退化或模态不一致时仍能提供更好的风险-覆盖率权衡（risk-coverage trade-off）。
Motivation: 急诊分诊要求在短时间内做出可靠决策，但可用的电子健康记录（EHR）数据常不完整、不可靠且不一致，使得基于 ML 的分诊预测更具挑战；现有模型通常依赖完整且可靠的数据才能准确预测患者病情严重程度（acuity levels）。
Method: 提出 CRS-Triage：对结构化数据与临床文本分别评估可靠性，再联合考虑两个模态之间的一致性来估计每个预测的置信度；将置信度与预设阈值比较，决定模型直接作出决策还是延后该病例。同时通过惩罚 under-triage 错误，使模型倾向于给患者略高的分诊等级（over-triage），以降低漏掉高危患者的风险。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV-ED 数据集上，CRS-Triage 取得较强的预测性能，并提供更好的风险-覆盖率权衡；在可用 EHR 数据不完整、退化或跨模态不一致时依然保持可靠。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过分别建模结构化数据与临床文本的可靠性并考虑模态间一致性，结合选择性延后机制，可以在不完整临床证据下提升分诊的可靠性与安全性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SciRet: A Compute-Aware Empirical Study of Retrieval and Reranking for Scientific RAG
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SciRet, a compute-aware empirical study of retrieval-augmented generation for scientific question answering over CORD-19. Rather than proposing a new model, we evaluate a fixed scientific RAG pipeline across three corpus scales: 1,034 chunks (1K papers), 5,160 chunks (5K papers), and 15,480 chunks (15K papers). The pipeline combines sentence-window chunking, BM25, BGE-M3 dense retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion, optional cross-encoder reranking, and grounded answer generation. Across these settings, hybrid retrieval is more robust than either sparse-only or dense-only retrieval in our setting, reaching Recall@10 of 1.000 at 1K and 15K. In contrast, an MS MARCO-trained cross-encoder reranker reduces precision on the scientific corpus, suggesting that domain mismatch can outweigh the benefits of stronger query-passage interaction. Generation faithfulness measured with RAGAS increases with corpus scale in our setup. Retrieval evaluation uses pseudo-relevance labels derived from the hybrid system, so we treat the results as controlled comparative evidence rather than a benchmark claim. We release code, indexes, and evaluation outputs to support replication and follow-up studies.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Beyond Representational Similarity: Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain for Generative Plagiarism Detection and Candidate Source Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) pose challenges to academic integrity and peer review. Yet generative plagiarism detection remains an underexplored and largely unresolved challenge. Prior work on LLM-generated-text detection targets AI involvement, which may be permissible, rather than source reuse, while similarity-based methods struggle after extensive rewriting and multi-source synthesis. Motivated by the description-length view of probabilistic prediction, in which relevant side information can reduce a target sequence's code length, we introduce Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG), a directional, training-free framework that contrasts a frozen language model's description length of a suspicious document $P$ with and without a candidate source $S$. This contrast yields token-level log-likelihood gains that measure the incremental predictive evidence supplied by $S$. We evaluate SCDG on the PAN at CLEF benchmarks for generative plagiarism. On a PAN 2025-derived pairwise benchmark, SCDG achieves 0.92 Precision, 0.97 Recall, and 0.94 F1, outperforming all baselines; on PAN 2026's multi-source retrieval task, it reaches 0.83 nDCG@10 and 0.96 Recall@100, surpassing all baselines. On a same-topic, same-event Multi-News test, the calibrated gain-distribution SCDG classifier predicts source reuse for only $0.125\%$ of pairs, supporting robustness to topical overlap under this evaluation protocol. These results establish SCDG as a unified and token-decomposable signal for source-specific content reuse under extensive transformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式抄袭检测（generative plagiarism detection）提出 Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG)：一个无训练、有方向性的框架，通过对比冻结语言模型在给定与不给定候选来源 S 时对可疑文档 P 的描述长度（description length），得到 token 级对数似然增益，用以衡量 S 提供的增量预测证据。在 PAN at CLEF 基准上，SCDG 在 PAN 2025 派生的成对检测任务上达到 0.92 Precision、0.97 Recall、0.94 F1，并在 PAN 2026 多源检索任务上达到 0.83 nDCG@10 和 0.96 Recall@100，均优于所有基线。
Motivation: LLM 对学术诚信和同行评审构成挑战，但生成式抄袭检测仍未被充分研究。既有工作多聚焦于检测文本是否由 AI 生成（可能被允许），而非检测来源复用；基于相似度的方法在大量改写和多源合成后表现不佳。
Method: SCDG 借鉴概率预测的描述长度视角，即相关侧信息能缩短目标序列的编码长度；具体做法是固定一个冻结语言模型，分别计算可疑文档 P 在有/无候选来源 S 条件下的描述长度并做对比，得到 token 级对数似然增益，作为 S 对 P 的增量预测证据。该框架是训练免费的、方向性的，并对 token 可分解。
Result: 在 PAN 2025 派生成对基准上，SCDG 取得 0.92 Precision、0.97 Recall、0.94 F1，超过所有基线；在 PAN 2026 多源检索任务上达到 0.83 nDCG@10 与 0.96 Recall@100，同样超过所有基线。在相同主题、相同事件的 Multi-News 测试中，校准后的增益分布分类器仅对 0.125% 的文本对判定为来源复用，表明在该评估协议下对主题重叠具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SCDG 可作为一种统一且可 token 分解的信号，用于在大量改写条件下检测特定来源的内容复用。其结论基于 PAN 基准和特定评估协议，摘要未提及跨领域或真实场景中的局限性。

papers.title: Bi-semantic Chemical Embedder for Joint Representation Learning of SMILES and Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models have revolutionized natural language processing (NLP), and text-based molecular representations like SMILES have successfully extended these architectures to chemistry. However, domain-adaptive pre-training often causes models to overfit to chemical syntax, catastrophically forgetting their foundational semantic capabilities. To address this challenge, we introduce CheMatE, a chemistry-oriented embedding model that jointly captures molecular structure and domain-specific natural language within the same representation space. Built on a ModernBERT backbone, CheMatE learns bi-semantic representations through a two-stage training procedure: continued masked language modeling (MLM) followed by a Matryoshka contrastive learning stage via Multiple Negative Ranking Loss (MNRL). First, we train the model using MLM on a novel, large-scale corpus of SMILES-annotated, long-context scientific documents that were constructed and curated from FineWeb and ChemPile (comprising 10.4B and 11.5B tokens, respectively). Subsequently, the model undergoes contrastive learning using a synthetic dataset of SMILES-text pairs algorithmically derived from our original training corpus. This design exposes the model to SMILES-enriched scientific literature, enabling bi-semantic understanding. We evaluate CheMatE across a range of downstream tasks covering molecular property prediction and scientific language understanding. Our results demonstrate that coupling our custom-curated datasets with this sequential training strategy yields robust, highly transferable representations. By effectively unifying structural and contextual signals within a single text-based framework, CheMatE achieves competitive performance across both specialized chemistry models and general-purpose language model baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CheMatE，一个基于 ModernBERT 的化学领域嵌入模型，目标是在同一表示空间中联合捕捉分子结构与领域相关的自然语言语义。训练分两阶段：先在由 FineWeb 与 ChemPile 构建并筛选的大规模 SMILES 注释长上下文语料（分别含 10.4B 与 11.5B token）上继续做掩码语言建模（MLM），再通过 Matryoshka 对比学习与多重负排序损失（MNRL）在合成 SMILES-文本对上训练。摘要报告其在分子性质预测和科学语言理解任务上取得与专用化学模型及通用语言模型基线相当的性能。
Motivation: 领域自适应预训练常使模型过拟合化学语法，灾难性地遗忘基础的语义能力；因此需要一种既能保留分子结构信息、又能保持自然语言语义理解的化学表示模型。
Method: 以 ModernBERT 为骨干构建 CheMatE，采用两阶段训练：首先在自建的大规模 SMILES 注释长文科学文献语料上进行继续 MLM，随后在从训练语料中算法生成的合成 SMILES-文本对上执行 Matryoshka 对比学习，损失函数为 MNRL。
Result: 在下游的分子性质预测与科学语言理解任务上，CheMatE 相对于专用化学模型和通用语言模型基线均取得有竞争力的性能，并表现出稳健且高度可迁移的表征。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将自定义筛选的数据集与该顺序训练策略结合，可以在单一基于文本的框架内统一分子结构与上下文信号，从而获得可迁移的化学表示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quantization Effects on Biomedical LLM Reliability
papers.abstract_en: When decoder language models are used as classifiers, predicted class probabilities depend on implementation choices, including the prompt template, verbalizer (label-to-token mapping), and scoring rule, that are rarely treated as experimental variables. We present a controlled evaluation of three Mistral-7B variants (Base, BioMistral, and Instruct) on PubMed RCT sentence classification (n=2000) under FP16, INT8, and INT4 precision using four answer-text prompt templates. Our primary finding is that the probability extraction protocol dominates apparent calibration. Switching from summed to mean token log-likelihood scoring reverses the calibration ranking between models: BioMistral average expected calibration error increases from 0.097 to 0.289, whereas Instruct decreases from 0.237 to 0.096, while accuracy changes by less than 1 percentage point for the specialized models but 4-6 percentage points for the base model. Prompt template choice produces accuracy differences of 7-24 percentage points, comparable to or larger than model-level effects. On one template, BioMistral outperforms Instruct although the overall mean favors Instruct by only 1.3 percentage points. For BioMistral and Instruct, INT8 quantization changes accuracy and F1 by only 1-2 percentage points relative to FP16, whereas the base model shows larger INT8 effects on some templates (up to +4.2 percentage points). INT4 produces heterogeneous but non-catastrophic effects. Temperature scaling reduces expected calibration error under summed scoring for both models but only for that scoring rule. A fine-tuned PubMedBERT reference achieves 82.7% accuracy but uses about 176000 labeled training examples, precluding direct comparison. These results demonstrate that prompt template design and scoring normalization are first-order experimental decisions when evaluating decoder language model calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对三个 Mistral-7B 变体（Base、BioMistral、Instruct）在 PubMed RCT 句子分类（n=2000）上进行受控评测，考察 FP16、INT8、INT4 精度与四种答案文本提示模板的影响。核心发现是概率提取协议主导表观校准：将求和改为平均 token 对数似然评分会反转模型之间的校准排序，而提示模板选择带来的准确率差异可达 7-24 个百分点。INT8 量化对专门模型影响较小，但对基础模型某些模板影响更大。
Motivation: 将 decoder 语言模型用作分类器时，预测类别概率依赖提示模板、verbalizer（标签到 token 的映射）和评分规则等实现选择，但这些很少被当作实验变量处理；作者希望系统量化这些选择对校准与准确率的影响。
Method: 对 Mistral-7B 的 Base、BioMistral 和 Instruct 三个变体，在 PubMed RCT 句子分类上采用四种答案文本提示模板，比较 FP16、INT8、INT4 精度，并对比求和与平均 token 对数似然两种评分规则，另用温度缩放（temperature scaling）及微调 PubMedBERT 作为对照。
Result: 求和改为平均评分使 BioMistral 的期望校准误差（ECE）从 0.097 升至 0.289，Instruct 从 0.237 降至 0.096，而准确率变化小于 1 个百分点（基础模型变化 4-6 个百分点）；提示模板造成 7-24 个百分点的准确率差异。INT8 对 BioMistral 和 Instruct 的准确率与 F1 仅改变 1-2 个百分点，基础模型在某些模板上最高 +4.2 个百分点；温度缩放只在求和评分下降低 ECE。PubMedBERT 参考达 82.7% 准确率，但使用约 176000 个标注样本，无法直接比较。
Conclusion: 作者强调提示模板设计和评分归一化是评估 decoder 语言模型校准时的一阶实验决策。该工作限于生物医学分类场景和 Mistral-7B 系列，且 PubMedBERT 因训练数据规模差异无法与零样本/少样本设置直接对比。

papers.title: FedCritic-MIMO: Communication-Efficient Serverless Federated Critic Learning for Massive-MIMO Resource Control in Open and Disaggregated 6G RANs
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes FedCritic-MIMO, a communication-efficient serverless federated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for AI-native resource control across independently deployable cell-level controllers in open and disaggregated 6G RANs. Controllers share no trainer, retain local actors and personalized critic components, and exchange only compatible shared critic parameters. FedCritic-MIMO targets reuse-$1$ multi-cell massive-MIMO OFDMA deployments, where RAN controllers jointly manage user scheduling, per-stream power allocation, beamforming, interference, and long-term QoS with limited inter-controller signaling. Each base station locally executes its actor without centralized training or actor federation, while critic knowledge is exchanged peer-to-peer over an interference-aware graph. It enables this collaboration through wireless-aware event triggering, adaptive layer-wise top-$k$ sparse critic exchange with error feedback, and balanced interference-aware fusion. We establish conditional finite-time stationarity and consensus guarantees for the balanced, compressed peer-to-peer critic recursion under a fixed-policy, frozen-target critic-regression model. In strongly interference-coupled reuse-$1$ simulations, FedCritic-MIMO achieves the best performance-communication tradeoff among heuristic, independent-learning, centralized-training, and communication-ablation baselines. It achieves the highest held-out throughput, improves user-rate distribution and mean SINR, increases QoS satisfaction, and attains the lowest interference cost per delivered bit among learning baselines. It reduces critic-communication overhead by $76\%$ relative to uncompressed distributed critic exchange. These results demonstrate that serverless exchange of compatible shared critic parameters can coordinate RAN controllers without centralized trajectory collection or parameter-server aggregation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCritic-MIMO，一种面向开放、解耦的 6G RAN 中小区级控制器的通信高效 serverless 联邦多智能体强化学习框架。控制器之间不共享训练器，各自保留本地 actor 和个性化 critic，只通过干扰感知图交换兼容的共享 critic 参数，并采用无线感知事件触发、自适应逐层 top-k 稀疏 critic 交换（带错误反馈）和平衡的干扰感知融合。作者还给出了固定策略、冻结目标 critic 回归模型下平衡压缩 P2P critic 递推的条件有限时间平稳性与一致性保证。
Motivation: 在开放且解耦的 6G RAN 中，多个可独立部署的小区级控制器需要协同进行用户调度、功率分配、波束成形和干扰管理，但集中式训练或参数服务器聚合会带来高昂的通信与轨迹收集开销，难以落地。
Method: 提出 serverless 联邦 critic 学习框架：每个基站本地执行 actor，不进行 actor 联邦或集中训练；共享 critic 知识通过干扰感知图进行对等交换，并组合无线感知事件触发、自适应逐层 top-k 稀疏 critic 压缩（含错误反馈）与平衡的干扰感知融合来限制通信。
Result: 在强干扰耦合的 reuse-1 大规模 MIMO OFDMA 仿真中，FedCritic-MIMO 在启发式、独立学习、集中训练和通信消融基线中取得最佳性能-通信权衡，获得最高留出吞吐量，改善用户速率分布与平均 SINR，提高 QoS 满意度，并达到学习基线中最低的每比特干扰成本；相对未压缩的分布式 critic 交换，critic 通信开销降低 76%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，无需集中轨迹收集或参数服务器聚合，serverless 地交换兼容的共享 critic 参数即可协调 RAN 控制器；理论保证限定在固定策略、冻结目标 critic 回归模型之下。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LiteMVS: Efficient Multi-View Stereo with Foundation Distillation and Expert Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Real-time 3D perception is crucial for robotics, augmented reality, and embodied intelligence applications. Existing multi-view stereo (MVS) methods primarily rely on geometric correspondences, which often fail in textureless or repetitive regions, while monocular depth models leverage strong image-level priors but lack robust multi-view geometric constraints. More importantly, in robotics and embodied manipulation scenarios, high-quality 3D geometry is not only essential for static reconstruction, but also serves as a critical foundation for learning temporally consistent 4D representations. To obtain visual representations with stronger structural awareness and greater potential for spatiotemporal extension, we present LiteMVS, a lightweight multi-view depth estimation model that integrates plane-sweep geometric reasoning with strong monocular semantic and structural priors. The central idea of LiteMVS is to efficiently inject high-level monocular knowledge, obtained from lightweight segmentation models and large-scale vision foundation models, into a multi-view stereo framework. In particular, LiteMVS enriches the cost volume with semantic descriptors and employs a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) formulation to enable adaptive geometric aggregation across depth hypotheses. Moreover, geometric priors distilled from vision foundation models further strengthen monocular guidance without increasing inference cost. Through this design, LiteMVS not only improves depth estimation and 3D reconstruction quality in static scenes, but also provides a more reliable geometric foundation for subsequent temporal modeling and 4D representation learning. Experiments on ScanNetv2 and 7-Scenes demonstrate that LiteMVS achieves high-quality depth prediction and 3D reconstruction while maintaining competitive efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiteMVS 提出一个轻量级多视图立体 (MVS) 深度估计模型，将平面扫描 (plane-sweep) 几何推理与来自轻量级分割模型和大规模视觉基础模型的单目语义、结构先验结合。模型通过语义描述符增强代价体 (cost volume)，并用 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 实现跨深度假设的自适应几何聚合，同时从视觉基础模型蒸馏几何先验而不增加推理开销。实验在 ScanNetv2 和 7-Scenes 上表明其能获得高质量深度预测与三维重建，同时保持有竞争力的效率。
Motivation: 现有 MVS 方法主要依赖几何对应，在无纹理或重复区域容易失效；单目深度模型虽有图像级先验但缺乏鲁棒的多视图几何约束。此外，机器人及具身操作场景中高质量三维几何不仅是静态重建所需，也是学习时间一致 4D 表示的基础。
Method: LiteMVS 将高层次的单目知识（来自轻量级分割模型和大规模视觉基础模型）高效注入 MVS 框架：用语义描述符丰富代价体，并采用 MoE 形式在深度假设间进行自适应几何聚合；同时通过从视觉基础模型蒸馏几何先验来增强单目引导，且不增加推理成本。
Result: 在 ScanNetv2 和 7-Scenes 上的实验显示，LiteMVS 实现了高质量的深度预测和三维重建，同时保持有竞争力的效率。
Conclusion: 该设计不仅提升了静态场景中的深度估计与三维重建质量，还为后续时间建模和 4D 表示学习提供了更可靠的几何基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAFIA: Query-Only Memory Attacks via Probing and Factual Injection against Audited LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented LLM agents rely on rich context for long-horizon reasoning and acting, yet their memory modules expose a persistent attack surface for malicious records, making the study of memory poisoning threats imperative. However, existing query-only attacks often fail to remain effective in two realistic and prevalent settings: large-scale benign memory pools and active input auditing. Consequently, current approaches fall short when facing the dual challenges of high retrieval competitiveness and rigorous semantic checks. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAFIA, a query-only Memory Attack framework via probing and Factual Injection against Audit, tailored to this extended threat model. Specifically, MAFIA introduces: (1) a placement strategy that ensures retrieval-competitive injection via memory probing, budget allocation, and scheduling; and (2) a payload design that bypasses audits using compact factual cloaks, preserving malicious effects while maintaining high semantic similarity. Extensive evaluations reveal that MAFIA achieves up to a 90.7% attack success rate while suppressing audit detection from a peak of 83.3% to at most 7.4%, exposing critical vulnerabilities across agentic memory systems. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/JiamingChen1234/MAFIA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAFIA，一种针对内存增强型 LLM 智能体 (memory-augmented LLM agents) 的纯查询式 (query-only) 内存投毒攻击框架，目标是绕过大规模良性内存池和主动输入审计这两类现实防御。MAFIA 通过内存探测、预算分配与调度实现可检索竞争的注入，并利用紧凑事实伪装 (compact factual cloaks) 绕过语义审计。实验显示其在攻击成功率达到 90.7% 的同时，将审计检出率从 83.3% 压低至最多 7.4%，表明智能体内存系统存在严重漏洞。
Motivation: 现有针对内存模块的查询式攻击在两类现实场景——大规模良性内存池与主动输入审计——下往往失效，难以同时应对高检索竞争性和严格语义检查的双重挑战。
Method: MAFIA 由两部分组成：(1) 放置策略，通过内存探测、预算分配和调度确保注入内容具有检索竞争力；(2) 载荷设计，利用紧凑事实伪装在保持高语义相似度的同时保留恶意效果，从而绕过审计。
Result: 大量评估表明 MAFIA 的攻击成功率最高达 90.7%，并把审计检测率从峰值的 83.3% 抑制到至多 7.4%，暴露了智能体内存系统的关键脆弱性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作揭示了内存增强型 LLM 智能体在面对此类扩展威胁模型时的严重安全缺陷，并承诺公开代码以促进后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sensitivity, Causality, and Repair Dissociate: A Layer-Wise Analysis of Perturbation Robustness and Its Scaling
papers.abstract_en: When a language model fails on surface-perturbed input (typos, OCR noise, homophones), "which layer is responsible" has three natural operationalizations: where representations diverge most (sensitivity), where restoring clean activations recovers the prediction (causality), and where a small adapter can repair the damage (compensatory capacity) - and we show these three layer maps dissociate. Across a five-model panel we identify two propagation regimes - spike-and-suppress (Phi-3.5, Gemma-2-9B) and late-accumulation (Llama-3, Mistral, Qwen2.5-7B) - and on the two models meeting an 80% identity-patch gate, sensitivity and causality are anti-correlated (rho = -0.72 to -0.88). Within-family scaling on Qwen2.5 (1.5B to 14B) shows the late-accumulation signature strengthening monotonically with scale, corroborated on a second family. We propose cascade disruption as the mechanism behind the dissociation: adapters placed at causally implicated early layers break intact downstream computation, making diagnostic-flagged sites the worst adapter placements. A fixed-harness layer sweep across four models (3.8-8B) confirms the core prediction on chain-of-thought GSM8K - the flagged sites are the most damaging adapter windows on every adjudicable model - and is sign-consistent but strongly attenuated on a multiple-choice control, consistent with damage that compounds with generation length. The sweep yields practical guidance: a training-free LRD pre-screen and a default-deepest placement rule, though absolute gains over no-adapter baselines remain small. Finally, apparent gains from a representation-stability loss reverse under an adequate generation budget - truncated chain-of-thought had been scored as empty - a methodological warning for any intervention evaluated on chain-of-thought tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在表面扰动输入（拼写错误、OCR 噪声、同音词）下的层级鲁棒性，把“哪一层负责”拆成三种操作化定义：敏感性（sensitivity）、因果性（causality）与补偿容量（compensatory capacity），并发现三者对应的层映射相互分离（dissociate）。在五个模型上识别出 spike-and-suppress 与 late-accumulation 两种传播模式；通过固定测试框架（fixed-harness）的层扫描实验在 chain-of-thought GSM8K 上确认了级联破坏（cascade disruption）的核心预测，并给出适配器放置的实际指导。摘要还报告了 Qwen2.5 家族上的缩放规律以及关于 chain-of-thought 评估截断的方法论警告。
Motivation: 当模型在表面扰动输入上失败时，“哪一层负责”缺少统一的操作化定义；现有工作可能混用表征发散、因果恢复与适配修复等不同的层定位方式。本文指出这三种层映射并不一致，并希望用统一机制解释这一分离现象，同时提供层修复场景下可用的实践指导。
Method: 将层责任细化为敏感性、因果性和补偿容量三种度量，在五个模型上比较它们的层映射；提出 cascade disruption 作为分离现象的候选机制，并用固定测试框架（fixed-harness）的层扫描在 chain-of-thought GSM8K 和多项选择控制任务上检验预测。另用 Qwen2.5 家族（1.5B 到 14B）及第二个模型家族做缩放分析，并评估表示稳定性损失（representation-stability loss）的作用。
Result: 摘要报告敏感性、因果性与补偿容量的层映射相互分离；在通过 80% identity-patch gate 的两个模型上，敏感性和因果性呈负相关（rho = -0.72 到 -0.88）。级联破坏预测得到确认：被诊断标记的层是最具破坏性的适配器窗口；late-accumulation 特征随模型规模单调增强。此外，表示稳定性损失带来的表面提升在充足生成预算下会反转，因为截断的 chain-of-thought 曾被误记为空白。
Conclusion: 摘要给出的实践结论包括：使用训练无关的 LRD 预筛和默认最深层（default-deepest）放置规则，但相对无适配器基线的绝对收益仍然很小；并强调在 chain-of-thought 任务上评估任何干预时，生成截断会造成虚假结论，构成方法论层面的警告。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Oilbird: Training-Free Speculative Decoding with Keys the Verifier Already Computes
papers.abstract_en: Training-free speculative decoding drafts by matching an exact suffix of the context against a pool of earlier context. That lookup misses correct drafts already in the pool, most visibly on tool-calling traffic, where a request repeats almost everything but the few values minted for it, and where one rejected token discards the correct continuation behind it. We diagnose the failure position by position across ten benchmarks and find it to be a problem of addressing rather than of coverage: on our densest tool-calling benchmark, about half of what the strongest exact-match drafter misses is present in the pool yet unreachable by exact matching. We therefore propose a second, semantic draft source: the same pool, re-keyed by the hidden state the verifier has already computed at each committed token, together with a merge that lets it ride inside an existing lexical drafter's tree. In three published drafters, at matched pool and budget, it lifts accepted length by 24-29%. Oilbird reaches 4.4x autoregressive decoding speed on API-Bank, against 3.9x for the strongest training-free baseline in our harness and 2.0x for EAGLE-3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Oilbird，一种无需训练的投机解码 (speculative decoding) 方法。它在现有基于精确后缀匹配的草稿器之外增加第二个语义草稿源：把同一上下文池改写为由验证器在每个已提交 token 处已计算的隐藏状态 (hidden state) 作为键，再与现有词法草稿器的树合并。摘要称在三个已发表草稿器上、以相同池和预算衡量，接受长度提升 24-29%；在 API-Bank 上达到 4.4 倍自回归解码速度。
Motivation: 无需训练的投机解码通过将上下文的精确后缀与早期上下文池匹配来生成草稿，但会漏掉池中已存在却无法被精确匹配寻址到的正确草稿，这在工具调用 (tool-calling) 流量上尤其明显：请求几乎逐字重复，只有少量新生成的值不同，而一个被拒绝的 token 会丢弃其后正确的延续。作者逐位置诊断十个基准后发现这是寻址 (addressing) 问题而非覆盖 (coverage) 问题。
Method: 提出第二个语义草稿源：对同一个池改用验证器在每个已提交 token 处已计算的隐藏状态重新建索引 (re-key)，并将该草稿源与现有词法草稿器的树进行合并，使其能搭在已有草稿器内部运行。
Result: 在三个已发表草稿器中、池和预算匹配的条件下，接受长度提升 24-29%。在 API-Bank 上，Oilbird 达到 4.4 倍自回归解码速度，而最强无需训练基线为 3.9 倍，EAGLE-3 为 2.0 倍。

papers.title: LatentGuard: Efficient and Inspectable Latent Reasoning for LLM Safeguards
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-based guard models improve LLM safeguards, but decoding explicit rationales for every interaction makes them costly to deploy. Although latent-reasoning methods reduce token generation by moving reasoning into continuous states, they remain underexplored for safety moderation and lack an inspection interface for deployment. In this paper, we propose LatentGuard, an efficient and inspectable safeguard framework that brings continuous latent reasoning to guard models. LatentGuard uses a staged curriculum to progressively compress task-aligned textual rationales into compact latent states, enabling safety verdicts to be predicted directly from continuous representations. To preserve inspectability, an isolated auxiliary decoder generates compact audit artifacts on demand, keeping rationale generation off the standard inference path. Experiments show that LatentGuard-8B improves mean weighted F1 from 83.95 to 84.91 over GuardReasoner-8B, while reducing critical-path reasoning cost from 268.56 generated rationale tokens to 1.60 latent reasoning tokens. Its audit decoder achieves an audit utility score of 85.75, demonstrating an efficient and inspectable path toward deployable LLM safeguards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LatentGuard，一个将连续潜推理 (latent reasoning) 引入 LLM 安全审核的框架，目标是在保持低部署开销的同时保留可检查性。该方法通过分阶段课程把任务对齐的文本推理逐步压缩为紧凑的潜状态，使安全裁决直接由连续表示预测；一个隔离的辅助解码器按需生成精简审计片段，使推理生成不进入标准推理路径。实验显示 LatentGuard-8B 在平均加权 F1 上比 GuardReasoner-8B 提升近 1 个点，同时将关键路径推理 token 数从 268.56 降到 1.60。
Motivation: 基于推理的护栏模型虽然能提升 LLM 安全性，但为每次交互解码显式推理导致部署成本过高；现有的潜推理方法在安全审核场景下尚未充分探索，且缺乏可供部署使用的检查接口。
Method: LatentGuard 采用分阶段课程 (staged curriculum) 将任务对齐的文本推理渐进压缩进紧凑的连续潜状态，直接在此表示上预测安全裁决；另设一个与主路径隔离的辅助解码器，在需要时生成紧凑的审计产物，从而将推理生成移出常规推理路径。
Result: 摘要报告 LatentGuard-8B 的平均加权 F1 从 83.95 提升到 84.91（相对 GuardReasoner-8B），关键路径推理开销从 268.56 个理由 token 降到 1.60 个潜推理 token；辅助审计解码器的审计效用分数为 85.75。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果展示了一条兼顾效率与可检查性的可部署 LLM 安全护栏路径；摘要未提及在更广任务或更长上下文上的局限。

papers.title: Resume Means Resume: A Machine-Checked Conformance Contract for Checkpoint, Interrupt, and Resume Semantics in Workflow Persistence Layers
papers.abstract_en: A framework that persists execution state so a run can be interrupted, survive a crash, and continue must decide what a resume means for effects that already fired. Five widely deployed agent workflow frameworks answer differently, none exposes a machine-checkable contract, and behavior violates even the fragments they state. The RESUME CONTRACT states six properties over the persistence API (prefix continuation, effect exactly-once, fork determinism, checkpoint validity, consume-once, recovery determinism), plus fork-intent and liveness obligations. A TLA+ model checks a reference semantics exhaustively, unchanged at scaled bounds (7.4 million states); a 39-cell fault matrix yields the separating models independence requires, and consume-once splits, its consumption clause independent of all six others. A deterministic, LLM-free harness measures them at pinned releases. LangGraph 1.2.9 durably records a second resume value and never consults it, persists schema-invalid state silently, and re-executes durably recorded work after a real SIGKILL: exactly-once across interrupts, at-least-once across crashes, on one API. CrewAI 1.15.2 re-executes completed effect-bearing methods against its written claim; pydantic-graph 1.x cannot resume after a mid-node crash; no two probed frameworks share a conformance profile. Consume-once holds sequentially and fails under concurrent delivery: k processes resuming one parked interrupt fire the gated effect k times, saturation 1.0 in 36 of 40 cells, and the failure crosses hosts. REMIT, a reference sequencer whose Verus-verified recovery core is line-identical to the shipped executable, repairs the fork and validity cells. The cross-process cell is repaired at the read path, and that repair ships: an opt-in gate claims consumption in the shared store, serving one racer and refusing the rest before any node executes.

papers.title: Geo-Embed: Towards Unified Multimodal Embeddings for Urban Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial and urban applications increasingly require models to compare heterogeneous evidence across street-view imagery, remote-sensing observations, text descriptions, region proposals, and temporal change cues. However, existing multimodal embedding models and benchmarks are still largely designed and evaluated around general-purpose image-text matching, leaving unclear whether unified embedding space can support heterogeneous geospatial tasks involving spatial relationships, fine-grained semantics, and temporal changes. To address this gap, we make three key contributions. First, we introduce GeoMEB, a large-scale multimodal embedding benchmark that standardizes 45 urban evaluation tasks across retrieval, visual question answering, change detection, classification, and visual grounding, together with training collections comprising 1.32M examples and 286K evaluation queries. Second, we present Geo-Embed, a unified embedding model that adapts a shared vision-language backbone to instruction-conditioned query-target matching over heterogeneous geospatial inputs, including single images, multiple images, text, regions, and masks. On GeoMEB, Geo-Embed achieves the strongest overall performance among representative multimodal embedders, with a 15.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline. These results motivate future geospatial embedders that organize training and evaluation around explicit query-target relations, including semantic, cross-view, region-level, and temporal correspondence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对城市地理空间应用中多模态证据（街景、遥感、文本、区域、时间变化）的异构匹配问题，提出统一多模态嵌入模型 Geo-Embed 和基准 GeoMEB。GeoMEB 标准化了 45 个城市评估任务，包含 132 万训练样本和 28.6 万评估查询；Geo-Embed 通过共享视觉-语言骨干和指令条件的查询-目标匹配，在基准上相对最强基线提升 15.3%。
Motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型和基准主要围绕通用图像-文本匹配设计，难以评估统一嵌入空间是否支持包含空间关系、细粒度语义和时间变化的异构地理空间任务。
Method: 构建大规模多模态嵌入基准 GeoMEB，覆盖检索、视觉问答、变化检测、分类和视觉定位等 45 个城市任务；提出 Geo-Embed，用共享视觉-语言骨干针对异构地理空间输入（单图、多图、文本、区域、掩码）做指令条件下的查询-目标匹配。
Result: 在 GeoMEB 上，Geo-Embed 在代表性多模态嵌入器中取得最强综合性能，相对最强基线有 15.3% 的改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为围绕显式查询-目标关系（语义、跨视角、区域级、时间对应）组织和评估训练，是未来地理空间嵌入模型值得遵循的方向。

papers.title: FlowForm: Synergizing Fluid Physics with Topological Consistency for Satellite Flood Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Developing robust flood assessment models requires high-quality paired satellite imagery, yet such data remain scarce for flood-specific image generation. Although generative models provide a promising means of data augmentation, existing methods often yield implausible spatial layouts of flooded regions and distort scene structures. We propose FlowForm, a framework for satellite flood synthesis that integrates SWE-inspired latent regularization with structure-aware conditioning. The Flood Descriptor Module (FDM) imposes differentiable penalties on residuals of the steady-state Shallow Water Equation in auxiliary latent fields at the diffusion bottleneck. The Terrain Anchor Adapter (TAA) injects depth, semantic, and edge features at four encoder scales of the U-Net. We further curate FloodScape, a large-scale, high-resolution dataset comprising paired satellite images acquired before and after disasters. In addition to standard image-generation metrics, we evaluate the consistency of flooded regions, zero-shot generalization to a geographically held-out flood event, and sensitivity to individual components. Across all reported comparisons, FlowForm achieves higher visual fidelity, greater similarity between paired images, and stronger consistency of flooded regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowForm，一个面向卫星影像洪涝区域合成的生成框架，旨在解决洪水图像生成中空间布局不合理与场景结构失真问题。方法在扩散模型瓶颈处引入基于稳态浅水方程残差的潜在正则化，并通过地形锚点适配器在 U-Net 四个编码器尺度注入深度、语义与边缘特征。作者还构建了 FloodScape 配对卫星影像数据集，并报告了更高的视觉保真度、更强的配对影像相似性与洪泛区域一致性。
Motivation: 洪水评估模型依赖高质量的配对卫星影像，但针对洪水场景的图像生成数据稀缺；现有生成方法常产生不合理的洪泛区域空间布局并扭曲场景结构。
Method: 提出 FlowForm，包含 Flood Descriptor Module (FDM)，在扩散瓶颈的辅助潜在场上对稳态浅水方程 (Shallow Water Equation) 残差施加可微惩罚；以及 Terrain Anchor Adapter (TAA)，在 U-Net 四个编码器尺度注入深度、语义和边缘特征。同时构建大规模高分辨率配对洪水卫星影像数据集 FloodScape。
Result: 除常规图像生成指标外，还评估洪泛区域一致性、对地理留出洪灾事件的零样本泛化及组件敏感性；在所有报告对比中，FlowForm 取得更高的视觉保真度、更大的配对影像相似性和更强的洪泛区域一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将流体物理约束与结构感知条件结合可显著改善卫星洪涝图像合成的合理性；其适用范围和局限性在摘要中未明确说明。

papers.title: UHP Detection: LVLMs have their Unique Hallucination Pattern in the Consistency Space
papers.abstract_en: Large vision--language models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong multimodal reasoning capabilities but remain prone to hallucination, where model predictions are not grounded in visual evidence. Existing black-box hallucination detection methods estimate uncertainty through a single consistency metric, implicitly assuming that model uncertainty can be adequately characterized by a single measure. However, hallucinations exhibit diverse manifestations of uncertainty across different behavioral probes, making a single measure insufficient to characterize their underlying behavior. We propose \emph{Unique Hallucination Pattern (UHP) Detection}, a fully black-box framework that models hallucination as a structured uncertainty pattern defined by two axes: perturbation modality (image vs.\ text) and logical polarity (a statement vs.\ its negation). Their intersection produces four complementary consistency groups that capture distinct manifestations of model uncertainty, from which both within-group and between-group features are extracted to train a lightweight classifier. Through comprehensive experiments on AMBER and PhD across three LVLMs, UHP Detection consistently outperforms prior black-box and white-box baselines, with improvements of up to $+18.72\%$ AUC-ROC and $+20.07\%$ AUC-PR over the strongest black-box methods. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate that each consistency group contributes complementary information and that their combination forms a structured hallucination pattern. Furthermore, cross-dataset evaluation shows that this learned pattern generalizes across benchmarks, indicating that hallucination behavior reflects a model-specific consistency pattern. \textbf{Code is publicly available at} https://github.com/amirezzati/uhpdet.

papers.title: OmniPack: Unified Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on audio-visual understanding tasks, but processing long and highly redundant visual and audio token sequences incurs substantial computational overhead, demanding aggressive token compression for efficient deployment. Existing methods often degrade at low token budgets: pre-LLM compression may discard structurally important and globally distributed evidence, whereas inner-LLM compression often underexploits query-conditioned audio-visual collaboration. To address these limitations, we propose OmniPack, a training-free framework that coordinates structural compression before the LLM with task-relevant semantic refinement within the LLM. Before the LLM, OmniPack removes structural redundancy through modality-specific importance, global coverage, and similarity-aware merging. After sufficient multimodal interaction, it further consolidates diverse, task-relevant representations through textual guidance and audio-visual collaboration. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks with three Omni-LLM backbones demonstrate that OmniPack consistently achieves the best performance-efficiency trade-off across diverse retention ratios, outperforming all existing methods. Notably, on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, OmniPack preserves 98.0% of the original performance while reducing FLOPs to 16.7%, and still retains 92.9% of the original performance with only 6.8% of the original FLOPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniPack，一个面向全模态大语言模型 (Omni-LLM) 的免训练 token 压缩框架，它在 LLM 之前进行结构化压缩（按模态重要性、全局覆盖与相似度合并去除冗余），并在 LLM 内部经过充分多模态交互后，借助文本引导与音视频协作进一步整合任务相关表示。在五个基准和三个 Omni-LLM 主干上的实验显示，OmniPack 在不同保留比例下取得最佳性能-效率权衡；在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上保留 98.0% 原始性能的同时将 FLOPs 降至 16.7%，且仅用 6.8% FLOPs 仍能保留 92.9% 的原始性能。
Motivation: Omni-LLM 在处理长且高度冗余的视觉与音频 token 序列时计算开销大，需要激进的 token 压缩以支持高效部署；现有方法在低 token 预算下性能退化明显：LLM 前压缩可能丢弃结构重要且全局分布的证据，LLM 内压缩则未充分利用查询条件化的音视频协作。
Method: OmniPack 是免训练框架，通过两个阶段协调压缩：LLM 之前利用模态特定重要性、全局覆盖和相似度感知合并移除结构冗余；充分多模态交互之后，再通过文本引导与音视频协作整合多样化且任务相关的表示。
Result: 在五个基准上与三个 Omni-LLM 骨干上的实验表明，OmniPack 在多种保留比例下一致取得最佳性能-效率权衡并优于现有方法；具体在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上，FLOPs 降至原始的 16.7% 时保持 98.0% 性能，仅用 6.8% FLOPs 时仍保持 92.9% 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将 LLM 前的结构化压缩与 LLM 内的任务相关语义细化相结合，可以在全模态大模型的低 token 预算下获得更好的性能-效率权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UNVaMP: Neural Knowledge Tracing with Variational Regularization of Latent Knowledge Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Unified Neural Variational Measurement of Proficiency (UNVaMP) architecture, a knowledge tracing method that integrates observed student-item interactions with internal memory to produce evolving latent representations of student knowledge. These representations support accurate predictions of future responses while enabling explicit control over the smoothness of estimated learning trajectories. UNVaMP can be configured as either a purely neural model or a hybrid model that predicts responses through an interpretable measurement function over the latent space. We show that a pure neural configuration (UNVaMP-MLP) achieves the strongest predictive performance among compared models on three out of four datasets. Meanwhile, a hybrid configuration (UNVaMP-MIRT, using a 1PL MIRT measurement function) lags only slightly behind UNVaMP-MLP, indicating that the predictive cost of interpretability is modest. Beyond predictive accuracy, UNVaMP provides the following: a principled mechanism for controlling volatility when estimating student latent variables, quantification of uncertainty over student knowledge state estimates, and flexible input specification that supports heterogeneous student-item interaction features. In addition, the hybrid UNVaMP-MIRT configuration generates interpretable moment-in-time student knowledge state estimates. Using an experimental dataset, we show that auxiliary inputs induce structured changes in the predictive behavior of UNVaMP-MIRT, consistent with sensitivity to underlying structure beyond response correctness. Furthermore, through a simulation study, we show that UNVaMP yields well-behaved knowledge state estimates under controlled measurement conditions. In total, these results indicate that UNVaMP is both useful for real-world education systems and capable of recovering underlying structure from student-item interactions.
