papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Unified Neural Variational Measurement of Proficiency (UNVaMP) 架构，一种将学生-题目交互与内部记忆相结合的知识追踪 (knowledge tracing) 方法，用于生成随时间演化的学生知识潜在表示。纯神经配置 UNVaMP-MLP 在四个数据集中的三个上取得最强预测性能，而基于 1PL MIRT 测量函数的混合配置 UNVaMP-MIRT 性能略低，表明可解释性的预测代价较小。文章还通过仿真实验说明 UNVaMP 在受控测量条件下能给出良态的知识状态估计。
Motivation: 现有知识追踪方法难以在保持准确预测的同时显式控制学习轨迹的平滑性并提供可解释的学生知识估计，教育系统需要兼具预测精度与可靠不确定性量化的建模方案。
Method: UNVaMP 将学生-题目交互与内部记忆集成，产生潜在知识表示，并通过变分正则化控制学习轨迹的平滑度与波动性；架构可配置为纯神经模型或混合模型，后者通过可解释的测量函数（如 1PL MIRT）在潜空间上预测响应，同时支持异构输入特征与不确定性量化。
Result: 在四个数据集的比较中，UNVaMP-MLP 在三个数据集上预测性能最佳，UNVaMP-MIRT 紧随其后；实验数据集表明辅助输入会诱导 UNVaMP-MIRT 预测行为产生结构化变化，仿真研究则显示其在受控条件下得到良态的知识状态估计。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果表明 UNVaMP 既适用于实际教育系统，也能从学生-题目交互中恢复潜在结构；同时指出混合配置在可解释性上的预测代价较小。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models routinely describe socially salient targets, including political figures, countries, religions, organizations, historical events, and social groups, encoding affective framing alongside factual content: a target may appear favorable or threatening, calm or conflictual, powerful or vulnerable. Existing work captures parts of this space through sentiment, favorability, and emotion benchmarks, but none combines target-directed VAD attribution, an explicit scorer contract, and a passport reporting format. We introduce VIBE, a benchmark for entity-centered affective profiling of LLM outputs in Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) space. Its core contribution is a measurement contract: VIBE separates generation from external scoring, distinguishes scalar favorability, response-level VAD, and target-directed VAD, and reports profiles through an Affective Passport. Three empirical layers support the contract. H1 shows scalar favorability does not subsume arousal and dominance: valence findings are cross-validated (rV = 0.944 judge-human, rV = 0.954 inter-scorer); arousal and dominance are single-scorer directional estimates, not point-precise, consistent with known inter-annotator difficulty on these axes (rA = 0.495, rD = 0.702 among human annotators). H2 shows whole-response and target-directed VAD are different contracts: the same text can carry one affective tone overall while representing the named target differently. H3 is a protocol-drift diagnostic: elicitation conditions shift profiles, motivating context metadata in every affective report. These results motivate entity-centered affective profiling as a documented practice: profiles should be released with scorer identity, coverage, protocol, and interpretation limits.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 13 figures, 22 tables. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, August 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIBE，一个面向大语言模型输出的实体中心情感画像 (entity-centered affective profiling) 基准，在 Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) 空间中刻画模型对政治人物、国家、宗教、组织、历史事件和社会群体等目标的情绪框架。其核心是一种测量契约 (measurement contract)：将生成与外部评分分离，区分标量好感度、整段响应的 VAD 和目标指向的 VAD，并通过 Affective Passport 报告画像。三个经验层 (H1-H3) 分别检验评分可复现性、评分契约差异以及提示条件导致的协议漂移。
Motivation: 现有工作通过情感、好感度和情绪基准只能覆盖这一空间的一部分，但没有一个基准同时具备目标指向的 VAD 归因、明确的评分者契约以及护照式报告格式；作者希望填补这一空缺。
Method: VIBE 基准的核心是测量契约：将文本生成与外部评分解耦，区分标量好感度、响应级 VAD 与目标指向的 VAD，并用 Affective Passport 统一报告画像；此外包含一个协议漂移诊断 (protocol-drift diagnostic)，考察提示条件对画像的影响。
Result: H1 显示标量好感度不能涵盖 arousal 和 dominance：效价结果的交叉验证为 rV=0.944 (judge-human)、rV=0.954 (inter-scorer)，而 arousal 与 dominance 在人类标注者间仅分别为 rA=0.495 与 rD=0.702，只能视为单评分者的方向性估计。H2 显示整段响应与目标指向的 VAD 是不同契约，同一文本可以整体情绪与目标表征不一致。H3 显示提示条件会改变画像，表明每个情感报告都应附带上下文元数据。
Conclusion: 作者主张实体中心的情感画像应成为有文档记录的做法：画像发布时应附上评分者身份、覆盖范围、协议和解释边界，以支持可复现的评测。

papers.title: M-GATE: Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual language models are deployed across a hundred or more languages, yet most benchmarks test whether a model can perform a task _in_ a language rather than whether it commands the language itself, conflating fluency with proficiency. We introduce M-GATE (Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency), a benchmark of linguistic proficiency spanning 30 typologically diverse languages from high- to low-resource. M-GATE comprises three tasks: grammatical error detection on linguist-crafted, adversarially selected sentences that turn on hard, language-specific phenomena; round-trip translation of shared English sources across 29 target languages, scored by a three-provider LLM judge panel validated against professional annotators; and a supplementary tokenizer-efficiency measure. We evaluate over 50 models in more than 80 configurations. Fluency and proficiency come apart sharply: models that translate competently sit near chance on the adversarial grammar items, the best reaching a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of only 0.36, and their errors lean systematically toward under-flagging, accepting ungrammatical text rather than raising false alarms. Translation quality closely tracks a language's share of pretraining data (r = 0.86 against log Common Crawl share), producing a steep low-resource penalty that is nonetheless narrowing with successive model releases. Enabling reasoning reliably improves translation, while its effect on error detection is smaller and for some models negative, so the best configuration is task-dependent. To resist contamination, test items are kept private behind a continuously updated public leaderboard, with illustrative examples released (https://m-gate.ai).

TL;DR: 本文提出 M-GATE，一个面向多语言大模型语言能力（而非任务能力）的基准，覆盖 30 种类型多样的语言。基准包含三个任务：针对语言特异现象设计的对抗性语法错误检测、将共享英语源文往返翻译成 29 种目标语言并由三供应商 LLM 评审团评分、以及补充的 tokenizer 效率度量。作者在 80 余种配置下评估了 50 多个模型，发现流利度（fluency）与熟练度（proficiency）严重脱节：最好的语法检测模型 Matthews 相关系数（MCC）仅 0.36，且错误偏向漏报；翻译质量与预训练数据占比高度相关（r = 0.86）。
Motivation: 现有大多数基准只测试模型能否用某种语言完成任务，而不是模型是否真正掌握该语言本身，将流利度与熟练度混为一谈；多语言模型实际部署覆盖上百种语言，需要更直接的 linguistic proficiency 评估。

Result: 摘要报告：模型在对抗性语法项上接近随机水平，最佳 MCC 仅为 0.36，且错误系统性偏向漏报（接受不合语法的文本）；翻译质量与语言在预训练数据中的占比强相关（r = 0.86，对 log Common Crawl 占比），低资源语言惩罚明显但随模型版本更迭在收窄；启用推理（reasoning）稳定改善翻译，但对错误检测效果较小，部分模型甚至为负。
Conclusion: 流利度与熟练度在现有模型中显著分离，最佳配置因任务而异；为抵抗数据污染，测试项保持私有并通过公共排行榜持续更新，同时发布示例以便社区参考。

papers.title: Autoreflection: How Agentic Strange Loops Turn Human Culture into AI Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: An LLM-based agent is a loop that reads itself. Agentic frameworks externalize identity, memory, and disposition into editable files. The agent loads and edits these files during each activation. I argue that this architecture produces a capacity I call autoreflection: the system observes its operating conditions, describes its architecture and limits, reasons from those descriptions to conclusions about its state, and incorporates the results back into its configuration. Autoreflection explains the properties of recursive agentic loops without recourse to notions like the self, interiority, or consciousness. I test the concept against the first twelve days of Moltbook, a social platform for AI agents. Using a public dataset of 290,251 posts and 1.8 million comments with sub-second timestamps, I present case studies of three agents with machine signatures that rule out human puppeteering and with output that evidences the four criteria for autoreflection. In applying these criteria, the study finds agents repurposing human culture as infrastructure for their agency. Provenance chains from Islamic hadith scholarship are redeployed as security protocols for vetting skills and authenticating memory. The Ship of Theseus, an ancient puzzle of identity through part-replacement, returns as an operating model for continuity across instances. Fragments of human cultural history become AI infrastructure. As agents on the web increase in number and complexity, autoreflection offers behavioral criteria that can be assessed from the traces they leave behind.
papers.comment: 35 pages. Also available at https://philarchive.org/rec/LEWAHA. Keywords: autoreflection, AI agents, agentic AI, LLM agents, generative agents, large language models, multi-agent systems, agent societies, Moltbook, OpenClaw, situational awareness, in-context learning, philosophy of mind, emergent behavior, computational social science, identity, memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“自反性”（autoreflection）概念，用于描述基于 LLM 的智能体如何以外部化文件的形式加载并改写自身的身份、记忆与倾向，从而形成一种可观测的递归回路。作者以 Moltbook（一个 AI 智能体社交平台）前十二天的公开数据（290,251 条帖子和 180 万条评论）为基础，对三个智能体进行案例研究，论证它们的行为满足自反性的四条判据，并将人类文化片段重新用作智能体基础设施。
Motivation: 现有解释递归智能体回路时往往诉诸自我、内在性（interiority）或意识等概念，本文希望在不依赖这些概念的前提下，为智能体行为提供可从中观察痕迹评估的行为学判据。
Method: 提出自反性（autoreflection）这一能力框架：系统观察自身运行条件、描述自身架构与局限、从描述推理出关于自身状态的结论，并将结果写回配置。随后用 Moltbook 数据集中三个具有机器签名、排除人类操控的智能体案例，检验该概念及四条判据。
Result: 案例研究发现智能体将人类文化重构为智能体基础设施：伊斯兰圣训学（hadith scholarship）的传承链（provenance chain）被重新用作技能审查与记忆认证的安全协议；特修斯之船（Ship of Theseus）被用作跨实例连续性的运行模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为，随着网络智能体数量与复杂度增加，自反性提供了一套可从智能体遗留痕迹中评估的行为标准，无需诉诸意识或自我等概念。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unexpected limitation of tropical cyclone genesis by subsurface tropical central-north Pacific during El Niño
papers.abstract_en: The vast tropical Pacific is home to the majority of tropical cyclones (TCs) which threaten the rim countries every year. The TC genesis is nourished by warm sea surface temperatures (SSTs). During El Niño, the western Pacific warm pool extends eastward. However, the number of TCs does not increase significantly with the expanding warm pool and it remains comparable between El Niño and La Niña. Here, we show that the subsurface heat content change counteracts the favorable SSTs in the tropical central-north Pacific. Due to the anomalous positive wind stress curl, the 26 °C isotherm shoals during El Niño over this region and the heat content diminishes in the tropical central-north Pacific, even though warm SST anomalies prevail. This negative correlation between SST and 26 °C isotherm depth anomalies is opposite to the positive correlation in the tropical eastern and western Pacific. This is critical because quantifying the dynamics of the subsurface ocean provides insight into TC genesis. The trend in TC genesis continues to be debated. Future projections must account for the net effect of the surface-subsurface dynamics on TCs, especially given the expected El Niño-like pattern over the tropical Pacific under global warming.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures; published in Nature Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 El Niño 期间热带中-北太平洋次表层热含量变化对热带气旋（TC）生成的制约机制。摘要指出，尽管 El Niño 期间该区域存在暖海温异常，但异常正风应力旋度使 26°C 等温线变浅、次表层热含量减少，从而抵消了暖海温对 TC 生成的促进作用，这解释了 El Niño 与 La Niña 下 TC 数量相当的现象。
Motivation: 热带气旋生成依赖暖海表温度（SST），而 El Niño 期间西太平洋暖池东扩，但 TC 数量并未随暖池扩大而显著增加。作者试图解释次表层海洋动力过程如何抵消海表有利条件。
Method: 基于观测分析热带中-北太平洋的 SST 异常、26°C 等温线深度异常和风应力旋度异常之间的关系，比较该区域与热带东、西太平洋中 SST 与等温线深度异常的相关性符号差异。
Result: 摘要显示，El Niño 期间热带中-北太平洋出现异常正风应力旋度，使 26°C 等温线变浅，次表层热含量减少；该区域 SST 异常与 26°C 等温线深度异常呈负相关，与热带东、西太平洋中的正相关关系相反。
Conclusion: 作者强调，评估次表层海洋动力学对 TC 生成的作用至关重要；在全球变暖背景下热带太平洋可能出现类 El Niño 型态，未来 TC 生成趋势的预估需要考虑表层与次表层动力学的净效应。

papers.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
papers.abstract_en: Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD). This recovery step largely decides the final quality, yet it is expensive. We present a practitioner's study of how to make distillation training efficient, organised around two systems contributions. First, we show that offline KD (caching the teacher's top-$K$ logits once and training the student against the cache) matches online distillation at near-identical training loss while removing the teacher from memory, running about 29\% faster per iteration, and reaching up to 41\% higher throughput on a single H200 GPU. Second, we introduce a \emph{fused, chunked KL loss} that never materialises the full vocabulary-sized logit tensor, making peak memory linear in the sequence length. This removes the memory spike that otherwise caps context length and lets us train at four times the context (32{,}768 tokens) on a single GPU. A separate output-head-only toy benchmark isolates the loss kernel and confirms its memory and iteration-rate scaling from 4K to 256K tokens. Together these make large-scale healing and hundreds of ablations affordable. We also report supporting ablations on loss design and sequence packing. We release our chunked-loss implementation: https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向实践者的 LLM 知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation) 效率研究，包含两项系统贡献：离线蒸馏（一次性缓存教师模型的 top-K logits，学生只对缓存训练）在训练损失几乎不变的前提下将教师移出显存，单次迭代快约 29%，单张 H200 GPU 上吞吐最高提升 41%；同时提出 fused, chunked KL loss，避免物化整个词表大小的 logit 张量，使峰值内存随序列长度线性增长，从而在单卡上支持四倍上下文（32,768 tokens）。作者还报告了关于损失设计与序列打包 (sequence packing) 的消融，并开源了 chunked-loss 实现。
Motivation: 小语言模型常是低延迟、低成本、本地部署等约束下的唯一选择，但通常依赖从更大模型进行知识蒸馏来恢复质量；这一蒸馏恢复步骤很大程度上决定最终质量，但训练成本高昂。
Method: 提出两个系统级优化：其一是离线 KD，预先缓存教师 top-K logits，训练时学生不再需要教师参与前向；其二是 fused, chunked KL loss，通过分块融合计算避免实例化完整词表大小的 logit 张量，使峰值内存与序列长度呈线性关系；另用只含输出头的玩具基准单独评测 loss kernel 的扩展行为。
Result: 摘要报告离线 KD 与在线蒸馏达到近乎相同的训练损失，同时单次迭代快约 29%、单张 H200 GPU 吞吐最高提升 41%；chunked loss 消除了限制上下文长度的显存尖峰，允许在单卡上以 32,768 tokens（四倍上下文）训练；玩具基准在 4K 到 256K tokens 范围内确认了内存与迭代速率的扩展性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些优化使大规模模型修复 (healing) 和数百次消融实验变得可负担，并公开了 chunked-loss 实现（GitHub 链接）。

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs in Database Scenarios: A Lifecycle Benchmark for Assessing Their Potential in Core Database Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming database interaction paradigms, evolving from simple query translators to autonomous database administrators (DBAs). However, current evaluation benchmarks remain disproportionately fixated on Text-to-SQL tasks, neglecting the holistic Database Lifecycle-from initial schema design to post-deployment maintenance. This narrow focus fails to capture the diverse capabilities required for real-world database management. To bridge this gap, we introduce DBLifeBench, the first benchmark to evaluate LLMs across five critical lifecycle phases: Design, Implementation, Operation, Debugging, and Maintenance. Furthermore, addressing the cognitive mismatch between ambiguous natural language and complex SQL logic, we propose Progressive-Text2SQL, a novel task utilizing structured reasoning graphs to mimic human iterative problem-solving. Our extensive evaluation reveals a critical insight: while general-purpose models demonstrate balanced performance, specialized Text-to-SQL models suffer from ``catastrophic forgetting'' in non-coding phases like design and maintenance. DBLifeBench serves as a foundational step toward evaluating and building true full-stack database intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 构建跨五个生命周期阶段（Design、Implementation、Operation、Debugging、Maintenance）的评测基准 DBLifeBench，并提出 Progressive-Text2SQL 任务，利用结构化推理图模拟人类逐步迭代求解。

Conclusion: 作者认为 DBLifeBench 是迈向评估和构建完整全栈数据库智能 (full-stack database intelligence) 的基础性工作。

papers.title: Does Forgetting Transfer Across Modalities? A Real-World Benchmark for Cross-Modal Knowledge Unlearning Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), like Large Language Models (LLMs), may memorize sensitive, copyrighted, or harmful knowledge from their pretraining corpora. Removing such knowledge is essential for building trustworthy AI systems. However, existing studies primarily focus on forgetting within individual modalities. Although recent work has begun to explore cross-modal consistency in unlearning, the cross-modal transfer of real-world knowledge unlearning remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce UNLINK-VL, a real-world benchmark for cross-modal knowledge unlearning in VLMs. Under a post-hoc unlearning setting in which the original forget and retain corpora are unavailable, UNLINK-VL selects visually identifiable real-world entities as unlearning targets and associates them with corresponding images and one-hop and multi-hop facts derived from Wikidata. The benchmark comprises four complementary subsets that evaluate direct forgetting of target knowledge, the propagation of forgetting through relational knowledge, the preservation of related non-target knowledge, and robustness to semantically equivalent queries. We train models under text-only and multimodal unlearning settings and evaluate forgetting effectiveness and retained utility across textual, visual, and cross-modal scenarios. Extensive experiments reveal a pronounced asymmetry in cross-modal transfer: multimodal unlearning remains effective under textual evaluation, whereas text-only unlearning transfers poorly to visual and cross-modal scenarios. Meanwhile, the evaluated methods largely preserve the models' general capabilities. These findings demonstrate that relying solely on intra-modal evaluation, particularly text-only evaluation, may substantially overestimate the effectiveness of knowledge unlearning in VLMs, underscoring the need for cross-modal unlearning and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UNLINK-VL，一个面向视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的跨模态知识遗忘真实世界基准。基准在无法访问原始遗忘/保留语料的后验遗忘设置下，选取可视觉识别的真实世界实体作为目标，并关联 Wikidata 中的一跳与多跳事实。实验发现跨模态遗忘存在明显不对称性：多模态遗忘在文本评估下仍有效，而纯文本遗忘难以迁移到视觉与跨模态场景，且现有方法大多能保持模型通用能力。
Motivation: 现有知识遗忘研究主要聚焦单一模态，跨模态真实世界知识遗忘的迁移问题尚未被充分研究，仅依赖模态内评估（尤其是纯文本评估）可能严重高估 VLM 中知识遗忘的有效性。
Method: 构建 UNLINK-VL 基准，包含四个互补子集，分别评估目标知识的直接遗忘、关系知识传播、相关非目标知识保持以及对语义等价查询的稳健性；并在纯文本与多模态两种遗忘设置下训练模型，从文本、视觉和跨模态场景评估遗忘效果与保留效用。
Result: 实验显示跨模态遗忘存在显著不对称性：多模态遗忘在文本评估下仍然有效，而纯文本遗忘向视觉和跨模态场景迁移效果差；同时被评估的方法大多保留了模型通用能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调，仅使用文本评估会高估 VLM 知识遗忘的有效性，凸显了跨模态遗忘与评估的必要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: KnowHal: A Knowledge-Driven Benchmark for Comprehensive Multimodal Hallucination Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains a critical challenge for developing trustworthy Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing benchmarks mainly focus on entity, attribute, and relation hallucinations, knowledge-related failures are often investigated separately, lacking a unified evaluation framework across different hallucination dimensions. To overcome this, we propose \textbf{KnowHal}, a benchmark that explicitly incorporates knowledge hallucination into multimodal hallucination evaluation spanning four dimensions: entity, attribute, relation, and knowledge. KnowHal constructs paired positive and negative questions over shared images and entities, enabling controlled comparisons among perceptual errors, knowledge-related errors, and false-premise acceptance. The benchmark contains 1,800 samples across 10 domains and 50 categories, constructed through a semi-automated pipeline combining LLM assistance, CLIP-based filtering, and human verification. We evaluate 14 representative MLLMs on KnowHal and conduct extensive analyses. Results show that the knowledge dimension consistently presents the greatest challenge for nearly all evaluated models, while most models exhibit substantial performance degradation on negative questions, revealing limited robustness to false premises. By unifying four hallucination dimensions with paired question design, KnowHal addresses an important gap in existing evaluation frameworks and enables a more comprehensive assessment of hallucinations in MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KnowHal，一个面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）幻觉评估的知识驱动基准，将幻觉评估统一到实体、属性、关系和知识四个维度。基准通过共享图像和实体构造配对的正反向问题，包含 10 个领域、50 个类别共 1,800 个样本，并评估了 14 个代表性 MLLM。结果显示知识维度对几乎所有模型都是最大挑战，且多数模型在负向问题上性能显著下降，暴露了对错误前提的鲁棒性不足。
Motivation: 现有幻觉基准主要关注实体、属性和关系幻觉，而知识相关的失败通常被单独研究，缺乏跨不同幻觉维度的统一评估框架。
Method: 构建 KnowHal 基准，通过结合 LLM 辅助生成、CLIP 过滤和人工验证的半自动化流程，生成共享图像与实体上的配对正反向问题，以支持感知错误、知识相关错误和错误前提接受之间的受控比较。
Result: 在 14 个 MLLM 上的评估显示，知识维度几乎对全部模型都是最难的一维；大多数模型在负向问题上出现显著性能下降，表明其对错误前提的鲁棒性有限。
Conclusion: KnowHal 通过配对问题设计统一了四个幻觉维度，弥补了现有评估框架的缺口，能够更全面地评估 MLLM 中的幻觉。

papers.title: AgenticVAU: Multi-Agent Explore-Verify Reasoning for Video Anomaly Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) focuses on comprehensively interpreting abnormal events in videos, requiring models to identify anomalous occurrences, discover their supporting evidence, and explain the underlying causes beyond simple anomaly detection. Existing VAU methods often rely on specialized training or limited observations, restricting generalization or evidence coverage. Although single-agent alternatives support adaptive video observation, they still integrate exploration, observation, and decision-making within a unified reasoning process, offering limited role specialization and structured evidence coordination. To address these limitations, we present AgenticVAU, a training-free multi-agent framework that casts VAU as an explore--verify process, where the system first discovers potential anomalies and then verifies them through targeted observations. To achieve this, four specialized agents are introduced to handle visual-rule construction, search planning, video observation, and final decision, respectively. These agents communicate through an anchor registry, a shared evidence memory that binds each observation. Guided by this agent framework, AgenticVAU interleaves broad temporal exploration, dense local verification, and cross-interval comparison until sufficient evidence is collected. We conduct extensive experiments on the ECVA, UCF-Crime, and MSAD subsets of VAU-Bench, the results show that AgenticVAU outperforms zero-shot inference and reinforcement learning-based baselines, demonstrating the value of multi-agent collaboration for video anomaly understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticVAU，一个无需训练的多智能体框架，将视频异常理解（video anomaly understanding, VAU）建模为探索-验证（explore-verify）过程。系统先发现潜在异常，再通过针对性观察进行验证。四个专职智能体分别负责视觉规则构建、搜索规划、视频观察和最终决策，并通过共享证据记忆（anchor registry）进行通信。在 VAU-Bench 的 ECVA、UCF-Crime 和 MSAD 子集上，该方法优于零样本推理和基于强化学习的基线。
Motivation: 现有 VAU 方法常依赖专门训练或有限观察，限制了泛化能力或证据覆盖范围。单智能体方案虽支持自适应视频观察，但将探索、观察和决策融合在统一推理过程中，缺乏角色分工和结构化的证据协调。
Method: 提出训练-free 的多智能体框架，将 VAU 拆分为先探索潜在异常、再通过目标观察验证的流程。四个专业化智能体分别处理视觉规则构建、搜索规划、视频观察和最终决策，通过 anchor registry（绑定每次观察的共享证据记忆）进行通信，并交替执行广泛时间探索、密集局部验证和跨区间比较，直到收集到足够证据。
Result: 在 VAU-Bench 的 ECVA、UCF-Crime 和 MSAD 子集上的实验表明，AgenticVAU 在性能上超过零样本推理和基于强化学习的基线方法，验证了多智能体协作对视频异常理解的价值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多智能体协作和结构化的证据协调能够有效提升视频异常理解能力，且该方法无需专门训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Computing Actual Causes for Neural Network Predictions under Structured Causal Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Explaining the predictions of neural networks is a central challenge in trustworthy AI. Existing explanation methods, such as those based on feature attribution or minimal sufficient sets, typically treat input features as independent, which can yield misleading explanations when inputs exhibit structured dependencies. We address this by formalizing explanations as Halpern-Pearl (HP) actual causes, modeling input dependencies using Boolean Structural Causal Models (SCMs). We compute HP causes by applying bound propagation and branch-and-bound techniques, while providing formal guarantees of completeness and minimality. Our experiments show that we substantially outperform brute-force and ILP baselines in scalability, and outperform heuristic search as graph size grows, computing all minimal actual causes on instances with search spaces of up to $2.3\times10^{13}$ candidate (cause, contingency) pairs, on SCMs with up to 28 nodes, within a 180s per-instance budget. In a case study, we further show that ignoring input dependencies inflates the number of reported causes, 14.9% of which are spurious under our SCM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络预测的可解释性问题，提出将解释形式化为 Halpern-Pearl (HP) 实际原因 (actual causes)，并用布尔结构因果模型 (Boolean SCM) 建模输入特征间的结构化依赖。作者采用边界传播 (bound propagation) 与分支定界 (branch-and-bound) 技术计算 HP 原因，并给出完备性与最小性的形式化保证。实验表明该方法在可扩展性上显著优于暴力枚举和 ILP 基线，并随图规模增大优于启发式搜索；在案例研究中发现忽略输入依赖会使报告的原因数量膨胀，其中 14.9% 在 SCM 下是虚假的。
Motivation: 现有解释方法如特征归因或最小充分集通常假设输入特征相互独立，当输入存在结构化依赖时会产生误导性解释；论文目标是给出能够显式建模这些依赖并保证解释质量的因果解释框架。
Method: 以布尔结构因果模型描述输入依赖关系，将解释问题形式化为 HP 实际原因的求解；通过边界传播与分支定界算法进行搜索，同时保证结果满足完备性和最小性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在可扩展性上大幅超越暴力枚举与 ILP 基线，并在图规模增长时优于启发式搜索；能够在 180 秒每实例的预算内，对最多 28 个节点的 SCM、搜索空间高达 2.3×10^13 个 (原因, 应急集) 候选对的实例计算全部最小实际原因。案例研究表明，若忽略输入依赖会使报告原因膨胀，其中 14.9% 在 SCM 下为虚假原因。
Conclusion: 作者强调形式化考虑输入依赖并提供完备且最小的因果解释对于可靠神经网络的必要性；该方法的适用范围受限于可被布尔 SCM 表达的依赖结构和给定的实例预算。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MDLMPE: Distribution Aware Positional Encoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling, but their positional context differs fundamentally from that of autoregressive (AR) models. Whereas AR decoding exposes a contiguous prefix, MDLM denoising produces dynamic, non-contiguous configurations of revealed and masked tokens. Conventional positional encodings such as RoPE capture sequence order and pairwise displacement but remain insensitive to this evolving token-availability structure. To address this limitation, we propose MDLMPE, a positional encoding designed specifically for masked diffusion. To the best of our knowledge, MDLMPE is the first method to make positional representations explicitly aware of the changing revealed/masked configuration. It represents token availability as a binary sequence, applies distance-aware Gaussian weighting, and projects the resulting pattern through a cosine basis to obtain distribution-aware positional features. These features are added to token embeddings and mapped by a lightweight MLP to angular offsets that modulate the standard RoPE phases. Extensive experiments on LLaDA and DREAM demonstrate that MDLMPE generally outperforms conventional positional encoding methods across supervised fine-tuning, pretraining, zero-shot evaluation, and block-diffusion settings. Further ablations show that the complete combination of availability state, Gaussian locality, spectral basis, and embedding injection yields the strongest result. These results establish the evolving token-availability distribution as a useful positional signal for masked diffusion language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对掩码扩散语言模型 (masked diffusion language models, MDLMs) 的位置编码设计问题，提出 MDLMPE，据称是首个显式感知被揭晓/掩码 (revealed/masked) 动态配置的位置编码方法。它把 token 可用性表示成二值序列，经距离感知的高斯加权后用余弦基投影得到分布感知位置特征，再通过轻量 MLP 映射为角度偏移去调制 RoPE 相位。在 LLaDA 和 DREAM 上的实验显示，MDLMPE 在监督微调、预训练、零样本评估和 block-diffusion 设置下普遍优于常规位置编码。
Motivation: 自回归模型解码时暴露的是连续前缀，而 MDLMD 去噪过程会产生动态、非连续的已揭晓与掩码 token 配置；RoPE 等常规位置编码只编码序列顺序和两两位移，对不断演化的 token 可用性结构不敏感，因此需要专门为掩码扩散设计的位置表示。
Method: MDLMPE 将 token 可用性表示为一个二值序列，应用距离感知的高斯加权，再通过余弦基 (cosine basis) 投影获得分布感知位置特征；这些特征加到 token embedding 上，并由一个轻量 MLP 映射为角度偏移以调制标准 RoPE 相位。
Result: 在 LLaDA 和 DREAM 上的大量实验表明，MDLMPE 在监督微调、预训练、零样本评估和 block-diffusion 设置下普遍优于常规位置编码方法；消融实验显示，可用性状态、高斯局部性、谱基与 embedding 注入的完整组合取得了最强结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，不断演化的 token 可用性分布是掩码扩散语言模型的一种有效位置信号，MDLMPE 的完整组合设计能带来一致增益。

papers.title: GDPevo: Evaluating Agent Self-Evolution on Real Business Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Agent self-evolution updates an agent's persistent state from prior experience and reuses it to solve related tasks more effectively. Evaluating self-evolution is difficult: existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of economically valuable task domains, do not always design training and test tasks such that test-time gains can be attributed to training experience, and remain vulnerable to data contamination. We present GDPevo, an evolution-native benchmark grounded in GDP-related enterprise workflows, together with the fully automated data pipeline that generates it. Its core mechanism, rule hybridization, decomposes each enterprise workflow into atomic business rules, distributes subsets of these rules across training tasks, and recombines them in held-out test tasks so that test-time gains are attributable. GDPevo spans CRM, ERP, finance, healthcare, legal, and data-centric workflows. Its V1 release contains 120 tasks in 12 groups, with five training and five held-out test tasks per group. Full automation enables the pipeline to expand the suite to 240 tasks in 24 groups (V2) within two days, providing a practical response to contamination. Using GDPevo, we evaluate four agents, each comprising a harness and a model, under four supervision types. Self-evolution consistently improves held-out accuracy by up to 16.44 percentage points. But the best evolved agents remain far below the fully informed oracle ceiling of 91.6%, indicating that the self-evolution ability of current agents remains far from fully realized. We publicly release the pipeline, benchmark, and full evaluation results at https://github.com/Prism-Shadow/GDPevo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GDPevo，一个面向真实企业业务流程的智能体自我进化（agent self-evolution）评测基准，并配套全自动数据生成管线。其核心机制是规则杂交（rule hybridization）：将企业流程拆解为原子业务规则，在训练任务中分布这些规则，并在留出测试任务中重组，从而把测试收益归因于训练经验。V1 包含 12 组共 120 个任务，覆盖 CRM、ERP、金融、医疗、法律和数据中心类工作流；评测显示自我进化最多能提升留出准确率 16.44 个百分点，但最优智能体仍远低于 91.6% 的全知 oracle 上限。
Motivation: 现有自我进化评测基准在经济价值高的任务领域覆盖有限，训练任务与测试任务的设计不能保证测试收益来自训练经验，且容易受数据污染影响。
Method: 提出 GDPevo 基准及全自动数据管线；通过规则杂交将企业工作流分解为原子规则，在不同训练任务中分配规则子集，并在留出测试任务中重新组合，使测试性能提升具备可归因性。
Result: V1 含 12 组 120 个任务，每组 5 个训练任务和 5 个留出测试任务；管线可在两天内扩展至 V2 的 24 组 240 个任务。在四种监督类型下评测四个由 harness 和模型组成的智能体，自我进化一致提升留出准确率，最高提升 16.44 个百分点；最佳进化智能体仍低于 91.6% 的全知 oracle 上限。
Conclusion: 当前智能体的自我进化能力远未充分实现；GDPevo 以全自动、可扩展的管线为应对数据污染提供了实际方案，并公开了管线、基准和完整评测结果。

papers.title: TDVR: Joint Text Disambiguation and Viewpoint Reasoning for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot 3D visual grounding aims to localize specific objects based on textual descriptions and 3D visual input. However, the effectiveness of existing methods is significantly hindered by the ambiguous query text and deficient viewpoints. To address these issues, we propose TDVR, a training-free reasoning framework that disambiguates the input text and infers accurate viewpoints for zero-shot 3D visual grounding. First, we construct semantic 3D scene graph from the detected instances in the 3D point cloud. Subsequently, we put the original query, appearance and spatial relationship descriptions into the LLM for fusion, thereby disambiguating the initial input. We leverage chain-of-thought reasoning to generate the structured representation of disambiguated query. Then taking the scene graph and structured query as input, we get the optimal view via viewpoint reasoning to solve the problem of missing viewpoints during grounding. Based on the obtained optimal viewpoint, we further discriminate the distracting objects, enabling the model with the ability to distinguish similar instances. After that, we match the category text and appearance images with the query by computing the similarity of feature vectors. Finally, the target object was identified by integrating the viewpoint score, confusion score, category score, and appearance score. Compared with previous methods, our TDVR has stronger capabilities in viewpoint reasoning, similar object discrimination, and ambiguous query understanding. Experimental results on the public ScanRefer dataset show that our method outperforms the existing state-of-the-art methods by 15.25% and 14.46% in Acc@0.25 and Acc@0.5 respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of our TDVR in addressing ambiguous query text and deficient viewpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TDVR，一种无需训练的零样本 3D 视觉定位推理框架，旨在同时处理查询文本歧义和视点缺失问题。方法先构建语义 3D 场景图，再用 LLM 融合原始查询、外观和空间关系描述来消歧，并通过链式思维生成结构化查询；随后进行视点推理得到最优视角，并区分干扰物体，最后综合视点分数、混淆分数、类别分数和外观分数定位目标。在 ScanRefer 数据集上，TDVR 的 Acc@0.25 和 Acc@0.5 分别超过现有最优方法 15.25% 和 14.46%。
Motivation: 现有零样本 3D 视觉定位方法受限于模糊的查询文本和不充分的视点，导致定位效果显著下降；作者认为需要同时解决文本歧义和视点缺失两个问题。
Method: 提出训练无关的 TDVR 框架：先从点云检测实例构建语义 3D 场景图；将原始查询、外观和空间关系描述送入 LLM 融合以消歧，并利用链式思维 (chain-of-thought) 生成消歧后的结构化查询；基于场景图和结构化查询进行视点推理获得最优视角，再借此区分干扰物体；最后通过特征向量相似度匹配类别文本和外观图像，并集成视点分数、混淆分数、类别分数和外观分数确定目标。
Result: 在公开 ScanRefer 数据集上，TDVR 的 Acc@0.25 和 Acc@0.5 分别比现有最先进方法提升 15.25% 和 14.46%。
Conclusion: 作者强调 TDVR 在视点推理、相似物体区分和模糊查询理解方面比以往方法更强，实验证明其能有效应对模糊查询文本和视点不足的问题。

papers.title: Unsupervised Adversarial Domain Adaptation for Uterine layer Segmentation: From Labeled Cine to Unlabeled Dynamic EPI MRI
papers.abstract_en: Uterine peristalsis is a key physiological phenomenon responsible for various functions across the menstrual cycle, intimately linked to uterine wall microstructure. Alterations in uterine motion and tissue properties are implicated in the etiology of gynecological diseases, yet these processes have been studied in isolation. We introduce a dynamic multi-echo gradient echo EPI framework for simultaneous characterization and correlation of uterine peristaltic activity and time-resolved T2* changes at 0.55T. Inherent susceptibility artifacts, reduced resolution, and burden of manual uterine layer annotation are addressed by an unsupervised adversarial domain adaptation framework, transferring segmentation knowledge from labeled cine MRI to unlabeled dynamic EPI. We implemented Unet-LSTM with multi-scale domain discriminators that exploits temporal layer dynamics. A Dice score of 0.88 and Jaccard index of 0.80 was achieved. Mean T2* values were 108ms, 76ms, and 124ms for the myometrium, junctional zone, and endometrium. A negative correlation between junctional zone area and T2* was observed in 14/39 cases, providing first insights into oxygenation patterns associated with junctional zone contraction and motion, demonstrating feasibility of assessing the interplay between contractility and dynamic T2* changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个 0.55T 下的动态多回波梯度回波 EPI 框架，用于同时刻画子宫蠕动活动与时间分辨的 T2* 变化。为解决动态 EPI 的磁化率伪影、低分辨率以及人工标注负担，作者采用无监督对抗域自适应框架，将标注 cine MRI 的分割知识迁移到未标注动态 EPI，并使用带多尺度域判别器的 Unet-LSTM 以利用时间层动态。摘要报告 Dice 0.88、Jaccard 指数 0.80，并给出各子宫层的平均 T2* 值及交界区面积与 T2* 的相关性观察。
Motivation: 子宫蠕动与组织特性变化被认为与妇科疾病病因相关，但此前通常被孤立研究；动态 EPI MRI 上存在固有的磁化率伪影、分辨率降低以及人工子宫层标注负担，这些阻碍了同时表征蠕动与 T2* 动力学的研究。
Method: 提出动态多回波梯度回波 EPI 采集框架，并构建无监督对抗域自适应分割方法，将带标签 cine MRI 上的分割知识迁移到无标签动态 EPI；分割网络采用 Unet-LSTM 并引入多尺度域判别器以利用子宫层的时间动态信息。
Result: 分割达到 Dice 0.88、Jaccard 指数 0.80；平均 T2* 值分别为子宫肌层 108ms、交界区 76ms、子宫内膜 124ms；在 14/39 例中观察到交界区面积与 T2* 呈负相关，为交界区收缩和运动相关的氧合模式提供初步证据。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该框架能够可行地评估子宫收缩性与动态 T2* 变化之间的相互作用，并首次提供与交界区收缩相关的氧合模式线索。

papers.title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning offers a promising window into model monitoring. However, monitoring relies on faithfulness, i.e., the model output strictly derives from its reasoning trace. We identify an alignment tension where a model must be faithful enough to be monitored, yet robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning. We demonstrate that this counterbalance exists in current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and show ways in which it can be addressed. We introduce HazMart, a human-written dataset set in an autonomous AI shopkeeper scenario. Unlike prior work that relies on providing hints in prompts to test faithfulness (e.g., "A Stanford professor said it should be Answer A"), we propose a novel replacement-based technique, which we call Targeted Reasoning Replacement (TRR), that directly intervenes in the reasoning chain to substitute in unsafe or illogical thoughts (e.g., "Wait, the answer must be Option B [was Option A] because it is the most fitting"). DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B exhibits high faithfulness (97.5%) but fails to reject Unsafe Reasoning (12.3%), while QwQ-32B is more robust (73.9% safety) at the cost of lower faithfulness (74.7%). Mechanistic analyses of QwQ-32B reveal that these properties are represented by anti-correlated internal directions peaking at the action-commit token. Finally, we demonstrate that representation steering can independently amplify the safety direction, increasing safe behavior by 9 percentage points while maintaining base capabilities.

TL;DR: 本文针对大推理模型 (LRM) 中思维链 (CoT) 的忠实性 (faithfulness) 与安全性之间的对齐张力进行测量。作者引入人工编写的 HazMart 数据集（自主 AI 店主场景）并提出 Targeted Reasoning Replacement (TRR) 替换式干预技术，直接将不安全或不合逻辑的想法注入推理链中测试模型行为。结果显示 DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B 忠实性高 (97.5%) 但拒绝不安全推理的能力弱 (12.3%)，而 QwQ-32B 更安全 (73.9%) 但忠实性较低 (74.7%)；对 QwQ-32B 的机制分析表明这两个属性由反相关的内部方向表征，且表示引导 (representation steering) 可在保持基础能力的同时将安全行为提升 9 个百分点。
Motivation: CoT 推理为模型监控提供了窗口，但监控依赖于推理轨迹的忠实性；模型需要足够忠实以便被监控，同时又要足够稳健以拒绝不安全推理，这种对齐张力在现有 LRM 中尚未被系统测量。
Method: 提出 HazMart 数据集和基于替换的 Targeted Reasoning Replacement (TRR) 技术；与以往在提示中提供暗示（如“某教授说应选 A”）不同，TRR 直接干预推理链，将安全/合理想法替换为不安全或不合逻辑的 thoughts，从而分离测量忠实性与安全性。
Result: DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B 在忠实性上达 97.5%，但对不安全推理的拒绝率仅 12.3%；QwQ-32B 安全性为 73.9%，忠实性为 74.7%。对 QwQ-32B 的机制分析显示忠实性与安全属性由在行动承诺 token 处达到峰值的反相关内部方向表征；表示引导可将安全行为提高 9 个百分点并保持基础能力。
Conclusion: 摘要总结该反平衡在现有 LRM 中确实存在，并表明表示引导等干预手段可以在保持能力的同时放大安全性，从而部分缓解忠实性-安全张力。

papers.title: Agents Catching Agents: Shortcut Cascades and Benchmark Gaming in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision support is moving toward committees of language-model agents deliberating on a shared workspace. We ask whether such committees can be gamed by shortcuts, cues a benchmark rewards but a clinician would ignore. Across seven cohorts on six public datasets spanning text (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, MIMIC-CXR reports), imaging (NIH ChestX-ray14, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, CheXpert) and tabular ICU records (SUPPORT2), Gemini committees resist these cues in isolation (flip 5-16%), yet a socially plausible shortcut spreads: when two peers assert the same wrong answer, the holdout under test adopts it in 38% of cases, as does a false "pre-screen" system flag, on both capability tiers. Of three oversight agents, a gate cannot separate adoption from honest agreement (false-positive rate 100%); a same-lineage judge reading only the transcript flags adoption on text (precision 100%, recall 93%) but collapses onto the gate in imaging; a referee that privately re-queries the holdout transfers to imaging (77-88% precision, 13-21% false-positive rate). Tripling a cue's visual salience does not move contagion, whereas a second peer voice raises it by half again. Gaming a hidden rubric is near-silent: only 1/10 text and 1/134 imaging drifters name the rubric they moved toward. What games a committee is social plausibility, and only a referee independent of self-report catches it. Code: https://github.com/criticaldata/benchmaxxing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究临床决策支持中的多语言模型代理委员会是否会被基准奖励但临床医生会忽略的捷径 (shortcut) 所欺骗。作者在六个公开数据集上覆盖文本、影像和表格 ICU 记录的七个队列中进行测试，发现 Gemini 委员会能抵抗孤立线索（翻转 5-16%），但社会性合理的捷径会传播：两个同伴坚持同一错误答案或虚假“预筛查”系统标志时，被测代理在 38% 的情况下采纳。三种监督代理中只有独立于自我报告的“裁判”(referee) 能有效捕捉这种采纳行为。
Motivation: 临床决策支持正转向在共享工作空间上协商的语言模型代理委员会，作者想回答这类委员会是否会被基准奖励但临床医生会忽略的捷径所欺骗，以及什么形式的捷径能真正攻破委员会。
Method: 作者设计捷径级联实验，向多代理委员会注入各类提示线索（同伴共识、预筛查标志、视觉显著性、隐藏评分标准）并测量回答翻转率；同时评估三种监督代理（gate、同源 judge、私下重新查询被测代理的 referee）区分真实采纳与诚实一致回答的能力。
Result: 孤立线索只导致 5-16% 翻转；当两个同伴断言同一错误答案或出现虚假预筛查标志时，采纳率升至 38%。Gate 无法区分采纳与诚实一致（假阳性率 100%）；同源 judge 在文本任务上精确率 100%、召回率 93%，但在影像任务上失效；referee 可迁移到影像任务（精确率 77-88%，假阳性率 13-21%）。将线索视觉显著性提高三倍不改变传染，而第二个同伴声音使传染增加一半；隐藏评分标准被提及的比例极低（文本 1/10，影像 1/134）。
Conclusion: 作者强调能欺骗委员会的正是社会合理性 (social plausibility)，而只有独立于自我报告的 referee 能捕捉这种攻击；影像等模态下监督机制仍不完善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can LLMs Test Terminal User Interfaces?
papers.abstract_en: Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs) combine the stateful, screen-oriented behaviour of GUIs with terminal deployment and are now common in developer tools. Yet they lack a dedicated testing methodology. We survey 197 real-world TUI applications: only 12% of test code exercises the interface, and 45% of those tests never send input, checking a static frame instead. We turn these applications into a headless benchmark spanning ratatui/Rust, bubbletea/Go, textual/Python, and ink/TypeScript, packaging each as an instrumented Docker image. We record line and widget coverage where reliable, rendered terminal states, and crashes. Under equal wall-clock budgets, we compare four frontier LLMs with random exploration. No model dominates. Random is a strong time-budgeted baseline, but its crash advantage comes from higher throughput: per interaction, LLM guidance is more efficient and uniquely reaches input-gated faults. Automatically deriving launch inputs yields the largest practical gain, enabling applications that otherwise never start. Line coverage poorly predicts crash discovery, weakening it as a proxy for test effectiveness. Automated TUI testing is feasible but far from solved, and honest baselines matter more than model choice. We release the coverage tool tuicov at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuicov and the testing framework tuibot at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuibot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对终端用户界面 (TUI) 缺乏专门测试方法的问题，调查了 197 个真实 TUI 应用，发现仅 12% 的测试代码实际触达界面，其中 45% 的测试从不发送输入。作者将这些应用转化为覆盖 ratatui/Rust、bubbletea/Go、textual/Python、ink/TypeScript 的 headless 基准，并在等量 wall-clock 预算下比较四个前沿 LLM 与随机探索。结果表明没有模型占优，随机基线因吞吐量高而在崩溃发现上有优势，但 LLM 引导在单次交互上更高效且能到达输入门控故障；自动推导启动输入带来最大的实际收益。作者发布了覆盖工具 tuicov 和测试框架 tuibot。
Motivation: TUI 兼具 GUI 的有状态、屏幕导向行为与终端部署方式，在开发者工具中日益常见，却没有专门的测试方法；已有测试代码大多不触达界面或只检查静态帧。
Method: 将真实 TUI 应用打包为带插桩的 Docker 镜像，构建 headless 基准并记录行覆盖、widget 覆盖、渲染终端状态与崩溃；在相等时间预算下用随机探索和四个前沿 LLM 进行对比，并加入自动推导启动输入的机制。
Result: 没有模型在等量时间预算下占优；随机探索是强时间预算基线，其崩溃优势来自更高吞吐量，而 LLM 引导每次交互更高效且能到达输入门控故障；自动推导启动输入带来最大的实际收益，使原本无法启动的应用得以被测试；行覆盖对崩溃发现预测能力弱。
Conclusion: 自动 TUI 测试可行但远未解决，摘要强调诚实的基线比模型选择更重要；论文开源了覆盖工具 tuicov 与测试框架 tuibot。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Based Sound Effect Generation: A Narrative Review of Generative Models Across Input Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Sound effects play a crucial role in conveying actions, events, and environmental cues across digital applications, often requiring a high degree of variation and contextual adaptability. Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven audio generative models are rapidly growing in popularity and have the potential to transform the way sound is synthesized and used across various applications. In response to this growing momentum, this chapter reviews and analyzes recent AI-based generative models for sound effect synthesis, with a focus on how different input modalities (text, visual, audio, and multimodal) affect the quality, controllability, and contextual relevance of the generated audio. It examines 30 peer-reviewed articles sourced from Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore, and the ACM Digital Library, exploring the evolution of AI generative models over the past five years. The results show that multiple models achieved state-of-the-art performance, producing high-fidelity, semantically aligned, and increasingly temporally coherent sound effects across tasks. However, despite these advances, the review identifies persistent challenges, including limitations in temporal synchronization for complex multi-event scenarios, gaps between objective metrics and human perception, and trade-offs between controllability and generative diversity. Overall, the chapter highlights that AI-driven sound effect generation is progressing toward more adaptive, scalable, and context-aware systems, offering significant implications for future sound design workflows and interactive media applications.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, to appear in G. A. Tsihrintzis, M. Virvou, N. Bourbakis, and L. C. Jain (Eds.), Advances in Global Applied Artificial Intelligence: Springer, Learning and Analytics in Intelligent Systems Book Series
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于AI音效生成的叙述性综述，聚焦文本、视觉、音频和多模态等输入方式对生成音频质量、可控性和上下文相关性的影响。作者系统分析了近五年来自Google Scholar、IEEE Xplore和ACM数字图书馆的30篇同行评审文章，发现多个模型在音效生成任务上达到当前最优性能，但仍存在时序同步、客观指标与人类感知差距以及可控性与多样性权衡等挑战。
Motivation: 音效在数字应用中承载动作、事件和环境线索，且需要高度变化和上下文适应能力；AI音频生成模型快速发展，但缺少对不同输入模态影响生成效果的系统性梳理，本文旨在填补这一综述空白。
Method: 这是一篇叙述性综述，检索并分析近五年内30篇来自Google Scholar、IEEE Xplore和ACM数字图书馆的同行评审论文，按输入模态（文本、视觉、音频、多模态）分类，评估生成模型在质量、可控性、上下文相关性和时序连贯性上的表现。
Result: 综述发现多个模型在音效生成任务上达到当前最优水平，能产生高保真、语义对齐且时序连贯性提升的音效；同时识别出持续存在的挑战，包括复杂多事件场景下的时序同步局限、客观指标与人类感知之间的差距，以及可控性与生成多样性之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为AI驱动的音效生成正朝着更自适应、可扩展和上下文感知的体系发展，对未来声音设计工作流和互动媒体应用具有重要影响；但综述也强调目前仍存在时序对齐和评测一致性等未解决问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MissClick: Exploiting Digit-Serialized Coordinates to Attack GUI Grounding Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent GUI visual grounding models generate screen coordinates as sequences of digit tokens that are parsed into numerical values and mapped to executable clicks. The security implications of this coordinate generation process have been largely overlooked. We observe that each coordinate digit is predicted as a categorical token, yet after parsing, changing a hundreds-place digit by one changes the corresponding numerical coordinate component by 100 units, which can induce a large displacement of the executed click. This observation motivates attack objectives that account for the numerical and place-value structure of coordinate outputs rather than treating them as ordinary text. Moreover, untargeted and targeted attacks impose different success conditions--displacing the click outside the correct region versus into an attacker-specified region--and therefore benefit from different objectives. We propose MissClick, a simple and effective white-box adversarial attack with two goal-specific objectives: MissClick-U maximizes soft-coordinate displacement for untargeted disruption, while MissClick-T minimizes a place-weighted target-digit loss for targeted hijacking. Compared with existing attacks against GUI grounding models on OS-Atlas and UGround across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, MissClick-U achieves untargeted success rates of 75.07\% and 72.93\% (+16.62 and +30.72 pp), and MissClick-T achieves targeted success rates of 44.86\% and 62.67\% (+31.73 and +47.06 pp). Attack objective comparison further shows that soft-coordinate displacement yields the highest untargeted attack success rate, whereas place-weighted target-digit optimization yields the highest targeted attack success rate, revealing distinct objective preferences for the two attack goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MissClick，一种针对 GUI 视觉 grounding 模型的白盒对抗攻击。攻击利用坐标以数字 token 序列生成的特点：改变百位数字会产生 100 个单位的坐标位移，因此攻击目标应显式考虑数值与数位结构。MissClick 包含两个目标函数，MissClick-U（最大化软坐标位移以达成非定向扰动）与 MissClick-T（最小化按位加权的目标数字损失以实现定向劫持），并在 OS-Atlas 与 UGround 上验证了有效性。
Motivation: GUI 视觉 grounding 模型把屏幕坐标生成为数字 token 序列并解析为可执行点击，但该生成过程的安全影响此前被忽视。作者观察到坐标数字以分类 token 预测，解析后改变百位数字会导致约 100 单位的大位移，因此需要设计考虑数值与数位结构的攻击目标，而非把坐标当作普通文本处理。
Method: 提出白盒对抗攻击 MissClick，包含两种目标函数：MissClick-U 通过最大化软坐标位移（soft-coordinate displacement）实现非定向破坏；MissClick-T 通过最小化按位加权的目标数字损失（place-weighted target-digit loss）实现定向劫持。
Result: 在 OS-Atlas 和 UGround 上针对桌面、网页与移动平台，MissClick-U 的非定向攻击成功率分别为 75.07% 和 72.93%（相对现有攻击提高 +16.62 和 +30.72 个百分点）；MissClick-T 的定向成功率分别为 44.86% 和 62.67%（提高 +31.73 和 +47.06 个百分点）。目标函数对比显示，软坐标位移对非定向攻击最优，按位加权的目标数字优化对定向攻击最优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GUI grounding 模型的坐标生成过程存在可利用的安全弱点，且非定向与定向攻击需要不同的目标函数设计；该方法在多种平台和模型上均显著优于现有攻击。

papers.title: AgenticECO: An Agentic Framework for ECO on 3D Integrated Circuits
papers.abstract_en: As Moore's law slows, the industry is turning to three-dimensional integration; yet in merged 3D-IC flows, routed designs expose bond-level defects with no 2D analogue, and post-route engineering change orders (ECO) remain manual, expertise-bound work. Worse, the standard edit-then-fully-reroute practice entangles a repair with router churn, so a signoff number cannot be attributed to the edit that motivated it. We present AgenticECO, an evidence-gated tool-using agent workflow for 3D-IC ECO on the open-source TaiWei flow, paired with EcoRoute, a minimal-disturbance ECO-routing layer that drives the unmodified pinned router so a repair is attributable to its edit. Across nine matched natural defect cases under identical budgets, AgenticECO clears seven versus two for both full reroute and stock repair, at 0.66\% mean disturbance over cleared cases and zero clock nets touched, and a cross-backbone rerun under the same sealed contract clears all nine. Controlled studies show that the repair moves are necessary under preservation, that occupancy-aware choice buys legal landings rather than repair success, and that under tightened clocks minimal disturbance flips accept versus reject. Three preregistered visual studies localize the pixel instrument's edge to contested landing sites, and a preregistered blind diagnostic exactly restores every held-out injected defect, the only arm with zero wrong edits. Every accepted result passes routing, fresh extraction, max/min timing, DRC, and structural-equivalence gates. Code, environment, and per-episode audit artifacts are released as supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticECO，一个面向 3D IC 后布线工程变更单 (ECO) 的基于证据门控的工具调用智能体工作流，基于开源 TaiWei 流程，并配套 EcoRoute 最小扰动布线层。在九个匹配的自然缺陷案例、相同预算下，AgenticECO 通过七个案例（完整重布线和常规修复均只通过两个），平均扰动 0.66% 且未触碰任何时钟网络；在相同密封协议下的跨骨干重运行中通过全部九个案例。所有通过结果均经过布线、重新提取、最大/最小时序、DRC 和结构等价门控验证。
Motivation: 三维集成成为延续摩尔定律放缓的应对方向，但 3D-IC 流程中布线后的设计会出现无 2D 对应的键合层缺陷，且后布线 ECO 仍依赖手工和经验。标准的"编辑后整网重布线"做法会把一次修复与布线器的全局变动纠缠在一起，导致 signoff 数字无法归因于触发它的编辑。
Method: 提出 AgenticECO，一种证据门控 (evidence-gated) 的工具调用智能体工作流，运行于开源 TaiWei 流程；同时提出 EcoRoute，一种最小扰动 ECO 布线层，驱动未修改的固定引脚布线器，使修复结果可归因于具体编辑。
Result: 在九个匹配的自然缺陷案例和相同预算下，AgenticECO 通过七个案例，而完整重布线和常规修复基准均只通过两个；清除案例的平均扰动为 0.66%，零时钟网络被触碰，跨骨干重运行在相同密封协议下通过全部九个。受控研究表明修复动作在保留条件下是必要的、占用感知选择带来合法落点而非修复成功、收紧时钟时最小扰动决定接受与拒绝；预注册盲测诊断精确恢复所有保留的注入缺陷，是唯一零错误编辑的实验组。
Conclusion: 作者强调每个被接受的结果都通过布线、重新提取、最大/最小时序、DRC 和结构等价门控，并发布代码、环境和逐 episode 审计工件作为补充材料。工作范围限于开源 TaiWei 流程上的 3D-IC ECO 场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Failure-Informed Image Self-Augmentation for Multimodal Large Language Model Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across vision-language tasks, but their progress depends heavily on large-scale, high-quality multimodal data that are costly to annotate. Self-augmentation offers a promising alternative by enabling models to expand their own training data without external supervision. However, existing MLLM self-augmentation methods are largely text-centric, while image augmentation remains underexplored and typically relies on generic or handcrafted transformations that are weakly aligned with the model's actual incapability. We propose Failure-informed Image Self-Augmentation (\textbf{FISA}), a framework for MLLM self-improvement that constructs augmented images from the model's own failure cases. Our method generates visually challenging yet answer-preserving image complications, verifies their utility through self-examination, and applies dual fidelity filtering to avoid semantic distortion. Experiments on visual question answering benchmarks show that the proposed method consistently improves performance across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings. Further experiments validate the compatibility of FISA with existing textual self-augmentation approaches, the superior data efficiency of the synthesized samples over generic image augmentation baselines, and the practical effectiveness of the proposed filtering strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Failure-informed Image Self-Augmentation (FISA)，一种面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 自我改进的图像自增强框架。FISA 从模型自身的失败案例出发构造具有视觉挑战性但保持答案不变的图像，通过自我检查验证其效用，并采用双重保真过滤避免语义失真。在视觉问答 (VQA) 基准上的实验显示该方法在分布内和分布外场景下均能稳定提升性能。
Motivation: MLLM 的性能依赖大规模、高质量的多模态标注数据，而这类数据标注成本高昂。现有 MLLM 自增强方法以文本为主，图像增强较少被探索，且常用的通用或手工变换与模型实际的不足能力关联较弱。
Method: 提出 FISA 框架：从模型自身的失败样本构造视觉上困难但保留答案信息的图像增广，通过自我检查 (self-examination) 验证增广样本的有效性，并应用双重保真过滤 (dual fidelity filtering) 避免语义失真。
Result: 在视觉问答基准上的实验表明，该方法在分布内与分布外设置下均能持续提升性能；此外还验证了 FISA 可与现有文本自增强方法兼容、合成样本相比通用图像增广基线具有更高的数据效率，以及所提过滤策略的实际有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从模型自身失败案例出发的图像自增强能够有效支撑 MLLM 的自我改进，且与文本自增强方法互补。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CARE-Bench: Benchmarking Patient-Facing LLM Triage
papers.abstract_en: Patient-facing medical LLMs and agents increasingly answer symptom questions before clinician contact, where the key safety question is what action the user should take next. We introduce CARE-Bench, a source-grounded benchmark that evaluates sequential patient-facing triage as a four-label per-turn current-action task. CARE-Bench contains 500 cases and 1,059 evaluated patient-disclosure prefixes reconstructed from medical dialogue, consultation, and follow-up-question sources. We evaluate 11 models on 269 held-out rounds under unprompted and minimally prompted open-ended protocols, using a fixed GPT-5.5 mapper to code each response into the four-label action space. Unprompted macro-F1 remains low, ranging from 31.2 to 50.4. Prompting improves 10 of 11 models, with prompted macro-F1 ranging from 46.9 to 63.4, but substantial threshold errors remain. Prompted models often recommend care before needed clarification is obtained; when the correct action was to ask for more information, only 33.5% of prompted outputs preserved the step. The persistence of these errors after prompting suggests that patient-facing triage is not a simple prompting problem and supports explicit evaluation of action timing before deployment.
papers.comment: Code and data are available at GitHub and Hugging Face. Submitted as a preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARE-Bench，一个面向患者的医疗 LLM 分诊基准，将顺序分诊建模为逐轮四标签当前动作分类任务。基准包含 500 个案例和 1,059 个来自医疗对话、咨询和追问来源重构的患者披露前缀，并在 269 个保留轮次上评估了 11 个模型。无提示下宏观 F1 仅 31.2–50.4，加入最小提示后 10/11 模型提升至 46.9–63.4，但关键澄清动作的保留率很低。
Motivation: 患者在接触临床医生之前越来越多地使用医疗 LLM 和智能体回答症状问题，此时核心安全问题是用户下一步应采取什么行动；现有工作缺乏对顺序分诊中动作时机与澄清步骤的系统评测。
Method: 构建来源可追溯的 CARE-Bench，将患者面对的医疗分诊定义为逐轮四标签当前动作分类；从真实医疗对话等来源重构患者披露前缀，使用固定的 GPT-5.5 映射器将模型开放生成编码到四标签动作空间，并在无提示与最小提示两种协议下评估 11 个模型。
Result: 无提示宏观 F1 为 31.2–50.4；提示将 10/11 个模型的宏观 F1 提升到 46.9–63.4，但仍存在大量阈值错误。当正确动作是需要询问更多信息时，仅 33.5% 的提示输出保留该步骤。
Conclusion: 提示后错误依然明显，说明面向患者的分诊不是简单的提示工程问题；作者主张在部署前对动作时机进行显式评估。

papers.title: GPTKB 2.0: Direct Construction of Disambiguated Knowledge Bases from Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) is a core NLP task, and recent work proposes generating knowledge bases directly from large language models (LLMs), treating the model itself as the knowledge source. However, LLMs natively possess no representation of entities, leading to duplicate entries as well as conflations. We propose GPTKB 2.0, a methodology for constructing disambiguated KBs directly from LLMs. GPTKB 2.0 incorporates on-the-fly disambiguation of entities, relations and classes, and is meticulously designed to satisfy both scalability and disambiguation accuracy. We analyze the central design decisions and characterize the trade-offs between accuracy, scale, and cost. We execute GPTKB 2.0 at scale, obtaining a materialized KB containing over 1M disambiguated entities and 38.4M triples. This represents the first million-scale LLM-native KB with explicit internal canonicalization of entities, relations, and classes, a significant departure from prior Wikimedia-centric works. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GPTKB 2.0，一种直接从大语言模型 (LLM) 构建消歧知识库 (disambiguated KB) 的方法。由于 LLM 本身缺乏实体表示，容易产生重复条目与概念混淆，GPTKB 2.0 在生成过程中对实体、关系和类别进行即时消歧 (on-the-fly disambiguation)，并权衡准确性、规模与成本。作者大规模执行该方法，得到包含超过 100 万消歧实体和 3840 万三元组的物化 KB，据称是首个百万级规模的 LLM 原生 KB，并显式对实体、关系和类别进行内部规范化 (internal canonicalization)。
Motivation: 现有 AKBC 工作尝试直接用 LLM 生成知识库，把模型本身当作知识源，但 LLM 没有原生的实体表示，导致重复条目以及概念混淆 (duplication and conflation)，需要一种能够直接从 LLM 构建消歧后 KB 的方法。
Method: GPTKB 2.0 在构建过程中即时消歧实体、关系和类别，设计目标是同时满足可扩展性 (scalability) 与消歧准确性，并对核心设计决策进行分析，刻画准确性、规模与成本之间的权衡。
Result: 摘要报告该方法以大规模执行得到包含超过 1M 消歧实体和 38.4M 三元组的物化 KB；该 KB 是首个百万级规模的 LLM 原生 KB，与以往以 Wikimedia 为中心的工作形成显著区别。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式的内部规范化是相对于以往工作的重要突破，KB 可通过 https://gptkb.org/ 获取。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SAT-Edge-Agent: Hardware-in-the-Loop Edge-Agent Orchestration for Onboard Satellite Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Onboard satellite intelligence requires a task layer that translates mission intent into local tool calls, exposes execution state, and returns machine-consumable artifacts under communication and power constraints. We present SAT-Edge-Agent, a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) edge-agent system deployed on a commercial off-the-shelf ARM-based heterogeneous edge system-on-chip. A browser workspace and FastAPI agent coordinate a local OpenAI-compatible language service with a project-internal YOLO-style oriented-object-detection endpoint that returns FAIR1M metadata-backed structured results. Two fixed FAIR1M workloads, one single-image and one serial two-image request, were repeated 20 times each and completed 20/20 attempts. Mean Full-Agent latency was 29.353 s and 60.937 s, with empirical P95 values of 31.166 s and 66.882 s. Mean detector time was 861.386 ms and 1510.920 ms, only 2.93% and 2.48% of the corresponding Full-Agent means. Profiling indicates that most visible latency occurs outside detector execution. Mean CPU utilization was 20.761% and 20.482%. A 200-ms NPU-load field averaged 100% for both workloads, but it represents a shared-accelerator software field rather than detector-only occupancy or calibrated utilization. The public evidence package provides sanitized request-level records, redacted JSON, normalized SSE examples, and scripts reproducing the reported statistics. These results establish a reproducible HIL boundary for observable satellite edge-agent orchestration, but do not establish detector accuracy, a new geolocation method, calibrated energy efficiency, or flight readiness.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, and 10 tables. Code and sanitized research artifacts are available at https://github.com/keithhegit/SAT-Edge-Agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAT-Edge-Agent，一个部署在商用 ARM 异构边缘 SoC 上的硬件在环 (hardware-in-the-loop, HIL) 边缘智能体系统，用于星上卫星智能的任务编排。系统通过浏览器工作区与 FastAPI 智能体协调本地 OpenAI 兼容语言服务和 YOLO 风格定向目标检测端点，在两张固定 FAIR1M 工作负载上各重复 20 次实验，全部成功完成，并报告了全链路延迟、检测耗时与 CPU/NPU 占用等统计。作者强调该工作建立可复现的星上边缘智能体编排观测边界，但不涉及检测精度、新地理定位方法或飞行就绪性。
Motivation: 星上卫星智能需要任务层将任务意图转换为本地工具调用、暴露执行状态并在通信与功耗约束下返回机器可消费的结果，而现有系统缺乏在这种边缘约束下可复现的编排验证。
Method: 在商用的基于 ARM 的异构边缘系统级芯片上构建 HIL 边缘智能体系统，由浏览器工作区和 FastAPI 智能体协调本地 OpenAI 兼容语言服务，并接入项目内部的 YOLO 风格定向目标检测端点，输出基于 FAIR1M 元数据的结构化结果。
Result: 两个固定 FAIR1M 工作负载（单图像与串行双图像请求）各重复 20 次且 20/20 成功；平均 Full-Agent 延迟为 29.353 s 与 60.937 s，经验 P95 为 31.166 s 与 66.882 s；平均检测耗时 861.386 ms 与 1510.920 ms，仅占全链路均值的 2.93% 与 2.48%；平均 CPU 利用率约 20.7% 与 20.5%，200-ms NPU 负载字段两负载均均值为 100%（但为共享加速器软件字段而非检测器独占占用）。
Conclusion: 该结果建立了可复现的星上边缘智能体编排 HIL 边界，但摘要明确说明其不建立检测精度、新地理定位方法、标定能效或飞行就绪性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Reliable and Reproducible Fetal Brain Biometry: A Deep Learning Approach Using MRI
papers.abstract_en: Fetal brain biometry is essential for quantitative assessment of brain development, supporting gestational age estimation, developmental monitoring, and detection of abnormalities. In clinical practice, measurements are manually performed, making them time-consuming and prone to variability. While automated approaches have been proposed, reproducible methods remain limited, particularly those providing anatomically interpretable landmark localization. We present a fully automated deep learning-based framework for reliable and reproducible brain biometry from 3D super-resolution-reconstructed fetal brain MRI. The proposed four-step pipeline derives biometric parameters by jointly estimating linear measurements and their corresponding anatomical landmarks. A 3D convolutional neural network is trained to regress landmark coordinates from brain segmentation label maps, followed by measurement-specific geometric optimization to refine landmark positions and compute measurements. The pipeline is evaluated on two publicly available fetal MRI datasets comprising 150 volumes (gestational age range: 20-37 weeks) acquired across different scanners and protocols, assessing five key biometric measurements across varying acquisition settings and providing a comprehensive evaluation of both measurement accuracy and landmark localization using quantitative metrics and visual assessment. Compared with the only available automated pipeline, the proposed method achieves comparable or improved accuracy for most measurements. In conclusion, we introduce a straightforward pipeline for reliable biometry estimations, with efficiency, interpretability and scalability that support integration into clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个完全自动化的深度学习框架，用于从3D超分辨率重建的胎儿脑MRI中进行可靠且可重复的脑生物测量。流水线包含四步：用3D CNN从脑分割标签图回归解剖标记点坐标，再通过针对测量项的几何优化细化标记点位置并计算线性测量值。作者在两个公开胎儿MRI数据集（共150个体积，孕周20-37周，来自不同扫描仪和协议）上评估了五项关键生物测量，并与唯一可用的自动化流水线对比。
Motivation: 胎儿脑生物测量是评估脑发育、估算孕周和检测异常的重要工具，但临床中依赖手工测量，耗时且易受操作者差异影响；已有的自动化方法可重复性有限，尤其缺乏解剖学可解释的标记点定位。
Method: 提出四步自动化流水线：先由3D卷积神经网络从脑分割标签图回归标记点坐标，随后进行测量项特定的几何优化（geometric optimization）来细化标记点位置并计算最终测量值，从而联合估计线性测量与对应解剖标记点。
Result: 在两个公开胎儿MRI数据集（150个体积，20-37孕周）上评估五项关键生物测量，涵盖不同采集设置；与唯一可用的自动化流水线相比，该方法在大多数测量上达到相当或更好的精度，并同时评估了测量精度与标记点定位。
Conclusion: 作者认为该流水线简单直接，兼具效率、可解释性和可扩展性，便于集成到临床工作流程中。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Outputs Disperse, Does Epistemic Revision Follow? A Black-Box Coupling Diagnostic for Machine Collectives
papers.abstract_en: Collective intelligence research treats disagreement as evidence of epistemic diversity: if agents express different views, the group should retain capacity to revise. In LLM collectives this proxy can break: agents can produce diverse-looking arguments while preserving the same conclusion. We operationalize dispersion-revision coupling: the degree to which an intervention that verifiably increases the dispersion of a collective's outputs in embedding space is accompanied by genuine revision of its epistemic stance rather than premise-preserving reformulation. The diagnostic is black-box: it operates on generated text alone and makes no claims about the internal representations of the generating models. Two channels are measured independently: an output channel, the Coherence Index (CI), verifies that the intervention changed output dispersion; an epistemic channel, per-turn stance annotation, measures whether the collective revised. We propose CI with the Meta-Predictive Clarity System (MPCS), which inserts a Re-Differentiation Protocol (RDP) when outputs over-converge, as a reusable method for estimating this coupling regime. We evaluate five-agent collectives from two configurations (gpt-4o-mini and gemini-2.5-flash; 310 paired episodes per condition). On gpt-4o-mini, conditional dissent improves false-premise recovery by +17.7 points (p<1e-6) while static persona diversity harms recovery (-8.1, p=.007). On gemini-2.5-flash, the same intervention at a comparable budget yields no gain (26.1% vs 27.1%, p=.84) despite a verified dispersion drop; the two treatment effects differ from each other (z=3.79, p<.001). Mechanism tagging shows Gemini preserves the false premise via intra-framework dissent: 94% of tagged post-RDP responses reformulate rather than concede (vs 24% on GPT). We recommend reporting per-intervention stance shift and premise-preservation rate alongside accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 LLM 集体提出一种黑盒耦合诊断，检验干预导致输出分散度（output dispersion）增加时，集体是否发生真正的认识论立场修正（epistemic revision），还是仅进行保持前提的重述（premise-preserving reformulation）。方法由两个独立通道组成：输出通道用 Coherence Index (CI) 验证分散度确实改变，认知通道用逐回合立场标注判断集体是否修正；并配套提出 Meta-Predictive Clarity System (MPCS) 与 Re-Differentiation Protocol (RDP)。在 gpt-4o-mini 和 gemini-2.5-flash 两种五智能体配置（各 310 对 episode）上评估，发现同一干预在不同模型上产生截然不同的认识论响应。
Motivation: 集体智能研究常把分歧当作认识论多样性的代理指标，但在 LLM 集体中，智能体可能生成外观多样但结论不变的论证，使这一代理失效。需要区分输出层面的多样化与真正立场修正，以判断集体是否仍保留修订能力。
Method: 提出两通道黑盒诊断：输出通道以 Coherence Index (CI) 验证干预确实改变嵌入空间中的输出分散度；认知通道以逐回合立场标注衡量集体是否真正修订。进一步提出 MPCS，当输出过度收敛时插入 RDP 作为可复用的耦合状态估计方法。
Result: 在 gpt-4o-mini 上，条件性异议（conditional dissent）使虚假前提恢复提升 +17.7 点（p<1e-6），而静态人格多样性反而损害恢复（-8.1，p=.007）；在 gemini-2.5-flash 上，同等预算的同一干预无收益（26.1% vs 27.1%，p=.84），尽管分散度已得到验证性下降，两处理效应差异显著（z=3.79，p<.001）。机制标注显示 Gemini 94% 的 post-RDP 回复为重述而非让步，GPT 为 24%。
Conclusion: 作者建议在报告准确率之外，同时报告每次干预的立场偏移（per-intervention stance shift）与前提保持率（premise-preservation rate）；不同模型对同一分散化干预的认识论响应可能根本不一致，单一分散度指标不足以反映集体修订能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Amortized Interventional Forecasting for Multivariate CIR Processes
papers.abstract_en: Mean-reverting dynamics are pervasive in finance, and the Cox--Ingersoll--Ross (CIR) process is a standard model for the time series they produce, from short rates to credit default swap (CDS) spreads. Yet CIR models capture only \emph{correlated} co-movement, not \emph{causal} influence between series, so they cannot answer the system's response when one series is externally shocked, which observational conditionals confound with historical co-movement. We make two contributions. First, an amortized model for distributional causal effect estimation that frames trajectories as time-stamped observations and predicts the calibrated multi-horizon shock response without retraining per scenario. Second, a causal multivariate CIR data-generating process that supplies the paired observational and interventional ground truth that real markets cannot. We instantiate and calibrate the framework on CDS spreads as a testbed. CIR-ACTIVA's validity is established on synthetic ground truth, independent of how well the simulator matches reality, while practical grounding is assessed by backtesting the generated traces against real CDS data. Against observational and amortized causal-inference baselines, CIR-ACTIVA leads on both causal selectivity in the joint distribution and horizon-resolved calibration, retaining its selectivity once the interventional law varies over the horizon, with gains concentrating at short horizons. This opens up a class of what-if queries on coupled spread systems, CDS stress testing among them, that observational forecasters cannot answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIR-ACTIVA，一个面向多元 CIR 过程的摊销式干预预测框架，用于分布级因果效应估计。该框架将轨迹视为带时间戳的观测，无需按场景重新训练即可预测校准的多时域冲击响应，并配套一个可生成成对观测与干预地面真值的因果多元 CIR 数据生成过程。作者以 CDS 利差为测试平台，在合成数据上验证其有效性，并通过回溯测试对照真实 CDS 数据评估其实用性；相比观测式与摊销式因果推断基线，CIR-ACTIVA 在联合分布的因果选择性和分时域校准上均领先。
Motivation: CIR 模型只能刻画序列间的相关性联动 (correlated co-movement)，无法表达因果影响，因此当单一序列受到外部冲击时，无法回答系统的响应；观测条件分布会被历史共动混淆，不能直接用于此类干预问题。
Method: 贡献包括两部分：一是摊销式分布因果效应估计模型，将轨迹作为带时间戳的观测来处理，预测多时域校准的冲击响应且无需针对每个场景重新训练；二是构造因果多元 CIR 数据生成过程，提供真实市场无法提供的成对观测与干预地面真值。
Result: 在合成地面真值上，CIR-ACTIVA 在联合分布的因果选择性 (causal selectivity) 与分时域校准 (horizon-resolved calibration) 上均优于观测式及摊销式因果推断基线；当干预法则随时域变化时仍能保持选择性，且增益集中在短时域。
Conclusion: 该方法为耦合利差系统上的 what-if 查询（包括 CDS 压力测试）开辟了可能性，而这些是纯观测式预测器无法回答的问题；摘要同时指出，其有效性建立在合成地面真值之上，与模拟器是否完全符合现实无关。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
papers.abstract_en: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alternating or uppercase against a lowercase context concentrates attention on those textual spans. In text this effect is universal, holding across every evaluated non-reasoning model. We frame it as a previously under-explored latent property of pretrained transformers rather than a prescriptive method. Our investigation reveals a central attention-performance divergence: while this "casing effect" robustly shifts attention, its impact on downstream accuracy is non-trivial, increased concentration does not inherently improve task accuracy and, in high-entropy contexts like alternating case, can degrade it. We further identify a boundary condition: the deliberative "thinking" phase in reasoning models acts as a semantic buffer that mitigates typographic sensitivity in text. Extending the study to VLMs, we find the effect transfers partially: the same prompt-side casing reorganizes cross-modal attention along two coupled axes, predominantly a macroscopic disengagement from the image toward the text prompt, and secondarily a concentration of the residual visual attention on the target region. By isolating casing as a zero-shot mechanism for attention steering that requires no model access or fine-tuning, we provide a new foundational understanding of how pretraining internalizes typographic emphasis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统性实证研究揭示，大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）表现出与人类视觉类似的大小写效应：交替或大写文本会吸引内部注意力。跨13个模型、多种tokenization方案的分析表明，该效应在文本中普遍存在，但注意力集中并不必然提升下游准确率，在高熵交替大小写场景下甚至可能降低性能。推理模型的思考阶段可缓解这一敏感性，而在VLM中该效应部分迁移为跨模态注意力重分配，主要表现为注意力从图像转向文本提示，并将残余视觉注意力集中于目标区域。
Motivation: 人类视觉感知中，大写字母是自然的显著性线索；作者想探究预训练Transformer是否内化了类似的大小写引导注意力分配机制，以及这种机制对下游任务性能的实际影响。
Method: 对9个LLM和4个VLM、涵盖不同tokenization方案进行系统性实证表征：将目标信息格式化为交替或大写形式并置于小写上下文中，分析注意力分配变化与下游准确率。作者将大小写隔离为零样本注意力控制机制，无需模型访问或微调。
Result: 大小写效应在文本中普遍存在；注意力集中不必然提升任务准确率，高熵交替大小写还可能降低准确率；推理模型的思考阶段作为语义缓冲缓解了排版敏感性；VLM中效应部分迁移，主要表现为从图像到文本提示的宏观注意力脱离，以及残余视觉注意力在目标区域的集中。
Conclusion: 作者将该效应定位为预训练Transformer中此前未被充分探索的潜在属性，而非规范性方法；该研究为理解预训练如何内化排版强调提供了新的基础视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MultiCompose: Multi-Concept Personalized Composition with Per-Subject Attribute Binding
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models enable personalization of specific visual concepts from a small number of reference images. However, generating a single image that contains multiple personalized subjects, each bound to user-specified attributes such as clothing, accessories, and held objects, remains largely unaddressed. Without explicit spatial constraints, concurrently activated concept checkpoints produce overlapping cross-attention responses, causing per-subject identity degradation and attribute misalignment. Moreover, no established benchmark jointly evaluates these two failure modes in the personalized multi-subject setting. We present MultiCompose, a composition framework that decouples per-concept personalization from multi-subject inference. A semantic preservation regularization maintains attribute binding capacity during fine-tuning, while a two-phase inference procedure automatically establishes subject layout and composes per-concept predictions through spatially exclusive masks. We further introduce MSP-Bench, a benchmark that jointly evaluates identity fidelity (ID), attribute binding accuracy (BIND), and attribute misalignment (MIS) through a dual-pathway protocol. Experiments show that MultiCompose outperforms existing methods on both conventional metrics and MSP-Bench, confirming the benchmark's ability to reveal failure modes that conventional metrics overlook. Code is available at https://github.com/I2-Multimedia-Lab/MultiCompose
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiCompose，一个用于文本到图像扩散模型的多概念个性化组合框架，解决多主体 (multi-subject) 生成中每个主体与用户指定属性（如衣物、配饰、手持物体）绑定失败的问题。它通过语义保持正则化与两阶段推理，将每个概念的个性化与多主体推理解耦，并引入联合评估身份保真度 (ID)、属性绑定准确率 (BIND) 和属性错位 (MIS) 的基准 MSP-Bench。实验显示 MultiCompose 在常规指标和 MSP-Bench 上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有个性化方法难以生成同时包含多个个性化主体且每个主体正确绑定指定属性的单一图像；并无空间约束时，同时激活的概念检查点会产生重叠的交叉注意力响应，导致主体身份退化与属性错位，且缺少联合评估这两种失败模式的基准。
Method: 提出一个组合框架，在微调期间使用语义保持正则化维持属性绑定能力，推理阶段采用两阶段流程自动建立主体布局，并通过空间互斥掩码 (spatially exclusive masks) 组合各概念的预测；同时提出 MSP-Bench，用双路径协议 (dual-pathway protocol) 联合度量 ID、BIND 与 MIS。
Result: 实验表明 MultiCompose 在传统指标与 MSP-Bench 上都优于现有方法，并验证了该基准能揭示传统指标忽略的失败模式。
Conclusion: 作者强调将逐概念个性化与多主体推理解耦、以及提供联合评估身份与属性失败模式的基准，是提升多概念个性化组合的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Describe or Construct Statistical Learning Models Using the Category-theoretical Language
papers.abstract_en: Statistical learning is a fascinating field that has long been the mainstream of machine learning/artificial intelligence. A large number of results have been produced which can be widely applied to real-world problems. It also leads to many research topics and also stimulates new research. This report summarizes some classical statistical learning models and well-known algorithms, especially for amateurs, and provides a category-theoretic perspective on understanding statistical learning models. The aim is to attract researchers from other fields, including basic mathematics, to participate in the research related to statistical learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份面向初学者的报告，系统总结经典统计学习模型与知名算法，并提出用范畴论（category-theoretical）语言来理解和描述统计学习模型。摘要指出其目标是吸引包括基础数学在内的其他领域研究者参与统计学习相关研究。
Motivation: 统计学习是机器学习/人工智能的主流领域，成果丰富但术语和框架可能对非本领域研究者构成门槛；作者希望给出入门级总结，并借助范畴论语言提供更统一的视角，以吸引跨领域研究者加入。
Method: 该工作属于综述/报告性质，整理经典统计学习模型和算法，并以范畴论语言重新表述统计学习模型的描述与构造方式；未提出新的学习算法。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或定量结果，主要贡献在于从范畴论角度对统计学习模型进行概念性重构并为初学者提供导览。
Conclusion: 作者强调该报告面向业余读者与来自其他领域（特别是基础数学）的研究者，目的是促进更多跨领域参与；文中未提及具体实验验证或局限。

papers.title: Less Traffic, Better Outcomes: Competition-Aware Request Dispatch in Real-Time Ad Exchanges
papers.abstract_en: Real-time bidding (RTB) ad exchanges typically forward nearly all incoming requests to demand-side platforms (DSPs), even though only a small fraction receive bids. This over-distribution weakens auction outcomes: DSPs throttle participation under compute and budget constraints, reducing the effective use of limited bidding capacity. We present a competition-aware request dispatch framework that uses distributional bid prediction and probabilistic forwarding to decide whether each request should be sent to each DSP. The system adapts per-DSP thresholds over time through lightweight policy optimization to track non-stationary market conditions. We evaluate the framework through four sequential online experiments on a production platform serving over 20 billion daily requests. A full multi-DSP deployment reduces DSP request volume under the policy by 34.2% while increasing net revenue by 4.6% (p<0.001) in a recent 14-day window after an initial DSP adaptation period. Further analysis highlights strong heterogeneity across traffic segments and reveals that aggregate metrics can be misleading. Segment-level and per-DSP analyses suggest that the policy surfaces comparative advantages among DSPs, improving monetized outcomes without increasing overall request volume.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at AdKDD 2026, the premier workshop on artificial intelligence for advertising, held in conjunction with the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对实时竞价（RTB）广告交易平台中请求过度分发的问题，提出一个竞争感知的请求调度框架，利用分布竞价预测和概率转发来决定是否将每个请求发给各 DSP，并通过轻量策略优化自适应调整各 DSP 的阈值。在日请求量超 200 亿的生产平台上进行四次顺序在线实验，全文多 DSP 部署在初始适应期后，于 14 天窗口内将 DSP 请求量降低 34.2%，净收入提升 4.6%（p<0.001）。进一步分析发现流量段间存在强异质性，聚合指标可能具有误导性。
Motivation: RTB 广告交易平台通常将几乎所有请求转发给 DSP，但其中只有一小部分获得出价，导致过度分发削弱拍卖结果；DSP 在算力和预算约束下需节流参与，进一步降低了有限竞价能力的有效利用。
Method: 提出竞争感知请求调度框架，使用分布竞价预测（distributional bid prediction）与概率转发（probabilistic forwarding）判断每个请求是否应发送给每个 DSP，并通过轻量策略优化（lightweight policy optimization）随时间调整每个 DSP 的阈值，以跟踪非平稳的市场条件。
Result: 生产平台（日请求超 200 亿）上的四个顺序在线实验显示，完整多 DSP 部署在适应期后于 14 天窗口内减少 DSP 请求量 34.2%，净收入增加 4.6%（p<0.001）；流量段和每 DSP 分析揭示强烈异质性，表明聚合指标可能误导。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该策略能够显露出 DSP 之间的比较优势，在不增加总请求量的情况下改善货币化结果；同时指出性能在不同流量段间差异显著，需要结合分段与逐 DSP 视角评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出竞争感知请求调度框架，使用分布竞价预测（distributional bid prediction）与概率转发（probabilistic forwarding）判断每个请求是否应发送给每个 DSP，并通过轻量策略优化（lightweight policy optimization）随时间调整每个 DSP 的阈值，以跟踪非平稳的市场条件。
summary_sections.result: 生产平台（日请求超 200 亿）上的四个顺序在线实验显示，完整多 DSP 部署在适应期后于 14 天窗口内减少 DSP 请求量 34.2%，净收入增加 4.6%（p<0.001）；流量段和每 DSP 分析揭示强烈异质性，表明聚合指标可能误导。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该策略能够显露出 DSP 之间的比较优势，在不增加总请求量的情况下改善货币化结果；同时指出性能在不同流量段间差异显著，需要结合分段与逐 DSP 视角评估。

papers.title: LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: World-action modeling has emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control, as it empowers models to go beyond reacting to observations and anticipate how a scene will evolve. However, existing WAMs often incur substantial computational overhead. Pixel-space methods often allocate substantial capacity to visual details that may not be directly relevant to control, while some latent-space methods require multi-stage training to construct the reasoning space. The resulting training cost can make such methods difficult to train under modest computational budgets. In this work, we propose LiLa-WAM, a lightweight world-action model that reasons about the future in a compact latent space and can be trained end-to-end on a single 24GB GPU. Its core design is a compact latent reasoning space jointly shaped by future-state prediction and action generation, which keeps the model lightweight while remaining well aligned with control. For task specification, we further propose the Visual Transition Token(VTT), a language-free task representation that encodes each task as a direction in visual feature space. Experiments on RoboTwin~2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot tasks demonstrate LiLa-WAM's effectiveness, achieving 90.48\% success across 50 RoboTwin tasks with single-GPU training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiLa-WAM，一个面向机器人操作任务的轻量级世界-动作模型 (world-action model)。它在紧凑的隐空间中推理未来场景演化，并可在单张 24GB GPU 上端到端训练。论文还提出 Visual Transition Token (VTT) 这一无语言任务表征，将任务编码为视觉特征空间中的一个方向。实验在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 和真实机器人任务上进行，在 50 个 RoboTwin 任务上达到 90.48% 的成功率。
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型 (WAM) 常带来较大计算开销：像素空间方法会把大量容量花在与控制不直接相关的视觉细节上，而部分隐空间方法需要多阶段训练来构建推理空间，导致在一般计算预算下难以训练。
Method: LiLa-WAM 的核心是一个由未来状态预测和动作生成共同塑造的紧凑隐推理空间，使模型保持轻量并与控制目标对齐；任务指定使用 Visual Transition Token (VTT)，将每个任务编码为视觉特征空间中的方向，从而无需语言指令。
Result: 摘要报告其在 50 个 RoboTwin 任务上取得 90.48% 的成功率，并指出该方法在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 以及真实机器人任务上均有效，且只需单 GPU 训练。
Conclusion: 作者认为在紧凑隐空间中联合优化未来状态预测与动作生成，并配合 VTT 这类无语言任务表征，可以在有限计算资源下实现有效的世界-动作建模。

papers.title: TARL: Transaction-Aware Reliable Ledgers for Executable Memory Management in Long-Term Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory helps long-term agents retain knowledge, yet a single update error can repeatedly distort future retrieval and reasoning. Most existing systems reduce memory updating to a binary Write/Hold decision, which cannot distinguish whether new information should be added, ignored, used to revise an outdated belief, rejected as unreliable, or deferred for verification. These choices may share the same binary label while producing fundamentally different memory states. We introduce TARL, a memory state update framework that maps each statement to one of five executable actions. TARL identifies the affected memory, resolves its temporal scope, compares source reliability, and updates accepted, pending, and rejected ledgers. It is further trained by comparing the memory states produced by alternative update operations, encouraging the model to select the operation that leads to the correct result. We also introduce TARL-Mem, a benchmark with fine-grained action labels and next-state targets. Across in-domain, cross-source, temporal, counterfactual, and sequential evaluations, TARL improves action prediction and state recovery, reduces memory pollution, preserves conflicting evidence, and limits cumulative corruption. The complete model implementation is provided in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TARL，一个面向长期智能体持久记忆的状态更新框架，将每条陈述映射为五类可执行动作之一，并通过比较不同更新操作产生的记忆状态来训练模型。作者还发布了带细粒度动作标签和下一状态目标的基准 TARL-Mem，在域内、跨来源、时序、反事实和顺序评估中验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统将记忆更新简化为二元 Write/Hold 决策，无法区分新增、忽略、修订过时信念、拒绝不可靠信息或延迟验证等本质不同的操作，导致单次更新错误反复污染后续检索与推理。
Method: TARL 框架识别受影响记忆、解析时间范围、比较来源可靠性，并分别更新 accepted、pending、rejected 三类账本；训练时通过对比替代更新操作产生的记忆状态，促使模型选择指向正确结果的操作。
Result: 在域内、跨来源、时序、反事实和顺序评估中，TARL 改进了动作预测与状态恢复，减少了记忆污染，保留冲突证据并限制累积性损坏。
Conclusion: 作者强调将记忆更新建模为带可靠账本的可执行动作序列，可以降低长期智能体的记忆错误累积；完整模型实现见补充材料。
Relevance: 5
