papers.title: Learning and Clustering on Temporal Graphs: Principles, Primitives, and Pooling
authors: Nelson Aloysio Reis de Almeida Passos
papers.abstract_en: This work focuses on the problem of learning on temporal graphs, with particular emphasis on the task of clustering: obtaining coarse-grained representations by aggregating information from nodes, edges, and temporal dynamics - a task related to pooling in machine learning on graphs, or community detection in network science. Although graph neural networks reach state-of-the-art performance across many downstream graph tasks, their advantage over established descriptive and inferential clustering algorithms is far less settled, especially under demands of efficiency and recovery accuracy. We frame this tension through three linked perspectives: principles, connecting graph learning and community detection through shared spectral foundations and detectability thresholds in stochastic block model regimes; primitives, making spectral clustering and multislice modularity optimization tractable through GPU-accelerated temporal backends; and pooling, viewing principled community detection as a theory-grounded coarse-graining operator for temporal graphs. Our results indicate that algorithmic methods remain the appropriate tool where attributes are absent or weak - scalability rather than accuracy being the binding obstacle - while neural models are most compelling when structural, temporal, and attribute signals align. By making temporal clustering scalable, GPU-accelerated primitives suggest a route toward theory-grounded pooling, while raising a central question: when does community-based coarse-graining preserve the dynamics needed for downstream learning tasks?
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 (Nectar Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论时间图上的学习与聚类问题，将聚类视为通过聚合节点、边和时间动态获得粗粒度表示的操作，并与图神经网络中的池化及网络科学中的社区检测相联系。作者从原则（谱基础与随机块模型可检测性）、原语（GPU 加速的时间后端使谱聚类与多层模块度优化可扩展）和池化（将社区检测作为理论支撑的粗粒度算子）三个视角展开，并指出在属性缺失或较弱时算法方法仍更合适，而神经模型在结构、时间与属性信号对齐时更有优势。
Motivation: 图神经网络在众多下游图任务中达到最先进性能，但相较于成熟的描述性和推断性聚类算法，其优势在效率和恢复准确率要求下远未定论；本文希望厘清图学习与社区检测之间的张力。
Method: 提出三个相互关联的视角：原则层面连接图学习与社区检测的谱基础和随机块模型可检测性阈值；原语层面通过 GPU 加速的时间后端使谱聚类和多切片模块度优化可行；池化层面将原则性的社区检测用作时间图的理论化粗粒度算子。
Result: 摘要报告算法方法在属性缺失或较弱时仍是合适工具，主要障碍是可扩展性而非准确率；神经模型在结构、时间与属性信号对齐时最为有说服力。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: GPU 加速的聚类原语能使时间聚类可扩展，并为理论支撑的池化提供路径，同时提出核心问题：基于社区的粗粒度化在何种条件下能保留下游学习任务所需的动态信息。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Accelerating Dynamic Graph Clustering on GPU Architectures with cuGraph
authors: Nelson Aloysio Reis de Almeida Passos
papers.abstract_en: This work addresses community detection in temporal networks through GPU-accelerated extensions of spectral clustering and modularity-based algorithms originally designed for static graphs. Built on the NVIDIA RAPIDS ecosystem, the framework enables the characterization and tracking of communities in snapshot-based dynamic graphs, either by Leiden greedy optimization with multi-GPU support via Dask-based workload distribution, or eigendecomposition of a symmetric Bethe-Hessian operator. Our multislice modularity backend achieves up to roughly three orders of magnitude speedup over the CPU reference under an equal-work budget, depending on graph density and snapshot count, while preserving compatibility with existing graph analytics pipelines. We demonstrate its applicability on real-world and synthetic datasets, facilitating exploratory analysis of structural network properties over time. Such capabilities are relevant across several application domains, such as epidemic spreading, financial systems, cybersecurity, and trajectory and mobility analysis. We release our implementation as free and open-source software, including Python bindings through the NetworkX-Temporal library for ease of use and zero-code acceleration with existing codebases.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at FRAME 2026, Euro-Par 2026 Workshops; to appear in Springer LNCS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时序网络中的社区检测问题，提出基于 NVIDIA RAPIDS 生态的 GPU 加速框架，将原本面向静态图的谱聚类与基于模块度 (modularity) 的算法扩展到快照式动态图。框架支持通过 Leiden 贪心优化（配 Dask 实现多 GPU 工作负载分配）或对称 Bethe-Hessian 算子的特征分解来刻画和追踪社区，其多切片模块度后端在等工作量预算下相比 CPU 参考实现可获得约三个数量级的加速。作者在真实与合成数据集上展示了该框架对网络结构随时间演化的探索性分析能力，并以免费开源形式发布，提供 NetworkX-Temporal 的 Python 绑定。
Motivation: 动态图或时序网络上的社区检测具有广泛的应用价值，但现有方法多面向静态图，缺少在 GPU 架构上高效扩展的解决方案，难以满足对时间演化社区结构的分析需求。
Method: 基于 RAPIDS 生态构建 GPU 加速框架，支持两条技术路线：一是带多 GPU 支持、通过 Dask 分布工作负载的 Leiden 贪心优化；二是对对称 Bethe-Hessian 算子做特征分解。其中多切片模块度 (multislice modularity) 后端作为核心加速路径，并保持与既有图分析流水线的兼容性。
Result: 摘要报告多切片模块度后端在等工作量预算下相比 CPU 参考实现获得最高约三个数量级 (roughly three orders of magnitude) 的加速，加速比取决于图密度与快照数量，并在真实与合成数据集上验证了适用性。
Conclusion: 该框架为快照式动态图提供社区特征刻画与追踪能力，并以开源形式发布、支持 NetworkX-Temporal 零代码接入，适用于流行病传播、金融系统、网络安全、轨迹与移动性分析等领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Pattern over Pixels: Measuring Pattern Completion Bias in Multimodal Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to translate webpage screenshots into front-end code, but repeated UI patterns may sway them toward visually incorrect yet pattern-consistent outputs. In this work, we test how repeated webpage patterns hurt MLLM accuracy on an objective screenshot-to-code fill-in-the-blank task. We introduce the first benchmark for visual pattern-completion bias, where one localized element in a repeated UI pattern is perturbed and the model must recover the masked width or font-size value from the screenshot and HTML context. Starting from 30 webpages curated from the Design2Code dataset, we build 1,440 evaluated screenshots spanning structural card and text-style patterns under standard and noise-overlaid conditions. We evaluate five frontier MLLMs and find that all are strongly biased toward the repeated baseline. Mean bias rate reaches 69.78% on card-width perturbations and 80.22% on text font-size perturbations, while mean accuracy is only 21.17% and 7.89%, respectively. Codex-5.3 performs best but still drops from 68.61% accuracy on cards to 13.89% on text, while Flash-3.0 reaches 96.11% bias on text. Noise, subtler perturbations, and boundary positions further increase bias rate. Reasoning analysis further shows that greater reasoning effort correlates with lower bias, yet qualitative evidence reveals that models can identify the anomalous element and still override it with the pattern-consistent answer. Our results identify a concrete failure mode in multimodal code generation and show that its severity is strongly associated with visual saliency

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在网页截图转前端代码任务中的视觉模式补全偏差 (visual pattern-completion bias)。作者构建了首个针对该偏差的基准，从 Design2Code 数据集的 30 个网页生成 1,440 张评测截图，覆盖结构卡片与文本样式模式以及噪声叠加条件。评估五个前沿 MLLM 后发现模型强烈偏向重复模式，平均偏差率在卡片宽度扰动上达 69.78%、文本字号扰动上达 80.22%，而平均准确率分别仅 21.17% 和 7.89%。
Motivation: 网页截图到代码生成中，重复 UI 模式可能使 MLLM 输出视觉上错误但与模式一致的代码，现有工作缺乏对这种模式补全偏差的客观量化评测。
Method: 引入截图到代码填空任务基准：扰动重复 UI 模式中的一个局部元素，要求模型从截图和 HTML 上下文恢复被遮蔽的宽度或字号值。从 Design2Code 的 30 个网页构建 1,440 张评测截图，覆盖结构卡片与文本样式模式、标准与噪声叠加条件，并评测五个前沿 MLLM。
Result: 所有模型都强烈偏向重复基线：卡片宽度扰动平均偏差率 69.78%，文本字号扰动 80.22%；平均准确率分别仅 21.17% 和 7.89%。Codex-5.3 表现最好但卡片准确率 68.61% 降至文本的 13.89%，Flash-3.0 在文本上偏差率达 96.11%。噪声、更细微扰动和边界位置进一步提高偏差率。推理分析显示更多推理努力与较低偏差相关，但定性证据表明模型能识别异常元素仍覆盖为模式一致答案。
Conclusion: 结果指出多模态代码生成中的一个具体失败模式，且其严重性与视觉显著性 (visual saliency) 密切相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAEF: A Lead-Agnostic ECG Foundation Model Towards Point-of-Care Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Point-of-care cardiac devices such as smartwatches and handheld ECG recorders typically capture 1--2 leads, yet existing ECG foundation models are architecturally constrained to fixed 12-lead inputs, degrading or failing under these reduced configurations. We introduce LAEF (Lead-Agnostic ECG Foundation), a 7M-parameter ECG foundation model that can natively process any lead subset without zero-padding or architectural modification. LAEF represents ECGs as variable-size spatiotemporal graphs with physiologically motivated intra- and inter-lead connectivity, processed by a Graph Attention Network that scales naturally with active lead count.Pre-trained on 9.2M 12-lead ECGs via masked node modelling with stochastic lead sampling, LAEF learns representations robust to lead configuration. Across 18 downstream datasets, LAEF is on par with specialized 12-lead baselines over 12$\times$ larger at full lead availability. Under direct point-of-care-oriented diagnostics (1--2 leads), it outperforms all zero-padded alternatives on 17 out of 18 datasets with with a single randomly sampled lead and on 14 out of 18 with 2 leads, with an average AUROC gain of +3.2 points. Representation analysis links this advantage to architectural lead-agnosticism, and a lead-importance study across 164 cardiovascular conditions shows population-level performance is stable across single standard input leads while still recovering established clinically lead-condition associations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAEF (Lead-Agnostic ECG Foundation)，一个 7M 参数的 ECG 基础模型，能够原生处理任意导联子集而无需零填充或架构修改。模型将 ECG 表示为可变大小的时空图，并采用图注意力网络 (Graph Attention Network) 处理；在 9.2M 条 12 导联 ECG 上通过带随机导联采样的掩码节点建模 (masked node modelling) 进行预训练。在 18 个下游数据集上，全导联可用时与规模大 12 倍以上的专用 12 导联基线相当；面向单双导联场景时，超过所有零填充替代方法。
Motivation: 现有 ECG 基础模型在架构上被限制为固定 12 导联输入，而智能手表和手持 ECG 记录仪等即时检测设备通常只采集 1–2 个导联，导致这些模型在此类缩减配置下性能下降甚至失效。
Method: 将 ECG 表示为具有生理学启发的导联内和导联间连接的可变大小时空图，由可随有效导联数自然扩展的图注意力网络处理；预训练采用带随机导联采样的掩码节点建模，使表示对导联配置具有鲁棒性。
Result: 在 18 个下游数据集中，全导联可用时 LAEF 与规模大 12 倍以上的专用 12 导联基线表现持平；在直接面向即时检测的 1–2 导联诊断中，单随机导联时在 17/18 个数据集、2 导联时在 14/18 个数据集上优于所有零填充替代方案，平均 AUROC 提升 +3.2 点。
Conclusion: 表示分析将性能优势归因于架构层面的导联无关性；针对 164 种心血管疾病的导联重要性研究显示，群体水平性能在单个标准输入导联间保持稳定，同时仍能恢复已确立的临床导联-疾病关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LiveEvalBench: Toward Open-World Evaluation for Web Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly capable of synthesizing executable frontend projects, yet existing benchmarks still treat web generation as a static evaluation problem. We argue that frontend artifacts demand a different paradigm: they are interactive rather than static, admit diverse yet equally valid implementations, and evolve faster than rigid pipelines can accommodate. To address these gaps, we present LiveEvalBench, an automated framework that reformulates web-generation evaluation as an agentic, adaptive, and extensible process. LiveEvalBench instantiates evaluation as a collaborative review workflow, in which a Build Engineer, a Code Engineer, and a UI Tester collectively gather evidence across the full lifecycle of a frontend project, from deployment and code inspection to browser-based interaction. To handle implementation diversity, an adaptive protocol couples shared rubrics for cross-model comparability with implementation-grounded criteria tailored to each artifact. The framework further supports incremental integration of new evaluator roles and assessment dimensions without pipeline redesign. Experiments across diverse real-world web-generation scenarios show that LiveEvalBench aligns closely with human expert judgment and provides fine-grained insights into frontier models' web generation capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/wyysteelhead/LiveEvalBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiveEvalBench，一个面向网页前端生成的开放式自动化评估框架，将网页生成评估从静态评测改造为基于智能体的自适应协作流程：Build Engineer、Code Engineer 和 UI Tester 协同从部署、代码检查到浏览器交互收集证据。框架用共享 rubric 与产物相关准则处理实现多样性，并支持增量扩展评估角色与维度。实验表明其与人类专家判断高度一致，并能提供对前沿模型网页生成能力的细粒度分析。
Motivation: 现有基准把网页生成当作静态评估问题，但前端产物本质上是交互式的、允许多种同样有效的实现，且技术演化速度快，固定评测管线难以适应这些特点。
Method: LiveEvalBench 将评估实例化为一个协作式审查工作流，由 Build Engineer、Code Engineer 和 UI Tester 跨前端项目的完整生命周期（部署、代码检查、浏览器交互）收集证据；其自适应协议结合共享 rubric 与针对每个产物的实现级准则，并支持在不重建管线的情况下集成新的评估角色与评估维度。
Result: 在多种真实网页生成场景上的实验显示，LiveEvalBench 的判断与人类专家高度一致，并为前沿模型的网页生成能力提供了细粒度洞察。摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 作者主张前端代码生成评估应采用动态、可扩展的开放式范式，并已开源代码（https://github.com/wyysteelhead/LiveEvalBench）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI policies require inference throughout their lifecycle, including model evaluation, cloud reinforcement learning rollout, edge GPU serving, and onboard deployment. Although these settings share the same checkpoint and action semantics, they often rely on separate inference programs. To unify them, we build PhyAI, a Physical AI inference engine with a single runtime that keeps architecture-specific conditioning, solver, cache, and output logic in model adapters while sharing graph execution, kernels, memory management, and parallel services. The same codebase runs vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) on single or multiple GPUs across onboard, edge, and cloud deployments. We used the adapter interface to add MiniCPM-Robot on the day of its release. PhyAI achieves 1.40x-4.65x speedups over the official implementations of pi0, pi0.5, GR00T N1.7, and MiniCPM-Robot. On Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID it reduces latency from 2.46 to 1.18 s on eight H20 GPUs (CFG=2, TP=4), a 2.08x speedup. Specialized runtimes remain faster in several configurations, so our goal is one runtime with competitive latency rather than the fastest result in every case. Detailed profiles reveal why different models need different execution policies: on a Hopper-series GPU at batch size one, the pi0.5 action expert accounts for 8.8% of FLOPs but 57.2% of latency; at batch size 32 its share drops to 13.5% and throughput reaches about 100 samples/s. Cosmos3 remains generation-dominated and gains only 14.3% throughput as batch size increases from 1 to 16. We further introduce the control-time Roofline, which distinguishes inference-bound from environment-bound control; the measured pi0.5 points on four LIBERO suites are environment-bound while Cosmos3 stays inference-bound. Code and benchmarks: https://github.com/mingti-org/phyai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 PhyAI，一个面向 Physical AI 的统一推理引擎，用单一运行时统一模型评估、云端强化学习 rollout、边缘 GPU 服务与板载部署。该引擎将架构相关的 conditioning、求解器、缓存与输出逻辑放在模型适配器中，共享图执行、内核、内存管理与并行服务，同一套代码支持 VLA 模型和世界动作模型（WAM）在多 GPU 上的各类部署。相比 pi0、pi0.5、GR00T N1.7 与 MiniCPM-Robot 的官方实现，PhyAI 取得 1.40x-4.65x 加速，并引入 control-time Roofline 分析来区分推理受限与环境受限的控制。
Motivation: Physical AI 策略在整个生命周期中都需要推理，包括评估、云端 RL rollout、边缘 GPU 服务与板载部署，这些场景共享同一 checkpoint 和动作语义，却往往依赖各自独立的推理程序，造成工程重复与部署复杂。
Method: 构建单一运行时，把架构相关的 conditioner、solver、cache 和输出逻辑下沉到模型适配器，而图执行、kernel、内存管理和并行服务被所有模型共享；适配器接口使 MiniCPM-Robot 在发布当天即可接入。同一代码库可运行 vision-language-action（VLA）模型和 world-action models（WAMs），支持单卡或多卡、板载/边缘/云部署。
Result: PhyAI 在 pi0、pi0.5、GR00T N1.7 和 MiniCPM-Robot 上相对官方实现取得 1.40x-4.65x 加速；在 Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID 上，8 块 H20 GPU（CFG=2, TP=4）的延迟从 2.46 s 降至 1.18 s（2.08x）。详细剖析显示，Hopper 系列 GPU 上 batch size=1 时 pi0.5 的 action expert 只占 8.8% FLOPs 却占 57.2% 延迟，batch size=32 时占比降至 13.5%，吞吐约 100 samples/s；Cosmos3 以生成主导，batch size 从 1 增到 16 仅提升 14.3% 吞吐。
Conclusion: 作者强调目标是提供一个在大多数场景下延迟具备竞争力的统一运行时，而非在所有配置中都做到最快；引入的 control-time Roofline 可将控制问题区分为推理受限（inference-bound）与环境受限（environment-bound），实测 pi0.5 在四个 LIBERO 套件上是环境受限，而 Cosmos3 保持推理受限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Keep the Needle, Prune the Haystack: Defect-Preserving Token Pruning for Efficient Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot visual anomaly detection has achieved remarkable progress, with recent vision-only approaches further improving performance while simplifying the inference pipeline. However, existing methods typically perform dense computation over all images and spatial tokens, despite the fact that normal samples dominate real-world scenarios and anomalies usually occupy only small regions. Token pruning offers a promising solution, but introduces an asymmetric pruning risk in anomaly detection: retaining normal tokens mainly incurs redundant computation, whereas removing anomalous tokens may eliminate the only evidence for detection and localization. This risk is particularly severe in early layers, where pruning provides the greatest computational benefit but anomaly semantics remain unreliable. We propose KeepAD, a defect-preserving token pruning framework that formulates token selection as high-recall, anomaly-aware routing. In shallow layers, KeepAD combines coverage-preserving selection over local $2\times2$ patch neighborhoods with deterministic anomaly rescue to reduce the risk of discarding subtle defects. In deeper layers, frozen normal and abnormal prototypes guide pruning under an image-adaptive token budget, aggressively removing low-risk normal tokens while preserving local anomaly evidence. Dense-to-sparse self-distillation further supervises early token routing without introducing additional inference overhead. Experiments on six industrial and seven medical zero-shot anomaly detection benchmarks show that KeepAD reduces the token retention ratio to below $20\%$, while limiting the average degradation in image-level and pixel-level AUROC to within $2.7$ percentage points. At the most aggressive operating point, KeepAD achieves a $7.9\times$ speedup over the strongest CLIP-based baseline.

Method: 提出 KeepAD 缺陷保留 token 剪枝框架，把 token 选择形式化为高召回、异常感知的路由；浅层结合覆盖保留选择与确定性异常救援，深层在冻结的正常与异常原型引导下按图像自适应 token 预算剪枝，并通过密集到稀疏的自蒸馏（dense-to-sparse self-distillation）监督早期 token 路由而不增加推理开销。

papers.title: DiagLoop: A Counterfactual Data Flywheel with Stage-Localized Reinforcement for Diagnostic LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Causal diagnostic models must explain how conclusions follow from evidence because diagnoses guide repairs and treatments. Yet serious cases are scarce, records rarely contain reasoning paths, and data transfer poorly across configurations, complicating local deployment. We present DiagLoop, a counterfactual data flywheel that converts codified physical relations or clinical guidelines, authored once per mechanism family, into training supervision beyond recorded cases. A training-only teacher proposes counterfactual worlds by varying causes, contexts, and observations, while an independent hybrid checker admits only valid worlds. The student reasons through symptom abstraction, causal-chain construction, and root-cause attribution. Stage-specific criteria identify its earliest failure. For nonterminal failures, a bounded repair probes downstream competence, and the resulting weakness profile guides subsequent data generation. Stage-localized reinforcement learning updates only the model-generated continuation, while replay and preservation reduce forgetting. The same criteria govern admission, attribution, reward, and regeneration through checks separate from the proposer. Using only synthesized scenarios and no case-level expert reasoning annotations, the resulting 8B model improves strict path correctness over the strongest conventional baseline. Gains are 11.6 points across eight industrial systems and 5.5 points across ten disease categories. Gains over a deranged-routing control are 3.9 and 2.3 points, respectively. The model also exceeds the evaluated proprietary references in both domains, even when they receive few-shot examples or the specification in context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiagLoop 是一个面向因果诊断大语言模型的反事实数据飞轮（counterfactual data flywheel），用每类机制家族一次性编写的物理关系或临床指南生成训练监督，而不依赖记录病例中的推理路径。训练期教师模型通过改变原因、情境和观测提出反事实世界，独立混合检查器只接纳有效世界；学生模型完成症状抽象、因果链构建和根因归因，并按阶段定位最早失败点，用阶段局部强化学习（stage-localized reinforcement learning）更新模型生成的续写。摘要报告，仅使用合成场景且无病例级专家推理标注，8B 模型在严格路径正确性上超过最强常规基线，在八个工业系统上提升 11.6 个点、十个疾病类别上提升 5.5 个点，并超过被评估的专有参考模型。
Motivation: 因果诊断模型需要解释结论如何从证据推出，因为诊断会指导维修或治疗；但严重病例稀缺、记录很少包含推理路径，且数据在不同配置间迁移效果差，给本地部署带来困难。
Method: 提出反事实数据飞轮：训练期教师基于编码化的物理关系或临床指南提出反事实世界，独立的混合检查器只接纳有效世界；学生按症状抽象、因果链构建、根因归因推理，并用阶段特定标准定位最早失败。非终止失败由有界修复探测下游能力，生成的弱点画像指导后续数据生成；阶段局部强化学习只更新模型生成的续写，同时用回放与保留减少遗忘。同一套检查标准独立于提议者，统一管理接纳、归因、奖励和再生成。
Result: 仅使用合成场景、无病例级专家推理标注，8B 模型在严格路径正确性上超过最强常规基线：八个工业系统上增益 11.6 个点，十个疾病类别上增益 5.5 个点；相对失序路由对照（deranged-routing control）分别增益 3.9 和 2.3 个点。模型在两个领域都超过被评估的专有参考模型，即使参考模型获得 few-shot 示例或上下文中的规格说明。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，阶段局部化的标准与独立检查器使模型可以在没有专家推理标注的情况下，仅凭合成反事实场景获得严格路径正确性的显著提升。

papers.title: CausalOPD: First-Wrong-Step Supervision for Distilling Causal Chain Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Many critical reasoning tasks, including clinical diagnosis, legal judgment, and industrial fault diagnosis, require step-dependent causal chains in which early errors propagate and correct conclusions can mask invalid reasoning. Although large language models perform well on such tasks, privacy, latency, and controllability motivate distillation into locally deployable models. Standard trajectory imitation does not correct process errors on the student's own rollout distribution. We propose CausalOPD, a curriculum online process distillation framework. A knowledge-augmented teacher first provides trajectories grounded in domain-specific causal rules, entity relations, and structural constraints. The student then generates on-policy trajectories, and the teacher identifies the first wrong step, defined as the earliest transition that verifiably violates available constraints. Starting from the verified prefix, short-horizon reinforcement learning repairs this localized failure. A causal-stage curriculum advances from evidence-level to mechanism-level and conclusion-level errors, following their propagation order. Across three domains, CausalOPD improves average path correctness by 23.4 percentage points over sequence-level online process distillation and reduces the right-label-wrong-reasoning rate from 15.7% to 4.4%. The domain-specific 8B students also surpass both evaluated proprietary references in path correctness across all domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CausalOPD，一个面向因果链推理蒸馏的课程式在线过程蒸馏 (online process distillation) 框架，用于将大模型能力蒸馏到本地可部署的小模型。教师模型基于领域因果规则、实体关系和结构约束生成轨迹，学生模型生成在线策略轨迹后，教师找出第一个错误步骤，并从已验证前缀出发用短视界强化学习修复局部错误。跨三个领域实验中，该方法相比序列级在线过程蒸馏将平均路径正确率提升 23.4 个百分点，并将“结论正确但推理错误”的比例从 15.7% 降到 4.4%。
Motivation: 临床诊断、法律裁判和工业故障诊断等任务依赖逐步因果链，早期错误会传播，且正确结论可能掩盖错误推理。标准轨迹模仿不会在学生自身 rollout 分布上纠正过程错误，而隐私、延迟和可控性需求又推动将大模型蒸馏为本地小模型。
Method: CausalOPD 采用知识增强的教师生成符合领域因果规则、实体关系和结构约束的轨迹，学生再生成 on-policy 轨迹，由教师识别第一个违反约束的最早错误步骤。随后从已验证前缀出发，用短视界强化学习修复局部失败，并按照因果传播顺序设计从证据级到机制级再到结论级的课程 (causal-stage curriculum)。
Result: 在三个领域上，CausalOPD 相比序列级在线过程蒸馏使平均路径正确率提升 23.4 个百分点，右标签错推理率由 15.7% 降至 4.4%；领域特定的 8B 学生模型在所有领域的路径正确率上均超过所评估的两个专有参考模型。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，以第一个错误步骤监督并配合因果级课程，可以有效修正蒸馏过程中的过程推理错误，并在多领域取得一致提升。

papers.title: XiDepth: a Lightweight and Efficient Network for Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation has emerged as an appealing solution to design lightweight and effective models for deployment on computationally constrained devices due to its reduced reliance on expensive depth sensors. By eliminating the need for ground-truth annotations and leveraging the simplicity of monocular camera setups, this approach facilitates cost-effective data collection and broad applicability across fields such as computer vision and robotics. A critical challenge is achieving resource-efficient neural networks without compromising the overall performance. State-of-the-art models generally adopt depth-wise convolutions and attention mechanisms; however, these functions often incur high energy costs and face compatibility issues in embedded environments. To address this, we propose XiDepth, a lightweight architecture based on the XiNet operator block, designed to enhance feature extraction while maintaining low computational complexity and energy demand. On the KITTI dataset, XiDepth achieves state-of-the-art performance with only 0.8M parameters. Tests on a Raspberry Pi 4 further confirm its suitability for real-world embedded applications, reducing FLOPs by 40% and energy consumption by 35% compared to leading methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XiDepth，一个基于 XiNet 算子模块的轻量级自监督单目深度估计网络。在 KITTI 数据集上以仅 0.8M 参数达到当前最优性能，并在 Raspberry Pi 4 上相对领先方法减少 40% 的 FLOPs 和 35% 的能耗。论文被 IEEE AVSS 2026 接收。
Motivation: 面向计算受限设备部署的自监督单目深度估计需要兼顾轻量化和性能，而现有先进模型常用的深度卷积与注意力机制能耗高且在嵌入式环境中存在兼容性问题。
Method: 提出基于 XiNet 算子模块的轻量级架构 XiDepth，在增强特征提取能力的同时保持较低的计算复杂度与能量需求。
Result: 在 KITTI 上以 0.8M 参数实现当前最优性能；在 Raspberry Pi 4 上的测试表明相比领先方法 FLOPs 降低 40%、能耗降低 35%，验证了嵌入式场景的适用性。
Conclusion: 作者强调 XiDepth 适合资源受限的真实嵌入式应用，为自监督单目深度估计提供低成本、低能耗的轻量方案。

papers.title: Morphology-Aware Implicit Super-Resolution Network for Pathological Images
papers.abstract_en: Accurate diagnosis in Digital Pathology (DP) relies on high-resolution whole-slide images, yet clinical deployment is often limited by hardware costs. Super-Resolution (SR) offers a promising alternative by computationally enhancing low-resolution acquisitions. However, existing SR methods frequently struggle to preserve fine-grained cellular morphology, leading to texture oversmoothing and blurred structural boundaries under complex tissue variability. To address this issue, we propose Morph-ISR, a morphology-aware implicit super-resolution framework for DP that restores diagnostically relevant details with sub-pixel precision. Morph-ISR reformulates SR as a continuous coordinate-based reconstruction problem and integrates an Implicit Position-aware Kernel Generator (IPKG) to adaptively model spatially varying tissue morphology. To further enhance structural fidelity, a Morphological Fidelity Prior (MFP) is introduced, leveraging semantic guidance from a pre-trained cell segmentation network to enforce boundary-preserving and region-aware reconstruction, thereby improving the representation of critical cellular boundaries and nuclear textures. Experiments on TCGA and SurGen datasets show that Morph-ISR achieves the best LPIPS and ST-LPIPS among the evaluated methods, reducing them by up to 38.37% and 39.55%, respectively, over the second-best methods while maintaining strong PSNR and SSIM. These results demonstrate superior preservation of diagnostically relevant cellular boundaries and nuclear textures, while compact parameterization and high throughput support efficient edge deployment. Code and trained models will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Morph-ISR，一种面向数字病理图像的形态学感知隐式超分辨率框架。它将超分辨率重构为基于连续坐标的重建问题，并引入隐式位置感知核生成器 (IPKG) 自适应建模空间变化的组织形态；同时提出形态保真先验 (MFP)，利用预训练细胞分割网络的语义引导进行边界保持与区域感知重建。在 TCGA 与 SurGen 数据集上，Morph-ISR 在 LPIPS 和 ST-LPIPS 上优于对比方法，较次优方法分别降低最多 38.37% 和 39.55%，同时保持较强的 PSNR 与 SSIM。
Motivation: 数字病理诊断依赖高分辨率全切片图像，但硬件成本限制了临床部署；现有超分辨率方法在复杂组织变异性下难以保持细粒度细胞形态，常导致纹理过度平滑与结构边界模糊。
Method: Morph-ISR 将超分辨率建模为连续坐标重建问题，通过隐式位置感知核生成器 (IPKG) 自适应建模空间变化的组织形态；并引入形态保真先验 (MFP)，借助预训练细胞分割网络的语义引导实现边界保持与区域感知重建。
Result: 在 TCGA 和 SurGen 数据集上，Morph-ISR 取得最优 LPIPS 与 ST-LPIPS，较次优方法分别降低最多 38.37% 和 39.55%，同时保持较强 PSNR 与 SSIM；摘要还指出紧凑参数化与高吞吐支持高效边缘部署。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能更好地保留诊断相关的细胞边界与核纹理，并具备低参数量与高吞吐的边缘部署潜力；代码与训练模型将在发表后公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shielding for Higher-Order Safety
papers.abstract_en: Safety shields are runtime enforcement mechanisms that restrict the actions of a controller to guarantee safety. Classical shields are usually synthesised for state predicates: the current physical state is either safe or unsafe, and the shield disables precisely those actions that can force the system into an unsafe state in the future. In many cyber-physical applications this view is too coarse. A vehicle approaching an obstacle should not only avoid collision, but also respect speed regulations, force limits induced by acceleration, and jerk limits to prevent injuries. From a physical perspective, these requirements are predicated over the derivatives of the state. This paper develops a finite-state safety-game construction for such high-order smoothness constraints. We define differential safety properties using finite differences over a discretised state space, characterise their expressiveness, and reduce shield synthesis to an ordinary safety game over a history state space. We give a synthesis algorithm whose shields store exactly $k$ past states for properties of order $k$ and prove that this memory is necessary. We describe an iterative synthesis procedure for a maximally permissive shield that operates over hierarchies of derivative constraints. The algorithm solves constraints iteratively in increasing order and uses the solution at each iteration to prune the state space for the next constraint. This makes shield synthesis more efficient in practice, as the algorithm refrains from exploring large regions of the state space that are known to be unsafe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对经典安全盾 (safety shield) 只能处理状态谓词、无法表达速度/加速度/加加速度等状态导数约束的局限，提出一种面向高阶光滑性约束的有限状态安全博弈构造。作者用离散状态空间上的有限差分定义微分安全属性，刻画其表达力，并把盾合成归约为历史状态空间上的普通安全博弈。摘要还给出一个存储恰好 k 个过去状态的合成算法，证明该内存下界必要，并描述按导数约束层级迭代合成最大许可盾 (maximally permissive shield) 的流程。
Motivation: 经典安全盾以当前物理状态是否安全为判断依据，对许多信息物理系统过于粗糙；车辆避障不仅要不碰撞，还要满足限速、加速度力和 jerk 限制等对状态导数提出的要求，因此需要支持高阶光滑性约束的盾合成方法。
Method: 用有限差分在离散状态空间上定义微分安全属性，并将盾合成转化为历史状态空间上的普通安全博弈。合成算法对 k 阶属性存储恰好 k 个过去状态，并证明该内存需求是必要的；同时提出迭代合成过程，按导数约束的阶数由低到高求解，用前一步结果剪枝状态空间以提升效率。
Result: 摘要报告了合成算法的内存下界结果（k 阶属性需存储 k 个过去状态且必要），并描述迭代约束求解能使合成更高效，因为算法避免探索已知不安全的大片状态空间；未给出具体数值实验。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于历史状态空间的有限状态安全博弈可以统一处理高阶导数类安全约束，且按导数层级迭代剪枝能提升盾合成的实际效率；该结论建立在离散化状态空间和安全博弈框架之内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Taming the Implicit: Dual-Channel Risk-Aware Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Continual Multimodal Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is widely believed to inherently resist catastrophic forgetting in continual post-training of multimodal large language models. Under pronounced task distributional shifts, however, forgetting across representative RFT algorithms escalates sharply. This stems from the implicit reward-variance regularization inherent to RFT, which proves incapable of suppressing uncontrolled optimization risk. We propose Risk-Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), the first dual-channel framework for explicit risk governance in continual RFT. On the policy channel, Risk-Aware Policy Scaling adaptively calibrates per-sample update magnitude via rollout reliability and Fisher-inspired local predictive sensitivity; on the data channel, Risk-Aware Dynamic Bucket Sampling reorganizes training batches through dynamic risk stratification, steering optimization toward informative yet stable samples. As a plug-and-play strategy requiring no cross-task memory, RAPO generalizes to any RFT algorithm without modification. On the public MLLM-CL benchmark, RAPO reduces final forgetting by 79.8% relative to its RLOO backbone while retaining new-task competitiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出强化微调 (RFT) 在多模态大语言模型持续后训练中并非天然抗遗忘；在任务分布偏移显著时，RFT 的隐式奖励方差正则化 (implicit reward-variance regularization) 无法抑制失控的优化风险。作者提出 Risk-Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO)，一个双通道显式风险治理框架，通过策略通道的 Risk-Aware Policy Scaling 与数据通道的 Risk-Aware Dynamic Bucket Sampling 共同校准更新幅度与批次重排。在 MLLM-CL 基准上，RAPO 相对 RLOO 骨干将最终遗忘降低 79.8%，同时保持新任务竞争力。
Motivation: 现有观点认为 RFT 本身能抵抗持续后训练中的灾难性遗忘，但在显著任务分布偏移下各类 RFT 算法的遗忘急剧上升。作者将根因归结为 RFT 自带的隐式奖励方差正则化无法抑制不受控的优化风险。
Method: 提出 RAPO，首个用于持续 RFT 的显式风险治理双通道框架：策略通道上，Risk-Aware Policy Scaling 依据 rollout 可靠性和 Fisher 启发的局部预测敏感性自适应校准每个样本的更新幅度；数据通道上，Risk-Aware Dynamic Bucket Sampling 通过动态风险分层重组训练批次，引导优化走向信息量大且稳定的样本。该方法即插即用，无需跨任务记忆，可适配任意 RFT 算法。
Result: 在公共 MLLM-CL 基准上，RAPO 相比其 RLOO (REINFORCE Leave-One-Out) 骨干将最终遗忘 (final forgetting) 相对降低 79.8%，同时保持新任务竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式双通道风险治理能够有效抑制持续 RFT 中的遗忘，且 RAPO 的即插即用特性使其无需修改即可推广到任何 RFT 算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Closely Do LLM Reviews Align with Human Peer Review?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate scientific reviews, yet existing evaluations rarely examine whether different providers align with both conference decisions and human reviewing priorities within the same controlled setting. We compare reviews from OpenAI GPT-5.4, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 with human reviews and final decisions for 300 topic-matched ICLR 2026 submissions, equally divided among oral, poster, and rejected papers. Each model reviewed every paper using identical instructions and rating scales after decision information was removed. Our study contributes a cross-provider analysis of three complementary dimensions: alignment with broad and fine-grained decision categories, differences in recommendation-scale usage, and thematic agreement in identified weaknesses. All three LLMs distinguished accepted from rejected papers, but none reproduced the oral versus poster distinction present in human ratings. Scoring patterns were provider-specific: Gemini assigned systematically higher ratings, while OpenAI and Claude were closer to humans for rejected and poster papers but more critical of oral papers. Human and LLM reviews also differed in emphasis, with LLMs more frequently identifying missing baseline comparisons and humans more often raising computational-efficiency concerns. These results show that broad decision alignment does not imply agreement with finer human judgments or reviewing priorities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控设置下比较了 OpenAI GPT-5.4、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 和 Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 三种 LLM 生成的同行评审与人类评审及会议最终决定的对齐程度。研究使用 300 篇 ICLR 2026 主题匹配投稿（口头、海报、被拒各三分之一），在移除决策信息后让每个模型用相同指令和评分量表评审每篇论文。结果显示三种 LLM 都能区分被接收与被拒论文，但均未复现人类评分中口头与海报的区分；评分模式存在供应商差异，且人类与 LLM 在指出论文缺陷的侧重点上不同。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于生成科学评审，但现有评估很少在同一个受控环境中检验不同提供商的评审是否与会议决定和人类评审优先级同时对齐。
Method: 构建 300 篇 ICLR 2026 投稿的评审数据集，每篇论文由三个 LLM 在统一指令和评分量表下评审；从三个互补维度分析：与广义及细粒度决策类别的对齐、推荐量表使用差异、识别出的缺陷主题一致性。
Result: 三种 LLM 均能区分被接收与被拒论文，但没有一个复现口头与海报之间的区分；Gemini 评分系统性偏高，OpenAI 和 Claude 对被拒和海报论文更接近人类、对口头论文更苛刻；LLM 更常指出缺失基线比较，而人类更常提出计算效率问题。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，广义决策对齐并不意味着与更细粒度的人类判断或评审优先级一致。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A windy sea surface with Stokes waves
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the transition of wind-forced, gravito-capillary surface waves from smooth to corrugated states remains a longstanding problem in nonlinear wave mechanics. Solving driven-dissipative, nonlinear potential flow equations we map these waves ($4-13$ cm) onto a Reynolds number -- wave energy phase-space. We identify a transition band separating smooth from corrugated wave states - the wave steepness exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on Reynolds number within this. Subharmonic (in)stability analysis reveals that the fastest-growing mode intensifies corrugations on alternate faces of the carrier wave, offering insights with broad implications for interfacial pattern-formation and oceanic remote-sensing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过求解驱动-耗散非线性势流方程，研究风驱动的重力-毛细表面波（波长4-13 cm）从光滑状态向波纹状态的转变，并将这些波映射到雷诺数-波能相空间。识别出一个介于光滑与波纹波态之间的转变带，在该带内波陡度对雷诺数呈非单调依赖；亚谐（不）稳定性分析表明最快增长模式会强化载波交替面上的波纹，对界面图案形成和海洋遥感有启示。
Motivation: 风强迫的重力-毛细表面波从光滑到波纹状态的转变预测是非线性波力学中长期存在的问题，理解该转变对界面图案形成和海洋遥感等应用具有重要意义。
Method: 求解驱动-耗散非线性势流方程，建立雷诺数与波能的相空间映射；对4-13 cm波长的波进行亚谐（不）稳定性分析，识别最快增长模式及其对载波面的影响。
Result: 识别出分离光滑与波纹波态的转变带，波陡度在转变带内对雷诺数呈非单调依赖；最快增长模式会强化载波交替面上的波纹。
Conclusion: 作者认为该研究为理解风驱表面波的界面图案形成与海洋遥感提供了新洞察，但摘要未给出具体数值结果或实验验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 求解驱动-耗散非线性势流方程，建立雷诺数与波能的相空间映射；对4-13 cm波长的波进行亚谐（不）稳定性分析，识别最快增长模式及其对载波面的影响。
summary_sections.result: 识别出分离光滑与波纹波态的转变带，波陡度在转变带内对雷诺数呈非单调依赖；最快增长模式会强化载波交替面上的波纹。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该研究为理解风驱表面波的界面图案形成与海洋遥感提供了新洞察，但摘要未给出具体数值结果或实验验证。

papers.title: Decoupling Generation and Selection for Budget-Constrained Faithful Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Abstractive summarization models remain vulnerable to factual inconsistency, redundancy, and weak length control. We propose a modular generation-and-selection framework for sentence-budget-constrained summarization. A pretrained generator produces multiple candidate summaries, which are decomposed into sentence-level candidates. A combinatorial selector then constructs the final summary by balancing relevance, factuality, and redundancy under an explicit budget. The framework supports MMR, ILP, and a DPP-inspired log-determinant objective without retraining the generator. Experiments on CNN/DailyMail, Multi-News, FaithBench, and TofuEval show consistent improvements in factuality and source-grounding metrics, especially for multi-document summarization, at the cost of lower reference-overlap scores. Human evaluation further indicates higher perceived consistency, relevance, clarity, and conciseness, with a small reduction in coherence. These results show that decoupling generation from selection provides a model-agnostic mechanism for improving factual grounding. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bcfs-D05E/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化的生成-选择 (generation-and-selection) 框架，用于受句子预算约束的抽象式摘要。预训练生成器先产生多个候选摘要并分解为句子级候选，再由组合选择器在显式预算下权衡相关性、事实性和冗余度，支持 MMR、ILP 及 DPP-inspired log-determinant 目标，且无需重训生成器。实验显示在事实性和源文本依据指标上一致提升，尤其对多文档摘要，但参考重叠分数下降。
Motivation: 抽象式摘要模型仍存在事实不一致、冗余和长度控制弱的问题；现有方法往往将生成与选择耦合，难以在不重训模型的情况下改进事实依据。
Method: 将生成与选择解耦：预训练生成器产出多个候选摘要并分解为句子级候选，组合选择器在句子预算约束下通过相关性、事实性和冗余度的平衡来构造最终摘要；选择器支持 MMR、ILP 和 DPP-inspired log-determinant 目标，与生成器无关。
Result: 在 CNN/DailyMail、Multi-News、FaithBench 和 TofuEval 上，事实性与源文本依据指标一致提升，多文档摘要尤其明显；代价是参考重叠分数降低。人工评估显示感知一致性、相关性、清晰度和简洁性更高，但连贯性略有下降。
Conclusion: 将生成与选择解耦提供了一种模型无关的机制来改善事实依据；作者指出这会以一定参考重叠和连贯性为代价。

papers.title: AutoSND: From Execution Evidence to Structural Policies for Automated Network Dismantling Heuristic Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Network dismantling is fundamental to analyzing the robustness and vulnerability of complex systems, yet practical heuristics must balance effectiveness and computational efficiency, and are usually designed manually by researchers. Existing large language model based automatic heuristic design methods can generate and screen candidates, yet they have difficulty further transforming candidate quality or failure states during execution into structural-level guid- ance for subsequent generation. We propose AutoSND, a three stage tree search framework for complete network dismantling pro- grams. Stage I broadly explores from simple heuristics and archives execution evidence. Stage II compiles candidate records into struc- tural policies concerning local signals, neighborhood access, and state update ranges. Stage III continues tree search conditioned on these policies and obtains the final quality prioritized and speed prioritized candidates, AutoSND-Q/S. Experiments on 12 real world networks and 3 large real world networks show that AutoSND achieves better search performance and stability and discovers more competitive and structurally interpretable network disman- tling programs. The final candidates form an interpretable structure that uses residual degree as the backbone, adjusts node order with bounded local signals, and restricts the state update range. Code is available at https://github.com/MirrorNew/AutoSND.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoSND，一个面向网络拆解 (network dismantling) 程序自动发现的三阶段树搜索框架。框架先从简单启发式出发收集执行证据，再将候选记录编译为关于局部信号、邻域访问和状态更新范围的结构化策略，并基于这些策略继续搜索，最终生成质量优先与速度优先的候选 AutoSND-Q/S。在 12 个真实网络和 3 个大型真实网络上的实验表明，该方法获得了更好的搜索性能与稳定性，并发现了具有可解释结构的拆解程序。
Motivation: 网络拆解是分析复杂系统鲁棒性与脆弱性的基础任务，实用启发式需要兼顾效果与计算效率，且通常依赖人工设计。现有基于大语言模型的自动启发式设计方法虽能生成和筛选候选，但难以将执行过程中的候选质量或失败状态转化为结构层面的指导信息。
Method: 提出 AutoSND，一个三阶段树搜索框架：阶段一从简单启发式出发广泛探索并归档执行证据；阶段二将候选记录编译为关于局部信号、邻域访问和状态更新范围的结构化策略；阶段三在这些策略约束下继续树搜索，得到质量优先与速度优先的最终候选 AutoSND-Q/S。
Result: 在 12 个真实世界网络和 3 个大型真实世界网络上的实验显示，AutoSND 在搜索性能与稳定性上优于现有方法，并发现了更具竞争力和结构可解释性的网络拆解程序。最终候选以残余度 (residual degree) 为主干，用有界局部信号调整节点顺序，并限制状态更新范围。
Conclusion: 作者认为将执行证据编译为结构化策略能够显著改善自动启发式发现的质量与稳定性，最终获得的拆解程序具有可解释结构，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do Fewer Visual Tokens Accelerate Multimodal Inference? A Break-Even Study Across Decision Locations and Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Fewer visual tokens do not guarantee lower end-to-end latency. We evaluate break-even with a reproducible protocol that accounts for decision overhead, shared work, and the operators each policy can avoid. A stage-level decomposition reconciles these components with measured end-to-end latency. In a 30-example pilot, the two tested autoregressive probes remain slower than Full despite state reuse. A lightweight post-vision predictor yields paired confidence intervals below zero on RTX 3090 and A100 and remains significant after a conservative all-pairs Holm correction. A pre-vision image-size rule also yields intervals below zero on both GPUs, although neither comparison remains significant after the same correction. Pre-vision routing has a structural opportunity unavailable to post-vision pruning: it can avoid preprocessing and vision encoding. On A100, this opportunity outweighs a nearly eightfold larger downstream token reduction by the post-vision policy. Reported quality is conditional on examples answered correctly by Full and is not benchmark accuracy.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables. Experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct on RTX 3090 and A100 PCIe GPUs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究减少视觉 token 数量是否一定能降低多模态推理的端到端延迟，并提出一个可复现的盈亏平衡 (break-even) 协议，该协议计入决策开销、共享工作以及各策略可跳过的算子；通过阶段级分解 (stage-level decomposition) 将各部分与实测端到端延迟对齐。基于 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 在 RTX 3090 和 A100 PCIe 上的 30 样本试点实验显示：两个自回归探针即使复用状态仍比 Full 更慢；轻量后视觉预测器在两个 GPU 上得到低于零的配对置信区间，并经保守的全对 Holm 校正后仍显著；前置视觉图像尺寸规则在双 GPU 上同样得到低于零的区间，但校正后不再显著。
Motivation: 直观上更少的视觉 token 应当加速推理，但端到端延迟还受决策位置 (post-vision 剪枝 vs pre-vision 路由)、共享计算和硬件特性影响，因此需要明确何种减少策略在何处、何种硬件上真正达到盈亏平衡。
Method: 提出可复现的评估协议，明确区分决策开销、共享工作与各策略可避免的算子，并用阶段级分解把这些成分与实测端到端延迟对应起来。测试了三类策略：两个带状态复用 (state reuse) 的自回归探针、一个轻量后视觉 (post-vision) 预测器，以及一个前置视觉 (pre-vision) 图像尺寸规则。
Result: 30 样本试点中，两个自回归探针即使复用状态仍慢于 Full。后视觉预测器在 RTX 3090 与 A100 上均给出低于零的配对置信区间，且在全对 Holm 校正后仍显著；前置视觉规则在两个 GPU 上也低于零，但校正后不显著。在 A100 上，前置视觉路由因能跳过预处理和视觉编码，优势超过后视觉策略近八倍的下游 token 缩减量。
Conclusion: 作者强调前置视觉路由具有后视觉剪枝无法获得的结构性机会，即避免预处理与视觉编码本身；同时指出报告的质量指标以 Full 正确回答的样本为条件，并非基准准确率，因此结果不能直接解读为通用精度提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conditionally Identifiable Latent-Environment Modeling for Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) recommendation is vulnerable to preference shifts induced by a latent environment. Existing methods can infer latent states from logged interactions, yet the statistical meaning of the latent environment and its effect on preference remain underdetermined. We formulate this task as conditionally identifiable risk-aware recommendation (CI-RR) and propose Conditionally Identifiable Latent-Environment Recommendation (CILER). CILER uses a user-conditioned exponential family to model the latent environment and a feature-indexed polynomial to specify how it changes preference. It predicts by marginalizing item probabilities over the inferred environment distribution. Under sufficient variation, correct specification, and decoder regularity, CILER identifies the environment-sensitive representation up to the stated equivalence class. We further bound excess deployment log-risk by environment-inference error. Controlled studies test the observable consequences of sufficient variation and model specification. Experiments on three datasets show that CILER improves all twelve OOD ranking metrics under feature, temporal, and geographical shifts within shared support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布外（OOD）推荐中由潜在环境引起的偏好漂移问题，提出条件可识别潜在环境推荐模型 CILER。该方法用用户条件指数族（user-conditioned exponential family）建模潜在环境，用特征索引多项式刻画环境对偏好的改变，并通过在推断出的环境分布上对物品概率取边际来预测。作者给出环境敏感表示的可识别性条件以及部署对数风险上界，并在三个数据集上的特征、时间和地理偏移场景中验证了效果。
Motivation: OOD 推荐易受潜在环境引发的偏好漂移影响，现有方法能从历史交互中推断潜在状态，但潜在环境的统计含义及其对偏好的影响机制尚未被充分确定。
Method: 将任务形式化为条件可识别风险感知推荐（CI-RR），提出 CILER：使用用户条件指数族建模潜在环境，使用特征索引多项式描述环境如何改变偏好，预测时在推断的环境分布上对物品概率取边际。
Result: 在充分变化、模型设定正确且解码器满足正则性的条件下，CILER 能将环境敏感表示识别到所声明的等价类；同时给出部署对数风险受环境推断误差控制的上界。三个数据集上的实验表明，在共享支撑内的特征、时间和地理偏移下，CILER 改善了全部十二项 OOD 排序指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调环境敏感表示的可识别性以及部署风险上界，并通过受控实验检验充分变化和模型设定这些前提的可观测后果；本文面向推荐系统场景，与天气或降水预测领域无关。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调环境敏感表示的可识别性以及部署风险上界，并通过受控实验检验充分变化和模型设定这些前提的可观测后果；本文面向推荐系统场景，与天气或降水预测领域无关。

papers.title: Is Inter-Seed Cross-Play Enough? Evaluating the Robustness of Zero-Shot Coordination Algorithms to Implementation Details
papers.abstract_en: AI agents deployed in real-world settings must be capable of coordinating with humans and other AI agents they have not encountered before. Zero-shot coordination (ZSC) algorithms aim to achieve this by specifying high-level learning rules such that independently engineered agents can coordinate with each other at test time. Rigorous evaluation of ZSC algorithms remains difficult: ideally, multiple independent implementations of each proposed algorithm must be used, reflecting the variation that arises when independent parties interpret and implement the same specification. In practice, however, ZSC algorithms have almost exclusively been evaluated using a single implementation trained across different random seeds, with only a handful of works additionally varying the neural network architecture. This leaves open questions about robustness to specification ambiguities and implementation details. In this work, we provide the first systematic evaluation of this robustness. We introduce a new evaluation scheme, cross-implementation cross-play, varying implementation details that prior work has shown to affect the performance of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms, and we evaluate Other-Play, a popular ZSC algorithm, with this scheme. Our findings are encouraging and suggest that, for Other-Play, the standard ZSC evaluation is, in fact, a reasonable proxy for this more thorough cross-implementation evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估零样本协调（zero-shot coordination, ZSC）算法对实现细节和规范歧义的鲁棒性。作者提出新的评估方案 cross-implementation cross-play，变化先前工作表明会影响多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法性能的实现细节，并用该方案评估了流行的 ZSC 算法 Other-Play。结果显示，对于 Other-Play，标准 ZSC 评估实际上是更彻底的跨实现评估的合理代理。
Motivation: 实际部署中的 AI 智能体需要与未见过的人类或其他 AI 协调，ZSC 算法通过高级学习规则实现这一目标。但严格评估困难：理想情况需要多个独立实现来反映规范解释差异，而实践中几乎只用单一实现跨随机种子评估，仅少量工作额外变化网络结构，因此对规范歧义和实现细节的鲁棒性缺乏系统性验证。
Method: 提出 cross-implementation cross-play 评估方案，变化先前研究证明会影响 MARL 算法性能的实现细节，并用该方案评估 ZSC 算法 Other-Play，以衡量标准评估是否足以反映跨实现差异。
Result: 摘要报告称评估结果令人鼓舞：对于 Other-Play，标准 ZSC 评估可以作为更全面的跨实现评估的合理代理。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现表明标准 ZSC 评估在实现细节变化下具有较好的可靠性和可迁移性，但结论主要限于 Other-Play 这一算法。

papers.title: Learning Biomechanically Plausible Human Motion from Sparse Radar Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Radar-based human pose estimation has focused on improving learning algorithms while representing the body as unconstrained keypoint coordinates. We address the underexplored dimension of anatomical fidelity by integrating a full-body skeletal model into a differentiable, end-to-end trainable radar-based pose estimation framework, in which the pose network is supervised through forward kinematics while subject-specific geometry is fitted beforehand. Subject-specific body segment proportions are predicted from radar point cloud features to scale a biomechanical skeleton. A motion prediction network maps temporal radar sequences to generalized coordinates, and differentiable forward kinematics converts predicted joint angles into 3D positions. A contact classification loss encourages physically plausible foot-ground interaction. Under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation on 11 healthy participants performing rehabilitation exercises, the framework achieves 6.456 +/- 1.759 cm mean per-joint position error (MPJPE), 8.083 +/- 0.884 degrees mean per-joint angle error (MPJAE), 0.935 +/- 0.009 contact classification F1, and 3.4 +/- 1.3 % scaling error. This proof-of-concept study demonstrates the feasibility of recovering interpretable biomechanical descriptors from a single low-cost radar sensor in a controlled laboratory setting, a prerequisite for future clinical motion analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将全身骨骼模型集成到可微分的端到端雷达人体姿态估计框架中，通过前向运动学监督姿态网络，并先从雷达点云特征预测受试者身体节段比例以缩放生物力学骨骼。在 11 名健康受试者康复动作的留一受试者交叉验证下，平均关节位置误差 (MPJPE) 为 6.456±1.759 cm，平均关节角度误差 (MPJAE) 为 8.083±0.884 度，接触分类 F1 为 0.935±0.009，缩放误差为 3.4±1.3%。
Motivation: 现有基于雷达的人体姿态估计主要改进学习算法，但将身体表示为不受约束的关键点坐标，缺乏解剖学可信度。作者希望弥补这一被忽视的维度，并从单个低成本雷达传感器恢复可解释的生物力学描述符，为未来临床运动分析奠定基础。
Method: 构建端到端可训练框架：首先从雷达点云特征预测受试者特定的身体节段比例来缩放生物力学骨架；随后运动预测网络将时间雷达序列映射到广义坐标；可微分前向运动学将预测关节角转换为 3D 位置；并引入接触分类损失以鼓励物理上合理的脚-地交互。
Result: 在 11 名健康受试者执行康复动作的留一受试者交叉验证中，框架取得 6.456±1.759 cm 的 MPJPE、8.083±0.884 度的 MPJAE、0.935±0.009 的接触分类 F1，以及 3.4±1.3% 的缩放误差。
Conclusion: 该概念验证研究表明，在受控实验室环境中，从单个低成本雷达传感器恢复可解释的生物力学描述符是可行的，这是未来临床运动分析的前提条件。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MuEvo: LLM-Driven Evolution of Multi-Heuristic Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based automated heuristic design (LLM-AHD) has shown strong potential in discovering effective heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems. However, existing methods primarily optimize a single heuristic, whereas practical optimization frameworks often rely on multiple interacting components. Directly extending single-heuristic methods is challenging because early component selection can overlook components with late potential, while independent evolution ignores inter-component dependencies. We propose MuEvo, an LLM-driven framework for evolving heuristic ensembles under ensemble-level feedback. MuEvo combines Dynamic Component Management, which uses short-budget probing and a reversible lifecycle to revise component priorities throughout the search, with LLM-Driven Co-Evolution, which coordinates component populations through Multi-Ensemble Evaluation, Cross-Component Information Sharing, Relation-Guided Pair Evolution, and Adaptive Budget Allocation. We evaluate MuEvo on selection hyper-heuristics and componentized ant colony optimization across four combinatorial optimization domains. Results show that MuEvo consistently improves human-designed frameworks and outperforms representative multi-component extensions of state-of-the-art LLM-AHD methods, demonstrating its effectiveness across both controller-mediated heuristic pools and functionally differentiated algorithmic components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuEvo，一个由大语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的框架，用于在集成级反馈下进化启发式集成 (heuristic ensemble)，目标是将 LLM 驱动的自动化启发式设计从单启发式扩展到多组件组合的优化框架。框架结合动态组件管理与 LLM 驱动的联合进化，在四个组合优化领域的选择超启发式和组件化蚁群优化上验证，能持续改进人工设计框架并优于已有的多组件 LLM-AHD 扩展方法。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的自动化启发式设计 (LLM-AHD) 主要优化单一启发式，而实际优化框架常依赖多个交互组件；直接将单启发式方法扩展存在困难：早期组件选择可能忽略后期才显现潜力的组件，独立进化又无法捕捉组件间依赖。
Method: MuEvo 包含两个核心部分：动态组件管理 (Dynamic Component Management) 使用短预算探测 (short-budget probing) 和可逆生命周期 (reversible lifecycle) 在搜索过程中修正组件优先级；LLM 驱动的联合进化 (LLM-Driven Co-Evolution) 通过多集成评估、跨组件信息共享、关系引导的配对进化和自适应预算分配来协调多个组件种群。
Result: 在四个组合优化领域的选择超启发式 (selection hyper-heuristics) 和组件化蚁群优化 (componentized ant colony optimization) 上，MuEvo 一致地改进了人工设计的框架，并优于当前最先进 LLM-AHD 方法的多组件扩展版本，在控制器中介的启发式池和功能分化的算法组件上都表现出有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MuEvo 展示了在集成级反馈下联合演化多个启发式组件的有效性，覆盖从控制器中介的启发式池到功能分化算法组件的场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Teachers Mislead: Spurious-Signal-Aware On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising student-sampled trajectories with dense token-level teacher signals. Recent selective OPD methods improve this process by prioritizing signals that are confident, informative, or learnable. However, the assumptions overlook a fundamental failure mode of language models: their token-level judgments can be driven by input-agnostic language priors, formatting conventions, or stereotyped reasoning templates rather than task-specific evidence. We refer to such optimization-relevant but weakly input-grounded supervision as spurious signals in OPD, which may produce large gradients while contributing little task-improving direction. To mitigate this issue, we propose SA-OPD, a Spurious-Signal-Aware On-Policy Distillation framework that identifies and filters misleading token-level supervision based on input-groundedness and optimization impact. SA-OPD introduces a lightweight input-groundedness proxy estimating whether a token-level distillation signal truly depends on the input. It then filters only tokens that simultaneously exhibit low input-groundedness and extreme distillation divergence, thereby removing high-impact spurious updates and achieving fine-grained OPD optimization. Extensive experiments on both large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) settings demonstrate that SA-OPD consistently outperforms Vanilla OPD and competitive selective methods. These results establish input-groundedness as a key dimension for OPD supervision selection and offer a simple, effective strategy for mitigating spurious updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在线蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）中教师模型的 token 级信号可能被输入无关的语言先验、格式惯例或刻板推理模板所驱动，这类作者称为伪信号（spurious signal）的监督会产生大梯度却贡献甚少。作者提出 SA-OPD 框架，通过输入接地性（input-groundedness）与优化影响来识别并过滤误导性的 token 级监督，并在 LLM 与 VLM 设置上验证其优于 Vanilla OPD 和现有选择性蒸馏方法。
Motivation: 现有的选择性 OPD 方法只关注信号的置信度、信息量或可学习性，忽略了语言模型中 token 级判断可能由语言先验或格式模板而非任务相关证据驱动，导致高梯度但低任务改进方向的伪信号被保留。
Method: SA-OPD 引入一个轻量级输入接地性代理，估计 token 级蒸馏信号是否真正依赖输入；仅过滤同时具有低输入接地性和极端蒸馏分歧的 token，从而移除高影响的伪更新，实现细粒度 OPD 优化。
Result: 在大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）设置上的大量实验表明，SA-OPD 一致优于 Vanilla OPD 以及多种有竞争力的选择性方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为输入接地性应成为 OPD 监督选择的一个关键维度，并提供了一个简单有效的缓解伪更新策略。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SEER: A Self-Grounded Evidence Interface for Controlled Spatial Relation Classification
papers.abstract_en: Spatial relation questions require a model to identify the queried subject and object before comparing their layout. Yet a VLM can recognize both entities and still answer from the wrong instance or an ambiguous global view. We ask whether making query-specific evidence explicit can mitigate this failure and propose SEER (Self-grounded Evidence for Entity-Relation Reasoning), a training-free inference-time evidence interface for frozen VLMs. SEER hides candidate relations during pair localization, constructs a query-specific view with explicit subject/object roles, and retains the full image and sparse box geometry as complementary evidence. For relation-choice protocols with exact inverse support, an optional refinement swaps the entity roles and changes the forward decision only when exactly one visual state obeys the corresponding inverse relation. On an image-disjoint GQA-Train900 test frozen before model scoring, SEER pools to +3.94 [2.17,5.72] over Full; the gain remains positive under label-independent grounding-order counterbalancing and on the 535 rows whose entity names are unique. The unchanged protocol yields +4.35 to +11.79 on all 2,434 filtered EmbSpatial pair-relation questions across three models. Matched controls separate local refocus from role-explicit conditioning. These results establish query-specific evidence construction as the principal intervention, with reciprocal consistency as a smaller protocol-specific refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEER，一种无需训练的推理时证据接口，用于冻结视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的空间关系分类。SEER 在配对定位时隐藏候选关系、构建带显式主/客体角色的查询特定视图，并保留完整图像和稀疏框几何作为补充证据。在 GQA-Train900 测试集上，SEER 相对 Full 基线平均提升 +3.94 分，在 EmbSpatial 的 2,434 个过滤问题上跨三个模型提升 +4.35 到 +11.79。作者通过匹配控制实验表明，查询特定证据构建是主要干预，互易一致性 (reciprocal consistency) 是较小的协议特定改进。
Motivation: 空间关系问题要求模型先识别查询的主客体再比较布局，但 VLM 即使能识别两个实体，仍可能从错误实例或模糊的全局视角作答。论文针对这一失败模式，探究使查询特定证据显式化是否能缓解问题。
Method: SEER 是一种训练自由的推理时证据接口：在配对定位阶段隐藏候选关系，构建带有显式主/客体角色的查询特定视图，同时保留完整图像和稀疏框几何作为互补证据。对于具有精确逆支持的 relation-choice 协议，可选细化步骤会交换实体角色，并且仅在恰好一个视觉状态服从对应逆关系时才改变前向决策。
Result: 在图像不相交的 GQA-Train900 测试集上，SEER 相对 Full 平均提升 +3.94（置信区间 [2.17, 5.72]）；在标签无关的 grounding-order 反平衡以及 535 个实体名称唯一的行上增益仍为正。未改变协议时，在全部 2,434 个过滤后的 EmbSpatial pair-relation 问题上，三个模型分别获得 +4.35 到 +11.79 的提升。匹配控制实验将局部重聚焦与角色显式条件作用分离。
Conclusion: 结果表明查询特定证据构建是主要的干预手段，而互易一致性是较次要的、协议特定的细化。论文强调其方法无需训练、适用于冻结 VLM，并提供了代码。

papers.title: POEM: Phase-Aware $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ Feature Rotation for Time Series Forecasting Under Periodicity Drift
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has advanced time series forecasting, but periodicity drift, in which cycle timing and phase vary over time, remains a challenging problem. Existing methods predominantly model these sequences on fixed time grids, suffering from a limited ability to accommodate phase-related variation. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{POEM}, a phase-aware forecasting framework based on latent feature rotation using the special orthogonal group in two dimensions, denoted by $\mathrm{SO}(2)$. POEM aims to reduce the phase-related variability by learning a phase-correction coordinate and applying an invertible $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-based rotation to paired latent features. To extrapolate this correction coordinate, Directional Phase Increment Attention (DPIA) retrieves historical phase increments from similar temporal contexts and integrates them into future phase corrections. Experiments demonstrate that POEM achieves competitive performance, while qualitative visualizations suggest that the learned phase-aware transformation makes latent trajectories more regular.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列预测中的周期性漂移 (periodicity drift) 问题提出 POEM 框架，核心思想是在二维特殊正交群 SO(2) 上对潜在特征做可逆相位旋转，通过学习相位校正坐标来降低相位相关的变化。为了外推该校正坐标，作者设计 Directional Phase Increment Attention (DPIA)，从相似时序上下文中检索历史相位增量并整合到未来相位校正中。实验显示 POEM 取得有竞争力的性能，定性可视化表明学习到的相位感知变换使潜在轨迹更规则。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法主要在固定时间网格上建模时间序列，难以适应循环时序和相位随时间的漂移，导致对相位相关变化的能力受限。
Method: 提出相位感知预测框架 POEM，利用 SO(2) 上的可逆旋转对成对潜在特征进行相位校正，并学习一个相位校正坐标；同时提出 DPIA 模块，从相似时间上下文中检索历史相位增量并用于外推未来的相位校正。
Result: 摘要报告 POEM 在实验中取得竞争力性能，且定性可视化显示学习到的相位感知变换使潜在轨迹更规则；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过 SO(2) 潜在特征旋转降低相位相关变异性，可以有效应对周期性漂移对预测带来的挑战。

papers.title: Cross-Layer Interaction under Weight-Space Ablation: A Closed-Form Attention Jacobian Bound and a Test on a Real Pretrained Model
papers.abstract_en: A companion paper studies when activation patching and weight-space ablation agree, inside an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream. For the one composition in that model where two carriers are architecturally dependent, an attention head and its own layer's normalization-MLP composition, it derives an exact first-order interaction formula, zero when only the MLP is ablated and second-order bounded when the head is also ablated. That result is confined to a single residual block and checked only on small transformers on a synthetic task. This paper extends the result past both limits. First, the interaction from ablating carriers spanning several layers decomposes exactly into same-block terms, one per touched layer, plus a cross-layer remainder on which the decomposition makes no claim of smallness. Second, we isolate that remainder exactly, for two layers, as a double integral of a mixed second derivative, and name the missing ingredient needed to bound it: a Jacobian bound for the attention sub-block. We derive this bound in closed form and verify it, without a single violation, against Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct's real weights, though we do not yet chain it across layers. We also give, in closed form, the curvature constant the companion paper's bound leaves unexhibited. Third, on that same model, we search for and find an emergent circuit for indirect object identification, never designed into it, using the original activation-patching method for this task, and test collapse, dissociation, and interaction on it. The result is mixed: a shared carrier emerges across all five tested instances, collapse and dissociation hold on most but not all, and a nonzero interaction is measurable on three of five, at layer pairs outside the same-block case the companion theorem covers.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Part II of a two-part series; see the companion paper "A Theory of Conditional Collapse under Low-Rank Weight-Space Ablations" (Part I)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是两篇系列论文的第二部分，扩展了同伴论文中关于激活修补 (activation patching) 与权重空间消融 (weight-space ablation) 一致性的理论结果。作者将单残差块内的交互公式推广到跨层情形，把跨层余项精确表示为混合二阶导数的双重积分，并给出注意力子块的闭式 Jacobian 界，用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的真实权重验证该界无一次违反。此外，作者在该模型上搜索间接对象识别 (indirect object identification) 的涌现电路，发现共享载波在五个测试实例中出现，但 collapse、dissociation 和交互的结果是混合的。
Motivation: 同伴论文中的交互公式仅适用于单个残差块，且只在合成任务的小型 Transformer 上验证；本文旨在将该结果扩展到跨层消融情形，并解决余项有界性所需的缺失成分。
Method: 作者将跨层载波消融的交互精确分解为逐层同块项加上跨层余项；对两层情形，将余项写成混合二阶导数的双重积分，并推导注意力子块的闭式 Jacobian 界；同时给出同伴论文界中未显式给出的曲率常数。随后在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上验证该界，并用原始激活修补方法搜索间接对象识别电路，测试 collapse、dissociation 与交互。
Result: 闭式 Jacobian 界在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的真实权重上无一违反，但尚未跨层链式验证；间接对象识别电路方面，五个测试实例均出现共享载波，collapse 和 dissociation 在大多数但非全部实例成立，五个实例中有三个在层对上可测到非零交互，且这些层对不在同伴定理覆盖的同块情形内。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果好坏参半：跨层扩展在理论上给出了精确分解和闭式界，但跨层链式验证仍未完成；涌现电路的测试表明共享载波存在，但 collapse、dissociation 和交互并非在所有实例上普遍成立，说明该理论框架的适用范围仍有局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ConformalShift: Targeted Event Reordering Against Adaptive ECG Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive conformal prediction can recover clinically important heartbeat classes missed by a point classifier, but delayed feedback makes its decisions sensitive to event order. We introduce ConformalShift, a bounded event-reordering attack that suppresses the ventricular class for rescued events without modifying ECG waveforms, labels, classifier scores, or the event multiset. ConformalShift searches for feasible permutations of authentic preceding events that lower the ventricular threshold before a selected target is evaluated. On disjoint MIT--BIH confirmation records, the attack suppressed 66.7% of eligible targets for Extra Trees and 60.0% for HistGradientBoosting, compared with random-schedule rates of 4.4% and 12.0%, respectively. Transferred configurations also outperformed random scheduling on INCART, while reducing the displacement budget weakened the attack on both datasets. These results show that adaptive monitors in healthcare can be compromised through the timing of authentic information, even when waveforms, labels, classifier outputs, and event contents remain unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConformalShift，一种针对自适应一致性预测（adaptive conformal prediction）的受限事件重排序攻击，在不修改 ECG 波形、标签、分类器分数或事件多重集的前提下，通过调整真实先前事件的顺序来压低目标事件评估前的心室阈值，从而抑制被抢救事件中的心室类别的检测。在不相交的 MIT-BIH 确认记录上，该攻击对 Extra Trees 抑制了 66.7% 的合格目标，对 HistGradientBoosting 抑制了 60.0%，而随机调度下的基线分别为 4.4% 和 12.0%。迁移配置在 INCART 上也优于随机调度，减少位移预算则会削弱攻击效果。
Motivation: 自适应一致性预测能够恢复点分类器遗漏的有临床意义的心跳类别，但延迟反馈使其决策对事件顺序敏感；作者旨在说明仅靠调整真实信息的时序即可破坏医疗场景中的自适应监测系统，而无需改动数据内容或模型输出。
Method: ConformalShift 是一种有界的事件重排序攻击，它在目标被评估之前搜索可行的前置事件排列，以降低心室类别的阈值；攻击不改变波形、标签、分类器分数或事件多重集，仅选择真实的先前事件的置换。
Result: 在 MIT-BIH 确认记录上，ConformalShift 对 Extra Trees 和 HistGradientBoosting 分别抑制了 66.7% 和 60.0% 的合格目标，远高于随机调度的 4.4% 和 12.0%；迁移配置在 INCART 上同样优于随机调度，而减小位移预算会削弱两个数据集上的攻击效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明，即使波形、标签、分类器输出和事件内容完全不变，仅通过真实信息的时间顺序也能使医疗自适应监测系统受到攻击，凸显了时序层面脆弱性的安全意义。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unequal Verdicts: Investigating Gender Bias in LLM-Based Fake News Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated fact-checking, yet their susceptibility to gender bias in this context remains underexplored. This study presents the first systematic investigation of gender bias in LLM-based fake news detection using real-world data. We augment the LIAR benchmark with three gender variants of speaker job titles (Neutral, Male, Female) for each statement to test whether veracity judgments vary solely based on gender presentation. Six state-of-the-art LLMs are evaluated across multiple bias and fairness metrics. All models exhibit gender sensitivity: 9.79%-35.13% of statements receive inconsistent labels across the three variants, with Male-Female comparisons showing 6.5%-23.6% flip rates. Two primary bias manifestations are identified: instability (inconsistent judgments) and directionality (systematic favoritism). Five models show statistically significant directional effects, with the strongest effects displaying male-skeptic patterns. These findings demonstrate that gender bias undermines both reliability and fairness in LLM-based fake news detection, highlighting the need for bias-aware evaluation and mitigation strategies. The augmented dataset is publicly released to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的假新闻检测中的性别偏见。作者将 LIAR 基准扩展为每个陈述附带中性、男、女三种说话者职位称谓变体，评估六个 SOTA LLM，发现所有模型都存在性别敏感性：9.79%-35.13% 的陈述在不同变体间得到不一致标签，其中男-女对比的标签翻转率为 6.5%-23.6%。识别出两种主要偏见表现：不稳定性（inconsistency）和方向性（systematic favoritism），五个模型呈现统计显著的定向效应，最强效应表现为偏向怀疑男性说话者的模式。增强数据集已公开。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于自动化事实核查，但性别偏见在此场景下的影响尚未被充分探索。该研究指出性别偏见会同时损害可靠性（reliability）和公平性（fairness），因此需要专门的评估与缓解策略。
Method: 使用真实世界数据，对 LIAR 基准进行增强，为每条陈述构建中性、男性、女性三种职位称谓变体，以检验真实性判断是否仅因性别呈现而改变。随后在六个 SOTA LLM 上使用多种偏见与公平性指标进行评估。
Result: 所有模型均表现出性别敏感性：9.79%-35.13% 的陈述获得不一致标签，男-女对比的翻转率为 6.5%-23.6%。五个模型存在统计显著的定向效应，其中最强效应为男性怀疑（male-skeptic）模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调性别偏见削弱了 LLM 假新闻检测的可靠性与公平性，凸显了对偏见感知的评估和缓解策略的需求，并公开了增强数据集以支持后续研究。

papers.title: A Security-Oriented Lifecycle Model for Large Language Model Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are being integrated into critical infrastructure and enterprise workflows at unprecedented scale,yet the lifecycle frameworks governing their development and operations were designed for operational efficiency rather than security analysis. As a result, security-relevant activities such as data provenance verification, artifact signing, agentic permission control, and decommissioning are often left implicit or assumed to receive due care. Governance frameworks, in turn, organise requirements around risk levels or management processes without clearly linking them to the lifecycle stages where they apply. This paper addresses both deficiencies. We propose a lifecycle model for LLM systems that supports security analysis by structuring it around security-relevant boundaries rather than workflow optimisation. The model comprises 32 stages across four core pipeline layers (Data, Model, Distribution, Application), supported by a 12-stage LLMOps pillar and a 9-category governance pillar. Thirteen stages are introduced here as separate units because they expose distinct security concerns that existing frameworks do not clearly distinguish. A governance mapping synthesising the NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001 reveals a structural property of the current regulatory landscape: governance evidence concentrates at deployment-facing stages, where systems are visible to regulators, while the most consequential decisions, data selection, alignment strategy, and capability boundaries, are made at development-facing stages, where regulatory visibility is lowest.

In: Kieseberg, P., Skopik, F., Atli, B., Schrittwieser, S., & Asplund, M. (Eds.), Availability, reliability and security---ARES 2026 EU Projects Symposium workshops (Lecture Notes in Computer Science, pp. 1-18). Springer Nature Switzerland
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有大语言模型（LLM）生命周期框架偏向运维效率、缺乏安全分析支持的问题，提出一个面向安全分析的生命周期模型。该模型围绕安全相关边界而非工作流优化来组织，包含四个核心流水线层（Data、Model、Distribution、Application）共 32 个阶段，辅以 12 阶段的 LLMOps 支柱和 9 类治理支柱，其中 13 个阶段因现有框架未明确区分的独特安全关切而被单独引入。治理映射还揭示了监管证据集中于部署面向阶段、而关键开发决策监管可见性最低的结构性失衡。
Motivation: LLM 正以前所未有的规模融入关键基础设施和企业工作流，但现有生命周期框架主要面向运营效率而非安全分析，导致数据来源验证、工件签名、智能体权限控制和退役等安全相关活动被隐式处理或假定已得到妥善关注；治理框架又按风险级别或管理流程组织要求，未与适用生命周期阶段清晰关联。
Method: 提出一个支持安全分析的 LLM 系统生命周期模型，以安全相关边界为结构主线，建立跨 Data、Model、Distribution、Application 四个核心层的 32 个阶段，并配套 12 阶段 LLMOps 支柱和 9 类治理支柱；其中 13 个阶段被单独定义，以区分现有框架未清晰识别的安全关切。还综合 NIST AI RMF、EU AI Act 和 ISO/IEC 42001 构建治理映射，将监管要求链接到对应生命周期阶段。
Result: 治理映射分析揭示当前监管格局的结构性特征：治理证据集中在面向部署（deployment-facing）的阶段，即系统对监管者可见之处；而数据选择、对齐策略和能力边界等最具后果性的决策发生在开发面向（development-facing）阶段，恰恰是监管可见性最低的地方。
Conclusion: 作者认为该生命周期模型通过显式划分安全相关阶段改善了 LLM 系统的安全可分析性，并指出现有治理框架在开发与部署阶段之间可见性失衡的短板；摘要未报告具体实证评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Theory of Conditional Collapse under Low-Rank Weight-Space Ablations: I. The Single-Block Theory and Synthetic Validation
papers.abstract_en: Activation patching and weight-space ablation both claim a component is causally responsible for a behavior, yet they act on different objects: one forward pass versus the parameters behind every forward pass. We ask when they agree. We study an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream, $F(x)=F_0(x)+\sum_iα_i(x)v_i$, read out by a linear functional, and prove three exact results. First, deleting a subset of carriers collapses a matched input pair onto the same unconditional output \emph{if and only if} the removal is symmetric on the pair and leaves no outside contrast; the error is deterministic, and we give its exact form even when the two conditions hold only approximately. Second, patching a carrier moves the readout by its donor-receiver \emph{contrast}, while ablating it moves the readout by its \emph{absolute level}; neither bounds the other, and we construct pairs where every single-carrier patch flips the decision while no single-carrier ablation does. Third, for an attention head composed with its own layer's normalization and MLP, we derive an exact first-order interaction formula with a provably second-order remainder, vanishing identically when only the MLP is ablated but not, in general, when a head is. Small transformers trained on a synthetic conditional task illustrate all three predictions: across thirty-nine ablation configurations the measured interaction is strongly rank-correlated with the idealized model's predictive accuracy (Spearman $-0.83$), and a second task and architecture reproduces the same pattern, including a further polarity reversal. The single-block interaction result extends past one residual block, and the synthetic validation is tested against a real pretrained model, in a companion paper that takes this theory further along both axes.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 2 figures. Part I of a two-part series; see the companion paper "Cross-Layer Interaction under Weight-Space Ablation" (Part II)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个关于残差流中条件计算在低秩权重空间消融（weight-space ablation）下行为的理论框架。作者证明：删除一组载体使匹配输入对塌缩到同一无条件输出当且仅当删除在输入对上的对称性成立且无外部对比；载体修补（patching）与消融对读出影响分别由供体-受体对比和绝对水平决定，二者互不界定；针对注意力头与其层归一化及 MLP 的组合，推导出精确的一阶交互公式且余项为二阶。小规模 Transformer 在合成条件任务上验证了三个预测，三十九种消融配置下 Spearman 相关系数为 -0.83，并在第二任务和架构上复现。
Motivation: 激活修补（activation patching）和权重空间消融都声称某组件对行为因果负责，但二者作用对象不同，一个作用于单次前向传播，另一个作用于每次前向传播背后的参数；论文研究这两种归因何时一致。
Method: 建立理想化加性残差流模型 F(x)=F_0(x)+∑α_i(x)v_i，由线性泛函读出，从数学上证明三种精确结果：载体删除的塌缩条件、修补与消融的对比/绝对水平效应、以及注意力头与层归一化及 MLP 组合的一阶交互公式；并用合成任务上的小 Transformer 和额外任务与架构验证。
Result: 在三十九种消融配置下，实测交互与理想模型预测精度强秩相关（Spearman -0.83）；第二任务和架构复现了相同模式并包括极性反转。
Conclusion: 单块交互结果可推广到超过一个残差块，合成验证也在配套论文中对照真实预训练模型测试；本文为两篇系列论文的第一部分。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Geospatial-Prior Guidance for 3D Semantic Scene Completion
papers.abstract_en: Inferring complete 3D geometry and semantics from onboard images remains challenging because occlusions and restricted fields of view leave large scene regions underconstrained. Although satellite imagery provides wide-area context, appearance cues alone offer limited structural guidance and may be unreliable because of spatial or temporal discrepancies. We present GeoScene, a geospatially guided framework that jointly uses satellite imagery and structured OpenStreetMap cues as soft priors for 3D semantic scene completion. GeoScene learns complementary voxel-wise reliability weights for onboard observations and geospatial guidance, and uses them to control feature refinement in observed and unobserved regions. This design preserves local visual evidence while exploiting large-scale road and building structure beyond onboard visibility. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate that GeoScene consistently improves both geometric and semantic completion under the geospatial-prior-assisted setting, with the most pronounced benefits for large-scale static and geospatially structured classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoScene，一个地理空间引导的 3D 语义场景补全 (semantic scene completion) 框架，联合使用卫星影像和 OpenStreetMap 结构线索作为软先验。框架学习体素级 (voxel-wise) 可靠性权重来调节车载观测与地理空间引导的特征细化，从而在保留局部视觉证据的同时利用车载视野之外的大尺度道路和建筑结构。在 SemanticKITTI 和 SSCBench-KITTI-360 上的实验表明，GeoScene 在几何与语义补全上均获得一致性提升。
Motivation: 从车载影像推断完整 3D 几何与语义很困难，因为遮挡和受限视野使大范围场景区域约束不足；卫星影像虽能提供广域上下文，但仅靠外观线索的结构指导有限，且可能因空间或时间差异而不可靠。
Method: GeoScene 将卫星影像和结构化 OpenStreetMap 线索作为软先验 (soft priors)，学习互补的体素级可靠性权重，分别对应车载观测和地理空间引导，并用这些权重控制已观测与未观测区域中的特征细化过程。
Result: 实验显示，在地理空间先验辅助设定下，GeoScene 在 SemanticKITTI 和 SSCBench-KITTI-360 上持续改进几何与语义补全性能，且对大规模静态和具有地理空间结构的类别收益最明显。
Conclusion: 该设计表明，通过可靠性加权的特征细化，可以在利用大尺度道路与建筑结构的同时保留车载局部视觉证据，从而缓解遮挡与视野受限带来的场景补全难题。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A machine-readable catalogue of the Tsiolkovsky papers (fond 555, Archive of the Russian Academy of Sciences), and a way to measure how well its handwriting can be read
papers.abstract_en: The personal archive of Konstantin Tsiolkovsky (1857-1935) is held as fond 555 of the Archive of the Russian Academy of Sciences. The archive scanned the fond and published the images, but with no queryable catalogue, no full-text search and no dataset: the holdings can only be browsed one page at a time. This paper describes a machine-readable catalogue of all 2,019 files and 51,008 scans, a dating for 1,969 files taken from the archive's own descriptions, a page-level classification of every scan into handwriting and typescript, and a growing corpus of machine transcriptions (currently 322 files, 5,454 scans). It also reports a way to measure handwritten-text-recognition accuracy in an archive with no ground truth. Archives of the typewriter era often preserve one text twice, as manuscript and as a typed copy; transcribing both and comparing isolates the reading error, since source and pipeline are identical and only page difficulty differs. Across 294 such pairs from 27 files, two readings of a handwritten page agree on a median 37% of words. On two files that also have a published edition the estimate can be checked against ground truth: it is unbiased to within a percentage point and ranks pages as the truth does (rank correlation 0.92 where the edition is a faithful witness). This bounds use: two variants of one work here share 19% of words, below the rate at which two readings of a single page agree, so the redactions cannot be collated word by word at this quality. That negative result is reported as such, and the constraint is built into the tool.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍齐奥尔科夫斯基个人档案（fond 555，俄罗斯科学院档案馆）的机器可读目录：涵盖全部 2,019 个文件、51,008 张扫描图，1,969 个文件的年代信息，逐页将扫描分为手写与打字稿，并给出目前 322 个文件、5,454 张扫描的机器转录语料。作者还提出一种在无 ground truth 档案中衡量手写识别准确率的方法：利用打字机时代同一文本常同时存在手稿与打字副本的特点，同时转录两者并比较以隔离阅读误差。
Motivation: 档案馆虽已扫描并公开图像，但没有可查询目录、全文检索或数据集，只能逐页浏览；同时档案没有 ground truth，无法直接衡量手写文本识别准确率。
Method: 构建机器可读目录与逐页分类；衡量方法依赖“同一文本有手稿和打字稿两份”的档案结构，对两者分别转录并比较，使源与管线相同而只改变页面难度，从而隔离阅读错误。
Result: 在来自 27 个文件的 294 对“手稿-打字稿”中，同一手写页的两次阅读在词级上中位一致率为 37%；对两个有出版版本的文件的检验显示该估计与 ground truth 相比偏差在一个百分点内，页面排序秩相关 0.92。同一个作品的两个变体只共享 19% 的词，低于单页两次阅读的一致率，因此在该质量下无法逐词校勘这些删节版。
Conclusion: 作者报告该负结果，并将这一约束内建到工具中，说明该方法适合无 ground truth 档案场景，但转录质量限制了逐词级校勘的使用边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictive Enhancement Calibration for Latent Breast MRI Virtual Contrast Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Virtual contrast enhancement (VCE) synthesizes enhanced breast MR images from pre-contrast acquisitions. Modern latent generators offer strong image priors, but their bounded natural-image autoencoders conflict with the non-canonical intensity scale of MRI. We show that the upper bound can alter radiomic fidelity before generation, while scaling source and target independently creates a coordinate inconsistency. We propose Predictive Enhancement Calibration (PEC), which represents each pair in a shared, case-adaptive coordinate during training and predicts its unavailable upper endpoint from the pre-contrast image at inference. We integrate PEC with a pretrained FLUX latent flow transformer via parameter-efficient reference conditioning. Target round trips first isolate representation loss before generation; near-matched conditional models then compare PEC with fixed-wide and separate coordinates under comparable training budgets and backbone settings. On the fixed internal MAMA100 development cohort, PEC improves all eight point estimates in this source-only VCE setting, with paired evidence strongest for MSE and LPIPS.\noindent\textbf{Code:} https://github.com/tanlei0/pec-breast-mri-vce
papers.comment: Top-3 submission in the MICCAI 2026 MAMA-Synth Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Predictive Enhancement Calibration (PEC)，用于乳房 MRI 的虚拟对比增强 (virtual contrast enhancement, VCE)：通过共享、逐案例自适应的坐标表示训练对，并在推理时从平扫图像预测无法获取的上端点。作者将 PEC 与预训练的 FLUX 潜在流 Transformer 结合，使用参数高效的参考条件化，在内部 MAMA100 开发集上报告所有八个点估计均优于基线，其中 MSE 和 LPIPS 的配对证据最强。
Motivation: 现有潜在生成器自带的有界自然图像自编码器与 MRI 非规范强度尺度冲突，上界可能在生成前就破坏影像组学保真度；而单独缩放源图像和目标图像又会造成坐标不一致。
Method: 提出 PEC，在训练时将每个图像对表示到共享的逐案例自适应坐标中，推理时从平扫图像预测缺失的上端点；并集成到预训练的 FLUX 潜在流 Transformer 中，采用参数高效的参考条件化。先通过目标往返 (round trip) 隔离生成前的表征损失，再在相近训练预算和骨干设置下比较 PEC 与固定宽坐标及分离坐标。
Result: 在固定内部 MAMA100 开发队列上，该纯源域 VCE 设置下 PEC 提升了全部八项点估计，其中 MSE 和 LPIPS 的成对改进证据最强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了共享案例自适应坐标对潜在生成器进行 MRI VCE 校准的有效性，并指出这是 MICCAI 2026 MAMA-Synth Challenge 的 Top-3 提交方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Modality Reliability in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Observations
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) integrates text, audio, and vision to infer human affect, yet real-world multimodal observations are often incomplete. Existing methods for incomplete-observation MSA mainly follow two paradigms. Reconstruction-based methods recover missing information from observed modalities, while joint-representation methods learn directly from incomplete inputs. Although effective, these methods usually treat modality reliability only implicitly within representation learning or fusion design rather than modeling it explicitly. We argue that modality reliability is a central variable in incomplete-observation settings. Failure to model it explicitly gives rise to two related issues. The first is reliability mismatch, in which the affective evidence retained by each modality varies across samples and missing rates. The second is reliability propagation bias, in which messages from degraded modalities may adversely affect cross-modal interaction and predictive performance. To address these issues, we propose MRCF, a Modality Reliability-Calibrated Framework for MSA with incomplete observations. MRCF contains a Reliability-Aware Branch that estimates sample-specific modality reliability from intramodal quality cues and cross-modal semantic consistency, a Reliability-Guided Interaction Branch that uses the estimated scores to modulate cross-modal information flow, and a Reliability-Calibrated Fusion Module that integrates reliability and semantic cues for final prediction. Experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS show that MRCF achieves strong performance under standard incomplete-observation protocols. Further analyses provide evidence that explicit reliability modeling helps mitigate reliability mismatch and reliability propagation bias during interaction and fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态情感分析中观测不完整的问题，提出用显式模态可靠性建模来替代传统隐式处理。作者提出 MRCF（Modality Reliability-Calibrated Framework），包含可靠性感知分支、可靠性引导交互分支和可靠性校准融合模块。在 CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI 和 CH-SIMS 上的实验表明，该方法在标准不完整观测协议下表现强劲，并缓解了可靠性失配与可靠性传播偏差。
Motivation: 现有不完整观测下的多模态情感分析方法要么重建缺失信息，要么从不完整输入直接学习，但都只隐式处理模态可靠性，未将其作为核心变量。这导致两个问题：不同样本和缺失率下各模态保留的情感证据不同造成的可靠性失配，以及退化模态信息对跨模态交互和预测产生的可靠性传播偏差。
Method: 提出 MRCF 框架，包括三个组成部分：可靠性感知分支从模态内质量线索和跨模态语义一致性估计样本特定的模态可靠性；可靠性引导交互分支用估计的可靠性分数调节跨模态信息流动；可靠性校准融合模块在最终预测中整合可靠性与语义线索。
Result: 在 CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI 和 CH-SIMS 三个基准上，MRCF 在标准不完整观测协议下取得强性能。进一步分析表明，显式可靠性建模有助于在交互与融合阶段缓解可靠性失配和可靠性传播偏差。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模模态可靠性是不完整观测设置下的关键环节，MRCF 的实验与分析为这一观点提供了证据。摘要未提及方法在完整观测或极端缺失率下的局限性。
Relevance: 5
