papers.title: Formal Verification of Agentic Systems over Operational Data
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems driven by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world workflows where they act on persistent operational data. Before deployment, these systems need to be verified against business requirements that govern workflow execution and data evolution. However, existing approaches do not provide such system-level guarantees, as they mainly constrain or analyse behaviour at the agent's interface level. We study here the verification of agentic systems comprising a single LLM and a tool orchestration harness over relational operational data. We formalise them as Stateful Tool-Enabled Agentic Deployments (STEADs), give their semantics, define the problem of verifying them against First-Order Computation Tree Logic (FO-CTL) specifications, and show that it is undecidable. We identify sufficient conditions for exact preservation of FO-CTL specifications under a finite-domain restriction, over which verification is PSPACE-complete. The key requirement is that renaming opaque identifiers in the data must correspondingly rename the selected tool calls. We show that LLM-driven agents can violate this condition and introduce a canonical deployment wrapper that guarantees it for arbitrary base agents while preserving already-equivariant behaviour. We prove that computing canonical representations required by this construction is graph-isomorphism-hard. Finally, we illustrate our framework on an LLM agent orchestrating a case-management workflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究由单个大语言模型 (LLM) 与工具编排框架构成的智能体系统在关系型运营数据上的形式化验证。作者将其形式化为有状态工具型智能体部署 (STEAD)，给出语义，并证明对一阶计算树逻辑 (FO-CTL) 规范的验证问题不可判定；在有限域限制下，若数据中的不透明标识符重命名与所选工具调用重命名保持一致，则该验证问题是 PSPACE-完全的。文中还引入一种规范部署包装器来保证该条件，并证明计算其规范表示是图同构难的。
Motivation: 现有方法主要在智能体的接口层面约束或分析行为，无法对工作流执行与数据演化所对应的业务需求提供系统级保证，而这正是此类系统部署前的验证缺口。
Method: 将单 LLM 加工具编排链路的系统形式化为 STEAD，定义其语义并研究 FO-CTL 规范验证；在有限域限制下刻画保持规范精确性的充分条件，并提出保证任意基础智能体满足该条件的规范部署包装器，同时保持已有的等变性行为。
Result: 一般情形下 FO-CTL 验证不可判定；在有限域限制且满足标识符重命名与工具调用重命名对应关系时，验证为 PSPACE-完全；计算该包装器所需的规范表示为图同构难问题。摘要以 LLM 智能体编排案件管理工作流为例说明该框架。
Conclusion: 作者指出 LLM 驱动的智能体可能违反标识符重命名与工具调用的一致性条件，而所提规范包装器可在任意基础智能体上恢复该保证；同时该构造的计算代价是图同构难的，这界定了该验证路径的适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Clinical-Trial Strategy: Offline Policy Training for Decision Agents
papers.abstract_en: Clinical development is sequential decision-making under uncertainty, where a sponsor must plan a portfolio of experiments from heterogeneous evidence. We study this setting by framing oncology clinical development as an offline decision-making problem in which an agent predicts the next six-month trial portfolio of an oncology drug program from information available at the decision date. To support this, we construct a temporal dataset that combines 31.7k heterogeneous public data records, including trial registries, regulatory reviews, sponsor filings, utilization data, and epidemiology, into 881 offline decision episodes across 45 historical programs. We compare four offline objectives: behavioral cloning, reward-weighted behavioral cloning, learned-reward training, and value-based implicit Q-learning against four frontier LLM agents that share a common date-gated retrieval scaffold across held-out drug, sponsor, drug-class, and temporal splits. Models trained offline outperform the non-fine-tuned baselines, particularly in the post-August 2025 contamination-clean holdout. Reward-weighted behavioral cloning performs the best, obtaining 46.2% indication F1 and 14.2% strict F1 against 25.0% and 2.1%, respectively, for the best-performing tool agent on each metric. These results suggest that structured offline learning can teach agents to plan clinical experiments.
papers.comment: Accepted for a spotlight at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology (GenBio) and as a poster at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning (DEMO). 15 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将肿瘤药物临床开发建模为离线决策问题，agent 根据决策日可得信息预测某肿瘤药项目未来六个月的项目组合。作者构造了包含 31.7k 条异质公开记录、跨 45 个历史项目的 881 个离线决策 episode 的数据集，并在留出药物、申办方、药物类别和时间切分下比较四种离线目标与四个前沿 LLM agent。结果显示离线训练模型优于未微调基线，其中奖励加权行为克隆表现最佳。
Motivation: 临床开发是在不确定性下进行的序列决策，申办方需要依据异质证据规划一组实验；此前缺乏将这一过程系统建模为离线强化学习或离线决策问题并评测可用方法的数据集与框架。
Method: 构建结合试验注册、监管审查、申办方文件、使用数据和流行病学记录的时序数据集，生成 881 个离线决策 episode；比较行为克隆、奖励加权行为克隆、学习奖励训练和价值式隐式 Q-learning，并让四个 LLM agent 共享日期门控检索脚手架，在保留药物、申办方、药物类别及时间划分上评测。
Result: 离线训练模型在各项指标上超过未微调基线，尤其在 2025 年 8 月之后的去污染保留集上；奖励加权行为克隆表现最佳，达到 46.2% 的 indication F1 和 14.2% 的 strict F1，而最佳工具 agent 对应指标分别为 25.0% 和 2.1%。

papers.title: FraQ: Efficient Coordinate-Space Recompression for Federated Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient collaborative adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) without centralizing private data. However, LoRA's two-factor parameterization creates an aggregation mismatch across clients: naively averaging the factors does not recover the average of their induced updates. This mismatch can be avoided by forming the exact aggregate in the full weight space and then recompressing it, but decomposing the resulting dense matrix is computationally expensive and memory-intensive. We propose FraQ, an efficient coordinate-space recompression method for federated LoRA. Starting from stacked factors that exactly represent the aggregate, FraQ factorizes it into an orthonormal basis and a compact coordinate matrix. It then recovers the singular spectrum from a small Gram matrix, selects the smallest rank satisfying a prescribed energy threshold, and maps the selected coordinate subspace back through the basis to construct the global adapter. Experiments on text classification and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that FraQ achieves accuracy close to uncompressed baselines while substantially reducing downlink communication with low server-side recompression overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FraQ，一种面向联邦 LoRA 的高效坐标空间重压缩方法。针对 LoRA 双因子参数化在联邦聚合时产生的更新不匹配问题，FraQ 从精确表示聚合结果的堆叠因子出发，将其分解为正交基和紧致坐标矩阵，再通过小规模 Gram 矩阵恢复奇异谱，按给定能量阈值选择最小秩，并把所选坐标子空间映射回新基以构造全局适配器。实验表明在文本分类和常识推理基准上，FraQ 的准确率接近未压缩基线，同时显著降低下行通信量和服务端重压缩开销。
Motivation: 联邦微调 LoRA 时，对两因子求平均无法恢复各客户端诱导更新的平均，导致聚合不匹配；若先在完整权重空间形成精确聚合再重压缩，则稠密矩阵分解的计算和内存开销过高。
Method: FraQ 从精确表示聚合结果的堆叠因子开始，将其分解为一个正交基和一个紧致坐标矩阵；随后从一个小型 Gram 矩阵恢复奇异谱，按预设能量阈值选出满足要求的最小秩，并将所选坐标子空间通过基映射回去，构建全局 LoRA 适配器。
Result: 在文本分类和常识推理基准上，FraQ 能达到接近未压缩基线的准确率，同时大幅减少下行通信，并保持较低的服务端重压缩开销。
Conclusion: 作者将 FraQ 定位为联邦 LoRA 中一种低开销的坐标空间重压缩方案，其有效性主要体现在文本分类与常识推理任务上的实验验证。

papers.title: Large language models for partial differential equation workflows
papers.abstract_en: Partial differential equations (PDEs) become actionable in science and engineering not as isolated formulae, but as executable workflows that connect modelling assumptions, governing equations, numerical solvers, diagnostics, and decisions. Large language models (LLMs) are beginning to support such workflows by linking natural language, symbolic mathematics, code, solver outputs, and feedback. Here we examine recent advances in LLM-assisted PDE research across three stages: the discovery and formulation of governing models, the generation and revision of executable numerical solvers, and the use of simulation feedback to support control, design, and optimization. Across these stages, current systems act primarily as workflow-level interfaces. Despite this progress, the field remains limited by the scarcity of high-quality datasets and benchmarks, especially for knowledge discovery and real-world applications, where expert annotation, executable problem construction, and task-level feedback require substantial domain effort. A further challenge is the persistent gap between simulation-based results and real-world scientific and engineering systems, which limits the direct transfer of numerical simulations, control policies, and optimized designs to practical settings. These challenges make LLM-assisted PDE workflows a critical testbed for developing scientific AI systems that can connect language, computation, physical constraints, and real-world decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇综述性论文，考察大语言模型（LLM）在偏微分方程（PDE）工作流中的近期进展。论文将 LLM 辅助 PDE 研究划分为三个阶段：控制方程发现与公式化、数值求解器生成与修正、以及基于仿真反馈的控制/设计/优化。作者指出当前系统主要作为工作流级接口，并系统分析了数据与基准稀缺、仿真结果与真实系统之间差距等制约因素。
Motivation: PDE 的价值体现在可执行工作流而非孤立公式中，LLM 有望连接自然语言、符号数学、代码与求解器反馈；但该领域缺乏对近期进展的系统梳理，且高质量数据集和基准尤其稀缺，因此需要阶段性审视其现状与瓶颈。
Method: 论文采用阶段性综述框架，按模型发现与公式化、可执行数值求解器生成与迭代、仿真反馈驱动的控制/设计/优化三个阶段组织并评述近期 LLM 辅助 PDE 研究。
Result: 摘要报告，当前 LLM-PDE 系统主要充当工作流级接口；同时指出知识发现和真实应用场景中专家标注、可执行问题构建与任务级反馈需要大量领域投入，仿真到实际科学工程系统的迁移仍存在明显差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些挑战使 LLM 辅助 PDE 工作流成为发展连接语言、计算、物理约束与真实决策的科学 AI 系统的重要试验场，数据/基准稀缺和仿真到现实（sim-to-real）鸿沟是当前主要瓶颈。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: FOUND-AF: Benchmarking ECG Foundation Models for Atrial Fibrillation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia and is associated with increased risks of stroke, heart failure, and mortality. Recent ECG foundation models offer transferable representations for automated AF detection. However, their relative effectiveness remains unclear because existing studies use different datasets, preprocessing procedures, classifiers, and validation protocols. This study presents FOUND-AF, a unified, leakage-controlled, and deployment-oriented benchmarking framework that evaluates the quality of pretrained ECG representations under identical experimental conditions. Nine publicly available foundation models from five families, including HuBERT-ECG, CLEF, ST-MEM, ECG-JEPA, and ECGFounder, were evaluated across four heterogeneous ECG datasets, namely AFDB, CinC2017, CPSC2021, and LTAFDB. All models were used as frozen feature extractors with standardized preprocessing, model-native resampling, a fixed XGBoost classifier, and recording-level grouped cross-validation. The evaluation included classification metrics, receiver operating characteristic analysis, paired recording-level bootstrap comparisons with Holm correction, embedding-space visualization, and computational efficiency profiling. The ECGFounder model consistently achieved the strongest overall performance across datasets while offering a favorable trade-off between accuracy, model size, inference time, and memory usage. FOUND-AF therefore provides a reproducible framework for selecting ECG foundation models and demonstrates that compact, clinically pretrained encoders can support robust and computationally efficient AF detection across heterogeneous acquisition settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FOUND-AF，一个统一且防泄漏的基准测试框架，用于在相同实验条件下评估预训练ECG基础模型在心房颤动检测中的表现。作者在四个异构ECG数据集上评估了来自五个家族的九个公开基础模型（如HuBERT-ECG、CLEF、ST-MEM、ECG-JEPA、ECGFounder），使用冻结特征提取器、标准化预处理、固定XGBoost分类器和记录级分组交叉验证。结果显示ECGFounder模型在准确率、模型大小、推理时间和内存使用之间取得最佳权衡。
Motivation: 现有ECG基础模型用于房颤检测的相对有效性不清楚，因为不同研究使用了不同的数据集、预处理流程、分类器和验证协议，缺乏统一比较基准。
Method: FOUND-AF框架采用冻结特征提取器、标准化预处理、模型原生重采样、固定XGBoost分类器和记录级分组交叉验证，并包含分类指标、受试者工作特征分析、配对记录级bootstrap比较（Holm校正）、嵌入空间可视化和计算效率分析。
Result: 在AFDB、CinC2017、CPSC2021和LTAFDB四个数据集上，ECGFounder模型持续取得最强综合性能，并在准确率、模型大小、推理时间和内存使用之间提供良好权衡。
Conclusion: FOUND-AF为选择ECG基础模型提供了可复现的框架，并表明紧凑的临床预训练编码器能够在异构采集设置下支持稳健且计算高效的房颤检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiagChain: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Evidence-Grounded Attack Chain Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer a promising approach to attack chain reconstruction by retrieving and interpreting heterogeneous telemetry to infer ordered attacker actions. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate final outputs or aggregate accuracy, providing limited insight into how errors arise and propagate across intermediate reasoning stages. We present DiagChain, a diagnostic benchmark for evidence-grounded attack chain reconstruction that enables stage-wise evaluation of LLM agents. DiagChain includes MAIN-69, a suite of 69 scenarios spanning multiple operating systems, evidence noise levels, and chain lengths. It further introduces Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ECRAG), which couples evidence retrieval with an evolving structured representation of the reconstructed chain. Five complementary metrics are introduced to assess distinct stages of the reconstruction process and support systematic failure diagnosis. Based on evaluations using 6 LLMs, DiagChain reveals that even the strongest configuration succeeds on only 39.6% of the 849 reference steps in MAIN-69. Our analysis further shows that smaller models struggle with the more basic task of incorporating retrieved evidence into their outputs, whereas larger models can proceed to later steps, where correctly ordering that evidence becomes the main bottleneck. These results validate the importance of diagnostic evaluation beyond end-to-end accuracy and provide actionable insights for improving evidence-grounded cybersecurity agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiagChain 是一个面向证据支撑攻击链重建 (evidence-grounded attack chain reconstruction) 的 LLM agent 诊断基准，包含 MAIN-69 场景集（69 个场景，覆盖多种操作系统、证据噪声水平和链长度），并提出 Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ECRAG) 将证据检索与不断演化的链结构表征耦合。该基准引入五个互补指标用于分阶段评估重建过程。基于 6 个 LLM 的评估显示，最强配置在 MAIN-69 的 849 个参考步骤上也仅成功 39.6%。
Motivation: 现有基准主要衡量最终输出或聚合准确率，难以揭示中间推理阶段错误如何产生和累积，因此缺少对 LLM agents 攻击链重建过程的细粒度诊断能力。
Method: 提出 DiagChain 诊断基准，采用 ECRAG 方法将证据检索与动态更新的链结构表征相结合；同时设计五个互补指标，分别对应重建过程的不同阶段以支持系统性失败诊断。
Result: 对 6 个 LLM 的评估表明，最强配置在 MAIN-69 的 849 个参考步骤上仅成功 39.6%；较小模型在将检索到的证据纳入输出这一较基础步骤上失败，较大模型虽能推进到后续步骤，但正确排序证据成为主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果印证了超越端到端准确率的诊断式评估的重要性，并为改进证据支撑的网络安全 agents 提供了可操作的见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Design-Time Optimization of Deep Neural Networks for Intermittent Learning on Microcontrollers
papers.abstract_en: We present a method for designing deep neural networks (DNNs) for intermittent, energy-autonomous, on-device learning on microcontroller units (MCUs). In mobile applications where the energy can run out, e.g., when solar-powered, executing artificial intelligence (AI) faces a technical issue as learning can be interrupted at any time. Our approach combines a hardware-aware energy prediction model with multi-objective optimization (MOO), enabling offline DNN optimization at the design stage without repeated deployment and online testing on the target MCU. Our proposed energy predictor estimates per-layer energy consumption for both DNN inference and training, including the intermittent checkpointing overhead, based on implementation-specific compute and memory features extracted from the DNN model. We validate our approach using autoencoders for anomaly detection on a Cortex-M4 MCU, where our predictor achieves a weighted absolute percentage error of 16.6%, which is sufficient for reliable architecture selection under intermittency constraints. As a result, this work bridges the gap between MOO, automated DNN design, deployment on energy-harvesting systems, and intermittent learning, truly enabling autonomous AI at the edge.

papers.title: GenOS: Compositional Certificates for Semantic Robustness in AI Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are stochastic workflows: prompts are interpreted, artifacts are sampled, validators produce observations, and orchestrators commit or repair. Small prompt or specification changes can therefore alter program-behavior distributions even when the texts appear synonymous. Existing systems evaluate correctness, but lack a compositional criterion for safely replacing a prompt, contract, generator, or program inside a complete agentic workflow. We introduce GenOS, a probabilistic operational semantics for this replacement problem. Each layer is modeled as a Markov kernel, and each interface carries an observer-relative equivalence. We prove that equivalence-compatible kernels descend to quotient classes and that quotienting commutes with distributional extension and sequential composition. Hence, equivalent prompts induce equal probabilities for all downstream equivalence-closed events, including verified commit. We also establish workflow bisimulation, guarded-commit safety under sound validation, total-variation non-expansiveness, and an additive robustness bound that attributes approximation error to individual pipeline layers. An executable insertion-sort audit instantiates the theory with natural-language paraphrases, a formal contract, six programs, two observers, and exhaustive execution on 121 inputs. Equivalent prompts yield identical code-class and commit distributions; a prompt assigning 5% probability to an in-place contract is distinguished by a mutation observer, while downstream distances remain within the predicted bound. Across 20,000 randomized finite-kernel trials, no exact or approximate law is violated. GenOS is model-parametric: compatibility is a measurable property to test, not an assumption about language-model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenOS，一种面向 AI 编码智能体工作流的概率操作语义 (probabilistic operational semantics)，用于刻画提示词、契约、生成器或程序在完整智能体流程中的可替换性。每一层被建模为 Markov kernel，界面携带相对于观察者的等价关系；作者证明等价兼容的 kernel 可下降到商类，且商化与分布扩展和顺序复合可交换。论文还给出一个可执行的插入排序审计，用 121 个输入穷举验证理论性质。
Motivation: AI 编码智能体是随机工作流，小的提示词或规约变化即使在文本看似同义时也可能改变程序行为分布。现有系统只评估正确性，缺乏在完整 agentic 工作流中安全替换提示词、契约、生成器或程序的组合式判据。
Method: 引入概率操作语义 GenOS：将流水线各层建模为 Markov kernel，每个接口带有观察者相对等价关系。证明等价兼容 kernel 可降为商类，商化与分布扩展及顺序复合可交换；并建立工作流互模拟、健全验证下的受保护提交安全性、总变差非扩张性以及将近似误差分配到各流水线层的可加鲁棒性界。
Result: 在插入排序审计中，使用自然语言改写、形式契约、六个程序、两个观察者并对 121 个输入做穷举执行：等价提示产生相同的代码类和提交分布；一个给原地契约分配 5% 概率的提示能被变异观察者区分，同时下游距离保持在预测界内。在 20,000 次随机有限核试验中，没有发现任何精确或近似定律被违反。
Conclusion: GenOS 是模型参数化的：兼容性是可测试的可测性质，而不是对语言模型行为的假设。

papers.title: From Social Coding to Agentic Coding: Productivity and Relational Reconfiguration in Open-Source Communities
papers.abstract_en: Open-source software communities are a form of digital public infrastructure that not only produces code, but also generates public knowledge and interpersonal relationships through visible collaboration. Generative coding agents (CAs) are an advanced tool to improve development efficiency while shifting part of activities from public human interaction to private human-agent loops. We study this shift using an LLM-based multi-agent simulation initialized with real GitHub data from 1,084 active developers and their repository relationships. After a warm-up with historical commits, we branch the same community state into parallel No-CA and CA conditions for 4-week simulations. CA introduction increases planned and completed tasks by 34.0% and 39.0%, respectively, and reduces median completion time from 45 to 20 minutes. However, adoption reaches only 26.0%, and the gains concentrate among developers who are already more active and well connected. CAs also restructure task execution pathways. Direct human-human interaction declines from 32.4% to 11.6%, while CA-involved modes increase to 57.3%, including 40.3% completed through CA-assisted self-loops. Public knowledge generated under CA condition also provides less support for later tasks. On a standardized retrieval benchmark, the CA corpus achieves 22.3% knowledge coverage, far below the 81.1% achieved by the real-human corpus, and requires more retrieval steps with a lower success rate. These results reveal a productivity-public knowledge tension: coding agents increase technical production, but more work shifts to agent-mediated or private loops, leaving public records less useful to future contributors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用LLM多智能体模拟研究开源社区引入生成式编码智能体（coding agents, CAs）的后果。模拟基于1,084名真实GitHub开发者及其仓库关系，历史提交热身后并行运行4周的No-CA与CA两种条件。结果显示CA使计划与完成任务分别提升34.0%和39.0%，中位完成时间从45分钟降至20分钟，但采用率仅26.0%，且收益集中在原本更活跃、连接更好的开发者；同时人类-人类直接交互从32.4%降至11.6%，CA参与模式增至57.3%。
Motivation: 开源社区是数字公共基础设施，既生产代码也通过可见协作生成公共知识和人际关系。生成式编码智能体提升开发效率，却把部分活动从公共人类交互转向私有的人-智能体循环，作者希望量化这一转变带来的影响。
Method: 提出基于LLM的多智能体（multi-agent）模拟方法，用真实GitHub数据初始化社区状态，经历史提交热身后将同一社区状态分成无CA与有CA两个并行分支，进行为期4周的对比模拟。
Result: CA引入使计划与完成任务分别增加34.0%和39.0%，中位完成时间从45分钟降至20分钟；采用率仅26.0%，收益集中于更活跃且连接更好的开发者。人类-人类直接交互占比从32.4%降至11.6%，CA参与模式升至57.3%（其中40.3%为CA辅助自循环完成）。在标准化检索基准上，CA语料知识覆盖率仅22.3%，远低于真实人类语料的81.1%，且需要更多检索步骤、成功率更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调存在生产率-公共知识张力（productivity-public knowledge tension）：编码智能体提高技术产出，但更多工作转向智能体中介或私有循环，导致公共记录对未来贡献者的支持减弱。

papers.title: Policy Fragmentation or Institutional Alignment? Institutional Governance of AI in Universities and Business Schools
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming high-skilled domains, requiring higher education institutions (HEI) to balance the teaching of foundational principles with the integration of emerging tools to ensure workforce readiness. While HEI are increasingly adopting AI, many continue to grapple with how it should be incorporated into curricula and governed through policy, especially when such policies are set at different levels of an institution. This research analyzes AI policies across HEI from 34 states in the United States to investigate what these policies entail and how policies set across institutions as well as within different levels at an institution differ. Using natural language processing (NLP) to analyze institutional AI policies, we find a clear divergence: university-level policies emphasize data security and risk mitigation whereas school-level policies, when present, focus on pedagogical applications and tool usage. When focusing on business school specific policies, relatively few business schools maintain AI policies distinct from university frameworks, creating misalignment with discipline-specific learning objectives. This gap poses challenges particularly for faculty and students as well as for accreditation purposes. Our insights suggest that guidelines should be aligned with broader institutional policies while addressing discipline-specific learning objectives and evolving workforce demands.
papers.comment: Our insights suggest that policy guidelines should be aligned with broader institutional policies while addressing discipline-specific learning objectives and evolving workforce demands
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用自然语言处理（NLP）分析美国34个州高等教育机构（HEI）的AI政策，考察大学层面与学院层面政策在内容上的差异。研究发现明显的分歧：校级政策强调数据安全与风险缓解，而院级政策则关注教学应用与工具使用；在商学院层面，独立于大学框架的AI政策很少，导致与学科特定学习目标不一致。作者建议政策制定应与更广泛的机构政策对齐，同时兼顾学科特定目标与不断变化的劳动力需求。
Motivation: 高等教育机构在课程中融入AI时常面临政策制定层级不同的难题，特别是商学院缺乏与学科目标相匹配的独立AI策略，这可能影响教师、学生及认证过程。
Method: 收集并分析来自美国34个州的高等教育机构的AI政策文本，运用NLP技术对大学层面、学院层面以及商学院层面的政策内容进行比较分析。
Result: 研究发现大学层面政策侧重数据安全和风险缓解，而学院层面政策侧重教学法和工具使用；相对较少的商学院拥有独立于大学框架的AI政策，存在与学科学习目标的错位。
Conclusion: 作者认为AI政策指南应与更广泛的机构政策对齐，同时还需回应学科特定的学习目标和不断变化的劳动力需求，以弥合当前的政策缺口。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Peer Review Across Research Communities: From Reviewer AI Policies to LLM Review Quality
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted peer review is increasingly discussed and adopted as a tool to support the scientific publishing process, yet there is little systematic understanding of how publication venues regulate its use or of how capable current AI review systems are. We address these questions by first surveying reviewer-facing AI policies across 111 leading AI/NLP conferences and medical journals, revealing substantial regulation differences between the two communities. Second, we evaluate AI-generated peer reviews at ICLR 2026 and Nature Communications using a novel dataset comprising original manuscript submissions and several hundred human- and machine-generated reviews. We compare reviews produced by open-source and proprietary models using complementary evaluation metrics, including LLM-as-a-Judge, score alignment, granularity, and overlap with human reviewers' concerns. Our results show that current LLMs can generate detailed and fluent reviews but exhibit systematic weaknesses, such as overly positive recommendations, generic criticism, and uneven evidence grounding. We demonstrate that aggregate quality scores alone can overestimate review quality and argue for multi-dimensional evaluation of AI-generated peer reviews.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 19 figures, 10 tables. Currently under peer review. GitHub link for code and data is given in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统调查了 AI/NLP 会议与医学期刊对审稿人使用 AI 的政策差异，并构建包含原始投稿与数百条人工/机器评审的新数据集，在 ICLR 2026 与 Nature Communications 场景下评估开源与专有 LLM 生成的同行评审质量。结果显示当前 LLM 能生成流畅详细的评审，但存在推荐分数过于乐观、批评泛泛而谈、证据支撑不均等系统性问题，且单一聚合质量分数会高估评审质量。作者据此主张对 AI 生成评审采用多维评估。
Motivation: AI 辅助同行评审正被广泛讨论和采用，但学界对出版机构如何规范其使用、以及现有 AI 评审系统的实际能力缺乏系统性认识。
Method: 作者首先对 111 个主流 AI/NLP 会议与医学期刊的 reviewer-facing AI 政策进行调研；随后构建包含原始投稿和数百条人工与机器生成评审的新数据集，利用 LLM-as-a-Judge、分数对齐 (score alignment)、粒度 (granularity) 以及与人工审稿人关注点的重叠度等互补指标，比较开源与专有模型的评审质量。
Result: 调查发现两个学术共同体对 AI 使用的监管差异显著；实验显示当前 LLM 评审虽然详细流畅，但系统性地给出过于正面的推荐、批评缺乏具体性且证据依据不均衡。作者还发现仅看聚合质量分数会高估评审质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AI 生成同行评审的质量评估需要多维指标，而不能依赖单一聚合分数。论文目前处于同行评审中，并公开了代码与数据。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统调查了 AI/NLP 会议与医学期刊对审稿人使用 AI 的政策差异，并构建包含原始投稿与数百条人工/机器评审的新数据集，在 ICLR 2026 与 Nature Communications 场景下评估开源与专有 LLM 生成的同行评审质量。结果显示当前 LLM 能生成流畅详细的评审，但存在推荐分数过于乐观、批评泛泛而谈、证据支撑不均等系统性问题，且单一聚合质量分数会高估评审质量。作者据此主张对 AI 生成评审采用多维评估。

papers.title: SlimVLM: Sensitivity-aware Dynamic Structured Pruning with Adaptive Visual Token Selection for Efficient Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in processing and understanding both text and images, their large parameter sizes lead to significant computational overhead, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices. While pruning has been effective for compressing Large Language Models (LLMs), directly applying it to VLMs leads to significant performance drops, largely due to redundant visual tokens interfering with importance estimation. To this end, we propose SlimVLM, a structured pruning framework designed to compress VLMs while preserving their task performance. We introduce an adaptive visual token selection strategy for VLMs that leverages average text-to-visual attention scores to assess the importance of visual tokens, removing redundant ones during pruning based on a set threshold, thereby optimizing the importance calculation. Recognizing the varying tolerance to sparsity across different modules, we also propose a Sensitivity-aware dynamic pruning mechanism that determines the appropriate pruning ratio for each module by calculating the linear reconstruction error between the outputs of the pruned and unpruned modules, ensuring overall performance stability. Experimental results show that SlimVLM outperforms existing methods across multiple multimodal benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SlimVLM，一个针对视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的结构化剪枝框架，旨在压缩模型并保持任务性能。方法包含自适应视觉 token 选择（依据文本到视觉注意力得分评估并移除冗余 token）与敏感性感知动态剪枝（通过线性重构误差决定每模块剪枝率）。实验显示在多个多模态基准上优于现有方法并达到 SOTA。
Motivation: VLM 参数量大导致计算开销高，限制其在资源受限设备上的部署；而将 LLM 剪枝直接应用于 VLM 会因冗余视觉 token 干扰重要性估计，造成明显性能下降。
Method: 提出自适应视觉 token 选择策略，利用平均文本到视觉注意力得分评估视觉 token 重要性，并在剪枝时按阈值移除冗余 token；同时提出敏感性感知动态剪枝机制，通过计算剪枝前后模块输出的线性重构误差来确定每个模块的合适剪枝率，以保持整体性能稳定。
Result: 摘要报告 SlimVLM 在多个多模态基准上优于现有剪枝方法，取得了 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够在压缩 VLM 的同时保持任务性能，但未给出具体数值或讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pin Once, Swap Light: Subspace-Aligned Centroid-Residual Training for Efficient Ultra-LoRA Serving
papers.abstract_en: Modern multi-tenant Low-Rank Adapters (LoRAs) serving systems concurrently host tens to hundreds of LoRA adapters. Though powerful, this introduces a critical system dilemma between serving efficiency and task performance: higher-rank adapters generally achieve better downstream task performance, but their GPU VRAM footprint and Host-to-Device PCIe swapping overhead severely constrain scalability. Conversely, ultra-low-rank adapters ($r \le 2$) minimize both VRAM footprint and PCIe transfer overhead, but suffer from downstream task performance degradation. To solve this problem, we propose Subspace-Aligned LoRA Training (SALT), a serving efficiency-aware hierarchical fine-tuning framework. Our solution operates in three phases. First, a provider jointly trains high-capacity domain centroids on public data within the domain using a novel alignment regularizer that coheres in-domain task subspaces into a unified basis. Next, users fine-tune ultra-low-rank task residual adapters on private data atop those frozen centroids. Finally, during inference, the provider pins the centroid in GPU VRAM and dynamically swaps in each user's task residual on demand. Across LLMs of varying scales, SALT recovers high-rank accuracy using $r \le 2$ residuals, achieving up to 18.5% absolute accuracy gains over state-of-the-art compression baselines and reducing per-adapter memory by up to 16x. When integrated into vLLM, SALT improves serving throughput by up to 51% under PCIe bandwidth pressure and 28% under GPU VRAM constraints for Llama-3.2-3B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Subspace-Aligned LoRA Training (SALT)，面向多租户 LoRA 服务系统，通过三段式层次化微调解决高 rank 适配器内存/PCIe 开销与超低 rank 适配器性能下降之间的权衡。SALT 先在域内公共数据上训练高容量域质心，再用 r<=2 的任务残差适配器在私有数据上微调，推理时将质心固定在 GPU VRAM 并动态换入残差。摘要报告其恢复高 rank 精度，相对压缩基线最高提升 18.5% 绝对准确率，每适配器内存降低最高 16 倍，集成到 vLLM 后在 Llama-3.2-3B 上吞吐提升最高 51%（PCIe 带宽压力下）和 28%（GPU VRAM 约束下）。
Motivation: 多租户 LoRA 服务系统同时承载数十到数百个适配器，面临服务效率与任务性能的困境：高 rank 适配器性能好但 VRAM 占用和 PCIe 换入换出开销严重限制可扩展性；超低 rank 适配器（r<=2）最小化 VRAM 和 PCIe 传输开销，但下游任务性能下降。
Method: 提出 SALT，一个服务效率感知的层次化微调框架，分三阶段：先用对齐正则化在域内公共数据上联合训练高容量域质心，将域内任务子空间凝聚到统一基；用户在冻结质心上用超低 rank 任务残差适配器在私有数据上微调；推理时质心固定于 GPU VRAM，按需动态换入各用户的任务残差。
Result: 跨不同规模 LLM，SALT 用 r<=2 残差恢复高 rank 精度，相对最先进的压缩基线取得最高 18.5% 绝对准确率提升，单适配器内存降低最高 16 倍。集成到 vLLM 后，在 Llama-3.2-3B 上，PCIe 带宽压力下吞吐最高提升 51%，GPU VRAM 约束下提升 28%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过域质心与超低 rank 任务残差的子空间对齐，可以在保持服务效率的同时恢复高 rank 准确率；其评估范围限于摘要所述的 LLM 规模及 vLLM 集成场景。

papers.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) exhibit fundamentally different behaviors in enhancing multi-task reasoning for large language models (LLMs). Our preliminary experiments revealed a phenomenon: SFT suffers from severe task conflicts under multi-stage training, whereas RL enables stable coexistence across diverse tasks. Empirically, we trace this to the parameter level, observing that RL induces sparse and approximately orthogonal updates across tasks. We provide a theoretical explanation for this mechanism by analyzing multi-task gradient interference. Our results reveal a distinction: interference in SFT is norm-limited, scaling with the absolute gradient magnitude, whereas interference in RL is variance-limited, bounded by the gradient variance induced by advantage normalization and on-policy optimization. This small variance bound yields near-orthogonal optimization directions across tasks. Leveraging this insight, we propose Parallel-RL, a paradigm that decouples multi-task training, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 SFT 与 RL 在多任务微调中的不同行为，发现 SFT 在多阶段训练中遭受严重的任务冲突，而 RL 能让多样任务稳定共存。作者从参数层面观察到 RL 的更新是稀疏且近似正交的，并通过多任务梯度干扰分析给出理论解释：SFT 的干扰受梯度绝对幅值限制，RL 的干扰则受优势归一化和在策略优化引入的梯度方差限制。基于该洞察，作者提出解耦多任务训练的 Parallel-RL 范式，以提升效率与灵活性。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型多任务训练中，SFT 与 RL 对任务冲突的表现差异缺乏系统理解，SFT 在多阶段训练下存在严重的任务冲突问题。
Method: 通过梯度干扰分析比较 SFT 与 RL 的更新行为，提出 RL 更新近似正交的理论机制，并据此设计 Parallel-RL 范式来解耦多任务训练。
Result: 摘要报告 RL 的更新是稀疏且近似正交的；SFT 的干扰是范数受限的，RL 的干扰是方差受限的，后者的小方差界带来跨任务的近正交优化方向。
Conclusion: 作者提出 Parallel-RL 以利用 RL 的跨任务共存特性，显著提升多任务训练的效率与灵活性。

papers.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools. However, we find that simply increasing the number of multimodal environments does not always benefit. We further analyze the limitations in current multimodal environment distributions through a series of experiments. Based on these findings, we study how to build more effective training environment distributions from two dimensions: **diversity** and **difficulty structure**. For diversity, we propose **Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)** to obtain diverse environment sets. For difficulty structure, we propose **Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC)**, which organizes curriculum learning through two difficulty levels: harness weakening and state-scale progression. Experiments show that AES and HDC effectively improve multimodal agent training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态智能体训练中环境分布的设计问题，发现简单扩大多模态环境池数量并不总是带来收益。作者通过实验分析了当前环境分布的局限，并从多样性（diversity）与难度结构（difficulty structure）两个维度提出改进方法：Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES) 用于获取多样化环境集，Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC) 通过 harness weakening 和 state-scale progression 两个难度层级组织课程学习。实验表明这两项措施能有效提升多模态智能体训练效果。
Motivation: 现有工作依赖大规模多模态环境池训练智能体，但作者发现单纯增加环境数量并不总是有益，说明需要更细致地设计环境分布。
Method: 提出两个互补组件：AES 从能力感知角度筛选环境以提升多样性；HDC 引入两个难度层级（harness weakening 与 state-scale progression）构造课程学习，从而形成更有效的训练环境分布。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明 AES 和 HDC 能有效改善多模态智能体训练。
Conclusion: 作者强调在设计多模态智能体训练环境时，不仅要关注环境规模，还应重视多样性和难度结构的合理组织。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adversarial Fast-Moving Real-World Domains as Test Beds for Benchmarking AI Scientist Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking the ability of AI scientists to generate novel ideas is notoriously difficult. Existing benchmarks in this field have made progress in evaluating scientific reasoning and research replication, but often rely on synthetic tasks or retrospective targets, which may be confounded by prior exposure. We hypothesize that complex, adversarial, fast-moving real-world domains where expert practitioners independently generate observable outputs can provide a practical solution to fill this gap and evaluate the capabilities needed for AI scientists, including reasoning, novelty, and hypothesis formulation. We instantiate this framework in two structurally different domains, Formula 1 (F1), where models ideate around car design concepts for the 2026 season, and real pre-season innovations provide a ground truth, and Magic: The Gathering (MTG), where models propose decks from a recently updated card pool and are evaluated against 19 Pro Tour (PT) decklists. Across both domains, models produce plausible outputs, but few align with real-world expert solutions. In F1, the best model, GPT-5.2 matched 10 of 40 real innovations with 166 ideas proposed across runs. In MTG, the best deck from Gemini 3 Flash recovered 5 of 7 new-set cards from the third-place PT deck, and across all 108 decks, the cards models selected most often were also the cards most widely adopted by PT decks (Spearman $ρ= 0.74$, $p = 0.0003$). These results suggest that a key capability gap for AI scientists is not idea generation, but filtering, prioritization, and coherent novelty.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI for Science workshop at ICML 2026. 14 pages, 11 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用复杂、对抗性、快速变化的真实世界领域作为 AI 科学家能力评测的基准框架，并在 F1 赛车与万智牌 (Magic: The Gathering) 两个结构不同的领域实例化。结果显示模型能产生看似合理的输出，但很少与真实专家方案对齐；作者据此认为 AI 科学家的关键能力缺口不在于想法生成，而在于筛选、优先级排序与连贯的新颖性。
Motivation: 衡量 AI 科学家提出新颖想法的能力十分困难，现有基准多依赖合成任务或回顾性目标，容易受先验暴露干扰。作者假设，专家实践者能独立产生可观察输出的复杂、对抗性、快速演变的真实世界领域，可以填补这一评估缺口。
Method: 在两个领域实例化该框架：F1 中让模型围绕 2026 赛季赛车设计概念进行构思，以真实季前创新为金标准；MTG 中让模型从近期更新的卡池提出套牌，并与 19 份 Pro Tour (PT) 套牌列表对比评估。
Result: 在 F1 中，最佳模型 GPT-5.2 在多次运行提出的 166 个想法中匹配了 40 项真实创新中的 10 项；在 MTG 中，Gemini 3 Flash 的最佳套牌从季军 PT 套牌中恢复出 7 张新系列卡中的 5 张，且全部 108 副套牌中模型最常选用的卡牌与 PT 套牌最广泛采用的卡牌显著相关 (Spearman ρ=0.74, p=0.0003)。

papers.title: Divide-and-Conquer: Towards Generalizable Amortized Bayesian Inference for the Drift Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: The drift diffusion model (DDM) is a cornerstone of cognitive decision-making research. Although numerous estimation methods exist, researchers continue to seek inference approaches that are both fast and flexible across diverse study designs. Amortized Bayesian inference (ABI) can provide nearly instantaneous inference for complex stochastic models like the DDM, but neural networks trained for one study design cannot generalize to others. In this paper, we propose a divide-and-conquer framework that address this limitation. The core idea is that the DDM's independence assumption allows the full dataset to be decomposed into pairwise shards, each sharing a common structure that a single neural network can learn. Inference is performed on each shard separately and the resulting posteriors are combined via consensus MCMC to approximate the full posterior. Using simulated datasets, we evaluate the accuracy and uncertainty of this method. Our results show that the proposed divide-and-conquer approach achieves accuracy and uncertainty comparable to MCMC while reducing computational cost by several orders of magnitude. This work not only advances DDM estimation but also demonstrates a general strategy for improving the scalability and generalizability of ABI methods across diverse applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对漂移扩散模型（DDM）的摊销贝叶斯推断（amortized Bayesian inference, ABI）跨研究设计泛化能力差的问题，提出一种分治（divide-and-conquer）框架。该方法利用 DDM 的独立性假设，将完整数据集分解为成对分片（pairwise shards），每个分片由单一神经网络学习公共结构，再通过 consensus MCMC 合并各分片的后验以逼近完整后验。在模拟数据上，该方法在准确性和不确定性上与 MCMC 相当，同时计算成本降低数个数量级。
Motivation: DDM 是认知决策研究的基石，研究者需要既快又灵活、能适应多种研究设计的估计方法。ABI 能对复杂随机模型进行近乎实时的推断，但针对一种研究设计训练的神经网络无法推广到其他设计。
Method: 提出分治框架：基于 DDM 的独立性假设，将完整数据集分解为共享公共结构的成对分片，用单个神经网络在每个分片上分别进行推断，最后通过 consensus MCMC 合并各分片后验来近似完整后验。
Result: 在模拟数据集上，该方法达到了与 MCMC 可比的准确性和不确定性，同时将计算成本降低数个数量级。
Conclusion: 这项工作不仅推进了 DDM 估计方法，还展示了一种提升 ABI 方法可扩展性和泛化能力的通用策略，适用于多样化应用。

papers.title: Enhancing Tabular Learners with Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: While modern tabular learners excel at capturing statistical patterns, they frequently operate in a semantic vacuum, treating textual features as discrete symbols, ignoring the rich semantics inherent in feature names or cell entries. We propose CASE (Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings), a novel framework that bridges the gap between the semantic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the statistical capabilities of tabular learners. Unlike existing methods that embed rows in isolation, CASE utilizes a contextualization strategy: we pre-fill the KV cache of a custom-trained Gemma 3-based Tabular Language Model with a representative sample of rows to establish a persistent anchor of the dataset's semantics. This ensures that generated row embeddings are dynamically contextualized, resolving semantic ambiguities and anchoring representations in domain-specific context. Our experiments across several benchmarks (CARTE, TextTab, and TabArena) demonstrate that CASE substantially improves the performance of tabular learners on semantically rich datasets, particularly in low-data regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CASE（Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings）框架，旨在把大语言模型（LLM）的语义理解能力与表格学习器（tabular learners）的统计建模能力结合。与逐行独立嵌入的既有方法不同，CASE 先在一个基于 Gemma 3 自定义训练的表格语言模型（Tabular Language Model）的 KV 缓存中预填代表性样本行，使生成的表格行嵌入具有数据集语义的动态上下文化。实验在 CARTE、TextTab 和 TabArena 等基准上表明，该方法在语义丰富的表格数据集上显著提升性能，尤其在低数据场景下。
Motivation: 现代表格学习器擅长捕捉统计模式，但往往把特征名或单元格文本当作离散符号处理，忽略其中蕴含的丰富语义，导致模型在语义真空（semantic vacuum）中工作。
Method: 提出 CASE 框架，通过将一批代表性样本行预填入自定义训练的 Gemma 3 表格语言模型的 KV 缓存，建立数据集的持久语义锚点；生成的表格行嵌入因此被动态上下文化，从而消解语义歧义并将表示锚定到领域特定上下文中。
Result: 在 CARTE、TextTab 和 TabArena 等多个基准上的实验显示，CASE 能大幅提升表格学习器在语义丰富数据集上的性能，尤其是在低数据（low-data）场景下。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CASE 弥合了 LLM 语义理解与表格学习器统计能力之间的鸿沟，并指出其优势在语义丰富和低数据条件下最为明显。

papers.title: Robust General Utility for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with general utility extends classic RL by optimizing an arbitrary utility functional of the policy-induced occupancy measure, thereby enabling a broader range of applications. However, previous work on general utility RL typically assumes the evaluation utility is fixed and correctly specified. In practice, the utility used at deployment can deviate from the training one, creating a robustness gap that prior work does not address. Motivated by this, we propose robust general-utility RL, a minimax learning framework that trains policies against utility misspecification within a prescribed uncertainty set. Our framework strictly generalizes standard general-utility RL while also providing a unified view of many existing RL frameworks, including reward-robust RL and constrained RL, through appropriate choices of the utility uncertainty set. We further develop provably convergent stochastic algorithms for two regimes. For concave utilities, we develop a projected stochastic gradient descent-ascent method and establish stationarity guarantees. For the more challenging nonconcave regime, we propose a stochastic prox-extragradient algorithm that mitigates ill-posed behavior induced by nonconcavity, with convergence guarantees to approximate first-order stationarity. Experiments on LLM safety alignment and exploration maximization tasks further corroborate the convergence behavior consistent with our theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出鲁棒通用效用强化学习 (robust general-utility RL)，将经典 general-utility RL 扩展到训练效用与部署效用存在偏差的场景。作者构建了一个 minimax 学习框架，在预设的不确定集内对抗效用误设定，并统一了 reward-robust RL 与 constrained RL 等现有框架。针对凹效用与非凹效用分别提出可证明收敛的随机算法，并在 LLM 安全对齐与探索最大化任务上验证了与理论一致的收敛行为。
Motivation: 此前 general-utility RL 的工作通常假设评估效用固定且被正确设定，而实际部署时的效用可能与训练时存在偏差，造成未解决的鲁棒性缺口。
Method: 提出鲁棒 general-utility RL 的 minimax 框架，通过选择效用不确定集统一涵盖标准 general-utility RL、reward-robust RL 和 constrained RL；对凹效用设计投影随机梯度下降-上升方法，对非凹效用提出随机 prox-extragradient 算法缓解非凹性导致的病态行为。
Result: 摘要给出凹情形下关于平稳性的保证，以及非凹情形下收敛到近似一阶平稳点的保证；实验在 LLM 安全对齐和探索最大化任务上验证了收敛行为与理论一致。
Conclusion: 该框架填补了 general-utility RL 对效用误设定的鲁棒性空白，为多种现有 RL 框架提供统一视角，但摘要未讨论极端不确定集或实际规模部署中的具体限制。

papers.title: Compass: Degradation-Simulated Reciprocal Learning with Lightweight Needle RWKV for Multimodal Crack Segmentation under Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: In multimodal crack segmentation for industrial facilities, the key challenge is preventing missing modalities from degrading pixel-level performance while maintaining low computational cost. Existing methods struggle to address semantic degradation caused by missing modalities. We propose Compass, a lightweight network for robust crack segmentation under arbitrary missing modalities. Compass comprises Degradation Simulation Distillation (DSD), Needle Block, and Evidential Topology-Preserving Fusion (ETPF). DSD constructs a degradation simulation stream that mimics more severe missing conditions and performs reciprocal distillation with the original stream, decoupling complete perception from degradation adaptation. Within DSD, Feature-Aware Prototype Transmitter (FAPT) performs modality agnostic prototype-guided feature completion to maintain semantic integrity under incomplete modality conditions. As a lightweight backbone, Needle injects crack-direction cues into WKV modulation and combines connectivity-aware gating with anisotropic context probing for structure-aware modeling. ETPF fuses multimodal features via Dempster-Shafer evidential combination with uncertainty-gated decoding, preserving crack topology while suppressing unreliable features. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance under diverse missing modality scenarios. Even with 90\% depth modality missing on CrackDepth, Compass achieves F1 of 0.8216 and mIoU of 0.8434 with only 2.58M parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/Karl1109/Compass.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by ACM MM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Compass，一个仅 2.58M 参数的轻量网络，用于任意缺失模态下的多模态裂缝分割。它由退化模拟蒸馏 (DSD)、Needle Block 和证据拓扑保持融合 (ETPF) 三部分组成，在三个数据集上达到 SOTA 性能；例如在 CrackDepth 上缺失 90% 深度模态时，F1 为 0.8216，mIoU 为 0.8434。
Motivation: 工业设施的多模态裂缝分割中，缺失模态会导致像素级性能下降，同时需要保持低计算成本；现有方法难以处理缺失模态引起的语义退化。
Method: 提出 Compass：DSD 构造模拟更严重缺失条件的退化模拟流，并与原始流进行互蒸馏，从而解耦完整感知与退化适应；其中的 FAPT 通过模态无关的原型引导特征补全维护语义完整性。Needle 作为轻量骨干，将裂缝方向线索注入 WKV 调制，并结合连通性感知门控与各向异性上下文探测进行结构感知建模。ETPF 通过 Dempster-Shafer 证据组合与不确定性门控解码融合多模态特征，在抑制不可靠特征的同时保持裂缝拓扑。
Result: 在三个数据集上的多种缺失模态场景下取得 SOTA 结果；在 CrackDepth 上深度模态缺失 90% 时，F1 达 0.8216、mIoU 达 0.8434，参数量仅 2.58M。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，该工作能够在低计算成本下应对任意模态缺失场景，并通过拓扑保持融合提升裂缝分割的鲁棒性；代码已开源。

papers.title: Test-Time Augmentation for Tabular-to-Image Classifiers under Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Tabular-to-image methods that convert tabular data into visual representations have emerged as a novel paradigm for leveraging the high performance of deep learning models. Despite their advantages, the robustness of these methods under distribution shifts remains under explored. Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) is an effective approach in image classification to improve model generalization and robustness, where predictions over multiple transformed views of each input are aggregated. This work evaluates the impact of TTA techniques on predictive performance under Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) for representations generated by tabular-to-image methods. Six tabular-to-image encoding methods were considered: TINTO, IGTD, DeepInsight, BIE, DistanceMatrix, Fotomics. Twenty-five TTA techniques were used, organized into six types: Geometric, Photometric, Structural, Frequency/Encoding, Mixup, and Composite. We employed two datasets from the TableShift benchmark (HELOC and Voting) that provide in-distribution and OOD test subsets designed to evaluate the effect of distribution shifts on tabular data. The results indicate that TTA improves OOD performance, with composite and photometric strategies providing the best trade-off between robustness and variance. In contrast, frequency-domain transformations that alter the encoder's feature-to-intensity mapping consistently degrade performance. These findings highlight TTA as a promising approach for improving the robustness and generalization of classifiers trained on image representations derived from tabular data, particularly under distribution shifts.

Motivation: 表格转图像方法利用深度学习处理表格数据已成为新范式，但其在分布偏移 (distribution shift) 下的鲁棒性仍未被充分研究；同时 TTA 在图像分类中已被证明能提升泛化与鲁棒性，二者的结合尚缺乏系统评估。

Conclusion: 作者认为 TTA 是提升基于表格数据图像表示的分类器在分布偏移下鲁棒性与泛化能力的有前景手段。

papers.title: Soft Guidance Starts to Outperform CoT Prompting as LLMs Improve
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains the standard baseline for evaluating models' reasoning abilities. Originally, this technique was introduced to elicit step-by-step reasoning from large language models (LLMs), which would otherwise tend to directly output the final answer. However, many modern LLMs produce CoT-style responses \textit{natively} when presented with reasoning tasks, which made us revisit the effectiveness of standard CoT prompting. We evaluate several modern mid-sized language models on a math problem-solving task and find that models specialized for reasoning achieve better performance in a simple zero-shot setting than when using few-shot CoT examples - significantly surpassing officially reported results at no additional cost (e.g., from $\sim$77\% to $\sim$84\% for Mathstral on GSM8K). For the tested general-purpose model, a zero-shot CoT prompt is also sufficient to outperform a few-shot CoT baseline. We attribute this to a `guidance-distraction' tradeoff: standard CoT prompting also demands style adaptation, formatting compliance, and potentially undesired contextualization, which can distract models from the core reasoning task. Our findings suggest that using standard CoT prompting increasingly acts as a source of distraction as models grow stronger.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了标准链式思考（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示在 LLM 推理评估中的作用。作者在数学问题求解任务上评估了几个中等规模的现代模型，发现专用推理模型在简单的零样本设置下比使用少样本 CoT 示例表现更好，零样本 CoT 对通用模型也足够。他们将这一现象归因于‘引导-干扰’权衡：标准 CoT 提示还要求风格适应、格式遵从和潜在的不必要上下文化，这会分散模型对核心推理任务的注意力。
Motivation: CoT 提示仍是评估模型推理能力的标准基线，但许多现代 LLM 在遇到推理任务时已经原生地产生 CoT 风格响应，因此需要重新检验标准 CoT 提示是否仍然有效。
Method: 在数学问题求解任务上评估多个中等规模的 LLM，比较零样本、零样本 CoT 和少样本 CoT 等设置，并分析标准 CoT 提示带来的额外格式与上下文要求对模型性能的影响。
Result: 专用推理模型在零样本设置下优于少样本 CoT，例如 Mathstral 在 GSM8K 上的准确率从约 77% 提升到约 84%，且无需额外成本；对测试的通用模型，零样本 CoT 也足以超越少样本 CoT 基线。
Conclusion: 随着模型能力增强，标准 CoT 提示越来越多地成为干扰源；作者建议在评估现代模型时重新考虑标准 CoT 提示的必要性。

papers.title: S$^3$-Diff: Structural Semantic Synergy Diffusion Model for High Fidelity Super Resolution of Pathological Images
papers.abstract_en: Digital pathology relies on high-resolution whole slide images for accurate diagnosis, yet limitations in imaging devices, storage, and transmission often make lower-resolution pathology images more common in clinical workflows. Current super-resolution techniques often tend to smooth diagnostically relevant morphology, leading to over-smoothed textures and semantic drift that compromise downstream clinical interpretation. To this end, we develop the Structural Semantic Synergy Diffusion Model (S3-Diff), a diffusion framework for high-fidelity super-resolution of pathological images. The core of S3-Diff is Specimen-aware Structural Anchoring (SSA), which combines prognosis-aware tissue support extracted by a fixed SAM with LR-HR gradient discrepancies to generate a specimen-specific structural anchor to preserve pathological morphology. Concurrently, we introduce Structure-guided Semantic Fidelity Tuning (SSFT) to adapt DINOv3 representations using SSA-derived structural supervision. SSFT combines the adapted semantic energy with LR-derived edge and grayscale cues. The resulting control guides denoising to suppress stochastic artifacts and maintain structural consistency. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that S3-Diff consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both reconstruction quality and downstream survival analysis performance. The source code will be made public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 S3-Diff，一个面向病理图像超分辨率的扩散模型，核心是 Specimen-aware Structural Anchoring (SSA) 与 Structure-guided Semantic Fidelity Tuning (SSFT)。SSA 结合固定 SAM 提取的预后感知组织支持与 LR-HR 梯度差异生成样本特定结构锚点，SSFT 则用该结构监督适配 DINOv3 表征并融合边缘和灰度线索引导去噪。实验表明其在重建质量和下游生存分析性能上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 临床工作流中因设备、存储和传输限制常使用低分辨率病理图像，而现有超分辨率方法容易平滑具有诊断价值的形态，造成纹理过度平滑和语义漂移，影响下游临床判读。
Method: 提出 S3-Diff 扩散框架：SSA 通过固定 SAM 提取的预后感知组织支持结合 LR-HR 梯度差异生成样本特定结构锚点以保持病理形态；SSFT 利用 SSA 的结构监督适配 DINOv3 语义表征，并与 LR 边缘和灰度线索共同控制去噪过程，抑制随机伪影并维持结构一致性。
Result: 大量实验显示 S3-Diff 在重建质量和下游生存分析性能上一致优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构锚定与语义保真微调的协同能提升病理图像超分辨率保真度，并提到源代码将公开。

papers.title: IRIS: Visual-Semantic Binding for Forgery-Resistant Watermarking of Diffusion Images
papers.abstract_en: Most in-generation diffusion watermarks embed patterns independent of the image that carries them, and attackers transplant the marks onto images the generator did not produce, resulting in forgery. Binding the mark to visual semantics prevents such transplantation, yet existing bindings anchor to a proxy image rather than the image they mark. Realizing visual-semantic binding inside generation faces two challenges. The mark derives from the image itself yet enters the sampling trajectory before that image exists, and may itself shift the semantics it binds. The binding also meets opposite sensitivity demands, breaking under semantic change while holding through common processing. We present IRIS, a training-free watermarking scheme that embeds an Intrinsic Ring Identifier from Semantics. IRIS reads a content code from the non-watermarked generated image, derives a one-time ring from the code and a secret key, returns to the final low-noise steps of the same trajectory and blends the ring in, after the semantics it binds are settled. To meet the opposite sensitivity demands, the code is read through a canonicalization shared between embedding and detection, holding through common distortions and mild regeneration while flipping under semantic change. Detection recomputes the ring from the query image and the key alone, and the mark therefore fails on a foreign or spliced image, with acceptance tracking semantic displacement. On three prompt datasets IRIS detects reliably and stays close to its same-seed non-watermarked counterpart, a fidelity prior in-generation marks do not reach. While forgeries transfer fixed-pattern marks and regeneration strips post-hoc marks, IRIS alone among the compared marks withstands both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的图像水印方案 IRIS，通过 Intrinsic Ring Identifier from Semantics 将水印环与生成图像的视觉语义绑定。水印环由非水印生成图像的内容码和密钥一次性派生，并在同一采样轨迹的最终低噪声步骤融合，从而避免被移植到其他图像。检测时仅由查询图像和密钥重算环，可抵抗常见失真和轻度再生，语义变化时失效。
Motivation: 现有扩散生成水印大多嵌入与图像内容无关的固定图案，攻击者可以把图案移植到生成器未生成的图像上造成伪造；将水印绑定到视觉语义可阻止移植，但已有绑定方法锚定到代理图像而非被标记图像本身。
Method: IRIS 先从无水印的生成图像读取内容码，用内容码与密钥派生一次性环，再回到同一扩散轨迹的低噪声步骤把环混合进去，此时绑定所依赖的语义已经稳定；嵌入与检测共享一种 canonicalization 来读取内容码，使其在常见失真切变和轻度再生下保持不变，在语义变化时翻转。
Result: 在三个提示数据集上，IRIS 检测可靠，且与同种子（same-seed）非水印版本保持接近的保真度，达到生成内水印未达到的保真度；伪造会转移固定图案水印、再生会剥离事后水印，而 IRIS 是所对比水印中唯一能同时抵抗这两种攻击的方案。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这种训练无关的语义绑定水印方案可同时抵御伪造移植与再生攻击，其嵌入必须发生在语义确定后的低噪声步骤，适合扩散图像生成场景。

papers.title: Behaviorally Adaptive Visual Diversion for Inclusive and Resilient Digital Assessment Delivery
papers.abstract_en: Institutions increasingly rely on browser lockdown, webcam monitoring, and behavioral analytics to secure high-stakes digital assessments, yet these mechanisms are commonly designed and evaluated independently and often overlook learner accessibility. This paper introduces Behaviorally-Adaptive Visual Diversion (BAVD), a theoretical framework in which a synthetic, non-semantic visual field is composited with assessment content and adaptively modulated according to observed candidate behavior. The underlying assessment content is never altered; only its visual presentation is modified to reduce the usefulness of unauthorized screen capture or screen sharing while remaining minimally intrusive for legitimate candidates. The framework further incorporates an accessibility-aware attenuation mechanism that reduces or suppresses diversion intensity for candidates with approved visual-processing accommodations. We formulate the model using a coupled dynamical-systems representation comprising a Diversion Field Generator, Rendering Tensor, Behavior Tensor, Composite Integrity Functional, and Multi-dimensional Entropy Model, and establish theoretical properties for content fidelity, rendering stability, entropy boundedness, integrity tracking, and closed-loop adaptation stability. The framework explicitly states its threat model, identifies deployment assumptions and limitations, and discusses the trade-off between accessibility and capture resistance. This work provides a mathematically grounded foundation for behaviorally adaptive and accessibility-aware assessment delivery and offers a basis for future empirical validation in trusted digital assessment platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出行为自适应视觉转移 (Behaviorally-Adaptive Visual Diversion, BAVD) 理论框架，将合成的非语义视觉场与考试内容复合，并根据考生行为动态调节其强度，以降低截屏或共享屏幕的利用价值，同时保持内容不变并为获批视觉处理适配的考生提供降低干扰的机制。模型采用耦合动力系统表示，包含 Diversion Field Generator、Rendering Tensor、Behavior Tensor、Composite Integrity Functional 和多维熵模型，并证明了内容保真度、渲染稳定性、熵有界性、完整性追踪和闭环自适应稳定性等理论性质。
Motivation: 机构依赖浏览器锁定、摄像头监控和行为分析来保障高风险数字考试，但这些机制通常被独立设计和评估，且常忽视学习者可访问性 (accessibility) 需求。
Method: 提出一个理论框架，把非语义视觉场叠加到评估内容上并按观察到的考生行为自适应调制，仅在视觉呈现层面改变内容；同时引入可访问性感知的衰减机制，对有批准的视觉处理适配的考生降低或抑制干扰强度。形式化使用耦合动力系统模型，并明确威胁模型、部署假设与限制。
Result: 摘要报告该框架建立了内容保真度、渲染稳定性、熵有界性、完整性追踪和闭环自适应稳定性的理论性质，未给出实证数据。
Conclusion: 本工作为行为自适应且可访问性感知的评估交付提供了数学基础，并作为未来在可信数字评估平台中进行实证验证的起点；同时讨论了可访问性与防截屏能力之间的权衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Training Documents Reranker with Search Rubrics for Deep Research Agent
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval systems help deep research agents generate high-quality answers by providing relevant documents. However, existing retrievers typically select documents through relevance matching, while individually well-matched top-$k$ documents may not form a \textit{set} that satisfies the complex information needs of an agent query (\eg, diverse, concise and authoritative documents). In this paper, we propose search-oriented rubrics that \textit{explicitly} define the requirements that high-quality document sets should satisfy for each agent query. Our search rubrics are organized into a hierarchical structure and synthesized using a powerful LLM. Based on these search rubrics, we further train a document reranker \textbf{RubricRanker} to select a high-quality subset from retrieved documents. We design a two-stage training framework that consists of rubrics-guided supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricRanker outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.6 points on four deep research benchmarks and generalizes well to five RAG benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向深度研究智能体 (deep research agent) 的检索环节，指出现有重排序器按相关性挑选的 top-k 文档未必能构成满足复杂信息需求的文档集，并提出搜索导向的评估准则 (search-oriented rubrics)。作者用 LLM 合成层级化 rubrics，训练重排序器 RubricRanker，通过 rubrics 指导的监督微调与基于 rubrics 的强化学习两阶段训练来选择高质量文档子集。摘要报告该方法在四个深度研究基准上超过最强基线 2.6 个点，并可泛化到五个 RAG 基准。
Motivation: 现有检索器通常单独按相关性匹配文档，但单篇匹配良好的 top-k 文档组成集合时不一定满足智能体查询的复杂信息需求（如多样、简洁、权威）。需要一个显式定义高质量文档集应满足何种条件的机制。
Method: 提出由强大 LLM 合成的、层级化组织的搜索导向 rubrics，显式规定每个 agent 查询下高质量文档集应满足的要求；基于 rubrics 训练文档重排序器 RubricRanker，采用包含 rubrics 引导的监督微调 (rubrics-guided SFT) 和基于 rubrics 的强化学习 (rubric-based RL) 的两阶段训练框架，从检索结果中选择高质量子集。
Result: 在四个深度研究基准上，RubricRanker 比最强基线提升 2.6 个点，并在五个 RAG 基准上展现出良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 显式地用搜索 rubrics 刻画文档集的整体质量并据此训练重排序器，能够改善深度研究智能体的文档选择效果。

papers.title: MinerU.Chem: A High-Precision System for Optical Chemical Structure and Reaction Recognition
papers.abstract_en: In organic chemistry papers and patents, molecular structures, reaction schemes, and experimental conditions are often presented as molecular structure depictions, reaction diagrams, and complex tables or figures. Such information is difficult for general-purpose document parsing systems to directly convert into machine-readable data. This limits data production for organic chemistry knowledge base construction and for AI for Chemistry tasks such as reaction prediction, retrosynthesis, condition recommendation, molecular property prediction, and drug molecule design. This report introduces MinerU.Chem, a document parsing system for organic chemistry literature integrated into the MinerU online platform. Built on top of MinerU's general document parsing pipeline, MinerU.Chem adds five chemistry-specific modules: chemistry relevance filtering, molecular structure detection, molecule identifier extraction, molecular structure recognition, and reaction scheme parsing. Together, these modules convert organic-chemistry-related image regions in documents into a Molecule Summary List and a Reaction Summary List. For molecular structure recognition, MinerU.Chem uses CARBON (Complex Atomic Representation and Bonding Object Notation) as its core representation. CARBON enables recognition results to preserve both the visual layout of the original image and complex chemical semantics, while supporting the export of standard downstream formats such as MolFile and SMILES. On the SMILES-evaluable subset of MolRecBench-Wild (N=2,392), MinerU.Chem's molecular structure recognition module achieves a SMILES exact-match accuracy of 93.02%, outperforming the best evaluated comparison system, GPT-5.6-Sol (74.87%), by 18.15 percentage points. The system has been integrated into the MinerU online platform and is available at https://mineru.net/OpenSourceTools/Extractor .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 MinerU.Chem，一个集成于 MinerU 在线平台的有机化学文献解析系统，在通用文档解析管线之上增加化学相关性过滤、分子结构检测、分子标识符提取、分子结构识别和反应方案解析五个专用模块，将文档中的化学图像区域转换为分子摘要列表与反应摘要列表。分子结构识别以 CARBON 为核心表示，保留原始图像的视觉布局和化学语义，并可导出 MolFile、SMILES 等下游格式。在 MolRecBench-Wild 的 SMILES 可评估子集（N=2,392）上，其分子结构识别模块的 SMILES 精确匹配准确率为 93.02%，比最优对比系统 GPT-5.6-Sol（74.87%）高 18.15 个百分点。
Motivation: 有机化学论文和专利中的分子结构、反应方案和实验条件常以图像形式呈现，通用文档解析系统难以直接转换为机器可读数据，限制了化学知识库构建以及反应预测、逆合成、条件推荐等 AI for Chemistry 任务的数据生产。
Method: 在 MinerU 通用文档解析管线之上新增五个化学专用模块：化学相关性过滤、分子结构检测、分子标识符提取、分子结构识别和反应方案解析，共同将文档中的化学相关图像区域转换为 Molecule Summary List 和 Reaction Summary List；分子结构识别采用 CARBON 作为核心表示，支持导出 MolFile 和 SMILES。
Result: 在 MolRecBench-Wild 的 SMILES 可评估子集上，分子结构识别模块达到 93.02% 的 SMILES 精确匹配准确率，超过最佳对比系统 GPT-5.6-Sol 18.15 个百分点。系统已集成到 MinerU 在线平台。
Conclusion: MinerU.Chem 展示了将有机化学文献中的图像信息高精度转化为机器可读化学数据的能力，并已作为在线工具开放使用。

papers.title: Dr. AGENTONOMICS: A Didactic Experiment of AGENTONOMICS
papers.abstract_en: AGENTONOMICS is a framework that treats AI agents as economic entities that can be designed, managed, and governed through an integrated management architecture. Dr. AGENTONOMICS is its first application: a lecture agent developed in the context of the TUM course on AI agents in business administration. Conceived during the winter semester 2025/26 and first introduced to students in the summer semester 2026, it serves as a didactic experiment in which the agent is both the object that students study and the medium through which they learn and apply the framework. The current prototype is a web-based, retrieval-grounded tutor that explains AGENTONOMICS concepts and supports student questions. This report argues that the same system can grow beyond tutoring into three additional cumulative roles: an avatar lecturer that delivers multimodal instruction, a design consultant that guides students through the AGENTONOMICS Design & Management Reference Framework (ADMRF), and a meta-agent that helps construct the agents students have specified. These roles are cumulative because they share the same interface, intelligence layer, tools, knowledge base, and ecosystem connection, while an orchestrator selects the role-specific algorithm required for each task. We present the architecture of the prototype, outline its development roadmap, and discuss its implications for a polycentric AI economy. This report is intended to invite further discussion on how agents can teach, apply, and eventually reproduce the frameworks by which they are designed.
papers.comment: Technical report, Technical University of Munich
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AGENTONOMICS 框架，该框架将 AI 代理视为经济实体，可通过集成管理架构进行设计、管理和治理；Dr. AGENTONOMICS 是其首个应用，即面向 TUM 商业管理课程开发的讲座代理。该代理既是学生研究的对象，也是学生学习和应用框架的媒介，当前原型为基于网页的检索接地 (retrieval-grounded) 辅导系统。报告还提出了三种累积扩展角色：虚拟讲师、设计顾问和元代理，并给出了架构、路线图及其对多中心 AI 经济的启示。
Motivation: AI 代理需要系统的设计、管理和治理框架；现有教学场景中缺少让学习者同时把代理当作对象和工具来理解这类框架的载体。
Method: 提出 AGENTONOMICS 框架及其首个教学应用 Dr. AGENTONOMICS，当前原型是基于网页的检索接地辅导代理；系统规划了四种共享同一接口、智能层、工具、知识库和生态连接的累积角色，并由编排器 (orchestrator) 为任务选择角色特定算法。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，仅描述原型架构、开发路线图以及代理在教学中承担的三种未来角色。
Conclusion: 作者认为同一系统可从辅导扩展到授课、设计咨询和代理构建等角色，并邀请学界进一步讨论代理如何教授、应用并最终复现设计它们的框架。

papers.title: Pivot-Centric Trajectory Prediction: Bridging Long Horizons via Dynamical Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting precise future motion of surrounding agents is essential for reliable autonomous vehicles. However, as the demand for longer prediction horizons increases, existing endpoint-completion or iterative-refine methods increasingly struggle with weak guidance and compounding errors. To tackle the long-horizon prediction challenge, we propose Pivot-Centric Trajectory Prediction (PCTP). By introducing ``pivots'' and focusing on predicting pivot points along extended trajectories, we divide the long-term prediction task into short-term sub-tasks at various scales. Specifically, PCTP decouples the long-term trajectory predicting process into two processes: pivot prediction and pivot-based trajectory refinement. The pivot prediction process aims to utilize global map context and agent-to-agent interactions to identify these ``pivot points'', while the pivot-based trajectory refinement process focuses on local map details and refines the short-term trajectory based on predicted ``pivot points''. Compared with existing methods, PCTP provides more intermediate guidance while reducing compounding errors. Moreover, PCTP is a flexible approach that can be integrated into most state-of-the-art trajectory prediction models. Experimental results show that PCTP improves the prediction accuracy of leading models on both Argoverse I and Argoverse II datasets with minimal impact on model size. Specifically, PCTP combined with QCNet outperforms all published ensemble-free methods on the Argoverse II leaderboard at submission.
papers.comment: Spatiotemporal Forecasting, Autonomous Driving, Trajectory Prediction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pivot-Centric Trajectory Prediction (PCTP)，针对长时域轨迹预测中端点补全或迭代细化方法因中间引导弱、误差累积而性能下降的问题，引入 pivot 关键点，将长时预测分解为不同尺度的短期子任务。PCTP 将预测过程解耦为 pivot 预测与基于 pivot 的轨迹细化：前者利用全局地图上下文和智能体间交互识别 pivot 点，后者聚焦局部地图细节并细化短期轨迹。实验表明 PCTP 在 Argoverse I 和 Argoverse II 上以很小的模型规模代价提升多个领先模型的精度，与 QCNet 结合时在 Argoverse II 排行榜上超过所有已发表的无集成方法。
Motivation: 随着预测时域变长，现有端点补全或迭代细化方法因弱中间引导和复合误差（compounding errors）而难以保持精度，长时域轨迹预测成为自动驾驶可靠性的关键瓶颈。
Method: 提出 PCTP，将长时轨迹预测解耦为 pivot 预测和基于 pivot 的轨迹细化两个过程；pivot 预测利用全局地图上下文与 agent-to-agent 交互识别轨迹关键点，细化过程基于这些 pivot 点结合局部地图细节细化短期轨迹；PCTP 可作为灵活组件集成到大多数现有轨迹预测模型。
Result: 在 Argoverse I 和 Argoverse II 数据集上，PCTP 以极小的模型规模影响提升多个领先轨迹预测模型的精度；PCTP 结合 QCNet 在 Argoverse II 排行榜上优于所有已发表的无集成方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PCTP 通过提供更多中间引导并降低复合误差来改善长时域预测，且集成成本低；摘要未报告具体数值或局限性。

papers.title: AI Forensics Across White-, Grey-, and Black-Box Access: A Process Model and Research Agenda for Post-Incident Investigation of AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are increasingly involved in decisions and actions that may later require investigation. When an AI related incident occurs, investigators need to reconstruct what the system did, why it behaved that way, and which part of the system or supply chain contributed to the outcome. Existing work on AI forensics remains fragmented, often focusing on a specific system type, artifact, or analysis technique. This paper argues that investigator access is a useful starting point for organizing the field. We distinguish white box, grey box, and black box access and show how each access level changes what can be collected, preserved, analyzed, and reported. Based on this distinction, we propose a process model matrix for AI forensics across four phases: collection, preservation, analysis, and reporting. We also introduce an order of volatility for AI systems, covering runtime state, context windows, logs, retrieval stores, model artifacts, and training lineage. From this matrix, we derive an access conditioned examination framework and identify open research problems, including black box preservation, model version attestation, uncertainty quantification for surrogate based analysis, and chain of custody for mutable AI artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以调查者访问权限（白盒、灰盒、黑盒）为组织原则的 AI 取证（AI forensics）过程模型。作者将取证划分为收集、保存、分析、报告四个阶段，并针对 AI 系统引入易失性顺序（order of volatility），涵盖运行时状态、上下文窗口、日志、检索存储、模型工件与训练谱系。基于该矩阵进一步提出访问条件化的检查框架，并列出若干开放研究问题。
Motivation: 现有 AI 取证研究较为碎片化，多聚焦于特定系统类型、工件或分析技术，缺少统一视角来组织该领域。论文认为调查者访问权限是组织 AI 取证工作的有用起点。
Method: 区分白盒、灰盒与黑盒三种访问级别，说明每种级别对可收集、保存、分析和报告内容的影响；构建覆盖收集、保存、分析、报告四阶段的过程模型矩阵，并引入 AI 系统的易失性顺序。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实证结果，主要贡献是过程模型矩阵、AI 系统易失性顺序以及访问条件化的检查框架，并识别出开放问题，包括黑盒保存、模型版本认证、基于代理分析的不确定性量化，以及可变 AI 工件的保管链。

papers.title: GVCCTurbo: Rate-Compute Quality Scheduling for Codebook Driven Generative Compression
papers.abstract_en: Codebook-driven generative compression uses a pretrained image or video generator as a zero-shot visual prior and transmits compact codebook indices to guide reconstruction at ultra-low bitrate. Current codecs tie each finite-rate correction to a fresh prior evaluation, so shortening the sampler also removes correction slots that carry target-dependent information. We propose GVCCTurbo, a BPP-driven scheduler that separates expensive prior refreshes from codebook corrections: after calibrating an atom-count operating point and skip-gap ratio once per protocol, it maps a target codebook-payload bitrate to a trajectory length and refresh period, making BPP a schedule input instead of a fixed consequence of sampler length. The same endpoint-prediction and finite-rate steering interface covers GVCC-style rectified-flow video and DDCM-style diffusion image compression, preserving zero-training deployment and compatibility with future distilled priors. Native 1080p curves position the complete zero-shot codec in the ultra-low-bitrate regime. In a controlled 720p Wan-GVCC study, the scheduler cuts prior evaluations from 20 to 9 for a $\sim\!44\%$ measured decoding-time reduction shared across the whole schedule family, at a small shared LPIPS cost on high-motion content; within that family, uniform refresh thinning (pure-skip) is a boundary point, and the BPP-aware interior point trades $2.9\%$ fewer codebook-payload bits for consistently higher PSNR at comparable LPIPS. These results support BPP-to-compute scheduling as a controllable extension of sampler-length tuning, without requiring the allocated point to dominate every boundary point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GVCCTurbo,一种面向码本驱动生成式压缩(codebook-driven generative compression)的 BPP 驱动调度器。它把昂贵的先验模型刷新(prior refresh)与码本校正分开,使目标码本负载位率(BPP)成为调度输入,而不是采样器长度的固定结果;该接口同时覆盖 GVCC 风格视频编码与 DDCM 风格扩散图像压缩。在受控的 720p Wan-GVCC 实验中,调度器将先验评估次数从 20 减到 9,解码时间减少约 44%,并以较小的 LPIPS 代价换取高运动内容上的收益。
Motivation: 现有码本驱动生成式压缩把每次有限速率校正与一次新的先验评估绑定,缩短采样器会同时减少携带目标相关信息的校正槽位,导致位率与计算量难以解耦。作者希望让 BPP 成为可调度的输入,而不是采样长度的固定后果,从而在不重新训练的前提下节省计算。
Method: 提出 GVCCTurbo:一个 BPP 驱动的调度器,先为每种协议校准原子数工作点(atom-count operating point)和跳跃间隔比(skip-gap ratio),再把目标码本负载位率映射到轨迹长度和刷新周期,从而分离昂贵的先验刷新与码本校正。统一的端点和有限速率导向接口同时覆盖 rectified-flow 视频编码(GVCC 风格)与扩散图像压缩(DDCM 风格),并保持零训练部署。
Result: 原生 1080p 曲线表明该零样本编解码器工作在超低位率区间。在受控 720p Wan-GVCC 研究中,调度器将先验评估次数从 20 降到 9,解码时间减少约 44%;在该调度族内,均匀刷新稀疏化(纯跳跃)是边界点,而 BPP 感知的内部点少用 2.9% 的码本负载位,同时在相近 LPIPS 下持续获得更高的 PSNR。
Conclusion: 作者认为 BPP 到计算的调度是采样长度调优的可控扩展,不需要分配的位点支配每个边界点;该方法保持零训练部署,并与未来蒸馏先验兼容。

papers.title: Detecting Pose Estimation Failures via Keypoint Self-Consistency
papers.abstract_en: One common approach to pose estimation involves predicting object keypoints in an image, followed by using Perspective-n-Point algorithms to compute the object's rotation and translation relative to the camera. While rotations preserve object shapes, this property is often neglected in keypoint-based pose estimation methods, where keypoints are typically predicted independently from each other. As imprecise keypoint predictions negatively affects pose estimation accuracy, it also limits its reliability in downstream tasks. In this work, we explore whether such inaccurate pose estimates can be identified by simply examining spatial locations between 2D keypoints. We propose a set of hand-crafted geometric features that capture the self-consistency of keypoint predictions, including pairwise distances, reprojection consistency, as well as render and mask consistency. Despite its simplicity, a logistic regression classifier trained on these features reliably detects pose estimation failures, outperforming confidence-based approaches like conformal keypoint predictions that rely solely on keypoint uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于关键点的物体位姿估计（pose estimation）中的失败检测问题。作者提出一组手工设计的几何特征来刻画二维关键点预测的自一致性（self-consistency），包括成对距离、重投影一致性以及渲染与掩码一致性，并用逻辑回归分类器判断位姿估计是否失败。摘要报告该方法在检测失败方面优于仅依赖关键点不确定性的置信度方法，如 conformal keypoint predictions。
Motivation: 关键点式位姿估计通常独立地预测各关键点，忽略了旋转保持物体形状这一性质；不精确的关键点会降低位姿估计精度，并限制下游任务的可靠性。因此需要一种方法识别不准确的位姿估计结果。
Method: 提出一组手工设计的几何特征，捕捉关键点预测的自一致性，包括成对距离、重投影一致性（reprojection consistency）以及渲染和掩码一致性（render and mask consistency）；在这些特征上训练一个逻辑回归分类器来检测位姿估计失败。
Result: 基于这些简单特征训练的逻辑回归分类器能够可靠地检测位姿估计失败，且优于仅依赖关键点不确定性的置信度方法，如 conformal keypoint predictions。
Conclusion: 摘要强调尽管方法简单，但通过检查二维关键点之间的空间位置即可有效识别不准确的位姿估计，为下游任务提供可靠性保障。

papers.title: Reversing Arrows in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on text-to-knowledge graph generation and related tasks. Nevertheless, it is still unclear whether they accurately model the direction-dependent semantics of inverse relations, in which reversing the order of the arguments alters the meaning of a relation (e.g., \textit{mother} versus \textit{child}). To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of inverse relation directionality in LLMs, using a benchmark consisting of 5,457 instances spanning 27 distinct inverse relation labels. We evaluate five open-source LLMs under a multiple-choice prompting framework and further examine the influence of relation descriptions and entity representations by substituting the original entities with synthetic and masked entities. Our findings reveal systematic asymmetries in inverse relation classification across LLMs, indicate that relation descriptions do not consistently improve performance, and show that model performance can be sensitive to variations in entity representations.
papers.comment: The preprint is under review in a venue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了大语言模型（LLM）对逆关系（inverse relation）方向性语义的建模能力，构建了包含 5,457 个实例、覆盖 27 种逆关系标签的基准，并在多选题（multiple-choice）提示框架下评估了五个开源 LLM。研究发现不同 LLM 在逆关系分类上存在系统性不对称，关系描述并非总能提升性能，且模型表现对实体表示的变化敏感。
Motivation: LLM 在文本到知识图谱生成等任务上表现优异，但其是否准确建模逆关系中的方向依赖语义仍不明确——例如反转参数顺序会改变关系含义（如 mother 与 child）。这是首次针对该问题的大规模系统研究。
Method: 构建包含 5,457 个实例、27 种逆关系标签的基准，采用多选题提示框架评估五个开源 LLM；并通过将原始实体替换为合成实体和掩码实体，考察关系描述与实体表示对分类性能的影响。
Result: 摘要报告发现 LLM 在逆关系分类上存在系统性不对称，关系描述并不能一致地提升性能，模型表现可能对实体表示的变异敏感。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了关于 LLM 处理逆关系方向性的首个系统性证据，指出逆关系分类中的系统性不对称及其对实体表示的敏感性。

papers.title: How Many Labels Are Enough? ALDA: Active Learning Deployment Advisor for Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Active learning (AL) promises to reduce the cost of medical imaging projects by lowering the number of clinical labels required. However, practical deployment requires committing to a sampling strategy before the full annotation budget is spent, and choosing the wrong strategy can increase rather than decrease costs. We propose Active-Learning Deployment Advisor (ALDA), a deployment-oriented framework for AL method selection under clinical performance constraints. Given a short pilot phase, ALDA fits a parametric learning-curve model to each candidate strategy, estimates whether that strategy is expected to reach a required clinical performance target, and predicts the number of expert annotations needed to do so. In addition to absolute annotation cost, ALDA introduces a deployment window that quantifies the sensitivity of this cost estimate to uncertainty in the clinical threshold. The final recommendation follows a risk-aware rule: among strategies with near-optimal predicted cost, ALDA prefers the strategy with the narrowest deployment window, the most robust to threshold revisions. Experiments on four medical imaging classification domains show that ALDA predicts the deployment-optimal method from a pilot of 15-30% of the intended budget and reduces annotation costs by up to 82% compared with a poor strategy choice. Rather than introducing a new sampling heuristic, ALDA provides a practical decision layer that answers a deployment-critical question: how many labels are enough?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Active-Learning Deployment Advisor (ALDA)，一个面向部署的主动学习 (active learning) 方法选择框架，用于在临床性能约束下决定在医学图像分类任务中采用哪种采样策略。ALDA 在短 pilot 阶段拟合参数化学习曲线模型，预测各策略能否达到临床性能目标以及所需的专家标注数量，并引入部署窗口 (deployment window) 量化成本估计对临床阈值不确定性的敏感度。实验表明，ALDA 能从计划预算的 15-30% 的 pilot 数据预测部署最优方法，相比糟糕的策略选择最多降低 82% 的标注成本。
Motivation: 主动学习承诺通过减少临床标签数量降低医学影像项目成本，但实际部署要求在完整标注预算消耗前预先承诺采样策略；若策略选择错误，成本不降反升。缺少在临床性能约束下进行 AL 方法选择的部署导向框架。
Method: ALDA 对每个候选策略拟合参数化学习曲线模型，估计其达到所需临床性能目标的概率并预测所需专家标注数量；额外引入部署窗口来量化该成本估计对临床阈值不确定性的敏感度，最终采用风险感知规则：在预测成本接近最优的策略中，优先选择部署窗口最窄、对阈值修订最稳健的策略。
Result: 在四个医学图像分类领域上的实验显示，ALDA 使用计划预算 15-30% 的 pilot 阶段数据即可预测部署最优方法，相比选择较差的策略可将标注成本降低最多 82%。
Conclusion: ALDA 并非提出新的采样启发式，而是提供一个实用决策层，直接回答部署关键问题“需要多少标注才够”，强调在 AL 方法选择中考虑临床性能约束与阈值不确定性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Multi-Resolution Cells to Gigapixel Whole Slide Images Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their hierarchical variants have achieved strong performance in Computational Pathology (CPath). However, most are pre-trained on single-resolution Whole Slide Images (WSIs), limiting their generalization across arbitrary resolutions. Gigapixel WSIs inherently contain diagnostic patterns at multiple scales, including cellular morphologies, tissue architectures, and global context, mirroring how expert pathologists examine WSIs. We introduce Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT), a model that hierarchically aggregates multi-resolution information from cellular to tissue and WSI levels. MRPT employs a biologically meaningful Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) mechanism to capture scale-independent interactions and enforces multi-resolution semantic consistency by aligning embeddings across resolutions, yielding robust and generalizable WSI representations. Pre-trained in a multi-resolution self-supervised manner on 624M patches, 2.4M regions, and 36K WSIs, MRPT learns rich coarse-to-fine histopathology features. Extensive experiments on 34 diverse datasets show that MRPT surpasses recent foundation models and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in cancer subtype classification, tissue phenotyping, and Visual Question Answering (VQA) for WSI understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT)，一个面向计算病理学 (Computational Pathology) 的多分辨率基础模型。它从细胞级到组织级再到全切片图像 (WSI) 层次化聚合多尺度信息，采用 Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) 机制捕获跨分辨率交互，并通过多分辨率自监督预训练（624M patches、2.4M regions、36K WSIs）学习由粗到细的组织病理特征。在 34 个数据集上的实验表明，MRPT 在癌症亚型分类、组织表型分型和 WSI 视觉问答 (VQA) 上超过现有基础模型与多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs)。
Motivation: 现有 Vision Transformer (ViT) 及其层次变体大多在单一分辨率的 WSI 上预训练，限制了对任意分辨率的泛化能力；而千兆像素 WSI 的诊断模式天然存在于多尺度中，包括细胞形态、组织结构与全局上下文。
Method: 提出 MRPT 模型，通过层次化结构聚合从细胞到组织和 WSI 的多分辨率信息；引入生物意义明确的 CCRA 机制以捕获尺度无关的交互，并通过跨分辨率嵌入对齐强化多分辨率语义一致性，从而得到鲁棒且可泛化的 WSI 表示。模型以多分辨率自监督方式在大规模补丁、区域和 WSI 数据上预训练。
Result: 在 34 个多样化数据集上的广泛实验显示，MRPT 在癌症亚型分类、组织表型分型和 WSI 视觉问答任务上超越了近期的基础模型与多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs)。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多分辨率信息聚合与语义一致性约束能产生鲁棒且可泛化的 WSI 表示，为该方向提供了一种计算病理学通用基础模型的方案。
Relevance: 0
