papers.title: ChronoLens: Measuring Language Change Across Time, Languages, and Linguistic Levels
papers.abstract_en: Historical language change affects morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, yet computational studies typically examine these levels with incompatible representations and therefore cannot determine whether they evolve together across languages. We address this problem by asking how the magnitude and direction of change vary across linguistic levels, languages, and historical periods within a single analytical space. We introduce ChronoLens, a framework that combines frozen multilingual language models, feature-aligned crosscoders, and post-hoc linguistic interventions, and apply it to 44.98 million documents and approximately 17.2 billion tokens from five parliamentary traditions spanning 1803--2026. The resulting sparse representations agree substantially more strongly with linguistic statistics than dense embeddings or a pooled sparse autoencoder ($ρ=0.72$ versus $0.29$ and $0.28$), and reveal that morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics generally change by comparable amounts within a language, while languages differ markedly in when, how far, and in which direction they change. These findings show that historical language change is a structured, multidimensional process: similar magnitudes can conceal different trajectories, and meaningful cross-linguistic comparison requires measuring both distance and direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChronoLens 框架，将冻结的多语言语言模型、特征对齐的跨编码器 (feature-aligned crosscoders) 与事后语言学干预 (post-hoc linguistic interventions) 结合，分析 1803--2026 年五个议会传统语料库共 44.98M 篇文档、约 17.2B tokens 的历时语言变化。结果表明其稀疏表示与语言学统计量的一致性明显高于稠密嵌入和池化稀疏自编码器（ρ=0.72 对比 0.29 与 0.28），并显示同一语言内形态、句法、语义和语用层面的变化幅度大体相当，而不同语言在变化时间、幅度和方向上差异显著。
Motivation: 历史语言变化会影响形态、句法、语义和语用等多个层面，但现有计算研究通常用互不兼容的表示来考察这些层面，因此难以判断各层面是否在不同语言中共同演化。
Method: 作者引入 ChronoLens 框架，组合冻结的多语言语言模型、特征对齐的跨编码器和事后语言学干预，并将其应用于跨 1803--2026 年、五个议会传统的 44.98M 篇文档与约 17.2B tokens 语料，在统一分析空间中测量不同语言层面、语言和历史时期的变化方向与幅度。
Result: 摘要报告稀疏表示与语言学统计量的一致性显著强于稠密嵌入或池化稀疏自编码器（ρ=0.72 对比 0.29 与 0.28）；同一语言内形态、句法、语义、语用变化幅度大致相当，而语言之间在变化发生时间、距离和方向上存在明显差异。
Conclusion: 作者认为历史语言变化是一个结构化的多维过程：相似的变化幅度可能掩盖不同的变化轨迹，有意义的跨语言比较需要同时测量距离和方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Many Answers Are Valid, Voting Fails: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K Causal Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Self-consistency assumes the most frequent answer among sampled reasoning traces is the most reliable, but this can fail in causal reasoning: samples often repeat the same confounding error, and votes fragment across multiple valid answers, letting an invalid answer win despite a valid minority trace. We introduce CALVER (Causal Axiom-Level VERification), a training-free symbolic verifier that scores structured traces against Pearl's causal criteria, including -separation, backdoor adjustment, and intervention, and selects the highest-scoring candidate without consulting a reference answer. On CLEAR find-one-valid queries that admit multiple graph-valid answers, CALVER reaches 42.1% where plurality, a reward model, an LLM judge, and model confidence remain near 30% on identical frozen pools. Scaling the judge to 72B does not close the gap. In an audited clean-core subset, 11 of 21 graph-valid CALVER selections differ from the benchmark's listed answer while still satisfying the requested predicate. The advantage widens with the sampling budget and reproduces across ten published Bayesian networks, a second model family, and settings where the model must build the graph from text. CALVER also improves thresholded average-treatment-effect decisions against exact ground truth, generalizes to logic under a truth-table checker, and scores each candidate in milliseconds on CPU. CALVER needs only a causal structure, supplied outright or built from the text; wherever that holds, selection can aggregate via causal validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出自洽性（self-consistency）假设多数采样推理轨迹最可靠，但在因果推理中会失败：样本常重复相同混杂错误，且投票在多个有效答案间分散，导致无效答案胜出。作者提出 CALVER（Causal Axiom-Level VERification），一种免训练符号验证器，依据 Pearl 因果准则（d-separation、backdoor adjustment、intervention）对结构化轨迹打分并选择得分最高候选，不依赖参考答案。在 CLEAR find-one-valid 查询上，CALVER 达到 42.1%，而 plurality、奖励模型、LLM judge 和模型置信度在相同冻结池上均接近 30%。
Motivation: 自洽性投票在因果推理场景下不可靠：无效答案可能因投票分散或重复混杂错误而胜出，即使存在少数有效轨迹；而奖励模型、LLM judge 和置信度也未能解决该问题。
Method: CALVER 是一种免训练的符号验证器，对候选推理轨迹按 Pearl 因果标准打分，包括 d-separation、后门调整（backdoor adjustment）和干预（intervention），无需参考答案；该方法仅需因果结构，可由用户直接提供或从文本中自动构建。
Result: 在 CLEAR 的 find-one-valid 查询上，CALVER 达到 42.1%，而 plurality、奖励模型、LLM judge 和模型置信度均约 30%；将 judge 扩至 72B 仍未缩小差距。在审计的 clean-core 子集中，21 个图有效选择中有 11 个与基准列出的答案不同但满足请求谓词；优势随采样预算增大，并在十个已发表贝叶斯网络、第二个模型族以及从文本构建图的设置中复现。CALVER 还改进了阈值化平均处理效应决策，可泛化到带真值表检查器的逻辑任务，并在 CPU 上以毫秒级为每个候选打分。
Conclusion: 在存在多个有效答案的因果推理中，投票式自选择会失败，而基于因果有效性的符号验证可以在无需训练的情况下改进选择。作者强调该方法的适用条件是需要因果结构，无论是直接提供还是从文本构建；只要满足该条件，选择聚合即可依据因果有效性进行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agents for Complex Sequential Decision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool-use, enabling new forms of autonomous agents. However, LLM-based agents struggle with long-horizon sequential decision tasks that require precise action optimization and environment interaction. Reinforcement Learning (RL), while effective for sequential control, often lacks the high-level abstraction and task decomposition abilities needed for complex scenarios. This paper introduces an LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent that integrates LLM-driven planning with RL-based action optimization. The proposed architecture leverages the LLM to generate subgoals, structured plans, and contextual guidance, while the RL agent refines low-level actions through interaction with the environment. Experiments on sequential decision tasks demonstrate improved sample efficiency, higher success rates, and more coherent action trajectories compared to RL-only and LLM-only baselines. This hybrid paradigm highlights a promising direction for building more capable autonomous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 LLM 增强的强化学习智能体 (LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent)，将 LLM 驱动的规划与 RL 的低层动作优化结合。LLM 负责生成子目标、结构化计划和上下文引导，RL 智能体通过环境交互精炼低层动作。摘要在顺序决策任务上的实验显示，相比纯 RL 和纯 LLM 基线，该方法在样本效率、成功率和动作轨迹连贯性上均有提升。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在需要精确动作优化和长期环境交互的长时域顺序决策任务上表现不足，而 RL 虽然擅长顺序控制，但缺乏复杂场景所需的高层抽象与任务分解能力。
Method: 提出混合架构：LLM 模块生成子目标 (subgoals)、结构化计划 (structured plans) 和上下文指导，RL 模块通过与环境的交互来优化和精炼低层动作，两者协同完成复杂顺序任务。
Result: 在顺序决策任务上的实验表明，该方法相比 RL-only 和 LLM-only 基线提升了样本效率与成功率，并产生更连贯的动作轨迹。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 规划与 RL 动作优化的混合范式是构建更具能力自主系统的一个有前景的方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Can LLM design high-quality experiments? A Comprehensive and Systematic Benchmark on Autonomous Experimental Design
papers.abstract_en: AI for Research (AI4Research) leverages AI to automate and improve scientific workflows. While experimental design is a critical stage of the research process, prior work has focused primarily on code implementation and execution, overlooking the importance of this stage, and no benchmark exists to evaluate AI's ability to conduct systematic experiment design. To bridge this gap, we propose SCOPE, a Scientific COmprehensive Planning Evaluation Benchmark constructed from 300 high-quality latest papers across 19 research domains from top-tier venues (e.g., ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR),evaluating LLMs on two dimensions: High-Level planning completeness (main, ablation, and analysis experiments) and Low-Level configuration accuracy and rationality (datasets, baselines, and metrics). Benchmarking reveals three findings: (1) most LLMs cannot directly design high-quality experiments; (2) all LLMs exhibit a performance bottleneck in low-level configuration; and (3) search mode does not improve design quality. Furthermore, to address these challenges, we propose OptED, a novel agentic workflow to optimize LLM-based experimental design, that enhances LLM-based experimental planning through stage isolation, tool augmentation, and rule-based constraints, effectively alleviating the configuration bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE，一个面向自主实验设计的综合基准，从 ICML、NeurIPS、ICLR 等顶会的 19 个研究领域选取 300 篇最新论文，评估 LLM 在高层次规划完备性（主实验、消融、分析实验）与低层次配置准确性和合理性（数据集、基线、指标）两方面的能力。基准测试发现多数 LLM 无法直接设计高质量实验、所有模型在低层次配置上存在性能瓶颈、搜索模式不能提升设计质量。作者进一步提出 OptED agentic 工作流，通过阶段隔离、工具增强和基于规则的约束来缓解配置瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有 AI4Research 工作主要聚焦代码实现与执行，忽视了实验设计这一关键研究阶段，且缺乏系统评估 AI 实验设计能力的基准。
Method: 构建 SCOPE 基准，从 19 个研究领域 300 篇顶会论文中提取实验设计需求，从高层次规划完备性和低层次配置准确性两个维度评估 LLM；并提出 OptED agentic 工作流，采用阶段隔离、工具增强和基于规则的约束来优化基于 LLM 的实验设计。

papers.title: WeClawArena: An Auditable Sandbox and Benchmark for Cross-User Agents Collaboration and Security in Human-Centered Agent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in persistent personal-agent frameworks are making human-centered agent networks realistic deployment targets: each user can be served by an AI agent that acts on the user's behalf, maintains state, and communicates with other agents through social and task relations. In these networks, everyday tool use becomes multi-party owned-agent collaboration over personal workspaces, where files, records, tools, and policies are not directly visible across owners. Existing agent benchmarks study tool use and collaboration, but they do not provide an end-to-end sandbox for verifiable cross-user agent collaboration with realistic user digital workspaces or test how harmful actions can travel through the human-centered agent network. We introduce WeClawArena, an auditable benchmark and runtime sandbox for multi-party owned-agent collaboration over personal workspaces. WeClawArena targets collaborative tool-use tasks in which personal workspaces serve as both operational tools and personal constraints. The benchmark contains 124 base tasks across six cross-user task domains and expands them into 620 scenario variants, with one benign control and four attack-vector variants per base task. The sandbox records peer messages, tool calls, resource operations, governed decisions, and final workspace states. WeClawArena reports utility and attack success rate separately and audits attack success from bounded runtime evidence, supporting diagnosis of task breakdown, privacy leakage, poisoned evidence, and invalid authority paths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WeClawArena，一个面向跨用户智能体协作的可审计沙箱与基准，用于在以人为中心的智能体网络（human-centered agent networks）中验证多方可信协作与安全性。基准包含六个跨用户任务域下的 124 个基础任务，并扩展为 620 个场景变体，每个基础任务附带一个良性对照与四个攻击向量变体。沙箱记录对等消息、工具调用、资源操作、治理决策和最终工作区状态，并分别报告效用（utility）与攻击成功率（attack success rate）。
Motivation: 现有智能体基准虽然研究工具使用与协作，但缺少端到端的可验证跨用户协作沙箱，无法模拟真实的个人数字工作区，也未测试有害行为如何在以人为中心的智能体网络中传播。
Method: WeClawArena 将个人工作区同时作为操作工具与个人约束，构建多方可信智能体协作的运行时沙箱；通过记录对等消息、工具调用、资源操作、治理决策与最终状态，实现从有界运行时证据中对攻击成功进行审计。
Result: 基准包含 124 个基础任务、覆盖六个跨用户任务域，并扩展为 620 个场景变体，其中每个基础任务有一个良性对照和四个攻击向量变体；评估指标将效用与攻击成功率分开报告。
Conclusion: 该沙箱支持诊断任务失败、隐私泄露、被投毒的证据以及无效的权限路径，目标是弥补跨用户智能体协作安全评测中缺少真实工作区与端到端可审计性的空缺。

papers.title: FedCARE: A Multi-Objective Personalised Federated Learning Framework for Smart Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed healthcare institutions without centralising sensitive patient data. However, real-world healthcare federations are often characterised not only by non-IID data, but also by heterogeneous clinical objectives and partially overlapping feature spaces. Different hospitals may optimise distinct and potentially conflicting objectives, such as mortality risk prediction, readmission reduction, or length-of-stay estimation, while also retaining institution-specific clinical features that cannot be shared with other participants. Existing personalised FL methods mainly address statistical heterogeneity, whereas multi-objective FL approaches typically learn a shared global model without explicit client-level adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{FedCARE}, a multi-objective personalised FL framework for smart healthcare services. FedCARE follows a two-stage training strategy. First, it learns a shared global backbone from common clinical features using Pareto-driven multi-objective federated optimisation. Second, each client independently fine-tunes the shared backbone using its private features and local clinical objectives, enabling institution-specific personalisation without additional communication overhead. We implement FedCARE in a cloud-based client-server federated deployment on the Melbourne Research Cloud and evaluate it on two real-world healthcare datasets, MIMIC-III and Diabetes 130-US Hospitals. Experimental results show that FedCARE consistently outperforms standard FL, multi-objective FL, and personalised FL baselines, achieving up to 12.5% AUROC improvement and 32.0% MAE reduction over FedAvg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCARE，一个用于智慧医疗的多目标个性化联邦学习框架。它采用两阶段训练：先用基于 Pareto 的多目标联邦优化在共同临床特征上学习共享全局骨干，再由各客户端利用私有特征和本地临床目标独立微调骨干，实现机构特定个性化且不产生额外通信开销。在 MIMIC-III 和 Diabetes 130-US Hospitals 两个真实数据集上，FedCARE 一致优于标准 FL、多目标 FL 和个性化 FL 基线，相比 FedAvg 最高提升 12.5% AUROC 并降低 32.0% MAE。
Motivation: 真实医疗联邦场景不仅存在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据，还包含异质临床目标和部分重叠的特征空间，不同医院可能优化相互冲突的目标并保留无法共享的机构专属特征。现有个性化 FL 方法主要处理统计异质性，而多目标 FL 通常只学习共享全局模型、缺少客户端级自适应，因此该工作针对这一缺口提出框架。
Method: 提出 FedCARE 两阶段训练策略：第一阶段使用 Pareto 驱动的多目标联邦优化从共同临床特征学习共享全局骨干；第二阶段每个客户端独立用私有特征和本地临床目标微调该骨干，从而实现机构特有个性化而不增加通信开销。系统部署于 Melbourne Research Cloud 上的云-客户端-服务器联邦架构。
Result: 在两个真实医疗数据集 MIMIC-III 与 Diabetes 130-US Hospitals 上的实验显示，FedCARE 在性能上一致超过标准 FL、多目标 FL 与个性化 FL 基线，相对 FedAvg 取得最多 12.5% 的 AUROC 提升和 32.0% 的 MAE 降低。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 FedCARE 通过结合多目标优化与客户端级私有特征微调，能够在医疗数据异质性场景下同时兼顾全局共享与个性化，并优于现有联邦学习方案。摘要未对其适用范围或局限作额外说明。

papers.title: Principles of Robot Autonomy
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robots are moving rapidly from research labs into everyday life - on roads, in the air, in warehouses, and in space. Robot autonomy is no longer solely an academic pursuit, but a collection of mature, field-tested methods and tools that practitioners rely on in real-world deployments. This book offers a clear, unified introduction to the methods that make this possible. Built on decades of teaching at Stanford, the text develops the core elements of modern autonomy stacks within a single conceptual framework, bridging classical robotics and modern physical AI. Every major topic is paired with hands-on Jupyter notebooks and implementation-driven exercises, so readers build practical intuition alongside theoretical understanding. The result is a principled, accessible, and deployment-aware foundation for anyone seeking to design, analyze, or contribute to the next generation of autonomous systems. This is a comprehensive resource for students, engineers, and researchers entering one of today's fastest-growing fields.
papers.comment: 531 pages. Pre-publication version of a book forthcoming from Cambridge University Press, posted with the permission of the publisher
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本关于机器人自主性的综合性教材，来自 Stanford 多年教学积累，由 Cambridge University Press 出版，arXiv 上发布的是 531 页的出版前版本。摘要称该书在单一概念框架内整合现代自主堆栈（autonomy stacks）的核心要素，连接经典机器人学与物理 AI，并为每个主题配套 Jupyter notebooks 与实现驱动的练习。
Motivation: 自主机器人正从研究实验室快速进入道路、空中、仓库和太空等实际部署场景，但缺乏一本统一、面向部署的教学资源；该书旨在为学生、工程师和研究人员提供系统性的入门基础。
Method: 以统一概念框架组织现代自主系统的核心方法，涵盖经典机器人学与物理 AI，并通过动手 Jupyter notebooks 和实现练习把理论理解与实际直觉结合起来。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数据或基准结果；作为教材，其交付物是一本部署导向的完整课程资源，覆盖从设计、分析到贡献自主系统的知识体系。
Conclusion: 该书面向进入自主系统领域的学生、工程师和研究者，强调原理性、可访问性和部署意识。摘要未提及与降水临近预报或气象数据同化相关的内容。

papers.title: Beyond Initialization Loss: A Systematic Study of Token Embedding Initialization Strategies for LLM Vocabulary Extension
papers.abstract_en: Vocabulary extension is an efficient way to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to new languages, but the initialization of newly added token embeddings can strongly affect continued pre-training (CPT) efficiency. We present a systematic study of more than 20 initialization strategies for Hindi vocabulary extension in Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. Our comparison spans vocabulary-averaging baselines; external and learned initialization methods, including FOCUS, top-k semantic retrieval, and residual MLP mappings; subword composition; norm calibration; and input-output asymmetry. We find that subword composition methods outperform both vocabulary averaging and external/learned initialization approaches. Within subword composition, asymmetric variants achieve the lowest observed early validation loss and reveal distinct preferences for input and output embedding initialization. The best observed configuration initializes the input embedding matrix with uniform subword averaging and Hindi-specific norm calibration, and the output language modeling head with character-length-weighted subword averaging. Relative to the standard Mean-all baseline, this full initialization pipeline reaches comparable validation loss with over a 6x reduction in CPT steps and exceeds the baseline's 3,500-step MILU-Hindi accuracy after only 500 steps. Finally, we show that initialization loss and initialization bits-per-byte (Init BPB) are unreliable predictors of downstream convergence, whereas lightweight CPT, as few as 50 steps, provides a cost-effective and reliable signal for selecting the best initialization strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 上印地语词表扩展的 20 余种 token 嵌入初始化策略进行了系统比较，覆盖词表平均化基线、外部/学习式初始化（如 FOCUS、top-k 语义检索、残差 MLP）、子词组合、范数校准以及输入/输出不对称设置。摘要报告子词组合方法优于词表平均化和外部/学习式方法，非对称变体取得最低的早期验证损失；最佳配置为输入嵌入采用均匀子词平均加印地语特定范数校准、输出语言模型头采用字符长度加权子词平均。相比标准 Mean-all 基线，该流程在超过 6 倍更少的持续预训练（CPT）步数内达到相当的验证损失，并在 500 步时超过基线 3500 步的 MILU-Hindi 准确率。
Motivation: 词表扩展是将预训练大语言模型（LLM）适配到新语言的高效途径，但新增 token 嵌入的初始化方式会显著影响持续预训练（CPT）效率，而现有研究缺乏系统性的初始化策略比较。
Method: 作者在 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 上针对印地语词表扩展，系统比较 20 余种初始化策略，包括词表平均化基线、外部/学习式初始化（FOCUS、top-k 语义检索、残差 MLP 映射）、子词组合、范数校准及输入输出不对称变体，并考察初始化损失与轻量 CPT 作为选择信号的可靠性。
Result: 摘要报告子词组合方法整体优于词表平均化和外部/学习式初始化；非对称变体取得最低早期验证损失，且输入与输出嵌入初始化偏好不同。最佳配置相对 Mean-all 基线以超过 6 倍少的 CPT 步数达到相当验证损失，并在 500 步时超过基线 3500 步的 MILU-Hindi 准确率；初始化损失和初始化 bits-per-byte（Init BPB）不能可靠预测下游收敛，而约 50 步的轻量 CPT 是廉价且可靠的选择信号。
Conclusion: 作者建议采用输入输出不对称的子词组合初始化用于 LLM 词表扩展，并强调用轻量 CPT 而非初始化损失来筛选初始化策略。

papers.title: Lightweight 3D Object Detection via Mamba-Based Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: 3D object detection using light detection and ranging (LiDAR) sensors requires a balance between accuracy and computational efficiency for onboard perception in autonomous driving and robotic navigation. Many existing LiDAR-based detection methods employ complex architectures to extract features, integrating large amounts of contextual information to enhance accuracy. This often results in significant computational costs, leading to suboptimal performance on resource-constrained embedded devices. In this study, we propose a knowledge distillation framework that transfers object-level voxel representations from a strong teacher model to lightweight student models through selective voxel-space feature alignment. Taking advantage of the linear-time sequence model with selective state spaces (Mamba), we design a multi-branch Mamba teacher backbone and a box-aware feature transfer mechanism that aligns spatially corresponding voxel features between teacher and student networks through a Mamba-based projection module. Experimental results on both a public dataset and real-world data show that our approach significantly reduces computational load while maintaining competitive accuracy compared with state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation) 的轻量化 LiDAR 3D 目标检测框架，利用 Mamba 的线性时间选择状态空间模型设计多分支教师骨干，并通过 box-aware 特征转移在体素空间对齐教师与学生网络的特征。实验在公开数据集和真实数据上表明，该方法显著降低计算负载，同时保持与最先进方法相当的精度。
Motivation: LiDAR 3D 目标检测需要在精度和计算效率之间取得平衡，而现有方法常依赖复杂架构和大规模上下文信息，导致计算开销大，难以在资源受限的嵌入式设备上运行。
Method: 提出基于 Mamba 的多分支教师骨干网络，并通过体素空间选择性特征对齐 (selective voxel-space feature alignment) 将目标级体素表征从教师模型迁移到轻量学生模型；其中利用 Mamba 投影模块实现教师与学生网络中空间对应体素特征的对齐。
Result: 在公开数据集和真实世界数据上的实验显示，该方法在显著降低计算负载的同时，与最先进方法相比保持有竞争力的检测精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合 Mamba 的体素特征对齐式知识蒸馏能够在不牺牲精度的情况下实现轻量化 LiDAR 3D 检测，适合自主驾驶和机器人导航中的嵌入式部署环境。

papers.title: Leveraging System-Level Observations to Inform Bayesian Learning of Model Parameters for Quantitative Verification
papers.abstract_en: Combining Bayesian learning and quantitative verification is a powerful toolset for analysing key quantitative properties of software systems, like reliability and response time. However, the accuracy and robustness of verification results strongly depend on the prior knowledge (PK) underlying Bayesian inference. This knowledge reflects original beliefs about the probability of events and typically depends on domain expertise. Using inaccurate or uninformative PK can negatively affect quantitative analysis, yielding incorrect verification results. Our EPIK approach tackles this important challenge by eliciting and embedding PK in quantitative verification equipped with Bayesian estimators. Unlike existing approaches that require PK on formal model transition parameters, EPIK leverages system-level properties that are directly observable and are linked to real-world semantics. EPIK formulates a twofold optimisation problem to derive the distributions of unknown transition parameters and then embeds these distributions to verify new or difficult-to-measure (elusive) properties. The detailed experimental evaluation using multiple variants of real-world case studies and diverse EPIK instantiations shows its effectiveness, flexibility and generality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EPIK 方法，将贝叶斯学习与定量验证 (quantitative verification) 结合，通过引入可直接观测、具有真实世界语义的系统级属性来获取先验知识 (prior knowledge)，从而估计未知转移参数分布，并用于验证难以直接测量的属性。实验基于多个真实案例变体和多种 EPIK 实例化，表明该方法在有效性、灵活性和通用性上均有良好表现。
Motivation: 定量验证结果的准确性和鲁棒性高度依赖贝叶斯推断中的先验知识，而不准确或无信息的先验会导致错误的验证结果。已有方法要求先验知识针对形式化模型的转移参数，这在实践中难以获得。
Method: EPIK 利用系统级、可直接观测且与真实语义关联的属性，构造一个双目标优化问题来推导未知转移参数的分布，再将所得分布嵌入到验证流程中，用于验证新的或难以测量的属性。
Result: 摘要报告了基于多种真实世界案例研究变体和多样化 EPIK 实例化的详细实验评估，结果显示该方法具有有效性、灵活性和通用性；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过系统级可观测属性来引出并嵌入先验知识，可以改善贝叶斯定量验证中先验知识难以获取的问题，EPIK 提供了一种通用且灵活的解决方案。

papers.title: A fully nonlinear structural vector autoregressive model identified via independent innovation analysis
papers.abstract_en: We develop a fully nonlinear structural vector autoregressive framework in which the contemporaneous structural mapping may be nonlinear and non-additive. Identification is achieved by exploiting variation in the conditional distributions of the mutually independent structural shocks induced by an observed exogenous variable. Specifically, a general contrastive learning framework that makes use of this variation together with the assumed exponential-family structure is employed to recover the shocks. Existing independent innovation analysis results identify such shocks only up to arbitrary componentwise invertible transformations, which is generally insufficient for structural econometric analysis. We strengthen this result by imposing a structured exponential-family specification for the conditional shock distributions. With the imposed sufficient statistics, the remaining ambiguity is reduced to a one-parameter transformed-scale map for each shock. We then show that, under a logistic specification used for the natural parameters, the identification is further strengthened up to permutation and componentwise sign changes. Once the shocks have been recovered, the fully nonlinear structural vector autoregression can be estimated using feed-forward neural networks, motivated by their universal approximation capabilities. The empirical application studies asymmetries in the responses of U.S. industrial production to the real oil price shock. We find modest asymmetries with respect to the sign of the shock and state of the economy. The accompanying R package iiasvar implements the introduced methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个完全非线性的结构向量自回归 (structural VAR) 框架，允许同期结构映射是非线性且非加性的。识别通过观察到的外生变量导致的结构冲击条件分布变化实现，结合指数族假设与对比学习框架恢复冲击；在 logistic 设定下识别可强至置换和分量符号变化。恢复冲击后用前馈神经网络估计模型，实证研究美国工业生产对实际油价冲击响应的非对称性。
Motivation: 现有独立创新分析 (independent innovation analysis) 只能将结构冲击识别到任意分量可逆变换，这通常不足以支撑结构性计量分析；需要引入更强的分布约束以获得可用于经济学解释的识别结果。
Method: 提出完全非线性结构 VAR，并对条件冲击分布施加结构化指数族设定，使剩余歧义缩减为每个冲击的单参数变换尺度映射；进一步对自然参数采用 logistic 设定，将识别增强到置换和分量符号变化。冲击恢复后，利用前馈神经网络的万能逼近性质估计模型，并实现为 R 包 iiasvar。
Result: 实证应用显示，美国工业生产对实际油价冲击的响应存在适度非对称性，且这种非对称性与冲击符号和经济状态有关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该识别结果将独立创新分析留下的不确定性降低到置换与符号变化层面，并展示了完全非线性结构 VAR 在油价冲击传导不对称性研究中的可行性。

papers.title: Continue or Replan? Bernoulli-Continuation Policy Learning for Adaptive Horizon Execution
papers.abstract_en: Existing chunk-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models execute a fixed number of actions (i.e., execution horizon) before replanning, turning replanning into a task-agnostic periodic schedule that is independent of task progress. As a result, when no replanning boundary falls before a critical manipulation stage, it is executed from a stale chunk rather than a freshly replanned one. To address this limitation, we propose Bernoulli-Continuation Policy (BCP), a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for adaptive horizon execution that keeps the base VLA frozen. Given a fixed-length action chunk, its continuation head decomposes execution-horizon selection into a sequence of continue-or-replan decisions, which imposes an ordinal, prefix-sharing inductive bias over candidate horizons rather than treating them as independent classes. Since the optimal horizon for each chunk is not observable, we train this head with reinforcement learning from trajectory-level outcomes and introduce a Replanning-Efficiency Reward that jointly rewards task success and efficient VLA usage, discouraging the policy from collapsing to unnecessarily short horizons. On RoboTwin 2.0 with LingBot-VLA as the base policy, BCP improves the average success rate by +11.08% on 13 low-success tasks and from 89.88% to 93.94% (+4.06%) across all 50 tasks. Although trained only under the Clean setting, BCP generalizes to the Randomized setting, raising the average success rate by +4.06%. It also transfers to a different base policy $π_{0.5}$, achieving a better result on LIBERO (+1.7%) and, notably, on the harder LIBERO-PRO (+6.8%). On a real robot, BCP lifts success from 74% to 92% and from 44% to 84% on two manipulation tasks. Meanwhile, its negligible overhead, combined with higher success, makes BCP's overall runtime even lower than the fixed-horizon baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于分块 (chunk) 的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型固定执行周期导致重规划时机与任务进度脱节的问题，提出 Bernoulli-Continuation Policy (BCP)，一种保持基础 VLA 冻结的轻量即插即用自适应执行框架。BCP 的 continuation head 把执行步长选择分解为一系列 continue-or-replan 决策，并用轨迹级结果的强化学习配合 Replanning-Efficiency Reward 训练。摘要报告在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 以及真实机器人任务上均显著提升成功率，且额外开销可忽略。
Motivation: 现有分块式 VLA 模型在固定动作块执行完后才重规划，使重规划变成与任务进度无关的周期调度；当关键操作阶段之前没有重规划边界时，该阶段会基于过时的分块执行，导致效果退化。
Method: 提出 BCP，在固定长度动作块上附加一个 continuation head，将执行周期选择转化为序贯的 continue-or-replan 二元决策，从而对候选周期施加有序、前缀共享的归纳偏置。由于每个分块的最优周期不可观测，该 head 使用轨迹级结果的强化学习训练，并引入 Replanning-Efficiency Reward 同时奖励任务成功与高效的 VLA 使用，避免策略坍缩到过短周期。
Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上以 LingBot-VLA 为基础策略，BCP 在 13 个低成功率任务上平均成功率提升 +11.08%，全部 50 个任务从 89.88% 提升到 93.94% (+4.06%)；仅用 Clean 设置训练即可泛化到 Randomized 设置，平均成功率再提升 +4.06%。它还能迁移到基础策略 π_{0.5}，在 LIBERO 上提升 +1.7%，在更难的 LIBERO-PRO 上提升 +6.8%；真实机器人两个操作任务成功率分别从 74% 提升到 92%、从 44% 提升到 84%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，自适应的执行周期选择可以作为一种轻量即插即用组件提升固定分块 VLA 的成功率与使用效率，且开销极小，整体运行时间甚至低于固定周期基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond the Gegenbauer Paradigm: q-Orthogonal Kernels for Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: The performance of Support Vector Machines (SVMs) critically depends on the kernel function choice, which enables implicit mapping of data into high-dimensional feature spaces. While classical kernels like Radial Basis Function (RBF) remain popular, orthogonal polynomial kernels offer mathematically interpretable alternatives that can incorporate structured prior knowledge. This work extends the orthogonal polynomial kernel paradigm by introducing a novel family based on discrete $q$-Hermite I polynomials, a class of $q$-orthogonal polynomials that generalize classical Hermite polynomials through a deformation parameter $q$. We formally define the q-Hermite kernel and establish its validity under Mercer's theorem. The kernel's inherent boundedness properties naturally prevent annihilation and explosion effects without requiring explicit scaling mechanisms. Extensive experiments across 20 benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed kernel achieves competitive performance compared to both classical kernels and other orthogonal polynomial kernels, while offering advantages in numerical stability and computational simplicity. Our results confirm that $q$-orthogonal polynomials constitute a promising direction for kernel design, bridging mathematical elegance with practical machine learning applications, that provides conceptual and algorithmic resources that may be further extended to emerging quantum computing paradigms. To facilitate full reproducibility, we provide the complete implementation and experimental pipeline in an open-access GitHub repository at https://github.com/Kokechacho/SVMs-QSVMs.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Source code and experimental pipeline available at https://github.com/Kokechacho/SVMs-QSVMs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类基于离散 q-Hermite I 多项式的 q-正交核 (q-orthogonal kernel)，用于支持向量机 (SVM)，形式化定义 q-Hermite 核并证明其满足 Mercer 定理。作者指出该核的内在有界性可自然避免核爆炸与消失效应，无需显式缩放机制。在 20 个基准数据集上的实验表明，其性能与经典核及其他正交多项式核相当，并在数值稳定性与计算简单性上具有优势。
Motivation: SVM 的性能高度依赖核函数选择，而经典 RBF 等核虽流行，但正交多项式核能提供可解释性并整合结构化先验。现有正交多项式核范式尚未系统探索 q-正交多项式，本文旨在扩展该范式。
Method: 引入基于离散 q-Hermite I 多项式的 q-Hermite 核，通过形变参数 q 推广经典 Hermite 多项式；形式化定义核函数并依据 Mercer 定理验证其合法性，利用核固有的有界性避免数值不稳定问题。
Result: 在 20 个基准数据集上的实验显示，所提核与经典核及其他正交多项式核相比性能具有竞争力，同时展现出更好的数值稳定性和更低的计算复杂度。
Conclusion: 作者认为 q-正交多项式是核设计中一个有前景的方向，兼具数学优美性与实际应用价值，并可能为量子计算范式提供概念与算法上的扩展资源；代码已开源以支持完全复现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adaptive Modality Reliability Diagnosis and Restoration for Robust Multimodal Intent Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal intent recognition combines linguistic, acoustic, and visual evidence, but individual modalities may be noisy, missing, semantically conflicting, or disproportionately dominant. Existing methods typically infer modality importance implicitly and either reweight or suppress unreliable inputs, without determining whether a degraded modality can be repaired and subsequently trusted. We propose PRIME (Precision-weighted Reliability Inference and Modality rEstoration), a closed-loop reliability guided framework that jointly diagnoses, restores, and reassesses modality quality at the sample level. PRIME represents the weakness of each modality through a contextual log-variance estimated from complementary diagnostic evidence, including predictive confidence, epistemic disagreement, cross-modal consensus, and feature degeneracy. Because modality-reliability annotations are unavailable, the estimator is explicitly trained using controlled modality corruption with known degradation severity, together with a heteroscedastic uncertainty objective. Rather than directly discarding an unreliable modality, PRIME uses its estimated weakness to control a prototype-conditioned variational restoration module that reconstructs the degraded representation from complementary modalities. Crucially, reliability is re-estimated after restoration, allowing the model to determine whether the repaired representation has become sufficiently trustworthy to contribute to prediction. The resulting post-restoration precisions are used for inverse-variance multimodal fusion. Experiments on multimodal intent-recognition benchmarks show that PRIME maintains competitive clean-data performance while improving robustness under missing, noisy, conflicting, and modality-imbalanced conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRIME（Precision-weighted Reliability Inference and Modality rEstoration），一个用于鲁棒多模态意图识别的闭环可靠性引导框架，在样本级别对语音、文本、视觉等模态进行可靠性诊断、表征修复与再评估。PRIME 用上下文对数方差刻画模态弱点，并在受控模态损坏下以异方差不确定性目标训练估计器，随后通过原型条件变分修复模块从互补模态重建退化表征，并在修复后重新估计可靠性以决定是否信任该模态，最后用逆方差融合方式结合各模态。实验表明 PRIME 在干净数据上保持竞争力，并在缺失、噪声、冲突和模态不均衡条件下提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 多模态意图识别中单个模态可能带有噪声、缺失、语义冲突或过度主导，现有方法通常隐式推断模态重要性并重新加权或抑制不可靠输入，却没有判断一个退化模态是否可以被修复并重新信任。
Method: 提出 PRIME 框架：用估计的上下文对数方差（contextual log-variance）表示每个模态的弱点，来源包括预测置信度、认知分歧（epistemic disagreement）、跨模态一致性和特征退化；估计器通过已知退化严重程度的受控模态损坏和异方差不确定性目标显式训练。框架不直接丢弃不可靠模态，而是用估计弱点控制原型条件变分修复模块（prototype-conditioned variational restoration）从互补模态重建退化表征，并在修复后重新估计可靠性，最终以修复后的精度进行逆方差多模态融合（inverse-variance multimodal fusion）。
Result: 在多模态意图识别基准上的实验显示，PRIME 在保持有竞争力的干净数据性能的同时，在缺失、噪声、冲突和模态不均衡条件下提升了鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张通过闭环的可靠性再评估来决定修复后表征是否可信，并认为这种显式诊断-修复-再评估范式优于直接抑制不可靠模态的做法；摘要强调其为样本级的联合诊断与修复框架。

papers.title: MT-Web2Code: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Multi-Turn Regional Reconstruction and Localized Modification
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in web UI generation. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on single-turn full-page generation from scratch, overlooking the iterative workflow of real-world frontend engineering, where developers repeatedly reconstruct missing regions and modify localized elements within existing codebases. To bridge this gap, we introduce MT-Web2Code, the first multimodal coding benchmark for multi-turn Macro-Level Regional Reconstruction and Micro-Level Localized Modification, which contains 102 tasks spanning 16 vertical domains. To construct deterministic repair trajectories without costly turn-level human annotation, we develop a scalable Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine that iteratively injects structural and stylistic defects into golden pages. We further propose a dual-axis evaluation protocol that measures target-region fidelity and the preservation of unaffected content, where regional reconstruction is assessed by a 5-dimensional VLM-based rubric and localized modification by deterministic pixel-grounded alignment. Experiments on 13 frontier coding agents reveal that current agents struggle to faithfully reconstruct target regions while preserving unaffected content, lack fine-grained visual-code alignment for localized edits, and suffer from error snowballing over multiple turns. Beyond benchmarking, our deterministic evaluation metrics provide fine-grained feedback signals that may facilitate future research on training iterative UI coding agents. Our evaluation code and data will soon be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MT-Web2Code，据称是首个面向多轮宏级别区域重建与微级别局部修改的多模态网页代码生成基准，包含 16 个垂直领域的 102 个任务。作者设计了一个可扩展的 Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine，通过向黄金页面迭代注入结构与风格缺陷来构建确定性修复轨迹，并提出双轴评估协议以衡量目标区域保真度与无关内容保持度。对 13 个前沿编码智能体的实验显示，现有模型难以在保持无关内容的同时忠实重建目标区域、缺乏细粒度视觉-代码对齐，并存在多轮错误雪球效应。
Motivation: 现有基准主要关注单轮从零生成整页网页 UI，而真实前端工程是迭代式工作流，需要在已有代码库中反复重建缺失区域和修改局部元素，这一过程缺乏评测资源。
Method: 构建多模态编码基准 MT-Web2Code，利用 Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine 自动生成确定性多轮修复轨迹；评估采用双轴协议，区域重建由 5 维 VLM 评分器（rubric）评定，局部修改则用确定性像素级对齐衡量。
Result: 在 13 个前沿编码智能体上的实验表明，现有智能体在重建目标区域时难以保持无关内容，局部编辑缺乏细粒度视觉-代码对齐，且多轮交互中错误会逐渐累积放大（error snowballing）。
Conclusion: 作者强调其确定性评估指标能提供细粒度反馈信号，可能有助于未来训练迭代式 UI 编码智能体，并计划发布评估代码与数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hi-Token: Hierarchical Coordinate Tokenization for Generative Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Generative Vision-Language Models (VLMs) commonly treat bounding-box coordinates as independent output symbols, leaving numerical order and axis semantics implicit. We identify this representation as an important source of error in visual grounding. Hi-Token encodes each coordinate with axis-specific tokens for the hundreds, tens, and ones digits, which adds coarse-to-fine structure and increases token reuse while retaining the existing VLM architecture. Hi-GAR complements this representation with a geometry-based reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using box overlap and coordinate accuracy at multiple scales. Controlled comparisons under matched training conditions show that Hi-Token improves localization throughout the evaluated IoU range. Hi-GAR further reduces low-overlap predictions and is used only during training. Experiments on three VLM backbones and the RefCOCO family show consistent gains across models and benchmarks. Hi-R1 achieves higher values than strong specialist baselines on most reported metrics. Analyses of token frequency, digit boundaries, object scale, and IoU distributions explain the effects of coordinate representation and reward training. The results show that structured coordinate generation provides an effective approach to generative visual grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式视觉语言模型 (VLM) 将边界框坐标视为独立输出符号、忽略数值顺序与轴语义的问题，提出 Hi-Token 分层坐标分词方法：对每个坐标按百、十、个位使用轴特定的 token 编码，引入由粗到细的结构并提高 token 复用，且不改变现有 VLM 架构。配套的 Hi-GAR 为 GRPO 提供基于几何的奖励，结合多尺度框重叠与坐标精度；在三个 VLM 骨干和 RefCOCO 系列上的受控对比显示一致的定位改进。
Motivation: 现有生成式 VLM 在视觉定位中把坐标当作相互独立的符号输出，数值顺序和坐标轴语义是隐式的，作者认为这种表示是视觉定位错误的重要来源。
Method: 提出 Hi-Token，用轴特定的 token 分别编码坐标的百位、十位和个位数字，形成从粗到细的层次结构并增加 token 复用；同时提出 Hi-GAR，一种用于 GRPO 的基于几何的奖励函数，在多尺度上结合框重叠 (box overlap) 与坐标精度，该奖励只在训练阶段使用。
Result: 在匹配训练条件下的受控比较中，Hi-Token 在被评估的整个 IoU 范围内改善了定位；Hi-GAR 进一步减少低重叠预测。在三个 VLM 骨干和 RefCOCO 家族基准上取得一致增益，Hi-R1 在大多数报告的指标上高于强专家基线；对 token 频率、数字边界、物体尺度和 IoU 分布的分析解释了表示与奖励训练的作用。
Conclusion: 结构化坐标生成 (structured coordinate generation) 为生成式视觉定位提供了一种有效途径；Hi-GAR 仅用于训练，不影响推理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Should the Boundary Term Be Learned in Reflected Diffusion? Conormal Trace and Reflection Masking
papers.abstract_en: We study score learning for reflected diffusion on bounded domains. Reflection keeps trajectories feasible but does not ensure that the learned score satisfies the boundary behavior implied by the forward process. With implicit score matching, integration by parts leaves a boundary term, and we show that it depends on one scalar at each boundary point: the diffusion- weighted normal component of the score, or conormal trace. The no-flux condition fixes this value while leaving the re- maining boundary components unrestricted; under anisotropic diffusion it generally differs from the ordinary normal score component. On hyperrectangles, our parametrization enforces the required trace without additional trainable parameters or a stochastic boundary estimator and, under regularity assump- tions, can represent the true score, whereas fixing an incorrect value creates an error that more data cannot remove. We ex- tend the construction to simplices and polygonal domains and identify reflection masking: hard reflection can keep samples feasible even when the learned trace is wrong, so post-reflection metrics may hide the error. Experiments show the clearest separation with less frequent reflection, anisotropic diffusion, and mass near intersections of constraints; under full reflection, final sample placement improves inconsistently, illustrating how hard repair can mask boundary-score errors and decouple score accuracy from downstream generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有界区域上反射扩散 (reflected diffusion) 的分数学习。作者证明，在隐式分数匹配 (implicit score matching) 中，分部积分留下的边界项由每个边界点上的一个标量决定，即扩散加权的分数法向分量 (conormal trace)，而 no-flux 条件恰好固定该值。论文提出一种无需额外可训练参数或随机边界估计器的参数化来强制该迹，并指出硬反射 (hard reflection) 可能掩盖边界分数错误，导致分数准确性与下游生成质量脱钩。
Motivation: 反射扩散中反射只保证轨迹可行，并不保证学习到的分数满足前向过程隐含的边界行为；隐式分数匹配产生的边界项若处理不当，会引入即使增加数据也无法消除的误差。
Method: 将边界项归约为每个边界点上由 no-flux 条件固定的 conormal trace，而其余边界分量不受限制；在超矩形上构造参数化直接强制所需迹，并在正则性假设下将其推广到单纯形和多边形区域，同时分析硬反射作为修复手段的掩盖效应。
Result: 固定错误迹值会产生数据无法消除的误差，而所提参数化在超矩形上能表示真实分数。实验显示，在反射较少、各向异性扩散以及质量靠近约束交点时，误差分离最明显；完全反射下最终样本位置改善不稳定，说明硬修复会掩盖边界分数误差。
Conclusion: 硬反射虽能保持样本可行，但会掩盖学习到的迹错误，使 post-reflection 指标失真并让分数准确性与下游生成质量脱钩，因此评估反射扩散时需谨慎看待该类指标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ToolLIFT: Lifting Tool-Specific Trajectories into Function-Level Graphs for Generalizable Tool Planning
papers.abstract_en: Historical tool-use trajectories provide valuable experience for large language model (LLM) agents to plan and coordinate tool usage. Existing approaches directly construct tool-level graphs from these trajectories, but the resulting graphs remain tied to specific tools and are hard to generalize across tool sets. To tackle this challenge, we find that despite differences in the tools involved, analogous tasks often share a common function-level workflow structure, which serves as a potentially more transferable abstraction for tool planning. Based on this insight, we propose ToolLIFT, a framework that lifts tool-specific trajectories into a function-level workflow graph (FWG) for generalizable tool planning. Specifically, we first propose a trajectory-lifting mechanism that encodes workflow structures in the FWG and shares collaboration experience across tools. Then, building on the global structure of the FWG, we introduce decoupled workflow planning and tool selection to align individual tool choices with the overall workflow. Lastly, to ensure reliable tool dataflow, we adopt Reinforcement Learning (RL) and propose source-gated and skill-specific rewards to maintain source-traceable information flow across tool calls. Experiments on two in-distribution (ID) and three out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks show that ToolLIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating strong generalization to unseen tool sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ToolLIFT，将工具特定的历史轨迹提升为函数级工作流图 (function-level workflow graph, FWG)，用于大语言模型代理的通用工具规划。摘要称该方法在 2 个分布内 (ID) 与 3 个分布外 (OOD) 基准上一致优于现有 SOTA 基线，并展现对未见工具集的强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法直接从历史工具使用轨迹构建工具级图，所得图与具体工具绑定，难以跨工具集泛化。作者观察到，尽管工具不同，类似任务往往共享函数级工作流结构，可作为更可迁移的规划抽象。
Method: 提出 ToolLIFT 框架，包含三部分：轨迹提升机制将工作流结构编码进 FWG 并跨工具共享协作经验；基于 FWG 全局结构解耦工作流规划与工具选择；采用强化学习 (RL)，设计源门控 (source-gated) 与技能特定 (skill-specific) 奖励，以维持跨工具调用的可溯源信息流。
Result: 在 2 个 ID 和 3 个 OOD 基准上的实验显示，ToolLIFT 一致优于现有 SOTA 基线，展现对未见工具集的强泛化能力。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调函数级工作流抽象是提升工具规划跨工具集泛化性的有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that redistributes positive advantages accord- ing to cluster rarity. Cue-GRPO instantiates this rule with- out auxiliary-model inference by using deterministic Strategy Cues to construct rollout-local partitions of verified-correct traces. Across Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Cue-GRPO improves AIME repeated-sampling performance, with the largest gains at high sampling budgets. Credit Re- distribution (CR) under Judge Partitions (JP) further indi- cates that the proposed redistribution mechanism can oper- ate with judge-derived partitions. Cue-GRPO adds only 6% wall-clock training overhead over GRPO. These results sup- port structure-level credit redistribution as a practical design axis for RLVR, with Strategy Cues providing a low-overhead implementation for competition mathematics. Code is avail- able at https://github.com/CzZ12/When-Correct-Solutions- Repeat-Rarity-Aware-Credit-Redistribution-for-GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GRPO 在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中把每个正确完成当作独立信号的问题，形式化描述了"多重性导致的结构级信用集中"（multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration），并提出 Cue-GRPO：用确定性策略提示（Strategy Cues）在 rollout 内对已验证正确的轨迹做分区，并按簇稀有度重新分配正优势。在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，该方法提升 AIME 重复采样性能，且仅增加约 6% 的训练开销。
Motivation: GRPO 对每个正确完成给予统一信用，导致反复出现的正确解法形式因采样频率高而累积正优势，稀有解法形式获得信用不足，形成结构层面的分布偏差；这一问题在 RLVR 中未被充分建模。
Method: 提出一种分区条件下的重分配规则，将正优势按簇稀有度（cluster rarity）重新分配；Cue-GRPO 无需辅助模型推理，仅用确定性 Strategy Cues 构造 rollout 局部分区来实例化该规则，并额外验证了基于评判模型分区（Judge Partitions）的信用重分配（Credit Redistribution）变体。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，Cue-GRPO 提升 AIME 重复采样性能，且在较大采样预算下收益最明显；相比 GRPO 只增加约 6% 的 wall-clock 训练开销。
Conclusion: 作者认为结构级信用重分配可以作为 RLVR 的一个实用设计维度，Strategy Cues 为竞赛数学场景提供了低开销实现；代码已开源。

papers.title: ChartAnno: Evaluating MLLMs for Chart Annotation Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in chart understanding, generation, and editing, but their ability to annotate existing charts remains underexplored. Annotating charts is a common yet challenging communicative task, requiring models to infer intended messages, interpret chart semantics, and place appropriate textual or graphical elements. To address this gap, we introduce ChartAnno, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on chart annotation generation. It contains 1,200 real-world charts with paired code and annotation instructions across three levels of instruction specificity. We evaluate 10 representative MLLMs under two primary input settings: (1) chart code alone and (2) both chart code and chart image, and further include a chart image-only ablation study. Results show that proprietary models remain stronger overall, although large-scale open-source models narrow the gap. More specific instructions improve annotation quality, while inferring abstract intent remains most difficult for current MLLMs. Providing chart images brings limited overall gains, with improvements mainly appearing in design-related metrics. These findings highlight chart annotation generation as a challenging task requiring semantic grounding and effective annotation design. Code and data will be released in a future version.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChartAnno，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 图表标注生成能力的基准，包含 1,200 张真实图表及配对代码和三种指令具体化程度的标注指令。作者在仅图表代码、图表代码加图表图像两种主要输入设置下评估了 10 个代表性 MLLM，并补充了仅图像消融实验。结果显示闭源模型整体更强，但大规模开源模型差距缩小；更具体的指令提升标注质量，而推断抽象意图仍最困难；提供图表图像带来的整体收益有限，主要改善设计相关指标。
Motivation: MLLM 在图表理解、生成和编辑方面已有进展，但对现有图表进行标注的能力尚未被充分探索；图表标注是常见且具挑战性的沟通任务，需要模型推断意图、理解图表语义并放置合适的文本或图形元素。
Method: 构建包含 1,200 张真实图表、配对代码以及三种指令具体化水平的标注指令的基准 ChartAnno；在仅代码、代码加图像两种输入设置下评估 10 个 MLLM，并增加仅图像的消融研究。
Result: 闭源模型整体表现更强，但大规模开源模型缩小了差距；更具体的指令改善标注质量，抽象意图推断仍是最难的部分；提供图表图像带来的整体提升有限，改善主要出现在设计相关指标。
Conclusion: 研究表明图表标注生成是一个需要语义接地 (semantic grounding) 与有效标注设计的挑战性任务；代码和数据将在未来版本中发布。

papers.title: LeanMem: Simple and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for LLM-based agents to sustain interactions and reliably leverage distant history. However, existing memory systems typically process heterogeneous dialogue content through a uniform summarization and retrieval pipeline, leading to either excessive token consumption or irreversible loss of fine-grained evidence. We argue that historical dialogue content should be handled differently according to its compressibility, temporal dynamics, and fidelity requirements. Based on this insight, we propose LeanMem, a lightweight long-term memory framework. LeanMem first filters out low-value content, then stores informative segments as compact profile memory, temporally structured event memory, or source-grounded record memory, depending on the nature of the information. During maintenance, only dynamically evolving event memories are selectively updated, avoiding redundant consolidation of stable profiles and immutable records. During inference, LeanMem dynamically selects memory types and allocates retrieval budgets according to query-specific evidence demands, assembling relevant evidence on demand. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S with GPT-4.1-mini and Qwen3-8B, LeanMem improves accuracy over the strongest memory-based baseline in every setting, by up to 15.1 points, at the lowest or near-lowest construction cost, inference tokens, and latency. The code and datasets are included in the supplementary materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LeanMem，一个轻量级 LLM 智能体长期记忆框架。核心观点是历史对话内容应根据可压缩性、时间动态性和保真度要求区别处理：先过滤低价值内容，再将信息性片段分别存储为紧凑的画像记忆 (profile memory)、时间结构化的事件记忆 (event memory) 和带来源锚定的记录记忆 (record memory)。维护时只选择性更新动态演化的事件记忆，推理时按查询的证据需求动态选择记忆类型并分配检索预算。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上配合 GPT-4.1-mini 与 Qwen3-8B，相比最强基于记忆的基线在每个设置上均提升准确率，最高达 15.1 点，同时保持最低或接近最低的构建成本、推理 token 数和延迟。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统对异构对话内容采用统一的摘要与检索流程，导致 token 消耗过大或细粒度证据不可逆丢失。作者认为应根据内容的可压缩性、时间动态性和保真度要求区别处理历史对话。
Method: LeanMem 框架包含几个阶段：先过滤低价值内容；再将信息性片段按性质分别存入画像记忆、事件记忆或来源锚定的记录记忆。维护阶段仅选择性更新动态演化的事件记忆，避免对稳定画像和不可变记录的冗余整合；推理阶段按查询特定证据需求动态选择记忆类型并分配检索预算。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 基准上，配合 GPT-4.1-mini 与 Qwen3-8B，LeanMem 在每一种设置下都超过最强的基于记忆的基线，准确率最高提升 15.1 个点，同时构建成本、推理 token 数和延迟处于最低或接近最低水平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调按信息性质分层存储并只在需要时聚合证据，可以在不增加开销的情况下提升长程记忆问答准确率。代码和数据集包含在补充材料中。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: LeanMem 框架包含几个阶段：先过滤低价值内容；再将信息性片段按性质分别存入画像记忆、事件记忆或来源锚定的记录记忆。维护阶段仅选择性更新动态演化的事件记忆，避免对稳定画像和不可变记录的冗余整合；推理阶段按查询特定证据需求动态选择记忆类型并分配检索预算。
summary_sections.result: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 基准上，配合 GPT-4.1-mini 与 Qwen3-8B，LeanMem 在每一种设置下都超过最强的基于记忆的基线，准确率最高提升 15.1 个点，同时构建成本、推理 token 数和延迟处于最低或接近最低水平。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调按信息性质分层存储并只在需要时聚合证据，可以在不增加开销的情况下提升长程记忆问答准确率。代码和数据集包含在补充材料中。

papers.title: Solver-Aware Decompositions for Programming-by-Example: When Dividing Requires Knowing how to Conquer
papers.abstract_en: Decomposition-based Programming-by-example (PBE) scales performance by splitting tasks into subtasks that a learned synthesizer solves: a decomposer predicts intermediate subgoals, and a synthesizer generates programs conditioned on them. Current approaches train the decomposer to imitate ground-truth ( GT) subgoals, implicitly treating decomposition quality as intrinsic to the task. We challenge this assumption: for bounded solvers with fixed inductive biases, GT decompositions reflect the annotator's factorization choices - not the solver's search dynamics. A decomposer trained to match GT decompositions may therefore propose subgoals that are logically valid yet intractable for the solver. We propose Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD), a training framework that retains supervised training on GT subgoals as a structural scaffold, while additionally optimizing the decomposer via direct feedback from a frozen synthesizer. Subgoals are rewarded based on the synthesizer's loss on the target program - a signal of subtask difficulty that encourages decompositions the solver can act on. Our experiments reveal an accuracy paradox: higher agreement with GT decompositions does not improve synthesis success - even though the synthesizer was trained on the very same GT data the decomposer is optimized to mimic. SAD instead learns decompositions that trade GT alignment for solver tractability, yielding consistent gains in synthesis and end-to-end task accuracy across two PBE domains. Moreover, SAD solves tasks that a GT decomposition oracle fails - empirical evidence that GT decompositions are not universally optimal for bounded solvers, and that decomposition quality is solver-relative, not intrinsic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于分解的编程示例合成（decomposition-based Programming-by-example, PBE）提出 Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD) 训练框架。作者质疑当前用 ground-truth (GT) 子目标训练 decomposer 的做法，认为对具有固定归纳偏置的有界求解器而言，GT 分解反映的是标注者的分解选择而非求解器的搜索动态，可能逻辑有效却难以被求解器处理。SAD 在保留 GT 子目标监督训练作为结构支架的同时，用冻结合成器在目标程序上的 loss 作为奖励信号直接优化 decomposer。实验发现“精度悖论”：与 GT 分解的一致度更高并不能提升合成成功率，而 SAD 学习到牺牲 GT 对齐换取求解器可解性的分解，在两个 PBE 领域上带来一致的合成与端到端任务准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有 decomposition-based PBE 方法训练 decomposer 去模仿 GT 子目标，隐含假设分解质量是任务的内在属性；但 GT 分解可能只反映标注者的因子分解偏好，无法保证被固定偏置的求解器采纳，因此需要一种面向求解器的分解学习方式。
Method: 提出 Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD)：在 GT 子目标监督训练的基础上，额外利用冻结合成器的直接反馈优化 decomposer；子目标根据合成器在目标程序上的 loss 获得奖励，该信号刻画子任务难度，促使模型生成求解器能够实际利用的分解。
Result: 实验揭示精度悖论：提高与 GT 分解的一致度并不会改善合成成功率，即使合成器本身是在同一 GT 数据上训练的。SAD 学习到的分解以降低 GT 对齐为代价换取求解器可解性，在两个 PBE 领域上稳定提升 synthesis 与端到端任务准确率，并解决了 GT 分解 oracle 无法完成的任务。
Conclusion: 作者据此论证 GT 分解并非对有界求解器普遍最优，分解质量是相对于求解器的（solver-relative）而非任务内在固有的；摘要未讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learning rate decays more rapidly with compute. For model--data allocation, IsoFLOP analysis reveals a slight data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. For MoE architecture, larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity, while moderate expert granularity remains consistently effective and the preferred fraction of activated capacity assigned to shared experts remains stable across scales. Guided by these findings, we train LLaDA MoE v2, a 30B-A3B dLLM, from scratch on 23.5T tokens. With approximately 65\% as many pretraining tokens as Qwen3, LLaDA MoE v2 approaches Qwen3 on several knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning alone, it outperforms SDAR Chat on seven of eight reasoning and coding benchmarks and remains close to Qwen3 on several tasks. These results establish practical scaling laws and design principles for MoE dLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统刻画了混合专家扩散语言模型 (MoE dLLM) 的扩展行为，指出其在优化超参数、计算分配与架构上与自回归模型的定量差异，并据此从零训练了 30B-A3B 的 LLaDA MoE v2。该模型用约 Qwen3 预训练 token 的 65% 即在知识、推理和编码基准上接近 Qwen3；仅经监督微调便在八个推理和编码基准中的七个上超过 SDAR Chat。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型是自回归建模的替代方案，但 MoE 扩散语言模型的扩展规律尚未被很好理解，缺少系统性的量化结论。
Method: 对 MoE dLLM 的优化超参数、计算分配和架构规模进行系统表征，通过 IsoFLOP 分析等识别扩展趋势，并依据这些发现训练 LLaDA MoE v2。
Result: 优化方面最优名义 batch size 增长更快、最优学习率随计算量衰减更快；IsoFLOP 显示数据侧略倾斜，最优 token 预算增长快于激活侧计算；更大规模偏好更大专家池，中等专家粒度保持有效，共享专家激活比例稳定。LLaDA MoE v2 以 23.5T token 训练后在多个基准上接近 Qwen3，并在监督微调后于八个推理与编码基准中的七个上优于 SDAR Chat。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果确立了 MoE dLLM 的实用扩展规律与设计原则。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces
papers.abstract_en: Data agents enable natural-language analytics over organizational workspaces, where relevant evidence may be scattered across databases, structured files, long documents, and multimedia. Existing benchmarks largely isolate structured querying, retrieval, or open-ended analysis, leaving heterogeneous evidence discovery, complete tabular outputs, and deterministic evaluation insufficiently unified. We introduce DataSpace, a benchmark in which data agents produce verifiable tabular results from task-local heterogeneous workspaces. It contains 410 cross-language tasks and 7,439 artifacts totaling 15.01 GB across CSV, JSON, SQLite, Markdown, PDF, and video. DataSpace also served as the official evaluation benchmark for the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents for Complex Data Analysis competition. Each agent receives only a question and workspace and returns the complete requested tabular result. We construct DataSpace with DataSpace-Builder, an execution-grounded framework comprising cross-language transformation, constraint-aware relational sampling, modality routing and artifact rendering, and human review and task repair by 11 domain experts. A deterministic evaluator performs header-invariant column alignment, type- and precision-aware normalization, and order-aware row comparison. Across six recently released frontier multimodal models and five widely used agent harnesses, the best accuracy reaches 66.34%, while harness choice creates a 15.36-point spread with the backbone fixed. Multimodal evidence integration and joins consistently reduce accuracy across all six backbones. These results show that DataSpace remains unsaturated and identify key challenges for improving data-agent reliability.
papers.comment: 8 pages of main text, 7 figures, with a supplementary appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DataSpace 是一个面向数据智能体 (data agent) 的基准，要求智能体仅凭问题与工作区，从异构工作区（CSV、JSON、SQLite、Markdown、PDF、视频）中产出可验证的完整表格结果。基准包含 410 个跨语言任务和 7,439 个工件，总规模 15.01 GB，并作为 KDD Cup 2026 数据智能体复杂数据分析竞赛的官方评测基准。摘要报告在六个前沿多模态模型与五个常见智能体框架上，最佳准确率为 66.34%，说明该基准尚未饱和。
Motivation: 现有基准大多把结构化查询、检索或开放式分析分开评测，缺乏对异构证据发现、完整表格输出和确定性评估的统一衡量，导致数据智能体在真实组织工作区上的可靠性难以系统比较。
Method: 提出 DataSpace-Builder 来构建基准，包含跨语言转换、约束感知的关系式采样 (constraint-aware relational sampling)、模态路由与工件渲染，以及 11 位领域专家的人工审查与任务修复；同时设计确定性评估器，执行表头不变的列对齐、类型与精度感知的归一化、以及顺序感知的行比较。
Result: 摘要报告在六个前沿多模态模型和五个智能体框架上，最佳准确率为 66.34%；固定骨干模型时，智能体框架的选择带来 15.36 个百分点的差距；跨全部六个骨干，多模态证据整合与连接 (join) 操作均稳定降低准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果表明 DataSpace 仍未被现有方法饱和，并指出了提升数据智能体可靠性的关键挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Balancing Efficiency and Efficacy: Training-Free Attention-Guided Switching Between Explicit and Latent Thoughts for MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) requires both fine-grained visual perception and rigorous logical deduction. Explicit text-based Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is computationally expensive and prone to visual hallucinations, while existing latent reasoning methods typically require costly training. Furthermore, directly adapting training-free LLM reasoning mechanisms to the multimodal setting yields unstable performance. We identify that this failure stems from their reliance on token-level entropy, which fundamentally conflates perceptual ambiguity (e.g., unclear visual details) with logical uncertainty (e.g., complex reasoning steps). To overcome this bottleneck, we present a novel training-free inference strategy for MLLMs that explicitly decouples perception and reasoning. We propose a novel metric, the vision-to-text attention ratio, to dynamically gauge the model's cognitive focus. Guided by this metric, our proposed framework, Attention-Guided Switching (AGS), adaptively triggers latent reasoning for perceptual tokens to preserve high-fidelity visual information in the continuous space, while enforcing explicit text generation for logical tokens to maintain structural anchoring. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly improving both accuracy and inference efficiency by reducing autoregressive steps and latency. Code is released at https://github.com/swordAndSnow/MM26-AGS.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的推理效率与准确率平衡问题，提出一种无需训练的推理策略 AGS（Attention-Guided Switching）。该方法通过视觉到文本注意力比率（vision-to-text attention ratio）动态判断模型当前的认知焦点，对感知类 token 触发隐式潜在推理以保留连续空间中的视觉细节，对逻辑类 token 强制显式文本生成以维持结构锚定。实验表明该方法在提升准确率的同时减少自回归步数和推理延迟。
Motivation: 显式文本链式思维（CoT）计算开销大且易产生视觉幻觉，而现有隐式推理方法通常需要昂贵的训练；直接迁移无训练的 LLM 推理机制到多模态场景性能不稳定，根源在于其基于 token 级熵的方法混淆了感知模糊性（如视觉细节不清）与逻辑不确定性（如复杂推理步骤）。
Method: 提出解耦感知与推理的训练无关推理框架 AGS。核心是定义视觉到文本注意力比率这一新指标来动态衡量模型认知焦点，据此在感知 token 上触发隐式潜在推理以保持高保真视觉信息，在逻辑 token 上强制显式文本生成以保持结构锚定。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在实验中达到最先进性能（state-of-the-art），并通过减少自回归步数和推理延迟在准确率与推理效率上均取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 本文认为显式解耦感知与推理、并以注意力引导切换隐式与显式思维，是提升 MLLM 推理效率和准确率的有效途径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文认为显式解耦感知与推理、并以注意力引导切换隐式与显式思维，是提升 MLLM 推理效率和准确率的有效途径。

papers.title: Approximate Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying a draft block with a target model in parallel. Under standard greedy verification, decoding stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, discarding the remaining target-scored suffix. Although accepting such a mismatch changes the decoding trajectory, it can make a contiguous suffix reusable when its tokens remain target-greedy under the realized prefix. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Approximate Speculative Decoding (ASD)}, a training-free verifier that replaces binary first-mismatch truncation with budgeted longest-prefix selection. ASD accepts selected mismatches subject to a local target-logit regret gate, a per-block exception cap, and a persistent request-level regret budget, then reuses the contiguous target-greedy suffix without additional approximate decisions or target-model forward passes. ASD requires neither a new draft model nor fine-tuning, and exactly reduces to standard greedy verification when the budget is zero. Experiments show that ASD improves fixed-workload throughput by $3.05\%$--$15.26\%$ over matched strict verification and averages a $7.78\%$ gain across seven Qwen3-14B + DSpark-14B tasks. On DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B) with DSpark it also raises verifier-side acceptance by roughly $10\%$--$16\%$ on GSM8K and MATH-500 in an FP4-to-FP8 compatibility setting. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Kissmetothemoon/ASD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出近似推测解码 (Approximate Speculative Decoding, ASD)，一种免训练的验证器，将标准贪心验证中的首次不匹配截断替换为带预算的最长前缀选择。ASD 在局部 target-logit 遗憾门控、每块异常上限和请求级遗憾预算约束下接受选定的不匹配 token，并复用连续的 target-greedy 后缀，无需额外目标模型前向传播。实验表明它能在固定工作负载下提升吞吐量，并在零预算时精确退化为标准贪心验证。
Motivation: 标准推测解码在第一个与目标 argmax 不一致的 draft token 处停止并丢弃已由目标模型评分的剩余后缀，造成计算浪费；作者认为接受这类不匹配可在 token 仍保持目标贪心的前提下复用连续后缀，从而提升解码效率。
Method: ASD 是一种无需训练和微调的验证器，用预算化的最长前缀选择取代二值化的首次不匹配截断；接受不匹配受局部 target-logit 遗憾门控、每块异常上限和持久请求级遗憾预算约束，随后复用连续的 target-greedy 后缀，不引入额外的近似决策或目标模型前向计算，预算为零时严格等价于标准贪心验证。
Result: 在固定工作负载下，ASD 较匹配的严格验证提升吞吐量 3.05%–15.26%，在七个 Qwen3-14B + DSpark-14B 任务上平均提升 7.78%；在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B) 配合 DSpark 的 FP4-to-FP8 兼容设置下，GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上的验证侧接受率提升约 10%–16%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ASD 无需新 draft 模型或微调即可提升推测解码吞吐量，并可平滑退化为标准验证；作者公开了源代码，但摘要未给出方法在更广泛任务或更长解码场景下的局限说明。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Low-Cost Hybrid Reservoir Computing Model for Isolated Sign Language Video Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Sign language recognition (SLR) enhances communication between hearing and hearing-impaired individuals. Although deep learning (DL) has achieved promising performance in SLR, its high computational cost limits deployment on edge devices. To address this challenge, we propose a lightweight reservoir computing (RC)-based approach for SLR. In the proposed method, MediaPipe extracts body and hand keypoints to capture the spatial and temporal dynamics of gestures. These keypoints are then processed by a hybrid reservoir computing (HRC) architecture that combines deep reservoir computing (DRC) and bidirectional reservoir computing (BRC), transforming the input into a high-dimensional dynamic representation. A ridge regression model maps the final HRC state to class labels. This HRC-based SLR method achieved Top-1, Top-5, and Top-10 accuracies of 61.12%, 86.05%, and 92.56%, respectively, on the Word-Level American Sign Language 100 (WLASL100) video dataset, demonstrating competitive performance compared to deep learning-based approaches. Additionally, due to the lightweight nature of RC, the training time was drastically reduced to only a few seconds compared with DL-based methods such as Bi-GRU.This method offers low computational cost, showing its potential for deployment on edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向孤立手语视频识别（SLR），提出一种基于储备池计算（reservoir computing, RC）的轻量级方法。MediaPipe 提取身体和手部关键点，随后由结合深度储备池计算（DRC）与双向储备池计算（BRC）的混合结构编码为高维动态表示，最后由岭回归映射到类别标签。在 WLASL100 数据集上取得 Top-1 61.12%、Top-5 86.05%、Top-10 92.56% 的准确率，训练时间仅需数秒。
Motivation: 深度学习在手语识别上性能好，但计算成本高，难以部署到边缘设备，需要低成本的替代方案。
Method: 使用 MediaPipe 提取人体与手部关键点以捕捉手势的时空动态，再通过混合储备池计算（HRC）架构，即深度储备池计算与双向储备池计算的结合，将输入变换为高维动态表示；最终用岭回归将 HRC 状态映射为类别。
Result: 在 Word-Level American Sign Language 100 (WLASL100) 数据集上，Top-1、Top-5 和 Top-10 准确率分别为 61.12%、86.05% 和 92.56%；与 Bi-GRU 等深度学习方法相比训练时间大幅缩短至数秒。
Conclusion: 该方法具备低计算成本，展示了在边缘设备上部署的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quality Control Algorithms for Pattern Counting
papers.abstract_en: In recent work, Marcussen, Rubinfeld, and Sudan introduced the notion of quality control problems, which aim to capture the task of determining if a given input is truly random. Formally, their goal is to accept typical inputs from the specified distribution while rejecting every input whose value of a specified statistic is far from the distributional baseline. This captures the empirical practice of using specified statistics as a proxy for the quality of randomness. Empirical algorithms, however, have not exploited the asymmetry in the definition of quality control problems, which require soundness guarantees in the worst-case while only seeking average-case completeness. Their work abstracted a problem definition emphasizing this asymmetry and used it to give efficient quality control algorithms for assessing the randomness of graphs. In this work, we introduce and study quality control problems over sequences, where the goal is to distinguish a sequence of i.i.d. characters from sequences where some specified pattern appears too often (or too infrequently) as a subsequence. We consider this problem in both the finite-alphabet setting and for real-valued sequences. We refer to the former setting as the pattern counting problem. In the latter case, the natural notion of a pattern is to consider the relative ordering of the characters in the subsequence, and we refer to this as the permutation pattern counting problem. Algorithms to approximately count (permutation) patterns of length $k$ in a worst-case sequence of length $n$ can provably require exponential in $k$ queries into the sequence. In contrast, we show that by taking advantage of the asymmetry in the definition of quality control, we give algorithms that run in poly$(k)$ time to solve these problems. We also prove that any quality control algorithm (over some natural distributions) requires superlinear queries in $k$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文延续 Marcussen、Rubinfeld 与 Sudan 提出的质量控制 (quality control) 问题框架，研究序列上的随机性检验：在有限字母表下区分 i.i.d. 字符序列与某个指定子序列模式出现过多或过少的序列，即模式计数问题 (pattern counting)；在实值序列下则考虑子序列中字符的相对顺序，即排列模式计数问题 (permutation pattern counting)。作者利用质量控制定义中“最坏情况可靠性 (soundness)、平均情况完备性 (completeness)”的不对称性，给出了 poly(k) 时间的算法，并证明任何质量控制算法在若干自然分布上都需要 k 的超线性查询。
Motivation: 经验上常用指定统计量作为随机性质量的代理，但已有经验算法没有利用质量控制定义中的不对称性。此前相关工作只处理图的随机性检验，本文将其推广到序列与模式出现频率，目标是区分真正的 i.i.d. 序列与某些子序列模式出现频率偏离基线的序列。
Method: 分别定义有限字母表上的模式计数问题和实值序列上的排列模式计数问题，并利用质量控制问题中最坏情况 soundness 与平均情况 completeness 的不对称性来设计 poly(k) 时间算法，避开一般近似计数算法在最坏情形下所需的指数级查询。
Result: 摘要指出，对长度为 k 的模式，在最坏情形序列中近似计数 (permutation) 模式可证明需要指数级查询；而本文给出的质量控制算法只需 poly(k) 时间。此外，作者证明任何质量控制算法（在若干自然分布上）都需要 k 的超线性 (superlinear) 查询。
Conclusion: 本文表明利用质量控制定义中的不对称性可以大幅降低序列模式计数类随机性检验的复杂度，但同时也存在关于查询复杂度的超线性下界；结论覆盖有限字母表与实值序列两种设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamically Allocating Evaluation Effort for Model Ranking
papers.abstract_en: While human evaluation is the gold standard in many NLP tasks, it suffers from prohibitive costs and poor scalability. When identifying top-performing models, typical evaluation protocols waste effort by exhaustively evaluating all models on the entire benchmark, a safe but inefficient approach. In this work, we formalize multi-model human evaluation as a best-arm identification problem in a multi-armed bandit setup with correlated arms, where pulling an arm corresponds to human-evaluating a model. By sampling adaptively based on the intermediate model rankings obtained on the samples so far, we can focus the annotation budget on the most competitive models. We prove the optimality of the proposed algorithms and show that it improves discrimination between top-performing models. This makes evaluations faster, cheaper and more aligned with large-scale competition evaluation goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将多模型人工评估形式化为多臂老虎机 (multi-armed bandit) 中的最优臂识别 (best-arm identification) 问题，其中拉动一个臂对应人工评估一个模型。通过根据已采样样本得到的中间模型排序进行自适应采样，可以把标注预算集中在最有竞争力的模型上。作者证明了所提算法的最优性，并显示其改善了对顶级模型的区分度。
Motivation: 人工评估虽是许多 NLP 任务的金标准，但成本高昂且可扩展性差；常规评估协议会在整个基准上穷尽评估所有模型，安全但低效，浪费宝贵预算。
Method: 将多模型人工评估建模为带相关臂的 multi-armed bandit 最优臂识别问题，依据当前已得的中间排名自适应选择下一个要评估的模型，从而聚焦预算于最有竞争力的模型。
Result: 摘要声称证明了提出算法的最优性，并表明该方法提升了顶级模型之间的区分度；未给出具体评测数字或基准。
Conclusion: 该方法能使评估更快、更便宜，并更契合大规模竞赛评估的目标；摘要未讨论领域外适用性或具体局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedRings: A Scalable and Topology-Aware Federated Learning Framework for LEO Satellite Constellations
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning over low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks is limited by frequent link changes, short contact times, and a highly dynamic topology, making centralized or synchronized training inefficient and hard to scale. To address this, we propose FedRings, a decentralized framework that organizes satellites into ring-based communication structures. It uses a spatio-temporal routing strategy with link-aware communication scheduling to align model exchange with actual visibility windows and time-varying connectivity patterns in LEO. Model updates are propagated along the ring using adaptive sparse incremental aggregation, which reduces communication overhead by progressively combining and compressing updates. To handle communication interruptions, a historical compensation mechanism maintains training continuity. By combining topology-aware routing, communication scheduling, and efficient aggregation, FedRings enables stable and efficient learning in dynamic LEO networks while reducing communication cost, and experiments show it consistently outperforms existing methods in realistic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedRings，一个面向低地球轨道 (LEO) 卫星星座的去中心化联邦学习框架。该框架将卫星组织成环状通信结构，结合时空路由与链路感知调度来匹配实际可见窗口，并使用自适应稀疏增量聚合降低通信开销，同时用历史补偿机制应对通信中断。实验表明，在现实设置下 FedRings 一致优于现有方法，并显著降低通信成本。
Motivation: LEO 卫星网络的频繁链路变化、短接触时间和高度动态拓扑使集中式或同步联邦学习效率低下且难以扩展，现有方法难以在真实卫星环境中稳定训练。
Method: 提出基于环状通信结构的去中心化框架 FedRings，包含时空路由策略、链路感知通信调度、自适应稀疏增量聚合，以及用于维持训练连续性的历史补偿机制。
Result: 摘要报告 FedRings 在现实 LEO 网络设置下的一致优于现有方法，并在提升学习稳定性和效率的同时降低通信开销。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合拓扑感知路由、通信调度与高效聚合的策略能够支持动态 LEO 网络中的稳定高效联邦学习。

summary_sections.motivation: LEO 卫星网络的频繁链路变化、短接触时间和高度动态拓扑使集中式或同步联邦学习效率低下且难以扩展，现有方法难以在真实卫星环境中稳定训练。
summary_sections.method: 提出基于环状通信结构的去中心化框架 FedRings，包含时空路由策略、链路感知通信调度、自适应稀疏增量聚合，以及用于维持训练连续性的历史补偿机制。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 FedRings 在现实 LEO 网络设置下的一致优于现有方法，并在提升学习稳定性和效率的同时降低通信开销。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为结合拓扑感知路由、通信调度与高效聚合的策略能够支持动态 LEO 网络中的稳定高效联邦学习。

papers.title: Stop Replacing Noise with Noise: Two-Source Reliability Assessment for Label Correction and Sample Reweighting in Label-Noise Learning
papers.abstract_en: Refurbishment-based noisy-label learning mixes an observed label with a model-derived pseudo target, typically using one sample-wise cleanliness score to control both branches. This creates a hidden coupling: reducing trust in the observed label automatically increases trust in the pseudo target. We show that this complementarity can replace one unreliable signal with another because a pseudo target learned from corrupted supervision may reproduce the noise it is meant to correct. Our representation diagnostics provide a consistent account of this mismatch: noisy supervision redirects deeper layers more strongly, whereas shallower relations remain comparatively stable and provide information beyond the loss posterior. We therefore propose TRACE, a Two-Source Reliability Assessment framework for Label Correction and Sample Reweighting. TRACE assesses the observed label using loss fit, shallow relation stability, and prediction agreement, while separately assessing the pseudo target using model confidence. Its source-specific scores control target correction and supervision strength without assuming complementary reliability. Across synthetic and real-world noisy benchmarks, TRACE improves representative refurbishment baselines and yields more reliable pseudo supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于翻新 (refurbishment) 的噪声标签学习中存在隐藏耦合：用一个样本级干净度分数同时控制观测标签与模型伪目标，会因互补性而用一个不可靠信号替换另一个不可靠信号。作者提出 TRACE 双源可靠性评估框架，分别评估观测标签与伪目标的可信度，并据此控制标签校正与监督权重。在合成与真实噪声基准上，TRACE 提升了代表性翻新基线并产生更可靠的伪监督。
Motivation: 现有翻新式噪声标签学习通常假定观测标签与伪目标的可靠性互补，但这种互补性可能导致伪目标复现它本应修正的噪声，从而用新噪声替换旧噪声。
Method: TRACE 分别评估两个来源：对观测标签使用损失拟合 (loss fit)、浅层关系稳定性 (shallow relation stability) 和预测一致性 (prediction agreement) 三个指标；对伪目标则仅使用模型置信度 (model confidence)。源特定的分数控制目标校正与监督强度，不再假设两个来源的可靠性互补。
Result: 表示诊断显示噪声监督对更深层的影响更强，而浅层关系相对稳定且能提供超越损失后验 (loss posterior) 的信息。在合成和真实世界噪声基准上，TRACE 改进多种代表性翻新基线并提升伪监督的可靠性。
Conclusion: 作者主张将观测标签与伪目标作为两个独立可靠性来源分别评估，可以避免噪声替换问题，从而实现更稳健的标签校正与样本重加权。

papers.title: Dual-domain U-Nets with embedded back projection operators for motion-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Four-dimensional cone beam CT (4D CBCT) is important for image-guided radiation therapy of thoracic cancers, but its use is limited by long scan times, causing high patient dose and motion/sparse-sampling artifacts. We propose a deep learning method for motion-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction from conventional free-breathing scans, without a respiratory signal or explicit projection binning. Our CNN takes free-breathing 3D CBCT projections as input and predicts a static volume at maximum inhalation plus ten displacement vector fields (DVFs) spanning a breathing cycle. The network extends U-Net: the encoder acts on filtered projection stacks, the decoder acts in the volume domain, and skip connections are replaced with non-trainable back-projection functions at multiple resolutions to transfer features between domains. The model is trained on simulated CBCT scans and evaluated on 11 unseen simulated patients and 13 clinical free-breathing scans. Two additional models (60 s and 6 s scans) were evaluated by clinical experts on three and two scans, comparing single phases of our 4D reconstruction to reference 3D SART-TV images for tumor and esophagus visibility. Experts preferred our method for tumor visibility (59% vs. 36% no preference, 5% reference) and esophagus visibility (47% vs. 42%, 11%). On simulated data, image quality matched SART-TV (mean RMSE: -1.19 HU, PSNR: +0.09 dB, SSIM: -0.009) while enabling 4D reconstruction. On clinical scans, our method showed sharper dynamic structures (e.g., diaphragm) and fewer motion streak artifacts than traditional reconstruction. This non-patient-specific CNN predicts static volumes and full 4D respiratory motion models from a single free-breathing scan, without a respiratory surrogate or projection binning, reducing motion artifacts while adding motion-modeling capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于运动分辨 4D CBCT 重建的深度学习方法，可从常规自由呼吸扫描中直接重建，无需呼吸信号或显式投影分箱 (projection binning)。网络以 U-Net 为基础：编码器处理滤波投影堆栈，解码器工作在体数据域，并用多分辨率下不可训练的反投影 (back-projection) 函数替代跳跃连接，预测最大吸气时的静态体数据外加覆盖一个呼吸周期的十个位移矢量场 (DVF)。模型在模拟数据上训练，并在 11 个未见过的模拟患者与 13 个临床自由呼吸扫描上评估。
Motivation: 4D CBCT 对胸部肿瘤的图像引导放疗很重要，但长扫描时间导致高患者剂量以及运动/稀疏采样伪影，限制了其临床应用。
Method: CNN 直接以自由呼吸的 3D CBCT 投影为输入，输出最大吸气静态体数据和十个覆盖呼吸周期的 DVFs。网络扩展了 U-Net：编码器作用于滤波后的投影堆栈，解码器作用于体数据域，跳跃连接被多分辨率下的不可训练反投影函数替代，以在两个域间传递特征。
Result: 在模拟数据上图像质量与 SART-TV 相当（平均 RMSE -1.19 HU，PSNR +0.09 dB，SSIM -0.009），同时实现 4D 重建。临床专家对肿瘤可见性的偏好为 59% 支持本方法、36% 无偏好、5% 支持参考；食管可见性为 47% vs 42%，11% 无偏好。临床扫描中本方法显示更锐利的动态结构（如膈肌）和更少的运动条纹伪影。
Conclusion: 该非患者特异性 CNN 能从单次自由呼吸扫描中预测静态体数据和完整 4D 呼吸运动模型，无需呼吸替代信号或投影分箱，在减少运动伪影的同时增加了运动建模能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SLAMFormer-$\infty$: Infinite SLAM Transformer for Unbounded Frontend and Backend Processing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Infinite SLAM Transformer (SLAMFormer-$\infty$), the first geometric transformer capable of supporting both long-range frontend and backend processing without an explicit distance bound. Instead of relying on a first-frame-anchored formulation, SLAMFormer-$\infty$ employs memory conditions to define flexible coordinate systems and scales for input frames, enabling more expressive structural conditioning. Built upon this formulation, the frontend preserves efficient local computation, while the backend jointly optimizes long-range trajectories and scene geometry in a globally consistent manner. Experimental results demonstrate that SLAMFormer-$\infty$ achieves superior or highly competitive performance in both trajectory estimation and scene reconstruction across large-scale datasets. Notably, SLAMFormer-$\infty$ generalizes to extremely long trajectories, successfully operating on sequences exceeding $17\mathrm{km}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLAMFormer-∞，一种无需显式距离界限的几何 Transformer，用于同时支持长距离前端和后端处理。它用内存条件 (memory conditions) 定义输入帧的灵活坐标系与尺度，取代首帧锚定公式，使前端保持局部高效计算，后端对长时间轨迹与场景几何进行全局一致联合优化。实验显示其在大型数据集上轨迹估计与场景重建表现优越，并能泛化到超过 17km 的极长轨迹。
Motivation: 现有 SLAM 公式依赖首帧锚定或显式距离界限，难以统一支持无边界的长距离前端与后端处理，该工作旨在用更灵活的结构条件实现无距离界限的 SLAM。
Method: 引入内存条件来定义输入帧的坐标系和尺度，构建 SLAMFormer-∞；在前端保持局部高效计算，在后端联合优化长时间轨迹与场景几何以实现全局一致性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在大型数据集上的轨迹估计和场景重建达到优越或极具竞争力的性能，并能成功处理超过 17km 的极长轨迹。
Conclusion: 摘要强调用内存条件替代首帧锚定，可以构造无显式距离界限的几何 Transformer，使前后端同时支持极长序列处理。

papers.title: OliveGemma: A 3 Billion Visual Language Model for Recognising the Mediterranean & European Diet
papers.abstract_en: Image based dietary assessment offers a scalable alternative to self reported food diaries, yet fine-grained food recognition remains challenging due to high intra-class variability and visually similar dishes. This study presents OliveGemma, a vision language model for recognising and reasoning about Mediterranean and European cuisine. Built on the open-weight PaliGemma-2-3B architecture, OliveGemma is fine-tuned with LoRA on a unified corpus of 17,340 images from three European research project datasets (MedGR, ODIN, and VIPPSTAR), reconciled into a vocabulary of 216 composed dish categories and paired with 102,642 instruction style question-answer items covering dish recognition, likely and visible ingredients, class boundary discrimination, visual evidence and overall visual food understanding. Under a 3-fold cross-validation scheme, OliveGemma achieves a top-1 accuracy of 92.96% +/- 0.91%, exceeding the strongest CNN baseline (DenseNet-121) by 7.31% and outperforming zero-shot frontier models with exact instructions and bounded classes including Gemini Flash 3 and 3.5, GPT-5.4 Mini, and Claude Haiku 4.6 by 8%, 46%, and 64% respectively. Furthermore, OliveGemma demonstrates competitive performance on Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy, being second best across CNNs and frontier models, surpassed only by DenseNet-121. In addition, OliveGemma achieves 90.79% +/- 1.3% Exact-Set on the likely ingredients of the food categories. These results demonstrate that PEFT adaptation of a small VLM can surpass substantially larger proprietary models on specialised food recognition. The model is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/JamesZar/OliveGemma-3B and the experiments and results can be found at https://github.com/tsiokris/OliveGemma.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OliveGemma，一个基于开源权重 PaliGemma-2-3B 架构、用 LoRA 微调的视觉语言模型，用于地中海与欧洲饮食的细粒度食物识别和推理。模型在统一整理的 17,340 张图像、216 个组合菜肴类别和 102,642 个指令式问答对上进行训练；3 折交叉验证下 top-1 准确率达 92.96% ± 0.91%，超过最强 CNN 基线 DenseNet-121 7.31%，并在类似设定下优于多个零样本前沿模型。
Motivation: 基于图像的饮食评估为替代自我报告式食物日记提供了可扩展方案，但细粒度食物识别因类内差异大、菜品视觉相似而仍然困难，现有通用模型在专门食物领域表现有限。
Method: 在 PaliGemma-2-3B 上使用 LoRA 进行参数高效微调（PEFT），将 MedGR、ODIN、VIPPSTAR 三个欧洲研究项目数据集统一为 216 个组合菜肴类别，并配以 102,642 个指令式问答对，涵盖菜肴识别、可能成分与可见成分、类别边界判别、视觉证据和整体视觉食物理解。
Result: 3 折交叉验证下 top-1 准确率 92.96% ± 0.91%，比 DenseNet-121 高 7.31%；在带精确指令和有界类别的设定下，分别超过 Gemini Flash 3 和 3.5、GPT-5.4 Mini、Claude Haiku 4.6 约 8%、46%、64%。Top-3 和 Top-5 准确率居第二，仅次于 DenseNet-121；在食物类别可能成分的 Exact-Set 上达到 90.79% ± 1.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调参数高效微调的小型 VLM 能在专门食物识别任务上超越体积大得多的专有模型，并公开了模型权重和实验代码。
