papers.title: State Propagation Also Satisfies: A Complex-Valued State-Space Model for Deterministic State Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based architectures have dominated sequence modeling, largely due to the expressive power of attention mechanisms. However, for a class of deterministic state tracking tasks---such as parity checking, modular counting, and parenthesis matching---attention may be overkill. In this paper, we show that \textbf{state propagation alone is sufficient}. We propose the \textbf{Complex State Propagator (CSP)}, a minimalistic recurrent architecture that \textbf{only propagates hidden states} across layers without output projections at intermediate steps. The state is represented as a complex-valued vector, updated via input-dependent rotations in the complex domain. To enable deep propagation without gradient vanishing or degradation, we introduce a \textbf{block-level skip connection} alongside element-wise complex normalization and SiLU activation at sequence boundaries. Applied with Focal Loss, CSP achieves \textbf{100\% accuracy} with perfect F1 scores across canonical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究确定性状态跟踪任务（如奇偶校验、模计数、括号匹配），提出仅依赖状态传播的极简循环架构 Complex State Propagator (CSP)。CSP 用复值向量表示状态，通过输入相关的复数域旋转更新状态，并引入块级跳跃连接、逐元素复数归一化与序列边界的 SiLU 激活来支持深层传播。配合 Focal Loss，CSP 在规范任务上达到 100% 准确率与完美 F1 分数，说明注意力机制并非这类任务所必需。
Motivation: Transformer 依靠注意力机制获得强大表达能力，但对于奇偶校验、模计数、括号匹配等确定性状态跟踪任务，注意力可能过于冗余；作者试图证明单纯的状态传播就足以解决这类问题。
Method: 提出 Complex State Propagator (CSP)，一种仅在层间传播隐藏状态、中间步骤不做输出投影的循环架构；状态以复值向量表示，经输入依赖的复数域旋转更新，并配合块级跳跃连接、逐元素复数归一化以及序列边界的 SiLU 激活避免深层传播中的梯度消失与退化，最终使用 Focal Loss 训练。
Result: 摘要报告 CSP 在规范的状态跟踪任务上达到 100% 准确率与完美的 F1 分数。
Conclusion: 作者认为对于确定性状态跟踪这类任务，仅靠状态传播即可满足需求，注意力机制并非必要；但摘要未讨论方法在更广泛或非确定性任务上的适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SGFormer: Structure-Guided Transformer for Robust Local Feature Matching
papers.abstract_en: Local feature matching is a fundamental component of photogrammetry, enabling accurate image correspondence critical for tasks such as 3D reconstruction, stereo mapping, and visual localization. While recent detector-free matching methods, like LoFTR, have advanced the field, the global features obtained by leveraging the global-range modeling capacity of the unconstrained attention mechanism compromise the model's attention to the salient structures in certain scenarios. This limitation leads to a phenomenon we define as attention divergence, wherein a portion of high-confidence matches are distributed outside the valid matching region (overlapping region), especially in scenes with large viewpoint variations. This occurs because similar features in irrelevant regions may receive equal weighting and consideration within the standard Transformer, limiting matching reliability in challenging photogrammetric environments. To address this issue in feature matching, we propose SGFormer (Structure-Guided Transformer), a novel structure-aware matching network that adaptively updates attention on features near salient structure in overlapping regions. SGFormer employs a semi-dense coarse-to-fine pipeline and incorporates the proposed Triple-Structure-Attention (TSA) module into the backbone net for extracting distinctive features. The TSA module utilizes shallow local features from early network layers to enhance the representation around salient structure, guiding subsequent transformer stages to intensify the model's focus on regions with salient structure across the global scope. SGFormer, thereby reinforcing attention to visually consistent areas while mitigating the influence of non-overlapping regions. Extensive experiments show that SGFormer significantly mitigates attention divergence and improves matching accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无检测器局部特征匹配方法（如 LoFTR）在全局注意力下对显著结构关注不足的问题，提出结构引导的 Transformer 匹配网络 SGFormer。其核心是引入 Triple-Structure-Attention（TSA）模块，利用浅层局部特征增强重叠区域内显著结构附近的表示，从而引导后续 Transformer 阶段加强对视觉一致区域的关注。实验表明该方法显著缓解注意力发散并提升匹配精度。
Motivation: 现有 detector-free 匹配方法依赖无约束注意力的全局建模，但全局特征在部分场景中会削弱对显著结构的关注，导致高置信匹配落在非重叠区域（称为注意力发散），尤其在大视角变化场景下影响匹配可靠性。
Method: 提出 SGFormer，采用半稠密 coarse-to-fine 流水线，并在主干网络中集成 TSA 模块。TSA 利用早期网络层的浅层局部特征增强显著结构周围的表示，引导后续 Transformer 在全局范围内聚焦于重叠区域中的显著结构，抑制非重叠区域的影响。
Result: 大量实验表明 SGFormer 能显著缓解注意力发散现象，并提高匹配精度。摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过结构引导的注意力更新可以强化对视觉一致区域的关注，从而提升挑战性摄影测量环境下的匹配可靠性。摘要未提及明确局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HyperbolicDiffusion: Sharp & Scalable Tiled Generation on the Hyperbolic Plane
papers.abstract_en: Planar tiled diffusion denoises overlapping windows of one rectangular canvas. The hyperbolic plane has no such canvas, and its area grows exponentially with radius. We introduce HyperbolicDiffusion, a training-free method for generating finite visual fields directly on the hyperbolic plane H2. Our Hyperbolic Blooming Cover reduces window placement to a compact dynamic program that runs in seconds while providing strong theoretical guarantees. Permanent surface IDs form a shared latent canvas: a standard diffusion model denoises local windows, whose predictions are fused back onto H2. Because curvature causes residual disagreement and blur at multi-window junctions, a geometry-derived second stage re-noises and repairs precisely those regions. The resulting fields are sharp, reprojectable, and consistent across viewpoints, providing a prompt-driven generative counterpart to Escher's Circle Limit series.
papers.comment: Work in progress. Updated version incoming
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperbolicDiffusion，一种无需训练的方法，直接在双曲平面 H2 上生成有限视觉场。其 Hyperbolic Blooming Cover 将窗口放置简化为一个运行只需数秒的紧致动态规划，并提供理论保证；永久表面 ID 构成共享潜在画布，标准扩散模型去噪局部窗口后将预测融合回 H2。由于曲率导致多窗口接缝处出现残差不一致和模糊，第二阶段基于几何对精确区域重新加噪并修复。摘要称生成场锐利、可重投影且跨视角一致，是 Escher Circle Limit 系列的提示驱动生成对应物。
Motivation: 平面平铺扩散通过在矩形画布上重叠窗口来去噪，但双曲平面没有这样的全局画布，且其面积随半径指数增长，因此需要一种直接在 H2 上生成视觉场的方法。
Method: 提出训练免费的 HyperbolicDiffusion：先用 Hyperbolic Blooming Cover 把窗口放置转化为紧凑动态规划，再由标准扩散模型对局部窗口去噪，并借助永久表面 ID 作为共享潜在画布将预测融合回 H2；随后用几何推导的第二阶段对曲率引起的接缝模糊区域重新加噪并修复。
Result: 摘要未提供定量指标，仅报告生成场是锐利的、可重投影的且跨视角一致。
Conclusion: 该方法作为提示驱动的生成模型，提供了对 Escher Circle Limit 系列的一种对应实现；摘要未明确说明当前局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Improving Sequential Decision-Making in LLM Agents via Experience Memory
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have improved substantially on single-shot reasoning tasks, but their performance in sequential decision-making is less well understood. We study this on fully-observable two-player zero-sum games, which provide ground-truth evaluation: outcomes are determined by the rules, and optimality of individual moves can be computed or approximated, without relying on a judge model. Across model tiers, LLMs play suboptimally in simple games such as tic-tac-toe or Connect Four, and lose to MCTS opponents. Obfuscations that preserve the game tree but rewrite its surface form leave performance largely unchanged, indicating the gap is not fully explained by recall of memorized strategies. Motivated by this performance gap, we introduce an agentic framework enhanced with an experience memory designed for the sequential setting and addressing common challenges of sequential decision-making such as credit assignment. We show that post-game reflection and rule extraction yield measurable improvements on tic-tac-toe without modifying the model weights.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables, 5 appendices, accepted at Neuro-Symbolic Intelligence for LLMs and Autonomous Agents workshop at IJCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在顺序决策 (sequential decision-making) 任务中的表现，使用完全可观测的两人零和博弈作为有真实标注的评测环境。摘要报告称，不同规模的 LLM 在井字棋 (tic-tac-toe) 和四子棋 (Connect Four) 等简单游戏中表现欠佳，且会输给 MCTS 对手；即使对游戏表面形式进行无关改写，性能也基本不变，说明差距不能完全归因于记忆策略。作者由此提出带经验记忆 (experience memory) 的智能体框架，在不修改模型权重的情况下，通过赛后反思和规则提取在井字棋上取得可测的提升。
Motivation: LLM 在单步推理任务上已有显著进步，但顺序决策能力尚未被充分理解；作者希望在不依赖评委模型 (judge model) 的情况下，用规则决定结果且可计算最优步的博弈环境提供真实标注评测。
Method: 采用完全可观测的两人零和博弈作为评测环境，并提出一个针对顺序决策场景、结合经验记忆的智能体框架，核心包括赛后反思 (post-game reflection) 与规则提取，以应对信用分配 (credit assignment) 等顺序决策常见挑战。
Result: 摘要显示 LLM 在简单博弈中表现次优并输给 MCTS 对手；保持博弈树不变但改写表面形式的混淆处理几乎不影响性能；所提框架在不改变模型权重的情况下，在井字棋上带来可测提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 在顺序决策上的差距并非完全由记忆策略解释，经验记忆增强的智能体框架是改善此类任务的有效方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Task Multi-Frame Visual Piano Transcription
papers.abstract_en: Audio-based piano transcription performs well on onset, pitch, and velocity, but the sustain pedal lets sound persist long after key release, so audio systems predict pedal-extended offsets rather than physical key release. Yet existing Visual Piano Transcription (VPT) systems focus on onset detection from short video windows, offset accuracy lags onset by a wide margin, and note-level velocity has not been reported. To address these gaps, we present V2N (Video to Notes), the first complete VPT system: a shared temporal backbone feeds task-specific heads for onset, offset, key hold, and velocity, jointly trained with per-frame supervision rather than only at the window center. Ablations show that multi-task supervision enables offset and velocity prediction while improving onset accuracy; longer temporal context yields further improvements. V2N sets new state-of-the-art results on PianoVAM and R3.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval (ISMIR) Conference, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V2N (Video to Notes)，据称是首个完整的视觉钢琴转录 (Visual Piano Transcription, VPT) 系统：共享时间骨干网络后接 onset、offset、key hold 与 velocity 四个任务头，并在整个帧序列上以逐帧监督联合训练，而非仅在窗口中心监督。消融实验表明多任务逐帧监督使 offset 与 velocity 预测成为可能，同时提升 onset 精度，更长的时间上下文带来进一步改善。V2N 在 PianoVAM 与 R3 基准上取得新的最优结果。
Motivation: 音频钢琴转录在延音踏板作用下会预测踏板延长的偏移而非物理释键，而现有 VPT 系统只关注短窗口上的 onset 检测，offset 精度与 onset 差距大，且未报告音符级 velocity，缺少一个完整的视频钢琴转录框架。
Method: 提出 V2N 架构，使用共享时间骨干网络提取特征，分别接入 onset、offset、key hold 和 velocity 的任务专用头；训练时对整个视频帧序列施加逐帧监督，而非仅对窗口中心帧监督，实现多任务联合学习。
Result: 消融实验显示多任务逐帧监督能够支持 offset 与 velocity 预测，并同时提高 onset 精度；更长的时间上下文会带来额外提升。V2N 在 PianoVAM 和 R3 上取得了新的最先进结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调 V2N 是第一个完整的 VPT 系统，核心在于多任务与逐帧监督的联合训练；摘要未讨论该方法的局限性或失败案例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI World Cup 2026: Benchmarking Large Language Models for End-to-End Football Tournament Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are now regularly asked to forecast real-world events, but comparisons are often difficult because models receive different information, use different tools, and are evaluated under different rules. This paper reports the completed \emph{AI World Cup} benchmark, in which ten LLM-based assistants made a single pre-tournament forecast of the entire 2026 FIFA World Cup. Every submission used the same tournament snapshot, prompt, JSON schema, and scoring procedure. The forecasts covered group-stage scores, group rankings, the knockout bracket, final placings, confidence values, and short explanations. After all 104 matches had been played, GPT-5.5 Thinking finished first with 744 points, followed by GPT-5.5 with 717, Gemini with 699, and Qwen 3.7 with 687. GPT-5.5 Thinking was also the only model to select Spain, which defeated Argentina 1--0 in the final, as champion. The final ranking was driven mainly by knockout performance: total score was strongly correlated with knockout points ($r=0.986$), but showed little relationship with group-stage match points ($r=0.055$), group-standing points ($r=-0.103$), or their combined pre-knockout score ($r=-0.054$). Match-level accuracy produced a different ordering. Claude Sonnet 4.6 correctly predicted the largest number of group-stage outcomes (63.89\%) but placed sixth overall. Average self-reported confidence was also unrelated to either outcome accuracy ($r=-0.060$) or total score ($r=-0.067$). The results suggest that forecasting a complete tournament tests something different from predicting matches one at a time, while also showing how strongly a bracket-based leaderboard can depend on scoring design. The benchmark materials, raw responses, and scoring code are released to support replication and future extensions.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Project repository available in the paper

TL;DR: 本文报告完成的人工智能世界杯基准（AI World Cup），让十个 LLM 助手在赛前对 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯整个赛程做单次预测，所有提交使用相同的赛事快照、提示、JSON schema 和评分流程。GPT-5.5 Thinking 以 744 分排名第一，且是唯一预测西班牙夺冠（决赛 1-0 胜阿根廷）的模型。分析显示总排名主要由淘汰赛得分驱动（r=0.986），与小组赛阶段的得分几乎无关，匹配级准确率则会给出不同的模型排序。

Method: 构建 AI World Cup 基准：十个 LLM 助手使用相同的赛事快照、提示、JSON schema 和评分流程，对整个 2026 世界杯做单次赛前预测，覆盖小组赛比分、小组排名、淘汰赛赛程、最终名次、置信度与简短解释；全部 104 场比赛结束后统一评分并发布基准材料与评分代码。
Result: GPT-5.5 Thinking 以 744 分夺冠，GPT-5.5 717 分、Gemini 699 分、Qwen 3.7 687 分；总分数与淘汰赛得分强相关（r=0.986），与小组赛比赛得分（r=0.055）、小组排名得分（r=-0.103）及赛前综合得分（r=-0.054）几乎无关。Claude Sonnet 4.6 正确预测最多的小组赛结果（63.89%）却总排名第六；自报置信度与结果准确率（r=-0.060）和总分（r=-0.067）均无关联。
Conclusion: 作者认为完整赛事的端到端预测所考验的能力不同于逐场预测，且基于淘汰赛 bracket 的排行榜在很大程度上取决于评分设计；基准材料、原始回答和评分代码已公开以支持复现与后续扩展。

papers.title: Enactive Artificial Intelligence: A Decision-Centric Architecture for Complex Systems
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI) continues to evolve and mature, recent AI practices have moved beyond large language models (LLMs) and text or image generation tasks, increasingly integrating tools, agents, and harnesses to solve real business and industrial problems. However, the power of AI is not verified under these real-world complex systems for various reasons, considering reliability, feasibility, resilience, and responsibility requirements in real commercial and industrial operations. This study synthesizes adjacent research and introduces Enactive AI as a conceptual framework for enterprise and industry reasoning, site-level decision support, and execution feedback. Four complementary roles organize the framework: an Organizational World defines operations management logic and an organizational behavior world model behind an enterprise from a strategic-institutional horizon; a Site World defines a physically bounded industrial optimization and execution world model from an operational-realization horizon; Schema Intelligence provides the coupling mechanism between two world models to weave various AI applications via two models; and Enactive Decision Cycle triggers the self-evolving dynamic process to update and audit the entire framework. By foregrounding decision intelligence in complex systems, Enactive AI expands the frontier of AI from model capability to system-aware action, opening new possibilities for scalable, governable, and socially valuable AI deployment. Enactive AI points toward a future in which AI progress is measured not only by what models can generate or automate, but by how reliably intelligent systems can support consequential action, responsible governance, and durable social value in the complex systems that shape modern life, which we believe will define the next frontier of AI research for enterprise-level and industrial complex systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Enactive AI 概念框架，面向企业和工业复杂系统的决策智能，包含 Organizational World、Site World、Schema Intelligence 与 Enactive Decision Cycle 四个互补角色，目标是让 AI 从模型能力走向系统感知的可靠行动。文章定位为 conceptual framework，整合相邻研究，强调在复杂系统中支持决策、执行反馈与治理。
Motivation: 现有 AI 实践已超越大语言模型和文本/图像生成，开始集成工具与智能体解决真实业务问题，但在真实商业和工业复杂系统中，AI 的可靠性、可行性、韧性、责任性等需求未得到验证，缺乏面向系统级决策支持的统一框架。
Method: 提出 Enactive AI 框架：Organizational World 从战略-制度视界建立企业运营管理与组织行为世界模型；Site World 从运营-实现视界建立物理有界的工业优化与执行世界模型；Schema Intelligence 提供两个世界模型的耦合机制以编排 AI 应用；Enactive Decision Cycle 触发自演化动态过程来更新和审计整个框架。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验或定量结果，主要贡献是概念框架的构建以及对 AI 前沿从模型能力扩展到系统感知行动的论述。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Enactive AI 为企业和工业复杂系统中的可扩展、可治理且具社会价值的 AI 部署开辟新可能，并主张未来 AI 进展应以智能系统在复杂系统中支持可靠行动、负责任治理和持久社会价值的程度来衡量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Earth Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Earth observation is moving from foundation models that users must run themselves toward embedding products that package model feature outputs as reusable data without needing to download and process the imagery used to generate them. Earth embeddings are vectors that summarize locations, image patches, or pixels, letting users analyze compact features instead of repeatedly training or running large models on raw satellite imagery. This chapter explains the main types of Earth embeddings, from implicit location encoders to explicit patch and pixel products, and compares their coverage, resolution, dimensionality, storage cost, licenses, and reproducibility. We review their use in land cover and crop mapping, ecological and hazard modeling, socioeconomic prediction, and semantic search, with evidence on when embeddings improve on conventional features and when pooling, fusion, or spatial transfer limit performance. Two case studies show practical workflows for similarity search and land cover mapping. We close with guidance for choosing, evaluating, storing, compressing, and publishing embeddings, and with open problems in oceanic and atmospheric coverage, uncertainty, and benchmarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于地球观测嵌入（Earth embeddings）的书章，系统梳理了从隐式位置编码器到显式图像块和像素嵌入产品的主要类型，并比较其覆盖范围、分辨率、维度、存储成本、许可证和可复现性。章中回顾了嵌入在土地覆盖、作物制图、生态与灾害建模、社会经济预测和语义搜索中的应用，给出何时嵌入优于传统特征的证据，以及池化、融合和空间迁移限制性能的情形。最后以相似性搜索和土地覆盖制图两个案例展示实践流程，并提出海洋与大气覆盖、不确定性和基准测试等开放问题。
Motivation: 地球观测正在从用户自行运行的基础模型转向可直接复用的嵌入产品，用户无需下载和处理原始卫星影像即可分析紧凑特征。作者认为需要对此类嵌入产品进行系统化的类型梳理、性质比较和应用评估，以帮助用户理解和选择。
Method: 本文章节性方法包括：分类介绍地球嵌入的主要类型（隐式位置编码器、显式图像块和像素产品），对比其多维度属性，综述各类下游应用并汇总实证证据；通过两个案例演示相似性搜索和土地覆盖制图中的工作流；最后给出嵌入的选择、评估、存储、压缩和发布指导。
Result: 摘要报告了嵌入在多种地球观测任务中的应用证据，指出嵌入在哪些场景下优于传统特征，也指出池化、融合和空间迁移会限制性能；两个案例研究展示了相似性搜索和土地覆盖制图的实际工作流。
Conclusion: 作者建议按文件格式选择、评估、存储、压缩和发布地球嵌入，并指出海洋与大气覆盖、不确定性量化和基准测试仍是开放问题。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Distilled Roads: Generalisable Road Network Extraction Across Sensors, Resolutions, and Region
papers.abstract_en: Road network segmentation from satellite imagery remains challenging due to large geographic variation in road appearance, occlusions, and domain shifts introduced by differing resolutions and sensors. Existing models, typically trained under narrow resolution--region combinations, generalise poorly to unseen environments such as rural settings, regions with distinct road materials, or imagery from new satellite platforms, often producing broken or disconnected predictions. Adapting these models to new domains usually requires retraining or fine-tuning, which is costly and risks catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we reframe global road extraction as a continual adaptation problem rather than an architectural one. Our framework combines cross-resolution knowledge distillation across a resolution-decreasing curriculum, multi-sensor training, and topology-aware supervision, yielding a single model that generalises across $0.3-1.0$ m imagery from multiple satellite platforms across continents. On publicly available benchmarks, including City-Scale and Global-Scale, our model outperforms state-of-the-art results by up to $22$ F1 points and $15$ APLS points, while remaining the most efficient, with $3\times$ faster inference. Our results suggest that improved robustness across diverse sub-meter satellite imagery can be achieved through targeted training strategies, such as data curricula, distillation, and topology-aware losses, rather than increasingly complex architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 workshop - TerraBytes II
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将全球道路网络提取重新定义为持续适应 (continual adaptation) 问题，提出结合跨分辨率知识蒸馏、分辨率递减课程、多传感器训练和拓扑感知监督的统一框架，得到一个在 0.3–1.0 m 多平台卫星影像上泛化的单一模型。在 City-Scale 和 Global-Scale 等公开基准上，该方法相比现有最优结果最多提升 22 个 F1 点和 15 个 APLS 点，同时推理速度提升 3 倍。
Motivation: 现有道路分割模型通常在狭窄的分辨率-区域组合下训练，对乡村场景、不同道路材料或新卫星平台的泛化差，且产生断裂或不连通的预测；迁移到新域往往需要重训或微调，成本高且有灾难性遗忘风险。
Method: 提出跨分辨率知识蒸馏配合分辨率递减课程 (resolution-decreasing curriculum)，结合多传感器训练与拓扑感知监督 (topology-aware supervision)，在不增加架构复杂度的前提下训练单一部署模型。
Result: 在公开基准上，模型比现有最优方法最多提升 22 个 F1 点和 15 个 APLS 点，并保持最高效率，推理速度提升 3 倍。
Conclusion: 结果表明，通过数据课程、蒸馏和拓扑感知损失等定向训练策略，而非更复杂的架构，就能提升多样化亚米级卫星影像上的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance
papers.abstract_en: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, thereby enabling agents to use tools more robustly and effectively. ExpG consists of three phases: (1) experience acquisition, which analyzes tool invocation quality from historical execution trajectories, producing structured learnable experiences through multi-aspect attribution; (2) experience distillation, which keeps the experience pool effective by filtering unhelpful experiences, selecting representative ones with an equivalence-class-based method, and summarizing them into generalizable guidance; and (3) experience reuse, which applies the guidance adaptively during future task solving. Extensive experiments show that ExpG brings consistent improvements across the tool selection, tool calling, and response generation tasks, enabling smaller agents to outperform larger ones that do not use ExpG. Moreover, ExpG achieves particularly strong gains in challenging settings, suggesting a promising path toward more robust tool use. Our code, experiments, and results are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExpG，一种通过构建并持续精炼自适应指导（adaptive guidance）来提升智能体工具调用鲁棒性的机制。ExpG 从历史执行轨迹中提取经验，经蒸馏后在新任务求解中按需复用，从而刻画每个工具的能力边界与最佳实践。实验显示该方法在工具选择、工具调用和响应生成三类任务上带来一致改进，并让较小的智能体在特定设置下优于未使用 ExpG 的更大模型。
Motivation: 智能体的性能瓶颈正从模型能力转向执行过程的鲁棒性，而工具是智能体与外部环境交互的主要接口；现有方法很少关注如何在不同运行条件下保证工具使用的稳健性。
Method: ExpG 包含三个阶段：经验获取（experience acquisition）从历史执行轨迹中通过多方面归因分析工具调用质量，生成结构化可学习经验；经验蒸馏（experience distillation）过滤无用经验、用基于等价类（equivalence-class-based）的方法选取代表性经验并总结为可泛化的指导；经验复用（experience reuse）在后续任务求解中自适应地应用该指导。
Result: 大量实验表明，ExpG 在工具选择、工具调用和响应生成任务上均带来一致改进，使较小模型在相关任务上胜过未使用 ExpG 的较大模型；在具有挑战性的设置中提升尤为显著。
Conclusion: 作者认为经验驱动的自适应指导是通往更鲁棒工具使用的一条有前景的路径，并已公开代码与实验细节以支持进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shorter Reasoning, Earlier Answers? An Evaluation of Reasoning Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often reason at length before answering, increasing cost and latency. Prompts and trained settings can shorten this reasoning, but a shorter trace may only show that the model stopped sooner. Here, we evaluate paired runs of the same question at matched reasoning horizons across 198 GPQA Diamond and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. We test a numeric/concision prompt that announces a token limit for Qwen3-14B and the trained effort settings of gpt-oss-20b and -120b. The Qwen prompt shortens reasoning traces by 12-17%, while accuracy changes at matched token limits are small and mixed. A concise/early-answer instruction raises MMLU-Pro accuracy by 3.8 percentage points at 512 tokens, including +2.7 points when both runs are unfinished. Its gain at 2,048 tokens is uncertain. For gpt-oss, candidate-logit answers from completed low- and medium-effort reasoning are 14.5-26.3 points more accurate than matched-horizon high-effort answers. Most of the 512-token advantage comes from lower effort finishing earlier, while differences among unfinished runs are smaller and mixed. Wrong early answers often concentrate probability on the chosen option, so earlier stopping does not uniformly improve probability quality. In these tests, a tight deadline can favor lower effort or a concise instruction, whereas allowing high effort to finish can recover higher final accuracy. Evaluations should report correct completion before a deadline, the answer obtained when a run is stopped, differences among unfinished runs, and probability assigned to the correct answer separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了让大语言模型更早停止推理是否真的能保持准确率。作者在 198 道 GPQA Diamond 和 500 道 MMLU-Pro 题目上，对同一问题在匹配的推理长度 (matched reasoning horizons) 下做配对运行，测试 Qwen3-14B 的数值/简洁提示词以及 gpt-oss-20b 和 -120b 的 trained effort 设置。结果显示 Qwen 提示词将推理痕迹缩短 12-17%，但匹配 token 限制下的准确率变化较小且方向不一；gpt-oss 在低/中 effort 完成时的候选 logit 答案比匹配长度的高 effort 答案高 14.5-26.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 大模型往往在回答前进行很长的推理，增加成本和延迟；提示词或训练设置可以缩短推理，但更短的痕迹可能只是说明模型更早停止，而不代表推理质量更好，因此需要一种能在匹配推理长度下公平比较准确率与停止时机的评估方式。
Method: 在两个基准上对同一问题以匹配的 token 限制进行配对运行，分别测试 Qwen3-14B 的数值/简洁提示词（声明 token 上限）和 gpt-oss-20b/-120b 的 trained effort 设置；比较完成与未完成运行、候选 logit 答案、停止时得到的答案以及正确答案上的概率。
Result: Qwen 的简洁提示词缩短推理痕迹 12-17%，匹配 token 限制下准确率变化小且混合；简洁/提前回答指令在 512 token 处将 MMLU-Pro 准确率提高 3.8 个百分点（其中双运行未完成时 +2.7 点），在 2048 token 处增益不确定。gpt-oss 中低/中 effort 完成的候选 logit 答案比对等长度的 高 effort 答案准确 14.5-26.3 个百分点；512 token 优势主要来自低 effort 更早完成，未完成运行间的差异较小且混合。错误的早期答案往往把概率集中在所选选项上。
Conclusion: 紧截止时间下，低 effort 或简洁指令可能更有利，而让高 effort 完成可以恢复更高的最终准确率；评估应分别报告截止时间前正确完成、运行被停止时得到的答案、未完成运行之间的差异，以及分配给正确答案的概率。

papers.title: MMLongBench-Doc-V2: A Corrected-Annotation, Semantics-Aware Revision of MMLongBench-Doc
papers.abstract_en: MMLongBench-Doc is a long-document QA benchmark of 1,082 questions over 135 PDFs. Two properties of it push measured scores away from the quantity they are meant to capture: the reference metric compares extracted answers, so 1,358,000 loses to 1358000; and a non-trivial share of ground-truth annotations are wrong, ambiguous, or incomplete --- concentrated, because of how they were found, in exactly the questions capable systems answer correctly. MMLongBench-Doc-V2 corrects 106 annotations, each published with the page and arithmetic that settle it, and replaces the string metric with a pinned LLM judge asked whether a response means the reference. Ten questions whose document ships under the wrong filename are removed rather than counted wrong, along with one duplicated question, leaving 1,071 questions over 134 documents. The most reusable contribution is a decision procedure for when an empty set key may be widened and when widening would destroy a deliberate negative sample; applied to all 208 rows, it widened 14. V2 scores are not comparable with published V1 numbers. The corrected corpus, the per-entry correction record and the evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/VectifyAI/MMLongBench-Doc-V2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMLongBench-Doc-V2，是对长文档问答基准 MMLongBench-Doc 的修订版。作者指出原基准存在两类问题：字符串参考指标会把 1358000 与 1,358,000 判为不同答案，且相当比例的 ground-truth 标注错误、歧义或不完整，且这些错误恰好集中在能力强的系统能答对的题上。V2 修正了 106 条标注，改用固定的 LLM judge 判断语义是否等价，并移除文件名错误或重复的题目，最终保留 1,071 道题、134 篇文档。
Motivation: 现有 MMLongBench-Doc 的测评分数受评测方式干扰：字符串匹配指标对格式敏感，使得分数偏离其本应衡量的真实能力；同时部分 ground-truth 标注本身有误，导致正确回答被误判。
Method: 逐条修正 106 条标注并公开每题的依据页码与计算过程；将字符串指标替换为固定的 LLM judge，让其判断回答是否在语义上等同于参考答案；移除因文档附错文件名而无法判分的 10 道题及 1 道重复题；并提出一套判定空集合键 (empty set key) 何时可以加宽、何时会破坏刻意负样本的决策流程，应用于全部 208 行并加宽了 14 行。
Result: 修订后的基准包含 1,071 道题、134 篇文档；作者明确说明 V2 分数与已发表的 V1 分数不可比。
Conclusion: 论文发布修正后的语料、逐条修正记录和评测框架，并强调最具复用价值的贡献是空集合键加宽的判定流程；该方法适用于需要区分缺失答案与刻意否定样本的评测场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SRAP: SVD-Refined Adversarial Perturbations for Imperceptible Face-Swap Defense
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake technologies pose increasing threats to facial privacy and identity security, motivating proactive defenses that protect facial images before misuse. Although adversarial perturbations generated by projected gradient descent (PGD) can disrupt the identity representations used by face-swapping models, their visual quality is degraded by two characteristics: perturbations are distributed broadly over the image, including identity-insensitive regions, and they contain visually salient high-frequency components. We analyze these spatial and spectral inefficiencies through identity-sensitivity estimation and the singular-value decomposition (SVD) of PGD perturbations. Our analysis shows that later singular components contain a disproportionate amount of high-frequency energy, while the leading components preserve most of the perturbation energy and defense utility. Based on these observations, we propose SRAP, which combines per-channel truncated SVD refinement with an identity-importance mask at every optimization step. The SVD refinement suppresses high-rank, high-frequency residuals, while the mask restricts perturbations to locations that strongly influence identity representations. Experiments on CelebA-HQ and VGGFace2-HQ demonstrate that SRAP substantially improves protected-image fidelity across all reported metrics while maintaining competitive identity-disruption performance, yielding a favorable trade-off between face-swap defense and visual imperceptibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度伪造换脸攻击，提出 SRAP，一种结合 SVD 截断精修与身份重要性掩码的对抗扰动生成方法。作者通过身份敏感度估计和 PGD 扰动的奇异值分解，分析出后部奇异分量携带过多高频能量、而前部主分量保留大部分扰动能量与防御效用的规律。在 CelebA-HQ 和 VGGFace2-HQ 上的实验表明，SRAP 在保持竞争性身份破坏性能的同时显著提升受保护图像的保真度，实现换脸防御与视觉不可感知性之间更好的权衡。
Motivation: PGD 等对抗扰动虽然能破坏换脸模型的身份表征，但其视觉质量受到两点损害：扰动广泛分布于包括身份不敏感区域在内的整幅图像，且包含视觉上显著的高频成分。
Method: 提出 SRAP，在每一步优化中结合逐通道截断 SVD 精修与身份重要性掩码：SVD 精修抑制高秩、高频残差，掩码将扰动限制在对身份表征影响最大的位置。
Result: 在 CelebA-HQ 和 VGGFace2-HQ 上的实验显示，SRAP 在所有报告的保真度指标上大幅提升受保护图像质量，同时保持具有竞争力的身份破坏性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为，针对 PGD 扰动进行空间与频谱上的精修能够实现换脸防御与视觉不可感知性之间更优的权衡，适用于主动保护人脸图像免受换脸滥用。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: TimeRLM: Recursive Language Models Enable Precise Anomaly Localization in Long-Context Time-Series
papers.abstract_en: Precise anomaly localization over long-context time series is a crucial task in monitoring applications across clinical care, industrial operations, financial services, and logistics, where brief evidence may hide inside long spans of high-frequency data. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) are able to ingest time series data and verbalize findings on anomalies in natural language; however, recent benchmarks report a decrease in retrieval performance at long contexts, mirroring failure modes in text, vision, and audio. In the text domain, Recursive Language Models (RLMs) can recover much of this lost performance by keeping context external to the large language model (LLM), allowing the model to query it through code. We present TimeRLM, an RLM formulation for time-series that sequentially manipulates the signal using code and vision capabilities. We further introduce AnomalyXL, a synthetic long-context anomaly localization benchmark with programmatically injected anomalies that require precise retrieval. We implement five different task categories and two variants: AnomalyXL-MCQ and AnomalyXL-Localize. TimeRLM outperforms every evaluated TSLM and single-pass baseline on four of the five AnomalyXL-Localize tasks, reaching 0.682 IoU on localization and 0.745 on classify-with-evidence, versus at most 0.329 and 0.072 across all baselines. We post-train TimeRLM using reinforcement learning. The resulting model further improves performance and requires approximately one-third as many agent interaction turns as its untrained base model to produce a final answer. On unseen real-world ECG, sleep and software observability recordings, the post-trained TimeRLM retains or improves performance, surpassing TSLMs despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data. Our findings suggest recursive interaction with time-series is an effective approach for long-horizon retrieval.
papers.comment: Open source code and datasets: https://github.com/OpenTSLM/TimeRLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TimeRLM，一种面向长时间序列的递归语言模型 (RLM) 方法，通过代码与视觉能力顺序操作信号，将上下文外置以缓解长上下文检索性能下降。作者同时发布了合成基准 AnomalyXL，涵盖五种任务类别和两个变体（MCQ 与 Localize）。在 AnomalyXL-Localize 的五个任务中，TimeRLM 在四个任务上超过所有对比的 TSLM 与单遍基线，达到 0.682 IoU 与 0.745 classify-with-evidence；经强化学习后训练后，性能进一步提升且交互轮数减少约三分之二，并在未见过的真实 ECG、睡眠和软件可观测性数据上保持或提升性能。
Motivation: 长上下文时间序列中的精确异常定位对临床、工业、金融和物流等监测应用至关重要，而现有 Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) 在长上下文下的检索性能会下降；文本领域的 Recursive Language Models (RLMs) 已证明可通过将上下文外置于 LLM 并用代码查询来恢复性能，本文将其引入时间序列领域。
Method: 提出 TimeRLM，一种基于 RLM 公式的时间序列方法，通过代码和视觉能力顺序操作信号，让模型以编程方式访问外部上下文；并构建 AnomalyXL 合成基准，程序化注入需要精确检索的异常，实现五种任务类别和 MCQ 与 Localize 两个变体；随后使用强化学习对模型进行后训练。
Result: 在 AnomalyXL-Localize 的五个任务中，TimeRLM 在四个任务上超过所有评估的 TSLM 和单遍基线，达到 0.682 IoU 和 0.745 classify-with-evidence，而所有基线最高仅为 0.329 和 0.072。强化学习后训练的模型进一步提升性能，交互轮数约为未训练基线的三分之一，并在未见过的真实 ECG、睡眠和软件可观测性记录上保持或改进性能，尽管仅用合成数据训练。
Conclusion: 作者认为递归交互式处理时间序列是长水平检索的有效途径，并且基于纯合成数据训练的 TimeRLM 也能泛化到真实领域数据。

papers.title: Benign interpolation and Occam's razor
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary deep learning methods generalize well even when they fit their training data perfectly, a phenomenon known as benign interpolation. This phenomenon cannot be accounted for by classical statistical learning theory and has prompted a range of attempted new explanations in the statistics and machine learning literature. A common feature of these new proposals is an appeal to a simplicity preference among interpolating models, often presented as a form of Occam's razor. We clarify this debate for a philosophical audience and argue that this new appeal to simplicity creates an explanatory gap. The classical theory offers theorems which connect the simplicity of model classes to good generalization, thus underwriting methodological simplicity norms. The new accounts instead appeal to properties of individual models, which they interpret as a kind of simplicity. Lacking a provable connection to generalization, it is the name "simplicity" that does the work a theorem used to do, making a substantive and unargued assumption look like the application of a familiar methodological principle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向哲学读者澄清深度学习中良性插值 (benign interpolation) 现象的新解释，指出这些解释普遍诉诸对插值模型的简单性偏好，并将其包装为奥卡姆剃刀原则。作者认为，这种新的简单性诉求造成了解释性鸿沟：经典理论用定理把模型类的简单性与泛化联系起来，而新解释只诉诸单个模型的属性，缺乏可证明的泛化联系。
Motivation: 现代深度学习在完美拟合训练数据时仍能良好泛化，这一良性插值现象无法被经典统计学习理论解释，催生了统计学和机器学习文献中的多种新解释；但这些解释共同依赖的简单性偏好被作者认为需要澄清和审视。
Method: 采用哲学分析方法，对比经典统计学习理论中关于模型类简单性与泛化之间具有定理保证的规范性简单性准则，与新近解释中诉诸单个模型属性并将之命名为简单性的做法。
Result: 论文不包含实验或定量结果；其主要论点是新解释中“简单性”一词替代了原本由定理承担的工作，将一个实质性且未经论证的假设伪装成熟悉的方法论原则。
Conclusion: 作者强调这类诉诸简单性的新解释存在解释性鸿沟，缺乏可证明的泛化连接，因此不能真正替代经典理论的解释地位。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FreqAdapt: Frequency-Adaptive Processing for RAW Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing object detection methods predominantly utilize sRGB inputs, which are compressed from RAW sensor data using Image Signal Processors (ISP) originally designed for visualization purposes. Compared to RGB images, RAW images possess favorable noise characteristics and richer information representation, which are crucial for object detection, particularly under challenging conditions such as adverse weather or low-light environments. In this paper, we propose FreqAdapt, a lightweight module for adaptive RAW data enhancement in the frequency domain. Unlike traditional spatial domain processing methods, FreqAdapt innovatively maps ISP operations to the Fourier frequency domain and performs domain separation based on the physical properties of ISP operations, ensuring each operation is performed in its most suitable domain. Meanwhile, through an adaptive frequency domain encoder that jointly analyzes amplitude spectrum, phase spectrum, and RAW image features, we provide global context for ISP parameter prediction and employ a learnable fusion mechanism to achieve adaptive feature enhancement. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets with diverse lighting and weather conditions demonstrate that FreqAdapt achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining lightweight efficiency and good physical interpretability. Furthermore, our module can be seamlessly incorporated into existing object detection frameworks, providing a novel solution for visual perception tasks in the RAW domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FreqAdapt，一种用于 RAW 域目标检测的轻量级自适应增强模块。该方法将 ISP（Image Signal Processor）操作映射到傅里叶频域，依据 ISP 操作的物理性质进行域分离，并通过联合分析幅值谱、相位谱与 RAW 图像特征的自适应频域编码器为 ISP 参数预测提供全局上下文。在多个覆盖不同光照和天气条件的数据集上，FreqAdapt 在保持轻量高效与较好物理可解释性的同时取得 SOTA 性能，并可直接嵌入现有检测框架。
Motivation: 现有目标检测方法主要使用 sRGB 输入，而 sRGB 是面向可视化设计的 ISP 从 RAW 传感器数据压缩得到的，会损失对检测有用的信息。RAW 图像具有更优的噪声特性和更丰富的信息表示，尤其是在恶劣天气或低光环境下对目标检测至关重要。
Method: 提出 FreqAdapt 轻量模块，在频域对 RAW 数据进行自适应增强：将传统空间域中的 ISP 操作映射到傅里叶频域，并按 ISP 操作的物理性质进行域分离，使每个操作在其最合适的域中执行；同时使用自适应频域编码器联合分析幅值谱、相位谱与 RAW 图像特征，以提供全局上下文并预测 ISP 参数，最后通过可学习融合机制实现自适应特征增强。
Result: 摘要报告在多个涵盖不同光照和天气条件的数据集上，FreqAdapt 取得 SOTA 性能，同时保持轻量高效与良好的物理可解释性；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: FreqAdapt 可无缝集成进现有目标检测框架，为 RAW 域视觉感知任务提供了新方案；摘要强调其适用于恶劣天气、低光等挑战性条件。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: LLM-Derived Priors for Thompson Sampling in Cold-Start Comment Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-armed bandit algorithms, especially Thompson sampling, are widely used in online recommendation. Despite their ability to adapt from online feedback, these methods often suffer from cold-start limitations when newly introduced arms have little or no interaction history. In our setting, the candidate arms are user-generated textual comments, whose semantic content can reveal a title's appeal before sufficient interaction feedback is available. We therefore use large language models (LLMs) to extract semantic signals from comment text and convert them into informative Bayesian priors that warm-start Thompson sampling under sparse early-stage feedback. To account for aggregate segment-level differences in response patterns, we maintain and update posteriors separately for each gender-age segment. In a real-world online A/B/C test, we compare a uniform prior with two LLM-based designs: a Gender Prior for demographic-affinity cues and a Content Prior for title-specific identity cues. The results show that LLM-based priors are most beneficial in sparse-feedback regimes -- with the largest gains emerging once a small amount of interaction evidence has accumulated -- and that prior design leads to distinct funnel-level effects. We further analyze prior-reward alignment and demographic heterogeneity, finding that click-oriented alignment is strongest for the Gender Prior and that treatment effects vary substantially across demographic segments. These findings suggest that LLM-derived priors can serve as a practical warm-start mechanism for text-rich bandit recommendation, while also revealing deployment trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究冷启动评论推荐中的多臂老虎机问题，提出用大语言模型 (LLM) 从评论文本提取语义信号并转化为贝叶斯先验，以热启动 Thompson sampling。作者在真实在线 A/B/C 测试中比较了均匀先验、Gender Prior 和 Content Prior，发现 LLM 先验在稀疏反馈阶段收益最大，且先验设计会带来不同的漏斗层效果。
Motivation: 多臂老虎机算法（尤其 Thompson sampling）依赖在线反馈，新加入的臂（用户生成的评论文本）缺乏交互历史时存在冷启动问题；评论文本的语义内容可在交互前提供关于标题吸引力的信息。
Method: 使用 LLM 从评论文本提取语义信号并构造信息性贝叶斯先验，用于热启动 Thompson sampling；同时按性别-年龄分段分别维护和更新后验，以刻画不同细分人群的响应模式差异。
Result: 真实在线 A/B/C 测试显示，LLM 先验在稀疏反馈阶段最有用，最大增益出现在积累少量交互证据之后；Gender Prior 在点击导向的对齐上最强，处理效应在不同人口统计分段间差异显著。
Conclusion: LLM 导出的先验可作为文本丰富型 bandit 推荐的实用热启动机制，但部署时需要权衡先验设计带来的不同漏斗层效应和人口统计异质性。

papers.title: Residual Flow Matching with Dynamic Cross-Interaction for 3D Multi-Person Motion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: 3D multi-person motion prediction requires modeling both individual kinematics and inter-person interactions. While Flow Matching is effective for multi-hypothesis generation to improve prediction accuracy, directly predicting skeletal sequences from pure noise often compromises structural consistency and introduces unreliable cross-agent interactions during early noise-dominated integration steps. To address this, we propose a Prior-Guided Residual Flow Matching framework. First, a Deterministic Coarse Prior (DCP) establishes a kinematic anchor, formulating the generative process as a conditional flow over motion residuals to simplify the generative objective and preserve structural stability. Second, a Dynamic Cross-Interaction (DCI) mechanism temporally synchronizes inter-agent message-passing with the integration progress, ensuring the extraction of reliable social contexts and improving multi-person motion fidelity. Finally, a decoupled joint-motion architecture with bidirectional fusion effectively preserves fine-grained kinematic coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art prediction accuracy across multiple datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/Wei-Wei-a/Residual-Flow-Matching-with-Dynamic-Cross-Interaction-for-3D-Multi-Person-Motion-Prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 3D 多人运动预测中直接从纯噪声生成骨骼序列所导致的结构一致性下降与早期积分阶段跨智能体交互不可靠问题，提出 Prior-Guided Residual Flow Matching 框架。框架先用 Deterministic Coarse Prior (DCP) 将生成过程建模为运动残差上的条件流，再用 Dynamic Cross-Interaction (DCI) 按积分进度同步智能体间消息传递，最后通过解耦关节运动与双向融合保留细粒度运动学一致性。摘要报告该方法在多个数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 预测精度。
Motivation: 现有 Flow Matching 虽适合多假设生成以提升预测精度，但直接从纯噪声预测骨骼序列会在噪声主导的早期积分步骤中破坏结构一致性，并引入不可靠的跨智能体交互。
Method: 提出三部分组成的 Prior-Guided Residual Flow Matching 框架：DCP 建立运动学锚点并将生成目标简化为运动残差的条件流；DCI 使跨智能体消息传递与积分进度时间同步；解耦的关节运动架构 (decoupled joint-motion architecture) 通过双向融合保留细粒度运动学一致性。
Result: 实验在多个数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 预测精度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将生成过程锚定到确定性粗先验、并让跨智能体交互随积分进度动态同步，可在保持多假设生成能力的同时改善多人运动预测的结构稳定性与运动保真度；代码已开源。

papers.title: Shaping Wind-Tunnel Airflow for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles using Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: The development and testing of advanced aerial robots require experiments in controlled environments with tailored airflow profiles. This paper presents an online learning algorithm for controlling the complex airflow field in a multi-fan vertical wind tunnel. Our method combines a simplified physical model with iterative, measurement-based learning, enabling sample-efficient convergence to desired airflow distributions. We demonstrate the method's versatility by generating complex airflow, such as uniform, Gaussian, and parabolic profiles. Crucially, we show that our algorithm can produce an airflow profile specifically designed for passive soaring, greatly enhancing flight performance of a soaring robot. papers.title: FACTWASH: Catching AI Rewrites That Wash Hearsay into Fact
papers.abstract_en: AI systems rewrite information constantly: conversations become stored memories, documents become answers. The rewrite can keep a claim while washing away what made it checkable, who said it, how sure they were, when it held. We call that failure factwashing, and release factwash, an open-source write-time gate that catches it deterministically, with named flags and evidence rather than an LLM judge. Building it answers a practical question: when does a cheap check suffice, and when do you need a model? What decides is whether the property has a bounded surface-cue inventory. Explicit negation cues are close to enumerable, so a word list finishes and transfers, reaching 0.91 F1 on untuned text. Hedging and attribution have open-ended realizations, so vocabulary plateaus near half recall, and a one-question LLM witness recovers +17 and +15 points of cue-detection recall at equal precision. Deployed, that witness may only lower a verdict, so it buys precision rather than coverage. We measure cue detection on 105,596 independently annotated sentences. A blind-labelled corpus of memory writes then locates the failure: 55% of bad writes in conversational hearsay, 7% in business email (p < 0.001), so the first deployment question is not which detector to use but whether the failure occurs at all. On unmodified mem0 2.0.7, the gate flags 5 of 8 hedged-hearsay writes.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/collapseindex/factwash
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出事实清洗 (factwashing) 这一失败模式：AI 在重写信息时可能保留原命题，却抹去使其可核查的来源、说话者、确定性和时效等信息。作者发布开源写时门控 factwash，用命名标记和证据而不是 LLM 裁判来确定性捕获该问题。基于 105,596 条独立标注句子的实验显示，否定线索可用词表完成且可迁移，而模糊限定和归因需要单问题 LLM 见证者来提升线索召回。
Motivation: AI 系统会不断重写信息（对话变成记忆、文档变成答案），重写过程可能把传言洗成事实，但现有方法缺乏在写入时确定性地检测这种可核查性丧失的手段。
Method: 提出一个写时门控 (write-time gate) 的判定框架：对于具有有界表面线索清单 (bounded surface-cue inventory) 的属性用确定性规则；对于实现方式开放的属性（如模糊限定 hedging 与归因 attribution）则用单问题 LLM 见证者来下调裁决，从而换取精确率而非覆盖率。
Result: 否定线索词表在未调优文本上达到 0.91 F1；模糊限定和归因线索上词表召回约一半后停滞，单问题 LLM 见证者在等精确率下分别提升 +17 和 +15 个百分点的线索检测召回。在盲标注的记忆写入语料中，55% 的坏写入出现在对话式传闻，业务邮件中仅 7%（p < 0.001）；在未修改的 mem0 2.0.7 上，该门控标记出 8 条中有 5 条模糊传闻写入。
Conclusion: 作者强调部署时的首要问题不是选哪个检测器，而是该失败模式是否实际发生；该门控采用确定性检查并开源，但 LLM 见证者只能降低判定等级，购买的是精确率而非覆盖率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DRPFNet: Dual-domain Residual Progressive Fusion Network for RGB-Thermal Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: RGB-thermal (RGB-T) object detection aims to fuse complementary information from visible and thermal modalities to achieve robust detection under varying illumination and weather conditions. Current methods typically employ attention mechanisms or transformers to perform cross-modal fusion independently at each feature scale, directly combining RGB and thermal features in the spatial domain. However, they still face significant limitations: cross-level knowledge inheritance caused by independent fusion at each scale,suppressing noise continuously due to the lack of bidirectional optimization, and information degradation induced by the absence of frequency-spatial collaboration. To address these issues, we propose DRPFNet, a Dual-domain Residual Progressive Fusion Network that constructs a unified information flow optimization system from three synergistic levels:structure, feature, and enhancement. At the structural level, we establish cross-scale propagation through bottom-up knowledge accumulation and bidirectional enhancement,ensuring smooth information flow. At the feature level, we collaboratively extract RGB high-frequency edges and thermal low-frequency structures via frequency band separation and edge guidance, guaranteeing representation quality. At the enhancement level, we enhance foreground-background discrimination through edge-guided dual-domain refinement,achieving precise object localization.Extensive experiments on two public RGB-T datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance with competitive efficiency, validating the effectiveness of this hierarchical collaborative strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRPFNet，一种用于 RGB-热红外目标检测的双域残差渐进融合网络，从结构、特征和增强三个层面构建统一的信息流优化系统。结构层通过自底向上的知识累积和双向增强实现跨尺度传播；特征层通过频带分离和边缘引导分别提取 RGB 高频边缘与热红外低频结构；增强层通过边缘引导的双域细化提升前景-背景判别。作者在两个公开 RGB-T 数据集上验证了该方法取得了有竞争力的性能与效率。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-T 融合方法通常在每个特征尺度上独立使用注意力或 Transformer 在空间域直接融合双模态特征，仍存在跨层级知识继承不足、缺乏双向优化导致噪声持续抑制困难、以及缺少频域-空间域协同造成信息退化等问题。
Method: 设计 Dual-domain Residual Progressive Fusion Network，从三个协同层面入手：结构层面建立自底向上的知识累积与双向增强的跨尺度传播；特征层面通过频率带分离和边缘引导，协作提取 RGB 高频边缘与热红外低频结构；增强层面利用边缘引导的双域细化来强化前景-背景判别，最终实现精确定位。
Result: 在两个公开 RGB-T 数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了与现有方法竞争的性能，同时保持有竞争力的效率，验证了这种分层协同策略的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将结构、特征与增强三个层面统一到渐进融合框架中，可以有效改善 RGB-T 目标检测中的信息流质量；但摘要未给出具体数值或与其他方法的量化对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tight Worst-Case Bounds for the Smallest Eigenvalue of ReLU NTK Gram Matrices
papers.abstract_en: For $n$ unit vectors $x_1,\ldots,x_n \in \mathbb{R}^d$, we study the continuous ReLU derivative Gram matrix $H$, whose entries are obtained by averaging pairwise gated inner products over a standard Gaussian direction. Writing $ Δ_\pm := \min_{i \neq j} \min\{ \|x_i-x_j\|_2, \|x_i+x_j\|_2 \} $ for their projective separation, we prove the universal dimension-free lower bound $ λ_{\min}(H) = Ω( Δ_\pm/\sqrt{\log n} ) $. Conversely, we construct worst-case families satisfying the matching upper bound $ λ_{\min}(H) = O( Δ_\pm/\sqrt{\log n} ) $, showing that this rate is tight up to universal constants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 n 个单位向量在 R^d 上定义的连续 ReLU 导数 Gram 矩阵 H，其元素通过标准高斯方向上的成对门控内积平均得到。作者用投影分离量 Δ_± 证明了普适且无维度依赖的下界 λ_min(H) = Ω(Δ_±/√(log n))，并构造最坏情形族达到匹配上界 O(Δ_±/√(log n))，说明该速率在通用常数意义下是紧的。
Motivation: ReLU NTK Gram 矩阵的最小特征值决定相关核矩阵的可逆性与学习理论保证，现有界在维度或样本结构上不够紧，需要最坏情形下的精确速率刻画。
Method: 利用单位向量之间的投影分离量 Δ_± 设计几何论证，证明最小特征值的通用下界；同时构造满足匹配上界的最坏情形向量族，以验证下界的紧性。
Result: 摘要给出普适无维度下界 λ_min(H) = Ω(Δ_±/√(log n))，并证明匹配的上界 λ_min(H) = O(Δ_±/√(log n))，即该速率在通用常数意义下紧。
Conclusion: 作者表明连续 ReLU 导数 Gram 矩阵最小特征值依赖投影分离与 log n 的平方根，该速率无法在通用常数意义下改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Evolutionary Origin of Values: implications for AI alignment, sentience and existential risk
papers.abstract_en: AI systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have prompted fears that they may harbor hidden goals, seek to dominate or eliminate humanity, or even suffer as sentient beings. We address these concerns by tracing the evolutionary origin of value in biological organisms. Values emerge from autopoiesis: living systems must actively maintain themselves against perturbation and dissipation. Natural selection has equipped them with hierarchies of "vicarious selectors" that guide their behavior toward fitness. LLMs, by contrast, are allopoietic and allotelic: they produce outputs for others, and their goals derive from user prompts rather than an autonomous drive. They lack the intrinsic motivation for self-preservation, dominance, or resource competition that underlies existential-risk scenarios, and the embodied vulnerability required for feeling or suffering. Still, because LLMs learn statistical patterns from human-generated text, they implicitly absorb human values as well as knowledge, allowing them to focus on what is relevant. That is why the "orthogonality thesis" separating intelligence from values does not apply to them. Such separation would in fact expose any intelligence to the frame problem: the combinatorial explosion of the search space that makes any realistic utility function physically uncomputable. That also precludes the convergence of instrumental values thesis. We conclude that the real alignment challenge lies not in preventing rogue AI agency, but in ensuring LLMs intelligently apply learned ethical values.
papers.comment: submitted chapter for book: T. Veloz & C. Rittberg (Eds.), AI and Human Values. Springer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从生物进化角度探讨价值（value）的起源，并以此分析大型语言模型（LLM）的AI对齐、感知能力与存在风险问题。作者认为，生命系统的价值源于自创生（autopoiesis）与自然选择形成的替代选择器层级，而LLM是异养（allopoietic）且异目的（allotelic）的，缺乏自我保存、支配或资源竞争的固有动机，也缺乏感受或痛苦所需的具体脆弱性。论文还主张正交性论点（orthogonality thesis）不适用于LLM，并认为真正的对齐挑战在于让LLM智能地应用其从人类文本中学到的伦理价值。
Motivation: LLM引发了关于隐藏目标、统治或消灭人类、以及作为有感知实体受苦的担忧，本文试图通过追溯价值的进化起源来回应这些存在风险议题。
Method: 概念性论证方法：从自创生和自然选择推出生物价值来源，对比LLM的运行方式，并借助框架问题（frame problem）和可计算性论证来否定智能与价值可分离的正交性论点。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据，主要结论是LLM隐含吸收人类价值，不具备驱动存在风险场景的内在动机，正交性和工具性价值收敛论点均不成立。
Conclusion: 作者认为真正的对齐挑战不是阻止恶意AI代理，而是确保LLM智能地应用习得的伦理价值；但本文为哲学/理论性章节，未涉及经验验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conformal risk control for model-form uncertainty in parametric non-intrusive reduced-order models
papers.abstract_en: Non-intrusive reduced-order models (NIROMs) have become a standard tool for approximating parametric partial differential equations from computer design of experiments while significantly reducing computational costs. However, assessing the reliability of their predictions remains a major challenge, particularly in extrapolation regimes or under limited training data. In this work, we introduce a framework for quantifying model-form uncertainty in NIROMs by combining a perturbative stochastic representation of reduced bases with distribution-free conformal-type methods. Starting from a deterministic reduced basis constructed from snapshot matrices, we model uncertainty through random perturbations defined on the Stiefel manifold, directed along the discarded modes, yielding stochastic reduced-order approximations whose induced variance reflects the basis-truncation error. A transport approximation gives a closed-form posterior variance that sepa- rates basis-induced from regression-induced uncertainty, without re-training the underlying Gaussian processes. We include this posterior variance within a conformal risk control calibration framework, that provides prediction sets with coordinate miscoverage guarantees. The calibration factor produced by this framework is itself an interpretable, scalar diagnostic of the quality of the uncertainty estimate. The methodology is evaluated on parametric PDE benchmarks and an industrial tire-manufacturing calendering process. Numerical experiments demonstrate reliable, locally informative uncertainty quantification that goes beyond the Gaussian predictive variance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非侵入式降阶模型 (non-intrusive reduced-order models, NIROMs) 的预测可靠性问题，提出一种结合 Stiefel 流形上随机扰动与分布自由共形方法的模型形式不确定性量化框架。该框架从确定性约化基出发，沿被丢弃模态方向施加随机扰动，得到反映基截断误差的随机降阶近似，并通过传输近似得到闭式后验方差。该后验方差被纳入共形风险控制 (conformal risk control) 校准框架，用于构造带坐标误覆盖保证的预测集，且无需重新训练底层高斯过程。方法在参数化 PDE 基准与工业轮胎制造压延过程上得到验证。
Motivation: 非侵入式降阶模型虽能高效逼近参数化偏微分方程，但其预测可靠性评估仍是主要挑战，尤其在 extrapolation 区域或训练数据有限时缺乏可信的不确定性度量。
Method: 提出一个量化模型形式不确定性的框架：对由快照矩阵构造的确定性约化基在 Stiefel 流形上定义沿丢弃模态方向的随机扰动，产生随机降阶近似并利用传输近似得到闭式后验方差，该方差可分离基诱导与回归诱导的不确定性；随后将此后验方差纳入共形风险控制校准框架，提供具有坐标误覆盖保证的预测集，校准因子本身作为不确定性估计质量的标量诊断。

papers.title: ArtECulture: Benchmarking Culture-Conditioned Visual Emotion Understanding in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing visual emotion understanding methods typically ignore cultural variations in emotional perception. We introduce culture-conditioned visual emotion understanding, a task that predicts the culture-specific emotional perception of a given image and explains the underlying rationale. Although related benchmarks exist, they are limited by inconsistent individual annotations, which hinder the derivation of majority-supported culture-level emotion labels, and imbalanced cultural coverage. Thus, we present ArtECulture, a benchmark containing 6,792 artworks with culture-specific emotion labels and explanations across English, Chinese, and Arabic cultures, with balanced Western and non-Western content. Evaluations of 16 open- and closed-source Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) under a zero-shot setting reveal that the task remains challenging, with the best model achieving below 50\% accuracy. To address this limitation, we introduce a retrieval-augmented culture-conditioned emotion understanding framework, which leverages a concept-based cultural emotion knowledge base to inject explicit cultural knowledge into MLLMs without additional training. The framework improves both culturally aligned emotion prediction and grounded explanation generation. Our benchmark and code will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出文化条件视觉情绪理解（culture-conditioned visual emotion understanding）任务，旨在预测特定文化对图像的情绪感知并解释其依据；为此构建基准 ArtECulture，包含 6792 幅艺术品、覆盖英语、中文和阿拉伯文化，并平衡西方与非西方内容。对 16 个开源和闭源多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的零样本评估显示任务仍有挑战，最佳模型准确率低于 50%。作者进一步提出检索增强框架，利用基于概念的文化情绪知识库向 MLLM 注入显式文化知识，无需额外训练即可改善文化对齐的情绪预测与可解释生成。
Motivation: 现有视觉情绪理解方法通常忽略情绪感知中的文化差异；已有基准受限于个体标注不一致，难以得到多数支持的文化级情绪标签，且文化覆盖不均衡。
Method: 构建 ArtECulture 基准，包含 6792 幅艺术品及文化特定情绪标签和解释，覆盖英语、中文与阿拉伯文化；提出检索增强的文化条件情绪理解框架，利用基于概念的文化情绪知识库（concept-based cultural emotion knowledge base）向 MLLM 注入显式文化知识，无需额外训练。
Result: 16 个 MLLM 在零样本设置下最佳准确率仍低于 50%，说明该任务对现有模型具有挑战性；所提框架同时改善了文化对齐的情绪预测和基于依据的解释生成（grounded explanation generation）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调文化条件视觉情绪理解仍未被现有 MLLM 解决，检索增强的知识注入可在不训练的情况下提升文化相关情绪预测与解释能力；基准和代码将公开。

papers.title: Can Text-to-Image Models Draw from the Right Frame of Reference?
papers.abstract_en: Spatial instruction following has become a crucial requirement for text-to-image (T2I) generation. A common challenge arises when directional expressions are interpreted under different frames of reference. For example, ``the left of'' may refer to the viewer's image coordinates or to the intrinsic orientation of an object, leading to different expected layouts. Existing T2I benchmarks reveal important layout failures, yet they rarely isolate whether models can follow a specified frame of reference when it differs from camera view. To mitigate this gap, we introduce FoR-T2I, a benchmark for evaluating this distinction with 1,200 prompt pairs built from controlled spatial layouts. In each pair, the camera-view (Cam) prompt states the target relation in camera view, while the frame-of-reference (FoR) prompt describes the same target placement through an oriented anchor object. Across 22 closed-source and open-source T2I models, mean final accuracy is 41.8\% lower on FoR prompts than on matched Cam prompts; even the best-performing model achieves only 44.3\% FoR accuracy. This suggests that current models struggle more when the same layout is described through an object's orientation rather than directly in image coordinates. We further analyze this gap by relation type and camera view, compare several training-free prompting and feedback-based mitigation strategies, and propose a VLM-gated rewriting approach that selects rewritten prompts using visual feedback, improving average FoR accuracy from 25.0\% to 29.2\% under the same generation budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FoR-T2I 基准，用于评估文本到图像（T2I）模型能否遵循指定参照系（frame of reference）解释空间方向表述。基准包含 1,200 对提示，每对分别用相机视图（Cam）和通过带方向锚定对象（oriented anchor object）的参照系（FoR）描述同一目标布局。在 22 个闭源与开源 T2I 模型上，FoR 提示的平均最终准确率比匹配的 Cam 提示低 41.8 个百分点，即使最佳模型也只有 44.3% 的 FoR 准确率。作者进一步提出 VLM 门控改写（VLM-gated rewriting）策略，在相同生成预算下将平均 FoR 准确率从 25.0% 提升到 29.2%。
Motivation: 现有 T2I 基准虽然能揭示布局错误，但很少单独测试模型在参照系与镜头视角不一致时能否遵循指定的参照系。诸如 "the left of" 这类方向表述可能指图像坐标或物体固有朝向，导致预期布局不同，因此需要专门评估这一区别。
Method: 构建 FoR-T2I 基准，包含受控空间布局生成的 1,200 对提示；每对中 Cam 提示用相机视角陈述目标关系，FoR 提示通过有朝向的锚定对象描述同一目标位置。作者还按关系类型和相机视角分析差距，比较多种免训练提示与基于反馈的缓解策略，并提出一种用视觉反馈选择改写提示的 VLM 门控改写方法。
Result: 在 22 个模型上，FoR 提示的最终平均准确率比匹配的 Cam 提示低 41.8 个百分点；最佳模型 FoR 准确率也仅 44.3%。提出的 VLM 门控改写策略在相同生成预算下将平均 FoR 准确率从 25.0% 提升到 29.2%。
Conclusion: 当前 T2I 模型在通过物体朝向而非图像坐标描述相同布局时明显更困难，说明模型对参照系的理解仍不足。摘要未明确讨论该工作的局限性。

papers.title: A Direct Route to Markov Chain Convergence via Asymptotic Equivalence with the Target
papers.abstract_en: For a Markov kernel $T$ with an invariant probability measure $π$, we give a self-contained proof of the Markov chain convergence theorem via a criterion called asymptotic equivalence with the target. It assumes two parts about the Lebesgue decompositions of $T^{n}_{x}$ and $π$ for every starting point $x$: 1.) asymptotic absolute continuity: the singular mass sing$(T^{n}_{x}\midπ)$ tends to $0$; 2.) asymptotic domination of the target: the singular mass sing$(π\mid T^{n}_{x})$ tends to $0$, as $n \to \infty$. This criterion, on countably generated measurable spaces, is both sufficient and necessary for the Markov chain convergence. A density version of this criterion is verified on general measurable spaces in three cases: (i) $T$ has a positive transition density wrt $π$; (ii) $T$ consists of an absolutely continuous part with positive transition density together with an atom at the starting point, which covers the Metropolis--Hastings algorithm; (iii) the transition density is positive only after a finite number of steps that may depend on the starting point $x$. To demonstrate our general criterion, we investigate the Gibbs sampler with random scan and the parallel tempering algorithm. Furthermore, we show that in all mentioned settings Birkhoff's ergodic theorem applies, so as to obtain the strong law of large numbers. Throughout this paper, neither irreducibility, nor aperiodicity, nor recurrence, nor couplings, nor splitting constructions, nor small sets are used. In most results, the state space is a general measurable space, which carries no structure beyond a $σ$-algebra. Countable generation is only assumed where the density-free form of the criterion is stated. None of the theorems proved here is new; what is offered is a short route to a single, widely applicable Markov chain convergence criterion, which is both sufficient and necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出一个关于 Markov 核 T 及其不变概率测度 π 的 Markov 链收敛定理的自包含证明，核心判据称为“与目标的渐近等价”(asymptotic equivalence with the target)。该判据基于 Lebesgue 分解：要求奇异质量 sing(T_x^n | π) 与 sing(π | T_x^n) 均趋于 0；在可数生成的可测空间上，它既是收敛的充分条件也是必要条件。作者进一步在一般可测空间上验证该判据的密度版本，涵盖具有正转移密度的情形、Metropolis–Hastings 情形以及有限步后转移密度为正的情形，并应用于随机扫描 Gibbs 采样器与 parallel tempering 算法。文中不使用不可约性、非周期性、递推性、耦合、分裂构造或小集合假设，且所有定理并非新结果，贡献在于提供一条通向统一判据的短路径。
Motivation: 现有 Markov 链收敛理论通常依赖不可约性、非周期性、递推、耦合、分裂构造或小集合等较强条件，作者希望寻找一个同时充分且必要、且适用范围更广的单一收敛判据，从而简化证明路径。
Method: 提出“与目标的渐近等价”判据：对每个起点 x，要求 T_x^n 关于 π 的奇异质量趋于 0（渐近绝对连续），以及 π 关于 T_x^n 的奇异质量趋于 0（目标被渐近支配）。在该判据下证明 Markov 链收敛定理；并在三种情形（正转移密度、Metropolis–Hastings 的绝对连续部分加起点原子、有限步后转移密度为正）中给出密度版本的验证。
Result: 在可数生成的可测空间上，该判据对 Markov 链收敛是充分且必要的；在所述三类密度情形下判据成立，且 Birkhoff 遍历定理适用，从而得到强大数定律。摘要未给出数值实验或具体收敛速率数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调本文所有定理在文献中已有，真正的贡献是给出一个短而统一的 Markov 链收敛判据证明路径；该判据在一般可测空间上成立，仅密度无关形式需要可数生成假设。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调本文所有定理在文献中已有，真正的贡献是给出一个短而统一的 Markov 链收敛判据证明路径；该判据在一般可测空间上成立，仅密度无关形式需要可数生成假设。

papers.title: When Oracle Conditioning Misleads Deployment: Conditioning-Availability Bias in Echocardiographic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Conditional segmentation models may be trained and evaluated with auxiliary signals cleaner than those available at deployment. We study this protocol-level manifestation of shortcut learning and auxiliary-variable shift in phase-conditioned echocardiographic segmentation. The complementary gap pair measures loss on the deployable oracle-estimated pathway and probes sensitivity on the oracle-random pathway. On held-out CAMUS data, one strong-cyclic, oracle-selected run fails severely with estimated phase, while sensitivity to incorrect phase persists across three runs. On EchoNet-Dynamic, the current estimator remains usable, but random-phase testing reveals strong latent sensitivity. Deployment-aware checkpoint selection and phase perturbation reduce both gaps with little change in mean Dice. Exploratory subgroup analyses quantify variation across measured strata, and a downstream ejection fraction (EF) audit shows that recovering segmentation does not necessarily recover EF error or signed bias. Together, the gaps test whether oracle-conditioned performance survives the inference pathway actually available at deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the MICCAI 2026 Workshop on Fairness of AI in Medical Imaging (FAIMI 2026). To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究条件分割模型在部署时的 Oracle Conditioning Bias：训练和评估使用比部署时更干净的辅助信号，导致性能虚高。作者在 phase-conditioned 超声心动图分割中提出 complementary gap pair，分别衡量可部署的 oracle-estimated pathway 上的损失和 oracle-random pathway 上的敏感性。在 CAMUS 上，一个强循环、oracle 选取的 run 在估计相位下严重失败；在 EchoNet-Dynamic 上，随机相位测试揭示强潜在敏感性。部署感知的 checkpoint 选择和相位扰动可缩小两个 gap，且平均 Dice 变化很小；下游射血分数（EF）审计显示恢复分割并不一定恢复 EF 误差或符号偏差。
Motivation: 条件分割模型常以比部署时更干净的辅助信号进行训练和评估，这种协议层面的捷径学习（shortcut learning）与辅助变量偏移（auxiliary-variable shift）缺乏系统性度量，导致模型在真实部署路径上可能失效。
Method: 提出 complementary gap pair 评估协议：在可部署的 oracle-estimated pathway 上测损失，在 oracle-random pathway 上探测敏感性；并引入部署感知的 checkpoint 选择与相位扰动来缓解该偏差。
Result: 在 CAMUS 上，一个强循环、oracle 选取的 run 在估计相位下严重失败；EchoNet-Dynamic 上当前估计器虽可用，但随机相位测试暴露强潜在敏感性。部署感知选择与相位扰动使两个 gap 均下降且平均 Dice 几乎不变；下游 EF 审计表明分割 Dice 的恢复并不等同于 EF 误差或符号偏差的恢复。
Conclusion: 这两个 gap 旨在检验 oracle 条件下的性能能否在部署时实际可用的推理路径上存活；作者强调恢复分割性能并不必然恢复下游 EF 指标的准确性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Route-Align-Verify for Functional Correctness in Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved code generation, yet achieving strong functional correctness remains difficult, especially for heterogeneous programming tasks where a single prompting strategy and a single directly generated output are often insufficient. In this paper, we present RAV, a lightweight and modular framework that improves code generation with a fixed backbone model through three coordinated stages: Route, which applies task-aware prompt routing before generation; Align, which reduces the mismatch between fine-tuning prompts and inference-time prompts through aligned LoRA adaptation; and Verify, which selects the final output by executing multiple candidates against visible public tests. We evaluate RAV on the MBPP benchmark under both the sanitized and full settings. The complete RAV pipeline achieves the best performance among all evaluated configurations, reaching 0.8911 on MBPP Sanitized and 0.8520 on MBPP Full. Compared with the base model, these results represent improvements of 6.35 and 9.92 percentage points, respectively. Component-wise ablation experiments further show that task-aware routing and aligned adaptation become substantially more effective when combined with execution-based verification. Additional robustness and contamination analyses support the reliability of the observed improvements. Overall, the results indicate that functional correctness in code generation can be meaningfully improved without modifying the backbone architecture, by jointly optimizing how tasks are prompted, how the model is adapted, and how final outputs are selected.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAV，一种轻量模块化代码生成框架，在固定骨干模型上通过 Route（生成前的任务感知提示路由）、Align（对齐 LoRA 适配以减少微调与推理提示失配）和 Verify（执行多个候选并依据可见公共测试选择最终输出）三个协调阶段提升功能正确性。在 MBPP Sanitized 和 Full 上分别达到 0.8911 和 0.8520，较基础模型提升 6.35 和 9.92 个百分点。消融与污染分析支持改进的可靠性。
Motivation: 大语言模型虽显著改进代码生成，但单一提示策略和单一直接输出在异构编程任务上往往不足以实现强功能正确性。
Method: RAV 由三个阶段组成：Route 在生成前进行任务感知的提示路由；Align 通过对齐 LoRA 适配（aligned LoRA adaptation）降低微调提示与推理提示之间的失配；Verify 通过执行多个候选并对照可见公共测试来选出最终输出。
Result: 在 MBPP 基准的 sanitized 与 full 设置下，完整 RAV 管线达到 0.8911 与 0.8520，分别比基础模型提高 6.35 和 9.92 个百分点。组件级消融表明，任务感知路由和对齐适配在与基于执行的验证结合时效果显著增强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过联合优化任务提示方式、模型适配方式和最终输出选择，可以在不修改骨干架构的前提下有意义地改进代码生成的功能正确性。

papers.title: Traceable Multi-Agent System for Knowledge-Based Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise forecasting increasingly relies on autonomous agents that interpret documents, search for data, generate code, and revise models. While this autonomy helps build adaptive forecasting pipelines, it also makes it difficult for practitioners to inspect why a forecast changed, which evidence supported the change, and how data and modeling choices were revised. We present TraceMAS, an interactive demo system for traceable multi-agent forecasting. TraceMAS organizes agent outputs around two causal-loop representations: an Ideal Causal Loop Diagram (Ideal CLD), which captures key factors and their causal relations extracted from domain documents, and a Data-Grounded Causal Loop Diagram (Data-Grounded CLD), which links those factors to internal variables, external data, or documented proxies. The Data-Grounded CLD guides feature construction and model design while preserving the connection between textual evidence, data choices, and model revisions. We demonstrate TraceMAS on crude oil price forecasting. The demo interface allows users to compare forecasting iterations, inspect agent-level revisions, explore causal maps, review feature-data mappings and model architecture, and connect scenario forecasts to market narratives. This demonstration shows how autonomous forecasting agents can retain flexibility while making the evidence-to-forecast process inspectable.
papers.comment: Accepted at KDD 2026 Workshop on Enterprise AI Agents (Oral)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceMAS，一个面向可追溯多智能体预测的交互式演示系统。系统将智能体输出组织为两种因果环图：从领域文档提取关键因素及因果关系的 Ideal CLD，以及将这些因素关联到内部变量、外部数据或文档代理指标的 Data-Grounded CLD。该系统以原油价格预测为演示场景，界面支持比较预测迭代、检查智能体层级修改、探索因果图、查看特征-数据映射和模型架构，并将情景预测与市场叙事连接起来。
Motivation: 企业预测依赖自主智能体解释文档、搜索数据、生成代码并修订模型，这种自主性提升了适应性，但使从业者难以检查预测为何改变、哪些证据支持改变，以及数据和建模选择如何被修订。
Method: TraceMAS 围绕两种因果环图组织智能体输出：Ideal CLD 捕获从领域文档中提取的关键因素及其因果关系，Data-Grounded CLD 将这些因素连接到内部变量、外部数据或有据可查的代理指标；后者指导特征构建和模型设计，同时保持文本证据、数据选择与模型修订之间的联系。
Result: 论文在原油价格预测上演示了该系统，演示界面允许用户比较预测迭代、检查智能体层级修订、探索因果图、审查特征-数据映射和模型架构，并将情景预测与市场叙事对应起来。
Conclusion: 该演示表明，自主预测智能体可以在保持灵活性的同时，使从证据到预测的过程可检查。需要说明的是这是交互式系统演示，而非大规模实证评估。

papers.title: SPADE: An Input-Adaptive Sparse Attention Engine for Fast Video Diffusion Models Inference
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality but pay quadratic self-attention cost, making inference prohibitive at video-token scales. The challenge is input-adaptive sparsity: selecting critical Q/K/V tokens with negligible overhead and executing them for end-to-end gains. We present SPADE, a training-free sparse-attention engine of three parts: (i) vDiT-SSR, a specification defining 3D blocking candidates and formalizing dynamic masks via Summarizer/Estimator expressions; (ii) runtime scheme generation using SICS and a head-wise policy; and (iii) an executor with low-overhead index search, flash block-sparse attention, and kernel grouping. Across Hunyuan-Video and Wan 2.1/2.2 for text-to-video and image-to-video generation, SPADE raises sparsity and speed while preserving quality, accelerating attention by 2.26x-3.40x and end-to-end inference by 1.49x-1.80x. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/6somehow/DAC-SPADE.
papers.comment: Published in the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC '26). 7 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPADE，一个无需训练的输入自适应稀疏注意力引擎，用于加速视频扩散 Transformer (vDiT) 的推理。SPADE 由三部分组成：vDiT-SSR 规范定义 3D 分块候选并通过 Summarizer/Estimator 表达式形式化动态掩码；基于 SICS 和逐头策略的运行时方案生成；以及包含低开销索引搜索、flash 块稀疏注意力和内核分组的执行器。在 Hunyuan-Video 和 Wan 2.1/2.2 的文生视频与图生视频任务上，SPADE 在保持质量的同时将注意力加速 2.26x-3.40x，端到端推理加速 1.49x-1.80x。
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer (vDiT) 具有二次自注意力成本，在视频 token 规模下推理代价过高，而输入自适应稀疏性的挑战在于以可忽略的开销选择关键 Q/K/V token 并执行以获得端到端收益。
Method: 提出三部分组成的训练无关稀疏注意力引擎：vDiT-SSR 规范定义 3D 分块候选并通过 Summarizer/Estimator 表达式形式化动态掩码；运行时方案生成采用 SICS 和逐头策略；执行器包含低开销索引搜索、flash 块稀疏注意力和内核分组。
Result: 在 Hunyuan-Video 和 Wan 2.1/2.2 的文生视频与图生视频生成中，SPADE 提高稀疏度和速度并保持质量，注意力加速 2.26x-3.40x，端到端推理加速 1.49x-1.80x。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练无关的输入自适应稀疏注意力可以在视频扩散模型上实现显著的注意力与端到端推理加速，同时保持生成质量；代码已开源。

papers.title: Long-term Traffic Scene Prediction via Polynomial Representations in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: This thesis addresses fundamental challenges in traffic scene prediction for autonomous driving by introducing robust and computationally efficient models based on polynomial representations. While conventional sequence-based representations often struggle with noise and generalization, this work demonstrates that polynomial representations offer significant advantages in computational efficiency, generalization, and prediction plausibility. Through theoretical analysis and empirical validation, this thesis demonstrates that moderate-degree polynomials capture real-world motion dynamics with high fidelity without constraining predictive performance. Building on this foundation, a prediction model representing both trajectories and map geometry with polynomial representations achieves near state-of-the-art accuracy on standard benchmarks while substantially improving generalization under distribution shift. Extending this concept, a diffusion- based generative framework enables multi-agent scene generation, producing traffic continuations that are more plausible and kinematically consistent than those generated by conventional baselines. Evaluations on the Argoverse 2 and Waymo Open datasets confirm that polynomial representations reduce computational cost, enhance cross-dataset generalization, and yield smoother trajectories and higher behavioral plausibility. The findings reveal that standard in-distribution evaluation and regression-based metrics may fail to reflect true model generalization and prediction plausibility. By providing theoretical justification and empirical validation, this dissertation estab- lishes polynomial trajectory representations as an efficient, expressive, and generalizable foundation for traffic scene prediction in safety critical autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇博士论文，面向自动驾驶中的交通场景预测问题，提出基于多项式表示 (polynomial representations) 的轨迹与地图几何建模方法。作者通过理论分析和在 Argoverse 2 与 Waymo Open 数据集上的实验说明，中等阶次多项式能兼顾计算效率、跨数据集泛化与预测合理性；以此为基础的预测模型接近 SOTA 精度，并结合扩散生成框架实现多智能体场景生成，生成的交通延续更平滑且运动学上更一致。
Motivation: 传统的基于序列的表示在交通场景预测中对噪声敏感且泛化能力有限，而自动驾驶安全关键场景需要既高效又具备良好泛化与合理性的预测模型。
Method: 先用理论分析论证中等阶次多项式足以高保真刻画真实运动动态；然后构建同时用多项式表示轨迹和地图几何的预测模型；再扩展出基于扩散 (diffusion) 的生成框架用于多智能体场景生成。
Result: 在 Argoverse 2 和 Waymo Open 上，多项式表示降低了计算成本、增强了跨数据集泛化，并生成更平滑、行为合理性更高的轨迹；预测精度接近当前最优水平。作者还指出，标准分布内评估与基于回归的指标可能无法真实反映泛化能力和预测合理性。
Conclusion: 论文将多项式轨迹表示确立为自动驾驶交通场景预测中高效、有表达力且可泛化的基础表示，并强调现有评估指标在衡量真实泛化与合理性方面的局限。

papers.title: Screenshots or Tools? Eliciting Tool Use and Managing Multimodal Context in Hybrid GUI-MCP Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid computer-use agents can act through screenshots or call text tools. We find that having a tool available does not settle which way the effect goes. Under one identical GUI-MCP harness on the OSWorld-MCP benchmark (309 tasks), the same MCP tools improve a reasoning model by +4.0pp and degrade a non-reasoning model by -5.9pp (5 runs each, both beyond 2 SE). What separates the two is tool-decision behavior. The non-reasoning policy ignores, misnames, or falsely terminates around tools. The reasoning model avoids these failures, yet still calls a tool on only 55/309 tasks, 23.9% of the tool-reachable ones. We call this shortfall the adoption gap. Both levels of the problem share one cause: the model already has a cheaper route and is never trained to take it. Multi-turn RL probes that cause. At the action level, a dense tool bonus raises spreadsheet adoption 0.03 -> 0.33 and carries into greedy decoding, but held-out accuracy does not follow. Behavior is steerable; competence is not. The bottleneck lies in tool-call semantics. At the context level, a successful tool call often makes the next screenshot redundant. Dropping it and halving image history cuts input tokens by about a third, at a small accuracy cost. Retraining under the same observation rule removes that cost. The compressed agent then reaches 37.8% against 33.0% for the uncompressed operating point, at 53% of the input cost, and closes the rich-lean gap on a pre-registered degraded subset to zero. Tools help when the model chooses and integrates them, and current hybrid agents leave many such choices unused.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究混合 GUI-MCP 计算机使用智能体中“截图行动 vs 文本工具调用”的行为差异。在 OSWorld-MCP 基准（309 个任务）上，同一 GUI-MCP 框架下的同一组 MCP 工具使推理模型性能提升 4.0pp，却使非推理模型下降 5.9pp（各 5 次运行，均超出 2 个标准误）。推理模型仅在 55/309 个任务中调用工具，占可调用工具任务的 23.9%，作者称此为采纳缺口 (adoption gap)。多轮 RL 探针实验表明工具行为可被引导，但能力并未随之提升，瓶颈在工具调用语义；上下文压缩后智能体在 53% 的输入成本下达到 37.8% 准确率，超过未压缩运行点的 33.0%。
Motivation: 混合智能体既可通过截图行动也可调用文本工具，但“有工具可用”并不能决定实际效果方向：同一工具在不同模型上产生相反效果，且模型对工具的采用率很低，形成采纳缺口。作者希望定位这一缺口的成因，并检验多轮训练能否修复它。
Method: 在 OSWorld-MCP 基准上对比同一 GUI-MCP 框架下的推理模型与非推理模型，并用多轮 RL (multi-turn RL) 探针分别处理动作层与上下文层：动作层加入密集工具奖励 (dense tool bonus)；上下文层在成功工具调用后丢弃冗余截图并将图像历史减半，再在相同观察规则下重训压缩智能体。
Result: 密集工具奖励将电子表格工具采用率从 0.03 提升到 0.33 并保持到贪心解码，但留出准确率没有随之提升；丢弃冗余截图并减半图像历史使输入 token 减少约三分之一且准确率损失很小，重训消除该损失后，压缩智能体达到 37.8%（对比未压缩的 33.0%），输入成本为 53%，并在预先注册的降级子集上将 rich-lean 差距降为零。
Conclusion: 工具只有当模型选择并整合它们时才起作用，当前混合智能体留下了大量未被使用的工具选择；行为可被引导但能力并未随之提升，摘要强调瓶颈在于工具调用语义 (tool-call semantics)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AS-FedBridge: Pseudo-Spike Bridge Distillation for Heterogeneous ANN-SNN Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across distributed edge devices while strictly preserving data privacy. To facilitate practical deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as a promising alternative to traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) due to their sparse computing mechanisms and high energy efficiency. However, jointly training ANNs and SNNs exposes a challenge of representational misalignment, which is intrinsically caused by differences in information representation, specifically the semantic gap between continuous real-valued activations in ANNs and discrete spatio-temporal spikes in SNNs. To overcome this barrier, we propose AS-FedBridge, a novel federated learning framework tailored for mixed ANN-SNN clients. AS-FedBridge features a lightweight Bridge equipped with a Pseudo-Spike Interface, which effectively projects continuous signals into a spike-compatible space to facilitate ANN-SNN alignment. Given the absence of existing mixed ANN-SNN federated frameworks, we establish a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate against multiple advanced heterogeneous FL methods. Our empirical analysis demonstrates a positive correlation between the degree of ANN-SNN alignment and the collaborative FL performance. Across four datasets, AS-FedBridge consistently demonstrates advanced accuracy while mitigating extreme scale, architecture, and client heterogeneity challenge. Furthermore, our framework enables a highly controllable trade-off between model performance and resource efficiency. AS-FedBridge accomplishes these robust performance gains while introducing only marginal computational overhead, establishing a robust and practical foundation for mixed ANN-SNN federated learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AS-FedBridge，一个面向混合 ANN-SNN 客户端的联邦学习框架。其核心是一个轻量级 Bridge，通过伪尖峰接口 (Pseudo-Spike Interface) 将连续信号投影到与尖峰兼容的空间，缓解 ANN 实值激活与 SNN 离散时空尖峰之间的语义鸿沟。作者建立了混合 ANN-SNN 联邦学习的基准，并在四个数据集上验证了该框架在不同规模、架构和客户端异构性下的先进精度，同时以极小的计算开销实现性能与资源效率的可控权衡。
Motivation: 联邦学习在资源受限的边缘设备上部署时，SNN 因稀疏计算和高能效成为 ANN 的替代方案，但混合训练 ANN 与 SNN 时存在表征错位问题，源于连续实值激活与离散脉冲之间的语义差异。当前缺乏现成的混合 ANN-SNN 联邦学习框架，需要专门机制来对齐两类网络表征。
Method: 提出 AS-FedBridge 框架，为混合 ANN-SNN 客户端设计一个轻量级 Bridge，其中配备 Pseudo-Spike Interface，将 ANN 的连续信号投影到尖峰兼容空间以促进表征对齐。作者还建立了一个综合基准，用于对比多种先进的异构联邦学习方法，并分析对齐程度与协同性能的关系。
Result: 在四个数据集上，AS-FedBridge 持续取得先进的精度，同时缓解极端规模、架构和客户端异构性带来的挑战。实验显示 ANN-SNN 对齐程度与合作联邦学习性能呈正相关，并且框架能够实现模型性能与资源效率的高度可控权衡，仅引入边际计算开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为混合 ANN-SNN 联邦学习系统建立了稳健且实用的基础，表明通过伪尖峰接口促进表征对齐可以在异构联邦设置中有效提升协作性能，同时保持资源效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PolyLayout: Multi-room Manhattan Layout Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating room layouts from multi-view imagery is a core task for indoor scene understanding. Existing methods are typically limited either by poor generalization to new datasets or restrictive geometric assumptions of the room shape or camera configuration. Most also estimate rooms independently, failing to exploit shared building structure such as dominant directions, ground plane or ceiling height. We propose PolyLayout, a multi-room layout estimation method that parameterizes room layouts as Manhattan 3D polygons and optimizes them jointly across multiple rooms. The optimization objective is predicted by a neural network on top of robust pre-trained visual features and trained end-to-end with supervision only on output room layouts. At the same time, camera projection and polygon updates remain explicit and model-based. This separation between learned scoring and geometry improves generalization to new datasets and camera parameters. During optimization, PolyLayout adaptively refines the polygon topology through iterative wall split and merge operations while jointly utilizing structural cues across rooms. We introduce two new multi-view multi-room layout benchmarks by providing layout annotations to existing datasets, and experiments show that PolyLayout outperforms prior approaches, both in terms of accuracy and robustness. Project page: https://ghanning.github.io/PolyLayout
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyLayout，一种多房间曼哈顿布局估计方法，将房间布局参数化为曼哈顿 3D 多边形，并在多个房间间联合优化。优化目标由基于预训练视觉特征的神经网络预测，训练时仅以输出房间布局为监督，而相机投影与多边形更新保持显式、基于模型。作者还引入两个多视角多房间布局基准，并显示该方法在精度和鲁棒性上优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有房间布局估计方法或泛化性差，或对房间形状和相机配置有严格几何假设；大多数方法独立估计各房间，未能利用共享建筑结构（如主导方向、地面平面、天花板高度）。
Method: PolyLayout 将房间布局参数化为 Manhattan 3D 多边形，并跨房间联合优化；神经网络在鲁棒的预训练视觉特征上预测优化目标，端到端训练，仅用输出布局监督，同时保持相机投影和多边形更新的显式模型化；优化中通过迭代墙分割与合并操作自适应细化多边形拓扑。
Result: 作者为现有数据集添加布局标注，构建两个多视角多房间布局基准；实验表明 PolyLayout 在准确性和鲁棒性上均优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 将学习型评分与显式几何优化分离可提升对新数据集和相机参数的泛化能力，并支持跨房间结构线索的联合利用。
Relevance: 0
