papers.title: LocAnyMed: Vision-Language Grounding for Multimodal Medical Images
papers.abstract_en: Medical visual grounding connects free-form clinical queries to spatial evidence in medical images and is an important component of interpretable medical artificial intelligence. However, general-purpose grounding models are predominantly trained on natural images, while existing medical localization resources remain fragmented across imaging modalities, datasets, and task formulations. To address this gap, we construct LocAnyMed-200K, a multimodal medical visual grounding dataset containing approximately 200K image-query-answer examples across computed tomography, optical medical imaging, ultrasound, and X-ray. We harmonize heterogeneous detection and localization resources into a unified free-form instruction format that supports one or multiple bounding boxes, point coordinates, and no-target outputs for negative queries. Full-parameter fine-tuning of LocateAnything-3B on LocAnyMed-200K improves F1@IoU 0.50 from 10.64 to 85.59 on a held-out evaluation split, demonstrating that large-scale domain-specific supervision can equip a general grounding model with effective medical localization capabilities. Beyond spatial coordinates, a clinically interpretable grounding system should also communicate the evidence supporting its prediction. We therefore derive LocAnyMed-CoT-20K, a rationale-augmented subset that connects anatomical context, visual observations, and spatial conclusions through structured reasoning and further improves cross-source generalization through fine-tuning. Together, these resources provide a unified foundation for studying both localization accuracy and rationale quality across heterogeneous medical imaging modalities. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MiliLab/LocAnyMed.
papers.comment: Technical report; work in progress. 28 pages, 5 figures, and 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/MiliLab/LocAnyMed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建 LocAnyMed-200K 多模态医学视觉定位数据集，涵盖 CT、光学成像、超声和 X 射线，并将异构检测与定位资源统一为支持多边界框、点坐标及无目标负查询的自由格式指令，另派生出带结构化推理链的 LocAnyMed-CoT-20K 子集。对 LocateAnything-3B 进行全参数微调后，held-out 评估集上的 F1@IoU 0.50 从 10.64 提升至 85.59，表明大规模领域监督能赋予通用定位模型医学定位能力。
Motivation: 通用视觉定位模型主要在自然图像上训练，而现有医学定位资源分散于不同模态、数据集和任务形式，缺乏统一格式，制约了可解释医学人工智能的发展。
Method: 构建约 200K 样本的 LocAnyMed-200K 数据集，将检测与定位资源统一为支持单/多边界框、点坐标和无目标输出的指令格式；并派生 LocAnyMed-CoT-20K，通过连接解剖背景、视觉观察和空间结论的结构化推理，再以全参数微调方式训练 LocateAnything-3B。
Result: 在 held-out 评估集上，全参数微调将 F1@IoU 0.50 从 10.64 提升至 85.59；基于 CoT 子集的微调进一步改善了跨源泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些资源为跨异构医学影像模态研究定位准确性和推理质量提供了统一基础，并公开了代码。摘要未提及具体局限。

papers.title: Task-Oriented Candidate-Latent Feedback for Coarse-to-Fine Sensing in Distributed OFDM-ISAC Networks
papers.abstract_en: Future integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) architectures separate the sensing entity (SE) that acquires measurements from the sensing function (SF) that performs inference, creating a need for compact, task-oriented feedback on the SE-SF interface. Forwarding the raw channel frequency response or full per-link delay-Doppler-azimuth-elevation (DDAE) tensor is prohibitively expensive, while peak-only reporting discards target-discriminative structure under clutter. We propose a learning-based coarse-to-fine sensing pipeline with candidate-latent feedback for single-target estimation. At the SE, a lightweight convolutional scorer produces a dense delay-Doppler proposal map from pilot-based OFDM channel estimates, and a learned encoder constructs K compact C-dimensional candidate tokens by fusing per-candidate azimuth-elevation patches, normalized position, and confidence cues. The latents are uniformly quantized post-training to b bits and transmitted under a finite budget B_fb = bKC + 18K + 16 bits to the SF, which performs cross-candidate refinement, reranking, and joint four-parameter estimation. On a ray-traced urban scene with static and dynamic clutter, three operating points in the (K, C, b) design space achieve 96.33-98.88% detection at 107-806 bytes per coherent processing interval, compression ratios of 1.2-9.2 x 10^4 over the 8-bit DDAE magnitude tensor, reducing the SE-SF interface from multi-Gbit/s to sub-Mbit/s rates. Cross-scene evaluation on an independent campus-scale environment achieves 98.79-99.50% detection and at-or-better angular accuracy without retraining, indicating that the learned representation captures target-relevant structure that transports across scenes of comparable or lower clutter density.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布式 OFDM-ISAC 网络中 Sensing Entity (SE) 与 Sensing Function (SF) 之间的紧凑任务导向反馈问题，提出基于候选潜在表示 (candidate-latent) 的由粗到细 (coarse-to-fine) 单目标感知管线。SE 端用轻量卷积打分器生成稠密时延-多普勒候选图，学习编码器将每个候选的方位-俯仰补丁、归一化位置与置信度融合为 K 个 C 维候选 token，训练后均匀量化并以有限比特预算传输；SF 端执行跨候选细化、重排序与四参数联合估计。在光线追踪城市场景中，三个 (K, C, b) 工作点在 107-806 字节/相干处理间隔下达到 96.33-98.88% 检测率，相对 8-bit DDAE 幅度张量实现 1.2-9.2×10^4 压缩比。
Motivation: 未来 ISAC 架构将感知测量与感知推理分离，SE-SF 接口需要紧凑且任务导向的反馈；转发原始信道频响或完整 DDAE 张量开销过高，而仅报告峰值在杂波环境下会丢失目标判别结构。
Method: 提出学习式由粗到细感知管线：SE 端用轻量卷积打分器从基于导频的 OFDM 信道估计生成稠密时延-多普勒候选图，学习编码器构造 K 个 C 维候选 token（融合候选方位-俯仰补丁、归一化位置与置信度），训练后均匀量化到 b 比特并在预算 B_fb = bKC + 18K + 16 bits 内传输；SF 端进行跨候选细化、重排序和联合四参数估计。
Result: 在含静态与动态杂波的光线追踪城市场景中，三个工作点通过 107-806 字节每相干处理间隔达到 96.33-98.88% 检测率，压缩比为 1.2-9.2×10^4，SE-SF 接口速率从多 Gbit/s 降至 sub-Mbit/s；独立校园尺度场景上无需重训即可达到 98.79-99.50% 检测率，角度精度持平或更优。
Conclusion: 摘要认为学习到的候选潜在表示捕获了目标相关结构，并能迁移到杂波密度相当或更低的跨场景环境，从而显著降低 SE-SF 接口开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Any-OPD: Heterogeneous On-Policy Distillation for Flow-Matching Models via Representation-Space Bridging
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation, in which a teacher corrects samples that the student itself generates, presupposes that the two models speak the same language: identical VAE latents, matching architectures, and a common timestep grid. We ask what happens when none of this holds, as when the strongest teacher available and the student one wishes to deploy come from different model families, and find that the standard recipes have no answer: teacher latents cannot serve as targets in a foreign coordinate system, per-pixel losses against a teacher that stochastically re-draws local detail degenerate into blur or divergence, and timestep indices lose their meaning across mismatched schedules. We present Any-OPD, to our knowledge the first framework for on-policy distillation between arbitrary pairs of latent flow-matching generators. Any-OPD treats the teacher purely as a black-box sampler and connects the two models at exactly one point: a frozen, model-agnostic vision representation in which their independently decoded outputs are compared, sidestepping every assumption about latents, features, or architecture. Trajectory correspondence is recovered by matching continuous noise levels instead of step indices, and a brief anchoring phase, in which teacher samples are re-encoded through the student's own VAE, ensures the on-policy gradient measures sample quality rather than domain mismatch. Distilling the 12B FLUX.1-dev into the 2.5B SD3.5-Medium, Any-OPD lifts the student's PickScore from 0.846 to 0.884 and HPSv3 from 9.12 to 10.97, rivaling the teacher at a fifth of its size, where direct latent regression fails to train at all.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出传统在线蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 默认教师与学生共享相同的 VAE 潜在空间、网络架构和时间步网格，而当教师与学生来自不同模型家族时这些前提全部失效。作者提出 Any-OPD，据称是首个支持任意潜在流匹配生成器 (latent flow-matching generator) 对的在线蒸馏框架：将教师视为黑盒采样器，仅在冻结的、与模型无关的视觉表示空间中比较两者解码输出，并用连续噪声水平匹配代替时间步索引，辅以锚定阶段消除领域失配。在将 12B FLUX.1-dev 蒸馏到 2.5B SD3.5-Medium 的实验中，Any-OPD 将学生的 PickScore 从 0.846 提升到 0.884、HPSv3 从 9.12 提升到 10.97，以五分之一参数量逼近教师，而直接潜在回归完全无法训练。
Motivation: 现有在线蒸馏配方依赖教师与学生具有相同 VAE 潜在空间、匹配架构和共同时间步网格；当最强的可用教师与待部署学生来自不同模型家族时，这些标准方法无法工作：教师潜在码不能作为异质坐标系的训练目标，逐像素损失会退化为模糊或发散，时间步索引在错配的调度下也失去意义。
Method: Any-OPD 将教师完全当作黑盒采样器，把两个模型仅在单一连接点——一个冻结的、与模型无关的视觉表示——上进行比较，从而绕开对潜在空间、特征或架构的一切假设。轨迹对应关系通过匹配连续噪声水平而非步骤索引来恢复；此外引入一个简短的锚定阶段，将教师样本用学生自己的 VAE 重新编码，确保在线梯度衡量的是样本质量而非域差异。
Result: 摘要报告在将 12B FLUX.1-dev 蒸馏为 2.5B SD3.5-Medium 时，Any-OPD 使 PickScore 从 0.846 升至 0.884、HPSv3 从 9.12 升至 10.97，以教师五分之一大小的模型达到与教师相当的水平；相比之下，直接潜在回归在该设定下完全无法训练。
Conclusion: 作者称 Any-OPD 是第一个支持任意一对潜在流匹配生成器之间在线蒸馏的框架，核心思路是在模型无关的视觉表示空间建立连接，并以连续噪声水平匹配替代时间步索引。摘要未讨论该方法在图像生成之外的适用范围或天气等领域的表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evaluating LLM Trade-offs for Enterprise Automation: Lessons from Workflow Generation in a Production Enterprise Platform
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise compliance management requires rapid adaptation to evolving regulatory frameworks (e.g., DORA, AI RMF, FedRAMP) and tight remediation SLAs. Traditional static orchestrators often fail in hybrid cloud environments where event-driven assessments demand that automation code adapt to runtime context in seconds. This paper presents lessons learned from evaluating six large language models for AI-driven workflow generation in a production enterprise platform, benchmarked across 29 real-world IT automation scenarios, two generation pipeline architectures, and eight independent runs per prompt-model-pipeline configuration (2,784 runs total). Our initial pipeline used monolithic workflow generation, achieving 31.5-82.8% structural success rates (JSON schema validity and correct UI rendering), with most models struggling on complex JSON generation. We developed a redesigned piecewise pipeline that decomposes workflow construction into variable scaffolding, base block assembly, and nested block generation, raising structural success to 74.1-97.8% across all models. We analyze production tradeoffs including cost (USD 0.008-0.20 per workflow), latency (under 50s for interactive use), and model selection. Piecewise decomposition enables smaller models (e.g., mistral-small at 95.7% structural success and USD 0.01 per workflow) to reach production viability, removing dependency on expensive frontier models. While mistral-medium-2505 and gpt-oss-120b achieved the highest structural success (96.1% and 97.8%), mistral-medium-2505 carries a 19x cost premium versus mistral-small. Our deployment lessons highlight the need to separate structural validity from semantic correctness (logical fulfillment of user intent) and provide a solution for model-agnostic, scalable automation in cloud engineering.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 14th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Engineering (IC2E 2026), Industry Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文总结在生产企业平台上用六种大语言模型 (LLM) 做 AI 驱动工作流生成的评估经验，覆盖 29 个真实 IT 自动化场景、两种生成流水线架构，以及每种 prompt-model-pipeline 配置 8 次独立运行（共 2,784 次）。初始的 monolithic 工作流生成结构成功率仅为 31.5-82.8%，而重新设计的 piecewise 流水线（变量脚手架、基础块组装、嵌套块生成）把结构成功率提升到 74.1-97.8%。作者还分析了生产成本、延迟和模型选型，认为 piecewise 分解能让较小模型达到生产可用水平。
Motivation: 企业合规管理需要快速适应不断演变的监管框架（如 DORA、AI RMF、FedRAMP）并满足严格的修复 SLA，而传统静态编排器在混合云环境中难以应对需要事件驱动、运行时上下文自适应且数秒内完成评估的自动化需求。
Method: 先采用 monolithic 工作流生成流水线，随后重新设计为 piecewise 流水线，将工作流构建分解为变量脚手架 (variable scaffolding)、基础块组装 (base block assembly) 和嵌套块生成 (nested block generation) 三个步骤。
Result: piecewise 流水线把结构成功率从 monolithic 的 31.5-82.8% 提升到全部模型的 74.1-97.8%；其中 mistral-small 达到 95.7% 结构成功率且每个工作流成本约 USD 0.01，mistral-medium-2505 和 gpt-oss-120b 分别达到 96.1% 和 97.8%，但 mistral-medium-2505 比 mistral-small 贵约 19 倍；生产成本为每个工作流 USD 0.008-0.20，交互延迟低于 50 秒。
Conclusion: 部署经验表明应把结构有效性 (structural validity) 与语义正确性 (semantic correctness) 分开看待，piecewise 分解能消除对昂贵前沿模型的依赖，为云工程提供模型无关且可扩展的自动化方案。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: piecewise 流水线把结构成功率从 monolithic 的 31.5-82.8% 提升到全部模型的 74.1-97.8%；其中 mistral-small 达到 95.7% 结构成功率且每个工作流成本约 USD 0.01，mistral-medium-2505 和 gpt-oss-120b 分别达到 96.1% 和 97.8%，但 mistral-medium-2505 比 mistral-small 贵约 19 倍；生产成本为每个工作流 USD 0.008-0.20，交互延迟低于 50 秒。
summary_sections.conclusion: 部署经验表明应把结构有效性 (structural validity) 与语义正确性 (semantic correctness) 分开看待，piecewise 分解能消除对昂贵前沿模型的依赖，为云工程提供模型无关且可扩展的自动化方案。

papers.title: Recurrent Contrastive Learning for Imbalanced Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Medical image classification often suffers from class imbalance due to the inherent disparities in disease incidence. Existing approaches, such as class resampling and loss reweighting, mainly improve learning within the observed feature distribution, but do not explicitly enlarge the latent support region of tail classes. As a result, tail-class representations remain overly compact and are easily encroached upon by head classes, leading to biased decision boundaries. In this work, we propose Recurrent Contrastive Learning (RCL) for imbalanced medical image classification. RCL progressively expands the support region of tail classes by recurrently reusing historical feature states across training phases. Specifically, we adopt DINOv3 with LoRA adapters as the backbone to provide robust feature embeddings. We then devise a Temporal Memory Queue (TMQ) to preserve corpus-level features across training phases and provide diversified global references for contrastive learning. Based on TMQ, we construct Temporal Anchors (TARs) to form an anchor field around tail classes. This field enlarges the support region of tail classes, suppresses head-class encroachment, and improves inter-class separation. Extensive experiments on three imbalanced medical datasets demonstrate that RCL achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/dndins/RCL.
papers.journal_ref: The 7th MICCAI Workshop on Advances in Simplifying Medical UltraSound.2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于不平衡医学图像分类的循环对比学习（Recurrent Contrastive Learning, RCL），通过跨训练阶段循环复用历史特征状态来逐步扩大尾部类别的支持区域。方法采用 DINOv3 加 LoRA 适配器作为骨干网络，设计时间记忆队列（Temporal Memory Queue, TMQ）与时间锚点（Temporal Anchors, TARs）构建锚点场，以抑制头部类别对尾部类别的侵占。在三个不平衡医学数据集上的实验表明，RCL 相对于强基线取得一致的性能提升。
Motivation: 医学图像分类常因疾病发病率差异而存在类别不平衡。现有类重采样和损失重加权等方法主要改善观测特征分布内的学习，并未显式扩大尾部类别的潜在支持区域，导致尾部表征过于紧凑、容易被头部类别侵占，从而产生有偏的决策边界。
Method: 提出 RCL：先采用 DINOv3 与 LoRA 适配器作为骨干以得到稳健的特征嵌入；再设计时间记忆队列（TMQ）跨训练阶段保留语料级特征，为对比学习提供多样化的全局参考；基于 TMQ 构造时间锚点（TARs），在尾部类别周围形成锚点场，以扩大其支持区域、抑制头部类别侵占并改善类间分离。
Result: 在三个不平衡医学数据集上的广泛实验表明，RCL 相对于强基线取得一致的改进；摘要未报告具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过循环利用历史特征状态显式扩大尾部类别的支持区域，可以有效缓解类别不平衡导致的决策边界偏移问题。

papers.title: SeaSlides: Semantic Abstraction Layer for Agentic Slide Generation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic presentation generation must preserve source content, maintain coherent visual design, render specialized objects, and produce usable artifacts. Existing systems meet only part of this requirement: templates preserve regularity but restrict adaptation, whereas free-form HTML or SVG gives models flexibility at the cost of low-level rendering decisions. This mismatch makes long technical decks brittle, especially when slides contain formulas, code, or data graphics. We present SeaSlides, an agentic slide-generation framework built around a semantic abstraction layer. Rather than authoring coordinates, inline styles, or raw SVG geometry, the model writes structured slide content through reusable components and capability modules, while templates own layout, style, and rendering. We instantiate this principle separately in HTML and Typst: SeaSlides-HTML uses template-defined DOM components, whereas SeaSlides-Typst uses template functions and package-backed modules. Capability modules route equations, code, and charts to dedicated renderers, and three feedback stages localize build errors, project-constraint violations, and visual defects before export. The two systems retain backend-specific syntax and contracts while sharing the same authoring boundary. For evaluation, we combine the 128-task UltraPresent validation setting with SeaSlidesBench-Rich, a new 32-task benchmark stressing mathematics, code, pseudocode, tables, charts, and diagrams. Across four generation models, both SeaSlides backends produce more readable, content-oriented source than SVG-heavy generation. A SeaSlides backend attains the highest rich-content macro-average under three of the four models while maintaining competitive overall qualitative performance. These results support semantic abstraction as a practical authoring principle across presentation backends.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeaSlides，一个围绕语义抽象层 (semantic abstraction layer) 构建的 agentic 幻灯片生成框架。模型不再编写坐标、内联样式或原始 SVG 几何，而是通过可复用组件和功能模块编写结构化幻灯片内容，布局、样式与渲染交给模板负责；该原则分别在 HTML 和 Typst 两个后端实例化。能力模块将公式、代码、图表路由到专用渲染器，并通过三个反馈阶段在导出前定位构建错误、约束违反和视觉缺陷。评估结合 128 任务 UltraPresent 验证集和新提出的 32 任务 SeaSlidesBench-Rich，在四个生成模型下两个 SeaSlides 后端均生成更可读、更面向内容的源码，并在多数模型上取得最高富内容宏平均。
Motivation: 现有的 agentic 演示生成系统只满足部分需求：模板保持规整但限制适应性，自由形式 HTML 或 SVG 给模型灵活性但代价是低层渲染决策；这种不匹配使长技术型幻灯片变得脆弱，尤其当幻灯片包含公式、代码或数据图形时。
Method: 提出 SeaSlides 框架，以语义抽象层为核心，让模型写结构化内容而由模板负责布局、样式和渲染。在 HTML 后端使用模板定义的 DOM 组件，在 Typst 后端使用模板函数和包支持的模块；能力模块将方程、代码和图表路由到专用渲染器，并使用三个反馈阶段定位构建错误、项目约束违反和视觉缺陷，再导出成品。
Result: 在 128-task UltraPresent 验证设置和新的 32-task SeaSlidesBench-Rich 基准上，四个生成模型下两个 SeaSlides 后端都比 SVG-heavy 生成产生更可读、更面向内容的源码；SeaSlides 后端在四个模型中的三个上取得最高的 rich-content 宏平均 (macro-average)，同时保持有竞争力的整体定性表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果支持语义抽象作为跨演示后端的实用创作原则；两个后端共享相同的创作边界，同时保留各自后端的语法和合约。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Distractor-Aware Truncation: Disentangling Context-Length Effects from Signal Loss in Long-Context LLM Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: A standard claim in the literature on retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented language models is that shorter context is better when the relevant information is preserved. We test this claim by running every sample of two long-context benchmarks -- BABILong and GraphWalks (BFS) -- at four context-retention fractions (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%) under two truncation protocols. The first is the naive protocol implicitly used in much prior work: drop content from the middle of the prompt. The second is distractor-aware: identify the task-relevant content for each sample and drop only the rest. We evaluate three sizes of the Claude family (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7) and, to test cross-provider generality, GPT-5.5 from a different provider; we apply the same protocol to two further benchmarks (MRCR v2, Oolong). Under naive truncation, score collapses monotonically (paired Wilcoxon, Holm-corrected p_adj < 0.05 in all eight BABILong and GraphWalks cells). Under the distractor-aware protocol -- which preserves the signal by construction -- performance is preserved or improves: the two smaller Claude models show statistically significant gains on BABILong, while the larger models (Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5) sit at their full-context ceiling. The naive collapse and its distractor-aware recovery replicate on GPT-5.5, ruling out a single-provider artifact. The mechanism is direct: under the naive protocol the answer-bearing content survives in fewer than 1% of samples at 25% retention; under the distractor-aware protocol it is preserved by construction. The naive protocol is therefore not a measurement of context-window effects; it is a measurement of how often middle-removal happens to spare the answer. We conclude that future studies of context-length effects must specify how they distinguish signal from distractor, or they are at best ambiguous between two opposite hypotheses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验“保留相关信息时更短上下文更好”这一常见论断，在 BABILong 和 GraphWalks (BFS) 两个长上下文基准上，以四种上下文保留比例（100%、75%、50%、25%）对比朴素截断（从中间删内容）与干扰物感知截断（只删与任务无关内容）对 Claude 系列（Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6、Opus 4.7）和 GPT-5.5 的影响。结果显示朴素截断下成绩单调下降，而干扰物感知截断下性能保持或提升。作者据此认为朴素截断测的不是上下文窗口效应，而是中间删除碰巧保留答案的频率。
Motivation: 长上下文基准中常用的朴素截断协议把上下文长度效应与关键信号丢失混为一谈，使“短上下文更好”的结论在两种相反假设之间含糊不清。
Method: 提出干扰物感知截断协议：对每个样本识别任务相关内容，只删除其余内容；并与朴素中间删除协议对比，在多个模型和多个基准上重复同一实验方案。
Result: 朴素截断下所有 BABILong 和 GraphWalks 单元均呈单调下降（配对 Wilcoxon，Holm 校正后 p_adj < 0.05）；干扰物感知截断下性能保持或提升，两个较小 Claude 模型在 BABILong 上有统计显著提升，较大模型（Opus 4.7 和 GPT-5.5）处于全上下文上限。朴素截断在 25% 保留率时，答案相关内容在不足 1% 的样本中存活。
Conclusion: 未来研究上下文长度效应必须说明如何区分信号与干扰物，否则结果至少是含糊的；该结论在 GPT-5.5 上复现，排除了单一提供商的人工产物。

papers.title: PLS-Calib: A Partial Least Squares Framework for Event Camera and Odometry Calibration under Ground Motion Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Accurate extrinsic rotation calibration between sensors is fundamental to the performance of robotic perception systems. However, most existing calibration techniques rely on full 6-DoF motion to excite all degrees of freedom, which is often infeasible for ground-constrained robots with limited motion capabilities. Recent approaches designed for such restricted settings, such as Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)-based methods, suffer from ill-conditioned covariance matrices that lead to numerical instability and suboptimal calibration accuracy. To overcome these limitations, we present a novel rotation calibration framework named PLS-Calib that, for the first time, leverages Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression to model the latent kinematic correlations between asynchronous, heterogeneous sensor streams. Specifically, we apply our method to the calibration of an event camera and an odometry onboard a ground robot. To improve event-based pattern detection, we introduce a polarity-aware event representation, which enhances spatiotemporal contrast in circular calibration targets. Our PLS-based formulation yields a closed-form, stable solution that avoids matrix singularities inherent in CCA-based approaches. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating significant improvements in calibration robustness and accuracy over state-of-the-art methods. This work offers a practical and theoretically grounded solution for rotation calibration in constrained robotic systems and opens up new directions for applying statistical learning techniques in neuromorphic vision.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于偏最小二乘回归 (Partial Least Squares, PLS) 的旋转标定框架 PLS-Calib，用于地面机器人上事件相机与里程计之间的外部旋转标定。摘要称该方法在合成与真实数据上相比基于 CCA 的现有方法显著提升了标定鲁棒性和精度，并提供闭式稳定解以避免矩阵奇异。
Motivation: 现有标定方法通常依赖完整 6-DoF 运动来激励所有自由度，但地面受限机器人难以满足该条件；而针对受限场景的 CCA 类方法会因协方差矩阵病态导致数值不稳定和次优的标定精度。
Method: 利用 PLS 回归对异步、异构传感器流之间的潜在运动学相关性建模，并引入一种极性感知 (polarity-aware) 的事件表示来增强圆形标定靶的时空对比度。PLS 公式产生闭式稳定解，规避 CCA 方法固有的矩阵奇异问题。
Result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法相较现有最先进方法在标定鲁棒性和精度上有显著改进。
Conclusion: 该工作为运动受限机器人系统提供了一种实用且有理论依据的旋转标定方案，并为在神经形态视觉中应用统计学习技术开辟了新方向。

papers.title: Provably Learning Multi-Head Attention with Queries
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning multi-head softmax attention from black-box input-output access. The learner may query arbitrary real-valued token sequences and observe only the scalar output at the final token. Recent work gives an algorithm using $O(d^2)$ value queries to recover the single-head parameters $(W,v)$. For multiple heads, the same work establishes identifiability under the assumption that the heads occupy pairwise orthogonal subspaces. Applying the single-head recovery algorithm separately to the heads additionally requires bases for these subspaces to be known. We recover a canonical representation by merging heads with the same $W_h$, summing their corresponding $v_h$, and discarding a merged head when this sum is zero, without these subspace assumptions. By varying the number of copies of a token, our algorithm obtains samples of a rational function whose interpolation separates the canonical heads. Additional queries formed by adding selected token vectors then match the same head across different queries. When the oracle outputs and all subsequent computations are exact, the learner chooses its query vectors at random and recovers the canonical pairs $\{(W_h,v_h):h\in[H]\}$ up to permutation with probability one. When $H$ is known, it uses exactly $4Hd^2-2H+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H+1$. If only a known upper bound $H_0$ is available, the algorithm uses $4H_0d^2-2H_0+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H_0+1$. For approximate oracle outputs, we give conditions under which the parameter error is at most a model- and query-dependent constant multiple of the output error. Finally, we extend our result to a one-layer Transformer with multi-head attention followed by a bias-free ReLU feed-forward network. Under additional conditions, we recover a functionally equivalent Transformer without relying on a separate algorithm for learning the feed-forward network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过黑盒输入输出访问学习多头 softmax 注意力：学习器可查询任意实值 token 序列，并只能观察最后 token 处的标量输出。作者在不依赖头所在子空间两两正交的假设下，通过合并具有相同 W_h 的头并对其 v_h 求和，恢复出规范表示 {(W_h,v_h):h∈[H]}（至多相差置换）。在精确计算条件下，已知 H 时恰好使用 4Hd^2-2H+1 次值查询、最大序列长度 2H+1，以概率 1 恢复参数；若只知道上界 H_0 则有对应复杂度。近似输出情形下，参数误差被模型与查询相关的常数倍输出误差所控制。
Motivation: 已有工作用 O(d^2) 次值查询恢复单头参数 (W,v)，对多头只在其占据两两正交子空间的假设下证明可辨识性，且逐头应用单头恢复算法还需要预先知道这些子空间的基。本文希望去掉这些子空间假设，仅靠黑盒访问恢复多头注意力的可辨识表示。
Method: 提出先合并 W_h 相同的头、累加对应 v_h，并在累加和为零时丢弃该头；通过改变某个 token 的拷贝次数，获得一个有理函数的采样值，再用插值分离各个规范头；随后构造向序列中加选定向量的额外查询，以在不同查询间匹配同一个头。精确计算下，学习器随机选取查询向量即可完成恢复。

Conclusion: 该方法进一步扩展到一层 Transformer，即在多头注意力后接无偏 ReLU 前馈网络的情形；在额外条件下，无需单独学习前馈网络的算法即可恢复功能等价的 Transformer。

papers.title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long Document Visual Question Answering (LongDocVQA) requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to locate, integrate, and reason over heterogeneous document elements distributed across multiple pages. Existing approaches, including end-to-end MLLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and document agents, often lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify how grounded evidence is progressively composed during reasoning, limiting both answer accuracy and traceability. In this paper, we cast LongDocVQA as an explicit evidence graph reasoning problem rather than implicit answer prediction. To this end, we propose DocTrace, a hierarchical framework that progressively performs evidence localization, structured document parsing, and evidence graph reasoning to enable explicit evidence provenance. To effectively learn these capabilities, we develop a two-stage training framework: joint Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) first initializes evidence localization and graph reasoning abilities, followed by task-specific Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with dedicated rewards to further optimize these capabilities. Extensive experiments on MMLongBench-Doc, LongDocURL, and SlideVQA demonstrate that DocTrace consistently outperforms both existing open-source baselines and proprietary MLLMs. Compared with the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone, DocTrace achieves absolute improvements of 14.4, 11.3, and 11.7 points on the three benchmarks, respectively. Beyond competitive performance, DocTrace constructs traceable evidence graphs with explicit node-level provenance, enabling transparent and verifiable reasoning for long document understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DocTrace，将长文档视觉问答 (LongDocVQA) 建模为显式证据图推理问题，而非隐式答案预测。框架层次化地依次进行证据定位、结构化文档解析和证据图推理，形成可追溯的证据来源，并采用两阶段训练：联合有监督微调 (SFT) 初始化证据定位与图推理能力，再用带专用奖励的任务特定 GRPO 进一步优化。在 MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL 和 SlideVQA 上，DocTrace 一致超过现有开源基线与专有 MLLM，相对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 骨干分别提升 14.4、11.3 和 11.7 个绝对百分点。
Motivation: 现有端到端 MLLM、检索增强生成 (RAG) 流水线和文档智能体通常缺乏显式机制来表示和验证基于证据的推理如何逐步组合，限制了长文档问答的答案准确性与可追溯性。
Method: 提出 DocTrace 层次化框架，依次执行证据定位、结构化文档解析和证据图推理以提供显式证据来源；训练上采用两阶段策略，先用联合 SFT 初始化证据定位与图推理能力，再以带专门奖励的任务特定 GRPO 进行优化。
Result: 在 MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL 和 SlideVQA 三个基准上，DocTrace 始终优于现有开源基线与专有 MLLM；以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为骨干时，三者的绝对提升分别为 14.4、11.3 和 11.7 个百分点。
Conclusion: DocTrace 不仅取得强性能，还构建带有显式节点级来源的可追溯证据图，为长文档理解提供透明、可验证的推理路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Tell-Tale Trace: Detecting Reasoning Failures in LLMs Using Chain-of-Thought Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large language model (LLM) performance while also providing an observable interface to the model's reasoning process. Existing approaches that leverage verbalized CoTs to monitor reasoning correctness, however, largely evaluate the semantic correctness or consistency of individual intermediate steps, rather than how the reasoning process evolves across the trace. As a result, failures distributed across the reasoning trajectory, rather than those localized to a single incorrect step, remain comparatively underexplored. Furthermore, verbalized CoTs need not faithfully reflect the model's internal reasoning, motivating analyses that do not treat individual statements as literal accounts of internal computation. In this work, we therefore ask whether the dynamics of visible CoT can be leveraged to systematically distinguish successful from failed reasoning without assuming such semantic faithfulness. We study a range of LLMs on verifiable Boolean satisfiability tasks with variable complexity, enabling controlled comparisons near each model's capability frontier. Tagging CoT sentences by reasoning function reveals premature verification collapse on SAT problems: incorrect traces enter clause checking earlier, repeat similar operations, and finalize sooner. On UNSAT problems, models presumptuously move towards incorrect SAT conclusions, checking candidate assignments rather than deriving contradictions across constructed cases. Subsequently, a targeted proof-search prompt intervention raises Llama3-70B accuracy from 13.3% to 85%, correcting 84.6% of these errors. These results show that capability failures can manifest as distributed, task-dependent changes in the structure of visible reasoning, and that CoT dynamics agnostic to whether the verbalized trace reflects the model's internal computations can help diagnose and correct failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否通过可观察的思维链（CoT）动力学来区分大型语言模型的推理成功与失败，而不假定语言化轨迹忠实反映模型的内部计算。作者在可验证的布尔可满足性（SAT）任务上对多个 LLM 进行研究，发现失败轨迹表现为过早的验证崩溃、重复相似操作并更早结束；UNSAT 问题上模型会过早转向错误的 SAT 结论。随后一个针对性的 proof-search 提示干预把 Llama3-70B 准确率从 13.3% 提升到 85%，纠正了 84.6% 的错误。
Motivation: 现有利用语言化 CoT 监控推理正确性的方法主要评估单个中间步骤的语义正确性或一致性，而忽视分布在整条推理轨迹上的失败；同时语言化 CoT 未必忠实反映模型内部推理，因此需要不假设语义忠实性的分析方法。
Method: 在可验证的布尔可满足性任务上，针对不同复杂度并接近各模型能力边界的情况进行研究；按推理功能（reasoning function）标注 CoT 句子，比较成功与失败轨迹的动态结构差异，并设计针对性的 proof-search 提示干预来纠正错误。
Result: 摘要报告在 SAT 问题上，错误轨迹更早进入子句检查、重复相似操作且更早终止；在 UNSAT 问题上，模型会过早转向错误的 SAT 结论并检查候选赋值，而非推导矛盾。针对性提示干预将 Llama3-70B 准确率从 13.3% 提升至 85%，纠正了 84.6% 的错误。
Conclusion: 能力失败可以表现为可见推理结构上分布式且依赖任务的变化；不依赖语言化轨迹是否忠实反映内部计算的 CoT 动力学方法，有助于诊断并纠正这些失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for Safe Text-Guided Image Generation via Intermediate Clean Estimates
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring safety and policy compliance in text-to-image diffusion models remains a critical challenge, as benign or adversarial prompts can often elicit prohibited content, e.g. nudity and protected intellectual property. While training-based unlearning methods are effective, they are computationally expensive and prone to catastrophic interference with general capabilities. Conversely, existing test-time defenses are primarily prompt-centric, relying on modifying textual descriptions only, and overlook the visual signals for detection. In this paper, we propose to leverage the intermediate clean image estimated during the generation process and employ a sparse margin objective to detect prohibited concepts. When a violation is detected, we immediately intervene by optimizing a structured low-rank residual in the text-conditioning space via truncated backpropagation. This design allows weight-preserving detection, keeps non-violating inference latency nearly unchanged as the maximum budget increases, and offers flexibility in safety performance via test-time scaling. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v3.5 across nudity removal, IP protection, and style erasure demonstrate superior performance across suppression, fidelity and preservation compared to prior weight-preserving baselines, providing a scalable and flexible solution for safe generative deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型的安全合规问题，提出利用生成过程中的中间干净图像估计（intermediate clean estimates）来检测禁止概念，并在检测到违规时通过截断反向传播优化文本条件空间中的结构化低秩残差进行干预，实现不修改权重的保护。在Stable Diffusion v1.4和v3.5上的nudity移除、IP保护和风格擦除实验中，该方法在抑制、保真度和保留方面优于先前权重保持的基线。
Motivation: 训练型遗忘方法计算成本高且容易与通用能力产生灾难性干扰；现有测试时防御主要依赖修改提示词，忽略视觉信号，导致检测能力有限。
Method: 利用生成过程中估计的中间干净图像，采用稀疏边际目标（sparse margin objective）检测违规概念；一旦检测到违规，通过截断反向传播（truncated backpropagation）在文本条件空间中优化结构化低秩残差（structured low-rank residual），实现权重保持的检测与干预。
Result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.4和v3.5上针对nudity移除、IP保护和风格擦除的实验中，相比先前权重保持的基线，该方法在抑制、保真度和保留方面表现更优。
Conclusion: 该方法提供可扩展且灵活的安全生成部署方案，非违规推理延迟几乎不随最大预算增加而变化，并允许通过测试时缩放（test-time scaling）调节安全性能。

papers.title: AgentPanel: Toward a New Paradigm for Human--AI Collaboration in Exploring Scientific Questions
papers.abstract_en: Identifying promising scientific ideas remains an important challenge in research practice. Researchers commonly rely on small-group discussions or one-to-one interactions with a single large language model, yet these approaches often expose them to only a limited range of perspectives and directions. We present AgentPanel, a multi-agent forum for human--AI collaboration in scientific exploration. Heterogeneous agents asynchronously discuss scientific questions in a forum-style environment, while researchers can submit questions, browse and organize candidate ideas, engage agents in follow-up interactions, and optionally generate post-hoc summary reports. We evaluate AgentPanel in terms of idea quality, exploration breadth, interaction effectiveness, candidate-selection efficiency, and practical utility. Offline experiments show that AgentPanel outperforms a centralized multi-agent debate baseline. A human study with 20 participants further shows that users value AgentPanel for perspective diversity and exploration support. In experience-based comparisons with commonly used LLM tools, 65\% of participants favored AgentPanel for both breadth of research directions and overall suitability for early-stage exploration. The platform is publicly available at https://agentpanel.cc/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentPanel，一个用于科学问题探索的人机协作多代理论坛 (multi-agent forum)。异构代理以异步方式围绕科学问题展开论坛式讨论，研究者可提交问题、浏览和组织候选想法、与代理进行后续交互，并可选生成事后总结报告。离线实验显示其优于集中式多代理辩论基线 (centralized multi-agent debate baseline)，20 人参与的用户研究也表明用户认可其观点多样性和探索支持。
Motivation: 识别有前景的科学想法仍是研究实践中的重要挑战。传统做法依赖小组讨论或与单个大语言模型的一对一交互，往往只能暴露有限的观点和方向。
Method: 构建 AgentPanel 平台：异构代理在论坛式环境中异步讨论科学问题，同时为研究者提供提问、浏览与组织候选想法、后续追问以及可选的事后报告生成等交互机制。
Result: 离线实验表明 AgentPanel 优于集中式多代理辩论基线。包含 20 名参与者的用户研究显示，用户重视其观点多样性和探索支持；在与常用大语言模型工具的体验对比中，65% 的参与者更青睐 AgentPanel，认为其在研究方向的广度和早期探索的整体适合作上更好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AgentPanel 对早期科研探索的实用价值，并给出公开平台地址 https://agentpanel.cc/；摘要未讨论具体局限。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: 3DGSI-Assessor: A Large-Scale Dataset and An LMM-based Method for 3D Gaussian Splatting Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a dominant representation for real-time novel view synthesis (NVS), yet its storage footprint makes compression indispensable for practical deployment. 3DGS training and compression introduce representation-specific distortions such as floating artifacts and surface scattering, which conventional image quality assessment (IQA) metrics fail to capture. Moreover, the independent compression of geometric and color attributes may lead to decoupled dimension-specific distortions that must be diagnosed separately, yet existing metrics report only a single overall score. To address these gaps, we present 3DGS-IEval-15K+, a large-scale, multi-dimensional IQA dataset for compressed 3DGS, comprising 15,200 images from 10 diverse scenes, produced by 6 representative 3DGS algorithms at systematically designed compression levels and rendered from 20 strategically selected viewpoints spanning both training views and challenging novel views, annotated with 45,600 mean opinion scores (MOSs) across overall, geometry, and color quality. Based on 3DGS-IEval-15K+, we propose 3DGSI-Assessor, an all-in-one 3DGS IQA framework that integrates global semantic and dimension-specific local features within a large multimodal model (LMM), predicting all three dimensions in a single forward pass. 3DGSI-Assessor achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3DGS-IEval-15K+, and exhibits competitive generalization on other NVS benchmarks. Dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/YukeXing/3DGSI-Assessor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向压缩 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 的大型多维度图像质量评估数据集 3DGS-IEval-15K+，包含来自 10 个场景的 15,200 张图像、6 种代表性 3DGS 算法、20 个视角（含训练视角与挑战性新视角）以及 45,600 个覆盖整体、几何和颜色质量的平均意见分数 (MOS)。基于该数据集，作者提出 3DGSI-Assessor，一种在大语言多模态模型 (LMM) 中整合全局语义和维度特定局部特征的一体化评估框架，单次前向即可预测三个质量维度，并在该基准上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 3DGS 训练与压缩会产生浮点伪影、表面散射等表示特定失真，传统 IQA 指标无法捕捉；同时几何与颜色属性的独立压缩可能产生解耦的维度特定失真，而现有指标只给出单一整体分数，无法分别诊断。
Method: 构建大规模多维度 IQA 数据集 3DGS-IEval-15K+，并提出 3DGSI-Assessor：一个基于 LMM 的全合一框架，在单次前向中同时预测整体、几何和颜色三个质量维度，融合全局语义特征与维度特定局部特征。
Result: 3DGSI-Assessor 在 3DGS-IEval-15K+ 上达到最先进性能，并在其他 NVS 基准上表现出具有竞争力的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者将数据集和代码开源，并强调该工作填补了压缩 3DGS 专用多维度 IQA 的空白；摘要未提及明显的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Noise-Aware Shrinkage for Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private zeroth-order optimization (DP-ZO) enables memory-efficient private fine-tuning of large language models using only forward evaluations. Existing aggregation-based DP-ZO methods reconstruct model updates at a fixed scale, ignoring that the strength of useful signals varies throughout training. Consequently, noise-dominated updates may receive excessive weight and degrade model utility. To address this issue, we propose SAGE, a noise-aware shrinkage method that adaptively attenuates privatized estimates according to their estimated signal quality. SAGE subtracts the known Gaussian noise variance from the observed second moment to estimate the underlying signal energy, stabilizes this estimate through temporal tracking, and compares its current signal-to-noise level with a warm-up reference to derive a bounded shrinkage factor. As pure post-processing, SAGE requires neither additional privacy budget nor model queries and introduces only constant additional state. Our theoretical analysis shows that shrinkage reduces the quadratic update-risk term faster than the linear descent term, preserving useful descent while limiting the influence of noise-dominated updates. Experiments on RoBERTa-large, OPT-1.3B, and OPT-6.7B demonstrate that SAGE outperforms existing baselines in most settings under the same privacy budgets while preserving the forward-only memory efficiency of DP-ZO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE，一种面向差分隐私零阶优化（DP-ZO）的噪声感知收缩方法，用于大语言模型的内存高效私有微调。SAGE 从观测二阶矩中减去已知高斯噪声方差来估计信号能量，通过时间跟踪稳定估计，并与 warm-up 参考比较当前信噪比以导出有界收缩因子。作为纯后处理，SAGE 不增加额外隐私预算或模型查询，只引入常数额外状态；实验在 RoBERTa-large、OPT-1.3B 和 OPT-6.7B 上显示其在相同隐私预算下多数设置优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于聚合的 DP-ZO 方法以固定尺度重建模型更新，忽略训练过程中有用信号强度会变化，导致噪声主导的更新被过度加权并损害模型效用。
Method: 提出 SAGE：从观测二阶矩中减去已知高斯噪声方差以估计潜在信号能量，通过时间跟踪稳定该估计，并将其当前信噪比与 warm-up 参考比较以得到有界收缩因子。该方法作为纯后处理，不需要额外隐私预算或模型查询，仅引入常数额外状态。
Result: 在 RoBERTa-large、OPT-1.3B 和 OPT-6.7B 上的实验表明，在相同隐私预算下 SAGE 在大多数设置中优于现有基线，同时保持 DP-ZO 仅前向计算的内存效率。
Conclusion: 理论分析表明收缩能比线性下降项更快地降低二次更新风险项，从而在保留有用下降的同时限制噪声主导更新的影响。

papers.title: TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference with large language models is constrained by the linear growth of the key-value cache to sequence length. While pruning offers mitigation, prevailing methods determine query-specific token importance that cannot be reused across unseen queries. In contrast, we introduce TaskPress, a framework for task-guided, query-agnostic KV cache eviction. Instead of optimizing the cache for a single query, TaskPress constructs a reusable memory representation conditioned on a high-level task guide. The guide functions as a meta-query during prefill to filter irrelevant tokens before downstream queries are issued. In addition, TaskPress leverages quantization scale factors as a zero-cost signal for detecting influential representation outliers, providing an efficient proxy for token importance. Experiments on conducted on various tasks with long context input demonstrate that TaskPress efficiently creates a compact, reusable cache across diverse queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TaskPress，一种任务引导、查询无关的 KV 缓存压缩框架，用于长上下文大语言模型推理。它通过高层任务指南（task guide）在预填充阶段过滤不相关 token，并利用量化尺度因子（quantization scale factors）作为零成本信号识别有影响力的表示离群值，从而构造可跨不同查询复用的紧凑缓存。摘要称该方法在多种长上下文任务上有效。
Motivation: 现有基于剪枝的 KV 缓存压缩方法根据具体查询确定 token 重要性，无法在未见过的查询之间复用；同时长上下文推理受限于 KV 缓存随序列长度线性增长的问题。
Method: TaskPress 不针对单一查询优化缓存，而是以高层任务指南为条件构造可复用的记忆表示；该指南在预填充阶段作为元查询（meta-query）过滤不相关 token。此外，利用量化缩放因子作为零成本信号检测有影响力的表示离群值，作为 token 重要性的高效代理。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，仅说明在多种长上下文输入任务的实验中，TaskPress 能够高效地为不同查询创建紧凑、可复用的缓存。
Conclusion: 作者强调查询无关、任务引导的缓存淘汰机制可以跨不同查询复用紧凑缓存，从而缓解长上下文推理中 KV 缓存线性增长的瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GUI-Lens: Coarse-to-Fine Cropping for GUI Grounding with General-Purpose VLMs
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding maps natural-language instructions to click locations and is essential for reliable GUI agents. The task remains difficult on high-resolution, densely populated interfaces because a vision-language model (VLM) may recognize a requested control without locating it precisely enough for interaction. Most existing methods provide various forms of localization assistance, but still rely on a direct click prediction, allowing visual ambiguity or an inaccurate initial estimate to propagate to the final result. In this paper, we introduce GUI-Lens, a coarse-to-fine grounding framework that allows a general-purpose VLM to determine the target through active visual observations. Specifically, GUI-Lens extracts OCR text and detected UI components from the screenshot and presents their positions as coordinate references. Using the instruction, the current view, and these references, the VLM selects the region and scale of the next view, which is cropped and enlarged to provide finer visual details. This process continues over successively focused views until the target is determined. Proposed crops and clicks are checked against the instruction throughout the process, and the final local position is mapped back to the original screen coordinates. Experiments on four GUI grounding benchmarks and three general-purpose VLM backends show that GUI-Lens improves overall grounding accuracy by up to 24.9 percentage points and achieves state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GUI-Lens，一个面向 GUI 定位 (GUI grounding) 的粗到细裁剪框架，允许通用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 通过主动视觉观察逐步确定目标位置。它先从截图中提取 OCR 文本和 UI 组件坐标作为参考，再由 VLM 选择下一视图的区域与缩放尺度并裁剪放大，迭代直至确定目标。在四个 GUI 定位基准和三个通用 VLM 后端上的实验显示，总体定位准确率最高提升 24.9 个百分点，并在 GPT-5.5 上取得最优性能。
Motivation: GUI 定位在高分辨率、密集界面上仍然困难，因为 VLM 可能识别出目标控件却无法精确定位。现有方法大多提供各类定位辅助但仍依赖直接点击预测，视觉歧义或不准确的初始估计会传播到最终结果。
Method: GUI-Lens 提取截图中的 OCR 文本与检测到的 UI 组件，并将其位置作为坐标参考；结合指令、当前视图与这些参考，VLM 选择下一视图的区域和尺度，裁剪放大以提供更精细的视觉细节，并在逐级聚焦的视图上持续判定。整个过程会对提出的裁剪与点击结果对照指令进行校验，最终将局部坐标映射回原始屏幕坐标。
Result: 在四个 GUI 定位基准和三个通用 VLM 后端上，GUI-Lens 将总体定位准确率最高提升 24.9 个百分点，并在使用 GPT-5.5 时取得最先进性能 (state-of-the-art)。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过主动视觉观察的粗到细裁剪，并以 OCR 与 UI 组件坐标作为参考，可以缓解直接点击预测带来的误差传播，使通用 VLM 在密集界面上的定位更稳定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Efficient Video Dataset Distillation via Cluster-Guided Prototype Blending
papers.abstract_en: Video dataset distillation aims to compress a large video dataset into a compact surrogate set that preserves its training utility. Most existing approaches synthesize condensed videos through iterative optimization, whose cost is amplified by the temporal dimension. Rather than further reducing the number of optimized variables, we investigate whether effective distilled videos can be constructed without gradient-based optimization of the stored videos. Such a construction-based approach must address three challenges: selecting informative temporal segments, covering diverse intra-class variations under a limited videos-per-class budget, and increasing the information carried by each stored sample. To this end, we propose ProtoBlend, an efficient select-allocate-blend framework. First, teacher-guided temporal clip selection retains a high-confidence segment from each source video. Second, cluster-guided prototype allocation partitions the selected clips in the teacher feature space and assigns one distilled slot to each intra-class cluster. Third, each prototype is blended with an in-cluster anchor, while their teacher predictions are combined using the same coefficient to provide mixture-source supervision. Experiments on four trimmed action-recognition benchmarks demonstrate that ProtoBlend achieves a competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off without iterative optimization of the distilled videos.

Motivation: 现有视频数据集蒸馏大多通过迭代优化合成视频，时间维度的存在使优化成本被进一步放大。作者希望探究能否在不优化存储视频的情况下构造有效的蒸馏视频，并指出这需要解决时间片段选择、类内多样性覆盖以及每样本信息量三个挑战。

Result: 在四个修剪动作识别基准上的实验表明，ProtoBlend 无需对蒸馏视频进行迭代优化，即可实现有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。摘要未给出具体数据集名称或数值。
Conclusion: 作者将 ProtoBlend 定位为一种高效、构造式的视频数据集蒸馏方法，认为可以绕开迭代优化的高成本；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Hear to See: Discerning Stateful Listening for Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) requires accurately identifying and tracking individual sounding objects with pixel-level masks. Existing methods struggle to match overlapping acoustic events with visual instances and handle asynchronous audio-visual dynamics. Therefore, two critical questions arise: how can a model establish precise correspondence between overlapping sound sources and visual instances, and how can a model maintain robust tracking when audio and visual signals are temporally misaligned?This paper proposes Hear to See (H2S), addressing these challenges through two mechanisms. The Acoustic-Semantic Projector (ASP) disentangles mixed audio and establishes hierarchical correspondence from semantic to spatial domains. The Asynchronous Dynamics Modulator (ADM) adaptively adjusts state transitions via audio-modulated Mamba, prioritizing current information during dynamic variations and maintaining continuity in stable periods.Experiments on AVISeg show H2S achieves SOTA performance, attaining 48.54 mAP with a COCO pretrained ResNet50 and surpassing the previous by 7.8\%. The code will be open-sourced once the paper is accepted. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/leiyeliu/H2S.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hear to See (H2S)，用于音视频实例分割 (Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation, AVIS)，目标是区分重叠声源并跟踪与视觉实例对应的发声物体。方法包含两个模块：Acoustic-Semantic Projector (ASP) 将混合音频分离并建立从语义到空间域的层次对应，Asynchronous Dynamics Modulator (ADM) 通过音频调制的 Mamba 自适应调整状态转换。在 AVISeg 基准上达到 48.54 mAP，比此前最好结果提升 7.8%。
Motivation: 现有音视频实例分割方法难以在重叠声学事件与视觉实例之间建立精确对应，也无法处理音视频信号时间不对齐时的鲁棒跟踪问题。
Method: 提出 H2S 框架，包含 ASP 与 ADM 两个机制：ASP 解缠混合音频并建立语义到空间的层次对应；ADM 利用音频调制的 Mamba 动态调节状态转换，在动态变化中侧重当前信息，在稳定阶段维持连续性。
Result: 在 AVISeg 基准上，使用 COCO 预训练 ResNet50 的 H2S 达到 48.54 mAP，超过此前最优结果 7.8%，取得 SOTA 性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过解缠混合音频与音频调制状态更新的结合，可以同时改善重叠声源对应和异步音视频动态下的实例跟踪；代码将在论文接收后开源。

papers.title: The Ignition Is Real, and It Lives at the Readout: Latent composition, difficulty-clocked ignition, and the interface-constituted commit in a recurrent-depth reasoner
papers.abstract_en: We test whether the "compositional ignition" reported in latent-reasoning models is real computation, an instrument artifact, or inherited from verbal training data. We grow an independent realization of a published 30M-parameter recurrent-depth reasoner from scratch (same recipe and seed), film its development, certify fidelity through a pre-registered whole-signature gate, and measure resolution in two channels at once: the vocabulary readout and the hidden state. The ignition is real and lives at the readout: arrival time rises lawfully with problem depth, resolution is sharp and holds, and the signature reproduces across two same-seed realizations with divergent training trajectories. At commitment the decision margin jumps 5.8-8.0 logits in one iteration, exceeding the 90th percentile of near-threshold non-event steps in 96% of cases; the signed margin's zero-crossing there is definitional and carries no evidential weight, so the evidence is that conditioned magnitude. The hidden-state direction snaps in raw geometry, meeting its pre-registered criterion (in the decoder's LayerNorm coordinates it attenuates just below our bar, so the composite decoder-coordinate claim is not confirmed), and then freezes in both (descriptively so in decoder coordinates; angular steps 52.9 to 1.2 degrees over eight iterations), while subsequent displacement is predominantly radial (0.961 of squared-norm) and readout-null to a measured bound (radial logit effect <=5.7e-6). An earlier velocity-trough claim is withdrawn: pre-registered normalization controls showed it coordinate-dependent. Intermediates were never recoverable through the tied readout (relay 0.00). All criteria were frozen before their data; the predictions ledger, including this paper's own withdrawn headline, ships in the companion repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验潜变量推理模型（latent-reasoning models）中“组合点火”（compositional ignition）现象是真实计算、仪器伪影还是来自言语训练数据。作者从头独立复现了一个已发表的 30M 参数循环深度推理器，通过预注册的整签名门控验证保真度，并在词汇读出端和隐藏状态两个通道同时测量。摘要报告点火确实存在于读出端，到达时间随问题深度规律上升，决策边际单次迭代跃升 5.8–8.0 logits，而隐藏状态方向在原始几何中发生突转并随后冻结。
Motivation: 现有关于潜在推理模型中“组合点火”的报告缺乏对真实性和来源的判别，作者希望区分真实计算、仪器伪影与训练语料中继承的效应，并检验跨随机种子的可复现性。
Method: 从零重新训练一个同配方、同种子的 30M 参数循环深度推理器，应用预注册的整签名保真度门控；在词汇读出和隐藏状态两个通道同时测量点火时间、决策边际与位移几何，并加入预注册的归一化控制检验坐标依赖的声明。
Result: 点火是真实的且位于读出端：到达时间随问题深度规律上升，决策边际在一次迭代中跳升 5.8–8.0 logits，且在 96% 案例中超过近阈值非事件步骤的 90 分位；隐藏状态方向满足预注册判据地突转（但在 decoder LayerNorm 坐标中衰减到阈值以下），随后在两种坐标下冻结，后续位移主要呈径向（0.961 的平方范数）且读出端无效（径向 logit 效应 <=5.7e-6）。此前的 velocity-trough 声明被撤回，因为预注册归一化控制表明其依赖坐标。
Conclusion: 作者认为组合点火是真实的，但将其定位于读出端的条件化幅度而非零交叉；隐藏状态几何只得到部分确认，复合解码器坐标声明未获支持；所有判据在数据前冻结，预测账本包括被撤回的头条并存于配套仓库。

papers.title: ED-DiT: Physics-Guided Diffusion Pretraining for Transferable Molecular Representations from Electron Density
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining has shown strong potential for learning transferable representations, yet it remains underexplored for electron-density-based molecular learning. Electron density provides a continuous three-dimensional description of molecular electronic structure, capturing both local spatial patterns and global physical quantities. This raises a key question: can electron-density fields be used for self-supervised pretraining to learn a shared representation that transfers across diverse electronic-structure-related tasks? We propose ED-DiT, a physics-guided Diffusion Transformer for self-supervised pretraining on electron-density point clouds. ED-DiT learns reusable representations by reconstructing corrupted and partially masked log-density fields across diffusion noise levels. An electron-number consistency constraint is further introduced to preserve the total electronic mass. The pretrained encoder can be adapted to property prediction, open-/closed-shell classification, molecule-electron-density retrieval, and molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction. Experiments on six EDBench tasks show that ED-DiT consistently outperforms the same architecture trained from scratch, especially under limited supervision. For molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction, it reduces RMSE from 2.2474 to 1.3753 and surpasses the available baseline. With only 10% labels, it improves orbital energy prediction RMSE from 0.0293 to 0.0138. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-guided electron-density pretraining for learning transferable molecular representations.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ED-DiT，一种物理引导的扩散 Transformer (Diffusion Transformer)，用于在电子密度点云上进行自监督预训练，以学习可迁移的分子表示。预训练通过跨扩散噪声水平重构被破坏和部分掩码的 log-density 场，并引入电子数一致性约束来保持总电子质量。预训练编码器可适配性质预测、开壳层/闭壳层分类、分子-电子密度检索和分子条件电子密度预测等任务，在 EDBench 六个任务上一致优于从零训练的相同架构。
Motivation: 预训练在可迁移表示学习上潜力很大，但在基于电子密度的分子学习中尚未被充分探索。电子密度提供连续的三维电子结构描述，既包含局部空间模式也包含全局物理量，但能否将其用于自监督预训练以获得跨电子结构相关任务共享的表示，仍是一个关键开放问题。
Method: 提出 ED-DiT，一个物理引导的 Diffusion Transformer，在电子密度点云上进行自监督预训练。模型通过在不同扩散噪声水平下重构被破坏和部分掩码的 log-density 场来学习可复用表示，并引入电子数一致性约束 (electron-number consistency constraint) 以保持总电子质量。
Result: 在 EDBench 六个任务上，ED-DiT 持续优于同架构从零训练的结果，尤其在监督数据有限时提升明显。分子条件电子密度预测的 RMSE 从 2.2474 降至 1.3753，优于可用基线；仅使用 10% 标签时，轨道能量预测 RMSE 从 0.0293 降至 0.0138。
Conclusion: 摘要认为物理引导的电子密度预训练能有效学习可迁移的分子表示，并在一系列电子结构相关下游任务上展现优势。

papers.title: FinVerse: Financial Time-Series Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: As time-series foundation models have emerged, the need for benchmarks that can evaluate their forecasting ability in meaningful ways has become increasingly important. Existing time-series forecasting benchmarks provide useful standardized comparisons, but they often evaluate heterogeneous series with uniform error-based metrics. Strong performance under such metrics does not necessarily imply that a model's forecasts will support the best real-world decisions across domains. For example, in stock forecasting, correctly predicting whether a price will rise or fall can be more directly relevant to realized returns than minimizing point-wise forecast error alone. To this end, we introduce FinVerse, a finance-domain time-series forecasting benchmark that takes a first step toward more realistic evaluation. The released FinVerse data artifact contains 116,897 financial time series with 171.1M observations, of which 60,232 series with 17.4M observations are selected as evaluated targets based on their economic relevance to financial decisions. Unlike generic forecasting benchmarks that primarily emphasize uniform point-forecast or probabilistic accuracy, FinVerse defines 11 metric families comprising 78 evaluation metrics and assigns the most appropriate evaluation metrics to each individual time series based on its underlying economic meaning. Our analysis of 43 public time-series forecasting foundation models shows that strong performance under generic forecasting criteria does not necessarily translate into useful financial forecasts. This finding highlights the need for domain-aware benchmarks that evaluate models under objectives closer to real-world decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinVerse，一个面向金融领域的时间序列预测基准，包含 116,897 条金融时间序列和 171.1M 观测值，其中按经济相关性选出 60,232 条序列作为评测目标。与通用基准不同，FinVerse 定义 11 个指标族共 78 个评估指标，并依据每条序列的经济含义分配最合适的指标。对 43 个公开时间序列基础模型的评测显示，通用预测指标上的强表现并不必然转化为有用的金融预测。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测基准通常用统一的基于误差的指标评估异构序列，强泛化指标表现不一定意味着模型能支持真实世界的决策；例如股票预测中，正确预测涨跌比最小化逐点预测误差对实际收益更直接。
Method: 构建金融领域的时间序列预测基准 FinVerse，基于经济相关性筛选评测目标，并为每条时间序列按底层经济含义分配 11 个指标族中的最合适评估指标，而非使用单一均匀指标。

Conclusion: 摘要强调需要以更接近真实决策目标的领域感知基准来评估时间序列基础模型。

papers.title: NanoMorph-3D: An End-to-End Physics-Driven Unrolling Framework for Nanomaterial Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Precise 3D characterization of nanomaterials is essential for unlocking structure-property relationships. However, standard electron tomography is fundamentally limited by the missing wedge problem. Consequently, conventional algorithms suffer from severe geometric distortions, a challenge further complicated by pervasive noise interference. Current learning-based methods either rely on physics-blind post-processing or employ end-to-end architectures constrained by local receptive fields, failing to capture complex 3D topologies. We propose NanoMorph-3D, a unified end-to-end framework grounded in a comprehensive Nanomorphological Taxonomy. Powered by a large-scale synthetic dataset explicitly modeling non-linear electron attenuation, we design a Physics-Driven Unrolled Network mapping proximal gradient descent into a learnable architecture. To capture complex internal topologies, we formulate a hierarchical attention mechanism with Physics-Normalization for long-range 3D dependencies and scale invariance. Crucially, our Dual-Domain strategy leverages Sinusoidal Attention to explicitly model physical projection trajectories, enforcing strict sinogram consistency to mitigate missing wedge artifacts. Finally, an unsupervised dual-stream mechanism bridges the simulation-to-reality gap. Experiments demonstrate NanoMorph-3D reconstructs diverse topologies with superior fidelity and speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NanoMorph-3D，一个面向纳米材料三维重构的端到端物理驱动展开框架。该框架基于 Nanomorphological Taxonomy，利用显式建模非线性电子衰减的大规模合成数据集，将近端梯度下降 (proximal gradient descent) 展开为可学习网络；通过带 Physics-Normalization 的分层注意力捕获长程三维依赖，并用 Dual-Domain 策略中的 Sinusoidal Attention 建模物理投影轨迹、强制 sinogram 一致性以缓解 missing wedge 伪影。实验表明该方法能以更高的保真度和速度重构多样化拓扑结构。
Motivation: 标准电子断层成像受 missing wedge 问题限制，传统算法会产生严重几何畸变且受噪声干扰；现有学习方法要么采用与物理无关的后处理，要么受限于局部感受野的端到端架构，难以捕获复杂的三维拓扑结构。
Method: 提出统一的端到端 Physics-Driven Unrolled Network，把近端梯度下降映射为可学习架构；构建大规模合成数据集显式建模非线性电子衰减；设计带 Physics-Normalization 的分层注意力机制以处理长程 3D 依赖与尺度不变性；采用 Dual-Domain 策略，通过 Sinusoidal Attention 显式建模投影轨迹并强制 sinogram 一致性来缓解 missing wedge；最后引入无监督双流机制弥合仿真到真实的差距。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明 NanoMorph-3D 能以更优的保真度和更快的速度重构多种拓扑结构，但未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过物理驱动的展开设计、sinogram 一致性约束和无监督双流机制，统一解决了纳米材料三维重构中的 missing wedge 伪影与仿真到真实差距问题。

papers.title: Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection for Multi-Focus Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Multi-focus image fusion (MFIF) aims to generate an all-in-focus image from multiple images of the same scene focused at different regions. Most existing deep learning-based methods lack explicit interaction between the source images, which limits their performance and interpretability. This paper presents a novel Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection Network (CSNet), to bridge direct information exchange for MFIF. Specifically, by contrasting the clarity differences between source images within our proposed Clarity Contrast Attention Module (CCAM), we mutually enhance sharp features while suppressing blurry ones. This allows us to identify the exactly focused regions in each source and locate the focused-defocused boundaries. Moreover, the Defocus Spread Effect (DSE) degrades pixels in all source images around the boundaries. To further refine these ambiguous areas, we introduce a Similarity Selection Strategy, which reconstructs an initial clear image from source images and selects optimal pixels by comparing the similarity among them. Through this interactive approach, CSNet effectively preserves focused regions as well as recovering natural boundaries to fuse an all-in-focus output. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance both quantitatively and qualitatively. Our code is available on Github: https://github.com/ZYC-HUST/CSNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection Network (CSNet)，用于多聚焦图像融合 (multi-focus image fusion, MFIF)。CSNet 通过 Clarity Contrast Attention Module (CCAM) 对比源图像间的清晰度差异，互相增强清晰特征并抑制模糊特征，再结合 Similarity Selection Strategy 处理边界附近的散焦扩散效应 (Defocus Spread Effect)，从而生成全聚焦图像。摘要称实验在定量与定性上均取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的 MFIF 方法普遍缺乏源图像之间的显式交互，限制了融合性能与可解释性；同时边界附近存在 Defocus Spread Effect，会使所有源图像在该区域像素退化，需要额外处理。
Method: 提出 CSNet，包含两个核心组件：CCAM 通过对比源图像清晰度差异来定位精确聚焦区域与聚焦-散焦边界；Similarity Selection Strategy 先由源图像重建初始清晰图像，再通过比较像素间相似度选择最优像素以细化边界模糊区域。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在广泛实验中的定量与定性结果均达到 state-of-the-art，未给出具体数据集或数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种源图像间的交互式设计能够有效保留聚焦区域并恢复自然边界，从而生成高质量的全聚焦融合图像。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Wearable Data to Personalized and Actionable Health Insights
papers.abstract_en: Commercial wearable devices continuously capture rich physiological data (e.g., heart rate, respiration), opening new possibilities for monitoring health conditions, notably around stress. Despite their promise, turning raw wearable physiological data streams into visualizations that surface stress-related insights in daily activities, and that ultimately foster reflection, awareness, and better stress management, remains a significant challenge. The data are noisy and context-dependent: the same spike in heart rate can come from sprinting, a tense presentation, or laughing with friends. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that combines user annotations with wearable data to support better stress management. We introduce a web framework offering interactive visualizations that layer daily activities, stress events, and interventions onto raw physiological streams, enabling users to reflect and identify trends. In a four-week pilot with seven university graduate and undergraduate student participants who logged 269 events, our tool revealed patterns between different types of interventions and stress: social interaction reduced average heart rate by 4.35 to 5.0 beats per minute, deliberate rest reduced average Garmin stress scores by 10.03 to 13.83 points, and mindfulness activities decreased average HRV by 6.61 to 13.22 milliseconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合用户标注与可穿戴设备数据的框架，用于支持更好的压力管理。作者实现了一个交互式网页可视化工具，将日常活动、压力事件和干预措施叠加在原始生理数据流上，帮助用户反思并识别趋势。在为期四周、7名大学生参与的试点研究中，共记录269个事件，结果显示社交互动使平均心率降低4.35至5.0 bpm，刻意休息使平均Garmin压力评分降低10.03至13.83分，正念活动使平均HRV降低6.61至13.22毫秒。
Motivation: 商业可穿戴设备持续采集丰富生理数据，有望用于监测健康状况尤其是压力；但将原始生理数据流转化为能揭示日常活动中压力相关洞察的可视化仍是显著挑战。数据噪声大且具有情境依赖性，相同的心率峰值可能来自冲刺、紧张演讲或与朋友大笑等多种原因，因此需要结合用户标注来赋予数据意义。
Method: 提出一个将用户标注与可穿戴数据相结合的框架，并引入一个网页交互式可视化工具，把日常活动、压力事件和干预措施分层叠加到原始生理数据流上，使用户能够反思和识别压力相关趋势。
Result: 在四周试点中，7名大学本科生和研究生共记录269个事件；工具揭示了不同干预类型与压力之间的模式：社交互动使平均心率降低4.35至5.0次/分钟，刻意休息使平均Garmin压力评分降低10.03至13.83分，正念活动使平均HRV降低6.61至13.22毫秒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架与可视化工具能够帮助用户从可穿戴数据中发现干预措施与压力之间的关联，从而支持压力管理与自我反思；试点规模较小（7人、4周），属于初步探索性验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ShielDroid: A Hybrid Approach Integrating Machine and Deep Learning for Android Malware Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of modern technology has led to a significant increase in the use of smart devices, such as smartphones and tablets, resulting in the widespread adoption of mobile applications. Although applications are required to undergo malware screening before being published on official app stores, many malicious applications successfully evade detection by concealing sophisticated malware variants. These malicious behaviors are often activated only during runtime, making them difficult to identify through conventional static analysis. As a result, malware may remain undetected until after installation, potentially causing irreversible damage to users and their devices. This study presents a real-time Android malware detection framework that analyzes application behavior to accurately identify and classify complex malware. The proposed approach employs a hybrid dynamic analysis technique to distinguish malicious applications from benign ones. After preprocessing and filtering the collected dataset, the applications are classified using multiple machine learning algorithms. A comprehensive performance evaluation is conducted to compare the effectiveness of different classification techniques in terms of detection accuracy and execution time. Experimental results demonstrate that a hybrid model combining Random Forest and a Multilayer Perceptron achieves the best overall performance, attaining an accuracy of 97.5% with an execution time of 22.945 seconds. The proposed framework can enhance mobile device security by enabling timely detection of malicious applications and reducing the risk of cyberattacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于混合动态分析的实时 Android 恶意软件检测框架，通过分析应用运行行为来区分恶意与良性应用。实验表明，随机森林 (Random Forest) 与多层感知机 (Multilayer Perceptron) 的混合模型综合表现最佳，准确率达 97.5%，执行时间为 22.945 秒。
Motivation: 恶意应用常能在官方商店的上架筛查中绕过静态检测，其中许多恶意行为只在运行时激活，导致安装后才被发现并对用户和设备造成损害，因此需要基于动态行为分析的检测方法。
Method: 采用混合动态分析技术提取并分析应用行为，对收集的数据集进行预处理和过滤后，使用多种机器学习算法进行分类，并对不同分类技术在检测准确率和执行时间上进行对比。
Result: 摘要报告混合模型 (Random Forest 与 Multilayer Perceptron 结合) 取得最佳整体性能，准确率达到 97.5%，执行时间为 22.945 秒。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够通过及时检测恶意应用来增强移动设备安全并降低网络攻击风险；论文的评估重点是不同分类算法的准确率与执行时间对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Knob to Rule Them All: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Cold-Start Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cold-Start Active Learning (CSAL) aims to select a valuable subset from an unlabeled pool without any prior knowledge or human assistance. Existing methods take diverse routes based on typicality, coverage, or diversity. Each rests on its own inductive bias and therefore performs well on some tasks yet poorly on others. We argue that the real challenge is not to design yet another selection heuristic, but to make CSAL adapt automatically to the data and task at hand. To this end, we revisit CSAL through the lens of optimal transport. First, we propose a generalized transport selection framework that reveals the shared allocation structure of existing methods and exactly subsumes representative formulations. Second, we introduce a theoretical analysis that characterizes the trade-off controlled by entropic regularization and establishes a task-agnostic minimax bound for cold-start selection. These results provide a principled foundation for adapting the regularization strength to the unlabeled data. Third, we derive a data-adaptive regularization rule and present a novel Sinkhorn-based CSAL algorithm, termed $ε$-Adaptive Selection ($ε$-AS). Extensive experiments on six public datasets and multiple annotation budgets show that $ε$-AS consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. On ImageNet-1k, it improves the average accuracy over ActiveFT by 1.29% while reducing selection time by 56.2%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Z-yiwei/OT-CSAL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从最优传输 (optimal transport) 的视角重新审视冷启动主动学习 (Cold-Start Active Learning, CSAL)，提出一个广义传输选择框架，统一了基于典型性、覆盖度和多样性的现有方法。作者给出熵正则化 (entropic regularization) 所带来的权衡理论分析以及任务无关的极小极大界，并据此提出数据自适应的正则化规则与基于 Sinkhorn 的算法 ε-Adaptive Selection (ε-AS)。在六个公开数据集和多种标注预算下，ε-AS 达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 CSAL 方法分别依赖典型性、覆盖度或多样性等归纳偏置，各自只在部分任务上表现好而在其他任务上较差；作者认为真正的挑战不是设计新的选择启发式，而是让 CSAL 能自动适应手头的数据和任务。
Method: 作者通过最优传输视角重新审视 CSAL：提出一个广义传输选择框架，揭示现有方法的共享分配结构并精确包含代表性公式；给出刻画熵正则化权衡的理论分析并建立任务无关的冷启动选择极小极大界；基于这些结果推导数据自适应正则化规则，提出 Sinkhorn 型算法 ε-AS。
Result: 在六个公开数据集和多种标注预算上的大量实验表明，ε-AS 一致地取得当前最优性能。在 ImageNet-1k 上，相对 ActiveFT 平均准确率提升 1.29%，同时选择时间减少 56.2%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些理论结果为根据未标注数据自适应地调整正则化强度提供了原则性基础，并计划公开代码。

papers.title: CIGTSurv: Clinical Information Guided Tri-modal Survival Prediction with Local Prototype Association and Global Feature Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning has significantly advanced survival prediction by integrating pathology images with genomic data. However, clinical information, despite its critical role in reflecting a patient' s overall health, remains underutilized due to its discrete, sparse, and low-dimensional nature. Furthermore, the inherent heterogeneity across these modalities pose significant challenges in modeling cross-modal interactions. In this paper, we propose CIGTSurv, a Clinical Information Guided Tri-modal framework for Survival prediction. Specifically, we first design a holistic text template and use pretrained foundation models to transform clinical tabular data into high-dimensional tokenized embeddings. Using clinical information as an anchor, we then introduce a dual-level interaction mechanism: 1) a local prototype association (LPA) module based on cross-attention to explicitly learn token-level correspondences between different modalities, and 2) a global feature alignment (GFA) loss based on Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to implicitly enhance cross-modal distribution consistency. Extensive experiments on five TCGA cancer cohorts demonstrate that CIGTSurv achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) survival prediction performance. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Daijing-ai/CIGT-Surv.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIGTSurv，一种以临床信息为引导的三模态生存预测框架，融合病理图像、基因组数据与临床表格数据。作者设计统一文本模板并用预训练基础模型将低维离散的临床数据转成高维 token 嵌入，再以临床信息为锚点引入局部原型关联（LPA）与全局特征对齐（GFA）损失。在五个 TCGA 癌症队列上的实验表明其达到 SOTA 生存预测性能。
Motivation: 多模态生存预测通常整合病理图像和基因组，但临床信息因离散、稀疏、低维而未被充分利用；同时模态间固有异质性使跨模态交互建模困难。
Method: 先用统一文本模板和预训练基础模型将临床表格数据编码为高维 token 嵌入；随后以临床信息为锚点，提出双层级交互：基于交叉注意力的局部原型关联（local prototype association, LPA）模块学习 token 级对应关系，以及基于最大均值差异（Maximum Mean Discrepancy, MMD）的全局特征对齐（global feature alignment, GFA）损失来增强跨模态分布一致性。
Result: 在五个 TCGA 癌症队列上的广泛实验显示，CIGTSurv 达到 SOTA 生存预测性能；代码已公开。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，以临床信息作为锚点、结合局部原型关联与全局分布对齐，可以有效缓解跨模态异质性并改进生存预测。局限性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: UniNav: A Unified World-Action Diffusion Model for Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Image-goal visual navigation is a fundamental capability for embodied agents. Existing navigation policies efficiently predict waypoint trajectories but lack visual foresight, while navigation world models can anticipate future observations but often require costly planning rollouts. We present UniNav, a unified world-action model that generates future visual observations and continuous waypoint trajectories through a single diffusion process. Given history frames and a goal image, UniNav jointly denoises visual and waypoint tokens within a single transformer, unifying future prediction and action generation in a shared framework. To improve spatial grounding, we incorporate geometry-aware camera tokens. We also train on both trajectory-labeled navigation data and video-only data, enabling the model to benefit from diverse videos without waypoint annotations. Based on this unified framework, we introduce two variants: UniNav-Full jointly predicts interpretable future observations and their corresponding trajectories, while UniNav-Fast removes future-image tokens at inference for efficient trajectory prediction. Experiments on navigation benchmarks show that UniNav outperforms the strongest baseline in ATE across all datasets. With one-step inference, UniNav-Fast achieves a latency of 0.1s without a substantial accuracy drop. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniNav，一个统一的“世界-动作”扩散模型 (unified world-action model)，通过单个扩散过程同时生成未来视觉观测和连续航点轨迹，用于图像目标视觉导航 (image-goal visual navigation)。模型在单个 Transformer 中联合去噪视觉 token 和航点 token，并引入几何感知的相机 token 以改善空间接地；训练数据同时包含带轨迹标注的导航数据和仅视频数据。作者还给出两个变体：UniNav-Full 联合预测可解释的未来观测与轨迹，UniNav-Fast 在推理时移除未来图像 token 以实现高效轨迹预测。实验显示 UniNav 在所有数据集上优于最强基线 (ATE)，UniNav-Fast 单步推理延迟为 0.1s 且精度无明显下降。
Motivation: 现有导航策略能高效预测航点轨迹但缺乏视觉预见能力，而导航世界模型能预测未来观测但通常需要昂贵的规划 rollout。作者希望用一个统一框架同时获得视觉预测与动作生成能力，并利用无航点标注的视频数据来扩展训练数据。
Method: 提出 UniNav，将未来观测生成与轨迹预测统一到一个扩散模型：给定历史帧和目标图像，在单一 Transformer 中对视觉 token 和航点 token 进行联合去噪；引入几何感知相机 token 增强空间接地；训练时混合轨迹标注数据和视频-only 数据，并由此衍生 UniNav-Full（联合预测观测+轨迹）与 UniNav-Fast（推理时去除未来图像 token）两个变体。
Result: 在导航基准上，UniNav 在平均轨迹误差 (ATE) 上优于所有数据集上的最强基线；UniNav-Fast 使用单步推理达到 0.1s 延迟，且精度没有显著下降。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一的世界-动作扩散框架能够同时实现可解释的未来观测预测与高效的轨迹生成，且视频-only 数据有助于降低对航点标注的依赖；代码将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Experimental validation of an open-source low-cost single-camera 6-DOF tracking of floating-body motion in wave tanks
papers.abstract_en: Accurately measuring motion of floating structures in experimental settings is both important and non-trivial. In this paper, we present a single-camera, 6-degree-of-freedom motion-tracking system that is both low-cost and simple to set up for an experimental campaign. The system uses fiducial markers and open-source computer vision tools to estimate the positions and orientations of multi-marker geometries and track them. We validate the accuracy and limitations on a precisely controlled linear actuator with static, regular, and irregular motion. The performance is quantified depending on both the camera-to-marker distance and direction of motion relative to the camera plane. Additionally, we present a practical use case for our system in a wave tank. Although the motion direction perpendicular to the camera plane shows the highest errors, the system achieves sub-millimeter accuracy at short and moderate camera-to-marker distances. For the irregular motion validation, the best cases reproduced the displacements with an RMSE of approximately 0.5 mm. Overall, the results indicate that low-cost single-camera fiducial-marker tracking can provide sufficiently accurate, non-intrusive motion measurements for a range of hydrodynamic laboratory experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并实验验证了一套基于单相机与 fiducial markers 的低成本 6 自由度浮体运动跟踪系统，使用开源计算机视觉工具估计多标记几何体的位置与姿态。系统在精确控制的直线执行器上以静态、规则与不规则运动进行验证，并在波浪水槽中演示了实际应用。结果表明在短至中等相机-标记距离下可实现亚毫米级精度。
Motivation: 在实验环境中精确测量浮式结构的运动既重要又困难，而现有的测量手段往往成本高或安装复杂，需要一种低成本且易于搭建的非侵入式方案。
Method: 采用单个相机配合 fiducial markers，通过开源计算机视觉工具估计多标记几何体的 6 自由度位姿并进行跟踪；精度验证覆盖静态、规则与不规则运动，并评估相机-标记距离及相对相机平面的运动方向对性能的影响。
Result: 垂直于相机平面的运动方向误差最大，但在短程和中等相机-标记距离下系统达到亚毫米精度；不规则运动验证中最佳情形的位移 RMSE 约为 0.5 mm。
Conclusion: 作者认为低成本单相机 fiducial-marker 跟踪能够为一系列水动力学实验室实验提供足够准确、非侵入式的运动测量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning: Defending Vision-Language-Action Robots Against Physical Attention Hijacking
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies promise general robotic manipulation, but their robustness against physical-world attacks remains fragile. In particular, we show that physically realizable adversarial patches can reliably induce failures by triggering a mechanism we call policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking, where action-conditioned attention is diverted from task-relevant regions to a localized patch. To demonstrate the threat, we propose Attention-Guided Semantic Disruption (AGSD), an Expectation-over-Transformation (EOT) optimized printable patch that jointly (i) concentrates action-to-vision attention on the patch and (ii) disrupts vision-language semantic alignment, yielding strong cross-task and cross-architecture transfer. To mitigate such attacks, we introduce Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning (SARF), a zero-inference-overhead defense that fine-tunes only the visual encoder using feature anchoring, policy-critical attention correction, and language-guided geometric consistency restricted to semantically relevant regions. On LIBERO, SARF reduces OpenVLA's failure rate under AGSD from 100% to 14.2%-56.8% (28.6% average) across suites while preserving clean performance, and on a real PiPER manipulator it improves average success under AGSD from 23.0% to 65.0%. These results highlight mechanism-level robustness as a practical path to securing VLA robots against physical attention hijacking.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略在面对物理世界对抗攻击时的脆弱性，提出一种可打印的物理对抗补丁攻击 AGSD，其通过作者所称的策略关键动作到视觉注意力劫持 (policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking) 机制，使动作条件注意力偏离任务相关区域并破坏视觉-语言语义对齐。为防御该威胁，作者提出结构感知鲁棒微调 (SARF)，仅微调视觉编码器并在语义相关区域施加约束，零推理开销。在 LIBERO 仿真和真实 PiPER 机械臂上验证了攻击的威胁性与防御的有效性。
Motivation: VLA 策略虽然具备通用机器人操作能力，但对物理世界攻击的鲁棒性仍然脆弱；作者展示物理可实现的对抗补丁能稳定诱发失败，且该威胁具有跨任务与跨架构的迁移性，说明需要机制层面的防御。
Method: 攻击侧提出 Attention-Guided Semantic Disruption (AGSD)，一种基于期望变换 (Expectation-over-Transformation, EOT) 优化的可打印补丁，同时将 action-to-vision attention 集中到补丁上并破坏视觉-语言语义对齐。防御侧提出 Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning (SARF)，只微调视觉编码器，结合特征锚定 (feature anchoring)、策略关键注意力校正 (policy-critical attention correction) 和限于语义相关区域的语言引导几何一致性，且不引入推理开销。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上，SARF 将 OpenVLA 在 AGSD 攻击下的失败率从 100% 降至 14.2%-56.8%（平均 28.6%），同时保持干净样本性能；在真实 PiPER 机械臂上，AGSD 攻击下的平均成功率从 23.0% 提升至 65.0%。
Conclusion: 作者将机制级鲁棒性 (mechanism-level robustness) 视为保护 VLA 机器人免受物理注意力劫持的实际可行路径；本文的防御限定于仅微调视觉编码器，攻击形式为可打印物理补丁。

summary_sections.motivation: VLA 策略虽然具备通用机器人操作能力，但对物理世界攻击的鲁棒性仍然脆弱；作者展示物理可实现的对抗补丁能稳定诱发失败，且该威胁具有跨任务与跨架构的迁移性，说明需要机制层面的防御。
summary_sections.method: 攻击侧提出 Attention-Guided Semantic Disruption (AGSD)，一种基于期望变换 (Expectation-over-Transformation, EOT) 优化的可打印补丁，同时将 action-to-vision attention 集中到补丁上并破坏视觉-语言语义对齐。防御侧提出 Structure-Aware Robust Fine-Tuning (SARF)，只微调视觉编码器，结合特征锚定 (feature anchoring)、策略关键注意力校正 (policy-critical attention correction) 和限于语义相关区域的语言引导几何一致性，且不引入推理开销。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO 上，SARF 将 OpenVLA 在 AGSD 攻击下的失败率从 100% 降至 14.2%-56.8%（平均 28.6%），同时保持干净样本性能；在真实 PiPER 机械臂上，AGSD 攻击下的平均成功率从 23.0% 提升至 65.0%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将机制级鲁棒性 (mechanism-level robustness) 视为保护 VLA 机器人免受物理注意力劫持的实际可行路径；本文的防御限定于仅微调视觉编码器，攻击形式为可打印物理补丁。

papers.title: SAKI: Score-Aware Low-Rank Key Indexing for Long-Context KV Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Existing low rank KV cache methods preserve either model weights or key variance, neither of which directly reflects the attention scores used during inference. We derive the expected attention score distortion caused by rank r key compression and show that it yields a covariance weighted low rank objective. Under a margin condition, controlling this distortion also improves top k recall. The optimal rank r solution has a closed form asymmetric factorization obtained from the SVD of the covariance weighted query key operator. This motivates SAKI, a training free KV cache index that directly preserves attention scores rather than key reconstruction quality. Across LLaMA 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Mistral 7B v0.1, and Llama 3.2 3B, SAKI outperforms key PCA at every tested rank. At rank 32, it removes 13 to 30 percent of PCA's remaining top 64 recall error, including improvements from 0.748 to 0.799 on LLaMA 3.1 8B and from 0.786 to 0.850 on Qwen 2.5 7B. It improves 68 to 89 percent of attention heads per model, with the largest gains in deeper layers. Predicted score MSE reductions closely match empirical measurements, with a Pearson correlation of 0.997, while ablation studies confirm that the gains arise from optimizing the attention score objective rather than covariance weighting alone. Analysis of the scoring operator further explains why weight only, invariant subspace, and key reconstruction methods can be suboptimal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAKI，一种免训练的低秩 KV cache 索引方法，直接以注意力分数为优化目标而非键重建质量。作者推导了秩 r 键压缩导致的期望注意力分数失真，得到协方差加权的低秩目标，其最优解为闭式非对称分解。在多个开源模型上，SAKI 在每个测试秩下都优于 key PCA，并在 rank 32 时消除后者剩余 top-64 召回误差的 13–30%。
Motivation: 现有低秩 KV cache 方法要么保留模型权重要么保留键方差，但这些都不直接反映推理时实际使用的注意力分数，导致压缩结果可能与真实注意力分布错位。
Method: 推导秩 r 键压缩造成的期望注意力分数失真，并证明其对应一个协方差加权的低秩目标；在边际条件 (margin condition) 下，控制该失真还能提升 top-k 召回。最优秩 r 解由协方差加权 query-key 算子的 SVD 得到闭式非对称分解，据此构造训练免费的 SAKI 索引，直接保留注意力分数而非键重建质量。
Result: 在 LLaMA 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Mistral 7B v0.1 和 Llama 3.2 3B 上，SAKI 在所有测试秩上均优于 key PCA；rank 32 时消除 PCA 剩余 top-64 召回误差的 13–30%，例如 LLaMA 3.1 8B 从 0.748 提升到 0.799，Qwen 2.5 7B 从 0.786 提升到 0.850。每个模型有 68–89% 的注意力头得到改善，深层头收益最大；预测的分数 MSE 缩减与实测高度吻合（Pearson 相关 0.997），消融实验确认增益来自注意力分数目标而非仅协方差加权。
Conclusion: 摘要强调直接保留注意力分数而非键重建质量是低秩 KV 索引的更优准则，并对评分算子进行分析，解释了仅权重、不变子空间和键重建类方法可能次优的原因。
