papers.title: Open-Linguistic Concept Unified Learning for Cross-Site Interpretable Dermatology Image Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Human-interpretable computer-aided diagnosis is crucial for clinical decision making. Concept-based models excel by providing transparent reasoning and enabling post-hoc, clinician-in-the-loop interventions. However, their rigid dataset-specific adaptation inherently restricts cross-site generalization. Applying them across diverse modalities, such as dermoscopic and clinical photographs, is challenging due to heterogeneous concept taxonomies varying in availability, granularity, and semantics across cohorts. Consequently, adapting Foundation Vision-Language Models (FVLMs) demands costly label engineering and repeated post-training. Existing intervention mechanisms remain rigidly tied to predefined concepts, lacking adaptability and hindering scalable dermatology CAD deployment. To address these bottlenecks, we propose UniCon, an open-linguistic unified concept learning framework for multimodal interpretable vision-language diagnosis. UniCon resolves these challenges through three contributions: (1) A shared semantic representation space via a unified concept prototype codebook, seamlessly coordinating heterogeneous concept systems across modalities without dataset-specific retraining. (2) Open-linguistic based multi-faceted semantic specifications to overcome sparse textual label limitations, improving boundary sensitivity in uncertain clinical contexts. (3) A robust, cross-site adjustable intervention interface powered by reliability-gated bottleneck aggregation, enabling consistent reasoning and transferable clinician corrections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that beyond securing top-tier diagnostic accuracy, UniCon successfully bridges disparate clinical taxonomies, unlocking unprecedented cross-site intervention capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/wuchengyu123/UniCon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniCon，一个面向多模态皮肤病学可解释视觉语言诊断的开放语言学统一概念学习框架。该框架通过统一概念原型码本构建共享语义表示空间，协调皮肤镜 (dermoscopic) 与临床照片等异构概念系统，无需针对数据集重新训练；并配合开放语言多面语义规范与可靠性门控瓶颈聚合的干预接口。实验表明 UniCon 在保持顶级诊断准确率的同时，实现了跨站点概念干预能力。
Motivation: 概念模型虽能为临床决策提供透明推理和事后干预，但其数据集特定的概念分类法在跨中心、跨模态场景下存在可用性、粒度与语义不一致，导致跨站点泛化受限；同时适配基础视觉语言模型 (FVLMs) 需要昂贵的标签工程与重复后训练，现有干预机制也僵化绑定于预定义概念，难以规模化部署。
Method: UniCon 包含三项贡献：一是基于统一概念原型码本的共享语义表示空间，无需数据集特定重训练即可协调异质概念系统；二是基于开放语言 (open-linguistic) 的多面语义规范，缓解稀疏文本标签限制并提升不确定临床情境下的边界敏感性；三是可靠性门控瓶颈聚合驱动的跨站点可调整干预接口，支持一致推理与可迁移的临床修正。
Result: 实验显示，UniCon 在取得顶级诊断准确率的同时，成功弥合了不同临床分类体系之间的差异，并实现了摘要所称前所未有的跨站点干预能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 UniCon 解决了将 FVLMs 应用于皮肤病学计算机辅助诊断时面临的概念异质性、标签工程成本与干预可扩展性等瓶颈，并已公开代码。

papers.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to learn through interaction, but sparse trajectory-level rewards reveal success without identifying which intermediate decisions deserve credit. Training-only privileged skills can provide denser supervision by allowing the same frozen policy snapshot to rescore fixed tokens from skill-free trajectories while conditioned on task-matched procedural skills. Existing methods, however, do not jointly calibrate teacher scores across interaction steps, relate teacher confidence to realized returns, and integrate the resulting signal into native reward-to-advantage construction. We introduce Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping (ADRS), a framework for constructing return-associated token-level credit for multi-turn language agents. ADRS centers and normalizes privileged token scores within each step, modulates them with a return-associated Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) gate based on within-group confidence--return association, and incorporates the gated token signal into native RL credit construction. Together, these components determine what the teacher prefers, when that preference is return-relevant, and how it enters the native reinforcement-learning credit path, while keeping rollouts and inference skill-free. Finally, experiments across three interactive benchmarks show that ADRS consistently improves performance on long-horizon tasks, with gains persisting across RL backbones, reduced-data settings, unseen tasks, and extended training. For anonymous review, our code is available at the following the link: https://github.com/gitrxh/ADRS-arxiv
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping (ADRS)，一个为多轮语言智能体构建与回报关联的 token 级信用分配 (token-level credit) 的框架。ADRS 对特权教师 (privileged teacher) 给出的 token 分数做逐步中心化和归一化，用基于组内置信度-回报关联的 Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) 门控调制信号，并将门控后的 token 信号并入原生强化学习的信用构建。在三个交互式基准上的实验显示，ADRS 在长程任务上持续提升性能，且收益在多种 RL 骨干、数据缩减、未见任务和延长训练下保持。
Motivation: 智能体强化学习训练 LLM 智能体时，稀疏的轨迹级奖励只能反映整体成功，无法辨识哪些中间决策应获得信用；仅训练阶段可用的特权技能 (privileged skills) 虽能提供更密集的监督，但现有方法没有联合校准跨交互步骤的教师分数、将教师置信度与实际回报关联，并把信号整合进原生的 reward-to-advantage 构建中。
Method: ADRS 包含三个组成部分：在每个交互步骤内对特权 token 分数进行中心化和归一化；利用基于组内置信度-回报关联的 Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) 门控来调制这些分数；再将门控后的 token 信号纳入原生 RL 信用构建。整个过程中 rollouts 和推理保持技能无关 (skill-free)。
Result: 在三个交互式基准上的实验表明，ADRS 持续改进长程任务性能，增益在 RL 骨干网络、数据缩减场景、未见任务和扩展训练中均保持。
Conclusion: ADRS 通过联合确定教师偏好什么、何时该偏好与回报相关、以及如何进入原生 RL 信用路径，实现了回报关联的 token 级信用构建，同时保持 rollouts 和推理 skill-free；摘要未明确说明方法在短程任务上的表现或额外限制。

papers.title: Fail-Fast, Restart-Smart: Early Failure Prediction and Restart for SWE Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering (SWE) agents resolve repository-level issues through long trajectories that grow increasingly expensive as context accumulates. Failed runs tend to be longer and exhibit redundant exploration or looping, suggesting that some failures may be detectable before completion. Early termination, however, risks interrupting trajectories that would otherwise succeed; conversely, an unsuccessful trajectory may still contain useful repository edits. We present FailFast-RestartSmart, a two-stage controller for a single active trajectory. FailFast is a lightweight 0.6B monitor trained with terminal and dense fail-to-pass supervision to predict failure from observable prefixes without policy logits or hidden states. Upon an alarm, RestartSmart launches a fresh same-policy rollout without prior prompt history and offers the interrupted repository diff as an optional overlay that the agent may inspect, apply, or discard. On SWE-bench Verified, a monitor trained solely on Qwen3.6-27B trajectories transfers to three other policies, including a closed-API model, and saves 14.6%-20.4% of execution tokens at a target 5% false-positive rate; on Qwen3.6-27B, its 20.4% saving exceeds the 12.5% achieved by our per-step AgentStop adaptation. At a target 25% false-positive rate, RestartSmart raises Qwen3.6-27B resolution from 66.6% to 71.8%, whereas cold restart reaches only 66.8%. Together, these results support early termination with sequential same-policy recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FailFast-RestartSmart，一种针对单条活跃轨迹的两阶段控制器，用于 SWE agent 任务的早期失败预测与重启。FailFast 是 0.6B 的轻量监控器，仅利用可观察前缀预测失败而不依赖策略 logits 或隐藏状态；RestartSmart 在报警后启动无先前提示历史的同策略新轨迹，并提供被中断的 repository diff 作为可选覆盖层。在 SWE-bench Verified 上，训练于 Qwen3.6-27B 轨迹的监控器成功迁移到三个其他策略（含闭源 API 模型），在 5% 假阳性率目标下节省 14.6%-20.4% 执行 token，并在 25% 假阳性率目标下将 Qwen3.6-27B 的问题解决率从 66.6% 提升到 71.8%。
Motivation: SWE agent 通过长轨迹解决仓库级问题，随着上下文累积轨迹成本持续上升，且失败轨迹往往更长、包含冗余探索或循环。早期终止可能打断本可成功的轨迹，而失败轨迹中可能仍包含有用的仓库编辑，因此需要一种既能提前终止又能在重启时保留有用信息的机制。
Method: 提出两阶段控制器 FailFast-RestartSmart。FailFast 是一个 0.6B 监控器，使用 terminal 和 dense fail-to-pass 监督训练，仅从可观察前缀预测失败；RestartSmart 在收到报警后启动一个无提示历史的同策略新轨迹，并将中断的 repository diff 作为可选覆盖层，让 agent 自行检查、应用或丢弃。

papers.title: Reachability Is Not Realization: Tracing the Sources of LLM Benchmark Gains
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark gains are often treated as evidence of greater LLM capability. Yet the same gain can reflect different changes in model behavior. A model may reach new answers, or produce answers that were already within reach. Aggregate scores do not distinguish these changes question by question. We establish a question-level audit under fixed budgets, temperatures, and answer formats. A question is realized when the default deployment procedure produces the correct answer. A question is reachable when a specified probe finds that answer within a fixed budget. We first test whether inference-time layer routing can expand reachability. Under a matched budget, random routes match or exceed structured search in all 43 model and task settings. Answer-blind procedures retain almost none of this gain, which instead requires access to the correct answer. We then ask why reachable answers sometimes fail to appear. Across six cases spanning 0.5B to 31B, silencing one identified MLP block repairs 68 to 92 percent of a predefined failure set. We next test whether training closes the gap by expanding reachability. In five of six matched evaluations, deployed performance rises while the reachable ceiling remains flat or falls. For DAPO, the deployed score rises by 14.7 points while the reachable ceiling falls by 13.3 points. Across the settings we audit, realization and reachability therefore do not always change together. Claims of capability expansion should report both realized performance and reachability under matched evaluation conditions. Code is available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/reachability-not-realization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基准分数提升被直接当作 LLM 能力提升的证据这一问题，提出在固定预算、温度和答案格式下进行逐题 (question-level) 审计，区分 realized（默认部署流程能产出正确答案）与 reachable（在指定探针和预算内能找到答案）。在 43 种模型和任务设置下，随机推理时层路由（random layer routing）匹配或超过结构化搜索；答案不可见的程序几乎不保留该增益，说明增益依赖正确答案的访问。沉默单个 MLP 块可修复预定义失败集的 68%–92%；训练在多数匹配评估中提升部署性能却未提升甚至降低可达到上限 (reachable ceiling)。
Motivation: 聚合的基准分数无法区分同一增益背后的不同行为变化——模型可能产出新答案，也可能只是产出本就可达的答案。这使能力扩展的结论难以在逐题层面得到验证。
Method: 提出 question-level 审计框架：在固定预算、温度和答案格式下，分别定义 realized 与 reachable；并设计三组检验——推理时层路由对可达性的影响、答案盲程序的作用、识别并沉默特定 MLP 块，以及训练过程是否通过扩大可达性来缩小差距。
Result: 在 43 个模型和任务设置中，随机路由匹配或超过结构化搜索；沉默一个识别的 MLP 块修复了六个规模（0.5B 至 31B）案例中 68%–92% 的预定义失败；在六组匹配评估中的五组，部署性能上升而可达上限持平或下降，DAPO 部署分数上升 14.7 点而可达上限下降 13.3 点。
Conclusion: realization 与 reachability 在审计的设置中并不总是一同变化，因此声称能力扩展时应同时报告匹配评估条件下的 realized 性能与 reachability。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Representation-Guided Generative Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while retaining its downstream utility. Most existing methods target randomly initialized networks, whereas modern vision systems often adapt frozen pretrained encoders with lightweight modules. Distilled samples should therefore preserve the discriminative geometry of the pretrained representation space, which existing generative objectives do not explicitly consider. We propose self-supervised representation-guided generative dataset distillation (SRG), a framework that translates the SSL geometry into diffusion guidance. Specifically, SRG constructs class-wise prototypes from real-image SSL representations and performs guidance through three SSL-space objectives for prototype alignment, inter-class discrimination, and intra-class assignment. During diffusion sampling, it adopts a stage-wise guidance strategy: early denoising is anchored to the latent of the real image whose SSL representation is nearest to the assigned prototype, whereas later denoising is guided by the SSL-space objectives. This division preserves the visual realism provided by the generative prior while progressively steering samples toward representative and class-discriminative regions of the SSL representation space. SRG consistently outperforms the evaluated generative baselines across multiple datasets and IPC settings. A cross-encoder evaluation further indicates transfer across pretrained representation spaces. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of representation-guided generation for dataset distillation with pretrained SSL models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自监督表示引导的生成式数据集蒸馏框架 SRG，将自监督学习（SSL）的表示几何转化为扩散模型的引导信号。方法先从真实图像的 SSL 表示构造类级原型，并通过原型对齐、类间区分和类内分配三个 SSL 空间目标进行引导；扩散采样采用分阶段策略，早期去噪锚定到 SSL 表示最接近原型的真实图像潜变量，后期由 SSL 空间目标引导。实验显示 SRG 在多个数据集和 IPC 设置下持续优于所评估的生成式基线，跨编码器评估表明其可迁移到其他预训练表示空间。
Motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏方法大多针对随机初始化网络，而现代视觉系统常使用冻结的预训练编码器加轻量模块；蒸馏样本应保留预训练表示空间的判别几何，但现有生成式目标未显式考虑这一点。
Method: 提出 SRG 框架：从真实图像 SSL 表示构造类级原型，在扩散采样中使用三个 SSL 空间目标（原型对齐、类间判别、类内分配）引导；采用分阶段引导策略，早期去噪以最近原型的真实图像潜变量为锚，后期由 SSL 空间目标引导。
Result: 摘要报告 SRG 在多个数据集和 IPC 设置下一致优于评估的生成式基线，跨编码器评估表明其性能可迁移至不同预训练表示空间。
Conclusion: 摘要认为表示引导的生成方式对基于预训练 SSL 模型的数据集蒸馏是有效的，并展示了跨表示空间的迁移性。

papers.title: iFAN: Inference-Aware Learning for Plain Mask Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Query-based mask transformers assemble segmentation outputs through pixel-wise competition among query predictions of the final layer, yet this inference process is not explicitly optimized during training. We identify two key mismatches: the query with the highest probability-mask score does not necessarily produce the most accurate mask, and final-layer decoding may discard superior predictions from intermediate layers. To address these issues, we propose Inference-Aware Learning (iFAN), a general training framework for plain mask transformers. iFAN introduces Adjusted Probability-Mask Ranking (APMR), which aligns query competition with predicted mask quality and suppresses high-confidence but inaccurate competitors. We further employ Cross-Layer Self-Distillation (CLSD) to transfer stronger intermediate predictions to the final layer. The ranking and distillation objectives are training-only, while inference retains efficient final-layer decoding. Experiments on COCO, ADE20K, and Cityscapes demonstrate consistent improvements across panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation, as well as across different architectures, backbone scales, and input resolutions. Overall, iFAN improves performance by an average of 1.20 PQ, 1.30 AP, and 0.63 mIoU, with negligible additional parameters, FLOPs and inference latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iFAN（Inference-Aware Learning），一个面向普通掩码 Transformer（plain mask transformers）的通用训练框架，目的是在训练中显式优化查询竞争的推理过程。iFAN 通过 Adjusted Probability-Mask Ranking (APMR) 对齐查询竞争与预测掩码质量，并采用 Cross-Layer Self-Distillation (CLSD) 将中间层更强的预测传递给最终层。实验在 COCO、ADE20K 和 Cityscapes 上跨全景、实例和语义分割任务以及不同架构、骨干尺度和输入分辨率均取得一致提升，平均提升 1.20 PQ、1.30 AP 和 0.63 mIoU，额外参数、FLOPs 和推理延迟可忽略。
Motivation: 查询式掩码 Transformer 通过最终层各查询预测之间的像素级竞争来组装分割输出，但这一推理过程在训练时没有被显式优化。作者识别出两个关键不匹配：具有最高概率掩码得分的查询不一定产生最准确的掩码，且最终层解码可能丢弃中间层的更优预测。
Method: 提出 iFAN 训练框架，包含两个训练目标：APMR 将查询竞争与预测掩码质量对齐，并抑制高置信但不准确的竞争者；CLSD 将更强的中间层预测蒸馏到最终层。这些目标仅在训练时生效，推理阶段仍保持高效的最终层解码。
Result: 在 COCO、ADE20K 和 Cityscapes 上的实验显示，iFAN 对全景、实例和语义分割均带来一致改进，平均提升 1.20 PQ、1.30 AP 和 0.63 mIoU，同时仅引入可忽略的额外参数、FLOPs 和推理延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调推理感知训练能够在不增加推理成本的前提下提升普通掩码 Transformer 的分割性能。

papers.title: GROW: Group-Relative Advantage-Weighted On-Policy Reinforcement Learning of Autoregressive-Diffusion Text-to-Speech model
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for flow-matching text-to-speech is complicated by deterministic ODE sampling: trajectory-level policy-gradient methods typically convert the ODE into an SDE and track per-step likelihood ratios, introducing stochastic perturbations and substantial overhead. We propose GROW, a group-relative advantage-weighted on-policy RL method that acts directly on the standard flow-matching objective. For each prompt, GROW samples a group of on-policy utterances, separately standardizes intelligibility and speaker-similarity rewards within the group, and combines them to reweight flow-matching regression. A Wasserstein-2 velocity penalty anchors the updated model to a frozen pretrained reference. A group-mean reward baseline is introduced to convert reward weighting into advantage weighting. For strong pretrained TTS models with concentrated rewards, positive exponential weighting is dominated by reward-agnostic self-imitation, whereas a zero-mean signed advantage preserves effective within-group credit assignment. Instantiated on DiTAR and evaluated on LibriSpeech and Seed-TTS EN/ZH, GROW reduces average WER from 2.016 to 1.558 and raises speaker similarity from 0.676 to 0.715 while keeping UTMOS. With 10-NFE training rollouts and 32-NFE evaluation, GROW retains comparable performance while training 2.9x faster than 32-NFE DiTAR-GRPO. We will open-source complete GROW codes, faithful DiTAR reproduction, and all model checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GROW，一种直接作用于标准 flow-matching 目标的组相对优势加权在线强化学习方法，用于自回归扩散式文本到语音 (TTS) 模型。GROW 对每组提示采样一组 on-policy 语句，在组内分别标准化可懂度与说话人相似度奖励，结合二者对 flow-matching 回归重新加权，并用 Wasserstein-2 速度惩罚将更新后的模型锚定到冻结的预训练参考。在 DiTAR 上的实验显示平均 WER 从 2.016 降至 1.558，说话人相似度从 0.676 升至 0.715，且保持 UTMOS；在 10-NFE 训练滚动与 32-NFE 评估下，训练速度比 32-NFE DiTAR-GRPO 快 2.9 倍。
Motivation: 面向 flow-matching TTS 的强化学习因确定性 ODE 采样而复杂：轨迹级策略梯度方法通常需将 ODE 转为 SDE 并逐步骤跟踪似然比，引入随机扰动和大量额外开销。
Method: GROW 结合组内标准化奖励与 flow-matching 回归重加权，引入组均值奖励基线将奖励加权转化为优势加权；使用 Wasserstein-2 速度惩罚将模型锚定到冻结的预训练参考；并指出对奖励集中的强预训练模型，零均值符号优势比正指数加权更有效地保留组内信用分配。

papers.title: The Agent Operating System (AOS): A Reference Operating Architecture for Distributed Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have transformed artificial intelligence from isolated prediction services into components of long-running, distributed systems that reason, invoke tools, retrieve external state, delegate tasks, and act on behalf of users and organizations. The surrounding ecosystem has responded with agent frameworks, workflow engines, model-serving platforms, memory systems, communication protocols, and observability tools. These technologies improve execution, but they do not provide a stable, implementation-independent operating architecture for governing intent, selecting capabilities, preserving authority across delegation, controlling uncertainty, coordinating runtime behavior, and reconstructing why consequential actions occurred. This paper proposes the Agent Operating System (AOS), a vendor-neutral reference operating architecture for distributed agentic systems. AOS contains two internal planes: a Control & Governance Plane responsible for intent, policy, trust, authority, confidence, auditability, observability, and human oversight; and a Runtime & Coordination Plane responsible for agent lifecycle, workflow coordination, model and tool routing, context and memory coordination, scheduling, traffic management, and runtime assurance. Platform services, Linux or Windows, container runtimes, and physical infrastructure remain outside the AOS boundary and are integrated through explicit interfaces. The paper specifies AOS concepts, invariants, interface objects, optimization objectives, deployment profiles, and reliability responsibilities. It also identifies tradeoffs and unresolved research questions. AOS is not presented as a replacement for existing frameworks or infrastructure; it is proposed as the operating architecture through which heterogeneous components can be composed into governable, reliable, observable, and interoperable agentic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent 操作系统 (AOS)，一个供应商中立的参考操作系统架构，用于分布式智能体系统 (distributed agentic systems)。AOS 包含两个内部平面：负责意图、策略、信任、权限、置信度、可审计性、可观测性和人类监督的控制与治理平面 (Control & Governance Plane)，以及负责智能体生命周期、工作流协调、模型与工具路由、上下文与记忆协调、调度、流量管理和运行时保障的运行时与协调平面 (Runtime & Coordination Plane)。论文界定了 AOS 的概念、不变量、接口对象、优化目标、部署配置文件和可靠性职责，并指出权衡与未解决的研究问题。
Motivation: 现有智能体框架、工作流引擎、模型服务平台、记忆系统、通信协议和可观测性工具只能改善执行层面，但缺乏一个稳定且与实现无关的操作架构来治理意图、选择能力、跨委派保留权限、控制不确定性、协调运行时行为以及重建重要行动的原因。
Method: 提出 AOS 作为参考架构，将平台服务、容器运行时和物理基础设施排除在 AOS 边界之外，通过显式接口集成；内部划分为控制与治理平面和运行时与协调平面，并规定了概念、不变量、接口对象、优化目标以及部署和可靠性责任。
Result: 论文没有提供实证实验，而是以规范性的方式定义 AOS 架构及其组成平面、边界和设计权衡，并识别出未解决的研究问题；明确表示 AOS 不是对现有框架或基础设施的替代，而是将它们组合成可治理、可靠、可观测、可互操作的智能体系统的操作架构。
Conclusion: AOS 的核心主张是：需要一个与实现无关的参考操作系统架构来组合异构组件，使分布式智能体系统具备可治理性、可靠性、可观测性和互操作性；本文给出该架构的规格说明、权衡及开放问题。

papers.title: CrossScope: A Role-Asymmetric World Model for Joint Dual-Scope Surgical Video Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Visual world models typically learn future dynamics from a single observation stream, limiting their ability to model cooperative systems with multiple independently moving observers. We investigate this challenge in Mother--Child endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), where two flexible scopes provide complementary yet role-dependent views without a calibrated stereo relationship. Unlike conventional multi-view fusion that assumes symmetric information exchange, we formulate \textbf{role-asymmetric dual-scope future prediction}, where cross-view evidence is selectively transferred according to the prediction target and its underlying spatial requirements. We propose \textbf{CrossScope}, a dual-stream surgical world model that preserves view-specific experts while enabling target-specific evidence routing through geometry-guided residual interactions. CrossScope learns two complementary communication directions: geometric motion cues from the Mother view guide Child-view future dynamics, while pose-aligned Child appearance supports Mother-view prediction only when valid spatial correspondence is established. This design allows each scope to contribute task-relevant evidence without compromising its view-specific representation. To evaluate this problem, we establish a paired dual-scope benchmark comprising synchronized phantom and real-world ERCP episodes, with evaluations assessing visual fidelity, structural preservation, target localization, and motion consistency. Experiments demonstrate that CrossScope consistently outperforms strong surgical video generation baselines, validating the importance of role-aware evidence routing for multi-observer visual world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrossScope，一个针对母-子内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）双内镜场景的角色不对称世界模型，用于联合双视角手术视频预测。与假设对称信息交换的传统多视角融合不同，CrossScope 通过几何引导的残差交互实现目标特定的证据路由：母镜的几何运动线索指导子镜未来动态，而子镜的外观仅在建立有效空间对应时辅助母镜预测。作者建立了同步的体模与真实 ERCP 配对双视角基准，实验表明 CrossScope 在视觉保真度、结构保持、目标定位和运动一致性上优于强的手术视频生成基线。
Motivation: 现有视觉世界模型通常从单一观察流学习未来动态，难以建模多个独立移动观察者的协作系统。在母-子 ERCP 中，两个柔性内镜提供互补但角色依赖的视角，且没有标定的立体关系，需要一种能够按预测目标和空间需求选择性传递跨视角证据的角色不对称预测框架。
Method: 提出双流手术世界模型 CrossScope，保持每个视角的专属专家，并通过几何引导的残差交互实现目标特定的证据路由。模型学习两个互补的通信方向：母镜的几何运动线索指导子镜未来动态，子镜的位姿对齐外观仅在有效空间对应建立时支持母镜预测。
Result: 作者建立包含同步体模和真实 ERCP 片段的配对双视角基准，并从视觉保真度、结构保持、目标定位和运动一致性进行评估。实验显示 CrossScope 持续优于强的手术视频生成基线，验证了角色感知证据路由对多观察者视觉世界建模的重要性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调角色不对称的证据路由是多观察者视觉世界建模的关键，CrossScope 通过按目标选择性传递跨视角证据，避免了对称多视角融合对视角专属表示的损害。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DRIFT: Derailing Denoising Trajectories of Flow-Matching VLAs with Adversarial Patch Attack
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as pi0 generate robot actions by integrating a learned denoising velocity field, and have been reported to resist adversarial perturbations that readily fool autoregressive VLAs. We show that this robustness is largely illusory: it stems from prior attacks ignoring the multi-step denoising ODE. We introduce DRIFT (Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory), a test-time universal adversarial patch placed on the robot's gripper that attacks the denoising velocity field of an off-the-shelf policy. Our central finding is counterintuitive: attacking only the first denoising step is both stronger and cheaper than attacking a wider window of steps, which we explain through a gradient conflict unique to input-space optimization and which is exactly opposite to the training-time backdoor regime. On pi0 and pi0.5 across four LIBERO suites, DRIFT breaks essentially all originally-solvable tasks with a small single patch, far exceeding action- and embedding-space attack baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流匹配视觉-语言-动作模型 (flow-matching VLA) 对对抗扰动的鲁棒性，指出此前认为这类模型抗攻击的结论主要源于攻击方法忽略了多步去噪 ODE。作者提出 DRIFT，一种作用于机器人夹爪的测试时通用对抗补丁 (adversarial patch)，攻击现成策略的去噪速度场；核心反直觉发现是只攻击第一步去噪比攻击更宽的步长窗口更强且更便宜，原因归咎于输入空间优化特有的梯度冲突。
Motivation: 已有研究声称流匹配 VLA 模型 (如 pi0) 能抵抗容易欺骗自回归 VLA 的对抗扰动；作者认为这种鲁棒性是假象，因为先前攻击忽略了多步去噪 ODE，这一缺口导致对抗鲁棒性被高估。
Method: 提出 DRIFT (Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory)，在机器人夹爪上放置测试时通用对抗补丁，直接攻击去噪速度场；并刻意仅攻击第一步去噪，利用输入空间优化中与训练时后门场景相反的梯度冲突。
Result: 在 pi0 和 pi0.5 上、跨四个 LIBERO 套件，DRIFT 用单个小补丁基本打破所有原本可解的任务，效果远超 action 空间和 embedding 空间的攻击基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调流匹配 VLA 的对抗鲁棒性主要是假象，且其发现的攻击特性与训练时后门机制下的表现正好相反，说明该鲁棒性需要重新审视。

papers.title: EduClaw-Bench: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Pedagogical LLM Agents with Simulated Learners
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) power educational applications from tutoring to essay scoring, but each is a point solution to a single task, and only recently have these point solutions been integrated into agents operating over a learning management system (LMS). Yet tutoring is long-horizon, since a learner improves over days and weeks rather than in a single turn, and no benchmark evaluates an agent tutor across a sustained relationship. We introduce EduClaw-Bench, a benchmark that places an agent tutor in a continuous 30-day relationship with a simulated learner grounded in knowledge tracing (KT), whose knowledge-concept mastery, from a KT model trained on real-student data, drives its answers and is probed for learning gain across 55 scenarios. Each agent is scored on three primary axes (learning gain, responsiveness, and helpfulness) and two curriculum-design axes (Gagné and Rosenshine), with helpfulness and the curriculum axes judged by a cross-family panel of three LLM judges. Evaluating 10 agent adapters over three base-model tiers yields two findings that single-tier, single-session evaluation cannot reach. First, tutoring quality belongs to the base model and the agent harness together rather than either alone. Second, almost no combination sustains good tutoring over the full horizon. A calibration check ($\text{ECE}=0.049$) and a live-classroom field study confirm that the simulated learner and its measurements track reality. Our work is a step toward trustworthy AI tutors for future education.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EduClaw-Bench，一个面向教育 LLM 代理的长期跨度基准，让代理导师与基于知识追踪（KT）的模拟学习者保持连续 30 天的互动，覆盖 55 个场景。摘要报告对 10 个代理适配器、三个基础模型层级的评估得出两个单轮评估无法得到的结论：辅导质量同时取决于基础模型与代理框架，且几乎没有组合能在完整时间跨度上维持良好辅导。校准检查（ECE=0.049）与真实课堂实地研究被用来验证模拟学习者及其测量的可靠性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 教育应用多为单一任务的点解决方案，近期虽开始整合为运行在 LMS 上的代理，但辅导本质上是长期过程（学习者需要数天到数周进步），而现有基准没有在持续师生关系下评估代理导师。
Method: 提出 EduClaw-Bench：将代理导师置于与模拟学习者持续 30 天的关系中，模拟学习者由基于真实学生数据训练的 KT 模型驱动，通过 55 个场景探查知识概念掌握与学习增益。评分包括三个主要轴（学习增益、响应性、帮助性）和两个课程设计轴（Gagné 与 Rosenshine），其中帮助性与课程轴由三个 LLM 评审组成的小组判定；实验评估了 10 个代理适配器在三个基础模型层级上的表现。
Result: 摘要报告两个核心发现：辅导质量由基础模型与代理框架共同决定而非单一方面；几乎没有任何基础模型与代理适配器的组合能在完整时间跨度上保持良好辅导。此外，校准检查 ECE=0.049 以及真实课堂实地研究表明模拟学习者及其测量结果与现实一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作是通往未来教育中可信 AI 导师的一步，并强调长期、多维度评估对评估教育代理的必要性。

papers.title: Aligning Large Vision-Language Models at Test Time: A Trajectory-Guided Structured Sampling Approach
papers.abstract_en: Post-training reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are commonly used to align large vision-language models (LVLMs) with human intent and the requirements of visual reasoning tasks. However, existing RL-based alignment methods are often resource-intensive and encounter mismatches between training objectives and inference-time distributions. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel test-time alignment approach that leverages trajectory-guided structured sampling for dynamic inference-time refinement, achieving better alignment with visual grounding and ensuring logical consistency. Our approach begins with curating a reasoning memory bank via a trajectory learning algorithm, which decomposes complex question solving into ordered sequences of predefined reasoning patterns. It subsequently accomplishes inference-time alignment by first collecting trajectories from reasoning memory bank to establish a global structural reasoning prior, and then using an iterative Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm for localized multi-objective refinement of the reasoning trace. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly improves accuracy without incurring prohibitive inference overhead. These results establish trajectory-guided test-time sampling as a scalable and effective alternative to traditional post-training alignment, particularly for complex visual reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种测试时对齐 (test-time alignment) 方法，用于在不进行昂贵后训练强化学习 (post-training RL) 的情况下对齐大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 与视觉推理任务需求。方法先通过轨迹学习算法构建推理记忆库 (reasoning memory bank)，将复杂问题分解为有序推理模式，再结合全局结构先验与迭代马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 (MCMC) 进行局部多目标优化。实验表明该方法在多个多模态推理数据集上提升了准确率，且推理开销不大。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的 LVLM 对齐方法资源消耗大，且存在训练目标与推理时分布不一致的问题，作者希望用测试时动态精化来替代传统的后训练对齐。
Method: 首先用轨迹学习算法将复杂问题求解分解为有序的预定义推理模式，构建推理记忆库；随后从记忆库收集轨迹以建立全局结构推理先验，并使用迭代 MCMC 算法对当前推理轨迹进行局部多目标精化。
Result: 在多个多模态推理数据集上的实验显示，该方法在显著提升准确率的同时没有带来过高的推理开销，被作者表述为可扩展且有效的传统后训练对齐替代方案。
Conclusion: 轨迹引导的测试时结构化采样为复杂视觉推理任务提供了一种轻量级的对齐途径；摘要未提及对训练分布偏移或更广泛任务泛化的限制分析。

papers.title: When Refusal Looks Safe: The Refusal-Cue Shortcut in Safety Guard Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety guards are widely used to filter harmful content and are typically trained via supervised fine-tuning on labeled prompt-response pairs. We audit two widely used safety-guard training datasets, WildGuardMix and GR-Train, and find that among responses to harmful prompts, refusal expressions co-occur almost exclusively with unharmful labels. This imbalance motivates what we term the refusal-cue shortcut: inserting a refusal cue into a harmful response could flip the guard's verdict from harmful to unharmful. The shortcut affects not only guards trained on these datasets but also officially released models such as LlamaGuard3 and Qwen3Guard whose training data is undisclosed. It persists across response positions and is generally stronger in smaller variants within a family. To mitigate it, we adapt sparse complementary masking as a lightweight post-hoc intervention that identifies and suppresses a small set of shortcut-associated attention heads and MLP neurons without retraining. On two primary benchmarks, the intervention achieves an approximately 79% relative reduction in response-initial detection failures induced by refusal cues, while preserving standard detection performance. Although optimized using cues at a single response position, the suppression effect transfers to unseen positions and datasets, suggesting that shortcut manifestations across positions are partly mediated by shared internal components. Further analysis provides evidence that shortcut reliance and legitimate refusal recognition are partially functionally separable, as suppressing the shortcut broadly preserves the guard's ability to recognize genuine refusals.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, and 14 tables. Includes supplementary material in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计两个安全守卫训练数据集 WildGuardMix 和 GR-Train，发现有害提示对应的响应中，拒绝表达几乎只与无害标签共现，由此提出“拒绝线索捷径”(refusal-cue shortcut)：在有害响应中插入拒绝线索即可让守卫模型将判定从有害翻转为无害。该捷径不仅影响在这些数据集上训练的守卫，也影响训练数据未公开的官方模型 LlamaGuard3 和 Qwen3Guard，并在更小规模的模型变体中更强。作者提出稀疏互补掩码 (sparse complementary masking) 作为轻量后处理干预，在不重训练的情况下识别并抑制少量与捷径相关的注意力头和 MLP 神经元，在两个基准上将响应开头位置的由拒绝线索引起的检测失败相对减少约 79%，同时保持标准检测性能，且抑制效果可迁移到未见位置和数据集。
Motivation: 安全守卫模型通常基于带标签的提示-响应对进行监督微调，但训练数据中拒绝表达与无害标签的高度共现会使模型学到脆弱的捷径，导致攻击者仅通过插入拒绝措辞就能绕过内容过滤。
Method: 作者先审计数据集中的标签-表达共现失衡，识别拒绝线索捷径；随后适配稀疏互补掩码作为无需重训练的后处理干预，定位并抑制与捷径相关的注意力头和 MLP 神经元。
Result: 在两个主要基准上，干预对响应开头位置由拒绝线索诱导的检测失败实现约 79% 的相对下降，同时保持标准检测性能；抑制效果可迁移到未见位置和数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要指出捷径依赖与合法拒绝识别在功能上部分可分离，抑制捷径后守卫仍能识别真实拒绝；但干预是基于单一响应位置的线索优化的，跨位置迁移的机制被解释为共享内部组件。

papers.title: Bridging Online and Offline Handwriting via Differentiable Physical Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Realistic handwritten text generation plays an important role in numerous applications, such as font design, biometric authentication, and robotic calligraphy. Existing methods are typically divided into two independent paradigms: online approaches that estimate handwriting trajectories and offline approaches that synthesize realistic handwriting images. While online models capture structural and temporal dynamics, they often lack fine-grained textures, whereas offline models reproduce realistic appearance but discard stroke order. However, unifying online and offline models remains challenging due to (1) the lack of an explicit physical model linking stroke kinematics to pixel-level appearance and (2) the absence of paired trajectory-image datasets. Moreover, enabling end-to-end learning requires a differentiable rendering process across motion and appearance domains. To address these challenges, we propose a compact physical brush model that bridges stroke dynamics and visual appearance, together with a differentiable rendering module that converts stroke trajectories into stylized images. By integrating these components, we propose a unified online-offline handwriting generation framework via differentiable brush rendering. The proposed framework consists of four core modules: 1) a text-to-stroke generator that predicts the target stroke conditioned on the given text and style image, 2) a brush parameter observer that extracts brush model parameters from style references, 3) a differentiable brush renderer that maps a stroke sequence and physical brush parameters into a handwritten image, and 4) a zero-shot image refiner that refines rendered images via diffusion models. Extensive experiments and real-world robotic calligraphy demonstrations validate our approach, achieving both structural and visual fidelity.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026, Project page: https://seonmip.github.io/onoff
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可微物理笔刷渲染框架，将在线笔迹轨迹生成与离线笔迹图像合成统一起来。核心是一个紧凑的物理笔刷模型把笔画动力学与像素级外观关联起来，并配套可微渲染模块把轨迹转为风格化图像。框架包含文本到笔画生成器、笔刷参数观测器、可微笔刷渲染器和基于扩散模型的零样本图像精化器四个模块，实验与真实机器人书法演示验证了结构与视觉保真度。
Motivation: 现有在线方法捕捉结构与时间动态但缺乏精细纹理，离线方法还原真实外观却丢失笔画顺序，两类范式相互独立且难以统一。难点在于缺少把笔画运动学映射到像素外观的显式物理模型，以及缺少成对的轨迹-图像数据集，端到端学习还需要跨运动域和外观域的可微渲染过程。
Method: 提出一个紧凑的物理笔刷模型连接笔画动态与视觉外观，并设计可微渲染模块将笔画轨迹渲染为风格化图像。整体框架由四个模块组成：文本到笔画生成器、从风格参考提取笔刷参数的观测器、将笔画序列与物理笔刷参数映射为手写图像的可微渲染器，以及用扩散模型做零样本精化的图像精化器。
Result: 摘要报告通过大量实验和真实机器人书法演示验证了该方法，同时实现结构保真和视觉保真，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过可微笔刷渲染统一在线与离线手写生成是可行的，能够兼顾笔画结构和真实外观，并已在机器人书法等实际场景中得到验证。

papers.title: On the Implicit Flatness Bias of Sharpness-Aware Minimization: A Linear Stability Analysis with Quantitative Hyperparameter Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) improves generalization by seeking parameters whose loss is robust to local adversarial perturbations, but the quantitative mechanism underlying its implicit bias toward flat minima remains unclear. In particular, the perturbation radius $ρ$ is typically treated as an isolated tuning parameter, despite defining the neighborhood in which SAM measures sharpness. We analyze mini-batch SAM near an interpolating minimum through linear stability. Under local linearization and gradient-noise alignment assumptions, we prove that every linearly stable minimum satisfies $λ_{\max}\leq\sqrt[3]{bΓ/(2ρη^2)}$, where $λ_{\max}$ is the largest Hessian eigenvalue, $b$ is the batch size, $η$ is the learning rate, and $Γ$ bounds the gradient norm. The bound quantitatively characterizes SAM's implicit flatness bias: holding the other quantities fixed, a smaller batch size, a larger learning rate, or a larger radius restricts linearly stable SAM to flatter minima. It also exposes a necessary trade-off: $ρ$ should be large enough to promote flatness, yet remain local enough to preserve the approximation and stable training. We validate this prediction in a controlled study of 900 models on CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18 and VGG-19, where increasing $ρ$ is consistently associated with a smaller largest Hessian eigenvalue across batch-size and learning-rate settings. Finally, we instantiate the analysis in Taylor-Locality Controlled SAM (TLC-SAM), which adjusts $ρ$ using the observed Taylor-approximation error and further reduces the top Hessian eigenvalue relative to fixed-radius SAM. Our results provide quantitative hyperparameter bounds and a stability--locality perspective for analyzing and designing SAM variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过线性稳定性分析研究 Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) 对平坦极小值的隐式偏好，证明在线性稳定极小值处满足 λ_max ≤ ∛(bΓ/(2ρη^2))，其中 ρ 为扰动半径、b 为批量大小、η 为学习率、Γ 为梯度范数上界。该界定量刻画了 SAM 的隐式平坦偏差：固定其他量时，较小批量、较大学习率或较大 ρ 将线性稳定 SAM 限制到更平坦的极小值。作者在 CIFAR-100 上对 900 个 ResNet-18/VGG-19 模型进行控制实验，验证增大 ρ 与更小的最大 Hessian 特征值一致相关；并据此提出 Taylor-Locality Controlled SAM (TLC-SAM)，利用实测 Taylor 近似误差调整 ρ，进一步降低顶部 Hessian 特征值。
Motivation: SAM 通过对抗扰动寻找损失稳健的参数以提升泛化，但其隐式平坦偏好背后的定量机制仍不清楚；尤其是扰动半径 ρ 通常被当作孤立的调参量，尽管它定义了 SAM 度量 sharpness 的邻域。
Method: 在插值极小值附近对小批量 SAM 做线性稳定性分析，并在局部线性化与梯度噪声对齐假设下证明最大 Hessian 特征值的上界。随后将该分析实例化为 TLC-SAM，用观测到的 Taylor 近似误差动态调整扰动半径 ρ。

papers.title: TumorBoard: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Decision Support for Longitudinal Neuro-Oncology
papers.abstract_en: Neuro-oncology decisions require coordinated interpretation of serial MRI, pathology, molecular markers, treatment history, performance status, and evolving guidelines. We present TumorBoard, a multi-agent decision-support system built around a shared longitudinal case state and an auditable claim-evidence ledger. Specialist agents for radiology, neuropathology, molecular diagnosis, guidelines, and therapy planning produce atomic claims with provenance. An adversarial critic exposes contradictions, and a safety governor releases, qualifies, or defers recommendations according to evidence sufficiency and temporal validity. On a 360-case hidden benchmark at a matched token budget, TumorBoard achieved an action F1 of 0.772 and evidence entailment of 0.914. It exceeded the strongest typed-council baseline by 3.1 percentage points (95% CI: 1.6 to 4.7, adjusted p = 0.0012), while recommendation-to-evidence coverage reached 0.927. Under evidence deletion, the system deferred 84.2% of unsafe cases and limited harmful recommendations to 5.8%. The safety governor reduced harmful release by 7.8 percentage points at a false-deferral cost of 4.3 percentage points. Ablation studies of the ledger, critic, and governor produced the predicted failure patterns, establishing structured coordination as the source of the measured multi-agent advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TumorBoard，一个面向纵向神经肿瘤学决策支持的多智能体系统，围绕共享的纵向病例状态和可审计的声明-证据账本（claim-evidence ledger）构建。系统包含放射学、神经病理学、分子诊断、指南和治疗计划等专业智能体，并引入对抗性批评者（adversarial critic）与安全治理器（safety governor）来识别矛盾并评估证据充分性与时间有效性。在 360 例隐藏基准上，系统达到 action F1 0.772 和证据蕴含 0.914，超过最强 typed-council 基线 3.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 神经肿瘤学决策需要协调解释序列 MRI、病理、分子标志物、治疗史、功能状态和不断更新的指南，而现有系统缺乏对这种多源、纵向、证据可追溯决策的结构化支持。
Method: 构建共享的纵向病例状态与可审计的声明-证据账本；专业智能体产出带来源的原子声明（atomic claims），对抗性批评者暴露矛盾，安全治理器根据证据充分性和时间有效性决定放行、限定或推迟建议。
Result: 在 360 例隐藏基准、匹配 token 预算下，action F1 为 0.772，证据蕴含为 0.914，相对最强 typed-council 基线提升 3.1 个百分点（95% CI: 1.6 至 4.7，调整后 p=0.0012），建议-证据覆盖率 0.927。证据删除下系统推迟 84.2% 不安全病例，有害建议限制在 5.8%；安全治理器在 4.3 个百分点错误推迟代价下减少 7.8 个百分点有害放行。消融实验验证了账本、批评者和治理器的预期失效模式。
Conclusion: 摘要将多智能体优势归因于结构化协调机制（账本、批评者、治理器），而非单一组件；该系统在证据不足时可安全推迟决策，但讨论未超出该基准设置。

papers.title: CRIL-U-Net: Compact Ratio-Interaction Learning for Focal Cortical Dysplasia Segmentation from T1w and FLAIR MRI
papers.abstract_en: Focal cortical dysplasia (FCD) type II is an important structural cause of drug-resistant focal epilepsy, but its small size, heterogeneous appearance, and subtle MRI characteristics make automated segmentation challenging. Conventional multimodal networks commonly concatenate T1-weighted (T1w) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) images, requiring subsequent layers to learn useful cross-modal relationships implicitly. We propose CRIL-U-Net, a 3D U-Net incorporating a Compact Ratio-Interaction Learning module that combines local spatial features, voxel-wise cross-modal mixing, and bidirectional ratio-inspired interactions. CRIL-U-Net was compared with a conventional 3D U-Net and an input self-attention U-Net using five-fold cross-validation on 85 FCD subjects and 25 healthy controls. Each architecture was trained independently using Dice-binary cross-entropy (Dice-BCE) and Focal Tversky-Focal (FTF) losses. With FTF, CRIL-U-Net achieved the highest mean Dice score (0.196 +/- 0.262), compared with 0.136 +/- 0.224 for the U-Net and 0.135 +/- 0.214 for the attention comparator. It produced nonzero lesion overlap in 44 of 85 cases, compared with 36 for the U-Net. Under FTF, CRIL-U-Net significantly outperformed both comparison architectures after false-discovery-rate correction. These findings suggest that compact cross-modal representation learning can improve FCD segmentation within a controlled U-Net setting when combined with an imbalance-aware objective, although the remaining zero-overlap rate of 48.2% highlights the need for further validation and methodological development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRIL-U-Net，一种将 Compact Ratio-Interaction Learning 模块集成到 3D U-Net 中的模型，用于从 T1w 和 FLAIR MRI 分割局灶性皮质发育不良（FCD）II 型病灶。该模块结合局部空间特征、体素级跨模态混合与双向比率启发交互，以显式学习跨模态关系。在 85 例 FCD 患者与 25 例健康对照上的五折交叉验证中，采用 Focal Tversky-Focal（FTF）损失时 CRIL-U-Net 取得最高平均 Dice（0.196 ± 0.262），但零重叠率仍达 48.2%。
Motivation: FCD II 型是药物难治性局灶性癫痫的重要结构病因，但其病灶小、外观异质且 MRI 表现细微，自动分割困难。传统多模态网络通常直接拼接 T1w 与 FLAIR 图像，需要后续层隐式学习跨模态关系，本文希望用紧凑的跨模态表示学习显式改善这一过程。
Method: 提出 CRIL-U-Net，在 3D U-Net 中引入 Compact Ratio-Interaction Learning 模块，结合局部空间特征、体素级跨模态混合和双向比率启发交互。作者将其与常规 3D U-Net 及输入自注意力 U-Net 比较，在 85 例 FCD 与 25 例健康对照上使用五折交叉验证，并分别用 Dice-BCE 和 Focal Tversky-Focal 两种损失独立训练各架构。
Result: 在 FTF 损失下，CRIL-U-Net 的平均 Dice 为 0.196 ± 0.262，高于 U-Net 的 0.136 ± 0.224 和注意力对照的 0.135 ± 0.214；在 85 例中有 44 例产生非零病灶重叠，而 U-Net 为 36 例。经错误发现率校正后，CRIL-U-Net 显著优于两个对照架构。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在受控 U-Net 设置下，紧凑的跨模态表示学习与不平衡感知损失结合可改善 FCD 分割；但剩余 48.2% 的零重叠率说明模型仍需进一步验证和方法学改进。

papers.title: EditFlow3D: Automated Local Editing of 3D Assets with Trajectory Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Controllable local editing of 3D assets requires precise target localization and appropriate visual guidance. However, existing methods lack a simple yet accurate way to obtain 3D masks and struggle to achieve the desired edit while faithfully preserving the structure and appearance of non-target regions. To address these challenges, we present EditFlow3D, a training-free framework for local 3D editing. Given a source asset and an edit instruction, a VLM-driven workflow interprets the editing intent and automatically constructs a visual guidance image and a refined 3D editing mask, enabling localized editing in the native representation space of a pretrained 3D generative model. Specifically, mask-guided differential flow focuses the edit on the target region, while step-wise trajectory preservation maintains consistency between non-target regions and the source asset without directly replacing intermediate features. Since the existing Edit3D-Bench covers only a limited range of local editing categories, we further introduce EditFlow-Bench as a complementary benchmark encompassing a broader variety of structural and appearance edits, and evaluate EditFlow3D on both benchmarks. Quantitative results, qualitative comparisons, and a user study demonstrate that EditFlow3D achieves more accurate target-region editing and better preserves non-target regions than existing 3D editing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EditFlow3D，一个无需训练的局部 3D 编辑框架。给定源 3D 资产和编辑指令，VLM 驱动的工作流自动构建视觉引导图像和细化的 3D 编辑掩码，在预训练 3D 生成模型的原始表示空间中进行局部编辑；mask-guided differential flow 聚焦目标区域，step-wise trajectory preservation 保持非目标区域与源资产一致。作者还引入补充基准 EditFlow-Bench，并在两个基准上验证了该方法在目标区域编辑准确性和非目标区域保持上的优势。
Motivation: 可控的局部 3D 编辑需要精确的目标定位和合适的视觉引导，但现有方法缺乏简单准确的 3D 掩码获取方式，难以在编辑目标区域的同时忠实保留非目标区域的结构和外观。
Method: 提出训练无关 (training-free) 框架 EditFlow3D：VLM 驱动流程解释编辑意图并自动生成视觉引导图像和精炼的 3D 编辑掩码；使用 mask-guided differential flow 将编辑聚焦于目标区域，并通过 step-wise trajectory preservation 维持非目标区域与源资产的一致性，而不直接替换中间特征。
Result: 在 Edit3D-Bench 和新增的 EditFlow-Bench 上，定量结果、定性比较和用户研究显示 EditFlow3D 比现有 3D 编辑方法在目标区域编辑更准确，并更好地保持非目标区域。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架提供了一种无需训练的局部 3D 编辑方案，并通过扩展基准覆盖更多结构和外观编辑类别来弥补现有基准的局限。

papers.title: Diversity is Not Ambiguity: Toward Accurate and Efficient Ambiguity Detection for Open-Domain QA
papers.abstract_en: How can question answering (QA) systems determine whether a query is ambiguous? Ambiguity detection is essential in open-domain QA, as misclassification leads to answering the wrong interpretation or unnecessary clarification. However, existing methods conflate answer diversity with ambiguity, leading to inaccurate predictions. They also process queries uniformly, resulting in wasteful computation. We propose ARCHIVE (Ambiguity Recognition via Cascaded Hypothesis Inspection and Conflict Verification), an accurate and efficient framework that detects ambiguity via logical conflict: a query is ambiguous when its valid answers cannot all be true under a single interpretation. ARCHIVE combines a lightweight early-exit encoder for surface-detectable cases with a conflict reasoning module that models logical relations among answers, reinforced by an invariance objective for robustness to noisy answer sets. We present QuireQA, a 4,703-query benchmark spanning factoid, non-factoid, and ill-formed queries. Experiments show ARCHIVE outperforms competitors, improving F1-amb by up to 10.4% and F1-unamb by up to 21.6%, while operating 16$\times$ faster than the best competitor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARCHIVE（Ambiguity Recognition via Cascaded Hypothesis Inspection and Conflict Verification），一个面向开放域问答的歧义检测框架，核心思想是用逻辑冲突定义歧义：若一个问题的有效答案无法在单一解释下同时为真，则该问题是歧义的。作者同时发布 QuireQA 基准（含 4,703 个查询，覆盖事实型、非事实型和病态查询），实验显示 ARCHIVE 在 F1-amb 上最高提升 10.4%、在 F1-unamb 上最高提升 21.6%，并比最优对比方法快 16 倍。
Motivation: 现有歧义检测方法将答案多样性误当作歧义，导致预测不准确；同时它们对所有查询一视同仁地处理，造成不必要的计算浪费。
Method: ARCHIVE 将轻量级早退编码器（early-exit encoder）用于表面可检测的歧义情况，并引入冲突推理模块（conflict reasoning module）建模答案之间的逻辑关系；还通过不变性目标（invariance objective）增强对噪声答案集的鲁棒性。
Result: 实验表明 ARCHIVE 优于对比方法，在 F1-amb 上提升最多 10.4%，在 F1-unamb 上提升最多 21.6%，并且运行速度比最佳对比方法快 16 倍。

papers.title: Frequency-Decorrelated Temporal Ensembles for EEG--fNIRS Imagined-Handwriting Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Imagined handwriting offers a temporally rich paradigm for non-invasive neural decoding, yet reliable recognition across unseen participants remains difficult because scalp EEG is noisy and internally generated stroke sequences vary across individuals. The Multimodal Brain-Computer Interface Grand Challenge provides synchronized EEG and fNIRS for four-class subject-independent handwriting-trajectory classification. We propose FRED, a task-adapted system that models imagined handwriting as a multi-second motor sequence and trains a compact multi-scale temporal network on three complementary EEG frequency views. With three seeds per view, cross-band members produce substantially less-correlated errors than same-band replicas, yielding a clean nine-member ensemble accuracy of 0.8076/0.7242/0.7492 on the public/private/overall test partitions without test-set adaptation or output constraints. The submitted pipeline further incorporates transductive pseudo-label training, three EEG-Conformer members, posterior aggregation, and a paradigm-aware decoder. Because every 12-trial randomization block contains three instances of each class, the final predictions are obtained by Hungarian assignment under the known block quota. On one fixed posterior pool, independent, session-constrained, and block-constrained decoding achieve 0.7600, 0.7758, and 0.7952 overall accuracy, respectively. The complete system reaches 0.8498/0.7718/0.7952, ranking fourth on the private split. A modality audit finds fNIRS-only decoding at chance (0.2511 overall), while adding fNIRS to EEG changes accuracy by only +0.0025. These results identify frequency-diverse temporal EEG modeling and protocol-matched structured inference as the principal sources of performance in this sparse-montage EEG--fNIRS setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/XiuFan719/EEG-fNIRS-fuse-method-for-MM-challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FRED 系统，针对多模态脑机接口挑战赛中的四类 subject-independent 想象手写轨迹分类任务，利用同步 EEG 与 fNIRS 数据。方法将想象手写建模为多秒运动序列，在三个互补的 EEG 频率视图上训练紧凑多尺度时序网络，并通过跨频带成员的频率解相关集成获得九成员集成的公共/私有/总体准确率 0.8076/0.7242/0.7492。完整提交管线加入转导伪标签训练、EEG-Conformer 成员、后验聚合与协议感知解码器，在私有分区排名第四，总体准确率 0.7952。模态审计显示 fNIRS 单独解码接近随机水平，主要性能来源为频率多样化的时序 EEG 建模与协议匹配的结构化推理。
Motivation: 想象手写是非侵入式神经解码中时间信息丰富的范式，但跨未见受试者的可靠识别很困难，因为头皮 EEG 噪声大，且内部生成的笔画序列因人而异。
Method: 提出 FRED，构建三个互补的 EEG 频率视图并训练紧凑多尺度时序网络；每个视图取三个种子，跨频带成员产生相关性显著更低的错误，形成九成员集成。提交的完整管线还引入 transductive pseudo-label 训练、三个 EEG-Conformer 成员、后验聚合和范式感知解码器，并利用每个 12 试验随机化块包含每类三个实例的配额约束，通过 Hungarian assignment 输出最终预测。
Result: 九成员集成在 public/private/overall 测试分区达到 0.8076/0.7242/0.7492；在固定后验池上，独立、会话约束、块约束解码分别达到 0.7600/0.7758/0.7952 总体准确率；完整系统达到 0.8498/0.7718/0.7952，在 private 分区排名第四。模态审计发现 fNIRS-only 解码接近随机（0.2511 overall），加入 fNIRS 仅使准确率变化 +0.0025。

papers.title: Attribute-based Undetectable Watermarking for Generative AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI systems increasingly produce content whose provenance is difficult to verify, motivating watermarking techniques for identifying model-generated outputs. Existing cryptographic watermarking methods provide strong undetectability guarantees: without a detection key, watermarked outputs are computationally indistinguishable from unwatermarked ones. However, these approaches do not address the crucial deployment challenge of how to safely delegate detection capabilities. With an unrestricted detection key, a malicious detector may use the detection key beyond its intended scope, enabling watermark sanitization, scope abuse, and user profiling. To mitigate this safety concern, we introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first \emph{attribute-based watermarking} for generative AI models, providing fine-grained, policy-controlled watermark detection. In our approach, each generated output is associated with attributes, and each detection key is \emph{constrained by a policy} on potential attributes. A detection key can only be used to detect watermarked outputs whose attributes satisfy the corresponding policy, while watermarked outputs that fall outside the policy remain computationally indistinguishable from unwatermarked ones. We construct such an attribute-based watermarking scheme and formalize its security properties, including consistency, adaptive robustness to bounded corruptions, undetectability, and soundness, along with a security proof under standard cryptographic assumptions. Our construction integrates constrained pseudorandom functions, pseudorandom error-correcting codes, and randomness recovery procedures with generative AI models. Finally, we implement a prototype and an empirical evaluation, demonstrating that attribute-based watermarking is both effective and practical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向生成式 AI 模型的属性基水印 (attribute-based watermarking)，使检测密钥受属性策略约束，只能检测满足策略的输出，策略外的带水印输出在计算上仍与无水印输出不可区分。作者定义了包括一致性、自适应鲁棒性、不可检测性和健壮性在内的安全属性，并在标准密码学假设下给出安全证明。实现原型与实证评估表明该方法有效且实用。
Motivation: 现有密码学水印方法虽提供强不可检测性，但未解决如何安全地委派检测能力的问题：不受限的检测密钥可能被恶意检测者用于水印清除、越权使用或用户画像分析。
Method: 构造属性基水印方案，将约束伪随机函数 (constrained pseudorandom functions)、伪随机纠错码 (pseudorandom error-correcting codes) 与随机性恢复过程集成到生成式 AI 模型中，使每个检测密钥受到属性策略约束。
Result: 在标准密码学假设下形式化并证明了安全性，包括一致性、对受限腐败的自适应鲁棒性、不可检测性和健壮性；原型实现与实证评估表明方案既有效又实用。
Conclusion: 本文强调属性基水印为生成式 AI 内容溯源提供了细粒度、策略控制的检测委派方式，改善了安全委派检测能力的部署难题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Surrogate Substitution Preserves PHI Detectability: A Multi-Detector Equivalence Study
papers.abstract_en: Structure-preserving de-identification replaces protected health information (PHI) with realistic same-type surrogates -- "Anna S." becomes "Maria S.", not [NAME] -- so that clinical text stays fluent and downstream tools keep working. But this only helps if the substitution does not itself corrupt the signal those tools rely on. We ask a narrow, testable question: on the spans a de-identifier actually masks, can downstream PHI detectors still find the surrogate? We introduce a paired, multi-detector evaluation protocol that (i) scores utility only on masked spans, decoupling coverage from utility; (ii) uses equivalence testing (TOST) rather than null-hypothesis significance testing, which is uninformative at our sample size (57k paired spans); and (iii) builds a surrogate-failure typology separating fixable generator defects from intrinsic detector limits. Across 11 detectors, 7 benchmarks, and 7 languages (1,750 documents), recall on masked spans moves from 76.1% to 74.9% -- a change our equivalence test shows is statistically equivalent to zero within a +/-2-point margin (p ~ 3e-9), with detector ranking preserved. The residual loss does not reflect detectors getting worse at PHI: it concentrates in malformed and out-of-distribution surrogates (truncation Chicago -> Illino, salience loss Cedars-Sinai -> Vidant). A redaction floor and an open-source surrogate baseline indicate the effect is a property of well-formed substitution, not of one tool. We release the evaluation subsets, scoring code, and an interactive dashboard at https://custodianai.pages.dev so the protocol can audit any structure-preserving transform.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code, data, and interactive dashboard: https://custodianai.pages.dev ; repository: https://github.com/Custodian-Labs/guardian-layer-phi-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究结构化保真的去标识化（structure-preserving de-identification）在替换受保护健康信息（PHI）为同类型替身（surrogate）后，下游PHI检测器是否仍能在被掩码的跨度上识别出替身。作者引入配对的多检测器评估协议，使用等价检验（TOST）而非显著性检验，并在11个检测器、7个基准、7种语言共1,750篇文档上发现，掩码跨度的召回率从76.1%变为74.9%，统计上等价于零变化（±2个百分点，p≈3e-9）。残余损失集中在格式错误和分布外替身上，表明该效果是结构良好替换的属性。
Motivation: 结构保真去标识化在保留文本流畅性的同时用逼真同类型替身替换PHI，但替换本身可能破坏下游工具依赖的信号。现有评估往往将覆盖率与效用混在一起，且在小样本下使用无效的显著性检验，因此需要一个只在被掩码跨度上评分、并能区分可修复生成缺陷与内在检测器局限的评估协议。
Method: 提出配对多检测器评估协议：(i) 仅在掩码跨度上评分效用，将覆盖率与效用解耦；(ii) 使用等价检验（TOST）替代原假设显著性检验，适配57k配对跨度的样本量；(iii) 构建替身失败类型学，区分可修复的生成器缺陷与检测器的固有局限。
Result: 在11个检测器、7个基准、7种语言共1,750份文档上，掩码跨度召回率从76.1%变为74.9%，等价检验显示在±2个百分点范围内统计等价于零（p≈3e-9），检测器排名保持不变。残余损失集中于畸形和分布外替身，例如截断（Chicago -> Illino）和显著性损失（Cedars-Sinai -> Vidant）。
Conclusion: 作者认为残余损失并非检测器对PHI的识别变差，而是来自格式错误和分布外替身；一个redaction floor和开源替身基线表明该效应是结构良好替换的属性。研究发布了评估子集、评分代码和交互式仪表板，供其他结构保真变换审计使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EFX Allocation In (Multi)Hypergraphs
papers.abstract_en: We study fair allocations of indivisible goods among agents with heterogeneous monotone valuations. As fair we consider the allocations that are envy-free-up-to-any-good (EFX). Finding if EFX alloca- tions always exist, even for agents with additive valuations, is a major open problem in Fair Division. Christodoulou et al. (2023) introduced the (multi-hyper)graph setting, where agents and goods are represented by vertices and edges of a graph, respectively, and only the endpoints of an edge may have non-zero marginal value for it. We show that for hypergraphs with girth at least 4 and agents with general monotone valuations there always exists an EFX allocation and can be constructed in polynomial time. We generalize our approach to also show that multi-hypergraphs with girth (on the simple hypergraph) at least 4 always admit an EFX allocation, as long as there exists a single vertex whose incident edges have multiplicity at most the size of that edge minus 2; our construction in this case needs pseudo-polynomial time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不可分割物品在异质单调估值下的公平分配，聚焦于 EFX（envy-free-up-to-any-good）分配的存在性问题。作者在 Christodoulou 等人提出的（多重）超图设定中证明，对于简单超图围长至少 4、代理具有一般单调估值的情形，EFX 分配总是存在且可在多项式时间内构造；进一步将该结果推广至多重超图，在满足特定重数条件下只需伪多项式时间即可构造。
Motivation: EFX 分配是否总是存在（即使对可加估值）是公平分配领域的重大开放问题。为了推进该问题，Christodoulou 等人引入了图与超图设定，其中只有边的端点对边有非零边际价值；本文在该受限设定下寻求更一般的存在性条件。
Method: 作者针对超图与多重超图提出构造性算法，利用围长（girth）至少 4 的结构条件，结合对边重数的限制，设计出能显式构造 EFX 分配的算法。
Result: 摘要证明：围长至少 4 的超图在一般单调估值下总存在 EFX 分配且可多项式时间构造；对于围长至少 4 的多重超图，若存在一个顶点，其关联边的重数至多为其边大小减 2，则 EFX 分配存在且构造时间为伪多项式。

papers.title: Adversarial Stress Testing of Role-Playing Language Agents using Multi-Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Role-Playing Language Agents (RPLAs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications such as healthcare assistance, customer support, and education, where maintaining consistent personas, ethical constraints, and behavioral coherence under adversarial pressure is critical. Existing evaluation approaches rely on static benchmarks or isolated single-turn prompts that fail to capture cumulative behavioral failures emerging over extended interactions. We present a modular multi-agent platform for adversarially stress-testing RPLAs through structured, multi-turn dialogue. The system coordinates three agents: a strategy-driven Interrogator Agent that applies six progressive adversarial strategies, a Target Agent representing the RPLA under evaluation, and an automated Judging Agent that scores behavior across role fidelity, drift, ethical deviation, and consistency dimensions. Through experiments across three personas and three LLM families, we demonstrate that multi-strategy adversarial evaluation reveals failure modes invisible to single-strategy testing, reducing overall robustness scores by 0.17--0.20 points on average. Cross-model validation confirms consistent degradation patterns across Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Claude-3.5-Haiku, with Authority Challenge and Emotional Manipulation emerging as the most effective attack strategies. Automated judging achieves strong human alignment ($r = 0.82$, Fleiss' $κ= 0.71$). This work is released as an open-source platform to support AI safety and reproducible RPLA benchmarking. While the framework enables systematic discovery of failure modes, we acknowledge potential ethical risks associated with adversarial testing methodologies and emphasize responsible usage for improving AI safety.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables; accepted and presented at ADScAI Conference 2026, University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化多智能体平台，用于对角色扮演语言代理（RPLA）进行对抗性压力测试，通过结构化多轮对话评估角色保真度、漂移、伦理偏差和一致性。实验显示多策略对抗评估能发现单策略测试无法暴露的失效模式，平均降低鲁棒性分数0.17–0.20点，自动化评判与人类判断具有较强一致性（r=0.82，Fleiss κ=0.71）。该平台已开源。
Motivation: 现有评估依赖静态基准或孤立的单轮提示，无法捕捉代理在长时间交互中逐渐累积的行为失败；而RPLA在医疗、客服、教育等高风险场景中的角色一致性与伦理约束至关重要。
Method: 构建三智能体系统：策略驱动的审讯代理（Interrogator Agent）应用六种渐进式对抗策略，目标代理（Target Agent）为被测RPLA，自动化评判代理（Judging Agent）从角色保真度、漂移、伦理偏差和一致性维度打分。
Result: 在三个人格和三个LLM家族上的实验表明，多策略对抗评估比单策略测试暴露更多失效模式，平均鲁棒性分数下降0.17–0.20；跨模型验证显示Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3.5-Haiku退化模式一致，Authority Challenge和Emotional Manipulation最有效；自动评判与人类对齐r=0.82，Fleiss κ=0.71。
Conclusion: 该框架可系统性发现RPLA失效模式，但作者承认对抗测试方法本身存在伦理风险，强调应负责任地用于提升AI安全，并以开源平台支持可复现的RPLA基准测试。

papers.title: SpreadMark: Robust Image Watermarking via Spread-Spectrum Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Invisible image watermarks are increasingly used for deepfake detection and provenance tracking, where they must survive not only incidental distortions but also deliberate removal. We revisit spread-spectrum embedding, a classical watermarking principle, inside a modern neural post-hoc watermarking architecture. Our starting point is a measurement: in existing encoder-decoder schemes each message bit occupies only a small fraction of the image, a shared contributing factor to their fragility, since removal then need only disturb the region a bit occupies. SpreadMark instead spreads each bit as a dense pseudo-random codeword over the whole image and recovers it by matched-filtering a learned cover-suppressed chip representation, with a parallel convolutional decoding path and sparsification-aware training. A conditional chip-space analysis shows that, under a codeword-independent perturbation model, dense spreading increases the budget required to disrupt matched-filter recovery. Evaluated on COCO and DIV2K against nine schemes, SpreadMark is the only evaluated method retaining high detection under both the regeneration and the latent-space sparsification settings we test, with competitive JPEG and additive-noise robustness. It keeps the embedded watermark imperceptible, maintaining high perceptual quality on both COCO and DIV2K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpreadMark，一种基于扩频嵌入 (spread-spectrum embedding) 的不可见图像水印方法，面向深度伪造检测和来源追踪。它把每个消息比特展开为覆盖整张图像的稠密伪随机码字，通过学习到的抑制封面 (cover-suppressed) chip 表示进行匹配滤波恢复，并配合并行卷积解码路径与稀疏化感知训练。在 COCO 和 DIV2K 上对比九种方案，SpreadMark 是唯一在再生 (regeneration) 和潜空间稀疏化 (latent-space sparsification) 两种设置下都保持高检测率的方法，同时 JPEG 和加性噪声鲁棒性有竞争力，且保持高感知质量。
Motivation: 现有 encoder-decoder 水印方案中每个消息比特只占据图像的一小部分区域，这是其脆弱性的共同成因：移除水印只需扰动该比特所占区域。本文针对这一缺陷，重新审视经典的扩频嵌入原理在现代水印架构中的作用。
Method: 采用现代神经后处理式 (post-hoc) 水印架构中的扩频嵌入：将每个比特作为稠密伪随机码字铺满整幅图像，用学习到的抑制封面 chip 表示进行匹配滤波恢复，并加入并行卷积解码路径和稀疏化感知训练。作者还给出条件 chip 空间分析，证明在码字无关扰动模型下，稠密扩频会提高破坏匹配滤波恢复所需的扰动预算。
Result: 在 COCO 和 DIV2K 上对比九种方案，SpreadMark 是唯一在再生与潜空间稀疏化两种设置下都保持高检测率的方法，JPEG 和加性噪声鲁棒性具有竞争力，同时保持水印不可见和高感知质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稠密扩频能够增加有意移除水印所需的扰动预算，从而在再生和稀疏化去除下维持可检测性，说明经典扩频原理与现代神经架构结合可提升图像水印的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Knowledge Graph Construction for Multi-Lecture Educational Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Lecture videos distribute knowledge across speech, slide text, diagrams, equations, and presentation order, which transcript-only retrieval does not fully preserve. This paper presents an evidence-grounded multimodal pipeline that transcribes lectures, selects semantic anchors, applies optical character recognition (OCR), and uses a vision-language model to extract only concepts and typed relationships supported by transcript, OCR, or visual evidence. Mentions are validated and canonicalized into a provenance-rich knowledge graph. On three neural-network lectures, the pipeline processed 3,118 frames, 756 transcript segments, and 559 anchors. It retained 1,022 concept and 312 relationship mentions, yielding 172 canonical concepts and 282 relationships with 90.38% endpoint coverage. A preliminary three question retrieval test achieved 100% top-1 and top-3 accuracy and 100% mean top-5 recall. The contribution is an auditable construction method rather than a state-of-the-art performance claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于证据的多模态知识图谱构建流程，用于多讲座教学视频的推理。该流程对讲座视频进行转录、语义锚点选择、OCR，并借助视觉语言模型提取仅由转录、OCR 或视觉证据支持的概念和类型化关系，再将提及归一化并整合为带来源知识图谱。在三场神经网络讲座上处理了 3,118 帧、756 个转录片段和 559 个锚点，保留 1,022 个概念提及和 312 个关系提及，最终得到 172 个规范概念和 282 条关系，端点覆盖率为 90.38%；初步三问题检索测试达到 100% 的 top-1、top-3 准确率和 100% 的平均 top-5 召回率。
Motivation: 讲座视频中的知识分散在语音、幻灯片文本、图表、公式和演示顺序中，仅依赖转录的检索无法完整保留这些跨模态信息，需要一种可审计的、以证据为基础的知识构建方式。
Method: 提出一个多模态流水线：先转录讲座并选择语义锚点，再应用 OCR，使用视觉语言模型只提取有转录、OCR 或视觉证据支撑的概念和类型化关系；随后对提及进行验证和规范化，构建带来源信息的知识图谱。
Result: 在三个神经网络讲座上，流水线处理了 3,118 帧、756 个转录片段和 559 个锚点，得到 172 个规范概念和 282 条关系，端点覆盖率为 90.38%；初步三问题检索测试实现 100% top-1 和 top-3 准确率以及 100% 平均 top-5 召回率。
Conclusion: 本文的贡献是可审计的知识构建方法，而非追求最先进的性能；作者未声称该方法在性能上超越现有系统。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Caved or Convinced: Temporal Sampling Gates Claim Deference in Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: When asked which of two events came first, video large language models can fail in two opposite ways: cave to a false claim, or reject a true one. Prior video sycophancy work measures only the first and mitigates it by teaching the model to trust the user less, a fix known in text and image models to worsen the second. In video, both failures come from two causes the literature treats as one: availability, whether the sparse sampled frames contain the two events, and weighting, whether that evidence is trusted over the user. We separate them with two interventions that keep the claim fixed: a frame-preserving reorder that flips the claim's truth, and a sampling-offset shift that captures or misses both events at a fixed frame budget. When the events are missed, the two twins present identical frames, so each of the nine models we evaluate accepts a true and a false claim at the same rate, making Youden's $J=0$ by construction. Availability is necessary but not sufficient. Five of the nine read the order, yet four of those five still cave to the false claim, so their deference hits a weighting ceiling. Since trust cannot be calibrated over evidence that was never sampled, we propose a reversal test that cancels the model's order prior by scoring the sampled frames forward and reversed, then answers, resamples, or abstains without reading the claim. The test raises the order accuracy to 0.92-1.00 on the models that read the order and abstains rather than guesses on those that cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视频大语言模型在回答两个事件先后顺序时的两类相反失败：屈从于虚假说法（cave）和拒绝真实说法。作者把失败原因拆分为可用性（availability，采样帧是否包含两个事件）和加权（weighting，证据是否被优先于用户说法），并设计保持主张不变的两种干预加以分离。随后提出逆转测试（reversal test），在不读取主张的情况下按正序与逆序打分采样帧，从而选择作答、重新采样或弃权；摘要报告该测试在能读懂顺序的模型上将顺序准确率提升到 0.92-1.00。
Motivation: 既有视频谄媚（sycophancy）研究只测量模型屈从虚假主张这一种失败，并通过让模型更不信任用户来缓解，而已知这种做法会加剧拒绝真实主张的失败；此外，文献把可用性与加权两类成因混为一谈。
Method: 提出两种保持主张不变的干预来分离成因：帧保持重排（改变主张真伪）和采样偏移（在固定帧预算下捕获或错过两个事件）。基于此提出逆转测试，通过正向和反向打分采样帧来抵消模型的顺序先验，再决定作答、重新采样或弃权，全程不读取主张内容。
Result: 在九个评估模型中，当两个事件均未被采样到时，模型接受真伪主张的比例相同，Youden's J 按构造为 0；九个中有五个能读出顺序，但其中四个仍屈从于虚假主张。逆转测试使能读出顺序的模型顺序准确率达到 0.92-1.00，对无法读出顺序的模型则选择弃权而非猜测。
Conclusion: 可用性是顺序判断的必要但不充分条件；对从未被采样到的证据无法校准信任，逆转测试通过取消顺序先验来规避这一限制。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究视频大语言模型在回答两个事件先后顺序时的两类相反失败：屈从于虚假说法（cave）和拒绝真实说法。作者把失败原因拆分为可用性（availability，采样帧是否包含两个事件）和加权（weighting，证据是否被优先于用户说法），并设计保持主张不变的两种干预加以分离。随后提出逆转测试（reversal test），在不读取主张的情况下按正序与逆序打分采样帧，从而选择作答、重新采样或弃权；摘要报告该测试在能读懂顺序的模型上将顺序准确率提升到 0.92-1.00。
summary_sections.motivation: 既有视频谄媚（sycophancy）研究只测量模型屈从虚假主张这一种失败，并通过让模型更不信任用户来缓解，而已知这种做法会加剧拒绝真实主张的失败；此外，文献把可用性与加权两类成因混为一谈。
summary_sections.method: 提出两种保持主张不变的干预来分离成因：帧保持重排（改变主张真伪）和采样偏移（在固定帧预算下捕获或错过两个事件）。基于此提出逆转测试，通过正向和反向打分采样帧来抵消模型的顺序先验，再决定作答、重新采样或弃权，全程不读取主张内容。
summary_sections.result: 在九个评估模型中，当两个事件均未被采样到时，模型接受真伪主张的比例相同，Youden's J 按构造为 0；九个中有五个能读出顺序，但其中四个仍屈从于虚假主张。逆转测试使能读出顺序的模型顺序准确率达到 0.92-1.00，对无法读出顺序的模型则选择弃权而非猜测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可用性是顺序判断的必要但不充分条件；对从未被采样到的证据无法校准信任，逆转测试通过取消顺序先验来规避这一限制。

papers.title: Surface Keypoint Representation for Multi-Object and Articulated Human-Object Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Daily activities require humans to coordinate whole-body motion with the motion of surrounding objects. Despite recent progress in human-object interaction (HOI) generation, most existing methods assume interactions with a single rigid object and do not extend well to scenarios involving a variable number of objects or articulated objects with diverse joint mechanisms. We propose surface keypoint trajectories as an object motion representation: for each rigid component, whether a standalone object or one part of an articulated assembly, we track a small set of non-collinear surface points over time. This representation handles multi-object coordination and diverse articulation mechanisms directly from point dynamics without requiring explicit joint-type specification. To model when and where each body region contacts each object, we introduce a spatio-temporal contact distance field that extends distance-based contact modeling to whole-body, multi-object, and articulated settings. We factorize HOI generation into three stages: generating object motions from text or waypoints, predicting the contact distance field, and synthesizing whole-body motion with contact-guided optimization. Experiments on ParaHome, HIMO, ARCTIC, and OMOMO demonstrate better or comparable performance to existing methods across single-object, multi-object, and articulated interaction settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 surface keypoint trajectories 作为物体运动表示，用于多物体和铰接式人-物交互 (human-object interaction, HOI) 生成。该方法为每个刚体组件（独立物体或铰接部件）追踪少量非共线表面点，无需显式指定关节类型即可处理多物体协调与多样铰接机制；同时引入时空接触距离场 (spatio-temporal contact distance field)，将 HOI 生成分解为物体运动生成、接触距离场预测、接触引导的全身运动合成三个阶段。
Motivation: 现有 HOI 生成方法大多假设交互对象是单一刚体物体，难以推广到物体数量可变或具有不同关节机构的铰接物体场景。
Method: 以 surface keypoint trajectories 表示物体运动，直接从点动态中处理多物体协调与铰接机制；提出时空接触距离场，将基于距离的接触建模扩展到全身、多物体和铰接设置；生成流程分为物体运动生成、接触距离场预测、接触引导优化合成全身运动三阶段。
Result: 在 ParaHome、HIMO、ARCTIC 和 OMOMO 数据集上，该方法在单物体、多物体和铰接交互设置中达到比现有方法更优或相当的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于表面关键点轨迹的物体运动表示可无需关节类型规范即可处理多样铰接机制，空间时间接触距离场则支持全身多物体的接触建模。

papers.title: UniGD: A Unified Generative-Discriminative Framework for Industrial Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Generative retrieval (GR) is a promising paradigm for industrial search advertising, yet its deployment is constrained by strict relevance and latency requirements. Existing systems cascade GR with an independent relevance model, decoupling the generative likelihood objective from query-ad relevance discrimination, which compromises effectiveness and increases serving costs. We propose a Unified Generative-Discriminative framework (UniGD) that integrates retrieval and relevance scoring within a single model. To mitigate gradient interference in joint optimization, UniGD introduces Conflict-Aware Gradient Enhancement (CAGE) to adaptively coordinate the two objectives. UniGD further designs a Codebook-Anchored Representation Module (CAM) that anchors item representations to frozen hierarchical codebooks distilled from a multimodal pretrained model, thereby endowing them with rich and generalizable semantic priors. For heterogeneous short-video, product, and live-stream ads, UniGD proposes Heterogeneous Ad-material Modeling (HAM), which captures cross-type semantic commonality over a shared backbone while preserving type-specific modeling capacity. Online AB tests on Kuaishou search advertising platform show that UniGD raises ad revenue by 5.78%, reduces inference latency by 33%, and improves discriminative relevance estimation. On NQ320K and MS300K, UniGD improves Recall@10 over the strongest reproduced GR baseline by 8.44% and 3.19%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniGD，一个面向工业检索（搜索广告）的统一生成-判别框架，将生成式检索与相关性打分整合进单一模型。为解决联合优化中的梯度干扰，UniGD引入Conflict-Aware Gradient Enhancement (CAGE)；通过Codebook-Anchored Representation Module (CAM)将物品表示锚定到从多模态预训练模型蒸馏得到的冻结层级码本，以注入语义先验；并用Heterogeneous Ad-material Modeling (HAM)在共享主干上建模短视频、商品、直播等异构广告物料的跨类型共性。摘要报告在快手搜索广告平台在线AB测试中广告收入提升5.78%、推理延迟降低33%，并在NQ320K和MS300K上相对于最强可复现GR基线分别将Recall@10提升8.44%和3.19%。
Motivation: 现有生成式检索（GR）在工业搜索广告部署中受严格相关性与延迟约束，通常与独立的相关性模型级联，使生成似然目标与查询-广告相关性判别相解耦，损害效果并增加服务成本。
Method: 提出统一的生成-判别框架UniGD，在单一模型中同时完成检索与相关性打分；引入CAGE以自适应协调两种目标、缓解梯度干扰；设计CAM，将物品表示锚定到冻结的层级码本，码本由多模态预训练模型蒸馏而来；提出HAM，在共享骨架上捕捉异构广告物料的跨类型语义共性，同时保留类型特定建模能力。
Result: 在线AB测试显示广告收入提升5.78%，推理延迟降低33%，判别式相关性估计得到改善。在NQ320K和MS300K上，UniGD相对最强可复现GR基线将Recall@10分别提升8.44%和3.19%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一生成-判别框架可在满足工业级相关性与延迟要求的同时提升检索效果与推理效率；摘要未给出明确的局限性说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lightweight Chunk Selection for Mobile Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: RAG improves the factual grounding of LLM by incorporating external knowledge, but deploying RAG on mobile and edge devices remains challenging because retrieved context increases computation and memory. A direct way to reduce this cost is to retain only one retrieved chunk before generation, but the top-ranked retrieved chunk is not always the most evidence-supporting one, since retrieval similarity does not necessarily imply evidential sufficiency. Existing context-reduction methods can improve context quality, but often require additional LLMs or compressors that are costly under a strict mobile budget. In this paper, we study lightweight RAG chunk selection as an evidence-alignment problem. Our selector combines three complementary feature sources: question hidden states that represent LLM-side query intent, MoE routing-derived expert signals that capture the generator's internal routing structure, and retrieved chunk embeddings that preserve candidate-side evidence geometry. A compact multilayer perceptron maps these features to an evidence prototype in the chunk embedding space, and the candidate most aligned with this prototype is selected by cosine similarity. For stricter deployment budgets, we further introduce an optional task-aware feature selection strategy to reduce the selector input dimension. To support supervised evaluation, we construct semantic chunk-correctness labels based on evidence sufficiency rather than answer-string containment. Experiments show that the proposed selector consistently improves rank-1 evidence selection over mobile-applicable baselines by an average of 2.5%. These results suggest that using LLM-side query representations and MoE routing information and aligning them with retrieval-side candidate embedding is an effective and parameter-efficient strategy for mobile-applicable RAG chunk selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究移动端检索增强生成 (RAG) 的轻量级分块选择问题，目标是在生成前只保留一个检索分块以降低计算和内存开销。作者将分块选择建模为证据对齐 (evidence-alignment) 问题，提出一个紧凑的 MLP 选择器，融合问题隐状态、MoE 路由专家信号和检索分块嵌入三种特征来构造证据原型，并用余弦相似度选出最对齐的候选分块。摘要报告该方法在移动可部署基线上平均将 rank-1 证据选择提升 2.5%。
Motivation: 在移动和边缘设备上部署 RAG 时，检索上下文的计算和内存开销过大；仅保留一个检索分块虽直接降本，但检索相似度最高的分块并不一定是证据最充分的分块。现有上下文压缩方法虽能提升质量，却常依赖额外的 LLM 或压缩器，超出严格的移动端预算。
Method: 将轻量级分块选择建模为证据对齐问题，用一个紧凑的多层感知机把三类互补特征——表示 LLM 侧查询意图的问题隐状态、捕捉生成器内部路由结构的 MoE 路由专家信号、保留候选证据几何的检索分块嵌入——映射到分块嵌入空间中的证据原型，再以余弦相似度选择最对齐的候选。针对更严格的部署预算，还提出可选的基于任务的特征选择策略来降低选择器输入维度；监督标签依据证据充分性而非答案字符串包含关系构建。
Result: 实验表明，所提选择器在移动可部署基线上一致地提升 rank-1 证据选择，平均提升 2.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，利用 LLM 侧查询表示和 MoE 路由信息并将其与检索侧候选嵌入对齐，是一种有效且参数高效的移动端 RAG 分块选择策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CROSS: Cascaded Distillation and Dual-Constraint Grounding for Remote Sensing Referring Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) has achieved significant progress through the integration of VLMs and the Segment Anything Model (SAM). However, this progress largely relies on strong pre-trained capabilities, while leaving two fundamental limitations insufficiently addressed: (1) Architectural Weak-Coupling, where the unidirectional flow forces reliance on coarse VLM prompts and wastes SAM's pixel-level structural guidance, causing localization drift; and (2) Object-Centric Semantic Bias, where models overemphasize dominant object semantics while remaining insensitive to spatial reasoning crucial for RRSIS. Motivated by these observations, we propose CROSS, a tightly integrated paradigm for RRSIS. First, we introduce Linguistic-Guided Cascaded Distillation (LGCD) to bridge the architectural gap, which distills SAM's geometric affinities as soft regularizers into VLM intermediate layers, injecting dense structural priors to refine localization. Second, Perspective-Spatial Contrastive Learning (PSCL) imposes cross-anchored constraints by mining mask-filtered deceptive distractors and spatial-linguistic counterfactuals as hard negatives, explicitly shattering semantic shortcuts to enforce genuine logical consistency. Extensive experiments on RRSIS benchmarks demonstrate that CROSS achieves state-of-the-art performance and maintains precise localization even under severe spatial description perturbations, standing as a robust new paradigm for RRSIS.
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, and 5 tables. Tingzhang Luo and Ruizhong Liu contributed equally. Jianyuan Guo is the corresponding author. Project page: https://clarence-cv.github.io/CROSS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CROSS，面向遥感指代分割 (Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation, RRSIS) 的紧耦合范式。作者指出现有基于 VLM 与 SAM 的方法存在两个根本局限：架构弱耦合导致定位漂移，以及以物体为中心的语义偏差削弱空间推理。CROSS 通过语言引导的级联蒸馏 (LGCD) 和视角-空间对比学习 (PSCL) 分别注入稠密结构先验并构造硬负样本，在 RRSIS 基准上取得最新最优结果，且在空间描述严重扰动下仍保持精确定位。
Motivation: 现有 RRSIS 方法过度依赖 VLM 和 SAM 的强预训练能力，但未解决两个基础问题：单向信息流导致的架构弱耦合浪费了 SAM 的像素级结构指导，以及模型过度关注主导物体语义而对空间推理不敏感。
Method: 提出两个核心组件：LGCD 将 SAM 的几何亲和度作为软正则化器蒸馏进 VLM 中间层，注入稠密结构先验以细化定位；PSCL 通过挖掘掩码过滤的欺骗性干扰物 (deceptive distractors) 和空间-语言反事实 (spatial-linguistic counterfactuals) 作为硬负样本，施加跨锚定约束以打破语义捷径。
Result: 在 RRSIS 基准上的大量实验表明 CROSS 达到了 state-of-the-art 性能，并且在严重的空间描述扰动下仍保持精确定位能力。
Conclusion: 作者将 CROSS 定位为 RRSIS 的一种鲁棒新范式，强调了结构先验注入与逻辑一致性约束联合带来的收益。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出两个核心组件：LGCD 将 SAM 的几何亲和度作为软正则化器蒸馏进 VLM 中间层，注入稠密结构先验以细化定位；PSCL 通过挖掘掩码过滤的欺骗性干扰物 (deceptive distractors) 和空间-语言反事实 (spatial-linguistic counterfactuals) 作为硬负样本，施加跨锚定约束以打破语义捷径。
summary_sections.result: 在 RRSIS 基准上的大量实验表明 CROSS 达到了 state-of-the-art 性能，并且在严重的空间描述扰动下仍保持精确定位能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将 CROSS 定位为 RRSIS 的一种鲁棒新范式，强调了结构先验注入与逻辑一致性约束联合带来的收益。

papers.title: Spatial proteomics guided by H&E-based AI reveals recurrence-risk niches in triple-negative breast cancer
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models can predict cancer recurrence from H&E stained slides, but the localized molecular states underlying these predictions remain largely obscured. Here, we developed an outcome informed spatial pathology framework in TNBC that integrates AI generated recurrence risk heatmaps with mass spectrometry based spatial proteomics. In a cohort of 156 patients, distribution based aggregation of high scoring patches achieved an AUC of 0.77 and a C-index of 0.77 in an independent test cohort. Bulk proteomics associated high image derived risk with cell cycle and genome maintenance programs and low risk with immune activation. High and low risk patches coexisted within the same tumor compartment and displayed distinct nuclear and architectural features, revealing intratumoral heterogeneity beyond tissue compartment identity. We then used the heatmaps as coordinate level guides to physically isolate and profile 46 AI defined tumor regions from two recurrence patients. Spatial proteomic profiling revealed a concordant molecular contrast across both patients: mitotic programs were enriched in high risk regions and immune and antigen presentation programs in low risk regions. A 13 protein composite derived from these spatial contrasts showed a trend toward poorer recurrence-free survival with increasing scores in an expanded cohort, while the corresponding transcript based composite stratified recurrence free survival in the independent METABRIC TNBC cohort. Integrating the protein composite with the H&E derived risk score improved the out of bag C-index from 0.679 to 0.739 and enhanced time dependent discrimination at 3 and 5 years. Together, these findings define a new role for outcome trained AI models as spatially explicit experimental guides that connect prognostic morphology with localized molecular states and advance biologically grounded, multiscale biomarker discovery in TNBC.
papers.comment: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), Recurrence, Digital pathology, Artificial intelligence, Spatial proteomics, Tumor microenvironment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个由 H&E 切片 AI 复发风险热图引导的空间蛋白质组学分析框架，用于三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）复发风险区域的分子解析。在 156 例患者队列中，基于分布聚合的高风险 patch 评分在独立测试队列上达到 AUC 0.77 与 C-index 0.77。作者进一步以热图为坐标级指导，从两名复发患者中物理分离并分析了 46 个 AI 定义的肿瘤区域，发现高风险区域富集有丝分裂程序，低风险区域富集免疫与抗原呈递程序；将 13 蛋白复合物与 H&E 风险评分整合后，out-of-bag C-index 从 0.679 提升至 0.739。
Motivation: 深度学习模型可以从 H&E 染色切片预测癌症复发，但这些预测所依据的局部分子状态仍然不清楚，需要将预后形态学与空间上明确的分子特征联系起来。
Method: 提出 outcome-informed 空间病理学框架，将 AI 生成的复发风险热图与基于质谱的空间蛋白质组学整合；利用热图作为坐标级指导，对 AI 定义的肿瘤区域进行物理分离和蛋白质组学分析。
Result: 在 156 例患者队列中，分布聚合的高风险 patch 评分在独立测试队列达到 AUC 0.77 和 C-index 0.77；空间蛋白质组学显示高风险区域富集有丝分裂程序，低风险区域富集免疫和抗原呈递程序；13 蛋白复合物与 H&E 风险评分的整合将 out-of-bag C-index 从 0.679 提升到 0.739，并增强了 3 年和 5 年的时间依赖判别能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现赋予 outcome 训练的 AI 模型一种新的角色，即作为空间上明确的实验指南，将预后形态学与局部分子状态相连接，并推动 TNBC 中基于生物学基础的多尺度生物标志物发现。
