papers.title: From Routes to Steps: Separating Semantic Progress from Local Execution in Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow a route-level instruction by executing its constituent steps from egocentric visual observations. Existing VLM-based navigators typically supervise both capabilities through next-action prediction alone, making progress-tracking errors difficult to distinguish from execution errors. When an agent deviates from the route, a corrective action label may recover the next movement but does not indicate whether the agent selected the wrong sub-instruction or failed to execute the correct one. Consequently, the agent may continue making decisions from an erroneous progress state. To resolve this ambiguity, we propose \textbf{Route2Step}, a framework that decouples semantic progress tracking from action generation through an explicit step-level interface. The Instruction Analysis Module ($\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{IA}}$) predicts this state from the global instruction and visual history. Conditioned on the predicted state and recent observations, the Action Generation Module ($\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{AG}}$) generates local action chunks. To supervise the progress state without manual temporal labels, E-SPA, a step-alignment procedure, associates sub-instructions with their corresponding portions of route-level demonstrations. These alignments enable state supervision for incorrect progress estimates, while direct action supervision is reserved for rollout groups that repeatedly fail under the correct active sub-instruction. On R2R-CE, Route2Step improves SR from 48.1\% to 55.3\% and SPL from 43.3\% to 48.2\%, using 190K state-level corrective samples while requiring only 11.5K directly action-supervised states. Experiments in real-world indoor and outdoor environments further demonstrate the practical applicability of Route2Step. The project page is: https://sisyphus-hxy.github.io/Route2Step/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Route2Step 框架，将视觉语言导航 (VLN) 中的语义进度跟踪与动作生成解耦，通过显式的 step-level 接口区分“选错子指令”与“执行错误”。框架包含指令分析模块 (M_IA) 预测全局指令与视觉历史对应的进度状态，以及动作生成模块 (M_AG) 基于预测状态生成局部动作。在 R2R-CE 上，SR 从 48.1% 提升至 55.3%，SPL 从 43.3% 提升至 48.2%，并在真实室内外环境中验证了实用性。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 导航器仅通过 next-action 预测同时监督进度跟踪与执行，导致进度错误与执行错误难以区分；即使纠正了当前动作，agent 仍可能基于错误的进度状态继续决策。
Method: 提出 Route2Step，包含指令分析模块 M_IA（从全局指令和视觉历史预测语义进度状态）和动作生成模块 M_AG（依据预测状态生成局部动作块）；并提出 E-SPA 步骤对齐过程，将子指令与路由级演示片段关联，从而无需人工时间标签即可监督进度状态。
Result: 在 R2R-CE 上，Route2Step 将 SR 从 48.1% 提升到 55.3%，SPL 从 43.3% 提升到 48.2%，仅使用 190K 状态级纠正样本和 11.5K 直接动作监督状态；真实室内外实验也验证了实用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式解耦语义进度跟踪与动作生成、并为进度状态提供监督，可以缓解 VLN 中纠正动作后继续从错误进度决策的问题；同时证明只需少量直接动作监督即可取得改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimax-Optimal Semiparametric Contextual Dynamic Pricing with Multimodal Revenue
papers.abstract_en: We study contextual dynamic pricing with arbitrary covariate sequences and bounded, possibly nonbinary purchase quantities. Demand follows a semiparametric surplus-index model with an unknown linear valuation parameter and an unknown Hölder-smooth response. We impose neither concavity nor strong unimodality on revenue and allow nonunique optimal prices. We develop a pilot-corrected layered decision-partitioning policy that combines directional pilot estimation, local polynomial learning, predictable data assignment, and global action elimination. Pilot correction removes the first-order effect of valuation-parameter error, while permanent labels enable concentration under adaptive sampling. The policy attains the minimax smoothness-dependent horizon rate up to logarithmic factors; a matching lower bound already holds for a constant-context binary-demand subclass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究协变量序列任意、购买量有界且可能非二元的上下文动态定价问题。需求服从半参数剩余指标模型，其中线性估值参数未知、响应函数为 Hölder 光滑且未知；模型不要求收入函数凹或强单峰，允许最优价格不唯一。作者提出一种 pilot 修正的分层决策划分策略，并证明其达到最小最大意义下依赖光滑性的期界（至多差对数因子）。
Motivation: 现有上下文动态定价方法通常依赖收入函数的凹性或强单峰性，且多限于二元购买需求。本文试图放宽这些假设，允许非单调或多峰收入函数以及非二元购买量，同时处理任意协变量序列下未知参数估计与定价决策的耦合。
Method: 提出 pilot 修正的分层决策划分策略 (pilot-corrected layered decision-partitioning policy)，结合方向性 pilot 估计、局部多项式学习、可预测数据分配和全局动作消除。Pilot 修正用于去除估值参数误差的一阶影响，永久标签 (permanent labels) 保证自适应采样下的浓度性质。
Result: 该策略在任意协变量序列下达到与光滑度相关的极小极大期界（至多相差对数因子），并且对于常数上下文的二元需求子类，已有匹配的下界成立。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在放宽凹性和单峰性假设、允许非唯一最优价格与非二元购买量的情形下，所提策略仍能获得最优的极小极大速率；论文篇幅为 53 页，属于理论性较强的工作。

papers.title: Internalizing Academic Writing Workflows for Introduction Generation via Struct-Aware Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generating a rigorous paper introduction with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging, since it requires coordinating background, gap identification, method and contribution within a coherent narrative. Existing solutions externalize this process as multi-stage prompts or agent workflows which are expensive and vulnerable to cross-stage drift. We propose StructPO, a struct-aware policy learning framework that internalizes the entire multi-stage writing workflow into a single-pass policy controlled by explicit stage tokens. StructPO introduces struct-aware credit assignment to decouple local stage quality from global coherence and refinement-guided optimization to internalize revision behavior into the first-pass policy. Experiments show that StructPO improves semantic alignment, structural rationality and inference efficiency over workflow-based baselines, generalizes to out-of-domain settings, and remains competitive with GPT-5.1 in human evaluation when scaled to Qwen3-32B. These results show that internalizing academic writing workflows through fine-grained policy optimization offers a viable alternative to costly external orchestration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StructPO，一种结构感知的策略学习框架，将多阶段学术写作工作流内化为由显式阶段记号（stage tokens）控制的单次生成策略，用于论文引言生成。通过结构感知的信用分配（credit assignment）将局部阶段质量与全局连贯性解耦，并用精炼引导优化（refinement-guided optimization）把修改行为内化到首次生成策略。实验表明它相比基于工作流的基线提升语义对齐、结构合理性和推理效率，并泛化到域外设置，在扩展到 Qwen3-32B 时的人类评估中与 GPT-5.1 保持竞争力。
Motivation: 用大语言模型生成严谨的论文引言需要协调背景、缺口识别、方法和贡献，现有方案通过多阶段提示或 agent 工作流外部化该过程，成本高且容易出现跨阶段漂移（cross-stage drift）。
Method: 提出 StructPO，将完整的多阶段写作工作流内化为带显式阶段记号的单次生成策略；引入结构感知的信用分配以解耦局部阶段质量与全局连贯性，并使用精炼引导优化把修订行为内化到首遍策略中。
Result: 摘要报告 StructPO 在语义对齐、结构合理性和推理效率上优于基于工作流的基线，能够泛化到域外设置，并在 Qwen3-32B 规模下的人类评估中与 GPT-5.1 保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 结果表明，通过细粒度的策略优化将学术写作工作流内化，是昂贵的外部编排（external orchestration）的一种可行替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Verifiable Memory: Learning Unified Memory Management with Local and Global Verifiers for Large Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain reusable information, control a bounded active context, and recover earlier evidence during long-horizon interaction. Existing methods commonly optimize long-term memory (LTM) and short-term memory (STM) separately, while unified policies are often trained primarily with trajectory-level feedback, which provides weak credit for individual memory decisions. We present Verifiable Memory (VerMem), a framework that represents LTM, active context, and episodic history as distinct states and controls them with one memory operation policy. Seven atomic operations let the policy add, revise, or soft-delete LTM entries; retrieve LTM into the active context; filter or summarize the active context; and restore selected episodic fragments. VerMem is initialized by supervised fine-tuning and trained with a three-stage reinforcement-learning curriculum. The local verifier scores executable memory transitions, and a global verifier assesses evidence coherence and terminal-memory consistency after task completion. These scores are combined with programmatically computed task, evidence-recall, efficiency, and constraint signals through hierarchical credit assignment. The verifiers are used only during training. Across five benchmarks and two LLM backbones, VerMem achieves the best result on the vast majority of reported metrics and consistently outperforms strong memory baselines. Under controlled online-token budgets on three interactive benchmarks, it also achieves the strongest efficiency--performance frontier among the compared methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Sun-SYSU-24/VerMem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Verifiable Memory (VerMem)，一个面向 LLM 代理的统一记忆管理框架，将长期记忆 (LTM)、活动上下文 (active context) 与情节历史 (episodic history) 分别建模，并用单一记忆操作策略控制七个原子操作。策略经监督微调初始化，再通过三阶段强化学习课程训练，训练中使用局部验证器 (local verifier) 与全局验证器 (global verifier) 提供分层信用分配。摘要报告该方法在五个基准与两个 LLM 骨干上取得多数指标最优，并在三个交互基准的受控在线 token 预算下取得最强的效率-性能前沿。
Motivation: 现有方法往往分别优化长期记忆与短期记忆，而统一记忆策略主要依赖轨迹级反馈训练，导致单个记忆决策的信用分配信号较弱，难以支持长时交互中证据恢复与上下文控制。
Method: VerMem 将 LTM、活动上下文和情节历史视为不同状态，用包含添加、修订、软删除 LTM 条目、检索 LTM、过滤或总结活动上下文、恢复情节片段等七个原子操作的单策略统一控制。初始化采用监督微调，随后进行三阶段强化学习课程训练；训练中局部验证器对可执行记忆转移打分，全局验证器评估证据一致性与任务结束时的终端记忆一致性，并把这些分数与程序化计算的任务、证据召回、效率和约束信号一起用于分层信用分配，验证器仅在训练阶段使用。
Result: 在五个基准和两个 LLM 骨干上，VerMem 在绝大多数报告指标上达到最佳结果，并一致优于强记忆基线；在三个交互基准上受控在线 token 预算下，它取得最强的效率-性能前沿。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一记忆管理结合局部与全局验证器可以改善 LLM 代理的记忆决策与任务表现，且验证器只参与训练，不增加推理负担；代码已开源。

papers.title: Frozen High-Resolution Inference for Cross-City Object Detection: An AI City Challenge 2026 Study
papers.abstract_en: Cross-city object detection requires a detector trained in one city to generalize to an unlabeled target city. In AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, we analyze archived configurations of a single RF-DETR-Large detector inside an air-gapped Training-as-a-Service platform whose server returns only an aggregate COCO-style AP over a hidden mixture of source- and target-city images. Frozen 1120 x 1120 inference of a checkpoint trained at 704 x 704 achieved the highest aggregate AP among the evaluated configurations (0.3272 -> 0.3654, +0.0382) without any parameter update, with the largest relative gain on small objects and the largest absolute gain on medium objects, at 2.53x the input pixels. A warm-start 1120px fine-tuning recipe reached 0.3470 while its in-domain validation AP rose (0.767 -> 0.789), a caution that in-domain validation is an unreliable model-selection signal under aggregate-only cross-city feedback. Because that run's evaluation used a higher confidence threshold than the inference-only runs (0.05 vs. 0.01), we treat its score as a descriptive archived outcome rather than a controlled verdict on fine-tuning. Gray-world normalization did not meaningfully change the frozen-1120 result, and a rectangular run was found by audit to have used an unintended portrait orientation. We release verbatim platform commands, configuration snapshots, and an explicit evidence boundary for every claim. Each configuration was submitted once and the best was selected on the hidden server, so these are exploratory, audited findings about the aggregate mixture; they do not establish target-city-specific improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6 的跨城市目标检测研究，在 air-gapped 的 Training-as-a-Service 平台内分析单个 RF-DETR-Large 检测器的归档配置，服务器只返回隐藏混合（源/目标城市）图像上的聚合 COCO AP。核心发现是：对 704×704 训练的 checkpoint 做冻结的 1120×1120 推理，在不更新任何参数的情况下取得最高的聚合 AP（0.3272 → 0.3654，+0.0382），小物体相对增益最大、中等物体绝对增益最大，输入像素为原来的 2.53 倍。作者同时指出 warm-start 1120px 微调虽然域内验证 AP 上升（0.767 → 0.789），但聚合 AP 反而更低，说明在聚合式跨城市反馈下域内验证不是可靠的模型选择信号。
Motivation: 跨城市目标检测要求在一个城市训练的检测器泛化到无标签的目标城市；在平台只暴露聚合 AP、无法看到目标城市细粒度指标的条件下，如何评估和选择配置是关键问题，而域内验证可能给出错误信号。
Method: 在空气隔离平台内对 RF-DETR-Large 的多种归档配置进行受控比较，包括冻结高分辨率推理（704 训练、1120 推理）、warm-start 1120px 微调、gray-world 归一化以及矩形输入；每个配置在隐藏服务器上各提交一次，并公开逐字命令、配置快照和证据边界。
Result: 冻结 1120×1120 推理获得最高聚合 AP（0.3654，+0.0382），小物体相对增益最大、中等物体绝对增益最大；warm-start 微调达到 0.3470，但其域内验证 AP 上升而聚合 AP 未超过冻结推理。gray-world 归一化对冻结 1120 结果无实质影响，矩形配置经审计发现使用了意外的竖屏方向。
Conclusion: 作者将这些结果定性为探索性、可审计的发现，仅针对隐藏的聚合混合体；由于每个配置只提交一次且最佳配置在隐藏服务器上选出，它们不能建立对目标城市特异的改进。warm-start 微调的一次运行因使用了更高的置信阈值（0.05 vs 0.01），只作为描述性归档结果而非对微调的受控结论。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rectify Then Diffuse: Disentangling Concepts Before Denoising Trajectory Unfolds
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate individual concepts well, but they often omit or merge concepts incorrectly with multiple concepts. We trace these failures to an early coordination bottleneck: before denoising begins, prompt-conditioned attention may allocate different concepts to strongly overlapping spatial support, which can keep their attention coupled as denoising proceeds. This observation motivates treating compositional generation as a boundary-condition problem rather than repeatedly controlling the evolving trajectory. To this end, we propose Rectify-then-Diffuse (RTD), a training-free framework that rectifies the initial allocation once before standard denoising. Firstly, we propose Soft-Overlap Disentanglement (SOD), which converts normalized overlap between pilot concept maps into a differentiable and layout-agnostic separation objective. Secondly, we introduce Isotropic Gradient Rectification (IGR), which normalizes the SOD gradient and applies a bounded latent displacement with a consistent scale across prompts and initializations. Extensive experiments show that RTD achieves state-of-the-art compositional fidelity and robust gains. On the AE-Bench object pair subset, RTD improves BLIP-VQA by 45.8% and ImageReward by 19.6% over CO3 while running 2.3$\times$ faster. Code will be released at https://github.com/Z-yiwei/rectify-then-diffuse
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型在多概念生成时出现概念遗漏或错误合并的问题，提出训练无关的 Rectify-then-Diffuse (RTD) 框架。作者将问题归因于去噪前的早期协调瓶颈：提示条件注意力可能让不同概念在高度重叠的空间支撑上耦合。RTD 通过 Soft-Overlap Disentanglement (SOD) 将归一化重叠转为可微分离目标，并用 Isotropic Gradient Rectification (IGR) 统一梯度尺度并施加有界潜变量位移，在 AE-Bench 物体对子集上取得 SOTA 组合保真度。
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型能良好生成单个概念，但面对多个概念时常遗漏或错误合并概念；作者追踪到去噪开始前提示条件注意力对不同概念分配了强烈重叠的空间支撑，导致后续去噪中注意力持续耦合。
Method: 提出训练无关的 RTD 框架，在标准去噪前一次性修正初始分配。包含两个组件：Soft-Overlap Disentanglement (SOD) 将概念图之间的归一化重叠转化为可微且与布局无关的分离目标；Isotropic Gradient Rectification (IGR) 对 SOD 梯度做归一化，并以跨提示和初始化一致的尺度应用有界潜变量位移。
Result: 在 AE-Bench 物体对子集上，RTD 相比 CO3 将 BLIP-VQA 提升 45.8%、ImageReward 提升 19.6%，且运行速度快 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将组合生成视为边界条件问题而非反复控制去噪轨迹，一次性的初始分配修正即可实现 SOTA 组合保真度与稳健收益；代码将公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DP-MemView: A Memory Interface for Attribute-Level Transcript Privacy in Long-Term LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables persistent personalization in LLM agents, but repeated memory-conditioned responses can cumulatively reveal protected attributes even when they are never stated explicitly. We formalize this threat as adaptive transcript privacy and introduce DP-MemView, a differentially private interface that privately selects public response-conditioning views and exposes those views---rather than raw memory---to the response LLM. Each private selection is charged to every protected attribute whose memory group intersects the read set. Per-attribute ledgers block any selection that would exceed its cap and return a fixed generic view instead. Under an explicit interface contract, we prove pure B_a-DP for the entire adaptive transcript. We also extend the result to stores that differ across multiple protected groups and bound how much observing the transcript can change an adversary's prior odds. We evaluate the online and preallocated modes with three response LLMs on a controlled adjacent-store benchmark and a public-corpus transfer track. Both modes keep transcript distinguishability near chance while preserving target-required personalization and overall response quality. Further diagnostics show that removing key safeguards causes mismatched output support, missing ledger charges, revealing side channels, or growing long-horizon leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注长期记忆 LLM 智能体中，重复的记忆条件化响应即使从未显式提及受保护属性，也可能累积性地泄露这些属性。作者将此威胁形式化为自适应转录隐私 (adaptive transcript privacy)，并提出 DP-MemView：一个差分私有接口，私有地选择公开的响应条件视图，并将视图而非原始记忆暴露给响应 LLM。论文在显式接口契约下证明了整个自适应转录满足纯 B_a-DP，并通过在线与预分配两种模式在受控基准和公开语料迁移轨迹上验证了隐私与效用之间的权衡。
Motivation: 长期记忆虽然支持 LLM 智能体的持续个性化，但反复基于记忆响应的交互在统计上可能暴露未被明说过的受保护属性，现有方法缺乏对这种跨轮次累积泄露的形式化刻画与防护机制。
Method: DP-MemView 对每次私有选择向所有记忆组与读取集相交的受保护属性计费，通过逐属性账本 (per-attribute ledgers) 阻止超过容量上限的选择并返回固定通用视图，从而不向响应 LLM 暴露原始记忆，并证明对完整自适应转录的纯 B_a-DP 保证，同时扩展到跨多个受保护组存在差异的存储，并给出观察转录对攻击者先验几率改变的界。
Result: 在受控相邻存储基准和公共语料迁移轨迹上，使用三种响应 LLM 评估在线与预分配两种模式，结果表明两种模式都能将转录可区分性保持在接近随机水平，同时保留目标所需的个性化和整体响应质量；诊断实验显示移除关键保障会导致输出支持不匹配、缺少账本计费、揭示侧信道或长期泄漏增长。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过显式接口契约和按属性的差分隐私记账，可以在保持个性化与响应质量的同时为完整交互转录提供可证明的隐私保证。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，通过显式接口契约和按属性的差分隐私记账，可以在保持个性化与响应质量的同时为完整交互转录提供可证明的隐私保证。

papers.title: Beyond Average Performance: Dynamic Instance Clustering and Specialized Algorithm Design in LLM-Assisted Evolutionary Search
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model-assisted Evolutionary Search (LES) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for automated algorithm design. However, existing LES methods primarily optimize for average performance, inherently directing search effort toward instances that contribute most to this metric while leaving others poorly served, resulting in weak tail robustness and limited real-world reliability. To address this limitation, we propose Dynamic Instance Clustering and Specialized Algorithm Design (DyCA), an LES framework with a feature-free, structure-aware mechanism for constructing reliable algorithm portfolios under heterogeneous instance distributions. DyCA treats instance clustering as a co-evolving component within the search process, reusing accumulated evaluation data as feature-free signals to progressively partition instances with similar algorithmic response patterns. The uncovered clusters decompose the mixed objective into a set of structure-aware sub-objectives, thereby enabling finer-grained and more adaptive guidance for specialized algorithm design. Experimental results across four algorithm design tasks with heterogeneous instances demonstrate that DyCA outperforms state-of-the-art LES baselines, improving tail robustness by an average of 15.2\% and overall performance by 7.1\% while maintaining competitive head performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DyCA（Dynamic Instance Clustering and Specialized Algorithm Design），一个面向大规模语言模型辅助进化搜索（LES）的框架，针对现有 LES 只优化平均性能导致尾部鲁棒性差的问题，将实例聚类作为搜索过程中的共进化组件，复用历史评估数据作为无特征信号，按算法响应模式划分实例，从而把混合目标分解为结构感知的子目标。实验在四个含异构实例的算法设计任务上，相比 SOTA LES 基线平均提升尾部鲁棒性 15.2%，整体性能提升 7.1%，同时头部性能保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 LES 方法主要优化平均性能，搜索努力集中在贡献最大的实例上，其他实例得不到充分服务，导致尾部鲁棒性弱、实际可靠性有限。
Method: DyCA 提出无特征、结构感知的机制：将实例聚类作为搜索过程中的共进化组件，复用累积的评估数据作为无特征信号，逐步划分具有相似算法响应模式的实例，并把混合目标分解为结构感知子目标，从而为专门算法设计提供更细粒度、更自适应的引导。
Result: 在四个含异构实例的算法设计任务上，DyCA 相比 SOTA LES 基线平均提升尾部鲁棒性 15.2%，整体性能提升 7.1%，同时头部性能保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为将实例聚类与专门算法设计共进化，可以把异构实例分布下的混合目标分解为更细粒度的子目标，从而构建更可靠的算法组合（portfolio），改善尾部鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DigitCode: Symbolic Tokenization of Hand Motion by Anatomical Units
papers.abstract_en: Hand motion carries the finest-grained information in human activity, yet the representations behind hand generation, understanding, and robot learning are overwhelmingly continuous--joint angles or MANO parameters. These are accurate but unstructured: a finger cannot be indexed or edited as a symbol, and nothing marks a pose as anatomically valid. Discrete symbolic representations supply exactly this structure, and Hand Labanotation (HL) has shown they are feasible for the hand, writing motion as a T x 40 grid of one fixed direction symbol per bone. Building on this grid, we ask the question underneath it: the anatomical unit a symbol should span--bone, finger, or whole hand. DigitCode answers it by adapting, grouping, and layering HL's alphabet along the hand's unit hierarchy within one code, cutting the symbolic representation's quantization error by three quarters. The lever is the unit, not the quantizer family: at a fixed unit, training-free and learned strong quantizers are interchangeable on reconstruction, while moving down the anatomical hierarchy is what shifts accuracy. The hierarchy also tracks what downstream tasks need. Because a finger is a genuine, enumerable unit, one per-finger token doubles as a training-free, editable handle for jobs a continuous representation cannot address--repairing malformed generated hands, and retargeting them onto robots. We release HandTok, a reproducible testbed, so hand tokenizers can be compared unit-for-unit. Project page: https://digitcode-demo.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DigitCode，一种基于解剖学单位（骨、手指、整只手）的手部运动符号化表征方法，在 Hand Labanotation 的 T x 40 网格基础上沿手部单位层级对字母表进行适配、分组与分层。摘要称该方法将符号表征的量化误差降低四分之三，并指出起到决定性作用的是解剖学单位而非量化器家族；每指 token 可作为免训练的可编辑句柄，用于修复畸形生成手部并将其重定向到机器人。作者还发布了可复现测试平台 HandTok。
Motivation: 现有手部运动表征（关节角度、MANO 参数）连续但无结构，无法按手指进行符号索引或编辑，也无法标记姿势是否解剖学有效；离散符号表征能提供这种结构，Hand Labanotation 已证明其可行性。
Method: 在 Hand Labanotation 的 T x 40 符号网格基础上，沿手部单位层级（骨、手指、整只手）对字母表进行适配、分组与分层，形成统一编码；每根手指对应一个 per-finger token，作为免训练的可编辑句柄。
Result: 摘要报告该方法将符号表征的量化误差降低四分之三；在固定单位下，免训练与学习型强量化器在重建上可互换，而沿解剖层次下移才是精度提升来源；每指 token 可用于修复畸形生成手部与机器人重定向。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解剖学单位（而非量化器家族）决定符号表征的精度与下游任务适用性，并发布 HandTok 可复现测试平台，以支持对手部 tokenizer 进行逐单位比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trajectory-Guided Forget-Recover Network for Continual LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to eliminate the influence of sensitive data on a model. In the real world, unlearning requests arrive continually, which gives rise to two challenges. First, an unlearning intervention may redistribute target-related computation across remaining pathways, allowing previously forgotten knowledge to re-emerge. Second, repeated unlearning interventions may progressively reduce the model capacity needed to preserve retained utility. To address these challenges, we propose the Trajectory-guided Forget-Recover Network (TFR-Net). TFR-Net tracks channel-level risk across requests. It separates persistent target-related channels from transient hotspots and suppresses only the persistent ones. TFR-Net also recovers model capacity by reactivating dormant channels. These channels make strong contributions to retained utility and show low current and historical forget risk. The recovery is accepted only when retained-utility degradation remains within a predefined tolerance. Experiments on four datasets show that TFR-Net consistently achieves a more favorable trade-off between unlearning effectiveness and retained utility than representative baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹引导的遗忘-恢复网络（Trajectory-guided Forget-Recover Network, TFR-Net），用于持续的大语言模型机器遗忘（continual LLM unlearning）。摘要指出，持续遗忘请求会带来两重挑战：遗忘干预可能使目标相关计算沿剩余通路重新分布，导致已遗忘知识复现；重复干预会逐步削弱保持保留效用所需的模型容量。TFR-Net 通过追踪通道级风险、分离持久目标相关通道与瞬时热点并仅抑制前者，同时重新激活休眠通道来恢复容量，且仅在接受保留效用退化在预定容差内时才采纳恢复。实验在四个数据集上显示该方法比代表性基线取得更优的遗忘有效性与保留效用权衡。
Motivation: 现实中的遗忘请求是持续到达的，而已有机器遗忘方法未充分处理两个问题：遗忘后目标相关计算可能沿剩余通路重分布使知识复现，以及多次遗忘干预会逐渐消耗模型用于保留原有能力的容量。
Method: TFR-Net 追踪每次请求的通道级风险，将持久目标相关通道与瞬时热点区分开，仅抑制持久通道；并通过重新激活对保留效用贡献强且当前与历史遗忘风险低的休眠通道来恢复模型容量，且需通过保留效用退化容差检验才接受恢复。
Result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，TFR-Net 相较代表性基线始终取得更有利的遗忘有效性与保留效用之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调同时处理知识复现与容量退化这两个持续遗忘挑战，并以通道级风险追踪和选择性恢复来实现更优权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SeCo-SBIR: Semantically Consistent Prompt Learning for Zero-Shot Sketch-Based Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Adapting CLIP for zero-shot sketch-based image retrieval (ZS-SBIR) via prompt learning faces a fundamental tension: the model must bridge the sketch-photo domain gap through task-specific adaptation, yet the added flexibility risks overfitting to seen training categories and eroding CLIP's zero-shot generalization. We present SeCo-SBIR, a semantically consistent prompt learning framework that resolves this tension from both sides. First, a text-guided multi-modal prompting strategy routes learnable prompt vectors through CLIP's text encoder and projects the resulting intermediate representations into the visual encoder at every layer via learnable coupling functions. Because the text encoder has already learned robust, abstract category-level semantics from large-scale language supervision, this mechanism injects transferable semantic knowledge directly into the visual pathway - adapting the model to the sketch-photo domain while inherently favoring generalization to unseen classes. Second, a perturbation-based consistency constraint addresses the residual overfitting risk from the learnable coupling functions by aligning the adapted model with a frozen CLIP reference branch using an asymmetric InfoNCE objective - augmented inputs feed the frozen branch while clean inputs feed the trainable branch - anchoring the learned representations to CLIP's generalizable feature space. Together with lightweight adapters and a multi-objective loss combining triplet, NT-Xent, and classification terms, SeCo-SBIR achieves state-of-the-art results on all three standard ZS-SBIR benchmarks across categorical, generalized, and across-dataset settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeCo-SBIR，一个用于零样本草图图像检索 (ZS-SBIR) 的语义一致提示学习框架。核心思路是通过文本引导的多模态提示策略将可学习提示向量经 CLIP 文本编码器路由，并在每一层通过可学习耦合函数注入视觉编码器；同时用基于扰动的非对称 InfoNCE 一致性约束对齐冻结的 CLIP 参考分支，以抑制过拟合。摘要报告该方法在三个标准 ZS-SBIR 基准的分类、广义和跨数据集设置上均达到最先进结果。
Motivation: 将 CLIP 适配到零样本草图图像检索时存在内在矛盾：任务特定适配需要桥接草图-照片域差距，但额外灵活性可能导致对已见训练类别的过拟合，从而侵蚀 CLIP 的零样本泛化能力。
Method: 提出双管齐下的框架：一是文本引导的多模态提示策略，利用 CLIP 文本编码器已学习的抽象类别级语义，通过可学习耦合函数将中间表示逐层注入视觉编码器；二是基于扰动的非对称 InfoNCE 一致性约束，增强后的输入送入冻结的 CLIP 参考分支，干净输入送入可训练分支，以锚定到可泛化的特征空间；同时结合轻量适配器和包含三元组、NT-Xent 与分类项的多目标损失。
Result: 摘要称 SeCo-SBIR 在全部三个标准 ZS-SBIR 基准上，于分类、广义和跨数据集设置下均取得最先进结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时从适配性和泛化性两方面入手，通过语义一致的提示学习与一致性约束，可以缓解 ZS-SBIR 中任务适配与零样本泛化之间的张力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Don't Peek at the Answer: Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization for Label-Free RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves LLM reasoning but typically relies on ground-truth (GT) answers, limiting scalability. Voting-based label-free RLVR replace gold supervision with answer-level consensus from model samples. However, collapse arises when the same answer-level signal is used both to estimate rewards and to drive token-level policy optimization, encouraging the model to directly reinforce answer tokens rather than improve reasoning. We propose OM-GRPO, a label-free RLVR framework that decouples reward estimation from policy optimization. OM-GRPO masks gradients on the answer span while retaining answer-level rewards through a soft consensus signal, shifting optimization pressure away from answer tokens. We further introduce Contrast-Augmented Reward, which refines reward estimation via low-cost pairwise comparisons over existing trajectories without additional rollouts. Across diverse reasoning benchmarks and three LLM backbones, OM-GRPO consistently outperforms existing label-free RLVR methods and matches supervised GT-reward training with stable optimization. This stability is particularly beneficial in the Test-Time Training setting, where OM-GRPO surpasses majority voting by 4.24 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OM-GRPO，一种无标签 RLVR (label-free RLVR) 框架，通过掩码答案跨度上的梯度并把优化压力从答案 token 移开，从而解耦奖励估计与策略优化。摘要称在多个推理基准和三种 LLM 骨干上，OM-GRPO 一致优于现有无标签 RLVR 方法，并能媲美使用 ground-truth 奖励的监督训练；在 Test-Time Training 设置下比多数投票高 4.24 点。
Motivation: RLVR 通常依赖 ground-truth 答案，限制了可扩展性。基于投票的无标签 RLVR 用模型样本的答案级共识代替金标，但同一答案级信号既用于估计奖励又用于 token 级策略优化时会出现 collapse，使模型直接强化答案 token 而非改进推理。
Method: OM-GRPO 在答案跨度上掩码梯度，同时通过软共识信号保留答案级奖励，将优化压力从答案 token 转移开。此外引入 Contrast-Augmented Reward，利用现有轨迹进行低成本的成对比较来细化奖励估计，无需额外 rollout。
Result: 在多样化的推理基准和三种 LLM 骨干上，OM-GRPO 一致优于现有无标签 RLVR 方法，并匹配受监督的 GT-reward 训练，且优化稳定；在 Test-Time Training 设置中超越多数投票 4.24 点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将奖励估计与策略优化解耦（结合答案级梯度掩码与对比增强奖励）能在无标签 RLVR 中带来更稳定的优化和更好性能，尤其在 Test-Time Training 场景下收益显著。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Simulation-free and finite-time diffusion model
papers.abstract_en: The performance of generative diffusion models is determined by the choice of the reference diffusion process connecting the empirical and prior distributions. Conventional approaches typically trade off simulation-free training against finite-time generation. We propose a framework for designing the reference process that achieves both simultaneously. The key idea is to prescribe tractable time-dependent conditional distributions and then construct the reference process realizing them as its marginals. This framework reveals that score matching is not fundamental to diffusion-model training but instead emerges naturally through reversal of the reference process. We further show that conditional flow matching arises as the small-noise limit of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于设计生成扩散模型中参考扩散过程的框架，使得无模拟（simulation-free）训练与有限时间生成可以同时实现。核心思路是先规定可处理的时变条件分布，再构造以这些分布为边缘分布的参考过程。作者证明分数匹配并非扩散模型训练的根本机制，而是参考过程逆转后的自然产物，并进一步说明条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）是该框架的小噪声极限。
Motivation: 传统扩散模型需要在无模拟训练与有限时间生成之间做权衡，而该权衡由参考扩散过程的选择决定，本文旨在打破这一取舍。
Method: 提出一个统一框架：通过指定可解析的时变条件分布来构造相应的参考随机过程，使这些条件分布成为该过程的边缘分布，从而在不依赖模拟路径的前提下获得有限时间的生成过程。基于该构造，训练目标经由参考过程的逆转自然涌现出分数匹配形式。
Result: 摘要没有给出具体的数值实验结果，而是宣称该框架同时实现无模拟训练与有限时间生成，并证明条件流匹配是小噪声极限下该框架的特例。
Conclusion: 本文从理论层面重新审视扩散模型的训练基础，指出分数匹配并非必备要素，而只是参考过程逆转后自然出现的形式；该框架为扩散模型的参考过程设计提供了新的理论视角。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Optimal Liability Design for Medical AI
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into medical decision-making, yet its liability implications remain complex, particularly when physicians differ in diagnostic skills and their quality is unobservable. This paper develops a principal-agent model in which a social planner designs medical liability to regulate a physician with private quality information who chooses between a standard treatment, a personalized judgment-based treatment, or following an imperfect AI recommendation. Our analysis yields several novel insights. First, we show that the optimal mechanism under asymmetric information is surprisingly simple: a uniform, one-size-fits-all liability level for all physician types who deviate from the standard of care. Despite physician heterogeneity, this simple policy often achieves the full-information first-best outcome, particularly when standard care is reliable or AI is highly accurate. Second, the relationship between AI accuracy and optimal liability is non-monotonic. Contrary to common intuition, better AI does not always imply more relaxed liability. As AI accuracy increases, the optimal liability either decreases monotonically or follows an inverted-U pattern, depending on the uncertainty of the standard treatment. Third, asymmetric information does not universally reduce social welfare. Welfare loss arises only when standard care is unreliable and AI accuracy is too low; even then, its magnitude follows an inverted U-shape, initially increasing as AI complicates the regulatory problem, but declining as more accurate AI helps mitigate it. Finally, we find that information asymmetry is a double-edged sword in the presence of AI, and greater transparency does not benefit all stakeholders equally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建一个委托-代理模型，研究社会规划者如何设计医疗责任制度，以约束拥有私人质量信息的医生在标准治疗、基于个人判断的治疗和采纳不完美AI推荐之间的选择。摘要显示，最优机制往往是一个统一的责任水平，且在许多情况下能实现完全信息下的最优结果；AI准确度与最优责任之间呈非单调关系，信息不对称也不总是降低社会福利。
Motivation: AI日益融入医疗决策，但其责任归属问题复杂，尤其是医生诊断技能存在差异且质量不可观测。作者试图在非对称信息条件下回答社会规划者应如何设计医疗责任制度。
Method: 采用委托-代理模型：社会规划者设计医疗责任，医生拥有私人质量信息，并可在标准治疗、个性化判断治疗或跟随不完美AI推荐之间做出选择。
Result: 摘要报告三个核心结果：统一的、一刀切的责任水平在标准治疗可靠或AI准确度较高时往往达到完全信息下的最优（first-best）；AI准确度与最优责任的关系呈非单调，可能单调下降或倒U形，取决于标准治疗的不确定性；社会福利损失仅在标准治疗不可靠且AI准确度过低时出现，且损失幅度呈倒U形。
Conclusion: 作者强调在AI存在时信息不对称是一把双刃剑，更大的透明度并非对各方利益相关者都有益。该结论属理论建模层面的启示，未涉及实证检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-Destructive Quantification of Urea Adulteration in Bovine Milk Using Transmittance Multispectral Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Adulteration of bovine milk using urea remains a major food quality and health concern, motivating the development of rapid and quantitative screening tools. Conventional approaches, including laboratory-based analytical methods and spectroscopic techniques, have been used for urea detection; however, many remain less suitable for rapid, low-cost routine screening due to requirements such as specialized instrumentation, sample preparation, chemical reagents, or laboratory operation. This study introduces a pragmatic, cost-effective, accurate, and laboratory-validated MSI-based method for quantitative urea estimation under controlled density conditions using a multispectral-imaging-based regression framework. An in-house-built multispectral imaging system operating in twelve discrete spectral bands (365--940~nm) was used to acquire multispectral images of milk samples prepared with controlled urea addition and water for density balancing. Fresh milk was obtained on the day of image acquisition, and the specific gravity of the milk was verified to be 1.032 at 20°C using a hydrometer. Multiple linear regression provided an initial mapping with a high validation $R^2$ of 0.9599, while a feed-forward neural network further improved predictive performance with a validation $R^2$ of 0.9773. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transmittance multispectral imaging for accurate, non-destructive urea quantification under controlled density-balanced conditions, supporting its potential as a rapid screening approach for milk-quality assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用透射式多光谱成像（transmittance multispectral imaging）结合回归框架，在受控密度条件下定量检测牛乳中的尿素掺假。自建多光谱成像系统覆盖 365–940 nm 共 12 个离散波段，对添加尿素并用水调节密度的牛奶样本成像；多元线性回归取得验证 R²=0.9599，前馈神经网络进一步提升到 R²=0.9773。作者认为该方法可作为一种快速、无损的乳品质量筛查手段。
Motivation: 尿素掺假是牛奶质量和健康隐患，现有实验室分析方法或光谱技术往往需要专门仪器、样品制备、化学试剂或实验室操作，难以满足快速、低成本的常规筛查需求。
Method: 使用自建的 12 个离散波段（365–940 nm）透射多光谱成像系统采集样本图像，样本通过受控尿素添加和水进行密度平衡；采用多元线性回归作为初始映射，并进一步用前馈神经网络（feed-forward neural network）改进预测性能。
Result: 多元线性回归在验证集上取得 R²=0.9599；前馈神经网络将验证 R² 提升到 0.9773。
Conclusion: 摘要认为透射多光谱成像在受控密度平衡条件下可实现准确、无损的尿素定量，有潜力用于乳品质量的快速筛查。该结论限定于受控密度条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Two-Stage Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Inference in Video-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models excel at image and video understanding but suffer from high inference latency due to the need to process thousands of tokens per image, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices and in real-time surveillance applications. This challenge is further amplified in video processing, where multiple frames must be analyzed simultaneously. Existing token reduction techniques are largely developed for single-image inputs and therefore fail to account for the temporal and inter-frame redundancies present in video sequences. In addition, these methods generally rely on a fixed, uniform pruning ratio applied across all inputs, which is suboptimal because the degree of redundancy can vary significantly between different videos, necessitating content-dependent pruning levels to preserve critical information. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage adaptive token pruning strategy specifically designed for video processing. In the first stage, we prune out the redundant frames, and in the second stage, token-level pruning is applied within the retained frames. Crucially, the pruning ratio in the second stage is determined adaptively based on the content of each video. This is achieved by analyzing the correlation structure of token embeddings to quantify redundancy, which is used to determine the ratio. Importantly, our method is entirely post-hoc and requires no additional training or fine-tuning, while achieving strong empirical gains; notably, it improves accuracy by +7\% on a video captioning benchmark at 10\% token retention, while reducing computation TFLOPs by 95\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对视频-语言模型的两阶段自适应视觉 token 剪枝策略，用于降低推理延迟。第一阶段剪除冗余帧，第二阶段在保留帧内进行 token 级剪枝，剪枝比例根据视频内容自适应决定。该方法完全后处理（post-hoc），无需额外训练或微调，在视频字幕任务上以 10% token 保留率取得准确率提升。
Motivation: 视频-语言模型需处理大量 token，推理延迟高，难以部署在资源受限的边端设备和实时监控场景。现有 token 剪枝方法多面向单图像输入，未利用视频帧间与时序冗余，且使用固定的统一剪枝比例，无法适应不同视频内容之间冗余度的差异。
Method: 提出两阶段自适应 token 剪枝：第一阶段剪除冗余帧，第二阶段在保留帧内进行 token 级剪枝。第二阶段的剪枝比例通过分析 token embedding 的相关性结构来量化冗余度，从而依据每个视频的内容自适应确定。
Result: 摘要报告在视频字幕基准上，10% token 保留率下准确率提升 7%，同时计算量减少 95% TFLOPs。
Conclusion: 该方法无需训练或微调即可适用，显著降低计算开销，适合资源受限设备和实时视频理解应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Double Descent in Gradient Boosting Decision Trees via Split-Candidate Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Double descent is commonly studied by scaling an explicit capacity parameter, such as neural-network width. For gradient boosting decision trees (GBDTs), however, an analogous single-axis capacity parameter has not been established. We propose the number of split candidates as an operational capacity parameter for GBDTs. Holding other training controls fixed, increasing the split-candidate budget refines the feature-quantization grid and expands the dictionary of root-to-leaf paths from which boosting selects its updates. To analyze this expansion, we construct an empirical tree-kernel diagnostic that summarizes how candidate-induced paths group the training examples. A regime in which the empirical kernel rank grows toward the sample size and very small positive eigenvalues emerge exposes noise-sensitive directions; in this regime, test error peaks before decreasing again at larger split-candidate budgets. This perspective predicts that deeper trees should reach the regime with fewer split candidates, larger training sets should require finer grids, and label noise should make the peak more pronounced. Experiments support these predictions and show test-error peaks at intermediate split-candidate budgets across XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, whereas a random-forest control improves monotonically under the same split-candidate sweep. Taken together, our analysis and experiments support split-candidate scaling as a single-axis capacity intervention for studying GBDTs and suggest that the observed double descent arises from an interaction between candidate-induced geometry and boosting dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将分裂候选数（split candidates）作为梯度提升决策树（GBDT）的操作性容量参数，用于研究其双下降（double descent）现象。作者构建经验树核诊断（empirical tree-kernel diagnostic），发现当核秩趋近样本量并出现极小正特征值时，测试误差在中等的分裂候选预算下达到峰值，随后再次下降；该现象在 XGBoost、LightGBM 和 CatBoost 中均被观察到，而随机森林对照组在同一扫描下单调改善。
Motivation: 双下降通常通过缩放显式容量参数（如神经网络宽度）来研究，但 GBDT 一直缺乏类似的单轴容量参数，这限制了对其泛化行为的系统分析。
Method: 将分裂候选数作为 GBDT 的容量参数，固定其他训练控制；增加分裂候选预算会细化特征量化网格并扩展 boosting 可选的根到叶路径字典，并构造经验树核诊断来总结候选诱导路径对训练样本的划分。
Result: 实验支持该视角的预测：更深的树在更少分裂候选时进入该机制，更大的训练集需要更细的网格，标签噪声使测试误差峰值更明显；XGBoost、LightGBM 和 CatBoost 在中等分裂候选预算下均出现测试误差峰值，而随机森林控制单调改善。
Conclusion: 分析支持分裂候选缩放作为研究 GBDT 的单轴容量干预，并表明观察到的双下降源于候选诱导几何与 boosting 动力学之间的交互。

papers.title: Multimodal Plant Root Phenotyping with Integration of 3D Skeleton Extraction and Language Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Plant root phenotyping is fundamental to understanding below-ground structures, optimizing crop management, and improving agricultural sustainability. This paper presents a multimodal robotic AI framework that integrates 3D skeleton extraction with language-guided reasoning for interpretable and data-efficient root analysis. We develop an unsupervised skeleton extraction network based on Weighted Laplacian Contraction (W-LBC) to generate high-fidelity structural representations from dense point clouds captured by robotic 3D sensing platforms. Quantitative morphological descriptors, including root count, length, branching angle, and density, are computed from the reconstructed skeleton graph to capture geometric and topological characteristics. Building on these features, we introduce an Evidence-First language modeling framework that fine-tunes GPT as an interactive analytical chatbot using automatically generated instruction--response pairs. Each training sample provides measurable evidence before natural-language reasoning, enabling the model to ground interpretation in quantitative morphology. Through supervised fine-tuning, GPT associates numerical structure with semantic meaning, producing biologically consistent explanations of growth patterns and adaptive traits. Experiments show that the structure-guided framework achieves robust, interpretable reasoning across 12 plant species with diverse root architectures. By integrating unsupervised 3D geometric perception with large-scale language understanding, our approach bridges quantitative analysis and semantic interpretation, establishing a unified paradigm for explainable robotic plant root phenotyping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态机器人 AI 框架，用于植物根系表型分析：先用基于加权拉普拉斯收缩 (Weighted Laplacian Contraction, W-LBC) 的无监督骨架提取网络，从机器人 3D 传感平台采集的稠密点云中生成根系结构表示；再计算根数量、根长、分支角度和密度等形态描述符，并基于这些特征微调 GPT 作为交互式分析聊天机器人。摘要称该方法在 12 个具有不同根系结构的植物物种上实现了稳健、可解释的推理，将定量几何分析与语义解释统一起来。
Motivation: 植物根系表型分析对理解地下结构、优化作物管理和提高农业可持续性很重要，但现有方法在解释性和数据效率上不足，难以把定量形态分析与自然语言理解联系起来。
Method: 提出无监督骨架提取网络 W-LBC，从机器人 3D 点云中重建高保真根系骨架图，并从中计算根数量、根长、分支角度与密度等形态学描述符。随后引入 Evidence-First 语言建模框架，用自动生成的指令-响应对微调 GPT，使每个训练样本先给出可量测证据再进行自然语言推理，从而让模型把数字结构关联到语义含义。
Result: 摘要报告该结构引导框架在 12 个具有多样根系构型的植物物种上实现稳健、可解释的推理，能够产生生物学一致的生长模式与适应性特征解释。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将无监督 3D 几何感知与大规模语言理解相结合，可以弥合定量分析与语义解释之间的鸿沟，为可解释的机器人植物根系表型分析建立统一范式。

papers.title: Convex-Hull-Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization: Controlling Local Correction Propagation in Offline RL
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning (offline RL) can benefit from nearby out-of-distribution (OOD) actions, but estimation errors at these actions may be amplified by bootstrapping. Existing regularization and local-generalization methods control either the admissible OOD region or the influence of generalized targets, often through separate mechanisms. We propose Convex Hull Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization (CSDG), which expresses the Bellman backup as an in-sample value target plus a CHN-local correction. This formulation makes the generalized contribution explicit and separates it from the in-sample reference path. The correction is obtained by smoothing in-sample-oriented and OOD-oriented candidates sampled at different perturbation radii. A mixture coefficient lambda scales its contribution to each backup, while the recursive discount remains gamma. Under boundedness and fixed perturbation kernels, we derive an exact one-step correction identity, a time-varying iterate bound, and a fixed-point bound that depends only on the branch discrepancy at the fixed point. We further characterize the implicit policies induced by the idealized operators and give a conditional non-degradation criterion. The practical algorithm approximates these quantities using asymmetric bounded noise and expectile regression, without exact support classification or an additional pessimistic OOD penalty. Experiments on Gym-MuJoCo and AntMaze show strong aggregate performance and stable value estimation. Code is available at: https://github.com/YOUNG-fnxm/CSDG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离线强化学习 (offline RL) 中邻近分布外 (OOD) 动作的估计误差会被 bootstrap 放大的问题，提出 Convex Hull Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization (CSDG)。该方法将 Bellman backup 表示为样本内价值目标加上一个 CHN 局部修正项，使泛化贡献显式化并与样本内参考路径分离；修正项通过对不同扰动半径采样的样本内导向与 OOD 导向候选进行平滑得到。作者推导了单步修正恒等式、时变迭代界和不动点界，并给出隐式策略特征与非退化条件。
Motivation: 现有正则化与局部泛化方法通常通过分离机制分别控制允许的 OOD 区域或泛化目标的影响，缺少把泛化贡献显式表达并与样本内参考路径分离的统一框架，导致邻近 OOD 动作的估计误差可能被 bootstrap 放大。
Method: 提出 CSDG，将 Bellman backup 写成样本内价值目标加 CHN 局部修正；修正量由不同扰动半径下采样的样本内导向与 OOD 导向候选平滑得到，用混合系数 lambda 控制每次 backup 中的贡献，递归折扣保持为 gamma。实际算法使用非对称有界噪声和 expectile 回归近似这些量，无需精确支持分类或额外的悲观 OOD 惩罚。
Result: 在 Gym-MuJoCo 和 AntMaze 上的实验显示强聚合性能 (strong aggregate performance) 和稳定的价值估计 (stable value estimation)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该公式化方法使泛化贡献显式化并可从样本内参考路径分离，且在理论上给出精确修正恒等式、迭代界和不动点界；算法避免精确支持分类与额外悲观惩罚。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Unified Resolution-Conditioned Framework for Orthogonal Line-Scanning Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Laser line-scanning microscopy enables fast volumetric imaging but produces anisotropic lateral resolution. Orthogonal line scans provide complementary directional information that can recover near-isotropic resolution, yet existing deep-learning methods require a separate model for each optical configuration. We present a unified, resolution-conditioned fusion framework based on Rank Enhanced Linear Attention (RELA). Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) conditions the network continuously on the resolving-power ratio, enabling one model to adapt across slit widths. We further introduce Adaptive RELA, which replaces fixed-kernel rank enhancement with ratio-conditioned multi-scale depthwise convolutions and uses a learnable attention temperature to adjust selectivity with degradation severity. Training data spanning multiple slit configurations are generated using a physics-grounded separable point-spread-function model verified against measured optical data at 48.3 dB accuracy. The resulting model achieves 34-40 dB PSNR across configurations, whereas unconditioned multi-slit training collapses to 24.3 dB and per-slit specialists lose 4-9 dB outside their training setting. It also generalizes smoothly to unseen intermediate configurations without interpolation artifacts. Ablations show that FiLM resolves configuration ambiguity, global linear attention captures long-range directional correspondences, and adaptive temperature yields an additional 2 dB in the challenging near-isotropic regime, where complementary signals are weak.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于激光线扫描显微镜图像融合的统一、分辨率条件化框架，基于 Rank Enhanced Linear Attention (RELA) 与特征级线性调制 (FiLM)，使单一模型能适应不同狭缝宽度。摘要报告该模型在多种配置下达到 34-40 dB PSNR，而未条件化的多狭缝训练仅 24.3 dB，且能平滑泛化到未见过的中间配置。消融实验表明 FiLM 解决配置歧义、全局线性注意力捕获长程方向对应、自适应温度在近各向同性区域额外带来 2 dB 提升。
Motivation: 激光线扫描显微镜能快速体积成像，但横向分辨率各向异性；正交线扫描可提供互补方向信息以恢复近各向同性分辨率，然而现有深度学习方法需要为每种光学配置单独训练模型。
Method: 提出基于 RELA 的统一融合框架，用 FiLM 以分辨力比率 (resolving-power ratio) 连续条件化网络；Adaptive RELA 用比率条件化的多尺度深度卷积替代固定核秩增强，并引入可学习注意力温度以按退化程度调整选择性。训练数据由基于物理的可分离点扩散函数模型生成，该模型以 48.3 dB 精度对照实测光学数据验证。
Result: 摘要报告模型在跨狭缝配置下达到 34-40 dB PSNR，而未条件化的多狭缝训练坍缩至 24.3 dB，单配置专家在训练设置外损失 4-9 dB；模型可无伪影泛化到未见过的中间配置。消融显示 FiLM 解决配置歧义，全局线性注意力捕获长程方向对应，自适应温度在近各向同性弱互补信号区域额外提升 2 dB。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的分辨率条件化框架可替代每配置专用模型，并泛化至中间配置；消融结果说明 FiLM、全局线性注意力与自适应温度各自的作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FaithIR: Rethinking Infrared Image Super-Resolution from Perceptual Sharpness to Task Relevant Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: Infrared image super-resolution (IISR) is important for downstream tasks such as object detection and semantic segmentation. Existing IISR methods often produce artificial textures, over-sharpened edges, and spurious high-frequency details that distort authentic thermal structures and semantic information. To address this issue, we propose FaithIR, a faithful infrared super-resolution framework for reliable machine perception. FaithIR consists of a patch-level conditioning branch that captures global thermal and structural information and a pixel-level restoration branch that performs dense local reconstruction under structural guidance. The entire restoration process is performed directly in the pixel domain to preserve infrared-specific structures and task-relevant information. Extensive experiments on FLIR-IISR, M3FD, and FMB demonstrate strong reconstruction fidelity, cross-dataset generalization, and superior performance in object detection and semantic segmentation. These results show that demonstrate that preserving faithful infrared structure preservations is more important for reliable machine perception than merely pursuing perceptual sharpness alone.
papers.comment: 14 pages: 7 pages of main text, 2 pages of references, and 5 pages of supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FaithIR，一个面向可靠机器感知的红外图像超分辨率 (IISR) 框架，旨在解决现有方法产生人造纹理、过度锐化边缘和虚假高频细节而扭曲真实热结构与语义信息的问题。框架包含一个补丁级条件分支以捕获全局热与结构信息，以及一个像素级恢复分支在结构引导下进行密集局部重建，整个恢复过程直接在像素域中进行。实验在 FLIR-IISR、M3FD 和 FMB 数据集上验证了重建保真度、跨数据集泛化能力，以及在下游目标检测和语义分割上的性能。
Motivation: 现有红外超分辨率方法往往追求感知锐度，生成不真实的纹理和伪高频细节，破坏热结构与语义信息，影响目标检测和语义分割等下游任务的可靠性。
Method: FaithIR 由两部分组成：补丁级条件分支捕获全局热与结构信息，像素级恢复分支在结构引导下进行局部密集重建；恢复过程直接在像素域执行以保留红外特有结构和任务相关信息。
Result: 在 FLIR-IISR、M3FD 和 FMB 上的大量实验表明该方法具有强重建保真度、跨数据集泛化能力，并在目标检测和语义分割下游任务上表现更优。
Conclusion: 作者强调，对可靠机器感知而言，保留真实红外结构比仅追求感知锐度更为重要。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 FaithIR，一个面向可靠机器感知的红外图像超分辨率 (IISR) 框架，旨在解决现有方法产生人造纹理、过度锐化边缘和虚假高频细节而扭曲真实热结构与语义信息的问题。框架包含一个补丁级条件分支以捕获全局热与结构信息，以及一个像素级恢复分支在结构引导下进行密集局部重建，整个恢复过程直接在像素域中进行。实验在 FLIR-IISR、M3FD 和 FMB 数据集上验证了重建保真度、跨数据集泛化能力，以及在下游目标检测和语义分割上的性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有红外超分辨率方法往往追求感知锐度，生成不真实的纹理和伪高频细节，破坏热结构与语义信息，影响目标检测和语义分割等下游任务的可靠性。
summary_sections.method: FaithIR 由两部分组成：补丁级条件分支捕获全局热与结构信息，像素级恢复分支在结构引导下进行局部密集重建；恢复过程直接在像素域执行以保留红外特有结构和任务相关信息。
summary_sections.result: 在 FLIR-IISR、M3FD 和 FMB 上的大量实验表明该方法具有强重建保真度、跨数据集泛化能力，并在目标检测和语义分割下游任务上表现更优。

papers.title: A Hierarchical Approach to Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Requiring Time Varying Forces
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies have shown strong performance in learning complex, multi-modal behaviors for robotic manipulation. However, their application to contact-rich disassembly tasks remains limited by a key trade-off: the iterative denoising process introduces inference latencies that makes high frequency control difficult, which is essential for realizing dynamic interactions such as chiseling and prying. Recent action-chunking techniques mitigate latency but use an open-loop execution window, rendering the system blind to rapid force transients caused by fracture events. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Diffusion Policy Augmented by Fast Trajectory Generation (DPA-FTG). Compared to recent visual-tactile approaches that focus on positional correction, DPA-FTG decouples low-frequency planning from high-frequency force regulation. At the high level ($5$ Hz), a conditional diffusion model predicts a sequence of latent parameters for selecting a strategy from a learned vocabulary of task primitives. At the low level ($60$ Hz), a lightweight, force-conditioned policy acts as a neural impedance controller, modulating execution in real-time to maintain contact stability. We validate our approach on a bimanual battery disassembly task involving the separation of a compliant sheet. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that DPA-FTG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对接触丰富的拆解任务，提出 DPA-FTG（Diffusion Policy Augmented by Fast Trajectory Generation）分层模仿学习框架，将低频规划与高频力调节解耦。高层以 5 Hz 的条件扩散模型预测潜参数以从任务原语库中选择策略，低层以 60 Hz 的力条件策略作为神经阻抗控制器实时调节执行。作者在双臂电池拆解（分离柔性片）任务上验证，称其优于包括 Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP) 在内的基线。
Motivation: 扩散策略在机器人操作中表现强，但迭代去噪带来的推理延迟使高频控制困难，而接触丰富的拆解任务（如凿击、撬动）需要高频动态交互；已有的动作分块 (action-chunking) 技术虽降低延迟，但采用开环执行窗口，对断裂事件造成的快速力瞬变不敏感。
Method: 提出 DPA-FTG，将问题分解为两个层次：高层（5 Hz）用条件扩散模型预测潜参数序列，从学习到的任务原语词汇表中选择策略；低层（60 Hz）用轻量级力条件策略充当神经阻抗控制器，实时调节执行以维持接触稳定性。
Result: 在双臂电池拆解任务（分离柔性片）中，实验评估显示 DPA-FTG 优于包括 Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP) 在内的当前最优基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过解耦低频规划与高频力调节，可以同时缓解扩散策略的推理延迟问题与开环执行对力瞬变的盲区，从而支持需要时变力的操作任务。

papers.title: Double Down on Defense: Strengthening Deep Perceptual Hashes against Evasion Attacks without Retraining
papers.abstract_en: Near-duplicate image matching is crucial for trust and safety, provenance verification, copyright enforcement, and large-scale visual search. Modern platforms increasingly rely on deep perceptual hashes, which map visually similar images to nearby representations despite common image transformations. However, adversarial perturbations can cause near-duplicates to evade matching. We present DualShield, a plug-in defense that improves the robustness of existing deep perceptual hashes without retraining or modifying their underlying models. DualShield combines matching-time randomized smoothing, which aggregates decisions over perturbed reference-query pairs, with publication-time hardening, which adds an optimized imperceptible perturbation to each reference image before publication. Together, these mechanisms provide certified and empirical robustness. DualShield achieves a certified $\ell_2$ radius of approximately 0.3, guaranteeing that query perturbations within this radius cannot evade matching. We further evaluate it against adaptive white-box, black-box, and image-transformation attacks. Across eight deep perceptual hashes and three datasets, DualShield substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving low collision rates. These results show that deep perceptual hashes can be strengthened without costly retraining by improving the matching procedure and hardening reference images before publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualShield，一种即插即用的防御方法，用于增强现有深度感知哈希 (deep perceptual hashes) 在近重复图像匹配中的鲁棒性，无需重新训练或修改底层模型。DualShield 结合匹配时的随机平滑 (randomized smoothing) 与发布前的图像硬化 (imperceptible perturbation)，提供认证与经验鲁棒性。摘要报告其在八种深度感知哈希和三个数据集上显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持低碰撞率。
Motivation: 深度感知哈希被广泛用于近重复图像匹配，但对抗扰动可使近重复图像绕过匹配。现有防御通常需要重新训练模型，代价高昂，本文目标是在不重训练的前提下增强已有哈希的鲁棒性。
Method: DualShield 包含两个机制：匹配时随机平滑，在扰动后的参考-查询对上聚合决策；发布时硬化，在参考图像发布前添加优化后的不可感知扰动。两者结合提供认证与经验鲁棒性。
Result: DualShield 实现了约 0.3 的认证 ℓ2 半径，保证该半径内的查询扰动无法绕过匹配；在自适应白盒、黑盒和图像变换攻击下，跨越八种深度感知哈希和三个数据集，显著降低攻击成功率且保持低碰撞率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过改进匹配流程并在发布前硬化参考图像，可以在不进行昂贵重训练的情况下增强深度感知哈希的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Channel-wise Dynamic Knowledge Distillation via Adaptive Sample Generation for Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a promising yet underexplored path for compressing large action recognition models. However, existing KD methods suffer from two key limitations: 1) reliance on fixed input samples leads to suboptimal feature alignment between the frozen teacher (larger model) and the learnable student (smaller model), and 2) applying a uniform distillation strength for all channels fails to account for their varying importance in capturing distinct knowledge (e.g., motion tempo or magnitude) across training epochs. This motivates us to develop an Adaptive Sample-aware Channel-wise Dynamic (ASCD) KD approach, which operates in two stages. First, we use an adaptive sample generation module to create updated samples by incorporating semantics from sample gradients, which are derived by minimizing a feature loss weighted by channel centroid frequency differences at each layer. Meanwhile, crucial motion-related details are preserved by applying a Gaussian mask to frequency features. Second, we employ a channel-wise dynamic distillation module to train student on these generated samples, guided by sample gradients and feature frequencies. For efficiency, samples are updated periodically rather than per epoch. Extensive experiments on three video benchmarks (UCF101, Kinetics-400, Something-Something-v2) and two image datasets (CIFAR-100, ImageNet) demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our method. Code is available at https://github.com/mlvccn/ASCD_KD_Action.
papers.comment: Accepted in ACM MM2026, 16 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向动作识别模型的压缩，提出一种自适应样本感知的通道动态知识蒸馏方法 (Adaptive Sample-aware Channel-wise Dynamic KD, ASCD)。方法分为两阶段：先用自适应样本生成模块基于通道质心频率差异加权的特征损失梯度更新训练样本，并用高斯掩码保留运动相关细节；再以通道级动态蒸馏模块在这些生成样本上训练学生模型。作者在 UCF101、Kinetics-400、Something-Something-v2 三个视频基准以及 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 两个图像数据集上报告了最优性能。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏在动作识别中依赖固定输入样本，导致冻结教师模型与可学习学生模型之间的特征对齐次优；同时对所有通道施加统一的蒸馏强度，忽略了不同通道在不同训练轮次对运动速度、幅度等知识的重要程度差异。
Method: 提出 ASCD：第一阶段通过最小化由各层通道质心频率差异加权的特征损失得到样本梯度，从而生成更新样本，并用高斯掩码保留关键的与运动相关的频率细节；第二阶段用样本梯度与特征频率指导的通道级动态蒸馏模块训练学生模型；为降低开销，样本采用周期性更新而非每轮更新。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在三个视频基准 (UCF101、Kinetics-400、Something-Something-v2) 和两个图像数据集 (CIFAR-100、ImageNet) 上达到最先进性能，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合自适应样本生成和通道级动态蒸馏能够缓解固定样本与均匀蒸馏强度带来的局限，为动作识别模型的知识蒸馏压缩提供更优方案，并开源代码。

papers.title: FakeI2V-Bench: Benchmarking the Applicability of Image-level Deepfake Detectors for Deepfake Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generation models have significantly intensified the deepfake threat, yet the current deepfake video detection benchmarks remain underdeveloped. In particular, the effectiveness of image-level detectors in the video domain has not been systematically assessed. To fill this gap, we present FakeI2V-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating state-of-the-art video-level deepfake detectors in challenging scenarios, with a particular focus on systematically assessing the performance of image-level deepfake detectors in the video domain. FakeI2V-Bench comprises 97,548 videos, containing content generated by the latest powerful generation models and covering a broader range of categories. Using this dataset, we conduct a systematic evaluation of eight video-level detectors and twelve representative image-level detectors. Experimental results show that the best-performing image-level detector achieves an 80.16% AUC, slightly outperforming the strongest video-level detector (i.e., 79.99% AUC). Going beyond benchmarking, we present IV-Bridge, a general framework that enhances the applicability of image-level deepfake detectors to videos. IV-Bridge employs a random forest model with statistical features to aggregate frame-level predictions, allowing eleven image-level detectors to surpass state-of-the-art video-level approaches, with the best-performing variant achieving a 93.80% AUC. Overall, FakeI2V-Bench establishes a rigorous benchmark for deepfake video detection and introduces a novel pathway for extending image-level detectors to the video domain, offering new insights and directions for future research. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CryptoAILab/FakeI2V-Bench.
papers.comment: To Appear in KDD 2026, Jeju, Korea, August 9-13, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FakeI2V-Bench 基准，用于系统评估图像级深度伪造检测器在视频域中的适用性。基准包含 97,548 个视频，覆盖最新生成模型与更广类别；作者评估了 8 个视频级检测器和 12 个图像级检测器，并进一步提出 IV-Bridge 框架，用随机森林与统计特征聚合帧级预测以提升图像级检测器在视频上的表现。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造视频检测基准发展不足，图像级检测器在视频域中的有效性缺乏系统性评估。
Method: 构建包含 97,548 个视频的 FakeI2V-Bench 基准，评测 8 个视频级检测器与 12 个代表性图像级检测器；并提出 IV-Bridge 通用框架，利用基于统计特征的随机森林模型聚合帧级预测。
Result: 最佳图像级检测器达到 80.16% AUC，略优于最强的视频级检测器（79.99% AUC）；IV-Bridge 使 11 个图像级检测器超越现有视频级方法，最佳变体达到 93.80% AUC。
Conclusion: FakeI2V-Bench 为深度伪造视频检测提供了严格基准，并展示了将图像级检测器扩展到视频域的新路径。

papers.title: VIVID: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark Exposing the Figurative Language Gap in Vietnamese NLP
papers.abstract_en: We present VIVID (Vietnamese Idioms for Validation and Interpretation Depth), the first systematic benchmark for evaluating culturally grounded figurative language understanding in Vietnamese. VIVID comprises 1,636 idioms and proverbs annotated with five complexity traits (literal expressions, pragmatic nuances, Sino-Vietnamese terms, uncommon vocabulary, folk knowledge) and seven semantic themes. We establish an evaluation framework combining generative and discriminative tasks, proposing an LLM-as-a-Judge approach with aspect-based prompting validated against human judgment (Cohen's kappa = 0.792). Evaluating eight state-of-the-art models reveals critical gaps: Vietnamese-specialized models drastically underperform multilingual systems (VinaLLaMA-7B: 0.13 vs. GPT-4o: 2.46), and even top models achieve less than 50% of maximum scores. Notably, few-shot prompting does not universally improve performance, with GPT-4o exhibiting degradation due to stylistic overfitting. Our analysis exposes systematic failures including literal over-interpretation, lexical gaps, and pragmatic flattening, demonstrating that current models lack cultural competence for nuanced figurative interpretation. VIVID provides an essential tool for advancing figurative language understanding in culturally rich contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIVID（Vietnamese Idioms for Validation and Interpretation Depth），据称是首个系统性评估越南语文化负载比喻语言理解的基准，包含 1,636 条成语和谚语，标注了五种复杂度特征与七类语义主题。作者建立了生成式与判别式任务相结合的评测框架，并采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 的方面级提示（aspect-based prompting）方法，其评分与人类判断的一致性 Cohen's kappa = 0.792。评测八个 SOTA 模型后发现，越语专用模型显著落后于多语言系统，且最优模型得分不足最高分的一半，few-shot 提示并非普遍有效。
Motivation: 现有 NLP 评测缺乏针对越南语中文化负载比喻语言（figurative language）的系统性基准，导致当前模型在该语言上的文化能力（cultural competence）无法被衡量和改进。
Method: 构建 VIVID 基准：1,636 条成语/谚语，标注五种复杂度特征（字面表达、语用细微差别、汉越词、生僻词汇、民间知识）和七个语义主题；结合生成式与判别式任务，提出基于方面级提示的 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估方案，并用人类判断进行验证。
Result: 八个 SOTA 模型的评测显示临界差距：越南语专用模型 VinaLLaMA-7B 得分为 0.13，远低于 GPT-4o 的 2.46；即便最优模型也仅达到最高分的不到一半。few-shot 提示并不普遍提升性能，GPT-4o 反而因风格过拟合（stylistic overfitting）出现退化；系统性失败模式包括字面过度解读、词汇缺口和语用扁平化。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前模型缺乏对越南语细腻比喻解释所需的文化能力，VIVID 可作为推动文化丰富语境下比喻语言理解研究的基础工具。

papers.title: SMOPD: Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning via Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: We aim to improve model performance in multi-reward reinforcement learning training process. Existing Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) has mitigated the issue of reward signals masking one another during direct scalarization by normalizing each reward dimension separately before aggregation. However, our experiments show that GDPO still struggles to balance reward signals with different granularities. Specifically, in some particular training tasks, the model may receive a dense reward that assigns fine-grained scores ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, together with a sparse reward that provides only binary feedback of either 0 or 1. In such cases, we find that the sparse reward may provide an insufficient optimization signal, preventing its corresponding capability from being effectively reinforced. Therefore, how can we strengthen the optimization signal from the sparse reward without sacrificing the capability already learned from the fine-grained reward? To overcome this limitation, we propose Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation (SMOPD), a two-stage training method for multi-reward optimization. Stage1-Specialize: SMOPD first employs reward-priority configurations to train multiple reward-specialized teachers, allowing each reward to be learned under conditions where its signal can effectively drive optimization. Stage2-Merge: SMOPD then utilizes online policy distillation to combine the reward-specialized capabilities of these teachers into a single student policy, while maintaining balanced task-level optimization. To validate our method, we conduct experiments on two multi-reward settings: complementary rewards(tool-calling accuracy and format) and conflicting rewards (helpful and harmless rewards). Based on above settings, SMOPD outperforms GDPO across 1.5B, 3B and 7B backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SMOPD（Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation），一种两阶段多奖励强化学习训练方法。现有 GDPO 虽按奖励维度归一化，但仍难平衡不同粒度的奖励信号，尤其在稠密奖励（0.1–1.0）与 0/1 稀疏奖励并存时稀疏信号不足以驱动优化。SMOPD 先训练多个奖励专用教师，再用在线策略蒸馏合并到单一学生策略，并在互补奖励与冲突奖励两种设置下以 1.5B、3B、7B 主干超越 GDPO。
Motivation: 多奖励强化学习中的直接标量化会导致奖励信号互相掩盖，GDPO 通过逐维度归一化缓解了该问题，但实验表明它仍无法平衡不同粒度的奖励：稀疏奖励提供的优化信号不足，使对应能力无法被有效强化。核心问题是如何增强稀疏奖励的优化信号，同时不牺牲已从稠密奖励中学到的能力。
Method: SMOPD 采用两阶段训练。Stage1-Specialize 使用奖励优先级（reward-priority）配置训练多个奖励专用教师，让每个奖励在信号能有效驱动优化的条件下被学习；Stage2-Merge 利用在线策略蒸馏（online policy distillation）将这些教师的奖励专用能力合并进单一学生策略，并保持任务级（task-level）优化平衡。
Result: 在互补奖励（工具调用准确性与格式）和冲突奖励（helpful 与 harmless）两种多奖励设置上，SMOPD 在 1.5B、3B 和 7B 三种主干规模上均优于 GDPO。摘要未报告具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SMOPD 能够增强稀疏奖励的优化信号，同时保留稠密奖励已习得的能力，并通过蒸馏实现多奖励能力的平衡合并。

papers.title: SynEnergy: Anomaly Semantic-Guided Diffusion for Synthetic Energy Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained energy consumption data are essential for applications such as demand forecasting, demand response planning, and grid reliability assessment. However, access to such data is often restricted by privacy concerns and data-sharing constraints, motivating growing interest in synthetic energy data generation. Although existing methods can reproduce overall consumption distributions and recurring temporal patterns, they often smooth out or underrepresent anomalous events caused by extreme weather, infrastructure failures, and behavioral shifts. Preserving these events is challenging because they are sparse, localized in time and space, and shaped by heterogeneous dependencies across geographical proximity and regional attributes. To address these challenges, we propose SynEnergy, a two-stage diffusion-based framework for anomaly-preserving energy consumption data generation. The first stage, Heterogeneous Graph-based Anomaly Semantic Learning (HG-ASL), extracts region-specific anomaly semantics from sparse residual structures by jointly modeling spatial and attribute dependencies across urban regions. The second stage, Anomaly Semantic-guided Diffusion (AS-Diff), injects the learned anomaly semantics into the denoising process to generate realistic consumption sequences while preserving anomalous patterns. This design enables controllable generation for individual regions and scales naturally to city-wide settings. We evaluate SynEnergy on four real-world energy consumption datasets against 11 general-purpose and energy-specific generation baselines. Experimental results show that SynEnergy improves anomaly preservation fidelity by an average of 12.21% and downstream quality by 2.96%, while maintaining competitive overall generation fidelity compared to baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynEnergy，一个两阶段扩散框架，用于生成保留异常事件的合成能源消耗数据。第一阶段 HG-ASL 通过异构图建模空间与属性依赖，从稀疏残差中提取区域特定的异常语义；第二阶段 AS-Diff 将这些异常语义注入去噪过程，生成真实且保留异常模式的消费序列。在四个真实能源数据集上对比 11 个基线，SynEnergy 将异常保真度平均提升 12.21%，下游质量提升 2.96%，同时维持有竞争力的整体生成保真度。
Motivation: 细粒度能源消耗数据对需求预测、需求响应和电网可靠性评估很重要，但隐私和数据共享限制阻碍了访问。现有合成数据方法能复现总体分布和周期模式，却常平滑或低估由极端天气、基础设施故障和行为变化引起的稀疏、局域化且依赖异质关系的异常事件。
Method: 提出两阶段扩散框架 SynEnergy：第一阶段 Heterogeneous Graph-based Anomaly Semantic Learning (HG-ASL) 联合建模城市区域的空间和属性依赖，从稀疏残差中学习区域特定异常语义；第二阶段 Anomaly Semantic-guided Diffusion (AS-Diff) 将习得的异常语义注入去噪过程，支持单区域可控生成并自然扩展到城市规模。
Result: 在四个真实能源消耗数据集上，与 11 个通用及能源专用生成基线相比，SynEnergy 将异常保真度平均提升 12.21%，下游任务质量提升 2.96%，同时整体生成保真度与基线相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过异构图建模异常语义并引导扩散过程，可以在合成能源数据中保留稀疏异常事件，并实现区域级可控生成；其适用范围为能源消耗数据生成。

papers.title: Automatic Patient-Specific Microwave Ablation Planning Accelerated by a Physics-Guided Deep Learning Model
papers.abstract_en: Microwave ablation (MWA) is a promising minimally invasive treatment for liver tumors, but its therapeutic outcome strongly depends on patient-specific planning of antenna insertion trajectory, power, and treatment duration. Accurate numerical simulation can provide physically reliable ablation predictions; however, its high computational cost limits its use in optimization-based planning, where repeated forward evaluations are required. To address this issue, we propose a digital twin-based automatic planning framework that combines a neural ablation prediction model with a genetic algorithm. The model was trained on multiphysics simulation data generated from patient-specific tumor and vessel structures, antenna configurations, and treatment conditions, and was used as a fast forward model during planning. The prediction model achieved a Dice score of 95.1%, enabling accurate deep learning-based optimization. In 13 unseen planning cases, the proposed method improved ablation efficiency by 54.3% and reduced organ damage by 55.0% compared with clinician-defined planning, while slightly shortening the insertion path length by 3.3%. Most generated plans were also judged clinically applicable by MWA specialists. Furthermore, the framework enabled approximately 420-fold faster planning than numerical-simulation-based planning, demonstrating its potential as a fast digital twin for quantitative and personalized MWA treatment planning. The code is available at: https://github.com/SeonAengCho/MWA-Planning.git
papers.comment: Accepted at the Digital Twin for Healthcare (DT4H 2026) workshop at MICCAI 2026; 10 pages, 2 figures

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于数字孪生的自动微波消融（MWA）规划框架，将神经消融预测模型与遗传算法（genetic algorithm）结合，用训练于多物理场仿真数据的深度学习模型作为快速前向模型来替代高成本数值仿真。预测模型达到 Dice 95.1%；在13个未见规划案例中，相比临床医生定义的计划，消融效率提升54.3%、器官损伤减少55.0%、插入路径长度缩短3.3%，规划速度比基于数值仿真的规划快约420倍，且多数生成计划被 MWA 专家判定为临床可用。

Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法可作为快速数字孪生，支持定量且个性化的 MWA 治疗规划，并已开源代码。

papers.title: Causal Inference with Unstructured Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference has traditionally centered on scalar outcomes: whether a patient recovers, how much a worker earns, or how many visits a website receives. Modern studies increasingly ask causal questions about outcomes with richer form, such as clinical notes, open-ended survey responses, and images. A hospital may want to know how an AI documentation tool changes the notes physicians write, or how a nurse training program alters what patients say in survey responses. For such outcomes, the usual average treatment effect is ill-defined: one cannot meaningfully subtract one text or image from another. To this end, we propose a causal query for unstructured outcomes. The key idea is to learn what features of the outcome are most causally affected by the treatment, which we call the maximally contrasting feature (MCF). To estimate the MCF, we learn a feature-scoring function that maps each outcome to a scalar and exposes the sharpest contrast between treated and control potential outcomes. We develop identification conditions and estimation algorithms for this query, and extend it to heterogeneous effects by allowing the feature-scoring function to depend on observed covariates. We also handle settings where both the treatment and the outcome are unstructured. Empirical studies on text and images show that the algorithm recovers salient aspects of an outcome changed by a treatment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对临床笔记、开放式调查回复、图像等非结构化结果提出一种因果查询，称为最大化对比特征（maximally contrasting feature, MCF）：通过学习一个将结果映射为标量的特征评分函数，暴露处理组与对照组潜在结果之间最尖锐的对比。作者为该查询建立了识别条件与估计算法，并扩展到异质性效应以及处理变量也为非结构化数据的情形。文本与图像上的经验研究表明，该方法能恢复受处理影响的结果中的重要特征。
Motivation: 传统因果推断以标量结果为中心，而现代研究常围绕文本、图像等非结构化结果提出因果问题；此时平均处理效应（ATE）没有明确定义，因为无法对文本或图像做减法。
Method: 提出 MCF 作为因果查询，核心是学习特征评分函数将每个结果映射为标量，使处理组与对照组潜在结果的对比最大化；同时给出识别条件与估计算法，允许评分函数依赖观测协变量以刻画异质性效应，并支持处理与结果均为非结构化数据的设定。
Result: 在文本和图像数据集上的经验研究表明，所提算法能够恢复由处理所改变的结果中的显著特征。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 MCF 为结构复杂、无法定义传统处理效应的结果提供了一种可识别且可估计的因果查询，并涵盖异质性效应与非结构化处理变量；未特别强调局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SUV: Future Scene Understanding as Video Generation for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end driving requires a coherent understanding of future scenes, yet existing methods model these scenes using task-specific heads and output formats, with limited scalability. Can video generation instead provide a shared predictor? We introduce SUV, a unified end-to-end driving framework that casts future Scene Understanding as Video generation using a pretrained video foundation model. SUV models future appearance, semantics, relative depth, and instance-level dynamics as video streams with a shared video expert, without stream-specific visual prediction heads. Through joint video-action attention, the action expert attends to the latent representations of all future streams and generates the ego trajectory. Experiments show that SUV directly predicts all four future streams, while controlled ablations show that structured future supervision and direct future-stream access yield higher trajectory planning scores. With only a single front camera and no candidate-trajectory selection, SUV outperforms a broad set of recent state-of-the-art methods on both NAVSIM-v2 splits, achieving 91.0 EPDMS on navtest and 36.9 on navhard. On the long-tail WOD-E2E benchmark, SUV achieves a competitive RFS of 7.94.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SUV，一个统一的端到端驾驶框架，将未来场景理解建模为视频生成，使用预训练视频基础模型作为共享预测器。SUV 将未来外观、语义、相对深度和实例级动态建模为视频流，并由共享视频专家处理，无需针对各流设计视觉预测头；动作专家通过联合视频-动作注意力（joint video-action attention）访问所有未来流的潜在表示并生成自车轨迹。实验表明，仅凭单个前视摄像头且无候选轨迹选择，SUV 在 NAVSIM-v2 两个划分上超过近期多种方法，取得 navtest 91.0 EPDMS、navhard 36.9，并在长尾 WOD-E2E 基准上取得有竞争力的 RFS 7.94。
Motivation: 端到端驾驶需要连贯的未来场景理解，但现有方法使用任务特定的头部和输出格式来建模未来场景，可扩展性有限。作者试图回答视频生成能否作为统一的共享预测器这一问题。
Method: 提出 SUV 框架，将未来场景理解转化为视频生成：利用预训练视频基础模型，把未来外观、语义、相对深度和实例级动态统一建模为视频流，并由一个共享视频专家处理，不使用逐流的视觉预测头。动作专家通过联合视频-动作注意力，对所有未来流的潜在表示进行注意力操作并生成自车轨迹。
Result: 实验显示 SUV 可直接预测全部四种未来流；受控消融表明结构化未来监督和直接未来流访问能带来更高的轨迹规划得分。仅用单前视摄像头且不做候选轨迹选择，SUV 在 NAVSIM-v2 上取得 navtest 91.0 EPDMS、navhard 36.9，并在 WOD-E2E 上取得有竞争力的 RFS 7.94。
Conclusion: 作者认为将未来场景理解建模为视频生成并使用共享视频专家，是一种可扩展的统一预测范式，能直接提升端到端驾驶的轨迹规划性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GSTEP: Global Spatio-Temporal Density-Driven Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (VideoLLMs) achieve strong video understanding performance, but their inference remains expensive due to the large number of redundant spatio-temporal visual tokens in long videos. Existing token pruning methods alleviate this cost by reducing redundant tokens, yet most of them rely on segment-level local pruning, where videos are partitioned into isolated segments and tokens are selected independently within each segment. Such designs may under-preserve short but semantically dense segments and discard tokens that appear non-salient locally but remain critical from a global perspective. To address this issue, we propose GSTEP (Global Spatio-Temporal Density Pruning), a plug-and-play pruning framework that models video as a continuous spatio-temporal information flow. GSTEP constructs a token-level spatio-temporal density by combining a continuous temporal density, obtained from a smoothed centered frame-level change signal, with intra-frame spatial density, and then performs global token sampling by jointly balancing information density and coverage. Extensive experiments on multiple VideoLLMs and public benchmarks demonstrate that GSTEP consistently achieves strong accuracy-efficiency trade-offs and generalizes well across model architectures and evaluation settings. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, GSTEP prunes 75% of visual tokens, preserves up to 100.2% of the original average performance across benchmarks, and achieves a 1.17 end-to-end speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GSTEP（Global Spatio-Temporal Density Pruning），一种即插即用的视频视觉 token 剪枝框架，旨在降低视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）的推理成本。GSTEP 将视频建模为连续时空信息流，通过平滑的帧级变化信号构造连续时间密度，并结合帧内空间密度进行全局 token 采样，在信息密度与覆盖之间取得平衡。在多个 VideoLLM 和公开基准上的实验表明，该方法在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上剪掉 75% 的视觉 token，仍保留约 100.2% 的平均性能，并取得 1.17 倍的端到端加速。
Motivation: 视频大语言模型推理昂贵，因为长视频中存在大量冗余的时空视觉 token。现有剪枝方法多为片段级局部剪枝，将视频划分为孤立片段并在各片段内独立选择 token，可能欠保留语义密集的短片段，且会丢弃局部看似不显著但全局关键的 token。
Method: 提出 GSTEP，一种 plug-and-play 的全局时空密度剪枝框架。它把视频视为连续时空信息流，结合平滑中心化帧级变化信号得到的连续时间密度与帧内空间密度，构造 token 级时空密度，并据此进行联合权衡信息密度与覆盖性的全局 token 采样。
Result: 摘要报告在多个 VideoLLM 和公开基准上，GSTEP 取得一致的强准确率-效率权衡，并跨模型架构与评估设置泛化良好。在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上剪除 75% 视觉 token 时，平均性能保持为原始的 100.2%，端到端加速为 1.17 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过全局时空信息密度建模替代片段级局部剪枝，可以更好地保留全局关键 token，从而在显著降低视觉 token 数量的同时维持视频理解性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DiverseDiT++: Quantifying, Analyzing, and Promoting Representation Diversity in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have enabled remarkable progress in visual synthesis, benefiting from their superior scalability. To facilitate DiTs' capability of capturing meaningful internal representations, recent works such as REPA incorporate external pretrained encoders for representation alignment. However, the underlying mechanisms governing representation learning within DiTs remain poorly understood in the community. To this end, this paper first presents a systematic analysis of the representation dynamics of DiTs via quantifying the diversity of block-wise representations. Specifically, we introduce a novel metric, termed the Weighted Diversity Score (WDS), to measure the representational discrepancies across different blocks. Through extensive investigations on the evolution and influence of internal representations under various settings, we reveal that representation diversity across blocks is a critical factor for effective representation learning in DiTs. More importantly, WDS exhibits a strong correlation with synthesis quality across diverse settings, model scales, and training stages (Pearson's $r=-0.869$ with $\log(\text{FID})$), suggesting its potential as an indicator to reflect model performance and a principled guide for model optimization. Based on this key finding, we propose DiverseDiT++, a novel framework that explicitly promotes diverse representation learning. Concretely, our method incorporates long residual connections to diversify input representations across blocks and a representation diversity loss to encourage blocks to learn distinct features. Extensive experiments on ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$ demonstrate that our DiverseDiT++ yields consistent performance gains and convergence acceleration when applied to different backbones with various sizes,...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) 的表示动力学，提出加权多样性分数 (Weighted Diversity Score, WDS) 来量化不同块之间的表示差异。摘要报告 WDS 与合成质量存在强相关（与 log(FID) 的 Pearson r=-0.869），并据此提出 DiverseDiT++ 框架，通过长残差连接和表示多样性损失显式促进表示多样化。在 ImageNet 256×256 与 512×512 上的实验表明，该方法在不同骨干网络和多种规模下带来一致的性能提升与收敛加速。
Motivation: DiTs 内部表示学习机制在社区中仍缺乏系统性理解，现有工作如 REPA 依赖外部预训练编码器进行表示对齐，而未揭示 DiTs 自身块级表示的演化规律。作者希望通过量化块间表示多样性来理解并改进 DiTs 的表示学习。
Method: 首先引入 WDS 指标度量不同块之间的表示差异，并通过跨设置、跨模型规模和跨训练阶段的分析揭示块间表示多样性是关键因素。基于该发现提出 DiverseDiT++：加入长残差连接 (long residual connections) 以多样化各块的输入表示，并设计表示多样性损失 (representation diversity loss) 促使不同块学习具有区分度的特征。
Result: 摘要报告 WDS 与 log(FID) 的 Pearson 相关系数为 -0.869，表明 WDS 可反映模型性能；在 ImageNet 256×256 和 512×512 上，DiverseDiT++ 应用于不同骨干与不同规模时均取得一致的性能提升和收敛加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为块间表示多样性是 DiTs 有效表示学习的关键因素，WDS 可作为模型性能的指示器并为主观的模型优化提供原则性指导。
Relevance: 5
