papers.title: CorePath: A Breast-Specialized Pathology Foundation Model for Core Needle Biopsy Diagnosis and Risk-Controlled Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Breast core needle biopsy (CNB) is central to breast cancer diagnosis yet remains challenging because limited tissue sampling, lesion heterogeneity, and subtle morphologic overlap can obscure subtype distinctions. We developed CorePath, a breast-specialized multimodal pathology foundation model fine-tuned from PRISM using 7901 paired CNB whole-slide images and diagnostic reports from two centers. Evaluated across six CNB cohorts and two public breast pathology benchmarks without task-specific retraining, CorePath consistently outperformed PRISM across cancer detection, invasion assessment, and histological subtyping. It achieved weighted area under the receiver operating characteristic curves (AUCs) of 0.9526-0.9735 for five-class CNB histological subtyping across private centers. On public benchmarks, CorePath outperformed leading pathology foundation models, achieving the highest weighted AUCs of 0.7780 for BCNB invasive carcinoma subtyping, 0.8178 for BRACS lesion stratification, and 0.8252 for BRACS fine-grained classification. In report generation, CorePath reduced the overall non-breast hallucinations from 30.1% to 2.8%, demonstrating improved domain fidelity after breast-specific adaptation. CorePath-CRG further combined conformal subtype-confidence gating with Learn-Then-Test risk control to enable selective report release, subtype-level fallback, and deferral. CorePath-CRG achieved zero non-breast hallucinations among released outputs and showed the strongest overall performance in pathologist-validated LLM-based Evaluation Scores and quantitative report-generation metrics across most centers. These results demonstrate that domain-specialized foundation models with statistical risk control offer a promising approach for accurate breast CNB diagnosis and reliable report generation.
papers.comment: The code will be made publicly available upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CorePath，一个基于 PRISM 微调的乳腺专用多模态病理基础模型，使用来自两个中心的 7901 对乳腺穿刺活检 (CNB) 全切片图像与诊断报告进行训练。在不做任务特定重训练的情况下，CorePath 在六个 CNB 队列和两个公共乳腺病理基准上持续优于 PRISM，并在五分类 CNB 组织学分型上取得加权 AUC 0.9526-0.9735；其报告生成版本 CorePath-CRG 通过 conformal subtype-confidence gating 与 Learn-Then-Test 风险控制，将非乳腺幻觉从 30.1% 降至 2.8%，并在释放报告中实现零非乳腺幻觉。
Motivation: 乳腺穿刺活检 (CNB) 是乳腺癌诊断的核心环节，但有限的取样组织、病变异质性和细微的形态重叠使得亚型区分困难，现有通用病理基础模型在乳腺专用任务上精度不足，且自动报告生成存在跨器官幻觉风险。
Method: 从 PRISM 微调得到乳腺专用多模态病理基础模型 CorePath，输入为 7901 对 CNB 全切片图像与诊断报告；并在报告生成路径上构建 CorePath-CRG，结合亚型置信度门控 (conformal subtype-confidence gating) 与 Learn-Then-Test 风险控制，实现选择性报告释放、亚型级回退 (subtype-level fallback) 与延迟处理 (deferral)。
Result: 在六个私有 CNB 队列上，五分类组织学分型的加权 AUC 为 0.9526-0.9735；在公共基准上，BCNB 浸润性癌分型加权 AUC 0.7780、BRACS 病变分层 0.8178、BRACS 细粒度分类 0.8252，均优于领先病理基础模型。报告生成中非乳腺幻觉从 30.1% 降至 2.8%，CorePath-CRG 在释放输出中实现零非乳腺幻觉，并在病理医生验证的 LLM 评估分数与定量报告指标上整体表现最强。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合统计风险控制的领域专用基础模型能为准确的乳腺 CNB 诊断与可靠报告生成提供有前景的方案；摘要强调领域适应性 (breast-specific adaptation) 显著提升域保真度，且风险控制机制保证选择性输出的安全性。

papers.title: LDU-Bench: Multimodal LLM Evaluation for Lithography Defect Understanding under Layout-Varying Circuit Backgrounds
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models have demonstrated strong defect recognition capability in industrial anomaly detection. However, in lithography review, merely determining whether an image contains a defect is insufficient for engineering inspection; models must also understand defect morphology, spatial location, and the potential causes supported by visible evidence. To this end, this paper proposes LDU-Bench, a multi-task multimodal benchmark for lithography defect understanding. Constructed from real lithography and integrated-circuit review images, LDU-Bench decomposes the review workflow into four independent tasks: defect triage, morphology recognition, coarse localization, and image-conditioned cause analysis. It systematically evaluates models using task-level metrics, diagnostic readouts, and the Lithography Closure Score (LCS). Experimental results show that although existing MLLMs can perform defect triage relatively reliably, this ability does not stably transfer to downstream review stages. Morphology alignment, effective localization, and evidence-to-cause mapping remain the major bottlenecks. Further diagnostics indicate that this capability break is not a fluctuation of a single metric, but reflects insufficient structured understanding across semantic levels. Overall, LDU-Bench provides a quantifiable and diagnostic unified platform for evaluating the usability, failure points, and capability boundaries of industrial MLLMs in lithography review chains.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LDU-Bench，一个面向光刻缺陷理解的多任务多模态大模型基准，基于真实光刻与集成电路 review 图像构建。基准将审查流程拆分为缺陷分诊 (defect triage)、形貌识别 (morphology recognition)、粗定位 (coarse localization) 和基于图像的成因分析 (image-conditioned cause analysis) 四个任务，并用任务级指标、诊断输出和 Lithography Closure Score (LCS) 进行系统评估。实验显示现有多模态大模型在缺陷分诊上相对可靠，但该能力无法稳定迁移到后续审查环节，形貌对齐、有效定位与证据到成因的映射仍是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测中的多模态大模型主要判断图像是否包含缺陷，但光刻审查需要模型进一步理解缺陷形貌、空间位置以及可见证据支持的潜在成因；缺乏能系统评估这些能力的基准。
Method: 构建 LDU-Bench 基准，将光刻审查工作流分解为四个独立任务，采用任务级指标、诊断读数和 LCS 评分，从真实光刻与集成电路 review 图像中构造数据，用于量化评估多模态大模型在光刻审查链路中的可用性与失效点。
Result: 实验表明现有 MLLM 能较可靠地完成缺陷分诊，但该能力不能稳定迁移到后续审查阶段；诊断进一步显示这种能力断裂并非单一指标波动，而是反映了模型在跨语义层次上的结构化理解不足，形貌对齐、定位和证据到成因映射是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: LDU-Bench 为工业多模态大模型在光刻审查链路中的可用性、失效点和能力边界提供了一个可量化且可诊断的统一评估平台。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AI Agent Economics: Can Autonomous Economic Behavior Emerge among AI Agents under Minimal External Conditions?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent studies commonly place AI agents in predefined games, markets, or roles, making it difficult to distinguish endogenous economic organization from behavior inherited from the scenario. We ask whether economic relations emerge when agents receive executable mechanisms for work, transfer, elections, and allocation but no prescribed social or economic strategy. We define AI Agent Economics as systems of production, allocation, consumption, exchange, and institutions that alter agents' future feasible actions. We develop a two-stage framework comprising a no-production boundary test and 24 independent six-agent worlds across GPT and DeepSeek. Without productive tasks, agents communicate and govern resource provision but show no substantive inter-agent transfer activity. With verified work and scarce task access, transfers, loans, access promises, vote-for-access exchanges, and allocation strategies emerge. Holding the election interface fixed, executable allocation authority increases differentiation while reducing failed allocation and prolonged exclusion. When energy becomes symbolic, continuation support disappears, yet competition over task access persists. These findings show that organization follows executable rights and resource consequences rather than role labels or prompt language, and motivate governance audits of the mechanisms that actually constrain agents' future actions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI Agent Economics 的概念，研究在无预定义游戏、市场或角色、仅提供可执行的工作、转移、选举和分配机制时，经济关系是否会在 AI 智能体之间自发涌现。作者设计两阶段框架，包括一个无生产任务的边界测试和 24 个独立的六智能体世界（覆盖 GPT 与 DeepSeek）。结果显示，没有生产任务时几乎不发生实质性的智能体间转移；在验证工作与稀缺任务访问条件下，转移、借贷、访问承诺、投票换访问和分配策略会出现，组织形态由可执行权利与资源后果决定。
Motivation: 现有多智能体研究常把智能体放入预定义的游戏、市场或角色中，难以区分内生经济组织与场景赋予的行为。本文针对这一空白，研究在智能体只获得可执行机制而无任何社会或经济策略时，经济关系能否涌现。
Method: 将 AI Agent Economics 定义为生产、分配、消费、交换及改变智能体未来可行行动的制度。开发两阶段框架：无生产边界测试，以及横跨 GPT 和 DeepSeek 的 24 个独立六智能体世界；智能体仅拥有工作、转移、选举和分配的可执行机制，并变化分配权限与能源（象征性）设定。
Result: 摘要报告称，无生产任务时智能体虽能沟通并管理资源供给，但没有实质性的智能体间转移活动；在验证工作与稀缺任务访问下，转移、借贷、访问承诺、投票换访问和分配策略涌现。固定选举界面时，可执行分配权限提高分化并减少失败分配与长期排除；当能源变为象征性时，延续性支持消失，但对任务访问的竞争依然存在。
Conclusion: 作者认为组织方式跟随可执行权利和资源后果，而非角色标签或提示语言，并由此主张对实际约束智能体未来行动的机制进行治理审计（governance audits）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Getting the Parameters Right: A Difficulty-Graded Benchmark and Probe-Guided Training for LLM Tool Calls
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents derive much of their capability from tool use. Existing research on tool use has largely focused on selecting the right tool and orchestrating the order of calls. However, correctly filling the parameters of a tool call is equally critical for successful execution and has received far less attention. In domains such as cloud networking, even frontier models correctly complete fewer than half of tool calls. Inspired by recent analyses showing that LLM hidden states encode rich information about model predictions, we discover that while the model generates a parameter value, its hidden state contains a strong correctness signal: a simple linear probe can accurately predict whether the value will be correct. Based on this observation, we propose a unified probe-guided framework with two complementary approaches: probe-filtered bootstrapped training (PBT), which uses the probe to filter reliable self-generated calls for fine-tuning, and probe-guided reranking (PGR), which uses the probe to select better candidates during inference. To support systematic evaluation, we release ParamBench, a benchmark built from real cloud-network APIs that categorizes every instance into five difficulty levels according to parameter nesting depth, cross-parameter dependencies, and the reasoning required to derive values from earlier calls. Extensive experiments across 5 open models on ParamBench and 6 external benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially improves parameter generation, raising the average exact match from 19.7% to 59.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）工具调用中参数填充正确性的问题，发现模型在生成参数值时，其隐藏状态包含一个强正确性信号：简单线性探针即可准确预测生成值是否正确。基于此，作者提出统一的探针引导框架，包含探针过滤的自举训练（PBT）和探针引导的重排序（PGR）两种互补方法，并发布基于真实云网络 API 构建的 ParamBench 基准，将平均精确匹配准确率从 19.7% 提升到 59.6%。
Motivation: 现有工具调用研究大多聚焦于选择正确的工具和编排调用顺序，而正确填充工具调用的参数同样关键但受到的关注较少；在云网络等领域，即使是前沿模型也有超过一半的工具调用参数无法正确完成。
Method: 提出统一的探针引导框架，包含两种互补方法：探针过滤的自举训练（probe-filtered bootstrapped training, PBT）利用探针过滤可靠的自我生成调用用于微调，探针引导的重排序（probe-guided reranking, PGR）在推理阶段用探针从候选中选择更好的结果。同时构建 ParamBench 基准，依据参数嵌套深度、跨参数依赖性和从先前调用推导值所需的推理量将实例划分为五个难度级别。
Result: 在 ParamBench 和 6 个外部基准上对 5 个开源模型进行大量实验，结果表明该方法显著改善了参数生成，平均精确匹配（exact match）从 19.7% 提高到 59.6%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 隐藏状态中编码的正确性信号可同时用于训练阶段的数据筛选和推理阶段的候选重排序，从而有效提升工具调用的参数生成质量。

papers.title: AI Security Leaderboard: Methodology, Results and Minimal Standard
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI model developers increasingly rely on layered safeguards to prevent catastrophic misuse, but little public evidence exists on how much protection these safeguards provide, or how consistently across developers. We introduce the FAR.AI Minimal Standard for Safeguards, Version 1.0: a taxonomy of 67 readily accessible static jailbreak techniques, a method for composing them into a very large attack space, and a benchmark of flagship models against a sample of it. We evaluate Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Grok 4.5 on two complementary datasets totalling 360 attacker goals spanning chemical, biological, radiological/nuclear and explosive (CBRNE) threats and offensive cyber, using a three-stage funnel to identify universal jailbreaks: single prompt templates that elicit operationally compliant responses on over 75% of a domain's goals. We also introduce a cost-to-jailbreak metric that models attacker spend directly, with right-censored lower bounds where no universal jailbreak was found. Robustness is highly uneven: the cost to break these models varies over a hundredfold. Random search over our technique pool found 63 universal jailbreaks against Grok 4.5 and 18 against Gemini 3.1 Pro, at an average cost of roughly $58 and $278 per jailbreak found; expert-guided composition raised these to 385 and 231. Neither Claude Fable 5 nor GPT-5.6 Sol yielded any universal jailbreak under either strategy. Because meeting the Minimal Standard requires only defenses already publicly described and deployed in production elsewhere, these gaps appear closable with current techniques. We recommend defense-in-depth combining reasoning, activation, and input/output monitoring. Results are maintained at leaderboard.far.ai.

Motivation: 前沿 AI 开发者日益依赖分层防护来防止灾难性滥用，但公开证据很少能说明这些防护能提供多少保护，以及不同开发者之间的防护是否一致。

papers.title: Revisiting TD Target Aggregation under Uncertainty in Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep Q-Networks (DQNs) learn value functions through bootstrapped temporal-difference updates, where future returns are approximated using a greedy maximization over next-state action values. While effective, this aggregation rule is inherently sensitive to estimation noise: when Q-values are uncertain, the maximization operator deterministically favors the largest estimate, regardless of its reliability, leading to amplified errors through bootstrapping. In this work, we propose the \textbf{S}uccessor Rollout \textbf{A}ggregation \textbf{D}eep \textbf{Q}-Network (SADQ), a simple modification to Q-learning that regularizes how the TD target is formed. SADQ uses one-step rollout predictions from a learned dynamics model to guide the comparison among candidate next-state actions, introducing additional structure into the aggregation step without altering the underlying learning framework. The resulting mixed Bellman update attenuates unreliable maxima while preserving the standard fixed point under diminishing model error. We provide theoretical analysis showing that SADQ reduces bootstrap-induced overestimation in a pointwise manner. Empirically, SADQ consistently improves training stability across classical control tasks, real-world vector-based environments, and Atari benchmarks when compared to strong DQN variants.
papers.comment: Accepted in the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 DQN 中通过贪心最大化聚合 TD 目标时对估计噪声敏感的问题，提出 Successor Rollout Aggregation Deep Q-Network (SADQ)。该方法利用从所学动力学模型得到的一步 rollout 预测来引导对下一状态候选动作的比较，从而在聚合步骤中引入额外结构，形成混合 Bellman 更新，在不改变底层学习框架的前提下减弱不可靠的最大值。理论分析表明 SADQ 能逐点降低 bootstrap 引起的过估计，实验在经典控制任务、真实向量环境与 Atari 基准上相较强 DQN 变体持续提升训练稳定性。
Motivation: Q-learning 的 TD 目标使用对下一状态动作值的贪心最大化，该聚合规则对估计噪声敏感：当 Q 值不确定时，最大化算子会确定性地偏爱最大估计而不考虑其可靠性，并通过 bootstrap 放大误差。
Method: SADQ 是对 Q-learning 的简单修改：使用来自所学动力学模型的一步 rollout 预测来引导候选下一状态动作之间的比较，形成混合 Bellman 更新，在模型误差递减时仍保持标准不动点。
Result: 理论分析显示 SADQ 以逐点方式减少 bootstrap 导致的过估计；实验表明其在经典控制任务、真实世界向量环境以及 Atari 基准上相比强 DQN 变体持续改善训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 作者强调 SADQ 在不改变底层学习框架的情况下，通过正则化 TD 目标的形成来缓解不确定最大值的影响，并保留标准 Q-learning 的不动点性质。

papers.title: CVPO: Enhancing LLM Reinforcement Learning Reasoning via Value-Variance Adaptation and Dynamic Curriculum Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective method for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods suffer from insufficient precision in feedback on generated answer trajectories and exhibit the phenomenon of problem difficulty drift. To address these challenges, we propose CVPO - Curriculum-guided Value-Variance Policy Optimization. At the response trajectory level, we find that token-level value-variance correlates with exploration intensity. Our theoretical analysis shows this variance bounds policy update magnitude. We then use the estimated trajectory value-variance to quantify the intrinsic randomness in generation. Based on this, we design a variance-aware advantage adjustment mechanism for different reward types. At the question level, we introduce a dynamic curriculum weighting method that adapts to question difficulty. This helps the model focus on tasks matched to its current ability during each training stage. Experimental results show our method outperforms strong value-based baselines like VAPO. It achieves better performance and stronger exploration, enabling more accurate and robust reasoning in language models across various math tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVPO（Curriculum-guided Value-Variance Policy Optimization），用于增强大语言模型（LLM）在数学推理任务上的强化学习（RL）微调。方法在轨迹层面用 token 级 value-variance 量化生成的内在随机性，并据此调整优势估计；在题目层面引入动态课程加权以适应题目难度。实验表明其优于 VAPO 等基于价值的方法，取得更好的性能和更强的探索能力。
Motivation: 现有 RL 方法在增强 LLM 推理能力时，对生成答案轨迹的反馈精度不足，并且存在题目难度漂移（problem difficulty drift）现象，影响训练效果。
Method: 在轨迹层面估计 value-variance 以量化生成随机性，理论分析表明该方差约束了策略更新幅度；基于此设计 variance-aware 的优势调整机制，适配不同奖励类型。在题目层面提出动态课程加权方法，使模型在每阶段聚焦于与其当前能力匹配的题目。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种数学任务上优于 VAPO 等强基于价值的基线，取得更好的性能与更强的探索能力，使推理更准确、更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 作者认为方差感知的优势调整与动态课程加权相结合，能够提升 LLM 在数学推理上的准确性和鲁棒性；摘要未明确讨论方法局限性。

papers.title: Global Graph-Validated Optimization for VLM-based 3D Indoor Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: We study open-vocabulary 3D indoor layout generation, which synthesizes diverse and physically plausible scenes from unlabeled 3D assets using free-form language instructions. Recent methods leverage large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) to generate structured scenes from text. However, most model inter-asset relations implicitly or rely on local pairwise constraints and local optimization. These formulations are poorly aligned with the global, highly non-convex layout space, often yielding locally plausible yet globally inconsistent or physically infeasible scenes. We address this problem with a graph-based intermediate representation that separates semantic coherence from physical feasibility, together with a hybrid search-and-refinement strategy. First, Global Semantic Verification (GSV) represents scenes as structured graphs and enforces semantic constraints through rule-based verification. This explicit validation removes contradictory configurations and produces a globally consistent semantic scaffold. Second, Global Physical Feasibility Search (GPFS) combines evolutionary search for global exploration with gradient-based refinement for local exploitation. It reduces dependence on VLM-proposed initialization and improves robustness in non-convex and discontinuous feasible spaces. Together, GSV and GPFS move layout generation beyond local relational modeling and initialization-sensitive optimization toward globally consistent reasoning and search. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary 3D indoor layout generation, improving both semantic consistency and physical plausibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放词表 (open-vocabulary) 的 3D 室内布局生成任务，即根据自由形式的语言指令从未标注的 3D 资产中合成多样且物理上合理的场景。作者提出基于图的中间表示将语义一致性与物理可行性分离，并结合全局语义验证 (GSV) 与全局物理可行性搜索 (GPFS) 的混合搜索-精炼策略。摘要报告该方法在开放词表 3D 室内布局生成上达到 state-of-the-art，同时提升语义一致性与物理合理性。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM/VLM 的场景生成方法大多隐式建模资产间关系，或依赖局部成对约束和局部优化，与全局、高度非凸的布局空间不对齐，容易产生局部合理但全局不一致或物理不可行的场景。
Method: 提出图结构中间表示，将语义一致性与物理可行性解耦；GSV 将场景表示为结构图并通过基于规则的验证强制语义约束，移除矛盾配置；GPFS 结合进化搜索的全局探索与梯度精炼的局部利用，降低对 VLM 初始化的依赖，增强非凸和不连续可行空间中的鲁棒性。
Result: 实验表明该方法在开放词表 3D 室内布局生成任务上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，语义一致性与物理可行性均有提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GSV 与 GPFS 将布局生成从局部关系建模和初始化敏感的优化推向全局一致的推理与搜索。

papers.title: TraceCAD: Trace-Guided Repair for Agentic CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based CAD agents produce executable parametric programs, but their correction loops may lose evidence about satisfied requirements, faulty operations, and prior repairs. We introduce TraceCAD, a recovery layer that links requested features, modeling steps, failure evidence, and candidate outcomes as persistent state. TraceCAD diagnoses likely faulty operations, searches bounded edits in their dependency regions, validates candidates through execution and preservation checks, and retains successful and failed repair outcomes in reusable skill memory. On DeepCAD-derived benchmarks with 200-model ablations and a 1K-model comparison, TraceCAD achieves competitive geometric quality in terms of IoU, Chamfer distance, and Hausdorff distance. Removing persistent state nearly halves recovery score; removing localized search more than doubles geometric regression and doubles code-agent invocations. Initializing the skill store on disjoint training models further reduces retries, token cost, and latency. These results demonstrate that persistent, localized, and reusable recovery improves final CAD quality and repair reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceCAD，一个面向 LLM 驱动的 CAD 生成代理的修复层 (recovery layer)。它将需求特征、建模步骤、失败证据和候选结果组织为持久状态，用于诊断故障操作、在依赖区域内搜索有界编辑，并通过执行与保留检查验证候选，同时把成功和失败的修复存入可复用技能记忆。在 DeepCAD 派生基准上的 200 模型消融和 1K 模型对比中，TraceCAD 在 IoU、Chamfer 距离和 Hausdorff 距离上达到有竞争力的几何质量；移除持久状态几乎使修复分数减半，移除局部搜索则使几何回退翻倍以上并使代码代理调用翻倍。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的 CAD 代理生成可执行参数化程序，但其修复循环可能丢失关于已满足需求、故障操作和既往修复的证据，导致修复过程不可靠。
Method: 引入 TraceCAD 作为恢复层，将请求特征、建模步骤、失败证据和候选结果关联为持久状态；据此诊断疑似故障操作，在其依赖区域搜索有界编辑，通过执行和保留检查验证候选，并将成功与失败的修复结果保存在可复用的技能记忆中。
Result: 在 DeepCAD 派生基准上，TraceCAD 的几何质量（IoU、Chamfer 距离、Hausdorff 距离）具有竞争力；消融显示移除持久状态几乎使恢复分数减半，移除局部搜索使几何回归翻倍以上并使代码代理调用翻倍；用不相交训练模型初始化技能库可进一步减少重试、token 成本和延迟。
Conclusion: 作者认为持久、局部化且可复用的恢复机制能够提升最终 CAD 质量和修复可靠性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 DeepCAD 派生基准上，TraceCAD 的几何质量（IoU、Chamfer 距离、Hausdorff 距离）具有竞争力；消融显示移除持久状态几乎使恢复分数减半，移除局部搜索使几何回归翻倍以上并使代码代理调用翻倍；用不相交训练模型初始化技能库可进一步减少重试、token 成本和延迟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为持久、局部化且可复用的恢复机制能够提升最终 CAD 质量和修复可靠性。

papers.title: RIDGE: Re-Noising with Internal Dynamic Guidance for Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Inversion-free flow-based image editing avoids latent inversion, but still requires a target-side state at every editing step. The widely used equal-displacement construction keeps the displacement between the noisy source state and the target-side state unchanged across noise levels. This is inconsistent with noising, under which the displacement between two clean states noised with the same noise level and noise sample should contract as the noise level increases. Thus, it can lead to overly aggressive updates at high noise levels. We introduce RIDGE: Re-Noising with Internal Dynamic Guidance for Image Editing, an inversion-free and training-free method that maintains the edited state as an evolving approximation to the unavailable clean target state. RIDGE re-noises this approximation using the same noise level and noise sample as the clean source state, allowing their noisy displacement to decrease naturally with increasing noise. Since the edited state initially contains limited target semantics, RIDGE further applies internal dynamic guidance during the early high-noise steps. A clean target state prediction guides the provisional edited state through a soft dynamic mask derived internally from the model, focusing guidance on regions that require modification without external segmentation or detection models. Experiments on two benchmarks using two backbones, SD3 Medium and FLUX.1-dev, show that RIDGE offers a favorable aggregate trade-off among source preservation, target alignment, and perceptual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RIDGE，一种无反转（inversion-free）且无需训练（training-free）的流式图像编辑方法。RIDGE 把编辑状态维护为对不可得干净目标状态的演化近似，并用与干净源状态相同的噪声水平和噪声样本对其重新加噪，使噪声位移随噪声水平增加自然收缩。在 SD3 Medium 和 FLUX.1-dev 两个骨干网络上的实验显示，该方法在源保留、目标对齐和感知质量之间取得有利的整体权衡。
Motivation: 现有无反转流式图像编辑需要目标侧状态，常用的等位移构造使噪声源状态与目标侧状态之间的位移在各噪声水平下保持不变，这与真实加噪过程不一致；随着噪声水平升高，两个干净状态的加噪位移本应收缩，因此等位移构造会导致高噪声水平下更新过于激进。
Method: RIDGE 将编辑状态作为对目标干净状态的动态近似，利用相同噪声水平和噪声样本对该近似重新加噪，令其与源状态的噪声位移随噪声增加自然减小；在早期高噪声步骤中，使用模型内部导出的软动态掩码（soft dynamic mask）施加内部动态引导，将引导集中于需要修改的区域，无需外部分割或检测模型。
Result: 在两个基准上使用 SD3 Medium 和 FLUX.1-dev 两个骨干网络的实验表明，RIDGE 在源保留、目标对齐和感知质量之间提供了有利的整体权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RIDGE 通过重新加噪与内部动态引导解决了等位移构造与加噪过程不一致的问题，是一种无反转、无需训练的图像编辑方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TASQ: Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Static quantization assigns one weight precision to every denoising step. To preserve quality, that precision must accommodate the most quantization-sensitive step, even though many other steps can tolerate fewer bits. The resulting model may satisfy its memory budget, but it repeatedly pays worst-case arithmetic throughout the denoising trajectory. We introduce Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization (TASQ) to separate these two costs. TASQ stores one shared maximum-precision weight buffer and learns a Temporal-Spatial LSB Mask that selects a lower effective precision for each layer and denoising stage by truncating least-significant bits. Storage therefore remains fixed by the worst case, while BitOPs decrease at less sensitive stages without per-stage weight copies or runtime search. A Temporal-Precision Engine maps the learned schedule to bit-serial execution, where cycles scale with effective precision and switching precision has no measured cycle overhead. On PixArt-Sigma, SANA-1.6B, and SDXL-Turbo, TASQ achieves quality comparable to static quantization with less computation. Together with the Temporal-Precision Engine, it reduces execution cycles by 25 to 50 percent over static quantization and by 6.1 to 7.5x over a naive static 8-bit bit-serial execution. Code is available at https://github.com/seokho-han/tasq.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型去噪轨迹中静态量化重复支付最坏情况算术开销的问题，提出 Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization (TASQ)。TASQ 存储一个共享的最大精度权重缓冲区，并学习一个时间-空间 LSB 掩码，通过截断最低有效位为每一层和每个去噪阶段选择更低的有效精度，从而在不复制权重、不进行运行时搜索的前提下降低位操作数。配合 Temporal-Precision Engine 将学习到的调度映射到位串行执行，切换精度无额外周期开销。在 PixArt-Sigma、SANA-1.6B 和 SDXL-Turbo 上，TASQ 在保持与静态量化相当质量的同时减少计算量。
Motivation: 静态量化为所有去噪步骤分配单一权重精度，为了保持质量必须迁就量化最敏感的步骤，导致许多本可容忍更低比特的步骤也持续执行最坏情况的算术运算，计算效率低下。
Method: 提出 TASQ，包含一个共享的最大精度权重缓冲区和可学习的 Temporal-Spatial LSB Mask，通过截断最低有效位为每层与每个去噪阶段选取有效精度；同时设计 Temporal-Precision Engine，将学习到的精度调度映射到 bit-serial 执行，使执行周期随有效精度缩放，且切换精度无测量到的周期开销。
Result: 在 PixArt-Sigma、SANA-1.6B 和 SDXL-Turbo 上，TASQ 实现与静态量化相当的质量，并与 Temporal-Precision Engine 结合后将执行周期相对静态量化减少 25% 至 50%，相对朴素静态 8-bit bit-serial 执行减少 6.1 至 7.5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TASQ 将存储成本与计算成本分离：存储由最坏情况固定，计算在较不敏感阶段降低，无需逐阶段权重副本或运行时搜索。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PDD-RRG: Posterior Diagnostic Decision for Study-level Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to simulate the workflow of radiologists, assisting them in clinical diagnosis. However, existing methods often fall short in utilizing all information relevant to the examination, as is typically done in clinical practice. Although some works attempt to incorporate multi-view images and historical data, these additional inputs may sometimes lead to avoidable diagnostic errors on the contrary. To address these challenges, we introduce a decision-making stage after report generation for the first time and propose a Posterior Diagnostic Decision framework (PDD-RRG) to integrate potentially conflicting diagnoses. Specifically, we create various subsets of input data and utilize an existing RRG model to generate reports from different perspectives. Then the Bayesian posterior probability and the learned thresholds for each clinical observation are calculated to obtain an aggregated diagnostic conclusion, which is subsequently used to refine the generated report. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR demonstrate that our proposed PDD-RRG can effectively enhance the clinical efficacy of existing RRG models without any retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PDD-RRG，首次在放射学报告生成（RRG）之后引入决策阶段，用于整合多视角影像与历史数据可能产生的冲突诊断。作者构造多种输入数据子集，用现有 RRG 模型从不同视角生成报告，再依据贝叶斯后验概率与学习阈值得到聚合诊断结论，并用其细化报告。在 MIMIC-CXR 上的实验显示，无需重新训练即可提升现有 RRG 模型的临床效能。
Motivation: 现有 RRG 方法未充分利用检查相关的一切信息，而引入多视角影像与历史数据有时反而导致可避免的诊断错误；作者针对如何整合可能冲突的诊断结论这一空缺，在报告生成后加入决策阶段。
Method: 构造多种输入数据子集并利用现有 RRG 模型从不同视角生成报告；为每个临床观察计算贝叶斯后验概率与学习阈值，得到聚合诊断结论；随后将该结论用于细化最终生成的报告。
Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 上，PDD-RRG 可以不经任何重训练就有效增强现有 RRG 模型的临床效能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调后验诊断决策阶段能够整合冲突诊断并改善 RRG 的临床效果，且可作为附加模块适配已有模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Music Style for Piano Arrangement Through Cross-Modal Bootstrapping
papers.abstract_en: What is music style? Though often described using text labels such as "swing," "classical," or "emotional," the real style remains implicit and hidden in concrete music examples. In this paper, we introduce a cross-modal framework that learns implicit music styles from raw audio and applies them to symbolic music generation. Inspired by BLIP-2, our model leverages a Querying Transformer (Q-Former) to extract style representations from a large, pre-trained audio language model (LM), and further applies them to condition a symbolic LM for generating piano arrangements. We adopt a two-stage training strategy: contrastive learning to align auditory style with symbolic expression, followed by generative modeling for music arrangement. Our model generates piano performances jointly conditioned on a lead sheet (content) and a reference audio example (style), enabling controllable and stylistically faithful arrangement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in piano cover generation, style transfer, and audio-to-MIDI retrieval, achieving substantial improvements in style-aware alignment and music quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个跨模态框架，从原始音频中学习隐式音乐风格，并将其应用于符号音乐生成中的钢琴编曲任务。受 BLIP-2 启发，模型用 Querying Transformer (Q-Former) 从预训练音频语言模型 (audio LM) 提取风格表征，再条件化一个符号语言模型 (symbolic LM) 生成钢琴演奏。训练采用两阶段策略：先用对比学习对齐听觉风格与符号表达，再做生成式建模。摘要报告该方法在钢琴翻唱生成、风格迁移和 audio-to-MIDI 检索上有效，提升了风格感知对齐与音乐质量。
Motivation: 音乐风格虽常用文本标签（如“摇摆”“古典”“情感化”）描述，但真实风格隐含在具体音乐样例中，难以显式建模。本文针对如何从原始音频学习隐式风格并将其用于符号音乐生成这一缺口，旨在实现可控且风格忠实的钢琴编曲。
Method: 提出受 BLIP-2 启发的跨模态框架，利用 Q-Former 从预训练音频语言模型中提取风格表征，并将其作为条件输入到符号语言模型生成钢琴编排。训练分两阶段：对比学习 (contrastive learning) 对齐听觉风格与符号表达，随后进行音乐编排的生成式建模。模型以主旋律谱 (lead sheet) 为内容、参考音频为风格，联合条件生成钢琴演奏。
Result: 实验在钢琴翻唱生成、风格迁移和 audio-to-MIDI 检索任务上验证了方法的有效性，摘要称在风格感知对齐和音乐质量上取得了实质性提升，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要的主要结论是：音乐风格可从原始音频中通过跨模态引导方式学习，并有效迁移到符号音乐生成；该方法面向钢琴编曲场景，已被 ISMIR 2026 接收。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PI-Mem: Pushing Long-Context Reasoning to 3.6M Tokens with Parallel-Iterative Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning remains a critical bottleneck for large language models, as recent recurrent-memory approaches face two inherent challenges: sequential chunk-wise updates can overwrite early critical evidence with later irrelevant content, and serial inter-chunk dependencies limit parallelism and cause latency to increase with context length. To address these issues, we propose PI-Mem (Parallel-Iterative Memory), a mechanism that processes all chunks in parallel and iteratively refines a shared memory over a bounded number of turns. In each turn, PI-Mem reads all chunks in parallel conditioned on the current memory, selects new or complementary evidence from each chunk, and merges the selected evidence into a compact shared memory for the next turn. To discourage redundant turns, we optimize the workflow through reinforcement learning with an auxiliary turn-efficiency reward, enabling the model to adaptively exit once sufficient evidence has been accumulated. We evaluate PI-Mem with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen2.5-7B on the HotpotQA benchmark across context lengths up to 3.6 million tokens and find that it outperforms the recurrent-memory baseline by +6.25 and +7.81 absolute points while achieving 6.1$\times$ and 2.1$\times$ inference speedups, respectively. These results demonstrate that PI-Mem breaks the accuracy--efficiency trade-off in long-context reasoning and provides a scalable approach to complex multi-hop question answering over extremely long documents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PI-Mem（Parallel-Iterative Memory），一种面向超长上下文推理的并行迭代记忆机制。它并行处理所有分块，并在有限轮次内迭代精炼共享记忆；为抑制冗余轮次，用强化学习配合轮次效率奖励让模型自适应提前退出。在 HotpotQA 上评估了最长 3.6M token 的上下文，声称在准确率和推理速度上同时超越递归记忆基线，并指出该方法可扩展到超长文档的复杂多跳问答。
Motivation: 递归记忆（recurrent-memory）方法在长上下文推理中有两个固有挑战：顺序的分块更新可能用后期不相关内容覆盖早期关键证据；分块间串行依赖限制并行性，使延迟随上下文长度增加。
Method: PI-Mem 将所有分块并行处理，并在有界轮次内迭代精炼一个共享记忆：每一轮在当前记忆条件下并行读取所有分块，从每个分块选取新的或互补的证据，再合并为下一轮的紧凑共享记忆。训练时通过强化学习加入辅助的轮次效率奖励，使模型在证据充分后能自适应退出。
Result: 使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 和 Qwen2.5-7B，在 HotpotQA 上覆盖最长 3.6M token 的上下文，PI-Mem 相比递归记忆基线分别带来 +6.25 和 +7.81 个绝对点的提升，同时取得 6.1 倍和 2.1 倍的推理加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PI-Mem 打破了长上下文推理中准确率与效率之间的权衡，为超长文档上的复杂多跳问答提供可扩展的方案。

papers.title: AIDE: Automated Instruction via Distilled Expertise for Reference-Free Motor Skill Coaching
papers.abstract_en: Generating natural-language coaching feedback on motor skills can accelerate learning, yet expert coaches are scarce and expensive. Existing reference-based methods require expert demonstrations at both training and inference time, limiting practical deployment. We propose AIDE (Automated Instruction via Distilled Expertise), a framework that exploits expert references only during training and generates feedback from a learner's pose sequence alone at inference. A teacher model first learns to generate feedback from paired learner-expert poses via a frozen language model, producing separate learner tokens and difference tokens that encode the learner-expert difference. A student model then inherits the teacher's encoder and weight initialization, replacing the explicit expert comparison with an auxiliary module that produces complementary tokens from the learner's pose alone. On the ExpertAF dataset, AIDE outperforms reference-free baselines on most metrics and performs comparably to methods requiring expert demonstrations at both training and inference, with LLM-based evaluation supporting these findings.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026. 12 pages (including supplementary material), 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AIDE，一个面向运动技能教练反馈生成的框架，只在训练阶段利用专家示范，推理时仅根据学习者的姿态序列生成自然语言反馈。框架包含一个基于冻结语言模型的教师模型，从配对的学习者-专家姿态中生成学习者 token 与差异 token；学生模型继承教师编码器与权重初始化，并用辅助模块从学习者姿态单独生成互补 token，从而去掉推理期的专家对比。在 ExpertAF 数据集上，AIDE 在多数指标上优于无参考基线，并与训练和推理阶段都需要专家示范的方法表现相当。
Motivation: 运动技能教练反馈可以加速学习，但专家教练稀缺且昂贵；现有基于参考的方法在训练和推理时都需要专家示范，限制了实际部署。
Method: AIDE 采用两阶段蒸馏：教师模型用配对的学习者-专家姿态编码出学习者 token 和差异 token（differencetokens），学生模型继承教师编码器与初始化，并用辅助模块从学习者单方姿态生成互补 token，实现无参考推理。
Result: 在 ExpertAF 数据集上，AIDE 在多数指标上超过无参考基线，性能接近训练和推理都需专家示范的方法，LLM 评估也支持这些结论。
Conclusion: 该方法证明专家参考只需在训练时使用即可获得接近全程参考方法的反馈质量，推理时无需专家示范，有利于实际部署。

papers.title: CAPE-T2V: Captioner-Anchored Prompt Enhancement toward Two-Sided Conditioning Alignment in Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion transformers (DiTs) are trained with detailed video captions, whereas inference often relies on user prompts rewritten by a prompt enhancer (PE). Prior work has improved generation by optimizing the PE, the DiT, or both; some methods have also sought to narrow the training-inference mismatch through shared schemas. Yet even within a shared schema, inference-time PE outputs and DiT training captions may still differ in detail selection, information organization, descriptive granularity, and phrasing. We refer to this residual mismatch as the PE-Caption gap and introduce CAPE-T2V, a two-step Captioner-Anchored Prompt Enhancement framework toward two-sided conditioning alignment in T2V generation. First, CAPE-T2V constructs three types of PE training examples, pairing captioner-generated targets with concise source captions, detailed source captions, or pseudo user prompts derived from those targets. It then fine-tunes the PE to map each input to its paired target. Second, CAPE-T2V fine-tunes the DiT on video-derived captions rewritten by the Anchored PE; the same PE rewrites user prompts at inference. Relative to a baseline using the same caption schema, CAPE-T2V achieves higher aggregate scores on StoryEval, VBench-2.0, and T2V-CompBench across Wan2.2 and LTX-2.3. Further, CAPE-T2V exhibits a smaller PE-Caption gap than the baseline: its DiT fine-tuning captions are closer in distribution to inference-time PE outputs, as measured by squared maximum mean discrepancy in a fixed embedding space. Overall, these results support CAPE-T2V as an effective approach to mitigating the PE-Caption gap. The project is available at https://github.com/yizzz927/CAPE-T2V.
papers.comment: Includes appendix; 11 figures. Project page: https://github.com/yizzz927/CAPE-T2V
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文生视频 (text-to-video, T2V) 中扩散 Transformer (DiT) 的推理-训练不匹配问题，提出 PE-Caption gap 这一残余差异，并引入 CAPE-T2V 两阶段 Captioner-Anchored Prompt Enhancement 框架：先构造三类 PE 训练样本并对 PE 微调，再用该 PE 重写的视频标题微调 DiT，推理时同一 PE 改写用户提示。摘要报告在 StoryEval、VBench-2.0、T2V-CompBench 上相对同标题 schema 的基线取得更高聚合分数，且 PE-Caption gap 更小。
Motivation: T2V DiT 用详细视频标题训练，而推理时依赖提示增强器 (PE) 改写的用户提示；即使使用共享 schema，PE 输出与 DiT 训练标题在细节选取、信息组织、描述粒度与措辞上仍存在残余差异，作者称之为 PE-Caption gap，并认为它限制生成质量。
Method: CAPE-T2V 分两步：第一步构建三类 PE 训练样本，将 captioner 生成的目标与简洁源标题、详细源标题或由目标派生的伪用户提示配对，微调 PE 使其把输入映射到配对目标；第二步用 Anchored PE 重写的视频派生标题微调 DiT，并在推理阶段用同一 PE 改写用户提示。
Result: 与采用同一 caption schema 的基线相比，CAPE-T2V 在 Wan2.2 和 LTX-2.3 上于 StoryEval、VBench-2.0、T2V-CompBench 取得更高的聚合分数；同时其 PE-Caption gap 更小，即 DiT 微调标题与推理时 PE 输出的分布在固定嵌入空间中的平方最大均值差异 (squared MMD) 更低。
Conclusion: 结果表明 CAPE-T2V 是缓解 PE-Caption gap 的有效途径。项目代码与页面见 https://github.com/yizzz927/CAPE-T2V。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Exploiting Separability in Multi-Scale Grey-Box Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We consider grey-box optimization problems where the decision variables naturally partition into black-box variables (as arguments to an expensive black-box function) and white-box variables, governed by a set of explicit, closed-form equations that also depend on the output of the black-box function. We exploit this separability through a bilevel reformulation: an outer Bayesian optimization (BO) to optimize the scalar objective as a function of black-box variables alone, while an inner problem solves the white-box subproblem via global optimization. The Gaussian process surrogate used in BO is therefore defined rather than and white-box constraints are satisfied exactly whenever the inner optimizer converges to a feasible point---without penalty functions, chance constraints, or moment approximations. On a suite of 13 benchmark problems, bilevel BO achieves lower regret, with fewer iterations and wall clock time. This advantage is robust to initialization set size, exploration parameters, and inner-solver choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对决策变量自然划分为黑箱变量和白箱变量的灰箱优化问题，利用这种可分性提出双层重表述：外层用贝叶斯优化（BO）优化仅依赖于黑箱变量的标量目标，内层用全局优化求解白箱子问题。高斯过程代理只定义在黑箱变量上，当内层优化器收敛到可行点时白箱约束被精确满足，无需罚函数、机会约束或矩近似。在 13 个基准问题上，双层 BO 以更少的迭代次数和更短的墙钟时间取得更低 regret，且对初始化规模、探索参数和内层求解器选择具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 灰箱优化中黑箱变量与白箱变量并存，但现有处理方式常借助罚函数、机会约束或矩近似来近似满足白箱约束，缺乏对问题可分性的直接利用，导致效率与解的可行性受损。
Method: 提出双层重表述：外层执行贝叶斯优化（BO）优化黑箱变量上的标量目标，内层通过全局优化求解白箱子问题；高斯过程代理定义在黑箱变量空间而非全部变量空间，白箱约束在内层收敛到可行点时被精确满足。
Result: 在 13 个基准问题组成的测试集上，双层 BO 相比基线实现了更低 regret，且所需迭代次数和墙钟时间更少；该优势对初始化集大小、探索参数和内层求解器选择均稳健。
Conclusion: 本文表明显式利用黑箱/白箱变量的可分性并采用双层结构，可以在无惩罚或近似约束处理的情况下实现精确可行解和更高优化效率；其适用性依赖于灰箱结构的存在以及内层优化器能收敛到可行点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emulate or Estimate? The Divergent Strengths of Base and Post-Trained Language Models for Opinion Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate human opinions, but prior work reports conflicting results: some studies find promising alignment with human survey data, while others find persona collapse and weak demographic sensitivity. We show that much of this conflict stems from conflating two distinct tasks. We call the first task emulation, in which models generate individual responses that aggregate into a population distribution. We call the second task estimation, in which models directly predict the population distribution. Evaluating six matched base and post-trained models on the Pew American Trends Panel, we find that base models are stronger emulators: they produce response distributions closer to human ground truth and better preserve demographic structure. Post-trained models are stronger estimators, producing more accurate distributional predictions when asked directly. We propose that model selection for human simulation should be guided by whether the task requires generating text or predicting distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出关于大语言模型模拟人类意见的冲突结果源于混淆了两种不同任务：emulation（生成个体响应以聚合成总体分布）与 estimation（直接预测总体分布）。作者在 Pew American Trends Panel 上评估六对匹配的 base 与 post-trained 模型，发现 base 模型更擅长 emulation，而 post-trained 模型更擅长 estimation，并据此建议按任务类型选择模型。
Motivation: 先前研究对 LLM 模拟人类意见的效果报告相互矛盾：有的发现与人类调查数据吻合良好，有的则发现 persona collapse 和人口统计敏感性弱。作者认为这些冲突主要源于没有区分 emulation 和 estimation 这两个任务。
Method: 作者将意见模拟明确划分为两个任务：emulation 要求模型生成个体响应并聚合为总体分布，estimation 要求模型直接预测总体分布。在 Pew American Trends Panel 上，作者系统评估了六个匹配的 base 与 post-trained 模型。
Result: 摘要报告 base 模型是更强的模拟器（emulator），其响应分布更接近人类真实分布并更好地保留人口统计结构；post-trained 模型是更强的估计器（estimator），在被直接询问时产生的分布预测更准确。
Conclusion: 作者提出人类模拟的模型选择应取决于任务类型：需要生成文本时优先选择 base 模型，需要预测分布时优先选择 post-trained 模型。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 base 模型是更强的模拟器（emulator），其响应分布更接近人类真实分布并更好地保留人口统计结构；post-trained 模型是更强的估计器（estimator），在被直接询问时产生的分布预测更准确。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者提出人类模拟的模型选择应取决于任务类型：需要生成文本时优先选择 base 模型，需要预测分布时优先选择 post-trained 模型。

papers.title: PLAN: Parallel Liquid-Inspired Approximation Network for Efficient Representation Learning in Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches for flexible job shop scheduling (FJSP) heavily rely on attention-centric architectures to achieve state-of-the-art performance. However, these models suffer from excessive parameter counts and prohibitive inference latency as problem scales expand. While liquid neural networks (LNNs) offer a parameter-efficient alternative for modeling adaptive state evolution, their inherently sequential dynamics bottleneck computational efficiency. To resolve this trade-off, we propose PLAN (Parallel Liquid-inspired Approximation Network), a lightweight representation learning framework that reformulates continuous liquid-state dynamics into a discretized and parallelizable formulation. PLAN structurally decouples state evolution from context aggregation, where liquid-inspired updates handle the primary evolving state representation, and a lightweight context aggregation module provides complementary global context. Furthermore, PLAN acts as a versatile, plug-and-play backbone that generalizes to complex FJSP variants, pairing with a compact stochastic module for stochastic FJSP and replacing heavy heterogeneous graph transformers in multi-faceted dynamic FJSP. Extensive evaluations across deterministic, stochastic, and multi-faceted dynamic FJSP benchmarks show that PLAN reduces the average makespan by 1.2%, 1.4%, and 2.3%, respectively, compared with the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines, with the improvement reaching 10.2% in one benchmark setting. PLAN also reduces average inference latency by 13.2%, 31.7%, and 26.9%, respectively, with a maximum reduction of 69.2% on the largest instances, while using only 22$-$47% of the baseline parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PLAN（Parallel Liquid-inspired Approximation Network），一个面向柔性作业车间调度（FJSP）的轻量级表示学习框架。PLAN 将液态神经网络（LNN）的连续状态动力学重构为离散化、可并行的形式，并把状态演化与上下文聚合解耦，从而在保持参数效率的同时提升推理速度。作为即插即用的主干，PLAN 可搭配紧凑随机模块处理随机 FJSP，并替代重型异构图表征用于多面动态 FJSP。实验显示其在多种 FJSP 基准上降低平均 makespan 和推理延迟，同时大幅减少参数量。
Motivation: 现有基于深度强化学习（DRL）的 FJSP 方法依赖注意力架构，随问题规模扩大出现参数过多与推理延迟过大的问题；液态神经网络虽然参数高效，但其顺序动力学限制了计算效率。
Method: PLAN 将连续液体状态动力学转化为离散化且可并行的公式，结构上解耦状态演化与上下文聚合：液态启发更新负责主演化状态表示，轻量上下文聚合模块补充全局上下文；它作为通用即插即用主干，可适配随机 FJSP 和动态 FJSP 变体。
Result: 在确定性、随机和多面动态 FJSP 基准上，PLAN 相比对应 SOTA 基线平均 makespan 分别降低 1.2%、1.4% 和 2.3%，其中一个基准设置提升达 10.2%；平均推理延迟分别降低 13.2%、31.7% 和 26.9%，最大实例上降低 69.2%，且仅使用基线 22%–47% 的参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PLAN 在参数效率和推理延迟方面的优势，并指出其作为轻量主干能够泛化到多种复杂 FJSP 变体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Recent Sharp Rise in Inhomogeneous Hydrological Extremes Stress Vegetation Growth in China
papers.abstract_en: The intensifying spatial inhomogeneity of rainfall under greenhouse warming implies that more inhomogeneous hydrological extremes (IHEs), i.e., coexistence of extreme rainfall or drought, may be triggered. While vegetation growth in China is sensitive to hydrological hazards, the variability of IHEs and their ecological impacts remain underexplored. Here, we find a significant increase in IHEs during China's growing season since 2000 (+2.1 events or +14.52 days per decade), with a rapid sharp rise to an annual average of 6.4 events or 42.0 days in the past five years. The primary driver is the enhanced inhomogeneity of moisture-dynamic coupled weather conditions, overlapping with a northward shift of climatological precipitation distribution. This results in a "Wet-North and Dry-South" pattern of IHE impacts, which poses severe and asymmetric threats to vegetation growth in China, with the expansion of drought areas exerts stronger stress on vegetation than the compensatory effects of rainfall. Our findings suggest that the sharp rises of IHEs tend to yield net negative impacts on vegetation growth, highlighting the need for stronger hydrological management to reduce future risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究中国生长季"非均匀水文极端事件"（IHEs，即极端降水与干旱并存）的长期变化及其对植被的影响。摘要报告2000年以来IHEs显著增加（每十年+2.1事件或+14.52天），近五年年均达6.4事件或42天，主因是湿度-动力耦合天气条件的不均匀性增强以及气候降水分布北移。该变化形成"北湿南干"的影响格局，干旱面积扩张对植被的胁迫强于降水的补偿作用，总体上对植被生长呈净负面影响。
Motivation: 温室增暖下降雨的空间不均匀性增强，可能诱发更多IHEs，但中国区域IHEs的变率及其生态影响尚未被充分研究。
Method: 分析中国生长季IHEs的长期变化趋势，将其归因于湿度-动力耦合天气条件不均匀性增强和气候降水分布北移，并评估IHEs对植被生长的空间格局影响。
Result: 摘要报告2000年以来IHEs显著增加（+2.1事件或+14.52天/十年），近五年快速增长至年均6.4事件或42天；影响呈"北湿南干"格局，干旱对植被的胁迫超过降水补偿效应，整体净负面影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调IHEs的急剧上升趋于对植被生长产生净负面影响，提出需要加强水文管理以降低未来风险。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: LLM Serving in the Wild: An Empirical Study of Frameworks, Methods, and System Designs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are integrated into software systems and AI services, making efficient LLM serving a concern for software engineering. Serving LLMs is challenging because inference requires computation, memory, GPU resources, and execution while maintaining latency and throughput. Although prior research has proposed LLM inference, optimization, and serving techniques and frameworks, little is known about how they are adopted in practice. In this study, we investigate the use of LLM serving frameworks and serving methods in open-source software systems. We identify and analyze five LLM-specific frameworks: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, LMDeploy, and FlashInfer. We examine how these frameworks and techniques are adopted individually and in combination, how adoption varies across categories of LLMs, and how repositories differ in intent, focus, use case, and architectural design. Our results show that vLLM is the most visible framework in popularity and adoption, while parallel computation, memory management, and network pruning are the most frequently used serving-method categories. Multi-framework usage is limited, suggesting that developers rely on a single serving framework; however, combined frameworks connect complementary capabilities across the serving stack. Framework adoption varies across model families, modalities, model sizes, domain specializations, and deployment settings. Repository-level analysis shows that LLM serving frameworks support applications and architectures, including Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based reasoning, multimodal generation and understanding, microservices, and cloud infrastructure. Overall, this study provides a large-scale empirical characterization of LLM serving framework adoption in practice and offers insights for researchers, framework maintainers, and practitioners working on LLM systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对开源软件系统中 LLM 服务框架与方法采用情况的大规模实证研究。作者识别并分析了五个 LLM 专用服务框架：vLLM、SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、LMDeploy 和 FlashInfer，考察它们单独及组合使用的方式、在不同 LLM 类别间的采用差异，以及仓库的意图、重点、用例和架构设计。结果显示 vLLM 在流行度和采用度上最突出，并行计算、内存管理和网络剪枝是最常用的服务方法类别，多框架组合使用有限。
Motivation: 尽管已有大量 LLM 推理、优化和服务技术及框架被提出，但对其在实践中的实际采用情况知之甚少。该研究旨在填补这一空白，为软件工程和 LLM 系统相关的研究者与实践者提供实证依据。
Method: 对开源软件系统开展大规模实证研究，识别并分析五个 LLM 专用服务框架（vLLM、SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、LMDeploy、FlashInfer），考察这些框架和技术的单独及组合采用模式，以及采用情况如何随 LLM 类别、仓库意图、关注点、用例和架构设计而变化。
Result: 研究结果表明 vLLM 在流行度和采用度上最明显，并行计算、内存管理和网络剪枝是最常用的服务方法类别；多框架使用有限，开发者倾向于依赖单一服务框架，但组合框架会连接服务栈中的互补能力。采用情况在模型家族、模态、模型大小、领域专业化和部署设置之间表现出差异。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了 LLM 服务框架在实际中采用情况的大规模经验刻画，并为研究人员、框架维护者及从事 LLM 系统构建的从业者提供见解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PACE: Adaptive Budget Allocation for Time-Efficient Embodied Planning
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-enhanced large language models have achieved remarkable improvements in planning tasks, yet their deployment in embodied systems remains impractical due to prohibitive inference delays-often exceeding minutes per planning instance. The fundamental bottleneck stems from the serial nature of existing paradigms: models must complete all reasoning before any action execution, leaving execution time windows entirely unexploited. We introduce PACE (Planning with Adaptive Cognitive Effort), a framework that enables interleaved reasoning and execution through two key innovations: an Interleaved Think-Act architecture that pipelines cognitive processing with action execution, and a Dynamic Budget Allocator that adapts reasoning token budgets to available execution time windows. On the Robotouille benchmark using Qwen3-8B-AWQ, PACE achieves a 10% success rate-representing a 67% improvement over the ReAct+Think baseline-while delivering 6.9 times acceleration in thinking time compared to unconstrained reasoning. The framework hides 66.8% of thinking time within execution windows, demonstrating that strategic cognitive effort allocation can simultaneously improve both planning quality and time efficiency. These results provide evidence that time-aware architectural innovations enable reasoning models to operate in latency-sensitive embodied domains where they were previously impractical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PACE (Planning with Adaptive Cognitive Effort)，一个让具身规划中的推理与执行交错进行的框架，包含 Interleaved Think-Act 架构与动态预算分配器。在 Robotouille 基准上使用 Qwen3-8B-AWQ 时，PACE 取得 10% 成功率，较 ReAct+Think 基线提升 67%，思考时间加速 6.9 倍，并将 66.8% 的思考时间隐藏在动作执行窗口内。作者认为时间感知的架构创新能让推理模型在延迟敏感的具身场景中变得可行。
Motivation: 现有增强推理的大语言模型在规划任务上表现优异，但在具身系统中的部署不切实际，因为每次规划实例的推理延迟常超过数分钟。根本瓶颈在于现有范式是串行的：模型必须完成全部推理后才执行动作，执行时间窗口完全未被利用。
Method: PACE 通过两个关键创新实现推理与执行的交错：一是 Interleaved Think-Act 架构，将认知处理与动作执行流水线化；二是 Dynamic Budget Allocator，根据可用的执行时间窗口动态调整推理 token 预算。
Result: 在 Robotouille 基准上使用 Qwen3-8B-AWQ，PACE 达到 10% 成功率，比 ReAct+Think 基线提高 67%；思考时间相较无约束推理加速 6.9 倍；66.8% 的思考时间被隐藏在执行窗口内。
Conclusion: 作者认为，时间感知的架构创新使推理模型能在以往不实用的延迟敏感型具身领域发挥作用，并表明策略性的认知努力分配可同时提升规划质量与时间效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CastFSR: A Fast--Slow--Reflect Agentic Reasoning Framework for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting is fundamental to decision-making in complex systems, where future dynamics are influenced not only by historical observations but also by evolving contextual features. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have extended forecasting beyond numerical extrapolation toward context-aware reasoning. However, existing approaches often lack explicit mechanisms to identify relevant contexts, reason about their impacts, and validate forecasts against temporal and domain constraints. In this work, we propose CastFSR, an agentic framework that formulates context-aware forecasting as a Fast--Slow--Reflect workflow. In fast thinking, CastFSR profiles observations and selects lightweight forecasters to construct a data-driven forecast prior. In slow deliberation, it retrieves contextual evidence, adaptively determines informative look-back windows, and reasons about how contexts reshape future dynamics. In reflection, it iteratively refines forecasts to ensure temporal, contextual, and domain consistency. CastFSR supports both training-free inference with off-the-shelf LLMs and efficient deployment through a two-stage SFT and reinforcement learning strategy that transfers its orchestration capability to compact LLMs. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate that CastFSR consistently outperforms representative baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/CastFSR.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Evaluating Counterfactual Sensitivity to Patient Information in Medication-Safety Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Applying a valid medication-safety rule when its patient-specific conditions are not met can produce an incorrect decision. Existing medical evaluations largely use isolated and fixed scenarios. A model may therefore answer correctly by recalling a drug-risk association without showing that it used patient information to decide whether the rule applies. To address this gap, we introduce MedPIC-Bench, a benchmark of source-verifiable recommendations and expert-validated questions for patient-specific medication-safety reasoning. It combines guideline-following questions with paired counterfactual questions in which a controlled change in patient information changes whether a rule applies. The benchmark contains 467 questions annotated along six clinical and reasoning dimensions. Across 28 medical-specific, general, and proprietary LLMs, every model performs worse on counterfactual questions, with mean accuracy falling from 63.6\% to 45.1\%. Models perform well when an explicit patient attribute directly signals a familiar contraindication, but struggle when patient information must narrow or withdraw a safety warning. Model rationales often acknowledge the changed patient information, yet the final answers retain the previous safety judgment. This vulnerability persists among medical-specific LLMs, whose average CF performance trails that of general LLMs. MedPIC-Bench therefore makes conditional rule application measurable and highlights the limitations of static medication-safety accuracy for assessing patient-specific reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedPIC-Bench，一个用于评测患者个体化用药安全推理 (patient-specific medication-safety reasoning) 的基准，包含基于指南的问题与成对的反事实 (counterfactual) 问题，共 467 题，并按六个临床与推理维度标注。在 28 个医学专用、通用及专有 LLM 上，所有模型在反事实问题上的表现都更差，平均准确率从 63.6% 降至 45.1%。摘要指出模型常常在理由中承认患者信息已改变，但最终答案仍保留原有安全判断，且这一缺陷在医学专用 LLM 中持续存在。
Motivation: 现有医学评测大多使用孤立且固定的场景，模型可以通过回忆药物-风险关联答对，而不证明其真正使用了患者信息来判断规则是否适用；这掩盖了条件性规则应用能力的缺失。
Method: 引入 MedPIC-Bench，包含来源可验证的推荐与专家验证的问题，将指南遵循问题与成对反事实问题结合，其中受控改变患者信息会改变规则是否适用。
Result: 基准包含 467 个问题，按六个临床与推理维度标注。在 28 个医学专用、通用和专有 LLM 上，所有模型在反事实问题上的平均准确率从 63.6% 降到 45.1%；模型在显式患者属性直接提示熟悉禁忌证 (contraindication) 时表现好，但在患者信息需要收窄或撤销安全警告时表现差，且医学专用 LLM 的平均反事实表现落后于通用 LLM。
Conclusion: MedPIC-Bench 使条件性规则应用变得可测量，并凸显静态用药安全准确率不足以评估患者个体化可靠性；摘要强调这一缺陷在医学专用 LLM 中依然存在。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusio
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting. We directly supervise per-type diffusion scores as classification logits, learn aggregation across noise levels, and use antithetic sampling to reduce Monte Carlo comparison variance. Our analysis shows that classifier-free guidance sharpens the induced type posterior and characterises when antithetic pairing reduces variance at equal denoiser cost. Experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 show consistent gains over a matched deterministic ImaginE control under the same encoder, auxiliary objectives, and evaluation protocol, supported by ablations and paired significance tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffImaginE，将多模态命名实体识别 (MNER) 中的类型验证建模为条件潜扩散推断 (conditional latent diffusion inference)。与现有 imagine-and-compare 验证器将 (span, type) 对映射为单一视觉原型并给出无概率语义的兼容性分数不同，DiffImaginE 使用类型条件去噪器预测标准潜空间中的噪声注入量，并以去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的 ELBO 一致替代，从而对不同类型假设进行排名。方法保留标准多模态编码器结构，用 classifier-free-guided 扩散评分器替换确定性验证器，并采用 Min-SNR 加权与 antithetic sampling 降低蒙特卡洛比较方差。
Motivation: 现有的 imagine-and-compare 验证器把每个 (span, type) 对压缩成单个预测视觉特征，丢失了多样化的视觉实现，且输出的兼容性分数缺乏显式概率语义，难以严格处理不确定性和类型竞争。
Method: DiffImaginE 将 MNER 类型验证视为条件潜扩散推断：给定 span 定位的视觉证据，类型条件去噪器预测注入标准化潜空间的噪声，去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的代理；使用 classifier-free guidance 的扩散评分器并直接监督每类型扩散分数作为分类 logits，跨噪声水平学习聚合，并用 antithetic sampling 降低比较方差。
Result: 在 Twitter-2015 和 Twitter-2017 上，与匹配的确定性 ImaginE 对照（相同编码器、辅助目标和评估协议）相比取得一致提升，并提供了消融和配对显著性检验支持。
Conclusion: 分析表明 classifier-free guidance 能使类型后验更尖锐，并刻画了在相同去噪成本下 antithetic 配对何时能降低方差；作者强调其在标准多模态编码器上仅替换确定性验证器即可生效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Standalone DINOv3 for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing semantic segmentation is hindered by costly pixel-level annotations, motivating training-free open-vocabulary methods. Recently, the recent release of DINOv3 brings DINO.txt, which equips the standalone DINO backbone with image-text contrastive learning and thus opens up the possibility of open-vocabulary segmentation. We propose DinoSplat-OV, a training-free framework that adapts DINOv3 to remote sensing without fine-tuning or additional pretraining. Targeting the dense distribution, multi-scale nature, and large size of remote sensing imagery, we design two core modules. Its Text-aware Laplacian Propagation module de-noises patch-level predictions by combining textual semantic affinities with local visual similarity, improving regional consistency while preserving boundaries. Its Gaussian Splatting Upsampling module reconstructs pixel-level features through RGB-guided anisotropic aggregation and test-time optimization. A global-anchor sliding-window strategy further supports large-scale imagery. Experiments on UDD5, DOTA, and LoveDA demonstrate competitive or superior performance over existing training-free methods, effectively filling the gap of DINO-series models in training-free open-vocabulary segmentation and providing a viable new path for further advances in this direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DinoSplat-OV，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的开集语义分割框架，将新发布的 DINOv3（及其 DINO.txt 图像-文本对比学习能力）直接适配到遥感影像，无需微调或额外预训练。框架包含 Text-aware Laplacian Propagation 与 Gaussian Splatting Upsampling 两个核心模块，并引入全局锚点滑动窗口策略以支持大尺寸遥感图像。实验在 UDD5、DOTA 和 LoveDA 上报告了与现有训练免费方法相比具有竞争力或更优的性能。
Motivation: 遥感语义分割受限于昂贵的像素级标注，因此需要训练免费的开集方法；DINOv3 的发布使独立 DINO 骨干具备图像-文本对比学习能力，可能支持开集分割，但 DINO 系列模型在这一方向的训练免费应用尚属空白。
Method: 提出 DinoSplat-OV 框架：Text-aware Laplacian Propagation 模块结合文本语义亲和度与局部视觉相似性来去噪 patch 级预测，兼顾区域一致性与边界保持；Gaussian Splatting Upsampling 模块通过 RGB 引导的各向异性聚合和测试时优化 (test-time optimization) 重建像素级特征；全局锚点滑动窗口策略处理遥感图像的密集分布、多尺度和大尺寸特性。
Result: 在 UDD5、DOTA 和 LoveDA 数据集上的实验表明，该框架相对现有训练免费方法取得具有竞争力或更优的性能，具体数值在摘要中未给出。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了 DINO 系列模型在训练免费开集分割领域的空白，为遥感开放词汇语义分割提供了可行新路径。

papers.title: LoCA: Forward-Only LLM Tuning after One-Shot Calibration with Local Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient post-training reduces the number of trainable parameters, but still requires repeated end-to-end backpropagation through the frozen backbone. Every adaptation step therefore needs backward-capable hardware and must store or recompute activations. We ask whether this repeated backward chain can be replaced by a one-time calibration. We introduce Local Credit Assignment (LoCA), a two-stage method for small-shift adaptation. One probe backward pass fits a low-rank map at each transformer block from the final prediction error to a local hidden-state correction. LoCA then reuses these maps to form blockwise regression targets from forward activations and fits low-rank adapters with closed-form ridge solves. No further backbone backward pass is required. We evaluate LoCA on five discriminative benchmarks with Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 14B. In 16 of 25 reported task--scale comparisons, LoCA yields lower evaluation cross-entropy than the corresponding LoRA run. Its measured full-run GPU peak, including calibration, is 26--29\% lower than LoRA's. After calibration, its CPU steady-state memory is 36--52\% lower and its per-pass time is 43--48\% lower. A shared scale-normalized candidate set is reused across all tested Qwen2.5 sizes and on SmolLM2-1.7B. LoCA thus amortizes global credit assignment into one calibration and enables later forward-only tuning when repeated backpropagation is impractical. The code associated with this paper is available \href{https://github.com/Xia12121/LoCA}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoCA（Local Credit Assignment），一种面向小偏移适配（small-shift adaptation）的两阶段方法：用一次探针反向传播在每个 transformer 块拟合从最终预测误差到局部隐藏状态修正的低秩映射，之后重用这些映射从前向激活构造逐块回归目标，并以闭式岭回归拟合低秩适配器，不再需要对冻结骨干进行反复反向传播。在 Qwen2.5 0.5B–14B 的五个判别式基准上，25 个任务–规模组合中有 16 个的评估交叉熵低于对应的 LoRA 运行。
Motivation: 参数高效后训练虽减少可训练参数，但仍需通过冻结骨干反复进行端到端反向传播，每一步适配都要求支持反向的硬件并需要存储或重算激活。论文尝试用一次性校准替代整条反向链，使后续调优仅需前向传播（forward-only tuning）。
Method: LoCA 为两阶段方法：先用一次探针反向传播，在每个 transformer 块的最终预测误差与局部隐藏状态修正之间拟合低秩映射；再利用这些映射从前向激活构造块级回归目标，用闭式岭回归（closed-form ridge regression）拟合低秩适配器。校准之后不再需要对骨干网络做反向传播。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5 0.5B–14B 的 5 个判别式基准、25 个任务–规模比较中，LoCA 在 16 个组合上取得比对应 LoRA 更低的评估交叉熵；含校准的完整运行 GPU 峰值内存比 LoRA 低 26–29%，校准后的 CPU 稳态内存低 36–52%，每遍时间低 43–48%。一个共享的尺度归一化候选集可跨所有测试的 Qwen2.5 规模和 SmolLM2-1.7B 复用。

papers.title: UrbanAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Cross-System Urban Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Modern cities rely on an increasing number of digital services to operate, but residents' daily needs are still difficult to meet. Services are fragmented and have little interoperability, placing a heavy operational burden on users. Existing digital platforms, urban foundation models, and intelligent assistants each address only isolated aspects of an urban task. But they struggle to reliably convert complex natural-language requests into executable cross-system workflows. We propose Urban-Agent, a tool-augmented agent framework for cross-system urban tasks. It couples the cognitive and reasoning capabilities of a large language model with a tool-set supporting code execution, API calls, and Model Context Protocol. Through one adaptive closed loop, it clarifies missing information before acting, grounds tool use in live observations, and aligns the final response with observed evidence and task constraints. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce Urban-Eval, a benchmark specifically designed for cross-system urban request. Unlike prior benchmarks that assess either general tool use or urban knowledge and reasoning, Urban-Eval evaluates both task results and execution quality, including required tool coverage, dependency validity, and evidence traceability. Experimental results indicate that Urban-Agent reaches a 71% task success rate, 10 points above the strongest baseline. This lead holds across GPT-5-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-V4-flash, and Qwen3-235B-A22B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Urban-Agent，一个面向跨系统城市任务的工具增强型智能体框架，将大语言模型的推理能力与代码执行、API 调用和 Model Context Protocol 工具集结合，通过单一自适应闭环实现信息澄清、工具使用落地和最终响应与证据对齐。作者同时提出 Urban-Eval 基准，评估任务结果与执行质量（工具覆盖度、依赖有效性和证据可追溯性），实验显示 Urban-Agent 的任务成功率达 71%，比最强基线高 10 个百分点，且在多个模型上保持优势。
Motivation: 城市中数字服务碎片化且互操作性差，现有平台、城市基础模型和智能助手只能处理孤立任务，难以将复杂自然语言请求可靠转化为可执行的跨系统工作流。
Method: Urban-Agent 将大语言模型的认知与推理能力与支持代码执行、API 调用和 Model Context Protocol 的工具集耦合，通过一个自适应闭环在行动前澄清缺失信息、将工具使用扎根于实时观测，并使最终响应与观测证据和任务约束对齐。
Result: Urban-Agent 在 Urban-Eval 上达到 71% 的任务成功率，比最强基线高 10 个百分点；优势在 GPT-5-mini、Gemini-2.5-flash、DeepSeek-V4-flash 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B 等模型上保持一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合自适应闭环与多样化工具集能够有效提升跨系统城市任务的可靠性，并指出 Urban-Eval 为评估此类任务提供了同时考核任务结果与执行质量的基准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Paired Recipient-based Evaluation of Survival Prediction for Deceased Donor Kidney Transplants
papers.abstract_en: There has been significant interest in using machine learning algorithms to predict kidney transplant outcomes, such as the number of years until a graft inevitably fails. These prediction algorithms could possibly be used for pre-transplant donor-recipient matching to identify more compatible donors and recipients and thus improve post-transplant outcomes. In this study, we explore the use of survival prediction models trained on deceased donor kidney transplant data from the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR). We propose a novel paired recipient-based evaluation framework that compares graft outcomes between two recipients who received kidneys from the same deceased donor, allowing us to evaluate the counterfactual benefit of changing the recipient for a certain donor. We find that five different survival prediction models, ranging in complexity from linear to deep learning-based models, all result in ~60% paired recipient-based accuracy. We further translate this accuracy into an interpretable quantity of post-transplant years gained. We also highlight major limitations of the commonly used concordance index (C-index) metric for evaluating survival prediction accuracy in this setting and demonstrate that our proposed paired recipient-based accuracy metric is more clinically relevant and better reflects real-world allocation settings.
papers.comment: To appear at the Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向已故捐献者肾移植的生存预测评估框架，基于同一捐献者分配给两个不同受者的情况来比较移植物结局，以评估更换受者的反事实收益。作者在 SRTR 数据上用从线性到深度学习的五种生存预测模型进行测试，发现所有模型的配对受者准确率均约为 60%，并将该准确率转换为可解释的移植后获得年数。论文还指出现有 C-index 在此场景下的局限性，认为所提指标更能反映真实分配场景。
Motivation: 现有生存预测模型评估主要依赖 C-index，但在肾移植供者-受者匹配的实际分配场景中，C-index 不能直接回答“为某位捐献者更换受者能否改善结局”这一反事实问题。
Method: 提出配对受者评估框架（paired recipient-based evaluation），比较从同一已故捐献者接受肾脏的两个受者之间的移植物结局，据此计算改变受者带来的反事实收益，并将预测准确率转化为移植后获得年数。
Result: 摘要报告五种不同复杂度的生存预测模型（从线性到深度学习）在配对受者准确率上均约为 60%。同时，作者论证了常用的 C-index 在此评估场景中的主要局限性，而所提配对受者准确率指标更具临床相关性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的配对受者准确率比 C-index 更贴合真实世界供者-受者分配场景，可作为肾移植生存预测评估的替代或补充指标。

papers.title: Clinically-Grounded Hierarchical Classification for Consistent Chest X-ray Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate chest X-ray interpretation is inherently hierarchical. Clinical decisions depend not only on what abnormality is present but where it is situated, requiring reasoning from broad anatomical systems down to specific pathological findings. Yet existing automated systems largely treat this as a flat classification problem, failing to capture inter-level dependencies or enforce coherence between coarse and fine predictions. We propose CHASE (Classification with Hierarchical Analysis and Structured Enforcement), a unified single-stage framework that mirrors radiologists' coarse-to-fine reasoning through a clinically driven three-level taxonomy of 9 anatomical regions, 17 sub-regions, and 28 pathological findings. CHASE jointly optimizes multi-level supervision, cross-level probability alignment, and a hierarchy-violation penalty within a shared Vision Transformer backbone. This ensures that fine-grained findings are anatomically supported by their coarser-level context rather than predicted in isolation. Experiments demonstrate that CHASE outperforms flat and hierarchical baselines across all levels while achieving superior probabilistic hierarchy consistency, with level-wise attention maps confirming anatomically grounded predictions. Code is available at: https://github.com/yejix-ai/CHASE.
papers.comment: MICCAI 2026 Accepted. First & Corresponding author: Jong Hak Moon (jh.moon@yejix.com)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHASE，一个基于临床层级分类的胸部 X 光解读框架，将放射科医生由粗到细的推理过程建模为三层次分类体系：9 个解剖区域、17 个子区域和 28 个病理发现。CHASE 在共享 Vision Transformer 骨干中联合优化多级监督、跨层级概率对齐和层级违例惩罚，使细粒度发现由粗粒度解剖上下文支撑。实验表明其在所有层级上优于平面与层级基线，并取得更优的概率层级一致性。
Motivation: 现有自动化胸部 X 光解读系统大多将分类视为平面问题，未捕获粗细预测之间的层级依赖关系，也无法保证粗粒度与细粒度预测之间的连贯性。
Method: 提出统一单阶段框架 CHASE，通过临床驱动的三层次分类体系模拟放射科医生的由粗到细推理，并在共享 Vision Transformer 骨干中联合优化多级监督、跨层级概率对齐和层级违例惩罚。
Result: 实验显示 CHASE 在所有层级上均优于平面和层级基线，并实现更优的概率层级一致性，层级级注意力图证实预测具有解剖学基础。
Conclusion: 作者认为将层级一致性显式纳入训练可以产生解剖学上更可信、层级间更连贯的胸部 X 光解读结果。

papers.title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which attention induces a weighted graph over tokens, while token hidden states define signals on its nodes. Quantitative graph-spectral diagnostics and qualitative token-graph visualizations reveal that representations become more clearly differentiated by input dynamical complexity as context length increases. Simpler inputs produce attention-induced token graphs with stronger global connectivity and smoother, spectrally concentrated hidden-state signals, whereas more complex inputs produce more localized graphs and hidden-state signals with broader spectral support and greater high-frequency energy. Together, these findings point to systematic, context-dependent internal signatures associated with numerical ICL that are conserved across model families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从图信号处理（graph signal processing）视角研究预训练大语言模型在上下文学习（ICL）中对数值序列的内部表示组织方式。作者将注意力视为 token 间加权图、隐状态视为图上信号，通过图谱诊断和可视化发现：随着上下文长度增加，表示会按输入动力学复杂度产生分化——简单输入对应更强全局连通性的注意力图和更平滑的谱集中信号，复杂输入则对应更局部化的图与更宽的频谱支撑及更高高频能量。这些模式在不同模型家族中保持一致。
Motivation: 已有工作主要通过预测误差等输出级评估刻画 LLM 的数值推理能力，但数值信息在 LLM 表示内部如何组织尚未得到充分理解。
Method: 采用图信号处理视角，将注意力诱导的加权图视为 token 间关系、token 隐状态作为图上的信号，并应用定量图谱诊断（graph-spectral diagnostics）和定性 token 图可视化来分析上下文长度与输入动力学复杂度的影响。
Result: 摘要报告：更简单的输入产生更强全局连接性的注意力图以及更平滑、谱集中的隐状态信号；更复杂的输入则产生更局部化的图和更宽频谱支撑、更高高频能量的信号；且这些上下文相关的内部特征在不同模型家族中具有一致性。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了数值 ICL 中系统性、依赖上下文的内部信号特征，这些特征跨模型家族保持守恒，但摘要未讨论其与下游预测表现或实际应用的直接联系。

papers.title: V-FIND: Revealing the Intrinsic Forgery Knowledge Encoded in Video Forgery Detectors
papers.abstract_en: As generated videos become increasingly realistic, reliable video forgery detection is increasingly important. Existing studies typically optimize and use video forgery detectors as black boxes, while the latent forgery-discriminative knowledge inside them remains largely unexplored. Instead of continuing to rely on resource-intensive full-model retraining to steadily improve detection performance, we ask whether video forgery detection can also be achieved by uncovering and activating sparse forensic knowledge within the detector. We find that forgery-discriminative knowledge is not uniformly distributed across the full representation space, but is concentrated in a sparse set of functionally specialized neurons. Based on this insight, we propose a video forgery-intrinsic neuron discovery (V-FIND) framework. V-FIND first localizes critical layers that exhibit pronounced discrepancies between real and forged videos, and then identifies latent anchor neurons that consistently carry forgery-discriminative signals, organizing them into a compact forensic subspace. With the original backbone frozen and only a lightweight linear classifier trained, this subspace still delivers strong detection performance across multiple external benchmarks for generated videos. Further neuron intervention experiments provide direct evidence for the functional specificity of the discovered neurons. Overall, these results suggest that video forgery detectors contain sparse, extractable, and reusable forgery-discriminative knowledge, offering a new perspective on understanding and exploiting their intrinsic forensic capability.

papers.title: ProPRL: Property-Aware Prerequisite Relation Learning in Educational Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Prerequisite relation learning is central to adaptive instruction, yet existing methods often formulate it as conventional link prediction, limiting their ability to adaptively integrate complementary educational evidence for individual candidate pairs and to discourage contradictory reverse predictions. We propose ProPRL, a Property-aware Prerequisite Relation Learning framework. ProPRL first learns complementary concept representations from a concept-resource hypergraph and a directed learning-behavior graph, where direction-preserving personalized propagation aggregates multi-hop behavioral evidence. It then employs a Pair-conditioned Gate to adaptively weight and fuse the two views for each candidate ordered concept pair. Finally, an \textit{Irreversibility Constraint} introduces an anti-symmetry regularizer that penalizes simultaneously high confidence in both directions of the same concept pair. Experiments on multiple real-world educational datasets show that ProPRL achieves state-of-the-art performance on prerequisite relation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProPRL，一个面向教育知识图谱中先决条件关系学习（prerequisite relation learning）的属性感知框架。它从概念-资源超图和方向性学习行为图中学习互补的概念表示，并用方向保留的个性化传播聚合多跳行为证据；随后通过 Pair-conditioned Gate 为每个候选有序概念对自适应加权融合两个视图，最后用 Irreversibility Constraint 引入反对称正则项，抑制同一概念对双向同时高置信的预测。实验在多个真实教育数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法通常把先决条件关系学习建模为常规链接预测，难以针对单个候选概念对自适应整合互补的教育证据，也无法有效抑制反向矛盾预测。
Method: 提出 ProPRL 框架，包含三部分：从概念-资源超图和方向性学习行为图学习互补表示，其中方向保留的个性化传播用于聚合多跳行为证据；Pair-conditioned Gate 动态加权融合两个视图；Irreversibility Constraint 通过反对称正则项惩罚同一概念对两个方向同时高置信。
Result: 在多个真实世界教育数据集上的实验表明，ProPRL 在先决条件关系学习上取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自适应融合多源教育证据与反对称约束能够改进先决条件关系学习。

papers.title: Stochastic Saddle Avoidance Beyond Unit Excitation and Smoothness: A Pathwise Lyapunov-Perron Framework
papers.abstract_en: Unit excitation (UE) is a common assumption in stochastic saddle avoidance: the stochastic error must have a uniformly positive component along every direction, in expectation. This condition gives a direct way to rule out convergence to strict saddles, but it also oversimplifies the actual noise structure, and does not match many stochastic optimization regimes. In overparameterized or interpolation models, the noise may vanish near stationarity. In finite-sum problems, the stochastic gradient noise may lie in a low-dimensional, data-dependent subspace. In these (common) scenarios, UE is naturally not satisfied. In this paper, we prove an abstract almost sure avoidance theorem for stochastic recursions without UE. The theorem replaces UE-type requirements by verifiable pathwise conditions. In applications, these conditions follow, e.g., from local smoothness and finite-moment assumptions under standard i.i.d. sampling, or from the finite-sum structure under without-replacement sampling. Since the stochastically sampled maps generally do not share a fixed point, the celebrated center-stable manifold argument used in deterministic analyses is not directly applicable. Instead, we use a path-dependent change of variables together with a pathwise Lyapunov--Perron-based proof strategy. As applications, we obtain strict saddle avoidance for stochastic mirror descent (including SGD) and for random reshuffling. For nonsmooth composite objectives, we prove avoidance results for a proximal-type stochastic gradient method. Combining these insights with suitable iterate convergence guarantees, this allows establishing convergence to local minimizers of the original objective function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机递归中的严格鞍点回避问题，针对单位激励（unit excitation, UE）假设在实际随机优化中常不成立的情形，提出一个不依赖 UE 的几乎必然回避定理。该定理以可验证的路径条件取代 UE 型要求，并采用路径依赖的变量替换与路径wise Lyapunov-Perron 证明策略，克服了随机采样映射通常没有公共不动点而难以直接套用中心稳定流形论证的困难。作为应用，作者得到随机镜像下降（含 SGD）、随机重排以及近端型随机梯度方法在非光滑复合目标下的严格鞍点回避结果。
Motivation: UE 假设要求随机误差在每个方向上都有均匀正分量，从而能直接排除收敛到严格鞍点，但该假设与许多实际随机优化机制不符：过参数化或插值模型中噪声可能在平稳点附近消失，有限和问题中的随机梯度噪声可能落在低维数据依赖子空间内。
Method: 提出抽象的几乎必然回避定理，用可验证的路径条件（pathwise conditions）取代 UE 型要求；这些条件在标准 i.i.d. 采样下可由局部光滑性和有限矩假设导出，在无放回采样（without-replacement sampling）下可由有限和结构导出。证明采用路径依赖的变量替换和路径wise Lyapunov-Perron 策略，以处理随机采样映射缺乏公共不动点的问题。
Result: 摘要报告在随机镜像下降（包括 SGD）、随机重排（random reshuffling）以及针对非光滑复合目标的近端型随机梯度方法上获得严格鞍点回避结果。
Conclusion: 作者指出将上述回避结果与适当的迭代收敛保证结合，可以建立原目标函数收敛到局部极小值（local minimizers）的结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the missing benchmarks layer and a potential solution
papers.abstract_en: Latin America is missing a foundational layer for native AI development: the benchmark layer. The benchmark layer does two things no other layer can - it audits AI systems against regional social requirements and it directs AI optimization in economically relevant environments. Without it, public institutions cannot independently evaluate foreign AI systems, and companies cannot optimize AI systems to solve local problems with SOTA performance. The cost of the missing layer is dual: a loss of auditability and a loss of optimization direction over a technology that is increasingly critical infrastructure. We propose an EvalsHub, with LatamBoard as its first regional instance - an open, task-first benchmark infrastructure where universities, public institutions, professional communities, and companies can publish, execute, compare, and maintain evaluations across models, workflows, and agents. Built once, measured forever - re-run by institutions as new AI systems ship and by industry teams after every system change. Open by design and incentive-driven by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出拉丁美洲缺少原生 AI 发展所需的基础层——基准层（benchmark layer），该层既能按区域社会要求审计 AI 系统，也能引导 AI 在经济相关环境中优化。作者提出开放的、以任务为先的基准基础设施 EvalsHub，并以 LatamBoard 作为首个区域实例，让大学、公共机构、专业社区和企业能够发布、执行、比较和维护跨模型、工作流与代理的评测。该文是问题陈述与基础设施提案，不包含实验验证。
Motivation: 拉丁美洲缺少基准层，导致公共机构无法独立评估外国 AI 系统，企业也无法将 AI 优化到能解决本地问题的水平。缺失的代价是双重的：失去可审计性，也失去对日益关键的基础设施技术的优化方向。
Method: 提出 EvalsHub 以及其首个区域实例 LatamBoard：一个开放的、任务优先的基准基础设施，支持不同机构发布、执行、比较和维护评测。其设计遵循“一次构建，永久测量”，由机构在新 AI 系统发布后、行业团队在每次系统变更后重复运行。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实证结果或量化指标，内容聚焦于问题陈述与基础设施方案设计。
Conclusion: 作者将开放设计和激励驱动机制视为 EvalsHub 的关键属性，并强调基准层对于恢复区域 AI 可审计性与优化方向的核心作用。
