papers.title: SparSEEty: Extracting Tokens from Sparsity-Exploiting LLM Serving Systems via Deterministic Side Channels
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) exhibit activation sparsity, wherein only a subset of their neurons is activated for given input tokens. Researchers have leveraged this property to optimize LLM serving systems by omitting weight accesses and computations pertaining to inactive neurons. Unfortunately, however, such optimizations create input-dependent weight accesses, which can be leaked over side channels. We present SparSEEty, a new token extraction attack that exploits input-dependent neuron weight accesses introduced by sparsity-exploiting LLM serving systems. SparSEEty first constructs a neuron-activation oracle using neuron weight access side channels during LLM inference, and then inverts the activation traces to reconstruct the input tokens, forming an end-to-end token extraction attack. We instantiate SparSEEty against an LLM serving system protected inside an Intel TDX confidential virtual machine (CVM), addressing three key challenges: (i) constructing a neuron-activation oracle using a combination of side channels exposed by CVMs, (ii) reducing inference-time overheads of neuron activation monitoring for covertness, and (iii) accurately inverting partial binary activation traces back to tokens. Our evaluation shows that SparSEEty can reconstruct both prompt and response tokens with consistently high BLEU scores (>0.95) across various models and datasets, while incurring monitoring overheads of 3.7% to 7.2%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparSEEty，一种针对利用激活稀疏性 (activation sparsity) 优化的大语言模型 (LLM) 服务系统的 token 提取攻击。攻击利用输入相关的神经元权重访问行为建立神经元激活预言机，再将激活轨迹反演为输入 token，形成端到端的 token 提取。作者在 Intel TDX 机密虚拟机 (CVM) 保护的 LLM 服务系统上实例化了该攻击，并以低监测开销实现高 BLEU 重建分数。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统利用激活稀疏性省略非活跃神经元的权重访问与计算，但这种优化引入与输入相关的权重访问模式，可能经侧信道泄露，威胁模型隐私。
Method: SparSEEty 首先利用 CVM 暴露的多种侧信道构建神经元激活预言机，然后降低推理期间的神经元激活监测开销以保持隐蔽性，最后将部分二值激活轨迹反演还原为输入 token，构成端到端攻击。
Result: 在多种模型和数据集上，SparSEEty 能以超过 0.95 的 BLEU 分数重建 prompt 和 response token，监测开销为 3.7% 至 7.2%。
Conclusion: 作者强调稀疏性优化引入的确定性侧信道可被利用来提取 LLM 的输入输出 token，即使在受 TDX 保护的机密计算环境中也难以避免。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: SparSEEty 首先利用 CVM 暴露的多种侧信道构建神经元激活预言机，然后降低推理期间的神经元激活监测开销以保持隐蔽性，最后将部分二值激活轨迹反演还原为输入 token，构成端到端攻击。
summary_sections.result: 在多种模型和数据集上，SparSEEty 能以超过 0.95 的 BLEU 分数重建 prompt 和 response token，监测开销为 3.7% 至 7.2%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调稀疏性优化引入的确定性侧信道可被利用来提取 LLM 的输入输出 token，即使在受 TDX 保护的机密计算环境中也难以避免。

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Reasoning with Incremental Knowledge for Sample Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: (Flat) Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents face significant challenges in environments with sparse rewards that require long-horizon reasoning. A compelling approach to improve sample efficiency is to incorporate knowledge into learning and decision-making. In standard Hierarchical RL (HRL), knowledge is encoded in a fixed, non-updatable form, such as architectural choices, and remains unchanged throughout learning. With fixed HRL, reasoning with incremental knowledge learned during exploration is impractical before sufficient environmental knowledge is acquired, leading to poor sample efficiency. In this work, we propose neurosymbolic HRL with {\em Incremental Knowledge (InK)}: symbolic high-level components perform {\em symbolic planning} (e.g. using $D^*$) on an updatable representation of current InK, while low-level goal-conditioned neural modules learn motion primitives through experience using reward shaping. Experiments on navigation tasks demonstrate that incorporating InK substantially improves sample efficiency. Additionally, to perform {\em optimal} symbolic planning given {\em prior} knowledge about the world, we develop Belief World Tree Search. The code is available at https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号分层强化学习 (neurosymbolic HRL) 方法 InK，将知识表示为可更新的增量知识 (Incremental Knowledge)，由符号高层组件基于该表示进行符号规划（如 D*），低层目标条件神经网络通过经验与 reward shaping 学习运动原语。摘要报告在导航任务上，引入增量知识显著提升样本效率，并额外提出 Belief World Tree Search 以在有世界先验知识时进行最优符号规划。
Motivation: 标准分层强化学习 (HRL) 将知识以固定、不可更新的形式（如架构选择）编码并在训练中保持不变，导致探索过程中获得的增量知识无法被即时利用。在足够环境知识积累之前，固定 HRL 难以进行增量推理，造成样本效率低下。
Method: 提出神经符号 HRL 框架 InK：符号高层组件在可更新的当前知识表示上执行符号规划 (symbolic planning)，低层目标条件神经模块通过经验学习运动原语；同时开发 Belief World Tree Search，用于在具备世界先验知识时执行最优符号规划。
Result: 摘要报告在导航任务上的实验表明，与固定 HRL 相比，引入增量知识可以显著提高样本效率。
Conclusion: 本文认为将可更新的增量知识纳入符号规划可改善稀疏奖励、长时域推理场景下 HRL 的样本效率，并公开了代码仓库；摘要未提供关于局限性的明确说明。

papers.title: Joint Affine Spectral Shaping: Coupling Weight and Bias Updates Beyond Weight-Only Muon
papers.abstract_en: Matrix spectral optimizers reshape weight-update spectra but usually delegate vector-valued biases to a separate optimizer. We study whether this separation is neutral. We formulate each affine layer as a joint momentum matrix $A=[M_W,αm_b]$ and apply a capped regularized-inverse spectral map to the complete matrix, producing both the weight and physical bias updates. A strict five-seed ablation on a four-layer BERT-mini trained from scratch on IMDb compares exact-SVD Muon, weight-only inverse shaping, affine-probe inverse shaping, and the proposed joint regularized inverse (JRI). Weight-only inverse shaping raises validation-loss-selected test accuracy from $84.903\pm0.242\%$ to $85.562\pm0.308\%$ and lowers selected test loss from $0.3479$ to $0.3345$. Allowing bias to alter the joint SVD while retaining an independent Adam bias update does not improve over weight-only inverse shaping. Using the transformed bias jointly raises selected test accuracy to $85.738\pm0.180\%$ and lowers test loss to $0.3291$, with all five seeds improving relative to the probe baseline. During the peak-performance window, JRI preserves the eligible weight-update norm while reducing the bias-update norm from $0.02095$ to $0.00301$, lowers boundary-function share from $86.58\%$ to $78.97\%$, and changes the cosine between weight-induced boundary motion and explicit bias from $+0.030$ to $-0.137$. An independent 22-seed replication yields $85.743\pm0.203\%$ selected test accuracy. These results identify joint affine spectral allocation as a small but consistent extension to weight-only spectral optimization.

papers.title: AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding verifies a tree of draft tokens in one target-model forward pass. For a mixture-of-experts (MoE) target, however, parallel verification can activate the union of the experts selected by all tree nodes, even though only a small subset of those nodes reaches the accepted output. Token count, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic are therefore distinct cost measures: reducing the token workload need not shrink the expert union proportionally, and under offloading, transfer traffic also depends on cache residency. We introduce AcceptMoE, a verifier-side expert selector that combines target-router scores with offline-estimated commitment probabilities and automatically adjusts the number of eligible experts for each verification block, eliminating the need for a user-specified expert budget. Under offloading, AcceptMoE conditions expert eligibility on cache residency instead of predicting natural routes and prefetching the corresponding expert weights. Although constraining target-expert eligibility changes the model distribution, across 12 model-task pairs spanning three MoE targets and four benchmarks, AcceptMoE's mean accuracy is 0.27 percentage points lower than that of EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with natural routing. Served with SGLang at batch size one, it reaches 1.290 times the throughput of this baseline with all expert weights in GPU memory, and 2.06 times under physical expert offloading, while reducing host-to-device traffic by 73.6 percent to 77.1 percent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AcceptMoE，一种面向混合专家 (MoE) 目标模型的投机解码验证端专家选择方法。核心思想是结合目标路由器得分与离线估计的提交概率 (commitment probabilities)，自动调整每个验证块可参与验证的专家数量，从而在无需用户指定专家预算的情况下降低激活专家并集大小与权重传输开销。在 12 个模型-任务组合、三个 MoE 目标和四个基准上的实验表明，与 EAGLE-3 自然路由投机解码相比，平均准确率仅下降 0.27 个百分点，但在 SGLang batch size 为 1 时吞吐量提升至基线 1.290 倍（全部专家权重驻留 GPU 内存）和 2.06 倍（物理专家卸载场景），并将 host-to-device 流量减少 73.6% 至 77.1%。
Motivation: MoE 投机解码的并行验证会激活所有树节点所选专家的并集，而其中只有少量节点会被接受，导致 token 数量、激活专家并集大小与专家权重传输量成为三个相互独立且难以同时优化的成本指标；现有方法通常需要用户手工指定专家预算，且卸载场景下的权重预取与自然路由预测不匹配。
Method: AcceptMoE 在验证端选择专家，将目标路由器得分与离线估计的提交概率结合，并自动调整每个验证块的合格专家数量；在模型卸载场景下，专家资格以缓存驻留状态 (cache residency) 为条件，而非预测自然路由并预取对应专家权重。
Result: 在 12 个模型-任务组合（三个 MoE 目标、四个基准）上，AcceptMoE 相对 EAGLE-3 自然路由投机解码的平均准确率仅降低 0.27 个百分点；以 SGLang 在 batch size 为 1 服务时，全内存场景吞吐量达基线 1.290 倍，物理专家卸载场景下达 2.06 倍，并减少 73.6% 至 77.1% 的 host-to-device 流量。
Conclusion: 作者表明，虽然限制目标专家资格会改变模型分布，但 AcceptMoE 能在准确率几乎无损的情况下大幅提升 MoE 投机解码的吞吐并降低卸载时的传输开销；摘要未提及该方法在其他服务配置或更复杂负载下的局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Internalising the Identity Primitive: Cryptographic Individuality for an Autonomous Agent on a Public Blockchain
papers.abstract_en: A software agent on a public blockchain accumulates authority and economic stakes, raising the engineering question of what makes it count as an individual. The paper's central contribution is a shift of trust root for the key-to-weights binding of agent identity: from hardware, operator, or wrapper trust to cryptographic assumptions enforced by a pinned implementation (liveness, key custody, oracle trust, and the underlying software stack remain external). We design and deploy on Solana devnet an agent whose neural-network weights are a deterministic function of its private key. The binding is committed in zero knowledge at genesis, re-checked against that commitment at every state transition, and signed by the agent into an on-chain history unforkable once finalized; in a PoC-tier extension, a protocol-imposed metabolic cost is debited each cycle from a key-derived economic account, adding a consumption-side economic-viability constraint to the key-history-economy triple. Empirically, the agent completes a 2.36-day on-chain run with two host-side resumptions but no rejected transition, at bounded per-transition verification cost; a substituted substrate is rejected on chain, and independently keyed agents diverge as predicted while a same-key control stays at zero. To our knowledge, this is the first published on-chain agent whose identity primitive is itself a cryptographic invariant re-checked at every state transition. The resulting transition-time invariant instantiates the cryptographic individuality proposed by Suzuki 2026's Artificial Externality framework.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Cryptographic key-to-weights binding (W = HKDF(sk) inside Groth16) with an on-chain state-commitment chain on Solana devnet; active-query, homeostatic, and economic-metabolism extensions; 166- and 168-cycle continuous runs. Code, threat model, and per-cycle telemetry: https://github.com/ksk-S/internalising-identity-2026 (tag arxiv-v1)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在公共区块链上实现代理的密码学个体性，将代理的神经网络权重设计为私钥的确定性函数，并在零知识证明（Groth16）中绑定，于创世时提交承诺，每个状态转换都重新验证该绑定，并由代理签名形成最终不可分叉的链上历史。作者在 Solana devnet 上部署并运行 2.36 天，期间有两次主机侧恢复但无被拒绝的状态转换，每次转换的验证成本有界；替换的底层被链上拒绝，独立密钥代理按预测发散，而同密钥对照组保持为零。作者称这是第一个在每个状态转换时都重新检查身份原语的链上代理。
Motivation: 软件代理在公共区块链上积累权威和经济权益，需要回答什么使其成为个体的问题；现有身份信任根依赖硬件、运营商或包装器，本文希望将信任根转移到密码学假设，并仅在 liveness、密钥托管、预言机信任和底层软件栈上保留外部依赖。
Method: 提出密钥到权重的绑定（W = HKDF(sk) 在 Groth16 内），在创世时以零知识方式提交承诺，每个状态转换重新检查该承诺并由代理签名上链；作为 PoC 级扩展，协议施加的代谢成本每周期从密钥派生的经济账户中扣除，增加消费侧的经济可行性约束。
Result: 在 Solana devnet 上完成 2.36 天连续运行，两次主机侧恢复但无被拒绝的状态转换，每次转换验证成本有界；替换的底层被链上拒绝，独立密钥的代理按预测发散，同密钥对照组保持在零。
Conclusion: 该工作将身份原语本身实现为每个状态转换都重新检查的密码学不变量，实例化了 Suzuki 2026 的 Artificial Externality 框架中的密码学个体性；作者明确 liveness、密钥托管、预言机信任和底层软件栈仍属于外部信任边界。

papers.title: Temporal Leakage in LLM Backtesting: Measurement, Validation, and Adjusted Scores
papers.abstract_en: The standard check for contamination in LLM backtests is simple: compare scores before and after the training cutoff. We show this check is uninformative. Four flagship models fail it on questions they cannot have memorized: every scored question resolved after their cutoffs. The reason is structural. Models legitimately know more about times near their cutoff, so recency mimics leakage, and we prove no passive backtest can separate the two from genuine skill. Measurement, not just detection, requires information from outside the backtest. We supply it in two forms. A known cutoff identifies leakage at the boundary; a matched clean control identifies it globally and yields a leakage-adjusted score. We also derive where leakage hides: it concentrates on outcomes that surprised the crowd and were well covered in training, and partial memorization is disproportionately rewarded. We validate the estimators against ground truth by planting leakage in twin models, where they recover the injected dose and return null on clean questions. Deployed on frontier models, they detect one cutoff-localized signature and, at the audit's power floor, clear five models whose apparent advantages were recency alone. Backtests need not be discarded; they need one defensible reference.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 LLM 回测中常用的污染检测——比较训练截止前后得分——几乎没有信息量；四个旗舰模型在无法记忆的题目（截止后解析的问题）上仍然通过失败该检查。作者证明这是由于“近因性”天然模仿泄漏，任何被动回测都无法将二者与真实能力区分，因此必须引入回测之外的信息。论文给出已知截止与匹配干净对照两种外部参考，并验证了能恢复注入泄漏剂量、在干净题上返回空结果的估计器；部署到前沿模型后检测到一个截止局部特征，并在审计功效下限下为五个模型祛除疑似泄漏。
Motivation: 标准做法通过比较训练截止前后的得分判断 LLM 回测是否被污染，但该检查被证明不可靠：模型对接近截止时间点的事件天然知道更多，近因性会伪装成泄漏，被动回测在数学上无法把泄漏与真实能力分开。
Method: 提出需要回测之外信息的两类度量手段：已知截止时间可识别边界处的泄漏；匹配干净对照（matched clean control）可在全局识别泄漏并产出泄漏调整分数（leakage-adjusted score）。论文还推导了泄漏的分布规律，并采用在孪生模型中人为植入泄漏的方式验证估计器。
Result: 四个旗舰模型在每个评分问题都晚于其训练截止的情况下仍能被近因性解释；植入泄漏的估计器能恢复注入剂量并在干净问题上返回零结果；在真实前沿模型上检测到一个截止局部化信号，同时在审计功效下限上为五个模型给出“仅为近因性所致”的结论。
Conclusion: 作者认为回测不必被废弃，只需要一个可辩护的外部参考（如已知截止或干净对照）即可获得可解释的泄漏度量；泄漏尤其集中在令大众意外且训练覆盖充分的结果上，部分记忆会得到不成比例的奖励。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Qwen-3D: A Generalist 3D Vision-Language Model for Spatial Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable success on images and short videos, yet scaling them to long videos remains challenging due to frame-centric tokenization and limited context windows. 3D geometry provides a natural compression mechanism for visual streams: depth and camera pose enable observations from multiple views and time steps to be fused into a persistent, world-aligned representation. While recent 3D LMMs leverage geometry-aware representations to improve spatial reasoning, they continue to lag behind specialist 3D perception systems on grounding and segmentation tasks. We argue that a key limitation is geometry-aware decoding: existing methods communicate 3D predictions through language tokens, proposal selection, or lightweight grounding queries, creating a bottleneck between language reasoning and dense geometric prediction. Building on these insights, we introduce Qwen-3D, a geometry-aware LMM that compresses visual information within the Qwen backbone using multi-view geometric cues, enabling efficient long-horizon visual reasoning over static scenes. Qwen-3D augments visual tokens with 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings, allowing attention to operate directly in 3D scene space rather than across independent image frames and thereby facilitating scalable cross-view and temporal reasoning. To bridge language and geometry, Qwen-3D incorporates a query-based segmentation decoder that grounds language directly in the underlying 3D scene representation, unifying referential grounding, instance segmentation, and visual question answering across both images and videos. Across a diverse set of benchmarks, Qwen-3D surpasses existing 3D LMMs and outperforms several large proprietary 2D models. Notably, Qwen-3D achieves these improvements while maintaining strong performance on standard 2D vision-language benchmarks by jointly training on 2D and 3D data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Qwen-3D，一个基于 Qwen 骨干的几何感知多模态大模型，利用多视角几何线索压缩视觉信息，并用 3D 旋转位置编码 (3D Rotary Positional Embeddings) 让注意力直接在 3D 场景空间而非独立图像帧上运作，以支持静态场景中的长时序视觉推理。模型还引入基于查询的分割解码器，将语言直接落地到 3D 场景表示上，统一了指代接地、实例分割和视觉问答。摘要称其在多个基准上超过现有 3D LMM，并优于若干大型专有 2D 模型，同时通过 2D/3D 联合训练保持标准 2D 视觉语言基准上的强性能。
Motivation: 3D 几何可作为视觉流量的自然压缩机制，但现有 3D LMM 在接地和分割任务上仍落后于专门的 3D 感知系统；作者认为关键瓶颈在于几何感知解码——现有方法通过语言 token、候选框选择或轻量接地查询来传递 3D 预测，在语言推理与密集几何预测之间形成瓶颈。
Method: 在 Qwen 骨干内利用多视角几何线索压缩视觉信息，为视觉 token 加入 3D 旋转位置编码，使注意力在 3D 场景空间中运行；并引入基于查询的分割解码器，将语言直接接地到 3D 场景表示，统一指代接地、实例分割和视觉问答，同时联合训练 2D 与 3D 数据。
Result: 在一系列多样化基准上，Qwen-3D 超越了现有 3D LMM，并优于多个大型专有 2D 模型；在标准 2D 视觉语言基准上也能保持强性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过几何感知解码和 3D 场景空间注意力，可以在静态场景中实现高效的长时序视觉推理，并统一图像与视频上的接地、分割和问答能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: TQLite: Multi-LLM Jury Guided Distillation for Real-time MQM Translation Quality Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in MQM-based translation quality (TQ) evaluation, and recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) promise even greater improvements. However, both LLMs and LRMs are computationally expensive to deploy at scale, while small language models (SLMs)---though much more efficient---struggle with the complex reasoning required for evaluation tasks. In this work, we present an extensive empirical study benchmarking SLMs, LLMs, and LRMs across a wide range of TQ evaluation setups, providing a comprehensive view of the current landscape and establishing best practices. To address the scalability challenge, we introduce TQLite, a novel distillation framework that enables SLMs to approach the MQM evaluation performance of the best LRM-based evaluators. Our approach leverages a multi-LRM jury to generate high-quality synthetic training data via practical data curation techniques and aggregation of evaluation responses across a diverse panel of models. Our results demonstrate that SLMs trained via TQLite achieve strong MQM evaluation performance that far exceeds off-the-shelf evaluation capabilities of standard SLMs, offering a scalable and cost-effective alternative to LLM- and LRM-based evaluators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项面向 MQM 翻译质量评估的实证研究，系统对比了小型语言模型 (SLM)、大型语言模型 (LLM) 与大型推理模型 (LRM) 在多种评估配置下的表现，并提出 TQLite 蒸馏框架。TQLite 利用多 LRM 陪审团聚合评估响应并配合数据整理技术生成合成训练数据，使 SLM 接近最佳 LRM 评估器的 MQM 评估性能。
Motivation: LLM 与 LRM 在 MQM 翻译质量评估上表现优异但部署成本高，SLM 虽高效却难以胜任评估所需的复杂推理，因此需要可扩展且低成本的替代评估方案。
Method: 提出 TQLite 蒸馏框架：通过多 LRM 陪审团 (multi-LRM jury) 聚合不同模型的评估响应，结合实用的数据整理 (data curation) 技术生成高质量合成训练数据，再用于训练 SLM 完成 MQM 评估任务。
Result: 摘要报告称，经 TQLite 训练的 SLM 在 MQM 评估性能上远超现成 SLM，接近最佳 LRM 评估器水平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TQLite 为 LLM/LRM 评估器提供了可扩展且成本更低的替代方案，但其适用范围限定在 MQM 翻译质量评估任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HyperFL: Query-Adaptive Representation Learning for Software Fault Localization
papers.abstract_en: Software fault localization identifies the code locations responsible for reported issues and is a fundamental step toward automated debugging and program repair. Recent retrieval-based approaches formulate fault localization as a dense retrieval task by learning a shared embedding space between issue reports and source code. However, these methods encode all issue reports using a fixed query representation, despite the substantial diversity of real-world issue reports in length, structure, and debugging information. To address this limitation, we propose HyperFL, a query-adaptive representation learning framework for software fault localization. HyperFL employs a lightweight hypernetwork to generate query-specific LoRA parameters for the query encoder, enabling dynamic query adaptation while keeping the code encoder fixed and reusable. Experiments on a real-world issue localization benchmark demonstrate that HyperFL consistently improves retrieval performance across multiple embedding backbones, achieving up to 13.3% relative improvement in function-level MRR@10 and 16.7% relative improvement in Hit@1 over the state-of-the-art method SweRank. Further analysis shows that HyperFL learns distinct adaptation patterns for different issue characteristics, highlighting the effectiveness of query-adaptive representations for software issue localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperFL，一种查询自适应表示学习框架，用于软件故障定位。针对现有检索式方法对所有 issue 报告使用固定查询表示的问题，HyperFL 用轻量级超网络为查询编码器生成查询特定的 LoRA 参数，同时保持代码编码器固定可复用。在真实 issue 定位基准上，HyperFL 在多个嵌入骨干上稳定提升检索性能，相比 SOTA 方法 SweRank 在函数级 MRR@10 上提升最多 13.3%，Hit@1 提升最多 16.7%。
Motivation: 现有检索式故障定位方法将 issue 报告和源代码编码到共享嵌入空间，但使用固定查询表示处理长度、结构和调试信息差异很大的真实 issue 报告，适应性不足，限制了故障定位性能。
Method: 提出 HyperFL 框架，采用轻量级超网络为查询编码器动态生成查询特定的 LoRA 参数，实现查询自适应编码，同时保持代码编码器固定且可复用。
Result: 在真实 issue 定位基准上，HyperFL 在多种嵌入骨干上一致提升检索性能，相对 SOTA 方法 SweRank 实现函数级 MRR@10 最高 13.3% 的相对提升、Hit@1 最高 16.7% 的相对提升；进一步分析显示 HyperFL 能针对不同 issue 特征学习不同的适应模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调查询自适应表示能有效提升软件 issue 定位效果，说明固定查询表示是检索式故障定位的主要瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Retrieval: Analytic Memory for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term multimodal memory must support not only retrieving relevant information but also computing over observations accumulated across interactions. Existing systems largely emphasize \emph{retrieval memory}, organizing interaction histories through summaries and indexes to return query-relevant information at multiple granularities, from high-level abstractions to underlying records. In this paper, we formulate \emph{analytic memory} as a complementary abstraction that organizes recurring multimodal observations into queryable structures supporting filtering, aggregation, ranking, and temporal comparison. We present AdaMM, a framework that jointly supports retrieval and analytic memory. Rather than relying on application-defined schemas, AdaMM extracts provenance-linked attribute-value observations from dialogue, images, and contextual metadata, discovers recurring field structures, and materializes them for analytical access. At inference time, a memory-aware planner decomposes queries into retrieval and analytic operations and routes each operation to the appropriate tools. Experiments on two long-term multimodal memory benchmarks, MemEye and MemGallery, show that AdaMM improves performance by up to 11.3\% and 6.9\%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将长期多模态记忆从仅支持检索扩展为同时支持分析计算，形式化定义 analytic memory，并构建 AdaMM 框架：从对话、图像和上下文元数据中抽取带溯源属性-值观测，发现重复字段结构并物化，推理时由记忆感知规划器将查询分解为检索与分析操作并路由到相应工具。在两个长期多模态记忆基准 MemEye 与 MemGallery 上，AdaMM 分别提升最高 11.3% 与 6.9%。
Motivation: 现有长期多模态记忆系统主要强调检索记忆，通过摘要和索引组织交互历史，只能返回查询相关的信息，无法对跨交互累积的观测进行过滤、聚合、排序和时间比较等计算。
Method: 提出 AdaMM 框架，无需应用定义的模式，从对话、图像和上下文元数据中抽取带溯源链接的属性-值观测，自动发现重复字段结构并物化以供分析访问；推理时由记忆感知规划器把查询分解为检索和分析操作，并路由到相应工具。
Result: 在两个长期多模态记忆基准 MemEye 和 MemGallery 上，AdaMM 的性能分别最高提升 11.3% 和 6.9%。
Conclusion: 论文强调 analytic memory 是检索记忆的互补抽象，能支持对长期交互观测的分析性访问，并在基准上优于基线。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MerchantBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Term Coherence in E-Commerce Operations
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly evaluated as autonomous tool users, yet most benchmarks focus on bounded tasks with immediate success criteria. Real-world deployments often require Long-Term Coherence, the capacity to preserve purposeful behavior across extended horizons while adapting decisions to accumulated evidence. Evaluating this capacity requires a persistent environment in which actions constrain future choices, feedback arrives at heterogeneous delays, and incoherent behavior produces measurable cumulative effects. Seller-side e-commerce provides a suitable setting for this evaluation through recurrent and interdependent decisions over Product Sourcing, Listing and Pricing Control, Cash-Flow Management, and Mixed-Latency Feedback Adaptation. We introduce MerchantBench, a 365-day order-level simulation grounded in 98,843 real e-commerce product records and equipped with 26 tools for agent interaction. MerchantBench couples promptly observable Upstream Supplier Events with delayed Downstream Order Outcomes, requiring agents to follow individual order lifecycles and revisit earlier decisions. We evaluate eight LLMs under two agent frameworks in 48 runs, each spanning 365 simulated days. Our results reveal a substantial gap between even the latest LLMs and human participants, with the best LLM configuration attaining only 27.3\% of the mean final net assets achieved by human participants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MerchantBench，一个面向电商运营场景中 LLM agent 长期一致性（Long-Term Coherence）评估的基准。它构建了基于 98,843 条真实电商商品记录的 365 天订单级模拟环境，配备 26 个交互工具，覆盖产品采购、列表与定价控制、现金流管理以及混合延迟反馈适应等任务。作者在两种 agent 框架下评估了 8 个 LLM，共 48 次运行，发现最佳 LLM 配置仅达到人类参与者平均最终净资产的 27.3%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 基准大多聚焦于具有即时成功标准的受限任务，难以评估真实部署中所需的长期一致性，即在长时间跨度内保持目标导向行为并根据累积证据调整决策。评估这种能力需要持久环境，其中行动会约束后续选择、反馈以异质延迟到达、不一致行为会产生可测量的累积效应。
Method: 作者引入 MerchantBench，一个 365 天订单级仿真环境，基于 98,843 条真实电商商品记录，并提供 26 个工具供 agent 交互。该基准将即时可观察的上游供应商事件与延迟到达的下游订单结果耦合，要求 agent 跟踪单个订单生命周期并重新审视早期决策；随后在两种 agent 框架下对 8 个 LLM 进行了 48 次、每次跨越 365 个模拟天的评估。
Result: 摘要报告，即便最新的 LLM 与人类参与者之间仍存在显著差距，最佳 LLM 配置仅达到人类参与者平均最终净资产的 27.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，卖家侧电商为评估和量化 LLM agent 的长期一致性提供了合适的测试场景，并指出现有 LLM 在该能力上仍远逊于人类参与者。

papers.title: PAIChecker: Uncovering and Checking PR-Issue Misalignment in SWE-Bench-Like Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: SWE-bench-like benchmarks are widely used for evaluating LLM's issue resolution capability. They typically follow a common construction pipeline: each PR (Pull Request) is paired with its linked issue by extracting issue references from the PR description; the issue description is used as the problem statement, and the PR patch serves as the test oracle. However, due to the inherent complexity of developing and maintaining large repositories, such PR-Issue pairings are often misaligned in practice. In this work, we systematically study SWE-bench Verified instances, finding that 13.6% exhibit misalignment across five patterns in eleven fine-grained scenarios. To enable reliable and scalable construction of those benchmarks in the future, we propose PAIChecker, a multi-agent system for checking PR-Issue misalignment in SWE-bench-like benchmarks. Specifically, PAIChecker adopts a three-phase design that combines specific pattern identification, cross-agent label synthesis, and code-level validation, thereby enabling more accurate, generalizable, and progressively verified detection. Experiments on SWE-Gym and SWE-bench Multilingual show that PAIchecker achieves the best performance across all four LLM backbones, reaching up to 92.12% and 91.67% binary accuracy, respectively.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026). Github Repo: https://github.com/manyiResearch/PAIChecker
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究 SWE-bench-like 基准中 PR-Issue 配对错位问题，发现 SWE-bench Verified 中有 13.6% 的实例存在错位，归纳为五种模式、十一类细粒度场景。作者提出 PAIChecker，一个多智能体系统，采用三阶段设计（特定模式识别、跨智能体标签综合、代码级验证）来检测这类错位。实验在 SWE-Gym 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上取得最高二元准确率 92.12% 和 91.67%。
Motivation: SWE-bench-like 基准广泛用于评估大语言模型的问题解决能力，但其构造流程依赖从 PR 描述中提取 issue 引用并配对，容易产生 PR-Issue 错位，影响基准可靠性与可扩展性。
Method: 提出 PAIChecker，一个检查 PR-Issue 错位的多智能体系统，采用三阶段设计：特定模式识别、跨智能体标签合成与代码级验证，以达到更准确、可泛化且逐步验证的检测。
Result: 在 SWE-Gym 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上，PAIChecker 在四个大语言模型后端上均取得最佳性能，二元准确率分别最高达 92.12% 和 91.67%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PR-Issue 错位在 SWE-bench-like 基准中普遍存在，PAIChecker 可作为未来可靠、可扩展基准构建的检测工具。

papers.title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Skill-based prompting has become a practical mechanism for improving large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing skill acquisition methods often treat skills as experience summaries, memory entries, or direct summaries of successful demonstrations. This creates a mismatch for weaker student agents: when a student fails because it lacks task knowledge or operational strategy, its failed trajectory may not contain enough evidence to infer the missing behavior, while the teacher trajectory may be too implicit to be internalized as reusable guidance. We propose SKILL-KD, a contrastive skill distillation framework that treats skills as an explicit distillation medium between agents of different capabilities. Given a student failure and the teacher trajectory on the same task, SKILL-KD distills their actionable discrepancy into a textual skill patch, evaluates the patch by re-running the student, and iteratively refines the patch when the student still fails. To prevent repeated local updates from causing skill drift, SKILL-KD further maintains trace-linked edit histories and performs Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation, deciding whether each patch should add a new rule, delete or modify an existing rule, or be skipped. Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, SKILL-KD consistently improves frozen student agents over fixed-model adaptation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不同能力 LLM Agent 之间的技能迁移问题，提出 SKILL-KD，一种对比技能蒸馏（contrastive skill distillation）框架，将技能视为显式的蒸馏媒介。它从学生失败轨迹与教师轨迹中提取可操作的技能补丁（skill patch），通过重新运行学生来评估并迭代细化补丁，并引入 Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation 管理补丁的增删改或跳过。在五个 Agent 基准和两种学生设置下，SKILL-KD 一致地提升了冻结学生 Agent（frozen student agent）的表现，优于固定模型适应基线。
Motivation: 现有技能获取方法通常把技能当作经验摘要、记忆条目或成功演示的总结，这忽略了较弱的学生 Agent 可能因缺乏任务知识或操作策略而失败，其失败轨迹缺少推断缺失行为的证据，而教师轨迹又过于隐式，难以被内化为可复用的指导。
Method: 提出 SKILL-KD：给定同一任务上的学生失败与教师轨迹，将二者的可行动差距蒸馏为文本技能补丁；通过重新运行学生来评估补丁，若仍失败则迭代细化。为防止重复局部更新导致技能漂移，维护带 trace 链接的编辑历史，并执行 Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation，决定每个补丁应新增规则、删除或修改现有规则，或是跳过。
Result: 在五个 Agent 基准和两种学生设置中，SKILL-KD 持续改进冻结学生 Agent，优于固定模型适应基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将技能作为能力不同的 Agent 之间的显式蒸馏媒介是有效的，且需要结合防止技能漂移的整合机制。其适用性限于文中所报告的基准与学生设置。

papers.title: The Geometric Nature and a Free Proxy for Flow-Matching Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) has become a popular action head paradigm for modern embodied models. However, as a conditional generative model, it does not explicitly expose its inherent uncertainty, producing faulty action chunks even when it misinterprets the scene or encounters out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. Therefore, determining when an FM-generated action can be trusted is essential for safe deployment, yet existing uncertainty estimation methods on real-time control suffer from several issues: extra training budget, high computational overhead, and low generalization ability. In this work, we provide a geometric interpretation of FM uncertainty in the velocity field, showing that uncertainty manifests as deviation from an ideal affine-isotropic contraction field. Building on this observation, we introduce denoising acceleration ($\mathrm{accel}$), a highly-generalizable and cost-free uncertainty proxy that measures the bending of the denoising trajectory from a single forward pass, without additional model evaluations, training, or resampling. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that $\mathrm{accel}$ is a faithful proxy for FM uncertainty and further test its utility in online failure detection. Results show that $\mathrm{accel}$ identifies failing rollouts well before termination, matching or even outperforming costly resampling- and training-based baselines across settings under realistic deployment budget. Code and demos available at: https://github.com/rrrrrrzy/fm-geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 flow matching (FM) 生成动作的不确定性提供几何解释，认为不确定性表现为去噪速度场偏离理想仿射-各向同性收缩场。基于该观察，作者提出 denoising acceleration (accel)，一种从单次前向传播即可测量去噪轨迹弯曲程度的不确定性代理，无需额外训练、重采样或模型评估。理论和实验表明 accel 是 FM 不确定性的忠实代理，并在在线失败检测中能够在 rollout 终止前识别失败，匹配或超过昂贵的重采样与训练类基线。
Motivation: FM 作为条件生成模型不显式暴露其固有不确定性，在场景误解或遭遇分布外输入时会生成错误动作块；现有不确定性估计方法在实时控制中面临额外训练预算、高计算开销和低泛化能力的问题，安全部署需要可靠的信任判断。
Method: 提出将 FM 不确定性解释为对理想仿射-各向同性收缩场的偏离，并引入 denoising acceleration (accel)，即从单次前向传播中度量去噪轨迹弯曲程度，作为无需额外模型评估、训练或重采样的不确定性代理。
Result: 作者在理论上和经验上证明 accel 是 FM 不确定性的忠实代理；在在线失败检测任务中，accel 能在 rollout 终止前识别失败，并在现实部署预算下匹配甚至超越基于重采样和基于训练的不确定性基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 accel 是一种高度可泛化且零额外成本的不确定性代理，适用于实时控制场景的安全部署，代码和演示已公开。

papers.title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a framework that teaches VLMs to reason with spatial tools and progressively internalize the specialist perceptual capabilities they provide. SpatialCLI proceeds in three stages: (1) Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools to augment the VLM's perception; (2) Learn uses Cold-Start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; and (3) Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to internalize specialist perceptual capabilities. We further introduce SpatialCLI-Bench, a 516-example benchmark for compositional perception across localization, segmentation, depth, and pose. On MindCube, SpatialCLI raises Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 29.3% to 84.6% with tools, surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol with tools (72.1%), while retaining 73.8% without tools after internalization.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: JigShape: Evaluating Visual-Geometric Reasoning in VLMs through Jigsaw Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: Jigsaw puzzle solving requires jointly reasoning about visual content and geometric constraints, yet existing benchmarks use rectangular cuts that create ambiguous ground truth in texture-repeated regions. We introduce \textit{\ours{}}, a benchmark with tab-and-blank interlocking pieces where geometric constraints provide strong local compatibility requirements that, combined with visual content, yield unambiguous ground truth. Across 95K instances at four grid densities (4$\times$4 to 16$\times$16), we find that \textbf{zero-shot VLMs largely lack geometric reasoning}: only one of five frontier models (GPT-5.5) exceeds random baseline on 4$\times$4 puzzles, while all others perform at chance level. While supervised fine-tuning achieves $>$97\% on 4$\times$4, \textbf{all models collapse on larger grids}: GPT-5.5 drops from 70\% to near-random on 8$\times$8, and even fine-tuned models fall below 5\% on 12$\times$12. This ``scaling cliff'' suggests current architectures cannot maintain consistent constraint satisfaction as the number of pieces increases. \ours{} establishes scalable geometric reasoning as an open challenge for vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JigShape，一个基于拼图任务的视觉-几何推理基准，使用榫卯式互锁拼块取代矩形切块，以消除纹理重复区域中的歧义标注。基准包含 95K 实例、四种网格密度（4×4 到 16×16），实验发现零样本 VLM 大多缺乏几何推理能力，只有 GPT-5.5 在 4×4 上超过随机基线；监督微调在 4×4 上可达 >97%，但所有模型在更大网格上崩溃，呈现明显的“缩放悬崖”。
Motivation: 现有拼图基准使用矩形切块，在纹理重复区域会产生歧义的真实标注，难以可靠评估 VLM 的几何推理能力。
Method: 引入 JigShape 基准，采用 tab-and-blank 互锁拼块，使几何约束提供强局部兼容性要求，与视觉内容结合形成无歧义标注；在 95K 实例、四种网格密度上评测多个前沿 VLM，并对比零样本与监督微调表现。
Result: 零样本设置下五个前沿模型中仅 GPT-5.5 在 4×4 上超过随机基线，其余均处于随机水平；监督微调在 4×4 上超过 97%，但 GPT-5.5 在 8×8 上从 70% 跌至接近随机，微调模型在 12×12 上低于 5%。
Conclusion: 摘要将这种“缩放悬崖”解释为当前架构无法在拼块数量增加时维持一致的约束满足，并指出可扩展的几何推理仍是视觉-语言模型面临的开放挑战。

papers.title: Investigating reservoir computing for branch prediction in pipelined processors using emerging CMOS memristor devices
papers.abstract_en: This project aimed to develop a novel reservoir compute (RC) implementation framework targeting high-speed operation and integration with CMOS digital logic. With the target workload of branch prediction (BP) for multistage pipelined central pro-cessing unit (CPU) cores. For this, a novel memristor based RC design framework was developed within the context of the workload requirements. This was then implemented in simulation using industry standard modelling languages of System Verilog (SV) and Verilog-AMS (VAMS).The developed RC design framework was subsequently verified using a basic sequence detection task before further benchmarking for its effectiveness at BP. The developed RC framework was tested using the Dhrystone performance benchmark, while targeting the RISC-V RV64GC instruction set architecture (ISA). Conducted testing demonstrates that RC shows great promise for ap-plication to BP and is capable of achieving impressive overall prediction accuracy. However, testing also shows that further refinement of the developed RC design framework is necessary to address shortfalls in the adaptability of the proposed RC system. As comparison against the state of the art TAGE predictor showed the proposed RC design framework to be 15x slower to adapt to changes in branching behaviour.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 61 figures, Master of Engineering final project report, awarded Peter John Award
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本项目面向流水线 CPU 的分支预测（branch prediction）工作负载，提出一种基于新型忆阻器（memristor）器件的储层计算（reservoir computing, RC）实现框架，目标是高速运行并与 CMOS 数字逻辑集成。框架使用 SystemVerilog 与 Verilog-AMS 建模并在仿真中实现，先用基本序列检测任务验证，再以 RISC-V RV64GC 指令集和 Dhrystone 基准测试分支预测性能。测试显示 RC 的总体预测精度较高，但相对 TAGE 预测器适应分支行为变化的速度慢 15 倍。
Motivation: 分支预测对多级流水线 CPU 性能至关重要，现有先进预测器（如 TAGE）适应性强，但作者希望探索储层计算与新兴忆阻器件在高速、CMOS 兼容环境下的应用潜力。
Method: 针对分支预测工作负载设计忆阻器 RC 设计框架，使用 SystemVerilog 和 Verilog-AMS 进行仿真实现；先用基本序列检测任务验证框架，再用 Dhrystone 基准和 RISC-V RV64GC ISA 评估其在分支预测上的有效性。
Result: 测试表明 RC 在分支预测上可以达到很高的总体预测准确率；与 SOTA 的 TAGE 预测器相比，所提 RC 框架适应分支行为变化的速度慢 15 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RC 应用于分支预测很有前景，但当前框架在适应性上存在短处，需进一步改进以满足实际需求。

papers.title: AgentSnare: Learning to Delay, Divert, and Defuse Autonomous Penetration Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents automate penetration testing through an observation-action loop, selecting actions based on observations returned by tools. This dependence allows defenders to inject deceptive observations that can mislead the agent's decision-making process. However, existing defenses rely heavily on static, isolated artifacts planted in the environment prior to an attack. Advanced agents can progressively recognize and bypass these artifacts, ultimately refocusing their exploitation attempts on the real target. To address this issue, we introduce AgentSnare, a trajectory-adaptive deception system that dynamically unfolds a decoy environment to continually steer the penetration agent away from the real target. Specifically, AgentSnare employs an artifact-construction policy model that constructs candidate artifacts conditioned on the agent's interaction history and decoy state. AgentSnare then validates these candidates and incrementally incorporates valid artifacts into a factually consistent decoy environment, thereby delaying the attack by absorbing its tool calls, diverting its post-entry trajectory within the decoy, and defusing it by inducing completion reports grounded in decoy evidence. Across 15 CVE-Bench web applications and three attacker models, AgentSnare absorbs 46.8% of the agent's tool calls in the decoy and retains 55.9% of post-entry actions there, while 90.0% of completion attempts are grounded in decoy evidence; across all 45 attacker-CVE pairs, no real target is successfully exploited at pass@3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentSnare，一种轨迹自适应的诱骗系统，用于防御大语言模型驱动的自主渗透测试智能体。系统根据智能体的交互历史动态构建诱饵环境，通过吸收工具调用、转移进入后的轨迹并引导基于诱饵证据的完成报告，使攻击偏离真实目标。在 15 个 CVE-Bench Web 应用和三种攻击者模型上，AgentSnare 吸收了 46.8% 的工具调用，保留了 55.9% 的进入后动作，且 90.0% 的完成尝试基于诱饵证据；在全部 45 个攻击者-CVE 组合中，pass@3 下没有真实目标被成功利用。
Motivation: 现有防御依赖攻击前预置于环境中的静态、孤立工件，先进智能体能够逐步识别并绕过这些工件，最终将利用尝试重新聚焦于真实目标。
Method: AgentSnare 采用工件构建策略模型，依据智能体的交互历史与诱饵状态生成候选工件；随后验证这些候选，并逐步将有效工件整合到一个事实一致的诱饵环境中，从而延迟攻击、转移其进入后轨迹并使其失效。
Result: 在 15 个 CVE-Bench Web 应用和三种攻击者模型上，AgentSnare 吸收了 46.8% 的工具调用，诱饵中保留了 55.9% 的进入后动作，90.0% 的完成尝试基于诱饵证据；在全部 45 个攻击者-CVE 组合中，pass@3 下没有真实目标被成功利用。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，动态展开且与攻击轨迹自适应的诱饵环境能够持续引导渗透智能体远离真实目标，为现有静态工件防御提供了一种替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feature Bagging Provides Stability
papers.abstract_en: We study feature bagging through the lens of algorithmic stability. Feature bagging is an ensemble strategy that aggregates base learners trained on randomly subsampled feature subsets, possibly in a data-dependent manner. We introduce feature instability (FI), the feature-axis analogue of instance instability (II), which measures sensitivity to removing a single feature. Smaller values of II or FI correspond to stronger stability, and our experiments show that FI captures generalization-relevant information complementary to II. Within this framework, we analyze feature bagging in both a parametric linear model and a model-free setting inspired by recursive feature subsampling in random forests. In both settings, we establish formal guarantees showing that feature bagging improves the relevant stability relative to its non-bagged counterpart, with larger improvements under more aggressive subsampling. We further show that a modest number of bagging rounds is sufficient to approach the infinite-bagging stability level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从算法稳定性角度研究特征袋装法 (feature bagging)，即对随机抽取的特征子集训练基学习器并聚合的集成策略。作者提出特征不稳定性 (feature instability, FI)，作为实例不稳定性 (instance instability, II) 在特征轴上的类比对偶，实验表明 FI 能捕获与 II 互补的泛化相关信息。在参数线性模型和受随机森林递归特征子采样启发的无模型设定下，作者给出形式化保证，证明特征袋装相比非袋装对应物提升相关稳定性，且子采样越激进提升越大。
Motivation: 现有算法稳定性分析主要关注对单个样本（实例）的敏感性，而特征维度上的稳定性及其在集成方法中的作用尚未被系统研究。理解特征袋装如何通过稳定性影响泛化，有助于从理论层面解释这类集成策略的有效性。
Method: 引入特征轴上的稳定性度量 FI，度量移除单个特征后学习算法的敏感性，并在此框架下分析特征袋装。作者在参数线性模型和基于随机森林递归特征子采样的无模型设定中分别建立理论分析。
Result: 实验表明 FI 携带与 II 互补的泛化相关信息；理论证明特征袋装能改善相对非袋装方法的稳定性，且更激进的子采样带来更大的稳定性提升；少量 bagging 轮次即可接近无限袋装稳定性水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为特征袋装通过提升特征轴上的稳定性带来泛化收益，且不需要大量集成轮次即可达到近似极限稳定性。摘要未讨论具体数据集或任务以外的局限性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为特征袋装通过提升特征轴上的稳定性带来泛化收益，且不需要大量集成轮次即可达到近似极限稳定性。摘要未讨论具体数据集或任务以外的局限性。

papers.title: Metis: Memory Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI agents have increasingly internalized native capabilities into their underlying foundation models, giving rise to multimodal foundation models and large reasoning models. However, agent memory is still primarily implemented through external modules, leaving the native memory capability largely unexplored. In this paper, we take a first step toward this direction by introducing memory foundation models, which empower foundation models with native memory capabilities. We formalize native memory from two perspectives: a persistent and dynamically evolving memory state within the backbone, and native memory procedures that autonomously store and utilize information through model computation. We show that native memory offers advantages in architecture, end-to-end optimization, and efficiency. Based on this formulation, we propose Metis, the first prototype of memory foundation models. Metis introduces a new architecture that equips a foundation model with a native memory state, allowing historical information to be compressed into the model and accessed through memory attention. We construct large-scale memory-specific training data and introduce multiple optimization objectives to acquire these native memory procedures through mid-training. The online memory maintenance of Metis is gradient-free, and the memory update requires only a forward pass. At inference time, all learned model weights remain frozen, while the native memory states are autonomously transformed through standard forward computation. Through extensive experiments, we show that Metis exhibits native memory capabilities and further provide a detailed analysis of its strengths, limitations, and behaviors. To facilitate future research on memory foundation models, we release our project and model checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出记忆基础模型 (memory foundation model) 的概念，并给出首个原型 Metis。Metis 在基础模型骨干内引入持久且动态演化的原生记忆状态，通过记忆注意力 (memory attention) 访问历史信息，在线记忆维护无需梯度、仅需一次前向传播。大量实验表明 Metis 展现出原生记忆能力，作者也分析了其优势、局限与行为，并开源项目与模型权重。
Motivation: 现有 AI agent 的记忆主要通过外部模块实现，基础模型本身的原生记忆能力尚未被充分探索。作者希望将记忆内化进基础模型，从而在架构、端到端优化和效率方面获得优势。
Method: 从两个角度形式化原生记忆：骨干网络内持久且动态演化的记忆状态，以及通过模型计算自主存储和利用信息的原生记忆过程。Metis 基于该形式化提出新架构，赋予基础模型原生记忆状态；作者构造大规模记忆专用训练数据，并通过多个优化目标在中途训练 (mid-training) 中习得这些记忆过程。推理时模型权重保持冻结，记忆状态通过标准前向计算自主变换。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但通过大量实验表明 Metis 具备原生记忆能力，并提供了关于其优势、局限和行为的详细分析。
Conclusion: 作者将 Metis 定位为记忆基础模型的第一个原型，强调其在架构、端到端优化和效率上的优势，同时指出需要进一步研究其局限。为促进后续研究，项目与模型 checkpoints 已开源。

papers.title: HERMES: A Hybrid Ensemble for Head-and-Neck Tumor Segmentation, TN Staging, and Recurrence-Free Survival on PET/CT
papers.abstract_en: We present HERMES (Hybrid Ensemble for Radiotherapy-target segmentation, Malignancy staging, and Event-free Survival), a single containerized algorithm for the three HECKTOR 2026 subtasks: segmentation of the primary tumor (GTVp) and pathological lymph nodes (GTVn), radiological T/N staging, and recurrence-free survival (RFS), computed from a paired FDG-PET/CT scan and an electronic health record. A 10-fold ensemble of STU-Net Small networks produces the segmentation; the predicted mask then drives two downstream tasks. Rather than pass a generic radiomics vector to the staging models, we derive from the predicted masks a compact set of geometry features aligned with the size and number axes of AJCC/UICC 7th-edition radiological N/T staging. On internal cross-validation these features raise N-stage balanced accuracy from 0.691 to 0.720 (+0.030), our largest single design gain, at lower feature dimensionality. For prognosis we combine complementary deep and clinical risk experts in an equal-weight ensemble, and train one deep expert with a concordance-tracking survival loss of our own, whose value approximates the concordance index during training. Every component was selected on honest out-of-fold predictions under a regularization-oriented protocol, with no tuning on the public validation set, and deployed as two decorrelated submissions. On the HECKTOR 2026 validation leaderboard, HERMES achieved a weighted score of 0.6454 (Mean Dice 0.641, T balanced accuracy 0.580, N balanced accuracy 0.642, RFS C-index 0.679) and qualified for the testing phase. Team: AMC_HNC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERMES 是一个容器化的混合集成算法，面向 HECKTOR 2026 的三个子任务：原发肿瘤 (GTVp) 与病理淋巴结 (GTVn) 分割、放射学 T/N 分期以及无复发生存 (RFS) 预测，输入为配对的 FDG-PET/CT 与电子健康记录。分割部分采用 10 折 STU-Net Small 集成，预测掩膜随后驱动两个下游任务。分期模型使用从掩膜导出的紧凑几何特征而非通用 radiomics 向量，内部交叉验证将 N 分期平衡准确率从 0.691 提升至 0.720；预后部分以等权集成结合深度与临床风险专家，其中一个深度专家使用作者自有的、近似一致性指数的 concordance-tracking 生存损失训练。所有组件基于诚实的 out-of-fold 预测在正则化协议下选择，未在公共验证集上调参。在 HECKTOR 2026 验证榜上获得加权分数 0.6454（Mean Dice 0.641，T 平衡准确率 0.580，N 平衡准确率 0.642，RFS C-index 0.679），进入测试阶段。
Motivation: 头颈肿瘤 PET/CT 分析需要同时完成分割、分期和生存预测，但现有方法往往为各任务单独设计，且分期模型常依赖高维通用 radiomics 特征，缺乏与 AJCC/UICC 分期标准对齐的紧凑几何信息。
Method: 提出单一容器化算法 HERMES：用 10 折 STU-Net Small 集成生成 GTVp/GTVn 分割掩膜；分期任务从掩膜提取与 AJCC/UICC 第 7 版 N/T 分期大小和数量轴对齐的紧凑几何特征；预后任务以等权集成组合深度与临床风险专家，并采用自定义的 concordance-tracking 生存损失训练一个深度专家。所有组件在正则化导向协议下基于 out-of-fold 预测选择，避免在公共验证集上调参。
Result: 内部交叉验证显示，分期特征将 N 分期平衡准确率从 0.691 提升到 0.720（+0.030），且特征维度更低。在 HECKTOR 2026 验证排行榜上，HERMES 取得加权分数 0.6454，其中 Mean Dice 0.641、T 平衡准确率 0.580、N 平衡准确率 0.642、RFS C-index 0.679，并进入测试阶段。
Conclusion: 作者强调从预测掩膜导出的几何特征比通用 radiomics 向量更能提升分期性能，且该设计增益是最大单项增益；同时验证了在不使用公共验证集调参的情况下，通过诚实的 out-of-fold 评估选择组件可以构建有效的多任务集成系统。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DHRCL:Training Code LLMs with Dense Hierarchical Rewards and Curriculum Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is a natural post-training paradigm for code-oriented large language models because generated programs can be evaluated through parsing, execution, unit tests, and structural analysis. However, existing methods often rely on sparse outcome rewards or statically combine heterogeneous dense signals, even though syntax validity, executability, functional correctness, and structural organization describe different and progressively dependent programming capabilities. We propose DHRCL, a reinforcement learning framework with Dense Hierarchical Rewards and Curriculum Learning. DHRCL decomposes feedback into syntax validation, execution success, unit-test pass rate, and AST-based structural similarity, and organizes these signals through a three-stage Syntax, Execution, Pass & Structural curriculum. Stage duration is determined automatically from recent validation trends rather than manually specified capability thresholds. We further introduce stage-aware probability-based token credit redistribution. The mechanism follows a consolidation-to-refinement principle: it emphasizes established token patterns during syntax-oriented optimization, applies uniform propagation for non-local execution feedback, and allocates more credit or blame to less-established token decisions during final functional optimization. Under a unified Qwen3-8B and KodCode protocol, the experiments compare DHRCL with binary, pass-rate, reward-model-based, and verifiable dense-reward baselines. We further evaluate DHRCL across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-14B backbones, showing that its advantage remains consistent as model capacity increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DHRCL，一个面向代码大语言模型的强化学习框架，结合密集分层奖励 (Dense Hierarchical Rewards) 与课程学习 (Curriculum Learning)。它将反馈分解为语法验证、执行成功、单元测试通过率和基于 AST 的结构相似度四类信号，并组织成语法、执行、通过率与结构的三阶段课程。阶段时长由近期验证趋势自动决定，而非人工设定能力阈值；同时引入阶段感知的基于概率的 token 信用再分配机制。实验在统一 Qwen3-8B 与 KodCode 协议下与多种基线对比，并在 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 上验证了跨规模的一致性优势。
Motivation: 现有代码 LLM 的强化学习后训练常依赖稀疏的结果奖励 (sparse outcome rewards)，或静态组合多种异构稠密信号；作者指出语法有效性、可执行性、功能正确性与结构组织描述的是渐进依赖的不同编程能力，需要专门设计的反馈组织方式。
Method: DHRCL 将反馈拆分为语法验证、执行成功、单元测试通过率和 AST 结构相似度，并通过 Syntax、Execution、Pass & Structural 三阶段课程组织这些信号。阶段时长由近期验证趋势自动确定；阶段感知的基于概率的 token 信用再分配遵循 consolidation-to-refinement 原则，在语法优化阶段强调已确立的 token 模式，对非局部执行反馈采用均匀传播，在最终功能优化阶段将更多信用或责任分配给较不稳定的 token 决策。
Result: 在统一 Qwen3-8B 与 KodCode 协议下，实验将 DHRCL 与二值奖励、通过率、奖励模型和可验证稠密奖励基线对比；在 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-14B 骨干上，方法的优势随模型容量增大保持一致。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DHRCL 通过分层奖励与自动课程调度能稳定提升代码 LLM 的强化学习效果，且收益在模型规模扩大时保持；未在摘要中说明局限性。

papers.title: AgentGUI: An Interface for Observing and Steering Long-Running AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly adept at tackling complex, long-running tasks. With the rapid surge of autonomous capabilities, human oversight is systematically lagging behind due to limited human-centered interfacing. Aiming to address this, we introduce AgentGUI, a user-friendly, locally hosted GUI for seamlessly observing and steering AI agents amid multiple concurrent, long-running sessions. AgentGUI features 1) rich agent trajectory visualizations, 2) effective manual and automated steering, and 3) integration with and coordination between open-source and frontier agent frameworks. A controlled user study demonstrates statistically significant reduction in the time it takes to identify key elements from agent traces (38% faster, p = 0.023). In a preliminary experiment, AgentGUI's automated drift prevention feature raises the task completion rate of small local agents by as high as 34pp across a 0.8B--9B model ladder (N=50 runs per model). AgentGUI is publicly available through its project website (https://agent-gui-project.github.io) and open-source repository (https://github.com/eth-medical-ai-lab/agent-gui), along with a demo video (https://youtube.com/watch?v=GSDyxN1gTF0).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentGUI，一个本地托管的图形界面，用于观察和操控多个并发的长时间运行 AI 智能体。它提供丰富的智能体轨迹可视化、手动与自动转向功能，并能集成多个开源与前沿智能体框架。受控用户研究发现，从智能体轨迹中识别关键元素的时间显著缩短（快 38%，p=0.023）；在初步实验中，其自动漂移预防功能将 0.8B–9B 小模型的任务完成率最多提高 34 个百分点。项目已开源并提供演示视频。
Motivation: AI 智能体在长时任务上的能力快速提升，但人类监督因缺乏以人为本的交互界面而系统性滞后。
Method: AgentGUI 提供三种核心能力：丰富的智能体轨迹可视化、有效的手动与自动转向、以及开放源代码与前沿智能体框架之间的集成与协调。
Result: 受控用户研究表明，从轨迹中识别关键元素的时间显著减少（38% 更快，p=0.023）；初步实验中，自动漂移预防使小本地智能体的任务完成率在 0.8B–9B 模型阶梯上最高提升 34 个百分点（每模型 N=50 次运行）。
Conclusion: AgentGUI 以用户友好的本地界面改善人类对长时智能体会话的监督能力，并通过项目网站、开源仓库和演示视频公开提供。

summary_sections.method: AgentGUI 提供三种核心能力：丰富的智能体轨迹可视化、有效的手动与自动转向、以及开放源代码与前沿智能体框架之间的集成与协调。
summary_sections.result: 受控用户研究表明，从轨迹中识别关键元素的时间显著减少（38% 更快，p=0.023）；初步实验中，自动漂移预防使小本地智能体的任务完成率在 0.8B–9B 模型阶梯上最高提升 34 个百分点（每模型 N=50 次运行）。
summary_sections.conclusion: AgentGUI 以用户友好的本地界面改善人类对长时智能体会话的监督能力，并通过项目网站、开源仓库和演示视频公开提供。

papers.title: Learning the Word Problem: Geodesic Lengths and Cryptographic Applications
papers.abstract_en: The Word Problem has been a subject of intensive mathematical study for over a century, initially driving advances in combinatorial group theory and more recently emerging as a foundational hardness assumption in post-quantum cryptography (PQC). While generally undecidable, several families of infinite non-abelian groups exhibit solvable or algorithmically fast word problems, making them attractive platforms for cryptographic design. This paper introduces WPNet, a novel Graph Neural Network architecture capable of solving the Word Problem heuristically, which is demonstrated on the Baumslag-Solitar group $BS(1,2)$ and on an Artin group. By mapping unreduced words to dynamic graph structures, the model learns to cluster algebraically equivalent elements in a continuous embedding space, effectively identifying the geodesic representative of a word without executing discrete reduction steps. As an application, a model variant is developed that can predict the geodesic length of an unreduced word in both groups. To demonstrate the cryptographic severity of this structural leakage, WPNet is successfully deployed against the Wagner-Magyarik public-key cryptosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WPNet，一种图神经网络 (GNN) 架构，用于启发式求解群论中的字问题 (Word Problem)，并在 Baumslag-Solitar 群 BS(1,2) 与一个 Artin 群上演示。模型将未归约词映射为动态图结构，在连续嵌入空间中聚类代数等价元素，从而无需执行离散归约步骤即可识别词的测地线代表元，并可预测未归约词的测地线长度。作为应用，作者将 WPNet 部署于 Wagner-Magyarik 公钥密码系统，展示该结构泄露带来的密码学风险。
Motivation: 字问题一般不可判定，但若干无限非阿贝尔群族具有可解或算法上快速的字问题，成为后量子密码 (PQC) 设计的候选平台；作者关注这类群中可学习的结构泄露是否可能威胁基于其上的密码系统。
Method: 提出 WPNet 图神经网络架构，将未归约词映射为动态图结构，学习在连续嵌入空间中对代数等价元素聚类，直接识别词的测地线代表元而无需离散归约步骤；并开发模型变体预测未归约词的测地线长度。
Result: 摘要报告 WPNet 在 Baumslag-Solitar 群 BS(1,2) 与 Artin 群上启发式求解字问题并成功预测测地线长度，且成功攻击 Wagner-Magyarik 公钥密码系统。
Conclusion: 摘要强调特定群族中的字问题可被图神经网络启发式求解，这种结构泄露具有密码学严重性，对基于此类群的密码设计构成警示。

papers.title: Knowledge-guided Disentanglement with Atomic Actions for Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Action recognition in complex scenes often involves multiple concurrent fine-grained actions, making it challenging to model internal action structures. Most existing methods rely on holistic representations, which are insufficient for capturing subtle interactions and fine-grained semantics. While recent prompt-based approaches introduce disentanglement, they lack explicit semantic guidance, and methods based solely on visual or structured cues remain coarse-grained. In this paper, we propose Knowledge-guided Disentanglement with Atomic Actions (KDA), which leverages fine-grained semantic knowledge to enhance action representations and enable more precise disentanglement. Specifically, we use Large Language Models (LLMs) to decompose action labels into atomic actions, providing explicit spatial-temporal semantics. A Knowledge Injection Module (KIM) first integrates atomic action knowledge into video features. Based on this enhanced representation, a Knowledge Disentanglement Module (KDM) further disentangles atomic action knowledge to produce more precise semantic guidance for action disentanglement. A Knowledge Disentanglement Loss (KD Loss) is introduced to encourage clearer disentanglement of knowledge components within KDM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KDA improves feature discriminability and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-label action recognition benchmarks. Moreover, KIM and KDM can be readily integrated into other methods, demonstrating strong generality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Knowledge-guided Disentanglement with Atomic Actions (KDA)，针对复杂场景中多并发细粒度动作的识别问题，利用大语言模型 (LLM) 将动作标签分解为原子动作，并结合知识注入与知识解耦模块增强动作表征。摘要报告该方法在多个多标签动作识别基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，且 KIM 与 KDM 模块可即插即用地集成到其他方法中。
Motivation: 现有动作识别方法多依赖整体表征，难以捕捉多个并发细粒度动作间的微妙交互；已有的基于 prompt 的解耦方法缺乏显式语义指导，仅靠视觉或结构化线索的方法粒度仍然粗糙。
Method: 先用 LLM 将动作标签分解为原子动作以获得显式时空语义；Knowledge Injection Module (KIM) 将原子动作知识注入视频特征，Knowledge Disentanglement Module (KDM) 进一步解耦原子动作知识以产生更精确的语义指导；并引入 Knowledge Disentanglement Loss (KD Loss) 促进 KDM 内知识组件的清晰解耦。
Result: 大量实验表明 KDA 提升了特征判别力，并在多标签动作识别基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能；同时 KIM 与 KDM 可方便集成进其他方法，具备较强通用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用细粒度语义知识进行显式解耦可以增强动作表征，并指出所提模块具有良好迁移性；研究范围限定在视频动作识别，未涉及其下游场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ForgettingOT: Certified Speculative Batching from Sinkhorn's Projective Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Positive two-marginal entropic optimal transport is solved by a nonlinear, positive, order-preserving, homogeneous Sinkhorn map. After quotienting the dual scaling gauge, we show that the active eigenmode of the fixed-point Jacobian $J_t^\star=QP=P^\star P$, generically $λ_2(QP)$, controls the strict correction tail. The projective-residual ratio converges to this mode, and the additional certified cycles required for tolerance $θ_τ$ scale as $\log(ρ/θ_τ)/[-\logλ_2]+O(1)$. ForgettingOT turns this nonlinear Perron--Frobenius fact into a certified executor for streams of related Sinkhorn problems. A computable projective variation $Ω_t$ in the marginals and kernel bounds the carry residual, while a verified contraction $q_t$ gives candidate repair depth. A window theorem converts these depths and the audit grid into bounds on packed work, collective rounds, overshoot, and fallback. Empirical tail estimates allocate work but never authorize release; current-instance certificates or measured marginal residuals do so, with ordinary Sinkhorn as fallback. On 15 FP64 A100/OTT-JAX cells, the observed quotient slow-mode ratio agrees with $λ_2(QP)$ to $9.84\times10^{-6}$. On controlled four-A100 streams, the complete executor is $1.42\times$--$3.55\times$ faster than sequential soft $c$-transform warm starts, with 30/30 paired wins and no violations of the $10^{-3}$ marginal tolerance. Eight-A100 support-4096 streams give $2.584\times$--$2.945\times$ wall-time speedup and $4.285\times$--$4.615\times$ fewer vector-collective rounds. The outer executor composes with target-preserving Sinkhorn accelerators; a changed map or approximate target needs a contraction or error bridge before inheriting the repair-depth bound.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Major revision: adds a variation-dependent nonlinear Perron-Frobenius work and communication analysis, expanded 8-A100 single-node experiments, and compatibility analysis with modern Sinkhorn accelerators
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForgettingOT，一个用于相关 Sinkhorn 问题流（即带正边际的熵最优传输问题）的认证投机批处理执行器。作者通过商掉对偶缩放规范，证明不动点 Jacobian J_t^\star=QP 的活动特征模态（generic 情况下为 λ2(QP)）控制严格修正尾部，并据此给出所需的额外认证迭代次数。实验显示该方法在 A100 上对连续 Sinkhorn 问题流取得显著加速且不违反边际容差。
Motivation: 连续求解多个相关的 Sinkhorn 问题代价高昂，而现有的 warm-start 策略缺乏可认证的容差保证；论文希望利用非线性 Perron–Frobenius 结构，在重用先前计算（投机批处理）的同时，对每次输出的边际容差提供严格证明。
Method: 利用 Sinkhorn 映射的正性、保序性与齐次性，通过商掉双缩放规范，将投影残差比与不动点 Jacobian 的第二特征模态 λ2(QP) 关联；引入可计算的投影变化量 Ω_t 来界定 carry residual，用验证过的压缩量 q_t 给出候选修复深度，再由 window theorem 将这些深度与审计网格转化为对 packed work、collective rounds、overshoot 和 fallback 的界限。实际调度只依据经验尾部估计分配工作，但只有当前实例的证书或实测边际残差才授权释放结果，普通 Sinkhorn 作为 fallback。
Result: 在 15 个 FP64 A100/OTT-JAX 单元上，观测到的商慢模态比与 λ2(QP) 一致到 9.84×10^-6；在受控四-A100 流上，完整执行器比顺序 soft c-transform warm starts 快 1.42 倍至 3.55 倍，30/30 配对获胜，且无违反 10^-3 边际容差；八-A100、support-4096 流上墙钟加速 2.584 倍至 2.945 倍，向量 collective 轮数减少 4.285 倍至 4.615 倍。
Conclusion: 该外层执行器可与保持目标不变的 Sinkhorn 加速器组合使用；但若映射改变或目标是近似目标，则需先建立压缩桥或误差桥，才能继承修复深度界的保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Moral Hazard in Multi-Agent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cooperation can fail when socially valuable effort is costly, weakly observable, and mainly benefits others. Drawing on Holmström's team moral-hazard model, we introduce the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game, a controlled textual game that operationalizes this hidden-action structure for language agents. In each episode, an agent can preserve an immediate local reward or pay a query cost to reveal a hidden safety fact that primarily helps another agent's downstream decision. We evaluate nine open-weight language models and one frontier API model, decomposing behavior into query use, realized information transfer, local-reward preservation, unsafe choice, format validity, and team success. Base open-weight models commonly preserve local reward without team success or query without communicating information that changes the final decision. GPT-5.6 Sol reaches ceiling behavior in the primary setting, and autonomous sweeps respond strongly to query cost and team reward. In a 3,015-decision incentive-isolation experiment with scripted partners, its empirical query threshold tracks the Holmström-derived private-share boundary across nine query costs with mean absolute error 0.013. We then use supervised fine-tuning, RLOO, sequential SFT+RLOO, and GEPA prompt optimization as diagnostic update mechanisms where coverage permits. Their effects are heterogeneous: SmolLM3-3B and OLMo-7B show the clearest mechanism-consistent weight-level improvements, whereas GEPA sometimes improves team success while reducing or eliminating costly queries. Thus, optimization can shift aggregate reward without recovering the designated cooperative mechanism, motivating evaluations that report mechanism-level behavior rather than team success alone.
papers.comment: Post Social Simulation with LLMS: Fidelity in Applications at COLM 2026 workshop version. Included GPT 5.6 Sol for construct validity and theory tests
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受 Holmström 团队道德风险模型启发，提出 Dialogue Moral Hazard Game，一个将隐藏行动结构操作化的受控文本博弈，用于考察语言智能体在成本高昂且难以观测的利他行为中的合作失败。作者对九个开放权重模型和一个前沿 API 模型进行评估，将行为分解为查询使用、信息传递、本地奖励保留、不安全选择、格式有效性与团队成功，并对比多种优化机制。
Motivation: 合作可能因社会性努力成本高、可观测性弱且主要惠及他人而失败；论文旨在把这一隐藏行动结构引入语言智能体评估，并指出仅看团队成功会掩盖机制层面的失败。
Method: 定义每回合中智能体可选择保留即时本地奖励，或支付查询代价以揭示主要帮助下游智能体决策的隐藏安全事实；随后用监督微调 (SFT)、RLOO、顺序 SFT+RLOO 和 GEPA 提示优化作为诊断性更新机制，并做激励隔离实验与理论边界对照。
Result: 基础开放权重模型常出现保留本地奖励却无团队成功、或查询但未传递改变最终决策的信息；GPT-5.6 Sol 在主设置中达到上限行为，在 3,015 次决策实验中其经验查询阈值在九个查询代价上跟踪 Holmström 推导的私人份额边界，平均绝对误差 0.013。SmolLM3-3B 与 OLMo-7B 表现出最清晰的机制一致权重级改进，而 GEPA 有时提升团队成功却减少或消除高代价查询。
Conclusion: 优化可以在不恢复指定合作机制的情况下改变聚合奖励，因此评估应报告机制级行为而非仅报告团队成功。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 基础开放权重模型常出现保留本地奖励却无团队成功、或查询但未传递改变最终决策的信息；GPT-5.6 Sol 在主设置中达到上限行为，在 3,015 次决策实验中其经验查询阈值在九个查询代价上跟踪 Holmström 推导的私人份额边界，平均绝对误差 0.013。SmolLM3-3B 与 OLMo-7B 表现出最清晰的机制一致权重级改进，而 GEPA 有时提升团队成功却减少或消除高代价查询。
summary_sections.conclusion: 优化可以在不恢复指定合作机制的情况下改变聚合奖励，因此评估应报告机制级行为而非仅报告团队成功。

papers.title: CAPT: A Multi-task Continuous Autoregressive Transformer enabling Cross-dataset and Cross-species Transfer for Calcium Population Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale calcium imaging has created an opportunity to build foundation-style models for neural population dynamics, but a central question remains unresolved: \textbf{whether a model pretrained on one collection of recordings can generalize to new datasets, experimental paradigms, and even species.} Existing approaches are often designed for specific tasks and evaluated on a single dataset, making it unclear whether their learned representations are reusable for new calcium trace datasets. To tackle this gap, we present \textbf{CAPT}, a \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{A}utoregressive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{T}ransformer for calcium population dynamics. CAPT models continuous calcium traces directly through a continuous patch tokenization strategy and is trained autoregressively, enabling end-to-end pretraining and adaptation to diverse downstream tasks. We first pretrain CAPT on a large-scale mouse calcium imaging dataset and evaluate its transferability across independent mouse, larval zebrafish, and \textit{C. elegans} datasets collected by different laboratories. In these transfer settings, the pretrained backbone is frozen and only adaptation modules are updated. Across neural population forecasting and behavior decoding tasks, CAPT consistently outperforms specialized and general-purpose baselines. Alongside predictive performance, multimodal analyses using NeuroPAL annotations in \textit{C. elegans} datasets show that CAPT embeddings form a shared functional space across datasets and capture anatomical cell-identity-related structure. These results suggest that the continuous autoregressive modeling opens up possibilities for a simple route towards general-purpose neural foundation models for calcium imaging, which can generalize across datasets, experimental paradigms, and species. Code is available at https://github.com/TSuXinH/CAPT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAPT，一个连续自回归群体 Transformer (Continuous Autoregressive Population Transformer)，直接对钙成像连续 traces 建模，采用连续 patch tokenization 和自回归训练，支持端到端预训练与多任务适应。作者在大型小鼠钙成像数据上预训练，并冻结骨干网络、只更新适应模块，在独立的小鼠、斑马鱼幼鱼和线虫数据集上评估跨数据集、跨物种迁移；在神经群体预测和行为解码任务上，CAPT 一致优于专用和通用基线。利用线虫 NeuroPAL 注释的多模态分析显示，CAPT embeddings 在不同数据集间形成共享功能空间，并捕获解剖细胞身份相关结构。
Motivation: 大规模钙成像为构建神经群体动力学的基础模型提供了机会，但一个核心问题尚未解决：在某一记录集合上预训练的模型能否泛化到新数据集、新实验范式和跨物种。现有方法多为特定任务设计并在单一数据集上评估，难以判断其学习表征是否可复用于新的钙 traces 数据集。
Method: CAPT 通过连续 patch tokenization 策略直接对连续钙 traces 建模，并以自回归方式训练，从而实现端到端预训练和下游任务适应。在迁移设置中，预训练骨干被冻结，仅更新适应模块。
Result: 在独立的小鼠、斑马鱼幼鱼和线虫数据集上，CAPT 在神经群体预测和行为解码任务中一致超越专用和通用基线；线虫 NeuroPAL 注释的多模态分析表明其 embeddings 形成跨数据集共享功能空间并捕获解剖细胞身份相关结构。
Conclusion: 连续自回归建模为钙成像通用神经基础模型提供了一条简单路径，能够跨数据集、实验范式和物种泛化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Automating theoretical research is constrained not only by the generation of candidate results, but also by their reliable evaluation. A common approach is to close the research loop with a large language model (LLM) reviewer. However, such reviewers remain empirically unreliable: they may accept fabricated papers and detect them at rates close to chance (Bad Scientist, 2025). We present CausalForge, a framework for automated theoretical research in causal inference grounded in the Lean proof assistant. CausalForge combines Causalean, a foundational Lean library for causal inference containing 7,035 machine-checked declarations developed with language-model assistance under human design and review, with CausalSmith, a self-improving agentic pipeline that selects research topics, proposes results, formalizes statements, constructs proofs, and presents the resulting artifacts for human inspection. Because a machine-checked proof establishes only that a formal statement follows from its assumptions, not that the statement faithfully captures the intended scientific claim, the pipeline augments kernel verification with a statement audit that compares each formal theorem against the informal claim it is intended to express. We evaluate the system using artifacts produced by completed autonomous research runs. The source code, formal library, and run records are available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/CausalForge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CausalForge，一个以 Lean 证明助手为基础、面向因果推断自动化理论研究的智能体框架。框架包含 Causalean（含 7,035 条机器可检查声明的基础库）和 CausalSmith（自改进的智能体流水线，用于选题、提出结果、形式化陈述、构造证明并交付人工检查）。由于机器检查仅保证形式陈述在假设下成立，作者在证明验证之外增加语句审计环节，将形式定理与其对应的非形式科学声明进行比对。摘要使用已完成自主研究运行产出的工件对系统进行评估。
Motivation: 自动化理论研究不仅受限于候选结果的生成，还受限于结果的可靠评估；常见做法是用大语言模型（LLM）作评审者，但这类评审者经验上不可靠，可能接受伪造论文且检测率接近随机水平。
Method: CausalForge 将 Causalean（在人类设计与审阅下借助语言模型辅助开发的因果推断基础库）与 CausalSmith（自改进的智能体流水线）结合，流水线负责选题、提出结果、形式化、证明构造和呈现，并在内核验证之外通过语句审计（statement audit）检查形式定理是否忠实表达其意图对应的非形式论断。
Result: 摘要报告使用完整自主研究运行产生的工件进行系统评估，但没有给出具体定量结果；代码、形式化库和运行记录公开在 GitHub。
Conclusion: 作者强调机器可检查的证明只说明形式陈述可从假设推出，并不说明该陈述准确捕捉了原始科学主张，因此有必要补充语句审计并保留人工检查环节。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: TriGlue: a Biology-Inspired Generative Model for Generating Molecular Glue-Induced Ternary Complex
papers.abstract_en: Molecular glue degraders have emerged as a promising strategy for targeted protein degradation by inducing ternary complex formation between an E3 ubiquitin ligase and a target protein. Despite their therapeutic potential, computational design of molecular glues remains largely unexplored. Unlike conventional structure-based drug design, molecular glue design is governed by the unknown protein-protein interface and requires the simultaneous modeling of ligand generation, protein-protein docking, and ternary complex assembly. In this work, we formulate molecular glue design as a ternary complex generation problem and propose a biology-inspired generative framework, TriGlue. Motivated by the mechanism of molecular glue action, we decompose ternary complex generation into two coupled stages: interface estimation and interface-conditioned complex generation. First, we develop an SE(3)-equivariant interface estimation module that predicts a geometrically constrained protein-protein interface from unbound monomer structures. Second, we introduce an interface-conditioned ternary flow matching network that jointly generates the molecular glue and predicts the rigid-body transformation required to assemble the ternary complex. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TriGlue generates chemically valid molecules and produces plausible ternary complexes, which highlight the potential of biology-inspired generative modeling for accelerating molecular glue discovery. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuliangyan0807/molecular-glue-design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriGlue，一个受分子胶作用机制启发的生成框架，将分子胶设计建模为三元复合物 (ternary complex) 生成问题。该框架将生成过程分解为两个耦合阶段：SE(3)-等变的蛋白质-蛋白质界面估计模块，以及基于界面的三元流匹配网络 (flow matching network)，后者同时生成分子胶分子并预测组装三元复合物所需的刚体变换。实验表明 TriGlue 能生成化学上有效的分子和合理的三元复合物。
Motivation: 分子胶降解剂通过诱导 E3 泛素连接酶与靶蛋白形成三元复合物实现靶向蛋白降解，但计算设计几乎未被探索。与传统基于结构的药物设计不同，分子胶设计受未知蛋白质-蛋白质界面控制，需要同时建模配体生成、蛋白质对接和三元复合物组装。
Method: 将分子胶设计形式化为三元复合物生成问题，提出生物学启发的 TriGlue 框架，将其分解为两个耦合阶段：先用 SE(3)-等变界面估计模块从未结合的单体结构预测几何受限的蛋白-蛋白界面，再用界面条件化的三元流匹配网络联合生成分子胶并预测组装三元复合物所需的刚体变换。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明 TriGlue 能够生成化学上有效的分子并产生合理的三元复合物，体现出生物学启发生成建模在加速分子胶发现方面的潜力。
Conclusion: TriGlue 展示了将分子胶作用机制融入生成模型可以有效处理三元复合物生成问题，代码已开源；摘要未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Dark Room in the Reward Channel: Dense Prediction Rewards Collapse GRPO-Trained LLM Agents -- and The Channel, Not the Content, Decides What Works
papers.abstract_en: Dense per-step supervision is the standard remedy for sparse-reward long-horizon LLM agents: reward the policy for predicting its next observation, which looks provably safe under potential-based shaping. Published prediction-reward and auxiliary-loss variants report both successes and instabilities; we supply the controlled account: 74 preregistered arms dissect one fixed prediction signal under GRPO across ALFWorld, WebShop, a synthetic POMDP, and Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, varying only the delivery mechanism. (1) Every run sustaining this difference-form reward under untouched std normalization (no filtering, dynamic-sampling, or decoupling mitigations) collapses: eleven runs across scales, coefficients, group sizes, and groupings (the floor-bound synthetic environment stalls instead); ALFWorld runs end in an absorbing state (prediction accuracy -> 1.0, success -> 0): the optimizer builds the "dark room". The algebra is one line: in all-fail groups z-scoring cancels the shaping coefficient; removing only std normalization restores baseline parity. (2) A signal's danger is set by its within-group variance trajectory, plus hackability as a second axis; it retrodicts every reward-channel collapse and survives preregistered prospective tests. (3) The same signal as a teacher-forced auxiliary loss is harmless on ALFWorld at 4B, but the gain is not the signal's: content-free placebos as a class match or beat gold at both matched seeds (s0: 78.8 vs 68.6; s42: 67.9 vs 57.9); the auxiliary update is the regularizer. (4) At 8B the recipe turns bistable: gold full-weight locks two of three seeds; every content-free or reduced-weight arm stays healthy. No ALFWorld or WebShop reward-channel variant measurably beats its matched-normalization baseline and no gold signal measurably outperforms its content-free placebo: the delivery channel, not the content, decides; which channel is safe is regime-dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过 74 个预注册实验臂，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、合成 POMDP 以及 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 上，仅改变传递机制（delivery mechanism）来解剖同一个预测信号在 GRPO 下的行为。摘要显示，在未经触动的 std 归一化下，任何维持差分形式（difference-form）奖励的运行都会崩溃：ALFWorld 进入吸收态（预测准确率趋近 1.0、成功率归零），即优化器构建出“暗室”（dark room）；而仅移除 std 归一化即可恢复基线水准。作者进一步提出信号危险度由组内方差轨迹与可劫持性（hackability）决定，并证实辅助损失通道无害但收益并非来自信号内容本身。
Motivation: 稠密逐步骤监督被视为解决长视界 LLM 智能体稀疏奖励问题的标准手段，但已发表的预测奖励与辅助损失变体既报成功也报不稳定；本文旨在提供受控实验支撑的解释，说明崩溃为何发生、由什么决定。
Method: 采用 74 个预注册实验臂，固定同一预测信号、仅变化奖励传递通道（reward channel vs teacher-forced auxiliary loss），并在三种规模模型和多种环境上测试；分析 std 归一化下的 z-score 如何抵消 shaping 系数，并引入基于组内方差轨迹与可劫持性的危险度度量，同时包含无内容占位（content-free placebo）对照。
Result: 摘要报告：未加过滤、动态采样或解耦缓解的差分奖励在全部运行中崩溃；ALFWorld 中预测准确率升至 1.0 而成功率降为 0。把同一信号用作 teacher-forced 辅助损失在 ALFWorld/4B 上无害，但增益不来自信号内容——无内容占位在两个匹配种子下匹配或超过 gold（s0: 78.8 vs 68.6；s42: 67.9 vs 57.9）。在 8B 上配方变为双稳态：gold 全权重锁死三颗种子中的两颗，而所有无内容或降权重臂保持健康；没有奖励通道变体可衡量地超过其匹配归一化基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调是传递通道而非信号内容决定训练效果，且哪个通道安全取决于具体设定（regime-dependent）；预测奖励在标准归一化下可被优化器轻易劫持，而辅助损失的作用本质上是正则化。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 采用 74 个预注册实验臂，固定同一预测信号、仅变化奖励传递通道（reward channel vs teacher-forced auxiliary loss），并在三种规模模型和多种环境上测试；分析 std 归一化下的 z-score 如何抵消 shaping 系数，并引入基于组内方差轨迹与可劫持性的危险度度量，同时包含无内容占位（content-free placebo）对照。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：未加过滤、动态采样或解耦缓解的差分奖励在全部运行中崩溃；ALFWorld 中预测准确率升至 1.0 而成功率降为 0。把同一信号用作 teacher-forced 辅助损失在 ALFWorld/4B 上无害，但增益不来自信号内容——无内容占位在两个匹配种子下匹配或超过 gold（s0: 78.8 vs 68.6；s42: 67.9 vs 57.9）。在 8B 上配方变为双稳态：gold 全权重锁死三颗种子中的两颗，而所有无内容或降权重臂保持健康；没有奖励通道变体可衡量地超过其匹配归一化基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调是传递通道而非信号内容决定训练效果，且哪个通道安全取决于具体设定（regime-dependent）；预测奖励在标准归一化下可被优化器轻易劫持，而辅助损失的作用本质上是正则化。

papers.title: OPOD: On-Policy Omni Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal models provide a unified interface for text, images, and audio. However, improving these abilities together remains difficult, as post-training on pooled multimodal data often fails to preserve the strengths of modality teachers. On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently become popular in model post-training. It samples responses from the current student and compares the teacher's and student's next-token distributions along those responses, yielding dense supervision while reducing the mismatch between training and inference. Despite these advantages, standard OPD does not readily extend to several modality teachers. Their guidance may favor conflicting changes to the shared model, while matching each teacher's next-token distribution can prevent the student from moving beyond that teacher. To address these challenges, we propose On-Policy Omni Distillation (OPOD), which consolidates text, image, and audio teachers into one omni model. OPOD routes each response to the corresponding teacher, controls the teachers independently, and applies guidance only when the teacher assigns a higher probability to the generated token. The selected teacher also evaluates answer confidence and whether the reasoning increases support for the answer. Extensive experiments on twelve benchmarks show that OPOD achieves the best average at three model scales, reaching 70.8, 51.7, and 46.2 and outperforming the strongest comparator by 2.1, 1.8, and 1.7 points. At 30B, it surpasses the base model and pooled RL training on all twelve benchmarks, and ranks first or second on eleven even when the teachers are included. Only the student is retained for deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 On-Policy Omni Distillation (OPOD)，一种将文本、图像、音频教师模型蒸馏到统一全模态模型的方法。该方法将每个响应路由到对应教师，独立控制教师，仅在教师对生成 token 赋予更高概率时应用蒸馏指导，并让选中的教师评估答案置信度和推理支持度。在十二个基准上，OPOD 在三种模型规模下均取得最佳平均分，分别达到 70.8、51.7 和 46.2，比最强对比方法高出 2.1、1.8 和 1.7 分；30B 规模下在所有十二个基准上超过基线和池化 RL 训练，部署时仅保留学生模型。
Motivation: 标准 on-policy distillation (OPD) 难以直接扩展到多种模态教师：不同教师的指导可能对共享模型产生冲突的修改，而逐一匹配每个教师的下一 token 分布又会限制学生超越教师的能力。
Method: 提出 OPOD，将文本、图像、音频教师整合到一个全模态模型。具体机制包括：将每个响应路由到对应模态的教师；对教师进行独立控制；仅当教师对生成 token 赋予更高概率时才施加蒸馏指导；由选中的教师评估答案置信度以及推理过程是否提高了对答案的支持。
Result: 在十二个基准上，OPOD 在三种模型规模的最高平均分分别为 70.8、51.7 和 46.2，超过最强对比方法 2.1、1.8 和 1.7 分。30B 规模下，它在全部十二个基准上超过基线和池化 RL 训练，并且在包含教师参与比较时，在十一个基准上排名第一或第二。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 OPOD 能够有效整合多种模态教师以提升全模态模型性能，且最终仅需保留学生模型进行部署。

papers.title: Cortex: Compact Behavior Cloning for Quake with Frozen Visual Features
papers.abstract_en: We study how far a deliberately simple behavioral-cloning policy can progress in a visually rich first-person game before adding reinforcement learning or explicit memory. Cortex is a compact Quake policy with 10.98 million trainable parameters in a six-layer transformer over a frozen DINOv3 encoder. It is trained on the Quake subset of the public Pixels2Play corpus: 6,849 recordings (about 474.7 hours), represented as 17.09 million cached decision frames with keyboard and mouse actions. One sampled training epoch uses 517,048 four-frame windows and takes 3.3 minutes of policy-head optimization on one RTX 5080, excluding one-time feature extraction. We evaluate two independent batches of 20 stochastic, 120-second episodes on Quake E1M1. Cortex does not complete the level, but every episode reaches the opening door, button room, and gate descent; 19 of 20 episodes in each batch record at least one kill. Under the same time-controlled harness, released P2P-150M and NitroGen checkpoints remain shallower in five matched-duration episodes each. These comparisons are limited by small reference samples and different native interfaces. Ablations show that denser visual tokens improve combat and survival, while longer optimization and naive action history improve offline metrics without consistently improving play. The remaining failures are consistent with covariate shift and motivate targeted corrective data. We release the policy implementation, checkpoint, and a representative rollout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在视觉丰富的第一人称游戏中，一个刻意简化的行为克隆 (behavioral cloning) 策略在加入强化学习或显式记忆之前能走多远。作者提出 Cortex，一个基于冻结 DINOv3 编码器的六层 Transformer 策略，仅 10.98M 可训练参数，在 Pixels2Play 语料库的 Quake 子集（6,849 段录音，约 474.7 小时，17.09M 缓存决策帧）上训练。在 Quake E1M1 的两批各 20 个随机 120 秒 episode 评估中，Cortex 虽未通关，但每个 episode 都到达开门、按钮房间和闸门下降处，且每批有 19/20 个 episode 至少获得一次击杀。
Motivation: 作者想弄清楚在视觉丰富的第一人称游戏中，纯行为克隆策略在引入强化学习或显式记忆之前能达到何种水平，以此作为后续复杂方案的基线参考。
Method: Cortex 是紧凑的 Quake 策略：6 层 Transformer 置于冻结的 DINOv3 视觉编码器之上，共 10.98M 可训练参数；输入为四帧窗口的缓存决策帧，预测键盘和鼠标动作。训练数据来自 Pixels2Play 的 Quake 子集，一个采样训练 epoch 包含 517,048 个四帧窗口，在单张 RTX 5080 上策略头优化耗时约 3.3 分钟（不包含一次性特征提取）。
Result: 在两个独立的 20 episode 批次（各 120 秒随机滚动）中，Cortex 未完成关卡，但每个 episode 都到达开门、按钮房间和闸门下降处，且每批 19/20 的 episode 记录了至少一次击杀。在相同时间控制的测试框架下，已发布的 P2P-150M 和 NitroGen 检查点在各自 5 个匹配时长的 episode 中表现更浅。消融显示，更密集的视觉 token 能改善战斗和生存，而更长的优化和朴素动作历史能改善离线指标但未持续改善实际游戏表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为剩余失败与协变量偏移 (covariate shift) 一致，并指向需要针对性的纠正数据；论文同时发布了策略实现、检查点和代表性 rollouts。
