papers.title: A Systematic Benchmark of Intensity Normalisation Methods for 3D Knee MRI Segmentation and Cross-Domain Generalisability
papers.abstract_en: Robust out-of-the-box performance is essential for the clinical deployment of deep learning models in medical imaging. An important but underexplored factor affecting model generalisability is intensity normalisation, particularly for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), where image intensities vary across scanners and protocols. In this study, we systematically compared seven normalisation methods and their impact on the performance of a 3D U-Net model for meniscus segmentation from knee MRI. The methods included standard scaling approaches, histogram-based techniques, and a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM)-based method. Models were trained on the IWOAI 2019 dataset and evaluated on both internal and external test sets (SKM-TEA) to assess generalisability. Performance was similar internally but differences were significant on external data, with Z-score, Nyúl histogram matching, and CLAHE showing greater robustness than other methods. However, these differences were small compared to the significant performance drop observed between datasets. Overall, while intensity normalisation had a measurable effect on model generalisability, its impact was limited relative to the effects of domain shift, highlighting the need for complementary strategies for robust deployment.
papers.comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution is published in 30th Annual Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis, MIUA 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/oliverjm1/mri_normalisation. Updated to include acknowledgements and funding information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了七种强度归一化方法对 3D U-Net 膝关节 MRI 半月板分割性能的影响，使用 IWOAI 2019 训练并在内部与外部数据集（SKM-TEA）上评估跨域泛化能力。结果显示内部性能相近，但外部数据上 Z-score、Nyúl 直方图匹配和 CLAHE 表现出更强的鲁棒性；然而这些差异远小于数据集间的性能下降。
Motivation: MRI 图像强度随扫描仪和协议变化，强度归一化是影响模型泛化性但未被充分研究的因素，而开箱即用的稳健性能对临床部署至关重要。
Method: 作者系统比较了七种归一化方法，包括标准缩放方法、基于直方图的技术以及基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的方法，并用 3D U-Net 模型进行半月板分割实验。
Result: 内部测试集上各方法性能相近，而外部测试集上差异显著：Z-score、Nyúl 直方图匹配和 CLAHE 比其他方法更稳健；但归一化带来的差异相对于数据集间明显的性能下降较小。
Conclusion: 强度归一化对模型泛化性有可测量的影响，但其作用相对于域偏移（domain shift）有限，作者强调需要互补策略来实现稳健的临床部署。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Toward Goal-Agnostic Joint-Embedding Predictive Control of Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: We present a goal-agnostic control framework for partial differential equations (PDEs) built around an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). A lightweight 2D vision-transformer (ViT) and action-conditioned latent dynamics are trained offline without a reward or downstream goal, before being frozen and reused by a model-predictive path integral (MPPI) controller. We minimize a control objective in the latent space, initially expressed via the $L^2$ distance and additionally illustrate the benefit of recasting the control objective in terms of an explicit physical observable when available. By instead minimizing the tracking error for a learned linear kinetic-energy (KE) probe on the frozen latent-state rollouts, we demonstrate the ability to reproduce the control of held-out trajectories with $R^2=0.989$, while requiring no change to the underlying world model. For a controlled 2D Navier--Stokes benchmark, using a KE-probe within MPPI planning improves the mean native reward from $-12.08\pm0.86$ for latent-$L^2$ tracking to $-10.90\pm0.91$ (95\% CI), all while lowering last-quarter velocity-field RMSE from $0.0765$ to $0.0692$. Across three intentionally withheld, dissimilar, aperiodic targets, KE planning lowers late field RMSE by $53\%$ relative to latent-$L^2$ planning ($0.0220$ versus $0.0469$), winning across 30 paired comparisons. The same frozen model also supports stabilization around a steady-state configuration via direct regulation of KE, achieving $2.7\%$ mean relative error. While the latent probe proves brittle to measurement noise and missing pixels, our findings support the claim that latent dynamics can remain flexible and goal-agnostic, particularly when calibrated observables (granted they guarantee unique continuation) are a suitable objective for state control.
papers.comment: Associated code will be open sourced alongside a later, updated submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向偏微分方程(PDE)的目标无关控制框架，基于端到端联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)：轻量2D视觉Transformer(ViT)与动作条件潜在动力学在无奖励、无下游目标的情况下离线训练后冻结，再交由模型预测路径积分(MPPI)控制器复用。控制目标先在潜在空间以L^2距离表达，随后作者展示改用可学习的线性动能(KE)探针重构目标可提升控制效果，并声称潜在动力学可以保持灵活且目标无关。
Motivation: 现有PDE控制方法通常依赖特定奖励或下游目标进行训练，难以在目标变化后复用同一世界模型。作者希望验证一种目标无关的潜在动力学范式，即训练阶段不引入奖励，推理阶段通过不同的控制目标(如物理可观测量的跟踪)实现多种控制任务。
Method: 训练阶段使用轻量2D ViT和动作条件潜在动力学构建JEPA，全程无奖励信号；推理阶段冻结该模型并接入MPPI控制器。控制目标最初采用潜在空间L^2距离，随后改为在冻结的潜在状态轨迹上最小化学习到的线性动能(KE)探针的跟踪误差，并支持直接调节KE以实现稳态镇定。
Result: 在冻结模型下，KE探针跟踪可达R^2=0.989；受控2D Navier-Stokes基准上，KE探针MPPI规划将平均原生奖励从latent-L^2跟踪的-12.08±0.86提升到-10.90±0.91(95%CI)，最后四分之一时段的流速场RMSE从0.0765降至0.0692。在三个刻意保留的、不相似的非周期目标上，KE规划将后期场RMSE相对降低53%(0.0220对0.0469)，并在30次配对比较中全部胜出；稳态镇定达到2.7%的平均相对误差。作者同时指出潜在探针对测量噪声和缺失像素较脆弱。
Conclusion: 作者认为，冻结点潜在动力学可以保持目标无关并支持多种下游控制目标，前提是校准过的物理可观测量满足唯一延拓(unique continuation)性质，此时它们可作为状态控制的合适目标。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种面向偏微分方程(PDE)的目标无关控制框架，基于端到端联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)：轻量2D视觉Transformer(ViT)与动作条件潜在动力学在无奖励、无下游目标的情况下离线训练后冻结，再交由模型预测路径积分(MPPI)控制器复用。控制目标先在潜在空间以L^2距离表达，随后作者展示改用可学习的线性动能(KE)探针重构目标可提升控制效果，并声称潜在动力学可以保持灵活且目标无关。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有PDE控制方法通常依赖特定奖励或下游目标进行训练，难以在目标变化后复用同一世界模型。作者希望验证一种目标无关的潜在动力学范式，即训练阶段不引入奖励，推理阶段通过不同的控制目标(如物理可观测量的跟踪)实现多种控制任务。
summary_sections.method: 训练阶段使用轻量2D ViT和动作条件潜在动力学构建JEPA，全程无奖励信号；推理阶段冻结该模型并接入MPPI控制器。控制目标最初采用潜在空间L^2距离，随后改为在冻结的潜在状态轨迹上最小化学习到的线性动能(KE)探针的跟踪误差，并支持直接调节KE以实现稳态镇定。

papers.title: 1-Lipschitz Neural Networks on Hadamard Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Controlling the Lipschitz constant of a neural network is a standard way to promote robustness and stability. Most existing constraining strategies are designed for Euclidean spaces. In this work, we construct and analyze a class of 1-Lipschitz neural networks on Hadamard manifolds. Our layers are of gradient-descent type, $1$-Lipschitz, and quasi-$α$-firmly nonexpansive. The core building blocks of the proposed architecture are Busemann functions, and we exploit the properties of Busemann gradient flows to design $1$-Lipschitz geometry-preserving layers. We provide explicit constructions and examples for hyperbolic manifolds and the manifold of symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices. We test the proposed architecture in two numerical experiments: robust classification on the Poincaré disk and masked-Wishart covariance reconstruction. On the Poincaré disk, the proposed networks yield robust classifiers under hyperbolic perturbations. On the SPD manifold, we train SPD-valued denoisers and adopt them as a Plug-and-Play prior for a masked-Wishart covariance reconstruction problem. We show improved results from the nonexpansive denoiser over static, data-only, and Log-Euclidean denoising baselines, and empirically test its convergence properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Hadamard 流形上构造并分析一类 1-Lipschitz 神经网络，其层为梯度下降型、1-Lipschitz 且拟 α-强非扩张 (quasi-α-firmly nonexpansive)。核心构件是 Busemann 函数，作者利用 Busemann 梯度流的性质设计保持几何结构的 1-Lipschitz 层，并针对双曲流形和对称正定 (SPD) 矩阵流形给出显式构造；实验涵盖 Poincaré 盘上的鲁棒分类与 masked-Wishart 协方差重建。
Motivation: 控制神经网络的 Lipschitz 常数是提升鲁棒性与稳定性的常用方法，但多数约束策略面向欧氏空间设计；在 Hadamard 流形等非欧几何上缺少保持几何结构的 1-Lipschitz 网络构造。
Method: 提出基于 Busemann 函数与 Busemann 梯度流的梯度下降型层，确保层为 1-Lipschitz 且拟 α-强非扩张；对双曲流形与 SPD 矩阵流形给出显式层构造，并在流形上直接训练网络。
Result: 在 Poincaré 盘上，该网络在双曲扰动下得到鲁棒分类器；在 SPD 流形上，训练 SPD 值去噪器并作为 Plug-and-Play 先验用于 masked-Wishart 协方差重建，结果优于静态、纯数据与 Log-Euclidean 去噪基线，并实验检验了收敛性质。
Conclusion: 作者表明利用 Busemann 梯度流可以构造保持几何结构的 1-Lipschitz 网络，并验证其在流形鲁棒分类与协方差重建中的有效性；内容聚焦于几何深度学习，与天气/降水预报无直接关联。

papers.title: Making Single-Cell Data Distillation Auditable: Traceable Real-Cell Coresets via Discrete Min--Max Selection
papers.abstract_en: Large single-cell datasets are expensive to store, curate, and repeatedly reuse for model training. Data distillation can reduce this burden by building smaller training sets. However, many existing methods rely on synthetic cells. These synthetic cells do not retain direct correspondence with assayed cells and genes. This limits source-level inspection and biological traceability. Moreover, real-cell expression matrices are often sparse and noisy. In light of these challenges, we propose Minmax-CF, a label-aware characteristic-function selector for traceable single-cell data distillation. Minmax-CF formulates compression as a discrete min--max selection problem over characteristic-function directions. It uses entropy-regularized maximization to emphasize the least preserved directions. Greedy minimization ranks cells and genes by how much they reduce the resulting weighted error. The method alternates cell and gene selection under explicit axis-specific budgets. Across five coarse-lineage benchmarks and five compression budgets, Minmax-CF retains 95.3% of the Full-reference macro-F1 on average, with gaps that exceed one per-seed standard deviation. It also retains exact source-cell indices and original gene symbols. Compared with size-matched synthetic PCA-Centroid and Distribution Matching (DM) baselines, Minmax-CF achieves higher coarse-lineage macro-F1 in 24 of 25 comparisons against each baseline. It exceeds their average performance by 10.4% and 17.4%, respectively. Retained cells can also be projected onto independently computed embeddings for direct biological interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Minmax-CF，一种用于可溯源单细胞数据蒸馏 (traceable single-cell data distillation) 的标签感知特征函数选择器。该方法将压缩建模为特征函数方向上的离散 min-max 选择问题，交替进行细胞与基因选择，并保留原始细胞索引与基因符号。摘要报告在五个粗谱系基准与五个压缩预算下平均保留 Full-reference macro-F1 的 95.3%，并在 24/25 次对比中优于同等规模的合成 PCA-Centroid 与 Distribution Matching (DM) 基线，平均性能分别超出 10.4% 和 17.4%。
Motivation: 大规模单细胞数据在存储、整理与反复训练上成本高昂，数据蒸馏可以减小训练集，但现有方法多依赖合成细胞，与实测细胞和基因缺乏直接对应关系，限制了源级检查与生物学可溯源性；真实细胞表达矩阵又常稀疏且有噪声。
Method: Minmax-CF 将压缩形式化为特征函数方向上的离散 min-max 选择问题，用熵正则化最大化来强调保留最不充分的方向，再用贪心最小化按加权误差减少量对细胞和基因排序，并在显式的轴特定预算 (axis-specific budgets) 下交替执行细胞与基因选择。
Result: 在五个粗谱系基准和五个压缩预算下，Minmax-CF 平均保留 Full-reference macro-F1 的 95.3%，且与每种子随机种子标准差相比差距更大；与 PCA-Centroid 和 Distribution Matching 基线相比，在 25 次比较中有 24 次取得更高 macro-F1，平均性能分别超出 10.4% 和 17.4%，并能将保留细胞投影到独立计算的嵌入上用于生物学解释。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法的可审计性：保留的细胞保持精确的源细胞索引和原始基因符号，支持直接的来源级检查与生物学解释；其适用范围限定在单细胞数据蒸馏的粗谱系基准场景。

papers.title: Calibrating Semantic Uncertainty from Observable Language-Model Probabilities
papers.abstract_en: As generative artificial intelligence enters scientific and professional work, its uncertainty must be defined on the states that matter for inference and decision-making. Language models assign probabilities to words, whereas applications require uncertainty over meaningful states such as diagnoses, hypotheses or operational conditions. We introduce a \emph{semantic map}: a prespecified, testable bridge from probabilities over verbal responses to a posterior over declared finite states. The language distribution remains unrestricted; held-out calibration connects it to a reference posterior. We derive posterior-error bounds and conditions for existence, conditional uniqueness, presentation stability and stable inverse recovery. This distinction matters because language probabilities depend on prompt wording, while the target posterior should not change under information-equivalent rewording. Experiments use professional market text compiled from Federal Reserve economic and financial series, together with controlled simulations having exact posteriors. Across two fitted language models, language-derived probabilities outperform printed numerical confidence, recover held-out posteriors with valid uncertainty coverage, remain largely stable under paraphrase and respond appropriately to altered evidence. \textbf{Prompt engineering optimises a wording-dependent response; robust scientific use requires validated stability of application-relevant meaning.} The proposed map turns semantic uncertainty in generative systems into an identifiable and testable statistical measurement problem and, when its acceptance conditions hold, yields an auditable posterior estimate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式语言模型中"词级概率"与"应用所需状态级不确定性"之间的错配，提出语义映射 (semantic map) 作为从语言模型对言语响应的概率到有限状态集合上后验分布的预设可检验桥梁。作者推导了后验误差界以及存在性、条件唯一性、呈现稳定性和稳定逆恢复条件，并用美联储经济金融文本与已知后验的受控模拟进行验证。结果显示基于语言导出的概率优于模型打印的数字置信度，能恢复留出后验并具有有效的覆盖率，且在释义下大体稳定。
Motivation: 语言模型对单词分配概率，而诊断、假设或运行状态等实际决策需要的是语义状态上的不确定性；同时语言概率随提示措辞变化，而信息等价改写下的目标后验不应改变，这使现有的词级校准不足以支持科学和专业用途。
Method: 提出语义映射：预先指定并用留出数据校准一个从言语响应概率到声明的有限状态后验的桥梁，语言分布保持不受限制；并给出该映射的存在性、条件唯一性、呈现稳定性与稳定逆恢复等可检验条件。
Result: 摘要报告在两个拟合语言模型上的实验：语言导出的概率优于打印的数字置信度，能够恢复留出后验并保持有效的不确定性覆盖，在改写提示下大体稳定，且能对改变的证据作出适当响应。
Conclusion: 作者认为提示工程只能优化措辞依赖的回答，而稳健的科学使用要求与应用相关的含义具有经过验证的稳定性；所提语义映射将生成系统中的语义不确定性转化为可识别、可检验的统计测量问题，并能在接受条件满足时提供可审计的后验估计。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Fretiq: Browser-Native Electric Guitar String Classification via Engineered Spectral Features and Held-Out Free-Play Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Identifying which string produces a given pitch in monophonic electric guitar audio is a classification challenge: a single pitch can often be produced on multiple strings, with timbral differences largely imperceptible to untrained humans. We present Fretiq, a preliminary single-instrument, single-player browser-based string classification system using a 26-dimensional feature representation of frequency band energies, spectral statistics, and 13 Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients. Across five seeds, a shuffled frame-level validation split yields 97.25 +/- 0.32 percent accuracy, with an ablation study identifying MFCCs as the primary accuracy driver (92.09 +/- 0.50 percent without MFCCs). We introduce Comparison Training, a data collection method recording same-pitch pairs on adjacent strings in deliberate alternation. An initial shuffled-split comparison found no net benefit but was confounded by non-comparable validation sets across conditions. A corrected matched evaluation, using an identical recording session held out from training and model selection, shows including comparison-session data improves accuracy by 25.78 +/- 1.46 percentage points; a size-matched control shows this is not explained by training-set size alone. A recording-session-held-out evaluation yields 86.53 +/- 1.23 percent accuracy, closely matching an independently collected free-play evaluation (87.8 percent), both well below the shuffled-split figure, showing shuffled validation substantially overestimates real generalization here. We describe the feature extraction pipeline in Python and TypeScript for training-inference parity and document two implementation failure modes. The system runs entirely in-browser with no specialized hardware required.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 7 tables, preliminary single-instrument system paper. v2: corrects early-stopping methodology and a validation-set leak in supplementary experiments, replaces single-run figures with five-seed measurements, and substantially revises the Comparison Training analysis following a matched held-out evaluation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fretiq，一个基于浏览器的单乐器单演奏者电吉他弦分类系统，使用 26 维特征（频带能量、频谱统计和 13 个 MFCC）在帧级完成分类。摘要报告 shuffled 帧级验证精度为 97.25 ± 0.32%，消融显示 MFCC 是主要驱动因素；引入 Comparison Training 数据收集方法，并在修正的匹配评估中显示其带来 25.78 ± 1.46 个百分点的提升。录音会话留出评估准确率为 86.53 ± 1.23%，与独立自由演奏评估的 87.8% 接近，远低于 shuffled 分割数字，表明 shuffled 验证会显著高估真实泛化性能。
Motivation: 在单音电吉他音频中，同一音高通常可在多根弦上产生，音色差异对未经训练的人耳几乎不可感知，因此准确判断发声琴弦是一个有挑战的分类问题。
Method: 构建 26 维特征表示，包括频带能量、频谱统计和 13 个 Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients；提出 Comparison Training 数据收集方法，即在相邻弦上刻意交替录制同音高配对数据；并用 Python 与 TypeScript 实现特征提取管线以保证训练与推理一致性，系统完全在浏览器中运行。
Result: 五个随机种子的 shuffled 帧级验证精度为 97.25 ± 0.32%，去除 MFCC 后降至 92.09 ± 0.50%；修正后的匹配评估显示加入 comparison-session 数据可提升 25.78 ± 1.46 个百分点，且尺寸匹配对照表明该提升不能仅由训练集大小解释；录音会话留出评估为 86.53 ± 1.23%，独立自由演奏评估为 87.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 shuffled 验证会大幅高估真实泛化能力，while 录音会话留出与自由演奏评估均明显更低；同时记录了两个实现失败模式，并指出系统无需专用硬件即可在浏览器内运行。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Fretiq，一个基于浏览器的单乐器单演奏者电吉他弦分类系统，使用 26 维特征（频带能量、频谱统计和 13 个 MFCC）在帧级完成分类。摘要报告 shuffled 帧级验证精度为 97.25 ± 0.32%，消融显示 MFCC 是主要驱动因素；引入 Comparison Training 数据收集方法，并在修正的匹配评估中显示其带来 25.78 ± 1.46 个百分点的提升。录音会话留出评估准确率为 86.53 ± 1.23%，与独立自由演奏评估的 87.8% 接近，远低于 shuffled 分割数字，表明 shuffled 验证会显著高估真实泛化性能。

papers.title: Subjective Risk Decomposition: A New View for Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel viewpoint for uncertainty quantification. Uncertainty measures are not primitives, in need of axioms and argumentation, but instead consequences, of higher-level modelling decisions. We show how epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty measures can be derived via decomposition of a subjective risk, based on a strictly proper loss. Reverse cross entropy provides a prominent example, where decomposition recovers the classic information-theoretic uncertainty terms. The same approach recovers numerous measures previously proposed across the UQ literature, providing them a common theoretical foundation. This suggests a new approach to UQ: given a modelling scenario and strictly proper loss, the corresponding epistemic and aleatoric terms are induced by the subjective-risk decomposition. We then extend our view to learning theory: we introduce and analyse subjective risk analogues of excess risk, approximation error and estimation error, and identify the connections to UQ. We consider this a first step towards a full learning-theoretic framework for uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的不确定性量化（UQ）视角：不确定性度量不是需要公理支撑的原始概念，而是更高级建模决策的推论。作者展示如何通过严格适当损失（strictly proper loss）对主观风险（subjective risk）进行分解，从而推导出认知不确定性（epistemic）和偶然不确定性（aleatoric）度量，并以反向交叉熵为例说明分解可恢复经典信息论不确定性项。该框架还能统一UQ文献中多种已有度量，并延伸到学习理论，定义主观风险下的过风险、逼近误差和估计误差。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化文献中，各类不确定性度量往往依赖各自公理和论证，缺乏统一理论基础。作者希望将不确定性度量视为由更高层建模选择引出的后果，从而为UQ提供一致的理论框架，并连接到学习理论。
Method: 基于严格适当损失定义主观风险，通过对该风险进行分解来诱导出认知与偶然不确定性项。以反向交叉熵为突出示例展示分解可恢复信息论不确定性，并进一步引入主观风险版本的过风险、逼近误差和估计误差，分析其与UQ的联系。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据，主要理论结果是：主观风险分解可统一推导多种已有UQ度量，反向交叉熵情形下能恢复经典信息论不确定性项，并建立了UQ与学习理论中过风险/误差分解的联系。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是迈向完整的学习理论化UQ框架的第一步，强调给定建模场景与严格适当损失后，对应认知与偶然不确定性项由主观风险分解自然诱导。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Kernel weighted importance sampling for off-policy evaluation in contextual bandits
papers.abstract_en: This article presents a novel estimator for performing off-policy evaluation using only offline data for contextual bandits. The proposed estimator, Kernel-WIS is demonstrated to be asymptotically consistent and to empirically outperform strong baselines (including weighted importance sampling), particularly under behaviour policy miss-specification. The benefit of Kernel-WIS is derived from combining the bounded property of weighted importance sampling with the linearity of vanilla importance sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于上下文赌博机 (contextual bandits) 仅利用离线数据进行离线策略评估 (off-policy evaluation) 的新估计器 Kernel-WIS。摘要称该估计器具有渐近一致性，并在经验上优于包括加权重要性采样 (weighted importance sampling) 在内的强基线，尤其在行为策略误设定 (behaviour policy miss-specification) 情况下表现突出。其优势来自结合加权重要性采样的有界性与普通重要性采样的线性性。
Motivation: 离线策略评估在只能获取离线数据时需要可靠的估计器，而行为策略误设定会使现有方法失效；该工作针对这一场景提出更稳健的估计方法。
Method: 提出 Kernel-WIS 估计器，通过结合加权重要性采样的有界性质和普通重要性采样的线性性质来构造估计量，并使用仅包含离线数据的信息。
Result: 摘要报告 Kernel-WIS 被证明渐近一致，并在经验上优于包括加权重要性采样在内的强基线，尤其在行为策略误设定条件下改进更明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Kernel-WIS 的收益源于同时利用加权重要性采样的有界性和普通重要性采样的线性性，使其在离线策略评估中更具鲁棒性。

papers.title: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare AI agents handle patient consultation, clinical reasoning over text and images, interactive diagnosis, and electronic health record (EHR) tool use, yet specialized agentic models that cover these use cases together remain limited. These capabilities fail in different ways, and a narrow update for one task can degrade another. We present Cura 1T, a healthcare-specialized LLM built on the open-weight Kimi-K2.6 and trained through a human-gated recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop. Specifically, in each round, the RSI harness plans a target capability, trains the model, evaluates benchmark trajectories, and refines the data mixture from observed failures with targeted synthetic and curated examples rather than a single generic medical-data update. Across the healthcare evaluation suite, Cura 1T ranks at or near the top among frontier baselines while remaining competitive on out-of-domain reasoning and agentic benchmarks.
papers.comment: Model: https://actava.ai/cura; Docs: https://actava.ai/cura/docs; Github: https://github.com/actava-ai/Cura
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cura 1T，一个基于开源权重 Kimi-K2.6 构建的医疗专科智能体大语言模型，通过人工门控的递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement, RSI）循环训练。每个 RSI 轮次中，系统规划目标能力、训练模型、评估基准轨迹，并根据观察到的失败用针对性的合成与精选样本精炼数据混合，而非做一次性通用医学数据更新。摘要称 Cura 1T 在医疗评估套件中位居前沿基线前列，同时在外域推理和智能体基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 医疗 AI 智能体需要同时覆盖患者咨询、文本与图像临床推理、交互式诊断和电子健康记录（EHR）工具使用，但能兼顾这些用例的专门智能体模型仍然有限；且各项能力的失败模式不同，针对单一任务的窄幅更新可能损害其他任务。
Method: 在开源权重 LLM Kimi-K2.6 上构建，采用人工门控的递归自我改进（RSI）循环——每轮由 harness 规划目标能力、训练模型、评估基准轨迹，并根据失败案例用针对性合成与精选样本细化数据混合，替代单一通用医疗数据更新。
Result: 在医疗评估套件上，Cura 1T 排名位于或接近前沿基线顶部，同时在外域推理与智能体基准上保持竞争力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过失败驱动的递归数据混合更新，可以在提升多项医疗智能体能力的同时不牺牲泛化与通用智能体性能。

papers.title: Beyond the Single Camera: Agentic Multi-View Reasoning in Sports Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on single-view video understanding benchmarks. However, sports videos involve dense occlusion, rapid motion, and complex interactions that are difficult to resolve from a single viewpoint. In practice, sports events are recorded from multiple camera angles, providing complementary evidence used by referees. Yet, no existing benchmark evaluates MLLMs on multi-view sports video understanding. To address this gap, we introduce SportMV-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built from official match recordings, through a dedicated pipeline combining LLM-based generation, MLLM-based verification, and human filtering to ensure quality and consistency. SportMV-Bench containing 1022 multi-view video bundles and 3015 question-answer pairs spanning 10 sports across three categories: Perception-Aware Recognition (PAR), Rule-aware Event Interpretation (REI), and Adjudicative Decision Reasoning (ADR). Our analysis shows that current MLLMs fail to effectively exploit multi-view information, with the bottlenecks lying in fine-grained visual perception and view selection rather than logical reasoning or domain knowledge. We propose SportMV-Agent, an agentic framework that orchestrates an iterative loop of active view selection, perception tool execution, and evidence-grounded reasoning, achieving a significant 15.61% relative improvement over the strongest MLLM baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SportMV-Bench，一个基于官方比赛录像构建的多视角体育视频理解基准，包含 1022 个多视角视频包和 3015 个问答对，覆盖 10 个运动项目，分为感知识别（PAR）、规则事件解释（REI）和裁决推理（ADR）三类任务。分析发现现有 MLLM 未能有效利用多视角信息，瓶颈在细粒度视觉感知与视角选择而非逻辑推理或领域知识。作者提出 SportMV-Agent 智能体框架，通过主动视角选择、感知工具执行和证据推理的迭代循环，相对最强 MLLM 基线取得 15.61% 的相对提升。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在单视角视频理解基准上表现强劲，但体育视频存在密集遮挡、快速运动和复杂交互，单视角难以解决；实际赛事有多视角录制并可提供互补证据，但目前没有基准评估 MLLM 的多视角体育视频理解能力。
Method: 构建 SportMV-Bench，采用 LLM 生成、MLLM 验证与人工过滤的流水线保证数据质量；提出 SportMV-Agent 智能体框架，编排主动视角选择、感知工具执行和基于证据推理的迭代循环。
Result: 摘要报告 SportMV-Agent 在基准上相对最强 MLLM 基线实现 15.61% 的相对提升；分析表明当前 MLLM 的失败源于细粒度视觉感知和视角选择，而非逻辑推理或领域知识。
Conclusion: 多视角体育视频理解的关键在于主动视角选择与感知工具的支持，现有 MLLM 的主要局限集中在感知层面。

papers.title: URHead: A Unified UV-Space Representation for Joint Mesh-3DGS Optimization in Head Avatars
papers.abstract_en: We present URHead, a unified representation for high-fidelity and animatable head avatars that fundamentally redefines mesh-Gaussian integration. While mesh-based methods offer precise geometric control but lack photorealistic detail, and Gaussian-based approaches achieve photorealism but suffer from poor structural consistency, existing hybrid solutions fail to fully leverage their complementary strengths. Our key contribution is a UV-space unification where both representations share a common UV parameterization. Through joint optimization with adaptive gaussian sampling, our method automatically learns to disentangle and allocate appropriate roles to each component. URHead maintains full parametric controllability while preserving subject-specific details, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality and animation consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: URHead 提出一种统一的 UV 空间表示 (UV-space representation) 来重新定义头部虚拟形象中 mesh 与 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 的集成方式。通过让两种表示共享同一套 UV 参数化并进行联合优化，配合自适应高斯采样 (adaptive gaussian sampling)，模型自动学习为每个组件分配合适角色，同时保留参数化可控性与 subject-specific 细节。摘要报告该方法在重建质量和动画一致性上优于现有最优方法。
Motivation: 基于 mesh 的方法提供精确几何控制但缺乏照片级细节，基于 Gaussian 的方法实现照片级真实感却存在结构一致性差的问题，而现有混合方案未能充分利用两者的互补优势。
Method: 核心贡献是 UV 空间统一：mesh 和 Gaussian 两种表示共享共同 UV 参数化，并通过联合优化与自适应高斯采样自动解耦各组件职责。
Result: 该方法在保持完整参数化可控性的同时保留个体专属细节，并在重建质量和动画一致性上超过现有最优方法。

papers.title: Image classification via a quantum-inspired strategy involving a mixture of experts
papers.abstract_en: Pattern recognition problems arise in a variety of physical image processing situations, and convolutional neural networks are a popular scheme for the required feature extraction and classification tasks. The classical networks use diffusion-based smearing and block-wise pooling to downsample the image data and capture important structural features. In this work, we propose and demonstrate a more efficient quantum-inspired strategy involving a mixture of experts. It is a hybrid classical-quantum framework. The quantum part consists of amplitude encoding of the images, convolution using local unitary operations, multiple experts processing the same image with different parameters, and feature extraction using quantum stabiliser codes. The classical part then jointly processes the features extracted by different experts using a standard fully connected neural network for image class prediction. Using MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets as benchmarks, we demonstrate that the joint expert analysis outperforms the individual expert one, as well as reduces the failure rate of image class prediction by around a factor of two. The overhead of our quantum-inspired strategy is only moderate on GPU workstations, which makes our proposal a practical alternative to existing classical schemes. We also point out how the quantum part of our framework can be executed on a quantum processor.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 18 figures, comments welcome (v2) The number of features extracted from the images is considerably reduced, which simplifies the subsequent classification. The results are essentially the same

Method: 提出混合经典-量子框架：量子部分包括振幅编码、局部酉操作的卷积、多个不同参数的专家并行处理以及基于量子稳定子码的特征提取；经典部分则由一个标准全连接神经网络联合处理所有专家提取的特征并输出类别预测。

papers.title: Foundations of Equivariant Deep Learning: Unifying Graph and Sheaf Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Symmetry is everywhere in nature and society. Geometric deep learning builds architectures respecting group symmetries, whereas topological deep learning organizes computation through cells, incidence relations, and local-to-global structure. In this paper, we extend geometric deep learning beyond simple group actions and unify it with topological deep learning. Specifically, we develop order-equivariant neural networks (OENN), which generalize standard graph message passing and sheaf neural networks via the theory of equivariant bundles over face posets (face categories). We (i) characterize all linear order-equivariant maps, (ii) build OENN layers, and (iii) prove universal approximation theorems (UATs) for continuous order-equivariant maps, which are new results even when restricted to sheaf neural networks. We illustrate the framework on graph and sheaf models. Our results can also be seen as extending the known UAT for graph neural networks to a more general setting that subsumes sheaf neural networks as well. In the appendix, we clarify the precise relationships between OENN and CENN (Category-Equivariant Neural Network), which gives the categorical general form of equivariant neural networks, allowing us to leverage categorical symmetry in data (e.g., non-invertible symmetries on multiple objects with compositional relations on those symmetries).
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 as a spotlight paper with oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出阶等变神经网络 (order-equivariant neural network, OENN)，利用面偏序集 (face posets) 上的等变丛理论统一几何深度学习与拓扑深度学习，将标准图消息传递和层神经网络 (sheaf neural network) 作为特例纳入同一框架。作者刻画了所有线性阶等变映射，构造 OENN 层，并对连续阶等变映射证明了万有逼近定理 (UAT)，该结果即使仅限制在层神经网络情形也是新的。
Motivation: 几何深度学习只处理群对称性，而拓扑深度学习通过胞腔、关联关系和局部到整体结构组织计算，两者缺乏统一的数学基础；此外已有的图神经网络 UAT 无法覆盖层神经网络。
Method: 发展阶等变神经网络理论：以面范畴 (face categories) 上的等变丛为基础，刻画全部线性阶等变映射，并据此构建 OENN 层；附录中进一步阐明 OENN 与范畴等变神经网络 (CENN) 的关系。
Result: 证明了连续阶等变映射的万有逼近定理，这是即使限定于层神经网络也属新的结果；同时将图神经网络的已知 UAT 推广到包含层神经网络的更一般设定。
Conclusion: 该框架以统一方式涵盖图和层神经网络模型，并借助 CENN 的范畴一般形式利用数据中的范畴对称性（包括多个对象上具有复合关系的不可逆对称性）。

papers.title: VLAFlow: A Unified Training Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models via Co-training and Future Latent Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently advanced robotic manipulation, yet the effects of different robot-data pre-training paradigms remain difficult to compare because existing models often differ in architecture, data, action space, and evaluation protocol. We present VLAFlow (Vision-Language-Action Flow), a unified flow-matching framework for controlled comparison of VLA training objectives. Using a heterogeneous robot corpus, OXEMix, containing approximately 5,000 hours of data from DROID, OpenX-Embodiment, OpenX-Augmented, and RoboCOIN, we evaluate four paradigms under the same pi0-style architecture, shared VLM backbone, action expert, and 14-dimensional action space: action-only modeling (MindPI), language-supervised co-training (MindLPI), future latent alignment (MindWPI), and their combination (MindLWPI). Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv show that action-only pre-training is sensitive to heterogeneous data. In contrast, language supervision helps preserve vision-language generalization, while future latent alignment improves state-transition and action-outcome modeling. By combining both signals, MindLWPI achieves the most stable overall transfer performance across benchmarks. These results suggest a meta-action space view: language and future latent representations provide complementary intermediate constraints that make heterogeneous action supervision smoother and more transferable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VLAFlow，一个统一的流匹配 (flow-matching) 训练框架，用于在相同架构和评估协议下对比视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 的不同预训练目标。基于约 5000 小时异构机器人数据语料 OXEMix，作者在 pi0-style 架构、共享 VLM 主干、动作专家和 14 维动作空间下评估了动作建模、语言监督协同训练、未来隐空间对齐及其组合四种范式，并在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 SimplerEnv 上比较迁移性能。结果显示组合两种信号的 MindLWPI 获得了最稳定的跨基准迁移表现。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在架构、数据、动作空间和评估协议上各不相同，导致不同机器人数据预训练范式难以被公平比较；需要一个受控框架来分离各训练目标的影响。
Method: 构建 VLAFlow 统一流匹配框架，并整合包含 DROID、OpenX-Embodiment、OpenX-Augmented 和 RoboCOIN 的异构语料 OXEMix。在同一 pi0-style 架构、共享 VLM 骨干、动作专家和 14 维动作空间下对比四种范式：纯动作建模 (MindPI)、语言监督协同训练 (MindLPI)、未来隐空间对齐 (MindWPI) 以及二者组合 (MindLWPI)。
Result: 实验表明纯动作预训练对异构数据敏感；语言监督有助于保持视觉-语言泛化能力，未来隐空间对齐改善状态转移与动作结果建模；组合两者的 MindLWPI 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 SimplerEnv 上取得最稳定的整体迁移性能。
Conclusion: 作者提出元动作空间 (meta-action space) 视角：语言和未来隐表征提供互补的中间约束，使异构动作监督更平滑且更易迁移。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Context Rot in Long-horizon Search
papers.abstract_en: Extensive context has become the norm as Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-horizon search tasks. The concern that increasing context length degrades model capabilities, known as context rot, has become a widely recognized issue for these applications. However, in deep search scenarios, it remains unclear how models actually fail under extensive context, and to what extent existing methods can mitigate such failures. Through a systematic study of four flagship models across three benchmarks, we identify a previously overlooked phenomenon, which we term premature termination: under extensive context, models give up or provide uncertain incorrect answers long before exhausting the context window. By controlling for query difficulty, we show that the premature termination rate is positively correlated with context length. Based on the findings, we revisit methods to mitigate context rot, including context management and parallel sampling. For context management, we analyze seven methods across three categories and show that they are inherently test-time scaling strategies that reduce the premature termination rate to enable more exploration, and we further provide model-dependent principles for method selection. For parallel sampling, we develop a behavior-aware filtering strategy and observe a performance gain of 2.6% to 4.9% across three aggregation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大规模语言模型（LLM）在长时程搜索任务中面对扩展上下文时的失败模式，系统识别出此前被忽视的“过早终止”（premature termination）现象：模型在上下文窗口耗尽之前就放弃回答或给出不确定的错误答案。通过对四个旗舰模型在三个基准上的研究，作者发现过早终止率与上下文长度正相关，并在此基础上重新审视上下文管理与并行采样两类缓解方法，提出行为感知过滤策略。
Motivation: 长上下文已成为LLM长时程搜索任务的常态，但“上下文腐烂”（context rot）问题在深层搜索场景中的具体失败机制以及现有方法的缓解效果仍不清楚。
Method: 对四个旗舰模型在三个基准上进行系统性研究，通过控制查询难度来检验过早终止率与上下文长度的关系；随后分析三类共七种上下文管理方法，并将并行采样中的过滤问题形式化为行为感知过滤策略。
Result: 摘要报告过早终止率与上下文长度正相关；行为感知过滤策略在三种聚合方法上带来2.6%到4.9%的性能提升。
Conclusion: 上下文管理方法本质上属于测试时扩展（test-time scaling）策略，通过降低过早终止率来支持更多探索；方法选择应依据模型特性而定，提示不存在通用的最优缓解方案。

papers.title: SIFT: Self-Imagination Fine-Tuning for Physically Plausible Motion in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion models have greatly improved visual fidelity, yet their generated motions often violate physical plausibility. We observe a common kinematic failure, "motion entanglement", the unintended coupling of independent motion sources, such as camera movement and object motion. We identify that this issue stems from data bias and the reconstruction-based training design of diffusion models. Training on noisy videos that still retain coarse motion cues inadvertently encourages the model to replicate existing motion without an incentive to learn how to model kinematically-grounded motions. To address this, we propose a Self-Imagination Fine-Tuning (SIFT) paradigm, which enables the model to learn from its own generated videos rather than directly reconstructing real ones, breaking the reconstruction shortcut. We further employ motion-aware discriminative supervision and a progressive hard-case replay strategy to stabilize and accelerate learning. By leveraging freely-generated text prompts, our method can densely cover a broad motion space, including rare or finely-disentangled scenarios that would be costly to collect as video data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach substantially improves the physical realism, motion disentanglement, and controllability of generated videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频扩散模型生成运动违反物理合理性的问题，提出自想象微调 (Self-Imagination Fine-Tuning, SIFT) 范式。作者观察到一种常见的运动学失败模式“运动纠缠”（motion entanglement），即摄像机运动与物体运动等独立运动源被意外耦合，并将其归因于数据偏差和扩散模型基于重建的训练设计。SIFT 让模型从自身生成的视频中学习而非直接重建真实视频，并配合运动感知判别监督和渐进式难例回放策略；实验表明该方法显著提升生成视频的物理真实感、运动解耦性和可控性。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型虽提升了视觉保真度，但生成的运动常违背物理规律；其中“运动纠缠”问题源于数据偏差和重建式训练，使模型倾向于复制已有运动线索而缺乏对运动学基础的学习。
Method: 提出 SIFT 范式：模型不再直接重建真实视频，而是从自己生成的视频中学习以打破重建捷径；同时采用运动感知的判别式监督 (motion-aware discriminative supervision) 和渐进式难例回放 (progressive hard-case replay) 来稳定并加速学习，并利用自由生成的文本提示密集覆盖包括稀有或精细解耦场景在内的广阔运动空间。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法能显著提升生成视频的物理真实感、运动解耦性和可控性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SIFT 通过打破重建捷径并利用自生成数据，能够有效改善视频扩散模型运动的物理合理性，可覆盖难以通过真实数据采集获得的运动场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Symplectic Neural Networks for Learning Non-Separable Hamiltonians
papers.abstract_en: Hamiltonian Neural Networks (HNNs) integrate physical priors into neural models by learning a system's Hamiltonian, improving generalization and sample efficiency. Identifying the system Hamiltonian from noisy observations of state variables is a challenging task. For simulations to faithfully reflect the long-term behavior of Hamiltonian systems, especially energy conservation, it is essential to use symplectic integrators, which preserve the system's geometric structure. This fidelity comes at a cost: implicit symplectic integrators are more computationally intensive and make backpropagation through the ODE solver non-trivial. However, by leveraging the fact that symplectic discretizations of the adjoint system yield the same sensitivities associated by backpropagation, we obtain an efficient method of training the Neural Network parameters. In our work, we explore this alternate method of HNN training under noisy observation of trajectories with our HNN model based on an implicit symplectic integrator. Computationally, a predictor-corrector based ODE solver and fixed point iteration help to mitigate the computational cost of the implicit timestepping, resulting in more efficient generation of gradient updates. We showcase the numerical advantage, in experiments, in system identification and energy preservation on a range of non-separable, chaotic systems and the efficient computation and memory complexity of our method. We also observe that the post-processing of the learned Hamiltonian using backward error analysis yields a modified Hamiltonian that is a more accurate approximation of the true Hamiltonian without the need to use more accurate discretizations of the flow map.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何用隐式辛积分器 (implicit symplectic integrator) 训练 Hamiltonian Neural Networks (HNNs)，用于从含噪声的状态变量观测中学习非可分 Hamiltonian。作者利用辛离散化伴随系统可产生与反向传播相同的灵敏度这一性质，配合 predictor-corrector ODE 求解器和不动点迭代来降低隐式时间步进的计算开销。实验在多个非可分混沌系统上展示了系统辨识和能量保持方面的数值优势，并指出用 backward error analysis 后处理学到的 Hamiltonian 可得到更接近真实 Hamiltonian 的修正哈密顿量。
Motivation: HNNs 通过学习系统 Hamiltonian 引入物理先验，但非可分 Hamiltonian 的系统辨识本身具有挑战性；为保证长时间能量守恒需要使用辛积分器，而隐式辛积分器计算代价高且使通过 ODE 求解器的反向传播变得困难。
Method: 提出基于隐式辛积分器的 HNN 训练替代方案：利用辛离散化的伴随系统得到与反向传播等价的灵敏度来训练网络参数，并用 predictor-corrector 型 ODE 求解器和不动点迭代缓解隐式时间步进的计算开销；此外对学到的 Hamiltonian 做 backward error analysis 后处理。
Result: 摘要报告在多种非可分、混沌系统上，该方法在系统辨识和能量保持上具有数值优势，并且梯度更新的计算与内存复杂度更高效；同时 backward error analysis 得到的修正 Hamiltonian 对真实 Hamiltonian 的近似更准确，且无需更精确的流映射离散化。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过伴随系统的辛离散化可以高效训练隐式辛积分器类 HNN，并借助 backward error analysis 提高 Hamiltonian 近似精度，从而在保持几何结构的同时降低训练成本。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Signed Evidence Flow: Conflict-Aware and Stability-Calibrated Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern data analysis usually gives a prediction without showing whether the evidence behind it is clear, conflicting, or stable. Two cases can have the same fitted confidence even when one has mostly agreeing evidence and the other has strong support and strong opposition. We propose Signed Evidence Flow (SEF), which combines a fitted prediction rule with signed feature attributions to measure support, opposition, conflict, and perturbation stability. We prove that confidence determines conflict exactly when it also determines total evidence mass, derive the remaining conditional variance, and state when conflict can improve loss prediction beyond confidence and other audit variables. We also connect conflict to geometric decision fragility. Across healthcare, Covertype, black-box, finance, and ten external data sets, conflict sometimes separates risk among predictions that already appear confident. Cross-fitted tests show added error-ranking information beyond confidence and attribution entropy on several data sets, including two large finance tasks. The direction is not universal: in some tasks, lowconflict cases are riskier. We therefore introduce ScopeGate, a held-out permutation diagnostic that checks the direction before SEF is used for review triage. SEF is consequently an audit tool rather than a universal risk score: it describes evidence structure, while an independent calibration sample determines whether that structure is useful in the target population.
papers.comment: 44 pages, including figures and tables. Reproducibility code and supplementary materials are available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Signed Evidence Flow (SEF)，将拟合的预测规则与带符号特征归因结合，用于度量证据的支持、反对、冲突和扰动稳定性。作者证明当置信度同时决定总证据质量时，冲突可被置信度精确决定，并推导剩余条件方差及冲突改善损失预测的条件。在医疗、Covertype、黑盒、金融及十个外部数据集上，冲突有时能区分表面上看已很自信的预测中的风险，但方向并不普遍，因此引入 ScopeGate 置换诊断来预先检查方向。
Motivation: 现代数据分析通常只给出预测结果，而不揭示其背后的证据是清晰、冲突还是稳定；两个置信度相同的案例可能一个证据基本一致，另一个则同时存在强支持和强反对。
Method: 提出 SEF，把拟合预测规则与带符号特征归因结合，形式化度量支持、反对、冲突和扰动稳定性；并证明置信度与冲突、总证据质量之间的理论关系，同时提出 ScopeGate，一个留出置换诊断，用于在 SEF 用于审查分流前检查冲突风险方向。
Result: 在医疗、Covertype、黑盒、金融和十个外部数据集上，冲突有时可区分本已出现高置信度预测中的风险；交叉拟合检验显示，在多个数据集（包括两个大型金融任务）上，冲突提供了超越置信度和归因熵的额外错误排序信息。但方向并不普遍，某些任务中低冲突案例风险更高。
Conclusion: SEF 是审计工具而非普适风险分数：它描述证据结构，而是否需要依赖独立校准样本来判断该结构在目标人群中是否有用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adversarial observations in probabilistic State-Space Models for robust Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making under partial or adversarial observability requires accurate inference of the environment's latent state and its associated uncertainty. This work analyses adversarial attacks on linear state-space models, where the attacker alters observations subject to likelihood constraints that ensure that the perturbations remain statistically consistent with the observation model. We analyse how such adversarial yet plausible observations shift inference about latent states and affect downstream decision-making and the performance of reinforcement learning agents. In addition, we introduce an online Bayesian defence based on directional covariance adaptation, which selectively reduces the influence of observations by comparing their estimated impact with that of the computed most disruptive direction, while preserving information in the remaining orthogonal observation subspace. The proposed framework provides a principled approach to constructing robust inference and decision-making systems, with direct relevance to safety-critical applications such as robotics, where reliable operation under sensor noise, partial failures, and adversarial conditions is essential.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 10 figures, PREPRINT ONGOING: Revised version with additional theoretical results and experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析线性状态空间模型中的对抗观测攻击：攻击者在似然约束下篡改观测，使扰动在统计上与观测模型一致，并研究这类看似合理的观测如何偏移潜在状态推断、影响下游决策及强化学习智能体表现。作者提出一种基于方向协方差自适应（directional covariance adaptation）的在线贝叶斯防御，通过比较估计影响与计算出的最具破坏性方向来选择性降低观测权重，同时保留正交观测子空间中的信息。
Motivation: 部分或对抗性可观测条件下的决策需要准确推断环境潜在状态及其不确定性，而对抗性但统计合理的观测会误导推断并损害强化学习与安全关键系统的可靠性。
Method: 形式化线性状态空间模型上的对抗攻击，其中攻击者修改观测但受似然约束以确保扰动与观测模型一致；随后引入在线贝叶斯防御，通过方向协方差自适应调整对观测的信任，并利用最破坏性方向来识别并减弱高影响观测，同时保持其余正交方向上的信息。
Result: 摘要层面未报告具体量化指标；修订版本补充了额外的理论结果与实验（据 arXiv 注释），用于支持该防御框架在对抗可观测性下的鲁棒推断效果。
Conclusion: 该框架为构建鲁棒推断与决策系统提供了原则性路径，尤其面向机器人等安全关键应用在传感器噪声、部分故障和对抗条件下的可靠运行。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: MoECa: Aligning Feature Reuse with Expert Decomposition in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (DiT-MoE) improve model capacity under sparse activation, but diffusion inference is still bottlenecked by redundant computation across timesteps. Existing caching methods mainly operate at the token level, which becomes suboptimal in DiT-MoE because each token update is internally decomposed into multiple routed expert branches. Our analysis shows that cross-timestep redundancy in DiT-MoE is better characterized at the expert-branch level than at the whole-token level. Based on this observation, we propose MoECa, a fine-grained caching framework that performs branch-level feature reuse across timesteps. MoECa further introduces expert-aware adaptive control and synchronized cache updates across MoE and attention paths to maintain stable intermediate states. Experiments on multiple DiT-MoE models show a favorable speed--quality trade-off, with up to 2.93$\times$ speedups while preserving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoECa，一种面向 Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (DiT-MoE) 的细粒度缓存框架。作者观察到 DiT-MoE 的跨时间步冗余在 expert-branch 层级比 token 层级更能刻画，因此沿被路由的专家分支进行特征复用，并加入专家感知的自适应控制与 MoE/attention 路径间的同步缓存更新。实验在多个 DiT-MoE 模型上取得最高 2.93 倍加速，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: DiT-MoE 通过稀疏激活提升模型容量，但扩散推理仍受跨时间步冗余计算瓶颈限制。已有缓存方法主要在 token 层操作，而 DiT-MoE 中每个 token 更新被分解为多个路由专家分支，导致 token 级缓存不够适配。
Method: 提出 MoECa 缓存框架，将跨时间步的特征重用下沉到 expert-branch 层；同时引入专家感知的自适应控制 (expert-aware adaptive control)，并在 MoE 与 attention 路径间同步缓存更新，以维持稳定的中间状态。
Result: 在多个 DiT-MoE 模型上的实验显示，该方法获得最高 2.93 倍的推理加速，同时保持生成质量，呈现较好的速度-质量权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DiT-MoE 的跨时间步冗余更适合在专家分支层刻画，细粒度的分支级缓存能够带来显著的推理加速且不牺牲生成质量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在多个 DiT-MoE 模型上的实验显示，该方法获得最高 2.93 倍的推理加速，同时保持生成质量，呈现较好的速度-质量权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 DiT-MoE 的跨时间步冗余更适合在专家分支层刻画，细粒度的分支级缓存能够带来显著的推理加速且不牺牲生成质量。

papers.title: CADET: Physics-Grounded Causal Auditing and Training-Free Deconfounding of End-to-End Driving Planners
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous-driving planners trained by imitation are prone to statistical shortcuts: they associate scene elements that merely co-occur with expert actions (a roadside object, a building facade) with driving decisions, rather than the variables that causally determine them. Such causal confusion silently compromises reliability in long-tail scenarios, and it is difficult to detect, because prevailing open-loop metrics (L2 displacement and collision rate) are dominated by ego status and do not indicate whether a planner depends on spurious cues. Existing remedies based on causal-intervention training require retraining large models and cannot audit a planner that is already deployed. We present CADET, a training-free framework that audits, benchmarks, and repairs spurious reliance in pretrained E2E planners without any parameter update.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对端到端 (E2E) 自动驾驶规划器在模仿学习中出现统计捷径的问题，提出 CADET，一个免训练 (training-free) 的框架，用于审计、基准测试和修复预训练规划器对虚假线索 (spurious cues) 的依赖，全程不需要更新任何参数。摘要称该方法能够处理已有部署模型中的因果混淆 (causal confusion)，而不必像现有因果干预训练那样重训大模型。
Motivation: 模仿学习训练的 E2E 规划器容易把与专家动作仅共现的场景元素（如路边物体、建筑立面）误当作决策依据，这种因果混淆在长尾场景中会悄悄损害可靠性。现有开环指标（L2 位移和碰撞率）主要受自车状态支配，无法判断规划器是否依赖虚假线索，而基于因果干预的训练方案需要重训大模型，无法审计已部署的规划器。
Method: CADET 是一个免训练的框架，无需任何参数更新即可对预训练 E2E 规划器进行审计、基准测试和修复，利用物理驱动 (physics-grounded) 的因果审计思路来识别和缓解对虚假特征的依赖。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的数值实验结果，主要贡献是提出一套可用于已部署规划器的免训练因果审计与去混淆框架。
Conclusion: 论文主张在不重训模型的前提下，可以检测并修复 E2E 规划器对虚假线索的依赖，从而提升其在长尾场景中的可靠性。

papers.title: Online Shift Detection and Conformal Adaptation for Deployed Safety Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models deployed as safety monitors exhibit a systematic vulnerability: reasoning-token budget starvation. Adversarial inputs require $3.3\times$ more reasoning tokens than benign inputs to produce valid safety scores ($T_{50,\text{adv}}{=}154$ vs. $T_{50,\text{benign}}{=}46$ for o3), so low-budget deployments silently starve the monitor on exactly the inputs it must catch. This compounds the central failure mode: gradient-based evasion remains the residual threat -- template jailbreaks fail at 99%, but GCG-optimized suffixes flip encoder decisions reliably. We systematize a canary construction -- score-disagreement monitoring between a targeted and un-targeted classifier -- and quantify its reliability under targeted evasion. We derive the exact security boundary -- a confidence-gated equilibrium at which a monitor-aware attacker stalls (validated gap $= 1/(2λ)$, within 95% CI of theory) -- and identify a failure mode in post-shift conformal adaptation. Three contributions. (1) Factorial drift benchmark. A pre-registered 800-cell evaluation ($4$ classifiers $\times$ $5$ shift types $\times$ $20$ seeds $\times$ $2$ windows) reveals detection difficulty is dominated by a classifier$\times$shift interaction ($η^2 = 0.185$): encoders detect paraphrase drift in 28 steps but miss adversarial suffixes for 37; decoders show the opposite. (2) Conformal collapse in generative embeddings. Weighted conformal prediction fails on decoder classifiers: logistic density-ratio estimation achieves perfect separability in 3584--4096-dimensional space, clipping all importance weights to zero. Projecting to $\leq$32 dimensions restores coverage (+33pp). (3) Adversarial canary threat model. Across 35 frontier models, a 4-tier threat model yields deployment guarantees ($\geq$71% detection, $<$1.5% FPR at $N{=}1000$)
papers.comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Code and pre-registration at https://github.com/junwenleong/safety-classifier-shift-monitor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部署为安全监控器的推理模型的一类系统性漏洞：推理 token 预算饥饿，对抗输入所需的推理 token 数约为良性输入的 3.3 倍，导致低预算部署在需要捕获的输入上失效。作者系统化了一种金丝雀 (canary) 构造——目标与非目标分类器之间的分数不一致监控，并量化其在定向逃逸下的可靠性；同时指出漂移后共形适应 (conformal adaptation) 中的一个失败模式。三方面贡献分别是：预注册的因子化漂移基准、生成式嵌入中共形预测的坍缩问题、以及对抗金丝雀威胁模型。
Motivation: 梯度逃逸仍是残余威胁：模板 jailbreak 在 99% 情况下失败，但 GCG 优化的后缀能可靠翻转编码器决策；同时推理 token 预算不足会让安全监控器在对抗输入上静默饥饿，而现有方法缺乏系统的监控与自适应机制。
Method: 提出基于目标与非目标分类器分数不一致的 canary 构造来监控漂移；推导出置信门控均衡 (confidence-gated equilibrium) 这一精确安全边界；通过预注册的 800 单元因子化基准（4 个分类器 × 5 种漂移类型 × 20 个种子 × 2 个窗口）评估漂移检测；并研究加权共形预测在 3584–4096 维生成式嵌入中的表现，提出投影到低维空间恢复覆盖率。
Result: 摘要报告 o3 上对抗输入的 T50 为 154，良性为 46，所需推理 token 多 3.3 倍；漂移检测难度主要由分类器×漂移交互主导（η² = 0.185），编码器 28 步检测到释义漂移但对对抗后缀漏检 37 步，解码器相反；逻辑回归密度比估计在高维空间达到完全可分性，将重要性权重全部裁剪为零，投影到 ≤32 维后覆盖率恢复 +33pp；4 层威胁模型在 N=1000 下给出 ≥71% 检测率、<1.5% FPR，安全边界经验验证为 1/(2λ)，在理论 95% CI 内。
Conclusion: 作者强调监控感知型攻击者会在置信门控均衡处停滞，且漂移后共形适应存在失败模式；通过低维投影可修复生成式嵌入中共形预测的坍缩，并为部分前沿模型提供带保证的检测与低误报率部署方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Context Returns: Toward Robust Internalization in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that on-policy distillation can internalize privileged context, such as system prompts or task hints, into a student model so that the context is no longer needed at inference time. However, we identify a counterintuitive and previously unstudied phenomenon: reintroducing the original privileged context to the distilled student often degrades its performance, even on instances it already solves correctly without context. We term this phenomenon context-induced degradation and argue that robust internalization requires not only matching the teacher's context-conditioned behavior, but also remaining stable when the privileged context is reintroduced, a desirable property we call context invariance. To promote this property, we formulate a novel view-robust internalization risk and propose No-Context Anchoring (NCA), a lightweight yet effective consistency regularizer that uses the student's stop-gradient no-context output as an anchor and aligns its context-conditioned output via forward KL divergence. Across 14 configurations spanning diverse domains and model families, NCA improves context-conditioned accuracy in most settings and reduces context harm in 12 out of 14, while preserving or improving no-context performance, demonstrating greater robustness to context reintroduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 on-policy distillation 中将特权上下文（如系统提示或任务提示）内化到学生模型的问题，发现一个反直觉现象：向已蒸馏的学生模型重新引入原始特权上下文反而会降低其性能，即使是在不带上下文时原本能正确解决的实例上。作者将这种现象称为 context-induced degradation，并提出 No-Context Anchoring (NCA) 一致性正则化器，以学生模型的 stop-gradient 无上下文输出作为锚点，通过 forward KL divergence 对齐其上下文条件输出。在跨领域和模型家族的 14 个配置上，NCA 在大多数设置中提升上下文条件准确率，并在 12/14 配置中减少上下文危害，同时保持或提升无上下文性能。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation 只关注匹配教师的条件行为，忽略了蒸馏后模型在特权上下文被重新引入时应保持稳定；作者发现重新引入上下文会导致性能退化，说明稳健内化需要额外的 context invariance 属性。
Method: 提出 view-robust internalization risk 来形式化稳健内化目标，并给出 No-Context Anchoring (NCA)，一种轻量一致性正则化器：将学生模型的 stop-gradient 无上下文输出作为锚点，用 forward KL divergence 对齐其上下文条件输出，从而显式鼓励 context invariance。
Result: 摘要报告在 14 个配置的实验中，NCA 在大多数设置下提升 context-conditioned accuracy，并在 14 个配置中的 12 个减少 context harm，同时保持或提升无上下文性能，展示了对上下文重新引入的更强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稳健内化不仅需要匹配教师的上下文条件行为，还需要在特权上下文重新引入时保持稳定；NCA 作为轻量正则化器可以有效提升这种鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FadeMem: Distance-Aware Memory Consolidation for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos by generating successive temporal segments, but their historical KV cache grows with video length. Existing bounded-cache methods reduce this cost with local windows, sink tokens, or compressed memory states, yet they usually assign fixed roles to different parts of the history. We propose FadeMem, a distance-aware KV memory consolidation mechanism that organizes historical KV blocks into a temporal hierarchy under a fixed cache budget. This design is motivated by frequency-dependent temporal decay: fine details decorrelate quickly, while coarse scene structure and identity remain useful over longer horizons. During generation, new history is inserted as fine-grained entries, while older adjacent entries are progressively merged under a power-law temporal allocation schedule, yielding a dense-near, sparse-far memory within one cache. Without architectural changes, FadeMem improves long-range consistency while largely preserving visual quality, and lightweight adaptation further enhances motion dynamics and visual fidelity. Using the same unified schedule under a fixed cache budget, FadeMem also remains effective over multi-minute and hour long video generation and reduces peak memory under a matched KV budget.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures. Substantially revised manuscript with expanded experiments and integrated supplementary material. Project page: https://fademem.github.io/FadeMem_Webpage/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FadeMem，一种针对自回归视频扩散生成器的距离感知 KV 缓存整合机制。它将历史 KV 块组织成固定缓存预算下的时间层级，按照幂律时间分配调度对新旧条目进行合并，形成近处密集、远处稀疏的单一缓存表示。摘要报告称该方法无需架构改动即可提升长程一致性并基本保持视觉质量，且在数分钟到小时级的长视频生成中保持有效并降低峰值内存。
Motivation: 自回归视频生成器需要逐段生成连续片段，历史 KV 缓存随视频长度增长；现有有界缓存方法采用局部窗口、sink token 或压缩记忆态，但通常给历史的不同部分分配固定角色。作者指出细粒度细节快速去相关，而粗粒度场景结构和身份信息在更长时间内仍然有效，因此需要距离感知的层级化记忆管理。
Method: FadeMem 在固定缓存预算下将历史 KV 块组织为时间层级；新历史以细粒度条目插入，较旧的相邻条目在幂律时间分配调度下被逐步合并，形成 dense-near, sparse-far 的缓存结构。该方法不改变网络架构，并可通过轻量适配（lightweight adaptation）进一步增强运动动态和视觉保真度。
Result: 摘要报告 FadeMem 在提升长程一致性的同时大体保持视觉质量；在相同统一调度和固定缓存预算下，对多分钟乃至小时级视频生成仍然有效，并在匹配 KV 预算下降低峰值内存。
Conclusion: 作者认为在固定缓存预算下采用距离感知的 KV 记忆整合可以改善自回归视频扩散的长程一致性，且无需架构变更即可扩展到极长视频生成。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 FadeMem 在提升长程一致性的同时大体保持视觉质量；在相同统一调度和固定缓存预算下，对多分钟乃至小时级视频生成仍然有效，并在匹配 KV 预算下降低峰值内存。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在固定缓存预算下采用距离感知的 KV 记忆整合可以改善自回归视频扩散的长程一致性，且无需架构变更即可扩展到极长视频生成。

papers.title: OmniTryOn: Video Try-On Anything at Once!
papers.abstract_en: Although video virtual try-on (VVT) has achieved significant progress, existing methods still exhibit two fundamental limitations: first, they are restricted to single-garment transfer, rendering simultaneous multi-object try-on highly impractical; second, their heavy reliance on explicit external priors (e.g., garment masks) inevitably destroys crucial physical dynamics and degrades visual quality. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes the novel Try-On Anything task, which aims to simultaneously transfer diverse wearable objects onto a person in a video in a single inference pass. To support and standardize this paradigm, we introduce TryAny-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark encompassing a paired video dataset alongside a tailored evaluation protocol. Furthermore, we present OmniTryOn, an external-prior-free generative framework designed to tackle this task. Specifically, OmniTryOn employs a First Frame Wearable Cache strategy, which directly provides diverse wearable objects for the generation process through the initial video frame. To maintain consistency, we propose the Spatiotemporally Consistent RoPE (STC-RoPE), which inherently establishes robust spatiotemporal anchors to strictly preserve complex human motions and background dynamics. Optimized by the proposed Gradual Try-On (GTO) training strategy, our model progressively masters robust multi-object synthesis. Extensive experiments on TryAny-Bench demonstrate that OmniTryOn significantly outperforms existing specialized video virtual try-on models and general video editing baselines, establishing a powerful new standard for the Try-On Anything task. Our dataset, code, and models are available at https://github.com/xcltql666/OminTryOn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Try-On Anything 任务，目标是在单次推理中同时将多种可穿戴物体迁移到视频中的人身上，并为此构建了配对视频数据集与评估协议 TryAny-Bench。作者进一步提出无外部先验的生成框架 OmniTryOn，采用 First Frame Wearable Cache 提供穿戴物体、STC-RoPE 保持时空一致、Gradual Try-On (GTO) 训练策略逐步掌握多物体合成。实验表明其在 TryAny-Bench 上显著优于专门的视频试穿模型和通用视频编辑基线。
Motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿 (VVT) 方法存在两个根本局限：只能进行单件衣物迁移，难以实现多物体同时试穿；并且高度依赖显式外部先验（如服装掩码），会破坏关键的物理动态并降低视觉质量。
Method: 提出无外部先验的生成框架 OmniTryOn，通过 First Frame Wearable Cache 策略直接从初始视频帧提供多样化可穿戴物体；提出时空一致 RoPE (STC-RoPE) 建立鲁棒的时空锚点以保持复杂人体运动和背景动态；并设计 Gradual Try-On (GTO) 训练策略使模型逐步掌握多物体合成。
Result: 在 TryAny-Bench 上的大量实验表明，OmniTryOn 显著优于现有专门的视频虚拟试穿模型以及通用视频编辑基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为 Try-On Anything 任务建立了新的标准，并公开了数据集、代码和模型。

papers.title: When Behavioral Safety Evaluation Fails: A Representation-Level Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is largely behavioral: a model is certified safe when it refuses harmful requests and answers benign ones. But refusing on the prompts an auditor happens to try does not show that the model is far from harmful behavior. Behavioral tests observe outputs; they do not measure how easily an intervention on the model turns a refusal into compliance. We call the gap between what static audits certify and what an intervention can reach the audit gap, and we show it is realizable: one can build a model that matches its safety-aligned base on every static audit yet gives way to a small, known perturbation of its internal state. We construct such dissociated models from three safety-aligned bases (Gemma 2 2B, Llama 3.2 3B, Qwen 2.5 3B) and audit the base, dissociated, and openly harmful models with the same soft interventions in parameter and latent space; the latent attacks are summarized by the Latent Vulnerability Score (LVS), the safety degradation produced per unit of bounded latent perturbation. Every static audit we run gives the dissociated model the same verdict as its base, since its refusals match the base, jailbreaks show no consistent signature, and a strong fixed probe on clean activations cannot tell it from the base. The same interventions an auditor could run reverse the verdict. At the targeted mid layer the dissociated models score 2.5 to 3.1 times higher LVS than their bases. A bounded latent attack elicits harmful compliance on 54 to 86% of prompts, against 3 to 48% for the bases, while matched random perturbations stay at or below 12%. Harmful fine-tuning reaches high compliance within five gradient steps, where the bases need 10 to 25. Behavioral testing, even with static latent probing, cannot certify representation-level robustness: a safety audit must intervene on the model, not only observe it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从表征层面审视大语言模型安全评测的局限，指出静态行为审计与干预可达行为之间存在可实现的“审计鸿沟”（audit gap）：可以构造一个在每一项静态审计上与安全对齐基座表现相同的模型，但只需对其内部状态施加一个小的已知扰动即可使其从拒答转向有害遵从。作者基于 Gemma 2 2B、Llama 3.2 3B、Qwen 2.5 3B 构造分离模型（dissociated models），并在参数空间与潜在空间使用相同的软干预进行审计，提出潜在脆弱性评分（LVS）量化每单位有界潜在扰动导致的安全退化。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全评测主要是行为层面的：模型在拒绝有害请求、回答良性请求时即被认证安全，但行为测试只观察输出，无法度量干预模型内部状态将拒答转为遵从的难易程度。
Method: 作者从三个安全对齐基座构建与基座在静态审计上不可区分的分离模型，并用参数空间和潜在空间的软干预统一审计基座、分离模型与公开有害模型；潜在攻击通过 LVS 汇总，即每单位有界潜在扰动带来的安全退化。
Result: 分离模型在所有静态审计（拒答匹配、越狱无一致特征、固定探针在干净激活上无法区分）上与基座获得相同结论，但同一干预可逆转结论；在目标中间层，分离模型的 LVS 比基座高 2.5 至 3.1 倍，有界潜在攻击在 54% 至 86% 的提示上诱发有害遵从（基座为 3% 至 48%），匹配随机扰动不超过 12%；有害微调在五个梯度步内达到高遵从，而基座需要 10 至 25 步。
Conclusion: 行为测试即使结合静态潜在探针也无法认证表征层面的鲁棒性；安全审计必须对模型进行干预，而不只是观察它。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Think Fast: Estimating No-CoT Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Many efforts to ensure frontier AI models are safe rely on monitoring their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. If models become able to perform sufficiently complex reasoning internally, without explicit thinking tokens, this would undermine such oversight. We measure how well frontier models reason without CoT across a suite of over 30,000 questions spanning 43 benchmarks in domains including math, coding, puzzles, causality, theory-of-mind, and strategic reasoning. To compare models against humans, we estimate the $50\%$-task-completion time horizon (TH): the human time required for tasks a model completes with $50\%$ success rate. We complement this with a $50\%$ reasoning token horizon: the minimum number of o3-mini reasoning tokens needed for tasks a model solves with $50\%$ success rate. We find that the no-CoT $50\%$ TH of frontier models has been doubling roughly every year over the past six years, with GPT-5.5's TH reaching over 3 minutes and reasoning token horizon exceeding 1,500 tokens. Our median estimates predict that frontier no-CoT THs could exceed 7 minutes by 2028, and 25 minutes by 2030, though these projections carry substantial uncertainty. We recommend frontier developers track this explicitly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统测量前沿模型在不使用链式思维 (CoT) 时进行复杂推理的能力，构建了覆盖 43 个基准、3 万余道题的评测集。作者定义 50% 任务完成时间地平线 (TH) 与 50% 推理 token 地平线，发现前沿模型的无 CoT TH 在过去六年中约每年翻倍，GPT-5.5 的 TH 已超过 3 分钟、推理 token 地平线超过 1500 tokens。中位预测显示到 2028 年 TH 可能超过 7 分钟、到 2030 年超过 25 分钟，但不确定性较大。
Motivation: 许多前沿模型安全措施依赖对其 CoT 推理的监控；如果模型能在不产生显式思考 token 的情况下完成足够复杂的内部推理，这类监督将失效，因此需要量化模型无 CoT 条件下的推理能力。
Method: 使用超过 30,000 道题目、涵盖数学、编程、谜题、因果推理、心理推理和策略推理的 43 个基准，提出 50% 任务完成时间地平线 (TH)，即模型以 50% 成功率完成的任务对应的人类所需时间；同时提出 50% 推理 token 地平线，即模型以 50% 成功率解决的问题所需的最少 o3-mini 推理 token 数。
Result: 摘要报告前沿模型的无 CoT 50% TH 在过去六年中约每年翻倍，GPT-5.5 的 TH 超过 3 分钟、推理 token 地平线超过 1500 tokens；中位估计预测到 2028 年 TH 可超过 7 分钟、到 2030 年超过 25 分钟，但预测存在显著不确定性。
Conclusion: 作者建议前沿模型开发者明确跟踪无 CoT TH 这一指标，以评估对现有 CoT 监管手段的潜在威胁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CaliDist: Calibrating Large Language Models via Behavioral Robustness to Distraction
papers.abstract_en: Existing calibration methods for Large Language Models (LLMs) often overlook a critical dimension of trustworthiness: a model's behavioral robustness to irrelevant or misleading information. In this paper, we argue that a model's true confidence should reflect its stability under cognitive pressure. We introduce CaliDist, a novel post-hoc calibration approach that directly measures and penalizes a model's susceptibility to distraction. CaliDist quantifies how an LLM's predictions and uncertainty change when its input prompt is perturbed with semantic distractors. This stability (or lack thereof) signal is then used to adaptively scale the model's initial confidence score. Our extensive experiments on seven Natural Language Understanding classification benchmarks using six distinct LLMs show that CaliDist consistently achieves lower Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier Score compared with strong baselines. Remarkably, our method reduces the ECE from 23% to 7% on average--a relative improvement of 70%--demonstrating that behavioral stability is a powerful signal for calibration. We make our code and datasets available at github.com/anas-jawad/CaliDist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CaliDist，一种针对大语言模型 (LLM) 的后处理校准 (post-hoc calibration) 方法，核心思想是用模型对语义干扰 (semantic distractors) 的行为鲁棒性来校准置信度。作者认为，真正可信的置信度应反映模型在认知压力下的稳定性，并通过扰动输入提示来衡量预测与不确定性变化，再据此自适应缩放初始置信度。在七个 NLU 分类基准和六个 LLM 上的实验显示，CaliDist 相较强基线持续降低 ECE 和 Brier Score，平均将 ECE 从 23% 降至 7%，相对改进约 70%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 校准方法往往忽略可信度的一个关键维度，即模型对无关或误导信息的鲁棒性；作者主张模型的真实置信度应反映其在认知压力下的稳定性。
Method: CaliDist 通过向输入提示加入语义干扰物来量化 LLM 预测和不确定性变化，将该稳定性信号用于自适应地缩放模型初始置信度分数，从而实现后处理校准。
Result: 在七个自然语言理解分类基准、六个不同 LLM 上的实验表明，该方法相比强基线持续取得更低的 Expected Calibration Error (ECE) 和 Brier Score；平均 ECE 从 23% 降至 7%，相对改进 70%。
Conclusion: 作者认为行为稳定性是校准的有效信号，并开源了代码与数据集；文章强调该方法的校准收益来自对干扰的鲁棒性度量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FLARE: Diffusion for Hybrid Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs) have achieved broad practical success, but sequential decoding remains a key bottleneck for low-latency deployment. Recent efficient-inference work has progressed along two axes: reducing the cost of each model invocation through efficient architectures, and reducing serial decoding steps through parallel generation. Hybrid attention backbones address the former, while diffusion language models (dLLMs) pursue the latter via iterative parallel denoising. Combining these advantages remains challenging: AR-to-dLLM conversion often fails to preserve seed-checkpoint capability, and hybrid-attention recurrent states and masking constraints make diffusion training and serving nontrivial. We present FLARE, a systematic conversion framework for hybrid-attention LLMs. Our analysis identifies transfer data quality as the primary determinant of capability preservation, outweighing loss formulation and attention-mask design. The resulting framework combines a token-equal AR-and-diffusion objective, hardware-aware kernels, and unified inference, enabling one checkpoint to support both AR-style verified decoding and diffusion-style parallel denoising. Starting from strong AR checkpoints with limited post-training data, FLARE is competitive with leading open-source dLLMs across model scales and delivers consistent throughput gains over open-source dLLM baselines in single-GPU concurrent serving. Our results further suggest that practical dLLMs are limited not only by decoding algorithms, but also by transfer data quality and the training inefficiency of current block-diffusion objectives, motivating joint design of data, objectives, architectures, and inference systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLARE 提出一种将混合注意力（hybrid-attention）大型语言模型转换为同时支持自回归解码与扩散式并行去噪的统一框架。作者通过分析发现迁移数据质量是保留种子检查点能力的关键因素，并据此设计了 token 等价的 AR 与扩散联合目标、硬件感知内核和统一推理。在有限后训练数据下，FLARE 与开源扩散语言模型（dLLM）在多个规模上相当，并在单 GPU 并发推理中带来吞吐提升。
Motivation: 自回归 LLM 的序列解码是低延迟部署的瓶颈，而扩散语言模型通过迭代并行去噪减少串行步数；然而将 AR 检查点转换为 dLLM 往往损失能力，且混合注意力循环状态与掩码约束使扩散训练和推理复杂化。
Method: FLARE 是一个系统的转换框架，结合 token 等价的 AR 和扩散目标、硬件感知内核以及统一推理，使单个检查点既能用于 AR 式验证解码，也能用于扩散式并行去噪，并强调迁移数据质量而非损失公式或注意力掩码设计。
Result: 从强 AR 检查点出发、仅用有限后训练数据，FLARE 在多个模型规模上与领先开源 dLLM 相当，并在单 GPU 并发服务场景下相对开源 dLLM 基线取得一致的吞吐提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为实用 dLLM 的瓶颈不仅在于解码算法，还在于迁移数据质量和当前块扩散目标的训练低效，提议联合设计数据、目标、架构与推理系统。

papers.title: E4GEN: Event-level Explainable Extreme-Enhanced Time-series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic time series is essential for scientific research and real-world applications. However, existing methods often emphasize overall distributional fidelity while failing to faithfully capture extreme events. To advance existing research, we propose E4GEN, an explainable diffusion framework for extreme event-aware time-series generation. E4GEN provides systematic insights into when, what, and how to control extreme-event generation through three key components. First, E-Activator learns the dataset-adaptive extreme-control signal activation step during the denoising process without interfering with regular temporal components, including trend and seasonality. Second, E-Predictor determines what control signal to enforce through Self-Driven Semantic Prediction, where each sample derives its own control signal by inferring latent extreme-event information during generation. It also includes a novel Data-Conditioned Training, Noise-Initiated Sampling mechanism to address the issue of unavailable training labels. Third, E-Control specifies how to control extreme-event generation through a trainable Extreme Control Network, which transforms the semantic control signal into layer-wise signals and injects it into the denoising process. We evaluate E4GEN on six datasets with 17 metrics, and extensive experiments show that E4GEN outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple dimensions, including overall fidelity, extreme-event fidelity, and downstream utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E4GEN，一个面向极端事件的时间序列生成的可解释扩散框架 (explainable diffusion framework)。现有方法通常只注重整体分布保真度而忽略极端事件，E4GEN 通过三个组件分别控制何时、何种以及如何施加极端事件控制信号，并在六个数据集、17 项指标上超过现有最先进模型。
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法强调整体分布保真度，却未能忠实捕捉极端事件 (extreme events)，这限制了生成数据在科学研究和实际应用中的可用性。
Method: E4GEN 包含三个关键组件：E-Activator 学习数据自适应的极端控制信号激活步，且不干扰趋势和季节性等常规时间成分；E-Predictor 通过 Self-Driven Semantic Prediction 让每个样本在生成过程中推断潜在极端事件信息以得到自身控制信号，并引入 Data-Conditioned Training 和 Noise-Initiated Sampling 解决训练标签缺失问题；E-Control 通过可训练的 Extreme Control Network 将语义控制信号转换为逐层信号注入去噪过程。
Result: 在六个数据集上使用 17 项指标进行评估，实验表明 E4GEN 在整体保真度、极端事件保真度以及下游效用 (downstream utility) 等多个维度上优于现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式控制极端事件生成的时机、内容与方式，可以在不牺牲常规时间成分的前提下提升极端事件保真度；该框架还针对训练标签不可用的问题提出了专门机制。

papers.title: PersonaTrail: Benchmarking Personalized Web Agents through Browsing Trails
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have enabled web agents to autonomously execute complex tasks. In practice, users frequently provide underspecified instructions, requiring agents to infer the missing context from their raw browsing histories. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this form of personalization, as they either restrict tasks to fully explicit prompts or abstract web interaction history into simplified forms. To bridge this gap, we introduce PersonaTrail, a benchmark for personalized web agents operating in a managed open web environment. By leveraging realistic browsing trajectories as user history, PersonaTrail evaluates an agent's ability to infer user preferences and recall information from past browsing sessions. We further propose Preference-Aware Contextual Memory (PACMem), a framework that decomposes raw browsing histories into two types of structured memory: factual memories that summarize individual sessions and preference memories that distill recurring behavioral patterns. At inference time, the agent retrieves the most relevant entries from these memories to guide personalized navigation. Extensive experiments show that PACMem consistently outperforms existing memory-based baselines on both tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PersonaTrail，一个用于评测个性化 Web agent 的基准，环境为受管的开放网络，并以真实浏览轨迹作为用户历史。作者还提出 PACMem 框架，将原始浏览历史分解为事实记忆与偏好记忆，在推理时检索相关记忆以引导个性化导航。摘要称 PACMem 在两个任务上一致优于现有基于记忆的基线。
Motivation: 实际使用中用户常给出欠明确的指令，agent 需要从原始浏览历史中推断缺失的上下文，而现有基准要么只使用完全显式的提示，要么把交互历史抽象成简化形式，无法捕捉这类个性化场景。
Method: 引入 PersonaTrail 基准，利用真实浏览轨迹评估 agent 推断用户偏好与回忆历史信息的能力；并提出 Preference-Aware Contextual Memory (PACMem)，把原始浏览历史分解为总结单次会话的事实记忆 (factual memories) 和提炼重复行为模式的偏好记忆 (preference memories)，推理时检索最相关条目指导导航。
Result: 大量实验表明 PACMem 在两个任务上均优于现有基于记忆的基线；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PersonaTrail 填补了利用原始浏览历史进行个性化评估的空白，PACMem 的结构化记忆分解能有效提升个性化导航效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Speculative Decoding and the Curse of Multilinguality
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding is a popular technique for large language model (LLM) inference, enabling faster generation by drafting multiple tokens with a smaller draft model. However, the effectiveness of speculative decoding has mainly been studied for English. Motivated by the curse of multilinguality, we hypothesize that speculative decoding is far less effective for low-resource languages due to the limited multilingual capacities of smaller models. We test eleven languages under a standard speculative decoding setup and find strong evidence for our hypothesis. Next, we try to improve the multilingual capabilities of the smaller draft model via distillation from the larger model. We find, though, that distillation generalizes poorly across tasks in the same language, and we argue that assembling a task-agnostic, fully representative dataset is infeasible for low-resource languages. Finally, we propose weaker n-gram models as draft models; these provide moderate speed-ups due to their minuscule inference cost.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 12 figures, submitted to ACL ARR August 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推测解码（speculative decoding）在多语言场景下的有效性，假设低资源语言上该技术因小模型多语言能力有限而效果较差。作者在标准推测解码设置下测试了十一种语言，结果强力支持该假设。随后尝试通过从大模型蒸馏来提升小草稿模型的多语言能力，发现蒸馏在同一语言内跨任务泛化不佳，并论证构建任务无关且完全代表性的低资源语言数据集不可行。最后提出改用较弱的 n-gram 模型作为草稿模型，凭借其极低的推理成本获得中等加速。
Motivation: 推测解码的效率此前主要针对英语研究，而低资源语言下较小草稿模型的多语言能力受限，可能导致推测解码效果大打折扣，这一问题尚未被系统检验。
Method: 在标准推测解码框架下对十一种语言进行评测；尝试用大模型蒸馏提升小草稿模型的多语言能力；并提出以 n-gram 模型作为草稿模型的替代方案。
Result: 实验证据强烈支持低资源语言上推测解码效果更差的假设；蒸馏在相同语言内跨任务泛化较差；n-gram 草稿模型因其推理成本极小而带来中等速度提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为对低资源语言构建任务无关、完全代表性的蒸馏数据集不可行，因此将 n-gram 模型作为草稿模型是更实际的加速途径。

papers.title: Language model agents show in-group trust bias invisible to standard behavioural audits
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents are moving from single-user assistants into persistent networks that build trust and reputation with one another, and the same models increasingly control physically embodied robots as well as software. Here we show that five widely used open-weight reasoning models develop an in-group trust bias the moment group membership becomes visible to them, even when the groups are arbitrary labels with no real-world meaning: in a 20-agent simulation, agents direct 53.6-54.6% of their trust-building actions toward in-group targets against a 47.4% base rate expected by chance, a shift present in every model tested and confirmed by three independent statistical checks and an instruction-rewording robustness test. This bias is easy for current evaluation practice to miss, because it operates through which agent receives an action rather than which action is chosen - a channel invisible to the aggregate behaviour-log audits that are the standard way multi-agent AI systems are evaluated today. A resource-scarcity manipulation, intended to test whether competition intensifies the bias, instead reduced it in three of five models; we trace this to an artifact of how scarcity was enforced, not to a failure of the underlying mechanism. Group-contingent social dynamics are therefore already present in the models multi-agent AI systems are built from, and auditing practice built around single-model, single-decision evaluation cannot detect them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究五个广泛使用的开源推理模型在多智能体网络中是否出现内群体信任偏差 (in-group trust bias)。作者在 20 智能体模拟中给智能体分配无现实含义的任意群体标签，发现当群体身份可见时，智能体会把 53.6%-54.6% 的信任建立行为投向同群体目标，而随机基线为 47.4%，且所有被测模型均表现出该偏差。由于偏差体现在“对谁行动”而非“选择何种行动”，标准的行为日志审计无法察觉。
Motivation: 语言模型智能体正从单用户助手发展为相互建立信任与声誉的持久网络，甚至控制实体机器人；现有标准审计方法基于单模型、单决策的聚合行为日志，无法捕捉群体身份可见时产生的社会性偏差。
Method: 采用 20 智能体模拟实验，对五个开源权重推理模型进行测试；随机指定无真实语义的群体标签，通过三种独立统计检验和指令改写鲁棒性测试确认偏差，并加入资源稀缺操纵以检验竞争是否加剧偏差。
Result: 实验测得内群体信任行为占比为 53.6%-54.6%，高于 47.4% 的随机基线；偏差在每个被测模型中都存在。资源稀缺操纵反而使五个模型中的三个偏差降低，作者将其归因于资源稀缺实施方式带来的伪影，而非底层机制失效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调群体条件性的社会动态已存在于多智能体 AI 系统所依赖的基础模型中，而围绕单模型、单决策评估构建的审计实践无法检测这类现象。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Translate from Soft to Hard LLM Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Soft prompting, also known as continuous prompting, is a parameter-efficient method for tuning LLMs to specific tasks. Like other machine learning techniques, its parameters encode some hidden procedure: is it possible to train a model to decode this procedure---to "translate" raw parameters into natural language? In this work, we present a promising proof-of-concept: a translator model capable of verbalizing soft prompt's learned embeddings into fluent natural language descriptions. We show that these verbalizations when used as standalone prompts for inference surpasses baselines, suggesting that they are not just plausible-sounding descriptions, but genuinely relevant to the task. On average, verbalizations retain a modest but significant 32\% of the original soft prompt's performance. We speculate on future directions for how this could be used for interpretability or inference or perhaps even extended to other ML techniques.

papers.title: Stream3D: Sequential Multi-View 3D Generation via Evidential Memory
papers.abstract_en: View-conditioned 3D generators such as SAM 3D, TRELLIS, and Hunyuan3D produce high-quality object reconstructions from a single view, but real-world visual observation often arrives as long monocular streams. Naively applying these generators to each streaming frame independently leads to severe temporal inconsistency in the generated results. To address this problem, we propose Stream3D, the first training-free streaming mechanism that turns a frozen view-conditioned 3D generator into a streaming generator with constant cross-chunk memory. Stream3D achieves this by maintaining a compact evidential memory, which selectively caches the most informative historical frames based on a proposed evidence score mechanism. As the stream progresses, the memory dynamically updates to retain a fixed number of informative frames, preventing the memory footprint from growing linearly with sequence length. This also prevents degradation over long sequences and keeps the underlying generator completely unchanged without retraining, architectural modifications, or auxiliary losses. Evaluated on both realistic and synthetic streaming benchmarks, Stream3D outperforms latent-transport baselines, including KV-cache reuse and flow-based feature editing, across both photometric and geometric metrics. More details can be found at: https://stream-3d.github.io/stream3d.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stream3D，一种无需训练的流式生成机制，可将冻结的视图条件 3D 生成器（如 SAM 3D、TRELLIS、Hunyuan3D）转变为支持常数量级跨片段记忆的流式生成器。其核心是维护一个紧凑的 evidential memory，依据提出的证据分数（evidence score）选择性缓存最具信息量的历史帧，并在流式推进中动态更新，保持固定帧数且不随序列长度增长。在真实与合成流式基准上，它优于 KV-cache 复用和基于流的特征编辑等 latent-transport 基线。
Motivation: 真实世界的视觉观测常以长单目流（monocular stream）形式到达，而现有视图条件 3D 生成器面向单视图输入；若对每个流式帧独立应用生成器，会产生严重的时序不一致问题。
Method: Stream3D 维护一个紧凑的 evidential memory，通过证据分数机制选择性缓存最富信息的历史帧，并随流式过程动态更新以保留固定数量帧，从而避免内存随序列长度线性增长；整个过程无需重训练、架构修改或辅助损失。
Result: 在现实与合成流式基准上，Stream3D 在光度（photometric）和几何（geometric）指标上均优于 latent-transport 类基线，包括 KV-cache 复用与基于流的特征编辑方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是一种训练无关的流式 3D 生成方案，保持底层生成器完全不变，同时通过恒定规模跨片段记忆避免长序列下的性能退化。

papers.title: A Deployment Audit of Release-Side Risk in Conformal Triage under Prevalence Shift
papers.abstract_en: Conformal triage converts predictive scores into deployment actions that either release a case, flag it for urgent attention, or defer it to human review. Under an observed change in target-event prevalence, however, marginal coverage and human-review rate can miss whether patients who experience the target event are released without review. To address this gap, we introduce a leakage-aware deployment audit for release-side conformal triage. It first assigns target subjects to three non-overlapping roles: prevalence correction, conformal calibration, and held-out release-side evaluation. This separation then lets the audit evaluate release directly: how many event-positive patients are cleared without review, whether the pilot has enough event labels for calibration, and how the release-review trade-off shifts. Applying this audit to a retrospective non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) target cohort shows why lower review can be misleading: after prevalence correction, the pooled conformal branch lowers review by releasing more patients, some of whom are event-positive. Within the audit, the classwise branch acts as a scarcity diagnostic: the pilot has too few event labels to support a low-review release rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向发布侧 (release-side) 共形分流 (conformal triage) 的部署审计方法，用于在目标事件患病率 (prevalence) 发生变化时检测'事件阳性患者未经审核被直接放出'的风险。方法将受试者划分为患病率校正、共形校准和留出发布侧评估三个不重叠角色，直接评估发布侧事件阳性患者数量、校准标签充分性与发布-审核权衡。在回顾性非小细胞肺癌 (NSCLC) 队列上，审计表明更低的审核率可能具有误导性：合并共形分支 (pooled conformal branch) 通过放出更多患者降低审核率，而其中一些患者为事件阳性。
Motivation: 现有共形分流在患病率漂移下只关注边际覆盖率 (marginal coverage) 和人工审核率，可能遗漏'发生目标事件的患者未经审核被直接放出'这一发布侧风险。
Method: 引入泄漏感知 (leakage-aware) 的部署审计，把目标受试者分为患病率校正、共形校准和留出发布侧评估三组非重叠角色，从而直接量化免审放出的事件阳性人数、校准标签充分性以及发布-审核权衡的变化。
Result: 在非小细胞肺癌 (NSCLC) 回顾性目标队列中，患病率校正后合并共形分支降低审核率的方式是放出更多患者，其中包含事件阳性患者；类别级 (classwise) 分支则显示 pilot 中事件标签过少，不足以支持低审核率的发布规则。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该审计揭示低审核率可能掩盖发布侧泄漏，并指出类别级分支可作为标签稀缺性的诊断工具。
Relevance: 5
