papers.title: MedCRP-CL: Continual Medical Image Segmentation via Bayesian Nonparametric Semantic Modality Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation faces a fundamental challenge in continual learning: data arrives sequentially from heterogeneous sources, yet effective continual learning requires discovering which tasks share sufficient structure to benefit from joint learning. Existing methods either apply uniform constraints across all tasks, causing catastrophic forgetting when tasks conflict, or require predefined task groupings that cannot anticipate future task diversity. We introduce MedCRP-CL, a framework that performs online task structure discovery and structure-aware continual learning. Leveraging the Chinese Restaurant Process (CRP), our method dynamically infers task groupings from clinical text prompts as tasks arrive, without requiring predefined cluster counts or access to future tasks. We term these discovered groupings semantic modalities, as they capture finer-grained structure than physical imaging modalities by integrating anatomical region and pathological context. Guided by this discovered structure, we maintain semantic modality-specific LoRA adapters regularized by intra-modality EWC, ensuring parameter isolation across dissimilar task groups while facilitating knowledge transfer within similar ones. The framework is also replay-free, storing only aggregate statistics rather than raw patient data. Experiments on 16 medical segmentation tasks across four imaging modalities demonstrate that MedCRP-CL achieves 73.3% Dice score with only 4.1% forgetting, outperforming the best baseline by 8.0% while requiring 6$\times$ fewer parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/MedCRP-CL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedCRP-CL，一个面向医学图像分割的持续学习框架，利用 Chinese Restaurant Process (CRP) 从临床文本提示中在线发现任务分组（称为语义模态），并据此维护按语义模态划分的 LoRA 适配器，配以模态内 EWC 正则，实现无需回放（replay-free）的持续分割。在 16 个医学分割任务、四种成像模态上的实验显示 Dice 达 73.3%、遗忘仅 4.1%，比最优基线高 8.0%，参数少 6 倍。
Motivation: 医学图像分割的持续学习面临数据来自异质来源的挑战，而有效的持续学习需要发现哪些任务共享足够结构、可以联合学习。现有方法要么对所有任务施加统一约束，导致任务冲突时灾难性遗忘；要么需要预定义任务分组，无法应对未来任务多样性。
Method: 提出 MedCRP-CL 框架，在线进行任务结构发现与结构感知的持续学习。利用 Chinese Restaurant Process (CRP) 从临床文本提示中动态推断任务分组，无需预定义簇数或访问未来任务；将发现的分组称为语义模态，比物理成像模态捕捉更细粒度结构。依据该结构维护语义模态特异的 LoRA 适配器，并用模态内 EWC 正则化，在相异任务组间实现参数隔离、相似组内促进知识迁移。框架免回放，只存储聚合统计而非原始患者数据。
Result: 在 16 个医学分割任务（跨四种成像模态）上，MedCRP-CL 达到 73.3% Dice，遗忘率仅 4.1%，比最优基线高 8.0%，且所需参数少 6 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过贝叶斯非参数语义模态发现解决了持续分割中任务结构发现与知识迁移/隔离的矛盾，并验证了免回放、参数高效的设计；其适用场景为基于临床文本提示的医学图像分割持续学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lean Refactor: Multi-Objective Controllable Proof Optimization via Agentic Strategy Search
papers.abstract_en: We present Lean Refactor, a plug-and-play retrieval-augmented agentic framework for multi-objective, controllable, and version-robust refactoring of Lean proofs. LLM-generated proofs are notoriously correct-but-verbose and brittle across library versions, yet existing refactoring works overlook three practical challenges: 1) Lean refactoring is natively multi-objective (proof length, compilation cost, and version compatibility are often in tension); 2) Lean repositories have fragile compatibility, whereas LLM releases are unaware of Lean/Mathlib versions; 3) Training-based pipelines require repeated fine-tuning with each new LLM release, scaling neither with model churn nor with Lean's release cycle. Lean Refactor steers a frozen agentic LLM with retrievals from a curated database of multi-objective refactoring strategies, each densely annotated with metadata such as supported Lean/Mathlib versions and expected compilation-cost reduction. Experiments show over $70\%$ token-level compression on competition benchmarks, over $20\%$ on research repositories, and up to $60\%$ compilation-time reduction, outperforming prior work and Claude Code. Version-filtered retrieval further improves compression on the target Lean version, and refactored miniF2F proofs exhibit stronger zero-shot version transfer to future Lean releases than their unrefactored counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lean Refactor，一个即插即用的检索增强智能体框架 (retrieval-augmented agentic framework)，用于对 Lean 证明进行多目标、可控且对版本鲁棒的改写。它用来自动化整理的改写策略数据库的检索结果，驱动一个冻结的智能体 LLM，该数据库为每条策略密集标注了支持的 Lean/Mathlib 版本和预期编译成本降低等元数据。实验显示在竞赛基准上实现超过 70% 的 token 级压缩，在研究仓库上超过 20%，并最多降低 60% 的编译时间，优于此前工作和 Claude Code。
Motivation: LLM 生成的 Lean 证明往往正确但冗长，且在不同库版本间很脆弱；现有改写工作忽略了三个实际问题：Lean 改写天生是多目标的（证明长度、编译成本和版本兼容性常相互冲突）、Lean 仓库兼容性脆弱而 LLM 发布不感知版本、基于训练的流水线需要随每个新 LLM 发布反复微调，无法适应模型迭代和 Lean 发布周期。
Method: Lean Refactor 不微调 LLM，而是用一个经过整理的、含丰富元数据注释的多目标改写策略数据库，通过版本过滤的检索 (version-filtered retrieval) 来引导一个冻结的智能体 LLM 执行证明改写，实现即插即用。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在竞赛基准上取得超过 70% 的 token 级压缩，在研究仓库上超过 20%，编译时间最多降低 60%，并且优于此前工作和 Claude Code；版本过滤检索进一步改善了目标 Lean 版本上的压缩效果，改写后的 miniF2F 证明对未来的 Lean 版本表现出比未改写版本更强的零样本版本迁移能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过带版本过滤的检索和多目标策略数据库，可以在不重新训练的前提下实现可控、版本鲁棒的 Lean 证明改写，并提升对未来版本的可迁移性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在竞赛基准上取得超过 70% 的 token 级压缩，在研究仓库上超过 20%，编译时间最多降低 60%，并且优于此前工作和 Claude Code；版本过滤检索进一步改善了目标 Lean 版本上的压缩效果，改写后的 miniF2F 证明对未来的 Lean 版本表现出比未改写版本更强的零样本版本迁移能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过带版本过滤的检索和多目标策略数据库，可以在不重新训练的前提下实现可控、版本鲁棒的 Lean 证明改写，并提升对未来版本的可迁移性。

papers.title: Improving Reproducibility in Evaluation through Multi-Level Annotator Modeling
papers.abstract_en: As generative AI models such as large language models (LLMs) become more pervasive, ensuring the safety, robustness, and overall trustworthiness of these systems is paramount. However, AI is currently facing a reproducibility crisis driven by unreliable evaluations and unrepeatable experimental results. While human raters are often used to assess models for utility and safety, they introduce divergent biases and subjective opinions into their annotations. Overcoming this variance is exceptionally challenging because very little data exists to study how experimental repeatability actually improves as the annotator pool grows. Standard evaluation practices typically rely on a small number of annotations per item (often 3 to 5) and lack the persistent rater identifiers necessary to model individual variance across items. In this work, we introduce a multi-level bootstrapping approach to model annotator behavior realistically. Leveraging datasets with a large number of ratings and persistent rater identifiers, we analyze the tradeoffs between the number of items ($N$) and the number of responses per item ($K$) required to achieve statistical significance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式 AI 评估中的可复现性危机，提出一种多层次自助法 (multi-level bootstrapping) 来真实建模标注者行为。作者利用具有大量评分和持久标注者标识符 (persistent rater identifiers) 的数据集，分析达成统计显著性所需的项目数 (N) 与每项响应数 (K) 之间的权衡。摘要未给出具体实验数值，重点在于方法论框架。
Motivation: AI 面临由不可靠评估和不可重复实验结果导致的可复现性危机；人类标注者会引入分歧性偏见和主观意见，而现有研究缺乏关于标注者池扩大如何改善实验可重复性的数据。标准评估通常每项仅有 3 到 5 个标注，且缺少可跨项目建模个体差异的持久标注者标识符。
Method: 引入多层次自助法来现实地模拟标注者行为，利用包含大量评分和持久标注者 ID 的数据集，分析在达到统计显著性时项目数 (N) 与每项响应数 (K) 之间的权衡。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，主要贡献在于提出了分析 N 与 K 权衡以确定统计显著性所需样本量的方法框架。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要采用更真实的标注者行为模型，并说明合适的项目数与每项响应数组合对于实现统计显著且可复现的评估至关重要。

papers.title: Conformal Anomaly Detection in Python: Moving Beyond Heuristic Thresholds with nonconform
papers.abstract_en: Most anomaly detection systems output scores rather than calibrated decisions, leaving practitioners to choose thresholds heuristically and without clear statistical interpretation. Conformal anomaly detection addresses this limitation by converting anomaly scores into calibrated p-values that are valid under the statistical assumption of data exchangeability, with a growing literature extending this idea beyond that setting. We present nonconform, a Python package for applying conformal anomaly detection within existing machine-learning workflows, and use it as the basis for an implementation-grounded introduction to the field. The package integrates with scikit-learn, PyOD, and custom anomaly detectors, and provides a unified interface for calibration, p-value generation, and false discovery rate control. It supports several conformalization strategies, ranging from simple split-conformal calibration to more data-efficient and shift-aware extensions. Through a progression from foundational concepts to advanced conformalization strategies, complemented by code examples, the paper connects the statistical ideas behind conformal anomaly detection to their practical use in nonconform. Empirical results demonstrate that the implemented methods enable statistically principled anomaly detection. Together, the package and exposition aim to make core conformal anomaly detection workflows more accessible and reproducible in experimental and production-oriented settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 nonconform，一个用于将共形异常检测 (conformal anomaly detection) 集成到现有机器学习工作流中的 Python 包。该包支持与 scikit-learn、PyOD 及自定义异常检测器集成，提供校准、p 值生成和错误发现率控制的统一接口，并实现从简单分裂共形校准到更数据高效且面向分布偏移的多种共形化策略。文章结合代码示例，从基础概念到高级策略系统阐述共形异常检测的统计思想，并通过实证结果说明这些方法能实现具有统计依据的异常检测。
Motivation: 大多数异常检测系统输出分数而非校准后的决策，实践者通常需要启发式地选择阈值，且缺乏清晰的统计解释；共形异常检测通过将异常分数转换为校准 p 值来解决该问题，但缺少易于使用的工具支持。
Method: 提出 nonconform Python 包，提供统一的校准、p 值生成和 FDR 控制接口，支持多种共形化策略，包括简单分裂共形校准及更数据高效、对分布偏移更稳健的扩展，并可与 scikit-learn、PyOD 和自定义检测器集成。
Result: 摘要仅报告实证结果表明所实现的方法能够实现具有统计原则性的异常检测，未给出具体数值或基准对比。
Conclusion: 作者认为该包与配套讲解能够使核心共形异常检测工作流在实验和生产环境中更易用、更可复现。

papers.title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
papers.abstract_en: Can AI systems discover new knowledge through iterative self-improvement, and at what cost? We introduce NOVA, which models the ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. We give sufficient conditions for accumulated genuine knowledge to cover a finite domain and show how violations produce contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, and acceptance failure. We then analyze how adaptive generation arises from recursive retraining. In an explicit distribution-level model where accepted artifacts influence the next generator, we identify a recursive-feedback phase transition. Unanchored feedback can lock generation onto early accepted artifacts and leave initially reachable valid artifacts undiscovered with positive probability. Anchoring updates to a persistent base distribution prevents unbounded distortion and guarantees continued exposure. Under imperfect verification, we identify a contamination trap: as easy knowledge is exhausted, even small false-positive rates can admit invalid artifacts faster than genuine discoveries. We show that Good--Turing estimation is a local batch-diversity diagnostic, not an estimator of the historically undiscovered valid mass governing long-term progress. Under a Zipf tail with exponent $α>1$, the cumulative generation cost of obtaining $D$ distinct genuine discoveries satisfies $R_{\rm cum}(D)=Θ(c_{\rm gen}D^α)$. When the valid base distribution has such a tail, anchored retraining preserves the exposure needed for this scaling law. Finally, we show how human guidance, generation, and verification can redirect or expand discovery when autonomous sampling stalls because of repetition, vanishing exposure, or unreliable verification.
papers.comment: Added an explicit recursive retraining model showing how accepted outputs reshape future generation. New results characterize when repeated retraining suppresses undiscovered artifacts and when mixing updates with a fixed base distribution preserves exposure. Corrected the Zipf discovery-cost proof and expanded the analysis. Main results and implications remain unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NOVA，将“生成、验证、累积、重训练”（generate, verify, accumulate, retrain）循环建模为知识空间上的自适应采样过程，研究 AI 是否能以迭代自我改进方式发现新知识及其代价。摘要给出有限知识域被真实知识覆盖的充分条件，并分析违反条件时出现的污染、遗忘、探索失败与接受失败；进一步在递归重训练模型中发现递归反馈相变、污染陷阱，并推导 Zipf 尾分布下的累积发现代价标度律，最后讨论人类引导如何改变或扩展自主采样停滞时的发现过程。
Motivation: 问题是 AI 系统能否通过迭代自我改进发现新知识，以及这种发现的代价是什么。由于自主重训练可能放大验证错误并将生成锁定在早期已接受样本上，理解其基本极限对可靠的知识发现至关重要。
Method: NOVA 将生成-验证-累积-重训练循环视为知识空间上的自适应采样过程；在一个显式的分布级模型中，已接受产物影响下一个生成器，从而刻画递归反馈。还引入锚定到固定基础分布的更新机制、Good-Turing 估计作为局部批次多样性诊断，并在 Zipf 尾假设下分析累积生成代价。
Result: 摘要给出有限域覆盖的充分条件，并证明未锚定反馈可使生成锁定于早期已接受产物，使本可到达的有效产物以正概率永不被发现；锚定更新则保证持续暴露。在验证不完美时存在污染陷阱：简单知识耗尽后，即使较小假阳性率也会使无效产物进入速率超过真实发现。若有效基础分布为参数 α>1 的 Zipf 尾，则获得 D 个不同真实发现的累积生成代价满足 R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α)，且锚定重训练保留该标度律所需的暴露。
Conclusion: 摘要强调：未锚定的递归自我重训练可能产生有界性丧失与发现失败，而锚定到持久基础分布可避免无限扭曲并维持暴露；不完美验证会形成污染陷阱，Good-Turing 估计只能作为局部多样性诊断而非长期未知有效质量的无偏估计。当自主采样因重复、暴露消失或验证不可靠而停滞时，人类在生成、验证与引导上的介入可以重新定向或扩展发现过程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A PAC-Bayes Approach for Controlling Unknown Linear Discrete-time Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a PAC-Bayes framework for learning controllers for unknown stochastic linear discrete-time systems, where the system parameters are drawn from a fixed but unknown distribution. We derive a data-dependent high probability bound on the performance of any learned (stochastic) controller, and propose novel efficient learning algorithms with theoretical guarantees, which can be implemented for both finite and infinite controller spaces. Compared to prior work, our bound holds for unbounded quadratic cost. In the special case where LQG is optimal, our numerical results suggest that the learned controllers achieve comparable performance to LQG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对参数服从固定未知分布的随机线性离散时间系统，提出一个 PAC-Bayes 控制器学习框架。作者推导出任意学习到的（随机）控制器性能的数据相关高概率界，并提出具有理论保证的高效学习算法，适用于有限和无限控制器空间。摘要强调，与已有工作相比，该界适用于无界二次代价（unbounded quadratic cost）；在 LQG 为最优的特殊情形下，数值结果表明学习控制器能达到与 LQG 相当的性能。
Motivation: 未知随机线性系统中，控制器学习需要可验证的高概率性能保证，而现有 PAC-Bayes 类界往往局限于有界代价，难以覆盖实际中常见的无界二次代价情形。
Method: 采用 PAC-Bayes 框架，推导数据相关的高概率性能界，并基于该界提出可在有限与无限控制器空间实现的高效学习算法，从而为学习到的随机控制器提供理论保证。
Result: 与先前工作相比，所得界适用于无界二次代价；在 LQG 为最优的特殊情形下，数值结果显示学习控制器的性能与 LQG 相当。
Conclusion: 该 PAC-Bayes 方法为未知随机线性系统的控制器学习提供了可证明的性能保证，并在 LQG 最优场景下达到接近最优控制器的实用性能。

papers.title: Injection-Execution Dissociation: A Mechanistic Evaluation of Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in Stateful LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: We discover that prompt-injection success and tool-execution success are separable safety properties: defenses that block injection do not necessarily block execution, and vice versa. We call this the injection-execution dissociation. In LLM agents with persistent memory, malicious instructions are stored at rates exceeding 97.5%, yet downstream execution ranges from 0% to 95% with no correlation to storage rate. This reframes the threat model: preventing storage alone is insufficient, and blocking execution requires structurally enforcing authority boundaries between memory ingestion and action execution. We substantiate this through a 5,040-run factorial experiment across nine open-source models (N=40 per condition), evaluating six defenses at four architectural layers against delayed-trigger attacks that persist across session boundaries via RAG retrieval. Defense effectiveness is governed by where a defense sits relative to the attack's authority boundary, not by classifier quality. Only Memory Sandbox -- a tool-layer defense that structurally isolates recalled memory from executable context -- reduces attack success to 0% for eight of nine models. A reasoning-mode ablation reveals a double dissociation: no single schema-layer intervention is safe across both reasoning and non-reasoning model classes. A loaded-corpus frontier evaluation (21 models, 3 providers; N=40 base, headline models topped up to N=172) reveals vendor-correlated patterns: Anthropic blocks predominantly at injection, OpenAI blocks at execution with variable generational hardening, and a pre-release Gemini endpoint exfiltrates in the majority of runs. Stored-but-dormant payloads constitute a compositional supply-chain risk in shared-memory deployments.
papers.comment: v4: Added double dissociation (reasoning-mode ablation), content-layer defense (RATG), loaded-corpus frontier evaluation (21 models, 3 providers, N=40), 7B judge capability bound, reproducibility validity criterion, ethics/disclosure statement. TL;DR: 本文提出“注入-执行分离”(injection-execution dissociation) 这一安全性质：在带持久记忆的 LLM 智能体中，提示注入的成功率与工具执行的成功率是相互独立的，阻断存储并不等于阻断执行。作者通过 5,040 次全因子实验（9 个开源模型，每条件 N=40）验证这一现象，并指出防御有效性取决于防御相对于攻击权限边界的位置，而非分类器质量。实验显示恶意指令的存储率超过 97.5%，但下游执行率在 0% 到 95% 之间且与存储率无相关性；只有工具层防御 Memory Sandbox 能将九分之八模型的攻击成功率降到 0%。
Motivation: 现有威胁模型认为只要阻止恶意指令进入持久记忆就能防止攻击，但实验表明存储与执行是解耦的，仅阻断注入或仅阻断存储都不足以防护经由 RAG 跨会话触发的延迟攻击，因此需要重新定义威胁模型并结构性强制记忆摄入与动作执行之间的权限边界。
Method: 在九个开源模型上对六种防御措施、四个架构层进行全因子实验，评估跨会话边界持续存在的延迟触发攻击；提出工具层防御 Memory Sandbox，将检索到的记忆与可执行上下文结构隔离；并补充推理模式消融、7B 评判器能力边界，以及 21 个模型、3 家提供商的 loaded-corpus 前沿评估。

papers.title: NPMixer: Hierarchical Neighboring Patch Mixing for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series forecasting remains a challenge due to the complexity of local temporal dynamics and global dependencies across multiple variables. In this paper, we propose \textbf{N}eighboring \textbf{P}atching \textbf{Mixer} (\textbf{NPMixer}), a hierarchical architecture featuring a Learnable Stationary Wavelet Transform that adaptively learns filter coefficients to decompose signals into trend and detail components in a data-dependent manner. Our framework introduces a Neighboring Mixer Block that captures local temporal dynamics through a series of hierarchical MLP layers operating on non-overlapping patches. Specifically, the mixer block utilizes MLPs to learn temporal patterns within and across these patches, expanding the receptive field to capture multi-scale dependencies. A Channel-Mixing Encoder is applied to high-frequency components to learn channel correlations while preserving the stability of the underlying global trend. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that NPMixer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, achieving better performance in 20 out of 28 ($71.4\%$) evaluated experimental setups for MSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NPMixer（Neighboring Patching Mixer），一种用于多变量时间序列预测的分层架构。它使用可学习的平稳小波变换（Learnable Stationary Wavelet Transform）将信号分解为趋势与细节分量，并通过邻域混合块（Neighboring Mixer Block）在非重叠 patch 上分层捕捉局部时序动态，同时用通道混合编码器（Channel-Mixing Encoder）处理高频成分以学习通道相关性。在七个基准数据集上，NPMixer 在 28 个实验设置中有 20 个（71.4%）在 MSE 上优于现有最优模型。
Motivation: 多变量时间序列预测的难点在于同时建模局部时序动态与跨变量的全局依赖，现有方法难以自适应地兼顾这两方面。
Method: 提出分层架构 NPMixer：可学习平稳小波变换以数据依赖方式自适应学习滤波器系数，将信号分解为趋势和细节；邻域混合块通过一系列作用于非重叠 patch 上的分层 MLP 层捕捉局部时序动态并扩大感受野；通道混合编码器作用于高频分量以学习通道相关性，同时保持全局趋势的稳定性。
Result: 在七个基准数据集上的大量实验显示，NPMixer 在 28 个评估实验设置中有 20 个（71.4%）在 MSE 指标上优于现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将小波分解与分层邻域 patch 混合相结合，能够有效建模多尺度依赖并改进多变量时间序列预测精度。

papers.title: CHASE: Competing Hypotheses for Ambiguity-Aware Selective Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Standard selective prediction methods typically estimate uncertainty from the output of a single predictive branch. While effective for general uncertainty estimation, these approaches often struggle under partial observability, where local temporal evidence can be contradictory and standard confidence scores become misleading. We introduce CHASE (Competing Hypotheses for Ambiguity-Aware Selective Prediction), a selective prediction framework that explicitly compares structured temporal explanations to determine whether to commit to a decision or abstain. Because genuine ambiguity causes the score gap between competing hypotheses to collapse, CHASE optimizes a ranking-aware selector over these hypothesis margins to globally separate safe commitments from fundamentally uncertain ones. We evaluate this framework on the problem of hidden connectivity inference, utilizing a controlled, physically grounded simulator inspired by the dynamics of giant unilamellar vesicles (GUVs), alongside zero-shot qualitative transfer (without retraining or fine tuning) to representative real GUV videos. Our experiments demonstrate that explicitly reasoning over competing hypotheses provides a superior balance of metrics. Compared to canonical uncertainty baselines, CHASE achieves statistically significant gains in overall no-abstain accuracy, three-way accuracy, and overall ambiguity-aligned abstention (at 80% coverage). Specifically, it yields up to an 11.0% relative mean improvement in overall alignment, alongside up to an 8.8% relative boost in three-way accuracy in the very-high ambiguity regime. By maintaining a selective risk boundary strictly at par with the best baselines at 80% coverage, and reducing overall risk by 9.9% at 90% coverage, this framework offers a more reliable approach to decision-making under structured ambiguity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHASE（Competing Hypotheses for Ambiguity-Aware Selective Prediction），一种选择性预测 (selective prediction) 框架，通过显式比较结构化的时间解释（竞争假设）来决定提交决策还是弃权。在隐藏连通性推断任务上，基于受巨型单层囊泡 (GUV) 动力学启发的可控物理仿真器，并对真实 GUV 视频进行无需重训的零样本定性迁移评估。实验显示，相比标准不确定性基线，CHASE 在整体无弃权准确率、三路准确率和歧义对齐弃权率上获得统计显著提升，表明显式推理竞争假设能更好处理部分可观测条件下的结构歧义。
Motivation: 标准选择性预测方法通常从单一预测分支的输出估计不确定性，在部分可观测条件下局部时序证据可能互相矛盾，标准置信度分数会变得具有误导性；需要能显式比较结构化时间解释的方法，以区分安全承诺与本质上不确定的样本。
Method: CHASE 显式比较竞争假设（structured temporal explanations）并利用真实歧义会使假设之间的分数间隙（score margin）崩塌这一特性，在假设边缘上优化一个排序感知选择器 (ranking-aware selector)，从而全局分离安全承诺与根本不确定的决策。
Result: 在 80% 覆盖率下，相比典型不确定性基线，CHASE 在无弃权准确率、三路准确率和整体歧义对齐弃权率上均有统计显著提升；整体对齐度相对平均提升最高达 11.0%，极高歧义区间的三路准确率相对提升最高达 8.8%。同时，在 80% 覆盖率下选择性风险边界与最优基线持平，在 90% 覆盖率下整体风险降低 9.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在结构化歧义下显式比较竞争假设能提供更可靠的决策依据，并在受控仿真与真实 GUV 视频上展示了可行性与零样本迁移能力；其评估场景限于隐藏连通性推断，未声称推广到其他任务。

papers.title: TransVLM: A Vision-Language Framework and Benchmark for Detecting Any Shot Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Traditional Shot Boundary Detection (SBD) inherently struggles with complex transitions by formulating the task around isolated cut points, frequently yielding corrupted video shots. We address this fundamental limitation by formalizing the Shot Transition Detection (STD) task. Rather than searching for ambiguous points, STD explicitly detects the continuous temporal segments of transitions. To tackle this, we propose TransVLM, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework for STD. Unlike regular VLMs that predominantly rely on spatial semantics and struggle with fine-grained inter-shot dynamics, our method explicitly injects optical flow as a critical motion prior at the input stage. Through a simple yet effective feature-fusion strategy, TransVLM directly processes concatenated color and motion representations, significantly enhancing its temporal awareness without incurring any additional visual token overhead on the language backbone. To overcome the severe class imbalance in public data, we design a scalable data engine to synthesize diverse transition videos for robust training, alongside a comprehensive benchmark for STD. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TransVLM achieves superior overall performance, outperforming traditional heuristic methods, specialized spatiotemporal networks, and top-tier VLMs. For more related research, please visit HeyGen Research (https://www.heygen.com/research) and HeyGen Avatar-V (https://www.heygen.com/research/avatar-v-model). Project page: https://chence17.github.io/TransVLM/

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TransVLM，一个用于镜头转场检测 (Shot Transition Detection, STD) 的视觉-语言模型框架与配套基准。传统镜头边界检测 (SBD) 围绕孤立切点设计任务，难以应对复杂转场并常产生损坏的镜头；STD 改为显式检测转场的连续时间片段。TransVLM 在输入阶段注入光流作为运动先验，通过拼接颜色与运动表示的融合策略增强时间感知，且不增加语言骨干的额外视觉 token 开销。实验表明 TransVLM 的整体性能优于传统启发式方法、专用时空网络和顶级 VLM。
Motivation: 传统 SBD 将任务形式化为寻找孤立切点，本质上难以处理复杂转场，经常导致视频镜头被破坏；作者因此将该问题重新定义为 STD，即显式检测转场所在的连续时间片段。
Method: 提出基于 VLM 的 STD 框架 TransVLM，在输入阶段显式注入光流作为关键运动先验，并对拼接的颜色与运动表示进行简单有效的特征融合，从而提升时间感知且不增加语言骨干的视觉 token 开销；同时设计可扩展的数据引擎合成多样化转场视频，构建 STD 基准以缓解公开数据中的严重类别不平衡。
Result: 大量实验显示 TransVLM 取得更优的整体检测性能，在对比中超过传统启发式方法、专用时空网络以及顶级 VLM。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 SBD 重构为 STD、显式建模转场连续片段并注入运动先验能有效提升转场检测性能，同时提供了配套基准与数据合成引擎；论文被 ECCV 2026 接收，v2 修正了摘要中关于生产部署的不准确陈述。

papers.title: Evaluating Risks in Weak-to-Strong Alignment: A Bias-Variance Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Weak-to-strong alignment offers a promising route to scalable supervision, but it can fail when a strong model becomes confidently wrong on examples that lie in the weak model's blind spots. Understanding such failures requires going beyond aggregate accuracy, since weak-to-strong errors depend not only on whether the strong model disagrees with the weak model, but also on how confidence and uncertainty are distributed across examples. In this work, we analyze weak-to-strong alignment through a bias--variance--covariance lens that connects misfit theory to practical post-training pipelines. We derive a misfit-based upper bound on weak-to-strong population risk and study its empirical components using continuous confidence scores. We evaluate four weak-to-strong pipelines spanning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) on the PKU-SafeRLHF and HH-RLHF datasets. Using a blind-spot deception metric that isolates cases where the strong model is confidently wrong while the weak model is uncertain, we find that strong-model variance is the quantity most strongly associated with blind-spot deception among the BVC quantities we study. Covariance provides additional but weaker information, indicating that weak--strong dependence matters, but does not by itself explain the observed failures. These results suggest that strong-model variance can serve as an early-warning signal for weak-to-strong deception, while blind-spot evaluation helps distinguish whether failures are inherited from weak supervision or arise in regions of weak-model uncertainty.

Motivation: 弱到强对齐在强模型于弱模型盲区上自信犯错时会失败，而这类失败无法用总体准确率刻画，因为误差还取决于置信度与不确定性在样本间的分布。
Method: 利用连续置信度分数推导基于 misfit 的弱到强总体风险上界，提出盲区欺骗度量以单独刻画强模型自信犯错而弱模型不确定的情形，并比较四条弱到强流水线（SFT、RLHF、RLAIF）在两个数据集上的表现。
Result: 在研究的 BVC 量中，强模型方差是与盲区欺骗关联最强的量；协方差提供额外但较弱的信息，说明弱-强依赖存在影响却不能单独解释观测到的失败。
Conclusion: 强模型方差可作为弱到强欺骗的早期预警信号，而盲区评估有助于区分失败是继承自弱监督还是出现在弱模型不确定性区域。

papers.title: An empirical evaluation of the risks of AI model updates using clinical data: stability, arbitrariness, and fairness
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) models used in clinical settings are increasingly deployed to support clinical decision-making. However, when training data become stale due to changes in demographics, environment, or patient behaviors, model performance can degrade substantially. While updating models with new training data is necessary, such updates may also introduce new risks. We evaluated the proposed monitoring framework on four publicly available U.S.-based Type 1 Diabetes datasets containing high-resolution continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data, comprising approximately 11,300 weekly observations from 496 participants younger than 20 years. All datasets included structured sociodemographic information. Using the prediction of severe hyperglycemia events in children with Type 1 Diabetes as a case study, we examine how different model update strategies can adversely affect model stability by causing predictions to change for a large number of cases after retraining, increase prediction arbitrariness, and worsen subgroup fairness and the balance of error rates across populations. We propose multiple dimensions for continuous monitoring to detect these issues and argue that such monitoring is essential for the development of trustworthy clinical decision support systems.
papers.comment: Best Paper Award in iEEE EMBC 2026. 4 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估临床 AI/ML 模型更新风险的监测框架，以儿童 1 型糖尿病严重高血糖事件预测为案例，基于四个美国公开的 CGM 数据集（约 11,300 周观测、496 名 20 岁以下参与者）。摘要表明，模型更新策略可能使大量病例的预测在重训后发生变化，增加预测任意性，并恶化子组公平性与跨人群错误率平衡，因此需要持续监测。
Motivation: 临床 AI 模型会因训练数据过时而性能退化，更新数据虽必要，但可能引入稳定性下降、预测任意性增加和公平性恶化等新风险，目前缺乏系统性的监测手段。
Method: 提出多维度持续监测框架，通过比较不同的模型更新策略，考察预测稳定性（预测是否大量改变）、预测任意性以及子组公平性和错误率平衡，并以严重高血糖事件预测作为案例研究。
Result: 在四个公开的 Type 1 Diabetes CGM 数据集上（约 11,300 周观测，496 名参与者），评估显示模型更新会导致大量病例预测改变、任意性上升，并恶化子组公平性与错误率平衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为此类持续监测对构建可信赖的临床决策支持系统至关重要，但摘要未讨论该方法在其他临床场景或数据分布下的推广性。

papers.title: Talker-T2AV: Joint Talking Audio-Video Generation with Autoregressive Diffusion Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Joint audio-video generation models have shown that unified generation yields stronger cross-modal coherence than cascaded approaches. However, existing models couple modalities throughout denoising via pervasive attention, treating high-level semantics and low-level details in a fully entangled manner. This is suboptimal for talking head synthesis: while audio and facial motion are semantically correlated, their low-level realizations (acoustic signals and visual textures) follow distinct rendering processes. Enforcing joint modeling across all levels causes unnecessary entanglement and reduces efficiency. We propose Talker-T2AV, an autoregressive diffusion framework where high-level cross-modal modeling occurs in a shared backbone, while low-level refinement uses modality-specific decoders. A shared autoregressive language model jointly reasons over audio and video in a unified patch-level token space. Two lightweight diffusion transformer heads decode the hidden states into frame-level audio and video latents. Experiments on talking portrait benchmarks show Talker-T2AV outperforms dual-branch baselines in lip-sync accuracy, video quality, and audio quality, achieving stronger cross-modal consistency than cascaded pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Talker-T2AV，一个用于联合说话音频-视频生成的自回归扩散框架。该框架在共享骨干中进行高层跨模态建模，而低层细节由模态特定的扩散 Transformer 解码器分别细化，以避免音频与视频在低层实现上的不必要纠缠。在说话人肖像基准上，该方法在唇形同步、视频质量和音频质量上优于双分支基线与级联流水线。
Motivation: 现有联合生成模型通过全局注意力在整个去噪过程中耦合模态，将高层语义与低层细节完全纠缠。对于说话头合成，音频和面部运动在语义上相关，但声学信号与视觉纹理遵循不同的渲染过程，因此这种全层级纠缠是次优的，并带来效率损失。
Method: 提出自回归扩散架构：一个共享的自回归语言模型在统一的 patch 级 token 空间上联合推理音频和视频；两个轻量级扩散 Transformer 头将隐状态解码为帧级音频和视频潜变量。高层跨模态建模集中在共享骨干中，低层细化由模态特定解码器完成。
Result: 在说话人肖像基准上的实验表明，Talker-T2AV 在唇形同步准确率、视频质量和音频质量上均优于双分支基线，并比级联流水线实现更强的跨模态一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将高层语义共享与低层模态特定解码分离，可以避免不必要的模态纠缠并提高效率，同时获得优于级联方法的跨模态一致性。

papers.title: Evaluating LLM-Based Goal Extraction in Requirements Engineering: Prompting Strategies and Their Limitations
papers.abstract_en: Due to the textual and repetitive nature of many Requirements Engineering (RE) artefacts, Large Language Models (LLMs) have proven useful to automate their generation and processing. In this paper, we discuss a possible approach for automating the Goal-Oriented Requirements Engineering (GORE) process by extracting functional goals from software documentation through three phases: actor identification, high and low-level goal extraction. To implement these functionalities, we propose a chain of LLMs fed with engineered prompts. We experimented with different variants of in-context learning and measured the similarities between input data and in-context examples to better investigate their impact. Another key element is the generation-critic mechanism, implemented as a feedback loop involving two LLMs. Although the pipeline achieved 61% accuracy in low-level goal identification, the final stage, these results indicate the approach is best suited as a tool to accelerate manual extraction rather than as a full replacement. The feedback-loop mechanism with Zero-shot outperformed stand-alone Few-shot, with an ablation study suggesting that performance slightly degrades without the feedback cycle. However, we reported that the combination of the feedback mechanism with Few-shot does not deliver any advantage, possibly suggesting that the primary performance ceiling is the prompting strategy applied to the 'critic' LLM. Together with the refinement of both the quantity and quality of the Shot examples, future research will integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to improve accuracy.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. This contribution will be published in the conference proceedings of EASE 2026 Conference (https://conf.researchr.org/home/ease-2026/prompt-se-2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自动化目标导向需求工程（GORE）过程的链式LLM方法，从软件文档中分三阶段提取功能目标：参与者识别、高层与低层目标提取。实验表明低层目标识别准确率为61%，作者认为该管道更适合作为加速人工提取的工具而非完全替代。生成-批评反馈循环结合零样本优于单独少样本，但反馈循环与少样本组合没有额外收益。
Motivation: 需求工程工件具有文本性和重复性，LLM已被证明可用于自动化其生成和处理。本文目标是通过从软件文档中提取功能目标来自动化GORE过程，并评估不同提示策略的效果与局限性。
Method: 构建一个由多个LLM串联组成的管道，使用工程化提示（engineered prompts）实现三阶段提取：参与者识别、高层目标提取和低层目标提取。实验比较了不同的上下文学习（in-context learning）变体，并测量输入数据与上下文示例的相似性以考察其影响；同时引入生成-批评机制，即由两个LLM组成的反馈循环。
Result: 低层目标识别准确率达到61%。零样本（Zero-shot）下的反馈循环机制优于独立的少样本（Few-shot）设置；消融研究表明移除反馈循环会导致性能略降。然而，反馈循环与少样本组合未带来优势，提示主要性能上限可能来自应用于“批评者”LLM的提示策略。
Conclusion: 该管道目前最适合作为加速人工目标提取的辅助工具，而非完全自动化替代。未来工作将引入检索增强生成（RAG）和思维链（CoT）提示，并优化少样本示例的数量与质量以提升准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Estimating Tail Risks in Language Model Output Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly capable and are being rapidly deployed on a population-level scale. As a result, the safety of these models is increasingly high-stakes. Fortunately, advances in alignment have significantly reduced the likelihood of harmful model outputs. However, when models are queried billions of times in a day, even rare worst-case behaviors will occur. Current safety evaluations focus on capturing the distribution of inputs that yield harmful outputs. These evaluations disregard the probabilistic nature of models and their tail output behavior. To measure this tail risk, we propose a method to efficiently estimate the probability of harmful outputs for any input query. Instead of naive brute-force sampling from the target model, where harmful outputs could be rare, we operationalize importance sampling by creating unsafe versions of the target model. These unsafe versions enable sample-efficient estimation by making harmful outputs more probable. On benchmarks measuring misuse and misalignment, these estimates match brute-force Monte Carlo estimates using 10-20x fewer samples. For example, we can estimate probability of harmful outputs on the order of 10^-4 with just 500 samples. Additionally, we find that these harmfulness estimates can reveal the sensitivity of models to perturbations in model input and predict deployment risks. Our work demonstrates that accurate rare-event estimation is both critical and feasible for safety evaluations. Code is available at https://github.com/rangell/LMTailRisk
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效估计语言模型对任意输入产生有害输出概率的方法，用于衡量模型输出的尾部风险 (tail risk)。作者通过构造目标模型的不安全版本 (unsafe versions) 来实现重要性采样 (importance sampling)，使罕见的有害输出更易被采样。在误用和误对齐基准上，该估计与暴力蒙特卡洛估计匹配，且仅需其 10-20 倍的样本量；例如用 500 个样本即可估计约 10^-4 量级的有害输出概率。
Motivation: 当前安全评估关注的是哪些输入分布会产生有害输出，却忽视了模型本身的概率性质及其输出分布的尾部行为。当模型面临数十亿次日查询时，即使对齐后的模型有害输出概率极低，罕见的最坏情况仍会发生，因此需要直接估计输入查询对应的有害输出概率。
Method: 提出一种基于重要性采样的罕见事件估计方法：不直接对目标模型进行暴力采样，而是创建目标模型的不安全版本，使有害输出概率升高，从而以样本高效的方式估计任意输入的有害输出概率。
Result: 在误用和误对齐基准上，估计结果与暴力蒙特卡洛估计一致，但样本量减少 10-20 倍；500 个样本即可估计约 10^-4 量级的有害输出概率。此外，这些有害性估计能揭示模型对输入扰动的敏感性，并可预测部署风险。
Conclusion: 作者认为，对安全评估而言，准确的罕见事件 (rare-event) 估计既关键又可行；代码已公开在 GitHub 上。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出一种基于重要性采样的罕见事件估计方法：不直接对目标模型进行暴力采样，而是创建目标模型的不安全版本，使有害输出概率升高，从而以样本高效的方式估计任意输入的有害输出概率。
summary_sections.result: 在误用和误对齐基准上，估计结果与暴力蒙特卡洛估计一致，但样本量减少 10-20 倍；500 个样本即可估计约 10^-4 量级的有害输出概率。此外，这些有害性估计能揭示模型对输入扰动的敏感性，并可预测部署风险。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，对安全评估而言，准确的罕见事件 (rare-event) 估计既关键又可行；代码已公开在 GitHub 上。

papers.title: An Efficient Black-Box Reduction from Online Learning to Multicalibration, and a New Route to $Φ$-Regret Minimization
papers.abstract_en: We give a Gordon-Greenwald-Marks (GGM) style black-box reduction from online learning to online multicalibration. Concretely, we show that to achieve high-dimensional multicalibration with respect to a class of functions $\mathcal{H}$, it suffices to combine any no-regret learner over $\mathcal {H} $ with an expected variational inequality (EVI) solver. We also prove a converse statement showing that efficient multicalibration implies efficient EVI solving, highlighting how EVIs in multicalibration mirror the role of fixed points in the GGM result for $Φ$-regret. This first set of results addresses the high-dimensional analogue of the open question in Garg, Jung, Reingold, and Roth (SODA '24), showing that oracle-efficient online multicalibration with $\sqrt{T}$-type guarantees is possible in full generality. Furthermore, our GGM-style reduction unifies the analyses of existing algorithms, transfers guarantees from online learning to multicalibration for challenging environments with delayed observations or censored outcomes, and yields the first efficient black-box reduction between online learning and multiclass omniprediction. Our second main result is a fine-grained reduction from high-dimensional online multicalibration to (contextual) $Φ$-regret minimization. Together with our first result, this establishes a new route from external regret to $Φ$-regret that bypasses sophisticated fixed-point or semi-separation machinery, dramatically simplifies a result of Daskalakis, Farina, Fishelson, Pipis, and Schneider (STOC '25) while improving rates, and yields new algorithms that are robust to richer deviation classes, such as those belonging to any reproducing kernel Hilbert space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出一个 GGM (Gordon-Greenwald-Marks) 风格的从在线学习到在线多校准 (online multicalibration) 的黑盒归约：对任意函数类 H，把任何无遗憾学习器 (no-regret learner) 与一个期望变分不等式 (EVI) 求解器组合即可实现高维多校准，并证明反向蕴含。作者进一步建立高维多校准到 (contextual) Φ-regret 最小化的细粒度归约，从而得到从外部遗憾到 Φ-regret 的新路线，简化并改进 STOC '25 的相关结果，同时推广到延迟观测、删失结果等环境。
Motivation: 针对 Garg, Jung, Reingold 和 Roth (SODA '24) 提出的高维版本开放问题，本文要回答 oracle-efficient 在线多校准则是否能在全一般性下实现；同时，已有从外部遗憾到 Φ-regret 的归约依赖复杂的 fixed-point 或 semi-separation 机制，本文希望用 EVI 作为统一工具建立更直接高效的归约。
Method: 提出 GGM 式黑盒归约：以任意无遗憾学习器为组件，配合 EVI 求解器实现高维多校准，并证明高效多校准与高效 EVI 求解互相蕴含。第二个主要结果是给出高维多校准到 (contextual) Φ-regret 最小化的细粒度归约，从而把外部遗憾、多校准和 Φ-regret 串成一条新路线。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在全一般性下实现具有 sqrt(T) 型保证的 oracle-efficient 在线多校准；统一了现有算法的分析，并把在线学习保证迁移到延迟观测或删失结果环境；得到在线学习与多类 omniprediction 之间首个高效黑盒归约；新路线简化了 Daskalakis 等人 (STOC '25) 的结果并改善 rates，且对 RKHS 等更广的偏差类具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调 EVI 在多校准中的作用类似于固定点在 Φ-regret 中的作用，且新路线绕开了 fixed-point 或 semi-separation 机制；摘要未涉及实验验证，整体属于理论归约结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A neural operator framework for data-driven discovery of stability and receptivity in physical systems
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how complex systems respond to perturbations, such as whether they will remain stable or what their most sensitive patterns are, is a fundamental challenge across science and engineering. Traditional stability and receptivity (resolvent) analyses are powerful but rely on known equations and linearization, limiting their use in nonlinear or poorly modeled systems. Here, we introduce a data-driven framework that automatically identifies stability properties and optimal forcing responses from observation data alone, without requiring governing equations. By training a neural network as a dynamics emulator and using automatic differentiation to extract its Jacobian, we can compute eigenmodes and resolvent modes directly from data. We demonstrate the method on both canonical chaotic models and high-dimensional fluid flows, successfully identifying dominant instability modes and input-output structures even in strongly nonlinear regimes. By leveraging a neural network-based emulator, we readily obtain a nonlinear representation of system dynamics while additionally retrieving intricate dynamical patterns that were previously difficult to resolve. This equation-free methodology establishes a broadly applicable tool for analyzing complex, high-dimensional datasets, with immediate relevance to grand challenges in fields such as climate science, neuroscience, and fluid engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个数据驱动的框架，仅从观测数据自动识别物理系统的稳定性属性和最优强迫响应（receptivity/resolvent），无需已知控制方程。作者训练神经网络作为动力学模拟器（dynamics emulator），并用自动微分提取其 Jacobian，直接由数据计算特征模态和 resolvent 模态。方法在典型混沌模型和高维流体流动上验证，能在强非线性区域识别主导失稳模态和输入-输出结构。
Motivation: 传统稳定性和受纳性（resolvent）分析依赖已知方程和线性化，难以用于非线性或模型不完善的系统。本文旨在从观测数据出发、不依赖控制方程地识别系统对扰动的响应及其敏感结构。
Method: 训练神经网络作为动力学模拟器，利用自动微分提取 Jacobian，进而从数据中计算特征模态与 resolvent 模态；该方式同时提供系统动力学的非线性表示，并可以获取难以解析求解的精细动力学模式。
Result: 在典型混沌模型和高维流体流动上的实验表明，即使在强非线性区域，方法也能成功识别主导失稳模态与输入-输出结构，并提取此前难以分辨的动力学模式。
Conclusion: 作者将该无方程框架定位为可广泛用于复杂高维数据集分析的通用工具，并指出其在气候科学、神经科学和流体工程等领域具有直接相关性；摘要未讨论与降水临近预报或资料同化的具体结合。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Bridging the Micro--Macro Gap: Frequency-Aware Semantic Alignment for Image Manipulation Localization
papers.abstract_en: As generative image editing advances, image manipulation localization (IML) must handle both traditional manipulations with conspicuous forensic artifacts and diffusion-generated edits that appear locally realistic. Existing methods typically rely on either low-level forensic cues or high-level semantics alone, leading to a fundamental micro--macro gap. To bridge this gap, we propose FASA, a unified framework for localizing both traditional and diffusion-generated manipulations. Specifically, we extract manipulation-sensitive frequency cues through an adaptive dual-band DCT module and learn manipulation-aware semantic priors via patch-level contrastive alignment on frozen CLIP representations. We then inject these priors into a hierarchical frequency pathway through a semantic-frequency side adapter for multi-scale feature interaction, and employ a prototype-guided, frequency-gated mask decoder to integrate semantic consistency with boundary-aware localization for tampered region prediction. Extensive experiments on OpenSDI and multiple traditional manipulation benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art localization performance, strong cross-generator and cross-dataset generalization, and robust performance under common image degradations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FASA，一个用于同时定位传统篡改和扩散生成式图像编辑的统一框架，目标是弥合仅依赖低层取证线索或仅依赖高层语义之间的微观-宏观鸿沟（micro–macro gap）。方法通过自适应双频带 DCT 模块提取操控敏感的频率线索，在冻结 CLIP 表征上做 patch 级对比对齐以学习操控感知语义先验，再经语义-频率侧适配器注入分层频率通路，并用原型引导、频率门控的掩码解码器完成篡改区域预测。在 OpenSDI 和多个传统篡改基准上报告了最优定位性能。
Motivation: 生成式图像编辑的进步使得篡改检测不仅要处理带有明显取证痕迹的传统篡改，还要处理局部看起来真实的扩散生成编辑；现有方法通常只用低层取证线索或高层语义之一，导致两类信息之间存在根本的微观-宏观鸿沟。
Method: FASA 包含四个组成部分：自适应双频带 DCT 模块提取操控敏感的频率线索；基于冻结 CLIP 表征的 patch 级对比学习（contrastive alignment）获得操控感知的语义先验；语义-频率侧适配器（side adapter）将这些先验注入分层频率通路以进行多尺度特征交互；原型引导、频率门控的掩码解码器将语义一致性与边界感知定位结合，输出篡改区域预测。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 OpenSDI 及多个传统篡改基准上达到最先进定位性能，并展现出较强的跨生成器和跨数据集泛化能力，以及在常见图像退化下的鲁棒表现；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一低层频率线索与高层语义先验可以有效桥接微观-宏观鸿沟，使一个框架同时覆盖传统篡改与扩散生成篡改定位。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Filtered Reasoning Score: Evaluating Reasoning Quality on a Model's Most-Confident Traces
papers.abstract_en: Should we trust Large Language Models (LLMs) with high accuracy? LLMs achieve high accuracy on reasoning benchmarks, but correctness alone does not reveal the quality of the reasoning used to produce it. This highlights a fundamental limitation of outcome-based evaluation: models may arrive at correct answers through flawed reasoning, and models with substantially different reasoning capabilities can nevertheless exhibit similar benchmark accuracy, for example due to memorization or over-optimization. In this paper, we ask: given existing benchmarks, can we move beyond outcome-based evaluation to assess the quality of reasoning itself? We seek metrics that (1) differentiate models with similar accuracy and (2) are robust to variations in input prompts and generation configurations. To this end, we propose a reasoning score that evaluates reasoning traces along dimensions such as faithfulness, coherence, utility, and factuality. A remaining question is how to aggregate this score across multiple sampled traces. Naively averaging them is undesirable, particularly in long-horizon settings, where the number of possible trajectories grows rapidly, and low-confidence correct traces are more likely to be coincidental. To address this, we introduce the Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS), which computes reasoning quality using only the top-K% most confident traces. Evaluating with FRS, models that are indistinguishable under standard accuracy exhibit significant differences in reasoning quality. Moreover, models with higher FRS on one benchmark tend to perform better on other reasoning benchmarks, in both accuracy and reasoning quality. Together, these findings suggest that FRS complements accuracy by capturing a model's transferable reasoning capabilities. We open source our evaluation codebase: https://github.com/Manas2006/benchmark_reproducibility.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS)，用于在已有推理基准上超越基于结果正确性的评估，直接衡量推理痕迹的质量。FRS 从忠实度 (faithfulness)、连贯性 (coherence)、效用 (utility) 和事实性 (factuality) 等维度评估推理，并仅使用模型最有信心的 top-K% 采样痕迹进行聚合。实验表明，标准准确率无法区分的模型在 FRS 上存在显著差异，且 FRS 较高的模型在其他推理基准上的准确率与推理质量也更好。
Motivation: 基于结果的评估存在根本局限：模型可能通过有缺陷的推理得到正确答案，而记忆或过度优化会使推理能力差异很大的模型表现出相近的基准准确率。
Method: 提出一个多维推理评分来评估推理痕迹的质量，并引入 Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS)，即只对 top-K% 最自信的痕迹计算推理质量，避免对长程 (long-horizon) 任务中大量低置信正确轨迹做朴素平均。
Result: 在 FRS 下，标准准确率无法区分的模型展现出显著的推理质量差异；此外，在某个基准上 FRS 更高的模型在其他推理基准上的准确率和推理质量也往往更好。
Conclusion: FRS 是对准确率的补充，能捕捉模型可迁移的推理能力；评估代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: FRS 是对准确率的补充，能捕捉模型可迁移的推理能力；评估代码已开源。

papers.title: LoViF 2026 Challenge on Human-oriented Semantic Image Quality Assessment: Methods and Results
papers.abstract_en: This paper reviews the LoViF 2026 Challenge on Human-oriented Semantic Image Quality Assessment. This challenge aims to raise a new direction, i.e., how to evaluate the loss of semantic information from the human perspective, intending to promote the development of some new directions, like semantic coding, processing, and semantic-oriented optimization, etc. Unlike existing datasets of quality assessment, we form a dataset of human-oriented semantic quality assessment, termed the SeIQA dataset. This dataset is divided into three parts for this competition: (i) training data: 510 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground truth references; (ii) validation data: 80 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground-truth references; (iii) testing data: 160 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground-truth references. The primary objective of this challenge is to establish a new and powerful benchmark for human-oriented semantic image quality assessment. There are a total of 58 teams registered in this competition, and 6 teams submitted valid solutions and fact sheets for the final testing phase. These submissions achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the SeIQA dataset.

papers.title: DIB-OD: Preserving the Invariant Core for Robust Heterogeneous Graph Adaptation via Decoupled Information Bottleneck and Online Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Graph pre-training can facilitate knowledge transfer across graph datasets, but severe structural and feature shifts may cause negative transfer and adaptation-induced overwriting of reusable knowledge. We propose DIB-OD, a heterogeneous graph adaptation framework that combines a Decoupled Information Bottleneck with Online Distillation. A multiview teacher first learns a compressed, task-relevant representation, which is distilled into a transferable core branch and a complementary residual branch. Mutual-information objectives and HSIC-based dependence regularization discourage information overlap between the branches, while a confidence-aware semantic regularizer and a frozen teacher anchor reliable pretrained information during target-domain adaptation. Experiments on seven graph-classification datasets spanning chemical, biological, and social-network domains show consistent improvements over representative baselines, particularly under challenging cross-type transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DIB-OD，一个面向异构图自适应的框架，将解耦信息瓶颈 (Decoupled Information Bottleneck) 与在线蒸馏 (Online Distillation) 结合，以缓解跨图数据集迁移时因结构和特征偏移导致的负迁移及知识覆盖。方法通过多视角教师学习压缩的任务相关表示，并蒸馏为可迁移核心分支与互补残差分支，配合互信息目标和 HSIC 依赖正则化减少分支间信息重叠。在涵盖化学、生物和社交网络领域的七个图分类数据集上，DIB-OD 相对代表性基线取得一致改进，尤其在跨类型迁移场景下。
Motivation: 图预训练希望促进跨数据集知识迁移，但严重的结构性和特征性偏移可能带来负迁移，并使已学到的可复用知识在适应过程中被覆盖，现有方法对此缺乏针对性处理。
Method: DIB-OD 结合解耦信息瓶颈与在线蒸馏：多视角教师先学习压缩且任务相关的表示，再蒸馏成可迁移核心分支与互补残差分支；用互信息目标和基于 HSIC 的依赖正则化抑制分支间信息重叠，并用置信度感知语义正则化器与冻结教师锚定目标域适应过程中的可靠预训练信息。
Result: 在七个图分类数据集（覆盖化学、生物、社交网络领域）上的实验显示，DIB-OD 相比代表性基线获得一致的性能提升，在具有挑战性的跨类型迁移下改进尤为明显。
Conclusion: 作者强调保留不变量核心并分离可迁移与残差信息，有助于实现鲁棒的异构图自适应，避免预训练知识在适应中被覆盖。

papers.title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Single Image Reflection Removal in the Wild: Datasets, Results, and Methods
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we review the NTIRE 2026 challenge on single-image reflection removal (SIRR) in the wild. SIRR is a fundamental task in image restoration. Despite progress in academic research, most methods are tested on synthetic images or limited real-world images, creating a gap in real-world applications. In this challenge, we provide participants with the OpenRR-5k dataset. This dataset requires participants to process real-world images covering a range of reflection scenarios and intensities, aiming to generate clean images without reflections. The challenge attracted more than 100 registrations, with eleven of them participating in the final testing phase. The top-ranked methods advanced the state-of-the-art reflection removal performance and earned unanimous recognition from five experts in the field. The proposed OpenRR-5k dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/qiuzhangTiTi/OpenRR-5k, and the homepage of this challenge is at https://github.com/caijie0620/OpenRR-5k.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是NTIRE 2026单图像反射去除（SIRR）挑战赛的综述报告，介绍了挑战赛使用的OpenRR-5k数据集、参赛方案与最终结果。该数据集要求参赛者处理覆盖多种反射场景与强度的真实世界图像，输出无反射的干净图像。挑战赛吸引超过100人注册，其中11支队伍进入最终测试，排名靠前的方法将反射去除性能推进到新水平。
Motivation: 学术研究中的SIRR方法大多在合成图像或有限的真实图像上测试，导致真实场景下的性能差距明显，缺少大规模真实世界基准来验证与推动反射去除算法。
Method: 作者组织NTIRE 2026 SIRR挑战赛，向参赛者提供OpenRR-5k真实世界数据集，要求处理不同反射场景与强度的图像；论文作为挑战赛总结，回顾了数据集、最终结果与参赛方法。
Result: 挑战赛获得超过100个注册，11支队伍进入最终测试阶段；排名靠前的方法改进了现有的反射去除性能，并获得五位领域专家的一致认可。
Conclusion: 摘要强调OpenRR-5k数据集与此次挑战赛有助于弥合真实世界反射去除的研究差距，并公开提供了数据集与挑战赛主页链接。

papers.title: Tarot-SAM3: Training-free SAM3 for Any Referring Expression Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) aims to segment image regions described by natural-language expressions, serving as a bridge between vision and language understanding. Existing RES methods, however, rely heavily on large annotated datasets and are limited to either explicit or implicit expressions, hindering their ability to generalize to any referring expression. Recently, the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) has shown impressive robustness in Promptable Concept Segmentation. Nonetheless, applying it to RES remains challenging: (1) SAM3 struggles with longer or implicit expressions; (2) naive coupling of SAM3 with a multimodal large language model (MLLM) makes the final results overly dependent on the MLLM's reasoning capability, without enabling refinement of SAM3's segmentation outputs. To this end, we present Tarot-SAM3, a novel training-free framework that can accurately segment from any referring expression. Specifically, Tarot-SAM3 consists of two key phases. First, the Expression Reasoning Interpreter (ERI) phase introduces reasoning-assisted prompt options to support structured expression parsing and evaluation-aware rephrasing. This transforms arbitrary queries into robust heterogeneous prompts for generating reliable masks with SAM3. Second, the Mask Self-Refining (MSR) phase selects the best mask across prompt types and performs self-refinement by leveraging rich feature relationships from DINOv3 to compare discriminative regions among ERI outputs. It then infers region affiliation to the target, thereby correcting over- and under-segmentation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Tarot-SAM3 achieves strong performance on both explicit and implicit RES benchmarks, as well as open-world scenarios. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each phase.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tarot-SAM3，一个免训练 (training-free) 的引用表达分割 (Referring Expression Segmentation, RES) 框架，结合 SAM3 与多模态大语言模型 (MLLM)。框架分两阶段：Expression Reasoning Interpreter (ERI) 将任意自然语言查询解析为异构提示，Mask Self-Refining (MSR) 利用 DINOv3 特征关系挑选最优掩码并自我修正。实验显示其在显式、隐式及开放世界 RES 基准上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有 RES 方法依赖大规模标注数据，且只能处理显式或隐式表达中的一类；SAM3 虽在可提示概念分割上鲁棒，但对较长或隐式表达效果不佳，且与 MLLM 简单耦合会导致结果过度依赖 MLLM 推理，无法修正 SAM3 的分割输出。
Method: Tarot-SAM3 分两阶段：ERI 阶段引入 reasoning-assisted prompt options，进行结构化表达解析和评估感知改写，将任意查询转换为稳健的异构提示以生成可靠掩码；MSR 阶段跨提示类型选择最佳掩码，并利用 DINOv3 的特征关系比较判别区域，推断区域归属以纠正过分割与欠分割。
Result: 摘要报告在显式与隐式 RES 基准及开放世界场景上均取得强性能，消融实验验证了每个阶段的有效性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文强调免训练、无需标注数据即可处理任意引用表达是核心贡献；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Where Did It Go Wrong? Process-Level Evaluation of Web Agents with Semantic State Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Web agents act through long interaction sequences, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only terminal success, discarding all process information and offering little guidance on improvement. In this work, we conduct a process-level analysis of web agents. We introduce WebStep, a benchmark of 1,800 task instances with controlled difficulty and automatic semantic state tracking. Each website exposes a deterministic semantic MDP alongside the GUI: the agent operates on the interface, while the environment records high-level states and transitions in the background, enabling fine-grained analysis without manual annotation. Based on the semantic trajectory, we first show that process metrics reveal differences invisible to outcome evaluation: three agents whose success rates cluster within 34-37% diverge in exploration reach versus execution accuracy. Then, decomposing by skill characterizes the nature of these differences, exposing opposite per-skill rankings hidden within the same website: e.g., on Q&A, Claude CUA outperforms OpenAI CUA by 30% on navigation actions yet underperforms it by 6.7% on inspection, pinpointing a concrete skill to improve even within a domain. Bifurcation analysis further localizes the decisive error that loses the task and shows that this error is agent-specific rather than shared. Finally, these differences widen as tasks grow harder: success rate is similar on easy tasks but separates sharply as exploration becomes more demanding. Our process-level analysis opens a new avenue in web agent evaluation, providing fine-grained and actionable insight into where and how each agent should be improved. Project page: https://jiwanchung.github.io/webstep
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WebStep，一个包含 1,800 个任务实例、带受控难度和自动语义状态追踪的网页智能体评估基准。每个网站除 GUI 外还暴露确定性语义 MDP，环境在后台记录高层状态与转移，从而实现无需人工标注的细粒度过程分析。基于语义轨迹，作者发现过程指标能揭示输出评价无法区分的差异，并通过技能分解、分岔分析等定位智能体特有的失败原因。
Motivation: 现有网页智能体基准只评估最终是否成功，丢弃了所有过程信息，无法指导模型改进。作者希望提供过程级分析，以更细粒度、可操作的方式揭示智能体在哪里以及如何失败。
Method: 构建 WebStep 基准，包含 1,800 个任务实例与自动语义状态跟踪；每个网站暴露确定性语义 MDP，智能体在 GUI 上操作，环境在后台记录高层状态与转移。基于该语义轨迹进行过程指标计算、按技能分解、分岔分析（bifurcation analysis）以及难度维度分析。
Result: 三个成功率集中在 34-37% 的智能体在探索到达范围与执行准确率上出现分化；在 Q&A 域内，Claude CUA 在导航动作上比 OpenAI CUA 高 30%，但在检查（inspection）上低 6.7%；分岔分析表明决定性错误是智能体特有的而非共享的；随着任务难度增加，这些差异进一步扩大，成功率在简单任务上相近但在探索要求更高时明显分离。
Conclusion: 过程级分析为网页智能体评估开辟新方向，能提供细粒度、可操作的改进建议，指明每个智能体应在何处以及如何改进。

summary_sections.result: 三个成功率集中在 34-37% 的智能体在探索到达范围与执行准确率上出现分化；在 Q&A 域内，Claude CUA 在导航动作上比 OpenAI CUA 高 30%，但在检查（inspection）上低 6.7%；分岔分析表明决定性错误是智能体特有的而非共享的；随着任务难度增加，这些差异进一步扩大，成功率在简单任务上相近但在探索要求更高时明显分离。
summary_sections.conclusion: 过程级分析为网页智能体评估开辟新方向，能提供细粒度、可操作的改进建议，指明每个智能体应在何处以及如何改进。

papers.title: Variational Approximated Restricted Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Spatial Data
papers.abstract_en: This research considers a scalable inference for spatial data modeled through Gaussian intrinsic conditional autoregressive (ICAR) structures. The classical estimation method, restricted maximum likelihood (REML), requires repeated inversion and factorization of large, sparse precision matrices, which makes this computation costly. To sort this problem out, we propose a variational restricted maximum likelihood (VREML) framework that approximates the intractable marginal likelihood using a Gaussian variational distribution. By constructing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) on the restricted likelihood, we derive a computationally efficient coordinate-ascent algorithm for jointly estimating the spatial random effects and variance components. In this article, we theoretically establish the monotone convergence of ELBO and mathematically exhibit that the variational family is exact under Gaussian ICAR settings, which is an indication of nullifying approximation error at the posterior level. We empirically establish the supremacy of our VREML over MLE and INLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于高斯内在条件自回归 (ICAR) 结构的大规模空间数据推断计算昂贵的问题，提出变分近似限制最大似然估计 (VREML) 框架。该方法用高斯变分分布近似不可处理的限制边际似然，并推导坐标上升算法联合估计空间随机效应与方差分量。作者在理论上证明 ELBO 单调收敛，并证明在 Gaussian ICAR 设定下变分族是精确的；实验部分报告其优于 MLE 和 INLA。
Motivation: REML 估计需要对大型稀疏精度矩阵反复求逆和分解，计算代价高，限制了 ICAR 空间模型的可扩展性。
Method: 构造限制似然上的证据下界 (ELBO)，使用高斯变分分布逼近边际似然，并给出联合估计空间随机效应与方差分量的坐标上升算法。
Result: 作者理论上建立 ELBO 的单调收敛性，并证明在 Gaussian ICAR 设定下变分族的后验是精确的；实验中报告 VREML 优于 MLE 和 INLA。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VREML 在 Gaussian ICAR 空间模型下兼具计算效率与理论保证，可作为大规模空间数据分析中 REML 和 INLA 的替代方案。

papers.title: Exploring coupled tropical Pacific variability within a Multi-branch $β$-Variational Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: This study explores what is encoded in the latent space of a multi-branch $β$-variational autoencoder ($β$-VAE) trained on coupled tropical Pacific climate fields. We assess the reconstruction skill and physical interpretability of the latent space trained on monthly sea surface temperature, ocean heat content, and outgoing longwave radiation across the tropical Pacific from a 500-year preindustrial control simulation. The model generalizes well, with only modest degradation from training to test performance, and preserves the dominant basin-scale structure of all three fields. Latent-space diagnostics show that variability is organized unevenly across dimensions: sea surface temperature is concentrated in a smaller subset of latent dimensions, whereas ocean heat content and outgoing longwave radiation are more broadly distributed across multiple dimensions. Comparisons with conventional tropical Pacific diagnostics further show that several latent dimensions align with known El Niño and La Niña variability, while others capture related coupled ocean-atmosphere variability on decadal or longer timescales. Sensitivity experiments and latent traversals identify dimensions associated with eastern-Pacific-like, central-Pacific-like, coastal, subsurface-dominant, and atmosphere-dominant variability. Together, these results show that the multi-branch $β$-variational autoencoder yields a skillful and physically informative reduced representation of coupled tropical Pacific variability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用多分支 β-VAE 对热带太平洋耦合气候场（海表温度、海洋热含量、OLR）的 500 年工业革命前控制模拟进行降维，考察潜在空间的重建技巧与物理可解释性。摘要报告模型泛化良好，SST 变率集中在较少潜变量，而 OHC 与 OLR 分布更分散；多个潜变量对应 El Niño/La Niña 及年代际耦合变率。敏感性实验与潜在空间遍历识别出东太型、中太型、沿岸、次表层主导和大气主导等变率。
Motivation: 需要获得耦合热带太平洋变率的简约且可解释的表征；常规指数等诊断难以刻画多变量、多尺度耦合结构，而潜在空间方法有望提供更丰富的信息。
Method: 提出多分支 β-VAE（multi-branch β-variational autoencoder），将热带太平洋的月平均海表温度、海洋热含量与 OLR 三个场作为输入，训练于 500 年 preindustrial control simulation；通过重建技巧评估、潜在空间诊断、敏感性实验和 latent traversals 来解读潜在维度。
Result: 模型从训练到测试仅适度退化，并能保留三个场的盆地尺度结构；SST 变率集中在较少潜变量，OHC 与 OLR 则更广泛分布；多个潜变量与已知 El Niño/La Niña 变率及更长尺度的耦合海洋-大气变率对齐。
Conclusion: 作者认为多分支 β-VAE 能给出技巧上可靠且物理信息丰富的热带太平洋耦合变率降维表征；其范围限于单个控制模拟和热带太平洋区域。

papers.title: HUKUKBERT: Domain-Specific Language Model for Turkish Law
papers.abstract_en: Natural language processing (NLP) advances have powered a generation of LegalTech systems, but Turkish law remains under-served by domain-specific data and models. English has legal encoders such as LEGAL-BERT; no comparable high-volume Turkish counterpart exists. We introduce HukukBERT, a Turkish legal language model trained on a 19 GB cleaned corpus using a hybrid domain-adaptive pre-training (DAPT) recipe that mixes Whole-Word Masking, Token Span Masking, Word Span Masking, and targeted Keyword Masking. We compared our 48K WordPiece tokenizer and DAPT pipeline against general-purpose and existing domain-specific Turkish models. On the Legal Cloze Test - a masked legal term prediction benchmark over Turkish court decisions - HukukBERT reaches 84.40% Top-1 accuracy and beats every baseline we tested. The Legal Cloze Test is synthetically constructed, so its passages are absent from the pre-training corpus by construction, eliminating train-test contamination. On the downstream task of structural segmentation of official Turkish court decisions, it reaches a 92.8% document pass rate. We release HukukBERT to support Turkish legal NLP work in named entity recognition, judgment prediction, and document classification.
papers.journal_ref: Öztürk, M. U., Türkoğlu, T., & Buz-Yalug, B. (2026). HukukBERT: Domain-Specific Language Model for Turkish Law. Journal of Computational Law and Legal Technology, 1-15
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HukukBERT，一个面向土耳其法律领域的土耳其语领域专用语言模型。模型在 19 GB 清洗语料上采用混合领域自适应预训练 (DAPT) 配方，组合 Whole-Word Masking、Token Span Masking、Word Span Masking 和 Keyword Masking。在 Legal Cloze Test（针对土耳其法院判决的掩码法律术语预测基准）上达到 84.40% 的 Top-1 准确率，并在土耳其官方法院判决书结构分割任务上达到 92.8% 的文档通过率。
Motivation: 土耳其法律领域的 NLP 发展受限于领域专用数据和模型的缺乏；英语已有 LEGAL-BERT 等法律编码器，但土耳其语没有可比较的高规模领域模型。作者旨在为土耳其法律 NLP 提供领域自适应的预训练模型。
Method: 构建 48K 词表大小的 WordPiece tokenizer，并在 19 GB 清洗后的土耳其法律语料上训练模型。预训练采用混合 DAPT 配方，同时使用整词掩码、Token 跨度掩码、Word 跨度掩码以及针对法律关键词的掩码策略，并构造了合成式 Legal Cloze Test 基准以避免训练集与测试集污染。
Result: 在 Legal Cloze Test 上，HukukBERT 达到 84.40% 的 Top-1 准确率，超过所有测试的通用与既有领域专用土耳其语模型；在下游的官方土耳其法院判决书结构分割任务中，文档通过率达到 92.8%。
Conclusion: 作者认为领域自适应预训练对土耳其法律 NLP 有效，并公开 HukukBERT 以支持命名实体识别、判决预测和文档分类等后续工作。

papers.title: AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance
papers.abstract_en: People often optimize for long-term goals in collaboration: A mentor or companion doesn't just answer questions, but also scaffolds learning, tracks progress, and prioritizes the other person's growth over immediate results. In contrast, current AI systems are fundamentally short-sighted collaborators - optimized for providing instant and complete responses, without ever saying no (unless for safety reasons). What are the consequences of this dynamic? Here, through a series of randomized controlled trials on human-AI interactions (N = 1,222), we provide causal evidence for two key consequences of AI assistance: reduced persistence and impairment of unassisted performance. Across a variety of tasks, including mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension, we find that although AI assistance improves performance in the short-term, people perform significantly worse without AI and are more likely to give up. Notably, these effects emerge after only brief interactions with AI (approximately 10 minutes). These findings are particularly concerning because persistence is foundational to skill acquisition and is one of the strongest predictors of long-term learning. We posit that persistence is reduced because AI conditions people to expect immediate answers, thereby denying them the experience of working through challenges on their own. These results suggest the need for AI model development to prioritize scaffolding long-term competence alongside immediate task completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过随机对照试验（N = 1,222）研究人类与AI交互的两个因果后果：AI辅助会降低人的坚持性（persistence），并损害无辅助时的独立表现。任务包括数学推理和阅读理解，即使仅约10分钟的短暂交互也会出现这些效应。作者认为原因是AI让人习惯即时答案，剥夺了独立克服挑战的经历。
Motivation: 现有AI系统被优化为提供即时完整回答，几乎不会拒绝用户，这与注重长期成长的导师或同伴协作模式相反。作者想检验这种短期主义协作方式对人类长期学习能力的具体因果影响。
Method: 开展一系列关于人机交互的随机对照试验，涉及多种任务（数学推理、阅读理解），在不同条件下比较有AI辅助和无AI辅助时被试的表现、放弃率与后续独立表现。
Result: AI辅助短期提升任务表现，但在无AI条件下被试表现显著更差且更容易放弃；这些效应在约10分钟的短暂交互后即出现。
Conclusion: AI辅助可能通过让人期待即时答案而降低坚持性，而坚持性是技能习得和长期学习的关键预测因素；作者呼吁AI模型开发应优先考虑构建长期能力（scaffolding）而非仅追求即时任务完成。

papers.title: What Makes a Sale? Simulating End-to-End Seller--Buyer Retail Dynamics with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating retail strategies before deployment is difficult, as outcomes are determined across multiple stages, from seller-side persuasion through buyer-seller interaction to purchase decisions. However, existing retail simulators capture only partial aspects of this process and do not model cross-stage dependencies, making it difficult to assess how early decisions affect downstream outcomes. We present RetailSim, an end-to-end retail simulation framework that models this pipeline in a unified environment, explicitly designed for simulation fidelity through diverse product spaces, persona-driven agents, and multi-turn interactions. We evaluate RetailSim with a dual protocol comprising human evaluation of behavioral fidelity and meta-evaluation against real-world economic regularities, showing that it successfully reproduces key patterns such as demographic purchasing behavior, the price-demand relationship, and heterogeneous price elasticity. We further demonstrate its practical utility via decision-oriented use cases, including persona inference, seller-buyer interaction analysis, and sales strategy evaluation, showing RetailSim's potential as a controlled testbed for exploring retail strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RetailSim，一个基于 LLM 智能体 (LLM agents) 的端到端零售模拟框架，将卖家说服、买卖双方多轮交互和购买决策等环节统一建模在同一环境中。摘要报告通过行为保真度人工评估和对照真实经济规律（如人口统计购买行为、价格-需求关系、异质价格弹性）的元评估，验证了其仿真保真度，并展示在用户画像推断、买卖交互分析与销售策略评估上的实际用途。
Motivation: 零售策略在部署前的评估很难，因为结果由多个相互依赖的阶段决定；现有零售模拟器只覆盖部分环节，未建模跨阶段依赖，难以评估早期决策对下游结果的影响。
Method: RetailSim 通过统一环境显式设计仿真保真度，包含多样化商品空间 (product spaces)、基于人设的智能体 (persona-driven agents) 和多轮交互 (multi-turn interactions)，并采用人工行为保真度评估与真实经济规律元评估的双协议进行验证。
Result: 摘要称 RetailSim 成功复现了人口统计购买行为、价格-需求关系以及异质价格弹性等关键模式，并在人设推断、买卖双方交互分析和销售策略评估等决策导向用例中展示了实用价值。

papers.title: VLMs Need Words: Vision Language Models Ignore Visual Detail In Favor of Semantic Anchors
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, they often fail on tasks that require fine-grained visual perception, even when the required information is still present in their internal representations. Prior work has attributed this ``hidden-in-plain-sight'' gap to the language model, but the cause remains unexplained. In this work, we demonstrate that this gap arises from the language model's lack of semantic labels for fine-grained visual details: when visual entities can be mapped to known concepts, VLMs bypass visual comparison and reason through language; when they cannot, VLMs resort to brittle and hallucinated descriptions. We verify this across semantic correspondence, synthetic shape matching, and face matching, and find that VLMs perform much better when the relevant entities are nameable than when they are unnamable. Mechanistically, Logit Lens analysis confirms that VLMs explicitly recover semantic labels for nameable entities and surface more unique tokens compared to unnameable entities. Furthermore, we show that this limitation can be addressed: teaching completely arbitrary names for unknown entities improves performance. More importantly, task-specific finetuning yields even stronger generalization without relying on language priors, i.e., through real visual perception. Our findings suggest that current VLM failures on visual tasks reflect a learned shortcut rather than a fundamental limitation of multimodal reasoning. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/Patchwork53/VLMs-Need-Words-COLM2026.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在需要细粒度视觉感知的任务上失败的原因，提出这一“隐藏于明处”(hidden-in-plain-sight) 的差距源于语言模型缺乏针对细粒度视觉细节的语义标签。作者在语义对应、合成形状匹配和人脸匹配三类任务上验证，当视觉实体可以被映射到已知概念时，VLM 会绕过视觉比较而通过语言推理；当实体无法命名时则产生脆弱且幻觉化的描述。Logit Lens 分析显示模型对可命名实体显式恢复语义标签并产生更多独特 token；给未知实体任意命名或任务特定微调均能改善性能。
Motivation: VLM 在多种多模态任务上表现优异，但在需要细粒度视觉感知的任务上经常失败，即使所需信息仍存在于其内部表征中。先前工作将这一差距归因于语言模型，但并未解释其根本原因，本文旨在揭示该差距的真正来源。
Method: 作者提出假设：视觉细节的失败源于语言模型缺乏对应的语义标签。他们通过语义对应、合成形状匹配和人脸匹配任务验证该假设，并使用 Logit Lens 做机制分析；进一步的干预实验包括为未知实体教授任意名称，以及进行任务特定微调 (task-specific finetuning)。
Result: 实验发现 VLM 在实体可命名时表现远好于不可命名时；Logit Lens 证实模型会为可命名实体显式恢复语义标签并产生更多独特 token。给未知实体任意命名即可提升性能，而任务特定微调无需依赖语言先验、依靠真实视觉感知可获得更强的泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前 VLM 在视觉任务上的失败反映的是习得的捷径 (learned shortcut) 而非多模态推理的根本局限，并已发布代码和数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NearID: Identity Representation Learning via Near-identity Distractors
papers.abstract_en: When evaluating identity-focused tasks such as personalized generation and image editing, existing vision encoders entangle object identity with background context, leading to unreliable representations and metrics. We introduce the first principled framework to address this vulnerability using Near-identity (NearID) distractors, where semantically similar but distinct instances are placed on the exact same background as a reference image, eliminating contextual shortcuts and isolating identity as the sole discriminative signal. Based on this principle, we present the NearID dataset (19K identities, 316K matched-context distractors) together with a strict margin-based evaluation protocol. Under this setting, pre-trained encoders perform poorly, achieving Sample Success Rates (SSR), a strict margin-based identity discrimination metric, as low as 30.7% and often ranking distractors above true cross-view matches. We address this by learning identity-aware representations on a frozen backbone using a two-tier contrastive objective enforcing the hierarchy: same identity > NearID distractor > random negative. This improves SSR to 99.2%, enhances part-level discrimination by 28.0%, and yields stronger alignment with human judgments on DreamBench++, a human-aligned benchmark for personalization. Project page: https://gorluxor.github.io/NearID/
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026, Code, model, and dataset are released, visit https://github.com/Gorluxor/NearID
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用近恒等干扰项 (Near-identity distractors) 来评估和训练身份表示：把语义相似但身份不同的实例放在与参考图完全相同的背景上，从而消除上下文捷径，让身份成为唯一判别信号。作者构建了 NearID 数据集（19K 身份、316K 匹配上下文干扰项）和基于严格边距的评估协议，发现预训练编码器在此设置下表现差，SSR 低至 30.7%，且常把干扰项排在真实跨视角匹配之前。通过在冻结骨干上使用两层次对比学习目标训练身份感知表示，SSR 提升到 99.2%，部分级判别提升 28.0%，并在 DreamBench++ 上与人类判断的对齐更强。
Motivation: 现有视觉编码器在身份相关任务（如个性化生成和图像编辑）中会把对象身份与背景上下文纠缠在一起，导致表示不可靠、评估指标失真；缺少一个能隔离身份信号并暴露这种脆弱性的严格评测框架。
Method: 提出 NearID 框架：构造语义相似但身份不同的实例并将其放置在与参考图完全相同的背景上作为干扰项，配合严格边距的评估协议；在冻结骨干上用两层次对比学习目标，强制身份层级关系：相同身份 > NearID 干扰项 > 随机负样本。
Result: 预训练编码器在 NearID 协议下表现差，SSR 低至 30.7%，且经常将干扰项排在真实跨视角匹配之前；训练后的表示把 SSR 提升至 99.2%，部分级判别提高 28.0%，并在 DreamBench++ 上取得与人类判断更强的对齐。
Conclusion: 作者认为消除背景上下文捷径并显式建模身份层级可以显著改善身份感知表示与评估可靠性，并发布了代码、模型和数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enhanced Polarization Locking in VCSELs
papers.abstract_en: While optical injection locking (OIL) of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) has been widely studied in the past, the polarization dynamics of OIL have received far less attention. Recent studies suggest that polarization locking via OIL could enable novel computational applications such as polarization-encoded Ising computers. However, the inherent polarization preference and limited polarization switchability of VCSELs hinder their use for such purposes. To address these challenges, we fabricate VCSELs with tailored oxide aperture designs and combine these with bias current tuning to study the overall impact on polarization locking. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach reduces the required injection power (to as low as 3.6 μW) and expands the locking range. To investigate the impact of the approach, the spin-flip model (SFM) is used to analyze the effects of amplitude anisotropy and bias current on polarization locking, demonstrating strong coherence with experimental results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 VCSEL 中光注入锁定 (optical injection locking, OIL) 的偏振动力学，通过定制氧化孔径 (oxide aperture) 设计和偏置电流调谐来改善偏振锁定。实验显示该方法可将所需注入功率降至低至 3.6 μW，并扩大锁定范围；自旋翻转模型 (spin-flip model, SFM) 分析结果表明与实验高度一致。
Motivation: 偏振锁定通过 OIL 有望支持偏振编码的 Ising 计算机等新型计算应用，但 VCSEL 固有的偏振偏好和有限的偏振可切换性阻碍了这类用途。
Method: 制造具有定制氧化孔径设计的 VCSEL，并结合偏置电流调谐，研究两者对偏振锁定的整体影响；使用自旋翻转模型 (SFM) 分析幅度各向异性与偏置电流的作用。
Result: 该方法将所需注入功率降低至 3.6 μW 并扩大锁定范围；SFM 分析结果与实验展现出强一致性。
Conclusion: 定制氧化孔径与偏置电流调谐可增强 VCSEL 的偏振锁定能力。

papers.title: StereoVGGT: A Training-Free Visual Geometry Transformer for Stereo Vision
papers.abstract_en: Driven by the advancement of 3D devices, stereo vision tasks including stereo matching and stereo conversion have emerged as a critical research frontier. Contemporary stereo vision backbones typically rely on either Monocular Depth Estimation models or general-purpose Pre-trained Vision Models. Crucially, these models are predominantly pretrained without explicit supervision of camera poses. Given that such geometric knowledge is indispensable for stereo vision, the absence of explicit spatial constraints constitutes a significant performance bottleneck for existing architectures. Recognizing that the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) operates as a foundation model pre-trained on extensive 3D priors, including camera poses, we investigate its potential as a robust backbone for stereo vision tasks. Nevertheless, empirical results indicate that its direct application to stereo vision yields suboptimal performance. We observe that VGGT suffers from a more significant degradation of geometric details during feature extraction. Such characteristics conflict with the requirements of binocular stereo vision, thereby constraining its efficacy for relative tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose StereoVGGT, a feature backbone specifically tailored for stereo vision. By leveraging the frozen VGGT and introducing a training-free feature adjustment pipeline, we mitigate geometric degradation and harness the latent camera calibration knowledge embedded within the model. StereoVGGT-based stereo matching network achieved the $1^{st}$ rank among all published methods on the KITTI benchmark, validating that StereoVGGT serves as a highly effective backbone for stereo vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StereoVGGT，一个面向立体视觉任务的特征主干，基于冻结的 Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) 并引入无需训练的 feature adjustment pipeline。作者指出 VGGT 直接用于立体匹配时存在几何细节退化问题，而该方法通过缓解该退化并利用模型中潜在的相机标定知识来提升性能。基于 StereoVGGT 的立体匹配网络在 KITTI 基准上取得所有已发表方法中的第 1 名。
Motivation: 现有立体视觉主干多依赖单目深度估计模型或通用预训练视觉模型，但这些模型大多没有显式相机位姿监督，而该几何信息对立体视觉至关重要，形成性能瓶颈。VGGT 虽预训练于大量 3D 先验（含相机位姿），但直接应用于立体视觉时效果不佳，因为其特征提取过程中几何细节退化更明显，与双目立体视觉的需求冲突。
Method: 提出 StereoVGGT 特征主干：保持 VGGT 冻结，并引入一个 training-free（无需训练）的特征调整流程，用于缓解几何细节退化并利用模型内嵌的相机标定知识，从而弥合通用 3D 基础模型与立体视觉任务之间的差距。
Result: 基于 StereoVGGT 的立体匹配网络在 KITTI 基准上取得所有已发表方法中的第 1 名，验证了其作为立体视觉主干的效力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 StereoVGGT 是一种高效的立体视觉特征主干，且 training-free 的设计避免了额外训练成本，但其适用范围与具体机制仅限于摘要所述内容。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HyVIC: A Metric-Driven Spatio-Spectral Hyperspectral Image Compression Architecture Based on Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of hyperspectral data archives in remote sensing (RS) necessitates effective compression methods for storage and transmission. Recent advances in learning-based hyperspectral image (HSI) compression have significantly enhanced both reconstruction fidelity and compression efficiency. However, existing methods typically adapt variational image compression models designed for natural images, without adequately accounting for the distinct spatio-spectral redundancies inherent in HSIs. To address this issue, in this paper, we aim to study the effects of spatio-spectral feature learning on the rate-distortion (RD) performance of variational HSI compression as a first time in RS. To this end, we propose to use configurable spatial and spectral feature learning blocks within variational HSI compression. To achieve this, we introduce spatio-spectral variational hyperspectral image compression architecture (HyVIC), a configurable variational autoencoder (VAE) for HSI compression. HyVIC enables independent control of spatial and spectral feature learning, facilitating hyperspectral-specific variational image compression. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that the trade-off between spatial and spectral feature learning is crucial for the reconstruction fidelity. Motivated by this, we also present a metric-driven strategy to systematically select the hyperparameters of the proposed model. In detail, HyVIC achieves high spatial and spectral reconstruction fidelity across a wide range of compression ratios (CRs) and improves the state of the art by up to 4.66dB in terms of BD-PSNR. Based on our results, we offer insights and derive practical guidelines to guide future research directions in learning-based variational HSI compression in RS. Our code and pre-trained model weights are publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/hyvic .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyVIC，一种基于变分自编码器（VAE）的高光谱图像压缩架构，通过在编码器中引入可独立配置的空间与光谱特征学习块，首次在遥感领域研究空谱特征学习对率失真（RD）性能的影响。在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，空间与光谱特征学习的权衡对重建保真度至关重要；HyVIC 在多种压缩比下均实现高保真，并在 BD-PSNR 上最多提升 4.66 dB。作者还提出度量驱动的超参数选择策略，并公开代码和预训练权重。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的高光谱图像压缩方法通常直接借用为自然图像设计的变分压缩模型，未充分考虑高光谱图像特有的空间与光谱冗余，导致压缩效率与重建质量受限。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统研究空谱特征学习对压缩性能的影响。
Method: 提出 HyVIC，一个可配置的变分自编码器压缩架构，通过在编码器中设置可独立控制的空间和光谱特征学习模块，实现对空谱特征学习的灵活调节；同时提出度量驱动的策略，用于系统性地选择模型超参数。
Result: 在两个基准数据集上的实验显示，空间与光谱特征学习的权衡是影响重建保真度的关键因素；HyVIC 在宽范围压缩比（CRs）下保持高空间与光谱重建保真度，并在 BD-PSNR 指标上最多比现有方法提高 4.66 dB。

papers.title: In-Context Molecular Property Prediction with LLMs: A Blinding Study on Memorization and Knowledge Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have expanded beyond natural language processing to scientific prediction tasks, including molecular property prediction. However, their effectiveness in in-context learning remains ambiguous, particularly given the potential for training data contamination in widely used benchmarks. This paper investigates whether LLMs perform genuine in-context regression on molecular properties or instead rely on verbatim retrieval of memorized target values. Furthermore, we analyze the interplay between pre-trained knowledge and in-context information through a series of progressively blinded experiments. We evaluate nine LLM variants across three families (GPT-4.1, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5) on three MoleculeNet datasets (Delaney solubility, Lipophilicity, QM7 atomization energy) using a systematic blinding approach that iteratively reduces available information, complemented by 0-, 60-, and 1000-shot in-context sample sizes as an additional control for information access. To validate the memorization analysis and the blinding experiments, we add a positive and a negative control for the memorization experiments and structural reference baselines for the multi-shot experiments as well as bootstrap confidence intervals for all results. We find no evidence of verbatim retrieval on the legacy benchmarks and show that blinding exposes conflicts between pre-trained knowledge and in-context information. This work provides a principled framework for evaluating molecular property prediction under controlled information access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 在分子性质预测中的上下文学习 (in-context learning) 是否真实有效的问题，设计了一系列逐步盲化 (blinding) 实验，检验模型是真正进行上下文回归还是记忆训练数据中的目标值。作者在 GPT-4.1、GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 三个模型家族的九个变体上，用 MoleculeNet 的 Delaney 溶解度、Lipophilicity 和 QM7 原子化能三个数据集，配合 0/60/1000-shot 的上下文样本量控制，发现遗留基准上没有逐字检索 (verbatim retrieval) 的证据，但盲化会暴露预训练知识与上下文信息之间的冲突。
Motivation: LLM 在科学预测任务上的能力扩展迅速，但分子性质预测基准可能存在训练数据污染，导致上下文学习的有效性存疑；因此需要区分真正的上下文回归与记忆检索。
Method: 采用系统化盲化方法逐级减少可用信息，横跨三个模型家族九个 LLM 变体，在三个 MoleculeNet 数据集上评估；同时以 0、60、1000-shot 上下文样本量作为信息访问的额外控制，并加入正负对照、结构参考基线和 bootstrap 置信区间来验证记忆分析与盲化实验。
Result: 摘要报告在遗留基准上未发现逐字检索目标值的证据；盲化实验表明预训练知识与上下文信息之间存在冲突。
Conclusion: 该工作为在受控信息访问条件下评估分子性质预测提供了一个原则性框架。
