papers.title: LogitScope: A Framework for Analyzing LLM Uncertainty Through Information Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and quantifying uncertainty in large language model (LLM) outputs is critical for reliable deployment. However, traditional evaluation approaches provide limited insight into model confidence at individual token positions during generation. To address this issue, we introduce LogitScope, a lightweight framework for analyzing LLM uncertainty through token-level information metrics computed from probability distributions. By measuring metrics such as entropy and varentropy at each generation step, LogitScope reveals patterns in model confidence, identifies potential hallucinations, and exposes decision points where models exhibit high uncertainty, all without requiring labeled data or semantic interpretation. We demonstrate LogitScope's utility across diverse applications including uncertainty quantification, model behavior analysis, and production monitoring. The framework is model-agnostic, computationally efficient through lazy evaluation, and compatible with any HuggingFace model, enabling both researchers and practitioners to inspect LLM behavior during inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LogitScope，一个轻量级的 LLM 不确定性分析框架，通过从概率分布中计算 token 级信息度量（如熵 entropy 和方差熵 varentropy）来刻画生成过程。框架在每个生成步骤测量这些度量，以揭示模型置信度模式、识别潜在幻觉并暴露高不确定性的决策点，全程无需标注数据或语义解释。LogitScope 是模型无关的，借助惰性求值 (lazy evaluation) 提高计算效率，并兼容任意 HuggingFace 模型，可用于不确定性量化、模型行为分析和生产监控。
Motivation: 传统评估方法难以在生成期间对单个 token 位置的模型置信度提供细粒度洞察，而可靠部署需要更细致的不确定性量化手段。
Method: 提出 LogitScope，在推理时从每个生成步骤的概率分布计算熵和方差熵等 token 级信息度量；通过惰性求值实现计算高效，并设计为与任意 HuggingFace 模型兼容的模型无关框架。
Result: 摘要指出该方法无需标注数据即可揭示置信度模式、识别潜在幻觉并暴露高不确定性决策点，并在不确定性量化、模型行为分析和生产监控等应用中展示其可用性；摘要没有给出具体的量化结果。
Conclusion: LogitScope 提供了一种面向研究者和实践者的推理时模型检查工具，强调模型无关性和计算效率；摘要未明确讨论其局限或适用范围边界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OsteoFlow: Lyapunov-Guided Flow Distillation for Predicting Bone Remodeling after Mandibular Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting long-term bone remodeling after mandibular reconstruction would be of great clinical benefit, yet standard generative models struggle to maintain trajectory-level consistency and anatomical fidelity over long horizons, particularly in low-data regimes. We introduce OsteoFlow, a flow-based framework predicting Year-1 post-operative CT scans from Day-5 scans. Our core contribution is Lyapunov-guided trajectory distillation: Unlike one-step distillation, our method distills a continuous trajectory over transport time from a registration-derived stationary velocity field teacher. Combined with a resection-aware image loss, this enforces geometric correspondence without sacrificing generative capacity. Evaluated on 344 paired regions of interest, OsteoFlow significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing mean absolute error in the surgical resection zone by ~20%. This highlights the promise of trajectory distillation for long-term prediction in low-data clinical settings. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/hamidreza-aftabi/OsteoFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OsteoFlow，一个基于流 (flow-based) 的生成框架，用于从下颌骨重建术后的 Day-5 CT 扫描预测 Year-1 术后 CT。核心贡献是 Lyapunov 引导的轨迹蒸馏 (Lyapunov-guided trajectory distillation)：与一步蒸馏不同，该方法从配准派生的平稳速度场教师模型中蒸馏传输时间上的连续轨迹，并结合切除感知图像损失 (resection-aware image loss) 施加几何对应约束。在 344 个配对感兴趣区上，OsteoFlow 显著优于现有基线，手术切除区平均绝对误差降低约 20%。
Motivation: 标准生成模型在低数据场景下难以在长时程预测中维持轨迹级一致性和解剖保真度；而临床上长期预测下颌骨重建后的骨重塑很有价值，现有方法在此任务上表现不足。
Method: 提出 OsteoFlow 流程：以 Day-5 CT 为输入，通过 Lyapunov 引导的轨迹蒸馏，从配准导出的平稳速度场教师模型蒸馏连续传输轨迹，并联合切除感知图像损失来强制几何对应关系，同时保留生成容量。
Result: 在 344 个配对感兴趣区上，OsteoFlow 显著超过了 state-of-the-art 基线，在手术切除区域将平均绝对误差降低了约 20%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轨迹蒸馏 (trajectory distillation) 在低数据临床场景下进行长期预测的潜力，并指出代码已公开在 GitHub 上。

papers.title: Towards Interpretable Foundation Models for Retinal Fundus Images
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are used to extract transferable representations from large amounts of unlabeled data, typically via self-supervised learning (SSL). However, many of these models rely on architectures that offer limited interpretability, a critical issue in high-stakes domains such as medical imaging. We propose DualIFM, a foundation model that is interpretable-by-design via a BagNet backbone whose small receptive fields generate class evidence maps that are faithful to the model's decision-making process. Additionally, DualIFM incorporates a $2D$ projection layer during pretraining that enables direct visualization of the representation space, providing a dataset-level view of the learned structure including meaningful clinical clusters as well as potential spurious correlations. We trained DualIFM on over 800,000 color fundus photographs from various sources to learn generalizable representations for different downstream tasks. Our model achieves performance comparable to RETFound, which has $16\times$ more parameters, while providing interpretable predictions on out-of-distribution data. These results suggest that large-scale SSL pretraining paired with inherent interpretability can lead to robust representations for retinal imaging. Code and pretrained models are available at github.com/berenslab/interpretable_FM.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, submitted to iMIMIC workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualIFM，一个面向视网膜眼底图像的可解释基础模型。它通过 BagNet 主干的小感受野生成忠于模型决策的类别证据图，并在预训练中加入 2D 投影层以直接可视化表征空间。模型在超过 80 万张彩色眼底照片上训练，性能与参数多 16 倍的 RETFound 相当，同时在分布外数据上提供可解释预测。
Motivation: 自监督学习 (SSL) 基础模型通常依赖可解释性有限的架构，这在医学影像等高风险领域是关键问题。
Method: DualIFM 采用可解释性设计的 BagNet 主干，利用小感受野生成类别证据图 (class evidence maps)；预训练中引入 2D 投影层，使表征空间可直接可视化，以展现临床聚类和潜在虚假相关。
Result: 在超过 800,000 张眼底照片上训练后，DualIFM 达到与 RETFound 相当的性能，而 RETFound 的参数量是其 16 倍；模型在分布外数据上也能提供可解释预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为大规模 SSL 预训练与固有可解释性结合可产生稳健的视网膜影像表征，并公开了代码和预训练模型。

papers.title: Rethinking Uncertainty Quantification and Entanglement in Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is crucial in safety-critical applications such as medical image segmentation. Total uncertainty is typically decomposed into data-related aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and model-related epistemic uncertainty (EU). Many methods exist for modeling AU (such as Probabilistic UNet, Diffusion) and EU (such as ensembles, MC Dropout), but it is unclear how they interact when combined. Additionally, recent work has revealed substantial entanglement between AU and EU, undermining the interpretability and practical usefulness of the decomposition. We present a comprehensive empirical study covering a broad range of AU-EU model combinations, propose a metric to quantify uncertainty entanglement, and evaluate both across downstream UQ tasks. Ensembles consistently exhibit lower entanglement and superior performance. Softmax models usually beat other AU methods, except in calibration where the results are dataset-dependent. A softmax ensemble performs remarkably well on all tasks. Finally, we analyze potential sources of uncertainty entanglement and outline directions for mitigating this effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学图像分割中的不确定性量化（UQ）问题，研究数据相关的偶然不确定性（AU）与模型相关的认知不确定性（EU）在组合时的相互作用，并关注二者之间存在的纠缠现象。作者对多种AU-EU模型组合进行系统实验，提出量化不确定性纠缠的指标，并在下游UQ任务上评估；结果表明集成（ensembles）的一致性更低且性能更优，softmax模型通常优于其他AU方法（校准任务上结果依赖数据集），softmax集成在所有任务上表现突出。最后分析了纠缠的潜在来源并给出缓解方向。
Motivation: 图像分割中总不确定性通常分解为AU和EU，但现有方法（如Probabilistic UNet、Diffusion用于AU，ensembles、MC Dropout用于EU）在组合时如何相互作用尚不明确；同时近期工作发现AU与EU之间存在显著纠缠，削弱了这种分解的可解释性和实际用途。
Method: 对涵盖多种AU-EU组合的模型进行全面的经验性研究，提出一个用于量化不确定性纠缠程度的指标，并在多个下游UQ任务上进行评估；同时分析纠缠的可能来源并指出缓解方向。
Result: 集成方法一致地表现出更低的不确定性纠缠和更优的性能；softmax模型通常优于其他AU方法，但在校准任务上结果依赖数据集；softmax集成在所有任务上表现极其出色。
Conclusion: 作者强调集成在降低AU-EU纠缠和提升下游任务性能上的优势，并指出纠缠现象的潜在来源及缓解方向，但研究主要是经验性的，结果在部分任务（如校准）上具有数据集依赖性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SAMSEM -- A Generic and Scalable Approach for IC Metal Line Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: In light of globalized hardware supply chains, the assurance of hardware components has gained significant interest, particularly in cryptographic applications and high-stakes scenarios. Identifying metal lines on scanning electron microscope (SEM) images of integrated circuits (ICs) is one essential step in verifying the absence of malicious circuitry in chips manufactured in untrusted environments. Due to varying manufacturing processes and technologies, such verification usually requires tuning parameters and algorithms for each target IC. Often, a machine learning model trained on images of one IC fails to accurately detect metal lines on other ICs. To address this challenge, we create SAMSEM by adapting Meta's Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) to the domain of IC metal line segmentation. Specifically, we develop a multi-scale segmentation approach that can handle SEM images of varying sizes, resolutions, and magnifications. Furthermore, we deploy a topology-based loss alongside pixel-based losses to focus our segmentation on electrical connectivity rather than pixel-level accuracy. Based on a hyperparameter optimization, we then fine-tune the SAM2 model to obtain a model that generalizes across different technology nodes, manufacturing materials, sample preparation methods, and SEM imaging technologies. To this end, we leverage an unprecedented dataset of SEM images obtained from 48 metal layers across 14 different ICs. When fine-tuned on seven ICs, SAMSEM achieves an error rate as low as 0.72% when evaluated on other images from the same ICs. For the remaining seven unseen ICs, it still achieves error rates as low as 5.53%. Finally, when fine-tuned on all 14 ICs, we observe an error rate of 0.62%. Hence, SAMSEM proves to be a reliable tool that significantly advances the frontier in metal line segmentation, a key challenge in post-manufacturing IC verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAMSEM，通过将 Meta 的 Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) 适配到集成电路 (IC) 金属线分割任务，解决 SEM 图像上跨芯片、跨工艺的泛化问题。方法包含多尺度分割、联合像素级损失与基于拓扑的损失，并经过超参数优化微调。基于来自 14 个 IC 的 48 个金属层 SEM 图像数据集，SAMSEM 在已见 IC 上取得低至 0.72% 的错误率，在未见 IC 上仍低至 5.53%。
Motivation: 在全球化硬件供应链背景下，验证芯片中不存在恶意电路至关重要，而 SEM 图像上的金属线识别是关键步骤。由于制造工艺和技术差异，传统方法需要针对每个目标 IC 调整参数，且在一个 IC 上训练的机器学习模型往往无法准确分割其他 IC 的金属线。
Method: 将 Meta 的 SAM2 适配到 IC 金属线分割领域，开发多尺度分割方法以处理不同尺寸、分辨率和放大倍率的 SEM 图像；同时部署基于拓扑的损失 (topology-based loss) 与基于像素的损失，使分割聚焦于电连接性而非像素级精度；最后通过超参数优化微调 SAM2，以跨技术节点、制造材料、样品制备方法和 SEM 成像技术泛化。
Result: 在 7 个 IC 上微调后，同一批 IC 的其他图像上错误率低至 0.72%；在其余 7 个未见 IC 上错误率仍低至 5.53%；在全部 14 个 IC 上微调后，错误率达到 0.62%。
Conclusion: SAMSEM 被证明是可靠的金属线分割工具，显著推进了制造后 IC 验证中这一关键挑战的解决。

papers.title: Modeling Matches as Language: A Generative Transformer Approach for Counterfactual Player Valuation in Football
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating football player transfers is challenging because player actions depend strongly on tactical systems, teammates, and match context. Despite this complexity, recruitment decisions often rely on static statistics and subjective expert judgment, which do not fully account for these contextual factors. This limitation stems largely from the absence of counterfactual simulation mechanisms capable of predicting outcomes in hypothetical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose ScoutGPT, a generative model that treats football match events as sequential tokens within a language modeling framework. Utilizing a NanoGPT-based Transformer architecture trained on next-token prediction, ScoutGPT learns the dynamics of match event sequences to simulate event sequences under hypothetical lineups, demonstrating superior predictive performance compared to existing baseline models. Leveraging this capability, the model employs Monte Carlo sampling to enable counterfactual simulation, allowing for the assessment of unobserved scenarios. Experiments on K League data show that simulated player transfers lead to measurable changes in offensive progression and goal probabilities, indicating that ScoutGPT captures player-specific impact beyond traditional static metrics.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at ECML-PKDD 2026 (Applied Data Science Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScoutGPT，一种将足球比赛事件建模为序列 token 的生成式 Transformer 方法，用于足球运动员的反事实估值。模型基于 NanoGPT 架构进行 next-token prediction 训练，学习比赛事件序列动态，并通过 Monte Carlo 采样模拟假设阵容下的比赛事件。在 K League 数据上的实验表明，模拟球员转会可带来进攻推进和进球概率的可测量变化，说明该方法能捕捉超越传统静态指标的球员个体影响。
Motivation: 球员转会选择常依赖静态统计和主观专家判断，未充分考虑战术系统、队友和比赛情境；现有方法缺乏能预测假设场景结果的反事实模拟机制，导致评估不全面。
Method: 将比赛事件视为语言模型中的顺序 token，采用 NanoGPT 架构通过 next-token prediction 学习比赛事件序列动态；随后利用该生成模型进行 Monte Carlo 采样，在假设阵容下模拟事件序列，实现反事实场景评估。
Result: 摘要报告 ScoutGPT 在预测性能上优于现有基线模型；在 K League 数据上的实验显示，模拟球员转会导致进攻推进和进球概率的可测量变化，表明模型能捕捉超出传统静态指标的球员具体影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将比赛建模为语言并结合 Monte Carlo 采样可以支持未观察场景下的反事实球员估值，基于 K League 数据验证了该方法的有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HAPEns: Hardware-Aware Post-Hoc Ensembling for Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Ensembling is commonly used in machine learning on tabular data to boost predictive performance and robustness, but larger ensembles often lead to increased hardware demand. We introduce HAPEns, a post-hoc ensembling method that explicitly balances accuracy against hardware efficiency. Inspired by multi-objective and quality diversity optimization, HAPEns constructs a diverse set of ensembles along the Pareto front of predictive performance and resource usage. Existing hardware-aware post-hoc ensembling baselines are not available, highlighting the novelty of our approach. Experiments on 83 tabular classification datasets show that HAPEns significantly outperforms baselines, finding superior trade-offs for ensemble performance and deployment cost. Ablation studies also reveal that memory usage is a particularly effective objective metric. Further, we show that even a greedy ensembling algorithm can be significantly improved in this task with static multi-objective weighting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HAPEns，一种面向表格数据的硬件感知后验集成方法，在预测性能与硬件资源消耗之间显式权衡。受多目标优化和质量多样性优化启发，HAPEns 沿性能-资源使用的 Pareto 前沿构建多样化的集成集合。在 83 个表格分类数据集上的实验表明，HAPEns 显著优于基线，能够找到更好的集成性能与部署成本折中；消融研究还显示内存使用量是特别有效的目标指标。
Motivation: 集成学习常用于提升表格数据上的预测性能与鲁棒性，但更大的集成通常带来更高的硬件需求。现有方法缺乏在集成阶段显式平衡精度与硬件效率的手段，且缺乏可用的硬件感知后验集成基线。
Method: HAPEns 借鉴多目标优化与质量多样性优化，构造一组位于预测性能和资源使用 Pareto 前沿的多样化集成。后验集成阶段以静态多目标权重来指导选择，并以内存使用等资源指标作为优化目标之一。
Result: 在 83 个表格分类数据集上，HAPEns 显著优于基线，找到更优的集成性能与部署成本权衡。消融实验表明内存使用量是特别有效的目标指标；此外，即使贪心集成算法配合静态多目标加权也能在该任务上获得显著改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为在表格数据的后验集成中显式考虑硬件效率可行且有效，并指出资源指标中内存使用尤其值得关注。摘要未提及该方法在非表格数据或超大规模模型上的适用性。

papers.title: Fusion-Poly: A Polyhedral Framework Based on Spatial-Temporal Fusion for 3D Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR-camera 3D multi-object tracking (MOT) combines rich visual semantics with accurate depth cues to improve trajectory consistency and tracking reliability. In practice, however, LiDAR and cameras operate at different sampling rates. To maintain temporal alignment, existing data pipelines usually synchronize heterogeneous sensor streams and annotate them at a reduced shared frequency, forcing most prior methods to perform spatial fusion only at synchronized timestamps through projection-based or learnable cross-sensor association. As a result, abundant asynchronous observations remain underexploited, despite their potential to support more frequent association and more robust trajectory estimation over short temporal intervals. To address this limitation, we propose Fusion-Poly, a spatial-temporal fusion framework for 3D MOT that integrates asynchronous LiDAR and camera data. Fusion-Poly associates trajectories with multi-modal observations at synchronized timestamps and with single-modal observations at asynchronous timestamps, enabling higher-frequency updates of motion and existence states. The framework contains three key components: a frequency-aware cascade matching module that adapts to synchronized and asynchronous frames according to available detection modalities; a frequency-aware trajectory estimation module that maintains trajectories through high-frequency motion prediction, differential updates, and confidence-calibrated lifecycle management; and a full-state observation alignment module that improves cross-modal consistency at synchronized timestamps by optimizing image-projection errors. On the nuScenes test set, Fusion-Poly achieves 76.5% AMOTA, establishing a new state of the art among tracking-by-detection 3D MOT methods. Extensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fusion-Poly，一个面向 LiDAR-相机 3D 多目标跟踪 (MOT) 的时空融合框架，用于处理异构传感器不同采样率导致的异步观测问题。框架在同步时间戳做多模态关联，在异步时间戳做单模态关联，实现更高频率的状态更新。在 nuScenes 测试集上达到 76.5% AMOTA，为 tracking-by-detection 3D MOT 方法中的新最优。
Motivation: LiDAR 与相机采样率不同，现有数据管线通常将异构流同步并降低标注频率，导致大多数方法仅在同步时间戳做空间融合，大量异步观测未被利用，限制了关联频率与短时间间隔内的轨迹估计鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 Fusion-Poly，包含三个核心组件：频率感知级联匹配模块，根据可用的检测模态适应同步/异步帧；频率感知轨迹估计模块，通过高频率运动预测、差分更新和置信度校准的生命周期管理维护轨迹；全状态观测对齐模块，通过优化图像投影误差提升同步时间戳的跨模态一致性。
Result: 在 nuScenes 测试集上，Fusion-Poly 达到 76.5% AMOTA，在 tracking-by-detection 3D MOT 方法中创造新最优；消融实验验证了各组件有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为融合异步 LiDAR 和相机数据支持更高频率的关联和更鲁棒的轨迹估计，所提框架树立了新的 SOTA；代码将发布。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为融合异步 LiDAR 和相机数据支持更高频率的关联和更鲁棒的轨迹估计，所提框架树立了新的 SOTA；代码将发布。

papers.title: SphUnc: Hyperspherical Uncertainty Decomposition and Causal Identification via Information Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Reliable decision-making in complex multi-agent systems requires calibrated predictions and interpretable uncertainty. We introduce SphUnc, a unified framework combining hyperspherical representation learning with structural causal modeling. The model maps features to unit hypersphere latents using von Mises-Fisher distributions, decomposing uncertainty into epistemic and aleatoric components through information-geometric fusion. A structural causal model on spherical latents enables directed influence identification and interventional reasoning via sample-based simulation. Empirical evaluations on social and affective benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, better calibration, and interpretable causal signals, establishing a geometric-causal foundation for uncertainty-aware reasoning in multi-agent settings with higher-order interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SphUnc，一个结合超球面表示学习与结构因果建模的统一框架。模型使用 von Mises-Fisher 分布将特征映射到单位超球面隐空间，并通过信息几何融合将不确定性分解为认知不确定性 (epistemic) 与偶然不确定性 (aleatoric)；在球形隐变量上构建结构因果模型，支持有向影响识别和基于样本模拟的干预推理。在社交与情感基准上的实验报告了更高的精度、更好的校准和可解释的因果信号。
Motivation: 复杂多智能体系统中的可靠决策需要校准的预测和可解释的不确定性，现有方法缺少统一的几何表征与因果识别视角。
Method: 将特征映射到单位超球面隐空间并采用 von Mises-Fisher 分布建模，使用信息几何融合将不确定性分解为认知与偶然两部分；进一步在球形隐变量上建立结构因果模型，实现有向影响识别和通过样本模拟进行干预推理。
Result: 摘要报告在社交与情感基准上取得更好的精度和校准，并产生可解释的因果信号。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为多智能体高阶交互场景下的不确定性感知推理建立了几何-因果基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: In-Context Pure Exploration in Continuous Decision Spaces
papers.abstract_en: In active sequential testing, also termed pure exploration, a learner is tasked with the goal to adaptively acquire information so as to identify an unknown ground-truth hypothesis with as few queries as possible. This problem has several motivating applications, including Best-Arm Identification (BAI) in bandits, where actions index hypotheses, and generalized search problems, where strategically chosen queries reveal partial information about a hidden label. In many modern settings, however, the hypothesis, or recommendation space, is continuous: for example, identifying a near optimal action in a continuous-armed bandit, localizing an $ε$-ball contained in a target region, or estimating the minimizer of a function from noisy observations. Existing methods are predominantly frequentist and model-specific, while learned approaches have been limited to finite recommendation spaces. We introduce C-ICPE, a theory-guided learned model for Bayesian fixed-confidence pure exploration with continuous recommendations. C-ICPE meta-trains sequential architectures over a task prior to jointly learn exploration, stopping and recommendations strategies. At inference time, it actively gathers evidence on tasks and identifies an $ε$-optimal recommendation without parameter updates.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at ICML 2026 Workshop on Hypothesis Testing, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-ICPE，一个面向贝叶斯固定置信度纯探索 (Bayesian fixed-confidence pure exploration) 的 learned model，将推荐空间从有限集合推广到连续决策空间。该方法在任务先验上元训练序列架构，联合学习探索、停止与推荐策略；推理时无需更新参数即可主动收集证据并输出 ε-最优推荐。摘要未给出具体数值实验结论。
Motivation: 现有主动序贯检验/纯探索方法多为频率派且模型特定，而基于学习的方案仅适用于有限推荐空间；在连续假设或推荐空间（如连续臂老虎机、目标区域定位、函数最小化器估计）中缺乏理论指导的可学习方法。
Method: 引入 C-ICPE，元训练 (meta-train) 序列架构以联合学习探索策略、停止规则和推荐策略，并针对连续推荐空间设计；推理阶段在任务上主动收集证据并识别 ε-最优推荐，无需参数更新。
Result: 摘要主要报告了方法本身及其能力：C-ICPE 在连续推荐空间中实现贝叶斯固定置信度纯探索，并联合学习探索、停止和推荐策略；未提供数值结果或基准对比。
Conclusion: 该工作将 learned pure exploration 方法从有限推荐空间扩展到连续假设空间，填补了现有方法在连续场景下缺乏理论学习模型的空白。

papers.title: Style-Aware Gloss Control for Generative Non-Photorealistic Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Humans can infer material characteristics of objects from their visual appearance, and this ability extends to artistic depictions, where similar perceptual strategies guide the interpretation of paintings or drawings. Among the factors that define material appearance, gloss, along with color, is widely regarded as one of the most important, and recent studies indicate that humans can perceive gloss independently of the artistic style used to depict an object. To investigate how gloss and artistic style are represented in learned models, we train an unsupervised generative model on a newly curated dataset of painterly objects designed to systematically vary such factors. Our analysis reveals a hierarchical latent space in which gloss is disentangled from other appearance factors, allowing for a detailed study of how gloss is represented and varies across artistic styles. Building on this representation, we introduce a lightweight adapter that connects our style- and gloss-aware latent space to a latent-diffusion model, enabling the synthesis of non-photorealistic images with fine-grained control of these factors. We compare our approach with previous models and observe improved disentanglement and controllability of the learned factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式非真实感渲染中光泽 (gloss) 与艺术风格的可控表达。作者在新构建的画家风格物体数据集上训练无监督生成模型，发现其隐空间呈层次结构且光泽与其他外观因素解耦，并据此引入轻量适配器连接 latent-diffusion 模型，实现具有细粒度光泽与风格控制的非真实感图像合成。摘要报告相比以往模型在解耦性和可控性上有所提升。
Motivation: 人类可以从艺术描绘中独立于艺术风格感知物体光泽，但光泽与艺术风格在学得模型中的表征方式尚不清楚，作者希望系统研究并利用这一表征进行可控合成。
Method: 构建一个系统变化光泽与艺术风格因素的画家风格物体数据集，训练无监督生成模型以分析隐空间；在此基础上提出轻量适配器 (lightweight adapter)，将风格与光泽感知的隐空间接入 latent-diffusion 模型，用于非真实感图像生成。
Result: 分析显示模型隐空间呈层次结构，光泽与其他外观因素解耦；与先前模型相比，所提方法在解耦性和可控性上表现更好。
Conclusion: 该表征与适配器支持对光泽和艺术风格进行细粒度控制，并可用于研究光泽在不同艺术风格中的表现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Signal Horizon: Local Blindness and the Contraction of Pauli-Weight Spectra in Noisy Quantum Encodings
papers.abstract_en: The performance of quantum classifiers is typically analyzed through global state distinguishability or the trainability of variational models. This study investigates how much class information remains accessible under locality-constrained measurements in the presence of noise. The authors formulate binary quantum classification as constrained quantum state discrimination and introduce a locality-restricted distinguishability measure quantifying the maximum bias achievable by observables acting on at most $k$ subsystems. For $n$-qubit systems subject to independent depolarizing noise, the locally accessible signal is governed by a Pauli-weight-dependent contraction mechanism. This motivates a computable predictor, the $k$-local Pauli-accessible amplitude $A_{k}(p)$, which lower bounds the optimal $k$-local classification advantage. Numerical experiments on four-qubit encodings demonstrate quantitative agreement between empirical accuracy and the prediction across noise levels. The research identifies an operational breakdown threshold where $k$-local classifiers become indistinguishable from random guessing despite persistent global distinguishability.
papers.comment: The manuscript is withdrawn because subsequent work showed that its central theoretical interpretation is incomplete. The relationship between local Pauli-weight contraction, measurement accessibility, and learnability requires a different theoretical framework. A substantially revised treatment is under preparation, and the current version should not be cited for these claims
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究含噪量子编码下，局域受限测量还能保留多少类别信息。作者将二元量子分类建模为受限量子态判别，引入局域受限可区分性度量，并证明在独立去极化噪声下，局域可访问信号由泡利权重相关的收缩机制决定，由此提出可计算的 k-局域泡利可访问振幅 A_k(p) 作为最优 k-局域分类优势的下界。四比特编码的数值实验显示预测与经验精度一致，并刻画了 k-局域分类器退化为随机猜测的阈值。需要注意的是，该稿件已被作者撤回，因为其核心理论解释不完整，不应被引用。
Motivation: 现有对量子分类器的分析通常关注全局态可区分性或变分模型的可训练性，但很少回答在噪声和局域测量约束下，类别信息实际有多少可被访问。
Method: 将二元量子分类形式化为约束量子态判别，定义作用于至多 k 个子系统的可观测量所能达到的最大偏差作为局域受限可区分性度量；对 n 比特独立去极化噪声系统，推导泡利权重依赖的收缩机制，并构造 k-局域泡利可访问振幅 A_k(p) 来下界最优 k-局域分类优势。
Result: 四比特编码上的数值实验表明，经验分类精度与 A_k(p) 预测随噪声水平定量一致；研究还识别出一个操作意义上的失效阈值，超过该阈值时 k-局域分类器与随机猜测不可区分，尽管全局可区分性仍然存在。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局域泡利权重收缩、测量可访问性与可学习性之间的关系需要不同的理论框架；稿件已撤回，当前版本不应被引用，修订版正在准备中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Deployment-Friendly Foundational Framework for Efficient Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) generalize well across computational pathology tasks but remain costly for gigapixel whole-slide image analysis. Here, we present LitePath, a deployment-friendly framework that addresses model over-parameterization and patch-level redundancy. LitePath combines LiteFM, a compact model distilled from Virchow2, H-Optimus-1 and UNI2 using 190 million patches, with the Adaptive Patch Selector for task-specific patch selection. Compared with Virchow2, LitePath uses 28x fewer parameters and 403.5x fewer FLOPs. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super, it processes 208 slides per hour, 104.5x faster than Virchow2, and consumes 0.36 kWh per 3,000 slides, 171x less energy than Virchow2 on an RTX 3090 GPU. We evaluated LitePath on 45 multicenter cohorts across four organs and 33 tasks, comprising 37 classification and 8 survival cohorts, including 33 internal, 10 external and 2 prospective cohorts, with 17,837 slides from 9,977 patients disjoint from the pretraining data. Among 22 PFMs, LitePath achieved the best average rank (6.56 vs. 6.58 for Virchow2), retained 99.71% of Virchow2's Macro-AUC across classification cohorts, and improved mean C-index by 2.14 percentage points across survival cohorts (71.91% vs. 69.77%). We further introduce the Deployability Score (D-Score), a weighted geometric mean of normalized task performance and FLOPs. LitePath achieved the highest D-Score (0.8455), outperforming H0-mini (0.7723) and Virchow2 (0.7297). In a randomized paired crossover study of four pathologists and 120 cases, LitePath increased diagnostic accuracy by 4.1-15.8 percentage points and reduced diagnostic time by 10.9-14.2%. These results demonstrate rapid, cost-effective and energy-efficient pathology image analysis on accessible hardware while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LitePath，一个面向计算病理学的部署友好框架，由从 Virchow2、H-Optimus-1 和 UNI2 蒸馏得到的紧凑模型 LiteFM（基于 1.9 亿 patches）与 Adaptive Patch Selector 组成。相比 Virchow2，LitePath 参数减少 28 倍、FLOPs 减少 403.5 倍，在 Jetson Orin Nano Super 上每小时处理 208 张切片，能耗大幅降低。在 45 个多中心队列、33 个任务上的评估显示其平均排名最佳，并引入 Deployability Score (D-Score) 作为性能与计算成本的综合指标。
Motivation: 病理基础模型 (PFM) 在跨任务泛化上表现良好，但 gigapixel 全切片图像分析的成本高昂；问题在于模型过参数化和 patch 级冗余，需要一种部署友好且高效的方案。
Method: 提出 LitePath 框架，结合两个组件：LiteFM，一个从多个大型 PFM 蒸馏出的紧凑模型；以及 Adaptive Patch Selector，用于任务特定的 patch 选择。此外引入 D-Score，即归一化任务性能与 FLOPs 的加权几何平均，用于评估部署友好性。
Result: 与 Virchow2 相比，LitePath 参数减少 28 倍、FLOPs 减少 403.5 倍，推理速度提升 104.5 倍，能耗降低 171 倍（0.36 kWh/3000 张切片）。在 22 个 PFM 中取得最佳平均排名（6.56 vs. 6.58），分类任务保留 Virchow2 的 99.71% Macro-AUC，生存任务平均 C-index 提升 2.14 个百分点（71.91% vs. 69.77%），D-Score 最高（0.8455）。病理医生交叉研究中，诊断准确率提升 4.1-15.8 个百分点，诊断时间减少 10.9-14.2%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在保持竞争性能的同时，可以在易获取的硬件上实现快速、低成本、节能的病理图像分析。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 LitePath 框架，结合两个组件：LiteFM，一个从多个大型 PFM 蒸馏出的紧凑模型；以及 Adaptive Patch Selector，用于任务特定的 patch 选择。此外引入 D-Score，即归一化任务性能与 FLOPs 的加权几何平均，用于评估部署友好性。
summary_sections.result: 与 Virchow2 相比，LitePath 参数减少 28 倍、FLOPs 减少 403.5 倍，推理速度提升 104.5 倍，能耗降低 171 倍（0.36 kWh/3000 张切片）。在 22 个 PFM 中取得最佳平均排名（6.56 vs. 6.58），分类任务保留 Virchow2 的 99.71% Macro-AUC，生存任务平均 C-index 提升 2.14 个百分点（71.91% vs. 69.77%），D-Score 最高（0.8455）。病理医生交叉研究中，诊断准确率提升 4.1-15.8 个百分点，诊断时间减少 10.9-14.2%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明，在保持竞争性能的同时，可以在易获取的硬件上实现快速、低成本、节能的病理图像分析。

papers.title: OR-Agent: Bridging Evolutionary Search and Structured Research for Automated Algorithm Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Automating heuristic design in complex, experiment-driven domains requires more than iterative mutation of solution algorithms. Current LLM-based evolutionary methods often rely on stochastic mutation loops that lack long-term strategic planning and a formal mechanism to learn from historical failures, leading to inefficient exploration and redundant trials. To address this, we present OR-Agent, a multi-agent research framework designed for automated heuristic design in optimization problems with rich experimental environments. OR-Agent organizes heuristic search as tree-based workflow that explicitly models branching hypothesis generation and systematic backtracking. Furthermore, to address the lack of adaptive learning in current agents, we introduce a hierarchical, optimization-inspired reflection system in which short-term reflections act as verbal gradients, long-term reflections as verbal momentum, and memory compression as semantic weight decay - collectively forming a principled mechanism for governing research dynamics. Extensive experiments on classical combinatorial optimization problems (e.g., TSP, CVRP, bin packing) and simulation-based cooperative driving scenarios demonstrate that OR-Agent outperforms strong evolutionary search baselines. All code and experimental data are publicly available at https://github.com/qiliuchn/OR-Agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OR-Agent，一个面向复杂实验驱动领域自动启发式设计的多智能体研究框架。它将启发式搜索组织为基于树的流程，显式建模分支假设生成与系统回溯，并引入受优化启发的分层反思系统，以短时反思作为口头梯度、长时反思作为口头动量、记忆压缩作为语义权重衰减。在 TSP、CVRP、装箱等经典组合优化问题及仿真协同驾驶场景上，OR-Agent 优于强进化搜索基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的进化方法通常依赖随机变异循环，缺少长期战略规划与从历史失败中学习的正式机制，导致探索效率低且重复试验多。
Method: OR-Agent 将启发式搜索组织为树状工作流，显式建模分支假设生成和系统性回溯；同时引入分层反思系统：短时反思充当 verbal gradients，长时反思充当 verbal momentum，记忆压缩充当 semantic weight decay，从而形成调控研究动态的原则化机制。
Result: 在经典组合优化问题（TSP、CVRP、装箱）以及基于仿真的协作驾驶场景上的实验表明，OR-Agent 优于强进化搜索基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将显式分支-回溯建模与受优化启发的分层反思机制结合，可以弥补当前 LLM 进化智能体缺乏自适应学习的不足；代码与实验数据已公开。

papers.title: Quantifying Hallucinations in Language Language Models on Medical Textbooks
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations, the tendency for large language models to provide responses with factually incorrect and unsupported claims, is a serious problem within natural language processing for which we do not yet have an effective solution to mitigate against. Existing benchmarks for medical QA rarely evaluate this behavior against a fixed evidence source. We ask how often hallucinations occur on textbook-grounded QA and how responses to medical QA prompts vary across models. We conduct two experiments, the first experiment to determine the prevalence of hallucinations for a prominent open source large language model (LLaMA-70B-Instruct) in medical QA given closed-source zero-shot prompts, and the second experiment to determine the prevalence of hallucinations and clinician preference to model responses. We observed, in experiment one, with the passages provided, LLaMA-70B-Instruct hallucinated in 19.7\% of answers (95\% CI 18.6 to 20.7) even though 98.8\% of prompt responses received maximal plausibility, and observed in experiment two, across models, lower hallucination rates aligned with higher usefulness scores ($ρ=-0.71$, $p=0.058$). Clinicians produced high agreement (quadratic weighted $κ=0.92$) and ($τ_b=0.06$ to $0.18$, $κ=0.57$ to $0.61$) for experiments 1 and 2 respectively. Our findings indicate that, across all scales and architectures tested, current large language models remain unfit for unsupervised clinical deployment, and that human expert oversight is both necessary and the dominant cost driver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在医学教科书问答中产生幻觉（hallucination）的频率。作者用固定证据源（教科书章节）设计两个实验：实验一测量 LLaMA-70B-Instruct 在零样本闭源提示下的幻觉率，实验二比较多模型幻觉率与临床医生偏好。结果发现幻觉率与回答貌似合理程度严重脱节，且模型在无监督临床部署上仍不可靠。
Motivation: 现有医学问答基准很少针对固定证据源评估幻觉行为，导致对模型在教科书支撑的任务中捏造事实的程度缺乏量化认识。
Method: 进行两个实验：实验一给 LLaMA-70B-Instruct 提供教科书段落并给出闭源零样本提示，统计答案中幻觉的出现率；实验二在多个模型上比较幻觉率与临床医生对回答有用性的评分，并量化临床医生间的一致性。
Result: 实验一中 LLaMA-70B-Instruct 的幻觉率为 19.7%（95% CI 18.6 至 20.7），但 98.8% 的提示回答获得最大似真性评分；实验二中较低幻觉率与较高有用性评分相关（ρ=-0.71，p=0.058）。临床医生评分一致性在实验一为二次加权 κ=0.92，实验二为 τ_b=0.06 至 0.18、κ=0.57 至 0.61。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在所测试的规模与架构范围内，当前大语言模型仍不适合无监督的临床部署，人类专家监督既必不可少，也是主要的成本驱动因素。

papers.title: Beyond Solving: Prescriptive Probing for Neural Routing Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) trains fast heuristics for routing problems, but planners often need more than a single solve: they ask which stop to drop, which transition to preserve, or which subset of stops to remove if a route is infeasible. Answering such counterfactual questions by re-solving each candidate is expensive even when the action set is small. We introduce Prescriptive Probing: using the frozen representations of a trained NCO model to rank candidate interventions for what-if decision support. While recent interpretability work descriptively probes what NCO solvers encode, we ask whether those same representations can prescriptively guide intervention choices on real-road routing problems. Where exhaustive labels are available, we train supervised probes from offline re-solve labels; where they are not (e.g., combinatorial action spaces), we train a lightweight reinforcement learning intervention head. Across real-road benchmarks on the Asymmetric Traveling Salesperson Problem and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, probes built on frozen model representations achieve the strongest performance on a majority of intervention tasks and improve over local-repair heuristics on edge-forbiddance and on key node- and multi-node-removal metrics. We further investigate probeability as a property of the routing model itself, varying model quality, the mix of supervised learning and reinforcement learning, and the architecture family. Overall, our results suggest a new use case for NCO solvers: representations learned for route construction can transfer to decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prescriptive Probing：利用训练好的神经组合优化 (NCO) 路由模型中的冻结表示，对候选干预动作（如删除某个站点、禁止某条边、移除节点子集）进行排序，以支持 what-if 决策。在非对称旅行商问题 (ATSP) 和带容量约束车辆路径问题 (CVRP) 的真实道路基准上，基于冻结表示训练的探针在多数干预任务上达到最强性能，并在边禁止以及节点/多节点移除指标上优于局部修复启发式。作者认为，为路径构建学到的表示可以迁移到决策支持任务。
Motivation: 规划者往往需要回答反事实问题（例如路线不可行时应删除哪个站点或保留哪条转移边），而逐一重新求解每个候选方案代价高昂。现有可解释性工作只是描述性地探测 NCO 求解器编码了什么，本文则追问这些表示能否规范性地指导干预选择。
Method: 提出 Prescriptive Probing 框架：在离线重求解标签可得时，训练监督探针 (supervised probe)；在标签不可得（如组合动作空间）时，训练轻量级强化学习干预头 (reinforcement learning intervention head)。探针基于冻结的 NCO 模型表示构建，不重新训练底层路由模型。
Result: 在 ATSP 和 CVRP 的真实道路基准上，基于冻结表示构建的探针在多数干预任务上取得最强性能，并在边禁止以及关键节点和多节点移除指标上优于局部修复启发式。作者还考察了 probeability 作为路由模型自身属性，变化模型质量、监督学习与强化学习的混合比例以及架构家族。
Conclusion: 结果表明，为路由构造学习到的表示可以迁移到决策支持，为 NCO 求解器提供了新的用例；同时 probeability 与路由模型本身的性质相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding can significantly accelerate LLM serving, yet most deployments today disentangle speculator training from serving, treating speculator training as a standalone offline modeling problem. We show that this decoupled formulation introduces substantial deployment and adaptation lag: (1) high time-to-serve, since a speculator must be trained offline for a considerable period before deployment; (2) delayed utility feedback, since the true end-to-end decoding speedup is only known after training and cannot be inferred reliably from acceptance rate alone due to model-architecture and system-level overheads; and (3) domain-drift degradation, as the target model is repurposed to new domains and the speculator becomes stale and less effective. To address these issues, we present Aurora, a unified training-serving system that closes the loop by continuously learning a speculator directly from live inference traces. Aurora reframes online speculator learning as an asynchronous reinforcement-learning problem: accepted tokens provide positive feedback, while rejected speculator proposals provide implicit negative feedback that we exploit to improve sample efficiency. Our design integrates an SGLang-based inference server with an asynchronous training server, enabling hot-swapped speculator updates without service interruption. Crucially, Aurora supports day-0 deployment: a speculator can be served immediately and rapidly adapted to live traffic, improving system performance while providing immediate utility feedback. Across experiments, Aurora achieves a 1.5x day-0 speedup on recently released frontier models (e.g., MiniMax M2.1 229B and Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B). Aurora also adapts effectively to distribution shifts in user traffic, delivering an additional 1.25x speedup over a well-trained but static speculator on widely used models (e.g., Qwen3 and Llama3).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Aurora，一个统一训练-服务系统，将投机解码（speculative decoding）中的草稿模型（speculator）训练从离线独立任务改为从在线推理轨迹中持续学习。摘要报告在 MiniMax M2.1 229B 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B 等前沿模型上实现 1.5 倍 day-0 加速，并在用户流量分布漂移下比静态 speculator 额外获得 1.25 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有部署将 speculator 训练与服务解耦，导致三类问题：训练后才能上线造成的高时延、端到端加速效果反馈延迟、目标模型迁移新领域后 speculator 过时退化。
Method: Aurora 将在线 speculator 学习建模为异步强化学习问题：被接受的 token 提供正反馈，被拒绝的提议提供隐式负反馈以提升样本效率。系统集成 SGLang 推理服务器与异步训练服务器，支持热切换 speculator 更新而不中断服务，并支持 day-0 部署。
Result: 摘要报告 Aurora 在 MiniMax M2.1 229B 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B 上取得 1.5 倍 day-0 加速；在 Qwen3 和 Llama3 等模型上，相对于训练良好但静态的 speculator，在流量分布漂移下额外获得 1.25 倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调闭环在线学习 speculator 可同时改善部署延迟、效用反馈与漂移适应能力，使投机解码从离线训练范式转向持续适应服务的系统。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Uncalibrated Multi-View Video Anonymization in the Operating Room
papers.abstract_en: Privacy preservation is a prerequisite for using video data in Operating Room (OR) research. Effective anonymization relies on the exhaustive localization of every individual; even a single missed detection necessitates extensive manual correction. However, existing approaches face two critical scalability bottlenecks: (1) they usually require manual annotations of each new clinical site for high accuracy; (2) while multi-camera setups have been widely adopted to address single-view ambiguity, camera calibration is typically required whenever cameras are repositioned. To address these problems, we propose a self-supervised multi-view video anonymization framework consisting of whole-body person detection and whole-body pose estimation, without annotation or camera calibration. Our core strategy is to enhance the single-view detector by "retrieving" false negatives using temporal and multi-view context, and conducting self-supervised domain adaptation. We first run an off-the-shelf whole-body person detector in each view with a low-score threshold to gather candidate detections. Then, we retrieve the low-score false negatives that exhibit consistency with the high-score detections via tracking and self-supervised uncalibrated multi-view association. These recovered detections serve as pseudo labels to iteratively fine-tune the whole-body detector. Finally, we apply whole-body pose estimation on each detected person, and fine-tune the pose model using its own high-score predictions. Experiments on the 4D-OR dataset of simulated surgeries and our dataset of real surgeries show the effectiveness of our approach achieving 99% and 97% recall, respectively. Moreover, we train a real-time whole-body detector using our pseudo labels, achieving comparable performance and highlighting our method's practical applicability. Code will be available at https://github.com/CAMMA-public/OR_anonymization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督的多视角视频匿名化框架，用于手术室（OR）场景，无需人工标注和相机标定。核心策略是通过时间与多视角上下文检索低置信检测（false negatives），并用检索结果作为伪标签迭代微调全身检测器，再对每个检测到的人进行全身姿态估计。在4D-OR模拟手术数据集和真实手术数据集上分别达到99%和97%的召回率，且用伪标签训练的实时检测器性能相当。
Motivation: 现有手术室视频匿名化方法通常需要为每个新临床站点人工标注才能保持高精度，且多相机设置一旦重新布置就需要重新标定，这两点限制了方法的大规模部署。
Method: 提出无标注、无相机标定的自监督多视角匿名化框架：先在每个视角用现成的全身检测器以低分数阈值收集候选检测，再通过跟踪和自监督无标定多视角关联，检索与高置信检测一致的假阴性作为伪标签，迭代微调全身检测器；最后对每个检测到的人运行全身姿态估计，并用自身的高置信预测微调姿态模型。
Result: 在4D-OR模拟手术数据集上达到99%召回率，在真实手术数据集上达到97%召回率；使用伪标签训练的实时全身检测器达到与直接训练相当的性能，表明该方法具有实际部署价值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需标注和相机标定即可实现高召回率的手术室视频匿名化，并展示了其在真实场景中的实用可行性。

papers.title: On the Limits of Layer Pruning for Generative Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that layer pruning can effectively compress large language models (LLMs) while retaining strong performance on classification benchmarks, often with little or no finetuning. In contrast, generative reasoning tasks, such as GSM8K and HumanEval\textsuperscript{+}, exhibit substantially weaker recovery. We show that beyond surface-level text degradation, pruning leads to a loss of key algorithmic capabilities, including arithmetic computation and balanced parenthesis generation. Under realistic post-training constraints, using a single 80GB GPU and without access to pretraining-scale data or compute, we evaluate a simple recovery strategy based on supervised finetuning with self-generated responses. This approach recovers up to 90\% of baseline performance on classification tasks, but recovery for generative reasoning remains limited. We further find that this gap persists even under a favorable task-aligned recovery setting, where pruned models are fully finetuned on self-generated GSM8K responses, suggesting that the degradation is not merely due to generic instruction data or parameter-efficient tuning. As complementary evidence, we analyze a depth-pruned model trained with nearly 100B post-pruning tokens and find that deficits persist even on simple arithmetic tasks that do not require multi-step generation. Overall, we characterize practical recovery limits of layer pruning for generative reasoning and provide guidance on when depth reduction is effective under constrained post-training regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层剪枝 (layer pruning) 对大型语言模型生成式推理能力的影响。作者发现剪枝后的模型在分类任务上可通过简单监督微调恢复大部分性能，但在 GSM8K、HumanEval+ 等生成式推理任务上恢复有限，且即使使用近 100B 剪枝后 token 训练的深度剪枝模型，简单算术任务上的缺陷仍持续存在。
Motivation: 现有研究表明层剪枝能有效压缩 LLM 并保持分类基准性能，但生成式推理任务的恢复能力明显较弱。本文旨在刻画实际后训练约束下，层剪枝对生成推理能力损害的可恢复边界。
Method: 在单张 80GB GPU、无预训练规模数据和算力的现实约束下，评估基于自生成响应的监督微调恢复策略；并进一步在任务对齐的恢复设置中，对自我生成的 GSM8K 响应进行完全微调，以及分析用近 100B 剪枝后 token 训练的深度剪枝模型。
Result: 该恢复策略在分类任务上可恢复约 90% 的基线性能，但生成式推理的恢复仍然有限；即使采用任务对齐的完全微调，差距仍存在。近 100B token 训练的深度剪枝模型在无需多步生成的简单算术任务上仍存在缺陷。
Conclusion: 层剪枝对生成式推理的深度能力（算法能力如算术和平衡括号生成）会造成难以通过常规后训练恢复的损害；论文提供了受限后训练机制下深度缩减何时有效的指导。

papers.title: When Classes Evolve: A Benchmark and Framework for Stage-Aware Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to sequentially learn new classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting of previously learned knowledge. Conventional CIL approaches implicitly assume that classes are morphologically static, focusing primarily on preserving previously learned representations as new classes are introduced. In practice, however, instances of the same semantic class may undergo substantial morphological evolution, such as a larva turning into a butterfly. Consequently, a model must both discriminate between classes and adapt to evolving appearances within a single class. To systematically address this challenge, we formalize Stage-Aware CIL (Stage-CIL), a paradigm in which each class is learned progressively through distinct morphological stages. We further introduce Stage-Bench, a 10-domain, two-stage benchmark and protocol for evaluating both inter-class forgetting and stage-level degradation within classes. Finally, we propose STAGE, an evolution-aware reference baseline that disentangles semantic identity from evolution dynamics through a fixed-size memory pool, enabling stage-aware prediction of later morphological forms from earlier representations. Extensive experiments show that conventional CIL reductions and existing continual-learning baselines remain insufficient under Stage-CIL, while STAGE consistently outperforms strong competitors, demonstrating the promise of explicit evolution-aware modeling for this new setting.
papers.comment: 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了一个新的持续学习范式 Stage-Aware CIL (Stage-CIL)：同一语义类别的样本会经历不同的形态演化阶段（如幼虫变为蝴蝶），模型既要区分类别，又要适应类别内部的形态变化。作者为此提出 10 个领域、两阶段的基准与评测协议 Stage-Bench，并设计演化感知的参考基线 STAGE。实验表明传统 CIL 归约和现有持续学习基线在该设定下不足，而 STAGE 一致优于强竞争方法。
Motivation: 传统 CIL 方法隐含假设类别形态是静态的，主要关注在新类别引入时保留旧知识；但实际中同一类别的实例可能发生显著形态演化，现有方法未系统处理类别间区分与类别内演化适应之间的权衡。
Method: 论文形式化 Stage-CIL 范式，提出 Stage-Bench 基准（10 个领域、两阶段协议），同时评测类别间遗忘 (inter-class forgetting) 和类别内的阶段级退化 (stage-level degradation)；并提出 STAGE 参考基线，通过固定大小记忆池将语义身份与演化动态解耦，从而从早期表征进行阶段感知的后期形态预测。
Result: 大量实验显示，传统 CIL 归约方式和现有持续学习基线在 Stage-CIL 下表现不足；STAGE 在评测中一致优于强竞争方法，说明显式演化感知建模在该新设定下有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作表明显式演化感知建模对 Stage-CIL 这一新设定是有前景的方向，并为后续研究提供了基准与参考基线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-Country Learning for National Infectious Disease Forecasting Using European Data
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasting of infectious disease incidence is critical for public health planning and timely intervention. While most data-driven forecasting approaches rely primarily on historical data from a single country, such data are often limited in length and variability, restricting the performance of machine learning (ML) models. In this work, we investigate a cross-country learning approach for infectious disease forecasting, in which a single model is trained on time series data from multiple countries and evaluated on a country of interest. This setting enables the model to exploit shared epidemic dynamics across countries and to benefit from an enlarged training set. We examine this approach through a case study on COVID-19 case forecasting in Cyprus, using surveillance data of European countries. We evaluate multiple models and analyse the impact of the lookback window length and cross-country 'data augmentation' on multi-step forecasting performance. The results show that combining data from other countries can lead to consistent improvements over models trained solely on national data. Although the focus is on Cyprus and COVID-19, the framework and findings provide promising insights for infectious disease forecasting in settings with limited national data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨国家学习（cross-country learning）的传染病发病率预测方法，即用多个国家的时序数据训练单一模型，再在目标国家上评估。以塞浦路斯的新冠病例预测为案例，使用欧洲国家监测数据，比较多种模型并分析 lookback window 长度与跨国家数据增强对多步预测的影响。结果表明引入其他国家数据能稳定提升仅用本国数据训练的模型性能。
Motivation: 多数数据驱动的传染病预测只依赖单一国家的历史数据，而这类数据往往长度有限、变异性不足，限制机器学习模型的性能。作者希望利用多国共享的疫情动态规律并扩大训练集，以改善数据受限国家的预测。
Method: 提出跨国家学习框架：将多个国家的时间序列合并训练一个模型，再对感兴趣的国家进行预测。在塞浦路斯新冠病例预测案例中，使用欧洲国家监测数据，评估多种模型，并考察 lookback window 长度和跨国家数据增强对多步预测的影响。
Result: 摘要报告，合并其他国家数据相比仅用本国数据训练的模型能带来一致的改进（consistent improvements），并分析了窗口长度与数据增强的作用。
Conclusion: 虽然案例聚焦于塞浦路斯和 COVID-19，但作者认为该框架和发现在本国数据有限的传染病预测场景中具有前景；研究局限在于结果基于特定国家与疾病，泛化性仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Where Knowledge Collides: A Mechanistic Study of Intra-Memory Knowledge Conflict in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In language models (LMs), intra-memory knowledge conflict arises when inconsistent information about the same subject is encoded within the model's parametric knowledge. Prior work has primarily focused on resolving conflicts between a model's internal knowledge and external sources, which is known as context-memory knowledge conflict, through approaches such as fine-tuning or knowledge editing, while the understanding of conflicts that arise internally remains largely unexplored. In this work, we design a framework to identify where internal conflicting knowledge is encoded within LMs. We test our framework on four LMs using both synthetic and real-world knowledge conflicts. We find that internal conflicts often arise and are resolved in the final layers across all models, but that interventions are markedly less effective on real-world knowledge conflicts. Targeted attention-head interventions outperform layer-wise ones, and a filtering analysis shows that heads specialized for a single competing fact are far more common in synthetic conflicts, helping explain this gap. Finally, we find no evidence of a single universal circuit for handling knowledge conflict. Instead, our results suggest that distinct circuits may separately encode competing pieces of knowledge, giving rise to conflict. Our results offer a first mechanistic account of intra-memory conflict resolution and highlight a substantial gap between synthetic and real-world settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型内部参数知识中的冲突（intra-memory knowledge conflict），即同一主体在模型参数中被编码了不一致信息。作者设计了定位框架，并在四个语言模型上结合合成与真实世界冲突进行测试，发现内部冲突通常在后几层产生并解决，但对真实冲突的干预效果明显更弱。注意力头干预优于层级干预，且没有发现处理知识冲突的单一通用回路。
Motivation: 已有工作主要关注模型内部知识与外部上下文之间的冲突（context-memory knowledge conflict），但模型参数内部编码的冲突还很少被理解，本文希望补上这一空白。
Method: 设计一个框架来定位语言模型内部冲突知识的编码位置，在四个语言模型上使用合成冲突和真实世界知识冲突进行实验，并比较层级干预与注意力头干预的效果。
Result: 内部冲突往往在最后的层中产生并解决；对真实世界知识冲突的干预效果明显弱于合成冲突；注意力头干预优于层级干预；过滤式分析显示，在合成冲突中专门处理单一竞争事实的注意力头更常见，可解释该差距；没有发现单一通用电路处理知识冲突，不同电路可能分别编码相互竞争的知识。
Conclusion: 该研究首次对模型内部记忆冲突的解决机制给出解释，并强调合成设置与真实世界设置之间存在显著差距。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该研究首次对模型内部记忆冲突的解决机制给出解释，并强调合成设置与真实世界设置之间存在显著差距。

papers.title: ChiEngMixBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Expert-Style Chinese-English Terminology Mixing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly mediate multilingual professional communication, where useful generation requires adapting to community conventions about which expressions are retained, translated, or mixed. Existing benchmarks rarely isolate such community-conditioned choices. We introduce ChiEngMixBench, a controlled benchmark for Chinese AI/CS discourse, where Chinese frames routinely incorporate established English technical terms. Built from public technical discussions, it contains 1,706 source-derived candidate pairs covering 1,344 non-empty normalized terms, including a 1,167-pair strict subset that fixes the Chinese prefix and syntactic position while varying only the terminology form. The benchmark combines paired likelihood comparisons with a transparent reference-profile diagnostic for open-ended responses. Across nine open-weight models, Chinese equivalents receive higher likelihood on most pairs, revealing a gap between source-attested usage and model preference. Specialized terms show a small directional lift that is not robust after frequency and length controls and multiple-comparison correction. Human evaluation and baseline analyses show that reference-profile conformity is informative under the intended mixed-style rubric but does not reliably predict holistic response preference. ChiEngMixBench provides a reusable testbed for community-specific multilingual conventions with explicit diagnostic boundaries.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Substantially revised version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChiEngMixBench，一个用于评估大语言模型在中文 AI/CS 话语中专业风格中英术语混合能力的受控基准。基准从公开技术讨论构建，包含 1,706 对源派生候选对、覆盖 1,344 个非空归一化术语，其中 1,167 对严格子集固定中文前缀和句法位置、仅变化术语形式。通过配对似然比较与参考画像诊断，九个开源权重模型上中文等价词在多数对上获得更高似然，揭示源文本实际用法与模型偏好之间的差距。
Motivation: 大语言模型日益参与多语言专业交流，生成需要符合社区关于保留、翻译或混合哪些表达的约定，而现有基准很少隔离这类社区条件化选择。本文针对中国 AI/CS 话语中中文框架惯用英文术语的现象，构建受控基准来评估模型对这一约定的适应能力。
Method: 从公开技术讨论构建 ChiEngMixBench，结合配对似然比较（paired likelihood comparison）与用于开放式回答的透明参考画像诊断（reference-profile diagnostic）。严格子集固定中文前缀和句法位置，仅变化术语形式；分析中采用频率和长度控制以及多重比较校正。
Result: 在九个开源权重模型上，中文等价词在大多数对上获得更高似然，表明源文本实际用法与模型偏好存在差距。专业术语呈现小的方向性提升，但在频率和长度控制及多重比较校正后不稳健。人类评估与基线分析显示，参考画像符合度在预期混合风格评分标准下具有信息量，但不能可靠预测整体回答偏好。
Conclusion: ChiEngMixBench 为社区特定的多语言术语约定提供了可复用的测试平台，并明确其诊断边界。摘要强调该基准可用于评估模型对特定社区术语混合约定的适应能力。

papers.title: T2VAttack: Adversarial Attack on Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of Text-to-Video (T2V) diffusion models has driven remarkable advancements in generating high-quality, temporally coherent videos from natural language descriptions. Despite these achievements, their vulnerability to adversarial attacks remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce T2VAttack, a comprehensive study of adversarial attacks on T2V diffusion models from both semantic and temporal perspectives. Considering the inherently dynamic nature of video data, we propose two distinct attack objectives: a semantic objective to evaluate video-text alignment and a temporal objective to assess the temporal dynamics. To achieve an effective and efficient attack process, we propose two adversarial attack methods: (i) T2VAttack-S, which identifies semantically or temporally critical words in prompts and replaces them with synonyms via greedy search, and (ii) T2VAttack-I, which iteratively inserts optimized words with minimal perturbation to the prompt. By combining these objectives and strategies, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation on the adversarial robustness of several state-of-the-art T2V models, including ModelScope, CogVideoX, Open-Sora, and HunyuanVideo. Our experiments reveal that even minor prompt modifications, such as the substitution or insertion of a single word, can cause substantial degradation in semantic fidelity and temporal dynamics, highlighting critical vulnerabilities in current T2V diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 T2VAttack，从语义与时序两个角度系统研究文本到视频（T2V）扩散模型的对抗攻击。作者提出两种攻击方法：T2VAttack-S 通过贪心搜索识别提示词中语义或时序关键的字词并替换为同义词，T2VAttack-I 则迭代插入优化词以最小扰动破坏生成结果。实验在 ModelScope、CogVideoX、Open-Sora 和 HunyuanVideo 上进行，显示即使替换或插入单个词语也会显著损害语义保真度与时间动态。
Motivation: T2V 扩散模型在生成高质量时序一致视频方面进展迅速，但其对抗鲁棒性尚未被充分探索，已有研究缺乏对视频数据动态特性的专门攻击视角。
Method: 提出两个攻击目标：语义目标（评估视频-文本对齐）与时序目标（评估时间动态）；并据此设计两类攻击策略，即基于同义词贪心替换的 T2VAttack-S 与基于最小扰动迭代插入的 T2VAttack-I。
Result: 摘要报告在四个 SOTA T2V 模型上的综合评估表明，仅对提示词进行单字词的替换或插入即可导致语义保真度与时序动态的大幅退化，暴露当前模型的明显脆弱性。
Conclusion: 作者强调当前 T2V 扩散模型对微小提示词扰动非常敏感，需要关注其对抗鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Ensemble Schr{ö}dinger Bridge filter for Nonlinear Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces a novel nonlinear optimal filtering method, termed the Ensemble Schr{ö}dinger Bridge nonlinear filter. The proposed filter combines the standard prediction step with a diffusion-generative-modeling-based analysis step, thereby completing one full filtering update. The resulting approach introduces no structural model error, and is derivative-free, training-free, and highly parallelizable. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithm performs effectively for highly nonlinear dynamics and nonlinear observation processes, including chaotic systems with dimension up to 40 and beyond. The results also show that the method outperforms classical approaches such as the ensemble Kalman filter and particle filter across a range of tests with varying degrees of nonlinearity. Future work will focus on extending the proposed method to practical meteorological applications and developing a rigorous convergence theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为 Ensemble Schrödinger Bridge 非线性滤波器的数据同化方法，将标准预测步与基于扩散生成模型 (diffusion generative model) 的分析步结合，完成一次完整的滤波更新。该方法无结构模型误差、无需导数、无需训练且高度可并行。数值实验表明，该方法在高度非线性动力学与非线性观测过程上表现良好，包括维数最高达 40 以上的混沌系统，并在多组非线性程度不同的测试中优于集合卡尔曼滤波 (ensemble Kalman filter) 与粒子滤波 (particle filter)。
Motivation: 非线性数据同化中，经典滤波器（如集合卡尔曼滤波和粒子滤波）在强非线性动力学与非线性观测过程下性能受限。本文旨在提出一种不引入结构模型误差、无需导数且无需训练的滤波更新方式，以应对高维混沌等强非线性系统。
Method: 方法由两阶段组成：沿用标准预测步，并用基于扩散生成模型的 Schrödinger Bridge 分析步替代传统分析步，从而构成完整滤波更新。算法具有无需导数、无需训练、高度可并行化的特点。
Result: 数值实验显示该方法对高度非线性动力学和非线性观测过程有效，可处理维数至 40 以上的混沌系统；在一系列非线性程度不同的测试中优于经典集合卡尔曼滤波和粒子滤波。
Conclusion: 作者认为该滤波器在强非线性数据同化中具有前景，并指出未来工作将扩展至实际气象应用并建立严格的收敛理论。

papers.title: ReCamDriving: LiDAR-Free Camera-Controlled Video Synthesis for Novel Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing multi-pass videos is important for autonomous driving. While current repair-based methods often struggle with out-of-distribution artifacts, camera-controlled methods often produce 3D-inconsistent results due to sparse LiDAR cues. We propose ReCamDriving, a purely vision-based framework that achieves camera-controlled generation by leveraging dense, structurally complete 3DGS renderings as geometric guidance. Specifically, to prevent the model from overfitting to a trivial repair solution when conditioning on 3DGS renderings, we adopt a two-stage progressive training paradigm: the first stage uses camera poses for coarse control, while the second stage incorporates 3DGS renderings for fine-grained viewpoint and geometric guidance. Furthermore, to align training and inference camera transformation patterns, we propose a 3DGS-based cross-trajectory data curation strategy, enabling consistent lateral-trajectory supervision from single-pass videos. Based on this strategy, we construct the ParaDrive dataset, containing approximately 110K parallel-trajectory video pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReCamDriving achieves state-of-the-art camera controllability and structural consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCamDriving，一个纯视觉（LiDAR-free）的摄像头可控驾驶视频合成框架，用于生成新轨迹的多视角行车视频。其核心是用稠密且结构完整的 3DGS 渲染图作为几何引导，并采用两阶段渐进训练避免模型退化为简单的修复方案；同时提出基于 3DGS 的跨轨迹数据整理策略，从单遍视频构造横向轨迹监督，构建约 11 万对平行轨迹视频的 ParaDrive 数据集。实验表明该方法在摄像头可控性和结构一致性上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有修复类（repair-based）方法容易产生分布外伪影，而摄像头控制类方法因 LiDAR 线索稀疏常导致 3D 不一致的结果。论文旨在仅依靠视觉信息实现一致且可控的摄像头轨迹视频生成。
Method: 采用纯视觉框架，将稠密且结构完整的 3DGS 渲染作为几何引导；训练分两阶段进行，第一阶段用相机位姿做粗控制，第二阶段引入 3DGS 渲染提供细粒度视角与几何约束。此外提出基于 3DGS 的跨轨迹数据整理策略，用于对齐训练与推理的相机变换模式，并据此构建包含约 110K 对平行轨迹视频的 ParaDrive 数据集。
Result: 大量实验表明，ReCamDriving 在摄像头可控性和结构一致性上达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为，利用稠密 3DGS 渲染作为几何引导并配合两阶段训练与跨轨迹数据整理，可以在不依赖 LiDAR 的情况下实现一致且可控的驾驶视频合成。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Audio-Visual World Models: Learning Physically Grounded Multisensory Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: World models simulate environmental dynamics to enable embodied agents to plan and reason about future states. While real-world perception is inherently multimodal, existing approaches focus primarily on visual observations, leaving crucial spatial and temporal acoustic cues underexplored. In this work, we present a unified formulation of Audio-Visual World Models (AVWM), casting multimodal environment simulation under action control as a partially observable Markov decision process with synchronized audio-visual observations. As a foundational benchmark, we construct AVW-4k, comprising 30 hours of action-annotated binaural audio-visual trajectories across 76 indoor environments. To capture these physically grounded multisensory dynamics, we propose AV-CDiT (Audio-Visual Conditional Diffusion Transformer), featuring a novel modality expert architecture that balances visual and auditory learning, optimized via a three-stage training strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AV-CDiT achieves high-fidelity prediction across both visual and auditory modalities. Furthermore, we validate its practical utility in embodied navigation, showing that AVWM significantly enhances a pretrained agent in continuous audio-visual navigation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出音频-视觉世界模型（Audio-Visual World Models, AVWM）的统一公式，将多模态环境模拟建模为具有同步音频-视觉观测的部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并构建包含30小时动作标注双耳音视频轨迹的AVW-4k基准。方法上提出AV-CDiT（Audio-Visual Conditional Diffusion Transformer），采用模态专家架构平衡视觉与听觉学习，并通过三阶段训练策略优化。实验表明其在视觉和听觉模态上均实现高保真预测，并在连续音频-视觉导航任务中显著提升预训练智能体的性能。
Motivation: 现实世界的感知本质上是多模态的，但现有世界模型主要聚焦视觉观测，忽略了空间和时间声学线索。论文旨在填补这一空白，探索在动作控制下如何模拟物理基础的多感官环境动力学。
Method: 将多模态环境模拟形式化为带同步音视频观测的POMDP，并以此构建基准AVW-4k，包含76个室内环境中30小时的动作标注双耳音视频轨迹。提出AV-CDiT，其核心是一种模态专家架构来平衡视觉和听觉学习，配合三阶段训练策略进行优化。
Result: 大量实验表明AV-CDiT在视觉与听觉两个模态上均能达到高保真预测；进一步的实验验证该方法在连续音频-视觉导航任务中的实用性，能够显著增强预训练智能体的性能。
Conclusion: 论文展示了将音频信号纳入世界模型对具身导航的有效性，为多模态世界模型研究提供了统一公式、基准（AVW-4k）与方法（AV-CDiT）。

papers.title: Embedded Universal Predictive Intelligence: a coherent framework for multi-agent learning
papers.abstract_en: The standard theory of model-free reinforcement learning assumes that the environment dynamics are stationary and that agents are decoupled from their environment, such that policies are treated as being separate from the world they inhabit. This leads to theoretical challenges in the multi-agent setting where the non-stationarity induced by the learning of other agents demands prospective learning based on prediction models. To accurately model other agents, an agent must account for the fact that those other agents are, in turn, forming beliefs about it to predict its future behavior, motivating agents to model themselves as part of the environment. Here, building upon foundational work on universal artificial intelligence (AIXI), we introduce a mathematical framework for prospective learning and embedded agency centered on self-prediction, where Bayesian RL agents predict both future perceptual inputs and their own actions, and must therefore resolve epistemic uncertainty about themselves as part of the universe they inhabit. We show that in multi-agent settings, self-prediction enables agents to reason about others running similar algorithms, leading to new game-theoretic solution concepts and novel forms of cooperation unattainable by classical decoupled agents. Moreover, we extend the theory of AIXI, and study universally intelligent embedded agents which start from a Solomonoff prior. We show that these idealized agents can form consistent mutual predictions and achieve infinite-order theory of mind, potentially setting a gold standard for embedded multi-agent learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向多智能体学习的数学框架，称为嵌入式通用预测智能（Embedded Universal Predictive Intelligence），以自预测（self-prediction）为核心，让贝叶斯强化学习智能体同时预测未来感知输入和自身动作，并把自身视为所栖居宇宙的一部分。作者基于通用人工智能理论AIXI，将框架扩展到使用Solomonoff先验的理想化嵌入式智能体，并论证这类智能体能形成一致的相互预测并达到无限阶心智理论（infinite-order theory of mind）。
Motivation: 标准无模型强化学习假设环境动态平稳且智能体与环境解耦，策略被视为独立于其所在世界；在多智能体场景中，其他智能体学习带来的非平稳性要求基于预测模型的前瞻学习，而准确建模其他智能体又需要递归地考虑对方如何预测自己，因此需要把自身建模为环境的一部分。
Method: 构建以自预测为中心的数学框架，使贝叶斯RL智能体不仅预测未来感知输入，也预测自身动作，从而必须解决对自身作为宇宙一员的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）；并在此基础上扩展AIXI理论，研究从Solomonoff先验出发的通用嵌入式智能体。
Result: 摘要表明，在多智能体设置中，自预测使智能体能够推理其他运行相似算法的智能体，从而产生经典解耦智能体无法获得的新博弈论解概念与合作形式；理想化智能体还能形成一致的相互预测，并具备无限阶心智理论。
Conclusion: 该框架为嵌入式多智能体学习提供了数学基础，并可能为这类学习设定一个金标准（gold standard）；全文共202页，属于理论性长篇论文。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Guided Adaptive Safety Alignment: Synthesizing and Internalizing Guidelines in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Explicit safety policies can improve reasoning-model safety, but their effective coverage may lag behind evolving jailbreak strategies. We study whether a reasoning model can synthesize and internalize a task-specific safety guideline from a small set of harmful and benign examples. We introduce Self-Guided Adaptive Safety Alignment (SGASA). The model generates a guideline, refines it on its own errors, and selects a version by self-evaluation, which can then be applied in context or distilled into the model for guideline-free inference. Across two adversarial prompt datasets and three Qwen3 scales, in-context guidelines improve a combined safety and non-over-refusal score by 20.0-45.5 points on the 8B and 14B models. Self-evaluation selects the externally best refinement round in five of six settings, while guideline generation and utilization show distinct scaling patterns. Using alignment supervision derived only from WildJailbreak, internalized models retain 13.3-14.1 point gains on WildJailbreak without an inference-time guideline. These results support self-generated guidelines as a useful intermediate representation for low-resource safety adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Guided Adaptive Safety Alignment (SGASA)，让推理模型从少量有害与良性示例中自行合成并内化任务相关的安全准则。准则由模型生成、基于自身错误迭代精炼，并通过自评估挑选版本，可上下文应用或蒸馏进模型以实现无准则推理。实验显示，在两个对抗性提示数据集和三种 Qwen3 规模下，上下文准则在 8B 与 14B 模型上使安全性与非过度拒绝的联合分数提升 20.0-45.5 点；仅用 WildJailbreak 的监督信号蒸馏后，内部化模型在 WildJailbreak 上仍保持 13.3-14.1 点的收益。
Motivation: 显式安全策略虽能提升推理模型的安全性，但其覆盖范围可能落后于不断演化的越狱策略。论文考察推理模型能否从少量有害与良性示例中合成并内化任务特定的安全准则，以应对低资源安全适配场景。
Method: 引入 Self-Guided Adaptive Safety Alignment (SGASA)：模型生成一条准则，基于自身错误进行精炼，并通过自评估选择最终版本；该准则既可放入上下文使用，也可通过蒸馏内化到模型中，从而实现无推理时准则的推理。
Result: 在两个对抗性提示数据集和三种 Qwen3 规模下，上下文准则在 8B 与 14B 模型上将安全性与非过度拒绝的联合分数提升 20.0-45.5 点；自评估在六种设置中的五种选出了外部最优的精炼轮次。仅以 WildJailbreak 作为对齐监督来源时，内部化模型在 WildJailbreak 上无需推理时准则仍保留 13.3-14.1 点的增益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，自生成准则可作为低资源安全适配中一种有用的中间表示（intermediate representation），支持准则生成与利用的独立扩展规律。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Target-Aware Early Stage Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Early Stage Ranking (ESR) in large-scale recommendation systems is dominated by ''user--item decoupling'' Two Tower architectures, which scale efficiently but cannot capture fine-grained, target-aware user--item interactions directly. We propose Target-Aware Early Stage Ranking (TESR), which augments the Two Tower with a Mixture of Attention (MoA) module trained as a request-level sequence modeling over user history. MoA combines (i) Hard Matching Attention (HMA) to capture explicit categorical-ID level overlap signals between user history and candidate item, (ii) target-aware HSTU attention for implicit affinities conditioned on the candidate, and (iii) target dependent and independent cross-attention for symmetric user-item contextualization. On top of this, a Multi-Logit Parameterized Gating (MLPG) head amplifies these signals at scoring time. To keep latency within ESR budgets, we co-design the architecture with FP8 quantization, custom kernels, and a Torch Inductor compilation path. On a production deployment, TESR delivers consistent offline NE wins and online topline gains, and is, to our knowledge, the first deployment of full target-aware attention sequence modeling in an ESR stage at this scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Target-Aware Early Stage Ranking (TESR)，在推荐系统早期排序 (ESR) 阶段为 Two Tower 架构加入 Mixture of Attention (MoA) 模块，通过请求级序列建模捕捉目标感知的用户-物品交互。MoA 结合硬匹配注意力 (HMA)、目标感知 HSTU 注意力以及目标相关与无关的交叉注意力，并用 Multi-Logit Parameterized Gating (MLPG) 头在打分时放大信号；同时配合 FP8 量化、自定义 kernel 与 Torch Inductor 编译路径控制延迟。生产部署显示离线 NE 与在线指标均有提升，作者称这是该规模下首次在 ESR 阶段部署完整的目标感知注意力序列建模。
Motivation: 大规模推荐系统的早期排序阶段主要由用户-物品解耦的 Two Tower 架构主导，这类架构扩展性好，但无法直接捕获细粒度的、目标感知 (target-aware) 的用户-物品交互信号。
Method: 提出 TESR，在 Two Tower 之上增加 Mixture of Attention (MoA) 模块：包括用于显式类别 ID 重叠信号的 Hard Matching Attention (HMA)、以候选物品为条件的目标感知 HSTU 注意力，以及目标相关与独立交叉注意力；再用 Multi-Logit Parameterized Gating (MLPG) 打分头放大这些信号。为满足 ESR 延迟预算，架构与 FP8 量化、自定义 kernel 及 Torch Inductor 编译路径协同设计。
Result: 在生产部署中，TESR 带来一致的离线 NE (Normalized Entropy) 提升和在线 top-line 增益；作者声称这是首次在如此规模的 ESR 阶段部署完整的目标感知注意力序列建模。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过架构与量化/编译路径的协同设计，可以在 ESR 延迟预算内引入目标感知注意力序列建模；具体局限和更多实验细节未在摘要中展开。

papers.title: MIMIC-MJX: Neuromechanical Emulation of Animal Behavior
papers.abstract_en: The primary output of the nervous system is movement and behavior. While recent advances have democratized pose tracking during complex behavior, kinematic trajectories alone provide only indirect access to the underlying control processes. Here we present MIMIC-MJX, a framework for learning biomechanically grounded neural control policies from kinematics. MIMIC-MJX provides a platform for modeling the generative process of motor control by training neural controllers that learn to actuate biomechanical animal models in physics simulation to reproduce real kinematic trajectories. We demonstrate that our implementation is accurate, fast, and generalizable to diverse animal body models, and that it can be trained with modest amounts of motion data. MIMIC-MJX can be used to model motor control policies and simulate behavioral experiments, illustrating its potential as an integrative modeling framework for neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIMIC-MJX，一个从运动学数据学习生物力学约束的神经控制策略的框架。该框架在物理仿真中训练神经控制器驱动生物力学动物模型，以复现真实运动轨迹，从而对运动控制的生成过程进行建模。摘要声称该实现准确、快速、可泛化到多种动物身体模型，并且只需适度的运动数据即可训练。作者认为它可以用于建模运动控制策略和模拟行为实验，作为神经科学的整合建模框架。
Motivation: 神经系统的主要输出是运动和行为，但仅靠运动学轨迹难以直接反映背后的控制过程。作者希望提供一个能够建模运动控制生成过程的平台，弥补运动学数据与底层控制机制之间的鸿沟。
Method: MIMIC-MJX 是一种学习生物力学 grounded 的神经控制策略的框架：在物理仿真中训练神经控制器，驱动生物力学动物模型以复现真实的运动学轨迹。它支持多种动物身体模型，并可用较少的运动数据进行训练。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在准确性、速度和泛化性方面表现良好，能够适应多样化的动物身体模型，并可在适度的运动数据量下完成训练。

papers.title: Design Criteria for SGD Preconditioners: Local Conditioning, Noise Floors, and Basin Stability
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) often slows in the late stage of training due to anisotropic curvature and gradient noise. We analyze preconditioned SGD in the geometry induced by a symmetric positive definite matrix $\mathbf{M}$, deriving bounds in which both the convergence rate and the stochastic noise floor are governed by $\mathbf{M}$-dependent quantities: the rate through an effective condition number in the $\mathbf{M}$-metric, and the floor through the product of that condition number and the preconditioned noise level. For nonconvex objectives, we establish a preconditioner-dependent basin-stability guarantee: when smoothness and basin size are measured in the $\mathbf{M}$-norm, the probability that the iterates remain in a well-behaved local region admits an explicit lower bound. This perspective is particularly relevant in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML), where achieving small training loss under stochastic updates is closely tied to physical fidelity, numerical stability, and constraint satisfaction. The framework applies to both diagonal/adaptive and curvature-aware preconditioners and yields a simple design principle: choose $\mathbf{M}$ to improve local conditioning while attenuating noise. Experiments on a quadratic diagnostic and three SciML benchmarks validate the predicted rate-floor behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在对称正定矩阵 M 诱导的几何下分析预条件 SGD，推导出收敛速率与随机噪声下限 (noise floor) 均由 M 相关量控制的界：速率由 M-度量下的有效条件数决定，噪声下限由该条件数与预条件噪声水平的乘积决定。对非凸目标，作者给出依赖预条件子的局部盆地稳定性 (basin stability) 保证，指出在 M-范数下度量光滑性与盆尺寸时，迭代停留在良好局部区域的概率有显式下界。实验在二次诊断问题与三个 SciML 基准上验证了预测的速率-噪声行为。
Motivation: SGD 在训练后期常因各向异性曲率和梯度噪声而变慢，现有分析缺乏对预条件子设计准则的统一刻画，尤其在科学机器学习 (SciML) 中，小训练损失与物理保真、数值稳定和约束满足密切相关。
Method: 作者分析了由对称正定矩阵 M 诱导的几何下预条件 SGD，推导收敛速率与随机噪声下限的界，并为非凸目标建立预条件子依赖的盆地稳定性概率下界。框架统一适用于对角/自适应预条件子和曲率感知预条件子，并给出简单设计原则：选择 M 同时改善局部条件数与衰减噪声。
Result: 摘要报告实验在一个二次诊断问题和三个 SciML 基准上验证了预测的速率-噪声行为，确认有效条件数控制收敛速率、条件数与预条件噪声水平的乘积控制随机噪声下限。
Conclusion: 论文强调将预条件子的选择视为改善局部条件数与衰减噪声的双目标设计问题，该视角对 SciML 中需要低训练损失的场景尤其有意义。

papers.title: Externally Validated Breast Ultrasound Segmentation via Multi-task Learning with BI-RADS-Consistent Morphological Priors
papers.abstract_en: External validation of breast ultrasound segmentation models remains limited because internal train--test splits do not capture domain shifts across imaging systems, acquisition protocols, and patient populations. We introduce a novel multi-task framework for breast ultrasound segmentation and malignancy classification. Its central methodological advance is a differentiable morphology-to-malignancy bridge: lesion area, boundary roughness, compactness, and texture are computed from the predicted soft segmentation mask, aggregated with learned weights into a morphology-based malignancy score, and constrained to agree with the image-level classifier. To our knowledge, this is the first breast ultrasound framework to use BI-RADS-inspired morphology derived from its own soft segmentation output as an end-to-end consistency target for malignancy classification. It is also the first 2D B-mode multi-task study to report every directed external transfer among four independent datasets: training on each dataset and testing on the other three yields 12 source--target pairs, assessed with single models and five-fold ensembles. In matched comparisons across all pairs, the proposed single-model configuration outperforms dedicated single-task baselines in segmentation (DC: 0.764 vs. 0.740) and malignancy classification (AUC: 0.818 vs. 0.791). The ensemble achieves a mean external DC of 0.786 and is competitive with SAM-based segmentation methods using an EfficientNet-B7 encoder while also predicting malignancy. The learned morphology weights retain the same ordering across all four datasets, with boundary roughness receiving the greatest weight. These results establish the first complete four-dataset directed benchmark for joint 2D breast ultrasound segmentation and malignancy classification and demonstrate that clinically grounded morphological consistency improves both tasks under domain shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于乳腺超声分割与恶性分类的多任务框架，核心创新是可微的形态-恶性桥接 (differentiable morphology-to-malignancy bridge)：从预测的软分割掩码计算病灶面积、边界粗糙度、紧致度和纹理，经学习权重聚合成形态学恶性评分，并与图像级分类器保持一致。作者在四个独立数据集上报告了全部 12 个定向外部迁移 (source-target pair)，并声称这是首个使用 BI-RADS 启发形态学作为端到端一致性目标、以及首个覆盖四数据集定向迁移的 2D B-mode 多任务研究。
Motivation: 乳腺超声分割模型的外部验证仍然有限，因为内部训练-测试划分无法捕捉不同成像系统、采集协议和患者群体之间的域偏移 (domain shift)，导致模型泛化性评估不足。
Method: 提出多任务框架联合优化乳腺超声分割和恶性分类，其中形态学特征从软分割掩码中可微地计算，并通过学习权重聚合为形态学恶性评分，约束该评分与图像级分类器输出一致；评估采用训练于每个数据集、测试于其余三个数据集的 12 个定向迁移对，使用单模型和五折集成。
Result: 在所有迁移对的匹配比较中，单模型配置优于专用单任务基线：分割 DC 0.764 对 0.740，恶性分类 AUC 0.818 对 0.791；集成模型平均外部 DC 为 0.786，在使用 EfficientNet-B7 编码器的同时与基于 SAM 的分割方法相当，并额外预测恶性。学习到的形态学权重在四个数据集上保持相同排序，其中边界粗糙度权重最大。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作建立了首个四数据集定向基准，用于联合 2D 乳腺超声分割与恶性分类，并证明临床驱动的形态学一致性在域偏移下能同时改善两个任务。

papers.title: STREAM-VAE: Dual-Path Routing for Slow and Fast Dynamics in Vehicle Telemetry Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Automotive telemetry data exhibits slow drifts and fast spikes, often within the same sequence, making reliable anomaly detection challenging. Standard reconstruction-based methods, including sequence variational autoencoders (VAEs), use a single latent process and therefore mix heterogeneous time scales, which can smooth out spikes or inflate variances and weaken anomaly separation. In this paper, we present STREAM-VAE, a variational autoencoder for anomaly detection in automotive telemetry time-series data. Our model uses a dual-path encoder to separate slow drift and fast spike signal dynamics, and a decoder that represents transient deviations separately from the normal operating pattern. STREAM-VAE is designed for deployment, producing stable anomaly scores across operating modes for both in-vehicle monitors and backend fleet analytics. Experiments on an automotive telemetry dataset and the public SMD benchmark show that explicitly separating drift and spike dynamics improves robustness compared to strong forecasting, attention, graph, and VAE baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STREAM-VAE，一种用于汽车遥测时间序列异常检测的变分自编码器。模型采用双路径编码器（dual-path encoder）分离缓慢漂移与快速尖峰信号动力学，并用解码器将瞬态偏差与正常工况模式分别表示，以在单个序列中同时处理慢漂移和快尖峰。实验在汽车遥测数据集和公开的 SMD 基准上表明，显式分离漂移与尖峰动力学相比强预测、注意力、图网络和 VAE 基线提升了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 汽车遥测数据常在同一序列中同时包含缓慢漂移和快速尖峰，而基于重建的标准方法（包括序列 VAE）使用单一潜过程，会混合不同时间尺度，导致尖峰被平滑或方差被夸大，削弱异常与正常的分离能力。
Method: 提出双路径编码器结构，分别建模慢漂移和快尖峰两类信号动力学；解码器将瞬态偏差与正常操作模式分开表示，从而在重建中保留异常瞬态信息。
Result: 在汽车遥测数据集和公开的 SMD 基准上，显式分离漂移与尖峰动力学比强预测、注意力、图网络和 VAE 基线更稳健；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: STREAM-VAE 面向部署设计，能在不同运行模式下为车载监控和后端车队分析提供稳定的异常分数。

papers.title: CLIP4VI-ReID: Learning Modality-shared Representations via CLIP Semantic Bridge for Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel CLIP-driven modality-shared representation learning network named CLIP4VI-ReID for VI-ReID task, which consists of Text Semantic Generation (TSG), Infrared Feature Embedding (IFE), and High-level Semantic Alignment (HSA). Specifically, considering the huge gap in the physical characteristics between natural images and infrared images, the TSG is designed to generate text semantics only for visible images, thereby enabling preliminary visible-text modality alignment. Then, the IFE is proposed to rectify the feature embeddings of infrared images using the generated text semantics. This process injects id-related semantics into the shared image encoder, enhancing its adaptability to the infrared modality. Besides, with text serving as a bridge, it enables indirect visible-infrared modality alignment. Finally, the HSA is established to refine the high-level semantic alignment. This process ensures that the fine-tuned text semantics only contain id-related information, thereby achieving more accurate cross-modal alignment and enhancing the discriminability of the learned modal-shared representations. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CLIP4VI-ReID achieves superior performance than other state-of-the-art methods on some widely used VI-ReID datasets.
papers.comment: This article has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIP 驱动的模态共享表征学习网络 CLIP4VI-ReID，用于可见光-红外行人重识别（VI-ReID）任务。网络由文本语义生成（Text Semantic Generation, TSG）、红外特征嵌入（Infrared Feature Embedding, IFE）和高层语义对齐（High-level Semantic Alignment, HSA）三部分组成，以文本作为语义桥实现可见光与红外模态的间接对齐。摘要在多个广泛使用的 VI-ReID 数据集上报告了优于已有方法的结果。
Motivation: 可见光图像与红外图像在物理特性上差异巨大，跨模态语义鸿沟使得两类图像的表征难以直接对齐。现有方法缺少利用 CLIP 文本语义作为桥梁来缩小该差距的机制，本文旨在通过文本语义注入身份相关信息，使共享图像编码器更好地适应红外模态并提升模态共享表征的判别性。
Method: 提出 CLIP4VI-ReID 网络，包含三个模块：TSG 仅对可见光图像生成文本语义，完成初步的可见光-文本模态对齐；IFE 使用生成的文本语义修正红外图像的特征嵌入，将身份相关语义注入共享图像编码器；HSA 进一步精炼高层语义对齐，确保微调后的文本语义仅保留身份相关信息，从而实现更准确的跨模态对齐。
Result: 实验部分在多个广泛使用的 VI-ReID 数据集上验证了该方法，摘要称 CLIP4VI-ReID 取得了优于其他最先进方法的性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于文本语义桥的间接可见光-红外对齐以及高层语义精炼能够提升模态共享表征的判别性与跨模态对齐准确性；摘要未提及方法的局限性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调基于文本语义桥的间接可见光-红外对齐以及高层语义精炼能够提升模态共享表征的判别性与跨模态对齐准确性；摘要未提及方法的局限性。

papers.title: $π$-Attention: Online Efficient Sparse Transformers for Long-Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention is crucial in long-context Transformers, which restricts each token to a limited neighborhood and thereby reduces the quadratic cost of full self-attention. Local windows capture nearby context effectively, yet they induce a receptive-field bottleneck for dependencies beyond the window, limiting long-range modeling under moderate depth. In this paper, we propose $π$-Attention, an \emph{online efficient} sparse attention operator: as tokens arrive, each step maintains a streaming working set of local neighbors plus a $π$-indexed long-range fetch, fused by an adaptive prior under a shared softmax. Rather than materializing a global sparse mask in advance, $π$-Attention computes attention on the live working set with hierarchy-aware IO. We analyze causal reachability and minimum depth under this online rule, and show per-step cost remains $\mathcal{O}(k)$. Experiments on language modeling, Long Range Arena, and efficiency profiling---across 4K--32K context lengths---show consistent gains over local-window and other sparse baselines, approaching dense attention quality at linear cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 π-Attention，一种在线高效稀疏注意力算子：每个 token 到达时，维护一个由局部邻居和 π 索引长距离取数组成的流式工作集，并在共享 softmax 下用自适应先验融合。与预先物化全局稀疏掩码不同，π-Attention 在实时工作集上进行层级感知 IO 的注意力计算，每步代价为 O(k)。作者分析了该在线规则下的因果可达性与最小深度，并在语言建模、Long Range Arena 和效率剖析（4K-32K 上下文长度）上显示一致改进，接近稠密注意力质量且保持线性代价。
Motivation: 局部窗口稀疏注意力能有效捕捉相邻上下文，但对窗口之外的长程依赖存在感受野瓶颈，限制中深度模型的长程建模能力；同时许多稀疏注意力方法需要预先构造全局稀疏掩码，带来额外开销。
Method: 提出 π-Attention 在线稀疏注意力算子：token 到达时每一步维护流式工作集（局部邻居加 π 索引长距离取数），通过共享 softmax 下的自适应先验融合两部分信息，并在实时工作集上以层级感知 IO 的方式计算注意力，避免显式物化全局稀疏掩码。
Result: 摘要报告在语言建模、Long Range Arena 和效率剖析中，跨 4K-32K 上下文长度一致优于局部窗口及其他稀疏基线；每步计算代价为 O(k)，以线性成本接近稠密注意力质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过在线工作集和 π 索引式长距离取数，能在保持每步线性代价的同时缓解局部窗口的感受野瓶颈；同时给出了因果可达性和最小深度的理论分析。
Relevance: 2
