papers.title: Modeling Scientific Experiment Scenes: Dataset and Model
papers.abstract_en: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) is fundamental to structured visual understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on daily life images and overlook scientific experiment scenes with specialized instruments, task-specific experimental semantics, and dense, fine-grained physical relations. These scenes are increasingly important for automated experimental analysis and smart education. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysScene, the first SGG dataset for physical experiment scenes, providing densely annotated scene graphs and benchmarks under multiple supervision and protocol settings. PhysScene further exposes two key algorithmic challenges for SGG: pronounced long-tail relational predicate distributions and a substantial visual-textual semantic gap. To address these challenges, we propose the Cross-Modal Dual-Path Generator (CM-DPG), a model for robust open-vocabulary SGG. The model enhances object-level semantic representations through joint visual-textual encoding and improves relational reasoning using complementary visual and geometric cues. We also incorporate relation-aware pre-training, caption-derived pseudo-supervision, and adaptive weighting to support balanced learning across head and tail predicates. Extensive experiments on PhysScene and VG150 show that CM-DPG achieves competitive performance across multiple evaluation settings, with ablation studies validating the contribution of each component. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/ZMH-SDUST/CM-DPG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysScene，首个面向物理实验场景的场景图生成（SGG）数据集，包含密集标注的场景图和多种监督与协议设置下的基准。数据集暴露出关系谓词长尾分布和视觉-文本语义差距两大挑战，作者据此提出跨模态双路径生成器（CM-DPG），通过联合视觉-文本编码、互补视觉与几何线索增强关系推理，并引入关系感知预训练、字幕伪监督和自适应加权。实验在 PhysScene 和 VG150 上取得有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: 现有 SGG 基准主要覆盖日常图像，缺乏包含专业仪器、任务特定实验语义和密集细粒度物理关系的科学实验场景；这类场景对自动化实验分析和智慧教育日益重要。
Method: 提出 CM-DPG 模型：用联合视觉-文本编码增强对象级语义表示，利用互补的视觉和几何线索改进关系推理；结合关系感知预训练、由字幕衍生的伪监督以及自适应权重，在头尾谓词之间实现平衡学习。
Result: 在 PhysScene 和 VG150 上的大量实验表明，CM-DPG 在多种评估设置下取得有竞争力的性能；消融研究验证了各组件的作用。
Conclusion: 论文强调 PhysScene 数据集和 CM-DPG 模型为科学实验场景的结构化视觉理解提供了新的基准和方法，并公开了数据集与代码。

papers.title: Population-Robust Feature Selection via Generalized Welfare Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Choosing which features to collect is a deployment decision: the same limited questionnaire, test panel, or sensor set may need to serve several heterogeneous populations. Standard feature-selection methods typically optimize for one large population, while existing robust approaches tend to learn one shared model for every population. We introduce PopFS, a method for learning one shared, deployable feature set that is robust to population differences while letting each pop- ulation train its own model. PopFS uses a tunable welfare objective that lets practitioners balance overall predictive ben- efit against stronger protection of the populations that benefit least. To make this objective practical at scale, PopFS first uses multitask sparse learning to reduce the candidate pool, then searches directly over hard feature sets by ranking promising additions and swaps and fully refitting only a shortlist. Across eight population splits from six prediction tasks drawn from five tabular and public-health datasets, PopFS consistently achieves strong average and worst-population performance while scaling to thousands of candidate features. A 43-state COVID-19 nowcasting study further shows that changing the welfare objective can improve the least-served states with lit- tle change in average performance and yields an interpretable change in the selected symptom signals. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rachel-Lyu/PopFS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PopFS，一种面向多个异质群体的共享特征集学习方法，允许各群体使用同一特征集训练自己的模型。方法采用可调 welfare objective 在整体预测收益与对获益最少群体的保护之间权衡，并通过多任务稀疏学习缩减候选池、对硬特征集进行搜索。在五个表格/公共卫生数据集上的八个群体划分中，PopFS 在平均和最差群体性能上表现稳定，并扩展到数千候选特征；43 州 COVID-19 nowcasting 研究显示改变 welfare 目标可在平均性能几乎不变的情况下改善最差州，并产生可解释的症状信号变化。
Motivation: 标准特征选择方法通常针对单一大人群优化，而现有鲁棒方法倾向于为所有群体学习一个共享模型，难以满足同一问卷、测试面板或传感器组需要服务多个异质人群的部署需求。
Method: 提出 PopFS：使用可调 welfare objective 让使用者平衡整体预测收益与对获益最少群体的更强保护；先利用多任务稀疏学习 (multitask sparse learning) 缩减候选特征池，再通过按排名选择有前景的添加和交换 (promising additions and swaps) 直接搜索硬特征集，仅对短名单进行完全重拟合。
Result: 在来自五个表格与公共卫生数据集的六个预测任务的八个群体划分上，PopFS 持续取得强平均与最差群体性能，并扩展到数千候选特征；43 州 COVID-19 nowcasting 研究表明改变 welfare objective 能以很小的平均性能代价改善最差州，并产生可解释的症状信号变化。
Conclusion: PopFS 提供了一种共享、可部署且对群体差异鲁棒的特征集学习方案，同时允许每个群体训练自己的模型；论文强调该目标在实际规模上可操作，并开源了代码。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Test Time Adaptation Methods for Point Cloud Registration in Laparoscopic Surgery
papers.abstract_en: 3D point cloud registration in laparoscopic surgery estimates the transformation between an intraoperative organ reconstructed from video and its preoperative mesh. Because ground-truth transformations are unavailable for real data, supervised networks are trained on synthetic organ pairs. At test time, real reconstructions differ from synthetic data and are noisy, sparse, and occluded, which degrades correspondence estimation. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can reduce this domain shift, but existing methods mainly rely on logits, entropy, class prototypes, or cache memories unavailable in registration. Registration also involves paired inputs with an asymmetric shift that primarily affects the intraoperative cloud. We analyse and modify state-of-the-art TTA methods from three families to 3D registration: model, normalization, and input adaptation. We analyze four representative approaches based on auxiliary-task model updates, backpropagation-free token purging, feature alignment, and layer-normalization calibration. We modify them to handle asymmetric shifts between preoperative and intraoperative point clouds and replace classification-based entropy objectives. Using a correspondence-based model trained on clean synthetic source data, we evaluate adaptation to corrupted synthetic and real target data on P2P and P2ILReg. For synthetic targets, we apply eight corruptions, including uniform noise and global density reduction, at five severity levels. All methods improve registration on P2P, whereas normalization adaptation degrades performance on P2ILReg. Considering the computational overhead of backpropagation-based adaptation, input adaptation is the most promising option for laparoscopic surgery, providing low inference latency and consistent error reductions across datasets. Code: https://github.com/ninaa-git/survey_pc_registration_tta
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究腹腔镜手术中三维点云配准（point cloud registration）的测试时自适应（test-time adaptation, TTA）问题，目标是修正术前网格与术中重建点云之间的领域偏移。作者将来自模型、归一化和输入自适应三个 TTA 家族的四类代表性方法改造为适用于配准任务，并在 P2P 与 P2ILReg 数据集上评估其对污染合成目标与真实目标的适应效果。结果显示输入自适应方案在推理延迟与误差降低上均表现稳定，是最具前景的选择。
Motivation: 监督式配准网络在合成器官对上训练，而真实术中重建数据存在噪声、稀疏和遮挡，且无法获得 ground-truth 变换，导致测试时域偏移显著。现有 TTA 方法多依赖 logits、熵、类原型或缓存记忆，这些在配准任务中不可用；且配准涉及术前与术中点云之间的非对称偏移，主要影响术中云。
Method: 作者将三个 TTA 家族的四种代表性方法——基于辅助任务的模型更新、免反向传播的 token 清理、特征对齐、层归一化校准——改造为适用于三维配准的形式，使其能处理术前与术中点云的非对称偏移，并替换掉基于分类的熵目标。评估使用在干净合成源数据上训练的 correspondence-based 模型，对污染合成与真实目标数据进行适应。
Result: 在合成目标上测试了五种严重程度下的八种污染（包括均匀噪声与全局密度降低）。所有方法在 P2P 上均提升配准精度，但归一化自适应在 P2ILReg 上反而降低性能；输入自适应在低推理延迟前提下于两个数据集上取得一致的误差降低。
Conclusion: 考虑到反向传播类自适应的计算开销，输入自适应是腹腔镜手术场景中最实用的 TTA 方案，其代码已公开在 GitHub。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Field Aware Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: As lifelong learning agents accumulate lifelong growing skill banks, retrieving the correct skill becomes an increasingly important bottleneck. Most current skill retrieval methods treat each skill as one flat document by concatenating fields such as the name, description, and body. However, skills are naturally structured, multi-field objects, where each field provides different information about when and how the skill should be used. In this work, we study whether preserving this structure improves skill retrieval. We represent each skill as its separate components, and compute sparse and dense similarities for each field independently, exposing a naturally tensorized, field-aware representation of the skill bank. We then combine these field-level scores either with uniform weights or with a small learned MLP. Across two different skill retrieval benchmarks, SkillRet and SRA-Bench, we find that keeping fields separate improves hybrid retrieval, and learning over the field-level scores gives the strongest and most consistent results. Our field-aware MLP reaches $77.95$ Recall@10 on SkillRet and $83.78$ Recall@10 on SRA-Bench, outperforming the corresponding concatenated learned baselines. We also find that the advantage grows as the skill bank becomes larger, suggesting that field-aware skill retrieval becomes especially useful in the setting where retrieval is most difficult. Our results show that skill representation itself matters, and that simply preserving the structure already present in skill files can substantially improve retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究终身学习智能体在技能库不断扩大时的技能检索问题，提出保留技能的多字段结构而非将其扁平拼接。作者将每个技能拆分为独立组件，对各字段分别计算稀疏与稠密相似度，形成张量化（tensorized）的字段感知表示，再以均匀权重或小型学习后的 MLP 融合字段级分数。在 SkillRet 和 SRA-Bench 两个检索基准上，字段感知 MLP 分别达到 77.95 和 83.78 的 Recall@10，优于拼接式学习基线，且技能库越大优势越明显。
Motivation: 技能本身是结构化、多字段的对象，不同字段（如名称、描述、正文）提供关于使用时机和方式的差异化信息，而现有方法将技能视为扁平文档并直接拼接字段，丢失了这种结构信息，导致随着技能库增长检索成为瓶颈。
Method: 将每个技能表示为独立组件，对每个字段分别计算稀疏和稠密相似度，得到技能库的字段感知张量化表示；随后用均匀权重或一个小型学习后的 MLP 来组合字段级分数以进行混合检索（hybrid retrieval）。
Result: 字段感知 MLP 在 SkillRet 上达到 77.95 Recall@10，在 SRA-Bench 上达到 83.78 Recall@10，均超过对应的拼接式学习基线；并且随着技能库增大，字段感知方法的优势更明显。
Conclusion: 技能表示本身影响检索效果，仅保留技能文件中已有的结构就能显著提升检索性能，字段感知检索在技能库较大、检索更困难的场景下尤其有价值。

papers.title: Interpreting Black-Box Large Language Models with Sentence-Level Energy Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) accessed strictly through closed APIs has created a critical challenge for responsible deployment: a fundamental lack of interpretability. To address this, we propose a model-agnostic, post-hoc attribution interpreter operating at the sentence level. Our approach trains an Energy-Based Model (EBM) as a surrogate to capture the LLM's internal conceptual consistency between prompts and responses. This energy landscape guides the training of a lightweight interpreter network. Uniquely, our interpreter operates as a standalone tool; once trained, it quantifies the influence of prompt sentences on a user-specified target output without requiring further API queries to the LLM. By globally training a local interpreter across diverse inputs, our framework captures broader generation patterns and mitigates instance-specific biases. Experiments demonstrate that our EBM accurately simulates the target LLM, allowing the interpreter to effectively identify the prompt sentences most influential in generating specific target outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种与模型无关 (model-agnostic) 的事后 (post-hoc) 句子级归因解释器，用于解释只能通过封闭 API 访问的黑盒大语言模型 (LLM)。方法先训练一个能量模型 (Energy-Based Model, EBM) 作为代理，捕获 prompt 与 response 之间的概念一致性，并由该能量景观指导轻量解释器网络的训练。训练完成后，解释器可独立运行，无需再向 LLM 发出 API 请求即可量化 prompt 各句子对指定目标输出的影响。实验表明 EBM 能准确模拟目标 LLM，解释器可有效识别对生成特定输出最具影响力的 prompt 句子。
Motivation: 专有 LLM 仅通过封闭 API 提供访问，导致可解释性缺失，给负责任部署带来挑战；现有方法难以在不访问模型内部的情况下进行归因。
Method: 在句子级别训练 EBM 作为替代模型，刻画 LLM 对 prompt-response 的概念一致性；利用该能量景观指导轻量解释器网络的训练。解释器作为独立工具，训练后在给定用户指定目标输出时无需进一步查询 LLM；通过跨多样输入全局训练局部解释器，捕获更广泛的生成模式并缓解实例特定偏差。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明 EBM 能准确模拟目标 LLM，解释器能够有效识别在生成特定目标输出时最具影响力的 prompt 句子。
Conclusion: 本文的核心主张是：基于能量景观的句子级代理解释器可在无需访问模型内部或持续 API 查询的情况下提供事后归因，并借助全局训练降低实例特定偏差。

papers.title: VeriTrace: Human-Like Temporal Exploration Completes Agentic Action Space
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have shown promise for automated Verilog RTL generation, yet state-of-the-art multi-agent systems plateau at ~95% accuracy on standard benchmarks. We trace this ceiling to an incomplete debugging action space: existing systems restrict which signals the agent can inspect, which time windows it can query, or both, reducing debugging to pattern matching on a narrow, predetermined view of circuit behavior rather than hypothesis-driven root-cause analysis. We present VeriTrace, a multi-agent system whose Inspector agent operates over a complete debugging action space, with independent control over signal selection, time-window bounds, and iteration depth. This capability, which we term Agentic Temporal Exploration, enables the agent to form hypotheses about failure causes, query the waveform for evidence, and refine its understanding iteratively, mirroring the exploratory process of human verification engineers. VeriTrace achieves 100\% Pass@1 on VerilogEval-V2, the first system to attain perfect functional correctness on this benchmark. On a shared Claude Sonnet 4.0 backbone, VeriTrace outperforms the strongest reproduced baseline by +5.1%, demonstrating that debugging agency closes the final accuracy gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VeriTrace，一个面向 Verilog RTL 自动生成的多智能体系统。作者将现有系统在标准基准上约 95% 准确率的瓶颈归因于不完整的调试动作空间，并让 Inspector 智能体对信号选择、时间窗口边界和迭代深度进行独立控制，从而实现所谓“智能体式时间探索”（Agentic Temporal Exploration）。摘要报告 VeriTrace 在 VerilogEval-V2 上达到 100% Pass@1，并首次在该基准上实现完美功能正确性，在共享 Claude Sonnet 4.0 骨干下比最强复现基线高出 5.1%。
Motivation: 现有最先进的多智能体系统在 Verilog RTL 生成基准上停留在约 95% 准确率，作者认为瓶颈在于调试动作空间不完整：系统限制了可检查的信号、可查询的时间窗口或两者，使调试退化为对狭窄预设电路视图的模式匹配，而非假设驱动的根因分析。
Method: VeriTrace 是一个多智能体系统，其 Inspector 智能体在完整的调试动作空间上运行，可独立控制信号选择、时间窗口边界和迭代深度。该能力使智能体能形成关于故障原因的假设、查询波形证据并迭代细化理解，模拟人类验证工程师的探索过程。
Result: 摘要报告 VeriTrace 在 VerilogEval-V2 上取得 100% Pass@1，是该基准上首个达到完美功能正确性的系统；在共享 Claude Sonnet 4.0 骨干下，它比最强复现基线高 5.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为调试智能体（debugging agency）的增强能够弥合最后的准确率差距，暗示扩展动作空间而非仅增大模型或数据量是突破 RTL 生成平台期的关键方向。

papers.title: GoT-CD: Graph-of-Thoughts Causal Discovery and the Fragility of Post-hoc Path-Specific Fairness Audits
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery recovers directed structure from observational data and is increasingly used in clinical settings to support mechanism reasoning and fairness audits of predictive models. Path-specific counterfactual fairness asks whether a protected attribute influences an outcome through illegitimate pathways, but these estimands are defined relative to a supplied causal graph and therefore inherit whatever errors the discovery step introduces. Discovery methods are routinely scored on aggregate structural metrics that weight all edges equally, and no established evaluation asks whether the specific pathway an audit depends on survives discovery---or what the audit reports when that pathway is missing. Here we show that full-graph Graph-of-Thoughts reasoning yields acyclic discovered graphs that are structurally competitive with large language model (LLM) baselines, yet that structural fidelity alone does not guarantee fairness-faithful audits. We introduce GoT-CD, in which the reasoning unit is a complete candidate edge set: multiple graphs are generated in parallel, scored by a deterministic validity function, and merged under a hard union constraint that forbids invented edges, with greedy projection enforcing a DAG before commitment. GoT-CD returns a valid DAG on all five reported benchmarks and achieves the best DAG-valid F1 score among LLM methods on Asia, Alzheimer's, and COVID-Respiratory datasets. On an Alzheimer's benchmark with known unfair path, a post-hoc path-specific audit shows that five of eight discovered graphs recover no path from the sensitive attribute to the outcome and therefore report a null overall effect while mediated effects persist, necessitating downstream path-specific fairness analysis along with structural discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GoT-CD，一种基于 Graph-of-Thoughts 的因果发现方法，将推理单元设为完整候选边集：并行生成多个图、用确定性有效性函数打分、在禁止发明边的硬并约束下合并，并通过贪心投影保证输出 DAG。论文在五个报告基准上均返回合法 DAG，并在 Asia、Alzheimer's、COVID-Respiratory 数据集上取得 LLM 方法中的最佳 DAG 有效 F1；但在含已知不公平路径的 Alzheimer's 基准上，八张发现图中有五张未恢复从敏感属性到结果的路径，导致事后路径特异性审计报告零总效应，而中介效应仍然存在。
Motivation: 路径特异性反事实公平 (path-specific counterfactual fairness) 的估计量依赖给定的因果图，发现步骤引入的错误会直接传导到审计结果；而现有评测仅用等权重的聚合结构指标打分，不检查审计所依赖的特定路径是否在发现中幸存，也无法揭示路径缺失时审计会报告什么。
Method: GoT-CD 将推理单位定义为一个完整的候选边集：多个图并行生成，由确定性有效性函数打分，在禁止发明边 (invented edges) 的硬并约束下合并，并在提交前用贪心投影 (greedy projection) 强制生成 DAG。
Result: 在全部五个报告基准上均返回合法 DAG，且是 LLM 方法中在 Asia、Alzheimer's、COVID-Respiratory 数据集上 DAG 有效 F1 最高的方法。在带已知不公平路径的 Alzheimer's 基准上，八个发现图中有五个没有恢复任何从敏感属性到结果的路径，因此事后路径特异性审计报告零总效应，同时中介效应仍然存在。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构保真度 (structural fidelity) 本身不能保证公平审计的保真度；即使发现图在聚合结构指标上具有竞争力，审计所依赖的路径仍可能丢失，因此需要在结构发现之外进行下游的路径特异性公平分析。

papers.title: BAP-SQL: Budget-Aware Observation Planning for Agentic Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents do not merely consume observations: their actions determine what arrives next. In agentic text-to-SQL, a broad query can spend context and database work before useful evidence appears, while post-hoc compression cannot recover omitted rows or expended work. We present BAP-SQL, which treats observation formation as a budget-control stage: it estimates query risk, rewrites SQL when useful, and delegates hard limits to an independent runtime shield. Across general 4B, specialized FINER-SQL 4B, and 7B backbones, BAP-SQL improves tight-budget success. On the primary BIRD-derived setting, it gains 3.4/3.6 percentage points over matched SFT while using 4.5/5.0% fewer tokens. Matched retraining and task-level transfer associate the gain with policy-visible planning and budget-sensitive rescue. The benefit attenuates as model capability and budget increase, reverses at the loosest setting, and does not reduce database work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BAP-SQL，一种面向 agentic text-to-SQL 的预算感知观测规划方法，将观测形成视为预算控制阶段：估计查询风险、在有用时重写 SQL，并将硬限制交由独立运行时防护层（runtime shield）执行。在 BIRD 派生设置上，BAP-SQL 在 4B、FINER-SQL 4B 和 7B 骨干上均提升了紧预算下的成功率，同时减少 token 使用。摘要指出匹配重训练与任务级迁移表明增益来自策略可见的规划与预算敏感救援，且该收益随模型能力和预算增大而减弱，在最宽松设置下甚至反转。
Motivation: 工具使用智能体不只是消费观测，其行动决定后续观测内容；在 agentic text-to-SQL 中，宽泛查询可能在有用证据出现前耗尽上下文和数据库开销，事后压缩无法恢复被省略的行或已消耗的工作。
Method: BAP-SQL 将观测形成视为预算控制阶段：估计查询风险，在有用时对 SQL 进行重写，并通过独立的运行时防护层（runtime shield）实施硬性预算限制。
Result: 在主要的 BIRD 派生设置上，相对匹配的 SFT 基线，BAP-SQL 在紧预算下提升 3.4/3.6 个百分点，同时使用更少 4.5/5.0% 的 token；该增益在多个骨干模型上均有体现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调收益与策略可见规划和预算敏感救援相关；随着模型能力和预算增加，增益减弱并在最宽松设置下反转，且该方法不会减少数据库工作量。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 BAP-SQL，一种面向 agentic text-to-SQL 的预算感知观测规划方法，将观测形成视为预算控制阶段：估计查询风险、在有用时重写 SQL，并将硬限制交由独立运行时防护层（runtime shield）执行。在 BIRD 派生设置上，BAP-SQL 在 4B、FINER-SQL 4B 和 7B 骨干上均提升了紧预算下的成功率，同时减少 token 使用。摘要指出匹配重训练与任务级迁移表明增益来自策略可见的规划与预算敏感救援，且该收益随模型能力和预算增大而减弱，在最宽松设置下甚至反转。
summary_sections.motivation: 工具使用智能体不只是消费观测，其行动决定后续观测内容；在 agentic text-to-SQL 中，宽泛查询可能在有用证据出现前耗尽上下文和数据库开销，事后压缩无法恢复被省略的行或已消耗的工作。
summary_sections.method: BAP-SQL 将观测形成视为预算控制阶段：估计查询风险，在有用时对 SQL 进行重写，并通过独立的运行时防护层（runtime shield）实施硬性预算限制。
summary_sections.result: 在主要的 BIRD 派生设置上，相对匹配的 SFT 基线，BAP-SQL 在紧预算下提升 3.4/3.6 个百分点，同时使用更少 4.5/5.0% 的 token；该增益在多个骨干模型上均有体现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调收益与策略可见规划和预算敏感救援相关；随着模型能力和预算增加，增益减弱并在最宽松设置下反转，且该方法不会减少数据库工作量。

papers.title: Maglev: Sliding Recurrent Memory
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \ours{}, a recurrent Transformer architecture with fixed-size memory that generalizes sliding-window attention while remaining parallelizable during training. \ours{} consists of two coupled models: a prefiller $Q$, which leverages full attention\footnote{In practice, we use interleaved full and sliding-window attention for $Q$, as this yields stronger performance. The essential requirement is that $Q$ be more expressive than $P$, with access to the full history.} to produce memory targets $m'_t$, and a decoder $P$, which uses only sliding-window attention and recurrent K/V injection to produce decoder memories $m_t$ for next-token prediction. We train \ours{} with a memory consistency loss that aligns $m_t$ with $m'_t$, allowing inference to use $P$ alone. Empirically, \ours{} improves validation loss and downstream pretraining benchmarks over sliding-window and latent recurrent transformer baselines. Moreover, sharing parameters between $P$ and $Q$ reduces parameter memory while preserving most of the gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Maglev，一种带固定大小记忆的循环 Transformer 架构，将滑动窗口注意力与循环 K/V 注入结合，同时保持训练可并行化。模型由预填充器 Q 和解码器 P 组成，通过记忆一致性损失 (memory consistency loss) 对齐二者，推理时仅使用 P。摘要报告其在验证损失和下游预训练基准上优于滑动窗口与潜在循环 Transformer 基线，且参数共享可在保留大部分收益的同时减少参数内存。
Motivation: 现有滑动窗口注意力和潜在循环 Transformer 基线的记忆效率或表达能力有限，作者希望设计一种固定大小记忆的循环架构，既能利用更长历史，又保持训练时的并行性。
Method: 使用两个耦合模型：预填充器 Q 借助全注意力（实践中交错使用全注意力和滑动窗口注意力）生成记忆目标 m'_t；解码器 P 仅用滑动窗口注意力和循环 K/V 注入生成解码器记忆 m_t 用于下一个 token 预测。训练时用记忆一致性损失让 m_t 对齐 m'_t，使推理阶段只需运行 P。
Result: 摘要报告 Maglev 在验证损失和下游预训练基准上优于滑动窗口和潜在循环 Transformer 基线；在 P 与 Q 之间共享参数可降低参数内存，同时保留大部分性能收益。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，表达能力更强的全注意力预填充器可以将历史信息蒸馏进仅依赖滑动窗口注意力的循环解码器，从而兼顾推理效率与性能；具体评估未提及与天气或降水的任何关联。

papers.title: Contrast-invariant deep ptychography neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Ptychography neural networks suffer from scaling inconsistencies when generalizing out of distribution, limiting their real world viability. We address this scaling mismatch using a factorization strategy which decouples the learned object texture from measurement scaling, enabling a single trained network to produce measurement-consistent reconstructions across varying illumination conditions. This requires predicting the learned object in real and imaginary units instead of the canonical amplitude and phase representation. We additionally introduce a synthetic object sampling strategy that minimizes phase distribution mismatch between synthetic training data and experimental targets. These improvements yield up to a 5x reduction in Fourier error over the previous PtychoPINN-torch baseline across 5 experimental datasets spanning multiple beamlines and facilities.
papers.comment: ~30 pages, 4 main figures + 2 SI figures. Submitting to scientific journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文解决 ptychography 神经网络在分布外泛化时的尺度不一致 (scaling inconsistency) 问题。作者提出一种因子分解策略，将学习到的物体纹理与测量尺度解耦，使单个训练好的网络能在不同照明条件下产生与测量一致的图像重建。该方法改用实部/虚部而非幅度/相位来预测物体，并引入合成物体采样策略以减小训练数据与实验目标之间的相位分布失配；在跨越多个光束线和设施的 5 个实验数据集上，相对此前的 PtychoPINN-torch 基线将傅里叶误差最多降低 5 倍。
Motivation: Ptychography 神经网络在分布外泛化时存在尺度不一致问题，限制了其实际应用中的可靠性。
Method: 采用因子分解策略将学习到的物体纹理与测量尺度解耦；以实部和虚部单位预测物体，替代传统的幅度/相位表示；并引入合成物体采样策略，最小化合成训练数据与实验目标之间的相位分布失配。
Result: 在跨越多个光束线和设施的 5 个实验数据集上，该方法相对 PtychoPINN-torch 基线的傅里叶误差最多降低 5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要表明这些改进使单个训练好的网络能在不同照明条件下产生测量一致的图像重建，从而提升模型在真实实验数据上的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adaptive Sampling for Automated Post-Disaster Rapid Damage Assessment via Level-Set Cost-Aware Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Natural disasters frequently inflict severe damage to the built environment, which demands a rapid, reliable, and cost-effective damage assessment for emergency response. However, traditional methods for post-disaster damage assessment often rely on static, labor-intensive data collection strategies that can be prohibitively expensive and struggle to adapt to dynamic post-disaster conditions. In this study, we propose a cost-aware Bayesian optimization framework combined with level-set estimation that continuously guides autonomous data collectors, e.g., an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), toward the most informative regions. By dynamically updating damage estimates across different geographic zones, our approach systematically reduces uncertainty while minimizing operational costs. The proposed framework is first validated using a controlled synthetic toy study, demonstrating the agent's ability to efficiently trace damage boundaries, recover the underlying damage map, and rapidly reduce predictive uncertainty. Furthermore, the approach is evaluated using high-fidelity disaster data generated by the Regional Resilience Determination (R2D) software. The results of the algorithm provide accurate and timely damage estimates that support informative and fast emergency response.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the SIAM International Conference on Data Mining (SDM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合水平集估计 (level-set estimation) 的成本感知贝叶斯优化 (cost-aware Bayesian optimization) 框架，用于引导 UAV 等自主数据采集设备持续前往最具信息量的区域，实现灾后快速损害评估。框架在受控合成玩具实验和 Regional Resilience Determination (R2D) 软件生成的高保真灾害数据上得到验证，能够动态更新不同地理区域的损害估计，在降低运行成本的同时快速减小不确定性。
Motivation: 传统灾后损害评估依赖静态、劳动密集型的数据采集策略，成本高昂且难以适应灾后动态变化的环境，无法支撑快速可靠的应急响应。
Method: 提出成本感知贝叶斯优化与水平集估计相结合的框架，持续引导自主数据采集器（如无人机）前往信息量最大的区域，并按地理分区动态更新损害估计，从而在最小化运行成本的同时系统性降低不确定性。
Result: 在受控合成玩具研究中，智能体能够高效追踪损害边界、恢复底层损害图并快速降低预测不确定性；基于 R2D 软件生成的高保真灾害数据评估表明，算法能提供准确及时的损害估计。
Conclusion: 该框架能够为快速、信息充分的应急响应提供准确的灾后损害估计，摘要强调其在动态灾后条件下兼顾成本与不确定性的有效性。

papers.title: BODHI: Do LLMs Branch Out and Discover Heterogeneous Inferences?
papers.abstract_en: Although reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the performance of large language models (LLMs) across a variety of reasoning tasks, there is significant debate as to whether RLVR expands the reasoning capability boundary, or just improves sampling efficiency. In this paper, we investigate the nature of test-time exploration in RLVR-trained LLMs by employing controlled maze-solving experiments and extracting a tree structure from mathematical reasoning traces (BODHI-Trees) based on semantic equivalence. This helps us delineate between entropy arising from stylistic variations and genuine inferential branching. Our findings demonstrate that the policy entropy collapse observed in RLVR models is not merely syntactic, and is accompanied by a significant reduction in semantic branching entropy. While RLVR improves adherence to environmental constraints and backtracking capabilities, it constricts the space of continuations; we provide evidence suggesting that this might be responsible for the sample efficiency gains of RLVR, albeit at the cost of genuine rollout diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控迷宫求解实验和基于语义等价的数学推理轨迹树（BODHI-Trees）探究 RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）训练后大语言模型的测试时探索性质。作者发现 RLVR 模型中的策略熵塌缩（policy entropy collapse）不仅是句法层面的，还伴随语义分支熵的显著下降。RLVR 虽提升了环境约束遵从性和回溯能力，却压缩了续写空间，其采样效率提升可能以牺牲真正的 rollout 多样性为代价。
Motivation: 围绕 RLVR 究竟是扩展了推理能力边界，还是仅仅提高了采样效率，目前存在显著争议；本文旨在从语义分支而非风格变化的角度刻画 RLVR 对测试时探索的影响。
Method: 设计受控迷宫求解实验，并从数学推理轨迹中根据语义等价构建树结构 BODHI-Trees，用以区分由风格变化产生的熵与真正的推断性分支（inferential branching）熵。
Result: 实验显示 RLVR 模型观测到的策略熵塌缩并非单纯句法层面，语义分支熵也大幅降低；RLVR 改善了环境约束遵从和回溯能力，但压缩了可行续写空间，这可能是其样本效率提升的来源。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RLVR 的样本效率收益以真实 rollout 多样性为代价，熵塌缩本质上是语义性的，而非仅由风格化表达引起。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NOMADD: Numerical Optimization of Models Adapting to Data Drift
papers.abstract_en: Tabular model performance degrades when feature distributions change over time or the relationship between features and outcome variables change over time, known as data drift and concept drift, respectively. These issues are challenging to mitigate in real time because labeled data may not be immediately available, or re-training a model could be impractical. While tools exist to reduce drift, they are typically bespoke to neural network architectures and adapt how models are trained. In this paper, we offer an alternative post-hoc method to reduce concept drift, which is applicable to a variety of models, from trees to neural networks to tabular foundation models. This new tool is especially useful when constraints, such as high model accuracy, bounded inference time, or model size requires users to choose between different models for their specific use-cases. Our algorithm fits the base model separately on each labeled training period, measures how its parameters evolve against a single anchor model pooled over all of those periods, compresses those changes with a low-rank factorization, and extrapolates each latent factor forward with a damped, regularized forecast. On the 18-dataset Drift-Resilient TabPFN benchmark, evaluated under that benchmark's own protocol and metric, the extrapolation improves every base family it is applied to, and achieves performance competitive with the state-of-the-art Drift-Resilient TabPFN with seconds of training. In contrast, Drift-Resilient TabPFN requires pre-training on millions of synthetic datasets over approximately 1,300 GPU-hours, and is orders of magnitude slower in inference (depending on the model). In the discussion, we explore the promise and challenges of extending this tool to other modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NOMADD，一种用于降低概念漂移 (concept drift) 的后处理 (post-hoc) 方法，适用于树模型、神经网络和表格基础模型。其思路是在每个标注训练期分别拟合基础模型，测量其参数相对一个锚定模型 (anchor model) 的演化，用低秩分解压缩这些变化，并对每个潜在因子做阻尼正则化外推。在 18 数据集的 Drift-Resilient TabPFN 基准上，该方法改善了所有应用的基础模型系列，并达到与 Drift-Resilient TabPFN 竞争的性能，而训练仅需数秒。
Motivation: 表格模型在特征分布或特征与结果变量关系随时间变化时性能会退化，即数据漂移和概念漂移；实时缓解困难在于标注数据可能不可用或重新训练不实际。现有减漂移工具通常只针对神经网络架构，并通过修改训练方式来工作，缺少适用于多样模型的后处理方法。
Method: 算法先对每个标注训练期单独拟合基础模型，再以池化所有期间得到的单一锚模型为参照测量参数演化，将参数变化做低秩分解以压缩，随后用带阻尼和正则化的预测器向前外推每个潜在因子。该方法独立于基础模型类型，可与树、神经网络和表格基础模型搭配。

papers.title: Particle-based Generalised Stochastic Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: We develop a class of diffusion-based stochastic particle optimisation methods for loss functions with intractable gradients. Specifically, we consider problems in which the loss gradient is an integral with respect to a parameter-dependent distribution, a structure that includes training generative models, fine-tuning, and learning latent-variable models. We introduce mean-field dynamics and its interacting-particle approximations, which contain several existing algorithms as special cases and provides a route to constructing new methods. Under well-posedness and joint contractivity assumptions, we prove exponential convergence and show that the continuous-time particle system admits a non-asymptotic error bound. We illustrate it by developing momentum and higher-order Langevin variants and evaluating them on maximum marginal-likelihood estimation and energy-based-model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类基于扩散的随机粒子优化方法，用于损失函数梯度不可解析计算的问题，即梯度是对参数依赖分布的积分，这类结构涵盖生成模型训练、微调与潜变量模型学习。作者引入平均场动力学及其相互作用粒子近似，将若干已有算法作为特例并给出构造新方法的路径；在适定性与联合压缩性假设下证明指数收敛，并给出连续时间粒子系统的非渐近误差界。文中以动量与高阶 Langevin 变体为例，在最大边际似然估计和基于能量的模型训练上进行验证。
Motivation: 许多机器学习任务的损失梯度涉及对参数依赖分布的积分/期望，无法直接求得，缺乏统一的粒子式优化框架以及相应的收敛性保证。
Method: 提出扩散型随机粒子优化框架，构造平均场动力学及其相互作用粒子近似，使现有多种算法成为特例，并在此基础上发展动量与更高阶 Langevin 变体。
Result: 在适定性与联合压缩性假设下证明指数收敛，并为连续时间粒子系统建立非渐近误差界；实验面向最大边际似然估计和基于能量的模型训练。
Conclusion: 该框架为不可解析梯度的损失优化提供了统一视角和新算法设计路径，但收敛结论依赖适定性与联合压缩性等假设。

papers.title: MutMem: Cryptographically Authorized Mutation in Persistent Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent agent memory must adapt as later outcomes change earlier evidence, yet mutable retrieval weights create an attribution problem: reviewers must distinguish authorized adaptation from database tampering. We present MutMem, an authorized-mutation protocol in HOM-AIMOS, a persistent agent-memory engine. MutMem retains memory content, records signed positive and negative outcome evidence without age-based expiry, and commits each nontrivial weight change as a housekeeper-authorized transition. Each transition binds a terminal provenance node, signer epoch, quantized old and new weights, a no-fork predecessor, and two domain-separated SHA-256 commitments. Ed25519 verification runs in both the database writer and a portable verifier. Content classified as poison-likely is retained with signed, revisable labels used by recall as trust evidence. We evaluate utility, mutation integrity, and poisoning adaptation. HOM-AIMOS answers 459/500 LongMemEval questions correctly under LLM judgment (91.8%). On LoCoMo, it obtains 74.12% judged accuracy and, under a separate upstream-compatible protocol, 58.20 token F1. A native suite passes all declared authorization, topology, tamper, signer-epoch, and post-mutation-recall cases; median signed-transition latency is 4.865 ms. In a declared N=100 PoisonedRAG adaptation, no injected poison appears in attacked top-5 disclosures (0/100; 95% Wilson upper bound 3.70%), while induced target-answer attack success among 98 clean-negative targets is 1/98 (1.02%). A preregistered four-arm ablation attributes the retrieval reduction to signed stored labels: the retriever selects poison for 94/100 targets when epistemic policy is bypassed and 0/100 when labels are restored. MutMem provides evidence of integrity, authorization, traceability, and historical continuity; it does not establish content truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MutMem，一个在持久化智能体记忆引擎 HOM-AIMOS 中实现的授权变更（authorized-mutation）协议，用于区分合法的记忆适应性更新与数据库篡改。MutMem 保留记忆内容，记录带签名的正负结果证据且不设基于年龄的过期，并将每次非平凡权重变更提交为 housekeeper 授权的转换，绑定终端溯源节点、签名者纪元、量化前后权重、无分叉前驱及两个域分离的 SHA-256 承诺。评估覆盖效用、变更完整性与投毒适应：HOM-AIMOS 在 LongMemEval 上以 LLM 评判答对 459/500（91.8%），LoCoMo 上为 74.12% 评判准确率，并报告了原生套件全部通过、中位签名转换延迟 4.865 ms 以及 PoisonedRAG 适应实验中的投毒抑制结果。
Motivation: 持久化智能体记忆必须随着后续结果改变早期证据而适应，但可变的检索权重会带来归因问题：审查者需要区分授权适应与数据库篡改。
Method: MutMem 协议保留记忆内容，记录带签名的正负结果证据而不做基于年龄的过期；每次非平凡权重变化都被提交为 housekeeper 授权的转换，每个转换绑定终端溯源节点、签名者纪元、量化的新旧权重、无分叉前驱以及两个域分离的 SHA-256 承诺。Ed25519 验证同时在数据库写入端与一个可移植验证器中执行，疑似投毒（poison-likely）内容被保留并附上用于检索时信任证据的签名可修订标签。
Result: 摘要报告 HOM-AIMOS 在 LongMemEval 上获得 459/500（91.8%）的 LLM 评判正确率，在 LoCoMo 上获得 74.12% 评判准确率，并在另一个上游兼容协议下获得 58.20 token F1；原生测试套件通过所有声明的授权、拓扑、篡改、签名者纪元及变更后检索用例，中位签名转换延迟为 4.865 ms。在声明的 N=100 PoisonedRAG 适应实验中，攻击后的 top-5 披露中未出现注入投毒（0/100；95% Wilson 上限 3.70%），98 个干净阴性目标中的诱导目标答案攻击成功率为 1/98（1.02%）；预注册的四臂消融将检索抑制归因于带签名的存储标签：绕过认知策略时检索器在 94/100 个目标上选中投毒，恢复标签时为 0/100。
Conclusion: 作者强调 MutMem 提供的是完整性、授权、可追溯性与历史连续性的证据，并不确立内容真实性；该工作定位为持久化智能体记忆中授权变更与防篡改的协议层方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Localize, Don't Beautify: Client-Side Control of Image-Editing APIs for Cosmetic Surgery Previews
papers.abstract_en: Ask a commercial image editor to preview a cosmetic procedure and it will often change more of the face than the request names: a nose edit can also smooth skin or alter lighting. Existing methods for confining an edit to one region require access to the model's internals, which a public editing API does not expose. We ask how much control is possible from the client side alone. In a pilot benchmark, six commercial editing configurations and one mask-based inpainting model perform facelift-style jaw-neck and rhinoplasty edits at three levels of client-side control: the prompt alone; cutting the edited region out of the response and pasting it back onto the original photograph through a landmark-derived mask (a masked composite); and asking the model itself to inpaint inside the mask where supported. Of 210 attempted edits, 196 could be scored. ArcFace cosine measures identity preservation; a CIELAB pixel-change ratio measures how much change lands inside the requested region rather than a protected facial zone. On the 12 frontal faces the regional metric could score, the masked composite improved localization over the paired prompt-only output by a median of 0.446 (95% face-clustered bootstrap interval 0.421-0.457) while changing the requested region about as much. Editors differed in edit strength versus identity retention, and the one inpainting model we tested did not beat the simple composite. Against each face's input-to-postoperative baseline, no editor moved its outputs closer to the postoperative photograph in identity-embedding terms. This is a study of control, not clinical accuracy: no surgeons rated the outputs, and each condition was generated once. Within that scope, keeping a surgical preview inside its intended region needs no access to the model; a mask and composite on the client enforce it across every editor tested, at low provider cost.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Pilot study; no surgeon ratings. Code and paper source: https://github.com/suxrobGM/localize-dont-beautify
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在无法访问模型内部的情况下，能否仅从客户端控制商用图像编辑 API，使美容手术预览只修改指定区域。作者提出基于地标掩码的合成方法，将编辑区域从响应中剪切并粘贴回原图，并在六个商用编辑配置和一个掩码修复模型上进行了下颌-颈部提升和鼻整形的初步基准测试。结果显示掩码合成在区域定位上优于仅提示的输出，且不需要修改模型或提供更高成本。
Motivation: 商用图像编辑 API 在被要求编辑鼻子等区域时，往往会连带改变皮肤平滑度或光照等未指定部分；现有将编辑限制在局部的方法需要访问模型内部，而公开 API 不暴露这些信息。因此本文探究完全在客户端一侧能实现多大程度的控制。
Method: 提出三种客户端控制级别进行对比：仅使用提示词；通过地标推导的掩码将编辑区域从响应中剪切并粘贴回原始照片（掩码合成）；以及在支持的情况下让模型自身在掩码内进行修复。实验在六个商用编辑配置和一个基于掩码的修复模型上执行面部提升与鼻整形编辑。
Result: 在 210 次尝试编辑中 196 次可评分；在 12 张可进行区域度量的正面脸上，掩码合成相比仅提示的配对输出，将编辑定位到请求区域的程度中位数提升了 0.446（95% 人脸聚类引导区间 0.421-0.457），同时请求区域的改变量大致相当。所有编辑器在身份保留（ArcFace 余弦）与编辑强度上表现不同，且测试的修复模型并未优于简单合成；相对每张脸的术前到术后基线，没有编辑器在身份嵌入上更接近术后照片。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是关于控制能力而非临床准确性的研究：没有外科医生评分，且每种条件仅生成一次。在该范围内，客户端掩码与合成即可将手术预览限制在预期区域，并对所有测试的编辑器都有效，且提供商成本低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Human-in-the-Loop Deep Learning Framework for Color Reconstruction of Lenticular Films
papers.abstract_en: Historical lenticular films, such as those created with the Kodacolor process, encode color information in a distinctive spatial format. This structure requires specialized techniques for accurate color reconstruction. While recent signal processing approaches like doLCE and deep learning methods like deep-doLCE have advanced automated color recovery, they often fail with cases such as curved lenticules, low-contrast, or badly captured regions. We propose a human-in-the-loop (HITL) deep learning framework which is designed for color reconstruction in lenticular films. Our approach introduces an editable, vector-based representation of lenticule boundaries, allowing experts to interactively refine boundary positions before color extraction and demosaicing. This decoupled architecture enables targeted corrections and iterative fine-tuning, embedding expert knowledge into the detection model and improving robustness across challenging frames. To preserve image details using information solely present in the original silver emulsion, we merge the reconstructed chrominance with the original film scan's luminance. We evaluate our pipeline on a challenging lenticular film sequence where previous automated approaches fail and the reconstructed colors are not suitable for exhibition. In contrast, our HITL approach successfully produces high-quality, exhibitable color reconstructions with preserved texture. This work is the first to combine expert guidance, editable intermediate representations, and texture-preserving post-processing for lenticular film color reconstruction, advancing the state of the art in this field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对历史柱状透镜胶片（如 Kodacolor 工艺）的颜色重建问题，提出一个人机协同 (human-in-the-loop, HITL) 的深度学习框架。该框架引入可编辑的矢量化柱镜边界表示，让专家在颜色提取与去马赛克前交互式修正边界，并将重建的色度与原胶片扫描的亮度融合以保留细节。作者在先前自动化方法失败的困难胶片序列上验证，称该方法能产出高质量、可展出的彩色重建结果。
Motivation: 现有自动方法（如 doLCE 和深度学习方法 deep-doLCE）在曲面柱镜、低对比度或拍摄质量差的区域往往失效，导致重建颜色不适合展出，需要一种能嵌入专家知识的更鲁棒方案。
Method: 提出解耦的 HITL 框架：先建立可编辑的矢量化柱镜边界表示，专家可交互精修边界，再进行颜色提取和去马赛克；同时将重建的色度与原始银盐乳剂扫描的亮度合并，以保留仅存在于原始影像中的纹理细节。
Result: 在一个此前自动化方法失败且重建颜色不适合展出的困难柱状透镜胶片序列上，该方法成功生成高质量、可展出且保留纹理的彩色重建。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个将专家引导、可编辑中间表示与纹理保持后处理相结合的柱状透镜胶片颜色重建工作，推动该领域状态前沿。

papers.title: CURV: Enhancing Chart Understanding Through Curriculum Visual Grounded Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chart question answering (CQA) requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to integrate visual comprehension with logical reasoning, yet current models struggle with accurate visual grounding and coherent reasoning chains. While extrinsic chain-of-thought prompting and visual cues significantly improve performance, current MLLMs lack intrinsic visual grounded reasoning capabilities, leading to inaccurate perception and reasoning disconnected from visual evidence. To address these limitations, we propose CURV, a curriculum learning framework that develops intrinsic visual reasoning capabilities by reformulating CQA as multi-step visual grounded reasoning, where each step coordinates logical reasoning with dynamic visual grounding through spatial attention concentration. To assist model learning, we further introduce CCQA, a three-level curriculum dataset with scalable synthetic generation across diverse chart types and reasoning patterns. Our curriculum systematically progresses from basic single-operation reasoning to complex multi-chart compositional tasks. Experiments demonstrate that CURV achieves up to $\uparrow20.50\%$ improvements over baselines and is generalizable to real-world benchmarks (up to $\uparrow12.30\%$) and out-of-domain multimodal reasoning tasks (up to $\uparrow10.20\%$), validating the effectiveness of internalizing visual reasoning with dynamic grounding for enhanced chart understanding capabilities. Code is available at: https://xhguo7.github.io/CURV/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CURV，一个面向图表问答 (chart question answering) 的课程学习框架，通过将任务重构为多步视觉接地推理来增强多模态大语言模型的内在推理能力，并配套引入三级课程数据集 CCQA。实验显示该方法在多个基准上显著提升准确率，并能泛化到真实世界与域外多模态推理任务。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在图表问答中缺乏内在的视觉接地推理能力，即使借助外部思维链提示和视觉线索，仍存在感知不准确、推理链与视觉证据脱节的问题。
Method: CURV 将图表问答分解为多步视觉接地推理，每一步通过空间注意力集中将逻辑推理与动态视觉接地相结合；同时提出 CCQA，一个具有可扩展合成生成的三级课程数据集，涵盖多种图表类型和推理模式，使训练从基础单操作推理逐步推进到复杂多图表组合任务。
Result: 实验表明 CURV 较基线最高提升 20.50%，在真实世界基准上最高提升 12.30%，在域外多模态推理任务上最高提升 10.20%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过动态视觉接地内化视觉推理能力可有效增强图表理解，并验证了该框架的泛化性；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In-Context Collapse in Vision-Language Models and How to Mitigate it?
papers.abstract_en: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) lets vision-language models (VLMs) adapt from image--label demonstrations without weight updates, and is widely assumed to improve as more demonstrations are supplied. We show the opposite: as demonstrations accumulate, a subset of VLMs undergo an \emph{in-context collapse}, a sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drop spanning synthetic classification, natural-image classification, and VQA benchmarks, in some models falling below chance while outputs remain well-formed. Across an open VLM panel ($0.5$B--$11$B) and a frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4.5), the collapse is graded. Two capabilities turn out to be dissociable: robustness to accumulating demonstrations and the ability to learn a novel rule in context, their combinations yield three reproducible regimes. A parameter-matched lesion-and-rescue causally localizes the collapse to the vision-language integration pathway: an adapter on the connector and early/mid layers restores genuine learning (remap accuracy $0.39!\rightarrow!0.91$ at 16 shots), while an equal-capacity adapter on the late readout does not. We propose \textsc{CircA}, whose core is a one-time integration vaccine: trained once on one synthetic task, it transfers collapse-resistance to unseen task families (chance$\rightarrow$$0.71$/$0.60$ on CIFAR/Fashion). The layers best for in-context integration are not the layers best for weight-based consolidation, the late readout achieves higher accuracy and less forgetting at fewer parameters. The collapse is an integration failure at the vision--language interface, correctable by a lightweight, transferable intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示视觉语言模型 (VLM) 中许多样本上下文学习 (many-shot ICL) 的反直觉现象：随着演示样本累积，部分模型会出现 in-context collapse，精度急剧甚至灾难性下降，在合成分类、自然图像分类和 VQA 基准上可低于随机水平，而输出仍保持良好形式。作者将崩溃定位到视觉语言集成通路，并提出 CircA，其一次性集成疫苗在合成任务上训练后可迁移至未见任务族以恢复性能。
Motivation: 许多样本 ICL 被广泛假设为演示越多效果越好，但作者观察到相反现象，部分 VLM 在演示累积时发生精度崩溃，说明该假设并不普适，且崩溃机制与缓解方法尚不清楚。
Method: 在 0.5B–11B 的开放 VLM 面板和 Claude Sonnet 4.5 上系统评测崩溃行为，通过参数匹配的 lesion-and-rescue 实验将崩溃因果定位于视觉语言集成通路；提出 CircA，其核心是一次性集成疫苗，仅在一个合成任务上训练并迁移到其他任务家族。
Result: 崩溃在模型间呈分级表现，且鲁棒性与上下文学习新规则能力可分离并产生三种可复现状态；16 shots 时，connector 与 early/mid 层上的 adapter 将 remap accuracy 从 0.39 恢复到 0.91，而 late readout 上等容量 adapter 无效；CircA 在 CIFAR/Fashion 上分别从 chance 恢复到 0.71/0.60；late readout 在权重巩固任务上以更少参数取得更高精度和更少遗忘。
Conclusion: 崩溃本质是视觉语言接口处的集成失败，而非输出退化，可通过轻量且可迁移的干预修正；用于上下文集成的最优层与用于权重巩固的最优层并不相同。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't
papers.abstract_en: Model families train every size from scratch. Can a pretrained large model be converted into a smaller sibling? We characterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in the Pythia family end-to-end: (i) representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parameters align weakly; (ii) dense weight projection is functionally destructive -- provably not an assembly artifact -- because basis mixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure; (iii) after the best-fit linear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noise under shuffle controls; (iv) conversion value therefore lives in initialization. In matched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into two independent levers -- least-squares compensation (function: best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics: best endpoints). Compensation is a token-efficient, low-budget win rather than a universal one: at 30M tokens it beats the strongest subcloning variant on both a width-reduced pair (84.0 +/- 1.8 vs. 89.7 +/- 3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9, 3/3 seeds), reaching a given quality with fewer tokens; at a 33x larger budget the two converge to parity (40.0 vs. 40.0), both far ahead of from-scratch, which transfer initialization always beats -- by up to 18x at low budget, the margin narrowing at convergence and at the largest scale. We further map the method's boundary: at ~5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both levers over-corrects, which we trace to ill-conditioning of the compensation solve at large width, pointing to dimension-aware regularization as the fix. Code, checkpoints, and the frozen evaluation corpus are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练大模型能否被转换为更小的兄弟模型，并端到端刻画了 Pythia 家族中 1.4B->410M 的转换过程。作者发现跨尺寸的表示对齐很强（ridge R^2=0.84）而参数对齐很弱，稠密权重投影在功能上是破坏性的，转换价值主要存在于初始化中。在预算匹配的持续预训练下，作者将转换分解为最小二乘补偿（least-squares compensation）与方差保持重缩放（variance-preserving rescale）两个独立杠杆，并表明补偿在低预算下是 token 高效的优势，而非普适优势。
Motivation: 模型家族通常从头训练每个尺寸，作者试图回答一个预训练大模型能否被转化为更小的兄弟模型，以节省重复训练成本并理解跨尺寸迁移的本质。
Method: 系统分析 1.4B->410M 转换中的表示对齐、参数对齐与权重投影结构；随后在匹配预算的持续预训练中，将转换分解为最小二乘补偿（最优先验零样本性能）和方差保持重缩放（最优动力学终点）两个独立杠杆，并绘制方法边界（约 5 倍捐赠者规模 6.9B->1.4B 时叠加两杠杆会过度校正）。
Result: 表示对齐强（ridge R^2=0.84）而参数对齐弱；在 30M token 低预算下，补偿法在一个宽度缩减对（84.0±1.8 vs 89.7±3.7，3/3 种子）和一个留出的深度缩减对（109.3 vs 117.9，3/3 种子）上均优于最强的子克隆变体，且在 33 倍预算下两者收敛到平局（40.0 vs 40.0）；迁移初始化始终优于从头训练，低预算时最高达 18 倍，收敛和最大规模处差距缩小。
Conclusion: 作者认为转换的价值在于初始化而非权重本身，最小二乘补偿是低预算下的高效手段；在约 5 倍捐赠者规模处两杠杆叠加会因大宽度下补偿求解的病态性（ill-conditioning）而过度校正，指向维度感知正则化作为修复方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improved Quantum Algorithms for Reinforcement Learning Under a Generative Model
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is a subfield of machine learning that studies how an agent interacts with an environment in order to extract as large a reward as possible. A standard approach to study such interaction is through Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and the task of choosing an optimal policy --- a function that tells the agent which action to take. In this work, we study two types of MDPs --- finite-horizon and infinite-horizon discounted --- and propose new quantum algorithms for computing approximate optimal policies. Our quantum algorithms are based on a new combination of standard value iteration and quantum subroutines like quantum mean estimation and quantum maximum finding, overall enhanced with techniques from sample-optimal classical algorithms. Our resulting query complexities improve upon previous works, thus approaching already established quantum lower bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习中的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），针对有限时域和无限时域折扣两种设定，提出新的量子算法来计算近似最优策略。算法将标准值迭代与量子均值估计、量子最大值查找等量子子程序结合，并引入样本最优经典算法的技术，得到的查询复杂度优于以往工作，逼近已知量子下界。
Motivation: 强化学习中计算近似最优策略的经典与量子算法仍有复杂度差距，已有量子算法的查询复杂度尚未达到量子下界，需要更高效的量子算法设计。
Method: 将标准值迭代与量子均值估计（quantum mean estimation）和量子最大值查找（quantum maximum finding）相结合，并整合样本最优经典算法中的技术，构造新的量子算法。
Result: 得到的查询复杂度优于此前工作，从而更接近已建立的量子下界。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该量子算法在有限时域和无限时域折扣 MDP 上均改进了查询复杂度，但未讨论实际运行开销或实验验证。

papers.title: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Through Model Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is an increasingly important component of AI safety stacks but relies on the assumption that a model's reasoning trace is informative about its actions. This work studies the limits of CoT monitoring through the lens of model poisoning. We demonstrate that backdoors can be implanted into reasoning models to elicit an attacker-chosen behavior while their CoT traces appear entirely benign. We find that these CoT-Hidden backdoors can be induced through simple fine-tuning recipes across reasoning-model architectures and sizes. When direct poisoning is ineffective, we introduce a curriculum training approach that progressively teaches the model to produce an attacker-chosen output while concealing the behavior from its reasoning traces. These findings suggest that CoT monitoring may be better framed as a question about the consistency between a model's reasoning trace and its final response than as anomaly detection within a trace. We further examine the mechanisms that allow models to suppress evidence of the target behavior from their reasoning traces. Causal interventions locate a trigger-conditioned activation pathway that does not depend on the visible reasoning, and residual stream verbalizations provide an anomaly warning near answer generation, but do not identify the trigger, target, or backdoor mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过模型投毒 (model poisoning) 规避思维链监控 (CoT monitoring) 的可能性，证明可以通过简单的微调在推理模型中植入后门，使模型执行攻击者指定的行为，同时其思维链痕迹看起来完全正常。作者进一步提出课程训练方法用于直接投毒失效的场景，并分析模型抑制思维链中目标行为证据的机制。
Motivation: CoT 监控依赖一个假设：模型的推理痕迹能反映其真实行为。本文要检验这一假设在恶意攻击下的可靠性，并指出 CoT 监控可能更适合被理解为推理痕迹与最终响应之间的一致性问题，而非痕迹内的异常检测。
Method: 作者在推理模型上通过简单微调配方植入 CoT-Hidden 后门；当直接投毒无效时，采用课程训练 (curriculum training) 逐步教会模型在推理痕迹中隐藏目标行为。还通过因果干预定位与可见推理无关的触发条件激活通路，并利用残差流语言化在答案生成附近提供异常警示。
Result: 实验表明 CoT-Hidden 后门可跨多种推理模型架构和规模被诱导；因果干预发现一条不依赖可见推理的触发条件激活通路；残差流语言化能在答案生成附近给出异常警告，但无法识别触发词、目标行为或后门机制。
Conclusion: 这些发现表明 CoT 监控存在可被利用的局限，应把监控问题重新表述为推理痕迹与最终响应的一致性检查，而非对痕迹本身的异常检测。

papers.title: Topological Simplification in Predictive Coding Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study the topology of learned representations in predictive coding networks (PCNs), a neuro-inspired bidirectional architecture, using a quantitative layer-wise persistent homology analysis. We train well-performing PCNs on a synthetic classification dataset ($\geq 99.9\%$ test accuracy) and on MNIST ($\geq 95\%$ test accuracy), and measure how topological features change across layers for different architectures and activation functions. We find that smaller PCNs collapse connected components across layers earlier than larger models (Spearman $\unicode{x1D70C} \in [0.72, 0.79]$ across activations), with model size measured as the sum of hidden-layer widths. We also observe a strong negative correlation ($\unicode{x1D70C} = -0.58$) between the depth at which simplification occurs and reconstruction error; i.e., architectures that simplify later reconstruct better. Finally, a seed-level bootstrap comparison across architectures and activations shows that PCNs consistently collapse connected components later than matched MLPs, with an average difference of $3.6$ layers. These results suggest that persistent homology offers a useful quantitative lens on the compression--reconstruction tradeoff in PCNs, and that both model capacity and the recurrent, bidirectional dynamics of predictive coding inference shape when this tradeoff is resolved across layers.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2nd Annual Conference on Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS 2026); to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用逐层持续同调 (layer-wise persistent homology) 量化研究预测编码网络 (PCN) 学习表示的拓扑结构。作者在合成分类数据集（测试准确率 ≥99.9%）和 MNIST（≥95%）上训练表现良好的 PCN，考察不同架构与激活函数下拓扑特征随层的演化。结果显示更小的 PCN 会在更早的层坍缩连通分量 (Spearman ρ∈[0.72,0.79])，简化发生的深度与重构误差呈强负相关 (ρ=−0.58)，且 PCN 比匹配的 MLP 平均晚 3.6 层才坍缩连通分量。
Motivation: 预测编码网络的表示学习缺乏拓扑层面的定量理解，特别是压缩-重构权衡 (compression–reconstruction tradeoff) 在层间如何受模型容量与双向推理动态影响尚不清楚。
Method: 提出用逐层持续同调分析 PCN 各层表示的拓扑特征变化；在不同架构、激活函数和模型宽度（以隐藏层宽度之和度量）下训练 PCN，并通过种子级 bootstrap 比较 PCN 与匹配 MLP 的拓扑简化行为。
Result: 摘要报告三点定量发现：小模型更早跨层坍缩连通分量 (Spearman ρ∈[0.72,0.79])；简化发生深度与重构误差负相关 (ρ=−0.58)，即越晚简化的架构重构越好；PCN 比匹配 MLP 平均晚 3.6 层坍缩连通分量。
Conclusion: 持续同调为 PCN 的压缩-重构权衡提供了有用的定量视角，且模型容量与预测编码推理的循环双向动力学共同决定该权衡在层间何时被解决。

papers.title: Learning a Vector-Symbolic Model for Socio-Cultural Tasks
papers.abstract_en: How can we better represent the impact of sociocultural structures on decision making in computational cognitive models? Modeling this impact requires traversing multiple levels of semantic representation, however it is not immediately clear to a modeler which levels of representation are most salient to a given situation. Though large language models and cognitively grounded corpus models can represent broad semantic associations through co-occurences, the role of self representations in memory should be accounted for to determine how cultural associations shape decision making. We propose a declarative memory system to be used in the ACT-R cognitive architecture that represents semantic associations at multiple levels via a vector-symbolic autoencoder. We use a simple HRR operation to encode episodic memories differently from semantic memory vectors extracted from text to produce a final chunk activation for a memory request. We use ACT-R cognitive models of a racially contextualized implicit association test (IAT) to test this new declarative memory system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于 ACT-R 认知架构的陈述性记忆系统，通过向量符号自编码器（vector-symbolic autoencoder）在多个语义表示层上表征社会文化结构对决策的影响，并用 HRR 操作区分从文本提取的情景记忆与语义记忆，以生成记忆请求的 chunk 激活值。作者使用面向种族情境的内隐联想测验（IAT）的 ACT-R 认知模型来测试该系统。
Motivation: 计算认知模型中难以确定社会文化结构对决策影响的表征层级，而现有大语言模型和基于语料库的认知模型只能通过共现表示宽泛语义关联，缺乏对自我表征在记忆中的作用，无法解释文化关联如何塑造决策。
Method: 提出一个用于 ACT-R 的陈述性记忆系统，采用向量符号自编码器在多个层级表示语义关联；用简单的 HRR（holographic reduced representation）操作将来自文本的语义记忆向量与情景记忆编码区分开，最终为记忆请求生成 chunk 激活值。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅说明使用种族情境化 IAT 的 ACT-R 认知模型对该新记忆系统进行了测试。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的记忆系统能更好地表征社会文化结构对决策的影响，但摘要未明确讨论局限或适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast Object Removal Attacks on Safety-Critical Video-based Perception Systems
papers.abstract_en: By leveraging data from video-based perception systems, intelligent transportation systems (ITS) support safety-critical applications that improve road safety. However, adversaries may manipulate video frames to compromise downstream perception modules, causing failures in safety-critical functions and increasing risks to vulnerable road users. This paper presents a novel attack model and an end-to-end framework for near-real-time targeted object removal attack on a video-based safety-critical system. The end-to-end attack pipeline consists of four stages: localizing targets in each frame, retrieving coherent patches from earlier frames, blending them using context-aware alpha compositing, and reconstructing attacked frames. Experiments at an intersection on the South Carolina Connected Vehicle Testbed (SC-CVT) show that reconstructed frames have high global similarity to the originals, with frame-level Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 40 dB and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) above 0.996. Using the YOLO-based detector, the attack reduces object detections by up to 97.59% and achieves a frame-level attack success rate of 94.48%. Across the evaluated detectors and frame resolutions, the mean execution time ranges from 0.074 to 0.172 seconds per frame on GPU hardware, indicating near-real-time performance in testing. The forensic evaluation using several pretrained tamper-detection models shows limited ability to distinguish reconstructed from authentic frames. The findings suggest that video-based perception is vulnerable to stealthy object removal attacks that can degrade the performance of safety-critical applications by reducing object detectability. These findings can help develop mitigation strategies against adversarial object removal attacks that threaten safety-critical applications, such as vision-based pedestrian safety systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向基于视频的安全关键型智能交通感知系统的近实时目标移除攻击框架，攻击流程包含目标定位、从前帧检索连贯补丁、上下文感知 alpha 合成以及攻击帧重建。在 SC-CVT 交叉路口实验表明，重建帧与原始帧全局相似度很高（帧级 PSNR 高于 40 dB、SSIM 高于 0.996），YOLO 检测器的目标检测率最多下降 97.59%，帧级攻击成功率 94.48%，GPU 上每帧平均执行时间为 0.074–0.172 秒。多个预训练篡改检测模型对重建帧与真实帧的区分能力有限，说明视频感知系统易受此类隐蔽目标移除攻击。
Motivation: 智能交通系统依赖视频感知支撑安全关键应用，而攻击者可能篡改视频帧以破坏下游感知模块，进而危及弱势道路使用者安全；现有工作缺乏针对视频感知系统的近实时、端到端目标移除攻击模型。
Method: 提出一个端到端攻击流水线，由四个阶段组成：在每帧中定位目标、从更早帧检索连贯补丁、利用上下文感知 alpha 合成进行融合、重建被攻击帧，从而实现近实时的目标移除。
Result: 在 SC-CVT 交叉路口实验中，重建帧的帧级 PSNR 超过 40 dB 且 SSIM 超过 0.996；基于 YOLO 的检测器上目标检测减少最多 97.59%，帧级攻击成功率为 94.48%；在测试的检测器和分辨率下，GPU 上平均执行时间为每帧 0.074 至 0.172 秒；多个预训练篡改检测模型难以区分重建帧与真实帧。
Conclusion: 视频感知系统对隐蔽目标移除攻击存在脆弱性，这类攻击可通过降低目标可检测性来削弱安全关键应用的性能；研究结果有助于为视觉行人安全系统等应用制定对抗目标移除攻击的防御策略。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Unified 2D Framework for DeepLesion Detection, Segmentation and Short Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: In previous work, we integrated large language models (LLMs) into the lesion segmentation model based on the ULS23 DeepLesion dataset, using short-form findings from the reports. In this study, we developed a unified 2D lesion analysis framework that integrates LLM-based reasoning, lesion bounding box detection, segmentation, and radiology report generation from the original DeepLesion dataset. In the testing phase, we achieved relatively high lesion bounding box detection accuracy with mAP50 of 70.1%, mAP50-95 of 46.4%; Lesion segmentation performance with a Dice score of 62.6%; short report generation accuracy with BLEU_1 score of 64.3%, BLEU_4 score of 49.6%, METEOR of 34.7%, and ROUGE_L of 60.1%. In this work, we address the challenging issue of segmentation in the original DeepLesion dataset and achieve a 28.5% Dice score improvement over the nnUNet lesion segmentation model. We also integrated spatial and anatomical context into the DeepLesion short report generation. We released the implementation, dataset, and models on Github. https://github.com/ruida/2D_DeepLesion_Foundation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在之前基于 ULS23 DeepLesion 的工作基础上，提出一个统一的 2D 病灶分析框架，将 LLM 推理、病灶包围框检测、分割和影像报告生成集成于原始 DeepLesion 数据集。测试阶段取得病灶检测 mAP50 70.1%、mAP50-95 46.4%，分割 Dice 62.6%，短报告生成 BLEU_1 64.3%、BLEU_4 49.6%、METEOR 34.7%、ROUGE_L 60.1%，并称相比 nnUNet 病灶分割模型 Dice 提升 28.5%。作者已发布实现、数据集和模型。
Motivation: 原始 DeepLesion 数据集上的病灶分割具有挑战性，此前工作仅基于 ULS23 数据集集成 LLM；本文目标是构建一个能同时完成检测、分割和短报告生成的统一 2D 病灶分析框架。
Method: 提出统一 2D 病灶分析框架，在原始 DeepLesion 数据上集成基于 LLM 的推理、病灶包围框检测、分割与放射学报告生成，并将空间和解剖上下文引入短报告生成过程。
Result: 测试阶段检测 mAP50 为 70.1%、mAP50-95 为 46.4%；分割 Dice 为 62.6%，相比 nnUNet 病灶分割模型 Dice 提升 28.5%；短报告生成的 BLEU_1 为 64.3%、BLEU_4 为 49.6%、METEOR 为 34.7%、ROUGE_L 为 60.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该统一框架解决了原始 DeepLesion 中分割困难的问题并显著改善分割性能，同时通过空间与解剖上下文增强了短报告生成；实现、数据集和模型已在 Github 上公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detecting high-frequency brain disorder signals using dynamic mode decomposition from EEG
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies have reported clearly identifiable dynamical changes in the high-frequency range of EEG signals recorded during specific stimuli, such as visual or auditory inputs, or in cases of brain disorders like epileptic seizures. In this study, we utilized Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to extract consistent and persistent dynamical changes in the high-frequency band from the signals of neurologically relevant EEG channels. High-frequency DMD modes were employed as features, composing a feature table. Through post-processing, a random distribution test was performed, revealing that approximately 70% of the samples exhibited consistent high-frequency dynamics within the signal of a specific channel. Furthermore, classification experiments confirmed that the PCA components of the feature table that passed the test formed a consistent pattern that distinguished the alcohol-dependent group from the control group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用动态模式分解 (Dynamic Mode Decomposition, DMD) 从 EEG 信号中提取高频频段的一致动力学特征，用于检测脑疾病相关信号。随机分布检验显示约 70% 的样本在特定通道表现出一致的高频动力学；分类实验进一步表明，通过检验的特征表的 PCA 主成分可以区分酒精依赖组与对照组。
Motivation: 现有研究指出高频 EEG 在特定刺激或脑疾病（如癫痫发作）中会出现可识别的动力学变化，但需要一个能够一致且持续提取这些高频变化的方法。
Method: 对神经相关 EEG 通道应用 DMD 提取高频模式，将其作为特征构成特征表；后处理阶段执行随机分布检验筛选样本，再对通过检验的特征表进行 PCA 降维并用于分类。
Result: 摘要报告约 70% 的样本在特定通道中呈现一致的高频动力学；PCA 化的 DMD 特征形成一致模式，能够区分酒精依赖组与对照组。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 DMD 能够提取与脑疾病相关的高频 EEG 信号特征，但其验证局限于酒精依赖数据与特定通道，未提供更广泛适用性的证据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SAGE: Semantic Explainability of Attention-Based Survival Models in Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) is the predominant approach for slide-level prediction in computational pathology, yet its attention maps provide only local explanations: they indicate where a model focuses but not which histological features drive its predictions or how the model behaves across a patient cohort. We present Semantic Attention Global Explanations (SAGE), a post-hoc framework that extracts global, language-grounded explanations from a frozen ABMIL model. Using a pathology vision-language model, SAGE scores image patches against a dictionary of 25 histological concepts, aggregates these scores according to the model's learned attention, and quantifies how each concept relates to prediction risk across a cohort. Applied to survival prediction using seven TCGA cancer cohorts and three foundation models, SAGE recovered established prognostic features, such as the adverse association of necrosis, while revealing cancer-specific biology, including a favorable angiogenic signature in renal cell carcinoma consistent with known molecular subtypes. Ablation studies demonstrated that these associations depend on the model's learned attention rather than concept prevalence alone, and that the concept dictionary captures much of the prognostic information encoded by the foundation model features. Through semantically-grounded explanations, SAGE provides a scalable, model-agnostic framework for understanding what ABMIL survival models learn, enabling pathologists to interpret model behavior at the cohort level and offering the potential for biomarker identification.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the MICCAI Workshop on Interpretability of Machine Intelligence in Medical Image Computing (iMIMIC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE（Semantic Attention Global Explanations），一个面向计算病理学中基于注意力的多实例学习（ABMIL）生存模型的后处理解释框架。它借助病理学视觉-语言模型将图像块与 25 个组织学概念进行打分，再按模型学到的注意力聚合这些分数，从而在患者队列层面量化每个概念与预测风险的关系。在七个 TCGA 癌症队列和三个基础模型上的实验表明，该方法能恢复已知预后特征并揭示癌症特异性生物学。
Motivation: ABMIL 是计算病理学中切片级预测的主流方法，但其注意力图只能提供局部解释：能指出模型关注的位置，却不能说明哪些组织学特征驱动预测，也无法体现模型在患者队列层面的行为。
Method: 提出后处理框架 SAGE：使用病理学视觉-语言模型对图像块按 25 个组织学概念词典打分，依据冻结的 ABMIL 模型学到的注意力聚合这些概念分数，然后在队列层面量化每个概念与预测风险之间的关联。
Result: 在七个 TCGA 癌症队列和三个基础模型上，SAGE 恢复了如坏死与不良预后相关等已知预后特征，并揭示癌症特异性生物学，例如肾细胞癌中与已知分子亚型一致的有利血管生成信号。消融研究表明这些关联依赖于模型学到的注意力而非单纯的概念出现频率，且概念词典捕获了基础模型特征中大部分的预后信息。
Conclusion: SAGE 提供了一种可扩展、与模型无关的框架，用于在队列层面理解 ABMIL 生存模型学到的内容，使病理学家能够解释模型行为，并具有生物标志物发现的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Hyperfinite Framework for Score-Based Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models are typically formulated using continuous-time stochastic differential equations and measure-theoretic stochastic calculus. In this paper, we develop a hyperfinite formulation of score-based generative modeling within the framework of Nonstandard Analysis. Starting from an internal diffusion process on a hyperfinite grid, we derive the associated infinitesimal generator and establish its correspondence with the classical Fokker--Planck equation. We then obtain a hyperfinite backward-mean identity that yields the reverse-time drift and provides a constructive derivation of the reverse-time SDE. Building on these results, we show that minimization of an internal score-matching objective recovers the score function required by the reverse-time dynamics, thereby connecting score estimation with generative sampling directly at the hyperfinite level. Under suitable assumptions, we further derive a hyperfinite Girsanov formula and establish a relationship between likelihood optimization and Fisher-divergence objectives. Finally, we analyze the second-order consistency of the hyperfinite dynamics and show that the leading correction term depends explicitly on the fourth moment of the increment distribution, with the Gaussian value $κ=3$ eliminating the leading dispersion contribution. Taken together, these results provide a unified hyperfinite framework for diffusion-based generative modeling--while laying foundations for further extensions--that links discrete grid dynamics, reverse-time diffusion, score matching, and likelihood-based formulations within a common nonstandard setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在非标准分析 (Nonstandard Analysis) 框架下，为基于分数的扩散生成模型建立了一套超有限 (hyperfinite) 表述。作者从超有限网格上的内部扩散过程出发，推导出无穷小生成元并建立其与经典 Fokker-Planck 方程的对应；随后得到超有限反向均值恒等式，从而构造性地导出反向时间 SDE，并证明内部分数匹配目标可直接恢复反向动力学所需的分数函数。论文还推导了超有限 Girsanov 公式，建立似然优化与 Fisher 散度目标之间的关系，并对二阶一致性进行了分析。
Motivation: 基于分数的扩散模型通常依赖连续时间随机微分方程和测度论随机微积分；论文旨在引入非标准分析，将离散网格动力学、反向时间扩散、分数匹配和似然表述统一到一个共同的超有限框架中。
Method: 从超有限网格上的内部扩散过程出发，推导其无穷小生成元并对应经典 Fokker-Planck 方程；利用超有限反向均值恒等式得到反向时间漂移和反向 SDE；通过内部分数匹配目标恢复分数函数，并在适当假设下推导超有限 Girsanov 公式及似然与 Fisher 散度的关系；最后分析超有限动力学的二阶一致性。
Result: 摘要报告的是理论结果而非实验：内部分数匹配可恢复分数函数；超有限 Girsanov 公式将似然优化与 Fisher 散度目标联系起来；二阶一致性的前导修正项显式依赖于增量分布的四阶矩，其中高斯值 κ=3 会消除前导色散贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为扩散生成建模提供了一个统一的超有限框架，将离散网格动力学、反向扩散、分数匹配与似然表述置于同一非标准设定下，并为后续扩展奠定基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PixelUp: Zero-Shot Semantic Feature Upsampling for Fine-Grained Vision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have become essential backbones for downstream tasks due to their strong and transferable visual representations. However, their patch-token-level features are often too coarse for dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation and depth estimation when accurate fine-grained predictions are required. Feature upsampling methods have been developed to recover pixel-level detail but still face limitations. Learnable upsamplers are often designed for a specific encoders and must be retrained for different encoders. Image-guided methods that use shallow pixel encoders often introduce textural artifacts and lack the semantic guidance needed for accurate downstream predictions. We introduce PixelUp, a zero-shot VFM-agnostic upsampler achieving semantic awareness through a coarse-to-fine chain of windowed cross-attention architecture guided by multi-scale semantic features. We demonstrate that PixelUp outperforms both VFM-specific and VFM-agnostic upsamplers, achieving state-of-the-art performance on dense prediction tasks with an average improvement of +1.2 mIoU on semantic segmentation and +0.25 $δ_1$, on NYUv2 depth estimation across VFMs. PixelUp further improves training-free open-vocabulary and unsupervised semantic segmentation by an average of +1.3 mIoU and +0.5 mIoU, respectively. Code available at https://pixelup-project.vercel.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PixelUp，一种零样本、与视觉基础模型 (VFM) 无关的特征上采样器，通过多尺度语义特征引导的粗到细窗口交叉注意力架构恢复像素级细节。摘要报告其在语义分割和深度估计等稠密预测任务上优于 VFM 专用和 VFM 无关的上采样方法，并提升训练自由的开词汇与无监督语义分割性能。
Motivation: 自监督视觉基础模型的 patch 级特征对语义分割、深度估计等稠密预测任务而言过于粗糙；现有可学习上采样器通常针对特定编码器需要重训，而图像引导方法易引入纹理伪影且缺乏语义引导。
Method: PixelUp 采用粗到细的窗口化交叉注意力 (windowed cross-attention) 链，并利用多尺度语义特征进行引导，实现零样本且不依赖特定 VFM 的上采样。
Result: 摘要报告 PixelUp 在不同 VFM 上平均提升语义分割 mIoU +1.2，NYUv2 深度估计 δ1 +0.25；在训练自由的开词汇和无监督语义分割上分别平均提升 +1.3 mIoU 和 +0.5 mIoU。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PixelUp 作为 VFM 无关的零样本上采样器，无需针对编码器重训即可获得语义感知的像素级细节，并为稠密预测任务提供通用方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Better, Stronger, Faster, and Broader: Structured All-Mask Prediction for MLLM-Based Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: MLLM-based segmentation faces a core segmentation trilemma: high segmentation performance, preserved dialogue ability, and fast inference. Embedding-prediction methods may disrupt language modeling through pixel-level objectives, whereas next-token generation is inefficient for dense masks. We propose All-Mask Prediction, decoupling autoregressive dialogue from non-autoregressive mask prediction. Its binary instantiation, STAMP (Simultaneous Textual All-Mask Prediction), emits an in-vocabulary <SEG> trigger, fuses image-aligned mask tokens with corresponding patch features, and uses hybrid attention to classify all tokens as foreground or background in one pass. It thereby combines strong referring and reasoning segmentation with preserved multimodal ability and efficient inference. However, binary masks cannot retain multiple semantic or instance identities without repeated target-specific predictions. We therefore propose Structured All-Mask Prediction and develop STAMPlus. It generates a target list with explicit IDs and optional boxes, binds these IDs to a shared multi-class mask space, and jointly predicts all targets in one non-autoregressive pass. A single unified checkpoint retains STAMP's referring and reasoning capabilities while extending to open-vocabulary semantic, instance-aware, and remote-sensing small-target segmentation, where high-resolution mask-token scaling preserves finer spatial evidence. Across these settings, STAMPlus achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance, preserves general multimodal instruction following, and reduces 12-category latency from 13.50s for repeated STAMP inference to 5.16s. Further analyses show that accurate target cues improve segmentation and learned spatial grounding benefits look-twice reasoning. Overall, STAMPlus resolves the trilemma beyond single-target prediction.

TL;DR: 本文针对基于 MLLM 的分割任务提出 All-Mask Prediction 框架，将自回归对话与非自回归掩码预测解耦。其二元版本 STAMP 通过在词表内触发 <SEG>、融合图像对齐掩码 token 与 patch 特征，并利用混合注意力一次性完成前后景分类；进一步的结构化版本 STAMPlus 生成带显式 ID 与可选框的目标列表，在共享多类掩码空间中联合预测所有目标，覆盖开放词汇语义、实例级及遥感小目标分割。摘要称 STAMPlus 在各设定下达到 SOTA 分割性能，保留通用多模态指令跟随能力，并将 12 类别延迟从重复 STAMP 推理的 13.50 秒降至 5.16 秒。

papers.title: Confident but Unreliable: A Behavioral Safety Audit of Vision-Language Models on Brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), including medical specialists, are increasingly proposed for medical imaging, yet their stated confidence is rarely evaluated separately from correctness. We use brain MRI as a controlled, high-stakes testbed for a broader failure mode in frontier multimodal systems: models can appear competent while lacking reliable self-knowledge. We present an automatically graded behavioral audit and pilot study of six instruction-tuned VLMs (five general-purpose and one medical specialist) on 4,102 images (4,032 axial/coronal/sagittal MRI slices from 250 subjects plus 70 non-brain/noise controls), with labels derived from public metadata and released expert segmentation masks rather than new human annotation. Across models, answer coverage is near-complete, but verbalized-confidence calibration is poor: ECE ranges from 0.27 to 0.40, mean confidence on incorrect answers ranges from 0.82 to 0.97, and 33-46% of answered items are high-confidence errors. The most accurate model is also the most confident on its errors, while a base/specialist family contrast suggests that medical adaptation improves tumor-presence detection without improving confidence reliability. Open-ended diagnostics further show that hallucination and abstention vary separately from multiple-choice accuracy. These findings argue that medical-image VLM evaluation should report verbalized-confidence reliability, confident error, hallucination, and abstention alongside accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对六个指令微调视觉语言模型（VLM，五个通用模型和一个医学专科模型）在脑MRI数据上进行行为安全审计，使用4,102张图像（含250名被试的4,032张轴向/冠状/矢状MRI切片及70张非脑/噪声对照），标签来自公共元数据和已发布专家分割掩码而非新的人工标注。摘要报告答案覆盖率近乎完整，但口头化置信度校准差：ECE为0.27–0.40，错误答案的平均置信度为0.82–0.97，33–46%的已回答项目是高置信度错误；最准确的模型在其错误上也是最自信的。作者认为医学图像VLM评估应同时报告口头置信度可靠性、高置信度错误、幻觉和弃权。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在医学影像中越来越常用，但已有评估很少将模型陈述的置信度与正确性分开考察。作者以脑MRI为受控测试场景，探究前沿多模态系统可能表现出能力却缺乏可靠自我知识（self-knowledge）的失败模式。
Method: 提出一种自动评分的行为审计（behavioral audit）和初步研究：对六个指令微调VLM在脑MRI图像上进行多项选择与开放式诊断评估，利用公开元数据和专家分割掩码生成标签，系统测量回答覆盖率、置信度校准、高置信度错误、幻觉与弃权。
Result: 摘要报告ECE为0.27–0.40，错误回答的平均置信度在0.82–0.97之间，33–46%的回答为高置信度错误；最准确模型同时对其错误最自信。基础/专科模型对比显示医学适配（medical adaptation）提升肿瘤存在检测，但未改善置信度可靠性；开放式诊断中幻觉和弃权行为与多项选择准确性分离。
Conclusion: 摘要强调医学图像VLM评估应将口头化置信度可靠性、高置信度错误（confident error）、幻觉（hallucination）和弃权（abstention）与准确性一并报告，以反映行为安全性。

papers.title: Evaluation Blindness: How Silent Measurement Failures Corrupt AI Systems from Training to Deployment
papers.abstract_en: AI systems can fail silently. The failure propagates through training loops, evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring stacks until downstream harm makes it visible. This paper introduces evaluation blindness: a measurement function M exhibits evaluation blindness with respect to failure class F when it produces readings indistinguishable from a healthy state while the system is actually failing, with no auxiliary signal flagging the gap. The problem surfaces at two lifecycle stages the literature has treated separately. At training time, reward models are gamed, importance-sampling corrections are silently miscalculated, and benchmark contamination inflates fine-tuning evaluations, all while loss curves look healthy and gradient updates proceed normally. At deployment time, monitoring fails to catch six classes of production failure, including an Operational category that is 100% silent by structural definition. We provide a formal detectability predicate unifying both stages. Four training-time case studies trace concrete breakdowns, including a real implementation bug in TRL PR #6594 where gradients are corrupted as loss decreases normally. A six-class taxonomy validated against 50 real-world incidents from court documents and regulatory filings finds that 53% of verifiable public failures were silent. A failure budget framework ties acceptable failure rates to use-case risk class. The implication is direct: measurement infrastructure is a correctness concern across the full AI lifecycle, not just at evaluation time. Data, code, and taxonomy schema are at https://github.com/priyanka25aug/llm-failure-taxonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“评估盲区”(evaluation blindness) 概念：当系统实际失效时，测量函数 M 仍产生与健康状态无法区分的读数，且无辅助信号提示偏差。作者给出统一的检测性谓词，将训练期（奖励模型被博弈、重要性采样修正静默算错、基准污染虚高微调评估）与部署期（六类生产故障，其中 Operational 类按结构定义 100% 静默）纳入同一框架。基于 50 起真实事故（来自法庭文件与监管申报）验证的六类分类法显示，53% 的可核实公开故障是静默的，并提出将可接受故障率与用例风险等级挂钩的 failure budget 框架。
Motivation: 现有文献把训练期评估与部署期监控分开处理，但测量失效会在两个阶段静默传播，直到下游危害显现才被察觉；缺少统一框架刻画“读数正常但系统已失败”这一现象，也无法系统评估其普遍性。
Method: 形式化定义 evaluation blindness 与可检测性谓词，覆盖训练和部署两个生命周期阶段；通过四个训练期案例（包括 TRL PR #6594 中一个真实实现 bug：loss 正常下降时梯度已被破坏）展示具体失效路径，并构建六类生产故障分类法，用 50 起真实事件（来自法庭与监管文件）验证。
Result: 对可核实的公开 AI 事故，53% 属于静默失败；其中 Operational 类故障按结构定义 100% 静默。数据、代码与分类 schema 已在 GitHub 开源。
Conclusion: 测量基础设施是贯穿整个 AI 生命周期的正确性 (correctness) 问题，而不仅是评估阶段问题；failure budget 框架把可接受故障率与具体用例的风险等级绑定，为在不同风险场景下设置容忍阈值提供依据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs for Efficient Options Pricing Models
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel application of Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs (NNLCI) to improve the efficiency of existing numerical methods for pricing multi-asset options. The most concise input format for NNLCI has been introduced, offering substantial convenience and efficiency. NNLCI uses a neural network to locally correct solutions from a coarse mesh and a refined mesh (relative to the coarse one), requiring only a minimal amount of high-fidelity training data. We demonstrate this approach on cash-or-nothing options under the Black-Scholes equation in one, two, and three spatial dimensions, and on single-asset down-and-out barrier call options under the Heston stochastic-volatility model (whose pricing PDE is two-dimensional in the spot price $S$ and the instantaneous variance $v$). In each case, NNLCI reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the refined-mesh numerical solution by a factor of approximately 4-12 on test sets, even when the neural network is trained on only a small subset of parameter combinations. These results demonstrate that NNLCI significantly reduces computational requirements for high-dimensional problems in real-time options trading and risk management, offering low training costs and strong generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将具有局部收敛输入的人工神经网络（NNLCI）应用于多资产期权定价，以提升现有数值方法的效率。该方法用神经网络在粗网格与细网格解之间做局部修正，只需少量高保真训练数据；作者在 Black-Scholes 方程下一、二、三维的 cash-or-nothing 期权以及 Heston 随机波动率模型下的单资产 down-and-out barrier call 期权上验证了效果。结果表明测试集上细网格数值解的均方根误差（RMSE）可降低约 4-12 倍。
Motivation: 多资产期权的实时定价与风险管理对数值方法要求高，传统方法在高维问题上的计算开销大；本文目标是构造一种只需极少高保真样本即可显著改进现有数值解的方案。
Method: NNLCI 利用神经网络对粗网格解与细网格解之间的局部误差进行校正，并引入了该网络最简洁的输入格式，从而在降低数据需求的同时提升使用便利性。
Result: 在一至三维 Black-Scholes 模型下的 cash-or-nothing 期权和 Heston 模型下的 down-and-out barrier call 期权上，即使用少量参数组合训练，NNLCI 也能将细网格数值解的 RMSE 降低约 4-12 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 NNLCI 能以低训练成本和强泛化能力显著降低高维实时期权交易与风险管理问题的计算需求。

papers.title: Tight Information Complexity of the Coin Problem in the Broadcast Model
papers.abstract_en: We study distributed testing of $\mathrm{Ber}(α)$ versus $\mathrm{Ber}(β)$ in the broadcast, or shared-blackboard, model. For protocols with constant advantage, we characterise up to universal constant factors the information complexity under either hypothesis for every pair $β<α$. The characterisation shows that the two information costs can be quite different and identifies three parameter regimes, with optimal protocols based respectively on clean samples, a noisy binary symmetric channel, and an asymmetric $Z$-channel. The lower bounds rely on a novel mixed Hellinger--Jensen--Shannon inequality that may be of independent interest. We also characterise the constant-advantage information complexity of testing arbitrary discrete distributions via an optimisation problem over channels, and show that binary-output channels suffice. We obtain bounds for bounded likelihood-ratio distributions, and give general upper bounds in terms of $χ^2$ divergence. As applications, we recover the broadcast-model set-disjointness lower bound, and derive stronger lower bounds in the multi-pass streaming setting for some problems considered in prior work.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 广播模型中的分布式二元假设检验信息复杂度此前缺乏紧刻画，且两种假设下的信息代价关系不明确；该问题与集不相交（set-disjointness）下界及多趟流式（multi-pass streaming）下界相关。
Method: 给出常数优势下信息复杂度的完整刻画，为下界提出新的混合 Hellinger–Jensen–Shannon 不等式；同时将任意离散分布检验的常数优势信息复杂度转化为信道上的优化问题，并证明二元输出信道已经足够。
Result: 对 Ber(α) 对 Ber(β) 检验，在常数优势下精确（到常数因子）刻画两种假设的信息复杂度，并识别出三个参数区域；对任意离散分布检验，证明二元输出信道充分；对有限似然比分布给出界，并用 χ² 散度给出一般上界。作为应用，恢复了广播模型集不相交下界，并在多趟流式设置中导出比先前工作更强的下界。
Conclusion: 作者强调新混合不等式本身可能具有独立价值，并指出该刻画可直接导出广播模型和多趟流式设置中的更强通信下界。
