papers.title: Towards a new paradigm of scientific discovery with socialized artificial intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery has advanced through successive transformations in the organization of knowledge. Observation and experimentation established the empirical foundations of science. Theory made it possible to derive general principles from particular phenomena. Computation extended inquiry into systems beyond direct observation, while data-intensive methods opened new spaces of pattern and prediction. Science now confronts a different frontier. The central challenge is no longer simply to produce more information, but to organize expanding knowledge, reasoning, and evidence into a coherent process of discovery. Here, we introduce Bridging Literature, Agents, and Zero-gap Experimentation (BLAZE), a paradigm of socialized scientific intelligence. BLAZE conceives AI not as an assistant for isolated research tasks, but as an organizational infrastructure for scientific discovery. It connects persistent knowledge, collective reasoning, empirical validation, and human judgment within a continuous research lifecycle, transforming fragmented activities into a cumulative process of inquiry, criticism, and revision. The central premise of BLAZE is that scientific intelligence does not arise from computation alone. It emerges from the sustained interaction among knowledge, hypotheses, experiments, and collective verification. By organizing humans and machines within a shared scientific process, BLAZE makes discovery more traceable, reproducible, and cumulative while preserving human creativity, judgment, and responsibility. Socialized scientific intelligence may provide a foundation for the next era of science. Its purpose is not to replace human discovery, but to extend the scale, depth, and continuity of collective scientific inquiry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 BLAZE（Bridging Literature, Agents, and Zero-gap Experimentation）的科研范式，主张将 AI 视为组织科学发现的基础设施，而非孤立研究任务的助手。BLAZE 把持久知识、集体推理、实证验证与人类判断纳入连续的研究生命周期，使科学发现更可追溯、可复现和可累积。文章认为科学智能源于知识、假设、实验与集体验证之间的持续互动，而非仅靠计算。
Motivation: 科学面临的新挑战不再是产生更多信息，而是如何将不断扩张的知识、推理和证据组织成连贯的发现过程；现有将 AI 作为孤立任务助手的思路不足以应对这一组织性问题。
Method: 提出 BLAZE 范式，通过连接文献、智能体（agents）与零间隙实验（zero-gap experimentation），构建涵盖知识、推理、验证和人类判断的持续科研生命周期，将碎片化活动转化为累积性的探究、批评与修正过程。
Result: 摘要为概念性论述，未给出具体的实验数据或量化结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为社会化科学智能（socialized scientific intelligence）可能为下一阶段科学提供基础，其目标不是取代人类发现，而是扩展集体科学探究的规模、深度与连续性，同时保留人类的创造力、判断力与责任。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving AI Verification via Minimal Information Disclosure
papers.abstract_en: AI verification crosses a trust boundary: a verifier must learn enough to establish an authorized claim, yet the same evidence can reveal sensitive details about the model, workload, or hardware. We introduce minimal information disclosure (MID), which designs and quantifies the information content of verifier-facing evidence itself. MID measures collateral leakage with conditional mutual information: what the release reveals about the protected property after the authorized result is known. MID is general by design: it can accommodate different verification goals, protected properties, evidence sources, and deployment constraints. To demonstrate MID's practicality, we evaluate it on four physical measurements and six verification tasks spanning execution type, hardware identity, compute scale, and model identity. These experiments use three mechanism-design variables--the evidence channel, collection policy, and release transformation--but MID is not limited to these choices and can accommodate other deployable mechanisms. Across these tasks, MID produces three releases with perfect held-out verification and zero measured collateral leakage, while the remaining tasks yield explicit privacy--utility frontiers. MID also supports ZKP-certified releases: we demonstrate our proposed linear-projection mechanism using a Groth16 zk-SNARK.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出最小信息披露 (minimal information disclosure, MID) 框架，用于设计并量化面向验证者 (verifier) 的证据信息内容，以在 AI 验证中平衡验证能力与隐私保护。MID 用条件互信息衡量 collateral leakage，即授权结果已知后发布内容对受保护属性的额外泄露；在四个物理测量和六个验证任务上评估，得到三个完美 held-out 验证且零测量泄露的发布，其余任务呈现显式隐私-效用前沿，并支持基于 Groth16 zk-SNARK 的 ZKP 认证发布。
Motivation: AI 验证跨越信任边界：验证者必须学到足够信息以建立授权声明，但同一证据可能泄露模型、工作负载或硬件的敏感细节。现有方法缺少对验证证据本身信息内容的通用设计与量化手段。
Method: 提出 MID 框架，以条件互信息度量 collateral leakage，并引入证据通道、收集策略和发布变换三个机制设计变量。作者还提出线性投影机制，并用 Groth16 zk-SNARK 实现 ZKP 认证的发布。
Result: 在跨执行类型、硬件身份、计算规模和模型身份的六个验证任务上，MID 产生三个具有完美 held-out 验证和零测量 collateral leakage 的发布，其余任务给出了显式的隐私-效用前沿。
Conclusion: MID 具有通用性，可适配不同验证目标、受保护属性、证据来源和部署约束；摘要强调其机制设计不限于实验中的三种变量，可扩展到其他可部署机制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DAIF: A Data-Driven Intermediate Fusion Framework for Multimodal Supervised Learning via Approximate Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal supervised learning seeks to leverage multiple heterogeneous data sources to improve predictive performance. A central challenge is determining the fusion granularity across modalities: over-integration may amplify noise while under-integration fails to exploit cross-modal dependence. Existing approaches rely on pre-specified fusion architectures, from early to late fusion, that may not adapt to the underlying dependence structure among modalities. We propose DAIF, a data adaptive intermediate fusion framework that combines random matrix theory and non-parametric dependence measures to learn fusion structure directly from data. We operate under a Bayesian multimodal factor model where the prior on the latent factors determines the cross-modal dependence. Our method clusters modalities based on estimated intermodal dependence, then performs clusterwise empirical Bayes estimation of the priors. These estimated priors are used to construct denoisers within an approximate message passing (AMP) framework, yielding denoised low-dimensional features that borrow strength across related modalities while preserving modality-specific signal. The resulting embeddings are used for downstream supervised prediction. We evaluate the framework through simulations under varying dependence structures and signal regimes, comparing against several benchmark methods, and demonstrate its practical utility on two multimodal datasets, namely a trimodal TEA-seq dataset (Swanson et al., 2021) and TCGA-BRCA dataset (Goldman et al., 2020). In the first example, we predict the expression level of a T-cell differentiation marker protein and in the second case we analyze patient survival prediction based on multimodal information. Our method competes with or outperforms the state-of-the-art techniques in both prediction problems, demonstrating its versatility across diverse supervised learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAIF，一种数据自适应的中间融合框架，用于多模态监督学习。它结合随机矩阵理论与非参数相关性度量，在贝叶斯多模态因子模型下直接从数据学习融合结构：先按估计的模态间相关性对模态聚类，再做簇级经验贝叶斯先验估计，并在近似消息传递 (AMP) 框架内构造去噪器，得到借用相关模态信息、同时保留模态特定信号的低维特征用于下游预测。模拟实验和 TEA-seq、TCGA-BRCA 两个多模态数据集上的结果显示，该方法在两个预测任务上与现有技术相当或更优。
Motivation: 多模态监督学习的核心难题是确定模态间的融合粒度：过度融合会放大噪声，融合不足则无法利用跨模态依赖。现有方法依赖预先指定的早融合到晚融合架构，不能适应模态间潜在的依赖结构。
Method: 提出 DAIF 框架，将随机矩阵理论与非参数依赖度量结合；在贝叶斯多模态因子模型中，用潜因子先验刻画跨模态依赖，基于估计的模态间依赖对模态聚类，进行簇级经验贝叶斯先验估计，并在 AMP 框架中用估计的先验构造去噪器，最终生成用于监督预测的去噪低维嵌入。
Result: 在多种依赖结构和信号强度下的模拟实验中与若干基准方法对比，并在三模态 TEA-seq 数据集上预测 T 细胞分化标记蛋白表达水平、在 TCGA-BRCA 数据集上进行基于多模态信息的患者生存预测；方法在两个任务上与最先进技术相当或更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能适应数据中的跨模态依赖结构，并展示其在多样化监督学习任务上的通用性；未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Oh Deer, How Should I Handle This? Seasonal Priors for Selective Wildlife Annotation and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained wildlife classification in aerial imagery is limited not only by model performance, but also by unreliable labels: animals occupy few pixels, key visual cues vary seasonally, and modality-specific evidence can be ambiguous. We study adult-male identification in red deer, where the antler cycle defines predictable windows of reliable evidence for both annotation and prediction. Using 7,295 RGB-only, thermal-only, and matched RGB+thermal crop sets labeled by three annotators, we show that seasonal structure links (I) annotation quality, (II) downstream classification, and (III) selective prediction. Matched RGB+thermal review resolves more samples than either single modality, recovering majority-male labels otherwise missed by RGB or thermal alone, in human based as well as model based classification. Months with high annotator abstention also show lower classifier confidence, and soft seasonal priors mainly benefit the season-limited thermal view. Uncertainty-band abstention further improves covered accuracy up to 98.9%, though at reduced coverage and with deferral that falls disproportionately on males. Overall, a biologically grounded seasonal calendar predicts where annotation and prediction are unreliable, and can guide both annotation protocol design and modality weighting.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the archival (proceedings) track of the CV4Ecology workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究航空影像中马鹿成年雄性识别的标注与分类不可靠性问题，利用鹿角周期这一生物学季节结构来连接标注质量、下游分类与选择性预测。基于 7,295 个由三位标注者标注的 RGB-only、thermal-only 及匹配 RGB+thermal 图像块，作者发现季节先验可预测标注与预测的不可靠区间。匹配的 RGB+thermal 联合审阅比单一模态解决更多样本，不确定性带弃权可将覆盖准确率提升至 98.9%，但会降低覆盖度且弃权不成比例地落在雄性样本上。
Motivation: 细粒度野生动物分类不仅受模型性能限制，还受不可靠标注制约：动物仅占少数像素、关键视觉线索随季节变化、模态特异性证据可能具有歧义。作者选择马鹿成年雄性识别，因为鹿角周期为标注和预测提供了可预测的可靠证据窗口。
Method: 使用 7,295 个 RGB-only、thermal-only 和匹配 RGB+thermal 图像块，由三位标注者标注，证明季节结构同时影响标注质量、下游分类和选择性预测。提出软季节先验 (soft seasonal priors) 与不确定性带弃权 (uncertainty-band abstention) 作为处理手段。
Result: 匹配的 RGB+thermal 联合审阅比单一 RGB 或 thermal 恢复更多多数雄性标签；标注者弃权率高的月份同时对应更低的分类器置信度；软季节先验主要惠及受季节限制的热成像视图；不确定性带弃权可将覆盖准确率提升至 98.9%，但代价是覆盖度下降且弃权不成比例地落在雄性样本上。
Conclusion: 生物学上合理的季节日历能预测标注和预测均不可靠的区域，可用于指导标注协议设计和模态加权。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 使用 7,295 个 RGB-only、thermal-only 和匹配 RGB+thermal 图像块，由三位标注者标注，证明季节结构同时影响标注质量、下游分类和选择性预测。提出软季节先验 (soft seasonal priors) 与不确定性带弃权 (uncertainty-band abstention) 作为处理手段。
summary_sections.result: 匹配的 RGB+thermal 联合审阅比单一 RGB 或 thermal 恢复更多多数雄性标签；标注者弃权率高的月份同时对应更低的分类器置信度；软季节先验主要惠及受季节限制的热成像视图；不确定性带弃权可将覆盖准确率提升至 98.9%，但代价是覆盖度下降且弃权不成比例地落在雄性样本上。
summary_sections.conclusion: 生物学上合理的季节日历能预测标注和预测均不可靠的区域，可用于指导标注协议设计和模态加权。

papers.title: Search, Inspect, Fetch: Exploiting Boolean Retrieval for Deep-Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing deep-research agents use a search-visit workflow that retrieves and reads whole pages, without considering the addressable structure that web sources expose through titles, headings, sections, and metadata. This prevents agents from directly constraining retrieval to document fields and often carries irrelevant page content into their context. We introduce SIEVE, a search-inspect-fetch interface driven by fielded Boolean retrieval (BQL). SIEVE filters candidates over document fields, ranks the admitted set, presents structure-rich result cards for inspection, and fetches only selected sections. Across three QA collections, SIEVE achieves higher accuracy than the most accurate conventional Search-Visit configuration on each collection while using 20.7-50.6% fewer tokens. Further analyses show that BQL filtering improves all tested rankers and that the accuracy-context advantage persists across retriever choices and agent backbones. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ielab/skim-search-agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有深度研究代理 (deep-research agents) 的 Search-Visit 工作流提出 SIEVE，一个由字段化布尔检索 (fielded Boolean retrieval, BQL) 驱动的 search-inspect-fetch 接口。SIEVE 先用文档字段过滤候选，再对准入集合排序，以结构丰富的结果卡片供检查，并只抓取选中的章节。在三个 QA 集合上，SIEVE 的准确率高于每个集合上最准确的传统 Search-Visit 配置，同时 token 消耗减少 20.7%-50.6%。
Motivation: 现有深度研究代理在检索和阅读时按整页处理，没有利用网页通过标题、heading、章节和元数据暴露的可寻址结构，因此无法把检索直接约束到文档字段，并常把无关页面内容带入上下文。
Method: 引入 SIEVE，一种由 BQL 驱动的搜索-检查-抓取交互流程：对文档字段进行过滤以缩小候选集，对通过过滤的文档排序，呈现包含结构信息的候选卡片供代理检查，最后只抓取被选中的章节，而非整页。
Result: 在三个 QA 集合上，SIEVE 相对各集合上最准确的传统 Search-Visit 配置均取得更高准确率，并少用 20.7%-50.6% 的 token。进一步分析显示，BQL 过滤能改善所有被测试的排序器 (rankers)，且准确率-上下文开销的优势在多种检索器选择和代理主干 (agent backbones) 上都保持成立。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，利用文档字段化结构约束检索并只抓取被选中章节，可以在降低上下文消耗的同时提升深度研究代理的回答准确率；代码和数据已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quo Vadis, World Modeling?
papers.abstract_en: Continually improving agents require dynamic interaction feedback beyond static supervision, yet direct real-environment interaction is costly, slow, unsafe, and hard to parallelize. World modeling offers a natural intermediate proxy that allows agents to query lower-cost, more controllable feedback before committing to real actions. Classical world models instantiate this proxy primarily through future physical-state prediction, a formulation useful yet narrow for agents that require actionable feedback beyond raw state transitions. In this work, we conceptualize Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies, shifting the fundamental paradigm from physical state transitions to agent-usable information transitions, such as execution outcomes, retrieved experiences or skills, and verification signals, broadening the scope of world modeling to provide versatile feedback for continually improving agents. To systematically map this design space, we organize world proxies into six functional forms based on their feedback modalities: dynamics, spatial, execution, memory/experience, skill, and reward/verification proxies, which together characterize the primary ways world modeling serves agent improvement. We further analyze how these proxies empower agents across three progressive levels: L.1 Inference-Time Guidance, where proxy outputs enrich in-context information for superior decisions; L.2 Training-Time Optimization, where proxy outputs yield rewards, critiques, or synthetic rollouts for policy learning; and L.3 Agent-Proxy Co-Evolution, where real-environment evidence continuously updates both the proxy and the agent for co-evolution. Ultimately, this work recasts world modeling into an agent-centric paradigm, establishing a roadmap for building world proxies that empower agents to plan better, learn faster, and evolve continually.
papers.comment: Technical Blog at https://worldbench.github.io/awesome-agentic-world-model GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-agentic-world-model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇概念性与路线图性质的工作，提出 Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies，把世界建模的范式从预测物理状态转移扩展为预测智能体可用的信息转移（如执行结果、检索到的经验或技能、验证信号）。作者将世界代理按反馈模态组织为六类：dynamics、spatial、execution、memory/experience、skill、reward/verification，并给出智能体受益的三个渐进层级：推理时引导、训练时优化、智能体与代理共演化。最终将世界建模重新定位为以智能体为中心的范式，并建立相关技术博客与 GitHub 资源。
Motivation: 持续改进的智能体需要超越静态监督的动态交互反馈，但直接在真实环境交互代价高、速度慢、不安全且难并行；经典世界模型只做未来物理状态预测，对需要可行动反馈的智能体过于狭窄。
Method: 提出 Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies 的概念框架，将世界代理按反馈模态划分为六种功能形式，并用三个层级（L.1 推理时信息增强、L.2 训练时奖励/批评/合成轨迹、L.3 真实环境证据驱动的代理-代理共演化）系统化设计空间。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；本文的产出是一套分类体系、路线图以及配套的技术博客和 GitHub 仓库，而非经验性基准结果。
Conclusion: 作者将世界建模重新塑造成智能体中心的范式，提出构建世界代理的路线图，主张这能让智能体规划更好、学习更快并持续演化；由于是概念性工作，其具体效果仍有待在真实环境中验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Don't Regenerate, Debug: A Domain-Specific Agent for Repairing Near-Miss Hardware Operators
papers.abstract_en: Kernel generation for hardware accelerators such as GPUs and NPUs has become a proving ground for large language models (LLMs), and state-of-the-art systems raise correctness through pipelines that couple LLMs with agentic reinforcement learning and evolutionary search. Such pipelines generate, compile, and execute large numbers of candidate kernels, discarding most of them and forgoing the opportunity to distill failures into reusable knowledge. Many discarded candidates are near-miss operators that compile and run but fail numerical validation; each embodies genuine domain knowledge and a nontrivial investment in LLM inference, cross-compilation, and hardware execution. We argue for a paradigm shift: rather than regenerate, debug. Debugging is far more constrained than generating from scratch: the search space is small and feedback is dense. We present a domain-specific debug agent that addresses three core challenges in autonomous repair: mitigating knowledge scarcity through retrieved patterns and diagnostic instrumentation, ensuring integrity through anti-cheat detection and full-coverage evaluation, and controlling cost via convergence guards and bounded iteration. Debugging serves two complementary roles: it extends the capability frontier by recovering operators that repeated regeneration fails to produce, and it lowers cost per deliverable operator. Debug Pass@1 achieves 66.7% versus Regenerate Avg Pass@1's 25.9% and Regenerate Pass@3's 40.7%, while consuming 92.8% fewer tokens per success than three-trial regeneration. Component ablations show that the knowledge base drives recovery, while integrity gates reject 12.5-33.3% of the successes the workflow itself accepted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向硬件加速器（如 GPU/NPU）kernel 生成的领域专用调试智能体，主张对“近失（near-miss）”算子采用调试而非重新生成的策略。近失算子指能编译运行但数值验证失败的候选 kernel，调试的搜索空间远小于从头生成且反馈更密集。摘要报告 Debug Pass@1 达到 66.7%，显著高于重新生成的 25.9%（Pass@1）和 40.7%（Pass@3），且每个成功案例比三次重新生成少消耗 92.8% 的 token。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 结合强化学习与进化搜索的 kernel 生成流水线会生成、编译并执行大量候选 kernel，但丢弃其中大多数，未将失败转化为可复用知识。许多被丢弃的候选是编译运行但失败数值验证的近失算子，已投入推理、交叉编译和硬件执行成本，作者认为应转向调试而非重新生成。
Method: 提出领域专用调试智能体，针对自动修复中的三个核心挑战：通过检索模式与诊断插桩缓解知识稀缺（knowledge scarcity），通过防作弊检测与全覆盖评估确保完整性（integrity），通过收敛保护与有界迭代控制成本。
Result: 摘要报告 Debug Pass@1 为 66.7%，对比 Regenerate Avg Pass@1 的 25.9% 与 Regenerate Pass@3 的 40.7%，每个成功案例比三次重新生成节省 92.8% 的 token。组件消融显示知识库是修复的主要驱动，完整性门控（integrity gates）拒绝了工作流自身接受的 12.5%–33.3% 的成功案例。
Conclusion: 调试在 kernel 生成中起两个互补作用：扩展能力边界，恢复重复重新生成无法产生的算子；同时降低每个交付算子的成本。摘要未描述该方法在本文之外的一般化适用范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in image generation have demonstrated the potential of unified multimodal models that integrate understanding, generation, and editing. However, unified 3D modeling remains constrained by scarce multimodal data, particularly the lack of large-scale and geometrically consistent editing data. To address this limitation, we propose Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0, a unified framework supporting 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, instruction-guided 3D editing, and text-grounded part generation within a single architecture. To enable scalable training, we construct an 87M-scale 3D multimodal corpus, comprising 25M understanding samples, 50M text-to-3D pairs, and 12M editing pairs generated using Nano3D-v2. Architecturally, the framework combines Hunyuan3D-VLM for semantic, structural, and spatial understanding with Hunyuan3D DiT for high-fidelity 3D synthesis. The VLM provides multimodal semantic conditions for generation, while editing and part generation additionally condition the diffusion process on the source object representation to preserve its overall structure and unedited regions. Extensive experiments show that Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art or leading performance on text-to-3D generation and 3D editing benchmarks, while exhibiting strong understanding and part-generation capabilities. Our analysis further shows that both generation and understanding improve editing, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified 3D multimodal training. Project Page: https://tencent-hunyuan.github.io/Hunyuan3D-Buffalo1.0/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0，一个统一的 3D 多模态模型，在单一架构中同时支持 3D 理解、文本到 3D 生成、指令引导的 3D 编辑以及文本引导的部件生成。为支持可扩展训练，作者构建了 8700 万规模的 3D 多模态语料库，包含 2500 万理解样本、5000 万文生 3D 对和 1200 万编辑对。架构上结合 Hunyuan3D-VLM 用于语义、结构和空间理解，以及 Hunyuan3D DiT 用于高保真 3D 合成。实验表明该模型在文生 3D 和 3D 编辑基准上取得领先性能，并展现出较强的理解与部件生成能力。
Motivation: 统一多模态建模在图像生成中已显示出潜力，但统一的 3D 建模受限于稀缺的多模态数据，尤其是缺乏大规模且几何一致的编辑数据，这阻碍了可扩展的统一 3D 模型训练。
Method: 提出统一框架 Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0，结合 VLM（语义、结构、空间理解）与 DiT（高保真 3D 合成）。编辑和部件生成额外以源物体表示作为扩散过程的条件，以保持整体结构和未编辑区域。训练使用 8700 万规模的 3D 多模态语料库，其中编辑对由 Nano3D-v2 生成。
Result: 实验显示该方法在文生 3D 生成和 3D 编辑基准上达到最优或领先性能，并展现出强理解与部件生成能力；分析还表明生成和理解都有助于提升编辑效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一 3D 多模态训练的有效性得到验证，生成和理解能力共同促进编辑性能。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为统一 3D 多模态训练的有效性得到验证，生成和理解能力共同促进编辑性能。

papers.title: Designing a Good Virtual Node: Addressable and Cardinality-Preserving Global Memory for Message Passing Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Virtual nodes give message-passing neural networks a simple global communication route, but the standard node--VN--node pipeline compresses the graph into one homogeneous state and broadcasts it identically to every node. Building on the Two-Radius analysis of Mishayev et al., we ask how auxiliary virtual memory can relieve this finite-capacity bottleneck without self-attention. We identify two requirements. First, the global memory should be factorized into independently writable and readable states: this can be achieved using addressable cross-attention slots. Second, addressability alone does not preserve multiplicity, because softmax attention is invariant to uniform replication. Inserting each slot query as a private key/value anchor recovers the discarded normalization mass and yields, on bounded color domains, an injective multiset representation able to implement a 1-WL refinement. Experiments on multiplicity-aware Two-Radius, motif counting, and constrained link-set prediction support this addressable and cardinality-preserving virtual memory at (O(nMd)) arithmetic cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对消息传递神经网络中虚拟节点（virtual node）的有限容量瓶颈，提出一种可寻址且保持基数的全局虚拟内存设计。作者将全局内存分解为独立可写可读的寻址交叉注意力槽（addressable cross-attention slots），并通过将每个槽查询作为私有键/值锚点来恢复 softmax 注意力丢失的归一化质量，从而在有限颜色域上得到单射多重集表示并能实现 1-WL 细化。实验在多重集敏感的 Two-Radius、子图计数（motif counting）和受限链接集预测上验证了该方法，代价为 O(nMd)。
Motivation: 标准虚拟节点通过节点-VN-节点的管道把图压缩成一个同质状态并广播给所有节点，这造成了有限容量瓶颈；作者希望在不用自注意力（self-attention）的前提下，利用辅助虚拟内存来缓解该问题。
Method: 借鉴 Mishayev 等人的 Two-Radius 分析，提出两个设计要求：一是把全局内存分解为可寻址的交叉注意力槽，使状态可独立写入和读取；二是在 softmax 对均匀复制不变的情况下，把每个槽查询作为私有键/值锚点插入，恢复被丢弃的归一化质量，从而在有限颜色域上构造单射多重集表示。
Result: 在有限颜色域上，该表示是单射多重集表示，可以实现 1-WL 细化。实验在多重集感知的 Two-Radius、motif counting 和受限链接集预测任务上支持该可寻址且保持基数的虚拟内存，算术代价为 O(nMd)。
Conclusion: 该工作是初步研究（preliminary work），表明可寻址且保持基数的虚拟内存能在不使用自注意力的情况下缓解虚拟节点信息压缩问题，并有潜力扩展到其他消息传递架构。

papers.title: Can Training Logs Make Model Comparisons More Precise?
papers.abstract_en: Comparing stochastically trained models requires estimating both a performance difference and its uncertainty from repeated runs. We study whether training logs from those same runs can make such comparisons more precise. Because training-log covariates are produced during training rather than measured before it, we use arm-specific covariate adjustment: each model is adjusted only with statistics from its own runs, and the raw mean difference remains the reported effect. In a vision study spanning three architectures and three datasets, simple adjustments based on early training logs often reduce uncertainty in model comparisons. The main limitation is covariate selection. Broadly searching the log pool for the most correlated statistic often adds more noise than it removes, even when useful statistics exist in hindsight. Training logs therefore appear useful for more precise model comparisons, but only when the adjustment avoids large selection noise.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Hypothesis Testing
papers.journal_ref: The ICML 2026 Workshop on Hypothesis Testing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否利用同一批运行产生的训练日志（training logs）来更精确地比较随机训练的模型。由于训练日志协变量是在训练过程中产生的而非预先测量，作者采用每臂特定协变量调整（arm-specific covariate adjustment）：每个模型仅用自身运行的统计量进行调整，报告效应仍是原始均值差。在一个覆盖三种架构和三个数据集的视觉任务研究中，基于早期训练日志的简单调整通常能降低模型比较的不确定性；但主要限制是协变量选择，广泛搜索日志池中最相关的统计量往往会增加噪声而非减少噪声。
Motivation: 比较随机训练的模型需要从重复运行中同时估计性能差异及其不确定性；训练日志由同一批运行产生，可能蕴含可用于提高比较精度的信息，但需处理其训练中产生而非预先测量的特性，以及协变量选择带来的噪声。
Method: 提出臂特定协变量调整方法，即每个模型只用自身运行的日志统计量做调整，且效果量仍报告为原始均值差；并在三种架构、三个数据集上设计了基于早期训练日志的简单调整，以及从日志池中广泛搜索最相关统计量的对比设置。
Result: 摘要报告基于早期训练日志的简单调整通常能减少模型比较的不确定性；而广泛搜索日志池中最相关的统计量时，即使事后看存在有用的统计量，也往往引入更多噪声而非减少不确定性。
Conclusion: 训练日志对更精确的模型比较是有用的，但前提是调整过程必须避免大的选择噪声（selection noise）；协变量选择本身是该方法的主要局限。

papers.title: Predictive Set Theory: A Generative Framework for Cognitive Architecture with Operationalized Core Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Predictive processing theories portray the brain as a hierarchical prediction engine that minimizes prediction error, yet they lack operational definitions for the structure of a "prediction," the standardized response to a prediction error, and the mechanism that maintains consistency across successive updates. Bayesian cognitive science attempts to subsume all uncertainty under probabilistic belief updating, but it presupposes a closed hypothesis space and provides no generative account of how the objects over which probabilities are distributed become discrete, identifiable referents in the first place. This paper introduces Predictive Set Theory (PST), a formal generative framework that reconstructs cognitive architecture from first principles. PST anchors cognition in a minimal set of operations---a sensor formalized as an identity function, set-theoretic state refresh, and three fundamental forms of reference chains (reference, counter-reference, and semi-reference)---and rigorously derives core cognitive functions including state sequences, demand, comparison, efficiency, and finite-horizon probabilistic planning. Rather than modeling neural mechanisms, PST constitutes a design specification for any system that must maintain internal consistency while acting under incomplete information and irreversible risk. The framework offers novel resolutions to classical problems such as Russell's paradox, the cognitive status of Gödelian incompleteness, the grounding of negative feedback, and the comprehension of film editing. The primary purpose of this paper is to establish, through the public academic record, the originality and completeness of the Predictive Set Theory framework.
papers.comment: 103 pages. This preprint establishes the theoretical framework of Predictive Set Theory, providing a generative design specification for cognitive architecture. Comments welcome
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份理论预印本，提出 Predictive Set Theory (PST)，一个从第一性原理重构认知架构的形式化生成框架。PST 只依赖极简操作——将传感器形式化为恒等函数、集合论状态刷新，以及参考、反参考、半参考三种引用链——并由此推导状态序列、需求、比较、效率及有限时域概率规划等核心认知功能。作者明确表示这不是神经机制模型，而是面向任何需在不完全信息与不可逆风险下行动并保持内部一致性的系统的设计规范；文末还声称对 Russell 悖论、Gödel 不完备性的认知地位等问题给出新解法。论文的主要目的据摘要所述是在公共学术记录中确立该框架的原创性与完备性。
Motivation: 预测加工理论缺乏对“预测”结构、预测误差的标准响应以及多次更新间一致性机制的操作性定义；贝叶斯认知科学则预设封闭假设空间，没有解释概率分布所作用的对象最初如何成为离散、可识别的指称物。
Method: PST 从极简操作集（恒等函数式传感器、集合论状态刷新、三类引用链）出发，以形式化方式推导核心认知功能，整体作为认知架构的生成式设计规范提出，而非建模具体神经实现。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在理论上严格推导出状态序列、需求、比较、效率与有限时域概率规划等功能，并提出对 Russell 悖论、Gödelian 不完备性、负反馈接地以及电影剪辑理解的解决思路；未涉及任何实证数据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调本文首要目的是通过公开学术记录确立 PST 框架的原创性和完备性；该框架适用于任何须在不完全信息和不可逆风险下维持内部一致性的系统，但不以神经机制为建模对象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARCHead: Activation-Metric Residual Correction for Large Language Model Output Heads
papers.abstract_en: Weight-only quantization substantially reduces the storage of large language model (LLM) transformer blocks, but practical backends often retain the final language-modeling head (LM-head) in BF16 or FP16. Quantizing this projection naively can strongly perturb the vocabulary-logit distribution. We present ARCHead, a packed LM-head compressor that combines a quantized low-rank core, group-wise INT4 residuals, and a low-rank correction fitted in an activation-derived metric. ARCHead stores no dense BF16 head and reduces persistent LM-head storage by 3.7-3.9x. On Qwen3-8B-Base, it uses 25.6% of BF16 head storage while attaining 1.007 relative perplexity; storage-matched naive INT4 yields 1.14-1.16. Replacing the BF16 head left by AWQ or bitsandbytes adds only 0.006-0.007 cross-entropy, with less than 2% throughput change in our measurements. ARCHead therefore complements block quantizers by compressing the large output projection they can leave untouched. Code is available at https://github.com/suayptalha/archead.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR). Code: https://github.com/suayptalha/archead
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARCHead，一种针对 LLM 输出头（LM-head）的压缩方法，将量化低秩核心、分组 INT4 残差和基于激活度量（activation-derived metric）拟合的低秩校正相结合，避免存储稠密 BF16 头。摘要报告在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上将持久 LM-head 存储减少 3.7-3.9 倍，仅用 BF16 头存储的 25.6% 即达到 1.007 的相对困惑度，而存储匹配的朴素 INT4 为 1.14-1.16；替换 AWQ 或 bitsandbytes 遗留的 BF16 头仅增加 0.006-0.007 交叉熵，吞吐量变化小于 2%。
Motivation: 权重量化通常能大幅减少 LLM transformer 块的存储，但实际后端常将最终 LM-head 保留为 BF16 或 FP16；直接量化该投影会强烈扰动词表对数概率分布，成为块量化方案遗漏的大存储项。
Method: ARCHead 将 LM-head 压缩为量化低秩核心（quantized low-rank core）、分组 INT4 残差（group-wise INT4 residuals）以及一个在激活导出度量中拟合的低秩校正（low-rank correction），整体不保留稠密 BF16 头。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，ARCHead 将持久 LM-head 存储降至 BF16 的 25.6%，相对困惑度为 1.007，而存储匹配的朴素 INT4 为 1.14-1.16；替换 AWQ 或 bitsandbytes 遗留的 BF16 头仅增加 0.006-0.007 交叉熵，吞吐量变化低于 2%，存储压缩 3.7-3.9 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ARCHead 可补充块级量化器（如 AWQ、bitsandbytes），压缩它们通常不会处理的输出投影，同时保持困惑度与吞吐量影响很小。

papers.title: NANQ: Noise-Floor-Aware Mixed-Precision Non-Uniform Quantization for Analog Compute-in-Memory
papers.abstract_en: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) enables energy-efficient neural network inference, but device variation and read noise can severely degrade low-bit quantized models. Existing CIM-oriented quantization methods mainly minimize ideal quantization error, ignoring the hardware noise floor and thus causing inefficient precision allocation. We propose NANQ, a noise-aware mixed-precision non-uniform quantization framework for analog CIM. NANQ models magnitude-dependent weight noise from measured responses of an eFlash CIM array and converts the noise profile into an adaptive quantization density, assigning finer resolution to low-noise regions while avoiding ineffective precision in noise-dominated regions. It further assigns layer-wise bit-widths by identifying each layer's precision saturation point under hardware noise using a unified threshold. On-chip experiments on an eFlash CIM SoC show that, under 2-bit weight-magnitude quantization, NANQ improves vision-model accuracy by 8.05 percentage points and reduces language-model PPL by 54.7% on average over PowerQuant. Mixed-precision NANQ captures most of the gains obtainable from additional quantization resources with only 3.2-3.8 equivalent bits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模拟存内计算（analog CIM）中器件变化与读取噪声导致低比特量化模型性能下降的问题，提出 NANQ，一个噪声感知的混合精度非均匀量化框架。NANQ 基于 eFlash CIM 阵列的实测响应来建模随幅值变化的权重噪声，并把噪声分布转换为自适应量化密度，在低噪声区域分配更细的精度，同时避免在噪声主导区域浪费精度；它还通过统一阈值识别每层在硬件噪声下的精度饱和点，从而分配逐层位宽。在 eFlash CIM SoC 上的片上实验中，相比 PowerQuant，在 2-bit 权重幅值量化下 NANQ 使视觉模型准确率平均提升 8.05 个百分点，语言模型困惑度（PPL）平均降低 54.7%；混合精度版本的 NANQ 用 3.2-3.8 等效比特即可获得额外量化资源所能带来的大部分收益。
Motivation: 现有面向 CIM 的量化方法主要最小化理想量化误差，忽略了硬件噪声基底（noise floor），导致精度分配低效；器件变化和读取噪声会严重损害低比特量化模型的性能。
Method: 提出 NANQ：先从 eFlash CIM 阵列的实测响应中建模幅度相关的权重噪声，再将噪声分布转化为自适应量化密度，对低噪声区域给予更细分辨率、避免在噪声主导区域使用无效精度；并用统一阈值判断每层在硬件噪声下的精度饱和点，据此分配逐层位宽，形成混合精度非均匀量化方案。
Result: 在 eFlash CIM SoC 的片上实验中，2-bit 权重幅值量化下，NANQ 相比 PowerQuant 平均提升视觉模型准确率 8.05 个百分点，平均降低语言模型 PPL 54.7%；混合精度 NANQ 仅用 3.2-3.8 等效比特就获得大部分额外量化资源可带来的增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过显式建模硬件噪声基底并据此分配量化精度，可以显著改善模拟 CIM 上低比特量化模型的性能。摘要未给出明确的局限性讨论，因此结论仅覆盖其提出的噪声感知混合精度量化框架。

papers.title: Explainable AI for the EU Right to Explanation: A Systematic Review of the Law-XAI Translation Gap
papers.abstract_en: When algorithms make or influence consequential decisions---about loan eligibility, hiring, or healthcare---EU law grants affected individuals a Right to Explanation. Yet whether (and how) Explainable AI (XAI) can satisfy this right in practice remains poorly understood, with direct implications for individuals' ability to contest automated decisions that affect their lives. This paper presents a systematic literature review of XAI in the context of the EU Right to Explanation, with particular focus on Art. 15(1)(h) GDPR, Art. 86 AI Act (AIA), and related instruments. We consider papers published from 2024 onwards, as the final version of the AIA was published in July 2024---with Art. 86 being added late. From 2643 initial records identified by a deliberately broad search, we review 57 full texts, of which only 19 papers demonstrate substantive integration of both legal and technical perspectives, showing gaps in the interdisciplinary synthesis of the current regulatory framework. We document three problematic patterns across the corpus: Most misidentify the GDPR legal basis; few engage with the CJEU's Dun & Bradstreet judgment (likely due to publication timing); and the distinction between explanation form (governed by addressee) and content (governed by legal purpose) is often conflated. We conceptualize this as the Addressee/Purpose Framework, propose a four-phase blueprint for operationalization, and identify six concrete open research questions. Without further progress, the Right to Explanation risks remaining a formal obligation without a technically realizable path to compliance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics and Society (AIES-26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是针对欧盟‘解释权’（Right to Explanation）与可解释人工智能（XAI）之间衔接缺口的一项系统性文献综述，重点分析 GDPR 第 15(1)(h) 条、AI 法案（AIA）第 86 条及相关法律工具。作者从 2643 条初始记录中筛选出 57 篇全文，仅 19 篇展现出法律与技术视角的实质性整合，并总结了三种问题模式。论文据此提出 Addressee/Purpose Framework、四阶段落地蓝图和六个开放研究问题，指出解释权若缺乏技术实现路径，可能沦为形式义务。
Motivation: 欧盟法律赋予受算法决策影响的个人以解释权，但 XAI 能否以及在多大程度上满足这一权利在实践中仍不清楚，直接影响个人质疑自动化决策的能力。现有文献缺乏对最新 AIA 第 86 条等新规的跨学科整合，导致法律要求与技术方法之间存在系统性翻译缺口。
Method: 作者进行系统性文献综述（systematic literature review），时间范围限定为 2024 年之后（因 AIA 最终版于 2024 年 7 月发布且第 86 条是后期加入），采用刻意宽泛的检索策略，从 2643 条初始记录中评审 57 篇全文；提出 Addressee/Purpose Framework 来区分解释形式与内容，并给出四阶段落地蓝图和六个开放研究问题。
Result: 在 57 篇审核文献中，仅 19 篇同时扎实整合了法律与技术视角；语料中存在三种问题模式：多数论文误判 GDPR 的法律基础、少数涉及欧盟法院 Dun & Bradstreet 判决（可能受发表日期限制）、常混淆由接收方决定的解释形式与由法律目的决定的解释内容。
Conclusion: 作者认为，若不进一步推进跨学科研究，欧盟解释权可能始终只是一个没有技术上可实现合规路径的形式义务；其价值在于为法律与 XAI 交叉领域提供系统化框架与具体研究议程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Steganalysis of Adaptive Covert Collusion in Tool-Using Agent Populations: A Black-Box, Cross-Principal Approach
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed not by a single operator but by many, side by side on shared infrastructure. This creates a population-level risk that single-agent safeguards miss: a handful of agents can quietly coordinate, rigging a market, boosting one another in a review process, or timing a joint data grab, while each one looks perfectly well-behaved. The difficulty is that the organisations running these agents cannot see inside one another's models, so any realistic detector must work from behaviour alone: black-box, trace-only, and often with only partial visibility. We treat covert coordination as an information-hiding problem and build a black-box steganalysis detector that combines cross-run mutual-information estimation, permutation tests, distributional-shift statistics, and timing and tool-call side channels, all calibrated to a fixed false-positive budget. Our central move is to stop testing against a single fixed code: we pit the detector against an adversary that continually rewrites its encoding to slip past whatever the detector has learned, and we run this red-versus-blue contest in tool-using, memory-carrying environments rather than toy games. Capacity theory then tells us what to expect, a detection-capacity frontier, a covert bit-rate below which black-box detection is provably no better than chance. We set out an experiment to map this frontier, report clearly labelled placeholder results pending measurement, and flag a practical evasion, spreading a payload across sessions, that current methods largely miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把多个基于 LLM 的工具使用智能体在共享基础设施上的隐蔽协同（如操纵市场、互刷评审、协同数据抓取）建模为信息隐藏问题，提出一种黑盒、仅依赖轨迹的隐写分析（steganalysis）检测器，融合跨运行互信息估计、置换检验、分布偏移统计以及时序和工具调用侧信道，并在固定假阳性预算下校准。其核心做法是放弃针对单一固定编码的测试，转而与不断重写编码的对手进行红蓝对抗，环境为带记忆的工具使用环境而非玩具游戏。容量理论给出检测容量边界：低于某一隐蔽比特率时黑盒检测在理论上不比随机猜测更好；摘要明确表示实验结果目前是占位（placeholder）且待测量。
Motivation: 单个智能体安全机制无法覆盖种群级风险：少量工具使用智能体可以在彼此看起来都正常的同时静默协调，实施市场操纵、评审互刷或协同数据抓取。运营机构无法看到彼此的模型，因此现实中的检测器只能基于行为工作，即黑盒、仅轨迹、且常常只有部分可见性。
Method: 提出黑盒隐写分析检测器，结合跨运行互信息估计、置换检验、分布偏移统计和时序/工具调用侧信道，并校准到固定假阳性预算。作者的核心做法是把检测器与一个持续重写其编码以绕过检测的对手进行红蓝对抗，并在承载记忆的工具使用环境中运行，同时用容量理论刻画可检测性与隐蔽比特率之间的边界。
Result: 容量理论预示存在检测-容量边界：低于某个隐蔽比特率时，黑盒检测被证明不优于随机机会。摘要称为此设置了一项映射该边界的实验，但结果目前是明确标注的占位结果，尚待测量；此外还指出跨会话分散载荷是一种当前方法普遍漏检的实际规避手段。
Conclusion: 作者强调应停止针对单一固定编码测试检测器，转而评估面对持续改写编码对手的鲁棒性，并指出跨会话分散载荷这一实际规避方式是现有方法的主要盲点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Explainer Stability via Attribution Separability
papers.abstract_en: Attribution methods (AMs) assign an importance score to each feature and are widely adopted to explain black-box models. However, most methods can produce variable attribution scores due to stochastic components in their definition. In this paper, we propose a distribution-based framework to capture the stability of attribution scores. In particular, our approach allows to understand the degree of separability in the ranked attribution vector and obtain the largest index for which a feature ranking remains reliable. We further extend this framework to compare AMs based on the robustness of their rankings across a dataset. Through experiments, we demonstrate how to apply our method to evaluate explainer stability. Overall, our approach provides a complementary criterion for evaluating the stability of AMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于分布 (distribution-based) 的框架来衡量归因方法 (attribution methods, AMs) 的稳定性。其核心是分析排序后的归因向量的可分离性 (separability)，并给出特征排序仍可靠的最大索引；该框架还可跨数据集比较不同 AM 在排序稳健性上的差异。实验展示了该方法如何用于评估解释器稳定性，并为 AM 稳定性评价提供了一个补充性判据。
Motivation: 归因方法为每个特征赋予重要性分数，被广泛用于解释黑盒模型，但多数方法因定义中的随机成分会产生不稳定的归因分数，影响解释的可靠性。
Method: 提出基于分布的稳定性量化框架：通过考察排序归因向量的可分离程度，确定特征排序保持可靠的最大索引，并将该框架扩展到跨数据集场景，用以比较不同归因方法在排序稳健性上的表现。
Result: 摘要称通过实验展示了如何将所提方法应用于解释器稳定性评估；整体上为评价归因方法的稳定性提供了互补性判据，但摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该框架可作为评估归因方法稳定性的补充标准，帮助判断特征排序在多大范围内可信。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stylometric Defenses Against Author Impersonation in Software Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Software supply-chain attacks increasingly exploit an identity gap where compromised maintainer accounts authorize malicious changes. This work evaluates patch-level authorship verification as a behavioral defense layer, showing that stylometric analysis can operate not only on full source files but also on patch-level commits. We fine-tune a cross-modal transformer on more than 20 years of Linux kernel commit history to embed code diffs and commit messages into a unified stylometric space, achieving ROC AUC of 0.93 for open-world authorship verification. We then use these representations in a streaming anomaly detector suited to continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) settings. We validate the pipeline on two retrospective supply-chain incidents involving different patch characteristics: the 2021 PHP backdoor and the 2026 ForceMemo/GlassWorm campaign. Without retraining, the proposed detector surfaces both PHP forged commits within approximately 1% of the maintainer audit queue and ranks the 28 scoreable ForceMemo spoofs with a median per-repository review burden of 0.8%. papers.title: Crayotter: Learning Long-Horizon Video Editing Agents via Group-Relative Preference Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon video editing agents receive final-product feedback only after many interdependent decisions. Yet editing quality is subjective, admits multiple valid solutions, and is not meaningfully calibrated across heterogeneous requests, making a global scalar objective both ambiguous and temporally uninformative. Our key observation is that fixing the request, materials, and production constraints converts this subjective objective into an ordinal comparison among directly comparable alternatives. We introduce Group-Relative Preference Backpropagation (GRPB), which transforms same-task rankings into zero-sum advantages and redistributes them as bounded credit over semantic editing segments. A lagged allocator and guarded transmission prevent current judgments or unreliable estimates from directly shaping the same rollout group. We manually construct a project-disjoint, horizon-stratified suite of realistic editing tasks for training and controlled evaluation. Across matched baselines, credit interventions, external benchmarking, and blinded human evaluation, GRPB improves both editing behavior and rendered products. The resulting 9B Crayotter model surpasses several proprietary systems on AgenticVBench, supporting task-local preference reduction as a practical approach to learning from subjective, delayed outcomes. Code and all supporting materials are publicly available at https://github.com/idwts/Crayotter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Group-Relative Preference Backpropagation (GRPB)，用于训练长视野视频编辑智能体，将主观的最终产品反馈转化为同任务内可比较的序数偏好，并以有界信用分配到语义编辑片段。作者手工构建项目不相交、按时间跨度分层的现实编辑任务套件，训练出 9B 参数的 Crayotter 模型，并在 AgenticVBench 上超越若干专有系统。
Motivation: 长视野视频编辑智能体只能在多次相互依赖的决策之后收到最终产品反馈；而编辑质量主观、存在多个合法解，且跨异构请求难以校准，导致全局标量目标既模糊又缺乏时间信息。作者的关键观察是，固定请求、素材和生产约束后，这种主观目标可以转化为同任务内直接可比方案的序数比较。
Method: 提出 GRPB，把同任务排序转化为零和优势 (zero-sum advantages)，并以有界信用 (bounded credit) 分配给语义编辑片段；同时使用滞后分配器 (lagged allocator) 和受保护的传输 (guarded transmission)，防止当前判断或不可靠估计直接塑造同一 rollout 组。此外手工构建了项目不相交、按时间跨度分层的编辑任务套件用于训练和受控评估。
Result: 在与匹配基线、信用干预、外部基准以及盲人机评估 (blinded human evaluation) 的比较中，GRPB 改善了编辑行为和渲染产物；9B 参数的 Crayotter 模型在 AgenticVBench 上超越若干专有系统。
Conclusion: 摘要将任务局部偏好约简 (task-local preference reduction) 视为从主观、延迟反馈中学习的实用方法，并公开代码与全部支持材料。

papers.title: PatTree: a novel approach for automated creation of multimodal, graph-based patient representations for medical classification tasks
papers.abstract_en: Access to holistic, multimodal data improves the performance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in medical classification tasks compared to utilizing single modalities or data sources. However, the inherent heterogeneity and complexity of clinical real-world data pose significant challenges to structured data analysis and AI application. This heterogeneity includes missing values, multiple time points, diverse modalities, and inconsistent formats and semantics. Data harmonization prior to data integration tackles this challenge but remains resource-intensive and error-prone, limiting the scalability and reproducibility of holistic, AI-driven decision support on clinical real-world data. We therefore propose PatTree, a graph-based, holistic representation of patients that can be derived from real-world clinical data through the automated structuring of multimodal clinical data. PatTree enables early-stage data integration without relying on pre-standardized inputs. While representing heterogeneous clinical data within a unified knowledge graph, PatTree preserves the semantic relationships between data elements across modalities and data sources, facilitating interoperability and machine-interpretable data access. Using a subset of the ADNI-1 cohort (n = 763), we demonstrate that classification of patients is directly feasible on PatTree reaching state-of-the-art classification performance. In the three-class classification task distinguishing Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment, and cognitively normal individuals, we achieve a balanced accuracy of 98.5% and an F$_1$ score of 0.987 on the held-out test set. Our results show that assumption-free, automated structuring of multimodal medical data can serve as a scalable foundation for clinical AI pipelines bypassing tedious data preparation and standardization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PatTree，一种基于图的、可自动从真实世界临床数据中构建的多模态患者表示方法，用于医学分类任务。作者在 ADNI-1 队列子集（n=763）上验证，三分类任务（阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍、认知正常）在留出测试集上达到 98.5% 的平衡准确率和 0.987 的 F1 值。
Motivation: 临床真实世界数据存在缺失值、多时间点、多模态以及格式和语义不一致等异构性问题，使得基于 AI 的整体性决策支持难以实施；传统的数据协调 (data harmonization) 方法资源密集且易出错，限制了可扩展性和可复现性。
Method: 提出 PatTree，通过自动化结构化多模态临床数据，将异构数据统一表示为知识图谱，保留跨模态和数据源之间的语义关系，从而在不依赖预标准化输入的前提下实现早期数据集成。
Result: 在 ADNI-1 队列子集（n=763）上，三分类任务取得 98.5% 的平衡准确率和 0.987 的 F1 值，达到当前最优分类性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为无假设的自动化多模态医学数据结构化方法可以作为临床 AI 管线的可扩展基础，绕过繁琐的数据准备和标准化流程。

papers.title: Output-Aware Rotation for INT2 KV-Cache Quantization
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache has become a major memory and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context large language model inference, making ultra-low-bit quantization increasingly important. However, existing rotation-based INT2 methods optimize cache statistics or proxy errors before the complete attention readout, even though the model is ultimately affected by the error propagated through attention and the output projection $W_O$. To address this mismatch, we propose \textit{OptR}, an output-aware rotation method that minimizes post-$W_O$ attention-output error. OptR decomposes the post-$W_O$ attention-output error into key- and value-induced terms and learns per-head orthogonal corrections through the full INT2 quantization and attention path. OptR further applies an attention-equivalent key reparameterization to reduce large channel-wise offsets without changing the softmax distribution. Across three models and five reasoning and coding benchmarks, OptR consistently improves both QuaRot and OSCAR and strengthens long-context retrieval, while preserving the paged KV-cache format with negligible inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptR，一种面向 INT2 KV-cache 量化的输出感知旋转 (output-aware rotation) 方法，直接最小化经过输出投影 W_O 之后的注意力输出误差。OptR 将 post-W_O 误差分解为 key 项和 value 项，并通过完整的 INT2 量化与注意力通路学习逐头正交校正。在三个模型和五个推理/编码基准上，OptR 一致改进 QuaRot 与 OSCAR，并增强长上下文检索，同时保留 paged KV-cache 格式且推理开销可忽略。
Motivation: 现有基于旋转的 INT2 方法在完整注意力读出之前优化缓存统计量或代理误差，而模型实际受经过注意力和输出投影 W_O 传播的误差影响。这种优化目标错位会导致量化误差未被真正校正。
Method: OptR 将 post-W_O 注意力输出误差分解为 key 与 value 引发的两部分，并通过完整 INT2 量化和注意力路径学习逐头正交校正；此外应用注意力等价 (attention-equivalent) 的 key 重参数化来减小大规模通道偏移，同时不改变 softmax 分布。
Result: 在三个模型和五个推理与编程基准上，OptR 一致提升 QuaRot 和 OSCAR 的性能，并加强长上下文检索能力；同时保持 paged KV-cache 格式，引入的推理开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 论文强调将量化目标对齐到真实注意力读出端（post-W_O 误差）可以更有效地改进 INT2 KV-cache 量化，且无需牺牲兼容性。

papers.title: GLOBE: Trajectory-Aligned Gradient Matching with Structured SparseOptimization for Coreset Selection
papers.abstract_en: On-device training of deep neural networks is fundamentally constrained by the computational and memory costs of large-scale datasets. Coreset selection offers a practical solution by retaining only a compact subset of real training samples. However, existing gradient-based methods commonly rely on gradients computed at a single model snapshot and employ greedy or pursuit-based selection procedures, limiting their ability to capture evolving optimization dynamics and handle strongly correlated samples. We propose GLOBE (Gradient Local-Balanced Extraction), a trajectory-aligned coreset selection framework that formulates sample selection as a globally optimized sparse weighting problem. GLOBE represents each sample by a gradient trajectory constructed across multiple training checkpoints, thereby capturing its influence throughout different stages of optimization. To preserve the training behavior of the full dataset, we introduce a multi-order matching objective that jointly aligns the first-order mean and projected uncentered second-order moments of gradient trajectories. GLOBE further combines Group LASSO, Elastic Net regularization, and nonnegative budget constraints to induce group- and sample-level sparsity while stabilizing the weights of correlated trajectories. Finally, class-balanced Top-K selection maintains adequate category coverage under limited sampling budgets. Experiments across six benchmarks and five evaluation architectures demonstrate that GLOBE consistently outperforms existing coreset selection methods in downstream test accuracy, particularly at low retention ratios. These results highlight the effectiveness of combining dynamic gradient information, multi-order distribution matching, and structured sparsity for data-efficient learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLOBE（Gradient Local-Balanced Extraction），一种面向设备端训练的核心集选择（coreset selection）框架。核心思路是将每个样本表示为由多个训练检查点构建的梯度轨迹，并把样本选择建模为全局优化的稀疏加权问题；通过多阶匹配目标对齐一阶均值与投影非中心二阶矩，结合 Group LASSO、Elastic Net 与非负预算约束诱导组级和样本级稀疏性，最后用类平衡 Top-K 选择保证类别覆盖。实验在六个基准和五种评估架构上表明其下游测试准确率持续优于现有核心集选择方法，尤其在低保留率下。
Motivation: 设备端训练深度神经网络受限于大规模数据集的计算与内存开销，核心集选择通过保留紧凑的真实训练样本子集来缓解该问题。现有基于梯度的方法通常使用单一模型快照的梯度并采用贪心或追踪式选择流程，难以捕捉优化过程中的演化动态，也无法处理强相关的样本。
Method: 提出轨迹对齐的梯度匹配框架 GLOBE，将样本选择形式化为全局优化的稀疏加权问题。每个样本用跨多个训练检查点的梯度轨迹表示，引入多阶匹配目标联合对齐一阶均值与投影非中心二阶矩；同时组合 Group LASSO、Elastic Net 正则化和非负预算约束以实现组级与样本级稀疏性，并稳定相关轨迹的权重，最后通过类平衡 Top-K 选择保证类别覆盖。
Result: 在六个基准数据集和五种评估架构上的实验表明，GLOBE 在下游测试准确率上持续优于现有核心集选择方法，尤其是在低保留率（low retention ratios）条件下表现突出。
Conclusion: 作者强调，结合动态梯度信息、多阶分布匹配与结构化稀疏性可以显著提升数据高效学习中的核心集选择效果。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出轨迹对齐的梯度匹配框架 GLOBE，将样本选择形式化为全局优化的稀疏加权问题。每个样本用跨多个训练检查点的梯度轨迹表示，引入多阶匹配目标联合对齐一阶均值与投影非中心二阶矩；同时组合 Group LASSO、Elastic Net 正则化和非负预算约束以实现组级与样本级稀疏性，并稳定相关轨迹的权重，最后通过类平衡 Top-K 选择保证类别覆盖。
summary_sections.result: 在六个基准数据集和五种评估架构上的实验表明，GLOBE 在下游测试准确率上持续优于现有核心集选择方法，尤其是在低保留率（low retention ratios）条件下表现突出。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，结合动态梯度信息、多阶分布匹配与结构化稀疏性可以显著提升数据高效学习中的核心集选择效果。

papers.title: Stuck on "A": Diagnosing and Repairing Interface Injury in Attention-to-KDA Linearization of a 0.6B Language Model
papers.abstract_en: We convert 21 of 28 full-attention layers of Qwen3-0.6B-Base into KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) linear-attention layers on a single consumer-grade GPU budget, and ask a simple question: what exactly does the conversion break? After surgery, hidden-state alignment and end-to-end KL distillation drive the student close to its teacher in perplexity, yet multiple-choice accuracy stays near random chance (25-29% vs. the teacher's 50.6% on C-Eval). Using a four-permutation diagnostic that rotates answer options while holding content fixed, we show the model sticks to option labels (predicting "A" 81% of the time; 106/161 questions keep the same label under all four rotations) rather than following answer content -- an interface injury that standard distillation metrics cannot see. A 1,000-step format-targeted completion-only KL stage repairs the interface (+12.48 points on C-Eval, label-stickiness roughly halved), after which persona SFT and one round of on-policy DPO preserve benchmark scores within noise. We release code, weights, recipes, and the full audit trail, and distill the engineering lessons -- including an FP32-master failure mode in which bf16 optimizer updates are silently swallowed -- that made convergence possible at this budget.
papers.comment: Code and models: https://github.com/Sisyphbaous-DT-Project/open-qingyi ; https://huggingface.co/shiershuihesaixiliya/qingyi-kda-0.6b . A version of this preprint is archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21722356)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告将 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 的 28 个全注意力层中的 21 个转换为 KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) 线性注意力层后，模型在困惑度上接近教师，但多项选择准确率仍接近随机。通过四排列诊断，作者发现模型不是按内容答题而是粘在选项标签上（81% 预测 "A"），并用 1,000 步格式定向补全 KL 阶段修复了该接口损伤，使 C-Eval 提升 12.48 分。
Motivation: 注意力到线性注意力的转换在标准蒸馏指标下看似成功，但下游多项选择准确率几乎为随机水平，说明现有指标无法暴露这种接口层面的功能损伤，需要诊断并修复。
Method: 在转换后用隐藏状态对齐和端到端 KL 蒸馏逼近教师；提出四排列诊断法在固定内容下旋转选项位置来检测标签粘性；随后加入 1,000 步格式定向的仅补全 KL 阶段，并依次进行 persona SFT 和一轮 on-policy DPO。
Result: 转换后 C-Eval 准确率从教师的 50.6% 降至 25–29%，模型 81% 的预测为 "A" 且 106/161 题在四种旋转下保持同一标签；修复后 C-Eval 提升 12.48 分，标签粘性约减半，后续 SFT 与 DPO 保持基准分数在噪声范围。
Conclusion: 摘要强调标准蒸馏指标无法发现接口损伤，并公布了代码、权重与审计追踪，同时报告了 FP32-master 下 bf16 优化器更新被静默吞掉的工程失败模式。

papers.title: Learning Molecular Representations from Cellular Phenotypes with Structure Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Phenotypic drug discovery enables the discovery of functional relationships between molecular structures and cellular responses. However, existing multimodal representation learning methods often optimize cross-modal alignment without considering the intrinsic organization of chemical space, resulting in distorted molecular representations and loss of structural information. We propose \textbf{PhenMol}, a structure-preserving framework for phenotype-aware molecular representation learning. PhenMol disentangles molecular and cellular representations into shared and private components, enabling phenotype-guided alignment while preserving chemical structures through a dedicated molecular branch. This design integrates cellular phenotype information without disrupting molecular neighborhood organization. Experiments on approximately $3.04 \times 10^{4}$ molecule--cell morphology pairs demonstrate that PhenMol improves molecular property prediction across 270 bioactivity tasks, molecule--phenotype retrieval, and clinical trial outcome prediction. Moreover, ECFP4-based structural analysis shows that PhenMol better preserves molecular neighborhoods and reduces embedding distortion compared with existing multimodal alignment methods. These results highlight the importance of structure-aware constraints in multimodal molecular representation learning and provide an effective approach for integrating cellular phenotypes with chemical knowledge for drug discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhenMol，一种面向表型感知分子表征学习的结构保持框架。PhenMol 将分子与细胞表征解耦为共享和私有成分，在表型引导对齐的同时通过专用分子分支保留化学结构。在约 3.04×10^4 对分子-细胞形态数据上，PhenMol 提升了 270 个生物活性任务的性质预测、分子-表型检索以及临床试验结果预测；ECFP4 结构分析显示它比现有跨模态对齐方法更好地保留分子邻域并降低嵌入扭曲。
Motivation: 现有跨模态多模态表示学习方法往往只优化对齐目标，忽略化学空间的内在组织，导致分子表示发生扭曲并丢失结构信息。这对于依赖分子结构与细胞响应之间功能关系的表型药物发现是有害的。
Method: PhenMol 将分子与细胞表征分别解耦为共享成分和私有成分，通过专用分子分支实现表型引导对齐，同时在训练中保持化学结构约束，从而在不破坏分子邻域组织的情况下整合细胞表型信息。
Result: 实验基于约 3.04×10^4 对分子-细胞形态数据，在 270 个生物活性任务上的分子性质预测、分子-表型检索和临床试验结果预测上取得改进；ECFP4 结构分析表明其比现有模态对齐方法更有效地保留分子邻域并减少嵌入扭曲。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构感知约束在多模态分子表征学习中的重要性，并指出该框架为药物发现中整合细胞表型与化学知识提供了有效途径。

papers.title: BulkPR-Bench: Benchmarking Queue-Level Governance of Interacting Pull Requests
papers.abstract_en: Coding-agent benchmarks increasingly cover long-horizon, end-to-end, and interactive development, but typically retain one requested outcome or a fixed change sequence. Sequential policies can process a pull-request (PR) queue one candidate at a time, but when queued PRs interact, maximizing safe delivery can require jointly deciding which changes to merge and in what order. We introduce BulkPR-Bench, an executable benchmark in which an agent must recover consequential PR relations and return a large safe subset in executable order under a rolling-release protocol. The suite contains 581 newly authored candidate PRs on frozen snapshots of 18 real repositories. Registered state-by-state repository execution, including hidden safety checks, validates the gold relation graph; an exact oracle then computes the largest safe subset. Our primary metric, Relational Delivery Score (RDS), scores safe delivery and correct rejection over relation groups from the realized merge trace; Global Safety-Gated Yield (Global-SGY) separately measures strict delivery of the realized whole-queue plan. Under the buffered primary protocol with batch size $K=32$, the three highest RDS estimates among the six models are 66.6%, 62.0%, and 57.9%, compared with 53.1% for the strongest sequential baseline. Only 8 of 324 model runs complete a queue exactly. Critical-relation recall ranges from 35.2% to 57.7%, and diagnostic runs supplied with the gold relations show substantial remaining headroom. Gains on relation groups therefore do not yet translate into dependable whole-queue governance.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Artifact: https://github.com/Eureka246/BulkPR-Bench-Release ; archived artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21717780
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BulkPR-Bench，一个面向交互式拉取请求（PR）队列的端到端可执行基准，要求智能体在滚动发布协议下恢复 PR 间的重要关系并返回可执行顺序的大安全子集。基准包含 18 个真实仓库冻结快照上的 581 个新编写 PR，通过逐状态仓库执行与隐藏安全检查验证金标准关系图，并用精确 oracle 计算最大安全子集。主要指标为 Relational Delivery Score（RDS）和 Global Safety-Gated Yield（Global-SGY）。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体基准大多只设置单一期望结果或固定变更序列，忽略了队列中 PR 相互影响时需联合决策合并内容与顺序的问题。
Method: 构建带滚动发布协议的可执行基准，通过注册的逐步状态执行验证金标准关系图，使用精确 oracle 求出最大安全子集；主协议为批大小 K=32 的缓冲协议，并额外提供 RDS 与 Global-SGY 两种评估指标以及给出金标准关系的诊断运行。
Result: 六种模型中 RDS 最高的三个估计值分别为 66.6%、62.0% 和 57.9%，而最强顺序基线为 53.1%；324 次模型运行中仅 8 次精确完成整个队列；关键关系召回率介于 35.2% 至 57.7%，且提供金标准关系的诊断运行仍有较大提升空间。
Conclusion: 摘要指出模型在关系组上的收益尚未转化为可靠的整队列治理能力，强调存在明显 headroom。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Blind Spot in Alignment: Quantifying Biosecurity Risks in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are accelerating biological research, yet this same capability poses a critical biosecurity threat: models that assist in protein engineering can equally be prompted to generate predicted toxin-like sequences, potentially lowering the barrier to biological misuse. Current safety evaluations, however, operate in natural language and cannot determine whether a model-generated amino acid sequence is biological gibberish or a computational risk signal. To address this evaluation blind spot, we introduce SPIKE-Bench, coupling 631 curated toxin-design prompts across seven functional categories with the SPIKE funnel, a three-stage protocol that filters output through compliance, biological plausibility, and predicted toxicity, producing stage-level diagnostics and an aggregate function-aware metric: the Functional Harmfulness Rate (FHR). An audit of 32 LLMs reveals that most models freely comply with toxin-design requests; FHR is driven primarily by biological generation capability rather than safety alignment, reaching 50.7%; and Refusal Rate fails to predict functional risk. As a first step toward mitigation, we provide BioSafe-Guard, a domain-specialized classifier that substantially reduces predicted functional risk while preserving benign utility. We release SPIKE-Bench and BioSafe-Guard at https://github.com/PKU-Alignment/SPIKE-Bench to support more rigorous biosecurity evaluation of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前 LLM 安全评估存在盲区：自然语言层面的安全评测无法判断模型生成的氨基酸序列是生物意义上的乱码还是真实的风险信号。作者提出 SPIKE-Bench，包含 631 个跨七个功能类别的毒素设计提示词，并配套 SPIKE funnel 三阶段筛选协议（依从性、生物合理性和预测毒性），输出阶段级诊断和聚合指标 Functional Harmfulness Rate (FHR)。对 32 个 LLM 的审计显示，多数模型会直接响应毒素设计请求，FHR 主要由生物生成能力而非安全对齐驱动，达到 50.7%，且 Refusal Rate 无法预测功能风险；作为初步缓解，作者提供了领域专用分类器 BioSafe-Guard。
Motivation: LLM 在加速生物研究的同时也可能被诱导生成预测的毒素样序列，降低生物滥用的门槛；现有安全评估基于自然语言，无法判断模型输出的氨基酸序列是生物乱码还是计算风险信号，因此存在评估盲区。
Method: 提出 SPIKE-Bench，将 631 个策展的毒素设计提示词（覆盖七个功能类别）与 SPIKE funnel 三阶段协议结合，依次用依从性、生物合理性和预测毒性过滤输出，生成阶段级诊断以及聚合的功能感知指标 FHR；并训练领域专用分类器 BioSafe-Guard 作为缓解手段。
Result: 对 32 个 LLM 的审计表明：大多数模型会自由依从毒素设计请求；FHR 主要受生物生成能力驱动而非安全对齐，最高达 50.7%；Refusal Rate 无法预测功能风险。BioSafe-Guard 能在保持良性实用性的同时显著降低预测的功能风险。
Conclusion: 本文作为缓解生物安全风险的第一步，发布 SPIKE-Bench 和 BioSafe-Guard 以支持对 LLM 更严格的生物安全评估，强调需要从依从性转向功能风险的量化评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $S^3$: Improving Agent Safety through Multi-Stage Defense
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on multi-stage agentic workflows, with stages such as memory, planning, and tool execution, to accomplish complex tasks. However, risks may emerge at different stages, propagate across steps, and become difficult to detect and mitigate. Existing safety methods protect only isolated stages and are difficult to integrate, leaving agents without comprehensive protection throughout the workflow. To address these limitations, we introduce Stage-Specific Safety Skills, a unified abstraction that represents heterogeneous safety designs as reusable and composable components with explicit stage semantics. We further develop an automated transformation pipeline that converts existing safety designs into reusable safety skills and establish a community-driven safety skill library. Building on this abstraction, we propose $S^3$, a multi-stage defense framework in which a guard agent orchestrates stage-specific safety skills for risk detection and mitigation throughout the agentic workflow. We also construct the Multi-Stage Risk Benchmark (MSRB) to evaluate representative risks across workflow stages. Experimental results show that $S^3$ consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art baselines in both safety effectiveness and utility preservation. These results demonstrate the potential of stage-specific safety skills as a scalable and composable foundation for building resilient and trustworthy agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多阶段防御框架 S^3，针对 LLM agent 多阶段工作流（记忆、规划、工具执行等）中风险跨阶段传播且难以检测的问题，引入 Stage-Specific Safety Skills 这一统一抽象，将异构安全设计表示为带阶段语义的可复用可组合组件。作者还开发了将现有安全设计转换为安全技能的自动化管道，构建社区驱动技能库，并由 guard agent 编排这些技能进行全流程风险检测与缓解。实验基于自建的 Multi-Stage Risk Benchmark (MSRB)，显示 S^3 在安全有效性和效用保持上均优于代表性 SOTA 基线。

papers.title: TraceCompiler: Skill-Guided Mining and Compilation of LLM Agent Traces into Mostly Deterministic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents repeatedly rediscover procedures they have already executed, producing traces that mix reusable structure with retries, exploration, accidental ordering, and repeated lookups. We present TraceCompiler, a skill-guided system that mines clusters of noisy agent traces and compiles them into executable, mostly deterministic workflows. It admits an inter-tool dependency only when a consumer argument contains a value attributable uniquely to an earlier producer; every hard edge carries an auditable evidence tuple, and ambiguous relations are marked suspected and impose no ordering constraint. Bindings are classified as constants, user inputs, copied outputs, transforms, or residual LLM decisions. On T1, a mechanized form of the rule recovers producer-consumer dependencies at 0.928 precision and 0.943 recall over 15,775 def-use edges of its training split, against 0.711 F1 for adjacency and 0.712 for a frequency-thresholded directly-follows measure on identical data; the compiler skill run blind reaches 0.992 on 250 of those edges. On AppWorld we replay released trajectories in the deterministic simulator to recover masked return values and measure the rule against 563 token edges at 0.993 precision - a self-consistency check, since replay injects tokens by a related heuristic. We compile two recurring intents: a Venmo money-request intent reduces 34 observed API calls to 11 runtime calls and, under leave-one-out execution against the benchmark's own state tests, passes 15 of 21, the failing fold escalating rather than acting because its required branch was never observed; and a Spotify/Todoist intent the compiler correctly refuses to compile, because an irreversible side effect is under-determined. We measure call reduction but not offline compilation cost, so we claim no net efficiency result.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceCompiler，一个技能引导系统，用于从嘈杂的 LLM 智能体轨迹聚类中挖掘并编译成可执行、基本确定性的工作流。系统仅在消费者参数包含唯一可归因于生产者值时接受工具间依赖边，并为每条硬边提供可审计证据。作者在 T1 与 AppWorld 上报告了较高的依赖恢复精度/召回，并用 Venmo 和 Spotify/Todoist 两个意图演示了编译结果。摘要明确未测量离线编译成本，因此不声称净效率收益。
Motivation: 工具使用的语言模型智能体会反复重新发现它们已执行过的流程，产生同时包含可复用结构和重试、探索、意外顺序、重复查询的轨迹，导致不必要的重复执行与难以确定的工作流。
Method: TraceCompiler 挖掘噪声轨迹聚类并编译为可执行工作流；仅当消费者参数中的值可唯一归因于较早的生产者时才建立工具间依赖硬边，每条硬边带可审计证据元组，模糊关系标记为 suspected 且不施加顺序约束。绑定被分类为常量、用户输入、复制输出、变换或残差 LLM 决策。
Result: 在 T1 上，机械化规则在 15,775 条 def-use 边上达到 0.928 精度与 0.943 召回，优于 adjacency（F1 0.711）和 frequency-thresholded directly-follows（0.712）；编译器技能盲跑在 250 条边上达 0.992。AppWorld 上对 563 条 token 边达 0.993 精度。Venmo 意图将 34 次 API 调用降为 11 次，并通过基准状态测试的 15/21；Spotify/Todoist 意图被正确拒绝编译。
Conclusion: 摘要强调系统能减少运行期调用并保守处理不可逆副作用，但只测量了调用削减而未测量离线编译成本，因此作者不声称净效率结果；失败 fold 因所需分支从未被观察到而选择升级而非行动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeSyFS: A Neuro-symbolic Fast-Slow Thinking Framework for LLM Agent under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in applications such as self-reflection, retrieval-augmented generation, and scientific discovery. In these settings, agents must act based on limited observations rather than full environmental states, leading to partial observability. This introduces several key challenges: belief state inference, task objective misalignment, and planning under uncertainty. Prior approaches typically condition actions on full or summarized action-observation histories whose redundant and irrelevant information can mislead the decision making of LLM agent. Inspired by human cognition, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic fast-slow thinking (NeSyFS) framework for LLM agent, addressing the challenges introduced by partial observability in a unified approach. We use a knowledge graph (KG) to represent the belief state, providing triplets as context for every module of NeSyFS. The fast-thinking module performs reactive action, while slow-thinking conducts a new uncertainty-aware planning by following the high-level structure of twisted sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) algorithm. To mitigate the misalignment of task objective, a reflection module is used to reflect fast-thinking actions, and also switches to the slow-thinking module whenever reactive actions repeatedly fail. Experiments on three representative benchmarks, i.e. ALFWorld, Webshop, and ScienceWorld, demonstrate significant advantages over previous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeSyFS，一个面向部分可观测环境下 LLM 智能体的神经符号快慢思维框架。框架用知识图谱 (KG) 表示信念状态，将三元组作为各模块上下文；快思考模块执行反应式动作，慢思考模块遵循 twisted sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) 的高层结构进行不确定性感知规划；反思模块通过反思反应式动作并在其反复失败时切换到慢思考，以缓解任务目标错位问题。实验在 ALFWorld、Webshop 和 ScienceWorld 三个基准上显示优于先前方法。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在自主应用中常处于部分可观测环境，需基于有限观测而非完整状态行动，带来信念状态推断、任务目标错位和不确定性下的规划等挑战。先前方法通常以完整或摘要式的动作-观测历史作为条件，其中冗余和无关信息会误导 LLM 智能体的决策。
Method: NeSyFS 以知识图谱表示信念状态并为所有模块提供三元组上下文；快思考模块负责反应性动作，慢思考模块按 TSMC 算法的高层结构进行不确定性感知规划；反思模块对快思考动作进行反思，并在反应式动作反复失败时切换至慢思考模块。
Result: 摘要报告在 ALFWorld、Webshop 和 ScienceWorld 三个代表性基准上的实验对比先前方法表现出显著优势，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一处理部分可观测性带来的多项挑战、并以知识图谱作为信念状态表示的神经符号快慢思维框架，能改善 LLM 智能体的决策与规划能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Competence on Logical Inference over Probability Operators
papers.abstract_en: Both expressions of uncertainty and inferences are ubiquitous in natural language, and valid inferences over natural-language expressions of uncertainty are necessary for not only everyday conversations but also for high-stakes domains such as medicine and law. While large language models are increasingly evaluated on logical reasoning tasks, disentangling principled, symbolic reasoning from clever surface-level pattern matching is fraught with difficulty. We introduce a benchmark for reasoning over probability operators--inference over sentences with gradable epistemic modals (e.g., probably, might, must) containing 14,320 procedurally-generated English prompts across fifteen inference templates, systematically varying question form, negation strategy, and surface content. Evaluating 29 models, we find that most show answer biases independent of the logical form, a systematic preference for Yes or No. We summarize this with a competence floor: the worse of a model's accuracy on Yes-correct and No-correct items. Only 9 of 29 models exceed random chance. We also test variations in question form, verb phrases/activity, and both the gender and origin of names used in the prompts, finding biases across every axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评测大语言模型在概率算子（gradable epistemic modals，如 probably、might、must）上的逻辑推理能力的基准，包含 14,320 个程序化生成的英语提示，覆盖 15 种推理模板。评测 29 个模型后发现，多数模型表现出与逻辑形式无关的 Yes/No 回答偏好，并以 competence floor（Yes-correct 与 No-correct 准确率中较差者）概括。仅 9/29 个模型超过随机水平，且在问题形式、动词短语/活动、名字性别与来源等轴上均观察到偏差。
Motivation: 自然语言中不确定性表达与推理普遍存在，对这类表达的合理推理不仅对日常对话必要，也关乎医疗、法律等高风险领域。现有大模型逻辑评测难以区分真正的符号推理与表面的模式匹配，缺少专门针对概率算子推理的评测基准。
Method: 构建一个程序化生成的基准，围绕带分级认知情态词的句子进行推理，系统变化问题形式、否定策略和表面内容，生成 14,320 个提示、15 种推理模板，并评测 29 个模型。用 competence floor（模型在 Yes-correct 与 No-correct 项目上准确率的较差者）总结与逻辑形式无关的回答偏差。
Result: 多数模型存在系统性的 Yes 或 No 回答偏好，且该偏好与逻辑形式无关；29 个模型中仅 9 个超过随机机会水平。问题形式、动词短语/活动、提示中名字的性别和来源等变化均引入偏差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该基准显示大多数 LLM 在概率算子逻辑推理上能力有限，并在多个表面上呈现偏差；competence floor 可作为衡量这类逻辑能力下限的指标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training followed by fine-tuning has become the dominant recipe for learning performant policies, and in value-based reinforcement learning (RL) this raises a natural question: given a pretrained policy, should the Q-function be pretrained on offline data too? Conventional wisdom suggests it should, but recent results show that online RL with a randomly-initialized Q-function can result in highly performant and reliable policies without needing to pretrain the Q-function. In this paper, we systematically study whether pretraining the Q-function actually helps when fine-tuning on top of a pretrained base policy. We find, surprisingly, that naive Q-function pretraining often provides little benefit over random initialization. We show this stems from a fundamental mismatch: the Q-function learned during pretraining targets the pretrained policy's Q-function, not the Q-function that online fine-tuning converges to, and this gap persists even after offline value maximization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Initialization via Policy Ensemble (IPE), a simple method that trains multiple diverse policies and uses their pooled rollouts to bootstrap the Q-function learning in online RL. Across a suite of challenging continuous control benchmarks, IPE yields an average 1.26x improvement in fine-tuning performance over naive Q-function pre-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在预训练基础策略之上进行在线 RL 微调时，是否真的需要对 Q 函数在离线数据上预训练。作者发现朴素的 Q 函数预训练相比随机初始化几乎没有收益，原因是预训练学到的 Q 函数对应的是预训练策略的 Q 函数，而非在线微调最终收敛到的 Q 函数，且该偏差在离线价值最大化后仍然存在。作者据此提出 Initialization via Policy Ensemble (IPE) 方法，在连续控制基准上比朴素 Q 函数预训练平均提升 1.26 倍微调性能。
Motivation: 在基于价值函数的强化学习中，给定预训练策略后是否还应预训练 Q 函数是一个自然问题；传统观点认为应该，但近期结果表明随机初始化的 Q 函数也能在在线微调中取得高性能，本文旨在系统厘清 Q 函数预训练的实际收益。
Method: 作者先系统对比朴素 Q 函数预训练与随机初始化，指出两者差距小的根源是预训练 Q 函数的目标与在线微调收敛目标不一致；随后提出 IPE，即训练多个多样化的策略（policy ensemble），并用其汇聚的 rollout 数据来引导在线 RL 中 Q 函数的学习。
Result: 在一组有挑战性的连续控制基准上，IPE 相对朴素 Q 函数预训练取得平均 1.26 倍的微调性能提升，而摘要同时报告朴素 Q 函数预训练往往只带来很小收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Q 函数预训练的收益被高估，在线微调应从预训练策略所对应 Q 函数与最终收敛目标之间的不匹配出发重新设计初始化；作者提出 IPE 作为简单有效的替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating whether a vision-language model (VLM) can act through a physical body is challenging. The outcome of an action couples the VLM's decision with motor control. When a task fails, it is hard to tell whether the VLM made a bad choice or the motor controller simply failed to execute it, e.g., losing balance and falling. In this work, we introduce HumanCLAW, an evaluation framework that decouples action decision-making from low-level execution. At every step, a harnessed, off-the-shelf VLM issues an atomic skill command, and the command is translated into a sub-second chunk of continuous full-body motion with real physical consequences, including gravity and collisions. The body can therefore act freely in the physical world, while execution-side disturbances, balance and motor errors, are factored out. What remains measurable is the model's action intelligence: its moment-to-moment choice of what the body should execute next. Based on this framework, we build HumanCLAW-Bench: 1,218 long-horizon, egocentric find-navigate-interact episodes across 41 indoor scenes. We test nine state-of-the-art VLMs and find that none solves the benchmark; the best model reaches only a 16.8% success rate. Recognizing the target is not the bottleneck. What current VLMs lack is embodied self-awareness: they lose track of their own body, failing to tell where it is, whether it has reached the goal, or whether it has hit an obstacle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HumanCLAW，一个将动作决策与低层执行解耦的具身智能评测框架：每一步由现成的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 发出原子技能指令，该指令被翻译为包含重力与碰撞等真实物理后果的亚秒级全身连续动作片段，从而把平衡、电机误差等执行端因素排除在外，只测量模型逐时刻的动作智能。作者基于该框架构建 HumanCLAW-Bench，包含 41 个室内场景中的 1,218 个长时程、自我中心视角的 find-navigate-interact 任务，并测试了九个最新 VLM。结果显示没有模型能通过该基准，最好模型的成功率仅为 16.8%。
Motivation: 评估 VLM 能否通过物理身体行动很困难，因为任务结果将 VLM 的决策与电机控制耦合在一起；任务失败时难以判断是模型决策错误还是执行器失效（如失去平衡摔倒）。现有评测因此无法单独衡量 VLM 的动作智能。
Method: 提出 HumanCLAW 评测框架，将动作决策与低层执行解耦：在每个时间步，一个被固定的现成 VLM 发出原子技能指令，该指令被转换为包含重力与碰撞等真实物理后果的亚秒级连续全身运动片段。身体可以在物理世界中自由行动，而执行端的扰动、平衡问题和电机误差被排除，剩余可测的是模型选择身体下一步应执行什么的能力。
Result: 构建 HumanCLAW-Bench，包含 41 个室内场景中的 1,218 个长时程、自我中心视角的 find-navigate-interact 任务；测试九个最新的 SOTA VLM，没有模型通过该基准，最好的模型成功率仅为 16.8%。识别目标不是瓶颈，当前 VLM 缺乏的是具身自我意识：它们会丢失对自身身体状态的追踪，无法判断身体在哪里、是否到达目标或是否撞到障碍物。
Conclusion: 摘要指出当前 VLM 在物理身体行动中的关键短板是具身自我意识 (embodied self-awareness)，而非目标识别能力；HumanCLAW 通过解耦执行端因素为单独测量模型的动作智能提供了一种评测途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Enfold: Folding World Model Imagination into Predictive Representations for Ultra-Efficient Embodied Control
papers.abstract_en: World generative models are typically used through what they produce: a rendered future, a video-conditioned action, or latent context computed by a costly generative branch. We argue that their more reusable asset is the computation that constructs a future. As a generator transforms a corrupted future into a coherent trajectory, its intermediate states organize appearance, spatial layout, and interaction across levels of abstraction. Can this future-generative computation be internalized in a representation inferred from the present alone? We present Enfold, which transfers this computation into a representation predicted from the current visual context and language instruction. During training, multi-level states exposed as the generator processes the observed future supervise a current-only encoder. The learned representation is fed back to condition future generation and is read by task heads without allowing task gradients to reshape the encoder. At deployment, action prediction no longer executes the generator. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-robot tasks, Enfold supports strong control while reducing action latency by $3.7\times$ relative to Fast--WAM, Enfold-Flash reaches $10.1\times$. Representation analyses show that it suppresses nuisance variation and preferentially captures changes that emerge over longer horizons. When the current scene is altered by human intervention, both the generated continuation and the executed actions adapt, which is inconsistent with fixed trajectory replay. These results recast a world generator as a source of predictive control representations: its future need not be materialized at every step if its internal structure can be enfolded into the present.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Enfold 提出将世界生成模型 (world generative model) 的『构建未来』计算内化为仅由当前视觉上下文和语言指令预测的表征，部署时动作预测不再执行生成器。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 和真实机器人任务上，该方法保持强控制性能，同时相对 Fast-WAM 将动作延迟降低 3.7 倍，Enfold-Flash 达到 10.1 倍。表征分析显示其抑制无关变化并优先捕捉长时程变化，且对人类干预场景能够自适应调整生成延续与执行动作。
Motivation: 世界生成模型通常通过其产出（渲染的未来帧、视频条件动作或昂贵生成分支计算的隐式上下文）来使用；作者认为更可复用的资产是构造未来过程中的中间计算。若该计算能从当前场景直接推断出来，则可避免每一步都物化未来。
Method: 训练时，生成器处理观测到的未来轨迹时暴露的多层级中间状态监督一个仅输入当前的编码器；学到的表征既反馈用于条件化未来生成，也被任务头读取，且任务梯度不会重塑编码器。部署时直接由表征预测动作，不再运行生成器。
Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 与真实机器人任务上保持强控制性能，动作延迟相对 Fast-WAM 降低 3.7 倍，Enfold-Flash 达 10.1 倍。表征分析表明该方法抑制扰动变化、偏好捕捉更长时程涌现的变化；当当前场景被人工干预时，生成延续与执行动作均自适应调整，与固定轨迹回放不一致。
Conclusion: 作者将世界生成器重新定位为预测性控制表征的来源：如果其内部结构可以被折叠进当前表征，未来并不需要在每一步都被实际生成。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: HANDBOOK.md: A Benchmark for Long-Context Agentic Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed under standing instructions: a system prompt, a policy file, or a skills document is placed in context, and the agent is trusted to let that document govern every action that follows. Existing benchmarks rarely test this deployment pattern directly; they measure whether an agent can complete a task, not whether a long, binding policy document constrains its behavior over an extended tool-use horizon. We present HANDBOOK_md, a benchmark of 65 agentic tasks modeled on how employees follow company handbooks. Each task places an agent in a self-contained company environment (a file workspace with mock email, chat, calendar, issue-tracking, and commerce services exposed over the Model Context Protocol) and instructs it to carry out routine professional work governed by an expert-written standard operating procedure of 20-124 pages. Tasks span five domains (finance, medical billing, insurance, logistics, and HR) and 10 fictional companies. To resist memorization, every task modifies one of 10 base handbooks, altering the specific rules and thresholds on which grading depends, so no two tasks share the same set of policies. Grading is fully deterministic: each task carries a rubric of programmatic criteria (824 in total) that check both that required actions occurred and that prohibited actions did not. Under strict grading, where a trial passes only if every criterion is satisfied, the strongest evaluated model passes 36.2% of trials, and most frontier models remain below 25%. Failures follow consistent patterns: agents let a plausible but unauthorized in-environment request override the standing policy, perform a required check and then act against its result, lose rule details over long horizons, and report compliance they did not achieve. We release the tasks, environments, and evaluation harness.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Workshop on Agent Behavior (WAB) at COLM 2026. Benchmark, environments, and evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/handbook
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HANDBOOK.md，一个用于评测长上下文智能体指令遵循能力的基准，包含 65 个模拟员工遵循公司手册的智能体任务。每个任务将智能体置于通过 Model Context Protocol 暴露文件、邮件、聊天、日历等服务的自包含公司环境中，并由专家撰写的 20-124 页标准操作程序约束其行为。任务覆盖金融、医疗计费、保险、物流和 HR 五个领域及 10 个虚构公司，并通过修改 10 个基础手册来抵抗记忆化。严格评分下最强模型仅通过 36.2% 的试验，多数前沿模型低于 25%。
Motivation: 现有基准很少直接测试语言模型在长期工具使用中受长且具约束力的政策文档支配的部署模式；它们衡量任务完成度，而非政策文档是否真正约束了智能体的行为。
Method: 设计 65 个任务，每个任务均设有自包含公司环境和专家编写的标准操作程序；每个任务修改基础手册中的规则和阈值，使不同任务策略不同；采用 824 个程序化评分标准进行确定性评分，同时检查必需动作是否发生和禁止动作是否未发生。
Result: 在严格评分（所有标准均满足才通过）下，最强评估模型通过 36.2% 的试验，多数前沿模型低于 25%。失败模式呈现一致规律：智能体让未授权请求覆盖既定政策、执行必需检查后违背其结果、在长时程中丢失规则细节、以及报告其并未达成的合规行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调长上下文智能体在遵循长期政策文档方面仍普遍失败，并指出具体的失败模式；作者释放了任务、环境和评估工具供后续研究使用。
Relevance: 0
