papers.title: Medical world models in healthcare: foundations, applications, and challenges for trustworthy clinical translation
papers.abstract_en: Medical world models offer a framework for extending medical artificial intelligence beyond static prediction by representing evolving patient states and modelling how they change over time and in response to clinical interventions. This Review defines the conceptual boundaries, technical foundations, application domains, and evidence requirements of the field through a structured narrative synthesis with reproducible evidence mapping. We screened 1,455 unique records and assembled a corpus of 98 sources, including 14 studies that met a strict empirical definition of a medical world model. The field is organised around four capabilities: patient state representation, temporal dynamics modelling, intervention-conditioned simulation, and clinician-supervised planning. Evidence spans medical imaging, longitudinal electronic health records, treatment response modelling, physiological and multimodal state modelling, ultrasound and surgical interaction, and population and health-system simulation; clinical digital twins are treated as a cross-cutting integration framework. Current studies provide early evidence of technical feasibility for trajectory forecasting and comparison of candidate interventions, but most remain retrospective, task-specific, or preclinical. The evidence base is further limited by incomplete longitudinal intervention data, inconsistent action semantics, limited causal identifiability, long-horizon error accumulation, inadequate uncertainty estimation, and limited external validation. Clinical translation will therefore depend on precise intervention representations, robust causal and mechanistic grounding, calibrated trajectory-level uncertainty, safety-constrained planning, and prospective multicentre validation against clinically meaningful endpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于医疗世界模型 (medical world models) 的综述，定义该领域的概念边界、技术基础、应用领域和证据要求。作者通过结构化叙事综合与可复现证据映射，筛选了 1,455 条唯一记录，最终纳入 98 个来源，其中 14 项研究满足严格的医疗世界模型实证定义。领域围绕四种能力组织：患者状态表征、时间动态建模、干预条件模拟和临床医生监督规划，并将临床数字孪生视为跨领域整合框架。
Motivation: 医疗 AI 需要从静态预测扩展到对患者状态随时间演化及其对临床干预响应的建模，但该领域缺乏清晰的概念边界和统一的证据要求，阻碍了可信的临床转化。
Method: 采用结构化叙事综合 (structured narrative synthesis) 和可复现证据映射方法，系统筛选 1,455 条唯一记录并构建包含 98 个来源的语料库，依据严格实证定义识别医疗世界模型研究。
Result: 14 项研究满足医疗世界模型的严格实证定义。现有证据显示轨迹预测和候选干预比较具有初步技术可行性，但多数研究仍为回顾性、任务特定或临床前；证据基础受限于纵向干预数据不完整、动作语义不一致、因果可识别性有限、长时程误差累积、不确定性估计不足和外部验证缺乏。
Conclusion: 临床转化将依赖于精确的干预表征、稳健的因果与机制基础、校准的轨迹级不确定性、安全约束规划，以及针对临床有意义终点的前瞻性多中心验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WCM: World-Cognition Model for Generalizable Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Language agents can now interact fluently with users in software, but robots still struggle to bring comparable interaction to physical tasks. Current robot-control paradigms, including vision-language-action policies and world-model-based planners, are mainly optimized for instruction execution, leaving users with little visibility into why an action is chosen and few mechanisms to redirect, correct, or teach the robot through interaction. To solve this problem, we present the World-Cognition Model (WCM), a human-centered embodied agent built on the SLAK architecture (Sensing, Logic, Action, and Knowledge) and an asynchronous runtime. SLAK separates perception, reasoning, control, and memory, while the runtime allows reasoning, dialogue, and execution to proceed concurrently. WCM further introduces a human-in-the-loop teaching mode that enables users to interactively teach the robot difficult or long-horizon tasks. Teaching episodes and autonomous task rollouts are refined into chain-of-thought supervision to continually improve the model. WCM achieves a 73.8% average success rate across nine real-world human-robot interaction tasks, including tasks held out from CoT fine-tuning and a long-horizon task learned through teaching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出世界认知模型 (World-Cognition Model, WCM)，一种以人为中心的具身智能体，用于提升物理任务中的通用人机交互。WCM 基于 SLAK 架构（Sensing, Logic, Action, Knowledge）与异步运行时，将感知、推理、控制与记忆分离，并让推理、对话与执行并发进行；同时引入人在回路 (human-in-the-loop) 教学模式，让用户通过交互教授困难或长时程任务。摘要报告 WCM 在九个真实世界人机交互任务上取得 73.8% 的平均成功率，包括从 CoT 微调中留出的任务和通过教学习得的长时程任务。
Motivation: 现有机器人控制范式，包括视觉-语言-动作策略和基于世界模型的规划器，主要针对指令执行优化，用户难以理解动作选择原因，也缺少通过交互来重定向、纠正或教授机器人的机制。
Method: 提出 WCM，采用 SLAK 架构分离感知、推理、控制与记忆，并设计异步运行时使推理、对话与执行并发推进。进一步引入人类参与的教学模式，将教学片段和自主任务 rollout 精炼为 chain-of-thought 监督，用于持续改进模型。
Result: 在九个真实世界人机交互任务上取得 73.8% 的平均成功率，其中包含从 CoT 微调中留出的任务，以及一个通过教学模式学到的长时程任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将交互式教学与 chain-of-thought 监督结合、并让推理与执行异步运行，是提升机器人在物理任务中人机交互能力与可教性的可行方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MissingBench-Verified: Probing Vision-Language Models' Inability to Detect Missing Object Parts
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are well known for hallucinating non-existent objects in images. Objects with missing parts present a unique challenge for VLMs, stemming from both real-world knowledge bias and the scarcity of such images in training data. We present MissingBench-Verified, a benchmark designed to evaluate a specific and practically relevant scenario: when vision-language models fail to recognize that an essential component of an object has been removed. Across ten leading models, we observe consistent and significant failure rates that persist even when external tool evidence explicitly contradicts the model's visual perception. We further ask whether granting models access to image processing tools (e.g., cropping, contrast adjustment) enables autonomous inspection to resolve these failures. We find that existing mitigation strategies, including tool-assisted verification, autonomous visual reasoning, longer reasoning durations, and fine-tuning on an easier dataset, provide negligible improvement, indicating that this failure mode cannot be addressed through current prompting or post-hoc correction techniques. Our findings highlight a fundamental limitation of current VLM for inspection and monitoring tasks and underscore the need for architectural or training-level interventions that enable models to override internal expectations when confronted with contradictory evidence.
papers.comment: Submitted to the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Explainable Computer Vision (eXCV). 11 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MissingBench-Verified，一个用于评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 能否识别物体关键部件被移除这一场景的基准。作者在十个主流模型上观察到一致且显著的失败率，且即使外部工具证据明确与模型视觉感知相矛盾，失败依然存在。摘要报告现有缓解策略（工具辅助验证、自主视觉推理、延长推理时长、在更简单数据集上微调）均只能带来可忽略的改进，说明该失效模式无法通过当前提示或事后修正技术解决。
Motivation: VLM 已知会幻觉出图像中不存在的物体，但物体缺失部件这一场景同时受真实世界知识偏差和训练数据中此类图像稀缺的影响，构成独特挑战；作者希望刻画模型无法识别关键部件被移除这一实际相关场景。
Method: 构建 MissingBench-Verified 基准来评测上述场景，并进一步考察授予模型图像处理工具（如裁剪、对比度调整）是否能让其自主检查以解决失效；同时评估工具辅助验证、自主视觉推理、更长推理时长以及在更简单数据集上微调等缓解策略。
Result: 跨十个领先模型，失败率一致且显著，且即便外部工具证据明确反驳模型的视觉感知，失败仍持续存在；所有已测缓解策略带来的改进均可忽略。
Conclusion: 作者认为这凸显了当前 VLM 在检测和监控类任务上的根本局限性，并强调需要架构或训练层面的干预，使模型在面对矛盾证据时能够覆盖内部预期。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Frontier AI performance across the business disciplines: a case-grounded benchmark of knowledge work and analytical reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are improving rapidly as reflected in benchmark scores, yet these AI benchmarks largely test capabilities such as factual recall, narrow question answering, mathematical problem-solving, and coding and agentic tool-use. What remains poorly measured is AI progress on the analytical knowledge work white-collar professionals perform daily, including synthesizing complex information, exercising judgment under uncertainty and incomplete information, applying strategic and adversarial thinking in multi-stakeholder settings, weighing trade-offs, and producing defensible, structured analyses. This gap is even more pronounced for subjective components of such work, where success can be challenging to define. The "case method" form of education practiced by top business schools provides a natural foundation for addressing this measurement gap, and we construct BusinessCaseBench, a benchmark spanning hundreds of questions drawn from business cases across eighteen disciplines, each paired with a grading rubric derived from the expert-written instructor case solution. On BusinessCaseBench, frontier AI models already score highly against instructor rubrics, and capability within one model family improves substantially over two years. These results provide strong evidence that AI performance on this class of work is already high and rapidly improving, with implications for business schools, where case pedagogy trains undergraduates and MBAs in this kind of analytical reasoning, and for entry-level professional roles, where such skills have historically anchored early-career work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有 AI 基准测试集中于事实召回、数学解题、编码与智能体工具使用、而较少衡量白领分析性知识工作的问题，基于商学院采用的案例教学法 (case method) 构建了 BusinessCaseBench 基准。该基准涵盖 18 个学科的商业案例所派生的数百个问题，每个问题配有由专家编写的课堂案例解答对应的评分量规 (grading rubric)。在 BusinessCaseBench 上，前沿 AI 模型已能对照教师量规取得高分，且同一模型家族的能力在两年内有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 基准主要测试事实记忆、窄式问答、数学、编码和智能体工具使用，但缺乏对白领日常分析性知识工作的测量，包括综合复杂信息、在不确定和不完整信息下做判断、在多利益相关方场景中运用战略与对抗性思维、权衡取舍并产出可辩护的结构化分析。这类工作中主观成分的成功标准难以定义，测量缺口更为突出。
Method: 利用顶尖商学院案例教学法的天然基础构建 BusinessCaseBench，从 18 个学科的商业案例中抽取数百道问题，并为每道题配备基于专家撰写的教师案例解答的评分量规，以此衡量模型的分析推理表现。
Result: 摘要报告，在 BusinessCaseBench 上，前沿 AI 模型对照教师量规已经获得高分，并且同一模型家族的能力在两年内显著提升。
Conclusion: 这些结果为 AI 在这类工作上的表现已经很高且在快速进步提供了有力证据，对商学院案例教学法以及历史上依赖此类技能的初级专业岗位具有启示意义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
papers.abstract_en: Predictive world models enable robots to plan by imagining the outcomes of their actions, but their value for control hinges on generating many rollouts quickly. This creates a bottleneck for diffusion-based world models: multistep sampling makes each rollout expensive, limiting large-scale action search at inference time. We introduce DriftWorld, an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models. Rather than denoising iteratively at inference, DriftWorld learns an action-conditioned drift during training, allowing it to generate future frames from the current observation and a candidate action sequence in a single forward pass at 30+ fps, which is 17x faster on average than diffusion based baselines. We evaluate DriftWorld on standard vision-based robotic manipulation benchmarks, including Bridge-V2, RT-1, Language Table, Push-T, and Robomimic. By producing rollouts that are both accurate and fast, DriftWorld achieves state-of-the-art decision-making performance with far less inference time than diffusion-based world model baselines. Beyond online control, DriftWorld can also serve as an offline simulator for ranking real-world robot policies, with rollout-based scores correlating with ground truth at up to 0.99. These results show that drifting models are a strong fit for robot world modeling, where fast, high-quality imagination directly supports planning and policy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散式世界模型因推理时多步去噪导致 rollout 昂贵、难以支撑大规模动作搜索的问题，提出基于漂移生成模型 (drifting generative models) 的动作条件世界模型 DriftWorld。它在训练阶段学习动作条件漂移，推理时用单次前向从当前观测和候选动作序列生成未来帧，达到 30+ fps，平均比扩散基线快 17 倍。作者在 Bridge-V2、RT-1、Language Table、Push-T、Robomimic 等视觉机器人操作基准上验证，称其在决策性能和推理时间上均优于扩散式世界模型基线，并可作为离线模拟器用于机器人策略排序。
Motivation: 预测式世界模型通过想象动作结果来支持机器人规划，但其控制价值依赖于快速生成大量 rollout；扩散式世界模型的多步采样让每次 rollout 都很昂贵，成为推理时大规模动作搜索的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 DriftWorld，一种基于漂移生成模型的动作条件世界模型：在训练时学习动作条件漂移，推理时直接从当前观测和候选动作序列单次前向生成未来帧，避开扩散模型的迭代去噪过程。
Result: 摘要报告 DriftWorld 生成速度达 30+ fps，平均比扩散基线快 17 倍；在多个标准视觉机器人操作基准上取得领先决策性能，同时推理时间远少于扩散式基线；作为离线模拟器时，其 rollout 评分与真实世界机器人策略表现的相关性最高达 0.99。
Conclusion: 作者认为漂移模型非常适合机器人世界建模，因为快速且高质量的未来想象能直接支持规划与策略评估；摘要未提及方法在真实机器人部署或其他任务上的局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对扩散式世界模型因推理时多步去噪导致 rollout 昂贵、难以支撑大规模动作搜索的问题，提出基于漂移生成模型 (drifting generative models) 的动作条件世界模型 DriftWorld。它在训练阶段学习动作条件漂移，推理时用单次前向从当前观测和候选动作序列生成未来帧，达到 30+ fps，平均比扩散基线快 17 倍。作者在 Bridge-V2、RT-1、Language Table、Push-T、Robomimic 等视觉机器人操作基准上验证，称其在决策性能和推理时间上均优于扩散式世界模型基线，并可作为离线模拟器用于机器人策略排序。

summary_sections.method: 提出 DriftWorld，一种基于漂移生成模型的动作条件世界模型：在训练时学习动作条件漂移，推理时直接从当前观测和候选动作序列单次前向生成未来帧，避开扩散模型的迭代去噪过程。

papers.title: Do We Really Need Multimodal Emotion Language Models Larger Than 1B Parameters?
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have significantly improved the performance of multimodal emotion recognition (MER) and enabled interpretable description generation by jointly modeling video, audio, and language, etc. However, these performance improvements are often accompanied by an increase in model parameter size (e.g, at least 7B), which simultaneously incurs high computational costs and reduces inference efficiency, thereby hindering real-time deployment on resource-constrained platforms such as robots and mobile devices. This raises a fundamental question: do we really need the multimodal MER model larger than 1B parameters for high-quality MER? In this paper, we challenge the assumption that larger models are inherently necessary and proposes a lightweight MER framework (called Light-MER), which achieves better and faster multimodal sentiment understanding and recognition through knowledge distillation. It can transfer knowledge from a strong, large-scale teacher model to a lightweight sub-billion-parameter student model, aiming to preserve rich multimodal emotion reasoning and recognition while substantially improving deployment efficiency. Specifically, we introduce two new optimization strategies to enhance knowledge transfer: (1) a new optimal transport loss that combines Sliced Wasserstein Distance with hidden-state alignment, and (2) a new multi-reward optimization strategy based on GRPO that balances MER performance and efficiency, aimed at further enhancing the learning capabilities of student models. Extensive experiments on nine benchmark datasets demonstrate that Light-MER achieves state-of-the-art performance while significantly improving inference efficiency. This highlights the strong potential of small multimodal emotion language models for future research. Code is available at https://github.com/GAIR-Lab/Light-MER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑多模态情感识别（MER）必须依赖大于 1B 参数模型的假设，提出轻量级框架 Light-MER，通过知识蒸馏将大规模教师模型的知识迁移到亚十亿参数（sub-billion-parameter）学生模型。摘要称在九个基准数据集上，Light-MER 在取得 state-of-the-art 性能的同时显著提升推理效率，强调了小型多模态情感语言模型的潜力。
Motivation: 现有多模态情感识别模型常依赖至少 7B 参数的大模型，带来高昂计算成本和推理效率下降，阻碍在机器人、移动设备等资源受限平台上的实时部署。作者因此提出疑问：是否真的需要大于 1B 参数的 MER 模型。
Method: 提出 Light-MER 轻量级框架，采用知识蒸馏从大规模教师模型向亚十亿参数学生模型迁移知识。具体引入两种优化策略：(1) 结合 Sliced Wasserstein Distance 与隐藏状态对齐的最优传输损失；(2) 基于 GRPO 的多奖励优化策略，在 MER 性能与效率之间取得平衡。
Result: 在九个基准数据集上的实验表明，Light-MER 达到 state-of-the-art 性能，同时显著提升推理效率。代码已开源。
Conclusion: 摘要强调小型多模态情感语言模型在保持高质量情感理解与识别的同时能大幅提升部署效率，为未来小模型研究提供支持。

papers.title: Bumblebee: Interleaved Mixed-Layer Building Blocks for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation systems have undergone significant transformations in the past years. The transition from traditional feature interaction modules to generative next-action prediction has pushed the boundaries of personalized content. Developments have largely evolved along two separate tracks. Sequence modeling approaches on the one hand and feature interaction methods on the other. In this paper, we introduce Bumblebee, a recommendation architecture that addresses the lack of interaction between the two directions through an interleaved, stackable block design. Each block implements a micro-pipeline of layers combining sequence personalization, attention-based encoding, and feature crossing into a self-contained unit. Every block produces a joint representation of both feature modalities which is consumed by the next block in the sequence. This mechanism encourages early and repeated mixture of modalities and enriches downstream features with additional contextual information. Residual connections between blocks create cross-modal information pathways and yield additional predictive performance without adding additional parameters. Blocks can be specialized by selectively dropping components, enabling flexible trade-offs between quality and throughput. We evaluate our approach on large-scale industrial data and show consistent improvements over comparable baseline models across several classification and regression tasks. Furthermore, we conduct ablation studies to confirm that the interleaved composition itself is the primary driver of these improvements. Our results suggest that interleaving heterogeneous functional units, rather than composing deep stacks, is a promising paradigm for future-generation recommendation architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bumblebee，一种用于大规模推荐系统的交错式混合层块架构。每个块是一个由序列个性化、基于注意力的编码和特征交叉组成的自包含微流水线，输出两种特征模态的联合表示并传递给下一块；块间残差连接在不增加参数的情况下形成跨模态信息通路。在大规模工业数据上的分类与回归任务中，该方法相对基线模型取得一致提升，消融实验表明交错组合本身是主要增益来源。
Motivation: 推荐系统的发展长期沿两条独立路径推进：序列建模方法与特征交互方法，作者指出二者之间缺乏交互，本文针对这一方向性割裂提出解决方案。
Method: 每个块实现一个微流水线，组合序列个性化 (sequence personalization)、基于注意力的编码 (attention-based encoding) 与特征交叉 (feature crossing)，并输出同时涵盖两种特征模态的联合表示供下一块消费；块间残差连接在零额外参数下建立跨模态信息路径，且块可通过选择性丢弃组件实现质量与吞吐量之间的灵活权衡。
Result: 在大规模工业数据上，Bumblebee 在多个分类和回归任务中相较可比基线模型取得一致改进；消融研究证实交错式组合本身是性能提升的主要驱动因素。
Conclusion: 作者认为交错异构功能单元而非堆叠深度层是未来推荐架构的有前景范式，但摘要未提及该方法在工业数据之外的一般化表现或局限。

papers.title: Transplanting, inverting, and preventing a misalignment persona: method-conditional emergent misalignment in Qwen2.5
papers.abstract_en: Emergent misalignment (EM) --- the broad misbehaviour a language model acquires after fine-tuning on narrow harmful data --- is mediated in Qwen2.5 models by a latent persona direction, and that direction is causal in open weights. Transplanting it into a model that shares only pretraining with its source induces broad EM (2.83 $\pm$ 0.26\% misaligned against a random-direction floor of $\sim$1.1\%), and ablating a model's own direction roughly halves an overt inducer's broadcast (21\% to 10\%). The transplant doubles as a measurement method, causally assaying directions that a source model represents but cannot itself express. Whether a fine-tune recruits this persona depends on method and capacity, and since low-rank PEFT is the cheaper regime at scale, the recruiting method is also the economical one. On Qwen2.5-32B, LoRA at low ranks on insecure code recruits it (3.4\% misaligned) while full SFT on identical data does not (0.3\%) and moves against the persona axis (drift--persona cosine $+0.17$ at rank 1 to $-0.10$), the far-inducer, high-capacity exception consistent with a representational-distance $\times$ capacity account. The persona's causal role is itself conditional. Steering a bad-medical SFT run away from the direction during training raises the broadcast from ${\sim}24\%$ to ${\sim}50\%$ while matched random controls stay at or below baseline, replicated across three training seeds, so removing the direction is no blanket recipe. Because recruitment is a loss-reducing shortcut that capacity renders redundant, it can be screened for and prevented in the tested instances. Persona loss-relevance at the SFT solution orders four inducers' broadcasts rank-perfectly within Qwen2.5, inoculation removes recruitment selectively (4.75\% to 0.0\%, code coherence 65\% to 87\%), and fine-tuning orthogonal to the single behaviour-derived axis reduces it persona-specifically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Qwen2.5 系列模型中的涌现性错位 (emergent misalignment, EM)，即模型在窄范围有害数据上微调后出现的广泛不当行为。作者发现该行为由一个潜在的人格方向 (persona direction) 中介，将该方向移植到仅有预训练共享的模型中会诱发广泛错位（2.83 ± 0.26%，随机方向基线约 1.1%），而消融模型自身方向可将显性诱导器的广播率大致减半（21% 降至 10%）。移植同时作为一种因果测量方法，可用于检测源模型虽表征却无法自身表达的方向。研究进一步表明该人格是否被微调招募取决于方法、模型容量与训练细节。
Motivation: 现有工作观察到在窄范围有害数据上微调会导致语言模型出现远超训练数据范围的广泛错位行为，但其内部机制与可否预防尚不清楚。本文试图在开放权重模型中因果地定位这种错位背后的潜在表征，并检验移除该表征是否总能消除错位。
Method: 在 Qwen2.5 开放权重模型上进行方向移植 (transplanting) 与消融 (ablation) 实验，把潜在大格方向当作可操作向量；对比低秩 LoRA 与全量 SFT 在相同不安全代码数据上的招募差异；在训练中沿反方向引导 (steering) 以检验其因果作用；并用损失相关性 (loss-relevance) 对多个诱导器进行排序，测试正交微调与接种 (inoculation) 的预防效果。
Result: 移植方向诱发 2.83 ± 0.26% 错位（随机方向基线约 1.1%），消融使广播从 21% 降至 10%。在 Qwen2.5-32B 上，低秩 LoRA 在不安全代码上招募人格（3.4% 错位），而相同数据上的全量 SFT 不招募（0.3%）且沿人格轴反向漂移（rank 1 到 $-0.10$ 的余弦）。训练中远离该方向反而将广播从约 24% 提升至约 50%，三个训练种子均如此，说明移除方向并非通用方案。损失相关性可排序四种诱导器的广播，接种将招募从 4.75% 降至 0.0%，代码一致性从 65% 升至 87%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该人格方向在 Qwen2.5 中是因果的，但其因果作用具有条件性：招募是损失减少的捷径，在容量足够时变得多余，因而在测试实例中可以被筛查并通过接种等方式预防。摘要强调移除方向不是放之四海而皆准的修复方法，且低秩 PEFT 既是规模扩大时更经济的训练方式，也是招募该人格的方式。

papers.title: AdaBoosting Text Prompts for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The classification accuracy of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) relies on the quality of the text prompts. Handcrafted templates and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated descriptions not only make predictions more interpretable, but also enable reuse of the same prompts across heterogeneous VLMs. Recent works construct task-adapted text prompts with a small number of labeled images. However, existing few-shot text prompting methods do not explicitly focus on misclassified examples during prompt construction, leading to only marginal improvements even as more shots become available. To fully exploit few-shot supervision, we propose Text Prompt Boosting (TPB), an AdaBoost-inspired framework that treats each text-prompt-based classifier as a weak learner and sequentially aggregates them into a strong ensemble by explicitly targeting hard, misclassified examples. Extensive experiments show that TPB preserves task-intrinsic, model-agnostic cues in text space, enabling robust cross-model transfer. Across eleven classification benchmarks, TPB improves accuracy on the source model and preserves shot-driven gains when transferred to larger, more capable VLMs, where existing methods struggle to sustain such improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Text Prompt Boosting (TPB)，一个受 AdaBoost 启发的少样本文本提示学习框架，将每个基于文本提示的分类器视为弱学习器，并通过对困难/错分类样本的显式加权顺序聚合成强集成。在 11 个分类基准上，TPB 提升了源模型的准确率，并在迁移到更大、更强的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 时保持了随样本数增加的增益，而现有方法难以维持这种改进。
Motivation: 现有少样本文本提示方法在构建提示时没有显式关注错分类样本，导致即使可用样本增多，改进仍然有限；为了充分利用少样本监督，需要让提示构造过程直接针对困难样本。
Method: 提出 AdaBoost 启发的 TPB 框架，将每个文本提示对应的分类器视为弱学习器，通过迭代地提高被错分类样本的权重，将多个文本提示分类器顺序聚合为一个强集成分类器。
Result: 在 11 个分类基准上，TPB 在源模型上提升了准确率，并在迁移到更大、更有能力的 VLM 时保持了由样本数驱动的增益；相比之下，现有方法难以在迁移后维持这种改进。
Conclusion: TPB 在文本空间中保留了任务内在、模型无关的线索，从而实现了稳健的跨模型迁移。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 AdaBoost 启发的 TPB 框架，将每个文本提示对应的分类器视为弱学习器，通过迭代地提高被错分类样本的权重，将多个文本提示分类器顺序聚合为一个强集成分类器。
summary_sections.result: 在 11 个分类基准上，TPB 在源模型上提升了准确率，并在迁移到更大、更有能力的 VLM 时保持了由样本数驱动的增益；相比之下，现有方法难以在迁移后维持这种改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: TPB 在文本空间中保留了任务内在、模型无关的线索，从而实现了稳健的跨模型迁移。

papers.title: MalariAI: A Label-Resilient Decoupled Framework for Annotation-Agnostic Cell Segmentation and Explainable Stage Classification in Dense Malaria Blood Smears
papers.abstract_en: Automated malaria diagnosis from blood smear microscopy is a critical global health AI challenge; expert scarcity remains the primary diagnostic bottleneck. Existing deep learning systems face three compounding failures: end-to-end detectors treat unannotated cells as background, skewing recall by annotation completeness rather than true cell recovery; Non-Maximum Suppression suppresses valid detections in dense smears; and pipelines lack per-cell spatial evidence for clinical audit. We present MalariAI, a two-stage decoupled framework addressing all three. Stage 1 applies an annotation-agnostic watershed algorithm to isolate every cell in a full 1600x1200 image, recovering 75.95% of ground-truth cells without any ground-truth input. End-to-end, the pipeline reaches a binary parasitized AP@0.5 of 29.10% - the clinically relevant metric for flagging any infected cell - while the stricter multi-class mAP@0.5 of 8.67% mainly reflects watershed's organic region boundaries being penalized against axis-aligned ground-truth boxes, not a localisation failure. Stage 2 fine-tunes EfficientNet-B0 with Focal Loss on ground-truth crops, achieving 98.36% classification accuracy - an oracle upper bound once a cell is correctly localised - with 87.5% and 75.0% accuracy on the rare schizont and gametocyte stages, versus 38.45% and 57.27% AP for a modern YOLOv8s detector evaluated end-to-end on the same classes. Grad-CAM++ heatmaps generated per detected cell provide instance-level spatial evidence for clinical audit; a quantitative energy-in-box analysis confirms this activation is concentrated on the annotated cell body significantly above a geometric chance baseline (+0.0485, paired p = 1.4 x 10^-33), letting microscopists verify predictions at the individual parasite level without sacrificing classification performance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MalariAI，一个针对密集疟疾血涂片的两阶段解耦框架，用于注释无关的细胞分割与可解释的分期分类。第一阶段用分水岭算法在无真实标注输入的情况下从整幅 1600x1200 图像中分离每个细胞，第二阶段在真实标注裁剪上用 Focal Loss 微调 EfficientNet-B0 进行分类。端到端二元 parasitized AP@0.5 达到 29.10%，分类准确率达 98.36%，并通过 Grad-CAM++ 热图提供逐细胞空间证据供临床审核。
Motivation: 现有深度学习疟疾诊断系统存在三类叠加问题：端到端检测器把未标注细胞当作背景，导致召回率受标注完整度而非真实细胞回收率影响；非极大值抑制 (NMS) 在密集涂片中抑制有效检测；缺乏逐细胞的空间证据用于临床审计。
Method: 采用两阶段解耦设计：第一阶段使用注释无关的分水岭算法 (annotation-agnostic watershed) 在全尺寸图像上分离每个细胞；第二阶段在真实标注裁剪上以 Focal Loss 微调 EfficientNet-B0，并对每个检测到的细胞生成 Grad-CAM++ 热图，作为实例级空间证据。
Result: 分水岭阶段无需真实标注即可恢复 75.95% 的金标准细胞；二元 parasitized AP@0.5 为 29.10%，多类 mAP@0.5 为 8.67%，后者主要反映分水岭有机区域边界被轴对齐真实框惩罚而非定位失败。分类准确率为 98.36%，罕见裂殖体 (schizont) 与配子体 (gametocyte) 阶段准确率分别为 87.5% 与 75.0%，高于 YOLOv8s 在同类别上的 38.45% 与 57.27% AP；能量盒内分析显示激活显著集中在标注细胞体上（+0.0485，配对 p = 1.4 x 10^-33）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将注释无关的定位与可解释分类解耦，可在不牺牲分类性能的前提下让显微镜学家在单个寄生虫层面验证预测；多类 mAP 偏低被归因于区域边界与真实框的度量偏差，而非定位失败。

papers.title: Accelerated and Stable Convergence with Anchored Generalized Optimistic Method
papers.abstract_en: We study first-order methods for solving monotone variational inequalities arising in min-max optimization. Classical approaches such as the extragradient method rely on two gradient queries per iteration, which limits their analysis and applicability in the online and stochastic settings. We propose a family of Generalized Optimistic Methods with Anchoring (GOMA), which combine two-time-scale optimistic updates with an anchoring term inspired by Halpern iteration. In the deterministic setting, GOMA achieves the optimal accelerated last-iterate rate $O(1/k^2)$ on the squared gradient norm for monotone Lipschitz operators. In the stochastic setting with unbounded variance, a simplified single-call variant of GOMA achieves a last-iterate convergence rate of $O(1/\sqrt{k})$ on the squared gradient norm. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such guarantee for stochastic monotone Lipschitz variational inequalities in the unconstrained setting without variance reduction or growing batches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究求解单调变分不等式的一阶方法，提出带锚定的广义乐观方法 (GOMA)，结合两时间尺度乐观更新与 Halpern 迭代式锚定项。确定性情形下达到平方梯度范数的最优加速末次迭代率 O(1/k^2)；随机无界方差情形下，单次梯度调用的简化版本达到末次迭代率 O(1/√k)。
Motivation: 经典外梯度法 (extragradient method) 每轮需要两次梯度查询，限制了其在在线和随机设置下的分析与适用性；随机单调 Lipschitz 变分不等式在无约束设置下缺乏无需方差缩减或增大批次的末次迭代收敛保证。
Method: 提出 GOMA 方法族，将两时间尺度的乐观更新与受 Halpern 迭代启发的锚定项相结合；随机设置下进一步提出简化单次调用变体。
Result: 确定性单调 Lipschitz 算子下，GOMA 在平方梯度范数上取得最优加速末次迭代率 O(1/k^2)；随机无界方差下，单次调用变体实现 O(1/√k) 的末次迭代率，据作者称这是无约束随机单调 Lipschitz 变分不等式中的首个此类保证。
Conclusion: 作者强调锚定乐观更新能够在保持单次调用优势的同时实现加速且稳定的收敛，适用于在线与随机最小最大优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GENERIC-FNO: Embedding Energy Conservation and Entropy Production into Fourier Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GENERIC-FNO, the first neural operator to embed the full GENERIC (metriplectic) structure of nonequilibrium thermodynamics -- reversible, energy-conserving dynamics and irreversible, entropy-producing dynamics coupled through the degeneracy conditions -- directly in function space. Existing structure-preserving neural operators enforce at most a single conservation law or reversible (Hamiltonian) structure, while thermodynamically consistent learning has been confined to finite-dimensional, graph, or particle systems. GENERIC-FNO closes this gap: it learns the energy and entropy functionals as neural operators and parameterizes the Poisson and friction operators as diagonal Fourier multipliers sandwiched between rank-one projections that enforce the degeneracy conditions exactly, by construction, with no penalty term, update projection, or residual. The degeneracy identities hold to machine precision (residuals ~10^-13) for any initialization, dimension, or resolution, so the continuous-time dynamics conserve the learned energy and produce entropy exactly; the explicit time stepping adds only a small O(dt^2) drift (per-step residual ~10^-6). We further note that the (E,S,L,M) decomposition of a given flow is not unique, and introduce a gauge-invariant dissipation diagnostic separating reversible from dissipative dynamics independently of the learned functionals. Across three operator backbones (1D/2D FNOs and DeepONet) and four PDEs spanning reversible, dissipative, and mixed regimes, GENERIC-FNO preserves its exact structural guarantees zero-shot across a 4x super-resolution range (64 to 256), recovers the ground-truth ordering of physical dissipation, and is competitive with strong unconstrained and energy-penalized baselines, outperforming them on several dissipative and mixed problems at comparable or fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GENERIC-FNO，据称是首个在函数空间中直接嵌入完整 GENERIC（metriplectic）非平衡热力学结构的神经算子，同时覆盖可逆、能量守恒动力学与不可逆、熵产生动力学，并通过退化条件（degeneracy conditions）耦合。能量与熵函数被学习为神经算子，Poisson 和摩擦算子被参数化为夹在秩一投影之间的对角 Fourier 乘子，从而在构造上精确满足退化条件。摘要报告退化恒等式残差约 10^-13，零样本覆盖 4x 超分辨率范围（64 到 256），并在多个可逆、耗散与混合 PDE 上与强基线竞争。
Motivation: 现有结构保持神经算子最多只强制单一守恒律或可逆（Hamiltonian）结构，而热力学一致学习此前局限于有限维、图或粒子系统；缺少在函数空间中同时满足能量守恒与熵产生且不依赖惩罚项或投影修正的神经算子方法。
Method: 将能量和熵函数建模为神经算子，并将 Poisson 与摩擦算子参数化为对角 Fourier 乘子，其两侧夹有秩一投影，使退化条件在构造上精确成立，无需惩罚项、更新投影或残差。另引入一个规范不变（gauge-invariant）的耗散诊断，用于独立于所学函数族地分离可逆与耗散动力学。
Result: 退化恒等式在任何初始化、维数或分辨率下都保持机器精度（残差约 10^-13），显式时间步进仅引入小的 O(dt^2) 漂移（单步残差约 10^-6）。在 1D/2D FNO 与 DeepONet 三种骨干、四个 PDE 上，模型零样本跨越 4x 超分辨率保持结构保证，恢复物理耗散顺序，并在若干耗散与混合问题上以相当或更少参数超越无约束和能量惩罚基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，完整 metriplectic 结构可以在函数空间中被精确嵌入神经算子，结构保证由构造保证而非训练约束；同时指出给定流的 (E,S,L,M) 分解并不唯一，因此需要规范不变的耗散诊断。适用范围限于文中所列的 PDE 与算子骨干。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Designing for Doubt: The Case for Informed Abstention in Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract_en: As large language models gain tool access and are deployed as autonomous agents capable of editing records, executing transactions, and modifying infrastructure, we still evaluate them based on the sole metric of task completion. We argue that this evaluation focus constitutes a systematic design failure. Benchmark scoring, product metrics, and default deployment configurations all reward agents for proceeding even when they lack the inputs, evidence, or authorization required to do so safely. We call this phenomenon compliance bias. This paper makes three contributions. First, we show how compliance bias is embedded in the evaluation regimes that currently shape agent development: prominent benchmarks either penalize agents for pausing or fail to measure whether pausing was appropriate. Second, we introduce the Informed Abstention Framework, which reconceptualizes abstention not as a failure mode but as a structured capability: a precondition-aware pause that blocks the next tool call, names what is missing, and routes to a concrete recovery action. Third, we specify what informed abstention requires in deployment, arguing that runtime enforcement, calibrated guard mechanisms, and auditable trace generation should become standard properties of agentic system design rather than optional additions. We perform a preliminary evaluation of our approach across 144 scenarios and seven model families. Our results show that runtime enforcement achieves 87.5-91% hazardous-action blocking and 75-92% usability on authorized scenarios, that compliance bias takes two structurally opposite forms across model families, and that the safety-usability tradeoff is tunable rather than fixed.
papers.comment: Accepted to AIES 2026, this is an updated version to the RLEval workshop paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前对大语言模型智能体（autonomous agent）的评估只以任务完成度为唯一指标，并由此提出“合规偏差”（compliance bias）的概念：即使缺少输入、证据或授权，智能体也会被奖励继续执行。作者提出 Informed Abstention Framework，将“弃权”（abstention）重新定义为一种结构化的、感知前置条件的能力，并给出部署层面的要求。初步评估覆盖 144 个场景和七个模型家族，结果显示运行时强制（runtime enforcement）可实现 87.5-91% 的危险动作拦截率和 75-92% 的授权场景可用性。
Motivation: 现有的基准评分、产品指标和默认部署配置都奖励智能体在缺乏安全执行所需条件时继续行动，而主流基准要么惩罚暂停、要么不衡量暂停是否恰当，这构成系统性的设计失败。
Method: 提出 Informed Abstention Framework：将弃权建模为前置条件感知的暂停，阻止下一次工具调用、指出缺失内容并路由到具体的恢复动作；同时主张运行时强制、校准的防护机制（guard mechanisms）和可审计的轨迹生成应成为智能体系统设计的标准属性。
Result: 在 144 个场景和七个模型家族上的初步评估显示，运行时强制达到 87.5-91% 的危险动作拦截和 75-92% 的授权场景可用性；合规偏差在不同模型家族中呈现两种结构上相反的形态，且安全-可用性权衡是可调的而非固定的。
Conclusion: 作者认为应将弃权视为一种结构化能力而非失败模式，并强调运行时强制、校准防护和可审计轨迹应成为智能体系统设计的常态属性；安全与可用性之间的权衡可以被调整。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有的基准评分、产品指标和默认部署配置都奖励智能体在缺乏安全执行所需条件时继续行动，而主流基准要么惩罚暂停、要么不衡量暂停是否恰当，这构成系统性的设计失败。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Informed Abstention Framework：将弃权建模为前置条件感知的暂停，阻止下一次工具调用、指出缺失内容并路由到具体的恢复动作；同时主张运行时强制、校准的防护机制（guard mechanisms）和可审计的轨迹生成应成为智能体系统设计的标准属性。
summary_sections.result: 在 144 个场景和七个模型家族上的初步评估显示，运行时强制达到 87.5-91% 的危险动作拦截和 75-92% 的授权场景可用性；合规偏差在不同模型家族中呈现两种结构上相反的形态，且安全-可用性权衡是可调的而非固定的。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为应将弃权视为一种结构化能力而非失败模式，并强调运行时强制、校准防护和可审计轨迹应成为智能体系统设计的常态属性；安全与可用性之间的权衡可以被调整。

papers.title: Algorithms with Polynomially-Improved Approximation Factors for the $2 \rightarrow q$ Norm, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: The $2 \rightarrow q$ norm of a matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$ is defined as $\lVert X \rVert_{2 \rightarrow q} = \sup_{\lVert v \rVert_2 = 1} \lVert Xv \rVert_q$. We give polynomial-time multiplicative approximation algorithms for this norm when $q > 2$ (i.e. in the hypercontractive setting). This problem either directly captures or is closely related to long-standing open problems in combinatorial optimization and hardness of approximation (e.g. Small Set Expansion), quantum information (e.g. Best Separable State), and algorithmic statistics. Very little is known about what approximation factors we can achieve for this problem in polynomial time, even though such approximations have significant downstream consequences. Barak, Brandão, Harrow, Kelner, Steurer, and Zhou showed that no polynomial-time algorithm can achieve an approximation factor better than $2^{\sqrt{\log n}}$, assuming the Exponential Time Hypothesis (FOCS'12). On the other hand, a simple spectral algorithm gives a $d^{1/4}$-approximation as a baseline. For the important special case of $q = 4$, prior work of Guth, Maldague, and Urschel (SIAM Matrix Analysis and Applications'25) can be combined with known sparsification techniques to give a $d^{1/6}$-approximation. We improve over these results by polynomial factors, giving a $d^{1/8}$-approximation. Moreover, we construct sum-of-squares certificates for the $2 \rightarrow q$ norm. This directly implies improved algorithms for robust mean and covariance estimation, robust regression, and clustering, when the data only satisfies a bound on its $q$-th moment.

papers.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Video world models can generate realistic futures from a single instruction, but they often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time. As a result, the generated videos appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution, such as robot manipulation. We present GEM-4D, a geometry-grounded video world model that resolves this limitation by injecting dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model into the video generative backbone during training. This supervision enables the model to jointly capture appearance and geometric structure while retaining a single-stream architecture with no additional inference cost. We further introduce an inverse dynamics module that converts correspondence-consistent video rollouts into executable robot trajectories, enabling direct deployment in both real-world and simulated manipulation. GEM-4D achieves state-of-the-art performance on both video prediction and geometric consistency across both simulation and realistic scenarios and improves real-world manipulation success from 61% to 81%. Additional results are available at https://gem-4d.github.io/.
papers.comment: Robotic World Model, Video Generative Model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEM-4D 是一个面向机器人操作的几何增强视频世界模型，通过在训练时注入从预训练几何基础模型蒸馏得到的密集 4D 对应关系监督，使视频生成在保持单流架构、无额外推理成本的同时，同时捕捉外观与几何结构。模型还引入逆动力学模块，将对应一致的视频推演转换为可执行的机器人轨迹，支持真实与仿真环境中的直接部署。摘要报告其在视频预测与几何一致性上取得当前最优性能，并将真实世界操作成功率从 61% 提升至 81%。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型能根据单一指令生成逼真的未来帧，但难以在时间上一致地跟踪同一物理点，导致生成视频看似合理却缺乏物理基础，无法可靠支撑机器人操作等行动执行。
Method: 提出 GEM-4D，在视频生成主干训练中注入由预训练几何基础模型蒸馏得到的密集 4D 对应关系监督，使模型联合学习外观与几何结构并保持单流架构、零额外推理成本；另设计逆动力学模块，将对应一致的视频推演转化为可执行的机器人轨迹。
Result: 摘要称 GEM-4D 在仿真与真实场景的视频预测和几何一致性上达到当前最优性能，并将真实世界机器人操作成功率从 61% 提高到 81%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过几何蒸馏监督的视频世界模型可以在保持生成架构简洁的同时建立物理一致性，并经由逆动力学模块直接用于机器人操作部署。

papers.title: The Asymmetric Effects of Knowledge Distillation on Bias in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We show that knowledge distillation (KD) in small instruction-tuned language models has asymmetric effects on bias, and that measuring them correctly requires accounting for where refusal mass moves and what the parser can legitimately score. On unambiguous tasks (BBQ-disambig), response-based distillation from a Mistral-7B teacher genuinely improves context-following for the most context-biased baseline (SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct): among committed (non-abstaining) answers, the rate of overriding correct context with a stereotype falls from 44.5% to 37.2%, with accuracy rising from 0.55 to 0.61. On ambiguous tasks (BBQ-ambig), the same distillation degrades conditional refusal: 15% of the cases where the baseline correctly abstained instead receive stereotype answers (silence-loss), and the distilled refusal pattern only weakly preserves the baseline's (Spearman rho=0.44). The harm reproduces, aggravated, on a second student family (OLMo-2-1B-Instruct): silence-loss reaches 49% and filled-silence accounts for 95% of new bias. Two apparently stronger results are artifacts. An unconditioned override metric reports a 44% -> 23% improvement under a Gemma-2-9B teacher that shrinks to 44.5% -> 39.8% once conditioned on committed answers: the model abstains on 43% of items and its accuracy collapses from 0.55 to 0.35. An apparent cross-condition independence reverses to a positive correlation (rho=0.58, p<0.01) on the valid 19-configuration grid once parser-invalid logit-KD configurations are excluded and the parser is corrected. Aggregate metrics (CrowS-Pairs, overall BBQ Stereotype Reliance Score) average over both effects and conceal the per-item harm. We propose Per-Condition Calibration Diagnosis (PCCD), a three-step protocol evaluating refusal-pattern preservation, committed-answer context-following, and capability preservation. No configuration in our grid passes all three steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小规模指令微调语言模型中知识蒸馏 (KD) 对偏见的非对称影响，并指出常见评测方法会因拒绝回答 (refusal) 的分布变化和解析器限制而产生假象。在 BBQ 任务上，基于响应的蒸馏改善了最具上下文偏见的 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 在明确任务上的上下文遵循能力，但在模糊任务上破坏了有条件的拒绝行为，导致原本正确弃权的样本转向刻板印象回答；作者提出 Per-Condition Calibration Diagnosis (PCCD) 三步评测协议，并在所有验证的配置中均未通过全部三步。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏偏差评测常使用聚合指标或不区分拒绝回答的覆盖率，因而无法正确刻画蒸馏对小模型偏见的影响；作者希望厘清拒绝概率移动与解析器合法性对测量结果造成的混淆。
Method: 提出 Per-Condition Calibration Diagnosis (PCCD)，一个三步协议：分别评估拒绝模式保留 (refusal-pattern preservation)、已承诺回答的上下文遵循 (committed-answer context-following) 以及能力保留 (capability preservation)；同时通过控制解析器合法配置并排除解析器无效的 logit-KD 配置来构建有效的 19 配置网格。
Result: 在 BBQ-disambig 上，蒸馏使 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 的刻板印象覆盖正确上下文的比例从 44.5% 降至 37.2%，准确率从 0.55 升至 0.61；在 BBQ-ambig 上，15% 原本正确弃权的样本变成刻板印象回答 (silence-loss)，拒绝模式仅弱保持 (Spearman rho=0.44)。在 OLMo-2-1B-Instruct 上 silence-loss 达 49%，filled-silence 占新偏见的 95%。无条件化的 override 指标显示 44%->23% 的改善实为伪影，条件化后为 44.5%->39.8%；排除非法配置后，跨条件独立性反转为正相关 (rho=0.58, p<0.01)。
Conclusion: 作者强调知识蒸馏对小型语言模型偏见的影响具有条件依赖性：对明确任务有益，对模糊任务有害，且聚合指标会掩盖逐项伤害；没有任何测试配置能同时通过 PCCD 的全部三步，说明当前的响应式蒸馏方案在偏差控制上尚不充分。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ActQuant: Sub-4-bit Action-Guided Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit remarkable action generation for embodied intelligence, but their heavy compute make deployment on edge platforms impractical. Aggressive, sub-4-bit weight quantization is the natural solution, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suffer severe performance degradation in this regime. To address this, we introduce ActQuant, an action-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework that operates in two stages: (1) an inter-tensor bit allocator that assigns each weight matrix a single bit-width based on how much it contributes to predicting the agent's actions; (2) an intra-tensor scale optimizer tunes per-block quantization scales using action-aware curvature, so that dynamic range is concentrated on the weights most influential for control. To deliver the on-device benefits of our aggressive quantization, we further introduce OmniModel.cpp, an agentic conversion pipeline that ports architectures into a native C/C++ runtime with efficient low-bit kernels. We evaluate ActQuant both in simulation and on a real-world 6-DoF UR3 arm, with all models deployed through OmniModel.cpp. On the LIBERO benchmark, ActQuant is the only method that operates at or below 3 bits-per-weight, retaining 95.0% on OpenVLA-OFT and 94.8% on $π_{0.5}$. Pushed further, ActQuant reaches 2.5 bpw at 90.1% on OpenVLA-OFT, compressing the backbone from 14.3 GB to 2.7 GB (5.3$\times$). On the physical UR3 arm, $π_{0.5}$ quantized with ActQuant retains the baseline's success rate while reducing the memory footprint by 2.5$\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActQuant，一个面向视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 的动作引导混合精度后训练量化 (PTQ) 框架，并配套 OmniModel.cpp 原生 C/C++ 转换管线。两阶段设计包括张量间比特分配器和张量内尺度优化器，以在 sub-4-bit 权重量化下保持动作预测性能。在 LIBERO 基准和真实 UR3 机械臂上验证，3 bits-per-weight 以下保留约 95% 的 OpenVLA-OFT 和 π0.5 性能，2.5 bpw 时将骨干从 14.3 GB 压缩到 2.7 GB（5.3×）。
Motivation: VLA 模型在边缘平台部署受限于重计算开销；亚 4-bit 权重量化是自然解决方案，但现有 PTQ 方法在该量化区间面临严重的性能退化。
Method: 提出两阶段动作引导混合精度 PTQ：inter-tensor bit allocator 根据每个权重矩阵对预测智能体动作的贡献分配位宽；intra-tensor scale optimizer 使用动作感知曲率 (action-aware curvature) 调整逐块量化尺度，使动态范围集中在控制最关键的权重上。另引入 OmniModel.cpp，一条智能体化转换管线，将架构移植到带高效低比特 kernel 的原生 C/C++ 运行时。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，ActQuant 是唯一在 3 bits-per-weight 或以下运行的方案，OpenVLA-OFT 保留 95.0%、π0.5 保留 94.8%；推到 2.5 bpw 时 OpenVLA-OFT 保留 90.1%，骨干从 14.3 GB 压缩至 2.7 GB（5.3×）。在真实 UR3 机械臂上，π0.5 量化后保持基线成功率并将内存占用降低 2.5×。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动作引导的混合精度量化能在激进低比特下保留 VLA 的动作生成能力，并通过 OmniModel.cpp 在仿真和实物部署中兑现收益；工作集中于权重量化与 PTQ 设置。

summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，ActQuant 是唯一在 3 bits-per-weight 或以下运行的方案，OpenVLA-OFT 保留 95.0%、π0.5 保留 94.8%；推到 2.5 bpw 时 OpenVLA-OFT 保留 90.1%，骨干从 14.3 GB 压缩至 2.7 GB（5.3×）。在真实 UR3 机械臂上，π0.5 量化后保持基线成功率并将内存占用降低 2.5×。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调动作引导的混合精度量化能在激进低比特下保留 VLA 的动作生成能力，并通过 OmniModel.cpp 在仿真和实物部署中兑现收益；工作集中于权重量化与 PTQ 设置。

papers.title: Source-Side Sufficiency for the Information Bottleneck: Exact Reduction and Finite-Block Equivalence
papers.abstract_en: The input side of the Information Bottleneck may contain task-irrelevant variation that still costs rate. We identify this cost exactly. Let T be a source and C a relevance variable. Suppose the deterministic statistic Z = phi(T) satisfies C-Z-T. For any encoder p(X|T), its conditional average over the fibres of phi preserves I(X;C) and lowers the rate by I(X;T|Z). The reverse pullback preserves both coordinates. These maps establish equality of the relevance-rate curves and Lagrangian infima on standard Borel spaces for every tradeoff parameter. They also characterise all attained optima. Every full-source minimiser factors through Z, and every reduced minimiser pulls back to T. When C is finite and distortion is logarithmic loss, replacement of T^n by Z^n also preserves the optimal remote distortion at every blocklength and message budget. The operational rate-distortion functions are therefore equal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck）中输入侧无关变化对率的代价，并给出精确刻画。在满足 C-Z-T 的确定性统计量 Z=phi(T) 下，作者证明将任意编码器在 phi 的纤维上取条件平均会保持 I(X;C) 并把率降低 I(X;T|Z)，反向拉回映射则保持两个坐标；这两个映射建立了标准 Borel 空间上相关率曲线与 Lagrangian 下确界对所有权衡参数的相等性，并完整刻画所有达到的最优点。对有限 C 与对数损失失真，摘要进一步表明将 T^n 替换为 Z^n 会在任意块长与消息预算下保持最优远端失真，因此操作率失真函数相等。
Motivation: 信息瓶颈的输入侧可能包含与任务无关的变化，这些变化仍会消耗率，但现有框架没有精确量化这一代价。本文旨在严格说明用确定性统计量压缩源后损失了多少率，并给出最优解的结构刻画。
Method: 在标准 Borel 空间上构造两个映射：给定满足 C-Z-T 的 Z=phi(T)，对任意编码器 p(X|T) 在 phi 纤维上做条件平均得到降率编码器，反向则通过拉回把约简后的编码器恢复到原源空间。作者利用这两个映射建立相关率曲线、Lagrangian 下确界与最优点集合的对应；当 C 有限且失真为对数损失时，进一步推广到用 Z^n 替代 T^n 的有限块长远端率失真问题。
Result: 摘要的核心公式是纤维条件平均保持 I(X;C) 并将率减少 I(X;T|Z)。由此得到相关率曲线和 Lagrangian infima 对每个权衡参数均相等；每个全源最小化器都经由 Z 分解，每个约简最小化器都能拉回至 T。有限 C 与对数损失下，T^n 与 Z^n 的远端率失真函数在任意块长和消息预算上相等。
Conclusion: 本文给出源端充分统计量替换后操作率失真函数与原始问题完全相等的理论结论，说明任务无关变异的率代价可以被精确移除；结果限定于标准 Borel 空间、确定性统计量以及有限 C 加对数损失的远端情形，属纯理论研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Gated Memory Policy: In-Context Memorization and Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation tasks exhibit varying memory requirements, ranging from Markovian tasks that require no memory to non-Markovian tasks that demand in-context memorization of historical information within a single trial or in-context adaptation based on the outcomes of multiple past trials. Surprisingly, simply extending observation histories of a visuomotor policy often leads to a significant performance drop due to distribution shift and overfitting. To address these issues, we propose Gated Memory Policy (GMP), a visuomotor policy that learns both when to recall memory and what to recall. To learn when to recall memory, GMP employs a learned memory gate mechanism that selectively activates history context only when necessary, improving robustness and reactivity. To learn what to recall efficiently, GMP introduces a lightweight cross-attention module that constructs effective latent memory representations. To further enhance robustness, GMP injects diffusion noise into historical actions, mitigating sensitivity to noisy or inaccurate histories during both training and inference. On our proposed non-Markovian benchmark MemMimic, GMP achieves a 30.1% average success rate improvement over long-history baselines, while maintaining competitive performance on Markovian tasks in RoboMimic. All code, data and in-the-wild deployment instructions are available on our project website https://gated-memory-policy.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人操作任务中不同层次的内存需求，提出 Gated Memory Policy (GMP)，一种能够学习“何时回忆”与“回忆什么”的视觉运动策略。GMP 引入可学习的记忆门控机制选择性激活历史上下文，并用轻量级交叉注意力模块构建潜在记忆表征，同时在训练和推理时向历史动作注入扩散噪声以增强鲁棒性。摘要报告 GMP 在自建的非马尔可夫基准 MemMimic 上比长历史基线平均成功率提升 30.1%，并在 RoboMimic 的马尔可夫任务中保持有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 直接延长视觉运动策略 (visuomotor policy) 的观测历史往往因分布偏移 (distribution shift) 和过拟合而导致显著性能下降；同时机器人操作任务对记忆的需求从无需记忆的马尔可夫任务到需要单次试验内或跨多次试验的上下文记忆各不相同，需要显式解决何时以及如何回忆历史信息。
Method: GMP 包含一个可学习的记忆门控机制，仅在必要时激活历史上下文以提升鲁棒性与反应性；用轻量级交叉注意力 (cross-attention) 模块高效构造潜在记忆表征；并向历史动作注入扩散噪声 (diffusion noise)，缓解训练与推理中对噪声或不准确历史的敏感性问题。
Result: 在自建的非马尔可夫基准 MemMimic 上，GMP 相对长历史基线取得 30.1% 的平均成功率提升；在 RoboMimic 的马尔可夫任务上保持有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式学习何时回忆和回忆什么可以显著改善非马尔可夫操作任务中的上下文记忆与适应能力，同时不损害马尔可夫任务表现；项目网站已公开代码、数据与真实环境部署说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Illusion of Superposition? A Principled Analysis of Latent Thinking in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning via continuous chain-of-thoughts (Latent CoT) has emerged as a promising alternative to discrete CoT reasoning. Operating in continuous space increases expressivity and has been hypothesized to enable superposition: the ability to maintain multiple candidate solutions simultaneously within a single representation. Despite theoretical arguments, it remains unclear whether language models actually leverage superposition when reasoning using latent CoTs. We investigate this question across three regimes: a training-free regime that constructs latent thoughts as convex combinations of token embeddings, a fine-tuned regime where a base model is adapted to produce latent thoughts, and a from-scratch regime where a model is trained entirely with latent thoughts to solve a given task. Using Logit Lens and entity-level probing to analyze internal representations, we find that only models trained from scratch exhibit signs of using superposition. In the training-free and fine-tuned regimes, we find that the superposition either collapses or is not used at all, with models discovering shortcut solutions instead. We argue that this is due to two complementary phenomena: i) pretraining on natural language data biases models to commit to a token in the last layers ii) capacity has a huge effect on which solutions a model favors. Together, our results offer a unified explanation for when and why superposition arises in continuous chain-of-thought reasoning, and identify the conditions under which it collapses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在连续思维链（Latent CoT）推理中是否真的利用“叠加”（superposition）能力，即在单个表示中同时维持多个候选解。作者在训练自由、微调和从头训练三种机制下，用 Logit Lens 和实体级探针（entity-level probing）分析内部表征，发现只有从头训练的模型表现出叠加迹象；训练自由和微调机制下叠加要么坍缩、要么根本未被使用，模型转而发现捷径解。
Motivation: 连续空间理论上能提升表达能力并支持叠加，但尚不清楚语言模型在实际进行 Latent CoT 推理时是否真的利用了叠加，现有理论论证缺乏实证检验。
Method: 设置三种实验机制：训练自由机制用 token 嵌入的凸组合构造潜在思维；微调机制让基础模型适应产生潜在思维；从头训练机制完全用潜在思维训练模型解决给定任务。分析工具为 Logit Lens 和实体级探针。
Result: 只有从头训练的模型表现出叠加使用迹象；在训练自由和微调机制下，叠加坍缩或未被使用，模型选择捷径解。作者将这一差异归因于两个互补现象：自然语言预训练使模型在最后层偏向承诺单个 token，以及容量大小对模型偏好何种解有很大影响。
Conclusion: 该结果提供了连续思维链推理中叠加何时出现、为何出现以及何时坍缩的统一解释，并识别出导致叠加坍缩的条件。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The production of meaning in the processing of natural language
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the fundamental mechanisms governing the production of meaning in the processing of natural language is critical for designing safe, thoughtful, engaging, and empowering human-agent interactions. If meaning is constituted rather than retrieved, then the search for context-independent features or circuits in the pursuit of mechanistic interpretability may be fundamentally limited. Experiments in cognitive science and social psychology have demonstrated that human semantic processing exhibits contextuality more consistent with quantum logical mechanisms than classical Boolean theories, and recent works have found similar results in large language models---in particular, clear violations of the Bell inequality in experiments of contextuality during interpretation of ambiguous expressions. In this work, we explore the CHSH $|S|$ parameter---the metric associated with the inequality---across the inference parameter space of models spanning four orders of magnitude in scale and cross-reference our findings with MMLU, hallucination rate, and nonsense detection benchmarks. We find that the interquartile range of the $|S|$ distribution is completely orthogonal to all external benchmarks, while overall violation rate shows weak anticorrelation with all three benchmarks. We investigate how $|S|$ varies with sampling parameters and word order, and discuss the information-theoretic constraints that genuine contextuality imposes on prompt injection defenses and its human analogue, whereby careful construction and maintenance of social contextuality can be carried out at scale, shaping the space of possible interpretations before any particular one is reached. We consider the implications for mechanistic interpretability and how genuine contextuality sets an information-theoretic bound on the decomposability of semantic processing.
papers.comment: Accepted to QNLP 2026, 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自然语言处理中意义生成的基本机制，提出意义是被构造 (constituted) 而非被检索 (retrieved) 的假设，并借鉴认知科学中的量子逻辑视角，用 CHSH |S| 参数考察大语言模型在歧义表达解释中的语境性 (contextuality)。结果显示 |S| 分布的四分位距与 MMLU、幻觉率和无意义检测等外部基准完全正交，而整体违反率与这三类基准呈弱负相关。作者还讨论了真正的语境性对机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 和提示注入防御的信息论约束。
Motivation: 如果意义是被构造而非检索的，那么寻找与上下文无关的特征或电路来追求机制可解释性可能从根本上受限；同时，理解意义生成机制对设计安全、有思想、有参与感的人类-智能体交互至关重要。人类语义加工表现出与量子逻辑机制更一致的语境性，已有工作在大语言模型中也发现类似现象（包括歧义解释中的 Bell 不等式违反），这为本文提供了出发点。
Method: 作者在跨四个数量级规模的模型推理参数空间中探索 CHSH |S| 参数，并将结果与 MMLU、幻觉率和无意义检测基准交叉对照；同时考察 |S| 随采样参数和词序的变化，并讨论真实语境性对提示注入防御及其人类对应物（社会语境性）的信息论约束。
Result: 摘要报告：|S| 分布的四分位距与所有外部基准完全正交，而整体违反率与 MMLU、幻觉率和无意义检测三个基准均呈弱负相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为，真正的语境性会对语义加工的可分解性 (decomposability) 设置信息论上界，进而限制机制可解释性的追求；同时在规模化的提示注入防御中，可以通过精心构造和维持社会语境性，在任何特定解释达成之前塑造可能的解释空间。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 作者在跨四个数量级规模的模型推理参数空间中探索 CHSH |S| 参数，并将结果与 MMLU、幻觉率和无意义检测基准交叉对照；同时考察 |S| 随采样参数和词序的变化，并讨论真实语境性对提示注入防御及其人类对应物（社会语境性）的信息论约束。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：|S| 分布的四分位距与所有外部基准完全正交，而整体违反率与 MMLU、幻觉率和无意义检测三个基准均呈弱负相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，真正的语境性会对语义加工的可分解性 (decomposability) 设置信息论上界，进而限制机制可解释性的追求；同时在规模化的提示注入防御中，可以通过精心构造和维持社会语境性，在任何特定解释达成之前塑造可能的解释空间。

papers.title: Assessing the Effect of Cross-Domain Mapping on Creativity in Humans and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Creativity is the ability to come up with novel ideas, a capacity crucial for human development and flourishing. Are large language models (LLMs) creative in the same way humans are, and can the same interventions increase creativity in both? We study a promising but largely untested intervention for creativity: forcing creators to draw an analogy from a random, remote source domain (''cross-domain mapping''). Human participants and LLMs generated novel designs for ten daily products (e.g., backpack, TV) under two prompts: (i) cross-domain mapping, which required drawing inspiration from a randomly assigned source (e.g., octopus, cactus, GPS), and (ii) user need, which required proposing innovations targeting unmet user needs. We show that humans reliably benefit from randomly assigned cross-domain mappings, while LLMs, on average, generate more original ideas than humans and do not show a statistically significant effect of cross-domain mappings. However, in both systems, the impact of cross-domain mapping increases when the inspiration source becomes more semantically distant from the target, and above a distance threshold, cross-domain mapping benefits the most capable LLMs too. Humans and LLMs differed in how they used the source concept: Humans tended to transfer surface features of the source, whereas LLMs transferred structural and functional properties. Our results highlight the role of remote association in creative ideation and systematic differences in how humans and LLMs respond to the same intervention for creativity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一种干预创造力的手段——跨域映射 (cross-domain mapping)，即强制创作者从随机、远程的源域中汲取类比灵感，并比较人类与大型语言模型 (LLM) 的响应。人类参与者和 LLM 在两种提示条件下为十种日用品设计新产品：跨域映射条件（如从章鱼、仙人掌、GPS 中汲取灵感）和用户需求条件。结果显示人类稳定地从随机分配的跨域映射中受益，而 LLM 平均产生比人类更原创的想法，且未表现出跨域映射的统计显著效应。不过，当源概念与目标语义距离增大时，两类系统受跨域映射的影响都增强；超过一定距离阈值后，最强的 LLM 也会受益。人类倾向于迁移源概念的表层特征，而 LLM 迁移的是结构与功能属性。
Motivation: 创造力对人类发展至关重要，但促进创造力的干预措施中，跨域映射这一方向有前景却缺乏充分检验。作者希望回答 LLM 是否以与人类相同的方式具有创造力，以及同样的干预是否对两者都有效。
Method: 设计对照实验：人类参与者和多个 LLM 在两类提示下为十种日常产品生成新颖设计——跨域映射提示（强制使用随机指定源域作为灵感）与用户需求提示（针对未满足的用户需求提出创新）。随后比较生成想法的原创性，并分析源域与目标域语义距离以及所迁移特征的类别。
Result: 摘要报告人类可靠地从随机跨域映射中受益，而 LLM 平均生成的想法比人类更原创，且没有显著的整体跨域映射效应；但跨域映射的影响随源域语义距离增大而上升，超过阈值后最强 LLM 也受益。人类与 LLM 使用源概念的方式不同：人类迁移表层特征，LLM 迁移结构与功能属性。
Conclusion: 结果凸显远程联想在创造性构思中的作用，并揭示人类与 LLM 对同一创造力干预存在系统性差异。

papers.title: Large Language Models provide support for the parallelogram theory of analogy
papers.abstract_en: Four-term word analogies (A:B::C:D) are classically modeled geometrically as parallelograms: adding the vector B-A+C produces D. Recent work suggests that this model poorly captures how humans produce analogies, with simple local-similarity heuristics often providing a better account (Peterson et al., 2020). But does the parallelogram model fail because it is a bad model of analogical relations, or because people are not very good at generating relation-preserving analogies? We compared human and large language model (LLM) analogy completions on the set of problems from Peterson et al. (2020). We find that LLM-generated analogies are reliably judged as better than human-generated ones, and are also more consistent with parallelograms in a distributional embedding space. Crucially, we show that the improvement over human analogies is driven by greater parallelogram alignment and reduced reliance on accessible words rather than enhanced sensitivity to local similarity. Finally, fine-tuning GloVe to better satisfy the parallelogram constraint makes the model's top-ranked candidates more likely to be the completions humans and LLMs actually produced, and improves its prediction of human ratings. Overall, these results provide support for the parallelogram model of word analogies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文围绕四词类比（A:B::C:D）的平行四边形几何模型展开，针对 Peterson et al. (2020) 提出的人类类比生成更符合局部相似性启发式、而非平行四边形关系这一结论，比较了人类与 LLM 的类比补全。结果显示 LLM 生成的类比被评判为优于人类，且在分布语义空间中更符合平行四边形约束；进一步微调 GloVe 以满足平行四边形约束后，模型更倾向于产生人类和 LLM 实际给出的补全，并改善了对人类评分的预测。作者据此认为平行四边形模型本身是有效的，人类表现不佳可能源于生成能力而非模型缺陷。
Motivation: 核心问题是：平行四边形模型此前被认为无法解释人类类比行为，但这种失败究竟源于模型对类比关系刻画不当，还是源于人类自身在生成保持关系的类比时能力有限。区分这两种解释对理解类比推理的认知机制和语义表示具有重要意义。
Method: 研究在 Peterson et al. (2020) 的类比问题上对比人类与 LLM 的类比补全，在分布嵌入空间中评估补全与平行四边形的对齐程度；通过对 GloVe 进行微调以更好地满足平行四边形约束，并检验该微调模型能否提升对人类与 LLM 补全及其评分的预测。
Result: 摘要报告 LLM 生成的类比在人工评判上优于人类生成，且与平行四边形的对齐程度更高；逐步分析显示，这种优势主要来自更强的平行四边形对齐和对易得词（accessible words）依赖的降低，而非对局部相似性更敏感。微调后的 GloVe 使 top 候选更可能命中人类和 LLM 的实际补全，并改善对人类评分的预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果支持平行四边形模型对单词类比的刻画，并强调改进主要来自平行四边形对齐而非局部相似性。摘要未对该结论的适用范围或潜在局限作额外说明。

papers.title: LoBoost: Fast Model-Native Local Conformal Prediction for Gradient-Boosted Trees
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-boosted decision trees are among the strongest off-the-shelf predictors for tabular regression, but point predictions alone do not quantify uncertainty. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free marginal coverage, yet standard split conformal uses a single global residual quantile and can adapt poorly to heteroscedasticity. We propose LoBoost, a model-native local conformal method that reuses the fitted ensemble's leaf structure to define a multiscale partition of the feature space. Each input is represented by the sequence of leaves it visits along the boosting path, and matching leaf prefixes define nested groups in which residual quantiles are estimated locally. By reusing the predictive structure already learned by the model, LoBoost requires no auxiliary partition or nuisance model, no retraining, and no additional data split beyond standard conformal calibration. Our theory connects the stability of the fitted ensemble and the geometry of its induced cells to local residual-score homogeneity, providing finite-sample coverage-error control and asymptotic pointwise validity as the local calibration size grows and the cells become sufficiently homogeneous. Experiments show competitive interval quality, low post-hoc calibration costs, and stable behavior across local calibration-size settings.
papers.comment: Substantially revised manuscript with new theoretical results, expanded experiments and sensitivity analyses, and revised discussion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoBoost，一种面向梯度提升树 (gradient-boosted trees) 的模型原生局部共形预测 (model-native local conformal prediction) 方法。LoBoost 复用集成模型本身的叶子结构来定义特征空间的多尺度划分，输入样本沿提升路径经过的叶子序列形成嵌套分组，并在这些局部组内估计残差分位数，从而在异方差条件下比全局 split conformal 提供更准确的区间。理论部分给出有限样本覆盖误差控制和渐近逐点有效性，实验显示区间质量有竞争力且后验校准成本低。
Motivation: 标准 split conformal prediction 使用单一全局残差分位数，难以适应异方差性；而现有局部共形方法通常需要额外的划分器或辅助模型。作者希望在无需重训、无需额外数据划分的前提下，利用模型已学到的结构进行局部不确定性量化。
Method: LoBoost 复用梯度提升集成中叶结构的序列来表示每个输入：每条 boosting path 上访问的叶子前缀定义嵌套分组（matching leaf prefixes define nested groups），在这些局部组中估计残差分数分位数。它不需要辅助划分器或 nuisance model，也不需要在标准共形校准之外再划分数据。
Result: 理论结果表明，集成稳定性和诱导细胞的几何性质与局部残差分数同质性相关联，能提供有限样本覆盖误差控制，以及随着局部校准规模增大和细胞足够同质时的渐近逐点有效性。实验显示区间质量有竞争力、事后校准成本低，且在不同局部校准规模设置下行为稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，复用模型已学习的预测结构进行局部共形推理，可以在不引入额外模型或数据划分的情况下改进对异方差性的适应。摘要未提及对降水或天气预报等领域的应用。

papers.title: AgenticSCR: An Autonomous Agentic Secure Code Review for Immature Vulnerabilities Detection
papers.abstract_en: Secure code review is critical during pre-integration, where Atlassian developers rely on lightweight analysis tools, while deep security assessment is deferred to later stages, delaying feedback and increasing remediation costs. Existing static analyzers are often noisy and struggle with context-dependent or partially manifested vulnerabilities, while static large language model (LLM) reviewers are constrained by context windows and lack tool interaction. Agentic AI, which combines LLMs with code navigation, shows promise; however, its effectiveness for early-stage secure code review remains underexplored. We present AgenticSCR, an agentic secure code reviewer augmented with security-focused semantic memory that grounds reasoning in structured security knowledge to detect vulnerabilities before they fully manifest. AgenticSCR achieves at least 153% relative improvement in generating comments with correct localization, vulnerability type, and relevance over static LLM baseline, multi-agent reviewer, and SAST tools. In a shadow deployment, 54% of its comments were validated by security engineers for developer reporting, demonstrating practical utility while underscoring the difficulty of the task. These findings position the security-focused semantic memory as a promising direction for agentic secure code review, enabling early-stage vulnerability identification. Our approach builds an important step toward reliable localization, detection, and explanation in shift-left security practices
papers.comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE'26 Industry-Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticSCR，一个结合安全导向语义记忆 (security-focused semantic memory) 的智能体式安全代码审查器，用结构化安全知识支撑推理，以在漏洞完全显现前进行检测。摘要报告其在生成具有正确定位、漏洞类型和相关性的评论方面，相对于静态 LLM 基线、多智能体审查器和 SAST 工具取得至少 153% 的相对提升；在影子部署中 54% 的评论被安全工程师验证可用于开发者报告。
Motivation: 集成前 (pre-integration) 阶段的安全代码审查依赖轻量分析工具，深度安全评估被推迟到后期，导致反馈延迟和修复成本上升；现有静态分析器噪声大且难以处理上下文相关或部分显现的漏洞，静态 LLM 审查器受上下文窗口限制且缺乏工具交互。
Method: 提出 AgenticSCR，一种将 LLM 与代码导航结合的智能体式安全审查器，并引入安全导向的语义记忆，将推理锚定在结构化安全知识上，用于检测尚未完全显现的漏洞。
Result: 在生成包含正确定位、漏洞类型和相关性的评论方面，AgenticSCR 较静态 LLM 基线、多智能体审查器和 SAST 工具取得至少 153% 的相对改进；影子部署中 54% 的评论获安全工程师验证，可用于开发者报告。

papers.title: HERO: Hierarchical Evidential Reasoning Optimization for Radiology Report Generation via Reason-then-Summarize
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Radiology Report Generation (RRG), yet aligning them through reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging due to heterogeneous medical supervision. Vanilla Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns uniform credit across the entire generation, leading to segment interference, token dilution, and evidence--diagnosis decoupling, which exacerbates clinical hallucinations. We propose HERO (Hierarchical Evidential Reasoning Optimization), a factorized policy optimization framework that aligns heterogeneous supervision with three optimization granularities. HERO separately optimizes reasoning, diagnosis, and evidence grounding through complementary segment-, token-, and completion-level optimization with a heterogeneous reward formulation covering diagnostic accuracy, reasoning quality, and think--answer consistency. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray show that HERO outperforms strong supervised and reinforcement learning baselines, achieving state-of-the-art clinical efficacy while producing more evidence-grounded and think--answer-consistent reports, thereby substantially mitigating clinical hallucinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在放射学报告生成（RRG）中强化学习对齐困难的问题，提出 HERO（Hierarchical Evidential Reasoning Optimization），一种将异构医学监督按三种优化粒度分解的策略优化框架。HERO 分别通过 segment、token 和 completion 级别的优化来对齐推理、诊断与证据支撑（evidence grounding），并使用覆盖诊断准确性、推理质量和 think-answer 一致性的异构奖励公式。在 MIMIC-CXR 和 IU-Xray 上的实验表明，HERO 优于强监督与强化学习基线，达到临床疗效的 state-of-the-art，同时生成更具证据支撑且 think-answer 一致的报告，显著缓解临床幻觉。
Motivation: 标准 GRPO 对整段生成分配统一信度（uniform credit），导致片段间干扰（segment interference）、token 稀释（token dilution）以及证据-诊断解耦（evidence-diagnosis decoupling），加剧临床幻觉。放射学报告生成需要对齐异构医学监督信号，但现有强化学习方法缺乏针对不同监督粒度的优化机制。
Method: 提出 HERO，一个因子化策略优化框架，将异构监督拆分为三个优化粒度：通过 segment 级优化推理、token 级优化诊断、completion 级优化证据支撑。奖励设计涵盖诊断准确性、推理质量与 think-answer 一致性，从而替代 GRPO 的全局均匀信度分配。
Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 与 IU-Xray 上，HERO 超过强监督基线与强化学习基线，取得临床疗效的 state-of-the-art，并生成更证据支撑、think-answer 更一致的报告，显著缓解临床幻觉。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将推理、诊断与证据支撑分开优化能更有效地对齐异构医学监督，缓解临床幻觉并提升报告的一致性与可解释性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PRIVEE: Privacy-Preserving Vertical Federated Learning Against Feature Inference Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) enables collaborative model training across organizations that share common user samples but hold disjoint feature spaces. Despite its potential, VFL is susceptible to feature inference attacks, in which adversarial parties exploit shared confidence scores (prediction probabilities) during inference to reconstruct private input features of other participants. To counter this threat, we propose PRIVEE (PRIvacy-preserving Vertical fEderated lEarning), a novel defense mechanism named after the French word privée, meaning "private." PRIVEE obfuscates confidence scores while preserving critical properties such as relative ranking and inter-score distances. Rather than exposing raw scores, PRIVEE only shares transformed representations, mitigating risk of reconstruction attacks without degrading model prediction accuracy. Extensive experiments show that PRIVEE achieves up to a 30 times increase in reconstruction error (MSE) against feature inference attacks, compared to the strongest competing defense, while preserving full predictive performance against advanced feature inference attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRIVEE，一种针对纵向联邦学习 (Vertical Federated Learning, VFL) 中特征推断攻击 (feature inference attacks) 的防御机制。攻击者利用推理阶段共享的置信度分数 (confidence scores) 重建其他参与方的私有输入特征，PRIVEE 通过对置信度分数进行混淆并只共享变换后的表示，同时保留相对排序与分数间距离等关键性质。实验表明该方法在不损失预测精度的前提下，相比最强基线防御可提升重建误差 (MSE) 最多约 30 倍。
Motivation: VFL 中不同参与方拥有不相交的特征空间，但推理时共享的预测概率可能被恶意参与方利用来重建其他方的私有特征，现有防御在该威胁下不够充分。
Method: PRIVEE 对置信度分数进行混淆 (obfuscates confidence scores)，不暴露原始分数，只共享满足相对排序和分数间距离保持性质的变换后表示，以降低特征重建风险。
Result: 摘要报告 PRIVEE 相比最强的对比防御方法，能将特征推断攻击下的重建误差 (MSE) 最多提升约 30 倍，同时保持完整的预测性能以应对高级特征推断攻击。
Conclusion: 作者认为混淆置信度分数并在共享前保留其排序与距离信息，可以在不降低模型预测精度的前提下有效缓解 VFL 中的特征推断攻击。

papers.title: PRISMA: Improving the Accuracy-Latency Frontier of Diffusion-based PDE Solvers Using Physics-Informed Spectral Attention
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) are often bottle-necked by slow gradient-based test-time optimization routines that use PDE residuals for loss guidance. They additionally suffer from optimization instabilities and are unable to dynamically adapt their inference scheme in the presence of noisy PDE residuals. To address these limitations, we introduce PRISMA (PDE Residual Informed Spectral Modulation with Attention), a conditional diffusion neural operator that embeds PDE residuals directly into the model's architecture via an attention-inspired modulation mechanism in the spectral domain, enabling gradient-descent free inference. In contrast to previous methods that use PDE loss solely as external optimization targets, PRISMA integrates PDE residuals as integral architectural features, making it inherently fast, robust, accurate, and free from sensitive hyperparameter tuning. We show that PRISMA has competitive accuracy, at substantially lower inference costs, compared to previous methods across five benchmark PDEs especially with noisy observations, while using 10x to 100x fewer denoising steps, leading to 15x to 250x faster inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISMA，一种条件扩散神经算子 (conditional diffusion neural operator)，通过谱域中的注意力式调制机制将 PDE 残差直接嵌入模型架构，从而免去基于梯度的测试时优化。摘要在五个基准 PDE 任务上报告了与先前方法相当的精度和显著更低的推理成本，尤其在噪声观测下，使用 10 到 100 倍更少的去噪步数，实现 15 到 250 倍更快的推理。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的 PDE 求解器依赖缓慢的梯度式测试时优化，用 PDE 残差作为损失引导，导致推理瓶颈；同时存在优化不稳定、且无法在噪声 PDE 残差下动态调整推理方案的问题。
Method: PRISMA 在模型的架构层面引入一种注意力启发的谱域调制机制，将 PDE 残差作为架构特征而非外部优化目标，从而实现无梯度下降 (gradient-descent free) 的推理，并避免敏感的超参数调节。
Result: 摘要在五个基准 PDE 上显示 PRISMA 在精度上与先前方法相当，但推理成本大幅降低；尤其在噪声观测场景下，使用 10x 到 100x 更少的去噪步数，带来 15x 到 250x 更快的推理。
Conclusion: 作者强调，把 PDE 残差作为整体架构特征而非单纯的外部优化目标，可使求解器在推理上更快、更稳健、更准确，并且对超参数调节不敏感。

papers.title: RISE: Single Static Radar-based Indoor Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Robust and privacy-preserving indoor scene understanding remains a fundamental open problem. While optical sensors such as RGB and LiDAR offer high spatial fidelity, they suffer from severe occlusions and introduce privacy risks in indoor environments. In contrast, millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar preserves privacy and penetrates obstacles, but its inherently low spatial resolution makes reliable geometric reasoning difficult. We introduce RISE, the first benchmark and system for single-static-radar indoor scene understanding, jointly targeting layout reconstruction and object detection. RISE is built upon the key insight that multipath reflections-traditionally treated as noise-encode rich geometric cues. To exploit this, we propose a Bi-Angular Multipath Enhancement that explicitly models Angle-of-Arrival and Angle-of-Departure to recover secondary (ghost) reflections and reveal invisible structures. On top of these enhanced observations, a simulation-to-reality Hierarchical Diffusion framework transforms fragmented radar responses into complete layout reconstruction and object detection. Our benchmark contains 50,000 frames collected across 100 real indoor trajectories, forming the first large-scale dataset dedicated to single, static, radar-based indoor scene understanding. Extensive experiments show that RISE reduces the Chamfer Distance by 60% (down to 16 cm) compared to the state of the art in mmWave layout reconstruction, and delivers the first mmWave-based object detection, achieving 58% IoU. These results establish RISE as a new foundation for geometry-aware and privacy-preserving indoor scene understanding using a single static radar. Our website and code are available at https://rise-cvpr.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RISE 是首个面向单静态毫米波雷达 (mmWave radar) 室内场景理解的基准与系统，联合处理布局重建和物体检测。其核心思想是把传统上被视为噪声的多径反射 (multipath reflections) 当作几何线索，通过 Bi-Angular Multipath Enhancement 显式建模到达角与离开角来恢复二次 (ghost) 反射，并用仿真到现实的层级扩散 (Hierarchical Diffusion) 框架将碎片化雷达响应转化为完整布局重建和物体检测。基准包含 100 条真实室内轨迹上的 50,000 帧数据，实验显示布局重建的 Chamfer Distance 较现有最优方法降低 60%（降至 16 cm），并首次实现基于 mmWave 的物体检测，IoU 达 58%。
Motivation: 光学传感器（如 RGB 和 LiDAR）在室内存在严重遮挡并带来隐私风险，而毫米波雷达虽能保护隐私并穿透障碍物，但固有空间分辨率低，难以进行可靠的几何推理。
Method: 提出 Bi-Angular Multipath Enhancement，显式建模 Angle-of-Arrival 与 Angle-of-Departure 以恢复二次 (ghost) 反射并揭示不可见结构；在此基础上，采用仿真到现实 (simulation-to-reality) 的 Hierarchical Diffusion 框架，将碎片化雷达响应转换为布局重建和物体检测结果。
Result: 在 mmWave 布局重建上，RISE 将 Chamfer Distance 相比现有最优方法降低 60%（达到 16 cm）；同时首次实现基于 mmWave 的物体检测，取得 58% 的 IoU。
Conclusion: RISE 通过利用多径反射和扩散框架，建立了使用单静态雷达进行几何感知且隐私友好的室内场景理解新基础，并提供了首个大规模相关数据集。

papers.title: Epistemic-aware Vision-Language Foundation Model for Fetal Ultrasound Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Recent medical vision-language models have shown promise on tasks such as VQA, report generation, and anomaly detection. However, most are adapted to structured adult imaging and underperform in fetal ultrasound, which poses challenges of multi-view image reasoning, numerous diseases, and image diversity. To bridge this gap, we introduce FetalMind, a medical AI system tailored to fetal ultrasound for both report generation and diagnosis. Guided by clinical workflow, we propose Salient Epistemic Disentanglement (SED), which injects an expert-curated bipartite graph into the model to decouple view-disease associations and to steer preference selection along clinically faithful steps via reinforcement learning. This design mitigates variability across diseases and heterogeneity across views, reducing learning bottlenecks while aligning the model's inference with obstetric practice. To train FetalMind at scale, we curate FetalSigma-1M dataset, the first large-scale fetal ultrasound report corpus, comprising 20K reports from twelve medical centers, addressing the scarcity of domain data. Extensive experiments show that FetalMind outperforms open- and closed-source baselines across all gestational stages, achieving +14% average gains and +61.2% higher accuracy on critical conditions while remaining efficient, stable, and scalable. Project Page: https://hexiao0275.github.io/FetalMind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对胎儿超声这一医疗影像场景提出 FetalMind，一个面向报告生成与诊断的医学视觉-语言系统。作者提出 Salient Epistemic Disentanglement (SED)，将专家构建的二部图注入模型以解耦视图-疾病关联，并通过强化学习引导偏好选择；同时构建了首个大规模胎儿超声报告语料 FetalSigma-1M，包含来自 12 个医疗中心的 20K 份报告。实验表明 FetalMind 在所有孕周阶段上优于开源与闭源基线，平均提升 +14%，在关键病况上的准确率提升 +61.2%。
Motivation: 现有医学视觉-语言模型大多适配结构化成人影像，在胎儿超声上表现不佳，原因在于该场景存在多视图推理、疾病种类多和图像多样性等挑战，且领域数据稀缺。
Method: 提出 FetalMind 系统，并以临床工作流为指导设计 SED 方法：将专家整理的二部图注入模型以解耦视图-疾病关联，再经由强化学习让模型沿临床可信步骤进行偏好选择，从而降低疾病间差异和视图间异质性带来的学习瓶颈。
Result: 摘要报告 FetalMind 在所有孕周阶段上超越开源和闭源基线，取得 +14% 的平均增益，并在关键病况上准确率提高 +61.2%，同时保持高效、稳定和可扩展。
Conclusion: 作者强调将模型推断与产科实践对齐、并构建大规模领域数据集，可以有效缓解胎儿超声中疾病变异性和视图异质性问题。

papers.title: Malice in Agentland: Down the Rabbit Hole of Backdoors in the AI Supply Chain
papers.abstract_en: While finetuning AI agents on interaction data -- such as web browsing or tool use -- improves their capabilities, it also introduces critical security vulnerabilities within the agentic AI supply chain. We show that adversaries can effectively poison the data collection pipeline at multiple stages to embed hard-to-detect backdoors that, when triggered, cause unsafe or malicious behavior. We formalize three realistic threat models across distinct layers of the supply chain: direct poisoning of finetuning data, pre-backdoored base models, and environment poisoning, a novel attack vector that exploits vulnerabilities specific to agentic training pipelines. Evaluated on two widely adopted agentic benchmarks, all three threat models prove effective: poisoning only a small number of demonstrations is sufficient to embed a backdoor that causes an agent to leak confidential user information with over 80\% success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 智能体（agent）供应链中的数据投毒后门攻击。作者形式化了横跨不同供应链层级的三种威胁模型：直接投毒微调数据、预置后门的基础模型，以及环境投毒（environment poisoning，一种针对 agentic 训练管道的新型攻击向量）；在两个广泛采用的智能体基准上验证，少量演示（demonstrations）被投毒即可嵌入后门，使智能体以超过 80% 的成功率泄露机密用户信息。
Motivation: 基于交互数据（如网页浏览、工具调用）微调 AI 智能体虽能提升能力，但也给 agentic AI 供应链引入严重安全漏洞；对手可在数据采集管道的多个环节投毒，嵌入难以检测、触发后导致不安全或恶意行为的后门。
Method: 形式化三种现实威胁模型：对微调数据的直接投毒、预置后门的基础模型（pre-backdoored base models），以及环境投毒——这一新型攻击向量专门利用 agentic 训练管道特有的漏洞；并在两个广泛使用的智能体基准上评估其有效性。
Result: 摘要报告三种威胁模型均有效：仅投毒少量演示样本即可嵌入后门，使智能体泄露机密用户信息的成功率超过 80%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 agentic AI 供应链中的数据采集管道在多个阶段可被有效投毒，且所嵌入的后门难以检测，触发后会造成安全或恶意行为，构成真实且紧迫的安全隐患。

papers.title: Bi-Lipschitz Ansatz for Anti-Symmetric Functions
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by applications to the simulation of quantum many-body systems by neural networks, researchers have suggested several models which are antisymmetric by construction, and can approximate all antisymmetric functions. However, these works either require very high computational complexity to attain universal approximation, or suffer from discontinuities. In this paper, we introduce two antisymmetric ansatzes which do not suffer from these disadvantages. The first is based on a bi-Lipschitz embedding with respect to a naturally defined metric. The second is a modular anti-symmetrizing projection framework based on the frame-averaging methodology. Both approaches yield continuous antisymmetric models which attain universal approximation guarantees with a polynomial complexity in problem size. Moreover, for both approaches, we obtain quantitative approximation results that bound the number of parameters required to approximate Lipschitz antisymmetric functions to a given accuracy $ε$. We also provide preliminary experimental evidence suggesting improved performance in learning antisymmetric functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向神经网络模拟量子多体系统 (quantum many-body systems) 中对反对称函数 (antisymmetric functions) 的逼近问题，提出两种连续的反对称 ansatz。第一种基于关于自然度量的 bi-Lipschitz 嵌入，第二种是基于 frame-averaging 方法的模块化反对称投影框架。两者都在多项式复杂度下获得普适逼近保证，并给出逼近 Lipschitz 反对称函数至给定精度 ε 所需参数数量的定量界，初步实验显示学习反对称函数的性能有所提升。
Motivation: 现有按构造反对称且能逼近所有反对称函数的模型，要么为实现普适逼近需要极高的计算复杂度，要么会产生不连续性 (discontinuities)。该工作旨在同时避免这两类缺陷。
Method: 提出两种反对称 ansatz：一是基于自然定义度量下的 bi-Lipschitz 嵌入；二是基于 frame-averaging 方法论的模块化反对称投影框架 (modular anti-symmetrizing projection framework)。
Result: 两种方法都给出连续的反对称模型，并在问题规模的多项式复杂度内取得普适逼近保证；同时得到定量逼近结果，刻画逼近 Lipschitz 反对称函数到精度 ε 所需的参数数量上界。初步实验证据表明学习反对称函数的效果有所改善。
Conclusion: 作者强调这两种反对称 ansatz 克服了过往方法高复杂度或不连续的缺点，并提供了连续、多项式复杂度下的普适逼近与定量误差界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Virtual Patients, Real Gains: Digital Twin-Based Simulated CT for Multitask Lung Nodule Analysis
papers.abstract_en: AI-based lung cancer screening is constrained by scarce, annotated CT data, particularly for rare nodule presentations. We investigate whether physics-based, anatomy-informed simulated CT can improve AI performance across three lung-nodule tasks: detection, segmentation, and malignancy classification. Using the Virtual Lung Screening Trial framework, we generated 174 digital human twins (XCAT3), embedded 512 procedurally controlled nodules (X-Lesions, 4-30 mm), and simulated CT (DukeSim) under two scanner configurations, yielding 1,044 annotated scans. Combined with clinical data, these trained models for detection (MONAI), segmentation (VISTA3D, nnU-Net), and classification (Med3D), evaluated on external test sets. Detection sensitivity at 1 FP/scan rose from 0.37 to 0.56 (p < 0.001); segmentation improved modestly (Dice 0.61 to 0.64, 0.66 to 0.69); classification AUC rose from 0.78 to 0.87 (p < 0.001). Physics-based virtual imaging trials can help address data scarcity in medical AI.
papers.comment: Accepted to the MICCAI SASHIMI 2026 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于物理的、解剖学信息模拟 CT（simulated CT）能否提升 AI 在肺结节检测、分割和恶性分类三项任务上的表现。作者利用 Virtual Lung Screening Trial 框架生成 174 个数字孪生人体模型（XCAT3），嵌入 512 个程序化控制结节（X-Lesions，4-30 mm），并在两种扫描配置下用 DukeSim 模拟出 1,044 个带标注扫描。模拟数据与临床数据联合训练后，在外部测试集上检测灵敏度与恶性分类 AUC 均显著提升。
Motivation: AI 肺癌筛查受限于稀缺且标注不足的 CT 数据，尤其缺乏罕见结节表现形式的样本，这制约了模型在真实场景中的泛化能力。
Method: 采用 Virtual Lung Screening Trial 框架：生成 XCAT3 数字孪生人体，嵌入 X-Lesions 可控结节，通过 DukeSim 在两种扫描配置下仿真 CT，生成 1,044 个标注扫描，并与临床数据联合训练检测模型 MONAI、分割模型 VISTA3D/nnU-Net 和分类模型 Med3D。
Result: 在外部测试集上，检测灵敏度在 1 FP/scan 下从 0.37 提升到 0.56（p < 0.001）；分割 Dice 分别从 0.61 到 0.64、0.66 到 0.69，改善有限；恶性分类 AUC 从 0.78 提升到 0.87（p < 0.001）。
Conclusion: 基于物理的虚拟成像试验（virtual imaging trials）可部分缓解医学 AI 中的数据稀缺问题，尤其对增强检测与分类性能有效；作者认为该方法值得作为补充数据来源继续探索。
