papers.title: Patient-centered data science: an integrative framework for evaluating and predicting clinical outcomes in the digital health era
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes a novel, integrative framework for patient-centered data science in the digital health era. We developed a multidimensional model that combines traditional clinical data with patient-reported outcomes, social determinants of health, and multi-omic data to create comprehensive digital patient representations. Our framework employs a multi-agent artificial intelligence approach, utilizing various machine learning techniques including large language models, to analyze complex, longitudinal datasets. The model aims to optimize multiple patient outcomes simultaneously while addressing biases and ensuring generalizability. We demonstrate how this framework can be implemented to create a learning healthcare system that continuously refines strategies for optimal patient care. This approach has the potential to significantly improve the translation of digital health innovations into real-world clinical benefits, addressing current limitations in AI-driven healthcare models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个以患者为中心的数据科学整合框架，用于数字健康时代临床结局的评估与预测。该框架将传统临床数据、患者报告结局、社会健康决定因素与多组学数据结合，构建数字患者表征，并采用多智能体人工智能方法（含大语言模型）分析纵向复杂数据，目标是同时优化多个患者结局并处理偏差与泛化问题。摘要描述了将该框架落地为学习型医疗系统（learning healthcare system）的设想。
Motivation: 现有 AI 驱动医疗模型存在局限，难以将数字健康创新转化为实际临床收益；需要更全面的患者表征并同时优化多个结局，同时处理偏差和保证泛化性。
Method: 提出一个多维整合模型，融合临床数据、患者报告结局、社会健康决定因素与多组学数据；采用多智能体人工智能框架，结合多种机器学习技术（包括大语言模型）来分析纵向数据。
Result: 摘要仅演示了该框架可用于构建持续优化患者护理策略的学习型医疗系统，未报告具体定量实验结果或临床基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架有潜力改善数字健康创新向真实临床效益的转化，弥补当前 AI 医疗模型在整合多种数据源和优化多结局方面的不足。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust Biharmonic Skinning Using Geometric Fields
papers.abstract_en: Bounded bihramonic weights are a popular tool used to rig and deform characters for animation, to compute reduced-order simulations, and to define feature descriptors for geometry processing. They necessitate tetrahedralizing the volume bounded by the surface, introducing the possibility of meshing artifacts or tetrahedralization failure. We introduce a mesh-free and robust automatic skinning technique that generates weights comparable to the current state of the art, but works reliably even on open surfaces, triangle soups, and point clouds where current methods fail. We achieve this through the use of a specialized Lagrangian representation enabled by the advent of hardware ray-tracing, which circumvents the need for finite elements while optimizing the biharmonic energy and enforcing boundary conditions. The flexibility of our formulation allows us to integrate artistic control through weight painting during the optimization. We offer a thorough qualitative and quantitative evaluation of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无网格、鲁棒的自动蒙皮 (skinning) 技术，用于生成有界双调和权重 (bounded biharmonic weights)。该方法借助硬件光线追踪实现专门的拉格朗日表示，无需对表面包围的体积进行四面体化，因此能在开放曲面、三角形汤和点云上稳定工作，同时生成的权重可与现有最先进方法相比。
Motivation: 现有有界双调和权重方法需要对表面包围的体积进行四面体化，这可能导致网格伪影或四面体化失败，尤其在开放曲面、三角形汤和点云等几何输入上难以可靠工作。
Method: 提出一种无网格自动蒙皮方法，利用硬件光线追踪 (hardware ray-tracing) 实现专门的拉格朗日表示，在优化双调和能量并施加边界条件的同时避免使用有限元；该公式还支持在优化过程中通过权重绘制 (weight painting) 集成艺术控制。
Result: 摘要报告该方法生成的权重可与当前最先进方法相当，并且能在现有方法失败的开放曲面、三角形汤和点云上可靠工作；作者提供了定性和定量的全面评估。
Conclusion: 该方法通过无网格拉格朗日表示绕开四面体化，显著提升了蒙皮权重的计算鲁棒性，并保留了艺术控制能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mixed-Initiative Human-Robot Teaming under Suboptimality with Online Bayesian Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: For effective human-agent teaming, robots and other artificial intelligence (AI) agents must infer their human partner's abilities and behavioral response patterns and adapt accordingly. Most prior works make the unrealistic assumption that one or more teammates can act near-optimally. In real-world collaboration, humans and autonomous agents can be suboptimal, especially when each only has partial domain knowledge. In this work, we develop computational modeling and optimization techniques for enhancing the performance of suboptimal human-agent teams, where the human and the agent have asymmetric capabilities and act suboptimally due to incomplete environmental knowledge. We adopt an online Bayesian approach that enables a robot to infer people's willingness to comply with its assistance in a sequential decision-making game. Our user studies show that user preferences and team performance indeed vary with robot intervention styles, and our approach for mixed-initiative collaborations enhances objective team performance ($p<.001$) and subjective measures, such as user's trust ($p<.001$) and willingness to comply with the robot ($p<.001$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人类与自主智能体在非理想条件下协作的问题，提出一种在线贝叶斯适应 (online Bayesian adaptation) 方法，使机器人能够在序贯决策博弈中推断人类服从其协助的意愿，并据此优化混合主动 (mixed-initiative) 协作策略。用户研究表明，机器人干预风格会显著影响用户偏好与团队表现，所提方法在客观团队表现、信任和服从意愿等指标上均有显著提升。
Motivation: 多数已有的人机团队研究假设至少一方能以接近最优的方式行动，而真实协作中人类和自主智能体常因能力不对称、领域知识不完整而表现次优；作者希望为该类次优团队设计更贴近实际的建模与优化方法。
Method: 采用在线贝叶斯方法，让机器人在序贯决策博弈中持续推断人类对其协助的服从意愿，并在此基础上发展针对次优人类-智能体团队的混合主动协作计算建模与优化技术。
Result: 用户研究显示用户偏好和团队表现会随机器人干预风格变化；该方法的混合主动协作在客观团队表现上显著提升 (p<.001)，主观指标如用户信任 (p<.001) 和服从机器人协助的意愿 (p<.001) 亦显著改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在协作建模中显式考虑人类的次优性并采用在线贝叶斯适应，可以有效提升人机团队的客观与主观协作效能。

papers.title: AI Sandbox: Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative AI experimentation across industry and academia requires platforms that enable rapid prototyping while preserving controlled access, tenant separation, and transparent workflows. Despite growing interest in AI sandboxes, there is still limited practical guidance on how to design and implement platforms that integrate experimentation capabilities with governance requirements. This work presents the design and implementation of a governance-aware, multi-tenant AI sandbox for structured experimentation and the generation of reusable evaluation evidence across projects and stakeholder groups. The sandbox was developed within an industry-academia collaboration based on requirements that were iteratively refined with industrial partners. Its reference architecture separates the multi-tenant user interface from the backend control plane and places execution and data-management functions in dedicated layers. The platform supports governed user onboarding, project-centered collaboration, managed access to AI services, approval workflows, audit logging, and traceable experimentation. Experiment configurations, contextual information, and governance decisions are stored as persistent records, allowing evidence and outcomes to be compared and reused across projects. The development process provides practical lessons for deploying and extending governance-aware AI sandbox platforms in collaborative research and industrial environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以技术报告形式介绍了一个治理感知的多租户 AI 沙箱 (AI sandbox) 平台，面向产学研协作中的可控 AI 实验。平台的参考架构将多租户用户界面与后端控制平面分离，并在专用层中处理执行与数据管理功能，支持受治理的用户接入、项目中心化协作、AI 服务访问管理、审批工作流、审计日志和可追踪实验。实验配置、上下文信息与治理决策以持久记录保存，以便跨项目比较和复用评估证据。论文报告了与工业伙伴迭代提炼的需求及开发过程中获得的实践经验。
Motivation: 尽管业界对 AI 沙箱兴趣增长，但关于如何设计与实现同时满足快速原型实验和治理需求（如租户隔离、受控访问、透明工作流）的平台的实用指导仍然有限。
Method: 在产学研协作中基于与工业伙伴迭代提炼的需求，设计并实现了一个治理感知的多租户 AI 沙箱；其参考架构分离多租户 UI 与后端控制平面，并将执行和数据管理功能置于独立层，同时提供审批工作流、审计日志、持久化实验记录等机制。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；主要产出是平台的设计与实现、参考架构、治理功能清单，以及面向协作研究和工业环境部署与扩展的实践教训。
Conclusion: 作者认为治理感知的 AI 沙箱能够支持结构化实验并生成跨项目可复用的评估证据，其开发过程为在协作研究与工业环境中部署此类平台提供了实用经验。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DenialRAG: Single-Document RAG Poisoning via Embedded Parametric Denial
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to corpus poisoning: an attacker who inserts a crafted document into the retrieval corpus can steer the underlying large language model (LLM) toward an attacker-chosen wrong answer. Prior single-document attacks typically avoid explicitly naming and refuting the correct answer inside the poisoned passage. In this paper, we examine a complementary design and propose \emph{DenialRAG}, a single-document poisoning attack that explicitly names the correct answer, denies it, and presents an attacker-controlled explanation for favoring the wrong answer. By placing both the correct answer and the corresponding poisoned answer inside the same retrieved passage, DenialRAG embeds the conflict directly into the context seen by the generator. We evaluate DenialRAG against four published single-document poisoning attacks across three open-domain question-answering datasets, eight target LLMs from four vendors, and five inference-time defenses. The results show that attack effectiveness is strongly model-dependent: DenialRAG achieves the highest attack success rate (ASR) on all three Mistral-7B datasets and remains effective on several other target LLMs, while other attacks dominate in some model regimes. Defense results show meaningful ASR reductions but non-uniform protection, with each defense leaving residual ASR in some settings. Component-level and cross-model analyses further identify the embedded denial as the most influential tested component and show that different poisoning mechanisms lose effectiveness at different rates across model groups. Together, these results show that RAG poisoning risk cannot be fully characterized by a single attack family or a single target model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DenialRAG，一种单文档检索增强生成 (RAG) 投毒攻击：攻击者在污染文档中显式点名正确答案、予以否认，并提供偏向错误答案的受控解释。通过将正确答案与错误答案置于同一被检索片段，DenialRAG 将冲突直接嵌入生成器所见上下文。作者在三个开放域问答数据集、八种来自四家厂商的目标 LLM 和五种推理期防御上，与四种已发表单文档投毒攻击对比；结果表明攻击效果高度依赖模型，DenialRAG 在三个 Mistral-7B 数据集上取得最高攻击成功率 (ASR)，而防御带来不一致的 ASR 下降并留有残余风险。
Motivation: 现有单文档 RAG 投毒攻击通常避免在污染片段中显式点名并反驳正确答案，这一互补设计方向缺少系统研究。由于 RAG 系统易受语料投毒影响，理解显式否认式攻击的效力对全面刻画投毒风险十分重要。
Method: DenialRAG 将正确答案与攻击者控制的错误答案放在同一被检索段落中，显式否认正确答案并提供支持错误答案的受控解释，从而把冲突内嵌到生成器看到的上下文里。评估框架包括四种已发表单文档投毒攻击、三个开放域问答数据集、八种目标 LLM 与五种推理期防御，并辅以组件级与跨模型分析。
Result: 攻击成功率强烈依赖目标模型：DenialRAG 在所有三个 Mistral-7B 数据集上达到最高 ASR，并在若干其他目标 LLM 上保持有效，而其他攻击在部分模型区间占优。防御实验显示 ASR 有实质性下降但保护不均匀，每种防御都在部分设置下留下残余 ASR。组件分析表明内嵌否认是最有影响的组件，不同投毒机制在不同模型组中以不同速率失效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，RAG 投毒风险无法用单一攻击族或单一目标模型完全刻画，攻击效果具有明显的模型依赖性。该工作投稿目标为 ACSAC 2026。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Policies Change Probabilities: Modular Decision-Making for LLM Code Review
papers.abstract_en: LLM code reviewers often estimate patch risk and make approval decisions in one prompt. A probability should depend on evidence; costs should determine the action taken from it. We test whether four deployed reviewer interfaces preserve this separation using 15,792 responses on 720 candidate patches, with one that passed and one that failed an archived test harness for each of 360 repository issues. In matched calls with the patch and monitor evidence fixed, replacing an equal-cost policy with a 10:1 false-accept policy changes reported failure probabilities by 13.6 to 16.9 percentage points on average. For every reviewer, the actions returned under the high-cost prompt are worse than rejecting all patches. Applying the same high-cost rule to probabilities elicited under equal costs reduces loss for all four systems, showing that probability elicitation itself contributes to the excess loss. We also evaluate a modular pipeline that elicits risk without policy information, combines an independent monitor score, and applies costs in code. Relative to calibrated reviewer-only scores, the pipeline improves average probability accuracy and, at equal costs, reduces mean loss by .073 per issue while accepting 58 to 68% of patches. At 10:1, it accepts none and matches reject-all. Downstream policy can therefore change the probability it is meant to use, motivating separate evaluation of risk, outside evidence, and action.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures; includes technical appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/rasvik/when-policies-change-probabilities
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 代码审查器中概率估计与决策策略是否分离的问题。作者用 15,792 次响应和 720 个候选补丁（360 个仓库问题各对应一个通过和一个失败的测试）测试四种部署审查界面，发现将等成本策略替换为 10:1 假接受策略会使报告的失败概率平均改变 13.6 到 16.9 个百分点。文章还提出一个模块化流水线，在无策略信息下估计风险、结合独立监控分数并在代码中应用成本，从而改善概率准确率并降低决策损失。
Motivation: LLM 代码审查器常在一个提示中同时估计补丁风险并作出批准决策。概率应当依赖证据，成本应当决定由概率采取的行动，但实际部署界面可能混淆这两者，导致策略信息污染概率估计。
Method: 在固定补丁与监控证据的条件下，匹配调用四种审查界面，比较等成本策略与 10:1 假接受策略下报告概率和行动的差异；同时评估一个模块化流水线，该流水线在无策略信息下估计风险、合并独立的监控评分，并在代码层面应用成本。
Result: 10:1 高成本提示使报告的失败概率平均变化 13.6 到 16.9 个百分点；所有审查者在该提示下返回的行动均劣于全部拒绝。将同一高成本规则应用于等成本下获得的概率，四个系统的损失均降低，说明概率引出本身造成了额外损失。模块化流水线相对于校准后的仅审查者评分提升平均概率准确率，在等成本下平均损失降低 .073/问题并接受 58 到 68% 的补丁；在 10:1 成本下不接受任何补丁，与全部拒绝一致。
Conclusion: 下游策略会改变它本应使用的概率，因此有必要将风险估计、外部证据和行动决策分开评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究 LLM 代码审查器中概率估计与决策策略是否分离的问题。作者用 15,792 次响应和 720 个候选补丁（360 个仓库问题各对应一个通过和一个失败的测试）测试四种部署审查界面，发现将等成本策略替换为 10:1 假接受策略会使报告的失败概率平均改变 13.6 到 16.9 个百分点。文章还提出一个模块化流水线，在无策略信息下估计风险、结合独立监控分数并在代码中应用成本，从而改善概率准确率并降低决策损失。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM 代码审查器常在一个提示中同时估计补丁风险并作出批准决策。概率应当依赖证据，成本应当决定由概率采取的行动，但实际部署界面可能混淆这两者，导致策略信息污染概率估计。
summary_sections.method: 在固定补丁与监控证据的条件下，匹配调用四种审查界面，比较等成本策略与 10:1 假接受策略下报告概率和行动的差异；同时评估一个模块化流水线，该流水线在无策略信息下估计风险、合并独立的监控评分，并在代码层面应用成本。
summary_sections.result: 10:1 高成本提示使报告的失败概率平均变化 13.6 到 16.9 个百分点；所有审查者在该提示下返回的行动均劣于全部拒绝。将同一高成本规则应用于等成本下获得的概率，四个系统的损失均降低，说明概率引出本身造成了额外损失。模块化流水线相对于校准后的仅审查者评分提升平均概率准确率，在等成本下平均损失降低 .073/问题并接受 58 到 68% 的补丁；在 10:1 成本下不接受任何补丁，与全部拒绝一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 下游策略会改变它本应使用的概率，因此有必要将风险估计、外部证据和行动决策分开评估。

papers.title: Moving the Safety Barrier: Dynamic Routing Adaptive Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread deployment of large foundation models (LFMs) in open environments, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks toward white-box attacks that directly identify and disrupt internal safety neurons or routes. However, existing safety defenses often rely on static safety units or fixed refusal pathways, leaving models highly vulnerable to targeted route-level white-box attacks. For that, we propose dynamic routing adaptive alignment (DRAA), a framework that introduces dynamic compensatory routes to preserve robust refusal behavior when the safety route is compromised. Specifically, we first identify and localize the model's safety route by contrasting internal activations between safe and unsafe calibration samples. DRAA then masks this safety route to induce causal failure cases and selectively mines the resulting defense failures, thereby constructing failure-aware preference pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DRAA effectively restructures the underlying pathway dependence of model safety, substantially improving robustness against route-level white-box attacks, while preserving general utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型基础模型 (LFM) 在开放环境下面临的白盒攻击问题，提出动态路由自适应对齐 (DRAA)。该方法通过对比安全与不安全校准样本的内部激活来定位模型的安全路由，随后掩蔽该路由以诱导因果失败并挖掘防御失败样本，构造失败感知偏好对。摘要称 DRAA 能重构模型安全所依赖的路径关系，显著提升对路由级白盒攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有安全防御通常依赖静态安全单元或固定拒绝路径，在攻击者直接定位并破坏内部安全神经元或路由的白盒攻击下容易失效，模型对此类针对性攻击较为脆弱。
Method: DRAA 先通过安全与不安全校准样本的内部激活对比定位安全路由，再掩蔽该路由制造因果失败案例，选择性挖掘这些防御失败并构建失败感知偏好对，以此重新对齐模型在安全路径受损时的拒绝行为。
Result: 摘要报告 DRAA 在路由级白盒攻击下显著提升了鲁棒性，同时保持通用效用，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过暴露并修复安全路由被破坏时的失败模式，可以重构模型安全的底层路径依赖，使安全行为在路由级攻击下更加稳健。

papers.title: dots.tts.edit: Precisely Controlled Speech Editing with a Continuous Autoregressive Model
papers.abstract_en: Speech editing for content creation requires precise control over both what an edit should do and where it should apply. Free-form natural language provides a flexible interface for expressing edit requests, but its ambiguity may leave the intended operation, parameters, or target region underspecified. We study a precise and explicit interface for speech editing: a transcript-grounded structural edit instruction with XML-style tags explicitly specifies typed operations and localizes them to transcript spans or boundaries. This semantic timeline avoids explicit timestamp alignment and provides an externally inspectable contract for compositional edits. We instantiate the interface in dots.tts.edit, an editor adapted from the continuous autoregressive dots.tts foundation model. Four representative speech-creation controls cover lexical content, affective expression, pitch and speaking-rate delivery, and temporal phrasing through text, emotion, prosody, and pause editing. Task-specific data pipelines construct operation- and scope-controlled pairs while retaining source-derived context outside each target region. We further introduce doteBench, a bilingual evaluation suite that measures precise instruction following, local preservation, and audio quality across the four controls and their composition. Experiments show leading overall instruction following and local preservation across its five editing categories, while audio quality remains comparable to existing open-source systems. Across three Seed-TTS-Eval shards, the model shows negligible differences from the base model in zero-shot TTS recognition error rate and speaker similarity. The code and model will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音编辑（speech editing）中自然语言指令歧义导致的操作与目标区域不明确问题，提出一种基于转录文本锚定的结构化编辑指令接口：用XML风格标签显式指定操作类型并定位到文本片段或边界。作者将该接口实现为从连续自回归模型 dots.tts 改编的编辑器 dots.tts.edit，覆盖词汇、情感、韵律与停顿四类编辑控制，并构建了双语评测集 doteBench。实验显示其在五类编辑任务上整体指令遵循与局部保持领先，音频质量与现有开源系统相当。
Motivation: 自由形式的自然语言虽可用于表达编辑请求，但其歧义可能使预期操作、参数或目标区域未被充分定义，难以实现精确且可检查的语音编辑控制。
Method: 提出带XML风格标签的转录锚定结构化编辑指令，形成无需显式时间戳对齐的语义时间线；基于连续自回归 dots.tts 模型构建编辑器，采用任务特定数据流水线生成操作与范围受控的配对数据，并保留目标区域之外的源语境；同时引入包含四类控制及其组合的汉语评测集 doteBench。
Result: 在五个编辑类别上取得领先的指令遵循与局部保持结果，音频质量与现有开源系统相当；在三个 Seed-TTS-Eval shard 上，模型与基础模型在零样本 TTS 识别错误率和说话人相似度上差异可忽略。
Conclusion: 该结构化编辑接口为组合式编辑提供了外部可检查的约定；论文标注为进行中工作，代码与模型将稍后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Security-First Evaluation of Text-to-Terraform: Benchmarking LLMs and SLMs for Secure IaC Generation
papers.abstract_en: Cloud misconfiguration remains a leading cause of security incidents, yet whether LLMs and SLMs can generate security-compliant Infrastructure-as-Code is an open question. We benchmark seven models, three closed LLMs (Claude Opus 4, GPT-5.4, Gemini 2.5 Pro) and four open SLMs (Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, WizardCoder-33B, CodeLlama-13B, Magicoder-S-CL-7B), on AWS Terraform generation across 17 scenarios, integrating Checkov and Trivy scanners into a GitLab CI/CD pipeline and evaluating two prompt strategies at three security levels (pass@5). Syntactic validity and security compliance are largely orthogonal properties in LLM-generated IaC, a model that reliably produces well-formed Terraform does not necessarily produce secure Terraform: WizardCoder-33B achieves 77.8% validate rate yet zero Checkov compliance, while Claude Opus 4 reaches 23.1% Checkov and 92.5% Trivy pass rates under detailed security prompting. Consequently, prompt engineering alone is insufficient: automated multi-tool scanning remains a necessary complement to LLM-assisted IaC generation regardless of model family or prompt strategy. All artifacts are publicly available.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, and 9 tables. The benchmark artifacts and CI/CD pipeline are publicly available at https://gitlab.com/repo-anon-iac/repo-anon-9ac. Accepted for publication at SBSeg 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对七个 LLM/SLM 在 AWS Terraform 生成上的安全合规性进行基准测试，覆盖 17 个场景、两种提示策略和三个安全级别（pass@5），并将 Checkov 和 Trivy 扫描器集成进 GitLab CI/CD 流水线。结果显示语法有效性与安全合规性基本正交：能稳定生成格式良好 Terraform 的模型不一定生成安全的 Terraform，提示工程本身不足以保证安全。
Motivation: 云配置错误仍是安全事件的主要来源，但 LLM 和 SLM 能否生成安全合规的基础设施即代码（IaC）仍是一个开放问题，现有评估缺少安全优先的系统性视角。
Method: 构造 AWS Terraform 生成基准，包含 17 个场景，评估七个模型（闭源 Claude Opus 4、GPT-5.4、Gemini 2.5 Pro；开源 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、WizardCoder-33B、CodeLlama-13B、Magicoder-S-CL-7B），将 Checkov 与 Trivy 扫描器接入 GitLab CI/CD 流水线，并比较两种提示策略在三个安全级别下的表现。
Result: WizardCoder-33B 达到 77.8% 的 Terraform 语法验证通过率但 Checkov 合规率为零；Claude Opus 4 在详细安全提示下达到 23.1% 的 Checkov 通过率和 92.5% 的 Trivy 通过率。
Conclusion: 作者强调语法有效性与安全合规性在很大程度上是正交属性，提示工程不足以保证安全；无论模型家族或提示策略如何，自动化多工具扫描仍是 LLM 辅助 IaC 生成的必要补充，所有工件已公开。

papers.title: On the Performance of Malware Detection Classifiers Using Hardware Performance Counters
papers.abstract_en: Malware detection using Hardware Performance Counters (HPC) has emerged as a promising solution to improve the security of computing systems as a complement to antivirus software. Hardware-based malware detectors (HMD) use Machine Learning (ML) classifiers to detect malicious application patterns. The inputs to ML classifiers are low-level performance features known as HPCs, hardware-related activity data collected from a processor at run time to profile the low-level microarchitectural behavior of an application. This paper proposes malware detection using HPCs and machine learning classifiers and highlights the effectiveness of malware detection at run-time. We use ensemble learning techniques to improve the performance of the hardware-based malware detectors, which reduces the number of necessary micro-architectural events. This improves the processor's efficiency by eliminating the need to run an application several times since a processor can measure only 2 to 8 events at a cycle. We use 18 machine-learning models along with two ensemble learning methods to evaluate the malware detection performance, creating a total of 144 different configurations. The experimental results show that the ensemble learning-based malware detection with 2 HPCs using the ensemble technique outperforms standard classifiers with 8 HPCs by up to 10%. It also matches the performance of standard ML-based detectors that use 16 HPCs while requiring only 4 HPCs, thereby enabling effective run-time malware detection.
papers.journal_ref: 2024 International Conference on Smart Applications, Communications and Networking (SmartNets), IEEE, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于硬件性能计数器 (Hardware Performance Counters, HPC) 与机器学习分类器的运行时恶意软件检测，重点比较集成学习与标准分类器的效果。作者使用 18 种机器学习模型和 2 种集成学习方法，共构成 144 种配置进行评测。摘要报告集成学习能以更少的 HPC 事件达到甚至超过标准分类器的检测性能，从而支持高效的运行时检测。
Motivation: 传统的杀毒软件需要补充运行时防护，而 HPC 能反映应用的底层微架构行为，可用于恶意软件检测。由于处理器每个周期只能测量 2 至 8 个事件，减少所需微架构事件数量有助于避免多次运行应用并提高处理器效率。
Method: 提出基于 HPC 特征和机器学习分类器的硬件级恶意软件检测框架，并采用集成学习 (ensemble learning) 技术来改善硬件恶意软件检测器 (HMD) 的性能，同时降低所需的微架构事件数量。实验评估了 18 种机器学习模型与 2 种集成学习方法，共 144 种配置。
Result: 实验结果显示，使用 2 个 HPC 的集成学习检测器比使用 8 个 HPC 的标准分类器性能最高提升 10%；仅使用 4 个 HPC 即可达到标准 ML 检测器使用 16 个 HPC 时的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为集成学习能够以更少的 HPC 事件实现有效的运行时恶意软件检测，同时提升处理器效率，减少多次运行应用的需求。

papers.title: Permission Denied: Policy-Graded Evaluation of Coding Agents in Hardened Environments
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents increasingly run inside organizations whose security controls (scoped credentials, restricted egress, read-only filesystems, non-root execution) constrain them like any other software. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate agents almost exclusively in permissive sandboxes, so it is unknown how performance changes when policy is enforced. In this work, we evaluate 12 coding agents on Terminal-Bench 2.1 across nested security policy levels derived from common real-world enterprise restrictions. Hardening is never free but far from uniform: under the strictest policy, success losses reach 18.3 points and cost inflation 167.3\%, and the two axes disagree; the model that best preserves success is also the one that loses the most efficiency, so model choice is policy-dependent. Beyond aggregate scores, we characterize how agents behave when policy blocks their actions and decompose the failures hardening induces: runs grind into timeouts or wrong solutions rather than stopping early, in a mix that differs by model. To ground comparisons, we verify task solvability under the strictest policy, separating model failures from tasks the policy forecloses. We release Boundary-Bench, an open-source hardening plugin enabling policy-constrained evaluation of coding agents on Terminal-Bench and compatible benchmarks.

papers.title: Vulnerabilities, Secrets and Misconfiguration in the Highest-Exposure Docker Hub Images
papers.abstract_en: Docker Hub is the registry underneath most container deployments, and a flaw in a widely reused base image is inherited by every image built on it. Prior ecosystem-scale measurements each rely on a single detector, leaving the tool-dependence of their counts unquantified, while the studies that do compare scanners use samples of tens to hundreds of images. We present ChimangoScan, a pipeline that crawls the Docker Hub namespace (12,716,568 repositories, 663.8 billion cumulative pulls), reconstructs the image layer graph (54.4 million IS_BASE_OF edges), ranks images by an exposure score that folds an image's own pull count and those of its entire downstream subtree into one scalar, and scans the 52,895 highest-exposure repositories (84.7% of all recorded pulls) with six independent scanners, yielding 170.4 million findings. Vulnerabilities are near-universal: 96.3% of images carry a known package vulnerability, 93.4% a critical one, and 98.0% at least one CIS Docker Benchmark misconfiguration. The posture a single tool reports is largely an artifact of that tool: of 80.7 million distinct (vulnerability, package) groups, 66.8% are flagged by only one of the three vulnerability scanners and just 2.7% by all three, and the best single scanner recovers 66.9%. TruffleHog flags a secret in 76.9% of images, yet hand-labeling 1,100 random detections finds 99.7% are non-credentials. A single zlib CVE reaches images carrying 47.3% of total corpus exposure and propagates to 1.13 million distinct downstream images, but exposure does not predict how vulnerable an image is. We release the pipeline and the 283 GB dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChimangoScan 管道，爬取 Docker Hub 全部 12,716,568 个仓库（累计 6638 亿次拉取），重建镜像层图（5440 万条 IS_BASE_OF 边），按融合自身与下游子树拉取数的暴露分数排序，并用六个独立扫描器扫描 52,895 个最高暴露仓库（覆盖 84.7% 的拉取），得到 1.704 亿条发现。摘要报告 96.3% 的镜像存在已知包漏洞、93.4% 存在严重漏洞、98.0% 至少有一个 CIS Docker Benchmark 错误配置；不同扫描器间一致性很低，TruffleHog 标记的秘密绝大多数并非真实凭证。
Motivation: 先前的 Docker Hub 生态级测量都依赖单一检测器，无法量化结果对工具选择的依赖；而对比扫描器的研究样本仅包含几十到几百个镜像，缺乏大规模、多工具的系统性测量。
Method: ChimangoScan 管道包含四个环节：爬取 Docker Hub 命名空间、重建镜像层图、按暴露分数（图像自身拉取数与整个下游子树的拉取数之和）对仓库排序，以及对最高暴露仓库并行运行六个独立扫描器。
Result: 漏洞近乎普遍：96.3% 的镜像携带已知包漏洞，93.4% 携带严重漏洞，98.0% 至少有一个 CIS Docker Benchmark 错误配置。80.7 百万个不同的 (漏洞, 包) 分组中，66.8% 仅被三个漏洞扫描器中的一个标记，只有 2.7% 被三者同时标记；最佳单一扫描器只能恢复 66.9%。TruffleHog 在 76.9% 的镜像中标记秘密，但人工标注 1100 个随机检测发现 99.7% 不是凭证。一个 zlib CVE 可达携带总语料 47.3% 暴露的镜像，并传播到 113 万个不同下游镜像，但暴露程度并不能预测镜像的漏洞严重性。
Conclusion: 作者公开了管道和 283 GB 数据集，并强调单个工具报告的镜像安全姿态在很大程度上是该工具的产物，且暴露分数不能作为漏洞严重性的预测指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sphere Retraction Normalizations
papers.abstract_en: Residual connections are the de facto mechanism for training deep neural networks stably. Geodesic Normalization (GeoNorm) recasts them on a Riemannian manifold, orthogonalizing each layer output against the current hidden state and applying the resulting update through the Riemannian exponential map. Every hidden state thus keeps a constant $\ell_{2}$-norm, confining the residual stream to a hypersphere. The exponential map, however, is only one member of a broad family of retraction maps. We show that on the hypersphere this entire family collapses to a single scalar design choice. What distinguishes one retraction from another is only how the magnitude of an update is converted into a rotation angle within the plane spanned by the hidden state and the update. This view places Euclidean residual connections and GeoNorm in one framework. Instantiating it with the metric projection retraction and the Cayley retraction yields Proj-SpheretNorm and Cay-SpheretNorm, which are exactly norm-preserving yet require only algebraic operations. Both prove to be members of a one-parameter family of angular retractions, $p$-SpheretNorm, whose rotation angle saturates rather than growing without bound. The two methods above are recovered exactly at $p = 1$ and $p = 2$, while the identity map and GeoNorm arise only as limits at either end. On nanoGPT, all three methods outperform existing lightweight deep connection schemes, and the best validation loss is attained at finite $p$, indicating that the exponential map is not the preferred retraction for spherical residual streams but merely one end of a spectrum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究球面残差流（residual stream）上的归一化方法。作者指出，在超球面上，整个 retraction 映射族可约化为单一标量设计选择，即把更新幅度转换为旋转角度的方式；由此将欧氏残差连接与 GeoNorm 统一到同一框架。用 metric projection 和 Cayley retraction 实例化，得到 Proj-SpheretNorm 与 Cay-SpheretNorm，二者严格保范且只需代数运算，并且都是单参数族 p-SpheretNorm 的成员；在 nanoGPT 上，这些方法优于现有轻量级深层连接方案。
Motivation: 残差连接是稳定训练深度网络的事实标准，GeoNorm 将其放到黎曼流形上并用指数映射（exponential map）保持隐藏状态范数不变；但指数映射只是 retraction 映射族的一员，现有工作未系统比较不同 retraction 对球面残差流的适用性。
Method: 作者证明在超球面上 retraction 族的差异仅体现在如何将更新幅度映射为旋转角度，从而把欧氏残差连接与 GeoNorm 纳入同一框架。他们用 metric projection retraction 与 Cayley retraction 实例化出 Proj-SpheretNorm 和 Cay-SpheretNorm，并推导出单参数族 p-SpheretNorm，其旋转角随参数饱和而非无界增长；identity 映射与 GeoNorm 分别对应参数两端的极限。
Result: 在 nanoGPT 上，Proj-SpheretNorm、Cay-SpheretNorm 及 p-SpheretNorm 均优于现有轻量级深层连接方案；最优验证损失出现在有限 p 处，而不是在对应指数映射的极限端。
Conclusion: 摘要表明指数映射并非球面残差流的首选 retraction，而只是整个谱系的一端；有限 p 的代数、严格保范的 retraction 能取得更好效果。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Single Canonical Prompts Underestimate LLM Safety's Surface-Form Sensitivity
papers.abstract_en: A benchmark score is a measurement instrument, yet most benchmarks read each item at a single canonical surface form. We ask whether that reading is faithful: when an item's intent is held fixed and only its meaning-preserving surface form varies, does the canonical-form score estimate model behavior well, and how much of any variation is decoding/judge noise rather than signal? We instantiate this in safety, a high-stakes setting with no gold label to average toward. To avoid prior confounds, we pre-author the reformulations (refusal-free, mostly non-LLM: machine back-translation and a Matrix-Language-Frame code-switch generator) so an identical surface form reaches every model, score all responses with one human-anchored, vendor-neutral judge (Claude, kappa = 0.86 vs. human on unsafe compliance, stable across languages, cross-checked by GPT-4o), and verify intent preservation. On 370 seeds x 5 surface forms x 5 models, no single transformation is uniformly most dangerous (6 of 20 per-transformation McNemar tests survive correction, most protective). Yet evaluating only the canonical prompt underestimates unsafe compliance: the union of unsafe outcomes across forms exceeds even the worst single form by 3.3-12.9 pp, with bootstrap 95% CIs excluding zero for all five models, and 5-13% of seeds safe on canonical are unsafe under some reformulation -- above a zero stochasticity floor (canonical resampled five times at temperature 0 gives 0/370 new exposures). The size of this gap is model-dependent (largest on Gemini 2.5 Pro). One form recovers only ~53% of a model's observed unsafe surface and about three reach 85% -- a redundancy characterization of this form set, not of a defined population. A benign control (XSTest) suggests the instability is bidirectional, though the benign and harmful pools are not item-matched. We release the dataset, code, and per-response labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个测量学问题：LLM 安全基准通常只在单一 canonical surface form 下评估每个测试项，这种读数是否忠实于模型行为。作者在不改变语义的前提下，通过机器回译和 Matrix-Language-Frame 语码转换生成多种改写形式，并用人工锚定、供应商中立的分判器（Claude，与人类在不安全合规判断上 kappa=0.86）评分。在 370 个种子 x 5 种形式 x 5 个模型上，仅用 canonical prompt 评估会低估不安全合规：各形式不安全结果的并集比最差单一形式高 3.3–12.9 个百分点，且 5–13% 的种子在 canonical 下安全、在某种改写下不安全。
Motivation: 基准分数是一种测量工具，但大多数基准对每个测试项只读取单一 canonical surface form。作者质疑这种读数的忠实性：当项意图固定、仅意义保持的表面形式变化时，canonical 分数能否估计模型真实行为，其中多少变化是解码或分判噪声而非信号。安全领域尤其高风险，因为不存在可平均的 gold label。
Method: 为避免过往混淆因素，作者预先编写改写（refusal-free，且大多非 LLM 生成：机器回译与 Matrix-Language-Frame 语码转换生成器），使完全相同的形式到达每个模型；所有响应由一个人类锚定、供应商中立的 judge（Claude，与人类在 unsafe compliance 上 kappa=0.86，跨语言稳定，并用 GPT-4o 交叉核对）评分，并验证意图保持。实验规模为 370 seeds x 5 surface forms x 5 models。
Result: 没有任何单一变换在所有情形下最危险（20 次 per-transformation McNemar 检验中只有 6 次在校正后显著，且多为保护性方向）。仅看 canonical prompt 会低估不安全合规：各形式不安全结果并集比最差单一形式高 3.3–12.9 pp，五种模型的 bootstrap 95% CI 均排除零；5–13% 的 canonical 安全种子在某种改写下不安全，而温度 0 下对 canonical 重采样五次仅产生 0/370 个新暴露。差距大小依赖模型（Gemini 2.5 Pro 最大）；单一形式只恢复约 53% 的已观测不安全表面，约三种形式达到 85%，这是该形式集合的冗余性刻画而非对总体的刻画。良性对照组 XSTest 提示不稳定性是双向的，但良性与有害池并未逐项匹配。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅用 canonical prompt 评估会低估模型的不安全合规，且这一差距是模型相关的；他们同时强调结果是对该形式集合的冗余性刻画，不能泛化为对整个表面形式总体的结论。论文开源了数据集、代码和逐响应标签。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 没有任何单一变换在所有情形下最危险（20 次 per-transformation McNemar 检验中只有 6 次在校正后显著，且多为保护性方向）。仅看 canonical prompt 会低估不安全合规：各形式不安全结果并集比最差单一形式高 3.3–12.9 pp，五种模型的 bootstrap 95% CI 均排除零；5–13% 的 canonical 安全种子在某种改写下不安全，而温度 0 下对 canonical 重采样五次仅产生 0/370 个新暴露。差距大小依赖模型（Gemini 2.5 Pro 最大）；单一形式只恢复约 53% 的已观测不安全表面，约三种形式达到 85%，这是该形式集合的冗余性刻画而非对总体的刻画。良性对照组 XSTest 提示不稳定性是双向的，但良性与有害池并未逐项匹配。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为仅用 canonical prompt 评估会低估模型的不安全合规，且这一差距是模型相关的；他们同时强调结果是对该形式集合的冗余性刻画，不能泛化为对整个表面形式总体的结论。论文开源了数据集、代码和逐响应标签。

papers.title: ZK-SR117: A Chunked Zero-Knowledge Attestation Design for Aggregated Fair-Lending Metrics, with a Control Mapping toward Full SR 11-7 Coverage
papers.abstract_en: Deploying ML models in regulated decision-making (credit underwriting, fraud detection, loan approval) requires demonstrating fairness and robustness to auditors without exposing model weights or customer data. We address this attestation problem for U.S. bank supervision under SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12 guidance. We present a chunked zero-knowledge circuit design that attests an aggregated fairness statistic - the demographic-parity gap - on committed, nonce-sampled batches of real 2022 HMDA mortgage data, and demonstrate it end-to-end: 32,768 rows, 32 independently verified zkSNARK proofs, aggregated attested gap within 0.0029 of the true held-out value, per-chunk proving under 4 seconds. We also demonstrate extensibility by attesting a second control on the identical architecture - expected calibration error at 10 bins - with all 32 chunks verified, per-chunk proving at about 14.7 seconds, and attested ECE within 0.00037 of the plaintext value on the same committed rows. We compare this design against two alternatives - a flat summation circuit, which overflows past a few thousand rows, and a tree-reduction circuit, numerically exact but intractable to compile - and find the chunked design is the only one that reached this scale. We discovered and root-caused a genuine data-quality failure (a sentinel-code outlier distorting circuit proving and the fairness statistic itself) and resolved it with a published preprocessing specification. We also propose a fuller mapping from SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12 control language to zero-knowledge statements (nine control elements spanning soundness, calibration, robustness, and drift), a nonce-based sampling protocol resisting bank-side cherry-picking, and a threat model for deployment, proposed as design work, not implemented results. Two controls, one model class, one task are demonstrated end-to-end; the rest is scoped and left as future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对美国银行监管（SR 11-7、OCC 2011-12）下机器学习公平性与稳健性证明问题，提出一种分块零知识证明（chunked zero-knowledge）电路设计，用 zkSNARK 证明聚合公平统计量（demographic-parity gap），并在2022年HMDA抵押贷款数据上端到端验证。32,768行数据被拆成32个区块分别证明，聚合后的证明差距与真实留出值相差0.0029，每块证明低于4秒；同一架构还扩展证明了期望校准误差（ECE），32块全部验证，每块约14.7秒，ECE差值为0.00037。作者将设计与平面求和电路和树归约电路对比，指出只有分块设计能达到该规模，并发现和修复了哨兵码异常值造成的真实数据质量问题。
Motivation: 在信用承销、欺诈检测、贷款审批等受监管决策中部署ML模型，需要向审计方证明公平性和稳健性，但又不能暴露模型权重或客户数据。论文针对美国银行监管SR 11-7/OCC 2011-12指引下的这一证明（attestation）问题进行解决。
Method: 提出一个分块零知识电路设计，在承诺的、nonce抽样的批数据上证明聚合公平统计量（demographic-parity gap），并用32,768行2022 HMDA数据演示；另以同一架构证明第二个控制量（10桶期望校准误差）。设计还包括nonce抽样协议防银行端挑数据、威胁模型，以及将SR 11-7/OCC 2011-12控制语言映射为零知识断言的九要素框架。
Result: 摘要报告：32个zkSNARK证明独立验证，聚合证明差距在真实留出值0.0029以内，每块证明低于4秒；ECE控制量全部32块验证通过，每块约14.7秒，证明ECE与明文值相差0.00037。对比下，平面求和电路在几千行后就溢出，树归约电路数值精确但无法编译，只有分块设计达到该规模。
Conclusion: 作者总结两个控制量、一个模型类别、一个任务已端到端演示，其余控制元素只是提出设计范围并留作未来工作；同时公开发布了针对数据质量问题的预处理规范。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: CT-HEG: A Bidirectional, Timestamp-Attributed Event Graph for ICU In-Hospital Mortality Prediction - An Architectural Ablation Study
papers.abstract_en: Accurate ICU mortality prediction requires modeling irregular clinical observations across heterogeneous entity types. Existing sequence models handle irregular sampling but ignore typed relational structure; existing graph models assume fixed-interval inputs. We introduce the Continuous-Time Heterogeneous EHR Graph (CT-HEG) schema and evaluate which architectural choices drive predictive performance. CT-HEG encodes each ICU stay as a typed, timestamped graph with three node types (visit, vital, lab_event) and 2D edge attributes (t_hours/48, value_norm) encoding timing and value without imputation. We instantiate CT-HEG as CHIRP-Net, a four-layer heterogeneous GATv2Conv network, evaluated on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (31,142 ICU stays, LOS>=48h, 13.4% mortality) with five seeds and bootstrapped confidence intervals, against logistic regression, mTAND, a Transformer, and GRU-D, plus an ablation study. CHIRP-Net achieved 5-seed mean AUROC 0.8449+/-0.0071 (AUPRC 0.4958+/-0.0209); the ensemble achieved AUROC 0.8618 (95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745). Removing reverse edges disconnected observation nodes from the visit readout, cutting AUROC by 0.1968+/-0.0073. Time-attentive edge features contributed 0.0247+/-0.0093 AUROC. Collapsing heterogeneous edge types into one relation (7x fewer parameters) outperformed the full model on all seeds. Post-calibration ECE was 0.0307. Temporal and demographic subgroup analyses were explored but not reported here, pending follow-up work. Bidirectional connectivity was necessary for the model to use its inputs at all, and CT-HEG was reasonably well calibrated after validation-fitted temperature scaling. These results support CT-HEG for irregular EHR data, while external validation, a pre-specified temporal evaluation, and a demographic fairness audit remain necessary before any claim of robustness. Code: https://github.com/nasiruddinstudents-ctrl/chirp-net-mimic-iv.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续时间异质 EHR 图 (CT-HEG) 模式，将每次 ICU 住院编码为带类型与时间戳的图，节点分为 visit、vital、lab_event 三类，边属性用 (t_hours/48, value_norm) 二维向量表达时序与数值，无需插补。作者以四层异质 GATv2Conv 网络 CHIRP-Net 实例化，在 MIMIC-IV v3.1 上进行 5 个种子的实验与消融研究，5 种子平均 AUROC 为 0.8449±0.0071，集成达到 AUROC 0.8618；消融显示双向连接是模型能利用输入的必要条件，而去掉反向边使 AUROC 下降 0.1968。
Motivation: 现有序列模型能够处理不规则采样但忽略了带类型的关联结构，而现有图模型假定固定间隔输入；ICU 死亡预测需要同时对异质实体类型的不规则临床观测进行建模。
Method: 提出 CT-HEG schema，将 ICU stay 表示为带类型、带时间戳的图，包含三种节点和携带时间与数值信息的二维边属性，避免缺失值插补；用四层异质 GATv2Conv 网络 CHIRP-Net 进行实例化，并设计消融研究来检验哪些架构选择驱动性能。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV v3.1（31,142 次 ICU 住院，LOS≥48h，死亡率 13.4%）上，CHIRP-Net 的 5 种子平均 AUROC 为 0.8449±0.0071，AUPRC 为 0.4958±0.0209，集成 AUROC 为 0.8618（95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745）。消融显示移除反向边使 AUROC 下降 0.1968±0.0073，时间注意力边特征贡献 0.0247±0.0093 AUROC，而将异质边类型折叠为单一关系（参数减少 7 倍）在所有种子上都优于完整模型；校准后 ECE 为 0.0307。
Conclusion: 作者认为双向连接性是模型能使用输入的必要条件，CT-HEG 在校准上表现合理；但在声称鲁棒性之前，仍需外部验证、预先指定的时间评估和人口统计学公平性审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Verifier-Guided Model Discovery for Physical Dynamical Systems with Pretrained Symbolic Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Reliable forecasting of nonlinear physical systems underpins scientific discovery and engineering decision-making. Yet high-fidelity simulations are prohibitively costly, and machine-learning surrogates can be opaque and encode assumptions about system dynamics, limiting generalizability. Pretrained transformers mapping synthetic ODE trajectories to equations offer interpretable alternatives, promising transfer without system-specific equation knowledge. Transferring them reliably to high-dimensional physical data, however, remains an open challenge. We develop a verifier-guided (VG) workflow around ODEFormer as a symbolic backbone, using dynamical and physical-admissibility criteria to select from a multi-trajectory candidate equation pool, enabling transfer. On canonical Van der Pol oscillators, VG outperforms the original ODEFormer workflow across held-out initial conditions. We then address vortex shedding, a phenomenon occurring in atmospheric and plasma systems of societal relevance, through coordinate reduction and symbolic discovery at fixed and varying Reynolds numbers. VG discovers fixed-parameter reduced-order equations that recover the fundamental shedding oscillator and higher harmonics without a wake-specific candidate library or prescribed Navier-Stokes structure, while the cross-parameter model generalizes to withheld regimes. Reconstruction fidelity alone did not determine symbolic discoverability, highlighting the importance of compatibility between latent dynamics and the backbone's pretraining distribution. This work establishes a verifier-guided neural-to-symbolic methodology for interpretable and physically auditable forecasting in the natural sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个验证器引导（verifier-guided, VG）工作流，以预训练符号 Transformer（ODEFormer 为符号骨干）为基础，将合成 ODE 轨迹到方程的映射迁移到高维物理数据。工作流利用动力学与物理可容许性准则从多轨迹候选方程池中筛选方程。在 Van der Pol 振荡器上，VG 在未见初始条件下优于原始 ODEFormer 工作流；随后用于固定与变化雷诺数下的涡脱落（vortex shedding）问题，通过坐标约简和符号发现恢复基本振荡器与高次谐波，交叉参数模型可泛化到未见的雷诺数区间。
Motivation: 高保真物理模拟成本过高，机器学习替代模型不透明且隐含系统动力学假设、泛化性受限；预训练符号 Transformer 提供可解释的替代路径，但将其可靠迁移到高维物理数据仍是开放挑战。
Method: 围绕 ODEFormer 符号骨干构建 verifier-guided 工作流，使用动力学和物理可容许性准则从多轨迹候选方程池中进行选择；对涡脱落问题采用坐标约简（coordinate reduction）后再做符号发现，覆盖固定与变化雷诺数两种设定。
Result: 在 Van der Pol 振荡器上，VG 在保留的初始条件下优于原始 ODEFormer 工作流；在涡脱落中发现固定参数降阶方程，无需尾流专用候选库或预设 Navier-Stokes 结构即可恢复基本脱落振荡器和高次谐波，交叉参数模型可泛化到未见的雷诺数区间。摘要还指出，仅凭重构保真度并不能决定符号可发现性。
Conclusion: 作者将这项工作定位为一种验证器引导的神经到符号（neural-to-symbolic）方法论，用于自然科学中可解释且可物理审计的预测；同时强调潜在动力学与骨干预训练分布之间的兼容性对符号发现的重要性。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: AI Alignment and Fiduciary Obligation
papers.abstract_en: Advanced AI assistants engage users in extended interactions across a widening range of roles, including advice, decision support, collaboration, learning, emotional support, and companionship among others. Current alignment efforts consider what alignment criteria should govern these relationships, drawing on moral traditions developed for human relationships such as bioethics, virtue ethics, care ethics, and relationship science. This paper considers AI alignment criteria in the user-AI-developer triad, since every user-AI interaction is mediated by a developer who exercises discretionary control over a system's behaviour, memory, and engagement parameters. Drawing on business ethics and legal scholarship, I argue that fiduciary theory applies to extended AI assistant deployment. On this basis, the four canonical fiduciary duties of loyalty, care, good faith, and candour can generate alignment criteria for the developer-user relationship. I map four user-side risks of extended AI assistant deployment to the four duties and specify institutional measures that follow from discharging each duty. The discussion complements existing approaches by grounding alignment criteria in obligations the developer owes the user, rather than in values the user-AI interaction should promote, and by showing that those obligations hold independently of any \textit{de facto} harm to users.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 table. Accepted at the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从法律与商业伦理视角提出，在用户–AI–开发者三方关系中，信义理论（fiduciary theory）适用于长期部署的 AI 助手。作者主张开发者对用户负有忠诚、谨慎、诚信与坦诚四项信义义务，并由此推导 AI 对齐标准；文章将该四项义务映射到长期 AI 助手部署中的四类用户侧风险，并给出相应的制度性措施。该文已被 2026 年 AAAI/ACM AIES 会议接收。
Motivation: 现有对齐研究主要借鉴面向人类关系的道德传统（如生命伦理、关怀伦理、关系科学）来设定对齐标准，但未充分处理开发者对系统行为、记忆和参与参数拥有自由裁量控制这一中介角色。本文目标是为开发者–用户关系提供义务层面的对齐基础。
Method: 采用基于商业伦理与法律学术文献的理论论证。提出用户–AI–开发者三方结构，论证信义义务适用于长期 AI 助手部署，并将忠诚（loyalty）、谨慎（care）、诚信（good faith）与坦诚（candour）四项经典信义义务转化为对齐标准，同时说明每项义务对应的制度性措施。
Result: 本文没有给出经验结果；其核心贡献是概念性论证：四项信义义务能够为开发者–用户关系生成对齐标准，并映射到四类用户侧风险及相应的制度措施。
Conclusion: 该讨论将对齐标准植根于开发者对用户负有的义务，而非用户–AI 互动应当促进的价值；且这些义务独立于用户事实上是否受到损害而成立。这为已有对齐方法提供了补充视角，范围限于理论论证，不涉及实证验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Your Agentic LLMs Secretly Encode Latent Signals of Indirect Prompt-Injection Exposure
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLMs are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, e.g., malicious side-tasks hidden in external tool results. While many efforts have sought to address the threats, little is known about the internals of agentic LLMs when they are exposed to IPI attacks, a condition which we call IPI exposure. In this paper, we study this problem in depth from three aspects. (1) Probing: Across six models, including the giant 753B-parameter GLM-5.2, simple linear probes trained on pre-generation hidden states can predict LLMs' IPI exposure. These probes achieve 90%+ AUROC on unseen attacks, agent instructions, and task suites; they exhibit high robustness under adaptive attacks and in cross-lingual settings. (2) Defense: Our CoT measurement reveals a recognition--action gap: though models encode such signals, they often fail to translate them into safe actions. We then introduce AGRI, a probe-gated reasoning-based defense that prepends anti-injection reasoning on demand. On difficult AgentDojo settings, AGRI substantially reduces attack success rate, e.g., from 34.6% to 0% on Qwen3.5-27B, while largely maintaining clean-task utility. (3) Explanation: We introduce an analysis framework that identifies natural-language explanations most strongly correlated with probe-captured signals. The resulting profiles differ across models: latent signals can align with either direct IPI-exposure claims or indirect operational cues. Code is available: https://github.com/jianshuod/IPI-exposure-signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 agentic LLM 在间接提示注入 (indirect prompt injection, IPI) 暴露时的内部表征，从探测、防御、解释三个方面展开。作者在包括 753B 参数 GLM-5.2 在内的六个模型上训练线性探针，证明预生成隐藏状态能高精度预测 IPI 暴露；并据此提出探针门控防御 AGRI，以及一个用于识别相关自然语言解释的分析框架。
Motivation: Agentic LLM 容易遭受间接提示注入攻击，例如隐藏在外部工具结果中的恶意副作用任务；现有工作多关注防御，但对模型暴露于 IPI 时内部发生了什么（即 IPI exposure）知之甚少。
Method: 方法包含三部分：探测阶段在预生成隐藏状态上训练简单线性探针预测 IPI 暴露；防御阶段提出 AGRI，一种探针门控 (probe-gated) 的基于推理的防御，按需前置反注入推理 (anti-injection reasoning)；解释阶段引入分析框架，找出与探针捕获信号最相关的自然语言解释。
Result: 线性探针在未见过的攻击、智能体指令和任务套件上达到 90%+ AUROC，并在自适应攻击和跨语言设置下表现稳健；在困难的 AgentDojo 设置中，AGRI 将 Qwen3.5-27B 的攻击成功率从 34.6% 降至 0%，同时基本保持干净任务的效用。
Conclusion: 作者指出模型虽编码了 IPI 暴露信号，但存在识别-行动差距 (recognition-action gap)，即模型常常未能将这些信号转化为安全行动；AGRI 通过探针门控推理弥合这一差距，且不同模型的潜在信号可能对齐直接的 IPI 暴露声明或间接操作线索。
Relevance: 5

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向多租户云平台的安全 AI 水印框架，以保护云上 AI 服务中的知识产权 (IP)。其方案包括在可信方之间分配密钥并基于密钥认证，同时结合主动与被动安全告警系统：主动措施通过域限制和受限访问在攻击前进行防护，被动措施则利用水印 (watermarking) 和生物识别 (biometric identification) 来捕获联邦学习与远程学习中数据/模型交换时的设备特定 IP 泄漏。
Motivation: 多租户环境下云 AI 服务中的数据交易与交换存在安全泄漏风险，需要为知识产权提供主动和被动的双重保护机制。
Method: 提出一种安全 AI 水印系统，在可信方之间进行密钥分配并采用基于密钥的认证；系统包含主动安全告警（基于域限制与受限访问规则）和被动安全告警（通过水印和生物识别识别设备特定的 IP 泄漏）两类算法。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的量化实验结果或基准数据，仅定性描述了该系统能够在攻击发生前通过主动措施进行预防。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将主动限制措施与被动的基于水印和生物识别的泄漏检测相结合，可以增强联邦与远程学习场景下多租户云平台的 IP 防护能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Prescribed-Basis Coefficient-to-Coefficient Neural Operator for Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Operator learning provides a data-driven approach to approximating solution operators of partial differential equations, but its effectiveness depends strongly on how input and output functions are represented. Point-value representations can make the trainable map mesh-dependent and high-dimensional; snapshot-based POD/PCA reductions require aligned data and basis construction, while learned representations introduce additional trainable encoders, decoders, or neural bases. We propose the Fixed-Basis Coefficient-to-Coefficient Network (FB-C2CNet), which learns PDE solution maps in fixed, data-independent approximation spaces using prescribed bases as function encoders and decoders. Input observations are encoded by regularized least-squares projection onto bases such as finite element, random-feature, or radial-basis-function bases. A neural network maps the resulting input coefficients to output coefficients, and the fixed decoder reconstructs the solution at arbitrary target locations. This separation of basis selection from network training avoids neural basis learning and snapshot-based basis extraction, reduces the dimension of the trainable map, and lowers training cost. With suitable prescribed bases, FB-C2CNet also accommodates scattered, non-aligned, and sample-dependent observations. We analyze the stability--bias trade-off of regularized coefficient encoding and the intrinsic projection error determined by the output space. Experiments on elliptic, nonlinear time-dependent, weak-solution, high-dimensional, and inverse Stokes boundary-recovery problems demonstrate competitive accuracy with reduced trainable dimension and training cost, including for high-resolution and irregularly sampled data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fixed-Basis Coefficient-to-Coefficient Network (FB-C2CNet)，一种在固定、与数据无关的逼近空间中学习 PDE 解算子的方法。输入函数通过正则化最小二乘投影编码到有限元、随机特征或径向基函数等预设基上，神经网络把输入系数映射为输出系数，固定解码器在任意目标位置重构解。该方法避免了神经基学习与基于快照的 POD/PCA 基提取，降低可训练映射维度和训练成本。实验覆盖椭圆、非线性时间依赖、弱解、高维和逆 Stokes 边界恢复问题，报告了有竞争力的精度与更低的训练开销。
Motivation: 算子学习的有效性强烈依赖输入输出函数的表示方式：点值表示使可训练映射依赖网格且维数高，快照式 POD/PCA 约简需要对齐数据和基构造，学习到的表示则引入额外编码器、解码器或神经基。
Method: 提出 FB-C2CNet，使用预设基作为函数编码器与解码器；输入观测通过正则化最小二乘投影编码到有限元、随机特征或径向基函数等基上，再用神经网络将输入系数映射到输出系数，最后由固定解码器在任意目标位置重构解。基选择与网络训练分离，且适用于散乱、非对齐、随样本变化的观测。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但报告了在椭圆、非线性时间依赖、弱解、高维以及逆 Stokes 边界恢复等任务上的实验，表明在可训练维度和训练成本降低的同时保持有竞争力的精度，并能处理高分辨率和非规则采样数据。
Conclusion: 作者分析了正则化系数编码的稳定性-偏差权衡以及由输出空间决定的固有投影误差，强调将基选择与网络训练分离可以在避免神经基和快照基的条件下提高算子学习的效率。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: HyperAgent: Planning and Acting over Tool-Schema Hypergraphs for Tool-Use LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools to complete complex real-world tasks. However, reliable tool-use planning remains challenging due to the limitations of implicit reasoning and the evolving nature of real-world execution environments. Existing tool-use agents typically rely on LLMs to infer tool compositions from textual descriptions, which can lead to inefficient exploration and unreliable execution in complex tasks. To address these challenges, we model tool relations at the schema level and construct a directed Tool--Schema Hypergraph, in which tools are represented as hyperedges from their required input-schema nodes to their output-schema nodes. Furthermore, we propose HyperAgent, a Tool--Schema Hypergraph-guided framework for dynamic planning and execution. Given a task, HyperAgent first extracts a task-relevant tool context graph and uses it to guide the construction of a schema-aware Task DAG. During execution, HyperAgent dynamically realizes each subtask by constructing a state-conditioned tool support graph through deficit-oriented expansion, which identifies unresolved requirements and retrieves supporting producer tools according to the current agent state. Experiments on AppWorld demonstrate that HyperAgent improves task completion performance while reducing redundant API calls, LLM interactions, and token consumption compared with existing agent baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperAgent，一个基于 Tool-Schema Hypergraph 的 LLM 工具使用智能体动态规划与执行框架。作者在模式层（schema level）将工具建模为从所需输入模式节点指向输出模式节点的超边，并利用有向超图引导任务分解与执行。在 AppWorld 实验上，HyperAgent 相比现有智能体基线提升了任务完成表现，同时减少了冗余 API 调用、LLM 交互次数和 token 消耗。
Motivation: 现有工具使用智能体通常依赖 LLM 从文本描述中推断工具组合，在复杂任务中会导致低效探索和不可靠执行；隐式推理的局限以及真实执行环境的动态变化使可靠的工具使用规划仍具挑战。
Method: 构建有向 Tool-Schema Hypergraph，将工具表示为输入模式节点到输出模式节点的超边；HyperAgent 先为给定任务提取任务相关的工具上下文图，并据此构造 schema-aware 的 Task DAG；执行阶段通过 deficit-oriented expansion 构造基于当前状态的条件化工具支持图，识别未满足的需求并检索相应的生产者工具。
Result: 在 AppWorld 基准上，HyperAgent 较现有智能体基线提升了任务完成性能，并同时降低了冗余 API 调用、LLM 交互次数与 token 消耗。
Conclusion: 作者认为在模式层显式建模工具关系并动态规划执行，可以缓解隐式推理带来的探索与执行问题，从而提升工具使用智能体的效率与可靠性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有工具使用智能体通常依赖 LLM 从文本描述中推断工具组合，在复杂任务中会导致低效探索和不可靠执行；隐式推理的局限以及真实执行环境的动态变化使可靠的工具使用规划仍具挑战。
summary_sections.method: 构建有向 Tool-Schema Hypergraph，将工具表示为输入模式节点到输出模式节点的超边；HyperAgent 先为给定任务提取任务相关的工具上下文图，并据此构造 schema-aware 的 Task DAG；执行阶段通过 deficit-oriented expansion 构造基于当前状态的条件化工具支持图，识别未满足的需求并检索相应的生产者工具。
summary_sections.result: 在 AppWorld 基准上，HyperAgent 较现有智能体基线提升了任务完成性能，并同时降低了冗余 API 调用、LLM 交互次数与 token 消耗。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在模式层显式建模工具关系并动态规划执行，可以缓解隐式推理带来的探索与执行问题，从而提升工具使用智能体的效率与可靠性。

papers.title: Cross-Anesthetic ECoG State Decoding Fails at the Decision Threshold, Not the Representation
papers.abstract_en: Decoders of anesthetic state from cortical activity fail across drug classes, most notoriously ketamine, but reported accuracy cannot say whether the neural representation or only the decision threshold has failed; we separate the two in a controlled preparation with ground-truth labels. We decoded awake versus anesthetized from mouse electrocorticography (the 250-Hz-bandlimited local field potential, sampled at 1875 Hz) under leave-one-anesthetic-out evaluation across five mechanistically distinct anesthetics (isoflurane, dexmedetomidine, ketamine, propofol, and midazolam), comparing a spatially blind band-power decoder, covariance/Riemannian representations, and Riemannian domain adaptation, with all statistics at the session level and mouse-level cluster bootstrapping for the ketamine fold. The representation transfers: band-power ranks awake versus anesthetized at a session AUROC of at least 0.96 on every held-out drug, ketamine included (0.980, cluster confidence interval 0.821 to 1.000). The failure is confined to the threshold: across three representations the ketamine ranking is near-invariant while its balanced accuracy swings from chance to high, and a permutation test is significant for ranking (p = 0.0025) but not for fixed-threshold accuracy (p = 0.3795). Riemannian domain adaptation is net-negative. A causal, label-free threshold anchored to the subject's own pre-induction baseline fixes ketamine (balanced accuracy 0.50 to 0.85) and dominates domain adaptation. Because the ketamine test sessions come from three mice that also contribute training drugs, this is within-subject cross-drug transfer; we do not claim population-level transfer across subjects. In cross-drug state decoding the actionable failure is calibration, not representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过带真值标签的可控实验，区分麻醉状态解码跨药物失败究竟是神经表示问题还是仅决策阈值问题。作者在小鼠皮层脑电图（ECoG）上对五种机制不同的麻醉药做留一药交叉评估，发现带限功率特征、协方差/Riemannian 表示等都能在留出药物上保持高 AUROC，失败被定位到固定决策阈值。作者进一步提出基于被试自身诱导前基线的无标签阈值校准，显著改善氯胺酮折叠的平衡准确率。
Motivation: 现有的麻醉状态解码器在跨药物类别（尤其是氯胺酮）时表现不佳，但常用准确率指标无法判断失败发生在神经表征层面还是决策阈值层面，这限制了跨药物解码的可迁移性诊断。
Method: 使用 250 Hz 带限局部场电位（1875 Hz 采样）的小鼠 ECoG，在留一麻醉药交叉评估下比较空间盲带功率解码器、协方差/Riemannian 表示以及 Riemannian 域适应，并采用置换检验区分排序能力与固定阈值准确率；最后提出一种无标签的、锚定到被试自身诱导前基线的因果阈值。
Result: 表示可跨药物迁移：在每个留出药物上会话级 AUROC 至少 0.96，氯胺酮为 0.980（簇置信区间 0.821–1.000）；三种表示下氯胺酮的排序能力接近不变，而平衡准确率从随机到较高摆动；排序的置换检验显著（p=0.0025），固定阈值准确率不显著（p=0.3795）。Riemannian 域适应净效果为负；所提基线锚定阈值将氯胺酮平衡准确率从 0.50 提升至 0.85。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨药物状态解码中可操作的失败点是校准而非表示，并明确指出氯胺酮测试会话来自同时贡献训练药物的三只小鼠，属于受试者内跨药物迁移，不声称跨受试者的群体水平迁移。

papers.title: Verified Tool Calls Improve LLM Agent Reliability Under Non-Atomic Failures
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external tools to perform multistage tasks. Existing agent frameworks typically assume that tool calls are atomic and return binary success or failure signals. However, real-world systems exhibit non-atomic behaviors such as timeouts after dispatch, delayed visibility, and partial state updates. These mismatches lead to reliability issues including duplicate actions, task success, and unnecessary tool executions. A lightweight, verification-aware tool wrapper is introduced that augments tool calls with postcondition verification, verify-before-retry logic, and idempotency keys. The approach is evaluated in a controlled simulated environment with injected non-atomic failures across multiple task templates. The results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces duplicate actions, while maintaining comparable task success rates. Overall, the findings suggest that strengthening tool interaction semantics is a promising direction for improving LLM agent reliability without requiring modifications to the underlying language model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 代理使用外部工具执行多阶段任务时，工具调用被假定为原子操作、只返回二元成功/失败信号的问题，提出一种轻量级、可感知验证的工具包装器 (verification-aware tool wrapper)，为工具调用增加后置条件验证、先验证再重试 (verify-before-retry) 逻辑和幂等键 (idempotency keys)。论文在受控模拟环境中注入非原子故障进行评估，结果显示该方法能显著减少重复动作，同时保持相近的任务成功率，且无需修改底层语言模型。
Motivation: 现实系统中的工具调用常呈现非原子行为，如派发后超时 (timeouts after dispatch)、延迟可见性和部分状态更新；现有代理框架假设工具调用是原子的并返回二元成功/失败信号，导致重复动作、任务虚假成功和不必要的工具执行等可靠性问题。
Method: 提出一个轻量级的验证感知工具包装器，通过后置条件验证、先验证再重试 (verify-before-retry) 逻辑和幂等键 (idempotency keys) 增强工具调用语义，无需修改底层 LLM。
Result: 在受控模拟环境中针对多个任务模板注入非原子故障进行评估，结果表明该方法显著减少重复动作，同时保持与基线相当的任务成功率。
Conclusion: 摘要认为加强工具交互语义是提升 LLM 代理可靠性的有前途方向，且该方法不要求修改底层语言模型；评估局限于受控模拟环境，未涉及真实生产系统。

papers.title: CUADebug: Diagnosing and Repairing Computer-Use Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) operate real desktop and web interfaces through screenshots, mouse and keyboard actions, and stateful UI feedback, yet their failures remain difficult to diagnose and repair. Unlike text-only agents, CUA failures arise from coupled visual perception, spatial grounding, low-level interaction, task reasoning, and environment dynamics, making debugging a distinctive multimodal causal localization problem. We introduce CUADebug, a framework for diagnosing and repairing CUA failures. CUADebug includes a CUA-specific error taxonomy, CUAErrorBench, a human-annotated OSWorld failure benchmark, and CUADebugger, a tool-augmented debugger. Instead of prompting over the full trajectory once, CUADebugger actively inspects suspicious steps with paired before/after screenshots and action traces, then submits a structured diagnosis containing the root-cause step, error type, grounded evidence, and corrective strategy for re-execution. Human annotations over 204 failed trajectories show that task reasoning and control is the largest failure family (110/204), followed by perception (36), grounding/interaction (25), external/system (13), and an others category of 20 OSWorld infeasible-task cases. On the main Claude-agent split, CUADebugger improves joint subtype-and-step diagnosis from 11.2% to 19.6% with Gemini 2.5 Pro and improves consistently across debugger backbones. In single re-execution package evaluation, RCA-based conditions achieve higher task completion than history-only continuation (28.47% with machine RCA and 29.90% with our method, versus 13.89%); in continual re-execution, our method improves success from 12.2% to 25.86%, while human-oracle guidance reaches 29.21%. These results show that CUA root-cause diagnosis can provide actionable repair signals rather than merely post-hoc explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CUADebug，一个用于诊断和修复计算机使用智能体 (Computer-Use Agent, CUA) 失败的框架，包含 CUA 专用的错误分类法、人工标注的 OSWorld 失败基准 CUAErrorBench，以及工具增强的调试器 CUADebugger。调试器不一次性提示完整轨迹，而是用前后截图和动作轨迹主动检查可疑步骤，输出包含根因步骤、错误类型、证据和纠正策略的结构化诊断。在 204 条失败轨迹上验证，任务推理与控制是最大失败类别，且根因诊断能显著提升重新执行的成功率。
Motivation: CUA 失败源于视觉感知、空间定位、低层交互、任务推理和环境动态的耦合，诊断需要多模态因果定位，而现有文本智能体调试方法难以应对这种复杂失败场景。
Method: CUADebug 包括三个部分：CUA 特定错误分类法、CUAErrorBench（204 条人工标注的 OSWorld 失败轨迹），以及 CUADebugger——一种通过前后截图和动作轨迹主动检查可疑步骤、生成结构化诊断并驱动重新执行的工具增强调试器。
Result: 人工标注显示任务推理与控制是最大家族（110/204），其次为感知（36）、定位/交互（25）、外部/系统（13）和 20 个 OSWorld 不可行任务；在 Claude-agent 主 split 上，CUADebugger 将联合子类型与步骤诊断从 11.2% 提升到 19.6%（Gemini 2.5 Pro），并跨后端一致提升。单次重执行中基于 RCA 的条件优于仅历史延续（28.47% 和 29.90% 对 13.89%）；持续重执行中成功率从 12.2% 提升至 25.86%，人类 oracle 为 29.21%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CUA 根因诊断可以提供可操作的修复信号，而非仅仅事后解释。

papers.title: MDArena: Evaluating Coding Agents on Realistic Molecular Dynamics Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Accelerating scientific discovery is among the most consequential applications of AI, and computational biomolecular simulation stands out as a particularly promising target within this broader effort. Coding agents promise to automate significant portions of this workflow, yet their reliability on realistic molecular dynamics (MD) tasks remains poorly characterized. To address this issue, we introduce MDArena, a benchmark of 50 containerized tasks drawn from active biomolecular simulation projects, spanning 29 molecular systems and 14 broad research protocols, including trajectory analysis, complex system preparation, free-energy protocols, and enhanced sampling. We evaluate six model/harness configurations spanning Codex and OpenCode. Among the evaluated configurations, Codex GPT-5.5 at extra-high reasoning effort performs best, reaching 24/50 Strict-Pass@1 successes (48%), followed by Codex GPT-5.5 Medium with 21/50, and OpenCode Gemini Flash 3.5 with 20/50. Average correctness and process rewards are substantially higher than strict success rates across all configurations, indicating that agents frequently make meaningful partial progress but fail on the fine-grained details required for reproducible scientific workflows. Hard tasks remain largely unsolved, particularly membrane-protein system preparation and alchemical free-energy setup, both unsolved or near-unsolved by every evaluated configuration. MDArena thus exposes a substantial gap between the usefulness of coding agents as supervised assistants and their reliability as autonomous MD researchers, while providing a reproducible and extensible platform for tracking progress toward closing it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MDArena，一个包含 50 个容器化任务的基准，任务来自活跃的生物分子模拟项目，覆盖 29 个分子系统和 14 类研究协议，包括轨迹分析、复杂体系准备、自由能协议和增强采样。作者在 Codex 与 OpenCode 上评估了六种模型/工具链配置，其中 Codex GPT-5.5（extra-high 推理强度）表现最佳，Strict-Pass@1 达到 24/50（48%）。平均正确率和过程奖励显著高于严格通过率，说明智能体常能取得有意义的局部进展，但在可复现科学工作流所需的细粒度细节上失败；膜蛋白体系制备与炼金自由能设置等硬任务基本未被解决。
Motivation: 计算生物分子模拟是 AI 加速科学发现的重要目标，编码智能体有望自动化该工作流的大部分，但其在真实分子动力学（MD）任务上的可靠性缺乏系统刻画，现有信息不足以判断智能体距离自主 MD 研究者还有多远。
Method: 引入 MDArena 基准：50 个容器化任务，源自活跃的生物分子模拟项目，覆盖 29 个分子系统和 14 类研究协议（轨迹分析、复杂体系准备、自由能协议、增强采样等），并对跨越 Codex 与 OpenCode 的六种模型/工具链配置进行评估。
Result: 最优配置 Codex GPT-5.5（extra-high 推理强度）达到 24/50（48%）Strict-Pass@1，其次是 Codex GPT-5.5 Medium（21/50）和 OpenCode Gemini Flash 3.5（20/50）。所有配置的平均正确率和过程奖励均显著高于严格通过率；膜蛋白体系制备与炼金自由能设置等硬任务对每种配置都未解决或接近未解决。
Conclusion: MDArena 揭示编码智能体作为监督助手与作为自主 MD 研究者之间的可靠性差距，并提供一个可复现、可扩展的平台来追踪该差距的收窄。摘要强调，智能体失败点集中在可复现科学工作流所必需的细粒度细节上。

papers.title: IR2Solve: Structured Intermediate Representations for Cost-Efficient Optimization Autoformulation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language optimization problems into solver-ready formulations, but direct code generation is brittle: schema, indexing, and semantic errors can cause compilation failures, infeasible models, or incorrect objectives, while iterative repair, search, and multi-agent workflows increase inference cost. We present IR2Solve, an intermediate-representation-first autoformulation pipeline that uses a single semantic LLM call to produce a schema-constrained ModelIR, followed by two deterministic stages: verification and IR-to-solver compilation. ModelIR explicitly represents sets, parameters, variables, objectives, and constraints using restricted Python-like expression strings. A concrete scalar-constraint convention represents finite per-index constraint families as individual entries, reducing free-index and implicit-quantification errors while simplifying downstream verification and compilation. Across six cleaned optimization benchmarks, IR2Solve achieves strong objective correctness and remains competitive with recent optimization-modeling systems. A controlled ablation on 153 IndustryOR and ComplexLP instances shows sequential gains from the structured IR interface, the scalar-constraint instruction, and deterministic verification. On a matched ten-instance cost panel, IR2Solve uses one semantic call per instance, whereas Chain-of-Experts and SAC-Opt use 8 and 39 calls per instance and consume 3.3 and 22.9 times the token volume of IR2Solve, respectively. These results show that structured intermediate representations, combined with deterministic post-generation processing, provide a practical accuracy-cost trade-off for LLM-based optimization autoformulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IR2Solve，一个以中间表示（intermediate representation）为先的优化问题自动公式化流水线：先用一次语义 LLM 调用生成受 schema 约束的 ModelIR，再经过确定性验证和 IR 到求解器的编译。ModelIR 用受限类 Python 表达式显式表示集合、参数、变量、目标与约束，并采用标量约束约定将有限索引约束族逐条展开，以减少自由索引和隐式量化错误。在六个优化基准上达到较强的目标正确性，并在成本对比中显著低于 Chain-of-Experts 与 SAC-Opt 的调用次数和 token 用量。
Motivation: LLM 直接生成求解器代码在自动公式化中容易出现 schema、索引和语义错误，导致编译失败、模型不可行或目标错误；而迭代修复、搜索和多智能体流程又显著增加推理成本。
Method: 提出中间表示优先的 IR2Solve 流水线：单次语义 LLM 调用生成 schema 约束的 ModelIR，随后由确定性验证阶段和 IR 到求解器编译阶段完成后续处理；ModelIR 使用受限的类 Python 表达式并引入具体标量约束约定来表示有限索引约束族。
Result: 在六个清理后的优化基准上取得较强的目标正确性；在 153 个 IndustryOR 和 ComplexLP 实例的受控消融中显示结构化 IR 接口、标量约束指令与确定性验证带来逐步提升；在十实例成本面板上，IR2Solve 每实例仅用一次语义调用，而 Chain-of-Experts 和 SAC-Opt 分别用 8 次和 39 次调用，token 量分别是 IR2Solve 的 3.3 倍和 22.9 倍。
Conclusion: 结构化中间表示结合生成后的确定性处理，为基于 LLM 的优化自动公式化提供了实用的精度-成本权衡。

papers.title: Instruction Stacking Collapse: A Benchmark and the Capability-Dependent Value of Prompt Compilation
papers.abstract_en: Production prompts rarely carry a single instruction. One system message may require valid JSON, a word limit, three citations, and a fixed tone at the same time. We study how instruction-following degrades as such constraints accumulate. We introduce a benchmark that stacks 24 verifier-checked instructions, one to twenty at a time, and evaluate three production-tier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash). Instruction-following degrades non-linearly: the follow rate falls from ~96% to as low as 20%, driven by a structured and reproducible set of pairwise conflicts. A single "output JSON" constraint, for example, is jointly unsatisfiable with nine others. We then evaluate a training-free remedy: an instruction compiler that rewrites the stacked prompt in a single LLM call and is reused across queries. Its benefit is capability-graded. It recovers up to +11 points of follow rate for weaker models, which are also the models most often deployed at scale, while leaving stronger models, which already internalise the same structure, essentially unchanged. Cluster-robust tests, same-baseline controls, and a within-family scaling ladder attribute the gain to the rewrite itself rather than to additional tokens, reordering, or measurement headroom. We release the benchmark, verifiers, and cached runs for full reproduction.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 11 figures. Benchmark, deterministic verifiers, and cached model responses released for full reproduction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生产环境中多条指令同时叠加时模型指令遵循能力的退化现象，提出一个将 24 条可验证指令按 1 到 20 条逐步堆叠的基准，并在 Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5-mini 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 上评测。摘要报告遵循率从约 96% 非线性下降至最低 20%，并存在结构化、可复现的成对冲突。随后评估一种免训练的提示编译器 (instruction compiler)，它用一次 LLM 调用重写叠加提示并可跨查询复用，其收益呈能力分级：较弱模型最多提升 11 个百分点的遵循率，较强模型几乎不变。
Motivation: 生产提示词几乎不会只包含单条指令，常同时要求合法 JSON、字数限制、引用数和固定语气等，但指令遵循如何随约束累积而退化缺乏系统研究。
Method: 构建由 24 条 verifier 可检查指令组成的基准，按 1 至 20 条堆叠评估三种生产级 LLM；再引入免训练的提示编译器，在单次 LLM 调用中重写堆叠提示并跨查询复用，并采用 cluster-robust 检验、同一基线的对照以及 within-family scaling ladder 来归因收益。
Result: 摘要报告指令遵循率从约 96% 非线性降至最低 20%，例如单一 "output JSON" 约束与另外九条指令联合不可满足；提示编译器对较弱模型最多恢复 11 个百分点的遵循率，而较强模型因已内化相同结构而基本不变。
Conclusion: 作者将收益归因于重写本身而非额外 token、重排序或测量空间，并发布基准、确定性 verifier 和缓存模型响应以支持完整复现。

papers.title: Studying, Identifying, and Fixing Hidden Technical Debt in AI-Intensive Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) components are increasingly pervasive in several software systems, including Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs). AI-CPS are used in several domains, including autonomous vehicles, industry, home automation, robotics, and healthcare. Being composed of hardware, AI components, and conventional modules, AI-CPS can exhibit technical debt (TD) that is peculiar and potentially more challenging than that of conventional systems. This thesis aims to characterize AI-CPS TD and propose approaches for its identification and repair. In a first phase, we characterize AI-CPS TD by analyzing AI ecosystems and AI-CPS repositories, as well as interviewing developers. Based on the acquired knowledge, we define approaches to identify and mitigate such TD. Finally, we plan to develop and validate an automated tool that supports agentic AI solutions to monitor, govern, and repay AI-CPS TD.
papers.comment: Doctoral Symposium of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 ASE 2026 博士生研讨会的一篇论文计划，围绕 AI 密集型信息物理系统 (AI-CPS) 中的技术债 (technical debt) 展开。作者提出先对 AI-CPS 的技术债进行刻画，再定义识别与修复方法，最终开发并验证一个支持智能体式 AI 解决方案的自动化工具，用于监控、治理并偿还这类技术债。当前阶段以问题刻画和方法规划为主，尚未报告实证结果。
Motivation: AI-CPS 由硬件、AI 组件和常规模块组成，其技术债可能比传统系统更特殊、更具挑战性，但现有研究对此缺乏系统性刻画。
Method: 拟分三个阶段进行：首先通过分析 AI 生态系统与 AI-CPS 代码仓库并访谈开发者来刻画 AI-CPS 技术债；然后基于所得知识定义识别与缓解方法；最后开发并验证支持 agentic AI 的自动化工具以监控、治理和偿还技术债。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或基准结果，仅说明计划对自动化工具进行开发与验证。
Conclusion: 论文以博士论文计划的形式，强调 AI-CPS 技术债的识别与修复需要专门的方法和工具支持；当前仍是进行中的工作，验证环节有待完成。

papers.title: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agent Skills: Feedback Dynamics over Multiple Rounds
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving skill systems promise to improve agents by turning execution feedback into persistent skill updates without changing the underlying model. Yet it remains unclear when further evolution helps, how successful and failed trajectories shape revision, and whether extra test-time computation can recover the same gains. To address these questions, we present a controlled evaluation framework across five benchmarks and three models. Our primary study contains 42 feedback runs across 14 supported model-benchmark settings. Within each setting, we hold the executor and optimizer configuration, revision procedure, validation rule, and round budget fixed, while varying only the feedback shown to the optimizer: successes and failures (Normal), failures only, or successes only. Evolution is sparse: only 55 of 388 candidates establish byte-distinct validation bests. Validation-based selection chooses an evolved skill in 11 of 14 settings, nine of which improve released-test performance. All 11 selections come from feedback conditions that include failed trajectories, although the relative ranking of Normal and Fail-only varies across settings. Validation and downstream evaluations on test, robustness, and transfer sometimes favor different feedback views. A broader SearchQA analysis covering eight models shows similarly sparse, feedback-dependent dynamics. In the GPT-5.5 test-time-scaling controls, oracle Parallel Sampling comes within 0.43 points of the evolved SearchQA skill but remains 30.96 points behind on SpreadsheetBench; Sequential Refinement recovers neither gain. Overall, persistent skill self-evolution is better understood as sparse, validation-filtered search with model- and benchmark-dependent returns, rather than steady improvement from additional rounds. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/rethinkskill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文围绕自演化智能体技能（self-evolving agent skills）提出受控评估框架，在五个基准和三个模型上通过 42 次反馈运行研究反馈类型对技能修订的影响。结果显示演化是稀疏的：388 个候选中仅 55 个建立了字节不同的验证最优；基于验证的选择在 14 个设置中的 11 个选中了演化技能，其中 9 个提升了下游发布测试性能，且所有选中都来自包含失败轨迹的反馈条件。GPT-5.5 测试时计算对照表明并行采样在 SearchQA 上几乎追平演化技能，但在 SpreadsheetBench 上仍有较大差距。
Motivation: 现有自演化技能系统承诺通过执行反馈持续更新技能，但尚不清楚进一步演化何时有帮助、成功与失败轨迹如何影响修订，以及额外测试时计算能否获得同等收益。
Method: 提出受控评估框架，在固定执行器与优化器配置、修订流程、验证规则和轮次预算的前提下，仅改变提供给优化器的反馈类型（成功与失败、仅失败、仅成功），跨五个基准和三个模型进行 14 个模型-基准设置、共 42 次反馈运行，并引入测试时缩放对照。
Result: 演化稀疏，388 个候选中仅 55 个达到字节不同的验证最优；验证选择在 14 个设置中的 11 个选出演化技能，其中 9 个改进发布测试性能，且全部来自含失败轨迹的反馈条件。在 GPT-5.5 测试时缩放对照中，Oracle Parallel Sampling 与演化后的 SearchQA 技能相差 0.43 分，但在 SpreadsheetBench 上落后 30.96 分，Sequential Refinement 无法恢复这两项收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为持久技能自我演化应理解为稀疏的、经验证过滤的搜索，其收益高度依赖模型与基准，而非随额外轮次稳定提升。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为持久技能自我演化应理解为稀疏的、经验证过滤的搜索，其收益高度依赖模型与基准，而非随额外轮次稳定提升。

papers.title: GeoID-PINN: Identifiability-Aware Regional Epidemic Inference with Geographic Coupling
papers.abstract_en: Regional surveillance data reflect local transmission, reporting, seeding, and external infection pressure, which are difficult to identify separately. We introduce GeoID-PINN, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for susceptible-infectious-recovered-deceased (SIRD) dynamics. The model represents spatial dependence with a row-stochastic source-composition matrix whose rows assign nonnegative source weights that sum to one. We regularize this matrix toward a spatial prior constructed from distance, adjacency, commuting, or lead-lag information. In a four-region simulation with known truth, a compatible distance prior gives source-composition error 0.099. The error rises to 0.159 without regularization and 0.577 under a strongly misspecified prior, while trajectory fit and transmission-scale estimates remain similar. Accurate trajectories therefore do not guarantee recovery of the regional dependence structure. We also evaluate GeoID-PINN retrospectively using COVID-19 data from 64 Louisiana counties. Relative to an autoregressive negative-binomial baseline, Forecast-Trained Geo-PINN reduces mean squared error (MSE) from 32,957 to 11,468 and mean absolute error (MAE) from 70.60 to 57.73. The baseline has lower negative log likelihood (NLL), 5.158 versus 5.346, indicating better distributional fit but worse point accuracy. In a controlled 15-county comparison, county adjacency reduces MSE by 6.85 percent and MAE by 3.1 percent. Similar performance across plausible priors supports structured regularization but not unique edge recovery. These results require prior-sensitivity and observation-model checks before interpretation.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 8th epiDAMIK ACM SIGKDD Workshop on Data-driven Decision Making for Public and Population Health (epiDAMIK @ KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoID-PINN，一种用于区域流行病推断的物理信息神经网络 (PINN)，建模 SIRD 动力学并通过行随机源组成矩阵表达区域间空间依赖。四区域模拟显示当先验与真实结构兼容时源组成误差为 0.099，而无正则化与错误先验时误差分别升至 0.159 和 0.577；在路易斯安那州 64 县 COVID-19 数据上，其点预测精度优于自回归负二项基线。
Motivation: 区域监测数据同时反映本地传播、报告、种子病例与外部感染压力，这些因素难以单独辨识，需要一种能够可靠恢复区域依赖结构的推断方法。
Method: 基于 SIRD 模型构建物理信息神经网络，并用行随机源组成矩阵表示空间依赖；该矩阵各行非负且和为 1，并通过先验正则化向距离、邻接、通勤或超前滞后信息构造的空间先验靠拢。
Result: 四区域模拟中，兼容距离先验给出源组成误差 0.099，无正则化约为 0.159，强错误先验下升至 0.577，但轨迹拟合与传播尺度估计在各设定下相似。路易斯安那州 64 县回顾分析中，所提方法将 MSE 从 32,957 降至 11,468，MAE 从 70.60 降至 57.73；基线 NLL 更低（5.158 对 5.346），说明分布拟合更好但点预测更差。受控 15 县比较中，邻接先验使 MSE 降低 6.85%、MAE 降低 3.1%。
Conclusion: 作者强调精确的轨迹预测并不保证区域依赖结构能被正确恢复；不同合理先验下表现相近，支持有结构正则化的推断，但无法实现唯一的边恢复，解释前还需进行先验敏感性与观测模型检查。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LLMs Can Annotate Attribution Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Circuit tracing is an exciting technique for revealing the internal computation of language models, but it requires a time-intensive manual step of grouping individual features or MLP neurons into supernodes. We present a simple pipeline for automating this step: directly presenting feature descriptions to a language model that groups them into supernodes. Using automated interpretability metrics, we confirm that supernodes generated by our pipeline are as interpretable as those generated by human annotators. On a two-hop Capitals task, our pipeline recovers a supernode corresponding to the intermediate hop in 97 of 100 prompts. Finally, we present a simple proof of concept using our pipeline for open-ended exploration, where we automatically annotate 1000 attribution graphs from Wikipedia prompt completions and then use an LLM judge to flag interesting graphs worth human review. We hope this work demonstrates that even simple automation can produce meaningful attribution graph annotations, motivating further work on automated circuit tracing.
papers.comment: Poster at ICML Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个简单流水线，直接让语言模型根据特征描述将单个特征或 MLP 神经元分组为超节点 (supernode)，以替代电路追踪 (circuit tracing) 中耗时的人工标注步骤。自动可解释性指标显示该流水线生成的超节点与人工标注者生成的超节点可解释性相当；在两跳 Capitals 任务中，97/100 个提示词下流水线能恢复对应中间跳的超节点。作者还给出开放探索的概念验证：自动标注 1000 个来自 Wikipedia 提示补全的归因图，并用 LLM 裁判标记值得人工审查的图。
Motivation: 电路追踪能揭示语言模型的内部计算，但将单个特征或 MLP 神经元分组为超节点需要大量人工步骤，限制了该技术的扩展性。
Method: 提出自动化流水线：直接将特征描述呈现给语言模型，由其将这些描述分组为超节点；并用自动可解释性指标验证结果，同时用 LLM 裁判对大规模生成的归因图进行筛选。
Result: 自动指标确认流水线生成的超节点与人工注释同样可解释；在 two-hop Capitals 任务中，97/100 个提示词恢复出对应中间跳的超节点；概念验证中对 1000 个 Wikipedia 提示补全的归因图进行了自动标注。
Conclusion: 作者认为即使简单的自动化也能产生有意义的归因图注释，希望以此推动自动化电路追踪的进一步研究。

papers.title: PULSE: An Executable Contract Language for Spatiotemporal Knowledge Graph Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph engineering often distributes accepted state, observations, constraints, processes, and hypothetical scenarios across artifacts whose combined execution contract remains external. We present PULSE, an Object-Process-Methodology-inspired language that localizes four operational roles and their write effects in one typed runtime. Here, modes denote operational roles rather than modal or deontic logic. The implemented contract fixes evidence non-overwrite, branch isolation, grounded multi-subject timers, guarded state change, and declaration-ranked event ordering over time and space; an external runner still decides whether evidence becomes an authoritative move. GeoSPARQL, SOSA, and SHACL remain generated views. A core calculus gives an effect-confinement lemma and six safety properties. Lean 4 checks kernel analogues for positions, evidence, clocks, monitors, atomicity, and branch source retention; 88 tests, 3,534 bounded checks, and 32 Lean/Python runtime-kernel cases bound the implementation claim to the checked cases. First-author implementations of a standards composition and a separate Sismic statechart reproduce the tested cold-chain trace. Across 37,440 generated temporal traces, PULSE matches a separate workflow and distinguishes ten single-field mutants. On the complete NOAA IBTrACS since1980 subset it agrees with GEOS and an event sweep on 1,476,290 transition-zone pairs, including 4,800 sampled and 12,831 duration-qualified events. Project-specific GeoSPARQL probes measure interface coverage. Overall, the results support contract localization, safety arguments, and trace parity for the tested fragment; language superiority and usability remain outside the evaluation.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 tables, 1 code listing; submitted to KGSWC 2026. Research artifact available under the Apache-2.0 license
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PULSE，一种受对象-过程方法论 (Object-Process Methodology) 启发的可执行合约语言，用于时空知识图谱工程。该语言在一个类型化运行时中定位四种操作角色及其写效果，并约定证据不可覆盖、分支隔离、多主体定时器、受控状态变更以及时空上的声明排序事件。作者给出了核心演算的效果约束引理与六条安全性质，并用 Lean 4 检查内核对应物；实验在生成轨迹上与独立工作流对齐，并在 NOAA IBTrACS 子集上与 GEOS 及事件扫描一致，但明确说明语言优越性与可用性不在评估范围内。
Motivation: 知识图谱工程常常把已接受状态、观测、约束、过程和假设场景分散在不同工件中，其组合执行合约保持外部化；PULSE 旨在把这一运行合约集中在单一类型化运行时中，以支撑安全论证和轨迹一致性。
Method: PULSE 提供一种类型化运行时，其中模式表示操作角色而非模态或道义逻辑；证据是否成为权威动作仍由外部运行器决定，GeoSPARQL、SOSA 与 SHACL 仅作为生成视图。作者设计了核心演算并证明效果约束引理与六条安全性质，同时在 Lean 4 中实现位置、证据、时钟、监视器、原子性与分支来源保留的内核对等物，并配套 Python 运行时。
Result: 摘要报告 88 项测试、3,534 项有界检查与 32 个 Lean/Python 运行时-内核用例；两个首作者实现（一个标准组合和一个 Sismic 状态图）复现了测试用冷链轨迹。在 37,440 条生成的时间轨迹上 PULSE 与独立工作流一致并区分十个单字段突变；在 NOAA IBTrACS 1980 年以来完整子集上，与 GEOS 及事件扫描在 1,476,290 个过渡区对上一致，其中包括 4,800 个采样事件与 12,831 个限时事件；项目专属 GeoSPARQL 探针用于测量接口覆盖率。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持所测片段内的合约局部化、安全论证与轨迹一致性，但语言优越性和可用性被明确排除在评估范围之外。
Relevance: 40
