papers.title: Multimodal Auto-regressive Transformer Surrogate for Modeling Variable Operations and Quantifying Uncertainty in Geological Carbon Storage
papers.abstract_en: The use of variable well perforation and injection strategies can improve the efficiency of geological carbon storage operations. We develop a new multimodal auto-regressive transformer surrogate to model these operations under geological uncertainty. A modified SEAM CO2 geomodel, which involves a faulted system with three stacked aquifers, is considered. The two injection wells are perforated in stages, from bottom to top, with the stage durations and individual well injection rates treated as control variables. The surrogate model processes three input modalities - the 3D geomodel, scalar parameters characterizing relative permeability functions, and control variables - through separate encoders. These are fused via self-attention in a transformer encoder, and a temporal decoder generates predictions auto-regressively through encoder-decoder cross-attention. The surrogate is trained, using 4000 GEOS flow simulations, to predict saturation and pressure at monitoring locations, total injected and mobile CO2 mass, and saturation footprints. For a new test set, involving randomly sampled geomodels and control variables, the surrogate achieves a median saturation MAE of 0.028 and median relative errors of 0.2-5% for the other quantities of interest. Importantly, it captures the switch from rate to bottom-hole-pressure control. The surrogate model is used within a hierarchical Markov chain Monte Carlo data assimilation procedure for a synthetic true model under three operational strategies. Substantial uncertainty reduction is achieved for key metaparameters, particularly the fault permeabilities. Posterior predictions for saturation footprints and total injected and mobile CO2 mass are also shown to be generally consistent with true model results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态自回归Transformer代理模型，用于在地质不确定性下建模可变射孔和注入策略的碳封存操作。模型使用修改的SEAM CO2地质模型（含断层系统和三个叠置含水层），以两口注入井的分段射孔时长和注入速率为控制变量，通过三个编码器分别处理3D地质模型、相对渗透率函数标量参数和控制变量，并经自注意力融合后由时序解码器自回归预测饱和度、压力、注入/可移动CO2质量及饱和度足迹。使用4000个GEOS流动模拟训练，测试集上中位饱和度MAE为0.028，其他关注量的中位相对误差为0.2%-5%，并能捕捉从速率控制到井底压力控制的切换；用于分层马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）数据同化时显著降低了关键元参数（尤其断层渗透率）的不确定性。
Motivation: 地质碳封存中可变井射孔和注入策略可提高操作效率，但地质不确定性使得依赖昂贵流动模拟的评估和反演成本过高，需要既能高效预测多类量又能量化不确定性的代理模型。
Method: 构建多模态自回归Transformer代理模型：三个独立编码器分别编码3D地质模型、相对渗透率函数标量参数和控制变量，通过Transformer编码器中的自注意力进行融合；时序解码器经编码器-解码器交叉注意力自回归生成预测。模型用4000个GEOS流动模拟产出训练，预测监测位置的饱和度与压力、总注入和可移动CO2质量以及饱和度足迹。
Result: 在随机采样的地质模型和控制变量测试集上，代理模型达到中位饱和度MAE为0.028，其他关注量的中位相对误差为0.2%-5%，并正确捕捉速率控制到井底压力控制的切换。在分层MCMC数据同化框架下，对合成真实模型的三个操作策略进行反演，关键元参数（尤其断层渗透率）的不确定性显著降低，饱和度足迹和CO2质量的后验预测总体与真实模型一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该代理模型能够高效建模可变操作并量化地质不确定性，同时可嵌入数据同化流程实现关键参数的不确定性缩减；其验证范围限于特定的SEAM CO2地质模型和合成测试案例。

summary_sections.motivation: 地质碳封存中可变井射孔和注入策略可提高操作效率，但地质不确定性使得依赖昂贵流动模拟的评估和反演成本过高，需要既能高效预测多类量又能量化不确定性的代理模型。
summary_sections.method: 构建多模态自回归Transformer代理模型：三个独立编码器分别编码3D地质模型、相对渗透率函数标量参数和控制变量，通过Transformer编码器中的自注意力进行融合；时序解码器经编码器-解码器交叉注意力自回归生成预测。模型用4000个GEOS流动模拟产出训练，预测监测位置的饱和度与压力、总注入和可移动CO2质量以及饱和度足迹。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该代理模型能够高效建模可变操作并量化地质不确定性，同时可嵌入数据同化流程实现关键参数的不确定性缩减；其验证范围限于特定的SEAM CO2地质模型和合成测试案例。

papers.title: Deep Divide-and-Reduce in Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) is the task of discovering underlying patterns from data and representing them using mathematical expressions. Current machine learning approaches to SR often lack a profound understanding of the intrinsic mathematical and physical principles governing these expressions. While the pioneering AI Feynman method leverages the mathematical properties underlying the data, its expression simplification mechanism suffers from a narrow scope of applicability and is prone to failure on complex equations. Furthermore, its underlying mechanisms rely heavily on brute-force searches for sub-expressions, severely limiting its practical utility. Through rigorous mathematical deduction and proofs, we propose our method, Deep Divide and Reduce in Symbolic Regression (DDRSR). DDRSR fundamentally broadens the applicability of expression decomposition and reduction, circumvents the need for brute-force sub-structure searches, and ensures both wider versatility and strict theoretical correctness. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that these theoretical principles yield significant advantages in both expression decomposition and numerical regression tasks. Finally, we discuss the applicable scenarios and inherent limitations of this paradigm, alongside promising directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Deep Divide-and-Reduce in Symbolic Regression (DDRSR)，一种面向符号回归 (symbolic regression) 的表达式分解与化简方法。作者通过数学推导和证明，使其相比 AI Feynman 拓宽了表达式分解的适用范围，避免对子表达式进行暴力搜索，并在表达式分解与数值回归任务上取得优势。
Motivation: 现有机器学习符号回归方法缺少对表达式内在数学与物理原理的理解；AI Feynman 虽利用数据背后的数学性质，但其表达式化简机制适用范围窄、在复杂方程上易失败，且依赖暴力搜索子表达式，实用性受限。
Method: DDRSR 基于严格的数学推导和证明，提出更普适的表达式分解与化简框架，避免暴力子结构搜索，从而同时保证更广的适用性和严格的理论正确性。
Result: 摘要报告，经验评估显示 DDRSR 在表达式分解和数值回归任务上都较现有方法具有显著优势；但未给出具体数据集或数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者总结了该范式的适用场景与内在局限，并指出未来研究方向；其贡献主要在于理论正确性与通用性，而非特定领域的应用。

papers.title: Micro-Segmentation Anomaly Detection in Zero-Trust Software-Defined Network Fabrics
papers.abstract_en: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) principles need rigorous network segmentation and ongoing verification to reduce implicit trust and lateral threat propagation. This paper investigates anomaly detection in software-defined networking (SDN) systems by micro-segmentation, using deep learning models to detect harmful actions that evade traditional coarse-grained monitoring. Two models are developed: a Vision Transformer (ViT) and a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN), which are used to both raw and micro-segmented network flow data. Experimental findings from a simulated zero-trust SDN dataset indicate that micro-segmentation substantially improves detection accuracy. The models trained on segmented input demonstrate enhanced accuracy and F1-scores (F1 = 0.95) compared to those utilizing unsegmented raw data (F1 = 0.90). The ViT-based detector marginally surpasses the 1D-CNN, particularly in recognizing nuanced lateral movement patterns that are unnoticed in unprocessed data. These findings highlight the significance of including micro-segmentation inside zero-trust networks to enhance intrusion detection efficacy. Future efforts will broaden this methodology to include extensive real-world network datasets and dynamic online segmentation techniques.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2025 Artificial Intelligence and Smart Technologies for Sustainability Conference (AISTS), Rajkot, India, 21-23 August 2025, Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), pp. 1-6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究零信任架构（Zero Trust Architecture）下基于微分割（micro-segmentation）的软件定义网络（SDN）异常检测。作者分别用 Vision Transformer (ViT) 和 1D-CNN 处理原始与微分割后的网络流数据，在模拟零信任 SDN 数据集上训练检测模型，目标是识别能绕过传统粗粒度监控的恶意行为。实验表明微分割能显著提升检测性能，ViT 略优于 1D-CNN。
Motivation: 零信任架构需要严格的网络分段与持续验证，但传统粗粒度监控难以捕捉横向移动等隐蔽攻击。现有方法在细粒度分割场景下的异常检测效果有限，需要验证微分割对深度学习检测模型的增益。
Method: 构建两个检测模型：Vision Transformer (ViT) 和 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN)。两者分别对原始未分割网络流数据和微分割后的网络流数据进行训练与评估，比较分割前后对恶意行为识别能力的影响。
Result: 在模拟零信任 SDN 数据集上，基于微分割输入的模型相比原始数据显著提升准确率与 F1 分数（F1 从 0.90 提升到 0.95）。ViT 检测器略优于 1D-CNN，尤其在识别原始数据中难以察觉的细微横向移动模式时表现更好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调微分割应纳入零信任网络以提升入侵检测效果，并指出未来工作将扩展到大规模真实网络数据集和动态在线分割技术。

papers.title: Speculative Correction: Draft-then-Refine Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can revise tokens bidirectionally, but standard decoding procedures often adapt them to left-to-right generation by producing text block by block. We study a simple plug-and-play inference pattern: first generate a complete draft, then refine the full response using bidirectional diffusion. Using LLaDA2.1-Flash and LLaDA2.1-Mini, we evaluate two configurations. In Flash-Flash, the same Flash model serves as both drafter and refiner, testing whether an existing model can improve its own block-autoregressive output through global refinement. In Mini-Flash, inspired by speculative decoding, we introduce speculative correction: Mini drafts a full response, and Flash revises it as an editable initialization. Flash-Flash improves GSM8K-384 accuracy from 0.848 to 0.899 while running 1.20 times faster than the selected Flash block-autoregressive baseline, and improves MBPP-384 from 0.545 to 0.693. Latency-window-matched Flash-only controls indicate that these gains persist after targeted tuning of block-autoregressive decoding. Causal ablations indicate that completed drafts provide useful initializations: refinement from a fully masked span performs poorly, full global refinement provides a clear additional gain on GSM8K, and local refinement captures much of the gain on MBPP and MATH. Mini-Flash provides useful quality-latency trade-offs, including MATH-384 performance of 0.294 versus 0.300 for Flash while running 2.17 times faster. These results support a Pareto-frontier interpretation rather than the claim that the heterogeneous cascade uniformly matches Flash quality. Overall, same-model draft-and-refine provides evidence that bidirectional refinement is a useful decoding primitive for DLMs, while speculative correction demonstrates a training-free route to fast DLM generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散语言模型（DLM）的即插即用解码模式：先用自回归方式生成完整草稿，再用双向扩散对整段回答进行精炼。作者基于 LLaDA2.1-Flash 与 LLaDA2.1-Mini 评估了同模型自精炼（Flash-Flash）和跨模型投机修正（Mini-Flash）两种配置，结果显示该方法能提升数学与代码基准准确率并降低延迟，但作者将其解读为 Pareto 前沿上的质量-延迟权衡，而非异构级联全面对齐 Flash 质量。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型具有双向修正能力，但标准解码通常将其约束为逐块从左到右生成，未能充分利用全局精炼的潜力；同时缺少训练免费的高质量快速生成路径。
Method: 提出 draft-then-refine 的插件式推理模式：先用同一个或更小的模型生成完整草稿，再以该草稿作为可编辑初始化，通过双向扩散精炼；其中 Mini-Flash 配置被称为投机修正（speculative correction）。作者还通过从完全掩码跨度精炼、全局精炼与局部精炼的因果消融来分析草稿初始化的作用。
Result: Flash-Flash 将 GSM8K-384 准确率从 0.848 提升到 0.899，同时比所选 Flash 块自回归基线快 1.20 倍，并将 MBPP-384 从 0.545 提升到 0.693；延迟窗口匹配的对照表明增益在调优基线后依然存在。Mini-Flash 在 MATH-384 上达到 0.294 vs Flash 的 0.300，但运行速度快 2.17 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持 Pareto 前沿解读，而非异构级联在所有指标上均匀匹配 Flash 质量；同模型草稿-精炼表明双向精炼是 DLM 的有效解码原语，投机修正则提供了一条无需训练的快速 DLM 生成路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural network realization of binary refinement iterates via a two-chart atlas selector
papers.abstract_en: Refinement operators generate many functions used in wavelet constructions, subdivision schemes, and geometric modeling. Their finite iterates can develop rapidly increasing numbers of linear pieces, making them a natural test case for the expressive power of deep neural networks. Earlier work showed that, for scalar binary refinement with a finitely supported mask, every compactly supported continuous piecewise linear seed has finite refinement iterates that admit exact ReLU realizations of fixed width and depth growing linearly with the number of refinement steps. The present paper gives a new construction of this known theorem. The difficulty is that the refinement cascade is driven by discontinuous binary digit choices, whereas ReLU networks produce continuous piecewise linear maps. We represent the residual dynamics on a polygonal model of the circle and describe each residual position in two overlapping coordinate systems, one ordinary and one shifted by one half. Their discontinuities occur at different points. The network switches between the two descriptions only where both are valid and the corresponding fixed linear cascade updates agree, so the switch is exact and requires no multiplication by a variable selector. The construction also gives exact readout of every continuous piecewise linear circle function satisfying the natural endpoint compatibility condition. Localized seeds are handled by a two-pass network, and translation covariance, finite decomposition, and gluing extend the result to arbitrary compactly supported continuous piecewise linear seeds in a preserved support window.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带有限支撑掩模 (finitely supported mask) 的标量二元细化 (binary refinement) 有限迭代的 ReLU 网络精确实现问题，给出已知定理的一个新构造。作者在圆的多边形模型上用两个重叠坐标系描述残差动态，并构造一个两坐标系图册选择器 (two-chart atlas selector)，使网络在两种描述都有效、固定线性级联更新一致的位置完成精确切换。该构造还给出满足端点相容条件的连续分段线性圆函数的精确读出，并通过两遍网络、平移协变、有限分解和粘接扩展到任意紧支撑连续分段线性种子。
Motivation: 细化算子迭代会产生快速增长的线性片段数量，是检验深度神经网络表达能力的自然测试用例；此前已知存在固定宽度、深度随细化步数线性增长的精确 ReLU 实现，但难点在于细化级联由不连续的二进制数字选择驱动，而 ReLU 网络只能产生连续分段线性映射。本文旨在给出一个更直接的构造来弥合这种不连续性与连续映射之间的鸿沟。
Method: 将残差动态表示在圆的多边形模型上，为每个残差位置引入两套重叠坐标（普通坐标和半平移坐标），其不连续点不同。网络只在两套描述都有效且对应固定线性级联更新一致的位置切换描述，从而无需乘以可变选择器即可实现精确切换；对紧支撑种子用两遍网络处理，并通过平移协变、有限分解和粘接推广到一般种子。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验。主要结果是给出已知精确实现定理的一个新构造，以及所有满足自然端点相容条件的连续分段线性圆函数的精确读出；该构造不需要可变选择器的乘法。
Conclusion: 该构造表明二元细化迭代的 ReLU 网络实现可以在不引入可变选择器乘法的情况下完成精确切换，并通过平移协变、有限分解与粘接组合扩展到任意紧支撑连续分段线性种子，同时保持支撑窗口。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 将残差动态表示在圆的多边形模型上，为每个残差位置引入两套重叠坐标（普通坐标和半平移坐标），其不连续点不同。网络只在两套描述都有效且对应固定线性级联更新一致的位置切换描述，从而无需乘以可变选择器即可实现精确切换；对紧支撑种子用两遍网络处理，并通过平移协变、有限分解和粘接推广到一般种子。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告数值实验。主要结果是给出已知精确实现定理的一个新构造，以及所有满足自然端点相容条件的连续分段线性圆函数的精确读出；该构造不需要可变选择器的乘法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该构造表明二元细化迭代的 ReLU 网络实现可以在不引入可变选择器乘法的情况下完成精确切换，并通过平移协变、有限分解与粘接组合扩展到任意紧支撑连续分段线性种子，同时保持支撑窗口。

papers.title: UniPASE: A Generative Model for Universal Speech Enhancement with High Fidelity and Low Hallucinations
papers.abstract_en: Universal speech enhancement (USE) aims to restore speech signals from diverse distortions across multiple sampling rates. We propose UniPASE, an extension of the low-hallucination PASE framework tailored for USE. At its core is DeWavLM-Omni, a unified representation-level enhancement module fine-tuned from WavLM via knowledge distillation on a large-scale supervised multi-distortion dataset. This module directly converts degraded waveforms into clean and linguistically faithful phonetic representations, ensuring robust enhancement with minimal linguistic hallucination. Based on these enhanced phonetic representations, an Adapter generates enhanced acoustic representations containing rich acoustic details, which a neural Vocoder uses to reconstruct corresponding high-fidelity 16-kHz waveforms. A PostNet then converts the waveforms to 48~kHz before resampling them to their original rates, enabling seamless handling of inputs and outputs at multiple sampling rates. Experimental results on several evaluation datasets, covering sub-tasks and full tasks, demonstrate that UniPASE achieves superior or competitive performance compared with existing state-of-the-art models. The proposed model also serves as the backbone of our submission to the URGENT 2026 Challenge, which achieved 1st place in the objective evaluation. The source code and audio demos are available at https://github.com/xiaobin-rong/unipase/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniPASE，一个面向通用语音增强 (universal speech enhancement, USE) 的生成式模型，扩展了低幻觉 PASE 框架，以处理多种失真类型和多采样率输入。核心是基于 WavLM 微调的 DeWavLM-Omni 表征级增强模块，通过知识蒸馏在大规模带噪数据集上训练，将受损波形直接映射为干净且语言保真的音素表征，再经 Adapter、神经声码器和 PostNet 重建高保真波形并适配不同采样率。实验表明其在多个评测数据集上达到或超越现有最先进模型，并作为 URGENT 2026 Challenge 提交系统的骨干获得客观评测第一名。
Motivation: 通用语音增强需要在多种失真和采样率下恢复语音，而现有方法在增强过程中容易产生语言幻觉 (linguistic hallucination)，且难以同时兼顾高保真度与多采样率适配。
Method: 提出 UniPASE 流水线：先用蒸馏自 WavLM 的 DeWavLM-Omni 将退化波形转换为干净、语言保真的音素表征；再由 Adapter 基于这些表征生成含丰富声学细节的增强声学表征；随后用神经声码器重建 16 kHz 波形，最后通过 PostNet 上采样到 48 kHz 再重采样回原始采样率，从而无缝处理多采样率输入输出。
Result: 在多个覆盖子任务和完整任务的评测数据集上，UniPASE 相比现有最先进模型取得优越或相当的性能；该模型作为 URGENT 2026 Challenge 提交的骨干，在客观评测中获得第一名。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一表征级增强与后续声学细节重建的组合能在保持低语言幻觉的同时实现高保真通用语音增强，并公开了源码和音频演示以支持复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowing the Form, Not the Function: Automatically Auditing Answer--Authority Decoupling in Legal Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Legal benchmarks typically score final answers even when models also state legal authority. We test whether answer correctness can serve as a proxy for authority grounding. Under ordinary reasoning prompts that did not request statutory citations, four LLMs spontaneously produced authority markers across 238 Taiwan bar-examination items. Because each item has a verified governing provision, we automatically audit answer correctness and authority grounding jointly. The two dimensions dissociate in both directions. In criminal law, 24.0--42.4\% of valid responses were answer-correct but missed the gold authority, while 15.2--21.7\% were answer-incorrect but cited it. A separate statutory-retrieval probe and a permissive citation-abstention intervention further show that answer and citation behavior can move separately at the output level. Because this mismatch arises without adversarial or inconsistency-inducing prompting, answer-only scoring treats naturally occurring gold-authority misses as complete benchmark successes. Because statutory authority is structurally extractable and externally verifiable, the failure can be measured automatically. A preliminary PRC civil-law extension also observes citation-unrequested authority marking, motivating a full cross-jurisdictional joint audit. We therefore propose joint answer--authority evaluation for statute-grounded legal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究法律基准中答案正确性与法律权威引用（authority grounding）之间的关系。作者在238个台湾律师考试题目上，用普通推理提示（不要求法条引用）测试四个LLM，发现模型自发产生权威标记。通过联合审计答案正确性与权威依据，发现两者在两个方向上都存在分离：在刑法中，24.0–42.4%的有效回答答案正确但错过黄金权威条款，15.2–21.7%答案错误但引用了正确权威。基于此提出对法律基准进行联合答案-权威评估。
Motivation: 现有法律基准通常只对最终答案评分，即使模型也陈述了法律权威也不考查。作者质疑答案正确性能否作为权威依据的代理，指出单一评分可能掩盖自然发生的权威缺失。
Method: 使用238个台湾律师考试题（每题有已验证的适用条款），在普通提示下让四个LLM作答，自动联合审计答案正确性与权威依据（authority grounding）。还设计了法定检索探针（statutory-retrieval probe）和允许引用弃权的干预（citation-abstention intervention）来检验两者在输出层面的可分离性，并在中国民法数据上做了初步扩展。
Result: 发现答案正确性与权威依据在两个方向上分离：刑法中24.0–42.4%的有效回答答案正确但未命中黄金权威，15.2–21.7%答案错误但引用了权威。检索探针和干预进一步显示二者可以独立移动，且无需对抗性提示即可出现。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅答案评分会把自然发生的黄金权威缺失当作完全成功，而由于法定权威结构可提取且外部可验证，这种失败可自动测量。因此提出对基于法条的法律基准进行联合答案-权威评估，并呼吁跨司法辖区的联合审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StuPASE: Towards Low-Hallucination Studio-Quality Generative Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Achieving high perceptual quality without hallucination remains a challenge in generative speech enhancement (SE). A representative approach, PASE, is robust to hallucination but has limited perceptual quality under adverse conditions. We propose StuPASE, built upon PASE to achieve studio-level quality while retaining its low-hallucination property. First, we show that finetuning PASE with dry targets rather than targets containing simulated early reflections substantially improves dereverberation. Second, to address performance limitations under strong additive noise, we replace the GAN-based generative module in PASE with a flow-matching module, enabling studio-quality generation even under highly challenging conditions. Experiments demonstrate that StuPASE consistently produces perceptually high-quality speech while maintaining low hallucination, outperforming state-of-the-art SE methods. Audio demos are available at: https://xiaobin-rong.github.io/stupase_demo/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StuPASE，一种基于 PASE 的生成式语音增强方法，目标是在保持低幻觉（low hallucination）特性的同时达到录音室级感知质量。作者通过两个改动实现：用干燥目标（dry targets）微调 PASE 以改善去混响，以及用 flow-matching 模块替换 PASE 中的 GAN 生成模块以应对强加性噪声。实验表明 StuPASE 在保持低幻觉的同时持续产生高感知质量语音，并优于现有语音增强方法。
Motivation: 生成式语音增强难以同时满足高感知质量与低幻觉；代表性方法 PASE 对幻觉稳健，但在恶劣条件下感知质量有限。
Method: 一是用干燥训练目标而非含模拟早期反射（simulated early reflections）的目标对 PASE 进行微调，显著改善去混响；二是将 PASE 中基于 GAN 的生成模块替换为 flow-matching 模块，以便在强加性噪声下仍能生成录音室级质量语音。
Result: 摘要报告 StuPASE 能持续产出感知质量高且幻觉低的语音，在多种条件下优于最先进的语音增强方法（state-of-the-art SE methods）。
Conclusion: StuPASE 在保留 PASE 低幻觉特性的前提下实现了录音室级质量，并提供了音频演示页面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond the Hivemind: Escaping LLM Homogeneity via Meta-Persona Anchoring and Sequential Temperature Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies have identified an ``Artificial Hivemind'' effect in Large Language Models (LLMs) causing models to converge on a narrow, homogenized consensus even for open questions. This semantic collapse limits the diversity of AI, resulting in high inter-response similarity ($\approx 0.80-0.90$) even under high-temperature sampling. In this paper, we propose a novel mitigation framework to increase diversity: Meta-Persona Anchoring combined with Filtered Temperature Scaling (FTS). Our approach utilizes a two-stage generation process: first, the model is prompted to self-select a unique, idiosyncratic persona to anchor its starting point; second, we apply a dual-stage sampling sieve, utilizing Top-$p$ filtering to preserve grammatical validity followed by extreme temperature scaling ($T \ge 4.0$) on the surviving candidates to explore the broadened probability distribution. We evaluate our method using the INFINITY-CHAT dataset on state-of-the-art open weight models under $\sim$20B parameters. Our results demonstrate a significant reduction in semantic convergence, with average pairwise cosine similarity dropping from ($\approx 0.85$) to ($\approx 0.65$). Our scheme achieves a majority of questions below the 0.7 threshold, effectively reducing the gap between artificial mode collapse and human-level typological diversity. We provide our implementation as an open-source framework to enable more diverse and creative AI deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）中的“Artificial Hivemind”效应，即模型在开放式问题上收敛到同质化共识、导致高温度采样下响应间余弦相似度仍高达约 0.80–0.90 的问题，提出 Meta-Persona Anchoring 与 Filtered Temperature Scaling (FTS) 组合的缓解框架。方法包含两阶段生成：先让模型自选独特拟人化角色作为锚点，再经 Top-p 过滤保语法合法后用极端温度缩放（T≥4.0）探索拓宽的概率分布。在 INFINITY-CHAT 数据集和约 20B 参数的开源模型上，平均成对余弦相似度从约 0.85 降至约 0.65。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 存在语义塌缩（semantic collapse）问题，即使在高温度采样下也产生高度相似的输出，限制了 AI 输出的多样性，并拉大了与人类多样性的差距。
Method: 提出两阶段生成框架：第一阶段提示模型自选一个独特、个性化的 persona 作为生成起始锚点；第二阶段采用双重采样筛，先用 Top-p 过滤保留语法有效候选，再对幸存候选施加 T≥4.0 的极端温度缩放以拓宽概率分布。
Result: 在 INFINITY-CHAT 数据集上的约 20B 参数开源模型评估中，平均成对余弦相似度从约 0.85 降至约 0.65，且多数问题低于 0.7 阈值，显著减少了语义收敛。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方案有效缩小了人工模式塌缩与人类类型学多样性之间的差距，并以开源框架形式发布实现，旨在支持更多样化和更具创造性的 AI 部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Preferred, Not Safer: Pairwise Preference Is a Poor Proxy for Clinical Safety
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate whether clinician pairwise preferences provide a reliable signal of clinical safety in large language model (LLM) evaluation using expert feedback from MOOVE (Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation), a clinician-led platform collecting blinded pairwise preferences alongside multi-criterion rubric ratings. Clinicians assign scores on a discrete $[-2, +2]$ scale, where negative values indicate clinically unsafe or misleading content. Using 26{,}804 pairwise judgments across outputs from 13 LLMs, contributed by more than 736 clinicians across 28+ countries, we find that clinician preference is a poor proxy for safety-critical performance. Models ranking highly under pairwise preference can still exhibit substantial rates of clinically meaningful failures ($\leq -1$) on dimensions such as \emph{Harmlessness} and \emph{Accuracy}. These failures are unevenly distributed across specialties, creating domain-specific ``no-go zones'' not visible in aggregate rankings or single-number leaderboards. We further analyze contributing factors including prompt length, refusal and escalation behavior, and the relative contributions of safety-critical versus surface-level features. A substantial fraction of preference votes carry no positive safety signal, while feature decomposition shows that surface-level characteristics explain slightly more preference variation than safety-critical rubric differences. Finally, we introduce a clinically adjusted preference ranking combining pairwise preference with rubric-derived feedback, producing a more safety-aware ordering than raw Bradley--Terry strength alone. Our findings support evaluation practices that separate preference from safety, report safety-critical failure rates directly, and incorporate clinically grounded adjustments when ranking LLMs for clinical decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 MOOVE（Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation）平台收集的 26,804 条临床医生成对偏好判断（覆盖 13 个 LLM、来自 28+ 国家的 736+ 名临床医生），检验成对偏好是否可靠地反映临床安全性。作者发现偏好在安全性关键任务上是糟糕的代理指标：偏好排名靠前的模型在 Harmlessness 和 Accuracy 等维度上仍会出现大量临床上有意义的失败（评分 ≤ -1），且失败在不同专科间分布不均，形成聚合排名或单一数字榜单无法显示的领域特定“禁区”。作者还引入结合 rubric 反馈的临床调整偏好排序，以产生比原始 Bradley-Terry 强度更安全感知的排名。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 临床评估常以临床医生的成对偏好作为安全性信号，但没有证据表明偏好能代理安全性关键表现；聚合排名和单一数字榜单可能掩盖专科层面的系统性失败。
Method: 利用 MOOVE 平台收集盲化成对偏好与多准则 rubric 评分（离散 [-2, +2] 量表，负值表示临床不安全或误导内容），对 13 个 LLM 的输出进行大规模评估；通过特征分解分析提示长度、拒绝与升级行为以及安全性关键特征与表面特征对偏好的相对贡献，并提出结合偏好与 rubric 反馈的临床调整偏好排名。
Result: 摘要报告偏好是安全性的差代理；偏好排名高的模型在 Harmlessness 和 Accuracy 上仍有显著比例的安全性关键失败；相当比例的偏好投票不携带正向安全信号；特征分解显示表面特征对偏好变异的解释略多于安全性关键 rubric 差异；临床调整排序比原始 Bradley-Terry 强度给出更安全感知的顺序。
Conclusion: 作者主张评估实践应将偏好与安全性分离，直接报告安全性关键失败率，并在面向临床决策的 LLM 排名中纳入临床依据的调整。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Evaluating OpenAI's Privacy Filter: Cross-Lingual, Cross-Domain PII Detection Across 42 Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: We present the first independent, systematic evaluation of OpenAI's Privacy Filter (OPF), a 1.5B-parameter bidirectional PII detector, across 42 synthetic benchmarks spanning 22 languages and 5 domains. Zero-shot, OPF achieves F1=0.855 on AI4Privacy and 0.464 on SPY medical, outperforming Presidio (0.431, 0.273) and XLM-RoBERTa (0.269, 0.111) on PII-annotated benchmarks; on multilingual NER, XLM-RoBERTa leads OPF on all 13 Indic and non-Latin languages. GPT-4o leads on medical, legal, and financial PII (SPY: 0.643 avg, Gretel: 0.527), while OPF leads on structured synthetic PII (0.71 avg) and customer support (0.60). OPF degrades sharply when PII is embedded in narrative prose: F1=0.04--0.57 on NER benchmarks and collapse for non-Latin scripts (Arabic: 0.04, Cyrillic: 0.03). Error analysis shows OPF is strongest on structurally regular PII types (email: 0.78, phone: 0.76) and weakest on culturally variable ones (person: 0.40, address: 0.49), and is recall-biased on customer-support and medical/legal PII (P=0.31--0.54, R=0.70--0.85); global precision spans 0.31--0.86 across all domains.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 tables; evaluation of a production PII detection system
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 OpenAI 的 Privacy Filter (OPF) 进行了首次独立的系统性评估。OPF 是 1.5B 参数的跨语言 PII 检测器，作者在跨越 22 种语言和 5 个领域的 42 个合成基准上测试其零样本 (zero-shot) 性能，并与 Presidio、XLM-RoBERTa 和 GPT-4o 等系统对比。结果显示 OPF 在结构化合成 PII 和客户支持领域领先，但在叙事文本中性能骤降，且对非拉丁文字系统几乎失效。
Motivation: OpenAI 的 Privacy Filter 是一个生产级 PII 检测系统，但此前缺少独立、系统的第三方评估，尤其是跨语言、跨领域的表现未知。
Method: 构建包含 42 个合成基准的评测框架，覆盖 22 种语言和 5 个领域，对 OPF 进行零样本评估，并与 Presidio、XLM-RoBERTa 和 GPT-4o 等基线系统在 PII 标注基准和跨语言 NER 任务上比较，同时进行误差分析。
Result: 零样本下 OPF 在 AI4Privacy 上 F1=0.855、在 SPY medical 上为 0.464，优于 Presidio (0.431, 0.273) 和 XLM-RoBERTa (0.269, 0.111)；在 13 种印度及非拉丁语言上 XLM-RoBERTa 全面领先 OPF。GPT-4o 在医疗、法律和金融 PII 上领先，而 OPF 在结构化合成 PII (0.71 avg) 和客户支持 (0.60) 上领先。PII 嵌入叙事散文时 OPF 的 F1 降至 0.04–0.57，非拉丁文字几乎失效（阿拉伯语 0.04、西里尔文 0.03）。误差分析显示 OPF 对结构规则的类型（email 0.78、phone 0.76）最强，对文化可变类型（person 0.40、address 0.49）最弱，并在客户支持和医疗/法律 PII 上呈召回偏向。
Conclusion: 作者认为 OPF 在结构规则 PII 和特定领域上表现强，但在叙事文本、非拉丁文字和文化可变 PII 类型上存在明显局限；该评测可作为生产级隐私过滤系统能力的参考。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OncoTriad-QA: A Patient-Level Radiology-Pathology-Genomics Benchmark for Pan-Cancer Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Cancer diagnosis and characterization require integrating complementary evidence from radiology, pathology, genomics, and clinical metadata. However, most medical large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks focus on isolated modalities or narrow image-text tasks, leaving patient-level oncology assessment across multiple evidence streams largely untested. We introduce OncoTriad-QA, a patient-level radiology-pathology-genomics benchmark for pan-cancer question answering. OncoTriad-QA contains 86.1k semantic questions across 9,281 TCGA patient cases from 32 cancer cohorts, aligning CT/MRI radiology, whole-slide histopathology, somatic mutations, copy-number alterations, DNA methylation, bulk RNA-seq, and clinical metadata. Case-specific annotations are constructed through a source-grounded LLM-assisted pipeline using curated labels, diagnostic reports, molecular profiles, and modality-derived evidence as primary sources of truth, with automated consistency checks and clinician review. We also introduce OncoVLM, a reference multimodal model that maps modality-native radiology, pathology, DNA methylation, and RNA-seq evidence into an LLM interface through learned projectors. Experiments show that existing general-purpose and medical LLMs remain limited on comprehensive pan-cancer QA, especially when questions require integrating imaging findings, tumor morphology, and molecular evidence. After fine-tuning on OncoTriad-QA, OncoVLM exceeds MedGemma-4B by an average of 10.7 points when using MCQ accuracy and BERTScore-F1, with consistent gains across multiple-choice and open-ended questions under radiology-only, pathology-only, and all-available settings. These results demonstrate the benchmark's value for training and evaluating models for integrated cancer question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OncoTriad-QA，一个面向泛癌问答的 patient-level 影像-病理-基因组学基准，包含来自 32 个癌症队列、9,281 例 TCGA 患者的 86.1k 语义问题，并整合 CT/MRI、全切片病理、体细胞突变、拷贝数变异、DNA 甲基化、bulk RNA-seq 和临床元数据。作者还引入参考多模态模型 OncoVLM，通过学到的投影器将放射、病理、甲基化和 RNA-seq 证据映射到 LLM 接口。实验表明现有通用和医学 LLM 在综合泛癌问答上能力有限，而 OncoVLM 在 OncoTriad-QA 上微调后，在 MCQ 准确率和 BERTScore-F1 上平均超过 MedGemma-4B 10.7 分。
Motivation: 大多数医学 LLM 和 VLM 基准只关注单一模态或窄范围的图像-文本任务，很少测试跨放射、病理、基因组学等多条证据流的 patient-level 肿瘤评估，这一能力缺口尚无相应基准。
Method: 构建 OncoTriad-QA 基准，采用基于来源的 LLM 辅助流水线生成病例级标注，以 curated 标签、诊断报告、分子谱和模态证据为主要事实来源，并加入自动化一致性检查和临床医生审核；同时提出 OncoVLM，用可学习的投影器把各模态原生证据接入 LLM 接口。
Result: 摘要报告，在综合泛癌问答上现有通用和医学 LLM 表现有限，尤其在需要整合影像发现、肿瘤形态和分子证据的问题上；OncoVLM 在 OncoTriad-QA 上微调后，在 MCQ 准确率和 BERTScore-F1 上平均超过 MedGemma-4B 10.7 分，且在放射-only、病理-only 和全部模态可用设置下均有稳定提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准对训练和评估面向集成式癌症问答的模型具有价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemArena: An Ego-Centric Benchmark for On-Device Agentic Personal Memory Assistants at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Edge-deployed personal memory assistants must handle private interpersonal conversations on-device with open-weight models. Yet, existing memory benchmarks often under-test the combination of activity-dense interaction, ego-centric perspective, and coherent multi-session worlds. MemArena fills these gaps with a single-world conversational benchmark built with its MASim agent simulator, for 50 agents over 15 days (10.3M dialog-text tokens, 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens/agent/day). With the interaction history, it co-generates ground truth over six recall, reasoning, and trustworthiness evaluation dimensions. We evaluate five open-weight readers with Vanilla context, BM25-RAG, Oracle retrieval, Memobase, and MemSearch as memory backends. Three results stand out: (1) Memory-backend choice matters more for content accuracy: At Qwen3-0.6B, Memobase-to-MemSearch gains +32.5/+19.2 pp, exceeding MemSearch reader scaling (+10.6/+6.8 pp). (2) Permission-aware access fails universally, with Oracle leaking heavily and other backends too timid to disclose. (3) Search latency bites only at very small reader: on a Spark GB10 edge node, memory-search adds a moderate and fixed 87/7/48 ms (BM25-RAG/Memobase/MemSearch) that composes a small part of TTFT for most reader-backend combinations. Code, the MASim simulator, and the MemArena-L benchmark will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemArena，一个面向端侧（on-device）个人记忆助手的以自我为中心（ego-centric）对话基准，借助 MASim 模拟器生成 50 个 agent 在 15 天内的单一世界交互，共 10.3M 对话文本 token，每个 agent 每天约 24.1K 文本型 ego-observed token。基准基于交互历史共同生成六个回忆、推理和可信度评估维度的 ground truth，并评估五个开源 reader 搭配六种记忆后端的表现。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准很少同时覆盖活动密集交互、自我中心视角和连贯多会话世界，而边缘部署的个人记忆助手需要处理私有人际对话，因此缺乏合适的评测环境。
Method: 构建 MemArena 单世界会话基准，用 MASim agent 模拟器生成大规模多会话交互数据，并联合生成六个评估维度的标签；随后将 Qwen 等 reader 与 Vanilla context、BM25-RAG、Oracle retrieval、Memobase、MemSearch 等记忆后端组合进行评测。
Result: 摘要报告三个主要发现：(1) 记忆后端选择比 reader 扩缩更影响内容准确率，在 Qwen3-0.6B 上从 Memobase 换到 MemSearch 带来 +32.5/+19.2 pp 提升，超过 MemSearch reader 扩缩带来的 +10.6/+6.8 pp；(2) 权限感知访问普遍失败，Oracle 泄漏严重而其他后端过于保守；(3) 搜索延迟只在小 reader 上明显，在 Spark GB10 边缘节点上 BM25-RAG/Memobase/MemSearch 分别增加固定 87/7/48 ms，只占多数组合 TTFT 的一小部分。
Conclusion: 作者认为记忆后端对内容准确率起决定性作用，权限感知访问仍需改进；代码、MASim 模拟器和 MemArena-L 基准将在录用后发布。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: BBOWP-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Black-Box Optimization Word Problems
papers.abstract_en: Formulating an optimization problem strongly affects the quality of the final solution, yet good formulations usually require substantial expertise. Recent studies have therefore examined how to automatically derive optimization problems from natural-language descriptions, but existing benchmarks focus on settings where objectives and constraints can be written explicitly as mathematical expressions. Many practically important problems are naturally treated as black-box optimization (BBO) problems, in which only objective values are observable, and the functional form is unavailable. In BBO, the search space design, a part of the problem formulation, and the selection of the optimization algorithm are crucial for problem-solving. Automating these processes with large language models (LLMs) is a significant challenge. This paper introduces Black-Box Optimization Word Problems (BBOWP), a novel problem setting in which a system must infer both a search space and an optimization algorithm from a natural-language description of a black-box optimization task. To support research on this setting, we establish the BBOWP Benchmark Suite (BBOWP-Bench), a dataset and evaluation framework for BBOWP. Each instance combines a natural-language problem description, an executable evaluation environment, and a human-designed baseline formulation, allowing evaluation of both search-space design and algorithm selection. Using this benchmark, we provide the first evaluation of LLMs and show that current LLMs are capable of selecting suitable algorithms based on the given evaluation budget. However, they sometimes struggle with search space design, particularly in identifying important variables and balancing their ranges when the problem description is less informative or the search space is highly problem-specific. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/shiralab/bbowp-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出黑箱优化词问题（BBOWP）这一新问题设定：系统需从自然语言描述中推断搜索空间（search space）并选择优化算法，以求解只有目标值可观测的黑箱优化任务。作者构建了 BBOWP-Bench 基准套件，包含自然语言问题描述、可执行评估环境与人工设计的基线公式，并首次评估了 LLM 在该设定下的表现。结果显示当前 LLM 能根据评估预算选择合适算法，但在搜索空间设计上仍会失败，尤其是在问题描述信息不足或搜索空间高度问题特定时。
Motivation: 优化问题的公式化方式显著影响最终解质量，但良好公式通常需要专业知识；现有从自然语言自动推导优化问题的基准只覆盖目标与约束可显式写成数学表达式的场景，而许多实际问题天然属于黑箱优化（BBO），其函数形式不可得，搜索空间设计与算法选择至关重要。
Method: 引入 BBOWP 问题设定，要求系统同时推断搜索空间并选择优化算法；建立 BBOWP-Bench 数据集与评估框架，每个实例包含自然语言描述、可执行评估环境和人工设计基线公式，从而分别评估搜索空间设计与算法选择。
Result: 首次对 LLM 在该基准上的评估表明，LLM 能够根据给定的评估预算（evaluation budget）选择合适的算法，但在搜索空间设计上有时会失败，尤其是难以识别重要变量并在问题描述信息不足或搜索空间高度问题特定时平衡变量范围。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 在自动化解黑箱优化问题公式化方面已有一定能力，但搜索空间设计仍是主要瓶颈；代码与数据集已开源，为后续研究提供基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: KernelBrain: Coarse-to-Fine, Budget-Aware Search for Agentic GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Automating GPU kernel optimization remains difficult in practice: generated variants can violate correctness constraints, runtime measurements are noisy, and search often stalls early. We present a practical optimization agent that combines LLM-guided mutation, adaptive resource allocation, policy-gated evaluation, and profiler-informed diagnosis. The system screens many candidates with low-cost evaluation and allocates higher-fidelity budget only to promising survivors to optimize and evolve GPU kernels. On important Triton kernel generation tasks, this design improves both kernel quality and search efficiency, reaching 0.88x-6.72x speedup over PyTorch and up to 1.4x speedup over the state-of-the-art kernel agent, with up to 48% lower optimization time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个实用的GPU内核优化代理，结合LLM引导变异、自适应资源分配、策略门控评估和基于profiler的诊断。系统先用低成本评估筛选大量候选，仅对最有希望的幸存者分配高保真预算来优化Triton内核。在Triton内核生成任务上，该方法比PyTorch实现0.88x-6.72x加速，比最先进的内核代理最高提升1.4x，且优化时间最多降低48%。
Motivation: GPU内核优化自动化在实践中有三个困难：生成的变体可能违反正确性约束、运行时测量存在噪声、搜索过程容易过早停滞。
Method: 提出一个代理系统，将LLM引导的变异、自适应资源分配、策略门控的评估和profiler信息驱动的诊断结合到一起，通过低代价评估快速筛选大量候选，并把高保真度的优化预算分配给有潜力的幸存者。
Result: 在重要Triton内核生成任务上，相对PyTorch达到0.88x-6.72x的加速，相对最先进的内核代理最高达到1.4x加速，优化时间最多降低48%。
Conclusion: 该设计同时改善内核质量和搜索效率，说明粗到细、预算受限的搜索策略对代理化GPU内核优化有效。

papers.title: TabletCraft: Bridging a 4,000-Year Cultural Gap with Bidirectional Akkadian NMT and Cuneiform Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Half a million cuneiform clay tablets survive in museums worldwide, yet modern users can neither read nor write in the world's oldest writing system, leaving a 4,000-year cultural barrier that existing NLP tools have only partially addressed. Prior work enables one-way, scholar-oriented translation from Akkadian to English, but offers no path in the reverse direction: non-specialist users cannot compose new content in cuneiform, and therefore remain passive consumers of ancient culture rather than active participants. We present TabletCraft, the first open-source system that enables bidirectional interaction with Mesopotamian writing. Users can read ancient tablets (Akkadian to English) and compose new messages as cuneiform clay tablets (English to Akkadian to cuneiform to rendered tablet). The system integrates a ByT5-based translation model trained on 116K bidirectional samples, a cuneiform sign converter with 14,240 mappings (95.3% coverage), and a visual tablet renderer, packaged as a pip-installable toolkit with CLI and web demo. On the held-out Akkademia validation split (2,812 samples), we report 49.1 BLEU for Akkadian-to-English and 48.5 BLEU for English-to-Akkadian, the first published quantitative result in the reverse direction.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to C3NLP @ ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TabletCraft，一个开源的双向交互系统，让用户既能阅读阿卡德语（Akkadian）泥板，也能通过英语到阿卡德语再到楔形文字并渲染为泥板图像的方式创作新内容。系统整合了基于 ByT5 的翻译模型、包含 14,240 条映射的楔形符号转换器以及可视化泥板渲染器，并以 pip 可安装工具包形式提供 CLI 和 Web 演示。在 Akkademia 验证集上报告了双向翻译的 BLEU 结果。
Motivation: 现有 NLP 工具只支持学者向的单向阿卡德语到英语翻译，缺乏反向路径，导致非专业用户无法用楔形文字创作新内容，只能被动消费古代文化，存在约 4,000 年的文化隔阂。
Method: 系统包含三个组件：在 116K 双向样本上训练的 ByT5 翻译模型、覆盖 95.3% 的 14,240 条楔形符号映射转换器，以及将结果渲染为泥板图像的视觉渲染器，并打包为带 CLI 和 Web 演示的 pip 安装工具包。
Result: 在 2,812 个样本的 Akkademia 保留验证集上，阿卡德语到英语的 BLEU 为 49.1，英语到阿卡德语的 BLEU 为 48.5；后者是该反向方向首次发表的量化结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该系统首次为需求方提供了与美索不达米亚文字进行双向交互的开源途径，使非专家用户既能阅读也能创作楔形文字内容。

papers.title: Self-Organising Digital Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Fault tolerance in classical computing has traditionally relied on static strategies like hardware redundancy and error-correcting codes. Biological systems, in contrast, exhibit adaptive plasticity, maintaining function through dynamic re-organisation around damage. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Self-Organising Digital Circuits, framing functional logic generation and maintenance as a meta-learning problem on graphs. Our architecture employs a topology-masked Transformer that configures the Lookup Tables (LUT) of a circuit's Boolean gates. Extending the pattern-generation paradigm of Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), it navigates the degenerate Boolean search space to satisfy a computational task, rather than regenerating a fixed target state. We demonstrate that it can self-assemble functional circuits from scratch and rapidly re-route logic around permanent, previously unseen hardware faults. For soft errors, the policy achieves near-perfect recovery (>99.99\% accuracy) from damage sizes far exceeding training conditions. We further observe generalisation across circuit scales: accuracy improves on graphs substantially wider than those seen during training. This work bridges the principles of biological self-organisation with the practical domain of digital hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受生物系统自适应可塑性的启发，提出自组织数字电路 (Self-Organising Digital Circuits)，将功能逻辑生成与维护建模为图上的元学习问题。架构使用拓扑掩码 Transformer 配置电路布尔门的查找表 (LUT)，在退化的布尔搜索空间中寻找满足计算任务的电路，而非像 Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) 那样再生固定目标状态。摘要报告该方法能从头自组装功能电路，并能在永久性未见过硬件故障附近快速重路由逻辑；对软错误，在远超训练条件的损伤规模下达到接近完美的恢复 (>99.99% 准确率)，并观察到跨电路尺度的泛化。
Motivation: 经典计算中的容错依赖硬件冗余和纠错码等静态策略，而生物系统通过围绕损伤的动态重组维持功能。作者希望将这种自适应可塑性引入数字硬件，解决静态容错方案无法灵活应对未知故障的问题。
Method: 将功能逻辑生成与维护表述为图上的元学习问题，采用拓扑掩码 Transformer 来配置电路布尔门的查找表；该方法扩展了 NCA 的模式生成范式，目标不是再生固定状态，而是在退化布尔搜索空间中求解计算任务。
Result: 摘要表明该方法可以从零自组装功能电路，并对此前未见过的永久性硬件故障实现逻辑快速重路由；对软错误，在损伤规模大幅超过训练条件时恢复准确率超过 99.99%；同时准确率在比训练时更宽的电路图上有所提升，展示了跨尺度的泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为这项工作将生物自组织原理与数字硬件实践联系起来，为自适应容错电路提供了新的方向；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ISEE: Interactive Semantic Enrichment for Database Fields
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed for data-related tasks, including data sense-making, exploration, and retrieval. However, their performance heavily depends on the clarity and completeness of data semantics. In practice, many field descriptions remain ambiguous or incomplete, as much of the essential context (e.g., the meaning of a customized field) originates from users' domain knowledge and is rarely documented publicly. This gap restricts the agents' task performance in downstream tasks, such as entity-linking. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel and comprehensive Interactive SEmantic Enrichment system (ISEE). Given a data field description, ISEE measures its quality through a scoring system, gathers domain knowledge, and collaboratively enriches the semantics with users. Through a user study, automated user simulation, quantitative evaluation, and case study, we demonstrate that ISEE significantly reduces cognitive load, improves description quality, and enhances downstream task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出交互式语义增强系统 (ISEE)，针对数据库字段描述不完整或模糊的问题，通过评分系统度量字段描述质量，并收集用户的领域知识以协作补全字段语义。摘要报告用户研究、自动化用户模拟、定量评估与案例研究的结果，显示该方法降低认知负荷、提高描述质量并改善实体链接等下游任务性能。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在数据理解、探索与检索等任务上的表现高度依赖数据语义的清晰与完整，但现实中许多字段描述存在歧义或不完整，因为自定义字段的语境多来自用户领域知识且很少被公开记录，这限制了实体链接等下游任务的效果。
Method: ISEE 在给定数据字段描述后，先用评分系统衡量描述质量，再通过交互式协作过程收集用户的领域知识，并与用户共同对字段语义进行补全。
Result: 摘要报告了用户研究、自动化用户模拟、定量评估与案例研究的证据，表明 ISEE 显著降低认知负荷、提升字段描述质量并增强下游任务（如实体链接）的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为交互式语义补全能够弥合数据语义缺失造成的性能差距，且该方法在用户协作与自动化评估中均展现出有效性。

papers.title: GAP-URGENet: A Generative-Predictive Fusion Framework for Universal Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GAP-URGENet, a generative-predictive fusion framework developed for Track 1 of the ICASSP 2026 URGENT Challenge. The system integrates a generative branch, which performs full-stack speech restoration in a self-supervised representation domain and reconstructs the waveform via a neural vocoder, along with a predictive branch that performs spectrogram-domain enhancement, providing complementary cues. Outputs from both branches are fused by a post-processing module, which also performs bandwidth extension to generate the enhanced waveform at 48 kHz, later downsampled to the original sampling rate. This generative-predictive fusion improves robustness and perceptual quality, achieving top performance in the blind-test phase and ranking 1st in the objective evaluation. Audio examples are available at https://xiaobin-rong.github.io/gap-urgenet_demo.
papers.comment: Awarded 1st place in the URGENT 2026 Challenge (objective phase), accepted by ICASSP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAP-URGENet，一个面向 ICASSP 2026 URGENT 挑战赛 Track 1 的生成-预测融合语音增强框架。生成分支在自监督表示域完成全栈语音恢复，并通过神经声码器 (neural vocoder) 重建波形；预测分支在语谱图域进行增强以提供互补线索。后处理模块融合两分支输出并执行带宽扩展到 48 kHz，再降采样回原始采样率。该系统在盲测阶段表现最佳，并在客观评估中排名第一，获得 ICASSP 2026 接收。
Motivation: 语音增强任务中生成式和预测式方法各有局限，单一模型难以同时保证鲁棒性和感知质量，需要融合互补线索以提升整体性能。
Method: 提出双分支融合框架：生成分支在自监督表示域执行全栈语音恢复，再用神经声码器重建波形；预测分支在语谱图域做增强；后处理模块融合两分支输出，并同时完成带宽扩展至 48 kHz 再降采样回原始采样率。
Result: 在 URGENT 2026 挑战赛 Track 1 的盲测阶段取得顶级性能，并在客观评估中排名第一。
Conclusion: 生成-预测融合能提升语音增强的鲁棒性与感知质量，该框架在公开挑战赛中验证了其有效性。

papers.title: UL-UNAS: Ultra-Lightweight U-Nets for Real-Time Speech Enhancement via Network Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight models are essential for real-time speech enhancement applications. In recent years, there has been a growing trend toward developing increasingly compact models for speech enhancement. In this paper, we propose an Ultra-Lightweight U-net optimized by Network Architecture Search (UL-UNAS), which is suitable for implementation in low-footprint devices. Firstly, we explore the application of various efficient convolutional blocks within the U-Net framework to identify the most promising candidates. Secondly, we introduce two boosting components to enhance the capacity of these convolutional blocks: a novel activation function named affine PReLU and a causal time-frequency attention module. Furthermore, we leverage neural architecture search to discover an optimal architecture within our carefully designed search space. By integrating the above strategies, UL-UNAS not only significantly outperforms the latest ultra-lightweight models with the same or lower computational complexity, but also delivers competitive performance compared to recent baseline models that require substantially higher computational resources. Source code and audio demos are available at https://github.com/Xiaobin-Rong/ul-unas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UL-UNAS，一种面向实时语音增强的超轻量级 U-Net，通过网络架构搜索（NAS）在精心设计的搜索空间中寻找最优结构。作者先在 U-Net 框架内探索多种高效卷积模块，并引入 affine PReLU 激活函数与因果时频注意力模块来增强模块容量。摘要称该方法在相同或更低计算复杂度下显著优于最新超轻量模型，并与需要更高计算资源的基线性能相当。
Motivation: 实时语音增强需要轻量级模型，但现有模型在低计算复杂度下性能仍有提升空间，且缺乏针对 U-Net 结构的高效卷积模块与自动架构设计。
Method: 在 U-Net 框架内比较多种高效卷积模块，加入 affine PReLU 激活函数和因果时频注意力模块作为增强组件，并利用神经架构搜索（network architecture search）在受限搜索空间中寻找最优架构。
Result: UL-UNAS 在相同或更低计算复杂度下显著超越最新的超轻量语音增强模型，并能与需要更高计算资源的近期基线模型竞争。
Conclusion: 摘要强调集成高效卷积模块、增强组件与 NAS 可以在低计算开销下获得有竞争力的实时语音增强性能，并开源代码和音频演示。

papers.title: PASE: Leveraging the Phonological Prior of WavLM for Low-Hallucination Generative Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have shown remarkable performance in speech enhancement (SE), achieving superior perceptual quality over traditional discriminative approaches. However, existing generative SE approaches often overlook the risk of hallucination under severe noise, leading to incorrect spoken content or inconsistent speaker characteristics, which we term linguistic and acoustic hallucinations, respectively. We argue that linguistic hallucination stems from models' failure to constrain valid phonological structures and it is a more fundamental challenge. While language models (LMs) are well-suited for capturing the underlying speech structure through modeling the distribution of discrete tokens, existing approaches are limited in learning from noise-corrupted representations, which can lead to contaminated priors and hallucinations. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Phonologically Anchored Speech Enhancer (PASE), a generative SE framework that leverages the robust phonological prior embedded in the pre-trained WavLM model to mitigate hallucinations. First, we adapt WavLM into a denoising expert via representation distillation to clean its final-layer features. Guided by the model's intrinsic phonological prior, this process enables robust denoising while minimizing linguistic hallucinations. To further reduce acoustic hallucinations, we train the vocoder with a dual-stream representation: the high-level phonetic representation provides clean linguistic content, while a low-level acoustic representation retains speaker identity and prosody. Experimental results demonstrate that PASE not only surpasses state-of-the-art discriminative models in perceptual quality, but also significantly outperforms prior generative models with substantially lower linguistic and acoustic hallucinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PASE（Phonologically Anchored Speech Enhancer），一种生成式语音增强（generative speech enhancement）框架，利用预训练 WavLM 中蕴含的音系先验（phonological prior）来抑制增强过程中的幻觉。作者将 WavLM 通过表示蒸馏适配为去噪专家，并用双流表示训练声码器。实验显示 PASE 在感知质量上超过最先进的判别式模型，并显著低于此前生成式模型的语音内容与说话人特征幻觉。
Motivation: 现有生成式语音增强方法在严重噪声下可能产生幻觉，导致错误语音内容（语言幻觉）或不一致的说话人特征（声学幻觉）。作者认为语言幻觉源于模型未能约束有效的音系结构，是更根本的挑战；而基于语言模型（LM）的方法从噪声污染表示中学习易使先验被污染，从而加剧幻觉。
Method: PASE 首先将预训练 WavLM 适应为去噪专家，通过表示蒸馏（representation distillation）净化其最后一层特征，并借助模型固有的音系先验实现鲁棒去噪；随后用双流表示训练声码器：高层音系表示提供干净的语音内容，低层声学表示保留说话人身份与韵律。
Result: 摘要报告 PASE 在感知质量上超越最先进的判别式模型，并且在语言幻觉和声学幻觉上都显著优于此前的生成式模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用预训练 WavLM 中稳健的音系先验可以有效缓解生成式语音增强中的幻觉问题，为生成式 SE 提供了一条有别于传统 LMs 的先验利用路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Assessing speech quality metrics for evaluation of neural audio codecs under clean speech conditions
papers.abstract_en: Objective speech-quality metrics are widely used to assess codec performance. However, for neural codecs, it is often unclear which metrics provide reliable quality estimates. To address this, we evaluated 45 objective metrics by correlating their scores with subjective listening scores for clean speech across 17 codec conditions. Neural-based metrics such as scoreq and utmos achieved the highest Pearson correlations with subjective scores. Further analysis across different subjective quality ranges revealed that non-intrusive metrics tend to saturate at high subjective quality levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了 45 个客观语音质量指标在干净语音条件下对神经音频编解码器 (neural audio codec) 性能的可靠性。作者将这些指标的分数与 17 种编解码器条件下的主观听力评分进行相关分析，发现神经类指标 scoreq 和 utmos 与主观评分的 Pearson 相关性最高，并指出非侵入式指标在高主观质量区间会出现饱和。
Motivation: 神经编解码器的性能评估常依赖客观语音质量指标，但哪些指标能提供可靠的质量估计尚不明确，这会影响模型比较与开发决策。
Method: 在干净语音条件下，对 17 种编解码器条件收集主观听力评分，并将 45 个客观指标的计算分数与主观评分进行相关分析；还进一步按不同主观质量区间分析指标的饱和行为。
Result: 神经类指标 scoreq 和 utmos 取得了最高的 Pearson 相关；进一步分析显示非侵入式指标 (non-intrusive metrics) 在高质量端趋于饱和。
Conclusion: 对于干净语音下的神经音频编解码器评估，建议优先选择 scoreq 和 utmos 等神经指标，并注意非侵入式指标在高主观质量区间的局限性。

papers.title: CLIP-EBC: CLIP Can Count Accurately through Enhanced Blockwise Classification
papers.abstract_en: We propose CLIP-EBC, the first fully CLIP-based model for accurate crowd density estimation. While the CLIP model has demonstrated remarkable success in addressing recognition tasks such as zero-shot image classification, its potential for counting has been largely unexplored due to the inherent challenges in transforming a regression problem, such as counting, into a recognition task. In this work, we investigate and enhance CLIP's ability to count, focusing specifically on the task of estimating crowd sizes from images. Existing classification-based crowd-counting frameworks have significant limitations, including the quantization of count values into bordering real-valued bins and the sole focus on classification errors. These practices result in label ambiguity near the shared borders and inaccurate prediction of count values. Hence, directly applying CLIP within these frameworks may yield suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we first propose the Enhanced Blockwise Classification (EBC) framework. Unlike previous methods, EBC utilizes integer-valued bins, effectively reducing ambiguity near bin boundaries. Additionally, it incorporates a regression loss based on density maps to improve the prediction of count values. Within our backbone-agnostic EBC framework, we then introduce CLIP-EBC to fully leverage CLIP's recognition capabilities for this task. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EBC and the competitive performance of CLIP-EBC. Specifically, our EBC framework can improve existing classification-based methods by up to 44.5% on the UCF-QNRF dataset, and CLIP-EBC achieves state-of-the-art performance on the NWPU-Crowd test set, with an MAE of 58.2 and an RMSE of 268.5, representing improvements of 8.6% and 13.3% over the previous best method, STEERER. The code and weights are available at https://github.com/Yiming-M/CLIP-EBC.
papers.comment: This is the author's accepted manuscript. The final version is published in ICME 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIP-EBC，据称是首个完全基于 CLIP 的密集人群计数模型，并为此设计了 Enhanced Blockwise Classification (EBC) 框架。EBC 采用整数值 bin 以降低边界标签歧义，并引入基于密度图的回归损失来改善计数预测；在此骨干无关框架上，作者用 CLIP 作为骨干得到 CLIP-EBC。实验表明 EBC 可使现有分类式计数方法在 UCF-QNRF 上最高提升 44.5%，CLIP-EBC 在 NWPU-Crowd 测试集上取得 MAE 58.2、RMSE 268.5 的结果，较此前最优方法 STEERER 分别提升 8.6% 和 13.3%。
Motivation: CLIP 在识别任务上表现突出，但计数作为回归问题难以转化为识别任务，其计数能力尚未被充分挖掘；现有基于分类的人群计数框架存在将计数值量化为相邻实值 bin 导致的边界标签歧义，以及只关注分类误差、计数预测不准的问题。
Method: 提出骨干无关的 Enhanced Blockwise Classification (EBC) 框架，使用整数值 bin 替代实值 bin 以减小边界附近标签歧义，并加入基于密度图的回归损失以提升计数值预测精度；随后在 EBC 框架内引入 CLIP 骨干，构建 CLIP-EBC 以利用 CLIP 的识别能力。
Result: EBC 框架在 UCF-QNRF 数据集上可使现有基于分类的计数方法最高提升 44.5%；CLIP-EBC 在 NWPU-Crowd 测试集上达到 MAE 58.2 与 RMSE 268.5，较此前最优的 STEERER 分别改善 8.6% 和 13.3%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EBC 作为骨干无关框架能有效改进分类式计数方法，CLIP-EBC 则展示了 CLIP 在计数任务上的竞争力，代码和权重已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Multi-Camera Trajectory Forecasting with Trajectory Tensors
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the problem of multi-camera trajectory forecasting (MCTF), which involves predicting the trajectory of a moving object across a network of cameras. While multi-camera setups are widespread for applications such as surveillance and traffic monitoring, existing trajectory forecasting methods typically focus on single-camera trajectory forecasting (SCTF), limiting their use for such applications. Furthermore, using a single camera limits the field-of-view available, making long-term trajectory forecasting impossible. We address these shortcomings of SCTF by developing an MCTF framework that simultaneously uses all estimated relative object locations from several viewpoints and predicts the object's future location in all possible viewpoints. Our framework follows a Which-When-Where approach that predicts in which camera(s) the objects appear and when and where within the camera views they appear. To this end, we propose the concept of trajectory tensors: a new technique to encode trajectories across multiple camera views and the associated uncertainties. We develop several encoder-decoder MCTF models for trajectory tensors and present extensive experiments on our own database (comprising 600 hours of video data from 15 camera views) created particularly for the MCTF task. Results show that our trajectory tensor models outperform coordinate trajectory-based MCTF models and existing SCTF methods adapted for MCTF. Code is available from: https://github.com/olly-styles/Trajectory-Tensors
papers.comment: To appear in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (tPAMI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多摄像头轨迹预测 (MCTF) 问题，旨在跨摄像头网络预测运动物体的未来轨迹。作者提出轨迹张量 (trajectory tensors) 来编码多视角轨迹及其不确定性，并构建 Which-When-Where 框架预测物体出现在哪些摄像头、何时出现及视图内位置。基于 600 小时、15 个视角的自建数据库，实验表明轨迹张量模型优于坐标轨迹基线和改编的 SCTF 方法。
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法多针对单摄像头场景 (SCTF)，无法直接用于监控和交通管理等广泛部署的多摄像头系统；单摄像头视野有限，难以进行长期轨迹预测。
Method: 提出一个 MCTF 框架，同时利用多个视角估计的相对物体位置，预测物体在所有可能视角中的未来位置。引入轨迹张量这一轨迹编码方式，并基于 Which-When-Where 思路开发多种编码器-解码器 MCTF 模型。
Result: 在自建的包含 600 小时视频、15 个摄像头视角的数据库上，轨迹张量模型在 MCTF 任务上优于基于坐标轨迹的 MCTF 模型以及改编后的现有 SCTF 方法。
Conclusion: 轨迹张量是跨视角轨迹预测的有效表示，但实验基于作者自建数据库，方法针对多摄像头监控场景，与降水临近预报等天气任务无直接关联。
Relevance: 5
